ESP.ORIGINAL: That's secure for a reason.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它被保护起来是有原因的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, now. That's my stuff. If you want something, you gotta buy it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨。那是我的东西。如果你想要什么，你就得买下来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa, whoa, whoa, hands off the goods.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，哇，哇，交出那些东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's not yours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那不是你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06061BE4]GenericCustomVoice) Generic dialogue for custom voices EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think you should mess with that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你不该去碰那东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: PLAYER PICKPOCKET
ESP.TRADUIT: 玩家偷窃

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't even think about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想都别想。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think you're doing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认为你在做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm watching you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我盯着你呢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep your hands to yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 管好你自己的手。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You won't get away with that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你逃不掉的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not a good idea.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是个好主意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the hell do you think you're doing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你他妈的在做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think you're doing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认为你在做什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06061BE4]GenericCustomVoice) Generic dialogue for custom voices EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't touch me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别碰我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: GREETING
ESP.TRADUIT: 问好

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I guess you weren't such a jerk after all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我想你不是一个蠢货。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow, you look like you've been through Hell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，你看起来像刚从地狱里回来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome to the Chop Shop. I'm Nurse Graves, Doctor Barrows' assistant.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎来到排骨店。我是格雷芙护士，巴罗斯医生的助手。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't let our place's name fool you. The Doctor is very good with injuries, dismemberments, and trauma.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别被我们这地方的名字吓到。医生对内伤、断肢和外伤都很在行。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you require any Stimpaks or Bloodpacks, let me know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你需要治疗针或血浆袋，就告诉我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And how can we help you today?
ESP.TRADUIT: 今天我能为你做些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doctor Barrows at your service. What brings you to the Chop Shop?
ESP.TRADUIT: 巴罗斯医生为你服务，什么风把你吹到排骨店的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come to lend me a hand I hope. I can always use fresh human samples.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望你过来帮把手。新鲜人类标本对我来说总是有用。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, what is it now? Please, be brief. I'm quite busy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，什么事？请简要说明。我很忙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Another human with a death wish... Welcome to the Mall, tourist.
ESP.TRADUIT: 又来个找死的……欢迎来到商业街，旅行者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Willow [060C4F40] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Can't believe she's talking to someone who just wandered into a combat zone EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You did me a great favor with those keys. How do you like my new armor? Those keys led me right to it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很感激你帮我拿到了钥匙，喜欢我的新装甲吗？那些钥匙让我得到了它。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please! Don't shoot! Oh man, don't hurt me! I just work here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢老兄！别伤害我！我只是个在这儿干活的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stiggs [090068BF] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Said after running up to the player and starting dialog EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well now, look who made it back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，看看谁回来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Everett [0800A688] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take those ingots, scab. You just get back in there and get about your business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会拿走那些钢锭，渣滓，你只是回到那边，干好你自己的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Everett [0800A688] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got a real knack for this! Here, this might help you work a little harder. Original owner can't use it anymore, on account of decapitation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你找到了真正的窍门！给，这可以帮你更卖力的干活。它原来的主人是用不上了，因为他被砍了头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Everett [0800A688] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well now, aren't you quite the scrapper? Congratulations.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不就是个非常喜欢打架的人吗？恭喜。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Krenshaw [08003300] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've done well. Ashur wishes to see you. The guards will be told to allow you to pass.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你做的很好，阿舒尔希望见你。守卫们将会接到通知，允许你通过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Krenshaw [08003300] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You came to visit! You'll never guess what I found out in the Wastes, when I was supposed to be patrolling.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你来看看！你肯定想不到我在废土巡逻的时候发现了什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here. This is for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给。这是给你的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There you go! I hope you like it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你！我希望你喜欢它。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good things, sweetie. Tonic's brewed and bottled.
ESP.TRADUIT: 做得好，亲爱的。药剂酿造好并且装满了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your pay and cut of the batch. Enjoy it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的报酬并且分给你一些。祝你愉快！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Y'ain't have the look of a local, son. Think you could help a sick woman get on the mend?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还没有拜访过当地，孩子。你认为你可以帮助生病的女士痊愈吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, I didn't know you were exploring, too! You don't know where we are, do you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，我不知道你也在这探险呢！你不知道我们在哪儿，对吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0B000969] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : she is completely lost EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No students in Hall without Pass. Visitors must sign in at Administration.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有学生可以不用通行证就进入天堂。来访者必须在管理处登记。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Finally! Free!
ESP.TRADUIT: 终于！自由了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have to get out of here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我必须离开这！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please! Help us!
ESP.TRADUIT: 求求你！救救我们！

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's no point...
ESP.TRADUIT: 没必要……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why bother?
ESP.TRADUIT: 何苦呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where could we go even if we did escape? We'd just die in the Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 即使我们逃了我们又能去哪呢？我们只能死在废土。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got to hand it to you kid. That was a brave thing you did, risking your life to start the Purifier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该把这个给你。你很勇敢，你冒着生命危险启动了净化器。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : sarcastic EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, do you know you've made my life a living hell? I'm guessing not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，你知道你把我的生活搞得一团糟了吗？我猜你不知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : sarcastic EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: The hero of the Wasteland probably has more important things to worry about. Don't you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来我们的废土英雄还有更重要的是要担心。 不是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : sarcastic EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't say I blame you kid-o. I wouldn't have risked it either. That Sarah on the other hand, she's got a bleeding heart like her old man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 到不能说我是在埋怨你。换作是我我也不会冒险。但是莎拉就不同了，他跟他家老爷子一样是个软心肠。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : annoyed EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and bravo for giving her that code to the Purifer. Since then, my life's been a living hell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，还给了她净化器的密码，。从那之后，我的生活就乱了套了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : annoyed EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: And I have YOU to thank for that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而这一切都是拜你所赐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : annoyed EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...okay. You got all that? I think you know enough now to at least move around in Power Armor without killing yourself. That’s something, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: ……好，你都了解了？我看你已经清楚怎样穿着动力装甲才不会送命了。那不赖，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: God help us all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 上帝保佑我们所有人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Gunny [06026C57] (mod) Quest : ([0606136D]FreeformPowerArmor) 0606136D (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You will come to regret your actions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会为你的行为后悔的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : deadly serious EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll live just long enough to regret your error in judgement.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你将来会有时间后悔你的判断失误的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good job taking care of our little problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 帮我们处理了小问题，干得漂亮。现在，如果你不介意的话……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : self important business man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should be proud of your accomplishment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你该为自己的成就自豪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do not interfere with security operations.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要干扰安保行动。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, but I am not at liberty to chat right now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很抱歉，我现在不方便聊天。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Protect and serve.
ESP.TRADUIT: 保护与服务。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is it now? Sir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么事吗，先生？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0607F477] (ID) NPC : [0607F476] (ID) NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) Quest : ([00015A37]GenericRobot) 00015A37 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : exasperated EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is it now? Ma'am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么事吗，女士？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0607F477] (ID) NPC : [0607F476] (ID) NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) Quest : ([00015A37]GenericRobot) 00015A37 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : exasperated EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do I look like I have time for idle chitchat?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看上去像是有空和你闲聊的样子吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do not interfere with security operations.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要干扰安保行动。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, but I am not at liberty to chat right now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很抱歉，我现在不方便聊天。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Protect and serve.
ESP.TRADUIT: 保护与服务。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Protect and serve.
ESP.TRADUIT: 保护与服务。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, it looks like you decided to do things their way huh. How come?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看上去决定按他们的方式做。为什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright. Let's go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。我们走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess it's my turn to thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想轮到我谢谢你了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyway, the area's secure, so you're free to talk to Three Dog if you need to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总之，这区域是安全的。需要的话，你可以随意和三狗谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: By the way, because you helped us I'm going to let you wear that Power Armor. But don't you ever forget where it came from.
ESP.TRADUIT: 顺便提一下，因为你救了我们，我准备让你穿上动力装甲，但是别忘了它是从哪里来的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess it's my turn to thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想轮到我谢谢你了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyway, the area's secure, so you're free to talk to Three Dog if you need to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总之，这区域是安全的。需要的话，你可以随意和三狗谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome to Rivet City. Please wait while the bridge extends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎来到铆钉城。请等待放好吊桥。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome to Rivet City.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎来到铆钉城。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Salutations, Commander! Sergeant RL-3, Gutsy-class robotic soldier, reporting for duty!
ESP.TRADUIT: 敬礼，指挥官！RL-3中士，“勇敢”级机器人士兵，向你报到。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My name's Clover. I hear you're the new man in my life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我叫可萝尔。我听说你是我人生中的新男人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're looking for a bodyguard, and I'm looking for a body. Sounds like we're going to have some fun times, lover.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在找保镖，而我在找肉体。看来我们会有些开心的日子，亲爱的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My name's Clover. I hear you're the new woman in my life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我叫可萝尔。我听说你是我人生中的新女人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're looking for a bodyguard, and I'm looking for a body. Sounds like we're going to have some fun times, lover.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在找保镖，而我在找肉体。看来我们会有些开心的日子，亲爱的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing to report.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有异常。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Carry on. I've got this in hand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你继续。我正在忙这事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kind of busy, here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有点忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : a little testy, but respectful EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're here to help, then help. If not... back off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你来帮忙那就埋头帮忙。否则…就给我滚。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you didn't notice, I'm busy. Get lost.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你没看到我在忙吗。走开。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Find someone else to bother, local.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要来烦我，本地人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not looking for trouble, or conversation either.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不想找麻烦，也不想和任何人交谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got nothing to say to you. Best move on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对你没什么好说的。最好继续走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't seem to take a hint. Get out of my face.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好像不明白我的意思，从我面前消失。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll mind my business, you mind yours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我管好我的事，你管好你的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got nothing to say to you. Best move on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对你没什么好说的。最好继续走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jesus, you really can't take a hint, can you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊，你真的不能接受暗示，是吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me be blunt. Go away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我直说了吧。走开。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know you, you don't know me. Let's keep it that way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不认识你，你也不认识我。让我们保持这种状态。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about you just mind your own business, okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就管好你自己的事吧，好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you need?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you need?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([0004ADEE]GenericAdult) 0004ADEE (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jenny Wilson [06029AA6] (mod) Quest : ([000038B2]Generic) 000038B2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿你好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jenny Wilson [06029AA6] (mod) Quest : ([000038B2]Generic) 000038B2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Heard some more people got attacked last night.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听说昨晚又有人受袭击了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, I've been wanting to talk to you. Leo told me what you said to him. You know, about his problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，我一直想和你说话。利奥告诉我你和他谈过，你知道，他的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just wanted to say thank you. I know I can be rough, but my little brother means the world to me and you may have saved his life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是想说谢谢。我知道我可能比较失礼，但是我的弟弟对我来说就是整个世界，而你救了他的命。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If there's anything that I can ever help you with, just let me know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果还有什么事是我可以帮你的，请尽管告诉我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey there, Leo's been doing a lot better. I think we have you to thank for that. How can I help you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，利奥现在做得好多了。我想我们该谢谢你。我能帮你什么忙吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Leo's tickets have stopped coming up short ever since he gave up the chems. Me and my wallet both thank you. What can we do for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 自从利奥戒了毒，他不再缺钱。我和我的钱包都很谢谢你。我们能为你做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't a man eat in peace? Go talk to Jenny or Leo if you need something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不能让人安静吃饭吗？如果你需要什么去和珍妮或利奥说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I need to balance these books. If you'd like to order some food, please talk to Jenny or Leo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我需要对账。如果你要点吃的，去和珍妮或利奥说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yep. Still balancing the books. Is there something exciting about watching me? Look: Go talk to Jenny or Leo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对。还在对账。你除了盯着我之外就没其他事可做了吗？听着：去和珍妮或利奥谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You again. Is there something exciting about watching me? Look: Go talk to Jenny or Leo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 又是你。你除了盯着我之外就没其他事可做了吗？听着：去和珍妮或利奥谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm? Oh. I'm afraid I'm quite busy right now. If it's food you're after, talk to Jenny or Leo. Otherwise, I can't help you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？哦。我恐怕我现在很忙。如果你要些吃的，去和珍妮或利奥谈。否则我没什么可帮你的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You again? Go Bother Jenny or Leo, will ya?
ESP.TRADUIT: 又是你？去找珍妮或利奥好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hooo weee! Look at you! Now I haven't seen one of those Vault jumpsuits in, wow, a LONG time. Pretty damn good condition, too!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇~~！看看你！我多久不见这样的避难所工作服了。而且状况还真他妈不错！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Name's Billy Creel. You call me Billy, all right? I know Megaton looks more like a boneyard than a town, but it ain't all bad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是比利·克里，你叫我比利，好吗？我知道核弹镇看起来更像是一个废车场而不是一个城镇，但是也不是都很糟。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take me and Maggie, for instance. We make do just fine. I trade the stuff I scavenge, and she helps keep me on the straight and narrow. He he he.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿我和玛姬举例。我们做得很好。我交易那些从废物中提取的东西，而她帮我保持循规蹈矩。呵呵呵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well hot damn! Someone new! Always a pleasure!
ESP.TRADUIT: 真是该死！新来的！太让人高兴了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Name's Billy Creel. You call me Billy, all right? I know Megaton looks more like a boneyard than a town, but it ain't all bad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是比利·克里，你叫我比利，好吗？我知道核弹镇看起来更像是一个废车场而不是一个城镇，但是也不是都很糟。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take me and Maggie, for instance. We make do just fine. I trade the stuff I scavenge, and she helps keep me on the straight and narrow. He he he.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿我和玛姬举例。我们做得很好。我交易那些从废物中提取的东西，而她帮我保持循规蹈矩。呵呵呵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, bud. It'd be best if you just drift on by and leave us alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，伙计。你最好把自己挪开，让我们自己待着。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You again? Go Bother Jenny or Leo, will ya?
ESP.TRADUIT: 又是你？去烦珍妮或利奥，好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, baby! Let me get you something special. How about a Dukov surprise? Hah ha!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，宝贝！让我给你些什么特别的吧。杜克夫式的惊喜怎么样？哈哈！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Never mind. You need a drink. Cherry! Need some fucking booze over here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 没关系。你需要喝一杯。 雪莉！这边来些酒！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello sweet cheeks! What can old Dukov do for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，小甜心！老杜克夫能为你做点什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Never mind. You need a drink. Cherry! I'm thirsty over here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 没关系。你需要来杯喝的，雪莉！我渴死了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you seen Cherry? I think the bitch ran out on me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看到雪莉了吗？我想这婊子在和我耍花样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who the hell are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你到底是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Never mind. You need a drink. Cherry! I'm thirsty over here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 没关系。你需要来杯喝的，雪莉！我渴死了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who the hell are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你到底是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Never mind. You need a drink. Fantasia! I'm thirsty over here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 没关系。你需要来杯喝的，凡塔纱！我渴死了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who the hell are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你到底是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Never mind. You need a drink. My women are gone, so help yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没关系。你需要来杯喝的。我的女人走了，你自己动手吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatcha need? How about a drink? No? Suit yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要什么？来一杯？不？那你自己看着办。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, yeah, you're my hero. Don't let it go to your head. Seriously though, thank you for getting me away from Dukov.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，嗯，你是我的英雄。不过不要自大。不过说真的，谢谢你帮我离开杜克夫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cherry [0602AE21] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : sarcastic EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So that prick Dukov is dead. Can't say I'll miss him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这么说那讨厌的杜克夫死了。不能说我会想念他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Even so, I'm going to need someone to protect me. A girl can't survive by herself in the Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，我需要有人来保护我。一个女孩在废土是不能独自生存下去的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, good looking. I'm Cherry. Can I do anything for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，帅哥。我是雪莉。有任何事可以帮你的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cherry [0602AE21] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : seductive. Pause before and emphasize "anything" as if she is hinting at sex EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hi, sweetie. I'm Cherry. What can I do for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，甜心。我是雪莉。我能为你做些什么吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hi, sugar. I'm Cherry. Do yourself a favor. Watch yourself with Dukov. He's all hands.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，甜心。我是雪莉。你自己动手做吧。小心杜克夫。他什么都做得出来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cherry [0602AE21] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : confidentially EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's dead! I'm going to miss the old lecher. We had some real fun times.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他死了！我会想念这色鬼的。有几次我们真的很尽兴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's going to look after me now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在谁来照顾我？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I uh... don't feel so good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我，呃……感觉不太好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : (slow speech pattern) confused and groggy EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Am I drunk? I think I'm drunk... Do I seem drunk to you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我醉了？我想我醉了……你看我醉了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : (slow speech pattern) confused and groggy EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa!!! Is it me, or is the world spinning?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇！！！是我，还是这世界在转？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : (slow speech pattern) confused and groggy EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 再说一遍你是谁？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : (slow speech pattern) confused and groggy EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is it? Can't you see that I'm watching the guards?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要什么？快点说，你挡住我视线了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you want? Make it quick, you're blocking my view!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦……嗨！你想要什么，年轻的小伙？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Expulsion Protocol KL-001 in effect. Disengage voice parameters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 排除协议KL-001生效。脱离语音参数。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, fellow employee? What can I do for you on this wonderful day?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，雇员？在这美好的日子里我能帮你什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Very chipper in an almost artificial way. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello there, fellow employee. I don't believe we've met. I'm your Factory Foreman, Milo. It's a pleasure to meet you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，雇员。我不觉得我们见过面。我是你的工头，麦洛。很高兴认识你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Very chipper in an almost artificial way. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please give me your job posting title and employee registration number for my permanent records.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请给我你的职称还有雇员注册号，便于我在的存档记录中查询。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Very chipper in an almost artificial way. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello again, fellow employee. I still have no record of your posting or employee identification.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，雇员。我还是没有你的职称或者雇员证明记录。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please give me your job posting title and employee registration number for my permanent records.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请给我你的职称还有雇员注册号，便于我在的存档记录中查询。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you want now? Come to make fun of me again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这次你要什么？又来耍我？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: No time to talk to your type, local.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没时间和你这种乡巴佬聊天。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why don't you go bother the Brotherhood or something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么不去纠缠兄弟会什么的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey local, shouldn't you be banging rocks together, or something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，乡巴佬，你不是应该在和那些石块还是什么东西交欢嘛？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't push your luck out here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好不要得寸进尺。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep an eye out for those locals.
ESP.TRADUIT: 警惕这些原住民。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey! Is that you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨！是你吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([0C008539]TTWMS03) 0C008539 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, my head's still ringing from that explosion... What happened?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，爆炸以后我的头一直嗡嗡响……发生了什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([0C008539]TTWMS03) 0C008539 (EDID) EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 走吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Impressive, slave. I guess I shouldn't call you that anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真犀利，奴隶。不过我想我不该再那样称呼你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not bad. Welcome to the club.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不赖，欢迎来到俱乐部。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You do actually know how to plant mines, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真的知道怎么埋设地雷，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: The robots are over in the junkyard, in case you're wondering.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想打听的话，机器人在废物堆积场那。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you going to show us how to fix the robots?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你准备让我们见识下怎样修理机器人？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: So are you going to ever show us how to be sneaky so we can hide from the Super Mutants?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是准备给我们演示怎么隐匿，让我们能躲开超级变种人吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm getting bored. I thought you were going to teach us something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我开始无聊了。我还以为你会教我们些什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bittercup [0602796A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go on, I'm watching. Show us what to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续，我在看着。告诉我们做什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flash [0602796B] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm confused. What am I supposed to be doing? Can you show me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我糊涂了。我该做什么？你能给我演示下吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kimba [0602AB94] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're all watching you waiting to learn something. Well. Get on with it already!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们都在看着你，等你教东西。来吧，准备好就开始吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pappy [0602796C] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go on. I'm paying attention. Show us what to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来吧。我正在看着。告诉我们做什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, hotshot. Are you going to teach us something, or just stand there looking stupid?
ESP.TRADUIT: 自命不凡的家伙。你准备教我们些什么，还是像蠢货一样站着。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : annoyed EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oooh. I can't wait. Show us what to do!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我等不下去了。教我们怎么做！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm watching. Go on. Teach us what to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在看着，来吧，教我们怎么做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Timebomb [0602805A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town EmotionType : Neutral
NPC : NCR Ranger [0015F42D] (mod) NPC : NCR Ranger [0015F42E] (mod) NPC : NCR Ranger [0015F42F] (mod) NPC : NCR Ranger [0015F430] (mod) NPC : NCR Trooper [0015F431] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Since you haven't pissed yourself I'll assume that you don't know who we are - next time I'll bring my sickle and wear my black cloak.
ESP.TRADUIT: 既然你没有被吓得尿裤子，那我估计你是还不认得我们，下次我会带上镰刀和黑披风的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: See, the NCR sends us when they want terrible things done to terrible people...
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，当NCR希望恶人遭受恶运时，他们就会派我们登场……

ESP.ORIGINAL: HAHA! I love it. Another slave wandered back here, huh? What's wrong, couldn't get over the bridge? You're lucky I don't fuckin' paste you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哼哼！我太高兴了，又搞回来一个奴隶，对吧？怎么啦，你连桥都过不来？算你走运，我他妈的没把你打成糨糊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mex [08006166] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why I should... wait... what the?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我为什么要……等……什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mex [08006166] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now would you look at this? Where'd you get all this shit anyway? Whatever. Mine now. Thanks, Scab! I hit the jackpot today!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要看看吗？不管咋说，你从哪搞到的这些狗屎？不管你愿不愿意，都是我的了。谢谢，渣滓！我今天赚大发了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mex [08006166] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now get back in there and get to work, or next time I'll just stake you out there for the Trogs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在回到那开始干活，要不然下次我会把你绑去喂兽化人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mex [08006166] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Down with Ashur!
ESP.TRADUIT: 打倒阿舒尔！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kill the taskmasters!
ESP.TRADUIT: 杀死工头！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go away! They'll see us!
ESP.TRADUIT: 走开！他们会瞧见我们的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: President Rosie? What's happening around here anyway?
ESP.TRADUIT: 萝丝总统？这附近到底发生什么事了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rosie? As President? You've got to be kidding me...
ESP.TRADUIT: 萝丝？做总统？你在开玩笑吧……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, now. President Bob. How do you like that? Boy, things are gonna change around here. First step: get rid of all this "Dave" shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。鲍勃总统。你觉得那怎么样？孩子，这的一切都会改变的，第一步就是除去所有与“戴夫”相关的狗屎。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Kingdom of Bob! Or maybe Bobtopia! I'll have to give it some thought.
ESP.TRADUIT: 鲍勃王国！要么就是鲍托邦！我会考虑下的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I guess you want something, don't you? Tell you what... Dave kept some old junk in that safe of his... I mean MY office. The code is 1138.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是你需要什么，不是吗？告诉你吧……戴夫在他那保险箱放了些旧垃圾……我是说在“我的”办公室。密码1138。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take whatever you want out of there. Consider it a gift from your kind and loving President Bob.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那的东西你尽管拿。就当是感谢你的对鲍勃总统的友善和热爱的回礼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe we need a flag? One with my picture on it. That could be pretty cool.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许我们需要一面旗？上面有我的照片。那样可能很酷。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe we need a flag? One with my picture on it. That could be pretty cool.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许我们需要一面旗？上面有我的照片。那样可能很酷。

ESP.ORIGINAL: First things first, we're gonna have to open up the Museum of Bob.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当务之急，我们首先必须开放鲍勃博物馆。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice party.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常不错的聚会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06095501] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Happy birthday!
ESP.TRADUIT: 生日快乐！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0609550A] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enjoying yourself?
ESP.TRADUIT: 玩的开心吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stevie Mack [060309B0] (mod) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good work! That's one less Radroach to deal with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得好！又少了一只辐射蟑螂要操心了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602FDCF] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's get a picture together. Capture the moment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们一起照张相。记住这瞬间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602FDCF] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You there. Hold it. Who the hell are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 站住。见鬼，你是谁？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : suspicious EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ho chum! What's the word?
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，好友！什么事？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : friendly, happy to see the player again EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're brave to keep bothering me. Or stupid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不停地打扰我真是很勇敢。或者说愚蠢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : midly threatening. unfriendly, not happy to see the player again\ EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You did it! You disarmed that thing!
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得好！你解除了那东西！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harden Simms [06000A73] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: My dad... he... He would have been real happy about that. Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我父亲……他……他一定会为此感到很高兴的。谢谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harden Simms [06000A73] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: He wanted you to have these... a key and the deed to an empty place up behind the Brass Lantern. You can move in there if you want.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他要你拿着这些……一把钥匙与黄铜灯后一间空房的地契。如果你愿意，可以去那住。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harden Simms [06000A73] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and talk to Moira at Craterside Supply. She can help you decorate the place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，和坑边杂货店的莫伊拉谈谈。她能帮你装修那地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harden Simms [06000A73] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: My dad told me about how you're going to disarm the bomb. He gave me some stuff for you for when you get it done...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我爸爸告诉了我你要解除那核弹。他让我在你完成后，把这些东西交给你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harden Simms [06000A73] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : talking about his dad who died recently EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: You will come to regret your actions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会为你的行为后悔的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : deadly serious EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll live just long enough to regret your error in judgement.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你将来会有时间后悔你的判断失误的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : deadly serious EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是现在！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : impatiently trying to get onto some difficult business. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll be damned! You did it, didn't you? You disarmed that thing!
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死！你做到了，对吧？你解除了那东西！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hell, where's my manners? I'm Lucas Simms, mayor and sheriff. And I'm pleased to say, we've had a reward for fixing up that bomb. Here you go!
ESP.TRADUIT: 见鬼，失礼了！我是卢卡斯·西姆斯，镇长兼警长。我很荣幸的说，我们要给解除核弹的人报酬。拿着！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Y'know, we could use someone like you living in town. We've got an empty place up behind the Brass Lantern.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道，我们需要你这样的人留在镇里。我们在黄铜灯后有间空房。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's the key and deed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是钥匙和地契。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And heck, Moira over at Craterside Supply can even sell you stuff to help fix the place up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 坑边杂货店的莫伊拉会卖给你家具去装修那地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Happy

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : suspicious and threatening (deadly serious)

ESP.TRADUIT: 我一定是老得迟钝了。谢谢你救了我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who do we have here?

ESP.ORIGINAL: My, my. Just when I had all but given up hope. My dear boy, I am very happy to make your acquaintance. I am Mister Burke.
ESP.TRADUIT: 喔，喔。就在我失去所有希望的时候，我亲爱的孩子。认识你很高兴。我是伯克先生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And you, well, you are not a resident of this putrescent cesspool. That makes you a rather valuable individual.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你，嗯，你不是这腐臭的污水池的居民。那让你更难能可贵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You haven't rigged the bomb yet? If it's information you need, get to it. Time is wasting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还没有装配好核弹？如果有你需要的信息，就快点去了解。时不待人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your reward. Hell, why don't you move in? Could use someone like you. Got an empty place here you can use. Here's the key and deed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的报酬。见鬼，你干嘛不搬进来？我们需要你这样的人。有间空房你可以拿去用。这是钥匙和地契。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It ain't much to look at. But talk with Moira. She's got random odds and ends you might be able to spruce the place up with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看起来不怎么样。但和莫伊拉谈谈，她有些零碎东西，你可以拿来装修下那地方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And all without asking for pay, too. Hell, why don't you move in?
ESP.TRADUIT: 完全不求回报。见鬼，你干嘛不搬进来？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's the key and the deed to an empty house. Consider yourself a Megaton citizen!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一间空房子的地契和钥匙。把你自己当成兆吨镇的镇民吧！

ESP.TRADUIT: 不是现在！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get outta here! They see me talking to you, I'm dead!
ESP.TRADUIT: 滚出去！要是他们看到我和你在说话，我就死定了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks for helping us, mungo. You're not so bad for a mungo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你对我们的帮助，毛人，作为一个毛人来说你真不错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Penny [06015691] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're going home now. You watch out, okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们现在得回家了。你小心，好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Penny [06015691] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Man, that sure was something. You're pretty brave, mungo!
ESP.TRADUIT: 伙计，真了不起，你真勇敢，毛人！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Squirrel [06015686] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.TRADUIT: 我们在这能搞定，没问题。但小心你的背后，那些混蛋奴隶贩子可不会忘了你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd think twice about coming back here if I were you. These guys aren't going to forget you, y'know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我是你，就不会再想回到这。这些家伙不会忘了你的，你知道吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll meet you outside, if you can make it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你搞定了，就到外面来找我们！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll meet you outside, if you can make it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你搞定了，就到外面来找我们！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Squirrel [06015686] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll meet you outside, if you can make it!

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Penny [06015691] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh geez, mungo! This is crazy!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哎呀，毛人！这太疯狂了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Penny [06015691] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're gonna run for it. You come meet us outside if you make it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们该逃了。如果你搞定了就到外面来找我们！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Penny [06015691] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Man, what a mess! Don't get yourself killed, mungo!
ESP.TRADUIT: 伙计，真是糟糕透了！别送了你的命，毛人！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Squirrel [06015686] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I already shorted out the fence system so our collars won't blow. I bet they won't even notice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经使栅栏系统短路，这样我们的项圈就不会爆炸。我打赌他们还没注意到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Squirrel [06015686] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're getting outta here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们离开这！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Squirrel [06015686] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got the gate, huh? Okay, we're outta here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你打开了门，呃？好，我们离开这！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shoot a couple of those mungo ass-bag Slavers for me, will ya?
ESP.TRADUIT: 帮我打死那对混蛋毛人奴隶贩子，好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Man, you've made a mess. Go get 'em, mungo! Get that key!
ESP.TRADUIT: 伙计，你搞砸了。干掉他们，毛人！拿到那钥匙！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Squirrel [06015686] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise Comment (NAM2) : laughing EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You go take care of the bad guys. I'll just stay out here, and... stay out of the way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你去干掉那些坏家伙。我待在这……不挡你的路。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess you decided to do this your own way, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你决定按你的方式来，呃？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, now you've really done it. They're gonna kill you if they can, so you better kill them all first.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，现在你已经搞定了。他们会竭尽所能杀死你，所以你最好先把他们都杀了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get the key for the slave pen gate off of the boss mungo, or that Forty asshole. If you can unlock the gate, we'll make a run for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从毛人老大或混蛋弗替那拿到奴隶栅栏门的钥匙。如果你能打开这门，我们就能逃出去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh man, they're gonna be mad at you! These Slaver guys are mean!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦 伙计，他们被你逼疯了！这些奴隶贩子很小气的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Listen, you gotta help us. Me and my friends... We gotta get home. Can you help? Can you get us out of here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，你得帮助我们，我和我的朋友……我们想回家。你能帮忙吗？你能帮我们逃出去吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You gonna help, or what? Squirrel and Penny are still in there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你到底要不要帮忙？“松鼠”和佩尼还在里面呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I guess that's it. Thanks for getting us out of there, mungo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，我想就这样了。谢谢你帮我们逃出来，毛人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're going back home now. You ever come out that way, you stop and say hi. I'll tell Mayor not to shoot you okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们现在得回家了。如果路过，你可以来打声招呼。我叫镇长不要开枪打你，好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I guess that's it. Thanks for getting us out of there, mungo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，我想就这样了。谢谢你帮我们逃出来，毛人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're going back home now. You ever come out that way, you stop and say hi. I'll tell Mayor not to shoot you okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们现在得回家了。如果路过，你可以来打声招呼。我叫镇长不要开枪打你，好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not bad, mungo. Not bad at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不错，毛人。很不错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Squirrel [06015686] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I told you I had a good plan. It sure worked, didn't it? You ever need anything, you go see MacCready in Lamplight. He'll help you out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我告诉过你我有万全之策。它成功了，对吧？如果你有什么需要，去小灯镇找麦迪，他会帮你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Squirrel [06015686] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks, mungo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢，毛人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Squirrel [06015686] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks for getting us out of there. If you ever need anything, you come see us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你帮我们逃出来，如果有什么需要，尽管来找我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Penny [06015691] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mayor will be nice to you. I'll make sure of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 镇长会好好招待你的。我保证。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Penny [06015691] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you got us out of there, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你帮我们逃出来了，呃？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Squirrel [06015686] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not so bad for a mungo, I guess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想，作为一个毛人来说你真不错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Squirrel [06015686] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, uhh. Thanks and stuff. We're gonna head home soon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，太感谢了。我们得赶快回家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Squirrel [06015686] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is Rory safe yet?
ESP.TRADUIT: 罗瑞已经安全了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Penny [06015691] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So. You're the genius who disarmed the bomb. Weeks of waiting and watching, ruined!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就是那解除核弹的天才。数周的观望，都白费了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([0C0093FD]TTWMS11) 0C0093FD (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a pity you acted so hastily. In the future, best sleep with one eye open.
ESP.TRADUIT: 都是因为你草率的行动。以后，你睡觉最好都睁只眼睛。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([0C0093FD]TTWMS11) 0C0093FD (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You self-righteous little... Do you have any idea what you've done to my employer's development plan? A word of advice: watch your back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有点自以为是……你知道你对我们老板的开发计划都干了什么吗？给你个忠告：小心你背后。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([0C0093FD]TTWMS11) 0C0093FD (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : exploding with anger, then regaining a malicious calm EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: What you did, it was a great thing. That place, those people... necessary sacrifices. Here's to a better future. Here's to Tenpenny Tower!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你做的事，是伟大的事。那地方，那些人……必须牺牲。为了更美好的未来，为了特佩尼大厦！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([0C0093FD]TTWMS11) 0C0093FD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, hey! How's it going? You need something, you just ask. Disarming that bomb, well... that's something I'm not ever likely to forget.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨！怎么样了？有需要尽管说。解除了核弹，啊……我永远不会忘记。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([0C0093FD]TTWMS11) 0C0093FD (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, now... how's my favorite explosives expert doing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在……我最爱的拆弹专家在干嘛？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([0C0093FD]TTWMS11) 0C0093FD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, you're pretty busted up, but you'll live. Stop by the clinic in the morning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，虽然你伤得很重的，但你会活下来。早上去诊所吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Church [06000A6E] (mod) Quest : ([0C0093FD]TTWMS11) 0C0093FD (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hurry and seal that hole from the attic! If you don't have any grenades then see if there's something nearby you can shoot that will explode!
ESP.TRADUIT: 快！把阁楼那个洞密封起来，如果你没有手榴弹，那就看看附近有没有能射爆的东西！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah? What is it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？什么事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who the hell are you?! Where did you come from?! Did Moriarty send you?!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你他妈是谁？你从哪来？是莫里亚蒂派你来的？！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here... you've done so much for us. I want you to have this. It's all I have to offer you...
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿好……你为我们做了很多。我希望你收下。我只有这些了……

ESP.ORIGINAL: All of us here thank you for everything you've done. For us... for the Wastes. We pooled together and got you this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里所有的人都感谢你为我们做的一切。为我们……为废土。我们凑了些东西给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the best we could do. Please take it, with our thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我们能做的最好的了。请收下它，还有我们的谢意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wish there were more people like you in the world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望这世界能有更多像你一样的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want you to have this. I hope it helps keep you safe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要你拿着这。我希望它能帮助保护你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess you'd better be on your way... Sorry for the uhh, for the interruption.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你最好出发。呃……抱歉打扰了你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enclave Officer [06039634] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're not who they say they are... Get out while you can, before they get you too!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们不像他们说的那样……趁他们没抓住你，赶快抽身！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nathan [06000A67] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, hi there! Welcome to Andale! I'm Willy Wilson, though folks just call me Bill. Is there anything I can do for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好！欢迎来到安戴尔！我是薇柳·威尔逊，不过人们都叫我比尔。有什么可以帮助你的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Man, what the hell is this place? What do they want with all these people?
ESP.TRADUIT: 伙计，这到底是什么地方？它们想要对这些人干什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Quest : ([0B000802]DLC05MZ1) Not of This World EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, I thought you should know... Someone must've hit a button during the fight just now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，我想你该知道…在战斗的时候好像有人按了那个按钮。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I understood the display correctly, I think we sort of launched a homing beacon of some kind down to the surface. Landed just outside D.C.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我对显示屏上的理解正确的话，我们大概是发射了一个归航信标到地表。就在特区附近。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wouldn't mention it, except that I think... Like I said, I'm not sure... I think it's a way to get back to earth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可没说，但我认为…就像我说的，我不知道…我认为这是回到地球的一种方法。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Seems like there's a teleporter in the Captain's quarters... I mean, I guess they're your quarters now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好像有一个传送装置在舰长的指挥台那…我的意思是，你现在不就是舰长吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: So I guess you can go home if you want. Don't worry, I'll stick around up here and keep an eye on things.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以我认为，如果你想的话，你可以用那个回家，不用担心，我会在这待一阵子看看有什么新情况。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hito wo azakeru na. Onushi no monoii wa sappari wakaran.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别耍我，完全不知你说的啥。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Toshiro Kago [0B0032FC] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sessha wo tasuke takuba, sessha no ken wo sagashi dase!
ESP.TRADUIT: 想帮在下就把在下的剑找出来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Toshiro Kago [0B0032FC] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here it is! This is the stuff I hid in here. You can have all of it, okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 在那！这是我藏在这里的东西。你可以全带走，好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on, I'll show you where the stuff is!
ESP.TRADUIT: 来啊，我给你看看我藏了什么东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nope, nope. Not real, none of it is real. It can't hurt me if it's not real.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，不是。不是真实的，全是假的。如果它不是真的，就不能伤害我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rivet City Security [0B007E50] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : scared, shocked EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wasn't aware that we had anything else to say to each other.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没发现咱们还有什么话可说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome back!
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎回来！

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you waiting for? DESTROY HIM!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还在等什么？消灭他！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A005A38] (ID) Quest : ([0A00584B]DLC04MQ05b) A Meeting Of The Minds

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep your distance. What are you doing in my house?
ESP.TRADUIT: 保持距离，你在我家干什么 ?
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A002F3E] (ID) Quest : ([0A002F47]DLC04FF02) The Dark Heart of Blackhall EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You said you'd mend the still, sweetie. When did you plan on getting' to that, exactly?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说过你要修，亲爱的。到底什么时候计划开始呢?
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks for mending the still, Sweetie. For this fee, the tonic had better taste like honey, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 亲爱的，谢谢你的修理。因为你的付出，药剂尝起来更像蜂蜜了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks for mending the still, Sweetie. You're a peach.
ESP.TRADUIT: 亲爱的，谢谢你的修理。你是个美人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks for mending the still, Sweetie. Here's your pay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 亲爱的，谢谢你的修理。这是你的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I hope you can find my Nadine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，我希望你能找到我的娜丁。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello, traveler!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，旅行者！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are welcome to our tribe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎来到我们的部落。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A00927F] (ID) Quest : ([0A005847]DLC04MQ02) Walking With Spirits EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tremendous showing! I do hope the experience was worth every cap.
ESP.TRADUIT: 重大发现！我希望这次经历能够物超所值。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's commemorate your first safari with a token of our friendship, shall we?
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们以此来纪念你第一次狩猎时我们的友谊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This axe was, er, 'misplaced' by one of my other patrons. She won't be needing it anymore, and it's a weapon of gruesome distinction. Enjoy it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这斧头是，呃，是我的一个顾客误放在这里的。她不再需要它了，这武器相当卓越。享受它吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mr. Plik's really outdone himself this time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 水疱先生这次真正的克服了自己。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, hello there young traveler. The fates had told me that I would receive a visitor today.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你好年轻的旅行者。命运告诉我，今天我将会有一个来访者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I'm being rude! I am Madam Panada, and this is Madam Panada's House of Wares! For all things a traveler needs, I am here to provide!
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是我已经粗鲁了！我是帕娜达女士，这是帕娜达女生的仓库！我再这里提供旅行者所需的一些东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bullets! Stimpaks! Armor! Weapons! Junk! If you need it, Madam Panada has already anticipated your need and procured it months ago!
ESP.TRADUIT: 子弹！治疗针！装甲！武器！垃圾！尽情挑选，帕娜达夫人已经在月前就预先采购好了你所需要的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good to see you again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再次见到你真好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <There is no answer>
ESP.TRADUIT: <无人应答>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Be at peace.
ESP.TRADUIT: 愿你平安！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep moving, Wastelander.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要停下来，游民。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've got this area locked down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这区域已经被我们封锁了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everything's above board.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一切都是光明正大的.

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're all clear here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里解决了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've got this area locked down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这区域已经被我们封锁了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not the most exciting job I ever had, but you gotta admit, it beats pulling the floaters out of the Basin. Ha ha ha.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我这工作说不上有意思，但是你得承认，把漂浮物从池子的水里弄出来可真恶心啊。哈哈哈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood of Steel Initiate [09001D3E] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : amused to think of his poor buddy pulling rotting mirelurks out of the water EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Brotherhood assholes! They won't give us enough water to last until the next shipment!
ESP.TRADUIT: 兄弟会的混蛋！在下一批货之前他们不会提供我们水了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : trying to convince himself that this is true EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're not going to let them leave with that water though. We need it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不会让他们带走水的。我们需要它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : trying to convince himself that this is true EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are they going to do, anyway? Kill us for stealing some free water?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们想怎么样？为了得到些免费的水而把我们杀了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : trying to convince himself that this is true EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is what happens to people who fuck with the Brotherhood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是跟兄弟会作对的下场。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you need something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是不是需要些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you need?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elder Lyons [060156E4] (mod) NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) NPC : Scribe Rothchild [060156EA] (mod) NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) NPC : [0002131F] (ID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If there's anything I can do to help, please just say so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果有什么我能帮到你的，请不要客气。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you need something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是不是需要些什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elder Lyons [060156E4] (mod) NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) NPC : Scribe Rothchild [060156EA] (mod) NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) NPC : [0002131F] (ID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good to see you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴见到你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elder Lyons [060156E4] (mod) NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) NPC : Scribe Rothchild [060156EA] (mod) NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) NPC : [0002131F] (ID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I first saw you long ago, I thought you were just some trashy Wastelander. I'm glad I was wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很久之前，我第一次见到你时，我还以为你是个一文不值的废土游民。但很高兴我错了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My father thinks the world of you... and so do I. If things were different, maybe we could have had time to become friends...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我父亲很欣赏你……我也是。如果不是在这种环境下的话，也许我们能有时间交个朋友……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyway... I wish you the best of luck and I hope you stick around for a while. We need people like you to help us finish what we've started here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管怎么说啦……我还是希望你能平安无事，还有……我希望你能在这里多呆几天。我们需要你这样的人来帮助我们完成未尽的事业！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You must cleanse your tongue of unseemly speech by drinking deep of the holy water. Then we may speak.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你必须用圣水清洗掉你口中的无礼言辞。之后我们才能开始谈话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brother Gerard [09004C76] (mod) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cleanse your tongue with the holy water. For we must speak with seemly tongues when we make mention of Atom's Light.
ESP.TRADUIT: 用圣水洗净你的喉舌。因为在我们谈论原子之光的时候必须言辞得体。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brother Gerard [09004C76] (mod) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you well, dear?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还好吗，亲爱的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [09004C77] (ID) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our veins flow with Atom's Eternal Glow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的血液中流淌着原子那永恒的光芒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Novice [09007E34] (mod) NPC : Wastelander [09007E35] (mod) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water Comment (NAM2) : brain washed EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Grrrrrloooow...
ESP.TRADUIT: 咯……咯……（光辉）
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sun of Atom [09007E36] (mod) NPC : Atom's Champion [09006520] (mod) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water Comment (NAM2) : Like a growling animal trained to say "Glow" EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Arrrr-taaahm.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊……特姆（原子）
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sun of Atom [09007E36] (mod) NPC : Atom's Champion [09006520] (mod) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water Comment (NAM2) : Like a growling animal trying to say "Atom" EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: The water she gave me... it... there's something... wrong...
ESP.TRADUIT: 她给我的水……里面……有点……不对…劲……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Water Beggar [09006517] (mod) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water Comment (NAM2) : dying painfully EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Arrrggghhhh!
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊呃呃呃！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Water Beggar [09006517] (mod) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water Comment (NAM2) : dying painfully EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you heard about that new cult? They took our water!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听说那所谓的新兴的邪教了么？他们抢走了我们的水！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, read this. It's one of their pamphlets.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来，看看这个。这是他们的小册子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I hadn't seen you in so long. I thought you died. Um... I stopped setting aside money for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，很久不见啊。我还以为你死啦。呃……所以我就没留你那份儿……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : annoyed EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um, here. Take this. It's all I have to spare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，给你。拿着这些。我只剩这些了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : annoyed EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now get out of here before my customers take notice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在在我的顾客们发现之前快点离开吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : annoyed EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is it that time already? Fine. Here's your money.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这么快就到日子了？好吧。这是你的钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : annoyed EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now get out of here. I'm trying to earn some money.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在快离开吧。我正在拼命挣钱呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : annoyed EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just can't stay away, can you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就离我远一点，行不行？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I guess it's good you're not dead. And I guess I should say thanks for getting us running.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我想看到你没死我该高兴。而且我想我该谢谢你帮了我们大忙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If there's anything you need, just let me know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果有什么需要，尽管说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I'm busy. Can we do this some other time?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我现在很忙。我们能不能等会儿再管它？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You found a Tesla Coil?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你找到了一个特斯拉线圈？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Tristan [09005686] (mod) Quest : ([09000AFD]DLC03BS2) Shock Value EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent. I'll see to it that this reaches the scribes immediately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好极了。我会确保它立即被送达文员那。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Tristan [09005686] (mod) Quest : ([09000AFD]DLC03BS2) Shock Value EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've done good work, soldier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你干得很好，士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Tristan [09005686] (mod) Quest : ([09000AFD]DLC03BS2) Shock Value EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you ready for your next assignment? We don't have time to spare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你准备好接受下一个任务了么？我们时间紧迫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Tristan [09005686] (mod) Quest : ([09000AFD]DLC03BS2) Shock Value EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is that?? What the hell is going on?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是什么？？到底发生什么事了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Tristan [09005686] (mod) Quest : ([09000802]DLC03BS1) Death From Above EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We need to find out what the hell just happened.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们需要弄明白到底他妈的发生什么事了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Tristan [09005686] (mod) Quest : ([09000802]DLC03BS1) Death From Above EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's no time to talk - get your ass inside that base, and help the troops locate the source of their transmission. Now soldier, NOW!
ESP.TRADUIT: 没时间多说了——麻溜进基地，帮助部队找到他们通讯源。现在，士兵。马上！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Tristan [09005686] (mod) Quest : ([09000802]DLC03BS1) Death From Above EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the hell...
ESP.TRADUIT: 这他妈的……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Tristan [09005686] (mod) Quest : ([09000802]DLC03BS1) Death From Above EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They knew we were coming... How did they know we were coming?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们知道我们要来了……。可他们是怎么知道的 ?
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood of Steel Paladin [09005730] (mod) Quest : ([09000802]DLC03BS1) Death From Above EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good work. You're one step away from Ashur... and our freedom.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得不错。你离阿舒尔……和我们的自由只有一步之遥。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That fight was impressive. One more to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那场战斗很犀利，还剩一个对手。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not bad, grinder. Not bad. The Bear Brothers were some pretty mean sons o' bitches.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不赖啊，苦力，不赖。贝尔兄弟是一对相当卑鄙的贱人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Faydra [080032E4] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One more fight and you're free. But I wouldn't plan on making it through the next one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再打一场，你就自由了。不过我对下一场没什么指望。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Faydra [080032E4] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's a shot for the rads. Come back when you're ready for your last fight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你去掉辐射，准备好了下一场就回来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Faydra [080032E4] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow. Impressive, slave. Those were some of the toughest scabs around here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇噢，真犀利，奴隶。那些可是这里本事最大的渣滓。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Faydra [080032E4] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've got some fight in you, it seems. But I wouldn't get too excited. I'm sure Ashur's got something special planned for your next fight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你像是斩获不小，不过我高兴不起来，我肯定阿舒尔为你的下一场战斗安排了些压轴戏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Faydra [080032E4] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's something for the rads. Enjoy it while you can. Come back when you're ready for your next fight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你去掉辐射。尽情享用。准备好了下一场就回来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Faydra [080032E4] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And what're you doing down here, slave? Don't tell me that your pale ass is gonna throw down?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你到这下面来做什么，奴隶？别跟我说你苍白的屁股要掉地下了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Faydra [080032E4] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You again? Back for more, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要再来吗？下一场吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Faydra [080032E4] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unless you're looking to get killed, you'll get the fuck out of my Arena.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除非你找死，不然就他妈的从我的竞技场滚出去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Faydra [080032E4] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Haha! So you're the dumbass scab that signed up to fight in the Hole, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈！那么你就是那个签下生死状，要在角斗坑角斗的傻瓜渣滓，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spook [08003E50] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, head on down! Faydra's waiting for you! HAHAHA!
ESP.TRADUIT: 直接下去！费德拉等着你！哈哈哈！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spook [08003E50] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can take weapons into the Hole.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以带着武器进入角斗坑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) NPC : Nola [08003E49] (mod) NPC : Marco [08003E48] (mod) NPC : Brand [08003E2E] (mod) NPC : Adan [08003E2D] (mod) NPC : Kai [08003E2F] (mod) NPC : Milly [08009F4B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Talk to Marco and get a weapon... if you haven't already.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟马克谈，搞把武器……你要是还没有的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) NPC : Nola [08003E49] (mod) NPC : Marco [08003E48] (mod) NPC : Brand [08003E2E] (mod) NPC : Adan [08003E2D] (mod) NPC : Kai [08003E2F] (mod) NPC : Milly [08009F4B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're so close...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们亲密无间……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) NPC : Nola [08003E49] (mod) NPC : Marco [08003E48] (mod) NPC : Brand [08003E2E] (mod) NPC : Adan [08003E2D] (mod) NPC : Kai [08003E2F] (mod) NPC : Milly [08009F4B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The first thing I'm going to do once I'm free is burn out Faydra's eyes. She's the worst of them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一旦我自由了，我做的第一件事就是烧瞎费德拉的眼睛。她是最坏的一个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) NPC : Nola [08003E49] (mod) NPC : Marco [08003E48] (mod) NPC : Brand [08003E2E] (mod) NPC : Adan [08003E2D] (mod) NPC : Kai [08003E2F] (mod) NPC : Milly [08009F4B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't stand the fucking bosses. This is disgusting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我受不了这些该死的老板，令人作呕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) NPC : Nola [08003E49] (mod) NPC : Marco [08003E48] (mod) NPC : Brand [08003E2E] (mod) NPC : Adan [08003E2D] (mod) NPC : Kai [08003E2F] (mod) NPC : Milly [08009F4B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those bastards. It's bad enough they force us to work, but they expect us to fight for their amusement!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些杂种很坏，他们强迫我们干活，却还指望我们为了逗他们开心去角斗！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) NPC : Nola [08003E49] (mod) NPC : Marco [08003E48] (mod) NPC : Brand [08003E2E] (mod) NPC : Adan [08003E2D] (mod) NPC : Kai [08003E2F] (mod) NPC : Milly [08009F4B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We all knew this was coming but... I dunno... the Hole is terrible.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们都知道就快开场了，不过……我不知道……角斗坑中很恐怖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) NPC : Nola [08003E49] (mod) NPC : Marco [08003E48] (mod) NPC : Brand [08003E2E] (mod) NPC : Adan [08003E2D] (mod) NPC : Kai [08003E2F] (mod) NPC : Milly [08009F4B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Midea is crazy. This'll never work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 美狄亚疯了，这绝没有用处。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) NPC : Nola [08003E49] (mod) NPC : Marco [08003E48] (mod) NPC : Brand [08003E2E] (mod) NPC : Adan [08003E2D] (mod) NPC : Kai [08003E2F] (mod) NPC : Milly [08009F4B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're fighting in the Hole? Well... good luck with that...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要在角斗坑里角斗？那么……祝你好运……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) NPC : Nola [08003E49] (mod) NPC : Marco [08003E48] (mod) NPC : Brand [08003E2E] (mod) NPC : Adan [08003E2D] (mod) NPC : Kai [08003E2F] (mod) NPC : Milly [08009F4B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're our best hope.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是我们最大的希望。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) NPC : Nola [08003E49] (mod) NPC : Marco [08003E48] (mod) NPC : Brand [08003E2E] (mod) NPC : Adan [08003E2D] (mod) NPC : Kai [08003E2F] (mod) NPC : Milly [08009F4B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: At least they cure your radiation when you come out of the Hole.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当你从角斗坑里出来，至少他们会治疗你的辐射。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) NPC : Nola [08003E49] (mod) NPC : Marco [08003E48] (mod) NPC : Brand [08003E2E] (mod) NPC : Adan [08003E2D] (mod) NPC : Kai [08003E2F] (mod) NPC : Milly [08009F4B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ashur's days are numbered.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿舒尔的时代到头了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) NPC : Nola [08003E49] (mod) NPC : Marco [08003E48] (mod) NPC : Brand [08003E2E] (mod) NPC : Adan [08003E2D] (mod) NPC : Kai [08003E2F] (mod) NPC : Milly [08009F4B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, what a dear little orphaned child that is. I know a place where she can have a safe home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们是替兄弟会运水的商队，你还没听说？铆钉城正给废土带去净水！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beth [080039C9] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Caring, and not-so-subtly suggesting that the player is a bad parent. EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: And you can be about your business, far, far away from her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 管好你自己的事，离她远点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beth [080039C9] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Caring, and not-so-subtly suggesting that the player is a bad parent. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can't make me talk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能和你谈话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Flatly refusing to talk, even if it means her death EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you need? Make it fast.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要什么？快点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not easy keeping these people from tearing each other apart. I don't know how Ashur did it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阻止这些人自相残杀不容易，我不知道阿舒尔是怎么办到的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Frustrated with politics EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kind of busy trying to keep this place in one piece. And here I thought freedom would make things easier...
ESP.TRADUIT: 有点忙于保持这个地方团结一致。我想自由将是可以更容易的达成这一目标的手段……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Slightly frustrated EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice trophy from Ashur you got there. You sure earned it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来自阿舒尔的美妙奖励，你肯定赚到了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Grimly proud of the player EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh joy. Our hero.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，太荣幸了，我们的英雄。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Very sarcastic and angry to the speaker. EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looking sharp in that suit, pal! Glad I wasn't there when you pried it off old Ashur, though. Bet it smelled like a sack full of dog asses.
ESP.TRADUIT: 穿着那套衣服看起来很酷，伙计！很高兴当你把它从老阿舒尔身上扒下来的时候我不在场。我打赌它闻起来就像是装了一麻袋的狗屁。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you mind? I've got a lot to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你介意吗？我有许多活得干。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Krenshaw [08003300] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Busy EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, Billy...
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，比利……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0800B161] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : weeping over the corpse of his dead brother EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got a problem?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有问题吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you a hungry pet?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个饥饿的宠物吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh. It's talking to me again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，它又在跟我说话了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, champ!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，冠军！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keeping busy? Need a pick-me-up?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还在忙？要不要来点提神的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Buzz off, new kid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 走开，菜鸟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Duke [0800413C] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A little irritated at being interrupted EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got better things to do than talk with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 比起跟你胡扯，我有更重要的事情要做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reddup [0800413E] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Angry, offended to even have to talk to the player EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, meat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，肉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm told that you might be looking for Marco. Am I right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说你可能在寻找马可，我说的对吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right. All better. But still...
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，有所好转，不过还有……

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'd better get out of here. They might suspect something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好离开，他们可能起了疑心。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right. All better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，有所好转。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, get out of here before the bosses suspect something. I'll be here if you get hurt again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，在老板们起疑心之前离开这。你要是再受了伤，来这找我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you get hurt, come talk to me. I can help you out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要是受了伤，来这找我，我可以帮你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No scabs near the gate. Back off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 渣滓们不许接近大门，回去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hammer [08003E4F] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Stern. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jackson, man. Don't forget it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 杰克森，老兄。别忘了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 走吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good to see you again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再次见到你真好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Attacking the Listening Post as ordered, sir. I'll give you a new update when the objective is complete.
ESP.TRADUIT: 按计划进攻监听站，长官。当任务完成后我会向你报告最新进展。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sergeant Benjamin Montgomery [070009C2] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're the backup? Great. Just great.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是来帮忙的？太好了，真是太好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Sibley [07000E24] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, follow me. I'll take you to Protector McGraw.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，跟着我。我会带你去见护卫麦格劳。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Sibley [07000E24] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're here to help? Fine, then put this on, get in the chair, and we'll run the simulation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是来帮忙的？好，那穿上这个，坐在那椅子上，我们来运行模拟程序。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Specialist Olin [07000E22] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on, let's move it. I ain't got all day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 快点啊。我可没那么多时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Sibley [07000E24] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You getting in there, or what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你倒底进不进去啊？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Sibley [07000E24] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is a Pre-War research facility. There's technology to be had, and I am determined to have it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一座战前的研究设施。里面有种科技，我决心要得到它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unfortunately, it's locked up tight. As far as we can tell, it's linked into some kind of simulator.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不幸的是，它被牢牢锁上了。据我们所知，它被连接在某种模拟器上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But we can't access the simulator, because we lack the proper interface. Your little computer there is exactly what we're looking for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不能进入模拟器，因为我们缺少适当的操作界面。你那件小电脑正是我们要找的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, I'll make you a deal. You access the simulator and get us into the rest of this base, and I'll give you a cut of what we find.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，我们来做个交易。你进入模拟器，带我们进入这个基地，我就把找到的东西分一份给你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Payment for Services Rendered." You help us, and we'll help you.
ESP.TRADUIT: “交易达成。”你帮了我们，我们也会帮你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've said my piece. If you're interested in assisting, follow Sibley to the simulation pod. Olin will help get you jacked into the sim.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说完了。如果你有兴趣帮忙的话，跟西布利去模拟舱。奥林会帮你进入模拟程序。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice work out there, soldier. Thanks for the back-up, but where's the rest of your detachment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得漂亮，士兵。谢谢你支援我，但你的其他队员哪去了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Morrill [07000E26] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Head on into the base and talk to McGraw. I'll let him know you're coming. Don't worry, they won't shoot you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 进基地去和麦格劳谈谈。我会告诉他你来了。别担心，他们不会向你开枪的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Morrill [07000E26] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Could you have been any more useless out there? You don't deserve to wear that armor after that display! Explain yourself, soldier!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在那边没事干吗？从你之前的表现来看，你还不够资格穿那件装甲！好好解释一下，士兵！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Morrill [07000E26] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, now who the hell are you, and what do you think you're doing wearing that armor?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你到底是谁，还有为什么穿着那件装甲？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Morrill [07000E26] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Give me one good reason why I shouldn't put you down right now, outsider.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我一个不杀你的理由，外来人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Morrill [07000E26] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't think for one second I didn't see what you're wearing. If you hadn't actually helped out here, I'd have put you down along with these mutants.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别以为我看不出你这身打扮是做什么的。如果你在这里碍手碍脚的，我就把你的尸体堆在变种人的上面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Morrill [07000E26] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've got about three seconds to explain yourself, outsider.
