ESP.TRADUIT: 你有3秒钟时间解释一下在做什么，外来人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Morrill [07000E26] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Damned guard detail! That sounded like a good ruckus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死的防卫细节！听起来像一堆废话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood Outcast [0700C3C8] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts Comment (NAM2) : Soldier addressing comrade EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can go ahead and stop right there. Who the hell are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以向前走，在那里停下。你到底是谁？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood Outcast [0700C3C8] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts Comment (NAM2) : Guarding a door. Gruff. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well? You headed down or not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么？你要不要下去？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood Outcast [0700C3C8] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts Comment (NAM2) : Guarding a door. Gruff. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stick with us until we make it through to the base!
ESP.TRADUIT: 紧跟着我们一起去基地！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take that elevator and report in to Defender Sibley.
ESP.TRADUIT: 坐电梯去向守卫西布利报到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think Defender Sibley's going to want to talk with you. Take that elevator down into the base.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想守卫西布利要和你谈谈。坐电梯到基地中去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So... you're in charge of Patterson's Suicide Squad, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么…你是帕特森敢死队的头头，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lieutenant Morgan [070009C3] (mod) Quest : ([070009C0]DLC02OA3) Paving the Way EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Congratulations on making it to the HQ. It's pretty fierce out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恭喜你安全回到总部。外面战况很激烈啊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Adami [0700B56E] (mod) Quest : ([070034DA]DLC02FF) DLC02FF EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your chem ration. I'm doctor Adami. Come see me if you need patching up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你药品配给。我是奥达米医生。如果还需要包扎就回来找我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Adami [0700B56E] (mod) Quest : ([070034DA]DLC02FF) DLC02FF EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's get you up to 100%, shall we? Uncle Sam needs you back in the fight! Hold still a moment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们来治好你，好吗？山姆大叔需要你回到战斗中去！坚持一下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Adami [0700B56E] (mod) Quest : ([070034DA]DLC02FF) DLC02FF Comment (NAM2) : treating a patient in a hospital ward EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What sort of scrape did you get yourself into, this time?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这次你又划伤到哪里了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm going on an adventure!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就要去冒险了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh hey, hi. You again, huh? I thought maybe you'd be blown up or shot or something by now, but I guess not. Not yet, anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，嗨，你好，又是你，呃？我还想可能现在你已经被炸死、被射杀或其它什么，不过好像还没。现在还没。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : hyperactive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, hi! Hi, lady. Hey there. What's going on? Anything new? You have any good stories? What about Nuka-Cola, you have any of that? Huh, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，你好！嘿，女士。嗨。怎么了？有什么消息？你有什么好故事？核子可乐，你有吗？呃，呃？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : hyperactive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, hi! Hi, mister. Hey there. What's going on? Anything new? You have any good stories? What about Nuka-Cola, you have any of that? Huh, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，你好！嘿，先生。嗨。怎么了？有什么消息？你有什么好故事？核子可乐，你有吗？呃，呃？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : hyperactive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey there. You have any Nuka-Cola? Even just a bit? Can I have some? Be your best friend. Honest. Totally. Not even kidding!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨。你有核子可乐吗？一点也好。我能来一些吗？我最好的朋友。真诚的。完全的。绝不是开玩笑！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Hyperactive, and spoken about as fast as you can. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks again for saving me. You're the best!
ESP.TRADUIT: 再次感谢你救了我。你是最棒的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you and my brother are tied for the best, at least. But that's still really good!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，你和我兄弟并列最棒的，至少。但是那还是真的很棒！

ESP.ORIGINAL: We didn't need any mungo's help getting outta there, you know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们逃出那里不需要毛人帮，你懂吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Frustration at returning to a job he hates. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: But you did it, so, uh, thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是你帮了我们，所以，呃，谢谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Frustration at returning to a job he hates. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: But that means I gotta go back to guarding the back gate with Princess. Ugh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过这是指我要去后面和“公主”一起守后门。呃。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Frustration at returning to a job he hates. EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, so you get in, but I got my eye on you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，你进来吧，不过我会盯你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't make any trouble in here, got it? I ain't having no shit-butts making trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不准在这撒野，明白吗？我不准任何臭狗屎捣乱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What now, mungo?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在又怎么样，毛人？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mayor MacCready [060156AC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : more good natured and teasing than actually angry EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, what the hell is wrong with you, mungo? This had better be important!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，你到底怎么回事，毛人？这最好是重要事！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mayor MacCready [060156AC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : actually getting irritated now EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, what now? You come to me to talk about how nice my damned cave is? Maybe a little small talk about local soil erosion or some bullshit?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在又怎么了？你来找我，就是想说我该死的洞穴有多么多么好？或者聊聊当地的土壤侵蚀之类的屁事？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mayor MacCready [060156AC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Increasingly furious EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, you know what? You can go take a hike, you insane mutant-fucker. Get out of my town!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，你知道吗？你可以出去远足了，你这疯狂的变种人养的。滚出我的镇子！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mayor said to let you in alive, but he didn't say you had to stay that way. Watch your step, mungo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 镇长说留你一条小命，但他可没说可以让你恣意妄为，你给我小心点，毛人！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa, a mungo down here, just walking around!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，这有个毛人，正在到处游荡。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) NPC : Stacey [060156AB] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, new kid! Try and catch me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，新来的！来抓我啊！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tag, you're it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 抓人游戏，来啊！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aw, man! I'm it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，哥们！我在这！

ESP.ORIGINAL: No way, that didn't count!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不行，那不算！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stay away, mungo, I don't wanna catch old from you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 走开点，毛人。我不想碰到你变老！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) NPC : Stacey [060156AB] (mod) EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks for getting Penny and Squirrel back. And Sammy too, I guess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你救回佩尼和“松鼠”，还有萨米，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Penny [06015691] (mod) NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) NPC : Squirrel [06015686] (mod) NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) NPC : Stacey [060156AB] (mod) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mungo, mungo, smells like dung-o!
ESP.TRADUIT: 毛人，毛人，闻着像屎！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) NPC : Stacey [060156AB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Sung teasingly EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gosh, you're big.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天，你很大啊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) NPC : Stacey [060156AB] (mod) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice as the weather is out here, how about you bring me a kid, so I can get back to Paradise Falls?
ESP.TRADUIT: 外面天气不错，你给我带个孩子过来吧？这样我就可以回到堕落天堂了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just waiting for you to bring me a new friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就等你给我带个新朋友过来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Child Slaver [06062AB2] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A little creepy EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: There you go, good as new.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好啦，一切如常。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got a lot to thank you for... I don't know how to do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我得好好感谢你……我不知道怎么报答。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here... take this. It's always given me good luck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着这。它一直都给我带来好运。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, don't mind the smoke. It's perfectly safe to breathe. Really!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，别在意这烟。这气体很安全。真的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's up? Anything interesting out there in the wild Wasteland?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么了？在废土荒野有什么有趣的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, hey. What's up?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，嗨，什么事？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : sounding defeated and ground-down by work EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, someone who doesn't have a cart for me to fix or a brahmin to wash up. That's a nice change.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，没人要我去修车，也没人叫我去给双头牛搓澡。真是个可喜的变化。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hope you don't mind the smell of brahmin dung. It's been one of those days.
ESP.TRADUIT: 希望你不介意双头牛的粪便味。每间隔几天就有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey. How's the wide, wild Wasteland out there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨。外面的废土荒野怎么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Sounding like someone envious of the ability to go out into the wasteland EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: How the heck are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're bad. I don't think I should talk to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是坏蛋。我不想和你说话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you like being bad? Or is it just you can't help it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想当个坏蛋？还是你身不由己？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I bet you're so bad because your mom didn't love you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我打赌你这么坏，是因为你妈妈不爱你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've heard of you. You're one of the good guys!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说过你。你是个好人！

ESP.ORIGINAL: It makes me feel safer knowing you're around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这让我觉得更安全了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're my hero, mister. I want to be just like you when I grow up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是我的英雄，先生。我希望长大后像你一样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're my hero, ma'am. I want to be just like you when I grow up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是我的英雌，女士。我希望长大后像你一样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome back. Have you been successful in your search for books?
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎回来。你寻找书籍的任务成功了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've returned. Have you brought me any books?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你回来了。你给我带回些什么书？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank God someone's come! You have to help me! Please!
ESP.TRADUIT: 感谢上帝，有人来了！你得帮帮我！求求你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Initiate Pek [06019938] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've saved my life. I am in your debt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你救了我的命。我欠你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Initiate Pek [06019938] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am forever in your debt. Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我永远欠你。谢谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Initiate Pek [06019938] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're almost to the door, don't stop now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们快到门口了，别停下！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Initiate Pek [06019938] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep going, we're almost outside!
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续前进，我们就快出去了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Initiate Pek [06019938] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stay on point. We will back you up. It's the least we can offer you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 站那别动。我们会增援你。这是我们所能给你的帮助。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Hoss [06015502] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. He is safe. The Brotherhood are men of their word and so, here is your payment. Spend it well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好极了，他安全了。兄弟会是守信用的，这是你的酬劳。好好拿去花吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Hoss [06015502] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Farewell, mercenary. May you find honor in your travels.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回见，佣兵。在你的旅途中找到你的荣誉吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Hoss [06015502] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Speak with Paladin Hoss.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和圣骑士霍斯谈谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood of Steel Paladin [0601558E] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've got some serious stones walking through here by yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你得有两下子才可以自己一个人通过这。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just stumbled into town? You sure picked a fine day for it, with the crazies out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是误撞到镇子的？你确实挑了个好日子，和外边的疯子一起。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, have a drink on the house. Welcome to Canterbury.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，在屋里喝一杯。欢迎来到坎特伯雷。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm Joe Porter. I make sure folks around here can get a meal when they need it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是乔·波特。我要确保这的人们饿的时候能有东西吃。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hear you're my mysterious investor! With your help, I've collected quite a few toys for myself. But what good are toys if they aren't played with?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听说你就是我那神秘的投资人！多亏你帮忙，我为自己收集了一些很好的小玩意。但是如果不拿出来玩玩，这些玩意又有什么价值？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks to you I have so many, I could hardly play with them all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太谢谢你了，这么多，我都快玩不过来了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, I present to you a prize of the collection, a micro-nuke. Enjoy it in safety!
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以。这微型核弹就作为你帮我收集这些东西的报酬。在确定安全的情况下尽情享用吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: A wanderer without a weapon doesn't last long out there. Pick up the best now, while you still can!
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个手无寸铁的流浪汉在这可是活不长的。换上最好的装备吧 — 趁你现在还能做到。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here to shop? Have a look!
ESP.TRADUIT: 来采购？那就进来看！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hear you're the one who's so deeply invested in my junk. Not as deeply as me, of course, but who is, really?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说了，你就是那在我这杂货铺投资最多的人。当然，我还是最多的，舍我其谁呢，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I picked up some Stealth Boys the other day, and they seemed like just the way to thank you for your investment. Kudos!
ESP.TRADUIT: 前些天我偶然结识了几个隐身小子，他们好像要对你的投资表示感谢。令人称赞！

ESP.ORIGINAL: A friend with deep pockets is a friend indeed! Welcome to my shop!
ESP.TRADUIT: 俗话说得好：“皮夹鼓鼓的朋友才是真正的朋友”！欢迎光临我的小店！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, hey! Looking to buy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，嗨！想买点什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: My investor arrives at last. This line of work doesn't allow for much sentiment, but how could I not offer you some material token of my thanks?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的投资商终于出现了。干我们这行的不能感情用事，但对于你的帮助又怎能没有实质性的回报呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: In that case, here. The gift of health - rarely given in this day and age, but all too often taken...
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果是那样的话，拿好。以健康为礼物吧 — 这年头很少有人能给，相反，往往被剥夺……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Hoff [06063BF7] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Sinister EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looking for your fix? You came to the right man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想修东西？那你就找对人了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Hoff [06063BF7] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Slightly sinister EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here to see the good doctor? Excellent.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想找个好医生？太棒了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Hoff [06063BF7] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Sinister EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: And here you are! The spirits have blessed me with many gifts, but you have given the more marketable gift of monetary investment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你！神灵已经赐予了我诸多礼物，但是你给我带来的礼物更有市场价值的金融投资。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please accept this offering - a mask and helmet made from the hide of the wisest spirits of the wind. May it benefit you as fully as it has myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请收下这份礼物 — 由风灵之皮制成的面具和头盔。希望它能像庇护我一样庇护你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Searching for a friend out in the Wastes? No one is more reliable than a cold, hard skin of steel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想要在这片废土中寻找一个朋友？一块冰冷、坚硬的钢铁皮肤比任何人都可靠。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here to acquire a new mantle of metal or mesh? If you have the caps, I have the merchandise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要不要来件崭新的金属或者网状的披风？一手交钱，一手交货。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Crow [06063BF8] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Slightly spiritual EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome! Welcome back! What do you have for us today?
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎！欢迎回来！今天给我们带来了什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Daniel Littlehorn [0606F1F2] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E7]PerkContractKiller) Contract Killer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why look who it is! My favorite associate! Have you brought me what I need?
ESP.TRADUIT: 看是谁！我最爱的伙计！你带来我要的东西了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Daniel Littlehorn [0606F1F2] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E7]PerkContractKiller) Contract Killer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's you! We always have time for our favorite employee!
ESP.TRADUIT: 是你！我们总是有时间来接待我们最喜欢的职员。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Daniel Littlehorn [0606F1F2] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E7]PerkContractKiller) Contract Killer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I’m headed to Big Town. There’s good money to be made there. They ordered a ton of supplies, and now that it’s safe, I’m heading up there!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正准备去大镇。那很好赚钱。他们订了成吨的补给，既然那安全了，我立刻就去！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I’m headed to Big Town. There’s good money to be made there. They ordered a bunch of high power explosives!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正准备去大镇。那很好赚钱。他们订了好多高爆炸弹！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I’m headed to Big Town. There’s good money to be made there. They ordered a bunch of robot parts!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正准备去大镇。那很好赚钱。他们订了好多机器人零件！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I’m headed to Big Town. There’s good money to be made there. They ordered a few Stealth Boys.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正准备去大镇。那很好赚钱。他们订了一些隐身小子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I’m headed to Big Town. There’s good money to be made there. They ordered a bunch of firepower.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正准备去大镇。那很好赚钱。他们订了好多军火。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm heading up to Big Town to see what's left for the taking. I heard everyone up there was either killed or dragged off by Super Mutants.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正准备去大镇，看看还有什么剩余东西可以拿。我听说那的人不是被杀就是被超级变种人拖走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Finders keepers, am I right? Ha Ha...
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁找到归谁，我说的对吧？哈哈……

ESP.ORIGINAL: That thing would have killed us all without your help. Thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果没有你的帮助，那东西会把我们都杀了的。谢谢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Listen, you may as well take this map. That's where we were headed, but that Deathclaw cured me of my itch for Wasteland adventure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，你最好也拿着这地图。那是我们要去的地方，但是死亡爪打消了我们去废土冒险的念头。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good morning, sir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 早上好，先生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can I do for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能为你做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good morning, madam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 早上好，女士。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can I do for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能为你做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Saints alive! You've done it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 圣人复活了！你做到了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06003A78] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Quickly, let me have the ink and I will produce the copy of the Declaration of Independence!
ESP.TRADUIT: 快，给我墨水，我来做一张《独立宣言》的复制品。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06003A78] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here you are... a perfect copy. That should give ol' George something to think about.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你……一份完美的复制品。那可是老乔治想要的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06003A78] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are the next orders from the Congress?
ESP.TRADUIT: 国会的下个命令是什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06003A78] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't wait to add the Declaration to the Society's collection.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我等不及要将《独立宣言》纳入协会的收藏中了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm expecting great things from you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很看好你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: What wonderful artifacts have you brought me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么精美的文物带给我？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, have you decided to become a part of history and triumphantly return with the Declaration of Independence in hand?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你决定永垂史册，拿着《独立宣言》荣耀而归了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Quite an impressive collection, isn't it? Well don't be shy, have a look around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很令人印象深刻的收藏品，不是吗？别客气，到处看看。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Abraham Washington's the name... curator of this little slice of American History.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我叫亚伯拉罕·华盛顿……这一小片美国历史的管理人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Finally... freedom! True freedom! I cannot thank you enough for this gift.
ESP.TRADUIT: 终于……自由了！真正的自由了！我无以回报你的大礼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have no idea how long I've pictured this moment in my mind... and it feels far better than I'd imagined.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你无法知道我在脑中幻想了这刻多久……而这感觉远比我想象中的还要好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, for my part of the bargain. Follow me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，轮到我执行约定了。跟着我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Finally... freedom! True freedom! I cannot thank you enough for this gift.
ESP.TRADUIT: 终于……自由了！真正的自由了！我无以回报你的大礼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have no idea how long I've pictured this moment in my mind... and it feels far better than I'd imagined.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你无法知道我在脑中幻想了这刻多久……而这感觉远比我想象中的还要好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We both know you're here to obtain the G.E.C.K. Now, follow me. I'll retrieve the G.E.C.K. for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们都知道你来这里是为了获得G.E.C.K.。现在，跟我来。我会为你取得G.E.C.K.。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there something amiss? The door still seems to be sealed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有些不对劲？这门看来仍旧锁着。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Back so soon? What is it now? Come to gawk at the caged animal?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这么快就回来啦？现在干嘛？傻傻地看着笼中困兽？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Standing around all day chit-chatting isn't going to help you track down my android. Is it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 整天站在那说废话，是无法让你帮我追踪到我的人造人的，不是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : impatient and annoyed EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks to you, we finally have that sniper, Arkansas, in a collar! You have no idea how many good men that prick put into the dirt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你，我们终于抓住那阻击手阿肯色并给他戴上了项圈！你不知道有多少好手在他手里入了土。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : encouraging the player to keep enslaving people EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm tempted not to sell him, just so we can torment him. Use him for target practice or something. Hehehe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真不想卖掉他，这样我们才能折磨他。用他来练习打靶或做其他事。呵呵呵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : encouraging the player to keep enslaving people EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's another collar. Keep those hoochies rolling in and you'll be rich in no time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你另一个项圈。继续努力让私货来得源源不断，很快你就会变得富有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : encouraging the player to keep enslaving people EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: How the hell'd you get old queen Flak, into that collar?! I'm surprised you're still alive!
ESP.TRADUIT: 见鬼，你是怎么拿下“高炮”弗莱克，并给他戴上项圈的？我很惊讶你还活着！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : encouraging the player to keep enslaving people EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: We need to keep a close eye on that one, though. He knows our system too well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可是我们要密切注意那家伙。他很了解我们的系统。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : encouraging the player to keep enslaving people EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: He sold us out to get into Rivet City. We'll never forget that. And now we'll make sure he never forgets it, either.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他出卖了我们才进入铆钉城。我们永远不会忘记。现在我们要让他也永远忘不了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : encouraging the player to keep enslaving people EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's another collar. Keep herding the swine in here and you'll have more bottle caps than you'll know what to do with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是另一个项圈。继续努力赶猪，瓶盖会多到你花不掉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : encouraging the player to keep enslaving people EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've been wanting to get Red in here for a long time. I have a little something special planned for her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在这等着抓瑞德很久了，我对她有些特殊想法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : encouraging the player to keep enslaving people EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take another collar, and keep those puppies coming!
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着另一个项圈，继续努力抓那些狗崽！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : encouraging the player to keep enslaving people EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Susan thought she could just up and leave, huh? We showed her different, didn't we?
ESP.TRADUIT: 苏珊认为她拍拍屁股就能走人？让她看看结果多么不同，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : encouraging the player to enslave more people EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: She'll think twice about slitting one of our throats now that she's collared! We'll need to come up with something extra special for her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在她被戴上了项圈，就会重新考虑是否要切开我们的喉咙了！我们得想出点特殊待遇招呼她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : encouraging the player to enslave more people EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's another collar. You're a welcome addition to our little operation here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你另一个项圈。欢迎加入我们的小买卖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : encouraging the player to enslave more people EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hold it right there. Nobody's allowed into Paradise Falls except on Slaver business. And I get to decide what qualifies as Slaver business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 站住。堕落天堂只允许从事奴隶买卖的人进入。而我来决定什么是奴隶买卖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You didn't really think you could just sneak into Paradise Falls did you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不是真的以为你能潜入堕落天堂，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do I look like someone who wants to be your friend? Are you a moron? Why do you keep coming around? Piss off already!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看上去像是想要成为你朋友的人吗？你是傻瓜吗？为什么还跟着来？你早就可以滚了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : doubtful EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unless, have you changed your mind? Do you want to take me up on the offer of employment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 除非，你改变了主意？你想接受我提供的工作吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : doubtful EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're here with some Quantum, I have caps with your name on them!
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你有量子版核子可乐，我就有印有你名字的瓶盖！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please, tell me you have some of the good stuff. I need that Quantum!
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜托，告诉我你有些好东西。我需要量子版核子可乐！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh! I hope you're here with some Quantum!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦！我希望你有量子版核子可乐！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh my gosh oh my gosh oh my gosh! Did you find any Quantum?
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊！天啊！天啊！天啊！你找到量子版核子可乐了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh! Did you need something else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦！你要些别的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well? What do you think? Will you take my offer?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你怎么看？你会接受我的提议吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As promised... here is a little pick-me-up. An Ice Cold Nuka-Cola! Just look at the frost on the bottle. So cold and delicious!
ESP.TRADUIT: 照约定……这是一点提神饮料。一罐冰镇核子可乐！看瓶子上的霜。很凉很可口！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pardon me... I tend to lose myself when I hold onto a Nuka-Cola.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不好意思……当我喝核子可乐的时候会迷失自我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Before I get to the little proposition I have for you let me tell you a little bit about Nuka-Cola Quantum.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我给你小提议之前，让我先稍微介绍下量子版核子可乐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, you ready to hear me out? I have a bit of a proposition for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你准备听我说了？我有个小提议。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But before I get to that, let me tell you a little bit about Nuka-Cola Quantum.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但在我开始前，让我先稍微介绍下量子版核子可乐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bringing me some Quantum I hope?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想，给我带些量子版核子可乐？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060388E1] (ID) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks for getting me out of there. I owe you one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你把我从那里救出来，我欠你一个人情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601569E] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now you get back in there and make sure Penny stays safe. I'll try and contact her sometime, if I can. I need to lay low for a while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在你回那去确认佩妮的安全。如果可以的话，过段时间我会试着联系她。我需要保持低调。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601569E] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks for getting me out of there. I owe you one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你把我从那里救出来，我欠你一个人情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601569E] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Listen, there are kids in there. You've gotta get them out too, if you can. Just be careful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，那还有些孩子。如果可以的话，你得帮他们也逃出来。但小心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601569E] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm gonna lay low for a while. As soon as they realize I'm gone, they're going to come looking for me. Thanks again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要保持低调。当他们发现我跑掉后，会来找我的。再次谢谢你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601569E] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks for getting me out of there. I owe you one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你把我从那里救出来，我欠你一个人情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601569E] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm gonna lay low for a while. As soon as they realize I'm gone, they're going to come looking for me. Thanks again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要保持低调。当他们发现我跑掉后，会来找我的。再次谢谢你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601569E] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I gotta get someplace safe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我得找个安全的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601569E] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601569E] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So what's the deal, mungo?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么回事，毛人？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Squirrel [06015686] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I guess this is one way to do it. We could've escaped, you know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想这能行。你知道，我们能逃出去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: If we're going to leave, then let's get it over with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我们要走，那就先让我们搞定它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you gonna take care of that guard, or what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会把那些守卫收拾掉，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Squirrel [06015686] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My hands are tied here. It's not like I want to be working with a mungo like you, but I got no choice. Come on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的人手不足。我可不想和你这样的毛人合作，不过我没得选择。来吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Squirrel [06015686] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh God, mister. You gotta help us. You gotta get us out of here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，天啊，先生！你要帮助我们，你得帮我们逃出这！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh God, lady. You gotta help us. You gotta get us out of here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，天啊。小姐，你要帮助我们，你得帮我们逃出这！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: This place is a whole lot quieter, now. Thanks, I guess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在这地方安静多了，大概要谢谢你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601FF12] (ID) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got nothing to say to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和你无话可说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601FF12] (ID) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, whaddya know? It worked! I mean, I was pretty sure it would, obviously.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好啦，你知道什么？它工作了！我的意思是，我早就肯定它行，很明显。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take a few radiation Chems with you. I'm sure you'll run into more in the future.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来，带些抗辐射药品。我肯定你以后会需要更多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you're alive... That's the good news. But there was a little side effect. A teeny, tiny, um, mutation. But it seems to be benign, at least.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还活着……真是好消息。但有些副作用。小小的、极小的、呃……突变。但至少，看上去是良性的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take a few radiation Chems, as my little way of saying, "I'm sorry I twisted your DNA like a kitten with a ball of yarn."
ESP.TRADUIT: 来，带些抗辐射药品。这是说表示“很抱歉我把你的DNA像小猫玩毛线球一样弄糟了”的方法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, I even stitched a little smiley-face in you, to keep up your spirits. It's kind of hard to see from your side, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，我甚至在你身上缝了个小笑脸，来提起你的精神。虽然从你的角度很难看到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take this environment suit of mine. It will help with medical tasks, and it should help prevent the effects of exposure, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来，拿着我的野外套装。它会在医学任务里帮上忙，而且还能防止核泄漏的影响。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, hey! Watch your step, I think one of my test subjects got loose. But don't worry, it's probably harmless.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，嗨！留神脚下，我好像丢了一个试验对象。但别担心，它应该没危险。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide Comment (NAM2) : distracted, preoccupied with her own musings EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, hey! Kinda busy here, but I guess I can talk for a bit. What's up?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，嗨！现在有点忙，不过我想还能聊会，什么事？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide Comment (NAM2) : Sounding upbeat and energetic EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, don't mind the smell. I was just testing a few chemicals, but it's perfectly safe to breathe. Really!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，别在意臭味。我在试验一些新的化学药品，但这气体很安全。真的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's up? Anything interesting out there in the wild Wasteland?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么了？在废土荒野有什么有趣的事吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: How's it going out there in the Wastes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 废土现在怎么样了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can follow us as far as GNR. But keep your head down if you don't want it to get blown off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能跟我们一起去银河新闻电台。但如果你不想脑袋开花的话，就把头低下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps Comment (NAM2) : to the player - slightly annoyed EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's it to be? A few caps to find out where your father went? Or are you going to have a go of it on your own?
ESP.TRADUIT: 想干嘛？花几个瓶盖来打听你父亲的去处？还是你准备自己去找？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Wasteland can be such an unforgiving place...
ESP.TRADUIT: 废土可是一片无情的地方...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You enjoy being a "recruiter" for Paradise Falls, eh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来你很乐意成为堕落天堂的“招募员”，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : chummy EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's another collar and some caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是另一个项圈和一些瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : chummy EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: The slaves keep rolling in. Keep this up and you're going to be rich!
ESP.TRADUIT: 把奴隶源源不绝地带来。继续努力，你会变得富有！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : approving EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your caps and another collar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的瓶盖和另一个项圈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : approving EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tallied the last slave you sent us. You're pretty good at the slaving thing. Keep it up!
ESP.TRADUIT: 算上了你交给我们的最后一个奴隶。你很擅长奴役嘛。继续努力！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : approving EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's another collar and pile of caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是另一个项圈和一堆瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : approving EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep it up. We all make a ton of caps on every slave you send to us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续努力！你交给我们的每个奴隶都让我们赚到大量瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : approving EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your cut and another collar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你那份和另一个项圈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : approving EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please be seated in the nearest available Tranquility Lounger. Thank you for your cooperation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请就座于附近空置的宁静巷催眠舱上。谢谢你的合作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Robobrain [06014F82] (mod) Quest : ([06014E89]MQ03) Scientific Pursuits EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please take a seat in the Tranquility Lounger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请找个宁静巷催眠舱就座。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Robobrain [060500B8] (mod) Quest : ([06014E89]MQ03) Scientific Pursuits EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome to Vault 112, Resident! According to sensors, you have arrived 202.3 years behind schedule.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎来到112号避难所，居民！根据传感器，你比预计到达时间晚到了202.3年。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Robobrain [06014F82] (mod) NPC : Robobrain [060500B8] (mod) Quest : ([06014E89]MQ03) Scientific Pursuits EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please re-dress in your Vault-Tec issued Vault suit before proceeding.
ESP.TRADUIT: 行动前请重新穿戴你的基于避难所科技的避难所服装，如果你找不到你的服装，我有权给你再发套新的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Robobrain [06014F82] (mod) NPC : Robobrain [060500B8] (mod) Quest : ([06014E89]MQ03) Scientific Pursuits EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once dressed, please proceed down the stairs to the main floor so that you may enter your assigned Tranquility Lounger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 穿戴完毕后，请由台阶下至主楼层，以便你进入分配给你的宁静巷催眠舱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Robobrain [06014F82] (mod) NPC : Robobrain [060500B8] (mod) Quest : ([06014E89]MQ03) Scientific Pursuits EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please dress in your Vault 112 suit. Remove all other articles of clothing to prevent damage to the equipment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请穿上你的112号避难所服装。脱掉所有其他服饰物品以免阻碍与损坏设备。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Robobrain [06014F82] (mod) Quest : ([06014E89]MQ03) Scientific Pursuits EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you for your cooperation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢您的合作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Robobrain [06014F82] (mod) Quest : ([06014E89]MQ03) Scientific Pursuits EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please dress in your Vault 112 suit. Remove all other articles of clothing to prevent damage to the equipment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请穿上你的112号避难所服装。脱掉所有其他服饰物品以免阻碍与损坏设备。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Robobrain [060500B8] (mod) Quest : ([06014E89]MQ03) Scientific Pursuits EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you for your cooperation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢您的合作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Robobrain [060500B8] (mod) Quest : ([06014E89]MQ03) Scientific Pursuits EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I warned you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我警告过你！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess you're wondering where I'm going. I'm off to annex Old Olney and forge the New Republic of Dave! Don't try to stop me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是在想我要去哪里吧。我要去吞并老奥尔尼，并成立新戴夫共和国！别想阻止我！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah? What do you want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，你想要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dave [06029A98] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Snappy; he didn't win the election. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Out with it, Ambassador. This Republic isn't going to run itself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别胡闹了，大使。这共和国是不会自己运作的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stop right there, mister! Whatcha think you're doing in the Republic of Dave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 站住，先生！你知道你都在戴夫共和国做了什么吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stop right there, lady! Whatcha think you're doing in the Republic of Dave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 站住，小姐！你知道你都在戴夫共和国做了什么吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dave says you're okay? Fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 戴夫说你没问题？好吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, who are you? What do you want from the Republic of Dave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，你是谁？你想从戴夫共和国得到什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did Dave say it was okay for you to be here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 戴夫说过你可以在这吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well now... who could have ever thought? Me! President! Things are really going to be different around here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在……谁会想得到？我！总统！真的是变天了啊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Listen, I can't thank you enough. You convinced me that I could do this, and you were right. I want you to have something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我对你无比感激。你让我确信自己有这能力，我因此才能成功。我想你能得到些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dave kept some big weapon or something locked up in the safe in his office. The code is 1138.
ESP.TRADUIT: 戴夫办公室的保险箱里存放着某种大型武器之类的东西。密码1138。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's yours if you want it. We don't need it anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要你就拿去吧。我们不再有用了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just can't thank you enough!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不胜感激！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Things are going to be different around here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的是变天了啊！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bob as president? I don't know how I feel about that...
ESP.TRADUIT: 鲍勃当总统？我不知道自己会有什么感觉……

ESP.ORIGINAL: President Bob. Well, that's a change. I don't know if it's a change for the better though...
ESP.TRADUIT: 鲍勃总统。好吧，是个转变。我不知道这是不是朝好方向转变……

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard that Dave allowed you to stay. Well, welcome stranger. Just be mindful of the children.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听说戴夫允许你留下？那，欢迎你陌生人。留神孩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you? Is it okay for you to be here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？你可以在这出现吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you want now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你现在想要什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: So Dave gave you the okay, huh? Well, welcome then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么戴夫已经同意了，欢迎啊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I run the Museum of Dave, where the children of the Republic can learn about their heritage.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我经营戴夫博物馆，共和国的孩子在这可以学到传统。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dave doesn't like us talking to strangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 戴夫不喜欢我们和陌生人谈话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: President Daddy says that people from outside the Republic are bad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总统爸爸说共和国之外的人都是坏人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you really from the Wasteland? Wooooow!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真的是从废土来的吗？哇！

ESP.ORIGINAL: With the fuses in place, you should be able to access the mainframe. No need to come back to the control room; just head straight there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 接通保险丝后，你才能进入主机。不需要回控制室，直接去那边。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0001E7B3] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're doing great out there. Keep it up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你干得好。继续努力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0001E7B3] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So the pumps are working, and some of the doors are opened. We're making progress.
ESP.TRADUIT: 水泵工作了，一些门也打开了。我们进展不错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Problem is that the water shorted out a few key fuse boxes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问题在于水让一些关键的保险丝盒短路了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take these fuses and replace the ones that have burnt out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，拿这些保险丝去把烧掉的换掉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We can't accomplish anything until we can get inside, but none of us are particularly capable fighters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除非我们进到里面，不然我们什么都做不了，但是我们中没有能胜任战士工作的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hate to ask you to put yourself in harm's way, but you seem to have learned to handle yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我讨厌将你推入危险的境地，但看上去你懂得怎么处理。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need you to go in and make sure it's safe for Doctor Li and her crew.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要你进去确保李博士和她手下工作人员的安全。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here we are. Where it all began. You remember your mother's favorite passage?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们到了。一切开始的地方，你记得你妈妈最喜欢的那段吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Revelation 21:6. I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life, freely.
ESP.TRADUIT: 启示录21：6。我是阿尔法，我是欧米伽，我是初，我是终。我要将生命泉的水，白白赐给那口渴的人喝。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't you see? This is what it all means. The water, the purifier. THIS is the water of life. Your mother's dream.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看见了吗？这就是它的含义。这水，这净化器。这就是生命之水。你母亲的梦想。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No point in wasting time. Let's get to work. There's much to be done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别浪费时间了。我们开始工作，还有很多事要做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not trying to put you off, but we need to get to Project Purity. Anything else can wait until later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不想让你失望，但我们要前往净化工程，其他事都得等等。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My goodness... You must be James' daughter. You look so much like him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的天……你一定是詹姆斯的女儿。你看起来很像他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm surprised to see you here. He gave me the impression that you were... somewhere else, and that we wouldn't be seeing you again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 见到你在这我很惊讶。他给我的印象是：你在……某处，我们无法再次见到你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're here to talk to him, I'm afraid he's come and gone. The last I knew, he was headed back to the lab.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你来着是想和他谈谈，我恐怕他已经走了。据我所知，他回实验室了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My goodness... You must be James' son. You look so much like him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的天……你一定是詹姆斯的儿子。你看起来很像他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm surprised to see you here. He gave me the impression that you were... somewhere else, and that we wouldn't be seeing you again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 见到你在这我很惊讶。他给我的印象是：你在……某处，我们无法再次见到你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're here to talk to him, I'm afraid he's come and gone. The last I knew, he was headed back to the lab.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你来着是想和他谈谈，我恐怕他已经走了。据我所知，他回实验室了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need to reach Madison as soon as possible. Now I can make her see that Project Purity is worth finishing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要尽快见到麦迪逊。现在我能让她了解净化工程是否值得完成。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good to see you again, sweetie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴再次见到你，亲爱的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good to see you again, son.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴再次见到你，孩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you need?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello there, fellah! Good to meet you! Name's Smith, Jack Smith. Welcome to Andale, the best little town in Virginia!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，伙计！很高兴见到你！我叫史密斯，杰克·史密斯。欢迎来到安戴尔，弗吉尼亚最好的镇子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello there, young lady! Good to meet you! Name's Smith, Jack Smith. Welcome to Andale, the best little town in Virginia!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，女士！很高兴见到你！我叫史密斯，杰克·史密斯。欢迎来到安戴尔，弗吉尼亚最好的镇子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello there, stranger! Good to meet you! Name's Jack Smith. I hear you've already met my wife. Sweet lady, isn't she?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，陌生人！很高兴见到你！我叫史密斯，杰克·史密斯。听说你已经见过我妻子了。温柔可人的淑女，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: But anyway, welcome to Andale, the best little town in Virginia!
ESP.TRADUIT: 总之，欢迎来到安戴尔，弗吉尼亚最好的镇子！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mr. Harris is nice to us, but he doesn't read the stories the same way that my daddy did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 海瑞斯先生对我们很好，但他讲故事的方式和我爸爸不同。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not really sure what happened. Mr. Harris said that our parents went away, and they won't be back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不太确定发生了什么。海瑞斯先生说我父母已经离开了，而且不再回来了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He says that he'll tell me more about it when I'm older but... I miss my mom and dad...
ESP.TRADUIT: 他说等我大些了再告诉我详细的事不过……我想念我爸和我妈……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mr. Harris is a lot like my dad. I never knew he could be so nice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 海瑞斯先生就像我爸爸。我从来没想过他会对我这么好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're new here, aren't you? Wow! I never get a chance to talk to the new people! Dad always takes care of them before I get a chance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是新来的，对吧？哇！我从没机会和新来的人讲话！爸爸总是在我有机会之前就全关照好他们了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, hello! Welcome to Andale! Winner of the best town in the USA contest!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好！欢迎来到安戴尔！美利坚合众国最佳城镇竞赛冠军镇！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why, hello there. I'd heard there was someone new coming. How can our little family help you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，你好。我已经听说有个新来的。我们的小家可以帮你什么吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Busy busy busy, a wife's work is never done!
ESP.TRADUIT: 忙忙忙，主妇的事永远做不完！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not sure why you'd come back here, but I'm glad to see you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不清楚为什么你回来这，但很高兴见到你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Little by little, each day, I'm trying to clean up the mess my family left.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一点一点，日复一日，我在努力处理我的家人留下的麻烦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh... hey! What do you need, young lady?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么……呃？我？你和我讲话吗？啊？你需要什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you want, square?
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉你真相，我很高兴那蠢货死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: To tell you the truth, I'm glad that fool is dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尤勒基负责这生意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Eulogy handles the business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？见到什么喜欢的了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, nothing personal, but if you need something, talk to the clown in the hat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再盯着我看，我就揍你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a mess. I hope you brought a lot of money with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是想把血都撒在我身上，还是想付钱给我来修好你？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you just going to bleed on me, or are you going to pay me to fix you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我喜欢看到跛足废物。对我来说你就像一堆移动的瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I love the sight of a limping Waster. You just look like a walking pile of caps to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看你跛成什么样了。你给“快刀”阿姨带瓶盖来了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well now, look at you limping in here like that. Did you bring some caps for Auntie Cutter?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你似乎过了几天好日子。几个瓶盖就可以把你修好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You look like you've seen better days. A few caps'll fix that up for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们经历了几次战斗，不是吗？那就是为何他们付给我这么多钱……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Been in a few fights, have we? Well, that's why they pay me the big bucks...
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么能比带有超多瓶盖，并负了伤的奴隶贩子更能吸引我的。但愿你也是那种类型的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just let me know if you need anything, and I'll do whatever I can to procure it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你是来谈生意的，我洗耳恭听。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <sighs> I'm sure that whatever you have to say is absolutely vital. So let's hear it.
ESP.TRADUIT: <叹气>我相信无论你要说什么都是至关重要的，说来听听。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What. Do. You. Want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要干嘛 ?

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look. I told you. My name's Forty. I'm not inclined to change it, so unless you've got something good to say, you'd best make it fast.
ESP.TRADUIT: 佐敦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey. Talk fast, they hate it when I talk to customers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨。讲快点。他们不喜欢我和顾客聊天。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Haha! Hello! I am Ymir!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈！你好！我是伊米尔！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey sorry, man. Let me get out of your way!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，不好意思，哥们。我给你让路！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa there. Easy, killer. I'm movin', I'm movin'!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇。别紧张，杀手。我走了，我走了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Heard about you. You're some pretty slick shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听说过你。你这狗屎。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Respect.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问候下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You look like a damn fool in that Vault Suit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你穿避难所套装太傻了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice! Did you get that monkey suit from the Brotherhood?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不错！你是从兄弟会那搞到这猴子套装的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, bro. Got nothin' to say to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不好意思，哥们。和你没什么好说的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, chica. Got nothin' to say to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不好意思，小妞。和你没什么好说的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep walkin'.
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't believe that Grouse let you in here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不敢相信是那葛劳斯放你进来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't think I won't throw your ass in the pens with the rest of the meat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别以为我不会把你和那帮菜鸟一起送进围栏。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't exactly look like you belong here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看上去不像是这里的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, seriously. Leave me alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，真的。不要管我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: *sniff* Smells like meat. Move on.
ESP.TRADUIT: *嗅* 像肉的味道。继续。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's it to be? A few caps to find out where your father went? Or are you going to have a go of it on your own?
ESP.TRADUIT: 想干嘛？想用些瓶盖来打听你父亲的去处？还是你准备自己去找？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Wasteland can be such an unforgiving place...
ESP.TRADUIT: 废土可是一片无情的地方...

ESP.ORIGINAL: No luck finding dear old dad? Can't say it surprises me. Wasteland's a big place. Maybe you need a drink.
ESP.TRADUIT: 找不到你亲爱的爸爸？我一点都不惊讶。废土可是很大的地方，或许你要杯喝的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're still standing here, and I can't think why. You know where your father went. Seems to me you ought to be out searching the Wastes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还站在这，我不知道还有什么理由。你知道你爸爸去哪了，我想你该到废土去找他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looks like you went and got yourself irradiated. Too bad for you, I'm off duty. Stop by the clinic in the morning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来你受辐射污染了。太糟了，我下班了。明天早上再来吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Doctor is off duty. Go away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 医生下班了，走开。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Boy, you're glowin' like a goddamn reactor core. You need help?
ESP.TRADUIT: 孩子，你身上发光像个该死的反应堆核心。需要帮助？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Girl, you're glowin' like a goddamn reactor core. You need help?
ESP.TRADUIT: 女孩，你身上发的光像个该死的反应堆核心。需要帮助？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the hell are you standin' there bleedin' on my floor for? If you need help, then ask for it, dammit!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你他妈干嘛站在我的地板上流血？如果你要帮助就说，见鬼！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't shoot! Please! Just tell me what you want!
ESP.TRADUIT: 别开枪！求你！你说你要什么吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Nervous. Very nervous. Used to be treated like crap. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, man... I'm glad to see you. Moriarty's been especially nasty lately and I need a friendly face.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，哥们……很高兴见到你。莫里亚蒂近来特别讨厌，我需要友善的面孔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Nervous but friendly. Used to be treated like crap. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dad used to say... oh, never mind...
ESP.TRADUIT: 爸爸常说……哦，算了……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Be careful, mister. My dad is right over there. Try anything, and I'll yell for him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小心，先生。我爸爸就在那。你敢对我怎样我就叫他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Be careful, lady. My dad is right over there. Try anything, and I'll yell for him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小心，小姐。我爸爸就在那。你敢对我怎样我就叫他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dad usually doesn't like when I talk to strangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 爸爸一般不喜欢我和陌生人说话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now I KNOW I've never seen you in Megaton before. Let me guess -- just passing through, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道我从未在核弹镇见过你。让我猜猜 — 你只是路过，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We get people tryin' to settle down here all the time. Anyway, if you're hungry, you came to the right place. What can I get you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 一直有人想在这定居。总之，你要是饿了，就算来对地方了。你要点什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey. What can I get you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，来点什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: So what'll it be today? We've got some noodles. And the Brahmin steak is pretty good, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 今天怎么样啊？我们有些面条。双头牛肉排也相当不错。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So what's it going to be?
ESP.TRADUIT: 想来点什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The noodle stand is closed right now. If you need something, talk to Leo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 面条摊现在关了。如果你要什么，和利奥说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, look. Another one of your pampered vault assholes. Look here, vault asshole -- I don't like you. Stay clear of me and we'll have no trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，看。又是个暴饮暴食的避难所混蛋。听好，避难所混蛋 — 我不喜欢你。离我远点，我们就不会有麻烦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you seen a radiphlange anywhere around here? I could really use one... ah, never mind. What can I get you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这附近见过电台投射器吗？我真的要用一个……啊，别介意。你要什么？ ?

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well goddamn. You're new, right? I've got to admit, the outfit's a little weird, but that's okay, that's okay. Name's Leo Stahl. It's a pleasure!
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死，你是新来的，是吗？我得承认，这套装有点怪异，但是没关系，没关系。我是利奥·斯塔尔。很荣幸！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well goddamn. You're new, right? Name's Leo Stahl. It's a pleasure! It's a pleasure! Yeah!
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死，你是新来的，是吗？我是利奥·斯塔尔。很高兴！真的很高兴！耶！

ESP.ORIGINAL: <sighs> It's you. I was hoping that you'd have moved on. What do you want?
ESP.TRADUIT: <叹气>是你。我还指望你走了。你要什么 ?

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey hey! Nice to see you! Everything okay? You doing all right? You need something? Come on, talk to me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，嗨！很高兴见到你！都好吧？干得不错吧？你需要东西？来吧，和我谈谈！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright! Good to see you again! What's new? Feel like having a drink? C'mon, let's talk!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧！再次见到你？有什么新消息吗？感觉想要喝一杯？来吧，我们谈谈 !

ESP.ORIGINAL: Heya! How's it going?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好！你好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good to see you're staying out of trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴见到你没惹麻烦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got my eye on you. Don't do anything stupid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我盯着你呢。别做蠢事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hi, I'm Maggie. I live with Billy. Billy Creel. Do you know him? He's not my dad or anything, but he takes care of me now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，我是玛姬。我和比利一起住。比利·克里。你知道他吗？他不是我爸爸或什么人，但是他现在照顾我。总之，我该走了，再见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you see Nathan, tell that man to get his ass back home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你见到内森，告诉他滚回家来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You seen Nathan anywhere around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你见到内森在附近什么地方吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hi there. I'm Nova. New to Megaton, huh? Do yourself a favor and keep walking. Some of us stay for a few days... and then it's five years later...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，我是诺瓦。刚来核弹镇，呃？为你自己好，继续赶路吧。我们当中一些人只想待几天……然后过去了五年……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Listen, I'm working right now. So make it quick, okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我现在正在干活。因此动作快点，好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just here to guard the goods. That's all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是来看守货物而已。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm here to watch over this stuff. Only touch what you've paid for, and we'll have no problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在这看守。只碰你付过钱的东西，那我们就会相安无事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got my eye on you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我盯着你呢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This place is so much better than Moriarty's. That place is just filled with scum.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这比莫里亚蒂那好多了。那都是人渣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pull up a chair if you want.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果需要就拉张椅子过来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey there, stranger. Talk to Leo if you need something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，陌生人。如果有什么需要就和利奥说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Always good to see a new face.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴见到新面孔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Leo's a nice guy, a bit twitchy, but nice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 利奥是个好人，他有点急躁，但是个好人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't mind Andy, he's just a busy guy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不用介意安迪，他只是有些忙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, you're back. We had feared both you and the G.E.C.K. were lost. Were you successful?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你回来了。我们还以为你和伊甸园创造器都完蛋了。你成功了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elder Lyons [060156E4] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hold it right there!
ESP.TRADUIT: 立刻站住。 !
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enclave Officer [06039634] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're supposed to be in that holding cell. You're not going anywhere!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你应该在传讯室里。你不能去任何地方！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enclave Officer [06039634] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a full complement of guards in the next room. As soon as I get them, you're going back to your cell. In a body bag, if necessary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 隔壁房间有一整队守卫。我一喊他们，你就只有回你的房间了。如果必要的话，用装尸袋拖回去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enclave Officer [06039634] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you insist on making things difficult?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么坚持要把事情复杂化？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colonel Autumn [06019A1F] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe I should start shooting. How much blood you think you can afford to lose before you tell me what I want to know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许我该开始射击。你考虑过在你告诉我我想知道的东西前，有多少血能流吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colonel Autumn [06019A1F] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you really think we would fall for that? I have had ENOUGH of your games.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真的以为我们会上当？我受够你的把戏了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colonel Autumn [06019A1F] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I should have killed you right away. We have the G.E.C.K., we'll get the code. We don't need you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我应该宰了你。我们拥有了伊甸园创造器，我们会得到密码。我们不需要你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colonel Autumn [06019A1F] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, you're awake.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你醒了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colonel Autumn [06019A1F] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's keep this nice and simple. You're going to tell me the code for that Purifier, and you're going to tell me now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们文明点。告诉我净化器的密码，立刻告诉我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colonel Autumn [06019A1F] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would surely have perished if it wasn't for Mister Tenpenny and his tower.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果不是特佩尼先生和他的大厦，我肯定早就死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would surely have perished if it wasn't for Roy Phillips and his tower.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果不是罗伊·菲利普斯和他的大厦，我肯定早就死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, Crowley is dead, eh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 考利死了，呃？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your pay. Now, don't spend it all in one place, unless that place is Tenpenny Tower.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的酬劳。现在，别在一个地方花光它，除非那地方是特佩尼大厦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fancy that! A visitor. I seldom get visitors. Which is a tiresome shame because I'm usually relentlessly bored out of my right mind!
ESP.TRADUIT: 有趣！一个来访者。我很少接待来访者。那很烦人，我经常被无情地打乱正常思维。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : flamboyantly bragging EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: All of these confounded people fluster about like I'm made of eggshells and about to fall to pieces at any moment. I'm surprised they even let you in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所有这些糊涂蛋都很惊恐，好像我是蛋壳做的，随时都会掉在地上摔成碎片。我很惊讶他们居然让你进来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : flamboyantly bragging EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: So what do you think of my fine tower here? It's quite the jewel of the Wasteland isn't it? I daresay I'm quite proud of it myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得我可爱的大厦怎么样？它真是废土上的一粒宝石，对吧？我为此感到自豪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : flamboyantly bragging EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome to New Urban Apparel. I carry the finest in Pre-War clothes. Hurry up, let's get you out of those old rags and into something fabulous!
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎来到新都市服装店。我有最好的战前衣服。快点，把这些破抹布脱了换上漂亮的新衣服！ !
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : snobby merchant EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hurry up, let's get you out of those old rags and into something fabulous!
ESP.TRADUIT: 快，让我们把你这身旧抹布换掉，换身动人的！ !
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : snobby merchant seeing a potential sale EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm off duty. Come back when... ah, what the hell. Let's just get it over with. I'm Doctor Banfield, what do you need?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我下班了。等……啊，见鬼。让我们搞定它。我是班菲尔德医生。你需要什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You look hurt. It's a good thing you've come in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来你受伤了。你来对地方了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know you. You're that girl. You know, the one that... whatever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你，你是那女孩，你知道，就是那……随便是谁吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Michael Hawthorne [060156D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : His voice trails off as if he's lost his train of thought. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Happy Holidays! Care for a drink?
ESP.TRADUIT: 假日快乐！来杯喝的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shakes [00017A03] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : bartender offering a drink EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah yes. Mister Burke is expecting you. He is waiting for you on the balcony.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，是。伯克先生正期盼与你见面。他在阳台等你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : bored guard/receptionist EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mister Tenpenny isn't taking callers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 特佩尼先生正在会客。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : bored guard/receptionist trying to brush off an unwanted visitor EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm on duty. Can't talk. Direct your security concerns to Chief Gustavo directly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在工作。别说话。你的安全问题直接去找古斯塔沃长官。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not here for your entertainment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是在这陪你玩的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was so weird! All of a sudden the ants went nuts and started fighting each other.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太不可思议了！这些蚂蚁突然变得发狂并开始互相厮打起来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was like they were totally crazy! It was really scary, but kinda cool at the same time, ya know what I mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 看上去它们完全疯了！真恐怖，不过同时也很酷，你懂我意思吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was so weird! All of a sudden the ants went nuts and started fighting each other.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太不可思议了！这些蚂蚁突然变得发狂并开始互相厮打起来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was like they were totally crazy! It was really scary, but kinda cool at the same time, ya know what I mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 看上去它们完全疯了！真恐怖，不过同时也很酷，你懂我意思吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on! Tell me already!
ESP.TRADUIT: 来吧！告诉我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you change your mind or something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你改变了主意还是怎么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, don't just stand there. You're distracting me. I must calculate the most efficient way to get to my equipment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，别站在那，你在分散我注意力。我必须算出拿到我的设备的最佳方案。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, don't just stand there. You're distracting me. I must calculate the most efficient way to get to my equipment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，别站在那，你在分散我注意力。我必须算出拿到我的设备的最佳方案。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, so much for celebrating.
ESP.TRADUIT: 庆典结束了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One of us is going to have to go in there and turn the damned thing on. And whoever does it isn't coming back out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们其中一人必须进去打开那该死的东西。无论是谁，必定有去无回。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not exactly how I imagined going out, you know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实我可不是这么想的，你懂吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, what should we do? Draw straws?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那，我们应该怎么办？抽签？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Before we get started, I wanted to let you know that my father and I have been talking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我们开始前，我想让你知道我父亲和我曾谈论过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Pride and I have decided that after all you've survived, you've done enough to be an honorary member of Lyon's Pride.
ESP.TRADUIT: “里昂斯的骄傲”和我一致决定，你经历过这么多，有资格成为“里昂斯的骄傲”的荣誉成员。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So congratulations. Membership comes with some privileges, including our Power Armor. You want the full suit, or the Recon armor?
ESP.TRADUIT: 恭喜你。成员有些特权，包括我们的动力装甲。你要全套动力装甲，还是一套侦察装甲？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks, friend. That was a narrow shave and no mistake. Probably would have eaten us or whatever those damned things do to people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢，朋友。那几乎是九死一生。或许我们会被吃或者被做些该死的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Listen, we got some water we can spare. Go ahead, you earned it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我们有一些备用的水。拿去，这是你应得的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whew. Thanks for the help. I thought I was a goner.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哟。谢谢帮助。我以为我死定了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You probably saved my life. Here, take this. You look like you may need it more than I will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许你救了我的命。来，拿着。你看起来比我更需要这。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where'd he come from? If you hadn't come along, that ugly brute probably would've eaten me, or dragged me off to wherever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他从哪来的？如果不是你来了，这丑陋的畜生已经把我吃了或者把我拖到哪去了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take this. It's the least I can do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来，拿着这。这是我唯一能做的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks, stranger. That thing would probably have killed me if it wasn't for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你，陌生人。如果不是你，这东西或许已经杀了我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wish I had more, but I want you to have this. And I won't take no for an answer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就这么点了，你都拿去吧。千万别拒绝。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't you look absolutely... miserable. Pull up a stool and lay down a few caps, tell Uncle Ahzrukhal all about it...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看上去真……不幸。搬张椅子，扔几个瓶盖，把这些全告诉阿祖卡叔叔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, what is it- Oh! Oh my! Someone new! I'm so sorry, you must think I'm terribly rude! Welcome! Welcome to Carol's Place! I'm Carol.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，那什么 — 哦！天啊！新来的！对不起，你一定觉得我很无礼！欢迎！欢迎到卡洛尔的地盘！我是卡洛尔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not much, I know, but it's mine! So, if you need anything, just let me know. Greta will get you any food you want, and I handle the rooms.
ESP.TRADUIT: 地方不大，我知道，但这是我的！那么，如果你需要什么东西，只要告诉我。想吃什么只管找葛丽泰，而我出租房间。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's so good to have someone new here, even if it is an ugly ol' smoothskin! I'm kidding! I'm just kiddin! Don't make that face! You'll love it here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这能见到新人真好，即使是丑陋的光皮肤！我开玩笑！开玩笑的！别拉长着脸！你会喜欢这的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Talk to Ahzrukhal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去和阿祖卡谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. Go talk to Ahzrukhal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。去和阿祖卡谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry. I'm on a break. I'll be back in a bit if you need some food.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起。我在休息。你如果需要食物我立刻回来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey. I saw you over there talking to Carol. She's friendly, isn't she? But don't you get any ideas about her. Got it? Good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨。我说你去那和卡洛尔谈了。她很友好，对吧？但是你不要打她任何主意。明白了？很好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, do you want something to eat?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在你需要什么吃的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，又是你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: ... ... huh? ... Ah! Jesus Christ! Don't... don't sneak up on me like that, the last fella... the last fella to do that damn near lost my arm.
ESP.TRADUIT: ……呃？……啊！耶稣基督！别……别这样偷偷接近我，最后一次这么做的伙计……最后一次这么做的伙计该死的差点废了我的胳膊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're new here, yeah... you must be, since you're actually talking to... talking to me... I'm Patchwork... or just "Patches" if... if you like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是新来这的，对……你肯定是，因为你现在正在和……和我说话……我是“拼盘”……或者就“补丁”，如果……如果你喜欢那样叫。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm... shit... I forget.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我……狗屎……我忘了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, hello, my boy! You've come back for more stories from ol' Quinn, have you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你好，小子！你来是想从老奎因这听更多故事的，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, hello, my girl! You've come back for more stories from ol' Quinn, have you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你好，女孩！你来是想从老奎因这听更多故事的，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Didn't you hear me? Leave us alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你没听到吗？离我们远点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well look who's back. What can I do you for, smoothskin?
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看谁回来了。我能为你做点什么，光皮肤？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you see that? Charon just shot Ahzrukhal!
ESP.TRADUIT: 看到了吗？卡隆刚向阿祖卡开枪！

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the fuck happened?
ESP.TRADUIT: 发生他妈什么事了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's so weird here without Ahzrukhal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿祖卡不在这太蹊跷了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I still can't believe that Charon shot Ahzrukhal. I never saw that one coming.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还是不敢相信卡隆向阿祖卡开枪了。我从未想到会发生这样的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know, Ahzrukhal was a bastard, but I kind of miss him...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要知道，阿祖卡是个杂种，但我有点想念他……

ESP.ORIGINAL: There are a lot more of us down here than there are of you, smoothskin. You just behave yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这下面，我们的人比你们多多了，光皮肤。放老实点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well done! You have defeated the vile AntAgonizer, and you've brought back her suit so that we may destroy the last taint of her villainy!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好极了！你打败了卑劣的痛苦蚁后，而且你拿回了她的套装，我们能毁掉她罪恶的最后一个污点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Mechanist [06036C1B] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hand it to me, and I'll make sure that no one else can ever bear the mantle of the foul AntAgonizer!
ESP.TRADUIT: 把它给我，我保证再也没有人会再次受到这肮脏的痛苦蚁后的阴影笼罩。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Mechanist [06036C1B] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You had best hand over the AntAgonizer suit. It's too dangerous to let it fall into the wrong hands.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好把痛苦蚁后的套装给我。让它落入别有用心之人手中就太危险了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Mechanist [06036C1B] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit Comment (NAM2) : Stern EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh man! Did you see it? Did you see it? The AntAgonizer was all like, "Fear me!" But the Mechanist was all, "Stop, evil-doer!"
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，哥们！你看到了没！你看到了吗？痛苦蚁后都像在喊“怕我吧！”，但是机械侠好像都在喊“住手，恶棍！”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Derek Pacion [06031EC7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit Comment (NAM2) : (quickly) with extreme excited EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whew! You wouldn't believe how much trouble those two have caused in this town. We've been looking for someone to get rid of them for a long time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哟！你不会相信那两个家伙在这镇上惹了多少麻烦。长久以来，我们一直期待有人出现除掉他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Uncle Roe [06031EC9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit Comment (NAM2) : Warm and hearty

ESP.ORIGINAL: But you just walked in and cleaned up the town, easy as you please! We're in your debt, that's for sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但你就这么走进去，然后解决了镇子的麻烦，就像玩似的！我们欠你的，真的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Uncle Roe [06031EC9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit Comment (NAM2) : Warm and hearty EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm mayor of Canterbury Commons, think of me as your own Uncle Roe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是坎特伯雷社区的镇长，把我当成你自己的罗伊大叔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Uncle Roe [06031EC9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit Comment (NAM2) : Warm and hearty EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: And take this, as our thanks for cleaning up the town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后拿着这，当作你解决镇子麻烦的酬谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Uncle Roe [06031EC9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit Comment (NAM2) : Warm and hearty EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whew! You wouldn't believe how much trouble those two have caused in this town. We've been looking for someone to get rid of them for a long time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哟！你不会相信那两个家伙在这镇上惹了多少麻烦。长久以来，我们一直期待有人出现除掉他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Uncle Roe [06031EC9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit Comment (NAM2) : Warm and hearty

ESP.ORIGINAL: But you just walked in, downed one, and drove off the other, easy as you please! That'll be the last we see of them, you can be sure of that!
ESP.TRADUIT: 但你就这么进去，干掉一个，赶走另一个，跟玩似的！这是我们最后一次见到他们，肯定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Uncle Roe [06031EC9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit Comment (NAM2) : Warm and hearty EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm mayor of Canterbury Commons, think of me as your own Uncle Roe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是坎特伯雷社区的镇长，把我当成你自己的罗伊大叔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Uncle Roe [06031EC9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit Comment (NAM2) : Warm and hearty EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: And take this, as our thanks for cleaning up the town.
