ESP.TRADUIT: 然后拿着这，当作你解决镇子麻烦的酬谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Uncle Roe [06031EC9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit Comment (NAM2) : Warm and hearty EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Glad to see you're finally awake. I can't believe they made you do that stupid ceremony.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴看到你终于醒来。我不敢相信他们居然要你参加那种愚蠢的仪式。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They listen when I talk, but they don't hear... you know what I mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说，他们听。但是他们听不进去……懂我意思吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: By insulting the Tree Father, you've insulted us all. You are no longer a guest here. I'd advise you to leave immediately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你侮辱“树之父”就是侮辱了我们所有人。你不再是这的客人。我劝你立刻离开。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any chance the Wasteland had for recovery someday is now gone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 能让废土有朝一日恢复生机的唯一机会就这么消失了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please... I wish to be alone right now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜托，我现在想一个人待会。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please, drink the sap from the basin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请吧，喝下池中的汁液。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is it you wish to talk about, my friend?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要说什么？我的朋友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Daddy... why... [crying]
ESP.TRADUIT: 爸爸……为什么……[呜]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06025093] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mommy... why... [crying]
ESP.TRADUIT: 妈妈……为什么……[呜]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06025093] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you realize what you’ve done? You’ve triggered the Failsafe! Ruined everything! The subjects will die, and I’ll be stuck here in this hell! Alone!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道你干了什么？你启动了故障保险！毁了这的一切！实验对象会死！我会被孤独地困在这地狱里！！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Betty [0602449C] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've ruined everything! EVERYTHING!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你毁了一切！一切！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Betty [0602449C] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Remember what I told you. The Failsafe. You've got to find it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 记住我告诉你的。故障保险，你得去找到它！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060244A2] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: What... What the hell is this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么……见鬼，这是什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602449F] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not quite what I had in mind. But you get a chance to try again. Go to it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不如我想的那样。但是你有机会再试一次。去吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Betty [0602449C] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane Comment (NAM2) : disappointed EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's good to see you back. But you'd better get to the lab right away, and report to Elder Lyons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴见到你回来。但是你最好立刻赶去实验室，向里昂斯长老报到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Bael [060B875B] (mod) NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) NPC : Elder Lyons [060156E4] (mod) NPC : Scribe Rothchild [060156EA] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, but I really don't have time to talk right now. Perhaps Scribe Jameson could help you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很抱歉，但我真的没空聊天。或许詹姆森文士能帮你？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Enclave seems to have developed advanced plasma-based weaponry. I need to analyze our Power Armor...
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来英克雷已经研发了进阶电浆武器。我需要分析我们的动力装甲……

ESP.ORIGINAL: What I wouldn't do to get my hands on one of those Enclave vertibirds...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我怎么都想逮到一架英克雷飞鸟……

ESP.ORIGINAL: All this time spent acquiring technology, and we look like cavemen next to the Enclave. That is not acceptable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 耗费了这么多时间来研发技术，但和英克雷比起来，我们看起来就像穴居人。这不能接受。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Super Mutants, Enclave -- they all bleed the same. No worries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 超级变种人，英克雷 — 他们一样会流血。别担心。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome to the Citadel. Just remember -- you're a guest in our home. I expect you to behave yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎来到五角大本营。请记住 — 你是我们的客人。我希望你遵守规矩。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome to the Citadel, friend of Steel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎来到五角大本营，钢铁兄弟会的朋友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You ever seen a Super Mutant's head explode? Hell of a mess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你见过一个超级变种人的脑袋爆炸吗？那真是恶心得一塌糊涂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hear those Enclave soldiers are equipped with Plasma weapons. Lucky bastards.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说那些英克雷士兵装备了电浆武器。幸运的杂种。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will serve the Citadel and Elder Lyons until my dying breath. Is there any better life?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会为五角大本营和里昂斯长老效忠至死。还有比这更好的人生吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Long live Elder Lyons!
ESP.TRADUIT: 里昂斯长老万岁！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Glad to see you and that egghead Li made it here in one piece. I heard what happened at that purifier. Hell of a thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴见到你和书呆子李安全到了这。我听说净化器那的事。真是见鬼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Initiate! You've got a lot of nerve to interrupt... Oh, my apologies, stranger. I thought you were one of these worthless Initiates.
ESP.TRADUIT: 新兵！你得鼓起勇气……哦，对不起。陌生人。我还以为你是那些没用的新兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I swear, these kids'd be lost without me here to powder their asses.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我保证，要是没有我照料的话，这些孩子早就完蛋了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hail. Name's Greg -- Greg Bear. Most of the guys just call me Kodiak.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好。我叫格雷格 — 格雷·贝尔。大多数人都叫我科迪亚克。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Heard about that mess over at the purifier. Don't you worry -- you're safe here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听说了在净化器那的混乱。但你不必担心 — 在这你很安全。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How may I serve you, friend of Steel?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能怎么帮你，兄弟会的朋友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: "If we value the pursuit of knowledge, we must be free to follow wherever that search may lead us."
ESP.TRADUIT: “如果我们珍惜对知识的追寻，那我们必须任由研究引领我们前进。”

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found that in an ancient book. The words of wisdom of one of the greatest men of the former civilization.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在一本古书里面发现这个的。出自以前文明的一位伟人的智慧语言。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Elder sent word of your arrival. I am Scribe Peabody. Welcome, et. cetera...
ESP.TRADUIT: 长老说过你要来。我是文士博迪。欢迎，诸如此类……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, I'm really very busy. Is there something you needed?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在我真的很忙。有什么你需要的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you want, outsider?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要什么，外来者？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I salute you, warrior. You walk among us, but apart from us. How may I aid you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 向你致敬，勇士。我们理想相同，却不得不分道而行。我能怎么帮你？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great job kid!
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得好，孩子！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : giving player special item to keep him safe from monsters EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take this mask. It'll keep you safe from the Ferals. Just don't get too close to them, or they'll sniff you out. Don't forget to PUT IT ON!
ESP.TRADUIT: 来，拿着这面具。这会保护你避免受到凶悍僵尸的攻击。只要别靠他们太近，就发现不了你。别忘了戴上它！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : giving player special item to keep him safe from monsters EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't hurt me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 别伤害我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shakes [00017A03] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : in the middle of an attack against his town EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Help us!
ESP.TRADUIT: 救救我们！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shakes [00017A03] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : in the middle of an attack against his town EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the status on those Tenpenny bigots?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些特佩尼偏执狂现在怎样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well kid, what've you accomplished?
ESP.TRADUIT: 孩子，你完成了什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the word at Tenpenny, kid?
ESP.TRADUIT: 特佩尼那有什么消息，孩子？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm really not in the mood, so leave me alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在心情不好，所以离我远点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : cranky and dismissive EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your constant need to chatter is pressing on my optic nerve.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我受不了你没完没了的唠叨了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : mildly annoyed EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : mildly annoyed EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have a curious look about you. I presume you have something interesting to tell me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的样子真奇怪。我想你有什么趣事要告诉我？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : hoping his time isn't going to be wasted EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Leave me alone! Me and Bob have better things to do than speak to a murderer!
ESP.TRADUIT: 走开！我和鲍勃才不要和杀人凶手说话！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now go away, never come back!
ESP.TRADUIT: 滚开，再也不要回来！

ESP.ORIGINAL: So what's the deal? You gonna get me some Sugar Bombs or what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么交易。你要给我一些糖麦弹还是什么？ ?

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're not... not here to try and steal my secrets are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你……你不会在想偷走我的秘密吧，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I like these guys, they let me play with their pucks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我喜欢这些人，他们让我玩他们的冰球。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, I may be just a Winger now, but I'll make Centre soon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，我或许现在只是个边锋。不过我不久就能成为中场。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, we've got practice. Maybe we'll cross sticks again one day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，我们要训练。或许有朝一日我们会有机会切磋球技。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh my, it's you. I-I wasn't expecting visitors all the way out here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，是你啊。我……我可没想到在这会有远道而来的来访者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My name's Agatha. What brings you to my home?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我叫阿加莎，是什么风把你吹到我家来了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: My my my. You certainly do look a little bit worn out from your travels.
ESP.TRADUIT: 喔喔喔，看上去你的旅途很艰辛啊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, just look at my terrible manners! I'm Agatha. It's so nice to meet you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，看我多没礼貌！我是阿加莎，很高兴见到你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, what brings you all the way out here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是什么风把你吹到我这来了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you decided to find me a violin?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你决定帮我找小提琴了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Quick! Unlock the door!
ESP.TRADUIT: 快！开门！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : very scared and in a desperate hurry EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've got to get this door unlocked!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你得把门打开！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : very scared and in a desperate hurry EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: We can talk back at Big Town. Let's get out of here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们回了大镇再说。我们快离开这！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : nervous and wanting to be home EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll feel better once we're safe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等安全了，我会觉得好些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : nervous and wanting to be home EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank God! Who are you? Never mind, I don't care right now. Let's go get Red and get out of here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢天谢地！你是谁？别在意，现在我不关心这。我们离开这去找瑞德！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : surprised to be rescued EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on, you've got to untie me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 来吧，给我解开绳子！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : desperate to be rescued EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks! Who are you? Never mind, I don't care right now. Let's go get Red and get out of here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢天谢地！你是谁？别在意，现在我不关心这。我们离开这去找瑞德！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : barking orders EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You lead. I'll follow. Let's go! Move it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你带路，我跟着。我们走！快点！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : barking orders EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: No more talking! Let's get out of here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 别说了！我们离开这！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : angry his rescuer wants to stop and chat in an unsafe place EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the hold up?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还在等什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : angry and scared that his rescuer wants to stop and chat in an unsafe place EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks for helping us. I just hope we can survive another attack. Probably won't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你帮助我们。我只是希望我们能在下次进攻中活下来。可能不会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where's Red?
ESP.TRADUIT: 瑞德在哪？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : concerned for his friend, where is she? EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Guess we can try living with the Ghouls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我们能试着和僵尸一起生活。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : praising in hopes of getting something in return EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope those Ghouls try to get along with us civilized people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望那些僵尸不要打扰我们这些文明人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello, hello!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，你好！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : glad he has someone to talk to finally EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm mighty appreciative of your straightening things out. Perhaps next time I go on safari I'll take you along.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我非常感激你把事情妥善处理了。或许下次旅行我会把你带上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there something you require?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么你需要的东西吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you for dealing with those Ghouls. You're a real hero.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你帮我们处理了那些僵尸。你是个真正的英雄。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : self important snob showing uncharacteristic genuine appreciation EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks for helping those Ghouls. They really aren't so bad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你帮助了那些僵尸。他们真的不坏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : self important snob showing uncharacteristic genuine appreciation EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey... you're the one with the Ghoul friends... well I guess they're our friends now, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨……你是那个僵尸的朋友……我想现在他们也是我们的朋友了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Michael Hawthorne [060156D6] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : high class alcoholic EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good job removing our little pest problem!
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得好，帮我们清理了害虫！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156D7] (ID) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : Can you close this, there will be no Pretend in Combat for wander... EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have nothing to say to you. Except this: Watch your back!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没话和你说，除了这句：小心！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156D7] (ID) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : self important snob confronting the person who ruined his life EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hrmph.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156D7] (ID) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : self important snob confronting the person who ruined his life EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You did it! You got rid of those vile creatures! Good show!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你做到了！你赶走了那些卑劣的生物！干掉漂亮！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Millicent Wellington [060156D8] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : self important snob congratulating the player EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll get yours soon enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很快你会得到你应得的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Millicent Wellington [060156D8] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : self important snob confronting the person who ruined her life EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goodbye!
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Millicent Wellington [060156D8] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : self important snob confronting the person who ruined her life EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello friend. Ghoul physiology is fascinating!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，朋友。僵尸的生理机能真令人着迷！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : self important doctor showing genuine appreciation EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello friend!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，朋友！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : self important doctor showing genuine appreciation EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those Ghouls won't be bothering us anymore, will they?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些僵尸不会再打扰我们了，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lydia Montenegro [060156DA] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : self important snob congratulating the player EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lydia Montenegro [060156DA] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : self important snob glad to see the player EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come to pour salt into the wound? Well, I won't stand for it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 想在伤口撒盐？我可受不了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lydia Montenegro [060156DA] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : self important snob confronting the person who ruined her life EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Zombie-lover!
ESP.TRADUIT: 丧尸迷！！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lydia Montenegro [060156DA] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : self important snob confronting the person who ruined her life EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fabulous!
ESP.TRADUIT: 难以置信！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : self important snob glad to see the player EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You think I want to talk to you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得我想和你说话？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : self important snob confronting the person who ruined his life EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've ruined my life!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你毁了我的生活！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : self important snob confronting the person who ruined his life EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey comrade! Those Ghoul's seem like a real community, hey? Adversity must have made them strong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，同志！那些僵尸看起来是个真正的公社，对吧？曾经的不幸一定让他们变得很强。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Irving Cheng [060156DC] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : (naively) self important man showing genuine appreciation EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey there!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156DE] (ID) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : self important snob showing genuine appreciation EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take a real good look, because you won't be getting any of this!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好好看一看，因为你不会得到任何东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156DE] (ID) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : self important prostitute telling off a jerk EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hah! I'm doing just fine, no thanks to you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！我也能做得同样好，不用谢你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156DE] (ID) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : self important prostitute telling off a jerk EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do YOU want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156DE] (ID) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : self important prostitute telling off a jerk EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Glad to see you were able to convince these people to open their minds a little. Those Ghouls will liven things up around here for a long time!
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴看到你能说服这些人稍微开放点他们的思想。那些僵尸会让这里很长时间都有生气的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : jovial EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it'll take a little elbow grease but then this place will be a true home!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这会费些体力，但之后这会变成一个真正的家！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bessie Lynn [0601DC18] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : looking on the bright side EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bastards. Could have done it the easy way and just let us live here with them. Oh well. Guess we better get started with the clean up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 杂种。可以让事情更简单的，让我们和他们一起生活。哦，算了。我想我们最好开始把这弄干净。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601DC19] (ID) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : scoffing at the massacre EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't know how you did it. I'd never allow those zombies room and board. But as long as Tenpenny keeps paying me I'll stay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不知道你是怎么做到的，我是永远不会允许给那些丧尸提供食宿。但只要特佩尼继续付我钱，我会留下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : gruff mercenary begrudging respect to an adversary EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good job handling those zombies!
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得漂亮，处理了那些丧尸！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : soldier greeting a fellow EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's up? Kill any more zombies lately?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么事？最近杀丧尸了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : soldier greeting a fellow EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey soldier!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，士兵！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : soldier greeting a fellow EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey. We grabbed this on our last mission. Thought you might like it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨。上次任务我们拿了这。我想你可能喜欢它。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A badass like you, you deserve a cut of everything around here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你个混蛋，这里所有的东西都该有你一份。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take it. It's yours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着，这是你的了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Check this out. Me and a couple of the boys thought you could use a cut of the loot we picked up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看这。我和几个兄弟认为你该得到一些我们战利品的分成。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have my condolences. Your father was a good man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请接受我的哀悼，你父亲是个好人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elder Lyons [060156E4] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8C]MQ06) Picking Up the Trail Comment (NAM2) : sympathetic EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: May I start by saying that I am sorry for your loss. I was acquainted with your father, many years ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对你的遭遇我非常难过，让我先说声抱歉。很多年前我就熟悉你的父亲了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Rothchild [060156EA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8C]MQ06) Picking Up the Trail EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The world has lost one of its few remaining visionaries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 世界又失去了一位为数不多的梦想者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Rothchild [060156EA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8C]MQ06) Picking Up the Trail EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't you have something to do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就没有要做的事？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you get past the guard? What do you want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么通过守卫的？你要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I haven't heard anything about Mister Crowley recently. So what could you possibly want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我目前还没有听到考利先生的任何消息。你又想知道些什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's the key. He never even noticed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是钥匙。他不会注意到的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cherry [0602AE21] (mod) NPC : Fantasia [0602AE20] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry, you'll get the hang of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别担心，你会掌握怎么使用它的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602FDCF] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here are some more BBs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这还有些BB弹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602FDCF] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're having trouble, try crouching to steady your aim.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果有麻烦，试着弯腰瞄准你的目标。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602FDCF] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go ahead. Try out your new gun on those targets over there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去吧。试试你的新枪，靶子在那。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602FDCF] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard how you helped out Timebomb. I'm not sure why you did it, but thanks. I only hope that he lives long enough to appreciate your help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说过你怎么帮助“定时炸弹”逃走。我不知道你为什么这么做，不过谢谢你。我只希望他能活到能感谢你的那天。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, did you need something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow. I can't believe that you were able to help Timebomb. And here I was sure that you were ready to just let him die. I guess I had you wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇。我不敢相信你能帮助“定时炸弹”。我本以为你一定会看着他死。看来我错看你了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He still can't fight, but if we survive for a bit longer, he should be back into it soon enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他还不能战斗，但是如果我们能再坚持一段时间，他应该能很快恢复战斗力。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, you're a better doc than me, that's pretty obvious. But if you need healing, I'll do it for you no charge.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，很明显你的医术比我高超。但是如果你需要治疗，我可以免费提供。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Woah, looks like you've seen some action. Do you need help?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，看起来你见过些大场面。你要帮助吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, pal. What's up?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，伙计。你好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Things are looking good here, bud.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这一切顺利，朋友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Watch the Wastes. Keep track of movement. Uh, what? Did you need something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 看着废土。跟上节奏。什么？你需要什么吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dusty [060288BC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Dusty chants the first two lines to himself, like a personal mantra. The last line is him snapping out of it and greeting the player. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whew! I thought I was a goner. You saved my life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哟！我还以为我死定了呢。你救了我的命。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take this. It's the least I can do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来，拿着这。这是我唯一能做的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello, stranger. I'm Tinker Joe, premier supplier of robotic parts and service throughout the D.C. Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，陌生人。我是廷克·乔，首都废土的机器人零件和服务的主要供应商。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you! Whoever you are, thank you! The... things they talked about doing to me...
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢！不管你是谁，谢谢！他们正商量要干掉我……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you, friend. We won't forget this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你，我的朋友，我们是不会忘记的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shh. Not too loud. I don't really want people to know that we're doin' business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘘。轻点。我可不想让别人知道我们在做交易。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Smiling Jack [060824AB] (mod) Quest : ([06028930]GenericRaider) 06028930 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There rest of these guys around here might not want anything to do with you, but I got no problem with you... well, not with your caps at least.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其余那些家伙或许不愿和你打交道，但我可不介意……至少不介意和你的钱打交道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Smiling Jack [060824AB] (mod) Quest : ([06028930]GenericRaider) 06028930 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, good to see you again. What do you need?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，很高兴见到你！需要些什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Smiling Jack [060824AB] (mod) Quest : ([06028930]GenericRaider) 06028930 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hear that you decided to speak to Ian regardless of my warnings.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说你无视我的警告，决定要和伊恩谈谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Be that as it may, I am still interested in what you conversed about. Did he come to a decision?
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论如何，我仍旧对你们谈话的内容感兴趣。他做出决定了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank God you came along when you did. I don't know what I might have done...
ESP.TRADUIT: 感谢上帝你赶来，我不知道自己会怎样做……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here. Take the gun. I don't want to find out what I'd do if I still had the gun when my father comes looking for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来，拿着枪。我可不想我父亲来找我时，我手里还拿着枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'd better get out of here. I'll try to meet you at the vault door. If I don't make it... good luck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好离开这。我会设法在避难所大门和你碰头，如果我不行的话……祝你好运。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We did it! My mom's gonna be okay! You're the best friend I've ever had, man!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们做到了！我妈妈安全了！你是我这辈子最好的朋友，伙计！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, I know it isn't much, but I want you to have my Tunnel Snakes jacket. Go ahead, take it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，我知道这不算什么，但拿上我的穴蛇帮夹克吧，给。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <bark>
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dogmeat [0606A772] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Slightly muffled bark, as if he's holding something in his mouth EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: RL-3 regrets to inform that you are obviously unfit to command, sir!
ESP.TRADUIT: RL-3很遗憾的通知您，先生，你无权命令我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Changed your mind about the job, yet?
ESP.TRADUIT: 对工作改变主意了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You did a good thing, delivering that component to Zimmer. Telling him the android was dead. For that, I'm going to entrust you with some information.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你做了好事，把零件给了齐默。告诉他人造人已经死了。为此，我会将一些信息委托给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The android's transformation was done by a man named Pinkerton, here in Rivet City. He's hidden down in the broken fore section of the ship.
ESP.TRADUIT: 人造人的改造是铆钉城一个叫做平克顿的人完成的。他藏在断裂的船头。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll need to swim to reach him, but if you're inclined, Pinkerton can perform a facial reconstruction on you as well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你得游过去找到他，但是如果你被他看中，平克顿也会对你进行面部改造。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It won't disguise your identity, but you'll be able to experience life in a new skin, and truly understand... that we're all human on the inside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那不会改变你的本质，但是你能用新面孔来体验生活，而且请理解……在我们内心，我们都是人类。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'd best not be seen speaking with each other further. If you want a new face, see Pinkerton, down in the flooded fore section of the carrier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们最好不要被人看见互相交流。如果你要张新面孔，去见平克顿，在航母被淹掉的船体前部。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The android's transformation was done by a man named Pinkerton, here in Rivet City. He's hidden down in the broken fore section of the ship.
ESP.TRADUIT: 人造人的改造是铆钉城一个叫做平克顿的人完成的。他藏在断裂的船头。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll need to swim to reach him, but if you're inclined, Pinkerton can perform a facial reconstruction on you as well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你得游过去找到他，但是如果你被他看中，平克顿也会对你进行面部改造。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It won't disguise your identity, but you'll be able to experience life in a new skin, and truly understand... that we're all human on the inside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那不会改变你的本质，但是你能用新面孔来体验生活，而且请理解……在我们内心，我们都是人类。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah! I made it to Big Town! Big Town! Hurray! Now I just need to find Red.
ESP.TRADUIT: 耶！我到大镇了！大镇！万岁！现在我需要找到瑞德。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : ecstatic EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go away! Hannibal is waiting for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 走开！汉尼拔在等你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alejandra Torres [060239D1] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State Comment (NAM2) : She'll be playing a cowering animation. EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are we going to do? Those Slavers have captured the Memorial.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们现在要去干嘛？那些奴隶贩子占领了纪念馆。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alejandra Torres [060239D1] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Oh! I didn't see you there. I get that way sometimes when I'm thinking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？哦！我没看见你在那。当我思考的时候我有时会过于专注。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alejandra Torres [060239D1] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excuse me, sir. I can't talk now. Slavers could be here any moment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，先生。我现在不能聊天。奴隶贩子随时会打进来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bill Seward [060239D2] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excuse me, ma'am. I can't talk now. Slavers could be here any moment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，女士。我现在不能聊天。奴隶贩子随时会打进来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bill Seward [060239D2] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't talk to strangers. You need to go talk to Hannibal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不和陌生人说话。你去和汉尼拔谈吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bill Seward [060239D2] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please, sir. Help us get rid of all those Slavers in the Memorial.
ESP.TRADUIT: 求求你，先生。帮我们把那些占领纪念馆的奴隶贩子赶走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bill Seward [060239D2] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State Comment (NAM2) : Very deferential EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please, ma'am. Help us get rid of all those Slavers in the Memorial.
ESP.TRADUIT: 求求你，女士。帮我们把那些占领纪念馆的奴隶贩子赶走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bill Seward [060239D2] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State Comment (NAM2) : Very deferential EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not now. We can talk after the Slaver attack.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在不行。等奴隶贩子攻击结束后我们再谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CF] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't you be stopping here, mister. You got to talk to Hannibal first.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别说了，先生。你先去和汉尼拔谈谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CF] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't you be stopping here, lady. You got to talk to Hannibal first.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别说了，小姐。你先去和汉尼拔谈谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CF] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've got to get those Slavers cleared out of the Memorial.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们必须把纪念堂里的奴隶贩子都消灭了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CF] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure Hannibal is cooking up a plan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我确信汉尼拔正在酝酿一个计划。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CF] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have a picture! And such a large one, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有张照片！好大的一张。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CF] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll have no problems restoring the Memorial with this. Thank you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 对我来说，用这来修复纪念堂一点问题都没有。谢谢！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CF] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Make it quick. I've got a lot of work to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 快点。我还有很多工作要做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CF] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those Slavers are all dead. We must stay vigilant. There may be more of them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些奴隶贩子都死了。我们必须保持警惕。可能还会来更多的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: We got wind that the Slavers are going to attack. We could really use your help in the fight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们得到风声，奴隶贩子准备攻击。我们在这场战斗中确实需要你的帮助。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hear you found a great picture for Caleb. Once the Memorial site is safe, we can move there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说你帮卡勒布找到张很棒的照片。只要纪念堂遗址安全了，我们就能到那去了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: So the Super Mutants are dead? This is wonderful news!
ESP.TRADUIT: 超级变种人死了？真是个好消息！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now all you have to do is get Caleb his picture and we can begin our journey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在你要做的就是帮卡勒布拿到他的照片，然后我们就能开始我们的旅程。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We made it! The Memorial is really ours! I cannot thank you enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们成功了！纪念堂是我们的了！我真不知道该怎么感谢你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take this. It's a token of our thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来，拿着这。这代表我们的谢意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have been good to your word. You are welcome at the Temple of the Union anytime.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你言而有信。欢迎你随时来到团结圣殿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take these schematics as a token of our gratitude.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着这些设计图，这是我们给你的谢礼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I killed them all after telling you not to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，在叫你别动手之后，我把他们都杀了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just couldn't trust anyone else to do it. I needed to see them dead with my own eyes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是不能信任其他人去做。我要亲眼看他们死掉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyway, the problem has been taken care of. I can go back to Paradise Falls now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总之，问题解决了。我现在能回堕落天堂了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll make sure they know you're our kind of people. You'll be welcome there any time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会让他们知道你是我们一伙的。那随时欢迎你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there something else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有什么事吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's your business stranger?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么事，陌生人？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239D0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State Comment (NAM2) : Suspicious EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: You again. Don't dawdle. Get in here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 又是你。别浪费时间。快进来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239D0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: You ain't supposed to be looking at me, to say nothing of talking to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不该找我，更别说和我谈话了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239D0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, beat it! Hannibal is waiting for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，快去！汉尼拔在等你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239D0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goddamn Slavers have the Memorial.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死的奴隶贩子占领了纪念堂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239D0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: As soon as Hannibal gives the word, we're going to charge in there and take it from them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要汉尼拔一声令下，我们就去进攻那，把它从他们手里夺回来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239D0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stay sharp. The Wasteland is dangerous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 保持警惕。废土很危险。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239D0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't look like much, stranger. Bet you run from Radroaches.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看上去不是很像，陌生人。我打赌你看见蟑螂都会跑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239D0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State Comment (NAM2) : Emphasis on MY. EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm Simone Cameron. Don't fuck with me. Hannibal says I can't shoot you, but I ain't trusting you with a gun to my back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是西蒙妮·卡梅隆。别和我对着干。汉尼拔告诉我不能对你开枪，但你在我身后拿着枪令我不舒服。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239D0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State Comment (NAM2) : Emphasis on MY. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you trying to piss me off?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想把我惹火？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239D0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State Comment (NAM2) : Emphasis on TRYING. EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's close enough. What the hell are you doing wandering around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真够悬的。见鬼，你在这游荡做什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Silas [00027FAF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State Comment (NAM2) : Suspicious EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard you're going to help us get those runaways.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说你准备帮我们抓住那些逃跑的家伙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Make it quick. I'm busy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 快点，我很忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey! It's my favorite wanker! I am so fucking glad I talked you out of putting a bullet in my brain. Hah ha!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨！是我最喜欢的卑鄙家伙！我他妈的真高兴，打消了你要把子弹打进我脑袋的想法，哈哈！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Loud and boisterous, overly so EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey! It's my favorite bitch assassin! Hah ha! I am so fucking glad I talked you out of putting a bullet in my brain!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨！是我最喜欢的婊子刺客！哈哈！我他妈的真高兴，打消了你要把子弹打进我脑袋的想法！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Loud and boisterous, overly so EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I presume you are still honoring our previous arrangement? I enjoy being alive, at least for the moment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜你还在为我们先前的安排而自豪？我很高兴还活着，至少现在是。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's always good to see one of our number here. Have you brought tales and trophies of justice?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真高兴在这见到我们的一员，你带来了正义的传说和战利品吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sonora Cruz [0606F211] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E8]PerkLawbringer) Lawbringer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Regulators welcome you back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 赏金猎人欢迎你回来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sonora Cruz [0606F211] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E8]PerkLawbringer) Lawbringer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The unrighteous will be punished.
ESP.TRADUIT: 邪恶将被净化。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sonora Cruz [0606F211] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E8]PerkLawbringer) Lawbringer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We bring law to a lawless land.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们把法律带到了无法无天的土地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sonora Cruz [0606F211] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E8]PerkLawbringer) Lawbringer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We are justice. We are the law.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们就是正义，我们就是法律。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sonora Cruz [0606F211] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E8]PerkLawbringer) Lawbringer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stay true to yourself and to the law. This is the rule of the Regulator.
ESP.TRADUIT: 保持诚实，遵守法律。这是赏金猎人的宗旨。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sonora Cruz [0606F211] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E8]PerkLawbringer) Lawbringer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, according to this, you're in line to be trained as a Laundry Cannon Operator. First time for everything, indeed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 根据结果，你接下来要受训成为一名洗衣机操作员。凡事总有第一次。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CFB7] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looks like the diner's going to get a new Fry Cook. I'll just say this once: hold the mustard, extra pickles. Ha ha ha.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来我们的餐厅要有一个新厨师了。我只说一次：去芥末，多腌汁。哈哈哈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CFB7] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Huh. I wonder who will be brave enough to be your first customer as the vault's new Tattoo Artist? I promise it won't be me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃。我很怀疑谁够胆成为你这避难所的新纹身艺师的首个顾客。我保证那不会是我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CFB7] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I'm not looking to rumble with you. How about we just stay out of each other's business, like usual.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我不想和你吵架。我们像往常那样井水不犯河水怎么样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CE26] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect Comment (NAM2) : surprised you're talking to him -- you and he have an uneasy truce worked out EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goodbye. We'll miss you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见。我们会想你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good riddance. Get out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 感谢上帝，你要走了。快出去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess you can see how bad things are down here. Sorry, where were we going?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你能看到这下面发生了多糟的事。对不起，我们这是要去哪？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060C09D5] (ID) NPC : [06027057] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Make it quick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 快一点儿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060C09D5] (ID) NPC : [06027057] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, if it ain't a fellow Tunnel Snake, slumming it down here with the old crew?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，如果他不是穴蛇帮一伙的，就用老规矩在这把他干掉？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought you'd be out there tearing up the Wasteland and raising Hell!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以为你在外面把废土搅得一塌糊涂呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront

ESP.ORIGINAL: But if you've gotta be back, might as well make yourself useful. You gotta help us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是如果你必须回来，就得让自己有点用。你必须帮助我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope you're making progress with my father. I can't imagine anyone else who would convince him we should venture outside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望你和我父亲之间有进展。我不能想象还有其他人能说服他让我们出去闯荡。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [0602549E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, another patient! What's it to be, eh? Appendectomy? Tonsillectomy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，又一个病人！想治疗什么，呃？阑尾切除？扁桃体切除？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Andy [06074163] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hysterectomy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 子宫切除？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Andy [06074163] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, if it isn't my star pupil.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那不是我的明星学生嘛。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mr. Brotch [0603D347] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: <yawn> What?
ESP.TRADUIT: <哈欠>什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The pulse charge is rigged? Excellent! Excellent!
ESP.TRADUIT: 脉冲充电器安装好了？好极了！好极了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : in rapture with the knowledge something disgusting is being destroyed by an atom bomb EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah. The anticipation is palpable. Isn't it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊。和预料的一样，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : in rapture with the knowledge something disgusting is being destroyed by an atom bomb EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When you have finished savoring the moment, you may have the honor of pressing the button. Oh, and mind your eyes. It'll be brighter than bright.
ESP.TRADUIT: 品味完这瞬间，我把按动按钮的荣誉给你。哦，小心你的眼睛。这会非常刺眼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : in rapture with the knowledge something disgusting is being destroyed by an atom bomb EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The detonator is right over there. You may have the honor. Hit the switch!
ESP.TRADUIT: 按钮就在那里。这是你的荣誉。按下开关！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do it! Detonate the bomb and together we'll usher in a new age of prosperity!
ESP.TRADUIT: 干吧！引爆这核弹，让我们一起进入一个繁荣新时代！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My God... what transcendent beauty... what purifying light...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的天啊……多么超凡的美丽……多么纯洁的光芒...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : heartfully congratulating the player for a job well done EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahem... Allow me to collect myself, as I'm sure you're anxious to collect your payment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯……允许我调整下自己的情绪。因为我想你肯定急着想拿到你的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : heartfully congratulating the player for a job well done EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've been asked to extend to you an invitation to reside at Tenpenny Tower.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我收到要求邀请你在特佩尼大厦居住。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : heartfully congratulating the player for a job well done EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's the key, and deed, to your new master suite. It's on the top floor, first door on your right from the elevator. Enjoy your new accommodations.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是钥匙还有地契，到你的新大套房吧。乘电梯至顶楼，右边第一扇门。好好享受你的新住处。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : heartfully congratulating the player for a job well done EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and if you wish to spruce the place up a bit, speak with Lydia Montenegro in the Boutique le Chic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，还有，如果你想让那整洁，就和时尚精品店的莉迪亚·黑山谈谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : heartfully congratulating the player for a job well done EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My God... what transcendent beauty... what purifying light...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的天啊……多么超凡的美丽……多么纯洁的光芒...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahem... Allow me to collect myself, as I'm sure you're anxious to collect your payment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯……允许我调整下自己的情绪。因为我想你肯定急着想拿到你的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's the key, and deed, to your new master suite. It's on the top floor, first door on your right from the elevator. Enjoy your new accommodations.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是钥匙还有地契，到你的新大套房吧。乘电梯至顶楼，右边第一扇门。好好享受你的新住处。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get the hell out of my face.
ESP.TRADUIT: 见鬼，离我远点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers Comment (NAM2) : very angry EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're going to continue to irritate me, I'm not going to be so nice about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你还要继续激怒我的话，我就对你不客气了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: What... Where am I? What happened?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么……我在哪？发生了什么 ?
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: How long have I been out?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我晕倒多久了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah? What is it? Ready to help?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？怎么？想要帮忙？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah? What do you want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，你想要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah? What do you want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，你想要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm afraid she's going to be out for a while. She's not well at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恐怕她会晕倒一阵。她的情况不太好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry though, I'm sure the rest of Reilly's Rangers will show up soon and take her home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尽管放心，我肯定剩下的莱莉游骑兵会立刻出现并带她回家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You sure know your shit. Ever consider joining the Rangers? I bet Reilly would love to have you on our team.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还挺能啊。考虑过加入游骑兵吗？我打赌莱莉会很乐意让你加入我们的队伍。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donovan [06029577] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I suppose thanks are in order... and a little something extra for your trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想先谢谢你……然后还有一点额外的谢礼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm going to head back to Ranger Compound and see if Reilly's back yet. If you make your way there, Reilly will pay you herself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我准备回游骑兵营地，看看莱莉是不是回来了。如果你去那里的话，莱莉会亲自给你报酬的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I can ever be of medical assistance or you need some supplies or repairs, let me or Donovan know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你需要药品援助、补给或修理，就告诉我或者多诺万。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome to... uh... the Capital Preservation Society.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎来到……呃……首都保护协会.

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hi. I'm Angela. My dad runs Gary's Galley. If you want anything to eat, let me know when you are ready to order.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨。我是安吉拉。我爸爸经营加里厨房。如果想吃什么，点餐的时候告诉我一声。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hi. I'm Angela. I run Gary's Galley. Let me know when you are ready to order.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，我是安吉拉。我经营加里厨房。准备点餐的话就告诉我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome to Gary's Galley. Can I take your order?
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎光临加里厨房。可以点菜了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lay a hand on Doctor Zimmer, and I'll snap your neck like a chicken bone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你敢动齐默博士一根汗毛，我就像拧鸡骨一样拧断你的脖子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's close enough. Keep your hands where I can see them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 够近了。把你双手放在我能看见的地方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The market is closing soon. You'd better make it quick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 市场很快就关门了。你最好动作快点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome to Potomac Attire. I am Bannon, proprietor and City Council member.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎光临波托马克服装。我是班侬，这的经营人和城市议会成员。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I carry discriminating attire for discriminating customers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我为不同客户准备不同的服饰。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard that Danvers found a letter from Slavers in Seagrave's room.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听说丹佛斯在西格雷夫的房间找到一份奴隶贩子寄来的信。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That will teach that bastard to mess with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看那杂种还敢不敢找我的麻烦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think you've earned a permanent discount here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你已经获得了这的永久折扣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome to Potomac Attire.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎光临波托马克服装。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I've seen you in here before. When you're ready to buy, just let me know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得之前有在这见过你。你什么时候想买了，就来找我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you found anything you like?
ESP.TRADUIT: 看中了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm Belle Bonny, and this is the Muddy Rudder.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是贝勒·邦尼，这是“泥舵”酒吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll tell you what I tell all the fresh meat. Don't start anything down here or I'll have Brock kick your ass.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把丑话说在前面。别在这找麻烦，否则我让布洛克给你好看。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm Belle Bonny, and this is the Muddy Rudder.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是贝勒·邦尼，这是“泥舵”酒吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll tell you what I tell all the fresh meat. Don't start anything down here or I'll have to kick your ass.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把丑话说在前面。别在这找麻烦，否则我会给你好看。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a new one. I'm Belle Bonny of the Muddy Rudder. Make it quick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是新来的吧。我是“泥舵”酒吧的贝勒·邦尼。动作快点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm Brock, the bouncer. I take care of the troublemakers. You aren't going to be a troublemaker, are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是保镖布洛克。我负责处理找麻烦的人。你不想找麻烦，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't tell me your problems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不想听你的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This place won't clean itself. That's my job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不会自己干净起来的。是我打扫的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I'm busy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我现在很忙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is A Quick Fix. I mean that's the name of our shop. Paulie and mine that is. My name is Cindy. Cindy Cantelli.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是快速修复。我指的是这商店的名字。我和保利的商店。我叫辛迪，辛迪·坎特利。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is A Quick Fix. I mean that's the name of the shop. My name is Cindy. Cindy Cantelli.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是快速修复。我指的是这商店的名字。我叫辛迪，辛迪·坎特利。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice to see you again. Are you looking for a quick fix?
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴再见到你。你需要快速修复吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Made up your mind yet?
ESP.TRADUIT: 想好了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not supposed to talk to strangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不应该和陌生人说话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, miss.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，小姐。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe you don't know who you're talking to. I'm Commander Danvers, assistant chief of security.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许你不知道你正在和谁说话。我是丹佛斯指挥官，警卫助理长官。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you seen Angela? I need to ask her something about our wedding.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你见过安吉拉吗？我需要向她询问我们婚礼的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh... never mind. I just remembered. Sorry. I'm so scatterbrained these days. What was it you wanted again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦……没关系。我记得了。对不起。我最近记性不好。你又是要什么来着？ ?

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're wounded. Let me bandage that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你受伤了。我来给你包扎一下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's almost closing time. I'd get out of here if I was you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 快关门了。如果我是你，我就离开这。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This here is Flak and Shrapnel's gun shop. Pretty catchy, huh? Take a look around. If you see anything you like, I'll be right over here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是“高炮”弗莱克和“榴弹”小帅的枪械店。很好记，呃？随便看看吧。如果看中什么，就去那找我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Decided to check out the shop, eh? If you want any of this shit, just holler.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想要在店里看看是吗？如果想要什么东西，叫我一声就行了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Made up your mind?
ESP.TRADUIT: 想好了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm Flak. If you want something better than that peashooter, stop by Flak and Shrapnel's.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是“高炮”弗莱克。如果你想要比那玩具枪好的武器，来“高炮”弗莱克和“榴弹”小帅的店里看看。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm Flak. If you want something better than that stick of yours, stop by Flak and Shrapnel's.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是“高炮”弗莱克。如果想要比你那棍子好的武器，来“高炮”弗莱克和“榴弹”小帅的店里看看。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm Flak. If you want a decent weapon, stop by Flak and Shrapnel's.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是“高炮”弗莱克。如果你想要件像样的武器，来“高炮”弗莱克和“榴弹”小帅的店里看看。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me introduce myself. I am Gary Staley gourmet chef and gourmand. I'll be preparing your meal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我先介绍下自己。我是美食家兼厨师长加里·斯塔利。由我来为你准备用餐。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My specialty is Mirelurk Cakes. Although the iguana is very popular too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的招牌菜是蟹人饼。蜥蜴类的也很受欢迎。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah! I knew you wouldn't be able to stay away from my cuisine for long.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊！我就知道你不久就会再来光临我的餐馆的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How may I serve you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 请问能为你做些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm Gary. Gary Staley. If you ever get hungry, stop by Gary's Galley.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是加里，加里·斯塔利。如果饿了，随时来加里厨房坐坐。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Make it quick. I'm on a tight schedule.
ESP.TRADUIT: 快点。我时间排得很紧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This isn't a good time. My daughter, C.J. is missing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在不合适。我女儿长江不见了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you hear anything, please let me know right away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你打听到什么消息，请立刻告诉我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This place could use a few more people willing to work. Everything is falling apart. I'm the only one willing to fix it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这可以多招几个愿意做事的人。一切都崩溃了，而我是唯一想要修复的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm busy. I've got a lot of repairs to make.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很忙。我有很多修理工作要做。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm scared. Will you take me home? Take me to my Mom.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很害怕。你能带我回家吗？带我去见我妈妈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm scared. Will you take me home?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很害怕。你能带我回家吗。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard Sister is dead. Thank God!
ESP.TRADUIT: 听说“修女”死了。太好了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd rather be alone just now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在还是让我一个人静一静吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wish I had the courage to end it all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望自己有勇气去结束这一切。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just taking things one day at a time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我每天就一次。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just leave me alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我一个人静静。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Haven't seen you in here before. Do you need a fix? I might have what you need. You can always come see Paulie to get what you need.
ESP.TRADUIT: 之前没见过你。需要修理吗？我说不定有你需要的。有什么需要随时都可以过来找保利。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you? Got any Psycho? I could really use a fix, but I'm broke.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是哪位？有疯狂药吗？我真想自己来一支，可我身无分文。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha ha! I run the chem shop, but I'm broke and can't buy chems!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈！我经营药店，却穷得买不起药品！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looking for a fix?
ESP.TRADUIT: 需要修理吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Make it quick, will ya? I'm coming down and I gotta get my fix.
ESP.TRADUIT: 快点，好不好？我到这来就是让你修一下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How the hell did you get in here? Hmph. I suppose you can't be all that bad if you made it this far without dying.
ESP.TRADUIT: 见鬼，你怎么进来的？哼。我觉得你既然能够活到现在，相信身手一定不错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : annoyed and telling the player to get on with it EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is the part where you tell me what the hell you are doing bothering an old man who obviously wants to be left alone... Get on with it already!
ESP.TRADUIT: 该你说说为他妈什么来打搅一个显然想独处的老人了……快点啊！ !
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : annoyed and telling the player to get on with it EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'd better get out of here. The guards are going to close up soon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好立刻离开，守卫要包围这里了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Howdy. I'm Seagrave. Seagrave Holmes. I have a little of just about everything here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好。我是西格雷夫，西格雷夫·福尔摩斯。我这什么都有点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey! I heard that Bannon got caught trying to frame me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨！听说班侬想要陷害我而被抓了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I also heard you ratted him out. I think you've earned a true, blue friendship discount.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还听说你出卖了他。我想你获得了一个真正的友情价。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You sneak into my room, steal my property, and then tell the world about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你潜入我的房间，偷走了我的财物，然后大肆宣扬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd ban you from my shop if they'd let me. Instead I'll just have to settle for ripping you off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他们同意，我会把你挡在门外。但我宁愿把你榨干。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take a look around. I got all kinds of stuff in here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好好看看吧。我这应有尽有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're going to close soon. You'd better get out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们就要关门了。你还是快点走吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They call me Shrapnel. I run this place. Got the best damn armament you'll ever see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们叫我“榴弹”小帅。我经营这地方。你在这可以见到最精良的装备。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shrapnel [060156B4] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Sarcastic emphasis on the word "you'll." EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you want any of this shit, just say so. Otherwise keep your fingers the hell away from the triggers. I don't want no accidents.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想要哪件烂货就说出来。否则让你丫的手指离扳机远点。我不想出乱子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't know you, don't care. Keep it short.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不认识你，也不想。有话快说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's your beef?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在抱怨什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm Tammy. Just leave me alone, okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧？你在等什么呢？赶快走，让我一个人静一静。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, good lookin'. How come you haven't bought me a drink yet?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，帅哥。为什么你不请我喝一杯？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shit. Just what this hole needs. Another woman.
ESP.TRADUIT: 狗屎。想什么来什么，又来个女人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Either buy me a drink, or take your skanky ass somewhere else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我买杯喝的，不然你就离我远点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome to the Weatherly Hotel. I'm your hostess, Vera Weatherly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎光临韦瑟利旅馆。我是女房主，薇拉·韦瑟利。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome back, ma'am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎回来，女士。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome back, sir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎回来，先生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Grayditch... it's burning... it's burning!
ESP.TRADUIT: 格雷蒂奇……它在燃烧……它在燃烧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060C47CA] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : stark raving mad EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: The slaves know their place now, thanks to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在奴隶知道他们的地位了，感谢你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Something else in you needing an answer?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还有什么需要答案的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ugh! It's bad enough the indignities you've put me through, must you continue to prattle on at me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 呸！你对我的无礼行为已经够过分了，你还要继续对我胡说八道么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No time to waste! Go deal with the Think Tank!
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有时间给你浪费了！快去处理那些思想体！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll see you at the Sink. Good luck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们在汇聚节点再见。祝你好运。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, it's you again. What do you want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，又是你，你想要什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice to see you back. I trust the adventuring is going well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴看到你回来。我想探险一定非常顺利吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, well, look who finally dragged themselves in out of the Wasteland. And where have we been, hmm? Crawling through pits of radioactive muck again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，好吧，看来有人终于把自己从废土之外拽回到这里了。我们去过哪儿，嗯？屈身在充满辐射的泥潭里爬行？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome home, Citizen! Find any seditious materials out there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎回家，公民！找到什么反动材料了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Book Chute Voice (NOT USED IN GAME) [0300F065] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah! Good day, Citizen! Library Processing Unit 232.7 is on-line and ready to eradicate sedition!
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊！日安，公民们！图书处理单元232.7已启动，随时准备铲除反动！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Book Chute Voice (NOT USED IN GAME) [0300F065] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've been seeing the other light switch, haven't you? Am I not enough for you any more?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你和另一个开关幽会去了是不是？你有我还不够吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Light Switch 02 Voice (NOT USED IN GAME) [0300F063] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hoi!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Katu Veo. Nayoo?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认识你。怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good evening, madam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 晚上好，女士。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can I do for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能为你做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: All better now, you big baby. Can I get back to work now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 全好了，你这大孩子。现在我能回去工作了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, you should be fine, and ready to run off and play.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好。你没事了，准备出去玩吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucy [06015696] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : Just woken up. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll say this; it's easier to work on a mungo, since you're a lot bigger. Easier to find a vein, at least.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会这样说：对付毛人更简单，至少，更容易找到血管。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucy [06015696] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : Just woken up. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now next time, try to be where the bullets aren't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 下次试着躲在子弹打不到的地方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There you go. All better, you big baby. You need anything else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 可以了。全好了，你这大孩子，你还有什么其他需要？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That should keep you going for a bit longer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那应该能使你多撑一阵了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Feel better? You should, that was the good stuff. Need anything else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 感觉好点了吗？你应该知道，这才好东西。需要别的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Back again? Jesus...
ESP.TRADUIT: 又回来了？天啊...

ESP.ORIGINAL: They never told us how expensive it was to get onto the Strip!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们从来没说过去一趟长街要花这么多钱！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [000FE89C] (file) NPC : Refugee [000FE89D] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I never should have left California.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就不该离开加利福尼亚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [000FE8A0] (file) NPC : Refugee [000FE8A1] (file) NPC : Refugee [000FE89B] (file) NPC : Refugee [000FE89E] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That son of a bitch Keith cheated me! I know he did!
ESP.TRADUIT: 基斯那个狗娘养的骗了我！我就知道是他！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [000FE89D] (file) NPC : Refugee [000FE89C] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You lose all your money too?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你也把钱全弄丢了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [000FE89E] (file) NPC : Refugee [000FE8A0] (file) NPC : Refugee [000FE8A1] (file) NPC : Refugee [000FE89B] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, you got a hit for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，能不能让我过过瘾？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't you be touching Keith's stuff!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要碰基斯的东西！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keith takes good care of us. Good care...
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯斯把我们照顾得很好。照顾得很好...

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have any luck with the Ghouls? I'm counting on you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你摆平那些尸鬼了吗？我全指望你了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The salvage business has really slowed down since those Ghouls took over REPCONN.
ESP.TRADUIT: 自从那些尸鬼霸占了瑞普康以后，废品回收业务就大受影响。

ESP.ORIGINAL: House selling out to the NCR? Who woulda figured him for a fink?
ESP.TRADUIT: 豪斯把我们卖给NCR了？谁能想到他居然是叛徒？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice to see a human palling around with a Ghoul. I see a lot of people around here avoid them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 人类与尸鬼和睦相处，这场面真温馨。我们这儿的多数人对他们可是避之不及呢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't want to join the Great Khans.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不想加入大汗帮。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Since Johnson won't be coming with us, you might as well take his suit of Power Armor. I'll teach you the basics of how to use it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 既然约翰逊不肯跟我们一起来，你把他那套动力装甲拿走吧。我会简单教你怎么用的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I appreciate you keeping Orion in the group. Since I won't be needing my armor - makes the cockpit a bit cramped - you should take it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你让厄里翁留了下来。我不需要护甲了——座舱里已经够挤了，你拿去吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It'll take a few hours to show you how to use it properly, so let's get started.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过要学会用这玩意可需要好几个小时，咱们马上开始吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I ain't got nothing for you to eat. If you're hungry, see Ruby Nash.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我这没有可以给你吃的东西。如果你饿了的话，就去找鲁比·纳什。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now you freed Deputy Beagle, all Primm needs is a law man who can shoot a gun without wetting hisself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 既然你救出了副警长比格尔，那么接下来普瑞姆也该再找一个开枪时不会尿裤子的执法官了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hear you aim to bring rule of law back to our town. God knows we need the help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听说你要帮助我们恢复秩序。我们确实需要帮忙啊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those soldiers you brought down on us is all business, stranger. Better than lawlessness, though. So you've got my thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你带回来的那帮士兵管得可真宽，陌生人。不过总比无法无天要好。所以还是谢谢你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This Sheriff Meyers you found for us is working out. Knows his business. We owe you a debt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你帮我们找来的这个迈尔斯警长已经走马上任了。他很专业。我们欠你一个人情。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll probably want to talk to Hayes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以去找海耶斯谈谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Never liked Bighorners.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大角羊真讨厌。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard Private Stone turned himself in for stealing medical supplies. We're all stressed out here, but stealing medical supplies is low.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听说列兵斯通自首了，就是他偷了医疗用品。我知道大家都有压力，但偷医疗用品就真的太缺德了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Knew those Ghouls were up to no good. Look where it got us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就知道那帮尸鬼干不了好事。瞧瞧这都是些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about you just do nice things for us. We liked those.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你其实可以只干好事。我们比较喜欢那样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm glad that I could start working here again, things were rough with those convicts in town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很高兴又能在这里工作了，自从那群逃犯流窜到这儿之后日子就很难过。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's important that you're relaxed for this next test. Please, have a seat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你只有保持放松，我们才能开始下一项测试。来吧，请坐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Mitchell [00104C0C] (mod) Quest : ([00104C1C]VCG01) Ain't That a Kick in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right. I'm gonna say a word. I want you to say the first thing that comes to mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。我先说一个单词。然后你告诉我你脑海中闪现的第一印象是什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Mitchell [00104C0C] (mod) Quest : ([00104C1C]VCG01) Ain't That a Kick in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dog.
ESP.TRADUIT: 狗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Mitchell [00104C0C] (mod) Quest : ([00104C1C]VCG01) Ain't That a Kick in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here. These are yours. Was all you had on you when you was brought in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你。这些都是你的。你被送进来的时候，身上就带着这些东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Mitchell [00104C0C] (mod) Quest : ([00104C1C]VCG01) Ain't That a Kick in the Head EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope you don't mind but I gave the note a look. I thought it might help me find a next of kin. But it was just something about a platinum chip.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看了一眼你的笔记，希望你别介意。我本来是想看看你有没有什么亲友，但上面只写了一则关于什么白金筹码的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Mitchell [00104C0C] (mod) Quest : ([00104C1C]VCG01) Ain't That a Kick in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here. These are yours. Was all you had on you when you was brought in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你。这些都是你的。你被送进来的时候，身上就带着这些东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Mitchell [00104C0C] (mod) Quest : ([00104C1C]VCG01) Ain't That a Kick in the Head EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope you don't mind but I gave the note a look. I thought it might help me find a next of kin. But it was just something about a platinum chip.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看了一眼你的笔记，希望你别介意。我本来是想看看你有没有什么亲友，但上面只写了一则关于什么白金筹码的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Mitchell [00104C0C] (mod) Quest : ([00104C1C]VCG01) Ain't That a Kick in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why did you do that? They were going to let us walk away. Why did you attack them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么要那样做？他们都要放我们走了。你为什么要攻击他们？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't care that they started it. What you did was inexcusable. You need to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管是谁先动的手，你做的事都是无法原谅的。你走吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Clearly you're determined to fight the Brotherhood. Well, you can add my name to your hit list because you're on your own.
ESP.TRADUIT: 显然你是决定和兄弟会为敌了。很好，把我的名字也加进你的黑名单里吧，从今往后你就自己干。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, sir, that's all the support I can spare today.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，长官，那是我今天剩下的全部物资。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get you a drink?
ESP.TRADUIT: 想喝点什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [00129550] (mod) Quest : ([00128588]VDialogueTops) Tops Dialogue EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wish more people had your kind of guts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果大家都能像你这么勇敢就好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You and me we're done traveling together. I want nothing more to do with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不想再和你结伴旅行了。我不想再和你扯上更多关系了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought there was a chance you'd change - not any longer, being a fucker is who you are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还以为你能改呢——但我不再这么想了，你就是个彻头彻尾的混蛋。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Guess my last warning didn't sink in too well. Things don't change, and soon, I'm gone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来我上次的警告没起什么效果。什么都没改变，再这样我就要走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are such an asshole sometimes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有时候真是混蛋透顶。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, maybe you were like this before I signed up with you, but if you keep acting this way, I'm not going to stick around much longer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，或许你在遇到我之前就是这样一号人，但如果你继续这种表现，我是不会再和你一起走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Farber is doing the best with what he's got, but man could I go for a nice cut of brahmin steak.
ESP.TRADUIT: 条件艰苦，法伯已经尽力了，但我还是想尝尝双头牛肉排。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Paperwork, paperwork, paperwork... It just never ends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 文书工作，文书工作，文书工作……没完没了的文书工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good thing I got stationed here and not at the Dam. I got connections because Major Dhatri's daughter married my nephew.
ESP.TRADUIT: 能在这儿呆着，不用被派到水坝上去，真是福气啊。全亏了我侄子娶了达特里少校的女儿，我才能有这样的门路。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're fighting for the NCR now? I don't know about that...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们现在给NCR卖命了？我都不知道...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jack [00140E6B] (file) NPC : Diane [00140E6D] (file) NPC : Regis [00140E70] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jack [00140E6B] (file) NPC : Diane [00140E6D] (file) NPC : Regis [00140E70] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the fuck are you looking at?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你他妈看什么呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Securitrons with faces like soldiers? Is this martial law or something? What the fuck?
ESP.TRADUIT: 电子保安怎么全换上大兵脸了？军事管制吗？到底怎么回事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your Ghoul wants to have some fun he can, we don't discriminate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你的尸鬼也想找乐子，我们不会歧视的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Tops is a real snooze fest. I hope they get some new shows soon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 九重天实在是让人打瞌睡。希望他们能尽快推出些新节目。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar's dead. So when do we go home?
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒已经死了。我们什么时候回家？

ESP.ORIGINAL: So tired...
ESP.TRADUIT: 太累了...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legion just came out of nowhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团不知从哪儿就冒出来了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I like you! Will you take Barnabas Bear to New Vegas when you go?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我喜欢你！你去新维加斯的时候能带上先知小熊吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: With Forlorn Hope's fall, our blades are at the NCR's throat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 既然攻陷了飘零希望营地，我们的利刃就架在NCR的脖子上了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That we hold Nelson, that is Caesar's will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们会守住纳尔逊，这是凯撒的意志。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll never get used to the sight of Ghouls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就是不习惯见到尸鬼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Move along, buddy. I have work to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让开，伙计。我有工作要做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Followers Guard [0015A81A] (file) NPC : Followers Guard [0015A81B] (file) NPC : Followers Guard [00124AFE] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a woman, and yet you wander free?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你一个女人居然还能四处乱逛？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's cramped in here, sure, but who really needs a fancy room, anyway?
ESP.TRADUIT: {Self Justification)这里空间很狭窄，的确如此，不过，谁需要那么花哨的房间呢 ?

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some of the slaves have been spreading stories about the Burned Man again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 又有奴隶在散布浴火者的故事了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They let Ghouls into the Strip, now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 长街现在还放尸鬼进来了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who would have thought a place like this would exist?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁能想到世上居然还有这样的地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're looking to join up, head on by the Embassy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想加入我们，请去大使馆。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Strip secure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 保卫长街。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've never heard of anyone breaking their contract and still getting their pay. Janet is damn lucky.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没想到违约的人还能拿到钱。珍妮特真他妈走运。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not sure I'll ever learn everything there is to know about this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道还会在这里学到什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our victory was never in question.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们早已胜券在握。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mike Lawson sure knows his way around the dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 迈克·劳森当然对水坝周边情况很熟悉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR is going to be grateful to have us around when the shooting starts.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR会庆幸这场战斗有我们帮忙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hanlon is pretty legendary. People talk about what he did at the first battle of Hoover Dam with awe and respect.
ESP.TRADUIT: 汉隆真是个传奇，大家说起他在第一次胡佛水坝之战中的表现时，都带着赞叹和尊重。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Private Watson sure seemed excited about meeting Kimball.
ESP.TRADUIT: 列兵沃森见到了金博尔，他肯定非常激动。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I miss California.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我好想念加利福尼亚。

ESP.ORIGINAL: First Recon is holding Forlorn Hope now. What I wouldn't give for sniper support here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 第一侦察营正在防守飘零希望营地，所以我现在提供不了狙击支援。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're supposed to be relieved any day. That's what they keep telling us. I don't think anyone's coming.
ESP.TRADUIT: 马上就有人来换班了，他们老是这么说。但我不觉得有谁会来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was only a matter of time before HELIOS fell to us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们重夺太阳神一号只是时间问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Under NCR control, this place was a gun in the hands of a child.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在NCR的控制下，这地方就像是小孩手里的枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, pardner, if you're heading for the penthouse, you gotta go alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，伙计，你要去顶楼的话，只能自己去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I told you I wouldn't work against the NCR. I meant it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我跟你说了我不会和NCR作对。我是认真的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要走了。
