ESP.ORIGINAL: Still helping the Legion. You're gonna get what's coming to you. I promise you that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还在帮军团做事。我敢打包票，你不会落得什么好下场的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're through working together.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不会再一起共事了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've never seen a Ghoul up close. Not sure I wanted to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从没近距离看过尸鬼。还是别看的好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't believe Pearl let you stay with us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真不敢相信珀尔居然让你和我们呆在一起。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I bet you'd make an awesome Boomer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我打赌你会成为一个了不起的大炮族成员。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yay! I love my new toy!
ESP.TRADUIT: 耶！我爱我的新玩具！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just try pulling some of your Brahmin shit here at the Dorado and see what happens.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要是敢在多拉多撒野，我就让你好看。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look all you want, just don't mess with any of the equipment. The control room's off-limits, and so is the enclosure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看可以随便看，但不要碰任何设备。控制室禁止进入，围场也一样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're not going to do anything crazy, are you? It's just, you know... the paperwork...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你应该不会也是来干苦差事的吧？比如……你懂的……文书工作...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not now, I'm busy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没空说话，我正忙呢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You seem really... high-strung. You know, I'm sure some of what I make my chems out of was an antipsychotic at some point...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看起来有点……压抑。你知道吗，刚好我做的药里含有一些镇静剂的成分...

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've heard the news about President Kimball? If I got my hands on the traitor that killed him...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听说金博尔总统的事了吗？要是让我抓到那个刺杀他的凶手...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well howdy, pardner! You made it out of Goodsprings no worse for the wear. Good for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好啊，伙计！你安全离开了清泉镇，真是太好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't believe we're allowed inside the Lucky 38. That place has been a legend since before the War...
ESP.TRADUIT: 真不敢相信我们能获准进入幸运38。那地方在伟大战争以前就已经是个传奇了...

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've beat Nightstalkers, right? We don't see that often down here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你消灭了夜行兽，是不是？这种事可不常见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We tolerate Wasteland savages, as long as they respect our rule around here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要守我们这里的规矩，我们也可以容忍废土的野人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm glad Mean Sonofabitch is on our side.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴无耻杂种和我们站一边。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mean Sonofabitch [000F83A2] (mod) NPC : Klamath Bob [000F839E] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything new happening?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么新情况吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your Ghoul friend looks shifty. Watch your pockets, buddy!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的尸鬼朋友看起来鬼鬼祟祟的。看好你的口袋，伙计！

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Strip ain't nothing but a monster. Chews folks up, sucks out their caps, and spits 'em back out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 长街就是个怪物。它把所有人都吞下去，吸干净了瓶盖再吐出来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't wait to see the Strip. I hear it's so beautiful!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我都等不及去看看长街了。听说非常漂亮！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't make any trouble for us, we won't make any trouble for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你别给我们找麻烦，我们也不会给你找麻烦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A friend of mine at the Dam says President Kimball might visit the troops out there. Imagine shaking the president's hand!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有个在水坝的朋友说金博尔总统要去那里视察部队。想想和总统握手的感觉！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I only work for caravans, all right? Try someone else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只为商队工作，懂了？找别人吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mercenary [000E6652] (file) NPC : Mercenary [000E6653] (file) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your pet Ghoul smells like ass.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这宠物尸鬼闻起来跟屎一样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: People all scared of those robots on the Strip since they changed. Like who needs the Strip anyway?
ESP.TRADUIT: 自从长街那些机器人变了之后，人们就很怕它们。谁他妈稀罕长街啊？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That Ghoul with you looks like he's older than the war! My the things he must have seen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟你一起的那个尸鬼看起来像是战前出生的！他肯定见识过许多事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh good, now I have to put up with the stench of rotting Ghoul as well. I hope the air filters are working.
ESP.TRADUIT: 妙极了，现在我还要忍受腐烂尸鬼身上的味道。希望空气净化器没出毛病。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The food here is to die for. No one cooks Brahmin like Philippe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 能尝到这里的佳肴，真是死了都不亏。菲利普做的双头牛肉无与伦比。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any word as to our arrangement?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们之间的交易进行得如何了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: How may I be of service, sir?
ESP.TRADUIT: 能为您效劳吗，先生？

ESP.ORIGINAL: How may I be of service, madam?
ESP.TRADUIT: 能为您效劳吗，女士？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our executive chef Philippe is the toast of New Vegas. His Brahmin Wellington is absolutely sublime.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的行政主厨菲利普是新维加斯最棒的大厨。他做的惠灵顿牛排是人间一绝。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wouldn't want to live forever if I had to look like a Ghoul.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是变成尸鬼那样，我宁愿不要长生不死。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our victory at Nelson's a worthy story to tell in my travels.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们在纳尔逊取得了大捷，这下我在路上可有话聊了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What a revolting sight. To call that a friend?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真恶心。你和那玩意做朋友？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You did a super job wrapping things up! And I'm not just saying that because I have to!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为一切划上了圆满的句号，真是太精彩了！我是打心眼里这么认为的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [001164F9] (ID) NPC : [001554EC] (ID) NPC : Yes Man [0016A21D] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I didn't want to make a big deal about this until after we won, but, well...
ESP.TRADUIT: 有件事，我本是打算等咱们胜利以后才告诉你的，不过，呃……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [001164F9] (ID) NPC : [001554EC] (ID) NPC : Yes Man [0016A21D] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found some code snippets in one of Mr. House's databanks that will let me, um, reprogram my personality! To be a little more assertive, basically!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在豪斯先生的数据库里找到了一节代码片段，它们可以，呃，重塑我的人格！简单来说就是，让我变得更加自信！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [001164F9] (ID) NPC : [001554EC] (ID) NPC : Yes Man [0016A21D] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So that's what I'm going to be doing, and it's going to take me a while, so it'll seem like I'm off-line. But don't worry, everything will be okay!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我决定部署这段代码，这要花上一段时间，期间我会一直处于离线状态。不过别担心，一切都会没事的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've updated the Securitrons' targeting parameters, so they know what to do! Vegas will be protected!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经升级了电子保安的目标参数，它们知道该做什么！维加斯会得到保护的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: So that's where I'll be, off making a few changes, and I... I guess I'll see you around!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，先失陪了，我要去离线升级了，祝……祝我们后会有期！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [001164F9] (ID) NPC : [001554EC] (ID) NPC : Yes Man [0016A21D] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We accomplished a lot together! It was fun! Take care!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们在一起创造那么多丰功伟绩！真是太有趣了！保重！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [001164F9] (ID) NPC : [001554EC] (ID) NPC : Yes Man [0016A21D] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I bet I'm going to like it in that mainframe!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我打赌那台主机里头一定会很有意思！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a good feeling about this! It's going to be great!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我感觉前途一片光明！我们肯定能干出一番大事！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hi! Nice to see you again!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨！很高兴再次见到你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Yes Man [0016A21D] (mod) NPC : [001164F9] (ID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sooooo... we can blow up the dam's generators, or I could route the dam's entire power output to the Fort.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么……我们可以炸掉水坝的发电机，或者我也可以把水坝的电力全部改送去城堡。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Yes Man [0016A21D] (mod) NPC : [001164F9] (ID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That'll activate a certain army of Securitrons and set them loose to ravage the Legion! What do you say?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这样就能启动一支电子保安大军，用它们一举摧毁军团！你怎么说？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Yes Man [0016A21D] (mod) NPC : [001164F9] (ID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You did a super job wrapping things up! And I'm not just saying that because I have to!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为一切划上了圆满的句号，真是太精彩了！我是打心眼里这么认为的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some of the machinery's frozen up. Need someone to take a look at it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有机器不能用了。得找个人过去看看是什么情况。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unless you wanna slap leather with me you'll put that gun down, friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你如果不想和我对着干，就把枪放下，朋友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Kings say they're keeping the peace, but this place is as violent as ever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 猫王帮说他们会维护和平，但是这里一直暴力不断。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey there, you want to cruise Freeside in style, you'd do worse than hire a King to tag along. Only 100 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，你要是想风光地逛逛自由之城，没有一个猫王帮跟着效果可就差多了。只要100瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kings Gang Member [0013EC30] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I help you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 需要帮忙吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you ever considered getting your head checked?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有没有想过自己的脑袋可能有病？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We don't specialize in psychiatry in this camp.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们这个营地不研究神经病。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great to see you again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再次见到你真高兴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm busy, make it quick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很忙，有话快说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What in the goddamn...?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这他妈怎么……？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's keep this in the groove, hey? Smooth moves. Smooth...
ESP.TRADUIT: 咱们有话好商量，行吗？冷静一点，别冲动……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello! The gasser everyone's been talking about, making a splash on the Strip. That's been you? Oh shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好啊！大伙都在谈论你，那个近来在长街声名鹊起的家伙就是你吧？哦，见鬼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What in the goddamn...?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这他妈怎么……？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's keep this in the groove, hey? Smooth moves. Smooth...
ESP.TRADUIT: 咱们有话好商量，行吗？冷静一点，别冲动……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello! It was you, smashed up the Omertas? You did that? Shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好啊！就是你把黑手党一锅端了吧？哦，见鬼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you hear him? My god, you were right all along. I'm no Ghoul! They were just using me...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听见他的话了吗？天啊，你一直都是对的。我不是尸鬼！他们利用了我...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good job making it through that simulation. All you have to do now is open the Armory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能通过模拟，干得好。现在你要做的就是打开军火库。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070014F6]DLC02OA4) Operation: Anchorage! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And, as agreed, you get your share. Feel free to take whatever you want. If our records are right, there's plenty for all of us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后，根据我们的协议，你将得到你应得的报酬。想要什么就拿什么吧。如果我们的记录没错的话，里面的东西够我们所有人的了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070014F6]DLC02OA4) Operation: Anchorage! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's been an honor working with you. I don't think I've ever seen bravery like that on any battlefield.
ESP.TRADUIT: 与你并肩作战是我的荣幸。我在任何战场上都没见过像你这么勇敢的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sergeant Benjamin Montgomery [070009C2] (mod) Quest : ([070014F6]DLC02OA4) Operation: Anchorage! EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hopefully, after we mop up the mess in Anchorage, we can get together and have a couple of beers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 希望在安克雷奇行动结束后，我们可以聚聚，喝上一杯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sergeant Benjamin Montgomery [070009C2] (mod) Quest : ([070014F6]DLC02OA4) Operation: Anchorage! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stay safe, soldier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多保重，士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sergeant Benjamin Montgomery [070009C2] (mod) Quest : ([070014F6]DLC02OA4) Operation: Anchorage! EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: The simulation has concluded, soldier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 模拟程序终止了，士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : General Chase [070009C1] (mod) Quest : ([070014F6]DLC02OA4) Operation: Anchorage! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks. Look, I've got to get back to HQ. I Found some papers before I got caught. Good hunting!
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢。听着，我得回到总部去。在我被抓之前我找到一些文件。祝你杀敌愉快！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : American Soldier [07003ED7] (mod) Quest : ([070034DA]DLC02FF) DLC02FF Comment (NAM2) : POW getting rescued.. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goddamn Commies caught me with my pants down. Don't tell anyone you found me like this, all right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死的中共在我睡觉的时候抓住了我。可别告诉别人你是这样找到我的，好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : American Soldier [07003ED7] (mod) Quest : ([070034DA]DLC02FF) DLC02FF Comment (NAM2) : POW getting rescued EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: They took us by surprise. I was the lucky one. Thanks for the rescue!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们出奇不意地抓住了我们。我比较走运。感谢你们救了我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : American Soldier [07003ED7] (mod) Quest : ([070034DA]DLC02FF) DLC02FF Comment (NAM2) : POW getting rescued EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank God! I thought I was a goner.
ESP.TRADUIT: 感谢上帝！我还以为我没命了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : American Soldier [07003ED7] (mod) Quest : ([070034DA]DLC02FF) DLC02FF Comment (NAM2) : POW getting rescued EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Am I glad to see you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴见到你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : American Soldier [07003ED7] (mod) Quest : ([070034DA]DLC02FF) DLC02FF Comment (NAM2) : POW getting rescued EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you for your help with those guys. They finally tracked me down... I thought I'd have more time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你帮忙对付那些家伙。他们还是追到了我……我想我将有更多时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've come about the broadcast, right? Risky, I know. But it had to be done. So you know who I am. Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是听到电台赶过来的吧？我知道这很冒险，但总得有人做。那么你知道我是谁了。你又是谁呢 ?
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You could have at least helped me with with those guys. They finally tracked me down... I thought I'd have more time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可能至少帮我对付了那些家伙们。他们还是追到了我……我想我将有更多时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've come about the broadcast, right? Risky, I know. But it had to be done. So you know who I am. Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是听到电台赶过来的吧？我知道这很冒险，但总得有人做。那么你知道我是谁了。你又是谁呢 ?
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is as far as I can go. It's up to you from here on out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只能走这么远了，现在开始，由你自己做主。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you dress up like a slave, you should be able to get past the gates without a problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要是穿得像个奴隶，过这些门应该是没什么问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once you're inside, find a slave named Midea. She'll be able to help you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一旦你进去了，就去找叫美狄亚的奴隶，她会帮你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt

ESP.ORIGINAL: Remember: your goal is to get access to Ashur and find the cure. After you have it, I'll contact you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 记住：你的任务是想办法接近阿舒尔，找到解药。得手之后，我会跟你联络。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Before we go, there's one last thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我走之前，还有最后的一件事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Head into The Pitt and find the cure. Remember: put the slave clothes on and stash your stuff if you can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 直接进入匹兹堡，找到解药。记住：穿上奴隶的衣服，尽可能把自己藏好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please...
ESP.TRADUIT: 求你……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please help us...
ESP.TRADUIT: 求你帮帮我们……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Sad
