ESP.ORIGINAL: Stop that. I mean it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 说真的。住手！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Quit it. You're making me nervous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 枪放下。你让我很紧张。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go ahead. Try me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来吧。你有种试试。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Think you're tough, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是不是觉得你自己很行，啊？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't point that thing at me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别把那东西对着我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, knock it off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，停下！

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think you're doing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认为你在做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Be careful with that!
ESP.TRADUIT: 小心点！

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's not a good idea.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是个好主意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Easy there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 放松。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're drawing on me, clown shoes? I don't think so!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想利用我，小丑？没门！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're drawing on me, bitch? I don't think so!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想利用我，小丑？没门！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now's not really the time for that, is it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在可不是做那事的时候，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Subai thah, tsahh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 停停。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Baje ka armoo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把舞气放下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, I can almost see right down the barrel!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，我几乎可以直接看到桶里的东西了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think you're doing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认为你在做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Be more careful, will you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 注意点！听到没？

ESP.ORIGINAL: HELLO
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're the best mungo ever!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是世界上最好的……毛人？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Penny [06015691] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just want Rory to be safe...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只希望罗瑞平安无事……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Penny [06015691] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, stranger. C'mon over here, I'd like to talk to you about something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，陌生人，到这来。我想和你谈些事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What... who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么……你是谁？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Old Man Harris [06029AA9] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you still here? Go!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么还在这？滚！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Old Man Harris [06029AA9] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you crazy? Get out of here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你疯了吗？离开这！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Old Man Harris [06029AA9] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't be fooled by them!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要被他们骗了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Old Man Harris [06029AA9] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <yawns> I could use a nap.
ESP.TRADUIT: <哈欠> 我得打会盹。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a fine day, isn't it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不错的一天，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Old Man Harris [06029AA9] (mod) NPC : Junior Smith [06029AA3] (mod) NPC : Jenny Wilson [06029AA6] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Glorious day, isn't it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 令人愉快的一天，你说呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Old Man Harris [06029AA9] (mod) NPC : Junior Smith [06029AA3] (mod) NPC : Jenny Wilson [06029AA6] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, hello there!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你好！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Old Man Harris [06029AA9] (mod) NPC : Jenny Wilson [06029AA6] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good to see you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴见到你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Old Man Harris [06029AA9] (mod) NPC : Jenny Wilson [06029AA6] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome to Andale!
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎来到安戴尔！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Old Man Harris [06029AA9] (mod) NPC : Jenny Wilson [06029AA6] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The good Lord made Andale for days like today.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是善良的主让安戴尔能够有今天这样的生活。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Old Man Harris [06029AA9] (mod) NPC : Jenny Wilson [06029AA6] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <humming a tune>
ESP.TRADUIT: <哼着小曲>
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Old Man Harris [06029AA9] (mod) NPC : Jenny Wilson [06029AA6] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't you have a component to deliver?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不是有什么东西要递送？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where is this damn place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这该死的地方到底在哪？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I swear it was this way!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我发誓肯定是这条路没错。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's going on in here, Midea? Who is this scab?
ESP.TRADUIT: 发生了什么事，美狄亚？这个渣滓是谁？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [08003E51] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's your problem?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么问题？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're funny looking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你长得很有趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you talking to me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在和我说话吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([00049037]GenericKids) GenericKids Comment (NAM2) : obnoxious mean girl EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um. Yeah. Please go away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，是的。请走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([00049037]GenericKids) GenericKids Comment (NAM2) : obnoxious mean girl EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Howdy mister.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好先生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hi there, miss.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨你好，女士。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hi. How are you today?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，你今天好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have a nice day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 祝你今天愉快。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello, sir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，先生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello, ma'am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，夫人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Move along, please.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请往前走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How may I serve you, master?
ESP.TRADUIT: 主人，我该如何为你服务？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([00015A37]GenericRobot) 00015A37 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : sarcastically obsequious EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How may I serve you, mistress?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我如何为你服务，夫人？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([00015A37]GenericRobot) 00015A37 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : sarcastically obsequious EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Another glorious day in this man's army!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这人的军队又迎来了辉煌的一天！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, great. Just what we need.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，太好了。这正是我们需要的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts Comment (NAM2) : sarcastic, annoyed. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep moving, local.
ESP.TRADUIT: 走吧，本地人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing to report, soldier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么要报告的，士兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Glad you could join the party!
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴你的加入。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice to see a friendly faceplate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看到友军真令人高兴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All clear, sir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 都安全了，长官。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good to have reinforcements.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有援军到来真不错。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't think I recognize your unit. Must be a new convert from old man Lyons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别以为我不知道你哪来的。肯定是刚从里昂斯老头那边投靠过来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Watch it, local.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小心点，本地人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're here to help, fine. Otherwise, out of my way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你是来帮忙的，那就好。否则给我滚开。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shouldn't you be huddling in a cave somewhere?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是不是应该躲在某个洞里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这干嘛？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great, another local.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太棒了，又来一个本地人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep your distance, mutt. No knowing what you've got breeding on you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 离我远点，混球。和你没什么好说的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got the best whores in the Wasteland. The two of them are going to break my bed springs some day. Hah ha!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在废土上碰到两个最棒的妓女。她们两个会把我的床折腾地粉碎，哈哈哈！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : overly loud and boisterous. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aren't my party girls sweet? I just want to eat them like candy. Ha ha!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的那些女人很甜吧？我真想把她们像吃糖一样吃下去，哈哈哈！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : overly loud and boisterous. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have my Cherry pie any more. That bitch ran away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我再也见不到雪莉了。那贱人跑了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My women are dead. I'm gonna have to get me some new ones.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的女人死了。我准备再找一个。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stay strong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 坚强点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sonora Cruz [0606F211] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E8]PerkLawbringer) Lawbringer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We are the law.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们就是法律。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sonora Cruz [0606F211] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E8]PerkLawbringer) Lawbringer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stay on the right side of the law.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和法律同在。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sonora Cruz [0606F211] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E8]PerkLawbringer) Lawbringer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Always good to see a new face in the fight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在战斗中看见新面孔是件开心的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sonora Cruz [0606F211] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E8]PerkLawbringer) Lawbringer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should talk to Sonora.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你应该和索诺拉谈谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sonora Cruz [0606F211] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E8]PerkLawbringer) Lawbringer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on, let me loose!
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜托，救救我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : excited (getting rescued from certain death) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Time to go yet?
ESP.TRADUIT: 该出发了吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : scared EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great, here's some of the local wildlife.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真棒，这有些当地野兽。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : Dismissive, as if the player isn't even there. EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Back off, local.
ESP.TRADUIT: 后退，当地人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're not involved in this. You want to keep it that way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不该掺和进去。你应该让它顺其自然。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good to see you're holding up alright.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴见到你又振作起来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Watch your back and keep your batteries dry out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小心背后，保持电池干燥。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : Like "keep your ammo dry" EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Run while you can!
ESP.TRADUIT: 快跑！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nathan [06000A67] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tsk. To think you could have been rich. And now all you'll be is sorry. VERY sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啧啧。想想原本你应该已经身缠万贯了。而现在你将拥有的只有你的悔恨。真是太遗憾了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : sarcastically apologetic, and hinting that he will kill the player for double crossing him EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would advise staying clear of me for awhile. A LONG while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我建议你让我一个人静一会。一大会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : calmly promising violence EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me. Do you have a death wish?
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉我，你可曾有过想死的念头？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : calmly promising violence EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was a wonderful thing you did. Inspirational. Truly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你做的真是太棒了。灵气十足，真的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : basking in the glow of pure evil genius EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes friend? Is there something I can assist you with?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么事，朋友？有什么需要我协助的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : basking in the glow of pure evil genius EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks again for you part in paving the way towards progress.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再次对你为我们铺平前进的道路而表示感谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : basking in the glow of pure evil genius EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Boy do I breathe a lot easier knowing that thing is truly dead!
ESP.TRADUIT: 知道那东西真的死了，可让我松了一口气！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : relieved EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mighty fine thing you did for this town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为这座镇子做了伟大的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : relieved EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey friend!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，朋友！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : genuinely happy to see the player EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎回来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice work in there, soldier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得好，士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070014F6]DLC02OA4) Operation: Anchorage! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Old games are no match for us Outcasts, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 老把戏难不倒我们放逐者，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070014F6]DLC02OA4) Operation: Anchorage! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You did us proud in there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在那所做的让我们感到骄傲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070014F6]DLC02OA4) Operation: Anchorage! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good work, for a local.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就本地人而言，你做得好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070014F6]DLC02OA4) Operation: Anchorage! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Never would have thought a savage could do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从没想过一个野蛮人可以做到这个地步。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070014F6]DLC02OA4) Operation: Anchorage! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks, I guess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070014F6]DLC02OA4) Operation: Anchorage! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The U.S. Army needs more soldiers like you. Carry on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 美国陆军需要像你这样的士兵。加油。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's wrap this thing up, soldier. We're cold, we're tired and we want our goddamn oil back!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们来把这个包起来吧，士兵。我们现在饿寒交迫，一定要把我们该死的原油抢回来！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Damn Chinese Communists are stomping all over us. Time for us to pay them back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死的共军的铁蹄一直在我们周围践踏。是时候算总账了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think it's time to show those Red bastards what the U.S. Army is all about.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想是时候让那些杂种共军尝尝美军的厉害了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those targets can't secure themselves. You've got a job to do, soldier... now snap to it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些目标很容易搞定。你有活干了，士兵…现在去干掉他们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're doing a man's job, soldier. Keep it up!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你正在做一件男人的工作，士兵。坚持下去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Carry on, soldier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 加油，士兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are in the presence of ant royalty!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就在蚁后的面前。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The AntAgonizer [06036C1C] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit Comment (NAM2) : regal and a little deranged EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well hello there, sweeheart.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，你好，甜心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Karen Johnson [06029AA8] (mod) NPC : [06029AA5] (ID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello there, Junior.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，新人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Karen Johnson [06029AA8] (mod) NPC : [06029AA5] (ID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello there, Junior, sweetheart. It's a lovely day, isn't it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，新人，甜心。今天天气不错，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Karen Johnson [06029AA8] (mod) NPC : [06029AA5] (ID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome to the Capital Preservation Society!
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎来到首都保护协会！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Casdin said you're clear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡斯丁说你没问题了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector Casdin [06040C39] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Grudging acceptance EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stay in line, and you'll be okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 规矩点对你有好处。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't start anything and you'll be fine. Um, probably.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你不惹事你就不会有事。嗯，这也是相对而言。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep that tech coming, and we'll make it worth your while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多带些高科技产品来，我们会酬谢你的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll, uh, um, need help with the barricades soon, right Pappy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你，呃，嗯，是不是需要人手帮你搭建防御工事，帕匹？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Timebomb [0602805A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Timebomb is a little awkward around people. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kimba, um, I heard you helped bandage me up when I was on the table. Uh, thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 金巴，嗯，听说我躺在台子上不省人事的时候是你帮我包扎绷带。呃，谢谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Timebomb [0602805A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Timebomb is a little awkward with people. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was thinking of hitting patrol again soon, Flash.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我计划迟点再去巡逻一遍，福莱斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Timebomb [0602805A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Timebomb wants to get on with life after his injuries. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey Sticky, um, uh, what do you think of Big Town?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，斯蒂奇，嗯，呃，你觉得大镇怎么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Timebomb [0602805A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Timebomb tries to be friendly to Sticky. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wonder if someone should work on the barricades again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道是不是该找个人加固防御工事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Timebomb [0602805A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Timebomb is a little out-of-it, and he is confused. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, Red, can I stop by the clinic later? You know, just in case?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，瑞德，等下我能不能去下诊所？你知道的，以防万一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Timebomb [0602805A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Timebomb is worried about his previous injuries. EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Timebomb, I heard you got hurt. Wow... What does it feel like?
ESP.TRADUIT: “定时炸弹”，我听说你受伤了。喔哦……那是什么样的感受？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Sticky is fascinated by Timebomb's injuries. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, Flash. Patrolling sounds like a lot of fun. Maybe I could come out with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，福莱斯。巡逻听起来挺有意思，能不能带上我？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Sticky is like a kid trying to find something to do. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have any idea of what I can do in town, Shorty?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想做些事，你有什么建议吗，“矮子”？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Sticky is like a kid trying to find something to do. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey there, Pappy. I was out trying to gather food. Did you know there's not much food out here in the Wastes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，帕匹。我刚出去想找点食物。你知不知道这片废土很难找到吃的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Sticky is half-way joking. The horror of the Wastes hasn't really sunken in. EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey there, Kimba. Is there anything I can do around town?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，金巴。镇里有什么需要我做的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Sticky is like a little kid searching for something to do. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, Red. Is there anything I can do around town to help out?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，瑞德。有什么我能帮的上忙的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Sticky is like a little kid asking for something to do. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sticky, it's about time you learned that I'm in charge here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 斯蒂奇，是时候该让你知道了，我，是这的领袖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Shorty taking advantage of Sticky being new to town. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I should be mayor of this town, Kimba...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我应该做这镇的镇长，金巴……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Shorty shares his dreams of conquest with Kimba. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't like the looks of the barricades, Pappy. Why don't you redo them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不太喜欢这防御工事，帕匹。你为什么不重新搭建？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Shorty trying to push Pappy around. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Timebomb, since you insist on staying alive, why don't you make yourself useful and help me reset the barricades.
ESP.TRADUIT: “定时炸弹”，既然你坚持活着，为什么你就不能让自己变得有点用处呢？至少能帮帮我搭建防御工事啊？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Shorty tries to push Timebomb around. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't go far out enough on your patrol, Flash. A real patrol would cover a solid half-mile radius.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的巡逻范围还不够大，福莱斯。最起码覆盖半径半英里的区域才称得上是真正的巡逻。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Shorty attempts to push Flash around. EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm telling you, Red, just let me run everything. I'll get those barricades twice as high!
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我听好，瑞德，你应该让我来管理一切。我会把这些防御工事加高两倍！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Shorty attempts to assert his authority over the citizens of Big Town. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bittercup, make sure you're paying attention out on patrol. There are dangerous people out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: “苦杯”，你应该更认真地巡逻，到处都是危险的家伙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Red is disciplining Bittercup. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, Flash. How are you feeling? Any calluses from stroking that new gun of yours?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，福莱斯。感觉怎么样？摸你的新枪有没有让手出老茧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Red is playfully sarcastic. She is a bit annoyed that Flash likes that gun so much. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How are you feeling, Timebomb? Are those stitches holding together?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你感觉怎么样，“定时炸弹”？那些缝线伤口愈合了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Red is checking up on her patient. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's my Sticky! How are you doing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 亲爱的斯蒂奇！你过得怎么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Red is glad to see Sticky. They were close in Little Lamplight. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, Pappy. How's that wound on your arm?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，帕匹。你胳膊上的伤口怎么样了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : As the town doctor, Red is checking up on Pappy. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shorty, I want to gather everyone together soon about setting up the barricades higher. I'd really appreciate your, uh, expertise.
ESP.TRADUIT: “矮子”,我想要尽快聚集所有人来加高防御工事。我真感谢你的帮助，哦，专家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Red is planning things for the town and realizes she might offend Shorty because she needs to talk about height. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excuse me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 打扰一下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucy [06015696] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A little harried EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got a minute?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有空吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If it isn't MacCready himself...
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果不是麦迪他自己……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucy [06015696] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Good natured joking EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looks like something's on your mind, Lucy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看上去你想到什么了，露西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's bothering you, Penny?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么事让你烦心，佩尼？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Care to talk?
ESP.TRADUIT: 介意我们谈谈吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joseph [0601568D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Friendly and genial EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, Zip. Come over here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，拉链。到这来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Finding your way about all right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 在寻找正确的路？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hail.
ESP.TRADUIT: 致敬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Dusk [060156E7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hail.
ESP.TRADUIT: 致敬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Gallows [060156E8] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll train these marshmallows if it kills me...
ESP.TRADUIT: 要训练这些菜鸟，这简直要了我的命……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Gunny [06026C57] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Grumbling under his breath at the incompetency of his students. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hail.
ESP.TRADUIT: 致敬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Presence detected. This unit has activated.
ESP.TRADUIT: 发现物件。该单位已被激活。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hail.
ESP.TRADUIT: 致敬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hail.
ESP.TRADUIT: 致敬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Outsiders in the Citadel. Such a pleasure...
ESP.TRADUIT: 五角大本营里的外来人。幸会……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Rothchild [060156EA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : sarcastic EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: H... Hello...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你……你好……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Squire Maxson [060156E2] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : nervous EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hail.
ESP.TRADUIT: 致敬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hail.
ESP.TRADUIT: 致敬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahzrukhal, boy, I want to talk to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿祖卡，孩子，我想和你谈谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We owe you so much. The Memorial will be a beacon for slaves everywhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们欠你很多。无论在何地，纪念堂将会成为奴隶贩子的信标。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([060284F0]MS06Fin) 060284F0 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everyone is grateful for what you've done for us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们所有人都感激你为我们所做的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alejandra Torres [060239D1] (mod) Quest : ([060284F0]MS06Fin) 060284F0 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Slavers will have some goddamn respect for now, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 奴隶贩子该死的得到了尊重，呃？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's going to take a lot of work to repair the Memorial. Thanks to you, I'll get to do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来要花上一段时间来修复纪念堂。谢谢你，我现在就要开始工作了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a hero to everyone here, sir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是这的所有人的英雄，先生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bill Seward [060239D2] (mod) Quest : ([060284F0]MS06Fin) 060284F0 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a hero to everyone here, ma'am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是这的所有人的英雌，女士。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bill Seward [060239D2] (mod) Quest : ([060284F0]MS06Fin) 060284F0 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please have your password ready.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请准备好密码。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello, dear. Hope you're not spending all your time working.
ESP.TRADUIT: 喂，亲爱的，希望你别把所有时间都花在工作上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : With love, to his wife EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: We never seem to have any alone time anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们好像再也没有过独处的时间了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : With love, to his wife EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, if it isn't our fearless champion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不就是我们不怕死的冠军。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Said in a relaxed, but non-insulting fashion EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is it? I'm a little busy right now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么事？我现在有点忙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice work cleaning up the town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那镇子的扫荡工作做得不错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominic D'Ellsadro [06031EC6] (mod) NPC : Machete [06031EC8] (mod) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Town's a lot safer now. Thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 镇子现在安全多了，多谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Uncle Roe [06031EC9] (mod) NPC : Joe Porter [06031ECA] (mod) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aw, you made this place get so boring.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，你让这地方变得无聊起来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Derek Pacion [06031EC7] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : bored frustration EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing new, sir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么情况，先生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Officer Kendall [06027055] (mod) NPC : [06027056] (ID) NPC : [060C09D5] (ID) NPC : Officer Taylor [060C09D6] (mod) NPC : [06027057] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sir, people are mostly staying quiet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 平安无事，先生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Officer Kendall [06027055] (mod) NPC : [060C09D5] (ID) NPC : Officer Taylor [060C09D6] (mod) NPC : [06027056] (ID) NPC : [06027057] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who do we have here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 看是谁来了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Humph.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Armitage [0601E7AE] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : A body guard saying "talk to the boss, i aint got nothing to say to you." EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose the dog's coming with us, yes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我猜猜。狗也跟着我们来了，是吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Father and son, side by side. This is the way it should be.
ESP.TRADUIT: 上阵父子兵，本应如此。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My God, can you believe the devastation out here? That's why our work is so important.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的天啊，你能相信外面的这一切吗？那就说明了为什么我们的工作如此重要。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm glad I've got you watching my back. I'm not quite sure I'm cut out for all this excitement. Not anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴有你协助我。我都不确信我能不能承受这兴奋。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on, let's keep moving.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来吧，我们继续走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not much farther. We'll be at Rivet City before you know it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是很远。我们会在你知道前抵达铆钉城。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What a sight we must be! If only your mother could see us now...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们一定是一道壮丽的景观！如果你妈妈现在能看见我们……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't do this. Please tell me the code.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别这样。请告诉我密码。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep moving!
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续前进！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get inside!
ESP.TRADUIT: 进去！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Head for the Control Room.
ESP.TRADUIT: 前往控制室。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E89]MQ03) Scientific Pursuits Comment (NAM2) : annoyed EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stay away from me! I don't want whatever you smoothskins are infecting us with!
ESP.TRADUIT: 离我远点！我不想被你们光皮肤给传染了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Almost there!
ESP.TRADUIT: 几乎都在！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is it safe yet?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这还安全吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have my vote, Mister President.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我投你一票，总统先生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That election is getting pretty close, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 大选很快就要开始了，呃？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you going to vote for, Bob?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你准备选谁，鲍勃？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey Jessica, you excited about the election?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，杰西卡，要选举了，你激动吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey Shawna, did you do the early voting?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，肖纳，你提前投票了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Isn't election time so much fun, Mary?
ESP.TRADUIT: 选举并不有趣，你说呢，玛丽？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rachael, can you believe you're almost old enough to vote?
ESP.TRADUIT: 拉克尔，你相信吗？你都差不多到能投票的年纪了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who would you vote for if you were old enough, Flower?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你能投票你会投谁，福劳尔？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't you just love election time, Ralph?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不喜欢选举吗，拉尔夫？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello Mister President.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，总统先生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hi, Mister President.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，总统先生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How's my first lady doing today?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的第一夫人今天过得怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hi Mary. I mean Flower. Rachael!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，玛丽。我是说福劳尔。拉克尔！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rachael, come play with me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 拉克尔，来和我一起玩吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lookin's free, the rest will cost ya.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看不要钱，再来就要收费了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nova [06000A63] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got something on your mind?
ESP.TRADUIT: 想好了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nova [06000A63] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't look at me like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要那样看着我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nova [06000A63] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got a problem?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么问题？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nova [06000A63] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome to Moriarty's Saloon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎来到莫里亚蒂的酒吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looking for a drink? You've come to the right place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想来一杯？你来对地方了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: S'matter? Never seen a Ghoul before?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么了？从没见过僵尸？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, what the hell do you want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，见鬼，你想要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You want something or you just looking to get your ass beat?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是有事找我还是屁股痒了找打？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: This better be important. I'm a busy man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要说的最好是重要的事，我是大忙人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, what is it now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在怎么了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you need something from me, spill it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有话快说，有屁快放。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Information I got... but it'll cost you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要的消息我有……但是你要为此破费。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I owe you Follower people a beer for patching me up a while back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 前阵子你们替我包扎，我欠你们这些天启追随者一杯啤酒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, isn't that the King's dog?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，这不是猫王的狗嘛？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looking to make a trade?
ESP.TRADUIT: 想做些买卖吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Crow [06063BF8] (mod) NPC : Doc Hoff [06063BF7] (mod) NPC : Lucky Harith [06063BF9] (mod) NPC : Crazy Wolfgang [06063BFA] (mod) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Searching for that special something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 想买特殊物品？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Crow [06063BF8] (mod) NPC : Doc Hoff [06063BF7] (mod) NPC : Lucky Harith [06063BF9] (mod) NPC : Crazy Wolfgang [06063BFA] (mod) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Trading caps for crap, step right up!
ESP.TRADUIT: 卖破烂喽，过来看看！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got some junk to unload? I'm buying!
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么不需要的垃圾吗？我要！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome, friend. Looking for more appropriate attire?
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎，朋友。想买套合适的漂亮衣服吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The spirits told me you'd be coming. And that you're looking to buy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 第六感告诉我你会来，没想到你真的来买东西了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here for a pick-me-up?
ESP.TRADUIT: 想把“我”买走吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you've got the caps, I've got your fix.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你有瓶盖，我就给你修。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here to pick up a few of my marvelous toys?
ESP.TRADUIT: 想从我这买点惊人的小玩具吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fear not, for Lucky Harith is here to offer you protection for a price!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不用害怕，幸运哈里斯在这为你提供有偿保护！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello, there!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Uncle Roe [06031EC9] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Jovial EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Uncle Roe [06031EC9] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Jovial EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Morning, sleepyhead! Sleep well, boy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 早上好，小懒虫！睡得好吗，孩子？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rise and shine! How was your night, my boy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 快起床！晚上怎么样，我的孩子？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Watch your step, sister.
ESP.TRADUIT: 留心脚下，姐妹。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've never seen a Ghoul up close. Not sure I wanted to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从没近距离看过尸鬼。还是别看的好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Make my day, mutant.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的天哪，变种人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever you're selling, we have plenty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管你要推销什么，我们都已经有了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once a republican, always a republican.
ESP.TRADUIT: 生是共和国的人，死是共和国的鬼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You aren't stealing our medicine, are you, doc?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你没偷我们的药吧，没有吧，医生？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can take care of that robot problem for you. Just saying.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你那个机器人有什么问题我都可以修好。尽管开口。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you can't keep that thing under control, I will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你不能控制好那东西，就让我来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's up?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 致敬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aurelius of Phoenix [0012B512] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 致敬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 致敬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 致敬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks for talking us out of our evil ways. I'm starting on that novel soon. Pauline is so happy. You are a nice person! Hurray!
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你把我们带出邪道。我很快就会开始写那本小说了。宝琳非常高兴。你真是个好人！万岁！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sammy and I are grateful. We are going to follow our dreams.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和萨米都很感激。我们会继续追逐梦想。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We need to talk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们需要谈一谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome to Tenpenny Tower.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎来到特佩尼大厦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Charmed, I'm sure...
ESP.TRADUIT: 幸会，真的……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, hello!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice to see you. Doing well, I hope?
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴见到你。但愿过得不错？

ESP.ORIGINAL: And how are you this fine day?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你今天过得怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: How are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: How are things?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿你好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good to see you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴见到你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Morning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 早上好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Evening.
ESP.TRADUIT: 晚上好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0004ADEE]GenericAdult) 0004ADEE (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : abbreviated "Good evening" greeting EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Evening.
ESP.TRADUIT: 晚上好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0004ADEE]GenericAdult) 0004ADEE (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : abbreviated "Good evening" greeting EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Morning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 早上好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Begone from this place, blasphemer!
ESP.TRADUIT: 从这滚蛋，亵渎者！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're no longer welcome here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不再欢迎你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oasis is no longer a refuge for you, Outsider.
ESP.TRADUIT: 绿洲不再是你的避难所了，外来人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I help you, Sheriff?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么能帮你的，警长？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06000A6C] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Annoyed at being interrupted. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know why RJ's letting you back in, but if you touch any of my kids, I'll make sure you never have any of your own.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不明白为什么镇长让你回来，但是你要是敢动孩子们一根汗毛，我就让你好看！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucy [06015696] (mod) Quest : ([00075D21]DialogueCrimeKarma) Crime/Karma dialogue for specific NPCs EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Remember my offer, Outsider: cash for Pre-War books.
ESP.TRADUIT: 记住我的任务：寻找战前书籍，我会给你报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you have any Pre-War books, I'll take them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要你有战前的书籍，我照单全收。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's up?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you need, sir?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要什么，先生？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello, sir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，先生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 长官。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : matter of fact greeting EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Squire.
ESP.TRADUIT: 侍从。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : matter of fact greeting EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sir Knight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 骑士先生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : matter of fact greeting EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Paladin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 圣骑士。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : matter of fact greeting EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sentinel. What can I do for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 莎拉。我能为你做些什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : matter of fact greeting EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello, Elder.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，长老。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : matter of fact greeting EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've gotta get out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们必须离开这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Quest : ([0B000802]DLC05MZ1) Not of This World EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I sure hope we don't get caught!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真的希望我们不会被抓住。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0B000969] (ID) Quest : ([0B000802]DLC05MZ1) Not of This World EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything I can help with?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能帮着干点什么吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't get off this ship fast enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有足够的时间下船。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Quest : ([0B000804]DLC05MZ3) This Galaxy Ain't Big Enough... EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: At least I'm still in one piece...
ESP.TRADUIT: 至少我还安然无恙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elliott Tercorien [0B00096B] (mod) Quest : ([0B000804]DLC05MZ3) This Galaxy Ain't Big Enough... EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is everything okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0B000969] (ID) Quest : ([0B000804]DLC05MZ3) This Galaxy Ain't Big Enough... EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Relax. She's okay... for now...
ESP.TRADUIT: 放松。她没事…现在是这样…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0A0035B4] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Calming the dog and referencing the player. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, there's a good pup...
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，有一条好狗…

ESP.ORIGINAL: <mumbles to himself>
ESP.TRADUIT: <自言自语>

ESP.ORIGINAL: <mumbles to himself>
ESP.TRADUIT: <自言自语>

ESP.ORIGINAL: <mumbles to himself>
ESP.TRADUIT: <自言自语>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our business is at an end. Leave this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的交易结束了。离开这地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A002F3E] (ID) Quest : ([0A002F47]DLC04FF02) The Dark Heart of Blackhall EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should have seen this place thirty years ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你三十年前就该看看这地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A002F3E] (ID) Quest : ([0A002F47]DLC04FF02) The Dark Heart of Blackhall EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you want to talk? I won't bite.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想谈谈吗？我不会吃了你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcella [0A002F42] (mod) Quest : ([0A002F47]DLC04FF02) The Dark Heart of Blackhall EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hail Mary, full of Grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women and blessed is the fruit of your womb, Jesus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 万福玛利亚，你充满圣宠。主与你同在。你在妇女中受赞颂，你的亲子耶稣同受赞颂…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcella [0A002F42] (mod) Quest : ([0A002F47]DLC04FF02) The Dark Heart of Blackhall Comment (NAM2) : quietly, saying Hail Mary to herself, privately. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You findin' your way around, sweetie?
ESP.TRADUIT: 找得到路吗，宝贝？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome aboard!
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎上船。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A006634] (ID) Quest : ([0A005846]DLC04MQ01) The Local Flavor EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need your help!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要你的帮助。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Catherine [0A006636] (mod) Quest : ([0A005846]DLC04MQ01) The Local Flavor EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Whistling tunelessly.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <难听的口哨。>
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kenny [0A00815A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : whistling tunelessly EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Step right up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 迈步前进。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mines help, if you got 'em.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的东西有帮助，如果你拿去的话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Warmest regards.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最温暖的关心。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looking to travel?
ESP.TRADUIT: 想要旅行吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Empty your thoughts, child.
ESP.TRADUIT: 摒除杂念，孩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The physical world holds nothing for us. Release any lingering connections to it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 万事皆空，无需流连。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Embrace the simple things in life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拥抱生命中的朴实吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Submerge your will in the depths of the astral sea!
ESP.TRADUIT: 让你的意识湮灭在星海的深渊中！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm watching you, child.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正看着你，孩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Woodrose [0A00A862] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Like a distrustful nanny. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: New girl, you try too hard. Be calm.
ESP.TRADUIT: 新来的女孩，你太卖力了。冷静些。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good to see you still here, my child.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴你还在这儿，孩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you seen the Chop Shop? Full of sick Ghouls... I wonder who's next?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看见排骨店了吗？全都是生病的僵尸……我不知道下一个会是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No offense, but I don't want whatever's going around. So just keep your distance, okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有冒犯你的意思，但是我不想让任何人靠近。所以请保持你的距离,好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You better stay away from me. I think I may be sick. It's like a... burning in my guts. Damn, it hurts!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好离我远点。我想我病了。就好像……我的内脏在着火。该死，真疼！

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you feel you're getting sick, quarantine yourself at the clinic, immediately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你觉得你病了，立刻到门诊来进行隔离，一刻也不要耽搁。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everything should be in place by now. Even if they know we're coming, it won't matter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这会儿一切都应该就位了。就算他们知道我们要来了，也没关系。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Tristan [09005686] (mod) Quest : ([09000802]DLC03BS1) Death From Above EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's good to see you again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见到你真是太好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Rothchild [060156EA] (mod) Quest : ([09000802]DLC03BS1) Death From Above EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Scribe Rothchild is going to need an update on your progress. Have you sent a report recently?
ESP.TRADUIT: 文员罗斯查德想要知道你的工作进度。你最近发过报告了么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃哼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bigsley could really cut us some slack.
ESP.TRADUIT: 比格斯利能给咱们点好处。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : exhausted and worried his boss is disappointed EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the hell are we doing here, really? We have better things to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说真的，我们他妈的到底在这儿干什么？我们有更有用的事情要做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : exhausted and worried his boss is disappointed EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: The mercenary caravan has returned. They ran into some trouble - Sir? Scribe Bigsley? Is everything alright, sir?
ESP.TRADUIT: 雇佣商队回来了。他们遇到麻烦了- 长官？比格斯利文员？一切都还好吧，长官？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : worried his boss is disappointed EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Grrrrrloooow...
ESP.TRADUIT: 咯……咯……（光辉）
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Novice [09007E34] (mod) NPC : Wastelander [09007E35] (mod) NPC : Sun of Atom [09007E36] (mod) NPC : Atom's Champion [09006520] (mod) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water Comment (NAM2) : Like a growling animal trained to say "Glow" EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know why they don't just build a pipeline. Schlepping bottles of water back and forth is the worst kind of stupid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真搞不明白为什么他们不直接建根水管呢。装在瓶子里一车一车地运来运去简直是我见过的最蠢的主意了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shh. If you spook the lurks I'll never get out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘘。如果你惊吓了蟹人，那我就再也出不去了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood of Steel Initiate [09001D3E] (mod) EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: The lurks get real shy when they're sick. You gotta wait for 'em to poke their noses up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 蟹人生病的时候会非常的胆小。你得等他们浮出水面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood of Steel Initiate [09001D3E] (mod) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you really going to fight in the Hole?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真的要去角斗坑里角斗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ashur's looking forward to meeting you, champ.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿舒尔正盼望跟你会面，冠军。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : A little congratulatory, a little sinister EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hurry over to Haven, kid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 快去避风港，孩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Off to talk with Ashur? Lucky you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去跟阿舒尔谈话？你真走运。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Not envious of the player's situation. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's about time we had a talk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们是时候谈谈了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Stern, but approachable EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Die, you bastard!
ESP.TRADUIT: 死吧，你这个杂种！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Stern, but approachable EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got a funny look on your face. You got something you wanna say?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的表情很滑稽，你有什么要说的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0800293B] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : (hushed) quietly conspiring with cohorts EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Having a good time?
ESP.TRADUIT: 过得愉快吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Scram, before I mess your face up bad as mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我把你的脸蛋弄得跟我的一样稀巴烂之前，赶紧滚。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do I look like your personal assistant?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我长得像你的私人助理吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Another fine day in The Pitt, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 在匹兹堡度过的又一个好日子，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't seem to get enough sleep, these days.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些天像是没有睡好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't you have something you should be doing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你难道没有该做的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keeping busy, meat?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还在忙，肉？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mind your own business, nebby.
ESP.TRADUIT: 少管闲事，菜鸟。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You want something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想干嘛？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Back to work, you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你，回去干活。

ESP.ORIGINAL: WHAT?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's one way to get out of work, isn't it? Ha!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是一个逃避干活的办法，对吗？哈！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stop staring, newbie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别再盯着看，菜鸟。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aww, such a sweet face. Get back to work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，瞧瞧这张脸多么可爱啊。回去干活。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : Cruel and sarcastic. EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, sexy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，美人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : A little creepy, but not over-the-top EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Man, the scabs ain't half as feisty as that last batch. At least when they fight back I get some fuckin' exercise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 老兄，这些渣滓不像最后的那一批争强斗狠。至少，当他们反击的时候，我他妈的能练习一下枪法。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey... Um... Ah, never mind... It's nothing...
ESP.TRADUIT: 喂…嗯…啊，算了…没事…...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Sibley [07000E24] (mod) NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) NPC : Specialist Olin [07000E22] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's my super-assistant! What's up?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是我的超级助手吗！什么事？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide Comment (NAM2) : Proud EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you hear about those newbies? The ones who went up north lookin' for raids?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听说那些新人了吗？他们要去北方寻找歹徒？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哟。

ESP.ORIGINAL: May I take your order?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想点些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll be right with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我立刻就来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Mirelurks have been quiet lately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最近蟹人好像安分很多。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll have two Mirelurk Cakes, carrots and wine, if you have it, beer if you don't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要两个蟹人饼，胡萝卜和红酒，如果没有红酒，那就来啤酒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome to Potomac Attire.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎光临波托马克服装。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmmph.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Belle Bonny [060156C1] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Annoyed EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is the Muddy Rudder. Cause any trouble, and you'll have to deal with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是“泥舵”酒吧。如果你惹了什么麻烦，就必须给我个交代。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Care for a drink?
ESP.TRADUIT: 来一杯？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh! Hello. Are you lost?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦！你好，你是不是迷路了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome to A Quick Fix.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎来到快速修复。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you need something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是不是需要些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excuse me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 打扰一下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : C.J. Young [060156C6] (mod) NPC : Mister Buckingham [0001E746] (mod) NPC : [0001E747] (ID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're hurt. Fortunately, this is a medical clinic. Why don't you let me take a look at that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你受伤了。幸运的是，这就是诊所。为什么你不让我瞧瞧呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Preston [060156D0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : worried EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome to Flak and Shrapnel's. Best god damn weapons anywhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎来到“高炮”弗莱克和“榴弹”小帅。这该死的到处都是上好的武器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have a seat anywhere. Someone will be with you in a minute.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便坐，立刻会有人来招待你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I... never mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我……没事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't mind me, mister.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要在意我，先生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't mind me, lady.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要介意我，先生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is A Quick Fix. We sell all kinds of chems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是快速修复。我们这出售所有种类的药品。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello, Bannon. Anything interesting happen in the last council meeting?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，班侬。最近的那次议会会议上有没有发生什么有趣的事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello, Henry. I just got in some new torque wrench and some electrical test equipment. You should take a look at them when you're done eating.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，亨利。我新进了一批扳手和电子测试设备。你吃完饭之后不妨来我店里看看。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome to Rivet City Supply. I've got a little bit of everything here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎来到铆钉城补给点。我们这应有尽有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, girlie. This ain't a god damn dress shop. There's nothing in here you oughta be buyin'.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，女孩。这可不是什么该死的服装店，不会有你想要的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you want a gun, you've come to the right place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想买把枪，你可算来对地方了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you seen my good-for-nothing son, James?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有没有看见我那一无是处的孩子，詹姆斯？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey stranger. Wanna buy a girl a drink?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，陌生人，不想请女孩喝一杯吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you spare enough for a drink? I could really use one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能不能多留些酒？我真想来一杯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome to the Weatherly Hotel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎来到韦瑟利旅馆。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wastelander.
ESP.TRADUIT: 废土游民。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everything looks okay here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一切正常。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) NPC : Commander Danvers [060156AD] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any trouble in this area?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这区域有什么问题吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) NPC : Commander Danvers [060156AD] (mod) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for troublemakers. Have you seen any?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找制造麻烦的家伙。你看见没？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) NPC : Commander Danvers [060156AD] (mod) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Out of the way you rust bucket.
ESP.TRADUIT: 闪开点，你这生锈的铁桶。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard that the City Council is debating putting railings on the flight deck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说城议会在讨论在甲板上装置栏杆。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Chief Harkness has vanished. Nobody knows what happened to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈克尼斯长官失踪了。没人知道他出了什么事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 长官。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ma'am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 女士。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Attention! Officer on deck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 注意！长官来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0001E747] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Said like a marine. Draw out the "Attention" part. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Authorized Civilian. Proceed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 授权平民，获准通行。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey Kimba, thanks for offering to help me in the clinic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，金巴。感谢你为我的诊所提供帮助。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Red is grateful that Kimba volunteers to help her from time to time. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: How are you feeling, Timebomb?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你感觉怎么样，“定时炸弹”？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kimba [0602AB94] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A bit worried about Timebomb, as he almost died. EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey there, Sticky.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，斯蒂奇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kimba [0602AB94] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Random greeting to Sticky. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How are the patrols going, Flash? Are we still safe?
ESP.TRADUIT: 巡逻进行得怎么样了，福莱斯？看看我们是否依旧安全？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kimba [0602AB94] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A little scared. Kimba is afraid of the Raiders and Mutants that have attacked the town before. EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wonder how the Lamplighters are doing...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想知道现在小灯镇怎么样了……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kimba [0602AB94] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Nostalgic. Lamplight was comparatively much better than Big Town. EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, Red. Do you need any help washing bandages later?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，瑞德。你迟点需要人帮你洗绷带吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kimba [0602AB94] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Kimba is trying to make herself useful. She looks to Red for things to do. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey Shorty. How's our favorite little guy doing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，“矮子”。我们至爱的小家伙过得怎么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kimba [0602AB94] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Kimba still treats Shorty like a kid. His height makes her forget that he's grown up. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How are you doing, Pappy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你过得怎么样，帕匹？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kimba [0602AB94] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Innocently checking on her friend's health. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, Sticky. Keep your stickiness away from me and my new gun. This is a Sticky-free zone!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，斯蒂奇。让你的口水离我和我的新枪远点。谢绝斯蒂奇靠近！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flash [0602796B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Flash is teasing Sticky like he did when they were children in Lamplight. Laughs at the end. EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Timebomb! How're you doing? I thought you were dead for sure!
ESP.TRADUIT: “定时炸弹”！你怎么样？我以为你死定了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flash [0602796B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Flash is happy that Timebomb is still alive despite the odds EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey Shorty, you should come with me on patrol. The Raiders will never see you coming.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，“矮子”。你应该和我一起巡逻。歹徒根本看不到你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flash [0602796B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Flash is confident that Shorty would be helpful on the daily patrol, silently alluding to the fact that Shorty is difficult to see due to height. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey Red, can I stop by the clinic later? I feel a bit sick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，瑞德，迟点我能去诊所看看吗？我感觉有点难受。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flash [0602796B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Flash is talking to the town doctor (Red) about his health. EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow, you should have seen me on patrol, Kimba, I was all "bang-bang-bang." I must have killed a hundred Raiders!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，你真该来看我巡逻，金巴，我刚才一直在“嘣-嘣-嘣”。我肯定已经杀了100个歹徒了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flash [0602796B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Flash is exaggerating. He wants to appear confident and daring. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Red, have you got a sec? It’s about this wound on my arm.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瑞德，你有时间吗？看看我胳膊上的伤口。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pappy [0602796C] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Pappy is going to Red (the doctor) about a cut on his arm. He is sure that the wound is worse than it seems. EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're all going to die here. There's no way we can survive out here in this mess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们都会死在这。我们没法从这堆垃圾中活着出来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pappy [0602796C] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Hopeless. Pappy sees no way out of the current situation. EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey there, Kimba.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，金巴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pappy [0602796C] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Random greeting to Kimba. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the barricades, Shorty?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得防御工事怎么样，“矮子”？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pappy [0602796C] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Pappy is always concerned about the barricades (the thin line between them and danger). He is soliciting Shorty's opinion for comfort. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, Timebomb. You look like you're going to fall over dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，“定时炸弹”。你看上去像要立刻倒地而死似的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pappy [0602796C] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Flat-toned. Pappy is not being sarcastic. He really believes Timebomb (or anyone for that matter) is going to die, and soon. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Never thought you'd make it, Sticky. Out of everyone who died trying to get here from Lamplight, we get you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没人觉得你会成功，斯蒂奇。有很多人试着从小灯镇来这儿却死了，但是你成功了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pappy [0602796C] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Pappy wants Sticky to know that he's as doomed as the rest of them. EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything out there, Flash? The Super Mutants and Raiders are coming back soon, aren't they?
ESP.TRADUIT: 外边有动静吗，福莱斯？超级变种人和歹徒不久就会回来，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pappy [0602796C] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Worried about the town being attacked again. Everyone is worried, but Pappy's concern borders on chronic depression. EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello, sugar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，甜心。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you still here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还在吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you planning on moving in, or what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是打算进来还是怎样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wish he'd get us some regular clothes. It's cold out here dressed like this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望他会给我们带点正常的衣服。在这穿成这样很冷。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please don't take Ian away from us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请不要把伊恩从我们身边带走。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Justin [060200C9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey hey, mungo! We're getting' outta here, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，嗨！毛人！我们是要逃出这地方是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Squirrel [06015686] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Leave us and never look back, Outsider.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不准回头，离我们远点，外来人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll begin as soon as the rest of the Treeminders have taken their places.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们等其他树启者一休息就开始行动。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, Outsider?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是，外来者？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I help you, Outsider?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能帮你什么，外来人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is something amiss?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么事出错了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't believe you're here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不敢相信你在这！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gob. These people aren't nearly drunk enough. Fix it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 盖博，这些人还没喝够呢，继续上酒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Tense and angry. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gob!
ESP.TRADUIT: 盖博！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Screaming. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want a word with you, zombie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想和你说两句，丧尸。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sheriff Simms...
ESP.TRADUIT: 西姆斯警长……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) NPC : Harden Simms [06000A73] (mod) NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's my turn!
ESP.TRADUIT: 轮到我啦！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nathan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 内森。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, oh! Mr. Ahzrukhal, I want to ask you something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，哦！阿祖卡先生，我有些事要问你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, hey... Mr. <coughs> ... Mr. Ahzrukhal... hi.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，嗨……阿……<咳嗽>阿祖卡先生……嗨。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, Mr. Ahzrukhal...
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，阿祖卡先生……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excuse me, Mr. Ahzrukhal...
ESP.TRADUIT: 打扰了，阿祖卡先生……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahzrukhal...
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿祖卡……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, robot, have you seen any toes laying around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，机器人，你有没有看见放在这的脚趾？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cerberus! How are you? Programming holding up?
ESP.TRADUIT: 地狱犬！你好吗？程序运行得怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Heya, Patches. You alright, buddy? You're not lookin' so good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，“拼盘”。你还好吧，老兄？你看上去不太妙啊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Quinn, no one told me you were back!
ESP.TRADUIT: 奎因，没人告诉我你回来了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, Quinn.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，奎因。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, Winthrop. How's it going?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，温思罗普，近来怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, I wanted to tell you, Patchwork got drunk last week and left his booze in the air filter...
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，我想告诉你，“拼盘”昨天喝多了，把他的酒落在空气过滤器里了……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Winthrop, I was wondering if you could take a look at the generator down in the common area...
ESP.TRADUIT: 温思罗普，我想你是不是能去查看下工作间的发电机……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Heya, Winthrop. You got a second?
ESP.TRADUIT: 呀，温思罗普。你有空吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: How's everything? Enjoying your drinks?
ESP.TRADUIT: 一切顺利？喝得还满意吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, yes, how is everyone doing? Everything alright? Do you need anything else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，是的，所有人都好吗？一切都好？你还有什么其他需要？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The air is off in the common house again. It stinks of sweaty death down there. I swear, every day it's something new.
ESP.TRADUIT: 工作间的空气又不流通了。臭气熏天。我保证，每天都会出现新麻烦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the hell is that smell? I mean, it's not bad, it's just... I don't know... do you smell that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那到底是什么味道？我说，其实味道还不赖，就是有点……我说不清楚……你没闻到？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mmmm... dinner smells delicious, honey!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯……晚餐闻起来真不错，亲爱的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's my honey pie!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的爱心派！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hi, Mrs. Smith!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，史密斯先生！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mrs. Wilson...
ESP.TRADUIT: 威尔逊夫人……

ESP.ORIGINAL: I love you, Mommy!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我爱你，妈妈！

ESP.ORIGINAL: My room is all clean, Mommy!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的房间都收拾好了，妈妈！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello, Mr. Harris.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，海瑞斯先生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mommy says that it's almost time for dinner!
ESP.TRADUIT: 妈妈说差不多该吃晚餐了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I saw you napping, daddy!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看见你打盹了，爸爸！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hi there, daddy!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，爸爸！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hi, Bill.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，比尔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello, Bill.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，比尔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're going to love what I'm cooking tonight, dear!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你一定会喜欢我今晚烧的菜，亲爱的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mr. Smith...
ESP.TRADUIT: 史密斯先生……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jenny Wilson [06029AA6] (mod) NPC : Linda Smith [06029AA2] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello, Jack.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，开膛手“杰克”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hi, Jack.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，开膛手“杰克”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh oh, Jenny. Look at you. The boys better watch out!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，珍妮。看看你自己。男孩们得小心了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey there, Jenny, sweetheart. Looking gorgeous as usual.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，珍妮，甜心。你总是那么美丽。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hi there, honey. Don't you look precious today?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，亲爱的。你今天看上去非同寻常。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jenny, you look beautiful today! You're like a little doll!
ESP.TRADUIT: 珍妮，你今天看上去真漂亮，就像个洋娃娃！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029AA4] (ID) NPC : Junior Smith [06029AA3] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jenny, honey, you look so cute in that dress.
ESP.TRADUIT: 珍妮，亲爱的，你穿那衣服看上去真可爱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029AA4] (ID) NPC : Junior Smith [06029AA3] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Evening! Get a lot of work done today, boy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 晚上好！今天一定干了很多事，孩子？

ESP.ORIGINAL: How're you doing, boy? Is everything all right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最近怎么样，孩子？一切都好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello, Dom. Everyone behaving themselves?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，多米。每个人都在岗位上吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dom. Any news I should be worried about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 多米。有什么需要我担心的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: 'Scuse me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 打扰一下！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Heya!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Umm... Hi, miss. I mean, Machete. Things okay with the, umm, guarding?
ESP.TRADUIT: 唔……嘿，小姐。我是说，玛切蒂。这一切都好吧，嗯，在站岗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Derek Pacion [06031EC7] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : has a crush on her, and a little nervous to talk with her EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, Machete. You on guard? I mean, of course you are. I mean, umm, never mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，玛切蒂。你在站岗？我的意思，当然你是。我的意思，哦，算了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Derek Pacion [06031EC7] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Flustered and nervous to talk to the girl. EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: How's it going?
ESP.TRADUIT: 进展如何？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, Derek. You did some fine work out there with those Brahmin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，德里克。你在那把这些双头牛照顾得很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joe Porter [06031ECA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Warm and genial, but not over the top EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Derek, been hearing good things about your work with the traders. Way to go, man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 德里克，听说你和那些商人处得不错。干得好，哥们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joe Porter [06031ECA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Warm and genial, but not over the top EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Eating right? Hope so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 吃饱了吗？希望如此。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No need to look so nervous... right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不需要这么紧张……对不对？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominic D'Ellsadro [06031EC6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Matter-of-fact, a little friendly EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got my eye on you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我盯着你呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominic D'Ellsadro [06031EC6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Matter-of-fact, a little friendly EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, Machete. Report in. You see anything odd out there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，玛切蒂。向我报告。你看到那边有什么异样吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominic D'Ellsadro [06031EC6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : businesslike, but a little friendly EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Machete, what's the word from your watch?
