ESP.TRADUIT: 滚开，傻子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239D0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, clown shoes. I hope that key was worth it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，乡巴佬。我希望那钥匙是有价值的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Too bad about Crowley. I heard Tenpenny put out a contract on him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这下考利糟糕了。我听说特佩尼与他签订了一份协议。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahzrukhal [060156F7] (mod) NPC : Carol [060156F2] (mod) NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) NPC : [060156F3] (ID) NPC : Quinn [060156F4] (mod) NPC : Patchwork [060156EF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tag! You're it, Ralphie!
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟紧了！说你呢，拉尔夫！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on Mary, let's go play!
ESP.TRADUIT: 来吧，玛丽，让我们去玩吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello Rosie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，萝丝。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excuse you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 失陪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, go clean up after the Brahmin. It's your turn.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，去清扫下双头牛那儿，该你了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Man, the Brahmin smell awful today.
ESP.TRADUIT: 伙计，双头牛的味道可真重。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm Dave's wife, so don't even think about trying anything...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是戴夫的妻子，所以请你不要轻举妄动……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you heard about Dave, lady?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有没有听说过戴夫，女士？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you heard about Dave, mister?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有没有听说过戴夫，先生？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're almost as big as Dave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你差不多和戴夫一样大。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hi there, honey. Have you spoken to Dave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，亲爱的，你和戴夫说过了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Elder on deck!
ESP.TRADUIT: 听候长老的命令！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Elder Lyons...
ESP.TRADUIT: 里昂斯长老……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Initiate reporting, Sir Dusk!
ESP.TRADUIT: 新兵随时汇报，达斯科长官！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Knight Captain Dusk, Sir!
ESP.TRADUIT: 骑士队长霞妹，长官！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Damn robot. Worst bedside manner ever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死的机器人。这是我见过最差的态度。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Scribe Bowditch, I trust you are well. I'm here for your progress report on the modified Recon Armor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 文士鲍蒂奇，我相信你能行。我是为了你那改良型侦查装甲的进度报告而来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hail, Scribe Bowditch. All is well with your work?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，文士鲍蒂奇。你的工作顺利吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hail to you, Scribe Bowditch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 向你问好，文士鲍蒂奇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hail, Scribe Peabody. I trust that your research goes well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，文士博迪。我相信你的研究一定有进展。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sir Scribe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 文士先生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sentinel Lyons, ma'am!
ESP.TRADUIT: 莎拉·里昂斯，女士！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hail, Star Paladin, sir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，骑士之星，长官。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Star Paladin Cross, sir!
ESP.TRADUIT: 星骑士 克罗丝，长官！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Need something, friend?
ESP.TRADUIT: 需要些什么，朋友？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hail.
ESP.TRADUIT: 致敬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh... hi!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦！嘿 !

ESP.ORIGINAL: <sniffs>You smell like the Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: <嗅>你身上一股废土气息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't nobody eat fifty eggs...
ESP.TRADUIT: 居然能吃50个鸡蛋……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I guess I gotta find my own way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我猜我找到自己的办法了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Psst. Hey. Help me out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘘。嗨。救我出去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa, sorry! I'll get out of your way!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，对不起！我这就让开！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Respect, man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 向你致敬，伙计。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Holy shit, it's you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他妈的！是你！

ESP.ORIGINAL: We should grab a drink sometime.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们应该找时间一起喝一杯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's up, killer?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么事，杀手？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, welcome, buddy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，欢迎你，老兄。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're not so bad from what I've heard.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说你过得还不错。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Heh. I've heard a few things about you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿。我听说了一些你的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Watch it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小心。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We don't like outsiders here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们这不喜欢外来人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get your business done and go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干完你的事立刻滚。

ESP.ORIGINAL: One wrong move, and you're going in the meat pen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是你干错一件事，就把你剁成肉酱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Watch your step, square.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小心行事，老古板。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep walkin'.
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't look like you belong here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看上去不像这的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goddamn tin can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死的锈罐头。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looks like one of those Brotherhood assholes...
ESP.TRADUIT: 看上去像是兄弟会的混蛋……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice outfit. You raid a vault or something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不错的外套。你洗劫了避难所还是别的什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fucking Vault brats...
ESP.TRADUIT: 他妈的避难所捣蛋鬼……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice to see you. Carry on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 见到你很高兴。你请便。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now's not the best time. Perhaps we could parlay sometime later? Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在还不是时候，我看下次吧。谢谢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I bet you exercise a lot, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜你一定经常锻炼，呃？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : flirting EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hi there! That's quite some ordnance you're packing, isn't it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好！你带着不少军用品啊，是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : flirting EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're tired of sleeping in those barracks, let me know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你厌倦了在兵营里睡觉，告诉我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : flirting EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I made it just like you like it. Enjoy!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我按你的口味做的，慢用！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Chef bringing out the meal EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Chief. I'm concerned some of your men have been sleeping on the job. Well not literally, I just mean, they don't seem that alert.
ESP.TRADUIT: 长官。你的手下在工作时间睡着了，这让我很难办。可能我言重了，我是想说，他们似乎不那么警惕了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Millicent Wellington [060156D8] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : self important EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm afraid I can't stop and chit chat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恐怕我没空停下来闲谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : mildly sarcastic EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm afraid I can't stop and chit chat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恐怕我没空停下来闲谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : mildly sarcastic EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : a greeting in passing, not meant to initiate a conversation EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa. Feel woozy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，头晕眼花。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sigh. This is a long way from the Statesman Hotel. Why are you still here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 唉。去政要酒店的路途很遥远。为什么你还在这？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you just standing around here? My men might be dying!
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么你还在这站着？我的人都快死了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please, don't hang around here... just get out to the Statesman Hotel and rescue my men.
ESP.TRADUIT: 求你了，不要再在这游荡了……快去政要酒店救出我的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're still here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还在这？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you all right, Madison?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还好么，麦迪逊？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Janice, I have something for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 贾尼斯，我有东西给你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Janice, a moment please.
ESP.TRADUIT: 贾尼斯，打扰你一会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Crime doesn't pay, it just pisses people off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 犯罪不能给你带来任何好处，只会激起民愤。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Next time you want to talk to someone, stay away from me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 下次要是你想找个人说话，拜托你不要找我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just make this fast. I don't like talking to criminals.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有屁快放。我可不喜欢和罪犯说话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a fine line between badass and dumbass, and you crossed it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 愚蠢和邪恶之间是有明显的界限的，而你已经越界了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Make no mistake. Try something and I drop your ass.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别做傻事。你敢乱动我就割下你的屁股！

ESP.ORIGINAL: We may be alike, but don't take me for stupid. I got my eyes on you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们或许很像，但你别以为我是蠢货。我自己有眼睛。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep acting the way you've been acting and they'll catch you, lock you up and throw away the key.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要是继续这样，他们就会抓住你，把你永远的关起来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not sure I should even be seen talking to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在想我该不该被人看到和你说话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, it's you. Up to the same old crap, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，是你啊！你就像个老垃圾，呃？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sometimes being bad feels pretty damn good, eh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 偶尔使点坏感觉真他妈爽，你说呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should be ashamed of yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真应为你自己感到羞愧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Next time, use your brains... I know you have it in you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜托你下次动动脑子好吗？你那圆脑袋里装的该不会是草吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the matter with you? You can't get away with crap like this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说你是怎么了？你总不至于要带着这样的垃圾离开吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The way you're acting surprises me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的所作所为让我感到惊讶。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everyone makes mistakes... just don't do it often.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每个人都会犯错……但你不能老犯同样的错。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your bad deeds surprise me, they really do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的恶行让我感到惊讶，真的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't act like you didn't enjoy what you did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要装出一副对你所做的事丝毫不感兴趣的样子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're as guilty as the rest of us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你，还有我们，都是有罪之人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We need more people like you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 像你这样的人再多点就好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bless you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 上帝保佑你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're an example to us all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是我们的楷模！

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not easy to be good in this world. I'm glad that someone is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在现在这社会做个好人实属不易。但我很高兴还有这样的人存在。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've heard about you. Let it never be said that there aren't some good people left in the world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说你的事迹了。你让人们相信这世上还是有好人存在的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's never been anyone like you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从没见过像你这样的人！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is everyone from the Vault as kind as you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是不是从避难所出来的人都和你一个样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, young madam! Very good to see you again. I do suppose you’re looking for your father the doctor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，年轻的女士！很高兴又见到你。我猜你是来找你的医生父亲吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Andy [0006B237] (mod) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just hold still. Your left stabilizer's been knocked loose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别动，你左面的稳定器已经被敲松了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't be such an old woman. Just a few more adjustments and you'll be as good as new.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别像个老太婆一样。再调试两下你就和新的没两样了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go ahead and take a seat so we can start.
ESP.TRADUIT: 找个座位，我们开始。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CFB7] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Time for the G.O.A.T. Find a seat and wait for instructions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该开始G.O.A.T.了。找个座位，等着听说明。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CFB7] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You did fine. You should celebrate with your friends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你做得很好，你可以和你的朋友们好好庆祝一番。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CFB7] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, hey there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，嗨。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Show us how smart you are, Wally. What should we call ourselves?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你最擅长了，瓦利。我们应该给我们自己弄个什么名号呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060300EA] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, Paul, your hobby's open. Whoa, that's your hobby? Ha ha ha ha! Now quick, give me an idea for what to name our gang.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，保罗，你的兴趣最广泛了。哇，那就是你的兴趣？哈哈哈哈！快点，告诉我你觉得我们的帮派叫什么名字。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060300EA] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah man, you got a Pip-Boy. I wish I was ten.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，你有哔哔小子了。我希望我也已经10岁了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paul Hannon [060300EB] (mod) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast Comment (NAM2) : wistfully EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry about Butch... Your Dad said we had to invite him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我为布奇向你道歉……你爸爸说我们必须要邀请他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [060300E9] (mod) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fun party, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 很有意思的聚会，呃？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [060300E9] (mod) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks for coming. Are you having fun?
ESP.TRADUIT: 感谢你的光临，过得还愉快吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [060300E9] (mod) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks for coming. It means a lot to both of us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 感谢你来参加这聚会。对我们来说你的光临真是意义重大。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602FDCF] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you having a nice time?
ESP.TRADUIT: 玩得开心吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602FDCF] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you heard about Freddie Gomez?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听说过弗雷迪·戈麦斯吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a lowlife, but if you keep your nose clean, we'll let you stay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 虽然你是个下等人，但如果你能不惹是生非，我们还能愿意让你留下来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) NPC : Commander Danvers [060156AD] (mod) Quest : ([00075D21]DialogueCrimeKarma) Crime/Karma dialogue for specific NPCs EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: You watch yourself. You cause any more trouble and you'll be dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你小心点，你再惹麻烦就死定了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([00075D21]DialogueCrimeKarma) Crime/Karma dialogue for specific NPCs Comment (NAM2) : security guard calmly intimidating a trouble maker EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Find him!
ESP.TRADUIT: 找到他！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : arrogant and anxious EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those Temple Union slaves got what they deserved.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些联邦神殿的奴隶是自作自受。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Umm... hello there. Right! Uh, don't mind me then. I'm uh... just practicing my hunting skills. Keeps me young and all that. Right. Goodbye now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 唔……你好！呃，不要在意我。我，呃……只是在练习我的打猎技巧。这样让我保持年轻。再见！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : classic "pay no attention to me while I'm doing something naughty" shtick EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dashwood. What the hell are you skulking about for?
ESP.TRADUIT: 达什伍德。你鬼鬼祟祟地到底是要干嘛？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : confused and slightly suspicious EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey! What are you up to old man?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨！你在对老人干嘛？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : confused and slightly suspicious EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahem. Dashwood. Don't do anything stupid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊。达什伍德。别做蠢事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : gruff and slightly suspicious EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You feeling alright, Daring? You having a flash back or something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 亲爱的，你觉得怎样？你是突然想起什么还是怎么了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : confused and slightly suspicious EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're behaving rather oddly, Mister Dashwood. Perhaps you should go lie down for awhile.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的举止很古怪，达什伍德先生。恐怕要请你到一边冷静一会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156D7] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : confused and slightly suspicious EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you alright, Comrade?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还好吧，同志？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Irving Cheng [060156DC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : confused and slightly suspicious EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Daring! What on earth are you up to?
ESP.TRADUIT: 亲爱的！你到底在忙什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lydia Montenegro [060156DA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : confused and slightly suspicious EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're up to something. I can tell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在忙。我知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : confused and slightly suspicious EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Daring! What the bloody hell are you up to this time?
ESP.TRADUIT: 亲爱的！现在你到底还在忙什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Michael Hawthorne [060156D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : confused and slightly suspicious EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mr. Dashwood. Perhaps you should go take a nap, dear. You're acting rather peculiar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 达什伍德先生。恐怕要请你去小睡一会，亲爱的。你的行为实在太“特别”了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Millicent Wellington [060156D8] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : confused and slightly suspicious EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Daring... you're up to no good, aren't you? Naughty, naughty old man!
ESP.TRADUIT: 亲爱的……你在做坏事，对吧？顽皮，顽皮的老小孩！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156DE] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : playfully suspicious EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing, Dashwood?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在干嘛，达什伍德？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : confused and slightly suspicious EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: There he is!
ESP.TRADUIT: 看，是他！

ESP.ORIGINAL: There she is!
ESP.TRADUIT: 看，是她！

ESP.ORIGINAL: 'can I do for you, Sheriff?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么我能帮你的，警长？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You... uh... want a drink?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你……呃……要不要来一杯？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dad says not to talk to strangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 爸爸说不要和陌生人说话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Billy says not to talk to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 比利让我不要和你说话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got nothin' to say to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和你没什么好说的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...now where has that man got to?
ESP.TRADUIT: ……那家伙去哪了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06000A68] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Muttering to herself under her breath. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You seen Nathan around anywhere?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看到过内森吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hrm?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mr. Eulogy... uhm... can I talk to you for a second? If, if you're not busy, I mean.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尤勒基先生…嗯……我能不能占用你点时间？如果，我的意思是，如果你不是很忙的话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're not busy, Mr. Eulogy... I... I wanted to talk to you for a second.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你不是很忙，尤勒基先生……我…我想和你谈谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Grouse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 葛劳斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ug. Get away from me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 咳。离我远点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Miss Jeanette...
ESP.TRADUIT: 珍妮特小姐……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pronto...
ESP.TRADUIT: 普郎托……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Richter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 里克特。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ymir...
ESP.TRADUIT: 伊米尔……

ESP.ORIGINAL: S'up, fool?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么事，傻瓜？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, you're back. You get anything good?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，你回来了，有什么好消息？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You caught anything lately?
ESP.TRADUIT: 最近你有什么新消息？

ESP.ORIGINAL: How'd that roundup go?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那帮畜生怎么样了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: How's the meat?
ESP.TRADUIT: 肉怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, how'd it go with that blonde thing you brought in here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，会怎么处置你在这抓的金发小妞？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You went out with Ymir last week, didn't you? Catch anything good?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你上周和伊米尔出去了，对吧？抓到什么好东西？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Catch any good meat lately?
ESP.TRADUIT: 最近有没有抓到好东西？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Things are quiet around here. We haven't had any good roundups in a while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最近这很平静，我们有段日子没活动了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: S'up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: THE ONE WHO DEFENDED US FROM MOBIUS. HELLO.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个帮助我们抵御莫比乌斯的人。你好啊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If it isn't the beautiful ping of my radar-scan picking up a heroic Lobotomite.
ESP.TRADUIT: 叮，看我的雷达扫描到了谁，这不是英勇的小无脑人么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: -The ONE who SAVED us! To you, I bestow a hello. Hello.-
ESP.TRADUIT: -是救了我们的那个人！让我授予你问候。你好啊。-

ESP.ORIGINAL: *Thanks for helping us. Don't get a big head or anything, even if I am insanely jealous.*
ESP.TRADUIT: *谢谢你帮了我们。尽管我发疯一样嫉妒，也请不要介意。*

ESP.ORIGINAL: So nice seeing you again - for perhaps the first time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再次见到你太好了，或许是第一次见到你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It appears you've been wounded, sir. May I suggest you utilize your infirmary?
ESP.TRADUIT: 先生，看起来您受伤了，我建议您使用您的医务台。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You appear to have been wounded, madam. May I suggest you utilize your infirmary?
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来你受伤了，女士。允许我向你建议使用你的医务台？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It appears you've been wounded, madam. May I suggest you seek medical attention as soon as possible?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好像受伤了，女士。允许我向你建议尽快寻找医疗援助？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope things are going well for you today, madam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望你今天过得愉快，女士。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome home, madam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎回家，女士。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's good to see you alive and well, madam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴见到你还活得不错，女士。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Run faster or I will throw you off the side.
ESP.TRADUIT: 快点跑，不然我就把你扔到一边去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've got stuff you never realized you needed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们这儿卖的东西绝对能让你眼前一亮。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've got competitive prices and a good inventory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们有最低的价格，还有最好的存货。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Heh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cpl. William Farber [000E8F69] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about some grub?
ESP.TRADUIT: 来吃的怎么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cpl. William Farber [000E8F69] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a busy man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是个大忙人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 又是你？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Scoot your boots, ya bum!
ESP.TRADUIT: 小鬼，走路看着点！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just try pulling some of your Brahmin shit here at the Dorado and see what happens.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要是敢在多拉多胡作非为，那就不妨试试看。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look all you want, just don't mess with any of the equipment. The control room's off-limits, and so is the enclosure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看可以随便看，但不要碰任何装备。控制室禁止进入，围场也一样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey Rexie, who's a good dog?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，小雷克斯，今天乖不乖啊？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : The "who's a good dog?" part is said in that odd way that people reserve exclusively for pets. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you looking at?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在看什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello, cutie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，小可爱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's a pretty girl like you doing with someone like this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这么漂亮的女孩和这家伙在一起干嘛？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You need a boyfriend, honey?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要个男朋友吧，宝贝儿？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You want to have some fun with a real man, baby?
ESP.TRADUIT: 要不要找个真汉子来陪陪你啊，宝贝？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Want a massage, cutie? No charge.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想要按摩吗，小可爱？免费的哦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Buy you a drink, honey?
ESP.TRADUIT: 想来一杯吗，宝贝儿？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great, another fuckin' robot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，又一个该死的机器人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um, er, excuse me. I'll just get out of your way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，呃，请原谅。我马上走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Things are tense on the Strip right now. The head of one of Mr. House's Families was killed. Time to lay low, you ask me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 长街现在局势紧张。豪斯手下一个家族的老大都被杀了。要我说，还是低调点好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey baby. Wanna get wild tonight?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，宝贝，晚上要不要一起疯一把啊？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, baby. I know a quiet place we can be alone. Or a loud place if you're one of those.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，宝贝。我知道个独处的好地方。或者你喜欢的话，我带你去个热闹的地方也行。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got something you want to say?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么话要说吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？

ESP.ORIGINAL: May I help you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 需要帮忙吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, what's up?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, pal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，伙计。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, doll.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，小妞。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look who it is. Freeside's favorite son.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瞧瞧是谁来了。自由城的宠儿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look who it is. Freeside's leading lady.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瞧瞧是谁来了。自由城的大姐大。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, it's good to see you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，很高兴见到你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey there. You're the King's friend, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好。你是猫王的朋友，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You here to start trouble?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是来这儿惹麻烦的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You in the right neighborhood?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得自己来对地方了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd keep moving, if I were you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我是你，我就会走开。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know, I was just talking about trash, and here you are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 知道吗，我刚说到垃圾，你就来了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Be advised, visitors will be held responsible for the behavior of any non-human sapients accompanying them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 提醒您一句，游客们需要为随行的非人智慧生物的行为承担相应责任。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am so happy to see you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 见到你真高兴！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Without leadership, the Fiends are as good as dead!
ESP.TRADUIT: 没了首领，恶魔帮已经和死了没区别了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who would have thought a place like this would exist?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁能想到世上居然还有这样的地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Strip secure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 长街安全。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please don't kill me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 请别杀我！

ESP.ORIGINAL: With Caesar dead, maybe they'll stop attacking us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒死了，或许他们会停止攻击了吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: People are whispering, everywhere, about the massive Legion army gathering past the Colorado.
ESP.TRADUIT: 人们都在窃窃私语，大批军团部队正在科罗拉多峡谷一侧集结。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your pet Ghoul smells like ass.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这宠物尸鬼闻起来跟屎一样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your pet Ghoul smells like ass.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这宠物尸鬼闻起来跟屎一样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dixon's hooch may be cheap, but it tastes like it was filtered through a dirty sock.
ESP.TRADUIT: 迪克森的酒便宜归便宜，但尝起来像是用臭袜子滤出来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey baby, I got what you need right here! <Burp>
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，宝贝儿，我有你想要的东西！<嗝儿>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Smells like shit all the time, but at least we're safer than in the Wastes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 闻起来永远都是屎味，但至少我们比待在废土安全。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Leave this instant!
ESP.TRADUIT: 马上离开！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Howdy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If we lose Hoover Dam, we can kiss Nevada goodbye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我们丢了胡佛水坝，那就只能和内华达说再见了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: True to Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒万岁。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ain't that the bird that tried to ice the President? Gutsy dame, showing her face in here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那不就是想要做掉总统的小鸟吗？这娘们够有种的啊，还敢在这里露脸。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well hello, pretty lady.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好啊，漂亮的女士。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I still can't believe we came to terms with the NCR.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还是无法相信我们居然和NCR签署了和平协议。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your Ghoul wants to have some fun he can, we don't discriminate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的尸鬼在这儿可以随便逛，我们不会歧视它的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your Ghoul wants to have some fun he can, we don't discriminate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的尸鬼在这儿可以随便逛，我们不会歧视它的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the fuck are you looking at?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你他妈东张西望看什么呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't walk away, let me show you the time of your life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别走开，我会让你享受这一生最美好的时刻。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Tops is a real snooze fest. I hope they get some new shows soon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 九重天实在是让人想打瞌睡。我希望他们能尽快推出些新节目。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know you want a piece of this, give me some sugar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要吧，来和我一起快活吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think that's what they mean by doggy style.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得他们说的“小狗式”不是那个意思。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mmm, I haven't had a Ghoul before. Do I get to keep the tip?
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，我没和尸鬼打过交道。是不是可以留着小费？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ooo, the big one looks like fun. Let me know if you want a good time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 喔，这大块头看上去很有趣。如果你想爽一番的话，记得来找我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gomorrah has the loosest slots on the Strip.
ESP.TRADUIT: 蛾摩拉的老虎机是长街最黑的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hot damn do I love this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我爱死这地方了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have to go now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在要走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks. Hopefully, it'll just be skinned knees and bloody noses, today.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢。但愿今天只是磕破膝盖或鼻子流血。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll let you get back to work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还是让你回去工作吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't get too hurt out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 出门别伤太重了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know what you need to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道你需要做什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Happy trails partner.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一路顺风，伙计。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jerry the Punk [001413BD] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 长官。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ma'am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 女士。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, amigo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，朋友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, amiga.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，朋友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, man. Later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，兄弟，迟点见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, girl. Later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，女孩，迟点见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stay safe, brother.
ESP.TRADUIT: 注意安全，兄弟。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stay safe, girl.
ESP.TRADUIT: 注意安全，女孩。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yup. Talk to you later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，回头再聊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, me too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我也是。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll be here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们会到的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have lots of work to do!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有很多事要去做！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Betty [0602449C] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane Comment (NAM2) : cheery yet menacing EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mabel's waiting for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 梅布尔正在等你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Betty [0602449C] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I look forward to seeing how you deal with this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来看看你是怎么解决这事的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Betty [0602449C] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell Timmy I said hi!
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉提米，我向他问好！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Betty [0602449C] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Run along now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在走开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Betty [0602449C] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Citadel is our only chance now. We have to make it there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 五角大本营是我们现在唯一的机会。我们必须去那。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get outta here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 闪一边去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Forty [060156A0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，继续。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Penny [06015691] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't screw up, okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 别搞砸，好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Squirrel [06015686] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're counting on you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们都指望你了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Begone from my sight!
ESP.TRADUIT: 滚出我的视线。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A005A38] (ID) Quest : ([0A00584A]DLC04MQ05a) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hurry up!
ESP.TRADUIT: 快点儿！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0A0035B4] (mod) Quest : ([0A00584A]DLC04MQ05a) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's get to it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 开始吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0A0035B4] (mod) Quest : ([0A00584B]DLC04MQ05b) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Brand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 布兰德。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't get yourself killed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别把小命丢了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A002F3E] (ID) Quest : ([0A002F47]DLC04FF02) The Dark Heart of Blackhall EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go with great care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谨慎行事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcella [0A002F42] (mod) Quest : ([0A002F47]DLC04FF02) The Dark Heart of Blackhall EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As you please.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如你所愿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good luck out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 祝你好运。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep your head low.
ESP.TRADUIT: 保持低调。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Northup [0602E032] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right. I'm out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，我走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come back later. I mean, don't come back later. See if I care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回头见。我的意思，回头别见。我不在乎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bittercup [0602796A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Bittercup pretends to be apathetic but is actually quite lonely. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Later, spooky girl.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回见，小妞。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Watch out for Muties and Raiders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小心变种人和歹徒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flash [0602796B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Flash is mindful of danger. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll let you and gun have some alone time...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还是让你和枪独处吧……

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you see anyone from Lamplight, tell them to be careful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你看到任何从小灯镇来的人，告诉他们小心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kimba [0602AB94] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Kimba is concerned about new arrivals from Lamplight ending up like them. EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm going to go look around town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要去镇里看看。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're doomed and so are you if you stick around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们是完了，如果你在这待着，也一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pappy [0602796C] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Pappy is eternally cynical EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm going to go look around town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要去镇里看看。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't get yourself hurt. I have enough red on my clothes already.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别再把自己弄伤了。我的衣服已经够红了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : As a doctor, Red makes sure to warn people to be more cautious. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goodbye, Red.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见，瑞德。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stay clear of mutants. Especially the big, hungry ones.
ESP.TRADUIT: 离变种人远点。尤其是那种又大又饿的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Shorty is still frightened from mutants attempting to eat him in Germantown. EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Later, Shorty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回头见，“矮子”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, I'll just be here doing grown-up stuff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我只是在这做些大人的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Sticky still acts a little childish. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: See you, Sticky.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见，斯蒂奇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Be careful out there. You don't want to end up on that table in Red's clinic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 出门小心。你不想最后又躺在瑞德的手术台上吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll be going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要走了

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't be distracted by the size. Stay calm; shoot straight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别被体型吓到。冷静；瞄准打。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dusty [060288BC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Introverted. He is talking mainly to himself. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right. I'm going to get going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。我要走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yessir, Mr. Moriarty. More drunk customers, coming up!
ESP.TRADUIT: 遵命，莫里亚蒂先生。好多喝醉的顾客，来吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: See you around, mister.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回头见，先生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll talk to you later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我待会再和你谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, miss. See you around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，女士。回头见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll talk to you later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我待会再和你谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, bye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，拜。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need to get going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在要走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, me too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我也是。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Time for me to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我该走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bye-bye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜拜。

ESP.ORIGINAL: See you later, alligator.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回头见，鳄鱼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course, of course! Don't let me keep you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，当然！别让我耽误你了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goodbye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need to get going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在要走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. See you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，再见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0004ADEE]GenericAdult) 0004ADEE (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : Default backup bottom of the stack no condition failsafe goodbye. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Time for me to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我该走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Time for me to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜。

ESP.ORIGINAL: See you later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回头见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please... help me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请...帮帮我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please... God... I just need water.
ESP.TRADUIT: 求你...上帝啊...我只需要水。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have a wonderful and productive day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多好的一天啊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get out of here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 滚出去！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nathan [06000A67] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't let me keep you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别让我耽误你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Remember that the Department of Tourist Rights only guarantees your safety for 24 hours. After that time, you will be executed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 记住旅游者权益部门只能保护你二十四小时。之后，就要靠你自己了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goodbye, Mister President.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见，总统先生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come back... please.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要来噢……一定噢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come back if you need something. Not like I'm going anywhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你有需要就回来。我会一直在这的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wha... huh? I don't get it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什……呃？我不明白。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Y'all come back real soon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 迟点见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll tell Mr. Eulogy that we talked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会告诉尤勒基先生我们聊过了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'd better go before he sees you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 快走吧，别让他看见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. Come back when you've got more injuries. And some more caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。你受伤的时候可以回来。别忘了多带点瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Paradise Falls is here if you need it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想回来，堕落天堂就在这。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <belches>
ESP.TRADUIT: <打嗝>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, just behave yourself. The boys up there don't fuck around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，老实点。那边那群家伙可不是吃素的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那走吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please... if you get to Underworld, let them know that I'm okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你去地下城，请让他们知道我一切都好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, man. Come back any time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，哥们。欢迎随时回来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Told you: there's nothing exciting down here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 已经告诉过你：在那没有什么好玩的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's only a matter of time now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在只是时间问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come back when you are ready to drink, little man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当你想喝点什么的时候就回来，小伙子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come back when you are ready to drink, little girl.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当你想喝点什么的时候就回来，小女孩。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hail.
ESP.TRADUIT: 致敬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So long, Bill...
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见，比尔……

ESP.ORIGINAL: So long, Jack...
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见，开膛手“杰克”……

ESP.ORIGINAL: So long, Jenny...
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见，珍妮……

ESP.ORIGINAL: So long, Junior...
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见，“小子”……

ESP.ORIGINAL: So long, Karen...
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见，卡伦……

ESP.ORIGINAL: So long, Linda...
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见，琳达……

ESP.ORIGINAL: So long, Martha...
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见，玛莎……

ESP.ORIGINAL: So long, Mr. Harris...
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见，海瑞斯先生……

ESP.ORIGINAL: So long, Tuck...
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见，塔克……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good luck out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 祝你好运。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Officer Lepelletier [09003B3C] (mod) Quest : ([09003B42]DLC03WQ01) Protecting the Water Way EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, you never any fun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你一点都没意思。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, never mind! Talk with you is... stupid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，算了！和你说话真是……太蠢了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hope you find what you're looking for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 希望你找到你要找的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes! They're all dead! And I have the keys. The keys to the... are you still here? Get lost. I have a trip to plan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯！他们都死了！我得到了钥匙。这钥匙是开……你在听吗？滚。我还要安排旅行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Finally, I have the keys. Your job is done and you've been paid, so move along. I have a trip to plan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最后，我得到了钥匙。你的活已经干完并且得到了报酬，走吧。我还要安排旅行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, they may not all be dead, but I have the keys. I should have hired a better mercenary. Run along. I have a trip to plan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，他们或许没都死，但我还是得到钥匙了。我应该雇个更好的佣兵。走开。我还要安排旅行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good luck in the Museum. Bring me back something and I'll let you get a closer look at the Memorial.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在博物馆里好运。给我带回点东西的话，我会让你仔细看看纪念堂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd better get going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要闪了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. Silas will tell them you're allowed up there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。西拉斯会告诉他们你可以上来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: So... Can I take a peek at the Memorial now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么……我能现在看看纪念碑吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever. I need to get back to work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管怎样。我要回去工作了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Talk to you later, Andy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回头聊，安迪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, come on!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，来吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0B000969] (ID) Quest : ([0B000802]DLC05MZ1) Not of This World EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's keep moving.
ESP.TRADUIT: 咱们接着走吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're doing a great job. Really.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你干得真棒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0B000969] (ID) Quest : ([0B000804]DLC05MZ3) This Galaxy Ain't Big Enough... EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, I'll make sure they don't cut us off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，我确保它们不会把我们隔断的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Quest : ([0B000804]DLC05MZ3) This Galaxy Ain't Big Enough... EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: First aliens, now Death Rays. This is like a crazy TV show.
ESP.TRADUIT: 先是外星人，现在是死光。就像一个疯狂的电视节目。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elliott Tercorien [0B00096B] (mod) Quest : ([0B000804]DLC05MZ3) This Galaxy Ain't Big Enough... EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know where to find me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道在哪里能找到我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paulson [0B0032FB] (mod) Quest : ([0B000804]DLC05MZ3) This Galaxy Ain't Big Enough... EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, go on! Get!
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续！快！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Back to business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回去干活吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come back any time, them swampfolk types are always bringin' me new stuff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随时恭候，那些沼泽居民常给我带新玩意来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, before you go. If you ever want to get rid of that scar on your head, just come and see me, okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，你走之前。如果你想去除头上的疤痕，就来找我，好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, enough gabbing. Let's move!
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，说够了。快走吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good travels to ya!
ESP.TRADUIT: 旅途愉快！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, away with you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，走开吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come back again soon! Marie and I will be waiting!
ESP.TRADUIT: 快点回来！玛丽和我等着！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds like Ashur's working you pretty hard. Must be so tough for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来阿舒尔像是在你身上下了大功夫，你想必很有本事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Sarcastic concern for the player's well-being. EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yessir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 遵命长官。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sergeant Benjamin Montgomery [070009C2] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As you were.
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow, okay, I'm sorry. I was just... kidding...
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，好吧，对不起。我只是…开个玩笑…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Sibley [07000E24] (mod) NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) NPC : Specialist Olin [07000E22] (mod) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那好吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goodbye. Take care of yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见。你自己保重。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goodbye, Rosie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见，萝丝。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stay away from Dave. He's mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 离戴夫远点。他是我的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: See you, Jessica.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见，杰西卡。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're safe as long as Dave says so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 戴夫说你安全，你便是安全的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: See you, Jessica.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见，杰西卡。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come back and visit the museum anytime!
ESP.TRADUIT: 随时欢迎回博物馆。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll leave you to the kids.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还是让你和孩子们在一起吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just don't bother me. I've got stuff to do for Dave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别烦我。我正在为戴夫做事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Later, Bob.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回见，鲍勃。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have to go practice my Dave impression, anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论如何，我都得让戴夫对我有所印象。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Talk to you later, kid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回头聊，孩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goodbye, Mister Not-Dave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见，不是戴夫先生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Talk to you later, kid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回头聊，孩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's what Dave always says.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就像戴夫一直挂在嘴边的那样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Talk to you later, kid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回头聊，孩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I'd rather just stay broken than submit to any further indignity.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得我什么都不做，也比受到更多的侮辱强。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Andy [0006B237] (mod) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good luck. Careful around that bomb.
ESP.TRADUIT: 祝你好运。小心那核弹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : joking, but to cover up serious nervousness EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goodbye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come back if you need something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你需要什么就回来吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll expect to see you in class, Freddie. No excuses. Run along now, son.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我等你来上课哦，弗雷迪。别找借口。现在走开，孩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CFB7] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever you say, Mr. Brotch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便吧，布洛彻先生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601D019] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: You be careful now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小心。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me know if you have any of that Scrap Metal to sell!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有废金属的话，告诉我一声！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come back soon! ...please.
ESP.TRADUIT: 迟点见！……一定噢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me know if you need something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 缺什么就告诉我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. See ya later, pal!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。回头见，朋友！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, I'll be going now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，我现在就要走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's right. And don't come back!
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错。别回来！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, I'll be going now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，我现在就要走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why won't you just take me to Big Town?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不如你不把我带到大镇吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : a bit of whining EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll wait over here for you. When you're done playing with the children we'll go to Big Town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会在这等你。等你跟这些孩子玩够了，我们再去大镇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (accidentally sarcastic) trying to hide his disappointment EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: See you later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回头见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06025093] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bye, Timmy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见，提米。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, yeah. Thanks for asking. I'll catch up with you later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，嗯。谢谢你的邀请。我迟点来找你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060244A0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane Comment (NAM2) : embarrassed, trying to be friendly EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No way. Not on my watch. GUARDS!
ESP.TRADUIT: 没门。在我当班的时候不行。守卫！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enclave Officer [06039634] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Farewell, Outsider.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回见，外来人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: May the Great One bless you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 愿圣贤祝福你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : rote religious saying EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: May you remain under the canopy of His protection.
ESP.TRADUIT: 愿你一直处在他庇护之下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : rote religious saying EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come back soon!
ESP.TRADUIT: 迟点见！

ESP.ORIGINAL: See you next time!
ESP.TRADUIT: 下次见！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Be back soon! And bring more caps!
ESP.TRADUIT: 赶快回来！多带瓶盖！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll be on my way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我先告辞了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose there's no chance for a nice conversation today, is there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜今天没机会好好聊天了，对吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Uncle Roe [06031EC9] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A little crestfallen EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well... Good talking with you, boy, as always.

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get away from my daughter!
ESP.TRADUIT: 离我女儿远点！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : attacking with a melee weapon, like a knife or club EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get away from my son!
ESP.TRADUIT: 离我儿子远点！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : attacking with a melee weapon, like a knife or club EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You see? This is why I took you to that Vault in the first place...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你明白了？这就是我为什么先带你去避难所……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : attacking with a pistol EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is lunacy!
ESP.TRADUIT: 太蠢了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : attacking with a pistol EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You think I'm going to let YOU stop me? After all I've been through?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得我会让你阻止我吗？尤其是在我经历了这么多事之后？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : attacking with a pistol EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll kill you before I let anyone harm my child!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会在你伤到我孩子之前杀了你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : attacking with a pistol EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: First that crazy simulation, now this. Has the entire world taken leave of its senses?
ESP.TRADUIT: 先是那疯狂的模拟，现在又是这。整个世界都发了疯吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : attacking with a pistol EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Traveling the Wasteland, shooting guns! By God, I'm getting too old for this sort of thing!
ESP.TRADUIT: 在废土上，旅旅行开开枪！的确，对于这些事来说我太老了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : attacking with a pistol EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Damnit, just leave us alone!
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死，离我们远点！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : attacking with a pistol EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just like shooting that old BB Gun! You remember?
ESP.TRADUIT: 就像使用旧BB枪那样！你记得吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : attacking with a pistol EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahhhhh!
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊啊啊！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : attacking with a pistol -- screaming in anger and frustration EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enough! Enough of this!
ESP.TRADUIT: 够了！这够了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : attacking with a pistol EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Run!
ESP.TRADUIT: 跑！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : attacking with a melee weapon, like a knife or club EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll have your scalp!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要扒了你的头皮！

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you won't give us the water, we'll just have to take it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要是不给我们水，那我们只能抢了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Help me out, buddy! c'mon!
ESP.TRADUIT: 帮帮我，老兄！快来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thought you could get away, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你以为你逃得掉吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Back in your work-hole, worker.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回你的工地去，工人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rrrarrr!
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : Attacking with intent to kill. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Help me...
ESP.TRADUIT: 救救我……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't let them keep us down!
ESP.TRADUIT: 别让他们压制住我们！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got to shoot them in the head!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你应该射他们的头！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : professional mercenaries fighting an overwhelming force EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Someone flank that one!
ESP.TRADUIT: 快解决那个！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : professional mercenaries fighting an overwhelming force EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.TRADUIT: 去死吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm gonna beat you up!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会打败你的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06025093] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You need to learn some manners!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要学会一些礼貌！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06025093] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane Comment (NAM2) : angry, throwing a punch EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm going to teach you a lesson you won't forget!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会教你一堂不会忘记的课！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06025093] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane Comment (NAM2) : angry, throwing a punch EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Arrgh!
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane Comment (NAM2) : record as "kid" voice EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Grrrghh!
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane Comment (NAM2) : record as "kid" voice EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Had enough?
ESP.TRADUIT: 受够了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Betty [0602449C] (mod) NPC : Biwwy [06061794] (mod) NPC : Mayor MacCready [060156AC] (mod) Quest : ([06061BE4]GenericCustomVoice) Generic dialogue for custom voices Comment (NAM2) : shouting encouragement at friends during combat EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where's that damn robot?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那该死的机器人在哪？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Charon [060156F6] (mod) NPC : Cerberus [0602B8EA] (mod) NPC : [00000007] (ID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your time here is over!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的时代将在此终结！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your time has come!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的死期已经到了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do you like that, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么会喜欢那样，呃？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060300EA] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm getting hungry just looking at you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 光是看你就让我觉得开胃！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kill the Slaver!
ESP.TRADUIT: 杀了奴隶贩子！

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's it, I'm officially coming out of retirement!
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错，我已经正式退休了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : jovial adventurer glad to be killing things again EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're messin' with the best, asshole!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在和最好的过招，混蛋！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : professional mercenaries fighting an overwhelming force EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Somebody help me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 救命！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : scared and about to die EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Help me with this asshole!
ESP.TRADUIT: 帮我干掉这混蛋！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Eyes open and heads down, people!
ESP.TRADUIT: 眼睛睁大点，头放低点，大家伙！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take 'em down, people!
ESP.TRADUIT: 杀了他们，大家伙！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You ain't so super now, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你现在不够强了，呃？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601D42F] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : bloodlust in combat, firing his weapon EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Too easy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太容易。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Colvin [0601D432] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're dead!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你死定了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dropping hostile!
ESP.TRADUIT: 敌方空降！

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Overseer's going to hear about this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 监督者会听到这事的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Overseer won't tolerate this kind of behavior.
ESP.TRADUIT: 监督者不会容许这种背叛。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tunnel Snakes rule!
ESP.TRADUIT: 穴蛇帮主宰一切！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tactical assessment: Red Chinese victory... impossible.
ESP.TRADUIT: 作战评估: 中国红军胜利……不可能。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Democracy is truth. Communism is death.
ESP.TRADUIT: 民主是真理。共产主义是死亡。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Threat level: red.
ESP.TRADUIT: 威胁等级：红色。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Weapon status: engaged.
ESP.TRADUIT: 武器状态：已投入使用。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Weapon systems locked on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 武器系统已锁定。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Engaging hostile target.
ESP.TRADUIT: 与敌对目标交战。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Weapons free. Non-combatants are advised to stand clear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有武器。建议非战斗人员不要靠近。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Status report: green. All systems within acceptable operating parameters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 状态报告：绿色。所有系统都在可接受的运行参数之内。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Status report: yellow. Primary systems have sustained significant damage. Reinforcement recommended.
ESP.TRADUIT: 状态报告：黄色。主要系统遭受严重破坏。建议进行加固。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Status report: yellow and falling. Perimeter security can no longer be guaranteed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 状态报告：黄色，正在下降。周边安全不能再得到保证。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Status report: red. Primary system failure imminent. Repair or reinforcement recommended.
ESP.TRADUIT: 状态报告：红色。主要系统即将发生故障。建议维修或加固。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Warning! System failure imminent.
ESP.TRADUIT: 警告! 系统故障迫在眉睫。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Threat assessment: primary target is at large and undamaged. Full perimeter alert recommended.
ESP.TRADUIT: 威胁评估：主要目标在逃，未受损害。建议进行全面的周边警戒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Threat assessment: primary target has been engaged, but continues to exhibit hostile intent.
ESP.TRADUIT: 威胁评估：主要目标已经交战，但继续表现出敌对的意图。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Threat assessment: primary target heavily damaged. Continuing to engage.
ESP.TRADUIT: 威胁评估：主要目标严重受损。继续进行交战。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Threat assessment: primary target has suffered critical damage. Neutralization imminent.
ESP.TRADUIT: 威胁评估：主要目标已遭受严重损害。中止行动迫在眉睫。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Threat assessment: primary target almost neutralized. Stand by.
ESP.TRADUIT: 威胁评估：主要目标几乎被消灭。准备就绪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Be advised. Hostiles in area. Threat neutralization in progress.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请注意，敌人在该地区。威胁正在解除中。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Non-combatants are advised to stand clear of weapons discharge.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非战斗人员应远离武器发射。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alert. Hostiles in area.
ESP.TRADUIT: 警报。敌人在该地区。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Locking on... firing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 锁定...发射。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alert. Security operation in progress. Stand clear of security perimeter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 警报。正在进行安全操作。远离安全区域。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alert. Use of lethal force in progress. Non-combatant safety cannot be guaranteed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 警报。正在使用致命武力。不能保证非战斗人员的安全。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tsk. I really thought we could be friends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啧啧，我真的以为我们可以成为朋友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please, lower your weapon and submit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请放下武器并提交。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a much better tactician than you. It's all in the brain, you see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是一个比你强得多的战术家。这一切都在大脑中，你看。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please don't take this the wrong way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请不要误解。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which do you like better -- the psionic beam or the laser?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你更喜欢哪一种 -- 幻象光束还是激光？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing personal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是针对个人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You could run? I am trying to kill you, after all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能跑吗？毕竟我是想杀了你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope this unpleasantness will be over soon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望这种不愉快会很快结束。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hold still please. It's harder to hit you if you keep running around like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请不要动。如果你一直这样跑来跑去，就更难打到你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope we can still be friends when this is all over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望这一切结束后，我们还能成为朋友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please believe me when I say I'm not enjoying this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请相信我，当我说我不喜欢这样的时候。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wish there was some other way we could have worked this out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望我们当时能以其他方式把这件事解决掉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm afraid I'm a very lethal killing machine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我担心我是个致命的杀人机器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Running away is probably your only hope.
ESP.TRADUIT: 逃走可能是你唯一的希望。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My programming requires that I keep trying to kill you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的程序设计指使我继续尝试杀死你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't feel bad if you don't defeat me. I am one of the most advanced military robots available.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你被我打败请不要感到气馁，我是现存最先进的军用机器人之一。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not programmed to fail. Just so you know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有被编程为失败，只是让你知道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They could have programmed me to love. To forgive. But nnoooo...
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们原本可以把我设计来去爱，去宽恕，但是没有....
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([00015A37]GenericRobot) 00015A37 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : talking to herself, frustrated that she has to kill someone EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't mean to be insensitive, but you really can't win.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是我不友好，你真没法赢我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I calculate your chance of success as... well, no need to be morbid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我算了一下你成功的概率.... 哎呀，完全不用紧张。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Firing weapons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 武器开火。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([00015A37]GenericRobot) 00015A37 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : blank info for attack sound EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.TRADUIT: 与敌对目标交战。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Law abiding citizens, please leave the area.
ESP.TRADUIT: 守法的市民，请离开这片区域。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please take cover until the danger has been eliminated.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在危险消除之前，请躲藏起来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Put down your weapons and submit to authority.
ESP.TRADUIT: 放下武器向当局投降。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Warning. Systems failure imminent.
ESP.TRADUIT: 警告。系统即将崩溃。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Warning. Repair urgently required.
ESP.TRADUIT: 警告。迫切需要维护。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Warning. Continued operation cannot be guaranteed. Please contact an authorized repair representative immediately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 警告。无法保证继续运行。请立即联系许可的维修人员

ESP.ORIGINAL: Calculating chance of success... 80%.
ESP.TRADUIT: 计算胜利概率中.... 80%。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Calculating chance of success... 50%.
ESP.TRADUIT: 计算胜利概率中.... 50%。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Calculating chance of success... 20%.
ESP.TRADUIT: 计算胜利概率中.... 20%。

ESP.TRADUIT: 计算胜利概率中.... 小于5%。 无法继续保证你的安全。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do not be alarmed. Order will be restored soon. Please stand by.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请不要担心。 秩序很快就会恢复。请等待。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Continued resistance is unlawful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续抵抗是违法的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your cooperation is requested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请你保持合作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Warning. Hostiles in area.
ESP.TRADUIT: 警报。区域中出现敌意目标。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Multiple hostile targets detected. Requesting backup.
ESP.TRADUIT: 发现多个敌意目标。请求支援。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Engaging multiple hostiles.
ESP.TRADUIT: 与多个敌意目标交战中。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Engagement with multiple hostiles in progress. Please stand clear of the combat area.
ESP.TRADUIT: 与多个敌意目标的交战正在进行。请离开战斗区域。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do not be alarmed. Law and order will be restored shortly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请不要担心。 法律和秩序不久就会恢复。请等待。

ESP.ORIGINAL: For your safety, please take cover until the lawbreaker is dealt with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了您的安全，在解决违法者之前，请先躲起来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is a lawful use of deadly force. Please direct complaints to your local law enforcement authorities.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是合法性的使用致命武力，如有不满请直接与地方法律机构联系。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please clear the area until order has been restored.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请离开这片区域直到秩序恢复为止。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A lawful use of deadly force is in progress. Citizens are advised to clear the area.
ESP.TRADUIT: 合法性的致命武力使用中，建议市民离开这片区域。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Violence will not be tolerated.
ESP.TRADUIT: 暴力是不被允许的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Eat hot lead, you commie bastard!
ESP.TRADUIT: 天打雷劈， 你这个混蛋共匪！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ready to die for your country?
ESP.TRADUIT: 准备为国捐躯了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pain is just weakness leaving the body!
ESP.TRADUIT: 痛苦会让人更坚强！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Today's a hell of day to die, commie!
ESP.TRADUIT: 今天就是你的忌日，共产党！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on, people, give 'em hell!
ESP.TRADUIT: "来啊，各位，让他们去死！"

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do you like that, you mother-loving commie!
ESP.TRADUIT: "感觉怎样，你妈妈的共产党！"

ESP.ORIGINAL: Made in the U.S.A.!
ESP.TRADUIT: 美国万岁！

ESP.ORIGINAL: No surrender!
ESP.TRADUIT: 宁死不降！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that the best you can do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就这水平？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just getting warmed up! Hoo-ah!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我刚刚热完身！ 呼-啊！

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's nothing I like better than the smell of plasma in the morning!
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有比一大早上闻到等离子的味道更让人兴奋的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the matter, you pansy ass pinko? Getting tired?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎样，娘娘腔？累了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We are lean! We are mean!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们猥琐！我们卑鄙！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a personal message for you from Uncle Sam!
ESP.TRADUIT: 山姆大叔让我给你带个口信！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Running will only make the pain last longer!
ESP.TRADUIT: 逃跑只会让你痛苦更久！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kill them all! God will understand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把他们都杀了！ 上帝会理解的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's nothing I like better than making some other poor bastard die for his country.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有什么事比让卑微的蠢蛋为他的国家献身更让我感到兴奋的了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now you're starting to piss me off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在你开始让我生气了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: *Sigh.* Why must you humans always resort to violence?
ESP.TRADUIT: *叹气*为什么你们人类总会使用暴力呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do stand still!
ESP.TRADUIT: 站住别动！

ESP.ORIGINAL: And who gets to clean up all this blood? Me, that's who...
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后谁去清理这些血？ 那个人就是，我....

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oohh. Yesss... Let's all beat up on the robot...
ESP.TRADUIT: "噢，好啊……让我们一起暴打机器人吧……"
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([00015A37]GenericRobot) 00015A37 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : Sarcastic and annoyed EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: By God, if I had hands I would strangle the life out of you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 以上帝之名，如果我有手我一定会掐死你！"

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have at thee!
ESP.TRADUIT: 揍汝！

ESP.ORIGINAL: For Queen and country!
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了皇后和国家！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have insulted my honor, and for that, you must die!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你侮辱了我的荣耀，于是乎，你一定要死！

ESP.ORIGINAL: On my target, Outcasts!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是我的靶子，监督者！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ooohh! I love when they fight back!
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢！我喜欢他们反击！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Grrrr...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06028930]GenericRaider) 06028930 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : growing to himself EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You wanna be my new boyfriend? Ha ha ha ha ha ha!

ESP.ORIGINAL: Warning. Use of lethal force is authorized.
ESP.TRADUIT: 警告。已获得致命武器使用授权。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Warning. You are in violation of a security zone. Use of lethal force is imminent.
ESP.TRADUIT: 警告。你已侵犯安全区域。致命武力即将实施。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Warning. You have entered a security zone. Lethal force may be used without further warning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 警告。你进入了受保护的区域。再往前走，不经警告，就会对你使用致命武器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Warning. Leave the security zone immediately or you may be fired upon without further warning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 警告。马上离开受保护的区域，否则你将在不经警告的情况下受到攻击.

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't mean to be rude, but you're not allowed here. You'd better leave before I'm forced to take preventive measures.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我无意冒犯，但你不能进来。在我不得不采取预防措施之前，你最好离开。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're still within the restricted area. I really do advise you to leave immediately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你仍处在受限区域内. 我很郑重议你马上离开.

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps you didn't hear me the first time. This is a restricted area. Please leave immediately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许你没听清我刚才说什么. 这是首先区域.请立刻离开.

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, but you're not allowed here. I hope you won't turn this into an unpleasant situation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很抱歉。但是你没有被允许来这里. 我不希望你让这转化成不愉快的结局.

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry. You've entered a restricted area. I may have to use deadly force if you don't leave immediately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很抱歉。你已经进入了受限区域.如果你不马上离开的话,我将不得不使用致命武器.

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excuse me, sir, but this is a restricted area. Please leave immediately so we can remain friends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，先生，但这里是受限区域。如果你能立刻离开,我们将仍是朋友.

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excuse me, ma'am, but this is a restricted area. Please leave immediately so we can remain friends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，女士，但这里是受限区域。如果你能立刻离开,我们将仍是朋友.

ESP.ORIGINAL: Trespasser, be advised that deadly force will be used against you without further warning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 入侵者，现在告诉你，在不经警告的情况下,我们随时都会对你使用致命武器.

ESP.ORIGINAL: Leave the restricted area immediately. No further warning is required.
ESP.TRADUIT: 立刻离开受限区域。不会再一次警告你了.

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is a restricted area. You will be sanctioned with deadly force if you do not leave immediately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是受限区域。如果你不马上离开,你将受到致命武器的攻击.

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are now trespassing. Be advised that deadly force may be used against you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你现在是非法侵入。请注意，可能会对你使用致命武力。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Warning. You are trespassing. You must leave immediately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 警告。你未经许可进入私人土地. 你必须立刻离开.

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is a restricted area.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里是不对外开放区域.

ESP.ORIGINAL: You had better remove yourself from this area before I am forced to declare you an enemy of the U.S. of A.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我宣布你成为美军的敌人之前,你最好从这里消失.

ESP.ORIGINAL: This area is under the protection of the U.S. army. Remove yourself or be prepared to defend yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个区域受到美军的保护. 从这里消失或者准备迎接攻击

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're not allowed in here. Don't give me an excuse to use my weapon on you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你没有被允许来这里. 不要给我一个攻击你的理由.

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do not push your luck any further.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要试图碰碰运气.
