ESP.ORIGINAL: Haha, Gary!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈，加里！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : as in "haha, I found you!" EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hooo, Gaary!
ESP.TRADUIT: 喔，加里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : Just found somebody to play with/shoot at. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Alert music>
ESP.TRADUIT: <警报音乐>

ESP.ORIGINAL: *O, I found it!*
ESP.TRADUIT: *哦，我找到了！*

ESP.ORIGINAL: -The battle rages on!-
ESP.TRADUIT: -战火纷飞！-

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's end this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 快结束吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Judgment's coming.
ESP.TRADUIT: 审判你！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Time's up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 时候到了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Target found.
ESP.TRADUIT: 发现目标。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Target reacquired.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再次发现目标。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Target found. Engaging.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再次发现目标。锁定。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Won't lose you again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不会再让你跑掉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Didn't walk through ash and hell to lose you now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是为了现在跟丢你才经历地狱般的磨难的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There you is!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在那里！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Zombie, over there. I see you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 丧尸，在那。我看到你了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : jovial adventurer glad to be killing things again EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Spotted, over there!
ESP.TRADUIT: 已捕获，在那！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : professional mercenaries fighting an overwhelming force EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There you are!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这儿！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Positive contact near the Archives!
ESP.TRADUIT: 在档案馆附近与敌接触！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Rothchild [060156EA] (mod) NPC : Elder Lyons [060156E4] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Positive ID on lost target acquired!
ESP.TRADUIT: 失去的目标已重新获取！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Reengaging target!
ESP.TRADUIT: 重新发动攻击！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Target found! Firing!
ESP.TRADUIT: 发现目标！开火！

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've got the target!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们发现了目标！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Target relocated! Engaging!
ESP.TRADUIT: 新定位目标位置！出击！

ESP.ORIGINAL: There you are, you little bitch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这啊，你这小婊子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your time just ran out!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的气数已尽！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuckin' hide from me? You're dead!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他妈的躲着我？你死定了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! Found your sorry ass!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！找到你这可怜虫了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thought you could hide?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你以为能藏得了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here he is!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他在这！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here she is!
ESP.TRADUIT: 她在这！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got him. Rally on me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我发现他了。跟我来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So are you going to let me kill you now, or are you going to run away again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是等着现在被我杀掉，抑或要再次撒腿就跑？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : smugly taunting an enemy who was hiding but now found and about to be killed EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I knew it! Oh I'm gonna tear you apart!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道！我要把你撕开！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha ha! I found you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈！我找到你了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: There you are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's sweet of you trying to keep my hopes up, to convince me he's still alive. But I can tell you're not telling me the truth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想着法子叫我相信他还活着，好让我继续满怀希望，这真美好。但我能看出来你没跟我讲实话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bill's dead, isn't he? Actually, I don't want to hear anymore. Thank you for your help. I need to let the others know what happened to Bill.
ESP.TRADUIT: 比尔死了，对吗？我真的再也不想听下去了。谢谢你帮忙。我要告诉其他人比尔出了什么事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take these stimpaks. It's all I have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，拿上这些治疗针，我就剩下这些了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How dare you talk like that! Bill's dead, isn't he?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么敢那样说！比尔死了，对吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, I don't want to hear anymore. Thank you for your help. I need to let the others know what happened to Bill.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真的再也不想听下去了。谢谢你帮忙。我要告诉其他人比尔出了什么事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry friend. You oughta keep better track of your loved ones.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很抱歉，朋友。你更应该跟紧你的爱人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're... You're lying! He may be crazy, but he'd never try to destroy the Vault like this!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你……你在撒谎！他或许很疯狂，但他绝不会去破坏避难所的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [0602549E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only an outsider would do something like that. Someone like... you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有一个外来人会做出这样的事。就是……像你这样的家伙！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [0602549E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd deal with you myself, except these people are going to need someone to watch out for them out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想亲自对付你，不过这些人需要有人照看。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [0602549E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: As for you... You can stay down here and die, for all I care. If you ever talk to me again out there, I'll kill you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至于你……你可以留在这等死，那与我无关。可如果你到了外面再找我废话，我会杀了你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [0602549E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Overseer's insane and thought no one would leave if they all died. <Lie>
ESP.TRADUIT: 监督者精神出了问题，认为如果他们都死了，就没人会离开。<撒谎>

ESP.ORIGINAL: But we don't want to give up the safety of the Vault. We just want to end its isolation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我们不想放弃避难所的安全。我们只想终止它与世隔绝。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [0602549E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : Mild exasperation EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's what you and my father don't seem to understand!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是你和你父亲不明白的地方！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [0602549E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : Mild exasperation EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've been across this Wasteland, and nowhere's safer than this Vault. Trust me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我走遍了废土，没什么地方比避难所更安全的了，相信我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But we can't stay isolated forever, or eventually all we'll have left is a handful of inbred remnants!
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我们不能永远与世隔绝，不然最后我们只会剩下一帮近亲交配的后代了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [0602549E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: This Vault is the safest place I've ever seen. It's insane to give that up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 避难所是我见过的最安全的地方。放弃它才疯了呢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You may think Vault security is just bunch of chubby guys in padded helmets, but I promise you, most of them aren't as friendly as you remember.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你或许认为避难所警卫都是一些套着头盔的胖家伙，但我可以肯定的对你说，他们中的多数并不像你印象中的那么友善。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06027057] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just report in that I'm here for one last visit. I'm sure security won't mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就说我到这来最后看看。我确信警卫不会介意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry about it; I won't tell the Overseer if you won't. To tell the truth, I'm glad she did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别担心。如果你不做，我是不会告诉监督者的。告诉你实话，我很高兴她的所为。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06027057] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : A little hopeful. EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Heck, maybe you can even put all this trouble to rest once and for all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 见鬼，或许你甚至可以一劳永逸地解决所有麻烦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06027057] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : A little hopeful. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: It wasn't a message from her. I just had a hunch she was in trouble. <Lie>
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是她留的消息。我只是感觉到她遇到麻烦了。<撒谎>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Even they aren't foolish enough to destroy their homes just to prove a point. It could only have been you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 即使是他们，也没蠢到为证明这点而毁坏自己的家园。这只有你才做的出！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: How many of them do you think will survive out there? Still, better a few of them stay alive out there than have them all die down here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认为去到外面，他们有多少人能幸存下来？然而，就算幸存者很少也比全部在这等死好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: The evacuation will begin immediately. But you won't be joining them outside. I'll see to that myself!
ESP.TRADUIT: 立即开始疏散。但你不许在外面与他们汇合。我会盯着的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: One of the rebels did it to force everyone to leave. <Lie>
ESP.TRADUIT: 反叛者中的某个人干的，以便强迫所有人离开。<撒谎>

ESP.ORIGINAL: The previous Overseers were idiots, and we nearly died because of their naivete. I'm simply trying to make up for their mistakes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 以前的监督者都是白痴，他们的无知差点让我们丧命。我只不过是在补救他们的过错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : Very sinister. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: In a generation or two, no one will remember it ever happened, and we'll still be the safest, purest humans left.
ESP.TRADUIT: 过一、两代人，就没人记得它曾经发生过了，而我们仍会是最安全、最纯粹的人类。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : Very sinister. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: But for that to happen, we can't let ourselves be further tarnished by outsiders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是为了让那成真，我们不能再接受任何外来人的污染了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : Very sinister. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know that the vault's been open before, and that you lied about its isolation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道避难所过去曾开放过，你所说的与世隔绝是瞎话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We can make more. That's what humanity does. It survives.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们可以制造更多。那就是人类的本领。适者生存。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You simply don't have enough people to stay isolated down here forever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的人口就不足以永远封闭地维持下去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My only secret is patience. If I could share it with you, I would.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我唯一的秘密就是耐心。如果我能与你分享的话，我会的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you share your secret to getting them to grow?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能分享下你让他们生长的秘密吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, like you could manage that. You really don't know shit about how we work, do you? But if you're that serious...
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，就像你能应付一样。你对我们怎么工作根本一无所知，不是吗？但如果你是认真的话……

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got some I keep for myself in case there's an accident or something. Will you shut up about this if I give some to you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为预防突发事故或者类似状况，我自己还留着些。如果我把它分些给你，你能保证不外传吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This kind of crap gets around, you know. You try bullying too many people, and it's going to cost you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这种事四处传播，你知道的。你试图恐吓太多人，你就会付出代价的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Give me the fungus, or I'll seal this place underground. And you with it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把蘑菇给我，否则我就把这地方给填平了，让你一起陪葬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't have to lie to make me feel better. I know it's a dumb joke. We don't really tell them to laugh with them - more to laugh at them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不必为了让我好受点而撒谎，我知道这笑话很蠢。与其说是我们让人们跟着它笑 — 不如说是让人们嘲笑它的愚蠢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're more like a tradition. Most of them were passed down from this book we found down back, called "Vault Boy's Big Book of Laughs for Kids".
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们更像一种传统。它们大多数是来自我们过去发现的一本书，叫什么“避难所男孩的儿科笑话大全”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're not really funny, but something about hearing them is a little comforting, you know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们并非真的有趣，但是听听它们有安抚的作用，你懂吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was pretty funny! <Lie>
ESP.TRADUIT: 太有趣了！<撒谎>

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. Because I don't trust you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。因为我不信任你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's a jerk, but she's still one of us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她是个蠢货，但她仍是我们中一员。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you tell me why Princess gets angry about her nickname?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能告诉我，为什么公主对她的外号这么气愤？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't want to talk about it with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不想与你谈那事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You said you used to have another guard. What happened?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说过去还有一个守卫的。发生什么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No! I'm not supposed to go outside with strangers!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不！我不应该和陌生人外出！救命啊！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm afraid whoever told you that you were charming was playing a cruel joke on you. But don't fret. There are other means to persuade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我害怕告诉你，那些说说你很迷人的家伙，都是在给你开一个残酷的玩笑。但是别担心，还有其他方法来说服。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's not going to work on me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那对我可不奏效。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not falling for that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可不会听信那事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I'm sorry. I will not force her to awaken. I can't predict the effect it may have on her system.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，很抱歉。我不会强迫她醒来。我无法预见那会对她的生理造成什么影响。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I think I can wait a little while longer before I head back. Say, long enough for you to get five hundred caps...
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，我想在我赶回去前还可以再多待一会。可能，时间足够你凑够500个瓶盖…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A006634] (ID) Quest : ([0A005846]DLC04MQ01) The Local Flavor EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're headed back there anyway, how about I ride along for just 250 caps?
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是你非要回那去，让我用250个瓶盖搭个便车如何？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not stupid, and I'm not falling for your tricks. Forget it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可不蠢，不会上你当的。算了吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha ha. Really now? I'm afraid you aren't as agile tongued as you'd like to think.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈。真的？我担心你的舌头并非你所想象得那般灵巧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : amused and sarcastic EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why can't man follow the ant's example? They work together as a team... every waking moment dedicated to the colony.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么人类不能效仿蚂蚁呢？他们团队般的协作……无时无刻不为群体奉献力量。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They require no wealth or material items... everything they need is provided for them by their fellow insects.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们对金钱与物质没有追求……他们所需要的都由同伴提供。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I digress. If it's payment you need, all I can offer is one of my Mutagenic Bioenhancers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 顺便说下。如果你需要报酬，我所能提供的只有我的突变体基因活性增强剂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I had a cap for every punk that tried that line on me, I'd be rich.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我能从每个那样对我的废物那得到一个瓶盖，我会变得很富有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mayor MacCready [060156AC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I don't give a shit. Take him somewhere else... we're closed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 与我无关。把他带到别处去……我们关门了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mayor MacCready [060156AC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your voice stress patterns indicate you are telling a falsehood. This is in violation of Protocol NC-01.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你话语中的重音模式显示了你正在撒谎。这违反了NC-01协议。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry. You have now exceeded 2 demerits. Now instituting Expulsion Protocol KL-001.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很抱歉。你被记过已经超过2次。现在开始执行驱逐协议KL-001。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your voice stress patterns indicate you are telling a falsehood. This is in violation of Protocol NC-01.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你话语中的重音模式显示了你正在撒谎。这违反了NC-01协议。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One demerit will now be issued. Note that further demerits can cause your expulsion from this job posting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在一次记过，小心，继续出错将使你被解雇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As previously stated, please identify yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如前所述，请说明你的身份。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not an option, I'm afraid. We aren't exactly rolling in cash, down here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恐怕，你别无选择。我们并不富足。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, sorry. I don't think so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，抱歉。我不这么认为。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, smoothskin. I can't take the risk. Moriarty will beat the shit out of me for even talking to you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 很抱歉，光皮肤。我不能冒这险。仅仅是和你说话，莫里亚蒂就会把我打个半死！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not buying it. I mean, I know it's scary, but you can't half-ass something like this, you know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不吃这套。我想说，我知道可怕之处，可你不能做什么都这样畏首畏尾，你懂吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, go on out there walk through that Minefield like a real researcher!
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，去穿越那片雷区吧，像个真正的研究员那样！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not buying it. I mean, I know it's scary, but you can't half-ass something like this, you know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不吃这套。我想说，我知道可怕之处，可你不能做什么都这样畏首畏尾，你懂吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, go on out there walk through that Minefield like a real researcher!
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，去穿越那片雷区吧，像个真正的研究员那样！

ESP.TRADUIT: 又一个满意的顾客。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pleasure doing business with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴和你做生意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You must come back soon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有空再来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's been a pleasure doing business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 做生意令人快乐。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enjoy your meal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 慢慢吃啊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't forget to sign out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别忘了签退。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Durga [0601E71A] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gotcha. We'll see you next time... leech...
ESP.TRADUIT: 抓住你了。我们会再见的……小偷……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Durga [0601E71A] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Try not to break it, outsider.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小心别打破，外来者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Durga [0601E71A] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come again! I should have more stuff in soon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎再来！我应该很快就补充货物了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Always a grab bag with my stuff, see?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的货里总有个摸彩袋，看见了吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come back later. Never know when I'll get another big find!
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎再来。天知道我什么时候又有大发现！

ESP.ORIGINAL: What wonderful items for the Museum of Dave!
ESP.TRADUIT: 对戴夫博物馆来说，这是绝佳的物品！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, yeah. I hope you choke on it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，嗯。你怎么不呛死。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't like your deal? Tough shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对你的交易不满？活该。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No refunds, asshole.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恕不退款，混蛋。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Watch out!
ESP.TRADUIT: 小心点！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇哦！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look out!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当心！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Damn, it's a fight!
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死，有人打架！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ain't none of my business!
ESP.TRADUIT: 与我无关！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇哦！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Watch out!
ESP.TRADUIT: 小心点！

ESP.ORIGINAL: This should be interesting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这应该很有趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Barbarians.
ESP.TRADUIT: 野蛮人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([00015A37]GenericRobot) 00015A37 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : with a superior sniff EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: So much violence in the world these days.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这年头暴力真多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([00015A37]GenericRobot) 00015A37 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : with a superior sniff EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is madness...
ESP.TRADUIT: 这太疯狂了……

ESP.ORIGINAL: This isn't right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这可不对。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is what we've come to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我们此行的目的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah! Awesome!
ESP.TRADUIT: 耶！棒极了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Me no kaade partu estee.
ESP.TRADUIT: 窝不想掺合。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fight!
ESP.TRADUIT: 打啊！

ESP.ORIGINAL: It would be nice if things could stop tearing each other apart around here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果大家能不老想着自相残杀，那世界会美好得多。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's time for you to leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你该走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've got to leave now so I can lock up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你得走了，我要关门了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm locking up, so you'll need to leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要关门了，你必须走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从这出去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Time for you to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你该走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is an automated distress message from Vault-Tec Vault 101. Message begins:
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一条由101号避难所发出的自动求救信号。消息内容如下：
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protectron [0601CF8F] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Should be said in neutral tone, preferably in one of the robot voices. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We stand now at the precipice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们现在站在悬崖边上。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rangers, this is the chief. I know I can ramble on sometimes, but I need you to listen close for the next minute or so. I've got some bad news.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵们，我是士官长。我知道有时候我可能有些爱唠叨，但接下来的几分钟，希望你们给我竖起耳朵听好。我有一个坏消息要宣布。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hanlon's Suicide Broadcast [0015867A] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I messed up. Made a mistake. I thought I could help get us out of here, but... it didn't work out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我错了。我犯了一个重大的错误。我原以为能帮助大家离开这里，但是……我失败了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hanlon's Suicide Broadcast [0015867A] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rangers get injured all the time. It's part of the job. But if you lose a few fingers, get a bad break, that's it. You step down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对游骑兵来说，流血负伤不过是家常便饭。大家入了行，也就自有分寸。可你要是断了几根指头，或者身体的哪一截成了麻花，那你的戎马生涯就到此为止了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hanlon's Suicide Broadcast [0015867A] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We rely on each other too much to let our infirmities become a liability. A ranger knows when it's time. Only I didn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们正是靠着彼此照应，才克服了原本的软弱，将其转化为了坚强。游骑兵都应当刚毅果决，可我却忘了这个道理。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hanlon's Suicide Broadcast [0015867A] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Somewhere along the way, something broke inside me. I couldn't find us a way out of this desert. I wrestled with it, and it took me down a dark road.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我感觉心灵深处，仿佛有东西迷失了。我找不到走出这片沙漠的方法。我奋力挣扎，却在这条漆黑的道路上越陷越深。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hanlon's Suicide Broadcast [0015867A] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wish I could explain it to you. The old chief's finally at a loss for words.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望能把这一切都向你们解释清楚。可你们的老士官长这次真的是无言以对了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hanlon's Suicide Broadcast [0015867A] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Send me all the Legion you can. I'll be waiting for them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多送些军团的人来陪我吧，我在地狱里等着他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hanlon's Suicide Broadcast [0015867A] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Howdy. My name is Jed Masterson, and I'm a caravan boss for the Happy Trails Caravan Company.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好。我的名字叫杰德·马斯特森，我是“欢乐小径”商队公司的老板。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dean
ESP.TRADUIT: 迪安

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is the Overseer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是监督者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Overseer Mack [0603D346] (mod) NPC : Radio 101 [0002485B] (mod) Quest : ([00071622]RadioVault101PA) Vault 101 PA system EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is the Overseer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是监督者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) NPC : Radio 101 [0002485B] (mod) Quest : ([00071622]RadioVault101PA) Vault 101 PA system EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Outside of the Pitt, the world lies in ruins and survivors scratch in the dirt without dreams. But in the Pitt, we can live and rebuild with purpose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在匹兹堡外边，世界一片废墟，有幸活下来的人在尘土中苟延残喘，他们没有梦想。但在匹兹堡，我们可以活着，有目的地重建家园。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you know -- the Vault-Tec/RobCo partnership is considered the most successful joint venture in the history of American industry?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道吗 — 避难所科技/RobCo的合作关系被公认为美国工业史上最成功的一次合资。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([00071622]RadioVault101PA) Vault 101 PA system EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's up Wastelanders? This is Three Dog, and you're listening to GNR! That's Galaxy News Radio, in case you forgot...
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么了，废土人民？这是三狗，你正在收听的是GNR！也就是银河新闻电台，如果你忘了的话……

ESP.ORIGINAL: <unintelligible>
ESP.TRADUIT: <莫明其妙的>
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0007C707] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : This should be in Alien Gibberish. We'll do several versions of this. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All peace-loving peoples must join together to stop the war of aggression being waged by the Wall Street gang!
ESP.TRADUIT: 所有热爱和平的人民应当紧密团结起来，遏制由华尔街罪恶组织发动的侵略战争！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : People's Republic of America Radio [0007C708] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : delivered in a chinese accent if possible EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is Tenpenny Tower radio, music and inspiring talk for forward thinking people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是特佩尼大厦电台，献给超前思想人士的音乐与鼓舞人心的对话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : trying to be a radio celebrity EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Game Over Man! GAME OVER!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哥们这回惨了！死定了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, then, let grandma see what she's got...
ESP.TRADUIT: 好啦，那么，让奶奶看看她都带了些什么好东西...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lily [0015F9BA] (mod) NPC : Lily's Grandkids Recording [0015F9BD] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can't be serious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是开玩笑吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, right. I'm not holding out hope for the cavalry to come save the world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，没错。我对装甲兵拯救世界早已不抱幻想了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope you're right. I really do. But after 200 years, don't you think they'd have done something by now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望你是对的。我真的希望。但你不觉得200年来他们应该已经做了些什么吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: "We have come from God and unto him we shall return..."
ESP.TRADUIT: “我们自主而来，亦将复归主去……”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : Quoting the Koran EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, come on. I'm a nice guy, really. May I please come in?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，拜托。我是个好人，真的。我能进去吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, okay. But you better not be lying, or else we'll shoot you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。你最好别撒谎，不然我们把你射成马蜂窝。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, come on. I'm a nice guy, really. May I please come in?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，拜托。我是个好人，真的。我能进去吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, okay. But you better not be lying, or else we'll shoot you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。你最好别撒谎，不然我们把你射成马蜂窝。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, come on. I'm a nice gal, really. May I please come in?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，拜托。我是个好人，真的。我能进去吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I'm sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我肯定。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, if you say so...
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，如果你这么说……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mayor MacCready [060156AC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8C]MQ06) Picking Up the Trail EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on. Let's get the gate open for you, mungo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 毛人，来吧，我去给你开门。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mayor MacCready [060156AC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8C]MQ06) Picking Up the Trail EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to use Murder Pass to reach Vault 87.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想穿过杀戮通道去87号避难所。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You sure about that? It's scary in there. Even I don't like going in there, and I'm really brave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你确定吗？那很可怕的，像我这么勇敢的人都不会轻易去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mayor MacCready [060156AC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8C]MQ06) Picking Up the Trail EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hear there's a door that doesn't work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说这有扇门打不开。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nuh-uh. Door works fine. Computer's broke.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。门没问题，电脑坏了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joseph [0601568D] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8C]MQ06) Picking Up the Trail Comment (NAM2) : indifferent EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, maybe not broke, but it sure don't work right. I turned it off because it was just wasting power.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，或许不是坏了，但现在确实不能用。我把它关上了，不然纯粹是在浪费电。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joseph [0601568D] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8C]MQ06) Picking Up the Trail Comment (NAM2) : indifferent EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Know anything about the area outside Megaton?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道核弹镇外面的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Outside of Megaton? Any place other than here sounds like heaven to me. Fuck this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说核弹镇外面？除了这以外的任何地方对我来说都是天堂。这鬼地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06000A6C] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Momentarily less hostile, gets to note of genuine caring when mentioning his family.

ESP.ORIGINAL: If it weren't for you Wasteland types coming through with your caps, I'd be out of here in a second. Assuming that I could convince Jenny and Leo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要不是你这种爱在废土冒险的人经常带着不少瓶盖路过这里，我早就离开这了。前提是我能说服珍妮和利奥的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06000A6C] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Momentarily less hostile, gets to note of genuine caring when mentioning his family.

ESP.ORIGINAL: I spent a lot of time out there and I've left a lot of ghosts in my path. Some of them, well... they're coming a bit close to catching up to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在那度过了很长时间，枪下也添了不少冤魂。当中有些人，唉……差点就把我干掉了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you know about the Wasteland?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道关于废土的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've said just about all I'm going to say about that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要说的已经全说了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you know about the Wasteland?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道关于废土的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's called "The Wasteland" for a reason. But there are settlements, too, spread all around. The human race is stubborn like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这被称作“废土”是有原因的。但到处都有新的定居点，人类就是这么顽强。

ESP.ORIGINAL: To the south you got Rivet City, but don't bother going to D.C. The place is a warzone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 往南走你能找到铆钉城，但没事别去特区，那是战区。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can you tell me about Megaton?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能和我说说核弹镇吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a hole. A dead end. So why do I stay? Well... it's a hole that makes me money.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是个破坑。一条死路。那我为什么还留在这？哼……我得该死的赚钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stay the fuck out of me business, don't go where you don't belong, and buy your drinks here. That's all you need to know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死的别管我的事，别去不该去的地方，再有就是到这来买酒。这就是你需要知道的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some people hate this place, but I guess that's their right, what the hell do they want out of life? Food, shelter and safety. Works for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有些人讨厌这，但我想他们有权讨厌。除了活下去以外他们还想要什么？吃的，住的，还有安全感，至少对我是这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jenny Stahl [06000A6D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : hyper/drugged up but sarcastic EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there a bar in town?
ESP.TRADUIT: 镇上有酒吧吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you joking? Yes, there's a bar -- The Brass Lantern. It's easy to find since you're standing in it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你开玩笑吧？是的，有个酒吧 — 黄铜灯。它很好找，因为你正站在里面。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I apologize, but I cannot encourage the consumption of alcohol. Alcohol impedes our personal quest for the Grand Division.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，但我不鼓励喝酒。酒精会妨碍到我们执行防卫的任务。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure is -- Moriarty's. The entrance is on the top level, opposite the Main Gate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然有 — 莫里亚蒂那。入口在最上层，正对着核弹镇的大门。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just be careful. Moriarty is NOT your friend, no matter what he may say, so don't fall for his lies. And for god's sake, don't trust the man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是要当心，不管莫里亚蒂说什么，他都不会成为你的朋友，所以别被他的谎话骗了。看在上帝的份上，别相信那人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need some equipment. Where's the nearest general store?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要一些装备。请问最近的店在哪？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Seek out Moira at Craterside Supply, although the true pilgrim relies on Atom to supply all that he needs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去坑边杂货店找莫伊拉，尽管一个真正的信徒会仰仗原子来满足他需要的一切。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Moira sells all kinds of stuff at her place, Craterside Supply. Take a guess where it is? Heh heh heh heh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 莫伊拉的店，坑边杂货店，里面什么都卖。猜猜在哪吧？呵呵呵呵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Seek out Moira at Craterside Supply. She's a darling girl.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去坑边杂货店找莫伊拉。她可是个可爱的女孩。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where's the closest clinic?
ESP.TRADUIT: 最近的诊所在哪？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll want to see Doc Church next to the Crater. Take your time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以去找弹坑边的丘奇博士。不用着急。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06000A6C] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Coldly. He might be wishing for your death just so you'll leave him alone. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Atom can only heal the wounds of the soul. For wounds of the body, you should see Doc Church. His clinic is directly to the north the Church.
ESP.TRADUIT: 原子教只能医治灵魂上的创伤。肉体上的，你得去找丘奇博士。他的诊所在弹坑正北方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our clinic is down in the crater, by the bomb. Doc Church is a little rough around the edges, but the man's got talent and compassion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的诊所在弹坑边，核弹旁。丘奇博士可能会稍微有点粗暴，不过他挺聪明，也挺热心。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll want to see Doc Church next to the Crater. You can't miss it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以去找弹坑边的丘奇博士，很容易找到的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for my father. Middle-aged guy. Maybe you've seen him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正在寻找我父亲，一名中年男子。你见过他吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: My God... It's you. The little baby boy, all grown up. Persistent little bastard, ain't ya? Then and now, it would seem. It's been a long time, kid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的天啊……是你。小男孩彻底长大了，都成了小帅哥了。估计以后会越来越帅。时间过得真快，孩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, your daddy passed through here, all right. Here and gone. Got what he came for, and then left. I'm assuming you'll do the same, correct?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你父亲来过这，是的。来了又走了。得到了他想要的随后就离开了。我猜你跟他一样，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My God... It's you. The little baby girl, all grown up. Persistent little flower, ain't ya? Then and now, it would seem. It's been a long time, kid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的天啊……是你。小女孩彻底长大了，都成了小美女了。估计以后会越来越美。时间过得真快，孩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, your daddy passed through here, all right. Here and gone. Got what he came for, and then left. I'm assuming you'll do the same, correct?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你父亲来过这，是的。来了又走了，得到了他想要的随后就离开了。我猜你跟他一样，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, yeah! I do remember a guy like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，耶！我确实记得这样一个人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Honestly, I usually keep my head down. I tend to get smacked around if I look customers in the eyes. But talk to Moriarty, he'll know more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 坦白说，平时我都是低着头的，如果盯着顾客看我会被揍的。去找莫里亚蒂谈吧，他知道得更多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't talk about that anymore. Moriarty will beat me again if I do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能跟你多说，否则莫里亚蒂又会打我了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not in here, I haven't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没见过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06000A6C] (ID) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps Comment (NAM2) : EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Many of the transient visitors end up at one of Megaton's seedier establishments.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很多匆匆的旅行者都最后选择在核弹镇的某个破房子里定居了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Confessor Cromwell [06000A6F] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suggest you speak to Colin Moriarty and continue your search there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要想继续找寻，我建议去科林·莫里亚蒂那。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Confessor Cromwell [06000A6F] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh man, you're looking for your dad? That is so sweet! Did he run out on you when you were a kid or something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，伙计，你在找你父亲？听起来真亲切！他在你还是个孩子的时候就抛下你走了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jenny Stahl [06000A6D] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our parents died when we were kids. My brother Leo, he's the oldest, he raised my brother Andy and me. It was hard on him, but we turned out okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的父母在我们还小的时候就死了。我的哥哥利奥，他是家里最大的了，抚养安迪和我长大。对他来说这很不容易，但我们还是活下来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jenny Stahl [06000A6D] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But God, you don't want to hear about that. I'm sorry, but I haven't seen your dad. He didn't eat at the Brass Lantern. I'd remember if he did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可是，天啊，你不会希望听到这些的。我很抱歉，我没见过你父亲。他没在黄铜灯里吃过饭，否则我会知道有那么个人的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jenny Stahl [06000A6D] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I usually avoid most of the Wasteland types that come through here, but there was one guy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一般我不愿意跟那些从废土来这的人打交道，但有一个人例外。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jericho [06000A71] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unlike most of the wannabe heroes that come in, he looked like he could actually read a book without giving himself a headache.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟那些梦想成为英雄的人不同，他看上去能静下心来读一本书而不会感到头疼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jericho [06000A71] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He spent a bunch of time at Moriarty's before moving on. I'd try talking to Colin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他离开之前在莫里亚蒂那待了好一阵子，去找科林谈谈看吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jericho [06000A71] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm glad we understand each other. Now, have you seen my dad?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很高兴我们能相互理解。现在，你见过我的父亲吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I usually avoid most of the Wasteland types that come through here, but there was one guy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一般我不愿意跟那些从废土来这的人打交道，但有一个人例外。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jericho [06000A71] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unlike most of the wannabe heroes that come in, he looked like he could actually read a book without giving himself a headache.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟那些梦想成为英雄的人不同，他看上去能静下心来读一本书而不会感到头疼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jericho [06000A71] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He spent a bunch of time at Moriarty's before moving on. I'd try talking to Colin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他离开之前在莫里亚蒂那待了好一阵子，去找科林谈谈看吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jericho [06000A71] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, come to think of it, I do remember a stranger coming through here. Had a look in his eye. You know the kind a man gets when he's got a purpose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 细想一下的话，我确实记得有个外来人来过。我注意到他的眼神。你知道当人怀有某种目的的时候眼神是特别的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Spent some time up in the saloon. Might want to check with Moriarty. Just watch yourself. That man's trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在酒吧待了一会，或许你可以去问问莫里亚蒂，但你自己要当心，那家伙可不好惹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now that I'm helping you, maybe you can help me. I'm looking for my dad...
ESP.TRADUIT: 既然我帮了你，或许你也可以帮我。我在寻找我的父亲……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Could be the guy I saw at Moriarty's Saloon not too long ago. I'd ask there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可能是不久之前我在莫里亚蒂的酒吧里见到的那个人。你去那问问。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Weld [0601FB39] (mod) NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) NPC : Nova [06000A63] (mod) NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) NPC : [06000A6C] (ID) NPC : [06000A65] (ID) NPC : Confessor Cromwell [06000A6F] (mod) NPC : Doc Church [06000A6E] (mod) NPC : Jenny Stahl [06000A6D] (mod) NPC : Leo Stahl [06000A6B] (mod) NPC : Jericho [06000A71] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pffft. Nice hat, Calamity Jane.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呸，好一顶帽子，瘟神。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So that's the way it's gonna be, huh? That's fine. That's fine...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就这副德行，呃？好吧，好吧……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just as long as we understand each other. This here is my town. These are my people. You so much as breathe wrong, and I'm gonna fuckin' end ya.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要我们能互相明白就好。这是我的镇子，他们是我的镇民。你要是敢惹麻烦，我就他妈的干掉你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there a weapons dealer around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这附近有武器供应商吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go see Moira at Craterside Supply. She sells some weapons. Makes some too, from what I hear. Her place is down by the crater.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去坑边补给点找莫伊拉。她有些武器卖，我还听说她也自己制作一些。她的店就在下面的弹坑边。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll probably want to see Moira at Craterside Supply. She sells some weapons. Makes some too, from what I hear. Her place is down by the crater.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你或许应该去坑边杂货店找莫伊拉。她有些武器卖，我还听说她也自己制作一些。她的店就在下面的弹坑边。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well I'll be! I could have sworn I heard this corpse speak! But that's impossible. Dead men don't talk, do they? They LISTEN. They OBEY.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，这么说吧。我可以发誓我听到这具尸体说话了！但那不可能，死人不会说话，对吧？他们只会听，只会服从。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, hey Jericho, baby! What's going on?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，嗨，亲爱的耶利哥！最近怎么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jericho [06000A71] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Flirty, but cautious. EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jericho, baby! What's happening?
ESP.TRADUIT: 亲爱的耶利哥！近来好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jericho [06000A71] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Flirty, but cautious. EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Food, Jericho. It's all I had for you yesterday. It's all I have for you today. It's all I'll ever have for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 食物，耶利哥。这是我昨天能为你准备的，这也是我今天能为你准备的，这同样会是我以后能为你准备的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, Leo... what do you need?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，利奥……你想要什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is it, Leo?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么了，利奥？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, heya Nathan. Sorry, I got lost in my work. What do you need?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，嗨呀，内森。抱歉我光忙自己的了。你需要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've been having those visions again. Not while I sleep, dear husband, but waking dreams. I see Atom, finally free! His glory revealed at last!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我再次憧憬这样的场面。不是在睡梦中，亲爱的老公，而是清醒地看到。我看到原子最终被解放了！他的光辉最终迸发！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You said we could take that trip. Up north, you know? To see one of the old towns? Come on, dad, you promised...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说过我们可以走那条路，往北，你懂吗？去找那些古老的镇子，拜托，爸爸，你答应过的...

ESP.ORIGINAL: We still haven't built that model, you know. The Corvega? You told me we could do it this weekend...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们还没完成那模型。科维加？你告诉过我，我们可以这周末再去的...

ESP.ORIGINAL: I set that special wine aside for you. The one you said makes you really... uninhibited.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把那种特别的酒放在你边上了，就是你说的那种使你……天不怕地不怕的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You look beautiful today, Nova. Just like always.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你今天看上去真漂亮，诺瓦。一如往常。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, I know you've turned me down before, but I'm gonna ask again -- what would you think about goin' out sometime?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，我知道你之前拒绝过我，但我还想再问一次 — 你愿意找个时间和我一起出去吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard something about you, boy. I heard that you was a scout for the Raiders, here to recoin.. recon... err... check out our defenses. That true?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说过你的事，小子，我听说你是那些歹徒派来的探子，到这来刺……刺……嗯，刺探我们的防卫情况，没错吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. Good idea. Not gonna happen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好主意。没事的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And where do you propose that we pick one of those up? We'd have to pay the caravan scavengers, and who knows what they'd bring back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得我们去哪能找个商队保镖来？我们要付钱拾荒人，但谁知道他们会有什么贡献。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure thing! ... you miserable drunken asshole ...
ESP.TRADUIT: 没问题！……你这烂醉如泥的混蛋……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : The second line is said quietly and under his breath. He's hoping that Jericho is too drunk to notice. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One more drink, coming up! ... shitbird ...
ESP.TRADUIT: 再来一杯，快点！……傻鸟……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : The second line is said quietly and under his breath. He's hoping that Jericho is too drunk to notice. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We should stay our course, dearest husband. Atom's power penetrates us all, does it not? Soon, every soul of Megaton will revel in His glory!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们应该坚持下去，亲爱的老公。原子的力量会渗透我们所有人，对吧？很快，核弹镇的每个灵魂都会陶醉于他的光辉之下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do not despair, dearest husband. Soon, all of Megaton will bask in Atom's glow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别灰心，亲爱的老公。很快，核弹镇的一切都会沐浴在原子的光辉下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Always with the nagging... I'll do what I do when I do it, woman.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别老是唠叨……我知道什么时候该干嘛。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who told you that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁告诉你的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Me? A Raider? Are you joking? I'm not a Raider! I've never even met a Raider before!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说我？歹徒？你开玩笑吧？我不是歹徒！我甚至都没见过歹徒！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not a Raider! I swear! Who told you that? They're lying!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我发誓，我不是歹徒！谁告诉你的？他们撒谎！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Me? Working with Raiders? Hell no! I just want to get a place here in Megaton, and I'll kill any Raider who shows up here to prove it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我？为歹徒工作？瞎说！我只是要在核弹镇找个住处，我愿意干掉闯入这的歹徒来证明！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry... Who's Maggie?
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉……谁是玛姬？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh! Sorry, I guess I got ahead of myself, huh? Maggie's nine, sweetest little girl you'd ever care to meet. We take care of each other.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦！抱歉，我只顾自言自语了，呃？玛姬只有九岁，一个你肯定想见见的可爱小女孩，她和我相依为命。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I ain't never had a daughter, but if I did, I'd want her to be Maggie. I took her in when her parents got killed by Raiders. That was two years ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有过女儿，但如果有的话，我希望就是玛姬。在她父母被歹徒杀害以后我收养了她，那是两年前的事了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was a pretty bad scene. Small settlement up north. I'd stopped in to trade some salvage, and the whole place had been wiped out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当时可是一片惨象。北面有一块小型定居点，我曾到那去倒卖废品，却发现那已被屠戮一空。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found Maggie hiding under a bed, in the same room where her parents had been butchered. We've been together ever since.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我发现玛姬藏在床底下，就在她父母被屠杀的那间房子里。从那以后，我们一直生活在一起。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have to go now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在要走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please, do what you can to find my brother.
ESP.TRADUIT: 求你了，尽你所能找到我的兄弟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06000A69] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, thanks again for doing this for me, it means a lot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，再次感谢你为我们做的这些，对我们很重要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06000A69] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Remember, my offer still stands.
ESP.TRADUIT: 记住，我的提议仍然有效。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06000A69] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Family.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和我说说家族。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Family has become our moniker because that is exactly what we are... related by blood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 家族成为了我们的绰号，正因为我们是为了……该死的血液而活。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Even if all of us look different on the outside, we all have had the same vice infesting our insides.
ESP.TRADUIT: 即便我们外表并不相同，但同样的邪恶在我们体内滋长。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: But now, through my teachings, these subjugated people have come together and formed a bond stronger than mere friendship.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但现在，在我的教导之下，这些顺民被一种比友谊更强的纽带维系在一起。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for Ian West. Have you seen him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正在找伊恩·维斯特，你见过他吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I haven't seen any of the Wests since we were told to head indoors.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我自从被告知待在屋里后，就再没见过任何维斯特家的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Karen Schenzy [0601D714] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nope. Everyone stays inside, except Evan King of course.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有，所有人都待在屋里，当然除了埃万·金。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ken Ewers [0601D710] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I recall he and the boys are probably at the lake fishing. Those rapscallions! There's no telling what monkeyshines they'll get into next!
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果没记错他和那群人应该在湖边打鱼。那群流氓！谁知道他们下一步会做出什么来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brailee Ewers [0601D711] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm afraid Vance has him in isolation and there's no way I'm going to override Vance's orders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恐怕万斯正让他独处，我可不会违抗他的命令。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's a good kid. I think Vance will set him along the correct path soon... like he did for all of us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个好孩子，我想万斯会引导他走上正路的……就像他引导我们那样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Like I said, he's in isolation. It's his time to meditate and reflect.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说过，他在独处，这是他专门用来冥想和反省的时间。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything else you can tell me about Ian West?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以和我说说关于伊恩·维斯特的其他事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Vance has him in meditation right now. No one's supposed to be in there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 万斯正让他冥想，不许任何人进去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brianna [060200BB] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Poor kid... he looks like he could use another friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可怜的孩子……看上去他需要一个朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brianna [060200BB] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nope. Like I told ya, Vance has him in meditation right now. No one's supposed to be in there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不行，我告诉过你了，万斯正让他冥想，不许任何人进去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brianna [060200BB] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything else you can tell me about Ian West?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以和我说说关于伊恩·维斯特的其他事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have any authority here. I'm pretty new myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在这没有任何权力，我只是个新人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alan [060200BE] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Justin's been trying to talk to Ian; make him feel better. Maybe you should speak to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 贾斯汀正试着跟伊恩谈话使他好过一些。或许你应该去找他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alan [060200BE] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do I look like a fucking babysitter? I don't know where he is. Even if I did, I wouldn't tell you anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我他妈的像个保姆吗？我不知道他在哪，就算知道，也绝不会告诉你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Karl [060200C4] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ian, Ian, Ian! Is that all you've got to say? Sheesh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 伊恩，伊恩，伊恩！你就只会说这些吗？天啊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Karl [060200C4] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything else you can tell me about Ian West?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以和我说说关于伊恩·维斯特的其他事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ian? What do you want from him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 伊恩？你找他干嘛？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Justin [060200C9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, just that Vance said he isn't to be disturbed while he's in meditation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，只是万斯说过他在冥想的时候不能被打扰。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Justin [060200C9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything else you can tell me about Ian West?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以和我说说关于伊恩·维斯特的其他事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had always assumed if a human happened upon our home, it would be for the purpose of our extermination.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我一直以为如果有人类接近我们的家，就是来屠杀我们的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: It appears my fears were ill-placed. It is a pleasant surprise to meet someone as amenable as yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来我的担心是错误的。能碰见像你这样通情达理的人真是让人惊奇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. I will allow you to speak to Ian. Perhaps you can help him come to grips with his greatest enemy. Himself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，我会让你去找伊恩谈。或许你能帮他对付他最大的敌人。他自己。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now that I have a better understanding of the Family, may I speak to Ian?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在我对家族有了了解，我可以和伊恩谈谈吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe I was very clear when I said you are not welcome to see him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我说的很清楚了，我们不欢迎你去见他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please allow me to speak to Ian.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请让我和伊恩谈谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah yes, my newest charge. What would you want with him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，是的，那个新来的孩子。你找他做什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've been searching for a young man named Ian West.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找一个叫伊恩·维斯特的年轻人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the word around town?
ESP.TRADUIT: 镇里有什么传闻？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Moriarty pisses in his still -- crazy bastard thinks it's hilarious. Besides, you'll get your throat cut in that pit. You're much better off here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 莫里亚蒂往他的酒里撒尿 — 这疯子认为这很搞笑。除此之外，你还可能在他的酒窖里被干掉，所以你最好离开这。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06000A6C] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Amusing himself. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, maybe I'll put that on the sign out front: "The Brass Lantern: Cleaner, safer, and less likely to have piss in the drinks".
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，或许我应该在这前面竖块牌子：“黄铜灯：更清洁，更安全，酒里面的尿更少”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06000A6C] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Amusing himself. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: People've been sayin' that there's somethin' wrong with the water purifier. But Ol' Walter's been keepin' that thing runnin' for decades.
ESP.TRADUIT: 人们都说净化器出了什么问题，但老沃尔特已经让那东西连续运转几十年了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not worried. No reason it'd pick now to go down for good... would it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不担心，那东西没理由会在这时候出问题……对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I own a saloon, kid. Rumors are part and parcel. So I'll give you this one for free...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我拥有一个酒吧，孩子。传闻是很重要的，所以我免费提供给你这一条……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not sure if you've met her, but Lucy West, that pretty young thing? She's afraid. Of what, of who, I couldn't say. But you can feel the fear on her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你见过露西·维斯特，那小美女了吗？她很害怕。但是害怕什么人或事我就不能说了，不过你可以感觉到她的那份恐惧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I already told you about the Stahl boy's drug problem. You said you wanted to help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经告诉过你斯塔尔那孩子嗑药的事了，你说过你会帮忙的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's about all the confidences I'm going to break for you, stranger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是所有我能对你敞开的心里话了，陌生人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you know about the people here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你了解这的人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A doctor doesn't talk about his patients. At least not to strangers, he doesn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 医生不跟别人谈论他的病人，至少不跟陌生人谈，没得商量。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you know about the people here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你了解这的人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I ain't heard much. Truth be told, I don't really ever leave the Lantern. Too much work, too few hours in the day, ya know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没听到多少。老实讲，我没什么机会离开黄铜灯，工作太多而时间太少，懂吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Remember what I told you, kid: Moriarty keeps his money locked up right next to his bed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 记住我告诉你的，孩子：莫里亚蒂把钱锁在他床头右侧的柜子里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, I just haven't been paying any attention at all since Nathan died.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很抱歉，内森的死让我无法回过神来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06000A68] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Still missing her husband. EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's only one thing that concerns me in this town these days: what my damn fool husband is doing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这几天镇子里唯一让我心烦的事就是：我那该死的白痴老公在干嘛。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He wanders around here all day and all night, preaching about the Enclave and tryin' to get parts for his guns.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他白天晚上都在这附近转来转去，一边向人讲述英克雷的故事，一边收集他那把枪的零件。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not sure who's the bigger fool, him or me. After all, I married him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道他和我哪个更傻，毕竟，我嫁给了他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not one to gossip, but I do know a few things. For instance, did you hear that Lucas wants someone to disarm our bomb?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是爱说闲话的人，但我确实知道些什么。比如，你听说卢卡斯在找人拆除那核弹吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Imagine the blasphemy! I can't believe it! I mean, I don't believe it. He would never do that to us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是种侮辱！我无法相信！嗯，我根本不相信！他绝不会对我们做这种事的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I couldn't tell you, really. I'd talk to Manya if you care that much. She's lived in Megaton longer than anyone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真的没法告诉你。如果你那么在意应该去找曼雅，她在核弹镇里住得比任何人都久。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Weld [0601FB39] (mod) NPC : Jericho [06000A71] (mod) NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) NPC : [06000A68] (ID) NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It used to be that you could ask Manya just about anything. Now that she's gone, I don't know what to tell you...
ESP.TRADUIT: 以前你可以去问曼雅任何事，现在她死了，我不知道我还能告诉你什么……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jericho [06000A71] (mod) NPC : Deputy Weld [0601FB39] (mod) NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) NPC : [06000A68] (ID) NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me where he is, Moriarty, or I'll beat it out of you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉我他去哪了，莫里亚蒂。否则我打到你说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha! Oh, kid... ah... I'll let that one go, chalk it up to youthful arrogance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈哈哈哈哈！哦，孩子……啊……我就饶了你这次，算是原谅年轻人的傲慢吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Listen carefully. I don't know what Sheriff Simms told you, but this is my town. Simms, he's a facade. An illusion of order I allow to exist.
ESP.TRADUIT: 仔细听着，我不知道西姆斯警长跟你说了什么，但这是我统治的镇子。西姆斯，他只是个傀儡，一个我允许存在的傀儡。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was slinging drinks and killing Raiders here in Megaton when the good sheriff was just an idiot kid with cowboy fantasies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当那大警长还是个沉迷装扮成牛仔的小屁孩的时候，我就在核弹镇里买醉和杀歹徒了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Raise a hand to me, and you'll never leave this town alive. Now, as for your dad... 100 caps, and I sing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要你敢对我动手的话，我会让你直着进来，横着出去。至于你父亲的事……100个瓶盖，我就说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're lying. The Vault's been sealed for 200 years!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你撒谎，避难所已经关闭了200多年。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha ha ha ha ha! God in Heaven, would you listen to yourself? Do you honestly believe that's true? The lies they've put into that head of yours...
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈哈哈哈！天上的主啊，你在自圆其说吗？你真的相信那是真的吗？真的相信他们的胡扯...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your father brought you to the Vault right after you were born. To keep you safe, you see. I remember it well -- you stayed in my saloon, after all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在你出生后不久，你父亲就带你去了避难所。这是为了你的安全，我记得很清楚 — 你毕竟在我的酒吧里待过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's right. Your father, his Brotherhood of Steel friend, and you, the suckling babe with nary a tit to suckle. Sorry about your mum. Truly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，你父亲，和他在钢铁兄弟会的朋友，还有你这乳臭未干的小子。至于你的母亲，真的很抱歉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, no matter. That big round door has opened now, hasn't it? Daddy's gone, and you need to know why. Could be I know where, and why...
ESP.TRADUIT: 但无论如何，那扇大圆门已经打开了，对吧？父亲出走了，而你想知道为什么，而我则是那个知道他去了哪以及为什么去的人...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me what you know! Tell me everything!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道什么都告诉我！所有！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, temper, temper. And your father was so reserved. Take after our mum, do we? God rest her soul.
ESP.TRADUIT: 冷静，想想你父亲多稳重。缅怀下你母亲吧。愿主令她的灵魂安息。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But at least you've got balls. Yeah, I know your dad, met him when you were just a baby, when you two passed through here on your way to the Vault.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但至少你还有种。嗯，我认识你父亲，在你还是一个婴儿的时候就见过他。那时候你们在去避难所的路上，正好经过这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You look shocked. You didn't think you were born in that hole, did you? Good Christ, boy. Know the truth, and it will set you free.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看上去挺惊讶的。你不会认为自己是在那洞里出生的，对吗？上帝保佑，明白真相会让你解脱的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, temper, temper. And your father was so reserved. Take after our mum, do we? God rest her soul.
ESP.TRADUIT: 冷静，想想你父亲多稳重。缅怀下你母亲吧。愿主令她的灵魂安息。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But at least you've got spunk. Yeah, I know your dad, met him when you were just a baby, when you two passed through here on your way to the Vault.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但至少你还有种。嗯，我认识你父亲，在你还是一个婴儿的时候就见过他。那时候你们在去避难所的路上，正好经过这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You look shocked. You didn't think you were born in that hole, did you? Ah, Lord... Know the truth, and it will set you free.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看上去挺惊讶的。你不会认为自己是在那洞里出生的，对吗？上帝保佑，明白真相会让你解脱的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Huh? My father and I were born in Vault 101...
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃？我父亲和我都出生在101号避难所里……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that what your father told you? That you were born in that hole? That HE was born there as well?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你父亲那么跟你说的？说你是在那洞里出生的？而且他也是的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, the lies we tell to those we love.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我们总是对所爱的人撒谎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your father brought you to the Vault right after you were born. To keep you safe, you see. I remember it well -- you stayed in my saloon, after all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在你出生后不久，你父亲就带你去了避难所。这是为了你的安全，我记得很清楚 — 你毕竟在我的酒吧里待过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's right. Your father, his Brotherhood of Steel friend, and you, the suckling babe with nary a tit to suckle. Sorry about your mom. Truly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，你父亲，和他在钢铁兄弟会的朋友，还有你这乳臭未干的小子。至于你的母亲，真的很抱歉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, life goes on. Daddy lied. Life's full of little disappointments. And now... you're all grown up, and wondering where he's gone to...
ESP.TRADUIT: 但，日子总要过下去。你父亲骗了你，正如生命里总是有这样那样的失望一样。现在……你长大了，想去找你的父亲...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was kidding! Dad talked about you all the time. Now really, where is he? <Lie.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 我刚才开玩笑呢！爸爸总是说起你。到底他去了哪？<撒谎>

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's on the menu?
ESP.TRADUIT: 菜单上都有什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, hon. The noodle stand is closed. If you want something, ask Leo in the restaurant.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，甜心。面铺已经关门了，如果你想点什么的话，到饭馆里面去问利奥吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then you best unhear it. I know all about you, old man. I'd be careful before I went around town spreading rumors about Raiders. You dig?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你最好什么也没听见。我知道你的一切，老头。在我往镇子上散布歹徒的传闻前最好小心，你懂了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060043C4] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Very threatening. He knows Jericho's secret, but he's willing to be quiet if Jericho does the same. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, well I'm the one accountable for this place -- not you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我是这地方的负责人 — 不是你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, all right! Stop your pathetic sniveling and just do what you're fucking told.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，好了！别哭得那么惨了，你他妈的该干嘛就干嘛。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gob? If I hear one more excuse come out of that rotting mouth, I'm going to sew it shut. Okay? There's a good zombie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 盖博？如果我再听到你那烂嘴里吐出借口，就会把你的嘴缝起来，听到了吗？当个好丧尸就行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now don't you go getting all mushy on me! We just... We got to look out for each other, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 别总来我这撒娇！我们得……我们得互相照料，对不对？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, if we ain't going to look out for each other, what's the point? You think Colin gives a shit about us, Gob? Come on, sweetie, wake up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，如果我们不互相照顾的话，还能怎样？你难道觉得科林会把我们当回事，盖博？拜托，甜心，醒醒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's important, Leo! I have to keep our head above water here. Please, just try to be more careful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这很重要，利奥！我不能让我们欠债，拜托，尽量小心。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha ha! I just love seeing you happy, sweetheart.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈！甜心，真高兴看到你开心。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hear things. I know a few people. What of it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说过一些事，也知道一些人。怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aw, Nova. I'd do anything for you. Well... I don't want to keep you. You're always so busy and...
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，诺瓦。我愿意为你做任何事，嗯……我不会一直打扰你的，你一向很忙而且……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything for you, Nova. Anytime.
ESP.TRADUIT: 诺瓦，愿意效劳，随时都行。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No thanks. I'll find out on my own.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，谢谢，我自己会处理的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Will you? Well, good luck with that. So far as I know, I'm the only one your Dad told where he was going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会吗？好吧，祝你好运，据我所知，你父亲只把他的行程告诉了我一个人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, when you change your mind, come see me. I'm usually at the saloon. 100 caps... Daddy wouldn't think twice if it were you out there...
ESP.TRADUIT: 那好，如果你改变主意了，就来找我。我通常都在酒吧里。100个瓶盖……如果失踪的是你，你父亲可不会为这犹豫的……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, Moriarty. Here's 100 caps. Now where's my father?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，莫里亚蒂，这是100个瓶盖。现在告诉我我父亲去哪了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent! Your dad raised a smart kid. Really no substitute for the love of a father, now is there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好！你父亲有个很聪明的孩子。父爱的确是无价的，不是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Speaking of dear old dad, he went southeast, into D.C. to the Galaxy News Radio station. Good luck now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你亲爱的爸爸，他往东南方到特区去了，目的地是银河新闻电台，祝你好运。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have 100 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有100个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, kid. Let me help you out, you know... for old time's sake.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，孩子。让我帮帮你吧，嗯……看在和你爸的老交情的份上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you don't have the caps to pay for the information, then maybe you could do a little favor for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你没有足够的钱用来交换信息，那么或许你可以帮我点小忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to buy a drink.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想喝点东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No problem at all. I'll take care of you until that lazy zombie wakes up to do his job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 完全没问题。在那懒散的丧尸起床工作之前让我为你服务吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell it to Gob, he'll get you whatever you need.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去找盖博吧，他会给你你想要的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then you need to talk to Gob. Don't worry, he doesn't drip into the drinks... much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要去找盖博，别担心，他不会喝醉的……至少不会太醉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're too chicken to run away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你胆子太小，所以你不敢离家出走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shut up, butt wipe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 闭嘴，擦屁虫。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stop saying that, butt face.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别说了，屁脸。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, yeah? I'll show you! I'll show all of you. My mother will be sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，嗯？我会让你瞧瞧！让你们都瞧瞧。我母亲会后悔的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome to Tenpenny Tower! Don't do anything stupid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎来到特佩尼大厦！记住千万不要做蠢事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : gruff mercenary giving a warning to be on best behavior EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't you tell the difference between me and a feral? Fine. I'll show you the goddamn difference! Just you wait! You'll get yours. All of you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你难道看不出来我跟该死的凶悍僵尸的不同吗？好吧，我会让你们明白的！你等着，你们所有人都会有报应的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : yelling at a obstinate enemy on the other end of an intercom EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can help take care of that little Ghoul problem for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以帮你们解决那些尸鬼的小问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that so? And why should I believe that? You ever kill a Ghoul before?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？我们凭什么相信你？你以前杀过僵尸吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : gruff mercenary testing a civilian's mettle EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bah! I thought you were more interesting than that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 算了吧！我觉得你都比那有趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. But you better not get caught with that!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，但你最好不要被抓住了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't want to play games... Can I please just borrow the key?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不想玩游戏……我能只借钥匙吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Son of a bitch!
ESP.TRADUIT: 混蛋！

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you know about Vault 87?
ESP.TRADUIT: 对于87号避难所，你都知道些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's behind the Back Door! The Back Door is my job, and I do it really well!
ESP.TRADUIT: 就在后门外。守卫后门也是我的工作，我也一直做得很好！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Princess [06015685] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8C]MQ06) Picking Up the Trail EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: See what happens is, Mayor says he wants the door open. Then I help him because I'm good at it. It takes two of us to do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是这样的，镇长说他想把这扇门打开，我就帮他打开。我对这可很在行。这需要我们两个人来完成。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Princess [06015685] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8C]MQ06) Picking Up the Trail EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But only Mayor can say it's okay. You gotta talk to him, and then I'll help him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但只有镇长才能批准。你得去找他谈，然后我才会帮他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Princess [06015685] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8C]MQ06) Picking Up the Trail EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not much, really. Mayor has us steer clear of the door to Murder Pass, just in case. If you go near it, you can hear them howling.
ESP.TRADUIT: 知道的不多。镇长让我们远离通往杀戮通道的门。如果你走近那，还能听见他们的嚎叫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stacey [060156AB] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8C]MQ06) Picking Up the Trail Comment (NAM2) : stoic EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't hear much around the other door, though. I guess maybe there aren't as many back there. Doesn't matter much, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，在另一扇门附近听不到什么。我猜这是因为那边没有多少。不过这不重要了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stacey [060156AB] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8C]MQ06) Picking Up the Trail Comment (NAM2) : stoic EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I know that place. Yep, sure do. Monsters back there. Big, scary monsters. Lots of them. Tons, even.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我当然知道哪个地方。后面是些怪物，很大，很吓人的怪物。很多，甚至上千。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8C]MQ06) Picking Up the Trail Comment (NAM2) : hyperactive, spoken as quickly as possible EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you going there? Are you? Are you gonna shoot 'em dead? I bet you are. That'll be so cool. Unless they eat your face. They do that, you know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要到那去？你确定？你要去干掉他们？你肯定是。那就太酷了，除非他们把你脸啃掉。嗯，他们会那样做的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8C]MQ06) Picking Up the Trail Comment (NAM2) : hyperactive, spoken as quickly as possible EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's where the monsters come from. We don't go back there. It's called Murder Pass for a reason, you know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怪物们就是从那来的。我们不到那后面去。那儿叫做杀戮通道是有原因的，你懂吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucy [06015696] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8C]MQ06) Picking Up the Trail Comment (NAM2) : condescending EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you go that way, you're probably gonna get hurt. I can patch you up as long as it's not real bad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你如果走那条路很可能会受伤的。只要不是特别严重，我倒是可以帮你包扎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucy [06015696] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8C]MQ06) Picking Up the Trail Comment (NAM2) : condescending EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know what that is, mister.
ESP.TRADUIT: 先生，我不知道那是什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bumble [06015699] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8C]MQ06) Picking Up the Trail Comment (NAM2) : quiet, confused EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you suspect your family is in danger?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怀疑你家人有危险？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No... not really. Maybe my letters just aren't arriving. Whatever you can do to get it there would sure be appreciated.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不……并不是。没准只是我的信没寄到。你要是能帮我送过去，我会非常感激的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06000A69] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, why not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，为什么不？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great! I'd like you to deliver this message to my family in the Arefu Settlement. I haven't heard from them in months and I'm worried.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好极了！我需要你帮我给在断桥镇定居点的家人送个信。我已经有几个月没跟他们联系了，很担心他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06000A69] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: As soon as you get there, talk to Davis West. He'll be glad to pay you for the trip.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你一到那边就去找大卫·维斯特，他会很乐意付你报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06000A69] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Today we hear the story of Saint Monica.
ESP.TRADUIT: 今天我们要讲圣莫尼卡的故事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) NPC : Diego [060156CE] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She was born in Great Lanta on the shores of the Ocean.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她在海边的大兰达出生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) NPC : Diego [060156CE] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Her parents were both Ghouls. Yes, that’s right, I said Ghouls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她的双亲都是僵尸，是的，我说的是僵尸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) NPC : Diego [060156CE] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That she was conceived at all was a miracle. That she was born unafflicted was an even greater miracle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她的父母能怀上她实在是个奇迹，而她被顺利生下来是个更大的奇迹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) NPC : Diego [060156CE] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: God tested Saint Monica. She did not lead an easy life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 上帝锤炼着圣莫尼卡，她的一生充满坎坷。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) NPC : Diego [060156CE] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sold into slavery by Raiders, she was forced to sell her body.
ESP.TRADUIT: 被歹徒卖身为奴后，她被迫出卖自己的肉体。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) NPC : Diego [060156CE] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They took her only son, Ehren, from her and sold him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们从她身边抓走了她唯一的儿子，艾仁，并把他卖掉了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) NPC : Diego [060156CE] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She prayed every night to God for his safety. She did not pray for herself, although her burden was great.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她每晚都向上帝祈祷她儿子能够平安。尽管她肩上的担子够重了，但她从不为自己祈祷。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) NPC : Diego [060156CE] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Each night she would preach the word of God to the Slavers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每天晚上她都要向上帝祈祷惩罚那些奴隶贩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) NPC : Diego [060156CE] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: After sixteen years, God provided a miracle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 16年之后，上帝恩赐了一个奇迹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) NPC : Diego [060156CE] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One of the Slavers repented his wicked ways and helped her to escape.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其中一个奴隶贩良心发现，帮她逃了出来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) NPC : Diego [060156CE] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Four years she looked for Ehren. Four years she wandered the Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她花了四年去找艾仁。四年间，她在废土上到处流浪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) NPC : Diego [060156CE] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: God looked over her in those years.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些年来，上帝一直眷顾着她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) NPC : Diego [060156CE] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When she found her son, she found he was a wicked man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当她最终找到她儿子时，却发现他已经变成了一个恶棍。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) NPC : Diego [060156CE] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ehren had overthrown his masters and taken their place. He was an owner of men.
ESP.TRADUIT: 艾仁推翻了他的主人并占据了他们的地盘，他拥有其他的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) NPC : Diego [060156CE] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ehren took his mother to be his slave, even knowing who she was, for Ehren blamed her for his painful early life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 即便知道她的身份，艾仁还是把他的母亲抓住当奴隶，因为艾仁认为自己童年的不幸是她的错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) NPC : Diego [060156CE] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Each day Ehren would think of a new and wicked trial to put her through.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每天艾仁都想尽办法折磨着她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) NPC : Diego [060156CE] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She would only smile at him and say, "I forgive you."
ESP.TRADUIT: 而她只是微笑着对他说，“我原谅你。”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) NPC : Diego [060156CE] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Each morning she would be miraculously healed as if nothing had happened.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每天早上，她都会奇迹般地痊愈，就像什么也没发生过一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) NPC : Diego [060156CE] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When Ehren truly realized her love and God's love was boundless, he flung himself at her feet and begged for Saint Monica’s forgiveness.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当艾仁最终意识到她的爱，还有上帝的爱是多么宽广的时候，他扑到她脚下，请求圣莫尼卡宽恕自己。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) NPC : Diego [060156CE] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ehren released all of his slaves, and they rejoiced.
ESP.TRADUIT: 艾仁释放了所有奴隶，大家欣喜若狂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) NPC : Diego [060156CE] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He repented all his wicked ways.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他为自己过去的恶行忏悔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) NPC : Diego [060156CE] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who among us is without sin? Who among us can claim to be innocent?
ESP.TRADUIT: 咱们谁没有罪？谁敢说自己是无辜的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) NPC : Diego [060156CE] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come, brothers and sisters, let us pray to God and Saint Monica for deliverance from our sins, as Ehren was delivered from his.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来吧，兄弟姐妹们，让我们祈祷上帝和圣莫尼卡宽恕我们的罪恶，就像艾仁救赎了他自己一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) NPC : Diego [060156CE] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Amen. Let us pray.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿门，让我们祈祷吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) NPC : Diego [060156CE] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goodbye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't let me keep you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别让我耽误你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : saying goodbye EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's time for me to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我该走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Time is wasting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在浪费时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's time for me to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我该走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've disarmed the bomb, Burke. That thing will never explode now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经把那核弹解除了，伯克，那东西以后再也不会爆炸了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You did WHAT? Are you out of your goddamned mind? Do you have any idea how long we've pained to put this plan into motion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你做了什么？你该死的疯了吗？你不知道我们为了实施这计划付出了多大代价吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Weeks of preparation, destroyed. No words of mine can express my utter contempt for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 经过数周的准备后，却被毁掉了。我已经无法形容对你厌恶的程度了。
