ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have made a very poor error in judgment, my friend. One day... one day it WILL come back to haunt you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你做了一个错误的判断，我的朋友。有朝一日，你会得到报应的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Messing with that bomb seems pretty technical. What if I can't do it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 摆弄那核弹可是个技术活，我要是办不到呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lack the aptitude, you mean? You're not re-wiring the thing, just attaching the Pulse Charge to the detonator.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说你没有经验吗？这没有关系，不需要你去接线，只要把这核融合脉冲电池接到雷管上就好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you get stumped, talk to Leo Stahl. He might have something to help you concentrate. He's got a bit of a reputation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你被难到了，就去找利奥·斯塔尔。他或许能帮你集中精力，这方面他还是小有名气的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought you knew what you were doing. If it's just nerves, maybe some chems will help. But if you can't handle it, don't go fiddling with it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你知道你的情况，如果你只是紧张，吃点药就好了。但如果你没这本事，就别乱动那东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : concerned someone unskilled might try to disarm the bomb EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not sure I can disarm the bomb.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不确定我能解除那核弹。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're talking a lot of innocent lives here, Burke. Can I warn them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这关系到这众多无辜的生命，伯克。我能警告他们吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Absolutely not! The place, the people, they're one and the same! Sacrifices for a nobler future.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然不能！这地方，这儿的人，他们是一个整体并且都是一样的，它们为了一个更荣耀的未来奉献着。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I assure you, they are worth ten times as much in death, as they are in life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我向你保证，像他们那样的人，早就该死几十次了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, Mister Burke. I'll do it. Megaton will burn.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，伯克先生，我会干。核弹镇会化成灰的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent! I had a feeling about you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好！我没看错你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's the Fusion Pulse Charge. It needs to be installed inside the bomb.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是核聚变脉冲炸药，需要安装在核弹内部。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: When it's done, meet me at Tenpenny Tower. It's southwest of here, well out of harm's way. You can't miss it. Questions?
ESP.TRADUIT: 搞定后来特佩尼大厦见我。它在这的西南方，一个很安全的地方，你不会找不到的。还有问题吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Megaton is under my protection. You're going to leave... now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会保护核弹镇的。你得离开这……立刻。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh. I see. I didn't realize Megaton had any guardian beyond its intrepid sheriff. Very well, then. I'll take my leave, as you suggested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我知道了。我从没想到核弹镇除了那位勇敢的警长以外还有其他守卫。那好，我会按你说的很快离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Throw in an extra 500 caps, and you've got yourself a deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多给500个瓶盖，我们就成交。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well played! An extra 500 caps, in addition to the base fee, when Megaton lies in ruins.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得好！当兆吨镇成为废墟以后我会再付你额外的500个瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's the Fusion Pulse Charge. Place it in the bomb.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是核聚变脉冲炸药，去安到那核弹上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: When it's done, meet me at Tenpenny Tower. It's southwest of here, well out of harm's way. You can't miss it. Any questions?
ESP.TRADUIT: 搞定后来特佩尼大厦见我。它在这的西南方，一个很安全的地方，你不会找不到的。还有问题吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a sick man, Burke. This conversation's over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真是疯了，伯克。我们的对话到此为止。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It seems I have misjudged you. Very well. I'll simply find someone with more entrepreneurial spirit. Good day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来我高估你了。好吧，我会去找其他更有冒险精神的人，再见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait... You're going to destroy the town?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等一下……你要毁掉这镇子？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, no, I'm merely a recruiter. YOU get to have the real fun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，不，我只是个猎头而已。是“你”来完成这有趣的工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: The undetonated atomic bomb for which this town is named is still very much alive. All it needs is a little motivation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 用来命名这镇子的那还没被引爆的核弹仍能被引爆，只需要动一点手脚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have in my possession a Fusion Pulse Charge. Once rigged to the bomb, it will be detonated, by you, at a secure location. Easy money, my friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我这有一个核融合脉冲电池。只要安在那核弹上，它就可以被引爆。这件事由你来做，而你不用冒任何风险。这钱好赚得很啊，我的朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go on. I'm listening.
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续，我在听。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The undetonated atomic bomb for which this town is named is still very much alive. All it needs is a little motivation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 用来命名这镇子的那还没被引爆的核弹仍能被引爆，只需要动一点手脚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have in my possession a Fusion Pulse Charge constructed for a singular purpose -- the detonation of that bomb.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我这有一个核融合脉冲电池。这东西的用途只有一个——引爆那核弹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll rig it to the bomb. Then you'll get paid. Handsomely. What do you say?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你把它安到那核弹上，然后就有报酬，非常丰厚。听起来怎么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Allistair Tenpenny.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和我说说奥利斯特·特佩尼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He owns this building. We get our caps from him, and don't you forget it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是这幢楼的主人。我们从他那领工资，这一点你可要记好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A very well dressed gentleman, when he bothers to get dressed. He hardly ever leaves his penthouse suite.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他特意着装的时候，是一个很得体的绅士。但他很少离开自己的套间。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He stays in his penthouse suite most of the time. So long as we pay the rent, he lets us live here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大多数时候他都在自己的套间里待着。只要我们按时付房租，他就允许我们住下去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's the landlord, although you hardly ever see him. I had to treat him once for bed sores, if you know what I mean.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是这的房东，尽管你很难见到他。我曾经帮他治疗褥疮，你知道吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait... don't tell him I said that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等一下……别告诉他那是我说的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Every day it's the same thing. The man has no imagination with his meals.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那人每天的生活都按部就班，对一日三餐一点特殊要求都没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : teasingly mocking EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: But it's his building, so everyday I make that damned "Iguana Bits sandwich, no salt, with a peeled pear on the side. Send it up to the penthouse."
ESP.TRADUIT: 但这是他的楼，所以每天我都得做该死的“蜥蜴肉丁三明治，不放盐，外加一个去皮的梨。送到他的套间里。”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : teasingly mocking EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is the right lord and master of Tenpenny Tower.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是特佩尼大厦合法的房东和主人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Or at least that's what my files say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至少我的文件里是这么说的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can you tell me about Tenpenny Tower?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能和我说说特佩尼大厦吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's named after Allistair Tenpenny, who runs this building. Got a bunch of rich guys that pay him to live in it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是以这幢楼的所有人奥利斯特·特佩尼来命名的。找了一群富人住在这给他付房租。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're here to make sure that people like you don't mess up his deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们在这的任务是确保像你这样的人不会妨碍他的交易。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some might say that Tenpenny Tower is my crowning achievement. But no! No, my dear girl, it is just the beginning!
ESP.TRADUIT: 有些人可能说特佩尼大厦是我最高的成就。但事实不是这样的！我亲爱的孩子，这只是个开始！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Quite a tower you have here, Mr. Tenpenny.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的大厦真是漂亮，特佩尼先生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to do business with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想跟你做笔生意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I only carry the finest garments.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只有最好的衣服。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My Boutique has many unique items for the discerning customer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的精品店有很多独特的货物，是专门为有眼光的顾客准备。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you in the mood for?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要来点什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I get something to eat?
ESP.TRADUIT: 能给我来点吃的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enjoy the holiday discount, compliments of Mister Tenpenny!
ESP.TRADUIT: 请享受节日折扣，这是特佩尼先生的恩赐！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm thirsty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我渴了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And what will our most distinguished guest be having today?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们今天最尊贵的客人想来点什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm thirsty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我渴了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have an excellent selection of thirst quenchers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有上选的解渴饮料。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm thirsty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我渴了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have some first aid supplies I can sell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有些急救用品可以出售。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess we could do a little trading. Here's what I got.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我们可以做点交易。这是我的货。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : gruff mercenary EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got an armament supply? Want to do some trading?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这有武器装备？想做交易吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's what I got.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我的货。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : gruff mercenary EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got an armament supply? Want to do some trading?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这有武器装备？想做交易吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This letter is all Ian has left of his old life. Allow me to give it to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这封信是过去的伊恩唯一的遗物，请让我把它交给他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your words impress me, human. Perhaps I misjudged you when we first met.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的话打动了我，人类。或许初次见面时我误会了你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you wish to speak to Ian, you are free to do so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想见伊恩，请自便。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here is the code to the area in which he is meditating.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是他的房间密码，他在那里冥想。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I find this all very hard to believe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这一切都让我难以相信。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The hunger that drives us must be kept in check. It is one of the most difficult things to teach.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们必须控制自己不被欲望驱使。这是最难被教导的事之一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ian lost control because no one was around to guide him. His own family was alien to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为没有人在身边指引他，伊恩无法控制自己。他觉得自己的家人都是异类。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He had a moment of weakness, and it was fatal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他有一阵子很虚弱，那对他是致命的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Initiate triage protocol.
ESP.TRADUIT: 启动治疗类选法程式。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Medical procedures initiated. Administering treat... ERROR ERROR!
ESP.TRADUIT: 医疗程序启动。实施治疗……错误 错误！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Medical procedures initiated. Administering treat... ERROR ERROR!
ESP.TRADUIT: 医疗程序启动。实施治疗……错误 错误！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, Ian, but your parents are dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很抱歉，伊恩，但你的父母都死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You think I don't know that? You think I don't know what I did?!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你以为我不知道？你以为我不知道我做了什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ian West [0601D5F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: RadioGoodbye
ESP.TRADUIT: 告别广播

ESP.ORIGINAL: Message repeats.
ESP.TRADUIT: 重复讯息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you know how to find one?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你知道该怎么找？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Possibly. I'm afraid I won't be able to assist you directly; the news Doctor Li has brought will require me to be elsewhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可能吧。我担心我不能直接帮上你，鉴于李博士带来的消息，我得到别处去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Rothchild [060156EA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8C]MQ06) Picking Up the Trail EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can, however, give you access to an old Pre-War computer from Vault-Tec. It may have the information you need.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，我可以给你使用避难所科技制造的战前电脑的许可，那可能会有你需要的信息。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Rothchild [060156EA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8C]MQ06) Picking Up the Trail EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll find the terminal in the archives in the A ring.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能在A环的档案室里找到那台终端。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Rothchild [060156EA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8C]MQ06) Picking Up the Trail EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do we need to do right now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在该干嘛？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right. The flooding shorted out some of the fuse boxes downstairs, including one that controls some of the automatic doors.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，溢水导致有些保险丝盒短路被烧掉了，包括控制某些自动门的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take these fuses. The box is back down in the sub-basement, near the eastern end of the level.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把这些保险丝拿去。保险丝盒在地下室的深处，接近那一层东头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once the fuses are replaced, you'll be able to get to the mainframe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 换上这些保险丝之后你就能够进到主控制室里了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You said something about fuses?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说保险丝怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, maybe this will shut you up. <Give a Nuka-Cola Quantum.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿去，这应该能让你闭上嘴。<给予一瓶核子可乐量子版>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh my gosh! Oh my gosh! A real Quantum! Yummie yum yum!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，上帝！哦，上帝！一瓶真正的量子版核子可乐！耶耶耶！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, I guess I can talk to you some more. Just be nicer next time!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，我想我可以跟你多说一些，不过下次对我好点！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, do you want to take the tour?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在你愿意谈谈你的经历吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. I'm sorry, Sierra. Here's a Nuka-Cola Quantum for you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，真抱歉，塞拉。我帮你找到了一瓶核子可乐量子版！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh my gosh! Oh my gosh! A real Quantum! Yummie yum yum!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，上帝！哦，上帝！一瓶真正的量子版核子可乐！耶耶耶！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, I guess I can talk to you some more. Just be nicer next time!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，我想我可以跟你多说一些，不过下次对我好点！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, do you want to take the tour?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在你愿意谈谈你的经历吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Vault101DadHolotape
ESP.TRADUIT: 101避难所里父亲的录音

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, here we are. Nestled all safe and snug inside Vault 101. It's so cold down here. Colder still with Catherine gone...
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，我们到了。栖身在安全又干净的101号避难所内。在这下面可真是冷，一想起凯瑟琳已经不在了就更冷……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, Catherine... I so wish you were here with me. How the hell am I supposed to do this by myself? Live down in this hole. Take care of our child...
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，凯瑟琳……我真希望你能在这陪着我。我一个人要怎样才能应付啊？住在地洞里面，照看我们的孩子...

ESP.ORIGINAL: But this is our life now, so I guess I'd better get used to it. The Overseer who runs the place is an overbearing bully, but I've dealt with worse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但这就是我们现在的生活，所以我还是得赶快适应。负责的监督者是个专横傲慢的人，不过我以前遇到过更差劲的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The code is "Priority Override, Authorization code 420-03-20-9"
I... Oh. Oh my...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我……哦。哦，我的…天…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0007DDCE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream Comment (NAM2) : monotone, computer-sounding EmotionType : Neutral
NPC : [0007DDCE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream Comment (NAM2) : monotone, computer-sounding EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Root level access granted. Override O-923. Authorization J-512. Self-destruct sequence initialized.
ESP.TRADUIT: 系统管理授权获准。撤销-923。授权码J-512。自毁序列初始化。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0007DDCE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream Comment (NAM2) : monotone, computer-sounding EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Civilian is requested to secure FEV vial and vacate the facility at once.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那人被要求拿取FEV病毒试剂瓶并立刻撤离本设施。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0007DDCE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream Comment (NAM2) : monotone, computer-sounding EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now what will you do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在你准备怎么办？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll do our best, is what we'll do. Me and the kids here in Andale... what's left of it, anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们会尽力，我们会的。不管怎样，我和安戴尔的孩子们……还有这剩下来的一切。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Old Man Harris [06029AA9] (mod) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: It'll be hard goin', but we'll do the best we can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 以后的日子将会很艰难，但我们会尽力的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Old Man Harris [06029AA9] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just hope that one day, these kids'll grow up to go some good for this place, after all the evil that's been done here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只希望有一天，孩子们长大了，能为这做些好事，毕竟这曾经是充满罪恶的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Old Man Harris [06029AA9] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you like living in Andale?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你喜欢住在安戴尔吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's okay, I guess. There aren't a lot of kids around here and no one who comes to visit stays around long.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还好吧，我想。就是周围没什么小孩子，访客也待不久。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dad says it could be worse; that there are a lot of starving kids in other places. But still, I wish I had more kids to play with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 爸爸说这已经算好了：别处总有小孩饿死。但我还是希望能有更多小孩和我一起玩。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Command protocol delta-five-three. Disengage security program.
ESP.TRADUIT: 命令协议D7-5-3。解除安全程序。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Command accepted. Security program disengaged.
ESP.TRADUIT: 命令收到。安全程序解除。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, fellow employee? What can I do for you on this wonderful day?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，雇员？在这美好的日子里我能帮你什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. Give me a few moments to bring the system online.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我这就登陆系统。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : trying to remain calmDAD_RECORD EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, but that's...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很抱歉，但这是……...

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you mean, "If we can make it"?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说“如果我们能的话”是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're underground. No one's been down here for a long time. Odds are we're not alone. Understand me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们在地底下，这很久没人来过了。很可能有什么怪物，明白了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life Comment (NAM2) : bossy EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We don't have time to waste. We need to get moving.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们没时间浪费了，得快点上路。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life Comment (NAM2) : bossy EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait here. I'll scout ahead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等在这，我去前面看看。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you sure? I don't want to stay in one place for too long.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你确定吗？我可不想在一个地方待太久。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life Comment (NAM2) : bossy EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's get moving. Follow me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们走吧，跟上我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll be right behind you. Be careful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们就跟在你后面，当心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life Comment (NAM2) : bossy EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe I can handle things from here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我能处理这的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can we talk about, you know... mom?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们能谈谈，你知道的……妈妈…

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your mother, she... she was beautiful. But... beyond the beauty you've seen. There's just so much those old photos can never show.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你母亲，她……她很漂亮。但……除了你见到的那些照片以外，还有很多已经找不到了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [0601CE38] (mod) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: And she was passionate. About life, about love. But most of all, most of all she was passionate about you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 同时她也充满了热情，对生命，对爱情。但最重要的是，她对你所倾注的感情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [0601CE38] (mod) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: When she became pregnant, it was the happiest I had ever seen her. Ahhhh... she had great things in mind for you...
ESP.TRADUIT: 当她怀孕的时候，是我见过的她最开心的时刻。啊……她把很大的梦想寄托在你身上...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [0601CE38] (mod) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: And so! Time for you to stop stalling and get to class! Please, honey, please take these achievement tests seriously.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以！时间到了，你该去教室了！拜托，亲爱的，认真对待这测试。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [0601CE38] (mod) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: The last thing I need is you mother's ghost haunting me because her only child became a garbage burner.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我最不愿意看到是，她唯一的孩子成了个废物，而你母亲的灵魂因为这来埋怨我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [0601CE38] (mod) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your mother, she... she was beautiful. But... beyond the beauty you've seen. There's just so much those old photos can never show.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你母亲，她……她很漂亮。但……除了你见到的那些照片以外，还有很多已经找不到了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [0601CE38] (mod) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: And she was passionate. About life, about love. But most of all, most of all she was passionate about you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 同时她也充满了热情，对生命，对爱情。但最重要的是，她对你倾注的感情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [0601CE38] (mod) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: When she became pregnant, it was the happiest I had ever seen her. Ahhhh... she had great things in mind for you...
ESP.TRADUIT: 当她怀孕的时候，是我见过的她最开心的时刻。啊……她把很大的梦想寄托在你身上...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [0601CE38] (mod) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: And so! Time for you to stop stalling and get to class! Please, son, please take these achievement tests seriously.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以！时间到了，你该去教室了！拜托，儿子，认真对待这测试。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [0601CE38] (mod) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: The last thing I need is your mother's ghost haunting me because her only child became a garbage burner.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我最不愿意看到是，她唯一的孩子成了个废物，以致你母亲的灵魂为此来埋怨我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [0601CE38] (mod) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: This ain't over, daddy's girl.
ESP.TRADUIT: 后会有期，乖乖女。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CE26] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. Let's go. I was done here, anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，我们走吧。怎么说我也完事了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CE26] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Done? We're not done! I say when we're done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了吗？我们完事了！我说我们完事了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CE26] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you sure? Butch? Um... okay. Whatever you say, Wally. Tunnel Snakes rule!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你确定吗，布奇？呃……好吧，听你的吩咐，瓦利。穴蛇帮主宰一切！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CE28] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't know who put you in charge. I say we're done. Let's go, Paul.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道谁派你来的。我说我们完事了。走吧，保利。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CE2A] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're done here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们到此为止。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CE2A] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've heard you do anything he tells you. And I mean anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说他说什么你就干什么，不管什么事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? What kind of shit is that? No one talks that way about Wally Mack!
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？这是什么话？没人敢这么跟瓦利·麦克说话！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CE2A] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's not the boss of me! Nobody's the boss of me! I'm out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他不是我的老大！没人是我的老大！我要离开这。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CE2A] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Leave her alone, or you'll answer to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别缠着她，否则我对你不客气。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa, take it easy. No need to go all psycho on me again. We were just joking with her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，别生气。不用替我喊医生，我们只是跟她开玩笑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CE26] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect Comment (NAM2) : a bully backing down from a bigger bully EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get away from me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 离我远点！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [0601CE24] (mod) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You think you're special because your daddy is the Overseer?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得爸爸是监督者就高人一等了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CE26] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's nothing, Butch!
ESP.TRADUIT: 布奇，她什么也不是！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CE28] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's go into the storeroom, Amata. I'll show you a good time...
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿玛塔，我们去储藏室吧，我会让你很爽的...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CE2A] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Show it to her, Butch!
ESP.TRADUIT: 布奇，给她看看！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CE2A] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Helping people? What about helping your own son?
ESP.TRADUIT: 帮助别人？还是先帮帮你的儿子吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can understand that you're angry. You have a right to be.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你为什么生气，当然你也确实有权利生气。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps the choice I made wasn't the right one. At the time, I thought I was doing what was best for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许当时我做了个错误的选择。当时，我以为为你做的一切都是最好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Helping people? What about helping your own daughter?
ESP.TRADUIT: 帮助别人？还是先帮帮你的女儿吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You really think you can do this? Make this thing work?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你确定你真的可以操作这些东西吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wouldn't be here if I didn't. With what I've learned from Doctor Braun, I know it can work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我不会，就不会站在这。我从布劳恩博士那学习了怎么操作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's why it's so important to find a G.E.C.K. as soon as possible. It's the key to Project Purity.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它之所以那么重要，是因为这是净化工程的关键，我们要尽快找到关键的伊甸园创造器。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doctor Li. My heart... I must rest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 李博士，我的心脏……我必须得歇会。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do I look like someone that you want to blow off?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我像是那种你想甩掉的人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, tough guy. Say what's on your mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，难缠的家伙，告诉我你有什么想法？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06000A6C] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Annoyed, but intimidated nonetheless. EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well now, looks like she's got some spice. Say what's on your mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她好像找到些有趣的东西，你怎么看？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06000A6C] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Annoyed, but intimidated nonetheless. EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, let's team up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可以，那我们合作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Smart move.
ESP.TRADUIT: 聪明的举动。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, the Declaration is secured in the Archives Strongroom underground.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，宣言存放在地下的档案库机要室里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a concealed cargo lift right here in the center of the rotunda. I've spent a few days hacking the lock with my remote terminal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这圆形大厅的中央有内藏式货梯，我耗费了几天时间才用远程终端打开了那锁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sydney [06003A22] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When you're ready, punch in the password and let's get going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当你准备好的时候，输入密码，我们就出发。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sydney [06003A22] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's it like living at Tenpenny Tower?
ESP.TRADUIT: 在特佩尼大厦居住的感觉如何？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our new neighbors aren't so bad after all. And they have big appetites, so that's good for the cafe!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的新邻居也不是很坏，他们只是胃口很大，这对餐厅而言也算是件好事！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : self important snob showing uncharacteristic genuine appreciation EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's swell. Those new neighbors of ours like to drink almost as much as I do… and boy, do they have some real good stories!
ESP.TRADUIT: 真不错。我们的新邻居和我一样爱喝酒，他们还有好多故事讲！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Michael Hawthorne [060156D6] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : high class alcoholic EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: People are happy and healthy for the most part. And those Ghouls make great case studies! Did I mention I'm working on an important dissertation...
ESP.TRADUIT: 最重要的是人们健康幸福。而且那些僵尸也是很好的研究对象！呃，我和你说过我正在写一篇很重要的论文么……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : self important doctor showing genuine appreciation EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Things are going well, I'd say. We've all learned a thing or two about what makes a real community. Don't you think, comrade?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在一切都不错，我们都认识到了什么才是一个真正的公社所应具备的。你说呢，同志？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Irving Cheng [060156DC] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : (naively) self important but showing appreciation EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I don't mind those Ghouls as much as I thought I would.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我并不像之前想象中那样介意这些僵尸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : self important but showing appreciation EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those Ghouls are disgusting, so I just spend all my time up here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些僵尸令人作呕，我只好在这消磨时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156DE] (ID) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : self important prostitute showing disdain EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm surprised by my fellow tenants. I used to think they were all closed minded idiots. Turns out they aren't so bad after all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对那些住户感到吃惊，我曾经认为他们是顽固的白痴。不过事实上，他们还不算太糟糕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : jovial EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've been looking for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I shouldn't be surprised. I'm sure Evan King is pretty pissed right about now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我不应该感到惊讶，我敢说埃万·金现在肯定很恼火。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ian West [0601D5F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I bet he has the entire town out looking for me. He's worse than my parents.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我打赌他已经让整个镇子的人都在找我了，他比我的父母还可恶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ian West [0601D5F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So what are you doing in the Metro tunnels?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在地铁隧道里干嘛？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Biding our time, making plans, getting ready. Tenpenny and his pack of elitist wannabes can't keep us out of that tower forever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等待时机，制定计划，做好准备。特佩尼和他的那群崇拜者别想把我们永远挡在大厦的外面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We got rights. And we'll take them if they aren't given to us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们有应得的权利。如果他们不给，我们就夺回来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Biding our time, making plans, getting ready. Tenpenny and his pack of elitist wannabes can't keep us out of that tower forever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等待时机，制定计划，做好准备。特佩尼和他的那群崇拜者别想把我们永远挡在大厦的外面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've got rights. And we'll take them if they aren't given to us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们有应得的权利。如果他们不给，我们就夺回来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about Tenpenny.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们谈谈特配尼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about Tenpenny.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们谈谈特配尼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Roy is coming up with a plan to get us into that tower. Tenpenny's. Says it's only a matter of time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 罗伊正在拟定一个让我们进入特佩尼大厦的计划，他说住进去只是时间问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bessie Lynn [0601DC18] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : wistfully in love EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's strong like that. He never gives up. The kind of guy who makes things happen, Roy is. That's why the others follow him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他很坚强，从不放弃。策划者，这就是罗伊。这也是为什么其他人都追随他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bessie Lynn [0601DC18] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : wistfully in love EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Me, I just like the way he looks at me. Makes me feel pretty again. I'd go anywhere with him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我，我喜欢他看我的样子，这让我觉得自己又漂亮了，我会追随着他到天涯海角。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bessie Lynn [0601DC18] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : wistfully in love EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've been stomping around with Roy and his gang of misfits. Roy's a no nonsense, take no prisoners kinda guy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我一直和罗伊还有他那帮痞子一起厮混，罗伊是那种说一不二的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601DC19] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : ironic EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He heard about this Tenpenny asshole, and now he's trying to get us in that tower. He's hatching some kind of plan to kill all those bigot bastards.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他听说过那混蛋特佩尼，现在他试着要带我们潜入那幢大厦。他在拟定一个计划，要干掉塔里那群种族分子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601DC19] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : ironic EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Believe it or not, I used to vacation there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 信不信由你，我曾经在那度过假。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601DC19] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : ironic EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah... Never mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊……别介意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You eat people's brains, right? So what's it like being a zombie?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你专吃人脑，对吗？做个丧尸感觉如何？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got balls. Really big ones. I'll assume you're kidding 'cause no one shit talks me and lives.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有种，你真有种。我只当你是开玩笑，因为还没哪个混蛋能这样和我讲话后还有命的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : spoken like a grumpy fatalistic philosopher EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We Ghouls are just like the rest of you: Shit out of luck and doing our best to make it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们僵尸和你们一样：运气像狗屎，还在拼命挣扎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : spoken like a grumpy fatalistic philosopher EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're the prejudiced asshole, not me. So you're ugly. Big deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 带有偏见的混蛋不是我，而是你。还是个丑八怪。真的太强了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe I misjudged. Pardons. So yeah, people treat us like shit. But it just makes us stronger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许我判断错误了，请你原谅。就是啊，人们对我们就像对待狗屎一样，但这也让我们更强大。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : like a grumpy fatalistic philosopher EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Otherwise we ain't no different than anyone else that had the misfortune to live past infancy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 否则我们就和其他人没有区别了，活在过去遭遇的不幸里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : like a grumpy fatalistic philosopher EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, really. I mean it. I don't care if you're a Ghoul or not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，真的。我不在乎你是不是一个尸鬼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh-huh? Fine, whatever. Being a Ghoul ain't anything worse than any other thing somebody's got to deal with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃？好的，随便。做僵尸和其他人要面对的难题一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : as a grumpy fatalistic philosopher EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Like your stupidity, for example. You can't help it. You were born stupid, or dropped on your head as a kid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 举个例子吧：你这愚德行。那是没办法的事。不是你天生就笨，就是小时候碰坏头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : as a grumpy fatalistic philosopher EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Either way it ain't nothing you can change. So you deal with it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不论如何，你都无法改变现状。因此你只有面对。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : as a grumpy fatalistic philosopher EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I didn't mean to offend. I'm not prejudiced.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有冒犯的意思，我没有偏见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, whatever you say. You pretentious two-faced asshole.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，随便你说什么，你这自负、伪善的混蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : telling the player off for being a bigot who pretends not to be prejudiced EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Listen good. I'll say this only once. I can respect a man's privacy. But I don't put up with bullshit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好好的给我听着，我只说一遍。我能尊重别人的隐私，但我不能容忍胡言乱语。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : likes the player, but threatens him to watch himself. (like a tough as nails cop) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep to yourself and we'll be fine. Cause any trouble for me or mine, and I'll end you. We understand each other?
ESP.TRADUIT: 别惹其他人，咱们就没事。因为任何给我和我的人惹任何麻烦的话，我就干掉你。明白了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : likes the player, but threatens him to watch himself. (like a tough as nails cop) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mind your fucking business, that's who.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是谁关你屁事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh... my... I guess... I was just trying to be nice. Am I babbling again? I tend to do that when I'm nervous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，我……我想……我只是想有点礼貌啊。我是不是又胡说了？我一紧张就会这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bessie Lynn [0601DC18] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : nervously trying to stay safe by warning she is with the boss EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh - you don't make me nervous. I mean, Roy says not to show weakness...
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦 — 你不会让我感到紧张，我是说，罗伊说不要轻易暴露自己的弱点……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bessie Lynn [0601DC18] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : nervously trying to stay safe by warning she is with the boss EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you met Roy? He's killed lots of people before. I'm his gal. He protects me. So better not try anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你见过罗伊吧？他以前干掉了很多人。我是他女人，他照顾我，最好别胡来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bessie Lynn [0601DC18] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : nervously trying to stay safe by warning she is with the boss EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm trouble. That's all you need to know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你只用知道我是个麻烦就行了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Harmless? Well, you're lucky I don't stick you and take your shit. Watch yourself, we don't take kindly to strangers, 'specially sweet-talking ones.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没危险？得了吧，我没抢你的垃圾已经算你走运了。你自己小心，我们不会对陌生人示好，尤其是那些油腔滑调的家伙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : haughty and threatening EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got nothing to worry about. I'm harmless.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不用担心我，我没有恶意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found him. He's with the Family.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到他的时候，他正和家族在一起。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Those gangers? I knew if he got mixed up with the wrong crowd this could happen! Why didn't I do anything to stop him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？这些帮匪？我就知道他跟那些家伙在一起会发生这种事！我为什么没有去阻止他？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I... I don't know what to say. I... can't believe this is happening to me. My entire family... gone. I...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我……我不知道该怎么说，我……不敢相信这些会发生在我身上，我的整个家庭……都毁了。我……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please, just go. Don't say anything, don't look back. Just go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你走吧，别再说了，别回头，走！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I haven't found him. <Lie.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找不到他。<撒谎>

ESP.ORIGINAL: I... I don't know what to say. I... can't believe this is happening to me. My entire family... gone. I...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我……我不知道该怎么说，我……不敢相信这些会发生在我身上，我的整个家庭……都毁了。我……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please, just go. Don't say anything, don't look back. Just go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你走吧，别再说了，别回头，走！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found him. He's safe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到他了，他很安全。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank goodness! You have no idea how worried I was... I haven't even slept well since you left.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢天谢地！你不知道我有多担心，自从你离开后我就没睡过好觉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks for bringing me the news, you've really cheered me up!
ESP.TRADUIT: 感谢你为我带来消息，这真叫人高兴！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a bitch to find.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真他妈的难找。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, maybe that's because I don't want to be found.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，或许是因为我不想被找到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ian West [0601D5F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why the heck are you looking for me anyway?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你到底他妈的为什么要找我？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ian West [0601D5F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh that sounds bad. I need my head. Where's Paradise Falls?
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，这听起来很糟。我需要我的脑袋。堕落天堂在哪？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : (suddenly waking up from a daze) shocked and afraid EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm afraid your head will explode if you don't get to Paradise Falls. Sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恐怕你不去堕落天堂的话项圈就会爆炸。抱歉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing personal? But I'm a person! ... I'm going, I'm going... don't hurt me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是针对个人？但我是一个人……我走，我走……别伤害我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : (suddenly waking up from a daze) shocked and afraid EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a slave now. Nothing personal. Get to Paradise Falls if you want to live.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你现在是奴隶了。这可不是个人恩怨。想活下去的话就去堕落天堂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My stuff? Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的东西？好吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : (suddenly waking up from a daze) shocked and afraid EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Give me all your stuff!
ESP.TRADUIT: 把你的东西都给我！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, okay. Here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，好的。给。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : (suddenly waking up from a daze) shocked and afraid EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Turn your pockets out, before I get... nasty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把你的口袋掏空，在我变得……残忍之前。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A slave? I don't remember being a slave... Which way is that again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个奴隶？我怎么不记得自己变奴隶了……再说一遍去哪？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : (suddenly waking up from a daze) shocked and afraid EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a slave now! Better get to Paradise Falls before your head explodes!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你现在是奴隶了！你最好在脑袋被炸掉之前到堕落天堂去！

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Slavers? I'm a slave? How did this happen?!
ESP.TRADUIT: 奴隶？我是一个奴隶？怎么会这样呢？！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : (suddenly waking up from a daze) shocked and afraid EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Give my regards to the Slavers in Paradise Falls. Move, or your head goes boom!
ESP.TRADUIT: 给堕落天堂的奴隶贩子带去我的问候。快，不然你的头就会炸掉！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I... I don't know... Where am I?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道……我这是在哪？！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : (slow speech pattern) confused and groggy EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're staring into space. You feeling okay? Wake up!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在看着空气发呆。你还好吗？醒醒！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Huh? Maybe... Yeah...
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃？或许……是的……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : (slow speech pattern) confused and groggy EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you been drinking? You'd better go get some rest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你喝醉了吗？你最好去睡一会。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure... what's this thing for anyway?
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然……这是怎么回事？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : (slow speech pattern) confused and groggy EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm going to put this collar on you. Just hold real still for a minute.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要给你戴上这个项圈。别乱动。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa! What is it? It's heavy! Oh... What friends are you talking about? Do I know them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇！这是什么？真沉！噢……你们说的那朋友是谁？我们认识吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : (slow speech pattern) confused and groggy EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have some friends who want to meet you. Here, put this collar on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有几个朋友想见你。来，带上这个项圈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah... Good idea. Okay. Here you go. I'm pretty tired all of a sudden. I can't even think straight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是……好主意。好吧，就照你那么做吧。猝然间我感觉思维混乱，已经不能正常思考了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : (slow speech pattern) confused and groggy EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You look exhausted. Let me carry your stuff for a while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看起来累极了。让我帮你拿东西吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Huh? ...I do? I don't think so, but go ahead and take a look if you want.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃？……我是吗？我可不这么认为，但如果你这么想的话，就过来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : (slow speech pattern) confused and groggy EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think you've got something that belongs to me. I need it back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得你手上有我的东西。我要拿回来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A thief? Yeah... I'm feeling a little out of it... Maybe you better hold onto this stuff, you know, to keep it safe or whatever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小偷？没错……我有点察觉到……或许你应该更好地看守这，无时无刻的保证它的安全, 你必须清楚！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : (slow speech pattern) confused and groggy EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a thief about, and you seem distracted. I'll hold onto your gear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这有个小偷，你看起来精神不太好。我来帮你保管物品吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Donate 100 caps.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <捐赠100个瓶盖>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Atom be with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 原子与你同在。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bless you, child.
ESP.TRADUIT: 保佑你，孩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Donate 50 caps.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <捐赠50个瓶盖>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Atom be with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 原子与你同在。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bless you, child.
ESP.TRADUIT: 保佑你，孩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Donate 10 caps.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <捐赠10个瓶盖>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Atom be with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 原子与你同在。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bless you, child.
ESP.TRADUIT: 保佑你，孩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to donate to the Church.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想给教堂捐助。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why yes, we do. How much would you like to donate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，好的，你想捐赠多少？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you accept donations?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们接受捐献吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's in charge around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这儿谁说了算？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, Moriarty thinks he is, but Lucas Simms is the law around here and everyone knows it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，莫里亚蒂觉得自己说了算，不过卢卡斯·西姆斯才是这儿的法律，这点大家都清楚。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need a drink.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要来点饮料。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. Enjoy. Dick...
ESP.TRADUIT: 好。好好享受吧。老兄……...

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need to buy medical supplies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要购买一些医疗用品。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Plannin' on goin' out and getting' shot up, eh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 打算出去挨子弹，嗯？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah? What do you need?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？你需要什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not quite as good as that vault stuff you're used to, but it'll do you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 虽然没有你以前用的避难所物品好，但对你来说也足够了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm hurt. I need help, Doc.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我受伤了。医生，我需要帮助。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look at you! You're fine! Don't come in here wasting my time with your hypochondria. I've got actual patients to see to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你自己看看！再正常不过了！别在这浪费我的时间来讨论你的疑心病，还有真正的患者在等着我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Church [06000A6E] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you do not. Just suck it up, you big baby.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，别那么干。面对现实吧，你这大小孩。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Church [06000A6E] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you're standing fine, but you could use some switching up. That'll be 50 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看上去不错，但你还可以更好。这需要50个瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Church [06000A6E] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your vitals are fine, but you could use some stitches on those cuts. Tell you what, 50 caps sound good?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的要害都正常，但是我可以帮你把伤口缝得更好，只收你50个瓶盖，这听起来很棒吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Church [06000A6E] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, you're not that banged up -- a couple of pain killers should do you fine. That'll be 50 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你还不算太糟糕 — 两粒止痛药能帮你缓解很多，大概要50个瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Church [06000A6E] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know, all things considered, you could be worse off. I can stitch you up for 50 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要知道，考虑到多种因素，你的情况可能恶化。如果你需要我缝合伤口的话，得拿出50个瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Church [06000A6E] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's see... moderate lacerations, maybe a broken bone or two... I should be able to do you up for 75.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看……中度撕裂，或许一两根骨头断裂……要痊愈你得支付75个瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Church [06000A6E] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well now, let's take a look at you... some 2nd degree burns... a couple of flesh wounds... it'll take some work but I can fix you up for 75.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，来看看你的情况……部分二度烧伤……还有几处皮外伤……需要耗费我一些时间，但是我要收你个75瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Church [06000A6E] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good lord, this'll take some work... 100 caps worth of work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的上帝啊，这可得耗费我不少时间……价值100个瓶盖的工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Church [06000A6E] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm surprised you made it in here. I can fix you up, but it'll run you 100 caps. What do you say?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还能活着走到这，真令我很吃惊。我会帮你痊愈的，不过你得给我100个瓶盖，你说呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Church [06000A6E] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you do not. Just suck it up, you big baby.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，别那么干。面对现实吧，你这大小孩。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you're standing fine, but you could use some switching up. That'll be 50 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看上去不错，但你还可以更好。这需要50个瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, you're not that banged up -- a couple of pain killers should do you fine. That'll be 50 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你还不算太糟 — 两粒止痛药就会让你好受点。大概要50个瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well now, let's take a look at you... some 2nd degree burns... a couple of flesh wounds... it'll take some work but I can fix you up for 75.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，来看看你的情况……部分二度烧伤……还有几处皮外伤……需要耗费我一些时间，但是我要收你个75瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm surprised you made it in here. I can fix you up, but it'll run you 100 caps. What do you say?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还能活着走到这，真令我很吃惊。我会帮你痊愈的，不过你得给我100个瓶盖，你说呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a doctor, right? I could use some help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是医生对吧？我需要你帮忙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That takes a lot of nerve, threatening to bury us all alive and then crawling to me for help. As RJ would say, "Fuck off, mungo."
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还真有勇气啊，先威胁要活埋了我们，然后又爬着求我帮助你。就像镇长会说的：“滚你妈的蛋，毛人。”

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I get some medical treatment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能得到治疗吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure thing. Run into a bit of trouble out there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。在外面遇到麻烦了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're lucky you're one of us. I'd be charging you through the nose, otherwise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 幸运的是你是站我们这边的，不然我肯定把你的鼻子打爆。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I get some medical treatment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能得到治疗吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got scraped up a bit out there, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 在外面受了伤，呃？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I get some medical treatment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能得到治疗吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, but only because you saved three of ours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，但是仅仅是因为你救过我们三个人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looks like it's just a scrape. I can take care of it for 50 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看起来好像只是擦伤。我可以治好，这需要50个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I get some medical treatment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能得到治疗吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, but it'll cost you. Every spare cap I get from you is more medicine for these germ-magnets.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可以，但要你花些钱。从你那里挣的每个瓶盖，对这些“病菌磁铁”来说就是更多的药品。
