ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，但是仅仅是因为你救过我们三个人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is going to be tricky. And not at all pleasant. And it'll cost you 100 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这非常棘手。并且令人不愉快。需要的费用为100个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I get some medical treatment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能得到治疗吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, but it'll cost you. Every spare cap I get from you is more medicine for these germ-magnets.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可以，但要你花些钱。从你那里挣的每个瓶盖，对这些“病菌磁铁”来说就是更多的药品。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is going to be tricky. And not at all pleasant. And it'll cost you 100 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这非常棘手。并且令人不愉快。需要的费用为100个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I get some medical treatment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能得到治疗吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe you should have been more careful down here, mungo. You're on your own.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许你本应该更小心，毛人。你是一个人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I get some medical treatment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能得到治疗吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unless you've got hurt feelings, there's not a damn thing wrong with you. Come back when you've got some injuries that I can earn some money from.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你什么该死的毛病也没有，除非你伤了心了。有伤在身再来找我，这样我才可以赚你钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, if you needed help, I'd gladly take your money, but you're just fine, buck-o. Now stop wasting my time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，如果你需要帮助，我会很乐意收取你的费用，但你确完全健康。他妈的，混蛋。别浪费我的时间。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's see, a few Stimpaks and a couple of stitches should get you goin'. And it'll only run you 50 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看，一些治疗针和几下缝合，你就可以痊愈了，仅需50个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, a few stitches and a couple of bandages should fix you up. Let's call it 50 caps. Sound good?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，缝几个伤口再绑上绷带，你就全好了。就收50个瓶盖吧，听起来不错吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A few broken bones, a couple of cuts... I should be able to do you up for 75.
ESP.TRADUIT: 断了些骨头，两处割伤……花费75个瓶盖，我能帮你治愈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, I'll help you. If you have the caps. Looks to me like you're pretty banged up, though. Let's say... 75 caps and I'll fix you good as new.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我会帮助你，只要你有瓶盖。你看起来伤得还挺重的。就付……75个瓶盖吧，我就能把你治得像什么事也没发生过一样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know, when I saw you limping in here, I knew that I smelled money. That'll be 100 caps. Or you can just bleed to death. Your choice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要知道，当你跛着脚进来的时候，我就知道生意上门了。那需要100个瓶盖，否则，你就只能失血过多而死，你自己选择吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, hello, meal ticket. 100 caps. Or I can just wait for you to die and take it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好啊，送钱来的。100个瓶盖。否则我就等你死，然后再来拿走你的钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't think because I'm a Ghoul, I'm stupid. You're fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别因为我是尸鬼就觉得我笨，你聪明。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is this a trick question? I don't even see a scratch on you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在开玩笑吧，你是一点伤都没有啊！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Injured... ha! This is just a nick. If you can't tough it out and you want to be fixed up it'll cost you 50 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这么点小伤的话，我50盖就能搞定了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd hesitate to even call this a wound, but if you insist. 50 caps should cover my expenses.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我都不觉得这叫伤口，但如果你坚持说是那就是吧。50瓶盖就够。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, you could do with some work. It'll set you back 75 caps, but well worth it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 75个瓶盖就能把你的伤势搞定了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is pretty bad, but I've seen worse. Still, it's going to cost 75 caps to get you back on your feet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的伤真是太糟糕了。75个瓶盖就能治好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, you look almost as bad as I do. Of course, I'm supposed to look this way and you aren't. 100 caps will do it for my expenses.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你快要死了，想治好没有100瓶盖是不行的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you get the number of that Brahmin that trampled you? Sheesh! If you want me to stitch you back together, it'll be 100 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还能记得双头牛蹂躏你的场景嘛？如果要治好的话100瓶盖就可以了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: For you? No problem. Now, hold still.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你？没问题。别乱动。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Heal me up, Red.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把我治好，瑞德。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't see anything wrong with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没看出你有什么问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0002131F] (ID) NPC : Lucy [06015696] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a doctor, right? I could use some help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个医生，对吧？我可能需要些帮助。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't see anything wrong with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看不出你有啥毛病。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a doctor, right? I could use some help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是医生对吧？我需要你帮忙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, I could patch you up. Nothing too serious. I don't work for free though. Let's say 75 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我能把你治好，并不算太严重。但我不会白干，我们说好，就75个瓶盖吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0002131F] (ID) NPC : Lucy [06015696] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a doctor, right? I could use some help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个医生，对吧？我可能需要些帮助。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, I could patch you up. Nothing too serious. I don't work for free though. Let's say 75 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我能把你治好，并不算太严重。但我不会白干，我们说好，就75个瓶盖吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0002131F] (ID) NPC : Lucy [06015696] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a doctor, right? I could use some help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个医生，对吧？我可能需要些帮助。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right. You do need a doctor. Lucky I happened along. But first let's discuss my fee... 100 caps ought to cover it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错，你的确需要一位医生。能遇到我算你走运，但首先让我们来谈谈价钱……应该只需100个瓶盖就够了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0002131F] (ID) NPC : Lucy [06015696] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a doctor, right? I could use some help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个医生，对吧？我可能需要些帮助。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're not kidding. You're in bad shape, friend. I'd be happy to fix you up... for 150 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还真不是在开玩笑。朋友，你的情况不佳。我很乐意来医治你，150个瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0002131F] (ID) NPC : Lucy [06015696] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a doctor, right? I could use some help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个医生，对吧？我可能需要些帮助。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't see nothing wrong with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没看出来你有什么问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Mitchell [00104C0C] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's not the worst injury I've seen - hell, it's not even the worst this week. I think we can patch you up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这伤还不是最惨的，这周我才收了个伤得比你还惨的人。我会治好你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lieutenant Markland [0012AC9F] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This doesn't look too bad. We'll have you good as new in no time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这还不算太糟。我们很快就能让你活蹦乱跳了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Sawbones [00155A03] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's not so bad. I'll have you looking good as new. I mean, what are the chances of me botching another routine procedure in the same day?
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么大问题。我会让你完好如初的。我是说，这种小手术，我总不至于一天搞砸两次吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Ada Straus [000CE88C] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't look like nothing too serious. Let me patch you up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看起来不大严重。我会治好你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Mitchell [00104C0C] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unless you dipped that in cheese fondue, I'd say it's infected. Let me fix that up for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除非你刚在奶酪火锅里泡过，否则我敢说肯定是感染了。我来帮你治治吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Ada Straus [000CE88C] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. I can help you out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我可以治好你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Mitchell [00104C0C] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, that's looking pretty bad. I think we can do something about it though - just a minute.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，看起来真的很糟糕。我看看有没有什么办法，稍等。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lieutenant Markland [0012AC9F] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Damn, that's got to hurt. Okay, hold still, it's gonna get worse before it gets better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死，一定很疼吧。忍着点，可能会不好受，但很快就能好过来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Sawbones [00155A03] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jesus, I don't think that's supposed to just dangle like that. And what the hell is that thing there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊，你看起来马上就要散架了。还有这个，这到底是什么玩意？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Ada Straus [000CE88C] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's gonna be expensive. Try not to speak. Just nod yes or no.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来得破费了。别说话。你只要点头或摇头即可。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Ada Straus [000CE88C] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Holy God, what battlefield did you just crawl off of? I'm going to be honest, this is kind of out of my league, but I'll do what I can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 上帝啊，你是刚从哪边的战场上爬回来的？老实说，我对此已经无能为力，只能死马当活马医了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lieutenant Markland [0012AC9F] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wasn't going to say anything, but when you walked in here I thought you were a Ghoul. We better get to work on this quick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我本来都不想说话，不过你走进来的时候，我还以为你是尸鬼呢。咱们还是赶紧治疗吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Sawbones [00155A03] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: This? This is nothing. You should see some of the wounds I've seen paladins come back with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就这个？这算什么。你应该看看那些圣骑士们带回来的伤。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Senior Scribe Schuler [000E27E6] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's not so bad. I should be able to treat you rather quickly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不算太糟。我应该能很快治好你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Senior Scribe Schuler [000E27E6] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: By Steel, I haven't seen wounds like this since HELIOS. I've got to get you treated quickly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 老天，自从离开太阳神一号之后我就没见过这样的伤了。我得赶紧治好你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Senior Scribe Schuler [000E27E6] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, but is this supposed to be a joke? There's nothing wrong with you. I can tell just by looking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不好意思，你是在开我的玩笑？你没什么问题啊。我一眼就看出来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Senior Scribe Schuler [000E27E6] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got nothing against you people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对你并没有敌意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well now. That's a surprise! I'm used to every asshole smoothskin in this town giving me shit just because I look like a corpse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，那太令人惊奇了。我已经习惯因为自己像具活尸而被镇上的光皮肤冷眼相看了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm glad to see that there are a few worthwhile people around here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很庆幸在这附近还能看到一些值得我去关注的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: For you, a discount.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你打个折。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. What's a Ghoul?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，什么是尸鬼？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hadn't planned on it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还没这打算。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well now. That's a surprise! I'm used to every asshole smoothskin in this town giving me shit just because I look like a corpse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，那太令人惊奇了。我已经习惯因为自己像具活尸而被镇上的光皮肤冷眼相看了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm glad to see that there are a few worthwhile people around here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很庆幸在这附近还能看到一些值得我去关注的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: For you, a discount.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你打个折。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you kidding? Me? Shut the hell up, Ghoul. I'll beat you if I feel like it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在开玩笑吗？我？闭上你那张臭嘴，尸鬼。只要我乐意，我就会痛打你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <sighs> I suppose I was wrong... should have known better.
ESP.TRADUIT: <叹气>我想我错了……我早该知道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gah! Fuck! What are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗷！他妈的！你是什么东西？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess they don't have a lot of Ghouls in the Vault.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜在避难所中并没有太多僵尸。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这儿是干嘛的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Me? I deal with the caravan suppliers. I used to ride with those guys, so they cut me some good deals. Helps keep the town supplied.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我？我和商队做买卖，我以前跟他们一起混，因此他们时常给我一些特价。这帮助我维持小镇的补给。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But more importantly, I take care of Maggie. Of course, she's getting' a little old to have Billy lookin' over her shoulder all the time...
ESP.TRADUIT: 但更重要的是，我照顾玛姬。虽然，她已经过了需要寸步不离看着的年龄了……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Me? I don't do a damn thing. Well, unless you count staying piss drunk and making Moriarty rich as something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我？闲人一个什么也不干。除非你把当酒鬼和给莫里亚蒂送钱也算工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, I'm the best shot in town with a rifle, so everyone comes running to ol' Jericho when the Raiders show up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我可是镇里使步枪使得最准的。所以每当歹徒出现的时候，大家都会跑去找老耶利哥。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But between raids, they're content to take my money and drag me home when I've had too much. Hahaha!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过在平时，他们都很乐意在我喝多了的时候拿走我的钱再把我丢回家。哈哈哈！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Never mind...
ESP.TRADUIT: 算了吧……

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're goddamn right "never mind".
ESP.TRADUIT: 算了就算了。".

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take this Magnum.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，拿着这马格南。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow, you sure about that? Okay...
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，你确定？好的……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Daniel Agincourt [0601CCA1] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life Comment (NAM2) : tired but hopeful EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about a Chinese Pistol?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这把驳壳枪你觉得怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm, okay. Never used one of these before, but I can probably figure it out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好吧，我以前从来没有用过，但我大概能搞明白。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Daniel Agincourt [0601CCA1] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life Comment (NAM2) : tired but hopeful EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can give you a Silenced 10mm Pistol.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以给你一把10毫米消音手枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not sure the silencer will do me much good, but I'll take it. Thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我并不认为这消音器会很管用，但我会用它的，谢谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Daniel Agincourt [0601CCA1] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life Comment (NAM2) : tired but hopeful EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got a 10mm Pistol. Want it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一把10毫米手枪。想要吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. Beats having nothing, doesn't it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然了，总胜过赤手空拳，不是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Daniel Agincourt [0601CCA1] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life Comment (NAM2) : tired but hopeful EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got a .32 caliber pistol.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一把.32左轮手枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess it's better than nothing. Thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想有总比没有好！谢谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Daniel Agincourt [0601CCA1] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life Comment (NAM2) : tired but hopeful EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, I don't have a pistol on me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很抱歉，我没有手枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. If you find one, let me know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，如果你找到了，请告诉我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Daniel Agincourt [0601CCA1] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life Comment (NAM2) : tired but hopeful EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have any meds on me, but what if we gave him some Buffout?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我身上没带药品，但如果我们给他一些壮大灵会怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I... Normally I would never approve of this. If the situation weren't so serious...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不太赞同，要是处境不是那么危急的话……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life Comment (NAM2) : stammering a bit, unsure of what to do EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you think this is the best course of action, we'll do it. I hope this isn't a mistake.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你认为这是最应该做的事，那么我们将会做到这一点，我只希望这不是一个错误。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life Comment (NAM2) : stammering a bit, unsure of what to do EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take some Stimpaks. That should get him through.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，来点治疗针 ，会让他好过一点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, this looks to be enough. He'll need medical attention once we've reached the Citadel, but this will get him there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，这看起来足够了，一旦我们到达五角大本营就需要让他接受治疗，而现在要帮他坚持到那。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life Comment (NAM2) : relieved EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you. Give me a moment, and we can continue.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢。给我几分钟时间，我们就可以继续了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life Comment (NAM2) : relieved EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey Leo, can you hook me up?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，利奥，你能来帮我介绍下吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What'll it be?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那会怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, sure thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，当然没问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What am I gonna say? No? You've got me over a barrel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还能说什么呢？说不吗？你让我别无选择。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I understand you have quite a Chem habit...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你有药品上瘾问题……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look. Keep your bullshit judgments to yourself, man. Just don't tell Jenny or Andy and we'll be fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着。留着你那毫无依据的判断吧。只要你不告诉珍妮和安迪，我们之间就没有麻烦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leo Stahl [06000A6B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : [EJC] Expand this into more branches. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: How's that chem problem treating you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的上瘾问题怎么样了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is the Stradivarius worth a ton of caps?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴值这么多钱吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope you're not thinking of doing anything dishonest. You gave me your word.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要向我发誓，你不会做不守信的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, I'd imagine it would fetch an incredible sum of caps to someone that was knowledgeable in musical history.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我可以想象，对于一个在音乐史上有丰富知识的人来说，它能卖出一大笔钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I doubt the average merchant would even realize what they're holding.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我怀疑一般的商人甚至意识不到他们手里拿的是什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How will I know the Stradivarius when I see it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我看到斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴的时候，我要如何识别？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, from my great-great-grandmother's diaries, I have deduced that she had a special pressurized case created for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从我高祖母的日记来看，我可以推断她一定为她的日记本做了一个特殊的加密码的盒子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hopefully, the Soil Stradivarius was in the case when she... well, you know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 庆幸的是，索耶尔的斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴就在这箱子里，当她……的时候，你知道是怎么回事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you know about the Soil Stradivarius?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对索耶尔的斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴了解多少？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not too much I'm afraid. It was fabricated way back in 1714 by a famous italian craftsman named Antonio Stradivari.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恐怕了解的不是很多，它是一个叫安东尼奥·斯特拉迪瓦里的著名意大利制琴师在1714年制作的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He had made a bunch of Stradivarius violins actually, and each one was individually named over time to identify them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他制作了好几把斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴，每一把都以制作时间来命名。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They are regarded as the most outstanding instruments ever made... and no two sound alike they say. Incredible.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们被誉为最不同凡响的乐器, 所演奏出的两个音阶丝毫不共鸣……如他们所说：好到难以置信。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Since the bombs fell laying waste to most of the world, it may be safe to say that this could be the last surviving violin of its kind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 核弹落于废土，祸及世界上的大部分国家和地区。可以肯定地说， 这是最后一把斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need some time to think about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要些时间来思考这问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I understand. Please don't mistake my evasiveness for mistrust. I am merely being cautious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我理解。请不要误认为我是不值得信任的，我回避你的问题，那只是持种谨慎的态度。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take your time, by all means.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随你，喜欢就好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right. I give you my word I'll do my best to recover a violin for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，我向你保证，我会尽力为你找到那把小提琴的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I don't think I've been this happy in years!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我想我有好几年没有如此开心了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: As promised, here's the key to the ammunition box. It's right under the radio table.
ESP.TRADUIT: 按照约定，这是弹药箱的钥匙。就在电台桌底下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Before you leave, I have some information that may help you. At least a place to begin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在你离开前，我有些消息可以帮助你，至少给你一个着手点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It all starts with my great great grandmother Hilda back in 2077 before the bombs fell...
ESP.TRADUIT: 这一切都始于2077年我的高祖母时代，当时核弹还没有落下……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I don't think I've been this happy in years!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我想我有好几年没有如此开心了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have some information that may help you. At least a place to begin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在你离开前，我有些消息可以帮助你，至少给你一个着手点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It all starts with my great great grandmother back in 2077 before the bombs fell...
ESP.TRADUIT: 这一切都始于2077年我的高祖母时代，当时核弹还没有落下……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your husband's radio can broadcast across the entire Capital Wasteland?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你丈夫的电台可以覆盖整个首都废土？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. My husband was very proud of the setup. He tinkered with that thing for years to get it working.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错，那套设备是我丈夫的骄傲，他修修补补弄了好几年才终于让那东西运作起来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've tried to use it to get whatever I need, but I've never gotten a reply.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我试过用它来寻找我想要的东西，但是从来没有成功。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: 100 caps? All right, I'll take a look at it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 100个瓶盖？好吧，我会去处理它的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great! Go ahead and see what you can do. Just be careful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好极了！让我看看你都会做些什么，小心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Demolition expertise doesn't come cheap. I want 500 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 爆破专家收费可不便宜，我需要500个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's pretty steep... Fine. Do it and you'll get your money. Don't screw up, though, or we'll ALL regret it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 确实麻烦……好吧，你完成工作我就付给我钱。可别搞砸了，不然我们全得后悔！.
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : haggling over the price to disarm a bomb EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I knew I shouldn't have trusted you. Dammit, boy! You picked the wrong man to mess with. Now I've got to put you in the ground.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道我不应该信任你，该死的家伙！但是你选错人来耍了，我现在不得不杀了你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : upset that he was provoked into killing the player. This is not an idle threat. He means to do it and is confident he can EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, Sheriff, I plan on detonating that bomb.
ESP.TRADUIT: 实际上，警长，我正打算引爆核弹。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I knew I shouldn't have trusted you. Dammit, girl! You picked the wrong man to mess with. Now I've got to put you in the ground.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道我不应该信任你，该死的家伙！但是你愚弄错对象了，我现在不得不杀了你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : upset that he was provoked into killing the player. This is not an idle threat. He means to do it and is confident he can EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, Sheriff, I plan on detonating that bomb.
ESP.TRADUIT: 实际上，警长，我正打算引爆核弹。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does the town have a doctor?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这镇上有医生吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yep. He's a bit cranky, but he means well. Just make sure there's something actually wrong with you before you bother him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对。他有些怪癖。但是人还不错，在打扰他之前确认你真的不舒服就行了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll find him down in the plaza at the bottom of the hill, across the way from The Brass Lantern.
ESP.TRADUIT: 穿过黄铜灯来时的路，你能在小坡下的广场找到他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think we got off on the wrong foot...
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来我们出师不利……

ESP.ORIGINAL: It takes some stones to admit a mistake. Maybe you're not so bad, stranger. Tell you what, buy me a drink sometime and we'll call it even.
ESP.TRADUIT: 道歉需要勇气。陌生人，或许你没有那么糟糕。跟你说吧，给我买杯酒我们就算扯平了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Dusk [060156E7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, what do you want that's worth pissing me off over?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要怎样才肯滚蛋？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Dusk [060156E7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Try loosening your grip, maggot. Hold the weapon higher -- see nothing but the sight and the target. Try to screw it up this time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别握得那么紧，菜鸟。把武器再端高些 — 专心看你视野中的目标。这次别再搞砸了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This has been a Tenpenny Truism.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这已经是特佩尼的老生常谈了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : trying to be a radio celebrity EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: The poor man wonders why he is poor. The rich man knows why he is rich.
ESP.TRADUIT: 穷人不明白他们为什么穷，富人知道他们为什么富。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And now a Tenpenny Truism.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在是特佩尼的老生常谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : trying to be a radio celebrity EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can trust me. I'm a doctor myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以信任我，我自己就是医生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, I suppose someone with medical training has to have at least a bit of compassion. And maybe you can talk some sense into the boy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，我想受过医疗训练的人多少有些同情心。或许你可以和这男孩好好谈谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Leo Stahl... that boy got hisself a problem with Jet. I've caught him in here two to three times tryin' to steal what I keep around for anesthetic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 利奥·斯塔尔…… 那男孩吸杰特上瘾了。他想偷我这的麻药时被我抓住过几次。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not even his own family knows it. He goes up to the water treatment plant at night to get high... I dunno... I can't reach him. Maybe you can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 连他的家人都不知道这事。他晚上去水处理厂吸杰特……我……我说不动他，或许你能。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice try. Maybe if you actually had some medical training, we could talk about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想的美，如果你真的确实受过医疗训练，或许我们可以谈谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm only trying to help, Doc.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是想帮忙，医生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right look, I'm only tellin' you this because you seem like an okay sort and I'm hopin' maybe you can talk some sense into the boy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，我之所以告诉你这些因为你看起来不错，我希望你可以和这男孩好好谈谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Leo Stahl... that boy got hisself a problem with Jet. I've caught him in here two to three times tryin' to steal what I keep around for anesthetic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 利奥·斯塔尔…… 那男孩吸杰特上瘾了。他想偷我这的麻药时被我抓住过几次。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not even his own family knows it. He goes up to the water treatment plant at night to get high... I dunno... I can't reach him. Maybe you can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 连他的家人都不知道这事。他晚上去水处理厂吸杰特……我……我说不动他，或许你能。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Church.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和我说说教堂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: For those answers I shall direct you to my husband, Confessor Cromwell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于这个问题的答案，我推荐你去见我的丈夫，忏悔者克伦威尔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's got you so spooked?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么把你吓成这样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sigh. Look... you can call me crazy if you want but there is something odd about those creeps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唉。听着……你想叫我疯子也行，但我就是觉得有些东西不对劲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Evan King [0601D5F6] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean, they got the guns and they got the muscle. Why don't they just bust down our doors and take us out already?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我意思是，他们有枪又有肌肉。为什么他们不打破门，把我们带走？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Evan King [0601D5F6] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're really in a bad way, and could use some help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们已经很惨了，需要些帮助。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Evan King [0601D5F6] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you, some kind of a wimp?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你懦弱吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, pal. If you think I'm gonna get my ass shot off playing the hero, you're dead wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，伙计。如果你认为我会逞英雄招来子弹，那你就大错特错了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Evan King [0601D5F6] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I know they're coming, I lock myself inside like everyone else. We're really in a bad way, and could use some help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我知道他们来了，我会像其他人一样把自己锁在屋里。我们已经很惨了，需要帮助。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Evan King [0601D5F6] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where is the science lab?
ESP.TRADUIT: 李博士的实验室在哪？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The door on the left goes to the stairwell. From there, just keep heading west.
ESP.TRADUIT: 左手的门通到楼梯间，到楼梯间再转西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: At the stern. That's the west end to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在船尾。在你的西面。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do your parents do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你父母是干嘛的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The same thing that all parents do! My mom cooks and cleans the house and my dad goes to work with Mr. Wilson.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟别的父母一样！我妈做饭打扫房子，我爸和威尔逊先生一起工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They work in the basement, or sometimes in Mr. Wilson's shed. Dad says that when I'm older, I'll come to work with him and learn the family business!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们在地下室工作，有时在威尔逊先生的工棚。爸爸说等我大一点的时候，我可以跟着他干，学着打理家里的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's all of 'em.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是他们所有人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Vargas [0601D44E] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : calling to Sarah from a distance EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looks that way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看那边。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Negative.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Vargas [0601D44E] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : shakes his head negatively. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now knock that off. You're wasting ammo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 停一下，你在浪费子弹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Vargas [0601D44E] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : to Reddin -- not actually annoyed -- he's pleased at how well Reddin did in the battle EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: We need to sweep the area. You think those were all the Uglies in D.C.? You take the east side, I'll go west.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们得清理干净这区域。你以为华盛顿的丑八怪只有这么点吗？你去东面，我去西面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Vargas [0601D44E] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : to Reddin -- patiently EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once we're inside, then we'll celebrate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一旦进去，我们就要大干一场了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Vargas [0601D44E] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : to Reddin -- to cheer him up EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I know. God DAMMIT!!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我知道。该死啊！！！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Vargas [0601D44E] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : still cursing Reddin's pointless death (after the battle). Big pause before "God DAMMIT" also. First part is glum. "God DAMMIT" is angry. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is this the idiot who blew our ambush?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是让我们的埋伏暴露的白痴吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : to Colvin EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jennings?
ESP.TRADUIT: 詹宁斯？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : to Vargas -- asking about the wounded soldier lying nearby EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just a stray we picked up. The one that blundered into the Uglies over on 42nd.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是要找一个走散的伙伴。在42街冒失地冲进丑八怪中去的那个愣头青。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : replying to Colvin's question about the player EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right. It's the usual drill. Reddin, you just do whatever Paladin Vargas says and keep your mouth shut.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。这是平常任务。瑞丁，你执行圣骑士维加斯的命令就行了，并且闭好你的嘴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : giving orders to the squad -- time to move out. She's putting Reddin in his place a bit. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, the outpost is just to the south of us. Colvin, you're the eyes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，敌人的前哨站就在我们南面。科尔文，你负责侦查。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : giving orders to the squad -- quietly (they are in enemy territory) and calmly. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Vargas, Reddin, secure this building.
ESP.TRADUIT: 维加斯，瑞丁，防守建筑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : giving orders to the squad -- quietly (they are in enemy territory) and calmly. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not your fault, Vargas. Reddin was good enough for the Pride, and she proved it here today.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是你的错，维加斯。瑞丁配得上“里昂斯的骄傲”这称号，她今天证明了这点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : to Vargas. As a friend, not a superior officer. Trying to comfort him after Reddin's death. EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: When we get back to the Citadel, I'll talk to the scribes. Let it be chronicled that Paladin Reddin passed her test.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等回到五角大本营以后，我要和文士说。让“里昂斯的骄傲”瑞丁今天的壮举载入史册。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : the last sentence is more formal -- almost as if she's quoting from what the scribes will write down. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: So how'd I do, Vargas? I pass my little trial run? Come on, Lyons' Pride needs me and you know it! That Citadel guard duty is such bullshit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 维加斯，你说我该怎么做？ 我只是个新手？ 少来了，你知道“里昂斯的骄傲”需要我的！防守五角大本营的任务太他妈傻了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601D42F] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : celebrating again EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aw, come on. We just kicked their asses!
ESP.TRADUIT: 加油，我们只是挠了挠痒！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，好的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Holy shit! What was that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他妈的！那玩意是什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601D42F] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Aghast in horror EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found a Brotherhood Holotag. What should I do with it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我发现了一个兄弟会全息军牌。怎么处理？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Talk to Scribe Jameson. She is our keeper of the Scrolls. She will want to know what you have found.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去和文员詹姆森谈谈，她是我们的史官，她会对你找到的东西有兴趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) NPC : Paladin Bael [060B875B] (mod) NPC : Paladin Tristan [09005686] (mod) NPC : Scribe Vallincourt [09005685] (mod) NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) NPC : [0002131F] (ID) NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have? Oh my. This brings to light a sad affair for the Brotherhood. But perhaps it is something that you can assist us with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有吗？天啊。这对兄弟会来说是件悲伤的事。但这有些事或许你能帮忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you have the time, I have an offer for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你有时间，我有个提议。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All clear, Sentinel. Five mutants released from their torment. The rest are keeping their heads down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 警报解除，哨兵。超渡了五个变种人。其他的都跑了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Colvin [0601D432] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : replying to Sarah Lyons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A new recruit?
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个新兵？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Colvin [0601D432] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : speaking to Sarah, but looking at player EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome!
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎啊！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Colvin [0601D432] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : to player -- warmly EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your violin, Agatha.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的小提琴，阿加莎。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh my goodness! I must see it... please!
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊！我一定要看一看…… 请让我看看吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh my... it's more beautiful than I could have ever imagined!
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，天啊…… 它的美丽完全超出我的想象！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't thank you enough. I wish I had something to give you, a more suitable reward for all your efforts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我无法表达我的谢意。我想我可以给你些什么，相对你的辛劳更适合的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: All I can give you is the frequency to my radio set. Tune in whenever you feel like listening to the strains of an old woman's violin playing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我所能给你的就是一个电台频率。无论何时你想听的时候就调到这频率，来收听一个老太太的小提琴演奏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I bet you like to look at butts, don't you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你很喜欢盯着别人的屁股看，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha ha ha!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈哈！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're all right for a mungo, you know that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这个毛人还不错，你知道吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why don't you come in. I think we can trust you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么你不进来呢，我想我们能信任你了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, your mom sure likes it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你妈妈一定会喜欢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha ha ha!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈哈！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're pretty funny for a mungo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个非常有趣的毛人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why don't you come on in?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么你不进来呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, well at least it doesn't smell as bad as you do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错，起码它比你好闻多了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha ha ha!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈哈！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're pretty funny for a mungo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个非常有趣的毛人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why don't you come on in?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么你不进来呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm here to do business with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来这是和你做生意的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's a menu.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿好菜单。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, what do you have?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，都有些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I must.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果必须的话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: For you, I always offer my best price.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我一直给你最优惠的价格。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Straight to the point. I like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 开门见山。我喜欢这样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What'll you have?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll have a drink.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我来点喝的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Commin' up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll have a drink.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我来点喝的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've got all kinds of chems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有各种药品。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you have for sale?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这卖些什么呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Need to do some killin' eh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 想杀点什么人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I see what kinds of guns you have for sale?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能看看你卖的枪吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here is our menu, sir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 先生，给你菜单。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm hungry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我饿了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here is our menu, ma'am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 女士，给你菜单。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm hungry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我饿了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's get high.
ESP.TRADUIT: 咱们来开心吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need some chems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要买点药。

ESP.ORIGINAL: After what you did? Only because I have to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在你做了那事之后？只是因为我必须。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What have you got to sell?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这都有些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything for you! You sure fixed Bannon good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 愿为你效劳！你真把班侬给修理了一顿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What have you got to sell?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这都有些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got a little bit of everything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我各种货品都有一点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What have you got to sell?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这都有些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatchya lookin' for?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在找什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm thinking of buying some ordnance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在考虑买一些武器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take a look at our menu.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看我的菜单。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you have to eat?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这都有些什么吃的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please place your order.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请决定你要什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you have to eat?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这都有些什么吃的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a big world out there, honey, full of all sorts of people. What about you? What kind of person are you going to be?
ESP.TRADUIT: 外面的世界很大，甜心，有形形色色的人。你呢？想当什么样的人？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0001F388]CG00) 0001F388 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : ;musing, thinking about how his child might turn out in the world he's born into EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a big world out there, son, full of all sorts of people. What about you? What kind of person are you going to be?
ESP.TRADUIT: 外面的世界很大，儿子，有形形色色的人。你呢？想当什么样的人？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0001F388]CG00) 0001F388 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : ;musing, thinking about how his child might turn out in the world he's born into EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: One, one thousand. Two, one thousand... Come on!
ESP.TRADUIT: 一，一千。二，二千……。加油 !
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0001F388]CG00) 0001F388 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : ;panicking, his wife's heart monitors flatlining EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hang on, Catherine! Hang on...
ESP.TRADUIT: 坚持住，凯瑟琳！坚持住...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0001F388]CG00) 0001F388 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : ;panicking, his wife's heart monitors flatlining EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: You left me there without saying goodbye. What was I supposed to do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你一声不吭地就离开我了，我该怎么办呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You were supposed to stay put. You could've had a good life in the Vault.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你应该待在那。你在避难所里会有一个不错的生活。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane Comment (NAM2) : proud EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I suppose it's too late to go back now, isn't it? The Overseer would likely have us shot on sight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是我想现在回去太晚了，是不是？监督者见到我们就会开枪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane Comment (NAM2) : proud EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well then, you'll just have to come with me to Rivet City. You've certainly proven yourself capable enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，那你一定要跟我去铆钉城。你已经证明你有足够的能力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane Comment (NAM2) : proud EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can do it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能做到！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [0602EA46] (mod) Quest : ([06014E83]CG01) Baby Steps EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right. Come on. Let's go see if your little friend Amata wants to play...
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，来吧。让我们去看看你的小朋友阿玛塔想不想玩玩……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [0602EA46] (mod) Quest : ([06014E83]CG01) Baby Steps EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Authorized ticketholders, please proceed to the main platform.
ESP.TRADUIT: 持票者验证通过，请前往主月台。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know, I was thinking about that. The lab at the facility had some old Pre-War computers that we scavenged. One of them might be useful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道，我刚考虑过。在工厂的实验室里我搜索到一些战前的旧电脑，也许能派上用场。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's as important to me as ever, Madison. I know it's important to you too. Let's finish it together.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这对我来说像过去一样重要，麦迪逊。我知道对你也很重要。让我们一起完成它。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You haven't lost any of your passion, have you James?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的激情没有被岁月磨灭，对吧，詹姆斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If only your mother...
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你母亲...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602FDCF] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast Comment (NAM2) : reedit previous line into 2 files EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...The Enclave? What are they doing here... They're where? Madison, lock the door!
ESP.TRADUIT: ……英克雷的人？他们在这干嘛…… 他们在哪？麦迪逊，关门！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) NPC : [0005A7CF] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : confused, distracted; then panicked EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please remain in your assigned areas while we get this sorted out...
ESP.TRADUIT: 待在这里别动，等我们去把这些杂碎赶走……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0005A7CF] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : calming, cut off at the end by someone talking to him EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everyone, listen; it seems we have some visitors. I don't know who they are or what they want.
ESP.TRADUIT: 各位，看来我们有客人来了。我不知道他们是谁和他们想要什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We have a singular opportunity here; a chance to make the Wasteland a better place for... what? What's that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们现在有一个千载难逢的良机，一个让废土变的更加美好的机会，让……等一下，那是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to thank you all for returning to this project after so many years. I know some of you thought; like me, that this day would never come.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我衷心感谢你们，感谢你们多年后还会再次参与这个工程，我知道你们当中不少人都没有想到还有重返工程的一天。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once the mainframe is online, we'll be able to access the database, and hopefully learn where we can find a G.E.C.K.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一旦连上主机，我们就能进入数据库，希望我们能够从中找到伊甸园创造器的蛛丝马迹。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a lot of deterioration in the pipes, and some damage to the substructure, but it's nothing we can't fix.
ESP.TRADUIT: 管道锈迹斑斑，地下结构也被破坏了，但是没有什么是我们修复不了的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've restored power to the mainframe, which is coming online now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们刚给主机恢复动力，它正在连线。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right everyone, you should be able to hear me now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，各位，你们应该能听到我说话吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think we're out of wine, but I'll check.
ESP.TRADUIT: 葡萄酒好像没了，我要看一下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's not like that, dad. Diego's a gentleman... unfortunately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他不像那样，爸爸。迭戈是个绅士……很不幸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Angela Staley [060156BD] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : "unfortunately" should be in a stage whisper. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I like sitting next to you. I... never mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想坐你旁边。我……没事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am...I mean, thank you, Mr. Holmes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是……我意思是，谢谢你，福尔摩斯先生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh. So you did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢。所以你这么做了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not yet, sweetheart. Finish your meal first.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还没，甜心。先吃完饭吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't make a fuss over it. Their just kids. Besides, maybe C.J. will rub off on James and not the other way around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别大惊小怪。他们不过是孩子。还有长江没准会让詹姆斯改好，她不会变坏的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Amen. We have each other, and we have C.J.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿门。我们拥有彼此，我们拥有长江。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The transformer is still touch and go. Doctor Li hopes her most recent tests will be good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 变压器仍然处于待命状态。李博士希望她最近的测试结果能使人满意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Give me a Brahmin steak, potato, and a beer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我双头牛肉排，土豆，还有啤酒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fucking junk heap. I should start eating at Gary's.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他妈的垃圾。我要去加里厨房吃饭了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: James? Who knows where that little shit has run off to. Mind your own business, Brock. I'm going to get a drink.
ESP.TRADUIT: 詹姆斯？谁知道这小崽子跑哪去了。管好你自己的事，布洛克。给我来点喝的就好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Huh? I don't get it. Never mind. Just buy me another drink.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃？我没明白。没关系。再来一杯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your food is very nourishing, Vera.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这的食物都很有营养，薇拉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose you're right. Being back here after all this time, I can't help but be a little concerned.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜你是对的。你终于回来了，我没帮上忙，只能聊表关心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm already taking care of that. I'll let you know if there are any abnormal results.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经注意到了。如果有什么异常结果，我会告知你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Janice Kaplinski [060156CB] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doctor Li asked me to keep an eye on the power relays in level 3, but I'll take care of that for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 李博士让我留意三层的动力继电器，但我要帮你留意这。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Janice Kaplinski [060156CB] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes sir. I'll attend to that in just a moment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，长官。稍后我会留意的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Janice Kaplinski [060156CB] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's fine, Madison. Everything is taken care of. There's no reason to be nervous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，麦迪逊。都在掌握中，不必紧张。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We haven't forgotten anything. We're on top of the situation. Come on, we're professionals!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们什么都没有忘。我状态良好。来吧，我们是专家！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Make sure to stay in contact with Daniel and Alex. I'm waiting for a report from them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 确保和丹尼尔与亚历克斯的联系。我正等待他们报告。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When you have a moment, can you check the pressure on tanks 3 and 4? I'm concerned there may be a leak.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你有空，能不能检查下3号和4号罐的压力？我担心那有泄漏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did we forget to compensate for the power fluctuations in our last calculation? I'd hate to see us short something out now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们上次计算是不是忘了需要补偿的能量波动？我痛恨我们总是丢三落四。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm concerned that we're overlooking something, James. I don't want us to be too hasty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在关心的是我们期待已久的东西，詹姆斯。我不希望我们太过草率。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, Doctor?
ESP.TRADUIT: 博士，什么事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm out of BBs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有BB弹了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Out already? Something wrong with the sights on that thing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 已经用完了吗？瞄准器有问题吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602FDCF] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here you go, honey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 甜心，拿好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Out already? Something wrong with the sights on that thing?

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here you go, son.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小子，拿好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602FDCF] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't like surprises.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不喜欢惊喜。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Since when? Regardless, I think you'll like this one. You're getting older, and you've got your Pip-Boy. I figure you're old enough for this, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么时候开始的？不管怎样，我想你会喜欢这个。你够大了，你也有了你的哔哔小子。我认为你也到了用它的年纪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602FDCF] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your own BB gun! It's a little old, but it should work perfectly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有BB枪了！尽管有点旧，不过应该很好用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602FDCF] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jonas found it down here. It was in pretty rough shape -- took us a good three months to find the parts to get it working again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 乔纳斯在这下面找到它。它锈得不行 — 我们用了整整三个月来找零件修好它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602FDCF] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know how tough it is to find a spring that small? Good thing Butch "misplaced" that switchblade of his. Ha ha ha!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道找到个这么小的弹簧有多难？还好布奇把他的弹簧刀“放错了”地方。哈哈哈！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602FDCF] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, what do you think? Want to give it a try?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么样？想试试吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602FDCF] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What kind of surprise?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么惊喜？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Overseer gave you your Pip-Boy, and you're old enough to do some work. So I figure you’re old enough for this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 监督者给你一个哔哔小子，你也够大了，可以做些工作了。因此，我觉得这件事你也够年龄了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602FDCF] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: God and Saint Monica hear my sermons. That's good enough for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 上帝和圣莫尼卡听到我的布道。这对我就足够了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Head on in, partner. Ya’ll enjoy your stay now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 进来吧，朋友。你会享受在这的时光的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yoo murdah my hainji!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你撒了我的盆友！

ESP.ORIGINAL: No! Net yoo!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不！你不是！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nona! Ud muerna!
ESP.TRADUIT: 喔不！他史了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ud matanna mes!
ESP.TRADUIT: 塔要杀了窝们！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Damnit. I'm just trying to keep the peace.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死。我只是想维持和平。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : angry that someone died EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goddamnit. Everyone stand the hell down! Let's solve this peacefully.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死。见鬼，都闭嘴！让我们和平地解决它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : angry that someone died EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dead. Great.
ESP.TRADUIT: 死了。太好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : angry that someone died EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now I'm pissed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在我怒了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : angry that someone died EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Argh!
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊咯！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : angry that someone died EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: There. You see? Natural selection at its finest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看到了吗？物竞天择，适者生存。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : smugly indifferent to another man's death EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Death can be so messy, can't it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 死相真是难看，对不。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : smugly indifferent to another man's death EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope someone deals with that body soon. I detest the smell of rotting flesh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望有人立刻处理下尸体。我讨厌腐尸的味道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : smugly indifferent to another man's death EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Death is such nasty business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 死亡是这么肮脏的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : appalled that someone has died violently EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh my God!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我的天啊！

ESP.ORIGINAL: No!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不！

ESP.TRADUIT: 噢不！

ESP.ORIGINAL: This can't be happening!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不可能！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please no!
ESP.TRADUIT: 求你，不要！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Somebody help!
ESP.TRADUIT: 救命！

ESP.TRADUIT: 我看不下去了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: No!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不！

ESP.ORIGINAL: This ain't over yet!

ESP.ORIGINAL: Man down! Man down!
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人阵亡！有人阵亡！

ESP.TRADUIT: 闭嘴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: More loot for me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要更多的战利品！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dammit! They owed me 50 caps!
ESP.TRADUIT: 她妈的！他们欠我50个瓶盖！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you're gonna pay for that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你要为此付出代价。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've lost one.

ESP.TRADUIT: 报告……我们的一个士兵倒下了。

ESP.TRADUIT: 不！她妈的……

ESP.TRADUIT: 我要让他们付出代价。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hell yeah! How do you like me now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 见鬼！你怎么做的和我一样！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dammit!
