ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colonel Cassandra Moore [001206FC] (file) NPC : General Lee Oliver [001300A9] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Press on!
ESP.TRADUIT: 顶住！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep fighting!
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续战斗！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Darn it...
ESP.TRADUIT: 见鬼……

ESP.ORIGINAL: What a waste...
ESP.TRADUIT: 真是徒劳……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Meaner than a rattlesnake, ain't ya?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你比毒蛇还毒，是不是？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goldurnit!
ESP.TRADUIT: 诅咒你！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Damn it to hell!
ESP.TRADUIT: 下地狱吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll pay for that!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会为此付出代价的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Damn...
ESP.TRADUIT: 见鬼……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shame...
ESP.TRADUIT: 可惜……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goddamn it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 天杀的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Blast it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他妈的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: God dammit...
ESP.TRADUIT: 活见鬼……

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll pay for that...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会付出代价的……

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll pay for that!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会为此付出代价的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fucker!
ESP.TRADUIT: 操！

ESP.ORIGINAL: They killed him!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们杀了他！

ESP.ORIGINAL: They killed her!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们杀了她！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look out!
ESP.TRADUIT: 注意！

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll get 'em.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们干掉他们了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Flank 'em!
ESP.TRADUIT: 包围他们！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bastard! You'll pay for that!
ESP.TRADUIT: 杂种！你会付出代价！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Roo too nait, ahk iss.
ESP.TRADUIT: 今晚休习，我的盆友！

ESP.ORIGINAL: No! Neekt ni!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不！你不是！

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've got a man down here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们有人倒下了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Man down!
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人倒下了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Engaging!
ESP.TRADUIT: 与敌人交火！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go, go, go!
ESP.TRADUIT: 冲，冲，冲！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Time to die, Outsider!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就送你上西天，外来者！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Damn, there goes a big earner.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死，亏大了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck, that's not good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 操，糟透了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm gonna kick your ass.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要打得你满地找牙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You wanna piece of this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要尝尝这个吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's get this goin'.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来大干一场吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm going to blow you to pieces.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要把你炸成碎片。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stupid shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 狗屎玩意儿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh yeah! That means more for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦！我会记住的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's rock.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm going to make you bleed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会给你放放血的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, it's on now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，开始吧 !

ESP.ORIGINAL: They killed him!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们杀了他！

ESP.ORIGINAL: They killed her!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们杀了她！

ESP.ORIGINAL: They killed him!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们杀了他！

ESP.ORIGINAL: They killed her!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们杀了她！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look out!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当心！

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll get 'em.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们会抓到他们的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Flank 'em!
ESP.TRADUIT: 包抄他们！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Man down!
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人倒下了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now you've gone and done it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你竟然干出这种事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get back!
ESP.TRADUIT: 回来！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇哦！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Duck!
ESP.TRADUIT: 趴下！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Protect yourself!
ESP.TRADUIT: 保护自己！

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's live!
ESP.TRADUIT: 会爆炸的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Moooove!
Heads down!
ESP.TRADUIT: 低头！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Watch out!
ESP.TRADUIT: 小心点！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nooooo!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nooooooo!
Move... MOVE!
ESP.TRADUIT: 行动……行动！

ESP.ORIGINAL: What?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Watch your ass!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当心后面！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get away from it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 离开它！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll get that door open, and then you can let your hordes in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会把门打开，然后你可以让你的人进来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well get going, then! Open the door! What's taking you so damn long? Hurry up!
ESP.TRADUIT: 快啊！开门！怎么他妈的花了这么长时间？快点！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : Anxious to put his master plan into action EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can get them to let you move in / You can now move in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以想办法让你们进来 /现在你们可以进来了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll be damned. Really? Good job kid! I was willing to unleash the Ferals and kill all those bigots. Guess I don't have to now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死。真的？做的好，孩子！我当时还想让那些凶悍僵尸杀了那些种族分子。现在看来不用了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : giving a reward for a job well done EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's a little something for your troubles, it'll help you deal with our Feral brethren if you meet any.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这有样东西报答你，它能让你不用再担心我们的疯狂兄弟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : giving a reward for a job well done EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've taken care of things. You can move in now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经把事情办妥了。你现在可以搬进去了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, maybe I should talk to Tenpenny. There may be a peaceful solution.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我应该和特佩尼谈谈。可能会有个和平的解决办法。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Try it if you like. Go talk to Tenpenny. Ask him he wants us living there. It won't work. So when you fail, we can do it my way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想就试试吧。去和特佩尼谈谈，让他同意我们住进去。不过这是没用的，要是你失败的话，再按我的方法做吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : scoffing at a bad idea EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: It won't work. So when you fail, we can do it my way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没用的。要是你失败的话，再按我的方法做吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : scoffing at a bad idea EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: There may be a peaceful solution.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许会有和平的解决办法。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me try talking to Tenpenny. Maybe he wouldn't mind you living there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我试试和特佩尼谈谈。或许他不介意你住进去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! Those snooty bitches probably can't stand living with each other, let alone with us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！那些傲慢的混账们相互间都快无法忍受了，更别说和我们住在一起。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : explaining plan to co-conspirator EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But by all means, try talking to Tenpenny if you like. But it won't work. Then we'll do it my way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 话说回来，这也是个办法，你可以试着努力和特佩尼谈谈。但是要是不成，那我就按我的方法做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : explaining plan to co-conspirator EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You get that escape door in the Tenpenny basement open, and I'll unleash those ferals on 'em!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你把特佩尼地下室的逃生门打开，那我就能放那些凶悍僵尸进去了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : explaining plan to co-conspirator EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! Those snooty bitches probably can't stand living with each other, let alone with us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！那些傲慢的混账们相互间都快无法忍受了，更别说和我们住在一起。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : explaining plan to co-conspirator EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It won't work. Then we'll do it my way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是不成，那我就按我的方法做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : explaining plan to co-conspirator EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You get that escape door in the Tenpenny basement open, and I'll unleash those ferals on 'em!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你把特佩尼地下室的逃生门打开，那我就能放那些凶悍僵尸进去了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : explaining plan to co-conspirator EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe they wouldn't mind you living there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许他们不介意你住进去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Honey? Over here; the intercom.
ESP.TRADUIT: 亲爱的？来对讲机这。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Son? Over here; the intercom.
ESP.TRADUIT: 儿子？来对讲机这。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rubbish! You must be daft. Look around! Where else in the Wasteland have you seen such magnificence, I ask you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 垃圾！你一定很愚蠢。到处看看！我问你，在废土上你还看到过这样富丽堂皇的地方吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : flaboyantly bragging EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had the great fortune to run into Mister Burke, an absolute gem of a man. He certainly has a way of getting done what needs to get done, doesn't he?
ESP.TRADUIT: 遇上伯克先生我真幸运，一个人才。他总是有办法完成要做的事，不是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : flaboyantly bragging EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then it was a matter of getting the right type of tenants with the right type of assets, and the rest is, as they say, history.
ESP.TRADUIT: 接下来重要的就是为房产找到合适的住客，至于其他，如他们所说，都已经是历史了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : flaboyantly bragging EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Eh. It's okay here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这还好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I say! Must you be so caustic? Come now, a lot of work went into turning this husk of a tower into a place people can call home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说！你一定要这么刻薄吗？来吧，要想把这废弃的大厦变成为象家一样的住的地方还有很多工作要做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : flamboyantly bragging EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've had help, of course. Especially in Mister Burke, an absolute gem of a man. He certainly has a way of getting done what needs to get done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然喽，我有帮手的。特别是伯克先生，一个人才。他总是有办法完成要做的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : flamboyantly bragging EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then it was a matter of getting the right type of tenants with the right type of assets, and the rest is, as they say, history.
ESP.TRADUIT: 接下来重要的就是为房产找到合适的住客，至于其他，如他们所说，都已经是历史了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : flamboyantly bragging EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: You didn't build this tower, you just found it and moved in. Big fucking deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这座大厦又不是你盖的，你只是找到它然后搬了进来。真他妈了不起。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Righto! When I saw this place jutting up out of the horizon, I knew what I had to do! I hired some muscle and we got this place fixed up right quick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对头！当我看到这地方从地平线冒出来的时候，我就知道该怎么做了！我雇了些肌肉男，然后很快就把这地方搞定了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : flamboyantly bragging EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had the great fortune to run into Mister Burke, an absolute gem of a man. He certainly has a way of getting done what needs to get done, doesn't he?
ESP.TRADUIT: 遇上伯克先生我真幸运，一个人才。他总是有办法完成要做的事，不是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : flamboyantly bragging EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then it was a matter of getting the right type of tenants with the right type of assets, and the rest is, as they say, history.
ESP.TRADUIT: 接下来重要的就是为房产找到合适的住客，至于其他，照他们的说法，都已经是历史了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : flamboyantly bragging EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Indeed! I'm extremely impressed!
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错！我大吃一惊！

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's more to this than you realize, Button.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这比你认为的要多，巴顿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please explain, but I warn you, I am well versed on the tactics of the underhanded Redcoat spy. You'd do well to remember that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请解释，不过我警告你，我很熟悉红衣间谍的伎俩。你最好记住。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06003A78] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: James, this is wrong. You can't do this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 詹姆斯，这样不好。你不能这么做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : losing her cool EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Madison, please. Now's not the time. I'll get the information the Colonel needs, but I need you to...
ESP.TRADUIT: 麦迪逊，拜托。现在不是时候。我会得到上校要的东西，但我需要你……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : calm, reassuring EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I won't help you do this James. Not after everything it took to get here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我完成任务之前我什么也不会帮你的，詹姆斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need you to monitor the output levels on pumps three and four. Please step over to the panel and keep an eye on them, will you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要你监控第三和第四水泵的输出水平。请盯着面板，可以吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : calm, reassuring. speaking to someone who's bordering on hysterical, trying to get her to listen EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? What are you talking about? That doesn't even make sense...
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？你正说什么？这甚至毫无意义……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : stressed out, confused EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Madison, please. It's very important that you do this right now. Just step over to the panel while I access the computer in the control booth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 麦迪逊，拜托。你现在做的事很重要。当我访问电脑的控制终端时，你盯着面板就好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : calm, reassuring, trying to get his point across to someone who's not listening EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: James, I...
ESP.TRADUIT: 詹姆斯，我……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : confused, but starting to understand EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please. Just monitor the pumps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜托。只要盯着水泵就好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : calm, reassuring. Basically saying goodbye to someone he cares about. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Intercom4-2
ESP.TRADUIT: 对讲机4-2

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wish not so much to live long as to live well!
ESP.TRADUIT: 宁可战死，不可苟活！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Archives Intercom [0C00EE5C] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Intercom4-1
ESP.TRADUIT: 对讲机4-1

ESP.ORIGINAL: The enemy is at the gates! Now is the time for the greatest of rallying cries!
ESP.TRADUIT: 敌人就在门口！是失守吹响这最伟大战斗的号角了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Archives Intercom [0C00EE5C] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Intercom3-2
ESP.TRADUIT: 对讲机3-2

ESP.ORIGINAL: The enemy will be here soon, you must defend your leader! Remember: Our cause is noble; it is the cause of mankind!
ESP.TRADUIT: 敌人就要来了，你们必须保护你们的领袖！记住：我们的事业是神圣的；这是全人类的事业！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Archives Intercom [0C00EE5B] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Intercom3-1
ESP.TRADUIT: 对讲机3-1

ESP.ORIGINAL: We cannot allow the enemy to penetrate our defenses any deeper! Old Glory must not be stained with the blood of tyranny!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不能允许敌人突破我们的防线！星条旗一定不能被暴政的血玷污！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Archives Intercom [0C00EE5B] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Intercom2-2
ESP.TRADUIT: 对讲机2-2

ESP.ORIGINAL: Strike now and strike hard. You may delay, but time will not!
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在进攻，猛烈进攻。你们可以等，但是时间不等人！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Archives Intercom [0C00EE5A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Intercom2-1
ESP.TRADUIT: 对讲机2-1

ESP.ORIGINAL: Men! We can't let the enemy's progress dissuade us from our task! We must defend our freedom and our right to be independent!
ESP.TRADUIT: 伙计们！我们不能让敌人的前进妨碍我们的任务！我们必须维护我们的自由和独立的权利！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Archives Intercom [0C00EE5A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Intercom1-3
ESP.TRADUIT: 对讲机1-3

ESP.ORIGINAL: As your leader, Button Gwinnett, distinguished representative of Georgia, I promise you I have not yet begun to fight!
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为你们的领导人，巴顿·格温耐特，乔治亚州的著名代表，我向你们保证，这对我还算不上战斗！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Archives Intercom [0C00EE59] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Intercom1-2
ESP.TRADUIT: 对讲机1-2

ESP.ORIGINAL: Remember, the will of the people is the only legitimate foundation of any government, and to protect its free expression should be our first object.
ESP.TRADUIT: 记住，人民的意愿是任何合法的政府唯一的基础，保护自由之音是我们的首要目标。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Archives Intercom [0C00EE59] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Intercom1-1
ESP.TRADUIT: 对讲机1-1

ESP.ORIGINAL: Men, today I address you with a message of utmost urgency. Our defenses have been breached, and soon we'll engage the enemy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 伙计们，今天我向你们宣布一个迫在眉睫的讯息。我们的防线被突破了，不久我们就要与敌人交火了了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Archives Intercom [0C00EE59] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Back off, man. That's my stuff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 退后，伙计。这是我的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey buddy, Bar's over here if you need something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，伙计，吧台在这，你要是需要什么的话，只管说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stacey! Open the gate, and let this mungo in!
ESP.TRADUIT: 斯泰西！开门，让毛人进去！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, sounds good. I would have done it for free.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没问题，听起来不错。我本来是可以免费完成这件事情的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah right. Good luck soldier. I'm not coming after you to rescue your ass if you get in trouble. You're on your own.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，祝你好运，士兵。如果你遇到麻烦，我也没法过来增援你的。你得靠自己了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Roy Phillips and his gang are somewhere in Warrington Station Metro tunnels. They've barred the main entrance. Try going through the train yard.
ESP.TRADUIT: 罗伊·菲利普斯和他的那伙人在沃灵顿站地铁隧道。他们控制了主入口。要从火车站台旁的小门进入那。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah right. Good luck soldier. I'm not coming after you to rescue your ass if you get in trouble. You're on your own.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，祝你好运，士兵。如果你遇到麻烦，我也没法过来增援你的。你得靠自己了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : ("Yeah right" said skeptically) but happy to find such a good recruit EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take it. And any other help you can offer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会接受。你提供的任何帮助我都会接受的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, you can take this rifle and ammo. But don't waste it shooting at shadows.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，你可以拿着这来复枪和子弹。不过别放空枪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Roy Phillips and his gang are somewhere in Warrington Station Metro tunnels. They've barred the main entrance. Try going through the train yard.
ESP.TRADUIT: 罗伊·菲利普斯和他的那伙人在沃灵顿站地铁隧道。他们控制了主入口。要从火车站台旁的小门进入那。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, you can take this rifle and ammo. But don't waste it shooting at shadows.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，你可以拿着这来复枪和子弹。不过别放空枪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : bitter mercenary accepting a volunteer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You want this problem resolved or not? You can spare more than that...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想解决问题还是不想？你可以派更多的人……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well... maybe you're right. It was something I was going to have to do eventually anyway. How about another 200 caps?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯…… 可能你是对的。有些事最终还是得靠我来做。多加200个瓶盖怎么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And here. You can take this rifle and ammo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给。你可以拿着这来复枪和子弹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But you better not screw this up!
ESP.TRADUIT: 但你最好不要浪费！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Roy Phillips and his gang are somewhere in Warrington Station Metro tunnels. They've barred the main entrance. Try going through the train yard.
ESP.TRADUIT: 罗伊·菲利普斯和他的那伙人在沃灵顿站地铁隧道。他们控制了主入口。要从火车站台旁的小门进入那。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well... maybe you're right. It was something I was going to have to do eventually anyway. How about another 200 caps?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯…… 可能你是对的。有些事最终还是得靠我来做。多加200个瓶盖怎么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : angry warning EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And here. You can take this rifle and ammo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给。你可以拿着这来复枪和子弹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : angry warning EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But you better not screw this up!
ESP.TRADUIT: 但你最好不要浪费！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : angry warning EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Like I tell my men: Don't bother reporting in, unless it's to tell me you got the job done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 像我告诉我弟兄们的那样：不停地汇报进度很烦人，除非你是打算告诉我已经搞定了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : gruff and dismissive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm still working on getting rid of Roy Phillips and his pack of Ghouls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还在忙着除掉罗伊·菲利普斯和他那伙僵尸。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? You? You're welcome to give it a try. But don't come crying to me when you get hurt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？你？欢迎你去试试。到你受伤的时候，可别来找我哭诉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : extending a contract to a fellow mercenary EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: They've holed up in the nearby metro tunnels. They're living with packs of Feral Ghouls. Be careful, Roy seems damn close to turning zombie himself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们蜗居在地铁隧道里，与一堆疯狂的僵尸生活在一起。小心，罗伊也快变成疯狂丧尸了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : extending a contract to a fellow mercenary EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose you won't be doing this out of the kindness of your heart, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜你并不是出于纯粹的善意吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : extending a contract to a fellow mercenary EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How's 500 bottlecaps sound? Payable upon termination of that damn Ghoul, Roy Phillips, and all his followers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 500个瓶盖怎么样？杀了该死的僵尸，罗伊·菲利普斯，和他所有的手下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : extending a contract to a fellow mercenary EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can help with your Ghoul problem. Where are they hiding out?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能帮你处理你的僵尸问题。他们藏在哪？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? You? You're welcome to give it a try. But don't come crying to me when you get hurt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？你？欢迎你去试试。到你受伤的时候，可别来找我哭诉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : extending a contract to a fellow mercenary EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Be careful, Roy seems damn close to turning zombie himself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小心点，罗伊自己似乎也快变成丧尸了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : extending a contract to a fellow mercenary EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose you won't be doing this out of the kindness of your heart, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜你并不是出于纯粹的善意吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : extending a contract to a fellow mercenary EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How's 500 bottlecaps sound? Payable upon termination of that damn Ghoul, Roy Phillips, and all his followers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 500个瓶盖怎么样？杀了该死的僵尸，罗伊·菲利普斯，和他所有的手下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : extending a contract to a fellow mercenary EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can help with your Ghoul problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以帮你解决尸鬼的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps the residents could be "persuaded" to let the Ghouls live here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许这的居民能被说服，同意让尸鬼住进来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're out of line. Those filthy bitches can stay living in those metro tunnels. They'll move in here over my dead body.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你过分了。那些肮脏的婊子只能住在那些地铁隧道里。不然就让他们跨过我的尸体住进来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : angry EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well... not exactly. But my colleagues have published papers...
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯……还没有。但我的同事发表了篇论文……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : growing excitement EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose someone ought to verify their findings... Perhaps I'll do that. Who knows? I might even finally get published!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜有人会去核实他们的发现……也许就是我。谁知道呢？我的论文可能也会出版！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : growing excitement EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't suppose you've consulted any Ghouls on your little theory?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你并没有跟任何僵尸商量过你那个小理论？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahem. I advise you to speak more civilly. Perhaps you can go enlighten Chief Gustavo. I have pressing "evil minion" things to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哼。我建议你说话再讲礼些。你可能得去启迪一下古斯塔沃长官。我还有些“魔鬼仆从”的事要做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : angry sarcastic indignation EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: For an evil minion, you're not very bright. You can't "contain" Ghouls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想当魔鬼仆从，你的头脑可不够聪明。你不可以“抑制”那僵尸问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you can do a better job than Chief Gustavo, perhaps you can go enlighten him. I have important matters to attend to. If you'll excuse me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你能比古斯塔沃长官做得更好，或许你可以给他些指导。我还有别的要事要办。不介意吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : mild sarcasm EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Contained? Don't you want a permanent solution?
ESP.TRADUIT: 抑制恶化？难道你不想一劳永逸的解决问题吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: About these Ghouls...
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些尸鬼...

ESP.ORIGINAL: That damn Roy Phillips won't take no for an answer. Keeps showing up, looking for a handout. He and his kind aren't wanted. End of story.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死的罗伊·菲利普斯可不接受不行这个答案。常来寻求施舍，自讨没趣。他和他那类东西是不会被我们接受的。故事结束。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : angry EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I were a betting man, I'd place a stack of caps on him trying something violent soon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我是赌鬼，我会把大把的钱押在他身上，赌他要不了多久就会使用暴力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : angry EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: And that would make Tenpenny nervous. I don't like it when Tenpenny gets nervous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那会让特佩尼紧张。特佩尼紧张的时候，我可不喜欢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : angry EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I can't spare the manpower to go hunt down Roy Phillips and his band of misfits, or I'd gladly end this thing once and for all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是我不够人手去清除掉罗伊·菲利普斯和他那帮废物，否则我会很高兴地结束这件事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : angry EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How's that Ghoul situation coming along?
ESP.TRADUIT: 僵尸的问题进展如何？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If they got in here, they'd get their filth over everything. You can smell them a mile away!
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是他们住了进来，那这儿的一切都会被弄得污秽不堪。你能在一里外闻到他们的臭味！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lydia Montenegro [060156DA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important snob EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope they come back and get killed by security.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望他们回来，然后被警卫干掉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lydia Montenegro [060156DA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important snob EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you afraid of the Ghouls trying to get into Tenpenny?
ESP.TRADUIT: 对于那些僵尸试图进入特配尼大厦，你害怕吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They were told they can't live here. But those zombies are too stupid to understand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们已经说过他们不能住进来。但是这些丧尸太愚蠢，听不明白。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important snob upset with the situation EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: They live in their own filth, squatting in the nearby metro tunnel. Security keeps shooting them, but they keep coming back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们住在他们的垃圾堆里，蜗居在附近的地铁隧道里。警卫见到他们就朝他们射击，但是他们总是又跑回来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important snob upset with the situation EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you worried about those Ghouls?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你担心那些僵尸吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't you worry about any such thing, sir. Care to wet your whistle?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不担心这样的事吗，先生。有什么打算吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shakes [00017A03] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : programmed to be happy EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know anything about those Ghouls trying to get in here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道关于想进住的那些僵尸的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't you worry about any such thing. Care to wet your whistle?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不用担心这种事。要不要来杯喝的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shakes [00017A03] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : programmed to be happy EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know anything about those Ghouls trying to get in here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道关于想进住的那些僵尸的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure it will end in bloodshed. It's serious business, comrade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我肯定这事最后会造成流血冲突。这是很严肃的事情，同志。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Irving Cheng [060156DC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : nervous EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the whole situation with the Ghouls?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么看待这个僵尸的问题？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're living in the nearby tunnels. They scare me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们住在附近的隧道里。他们让我感到害怕！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : upset no one is protecting her EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why doesn't somebody do something!
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么没人去解决这事！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : upset no one is protecting her EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know anything about these Ghouls?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道关于那些僵尸的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you going to do something about the problem, or not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要去把这问题解决掉，是吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156DE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important prostitute EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those Ghouls sure have people worked up, don't they?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些僵尸确实让人烦躁，是吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some Ghouls moved into the nearby Metro tunnel. There's a bunch of the so-called Feral Ghouls in there, but a handful seem the sociable type.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一群僵尸住在附近的地铁通道里。那有一群凶悍僵尸，但是还有少数僵尸看起来是友善的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : jovial, but with a hint of concern EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've tried explaining to my fellow tenants that not all Ghouls are monsters. But they don't seem to care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和这的租客解释过，并非所有的僵尸都是不可理喻的怪物。但是他们好像听不进去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : jovial, but with a hint of concern EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: The intelligent ones should stay away from our trigger happy protectors. If there're enough feral ones though, they could overwhelm security.
ESP.TRADUIT: 聪明的僵尸会离我们喜欢射击的警卫远点。但是如果凶悍僵尸数量够多的话，他们可能会打垮警卫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : jovial, but with a hint of concern EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I bet you know a thing or two about those Ghouls...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我打赌你知道点那些僵尸的事……

ESP.ORIGINAL: We have the situation... contained.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们已经抑制了情况……的恶化。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : Bureaucratic slyness EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you doing something about those Ghouls?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会为这僵尸问题做点什么吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Chief Gustavo assures us that he's increased the number of the security team, and will kill any zombies on sight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 古斯塔沃长官向我们保证他增加了警卫的数量，会杀掉任何一只出现的丧尸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important snob brushing off concern for her safety EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those Ghouls have you stressed out, too?
ESP.TRADUIT: 僵尸也让你这样紧张？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We haven't discussed this already? Apparently there's a pack of zombies living in the tunnels. Gustavo says he has it under control.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们还没谈过这事吗？显而易见，隧道里住着一群丧尸。古斯塔沃说他已经控制了局势。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Michael Hawthorne [060156D6] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : high class alcoholic making a joke. EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: On the bright side, it's given me another reason to hit the drink!
ESP.TRADUIT: 令人高兴，这给了我们另一个干杯的理由！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Michael Hawthorne [060156D6] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : high class alcoholic making a joke. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't suppose you know much about those Ghouls?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜你不是很了解那些僵尸？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a pack of zombies living nearby in some old tunnel. They asked to move in. Naturally, they were told to go to hell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有一群丧尸住在附近的旧隧道里。他们想住进来。当然，我们叫他们滚蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156D7] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important snob showing utter disdain EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gustavo's hired some additional goons. Seems to be working. Still, makes one a bit fidgety having those loathsome creatures around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 古斯塔沃另外雇了些警卫。似乎有点用。不过，这些讨厌的僵尸在周围游荡仍然让我们不安。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156D7] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important snob showing utter disdain EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wouldn't even want them as slaves!
ESP.TRADUIT: 让他们当奴隶我都不要！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156D7] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important snob showing utter disdain EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know anything useful about those Ghouls?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道关于那些僵尸有用的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Again with the Ghouls! It's all anyone will gossip about. I can't help thinking about them... doing things to us. Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 又是这些僵尸！每个人都在交头接耳地谈论。我也禁不住总是想像他们……给我们惹麻烦。还是谈谈其他事吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Millicent Wellington [060156D8] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : (wants to talk about something else) self important snobby busy body EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hear anything interesting about the Ghouls?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听说过那些僵尸的趣事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: My current theory is that the destructive disease of the Ghoul condition will always eventually render him little more than a mindless killer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在的理论认为僵尸身体所受的严重缺陷最终会导致他变成一个冷血的杀手。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : with a hint of sympathy EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: The proverbial Wasteland "zombie" with a predilection for raw human flesh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 众所周知，废土上的“丧尸”嗜好吃活人肉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : with a hint of sympathy EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They can't be cured. And there's nothing to alleviate the symptoms. All in all, it seems rather sad, really.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们不能被治愈。也没什么东西能减轻他们的症状。总而言之，他们真的很可悲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : with a hint of sympathy EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Know much about those Ghouls?
ESP.TRADUIT: 知道什么关于那些僵尸的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's it like living at Tenpenny Tower?
ESP.TRADUIT: 在特佩尼大厦居住的感觉如何？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a piece of Utopia jutting up from the Wasteland. Tenpenny is a true visionary. I do my part to assist him in unfolding his Master Plan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这儿就像是废土中的乌托邦。特佩尼是个真正的梦想家。我尽职尽责帮他扩展他的宏伟蓝图。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : ("dying to get in" is ironic because it's true) dismissing the deaths of lowlife scum who don't deserve to live here. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This tower is the symbol of true progress in this world! People are dying to get in here. Just ask those Ghouls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这大厦真是世界进步的象征！人们拼了命也想住进来。比如那些僵尸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : ("dying to get in" is ironic because it's true) dismissing the deaths of lowlife scum who don't deserve to live here. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go for the top shelf. On me. <Give 20 caps.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 最好的酒，我请客。<给予20个瓶盖>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa, twenty caps! Look at the big spender! Alright then, I can see you're in it for the big money, so I'll tell you all about Moriarty's.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，20个瓶盖！看看这大富翁！好吧，看在你出这钱的份上，我会告诉你所有莫里亚蒂的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Moriarty, he's a ratfuck bastard for sure, but he's also paranoid as all hell. So paranoid that he don't let no one handle the cash around here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 莫里亚蒂就是他妈个混蛋，也是他妈个偏执狂，所以他不会让任何人碰他的钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Every night, he takes what Gob and Nova earn and locks it in a file cabinet next to his bed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每天晚上，他拿走盖博和诺瓦赚的钱，锁到他床边的一个柜子里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't you know how a bribe works? You give me money, and I give you information. In order to do that, you have to have money. Christ. Kids!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道什么叫贿赂吗？你给我钱，我给你信息。要这么做，你必须有钱。老天啊。这孩子！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jericho [06000A71] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : "Christ.Kids!" Is said in mock exasperiation. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This should buy you something. <Give 10 caps.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿这钱去买点什么。<给予10个瓶盖>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha ha! You're gonna have to do better than that, kid! Thanks for the drink, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈！孩子，你其实应该再大方一点！不管怎么样，谢谢这杯喝的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What if all your other neighbors agree?
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是你的邻居全都同意呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't care. The only way those Ghouls are getting in is over my dead body.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那不关我事。除非我死了，不然僵尸别想进来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156D7] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important snob EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Would you tell Mister Tenpenny that you wouldn't mind Ghoul neighbors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会告诉特佩尼先生你不介意尸鬼做邻居吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想是的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! I don't suppose I'd mind terribly if Ghouls were to live here. And it'd be a good bit of sport hunting them down if they misbehaved.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！我在想我允许僵尸住进来后会出现什么麻烦。如果他们犯错的话，那会是个不错的狩猎机会的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : flamboyantly bragging EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I dare say though, you'll have a bit of trouble convincing certain residents to go along with your novel proposition.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我敢这么说，要是你去游说住客同意你天方夜谭式的想法的话，会惹大麻烦的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : flamboyantly bragging EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell you what. If you can convince Mr. and Mrs. Wellington, Mr. Ling, Ms. Montenegro, and Ms. Lancaster, those Ghouls can live here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉你吧。如果你能说服威灵顿夫妇，林先生，黑山小姐和兰卡斯特小姐，那些僵尸就可以住进来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : flamboyantly bragging EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you seen me shoot? I'm quite proficient, if I do say so myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没见过我射击吗？如果让我评价自己的话,我会说非常的准。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : flamboyantly bragging EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: What if the residents are okay with Ghoul neighbors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果这的居民同意僵尸做邻居又如何？

ESP.ORIGINAL: In time, after Tenpenny's projects have come to fruition, things like Ghouls and other aberrations of nature will be a thing of the past.
ESP.TRADUIT: 到时候，特佩尼的计划完成后，象僵尸和变形怪物都将成为历史。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important bureaucrat EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: These times are the crucible for a glorious future. One shouldn't be overly concerned with who gets burned in the process.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些都是对我们实现美好未来的严酷考验。人们不必关心在这过程中受伤的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important bureaucrat EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tenpenny seems rather heartless.
ESP.TRADUIT: 特配尼看起来更无情。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? Well... As long as they don't bother me... I guess, I really don't care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？好吧…… 只要他们不打扰我……我想，我真的不在乎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Michael Hawthorne [060156D6] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : letting go of prejudice EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've met these Ghouls. They're civilized and pose no threat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经见过这些僵尸了。他们看起来很文明，没有什么威胁。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm afraid I can't abide by that. I can't imagine Tenpenny would allow it. But I certainly won't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我担心我能否忍受。我不能想象特佩尼会同意。但是我可以不去想象。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156D7] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important snob EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've met these Ghouls. They're civilized and pose no threat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经见过这些僵尸了。他们看起来很文明，没有什么威胁。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! I think I know a fair share more than some vagrant blown in off the Wastes. You are simply mistaken.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！我想我认为公平分享要比在废土流浪要好吧。你犯了个小错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Millicent Wellington [060156D8] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important snob EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: They may appear nice, but deep down they want to kill. It's common knowledge among the educated.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们看着不错，但是内心深处，他们想杀人。从以往的经验看，这是显而易见的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Millicent Wellington [060156D8] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important snob EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You clearly don't know what you are talking about!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你完全不知道你在说什么！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Millicent Wellington [060156D8] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important snob EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've met these Ghouls. They're civilized and pose no threat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经见过这些僵尸了。他们看起来很文明，没有什么威胁。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well... If they don't mind me giving them a thorough exam and if they agree to follow any directives I give them regarding health and hygiene...
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧……如果他们不介意我给他们作彻底的检查，还有如果他们同意遵从我的任何指导，包括健康和卫生方面……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : letting go of prejudice EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose I wouldn't mind too terribly. It'd give me a chance to study Ghoul physiology.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我并不特别介意。这也给我机会研究僵尸生理学。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : letting go of prejudice EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've met these Ghouls. They seem healthy. All things considered.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经见过这些僵尸了。他们看起来很文明，没有什么威胁。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think you must have been out in the sun too long. Perhaps I could sell you a nice hat to keep your brain from frying?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你一定是在太阳下待的时间太久了。看来我可以卖你一个不错的帽子，防止你的脑袋烤晕？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lydia Montenegro [060156DA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important snob EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've met these Ghouls. They're civilized and pose no threat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经见过这些僵尸了。他们看起来很文明，没有什么威胁。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why would you hang out with dirty vermin like that? You enjoy sifting through feces?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么不和那些肮脏的歹徒住在一起？你很享受泡在粪池里的感觉吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important snob EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know it's only a matter of time before they get hungry and eat you. You're crazy. Ghouls will never live in Tenpenny Tower.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要知道他们因为饿了而来吃你只是时间问题。你疯了。僵尸决不能住进特佩尼大厦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important snob EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've met these Ghouls. They're civilized and pose no threat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经见过这些僵尸了。他们看起来很文明，没有什么威胁。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, perhaps you're right, comrade. Some of these folk have a few things to learn about camaraderie, that's for sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，可能你是对的，同志。这些家伙需要学习友情，一定要学。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Irving Cheng [060156DC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : letting go of prejudice EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well... alright. I'm willing to give them a chance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧……好的。我愿意给他们一个机会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Irving Cheng [060156DC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : letting go of prejudice EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Comrade, I've met these Ghouls. They seem friendly enough. More than this lot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 同志，我已经见过这些僵尸了。他们看起来很友好。比起大多数人类来说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well... you seem like you know what you're talking about. I guess I'd be willing to give it a try. I might not spend much time with them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧……你好像知道你在说什么。我想我愿意给你个机会试试。我可能不会花太多时间和他们在一起。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : letting go of prejudice EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: And if they do anything stupid, I'm sure they'll get kicked out. Fine, it's ok.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他们做任何愚蠢的事情，我一定把他们踢出去。好的，没问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : letting go of prejudice EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've met these Ghouls. They seem friendly enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经见过这些僵尸了。他们看起来很友好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, if you don't mind their stink, then you should go squat with them in their dirty tunnels, and leave us civilized people alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，如果你不介意他们身上的臭味，那么你就和他们蹲到肮脏的隧道里去吧，离开我们这些文明人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156DE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important prostitute EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've met these Ghouls. They aren't so bad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经见过这些僵尸了。他们看起来没那么坏。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well... As long as they don't bother me... I guess, I really don't care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧……只要他们不打扰我……我想，我真的不在乎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Michael Hawthorne [060156D6] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : letting go of prejudice EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: What if they're civilized and pose no threat?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他们是文明人，不构成威胁呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm afraid I can't abide by that. I can't imagine Tenpenny would allow it. But I certainly won't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我担心我能否忍受。我不能想象特佩尼会同意。但是我可以不去想象。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156D7] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important snob EmotionType : Anger
