ESP.TRADUIT: 那么你就和他们蹲到肮脏的隧道里去吧，离开我们这些文明人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156DE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important prostitute EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: What if they aren't so bad?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他们没那么坏呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: How would you feel about having a few Ghoul neighbors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有几个尸鬼做邻居你觉得怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: HELL NO! Tenpenny won't allow it. And I take my orders from him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 见鬼，不行！特佩尼不会允许的，我听命于他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : angry mercenary EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: After Tenpenny died, I assumed full command. And since I hate Ghouls, I guess the answer to that question is pretty damn clear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 特佩尼死后，我全权负责。因为我恨僵尸，所以我猜你能非常他妈的清楚我会回答你什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : angry mercenary putting a nosey civilian in place. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those Ghouls can live here over my goddamn body!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些该死的僵尸要住进来，只能跨过我的尸体！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : angry mercenary putting a nosey civilian in place. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I spend most of my days out acquiring and managing various... assets for Mister Tenpenny. So it matter's little to me personally.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我每天花费我大多数的时间来为特佩尼先生寻觅和管理那些各种各样的……资产。所以那些僵尸对我个人来说不太重要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important bureaucrat EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: However, the Ghoulish state is a bitter reminder that things aren't yet in line with Mister Tenpenny's vision for a pure and stainless future.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管怎样，僵尸的凄惨状况，提醒我们事情并没圆满到像特佩尼先生展望的那纯净无瑕的美好未来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important bureaucrat EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you see, Ghouls living here is simply out of the question.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你也知道，让僵尸住在这简直不可能的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important bureaucrat EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know you've been pressuring people into allowing Ghouls to live here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你在给大家施压，想让僵尸住进来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156D7] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : flustered EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who do you think you are, harassing honest people like that? You should be ashamed of yourself! I certainly won't allow Ghouls to live here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你以为你是谁，这样打扰正直的人们？你应该为你感到羞耻，我当然不允许僵尸住进来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156D7] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : flustered EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: My neighbors might be out of their minds, but I am not. Those Ghouls will NOT be living here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的邻居可能疯了，但我没有。那些僵尸不能住进来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Millicent Wellington [060156D8] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : angry EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah yes. I was wondering when you'd try me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。我正在想，你什么时候会来问我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lydia Montenegro [060156DA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : sarcastically sweet EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You may be able to coerce the others, but I'm not such a pushover. Your zombie buddies will need to find someplace else to live.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以去强迫其他人，但我不是懦夫。你的丧尸伙伴还是找其他地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lydia Montenegro [060156DA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : sarcastically sweet EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's my turn, eh? Well, you won't be getting me to go along with your ridiculous plan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 到我了，呃？好吧，你不要妄想我能配合你荒谬的计划。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : angry EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ghouls aren't human. They live in filth. They eat their own babies. You're out of your right freaking mind!
ESP.TRADUIT: 僵尸不是人类。他们生活在污秽中。他们吃自己的孩子。你疯了吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : angry EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know all about your plan to get your Ghoul pals in here, and I'm putting a stop to it. You can't just go around pushing us around like that!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你全盘计划，让你的僵尸伙计住进来，我劝你放弃吧。你不能这样四处活动来强迫我们同意！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156DE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've dealt with people like you before... people who think they know what's good for everybody else. I know what's best for me, and that's no Ghouls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以前也这样……人们总以为知道什么对别人好。我知道什么对我最好，其中不包括僵尸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156DE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you can run along and tell your Ghouls they'll just have to find somewhere else to squat. Or better yet, to go off and die somewhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以去告诉你的僵尸朋友，他们去找其他地方吧。或者出去死在哪更好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156DE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I know you've been lobbying for those Ghouls... and I've already been thinking it over. I guess I would be willing to give it a try.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我知道你在四处为那些僵尸游说……我已经想过了。我想我愿意给他们机会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : hesitant but sincere EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know you've been talking to the others about the Ghouls... and I've been mulling the whole thing over a few cocktails... well more than a few...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你一直在和其他人谈僵尸……我得喝几杯鸡尾酒才能搞明白整个事情……可能不止几杯……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Michael Hawthorne [060156D6] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : hesistant but sincere EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: And I've decided that I'd be willing to give it a go. Having Ghoul neighbors, I mean.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我决定了，我同意。我意思是同意让他们做邻居。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Michael Hawthorne [060156D6] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : hesistant but sincere EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I knew it was only a matter of time before you asked me about that... I've decided I want to do my own study of Ghoul physiology.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你来问我只是时间问题……我已经决定了我想做我的僵尸生理学研究。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : unknowingly conceited EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who knows, I could even publish my findings!
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁知道那，我甚至可能把我的发现出版！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : unknowingly conceited EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've finally got around to asking me, comrade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最后还是来问我了，同志。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Irving Cheng [060156DC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : excited EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've given it a lot of careful thought. I would welcome these Ghouls into our community.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认真想过了。我会欢迎僵尸来我们的公社。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Irving Cheng [060156DC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : excited EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've already formed a welcoming committee!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经成立了个欢迎委员会！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Irving Cheng [060156DC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : excited EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's my turn, eh? I'm still worried, but if the others are willing to let them live here, I guess I could try it. But they better behave!
ESP.TRADUIT: 到我了，呃？我仍然担心，但是如果其他人愿意让他们住进来，我想我也可以试试让他们进来。但是他们要表现良好！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : hesitant but sincere EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've heard they carry diseases. I'd have to sanitize everything after them all the time. Besides, they are dangerous, aren't they?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说他们带着疾病。我必须每时每刻都跟在他们后面打扫。而且他们很危险，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important snob EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've heard the stories I'm sure. About the mindless ones eating brains and the like. Well, I'm not sure I'm comfortable with all that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你一定听过那些故事。他们随意吃人脑之类的事情。所以和他们一起，我不可能感到舒适。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Michael Hawthorne [060156D6] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : high class alcoholic EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Haha. You're joking right? You're serious? Of course not! Ghouls can't live here. They're dirty loathsome creatures.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈。你开玩笑吗？你认真的？当然不行了！僵尸不能住这。他们是肮脏讨厌的生物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156D7] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important snob EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dear lord. Are you serious? Ghouls living here? With us? That's simply out of the question.
ESP.TRADUIT: 上帝。你认真的？僵尸和我们住一起？和我们？这绝不可能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Millicent Wellington [060156D8] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important snob EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not sure. My first responsibility is the health and welfare of the residents of Tenpenny Tower.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不确定。我的首要责任是特佩尼大厦居民的健康和安全。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : snobby doctor EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ghouls often carry diseases due to radiation damaging their immune systems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 僵尸经常带着疾病，因为辐射破坏了他们的免疫系统。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : snobby doctor EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're being serious? That's out of the question. What an absurd notion!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认真的？这不可能。太荒谬了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lydia Montenegro [060156DA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important snob EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can't be serious. Ghouls aren't human. They live in filth. They eat their own babies. You're out of your right freakin' mind!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不是认真的吧。僵尸不是人类。他们居住在污秽中。他们吃自己的小孩。你疯了吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important snob EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't have any data in my files about that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是绝对不会同意的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shakes [00017A03] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : programmed to be nice EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ghouls wouldn't make the best of neighbors, comrade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 僵尸不能成为最好的邻居，同志。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Irving Cheng [060156DC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important snob trying to be nice EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. I mean, they're all deformed and scary looking. I bet they're really mean, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。我意思是他们都畸形而且丑陋。我敢打赌他们一定很卑鄙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important snob trying to be nice EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've come too far to share my digs with some droopy Ghoul!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和它们差的太多了，不可能和这些猥琐的僵尸分享住所！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156DE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : self important prostitute EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I wouldn't mind. But they'd better be civilized. The tenants here are real uppity and most wouldn't take kindly to Ghouls living here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我不介意。但是他们最好文明点。这的住户都很傲慢，而且大多数人对僵尸住在这并不欢迎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : jovial EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've already told you no!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我告诉过你，不行！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156D7] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : annoyed EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe I've told you NO!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是告诉了你不行吗！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Millicent Wellington [060156D8] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : annoyed EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not happening.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不可能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : annoyed EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will not allow Ghouls to live here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不允许僵尸住这。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lydia Montenegro [060156DA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : annoyed EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm really tired of you and your Ghoul crusade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真的厌烦了你和你的僵尸运动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156DE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : annoyed EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wouldn't mind. It would certainly liven things up around here, that's for sure!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不介意。这里生活用品很齐备，没问题！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : jovial EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm willing to give it a try... On a trial basis.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我愿意试试……当然是在试试的基础上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : hesistant but sincere EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh what the hell? It's not like anything interesting happens around here anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，搞什么啊？这可不是件有趣的事情啊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Michael Hawthorne [060156D6] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : agreeing hesistantly but sincere EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: It would give me a chance to do my own study of Ghoul physiology.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那会给我个机会让我进行僵尸生理学研究。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : hesistant but sincere EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not really fair to deprive anyone of a community, is it? So we really ought to welcome them as comrades, shouldn't we?
ESP.TRADUIT: 剥夺任何人进入公社的权力都不公平，不是吗？所以我要欢迎他们来做我们的同志，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Irving Cheng [060156DC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : hesistant but sincere EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: If they behave, I suppose it'd be okay with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他们表现良好，我想我同意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : hesistant but sincere EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay pops, just hand over the reward and you can get back to your history books.
ESP.TRADUIT: 老头，把报酬给我，你就能继续研究你的历史文献了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well! The founding fathers would be disappointed in your fiery tone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧！国父一定会对你急躁的腔调失望的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: However, a deal is a deal. Here is your reward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过我说到做到，这是你的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have the Declaration of Independence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有《独立宣言》。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh my lord, I never expect... I mean, I am utterly shocked!
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，天啊，我从没想到……我意思是，我太震惊了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have earned your place in the annals of American History, yes indeed. You will be remembered for this great day!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在美国历史中已经赢得一席之地了。你会和这个伟大的日子一起被铭记！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I understand the road was difficult, so allow me to present you with an extra bonus to perhaps whet your appetite for future endeavors.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道世道艰难，所以请收下这额外的报酬，或许能激励你未来能更加努力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enjoy your reward, my friend. You've earned it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 享受你的报酬吧，朋友。你应得的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh my lord, I never expect... I mean, I am utterly shocked!
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，天啊，我从没想到……我意思是，我太震惊了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have earned your place in the annals of American History, yes indeed. You will be remembered for this great day!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在美国历史中已经赢得一席之地了。你会和这个伟大的日子一起被铭记！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I understand the road was difficult, so allow me to present you with an extra bonus to perhaps whet your appetite for future endeavors.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道世道艰难，所以请收下这额外的报酬，或许能激励你未来能更加努力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enjoy your reward, my friend. You've earned it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 享受你的报酬吧，朋友。你应得的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Funny. I'll take my caps back now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有趣。现在我要拿回我的瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, alright, I'm just fucking with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好啦，好啦，我是在逗你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hrm... lemme think. No. Consider it a fee for the lesson you've learned -- don't be such a tightass next time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯……让我想想。不。就把它作为你这次教训的学费 — 下次不要这么吝啬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks for the info, Jericho.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你的信息，耶利哥。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anytime. It'll be worth it to see the look on that asshole's face.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不用谢。看看那混蛋的脸色也值得。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds risky. What if he catches me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来有点冒险。他抓到我怎么办？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He'll probably blow your head off. That is, unless you can draw faster than a pissed off Irishman.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他可能会打掉你的脑袋。当然，除非你跑得比个发飙的爱尔兰人还快。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why haven't you robbed him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么不抢他？

ESP.ORIGINAL: My robbin' days are over, kid. I'm just here to drink and stink.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我抢掠的日子结束了，孩子。我只能在这喝酒，发臭。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So where's the key?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那钥匙在哪？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's dangling around Colin's neck. Get it... if you can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然是挂在科林的脖子上。去拿吧……你有这能耐的话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you know my father?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么认识我爸爸的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have been a part of the Brotherhood for many years. Enough that I was here when Project Purity first began.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我作为兄弟会的成员很多年了。当净水工程刚开始的时候，我就在那。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Rothchild [060156EA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8C]MQ06) Picking Up the Trail EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I did not work directly with your father; he and his team valued their independence, and I respected that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我并没有和你的爸爸一起工作；他和他的团队希望独立工作，我尊重他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Rothchild [060156EA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8C]MQ06) Picking Up the Trail EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, whatever. Let's get to it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，随便。我们去吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I find your attitude and lack of respect insulting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我发现你的态度无礼，缺乏应有的尊敬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Rothchild [060156EA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8C]MQ06) Picking Up the Trail EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um... okay... You do know there was a war 200 years ago, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯……好的……你知道200年前的战争吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I must speak to my husband about that. We could bring it up at the next homeowner's association meeting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，这我得跟我丈夫说一下。我们可以拿到下次业主委员会上讨论。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brailee Ewers [0601D711] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, I do love meetings so much. I think I'll bring muffins!
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，我很喜欢这些会议。我想我会带松饼去！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brailee Ewers [0601D711] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa, whoa, whoa... Take it easy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，哇，哇……放松。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could tell them for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会替你转告他们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. Thanks, but no. I got myself into this problem, I need to get myself out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。谢谢，但是不用了。我自己陷入了这困境，我需要自己摆脱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll figure something out. Look, I want to thank you for your help. I guess it took a complete stranger to show me what an ass I've been.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会解决。听着，我想谢谢你的帮助。想不到居然是一个陌生人让我看到自己曾是一个怎样的混蛋。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take this key, it's to my private stash in the water treatment plant. Just get rid of the stuff, burn it, sell it -- I don't care what happens to it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着钥匙，它可以开启我在水处理厂里的隐秘藏匿处。把里面的东西处理掉、随便你是烧了也好卖了也好 — 我不关心你用什么办法。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That would be a good idea.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那应该是个好主意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just don't know what to say. I've been stealing from both of them for years to get my fix. Where do I even start?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是不知道说什么。我以前从他们那偷东西来换取我的毒品。我要怎么重新开始？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'll figure something out. Look, I want to thank you for your help. I guess it took a complete stranger to show me what an ass I've been.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会解决。听着，我想谢谢你的帮助。想不到居然是一个陌生人让我看到自己曾是一个怎样的混蛋。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take this key, it's to my private stash in the water treatment plant. Just get rid of the stuff, burn it, sell it -- I don't care what happens to it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着钥匙，它可以开启我在水处理厂里的隐秘藏匿处。把里面的东西处理掉、随便你是烧了也好卖了也好 — 我不关心你用什么办法。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I never thought about it that way. Can you hook me up?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从没那样想过。你能帮我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I can. Just please... Don't tell Andy or Jenny. And don't ask me about it when I'm at the Brass Lantern.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我能。只是请……不要告诉安迪和珍妮。我在黄铜灯的时候也不要问我这事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll only sell to you when my shift is over. Meet me in the water treatment plant if you need something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只在我轮班结束后才会卖给你。如果你需要什么就到水处理厂找我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's it worth to you to keep it out of the public eye?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是什么值得让你置于公众视线之外？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can hook you up. A solid chem dealer is hard to find out here in the Wastes, trust me. I know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能帮你联系。一个靠得住的药贩子在废土上是很难找的，相信我，我很了解。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can only sell to you when my shift at the Lantern is over. Meet me up at the water treatment plant if you need something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只在我黄铜灯的轮班结束后才会卖给你。如果你需要什么就到水处理厂找我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm running short on time, here. Let's cut to the chase.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没时间，长话短说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, well... I am afraid that with the emergence of the Enclave, the Brotherhood is rather busy right now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，好吧……恐怕由于英克雷的紧急状况，兄弟会现在相当忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Rothchild [060156EA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8C]MQ06) Picking Up the Trail EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I elected to take time from my responsibilities to assist you. Perhaps I was in error. Nonetheless, we may have what you seek.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我决定在我工作之余花时间来帮助你。可能我是错的。不过，我可能有你要找的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Rothchild [060156EA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8C]MQ06) Picking Up the Trail EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In the archives upstairs is an old, Pre-War Vault-Tec terminal. I will send word that you need access to it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在楼上档案室有一个旧的战前避难所科技终端。我会通知他们，让你可以登入该终端。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Rothchild [060156EA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8C]MQ06) Picking Up the Trail EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I don't know, Daring darling. I find the Ghoul's instincts to be... frighteningly accurate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我不知道，亲爱的。我发现僵尸的直觉真是惊人的准确。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Radio Play NPC [00095D7E] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just over here! This large boulder! And now... the secret knock. And... voila!
ESP.TRADUIT: 就在这！那大石头！现在……用暗号敲击它。然后……看那！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Radio Play NPC [00095D7E] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to help, but nothing's free.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想帮忙，但不是免费的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Heh heh. Spoken just like a merc.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈。听着象个佣兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You get us off of here, and I guarantee you'll be paid well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你带我们离开，我保证报酬很丰厚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, I'd suggest we go back the way you came, but I think that may be impossible. Our only chance is this express elevator to the lobby level.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，我建议我们回到你来的地方，但是我想那不可能。我们只能乘电梯回到大厅。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, let's do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我们走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know you don't know me from the shit under your boots, but I promise you when we get out of this you'll be paid well for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从你乳臭未干的样子看来，你不认识我，但是我承诺我们出去后，你将得到不错的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd suggest we go back the way you came, but I think that may be impossible. Our only chance is this express elevator to the lobby level.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想建议从你来的地方回去，但是我想那不可能。只能乘电梯回到大厅。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know a Reilly, and I'm out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不认识莱莉，我正离开。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I got news for you. You're stuck up here like the rest of us. There's no going back the way you came.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我有消息给你。你像我们一样困在这了。这没有回头路。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: So what'll it be? You going to help us get off this roof or what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那怎么样？你帮我们离开楼顶还是不管？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know any Reilly, but I do know we need to get the hell off this roof.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不认识什么莱莉，但我知道我们需要离开这该死的楼顶。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She didn't send you? Dammit, that means she might be dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是她派你来的？该死，那意味着她可能死了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Forget it then, we can talk shop later. Can you help us get out of here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 算了吧，我们迟点再说。你能帮我们离开这吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Reilly? Who's that? Never heard of her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 莱莉？是谁？从没听说过。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's our commander. I hope she's still alive. When I saw you come up here, I assumed she'd sent you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她是我们长官。我希望她仍然活着。我看到你来，以为是她派你来的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, we can chit-chat about all that later. Right now, can you help us get off this damn roof?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我们可以迟点再说。现在，能帮我们离开这该死的楼顶吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ian's decided to stay with the Family.
ESP.TRADUIT: 伊恩决定和家族在一起。

ESP.ORIGINAL: When you first arrived I was suspicious of your intentions. I can see now it was an error in judgement.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你刚来的时候我还怀疑你的目的。看来我的判断有错误。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can assure you Ian will be well cared for and safe with the Family.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我保证家族会照顾好伊恩，并确保他的安全。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please, I want you to take this. Consider it as an apology to you for all the hardships you had to endure finding this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请你拿着这些，把它当作是我对你费劲艰辛寻到此地的歉意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goodbye, human. Our time together has been rather... educational.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见，人类。我们在一起的时间相当……有意义。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ian's decided to leave the Family.
ESP.TRADUIT: 伊恩决定离开家族。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It saddens me to lose one of my flock, but I believe everyone has to follow their own path.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们失去一员我很悲痛，但我相信每个人都有自己的路要走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All I was attempting to do was guide him. Now it seems that responsibility has fallen upon you. I hope you will be more successful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我所做的只是尝试引导他。现在这责任落到你身上了。希望你比我更成功。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please, I want you to take this. Consider it as an apology to you for all the hardships you had to endure finding this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请你拿着这些，把它当作是我对你费劲艰辛寻到此地的歉意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goodbye, human. Our time together has been rather... educational.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见，人类。我们在一起的时间相当……有意义。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please. Like I'm afraid of you people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜托。好像我怕你们这些人似的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: See? That. Right there. That's the sort of shit that'll land a little girl like you in the infirmary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看？那，就在那。那破玩意能让你这样的小女孩躺进医务室去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Dusk [060156E7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: See? That. Right there. That's the sort of shit that gets a man injured.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看？那，就在那。那破玩意能让男人受伤。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Dusk [060156E7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Brothers, today I offer a simple prayer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 兄弟，今天我将做一个简短的祷告。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hail, Creator. Blessed is your power and mighty is your gift of Steel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 万岁，造物主。福佑是你的能量，非凡是你赐予钢铁兄弟会的礼物。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bless us today, your noble warriors who dwell in this hall.
ESP.TRADUIT: 祝福我们吧，保佑大厅里你的战士。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let us ride upon wings of thunder and chariots of glory, to bring destruction to your enemies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们插上闪电的翅膀，驾驶荣誉的战车，为敌人带去毁灭。

ESP.ORIGINAL: To bring destruction upon your wicked enemies."
ESP.TRADUIT: 为邪恶的敌人带去毁灭。”

ESP.ORIGINAL: Brothers, as we take our meal this day, let us reflect upon the words of Elder Patrocolus of the Montana Bunker.
ESP.TRADUIT: 兄弟，就在我们今天就餐前，让我们回忆蒙大拿地堡的普特洛克勒斯长老的教诲。

ESP.ORIGINAL: "It is in service of Steel and guardianship of one's Brothers that each man finds his purpose. My friends, stand with your Brothers. Guard them...
ESP.TRADUIT: “为钢铁兄弟会服务，保护自己的兄弟，在这之中每个人都能找到他的目标。我的朋友们，和你的兄弟并肩作战、保卫他们……

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...guide them. And in each of them find purpose." Look around this table, my Brothers. Look into the eyes of each man and woman seated here today.
ESP.TRADUIT: ……指引他们吧。愿他们每个人都能找到目标。”看着桌前，我的兄弟。注视在座每位的眼睛。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pledge in your hearts and minds, pledge by your guns that you will stand with them in battle until the end. Trust each of them with your life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 用你的心灵承诺，用在战场上伴你战斗到底的钢枪承诺。用你的生命去信任他们每一个人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And earn the trust of each in turn. Eat well, my friends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 同时赢得每个人的信任。开始用餐吧，我的朋友们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you repair my gear?
ESP.TRADUIT: 能帮我修装备吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope you're willing to pay for the parts -- you're not getting them from our supplies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望你愿意为零件付钱 — 否则从我这你得不到任何东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Durga [0601E71A] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to buy something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想买些东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you need?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Durga [0601E71A] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Durga [0601E71A] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What else would I be doing back here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 回到这我还能做什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Durga [0601E71A] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hang on a second. I have a letter for Ian West from his sister.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等会。我有一封信给伊恩·维斯特，是他姐姐寄的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, the new kid? Yeah, Vance said we should be expecting someone soon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，新来的小孩？嗯，万斯说不久就会有人找上门来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Robert [060200CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can head on in, but I would speak to Vance first if I was you. You can find him on the mezzanine overlooking the common area.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是我的话，在四处晃荡前会先和万斯谈谈。你能在上面俯瞰这个区域的平台上找到他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Robert [060200CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not telling you jack. Now let me get by!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不告诉你。让我过去！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, sure. Look, I don't have time for your bullshit. Turn around and go back the way you came.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，没问题。我没有时间听你胡扯。哪来的就回哪去吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Robert [060200CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Otherwise, they'll be scraping you up with a shovel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 否则，他们会拿铲子把你砍了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Robert [060200CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm going to kick your ass all over this Metro station if you don't help me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是你不帮我，我就把你踢得满地铁乱滚！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Finally! Someone with some balls around this place!
ESP.TRADUIT: 终于！来了个有胆量的家伙！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Karl [060200C4] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties Comment (NAM2) : laugh at the end EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's the password to that little pipsqueak's room... why don't you go knock some sense into him? Ha ha ha!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是那小家伙房间的密码……为什么你不去和他讲讲道理？哈哈哈！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Karl [060200C4] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties Comment (NAM2) : laugh at the end EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have no idea.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不知道了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then that is a mystery you will have to solve on your own.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是一个秘密，你需要自己去找到答案。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In ceremony, each member of the Family must speak one of the Laws... it is theirs to remember and to enforce.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每当举行典礼的时候，我们当中的每个人都要说出法则中的一条。……那是他们必须记住和坚持执行的法则。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps from these Laws you can discover what we are. Return to me when you are ready.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可能从这些法则之中，你能发现我们是什么样的人。若你准备好就回来找我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Indeed! Everyone who lives here has worked hard to get here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 确实如此！这里的每个人都是通过努力工作才获得住在这的机会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : justifying her privelaged existence EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's why we can't just let those Ghouls in. They demand the right to live here, but what have they done to prove themselves worthy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这也就是为什么我们不能让那些僵尸进来。他们非要住在这的权利，但是他们怎么来证明他们有住在这的价值？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : justifying her privelaged existence EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Running a cafe can't be easy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 开咖啡店可不容易。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's terrific! A real man of action. That's just what we need!
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了！一个真正的实干家。这就是我们要的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : happy to have a hero EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could take a whole pack of Ghouls without breaking a sweat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以不费吹灰之力干掉一大批僵尸。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's terrific! That's just what we need!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那太好了！ 这正是我们所需要的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : happy to have a hero EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could take a whole pack of Ghouls without breaking a sweat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以不费吹灰之力干掉一大批僵尸。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not very lively are you? Perhaps you're just bored. You should go on an adventure. Nothing like a little bit of the unknown to motivate a person.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好像不太活跃，嗯？可能你只是烦了。你应该来一次冒险。没有什么比未知世界更能刺激一个人了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's what I did. In my... younger years. You know the G.N.R. radio play? The Adventures of Herbert ‘Daring’ Dashwood? That’s about me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就是干这行的。在我……年轻的时候。你知道G.N.R.电台吧？赫伯特·“大胆”·达什伍德的冒险？那就是在说我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) :

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hell, I even had me a Ghoul manservant. Let me ask you -- you ever met a Ghoul before?
ESP.TRADUIT: 妈的，我甚至有个僵尸仆人。我来问你 — 你以前遇到过僵尸吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Say nothing.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <一言不发。>

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm Thomas Jefferson and I've returned to liberate the Declaration.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是托马斯·杰斐逊代表，我回来找《独立宣言》。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Saints alive! It is both an honor and a privilege, sir. I was hoping this day would arrive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 圣人降临了！这既是荣誉又是责任，先生。我知道这一天会来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06003A78] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope these fortifications are up to your high standards, sir. All of my men await your command to push and retake the Capital!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望这些防御工事能达到你高标准的要求，长官。我的人都在等你命令前进发、夺回华盛顿！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06003A78] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: May I ask where you intend to bring the document?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能问下你要带文献去哪吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06003A78] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm an agent of Thomas Jefferson and I've returned to liberate the Declaration.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是托马斯·杰斐逊代表，我回来找《独立宣言》。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Saints alive! It is both an honor and a privilege, madam. I knew the day would arrive that Jefferson would send someone to help!
ESP.TRADUIT: 圣人降临了！这既是荣誉又是责任，先生。我知道这一天会来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06003A78] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope these fortifications are up to your high standards, madam. All of my men await your command to push and retake the Capital!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望这些防御工事能达到你高标准的要求，女士。我的人都在等你命令前进发、夺回华盛顿！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06003A78] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: May I ask where you intend to bring the document?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能问下你要带文献去哪吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06003A78] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need to leave. Can you open the gate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要走，你能开门吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : a gruff mercenary agreeing to do something a civilian asks. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright. One moment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，稍等一会儿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : a gruff mercenary agreeing to do something a civilian asks. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes sir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是，长官.
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : a gruff mercenary agreeing to do something a civilian asks. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes ma'am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，女士。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : a gruff mercenary agreeing to do something a civilian asks. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard that Rivet City is run by some sort of Council?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说铆钉城由什么议会来管理？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Chief Harkness meets with Doctor Li and Bannon to discuss security matters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈克尼斯长官会与李博士和班侬讨论安全事务。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a waste of a good Monday morning if you ask me. They should just let Chief Harkness call the shots.
ESP.TRADUIT: 叫我说，那只是浪费美好的礼拜一上午而已。他们应当都交给哈克尼斯长官。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Chief Danvers meets with Doctor Li and Bannon to discuss how to run this tub.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈克尼斯长官会与李博士和班侬讨论如何管理这大铁罐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0001E747] (ID) NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) NPC : Commander Danvers [060156AD] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a waste of a good Monday morning if you ask me. They should just let Chief Harkness call the shots.
ESP.TRADUIT: 叫我说，那只是浪费美好的礼拜一上午而已。他们应当都交给哈克尼斯长官。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0001E747] (ID) NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) NPC : Commander Danvers [060156AD] (mod) EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doctor Li, Chief Harkness and I are all on the council. We meet every Monday morning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 李博士、哈克尼斯长官和我都在议会。我们周一上午会面。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can be very influential, if you know what I mean. Far more than Seagrave Holmes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我非常有影响力，你懂吧。我的影响力远远超过了西格雷夫·福尔摩斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you're on the City Council.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么你是城议会的议员。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doctor Li, Chief Harkness and I are all on the council. We meet every Monday morning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 李博士、哈克尼斯长官和我都在议会。我们周一上午会面。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can be very influential, if you know what I mean.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我非常有影响力，你懂吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you're on the City Council.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么你是城议会的议员。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doctor Li, Chief Danvers and I are all on the council. We meet every Monday morning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 李博士，哈克尼斯长官和我都在议会。我们周一上午会面。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can be very influential, if you know what I mean. Far more than Seagrave Holmes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我非常有影响力，你懂吧。我的影响力远远超过了西格雷夫·福尔摩斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you're on the City Council.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么你是城议会的议员。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doctor Li, Chief Danvers and I are all on the council. We meet every Monday morning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 李博士，哈克尼斯长官和我都在议会。我们周一上午会面。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can be very influential, if you know what I mean.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我非常有影响力，你懂吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you're on the City Council.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么你是城议会的议员。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bannon and Doctor Li and I all meet on Monday mornings to talk about city wide issues.
ESP.TRADUIT: 班侬和李博士还有我在周一上午会面谈论城里的事情。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's pretty informal. The council doesn't have much real power.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那不是太正式的。议会没有太多真正的权力。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard you're on some sort of City Council.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说你是什么城议会的议员。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard Angela Staley has a crush on Diego.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说安吉拉·斯塔利喜欢上了迭戈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Someone told Father Clifford that Diego and I were... you know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人告诉克利福德神父，迭戈和我……你知道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Father Clifford expelled Diego. So now we can get married!
ESP.TRADUIT: 克利福德神父开除了迭戈。现在我们能结婚了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: So how are things with Diego lately?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你和迭戈之间发展得怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you talking about? I'm a man of the cloth! Well, I will be as soon as Father Clifford...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在说什么？我是个牧师！呃，只要克利福德神父……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Never mind. It doesn't matter what Angela thinks. Soon I will take vows of chastity.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没关系。安吉拉怎么想不重要。不久我要履行纯洁的誓言。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hear Angela Staley has a crush on you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说安吉拉·斯塔利在暗恋你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I... I don't know what came over me. I just lost control and seduced her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我……我不知道中了什么邪。我失去了控制，然后引诱了她。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I am an honorable man. I will make her an honorable woman. We're going to get married.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我是个有体面的人。我会让她成一个体面的女人。我要娶她。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought I would be more upset about leaving the church, but she makes me so happy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想离开教堂会让我心中不安，但是她让我很幸福。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How are things between you and Angela?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你和安吉拉之间发展得怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is the Capital Preservation Society?
ESP.TRADUIT: 首都保护协会是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm collecting artifacts. Historical artifacts. Um...all sorts of things from old D.C.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我收集文物。历史文物。唔……老特区的各种东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's important work. Because...well, it just is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是重要的工作。因为……呃，它就是很重要。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yea, your suffering shall exist no longer; it shall be washed away in Atom's Glow, burned from you in the fire of his brilliance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，你的苦难将不复存在；它将在原子的光辉中熔化掉，它将在他壮丽的火焰中灼烧掉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever, old timer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么都行，老前辈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bah! Sometimes I feel like it's hopeless.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呵！我有时感觉很无望。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wish I knew more about America.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望对美国能知道得更多。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, it's so good to finally meet... I mean, to yet again meet someone who actually cares about history!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，终于能遇到……我意思是，能遇到真正关心历史的人！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, you really care about these relics?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真的关心这些文物？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why, of course I do!
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，当然！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: If these items were lost to time, how would we ever be able to explore our heritage or appreciate the sacrifices our founding fathers made?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果这些东西随时间丢失，我们怎么探寻我们的传统或者继承我们开国者为之奉献的事业？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you up to?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想干嘛？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, now that we brought back the Declaration, I think I'll take my cut of the earnings and head out to get drunk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，我们找回了《独立宣言》，我要拿上我那份，然后去喝个够。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look me up in the Underworld if you ever need me. I usually hang there since the Ghouls don't hit on me all the time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果需要我就去地下城找我。我通常都在那，因为僵尸从来不攻击我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have 300 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有300个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that's a shame for you, isn't it? You don't have the caps, and I guess I don't have the information. Disappointment all around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，太遗憾了，不是吗？你没有那么多瓶盖，我想我也没有信息给你。大家都很失望。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps Comment (NAM2) : mocking EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, 300 caps. Now spill it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，300个瓶盖。快说吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing like the sound of caps jingling in your pocket is there? Always brightens my day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么会比瓶盖落到口袋里的声音更好听？这让我过得很快乐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: And to brighten your day, here's what I know. Your dad said he was headed southeast, into the city. He was aiming for Galaxy News Radio.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了让你也过得快乐，我告诉你我所知道的。你爸爸说他要东南方，去城里。他的目标是银河新闻电台。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No idea what he wants with them, but you can ask him all about it when you find him. Good luck with that, by the way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不知道他为了什么要找他们，不过等你找到他，你可以自己问他。顺便祝你好运。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, let's just take a step back. 100 caps was reasonable, wasn't it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，让我们各自退一步。100个瓶盖更合理，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I suppose it was. All right; because I'm such a softy, I'll honor our original agreement.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，我想是。好把；因为我心软，我尊重我们最初的约定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your dad came through here, all right. Didn't stay long, though. Said he had some important business to attend to, and headed off to the city.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你爸爸确实来过这。但待得时间不长。他说有些重要的事情要处理，就一直向城那边走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Something to do with Galaxy News Radio. Guess that'd be the place for you to start. Good hunting, and thanks for the caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和银河新闻电台有点关系。我想你应该从那里着手。祝你好运，另外谢谢你的瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's just see what we can do... mmm-hmm. Yep, just as I thought.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看我们能做什么……嗯。是的，和我想得一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Church [06000A6E] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoops, butterfingers! Hold on just a second... okay, got it. You're not feeling lightheaded, are you? Great.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哎呀，笨蛋！坚持一会……好的，好了。你不再感到头晕了，对吧？太好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Church [06000A6E] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's strange. Wait. Your left, my right. Okay, got it. There... we... go!
ESP.TRADUIT: 奇怪。等会。你左边，我右边。好了。就那样……成了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Church [06000A6E] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You weren't kidding. You love the smack, all right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不是开玩笑吧。你喜欢这东西，好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Church [06000A6E] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm taking food out of the mouths of some poor dealer's kids right now, you know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道，我正从一些穷商人的孩子嘴里抢吃的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Church [06000A6E] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That burning sensation you feel, all over your body? That's my patented Addiction-Be-Gone treatment at work!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有感到燃烧的感觉传遍全身吗？那是我专有的成瘾去除疗法在起作用！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Church [06000A6E] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You alright up there. Need another painkiller?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还好吧。还要止痛药吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, here's your caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，这是给你的钱，。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, hold still.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，别动。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This may sting a little...
ESP.TRADUIT: 这可能有点疼……

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, I'll just get my scalpel here, and... ugh. Did I leave that sitting outside? Well, you know what? Free tetanus shot!
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，我这就去拿我的手术刀，然后……呃。我把它落在外面了吗？好吧，你猜接下来是什么？一针免费的破伤风！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Ada Straus [000CE88C] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, fix me. Here's 100 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，治好我。这是100瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. Hold still.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。别动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Mitchell [00104C0C] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, fix me. Here's 100 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，治好我。这是100瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, that's about the best I can do. Try not to get hurt that bad again, it's not like I've got an endless supply of bandages.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，我只能做到这一步了。别再把自已搞得这么惨了，我的绷带可不是无限量供应的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lieutenant Markland [0012AC9F] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, fix me. Here's 100 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，治好我。这是100瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, just hold steady. Want a shot of whiskey to calm your nerves? Mind if I have one? Heh heh, little doctor humor there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，坐稳。要不要先来点威士忌压压惊？介不介意我也来一口？呵呵，这是咱们医生这行的小笑话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Sawbones [00155A03] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, fix me. Here's 100 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，治好我。这是100瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Darn it! That money was going to help pay to get me some medical training.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死！这些钱都足够我去接受正规的医疗训练了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Ada Straus [000CE88C] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, I don't have 100 caps.

ESP.TRADUIT: 铆钉城有教堂？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you actually do anything here in Rivet City?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在铆钉城到底做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mean, like fix stuff? Nah.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的意思是贩毒？不。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just hang out, dude. I've got enough chems to last a while. Oh, yeah!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就是闲逛，伙计。我的药品足够维持一阵了。哦，耶！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You seem pretty relaxed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看起来很轻松。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No point in getting all worked up. I get three squares, I got a place to crash, and nothing's trying to eat me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没烦恼了啦。我三餐不愁，有窝避雨，而且又没人要吃掉我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, you report to Chief Harkness?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是哈克尼斯长官的属下？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm his second in command. I run the night shift and he runs the day shift.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是他的副手。我管夜班，他管白班。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is this conversation going somewhere? Because I've got things to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要说些什么？我还有事要做。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, sir. I'm just here to drink and talk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，先生。我就在这喝酒聊天。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's keep it that way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就这样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Belle can mix almost anything, as long as it's beer or whiskey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要它是啤酒或者威士忌，贝勒能把任何东西混在一起。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here. Have some Psycho.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你。我有一些疯狂药。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks, man. I really need this fix.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢，哥们。我真的需要这货。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why wouldn't I remember you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么我不记得你？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nobody does. I'm not very memorable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没人记得。我不太能给人留下印象。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry, it won't be a problem for much longer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别担心，以后这就不是一个问题了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a priest?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个牧师？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's 25 caps. Maybe you can buy yourself a gun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你25个瓶盖。或许你可以给自己买把枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you! I'll go to Flak and Shrapnel's just before closing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢！我要在“高炮”弗莱克和“榴弹”小帅关门前，去他们店里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have anything to give you, but I think I can trust you with a secret.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没什么给你的，但是我想我能信任你保守我的秘密。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you ever go up north, there is a secret slave hide out called Temple of the Union. You might find them useful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你往北走，那有一个秘密的奴隶隐藏地，叫团结圣殿。你会发现他们很能干。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you! I'll go to Flak and Shrapnel's just before closing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢！我要在“高炮”弗莱克和“榴弹”小帅关门前，去他们店里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me think about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我想想。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I... I am at your mercy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请……请高抬贵手。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. Here's 5 caps. Go ahead and pick your poison.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。这是5个瓶盖。去买你的酒吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa! Why is the room spinning?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇！房子怎么晃起来了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trinnie [060156C3] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : very drunk. The second sentence is said in a sing-song voice. EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're nice. I can tell you a secret. I'm drunk. No no, that's not the secret. I have another secret.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真好。我要告诉你一个秘密。我醉了。不，这不是那秘密。我还有个秘密。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trinnie [060156C3] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : very drunk. The second sentence is said in a sing-song voice. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now that's what I like in a man. Enough caps to buy a lady a drink.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是我最喜欢的人。用足够的瓶盖请女士喝酒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess you're okay. Thanks for the drink.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你算个好人。谢谢你请的酒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I haven't seen him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我没见过他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Figures.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm going to the Muddy Rudder for a drink later. If I see you down there, you can buy me a drink.
ESP.TRADUIT: 过一会我要去 “泥舵”酒吧。如果碰到你，你可要请客哦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Red's fine. Let's go!
ESP.TRADUIT: 瑞德没事。我们走！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, if you say so boss. But if we get to Big Town and she isn't there, I'll kill you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，既然你这么说了，老大。但是如果我们去大镇而她却不在那，我会杀了你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : distrustful and deadly serious EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on, let's get out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来吧，让我们离开这。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright! Move it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的！行动！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : barking orders EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: That sucks! Really? She's dead? Damnit. Let's get out of here, and maybe we can kill a few Super Mutants on the way out! Come on!
ESP.TRADUIT: 真糟糕！真的吗？她死了？该死。让我们离开这，或许我们可以在出去的路上干掉一些超级变种人！来吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Red's dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瑞德死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for a woman named Red. Sticky promised me some caps...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找一个叫瑞德的女人。斯蒂奇答应会我给些瓶盖……

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Super Mutants took Red along with the others. She was the only person that really ever listened to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 超级变种人把瑞德带走了。她可是唯一一个听我说话的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bittercup [0602796A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : hiding concern for her friend with macabre goth chick musings. EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't tell Sticky, though. He's liable to kill himself if he knew Red was gone. And that would conflict with my own suicide plans.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别告诉斯蒂奇，因为如果他知道瑞德不在了，他有可能会自杀。这就与我自己的自杀计划冲突了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bittercup [0602796A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : hiding concern for her friend with macabre goth chick musings. EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on, don't charge me. It was an... accident. Won't happen again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜托，别逼我。这是一个……意外。不会再发生了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, fine. But just this once.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，没关系。但是下不为例。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's another collar. Be more careful this time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是另一个项圈。这次多加小心。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, I'll buy another one. Here's 100 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我还要买一个。这是100个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Try to be more careful next time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 下次多加注意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : talking down as if to a moron EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me how this all happened.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉我这都是怎么发生的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good choice. Pride has taken down more Brothers than I can count. You'd best remember that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 明智的选择。“里昂斯的骄傲”损失的兄弟多到我都记不清了。你最好别忘了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you part of the Railroad? What do you know about this android?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是“铁路”的成员吗？你知道这机器人的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's one of God's creatures, just like you and I.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是神造的生灵，就像你我一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: He wanted new memories and a new face. Sadly, I couldn't help him. He left to look for a tech, someone with Pre-War skills.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他想要全新的记忆和一张新的面孔。不幸的是我帮不了他。他离开了，去寻找一个拥有战前技能的技术员。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know you're part of the Railroad. What do you know about the android?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你是“轨道”的成员。对于那个人造人，你知道些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know anything about the mind wipe on that escaped android?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道关于清除那逃跑的人造人记忆的事情吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That Commonwealth robot was real! I have proof. Listen to this!
ESP.TRADUIT: 联邦人造人是真的！我有证据。仔细听着！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knick Knack [06015692] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : bragging that he's in the know

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some say it was all a hoax. But it's real.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人说这都是恶作剧，但它是真的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : bragging that he's in the know EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here. Check out this holotape I found. That Commonwealth robot was real!
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，听听我找到的全息磁带。那联邦人造人是真实的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : bragging that he's in the know EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some say it was all a hoax. But they're wrong. I've seen diagrams of that Neuralizer, it's real. And so is that android!
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人说这都是恶作剧。可是他们错了，我见过那神经器的设计图，这是真的。那人造人也是真的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : bragging that he's in the know

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found some info on a Circuit Neuralizer. Care to elaborate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在一个环状神经器上找到了一些信息。能详细说说吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Most believe it's a hoax.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大多数人认为这是一个恶作剧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bowditch [060156EC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's some evidence for you to consider for yourself. Take this holotape.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这有些证据你自己看看，给你这全息磁带。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bowditch [060156EC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I used to think it was all so much bullshit. But then I got this holotape.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我过去认为这都是些胡说八道的东西。但不久之后我得到了这全息磁带。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Winthrop [060156EE] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : bragging that he's in the know EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, listen to it yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，你自己听听吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Winthrop [060156EE] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : bragging that he's in the know EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you know about the android from the Commonwealth?
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于联邦的人造人，你知道些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah maaaan. I wish it wasn't just a giant practical joke.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊妈呀 ，我真希望这不是个恶作剧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knick Knack [06015692] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : doubting the rumors EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's a spare copy of that old holotape. Think how cool it would be if it were true!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这有一张那老全息磁带的复制品。想想如果它是真的该有多酷！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knick Knack [06015692] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : doubting the rumors EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you heard the so called "android recording?" It sounds like an ordinary man!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听说过“人造人磁带”吗？听起来好像一个正常人一样！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : doubting the rumors EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's a spare copy of that old holotape. It's a hoax for sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这有一张那老全息磁带的复制品，这无疑是个恶作剧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : doubting the rumors EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a hoax. Here listen to this "android recording." We analyzed it. That's clearly a human man speaking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是个恶作剧。听听这“人造人磁带”，我们对它进行过分析，那确实是个人类在说话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bowditch [060156EC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : doubting the rumors EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A bunch of bullshit, that's all that was.
ESP.TRADUIT: 完全是胡扯，完全是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Winthrop [060156EE] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : doubting the rumors EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take this old holotape. It's just some guy pulling a clever prank. Had lots of folk convinced though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你，拿着这老全息磁带。这就是一些家伙玩的恶作剧，很多人信以为真。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Winthrop [060156EE] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : doubting the rumors EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know who might have a Lipoplasticator or Micro Dermal Graftilizer?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道谁可能有去脂整形机或是微型植皮器？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard old Pinkerton at Rivet City had a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer. I'd be lying if I said I wasn't jealous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说铆钉城的老平克顿有去脂整形机和微型植皮器。如果说我不羡慕他，那一定是在撒谎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard old Pinkerton at Rivet City had a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer. I'd be lying if I said I wasn't jealous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说铆钉城的老平克顿有去脂整形机和微型植皮器。如果说我不羡慕他，那一定是在撒谎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Old Pinkerton over at Rivet City's rumored to have done it. Damn fool. High risk of infection and death. Though, I admit, I'm slightly jealous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有传闻说钉城的老平克顿有。很容易感染致死。不管怎么说，我承认有点羡慕他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found this holotape. What do you know about facial reconstruction?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到了这个磁带。关于面部整形你知道些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Probably down at Rivet City. Anything that has any use out here, they snatch up for themselves. That damn Pinkerton don't share nothin'.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许在铆钉城有。他们把这有用的东西都夺走了。那该死的平克顿什么都不愿意跟大家分享。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Church [06000A6E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dammit! Why are you wasting my time? I already told you, ask Pinkerton down at Rivet City.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死！为什么你要浪费我的时间？我已经告诉你了，去铆钉城问平克顿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Church [06000A6E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you are lookin' to change your face, I'd try Pinkerton at Rivet City. That boy's got no sense of ethics. And you're a fool if you try it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想改变你的容貌，我建议你去铆钉城去找平克顿，那家伙毫无道德。如果你够傻，就去试试。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Church [06000A6E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found this holotape. What do you know about facial reconstruction?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到了这个磁带。关于面部整形你知道些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They say old Pinkerton at Rivet City somehow got his hands on a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer. Amazing really.
ESP.TRADUIT: 据说铆钉城的平克顿用某种方法搞到了去脂整形机和微型植皮器，真的太神奇了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They say old Pinkerton at Rivet City somehow got his hands on a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer. Amazing really.
ESP.TRADUIT: 据说铆钉城的平克顿用某种方法搞到了去脂整形机和微型植皮器，真的太神奇了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pinkerton's the only surgeon crazy enough to try it. Too risky. Go to Rivet City if you want. But don't expect to come out looking better than me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 平克顿是唯一疯狂到去试验的外科医生。风险太大了。如果你想做的话就去铆钉城，但不要指望到时会比我帅。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found this holotape. What do you know about facial reconstruction?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到了这个磁带。关于面部整形你知道些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Try Pinkerton at Rivet City. Heard he has the goods. Hope he doesn't try to actually use them on anyone. Bet he would though. He's nuts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 到铆钉城找平克顿试试，听说他会用。希望他没有在某人身上实际用过。但是我打赌他会的，他是疯子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cutter [060156A3] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Try Pinkerton at Rivet City. Heard he has the goods. Hope he doesn't try to actually use them on anyone. Bet he would though. He's nuts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 到铆钉城找平克顿试试，听说他会用。希望他没有在某人身上实际用过。但是我打赌他会的，他是疯子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cutter [060156A3] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I tell these assholes to just stop looking in the mirror. But if you want to mess up your face, try Pinkerton at Rivet City. He's crazy enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我告诉这些混蛋别再照镜子了。但是如果你想改变容貌，去铆钉城找平克顿试试。他是个十足的疯子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cutter [060156A3] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found this holotape. What do you know about facial reconstruction?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到了这个磁带。关于面部整形你知道些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Guess old Pinkerton at Rivet City has some shiny Pre-War tech. He might have what you're looking for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜铆钉城的老平克顿一定有些很强的战前技术。他或许会有你想要的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucy [06015696] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Guess old Pinkerton at Rivet City has some shiny Pre-War tech. He might have what you're looking for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜铆钉城的老平克顿一定有些很强的战前技术。他或许会有你想要的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucy [06015696] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Guess old Pinkerton at Rivet City has some shiny Pre-War tech and knows how to use it. He could probably rearrange your face for you if you wanted.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜铆钉城的老平克顿一定有些很强的战前技术。并且知道怎样使用它。如果你需要的话，他可以给你的脸部整形。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucy [06015696] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found this holotape. What do you know about facial reconstruction?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到了这个磁带。关于面部整形你知道些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard a rumor that old Pinkerton at Rivet City somehow conjured up a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有传闻说铆钉城的老平克顿有神奇的去脂整形机和微型植皮器。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Preston [060156D0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard a rumor that old Pinkerton at Rivet City somehow conjured up a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有传闻说铆钉城的老平克顿有神奇的去脂整形机和微型植皮器。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Preston [060156D0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pinkerton's the only surgeon crazy enough to try a facial reconstruction. I'd advise my patients against it. Due to high risk of deadly infection.
ESP.TRADUIT: 平克顿是为一个疯狂到敢于做面部整形的外科医生。我建议我的病人不要做，因为感染致死的风险很高。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Preston [060156D0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found this holotape. What do you know about facial reconstruction?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到了这个磁带。关于面部整形你知道些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rumor had it Pinkerton at Rivet City found a Lipoplasticator and Graftilizer. Good luck to any fool that let Pinkerton test them on him though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有传闻说平克顿在铆钉城找到了去脂整形机和植皮器。祝那些让平克顿在他们身上做实验的傻瓜们好运。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rumor had it Pinkerton at Rivet City found a Lipoplasticator and Graftilizer. Good luck to any fool that let Pinkerton test them on him though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有传闻说平克顿在铆钉城找到了去脂整形机和植皮器。祝那些让平克顿在他们身上做实验的傻瓜们好运。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know it's foolish to cut into the body unnecessarily. Leads to infection. Heard Pinkerton's willing to give it a try though. Try him at Rivet City.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认为在身体上添无谓的伤口是愚蠢的，那还会导致感染。听说平克顿想要做些实验。到铆钉城找他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found this holotape. What do you know about facial reconstruction?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到了这个磁带。关于面部整形你知道些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ever do any facial surgery? Maybe on someone from the Commonwealth?
ESP.TRADUIT: 想做面部整形的？或许是从联邦跑来的某人吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Facial surgery's too dangerous. Plus you need some specialized Pre-War equipment. Hmm. That reminds me of an old hoax.
ESP.TRADUIT: 面部整形太危险了，而且你需要一些特殊的战前仪器。嗯，这让我想起了一个老恶作剧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's a copy of that holotape.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是那全息磁带的拷贝。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Need specialized equipment and expertise. It's also prone to infection. Too dangerous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 需要专门的仪器和技术。还很容易被感染。太危险了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Damn stupid idea. That reminds me of this old hoax.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真是个愚蠢的主意，那让我想起了一个老恶作剧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Church [06000A6E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take a listen to this crusty holotape and see for yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，你自己去听听这全息磁带吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Church [06000A6E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Medicine is an important art and science. Shouldn't be wasted on vanity. Hey, but that reminds me of this old hoax.
ESP.TRADUIT: 医学是一门重要的艺术和科学，不应被虚荣所糟蹋。嗨，但它让我想起了个老恶作剧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, listen to this holotape.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，听听这全息磁带。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm... that reminds me of this old hoax.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯……它让我想起了个老恶作剧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cutter [060156A3] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, listen to this. It's clearly a joke. No one's got the tech to do that without risking infection.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，听听这全息磁带。这显然是个玩笑。没人可以冒被感染的风险。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cutter [060156A3] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh if I got my hands on the right gear I might try it. It's dangerous though. Prone to infection. Reminds me of an old hoax.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我手头有合适的仪器我会试试。但那太危险了，很容易被感染。它让我想起了个老恶作剧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucy [06015696] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Listen to this holotape.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听听这全息磁带。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucy [06015696] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Facial surgery's way too dangerous to try. Need special equipment and expertise. Hmm. Reminds me of this old hoax.
ESP.TRADUIT: 脸部整形的方法太危险了，需要特殊的装置和技术。嗯。让我想起来一个老恶作剧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Preston [060156D0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, listen to this holotape.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，听听这全息磁带。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Preston [060156D0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nah. You need specialized gear that doesn't exist anymore. And why risk infection? That reminds me of this old hoax.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，你要的特殊装备已经不存在了。想过被感染的危险吗？让我想起来一个老恶作剧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, listen to this holotape.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，听听这全息磁带。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you know about this android from the Commonwealth?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道来自联邦的人造人的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you heard the so called "android recording?" Didn't know what to make it of myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听说过人造人磁带的事情吗？我自己不知道怎么做这东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's a spare copy of that old holotape. Take a listen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这有那套全息磁带的拷贝。拿去听听。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thought that hoax was long in the grave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想来那传闻已经很长时间没人提了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Church [06000A6E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here take this holotape and hear it for yourself. That was just some bored prankster. Forget about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着这全息磁带自己听听，就是些无聊的家伙搞的恶作剧。忘了它吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Church [06000A6E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've learned a thing or two about not taking things on appearances. That was an elaborate hoax.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我曾经学过不能以貌取人,以表观物。那是个精心策划的恶作剧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take this holotape and give a listen. Clearly fake.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去听听这全息磁带，很显然是假的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That old "android recording?" Some of the boys took that seriously. Clearly it was a hoax.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那老的人造人磁带？有些人很认真地对待这事，很显然这是个恶作剧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cutter [060156A3] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's a copy of the holotape. Listen for yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一份全息磁带的拷贝，自己好好听听吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cutter [060156A3] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh you mean that old "android recording?" Have you heard it? It's great.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你想说那“人造人磁带”的事情啊？你以前听说过吗？很棒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucy [06015696] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : excited EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's a spare copy of that old holotape. It's either real or a great joke.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是那老的全息磁带的拷贝，这如果不是真的，就是个大玩笑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucy [06015696] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : excited EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: That old story? Well, now... I haven't heard talk of that in quite some time. It was all just a rumor. A hoax. Someone's idea of a practical joke.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那老故事？嗯，现在……最近一段时间还真没人谈论这事情了。这完全是传闻而已，一个恶作剧。某些人精心策划的恶作剧而已。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Preston [060156D0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : Have you heard the so called "android recording?" It sounds like an ordinary man! Here's a spare copy of that old holotape. It's a hoax for sure. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Story was there was an android, escaped from the Commonwealth up north. From someplace called the Institute.
ESP.TRADUIT: 故事讲的是一个从北面联邦一个叫研究院的地方逃跑的人造人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Preston [060156D0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : Have you heard the so called "android recording?" It sounds like an ordinary man! Here's a spare copy of that old holotape. It's a hoax for sure. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There was a holotape that got circulated. I think I've got a copy of it...
ESP.TRADUIT: 有个四处传播的全息磁带。我想我有过一份……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Preston [060156D0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : Have you heard the so called "android recording?" It sounds like an ordinary man! Here's a spare copy of that old holotape. It's a hoax for sure. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, here it is. Give it a listen. That's a man's voice! Hoax for sure!
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，去听听。那是个人类的声音！毫无疑问是个恶作剧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Preston [060156D0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : Have you heard the so called "android recording?" It sounds like an ordinary man! Here's a spare copy of that old holotape. It's a hoax for sure. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had forgotten about that old hoax. Have you heard it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经忘了这老恶作剧了。你听说过吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's a copy of that old "android holotape." It's just some practical jokester.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这有一份那旧“仿真人磁带”的拷贝，只是些精心策划的玩笑罢了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This could be an opportunity of a lifetime for you! I've misplaced some very sensitive property. And you will help me find it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这对你来说是个千载难逢的好机会！我丢失了一些非常重要的财产。你可以帮我找到它！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : unintentionally but definitely condescending EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm listening.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在听。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How amusing. You've mistaken my metaphor for a derogatory remark. I need a local, you see. Someone with verve.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真好玩，你一定把我的隐喻当做了对你的不敬。我需要个原住民，你知道，一个有热情的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've misplaced some very sensitive "property."
ESP.TRADUIT: 我丢失了一些非常重要的财产。
