ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have a problem with the way I look?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看我不顺眼？

ESP.ORIGINAL: To the point. I like that. Well, as it turns out, I've misplaced some very sensitive "property."
ESP.TRADUIT: 我喜欢简明扼要，嗯，是这样，我丢失了一些非常重要的财产。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : unintentionally but definitely condescending EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: That depends. What exactly are we talking about, here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 天哪！我们究竟在这谈论什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The honor is all mine, Squire.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是我感到光荣，侍从。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh! Well... Thank you! Your words are... very kind. Kinder than those I usually hear... Is there... something I can help you with?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦！这个……谢谢你！你的话……很好。比我通常听到的话要好得多……是否……有我可以帮你的地方 ?

ESP.ORIGINAL: You seem nervous, kid. Do I make you nervous?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看起来很紧张，孩子。是我让你紧张了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well... yes. If I may speak my will. You do, sort of. We don't have many guests in the Citadel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯……是的，先生。请恕我直言：在某种程度上，是你。我们在五角大本营没有太多的客人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And when we do, they're usually visiting Brothers. Outsiders are not to be trusted, so says the codex.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有客人的时候，也通常是来访的兄弟会的人。外人是不可信的，法典上是这么说的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Shield yourself from those not bound to you by steel, for they are the blind. Aid them when you can, but lose not sight of yourself".
ESP.TRADUIT: “屏蔽那些没有和你一样用钢铁保护自己的人，因为他们是盲目的。尽量协助他们，但不要迷失自己。”

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's your tactical assessment of this new... situation?
ESP.TRADUIT: 对于这新形势……你有什么战术上的看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: So what do you think? Can we take these Enclave guys?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么你是怎么想的？我们能对付这些英克雷的家伙吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does this sound noble enough? "Quail before me, foul Super Mutant! Thine end is at hand! Yield, that I may ease thine suffering!"
ESP.TRADUIT: 这么说够庄严吗？“在我面前发抖吧，愚蠢的超级变种人！尔等死到临头了！屈服吧，我会让尔等死得痛快些！”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : Everything in quotes should sound really over-acted, and fake noble. The guy is trying to sound like an Olde English knight. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: To find my Dad, I'm ready for anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了找我父亲，我什么都可以做。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good, 'cause this isn't going to be easy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，因为这事将会很难。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Galaxy News Radio is my baby. I love it, I feed it, I keep it changed. But there's one problem, no one outside of D.C. can hear her cry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 银河新闻电台是我的宝贝。我热爱它，哺育它，并不断更新。可是有个问题是，在首都特区上没人能够听见她的呼唤。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You see, some brainless Super Mutant thought it would be funny to shoot at the shiny round thing on the Washington Monument.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你瞧，一些蠢货超级变种人觉得向华盛顿纪念碑上面的闪光处射击是件好玩的事情。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm ready for anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我什么都可以做。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good, 'cause this isn't going to be easy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，因为这不会很容易。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Galaxy News Radio is my baby. I love it, I feed it, I keep it changed. But there's one problem, no one outside of D.C. can hear her cry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 银河新闻电台是我的宝贝。我热爱它，哺育它，并不断革新。可是有个问题是，在首都特区上没人能够听见她的呼唤。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You see, some brainless Super Mutant thought it would be funny to shoot at the shiny round thing on the Washington Monument.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你瞧，一些蠢货超级变种人觉得向华盛顿纪念碑上面的闪光处射击是件好玩的事情。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just wipe that stupid look off your face and answer my questions!
ESP.TRADUIT: 别胡扯，老实回答我的问题！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa, whoa. Smoke a peace pipe. Take a deep breath and count to ten. Whatever it is you need to do to calm down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 喔，喔。抽口烟吧。深呼吸数十下，不管怎样你得先冷静下来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You need Three Dog's help, and Three Dog needs your help. Let's get together and make it work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要三狗帮助，而三狗也需要你帮忙。和平共处互惠互利。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't seem like you have much to offer if you spend all your time up here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说了半天好像也拿不出什么真正有价值的消息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, I may be the biggest mouth in the Capital Wasteland, but I've also got the biggest ears.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，我或许是首都废土最大嘴的人，但我也是最消息最灵通的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All sorts of people pass through our little oasis in the rubble and tell all sorts of interesting things.
ESP.TRADUIT: 各类人等经过我们的小小绿洲，告诉我们各种有趣的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You want to know something? Ask and we'll work it out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说你想知道的，交给我们搞定。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then Rivet City is where I'm headed. Goodbye, Three Dog.
ESP.TRADUIT: 铆钉城就是我迟点要去的地方。再见，三狗。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goodbye. Remember to keep us tuned in while you're out there, and watch yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见。到那里后记得调好频率和我们保持联系，还有照顾好自己。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rivet City? Where's that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 铆钉城？在什么地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've never heard of Rivet City? Wow. Just... wow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你没听说过铆钉城？哇。真是……哇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, a whole bunch of people got together and turned a beached aircraft carrier into a town. Pretty cool, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，一群人合力把一艘搁浅的航母改造成了一座城镇。真酷，呃？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just follow the river south from here... there's no way you can miss it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要沿着这河往南走……你不会错过的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, what's your story?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的故事是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Three Dog's seen it all. The Capital Wasteland at its ugliest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 三狗什么都见过。首都废土最丑陋的每一面。

ESP.ORIGINAL: People killed for scraps of food, wounded children wandering aimlessly. Some seriously fucked up shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 人们为残羹冷炙而互相杀戮，受伤的孩子四处徘徊。完全是一幅糟糕透顶的景象。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If it wasn't for the Good Fight, I think I would have gone crazy by now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要不是为了圣战，我想现在我早就疯了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me more about this relay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和我说说这中继设备的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, if you check out your radio, you can hear pretty good in this place. Get a few blocks away, still not too bad, maybe a little static.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，如果你检查下你的无线电，在这你会发现效果非常好。在几个街区以外，也不会太糟，或许会有些小噪声。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Step outside the city limits, and it's snake city... nothing but "hissssssss."
ESP.TRADUIT: 走出有效范围外，在这迂回的城市里……除了“他他他他”这样的拖音就没什么了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: With the relay back on, you'll hear GNR clearly in the whole Capital Wasteland area like it used to be.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果中继设备运作，你会像过去那样在整个首都废土地区清晰地听到银河新闻电台。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And what makes you so certain about that? I can't imagine you're still so naive after spending time in that hell outside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你凭什么这么肯定？我无法想象你去过外面那样的地狱，居然还如此幼稚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: None of them know what the outside is like, and most of them would die out there. Then the rest of us inside would eventually die out, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们不知道外面是什么样子，多数人还会送命。然后我们这里剩下的人也会死光。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I won't risk all of our lives just for a few people's passing fancy of taking a Wasteland vacation. I hope you can understand that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会以大家的生命为代价，让少数人心血来潮的人去废土度假。我希望你能理解。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Vault doesn't have to be isolated in order to keep its residents safe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 避难所没必要为了安全理由而永久孤立。

ESP.ORIGINAL: G.E.C.K.? We never had one of those things in the first place. We weren't supposed to ever leave, remember?
ESP.TRADUIT: 伊甸园创造器？我们一直没有得到过这件东西。我们原本就不该离开的，记得吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Overseer Mack [0603D346] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : Mockingly congratulatory

ESP.ORIGINAL: But take this Modified Utility Jumpsuit. I guess the rebels thought it would be useful when they left. Obviously, that won't be happening now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是拿上这件改良的工作服。我猜那些反叛者认为在他们离开的时候会有用。显然，那不会发生了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Overseer Mack [0603D346] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : Mockingly congratulatory EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Congrats, you saved the Vault. Now, get out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 祝贺你拯救了避难所。现在，出去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Overseer Mack [0603D346] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : Mockingly congratulatory EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take your G.E.C.K., and whatever technology you can spare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会拿走你们的G.E.C.K.，还有其他能给我的科技。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm afraid that, instead of a G.E.C.K., our Vault was supplied with technology better suited to functioning indefinitely.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恐怕是这样的，我们没有得到伊甸园创造器，而持续避难所运转的科技。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : Formal and brusque to the point of being rude.

ESP.ORIGINAL: But take this Modified Utility Jumpsuit. It seems the rebels thought it would be useful when they left. Obviously, that won't be happening now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是拿上这件改良的工作服。我猜那些反叛者认为在他们离开的时候会有用。显然，那不会发生了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : Formal and brusque to the point of being rude. EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you for saving our Vault. Now, you'll have to leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你拯救了我们的避难所。现在，你得走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : Formal and brusque to the point of being rude. EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take your G.E.C.K., and whatever technology you can spare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会拿走你们的G.E.C.K.，还有其他能给我的科技。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, fine. As it turns out, Brotch modified himself a utility jumpsuit for survival in the Wastes. As if he was ever getting out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，好的。原来是这样，布洛彻为了在废土生存，为他自己准备了工作服。就像他能够离开似的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Overseer Mack [0603D346] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, it's yours. Don't say I never repaid a favor. Now, get the hell out of my Vault.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，它是你的了。别说我没有还你人情。现在,从我的避难所滚开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Overseer Mack [0603D346] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take scientific equipment. That's one thing you've got plenty of.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会拿走科技装备。你们这里有很多。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think we may have just the thing, taken from the rebels not long ago. Edwin Brotch modified a utility jumpsuit for "survival in the Wastes."
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我们刚好有那东西，不久前从反叛者那得到的。德文·布洛彻为“废土生活”而改制的一件工作服。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : Brusque and formal.

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was a foolish idea, but that seems par for the course for them. I suppose they'd be happy to think it found its intended use, eventually.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是个愚蠢的主意，但是看起来跟他们很搭调。我想，它最终物尽其用，他们也会高兴的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : Brusque and formal.

ESP.ORIGINAL: But enough of that. Thank you for saving our Vault. Now, you'll have to leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不多说了。谢谢你拯救了避难所。现在,你必须从这离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : Brusque and formal. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take scientific equipment. That's one thing you've got plenty of.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会拿走科技装备。你们这里有很多。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That would be where you're wrong. By locking down this Vault, I'm protecting its future.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这你就错了，年轻人。封闭避难所，我才能保护它的未来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: In fact, I was protecting its future when I had to make those unpleasant choices the night you and your father abandoned us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，你和你父亲将我们抛弃的那天晚上，我不得不做那些不愉快的决定时，我实际上在保护它的未来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I only wish I could have stopped your father before he left. If anyone's to blame for the unpleasantness, it's him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真希望能阻止你父亲离开。如果谁该为这不愉快的事负责，那只能是他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: With your leadership, no one in this Vault has much of a future.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在你的领导下，这个避难所的每一个人都没有未来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, of course. The basic currency of a lawless society. Maybe you'd like a few pointed sticks and fighting dogs, as well?
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，当然。这是混乱地方的基础货币呢。要不要再来些尖棍和斗犬？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront

ESP.ORIGINAL: We don't have much ammunition down here, but we should be able to spare some packaged meals.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们这没有多少弹药，但我们应该可以分你一些备用的压缩食品。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, perhaps it'll be of some comfort to you once you return to the Wastes. Now, go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，但愿回到废土它会让你舒服些。现在，走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take my payment in food and ammo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要食物和弹药作为报酬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But... why?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但……为什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [0602549E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : Betrayed EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: The way I see it, if you and the rebels are dead, all these problems are over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想了想，如果你和这群反叛者都死了，那么问题就解决了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060C09D5] (ID) NPC : [06027057] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's only one solution, here. Death, and lots of it. You get to be first!
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有一个解决方法，那就是死。死很多人，而你是第一个！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's see, dealing with radiation, testing an experimental device, and I won't lie, it may include some reading. That sort of stuff, you know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看，处理辐射，测试实验装置，我不骗人，可能包含了些数据。关于那些，你懂吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide

ESP.ORIGINAL: But for all that, I can pay you with caps, meds, chems, and maybe even a few of those unique inventions, if you do a good job. Interested?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但所有的一切，如果你干得好的话，我可以付给你钱、药品、化学品，甚至是一些独一无二的发明。感兴趣吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pay? What sort of pay? And what sort of work?
ESP.TRADUIT: 报酬？什么样的报酬？又是什么样的工作？

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Target"? Whoa, no, no, no! It's not that sort of job! No, I'm talking about researching things like surviving in the Wastes and such.
ESP.TRADUIT: “靶子”？哇，不，不，不！不是那种工作！不，我在研究怎么在废土生存这样的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: And I can offer caps and meds and a few of my inventions in return. I guess I can even get you some ammo, if that's more your style.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以用钱或者是我的一些发明作为回报。我想我甚至可以给你些弹药，如果是你需要的类型的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pay? You just said the magic word. Name the target.
ESP.TRADUIT: 报酬？你怎么不早点说，告诉我目标吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe 100 caps will jog your memory?
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许100个瓶盖可以帮你恢复记忆？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's things like bottlecaps, and property, and ownership and all that nonsense that makes a person think he's better than another. Bah!
ESP.TRADUIT: 就像瓶盖，财富，所有权以及所有让一个人感觉比别人要优越的东西。哼！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : bragging EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I'll take your caps just the same. This android came in as one person, and he left as someone else. I replaced his face AND his memories!
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是同样我也会拿你的钱。这人造人来的时候是一个样子，而离开时却变了样子。我改变了他的面容和记忆！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : bragging EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't believe anyone's done that before. Certainly not down here. That Commonwealth tech isn't all that fancy when it comes down to it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别相信过去任何人的所作所为，当然在这也不要。当它到这的时候，那联邦就不是幻象了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : bragging EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm also the only one in the Wasteland with the skill and the nerve to perform facial surgery. That android flesh ain't so different than ours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也是废土唯一有技术和耐心去进行整容手术的人。那人造人的皮肤和我们的区别不大。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : bragging EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You want proof? I documented the whole thing. So I could rub it in the face of Dr. Li when I need to rankle her feathers. I hate that snooty bitch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要证明？我记录了整个事件。如果我想激怒她，我就在李博士的面前戳她的痛处。我讨厌那自大的婊子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : bragging EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's just say it's in your best interest to tell me what I want to know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们就说说你最感兴趣的事吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, whatever. This android, calls himself Harkness now, comes in and wants a memory job. I took new memories, and replaced his old ones.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，不管怎样。这人造人现在自称哈克尼斯，想要更换记忆。我植入了新的记忆来取代旧的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : bragging EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't believe anyone's done that before. Certainly not down here. That Commonwealth tech isn't all that fancy when it comes down to it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别相信过去任何人的所作所为，当然在这也不要。当它到这的时候，那联邦就不是幻象了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : bragging EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm also the only one in the wasteland with the skill and the nerve to perform facial surgery. That android flesh ain't so different than ours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也是废土唯一有技术和耐心去进行整容手术的人。那人造人的皮肤和我们的区别不大。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : bragging EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You want proof? I documented the whole thing. So I could rub it in the face of Dr. Li when I need to rankle her feathers. I hate that snooty bitch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要证明？我记录了整个事件。如果我想激怒她，我就在李博士的面前戳她的痛处。我讨厌那自大的婊子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : bragging EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's discuss the facial reconstruction and mind wipe you did for the Android.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈谈你给人造人做的面部整形和记忆移植吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What're you talking about, boy? I don't know anything about any of that, and a what-did-you-call-it? An android? What's that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在说什么呢，孩子？我什么都不知道，你刚说什么？人造人？那是什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : feigning anger to cover his hiding a secret EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you talking about, girl? I don't know anything about any of that, and a what-did-you-call-it? An android? What's that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在说什么呢，女孩？我什么都不知道，你刚说什么？人造人？那是什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : feigning anger to cover his hiding a secret EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've found your android. It's Harkness, Rivet City's security chief!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经找到了你的人造人。它现在叫哈克尼斯，是铆钉城的警卫主管！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Harkness, you say? Yes... Yes, that makes sense. He used to work for a special branch of the Commonwealth Police, after all...
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈克尼斯，你是说？是的……是的，这说的通。他过去在联邦警察的特别处工作，就是这样……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : unintentionally but definitely condescending EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: And he's right here in Rivet City! Excellent! I must wait... find an opportune moment to confront him...
ESP.TRADUIT: 他就在铆钉城！太棒了！我必须等待……找一个可以当面对质的机会……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : unintentionally but definitely condescending EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you for your discreet assistance, and continued discretion regarding this matter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你周到的帮助，请继续关注这事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : unintentionally but definitely condescending

ESP.ORIGINAL: And now for your payment. This combat module will directly affect your central nervous system. I think you will find it quite beneficial.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么关于你的报酬，这战斗模块将直接影响你的中枢控制系统。我想你会发现这是非常有用的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : unintentionally but definitely condescending EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm still looking, don't worry. I'll find him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正在找，别担心。我会找到他的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not soon enough! I don't think I can stand another day in this barbaric backwoods...
ESP.TRADUIT: 太慢了！我想我在这野蛮的地方一天也待不下去了……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : unintentionally but definitely condescending. EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're helping me retrieve this android! Aren't you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在帮我找人造人！对吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : unintentionally but definitely condescending EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've tracked him this far. He's out there, somewhere. In the Capital Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我跟了他这么远。他就在外面，某个地方。在首都废土。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : unintentionally but definitely condescending EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: He must have done something drastic, like facial surgery and a mind wipe, or else I would have found him by now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他肯定是做了些大工程，像整容手术和记忆移植，或是其他的什么事，反正我现在是找不到他了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : unintentionally but definitely condescending EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: It will be no easy task. He may not even realize he's an android. Don't upset him by talking with him. Just come get me immediately. I'll handle it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是个容易的事。他甚至没察觉到自己是个人造人。别和他明说，以免他情绪失控。找到他后就赶快通知我，由我来处理。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : unintentionally but definitely condescending EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Interesting... But what's this got to do with me, exactly?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真有趣…… 不过做这事我会有什么报酬？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, a woman of action. I knew I picked the right person for the job! Let me be clear, you won't be looking for a lost puppy or family heirloom.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，一个行动型的女人。我知道我为这工作选对了人！让我说清楚些，你不是要寻找一个走失的小狗或是传家宝。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : unintentionally but definitely condescending EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll be searching for an android! Do you know what an android is? No, I imagine you don't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要寻找一个人造人！你知道人造人是什么吗？不，我想你不知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : unintentionally but definitely condescending EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You see, we've moved beyond those primitive buckets you call robots, and have created Artificial Intelligence. Sentient machines!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看，我们的科技已经超越了那些你称为机器人的人造人，并且创造了人工智能。有感知的机器！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : unintentionally but definitely condescending EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Artificial persons that think and feel what we program them to. Occasionally their programming miscalculates, they get confused and wander off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 人造人思维感知的东西都是我们安排给他们的。有时计算失误，他们就会失控。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : unintentionally but definitely condescending EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cut to the chase, Zimmer. What's the job?
ESP.TRADUIT: 开门见山吧，齐默。想要我干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You think I asked those Super Mutants to wait until I got all my caps together before abducting me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得我可以要求那些超级变种人让我拿到我所有钱后再抓我吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : softening from anger EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't get me wrong. I'm terribly grateful. I'll gladly give you a reward. But let's get out of here first.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要误会我，我真的很感激你。我很乐意给你报酬，但先让我们离开这儿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : softening from anger EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Thanks"? That's all I get for risking my life to save you? How about some caps?
ESP.TRADUIT: “谢谢”？我冒着生命危险救你就得到这么句话？给点瓶盖怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, I'll help you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，我会帮助你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then let's get out of here! Don't forget we've got to get Red, too. She's still upstairs in the holding pens.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们从这离开！别忘了我们得去找瑞德，她就在楼上的栅栏里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't have to tell me twice. Let's get out of here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不用告诉我两次。让我们离开这！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: What makes you think I'm here to rescue you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你凭什么认为我是来这救你的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That isn't funny! We've got to get out of here before the Super Mutants come back to have me for lunch!
ESP.TRADUIT: 一点都不好玩！在那些超级变种人回来把我当作午餐前，我们还是立刻离开这吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hold on, short stuff. Who are you and what are you doing here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 住手，小东西。你是谁？你在这干嘛？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What does it look like? The Super Mutants raided Big Town and dragged me off here. I'm sure they're about to eat me. You can't just leave me here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得呢？超级变种人突袭了大镇把我拖到了这。我肯定他们会吃了我。你不能就这么把我扔在这！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mock you? I'd rather kill you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘲弄你？我宁愿宰了你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But... but... why?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但……但……为什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Initiate Pek [06019938] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, it's jammed good. I can't help you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，卡得好。我帮不了你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow... that's... that's easy. Now at least I can shoot back at those mutant bastards. Are you ready?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇…… 这真是……简单。现在我至少可以回击那杂种了。你准备好了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Initiate Pek [06019938] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure can. Here, just pull this back to clear the chamber.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。给，只要把这个往回拉把枪膛清空。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow... that's... that's easy. Now at least I can shoot back at those mutant bastards. Are you ready?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇…… 这真是……简单。现在我至少可以回击那杂种了。你准备好了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Initiate Pek [06019938] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure can. Here, just pull this back to clear the chamber.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。给，只要把这个往回拉把枪膛清空。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, you're a representative of the mighty Brotherhood? Please.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是兄弟会派来的，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can mock me all you want, I don't care. Just get me out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以随意嘲弄我，我不介意。把我从这弄走就行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Initiate Pek [06019938] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's in it for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这对我有什么好处？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Typical. You wasteland dogs have no honor. Very well, I will pay you 100 caps for your aid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就知道。你们这些废土的狗毫无荣誉感。好吧，为了你的帮助我会给你100个瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Hoss [06015502] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is the initiate still alive?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那新兵还活着吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's had enough training that he should know that when facing overwhelming odds, a Brother's best recourse is to wait for reinforcements.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他受过足够的训练，所以他在遭遇劲敌时知道怎么做，作为一个兄弟会成员，保护自己的最好方法就是等待增援。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Hoss [06015502] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suspect that he is making a stand inside of that building, but an Initiate won't be able to stand for long against those Mutants.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我怀疑他可能躲藏在那栋建筑物中, 但在周围都是超级变种人的情况下，一个新兵不会坚持得太久。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Hoss [06015502] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ooh! That hurt! Do us all a favor and just run away from home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦！那真是悲剧！你不如离家出走吧，也算是帮大伙一个忙！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll show you. I'll show all of you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会让你看到。我会让你们所有人看到！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : James Hargrave [060156C4] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : He's angry, but he's crying. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I'm gone, my mom will really miss me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我走了，我妈妈会非常想我的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : James Hargrave [060156C4] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : He's angry, but he's crying. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your mother's a bitch and you're a spoiled little punk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你妈妈是个婊子，而你是个被惯坏的小笨蛋。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh yeah? Well... well you're an asshole.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，是吗？这个……这个……那你是个混蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : James Hargrave [060156C4] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : He's desperate for an insult and this is all he can come up with. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've met your mother. No wonder you're such a brat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我见过你母亲。怪不得你是个小捣蛋。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What did you say about my mother? You... you take that back!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么能这样说我妈妈？你……你必须收回这话！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Poor James. His mother drinks too much. When she does, she doesn't treat him very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可怜的詹姆斯。他妈妈酗酒。当她喝了酒后，是不会好好待他的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Personally, I think she blames him for his father leaving her, which is ridiculous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从个人角度来讲，我认为她是因为他父亲的离开而在责罚他，这真可笑。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the deal with that little punk, James Hargrave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个小混蛋詹姆斯·哈格雷夫有什么毛病？

ESP.ORIGINAL: James' mom, Tammy, is a real bitch. She treats him like crap.
ESP.TRADUIT: 詹姆斯的母亲，塔米，是个十足的婊子。她对他很恶劣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think it's because she drinks too much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想这可能是因为她酗酒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why is James Hargrave such a brat?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么詹姆斯·哈格雷夫那么混蛋？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That poor child. His mother, Tammy Hargrave, is a very troubled woman.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那可怜的孩子。他的母亲，塔米·哈格雷夫，是个很麻烦的女人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She spends too much time down in the Muddy Rudder, drinking and using foul language.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她大部分时间都待在“泥舵”酒吧里喝酒和骂人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I feel so sorry for him. I think CJ is a good influence on him, but I do worry about the two of them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我为他感到非常难过。我认为长江会给他树立一个好榜样的，但是我也确实担心他们两个。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you let that James Hargrave kid play with your daughter?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么你敢让你的女儿和詹姆斯·哈格雷夫一起玩？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's trouble, that's what he is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他就是个麻烦，这就是他的本质。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't trust him, and neither should you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不相信他，你也不该信他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: His mother is a drunk. Spends all her time in the Muddy Rudder.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他母亲是个酒鬼，一天到晚都待在“泥舵”酒吧里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's up with that James Hargrave kid? He acts like such a brat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个詹姆斯·哈格雷夫有什么毛病？他像个流氓一样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's your decision. I'm sure you'll do the right thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这取决于你。我相信你会做出正确的选择的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The more I think about it, the more that recording haunts me. It sounds pretty bad for people -- androids -- like me in the Commonwealth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想它想得越多，那录音就越是萦绕在我脑子里。这对一个人 — 或者我这样的联邦人造人 — 来说糟透了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : appreciative EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I clearly can't stay here where Zimmer can find me and expose my true nature. I'll figure something out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是我不能留在这，齐默会找到我并且会泄露我的身份。我会想办法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : appreciative EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks for warning me. Here's a little token of my gratitude. The best weapon I've ever had. Seems like I've had it forever, come to think of it...
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你警告我。这是表达我感激的一点小礼物，我最好的武器。似乎它一直和我在一起，现在是时候为它想想了……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : appreciative EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're more than "just a machine." You're a person, Harkness. You belong here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你并不仅仅是“一台机器”，你是一个人，哈克尼斯。你属于这。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right. I have friends here. And Rivet City needs me to protect it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是对的。这有我的朋友。铆钉城需要我来保卫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : appreciative EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Even if they found out, they know me. They won't care if I'm made of real flesh and bone, or synthetic parts. Right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 即使他们发现了，他们还是我的朋友。他们不会介意我的身体是由血肉和骨头还是合成纤维组成，是不是？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : appreciative EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll need to take care of Zimmer, though, one way or the other.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我必须处理掉齐默，不管使用什么方法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : appreciative EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks for warning me. Here's a little token of my gratitude. It's the best weapon I've ever had. And it seems like I've had it forever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你来警告我。这是表达我感激的一点小礼物，我最好的武器，似乎它一直和我在一起。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : appreciative EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: People will kill you when they find out. The Commonwealth is where you belong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当他们发现你的本质后，他们会杀掉你。联邦才是你的归宿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right. It's not safe for me here. I don't know what I'll face in the North, but from the way Zimmer talks about it, it sounds like a paradise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是对的。我在这不会安全。我不知道北方会有什么在等待着我，但是听齐默所描述的，那是一个天堂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why would he go through such lengths to retrieve me -- or rather, the other me -- if he didn't care? I'll go back with Zimmer. I'll make a new life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他不在乎的话，他又为什么要这样大费周章地找我回去 — 或者，另一个我？我会和齐默回去的。我会开始我的新生活。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you for helping me make the right decision. Here's a little token of my gratitude. It's the best weapon I've ever had. And I've had it forever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你帮助我，使我做出了正确的决定。这是表达我感激的一点小礼物，我最好的武器。它一直和我在一起。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go tell Zimmer I'm ready to go home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去告诉齐默我已经准备好回家了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry, Harkness. Your secret is safe with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别担心，哈克尼斯。你的秘密在我这是安全的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you. I'm really not sure how people would react if they found out I'm, you know... not entirely human.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你。我真的不知道如果人们知道……我不是人类，这你知道……他们会作何反应。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : genuine appreciation for the help, and pride in his gift EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's a little token of my gratitude. Best weapon I've ever had, and I've had it forever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是表达我感激的一点小礼物，我最好的武器，它一直和我在一起。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : genuine appreciation for the help, and pride in his gift EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is violence really necessary? Can't you just... kick him off the boat?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这件事一定要暴力才能解决吗？你不能只是……把他赶下船吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose if I'm careful I could trump up some charges and throw him out...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想如果我谨慎些的话，我可以捏造一些罪名并把他赶走。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : appreciative EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to thank you for warning me about Zimmer, and for keeping this a secret.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想感谢你来警告我齐默的事并且为我保密。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : appreciative EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's a little token of my gratitude.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是表达我感激的一点小礼物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : appreciative EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sometimes you have to kill the bad guys.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有时候你不得不杀掉坏人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you for warning me about Zimmer, and for keeping this a secret.
ESP.TRADUIT: 感谢你来警告我齐默的事并且为我保密。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : hinting at his forthcoming revenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's a little token of my gratitude. Best weapon a man could ask for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是表达我感激的一点心意。个人能得到的最好武器。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : hinting at his forthcoming revenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just do me a favor and don't go blasting up my boat. People discharging weapons on my boat tends to get me nervous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我个面子，不要把我的船炸飞。人们在船上开枪让我紧张。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : hinting at his forthcoming revenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unless I'm the one doing the shooting. To kill dangerous thieves from the Commonwealth, for instance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除非我本人就是开枪的人。比如为了杀掉来自联邦的危险恶棍。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : hinting at his forthcoming revenge EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, I was hoping you'd let me kill him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，我希望你可以让我去杀掉他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmmm... He is a security threat, isn't he? All right. I authorize you to carry out Doctor Zimmer's execution.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唔……对于公众的安全而言他是个威胁，难道不是吗？好吧。我授权你去处决掉齐默博士。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : appreciative EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't think this gives you license to run around shooting anyone you want. Just Zimmer, and that bodyguard, if he gets in the way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别认为这样你就可以随便向任何人开枪。仅仅是齐默，如果他的保镖敢干涉的话，也把他干掉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : appreciative EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, use my weapon. I've had it forever, and it's never let me down. Consider it a token of my appreciation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，用我的武器吧。它一直和我在一起，并且从未让我在战斗中输掉。就把它当作我表达感激的礼物吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : appreciative EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: See you tomorrow night, Diego.
ESP.TRADUIT: 明晚见，迭戈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Angela Staley [060156BD] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Seductive. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shit. I've got a Council meeting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 狗屎。我还有一个议会的会议。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Time for the Council meeting. Don't want to be late.
ESP.TRADUIT: 议会会议时间到了，我不想迟到。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm done, mom. I'm going to go play with C.J.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经干完活了。我要去找长江玩。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm done, mom. I'm going to go play.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经干完活了。我要去玩。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got to go home, or my mom will kill me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要回家了，否则我妈妈会杀了我的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Almost out of caps. I'd better go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经快没钱了。我最好离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shrapnel [060156B4] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : slurred. he's drunk. EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Time to get drunk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该去大醉一场了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's this building for?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这建筑物干什么的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got a Pip-Boy. Tune into Galaxy News Radio and listen. It's the only radio station in the Capital Wasteland that really tells it like it is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有一个哔哔小子。把它调到银河新闻电台的频率然后听听。它是首都废土上唯一报导真事的电台。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pretty dire, huh? Thanks for completely ruining my day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很可怕，呃？感谢你把我的一整天都给毁掉了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why would they be looking for me? I haven't done anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么他们要到处找我？我什么也没做。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This isn't about some stupid prank. Your dad left the Vault somehow, and now my father's gone crazy. Jonas is dead!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是胡闹。你父亲离开了避难所，我父亲疯了。乔纳斯死了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DD] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : sad and angry at the same time EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you'd better listen to me and get moving if you don't want to end up like him!
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你不想成为下一个他的话，你最好听我的话，赶快离开这！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DD] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : sad and angry at the same time

ESP.ORIGINAL: Power systems are 90% at startup, but are running at 37% efficiency after coming fully online. I'm looking into what might be causing the leak.
ESP.TRADUIT: 能源系统在刚开始运作的时候处于90%的功率，但是当系统全部上线之后只有37%的有效输出。我现在正在调查泄漏的原因。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Damn it. Well, he's not loaded but I still don't like the idea of him viewing us all as targets. See if you can lock it down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死。他虽然没有装弹，但是我不喜欢他把我们当做目标锁定。试试把它关掉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right. How can I help?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。我该怎么做？

ESP.ORIGINAL: One of the Brotherhood guys that passed through here mentioned seeing a dish in one of D.C.'s old museums.
ESP.TRADUIT: 经过那的兄弟会提起过，他在特区的老博物馆里面看到过通讯碟形天线。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the dish off the old Virgo II Lunar Lander in the Museum of Technology.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是个在科技博物馆的处女座2号登月舱上的通讯碟形天线。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want you to get it and bring it to the Washington Monument to replace the bad one. That's it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想让你找到它，并带到华盛顿纪念碑去换了那个坏掉的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not playing any more of your games.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会继续你的游戏了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes sir! I'll have the techs come down and remove it immediately, sir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，长官！我会立刻解除这些技术限制。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enclave Soldier [06026361] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What Order are you a part of?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的修会是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, I am proctor of the Order of the Quill. I oversee the Archives and Library here in the Citadel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，我是羽之修会的监理。我在五角大本营里负责管理档案室和图书馆。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We are dedicated to preserving the history of the Brotherhood as well as unearthing the secrets of the Pre-War civilizations.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们专注于保护兄弟会的历史，并且同时出土战前文明的秘密。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We have a single field associate: Scribe Yearling. She operates out of the former Library of Congress to the northeast.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们只有一个外勤准会员：伊尔琳文士。她在东北地区国会图书馆工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sword! Of course! Weapons, my boy! You name it, I've helped someone kill it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 剑！当然了！武器，我的孩子！不管什么武器，我都用过。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm the Proctor of the Order of the Sword, you see. Weapons research, development and maintenance -- all my responsibility.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是剑之修会的监理，你看。武器研究，开发和维护 — 都是我的职责。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me guess. You belong the Order of the...
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我猜猜，你是属于那个什么修会的...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sword! Of course! Weapons, my girl! You name it, I've helped someone kill it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 剑！当然了！武器，我的孩子！不管什么武器，我都用过。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm the Proctor of the Order of the Sword, you see. Weapons research, development and maintenance -- all my responsibility.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是剑之修会的监理，你看。武器研究，开发和维护 — 都是我的职责。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me guess. You belong the Order of the...
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我猜猜，你是属于那个什么修会的...

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you Scribes do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们学士都做些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Indeed I can!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我当然能！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Peabody [060156ED] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : emphasis on the "more" EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pay no heed to those headstrong Knights, with their pop guns and bravado.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别理那些刚愎自用的骑士，整天端着枪虚张声势。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Peabody [060156ED] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : emphasis on the "more" EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is the Scribes, the Scribes who make the Brotherhood what it truly is! The brawn is useless without the brain, hmm? He he he.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是文士，文士才缔造了兄弟会！四肢再发达，无脑也不行，对吧？呵呵呵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Peabody [060156ED] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : emphasis on the "more" EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Each Order of Scribes is dedicated to a unique field. All equally important. All more important than those dim-witted grunts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每个文士的修会都专注于不同的领域之中。它们同等重要。都远远比那些头脑简单的大兵强多了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Peabody [060156ED] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : emphasis on the "more" EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you tell me something about the Scribes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能告诉我关于文士的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have some questions about the Brotherhood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一些关于兄弟会的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, one of my favorite subjects, of course! What would you like to know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，这可是我最爱的话题，当然！你想要知道些什么呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Escape the Vault? How?
ESP.TRADUIT: 从避难所逃出去？怎么逃？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Listen. There's a secret tunnel that leads directly from my father's office to the exit. You'll have to hack the computer in his office to open it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着。在我父亲的办公室有一个秘密的通道可以直接逃到出口。但你必须先想办法破解我父亲的电脑，打开秘密通道的入口。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DD] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : slight smile at her admission of breaking into her dad's office

ESP.ORIGINAL: Use these to get into his office. That's how I always get in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 用这进入到我父亲的办公室。我经常这么干。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DD] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : slight smile at her admission of breaking into her dad's office EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need to escape the Vault. And you're going to help me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要逃出避难所。并且我需要你的帮助。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's exactly what I had in mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就是这么想的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DD] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : with a wry smile

ESP.ORIGINAL: Listen. There's a secret tunnel that leads directly from my father's office to the exit. You'll have to hack the computer in his office to open it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着。在我父亲的办公室有一个秘密的通道可以直接逃到出口。但你必须先想办法破解我父亲的电脑，打开秘密通道的入口。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DD] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : with a wry smile EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Use these to get into his office. That's how I always get in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 用这进入到我父亲的办公室。我经常这么干。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DD] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : with a wry smile EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you want me to find Ian, I'll need to equip myself. That costs money.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想让我找到伊恩，那我就要武装一下自己。那是要花钱的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. Fine. Here, this is all I have left to feed myself, you selfish asshole!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，好吧。给，这是我的全部，用来养活我自己的，都拿去吧，你这该死的混蛋！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06000A69] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't care anymore. I just want to know where my brother is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经不在乎了，我只想知道我弟弟在哪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06000A69] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Spill it, Amata. How do I get to the exit?
ESP.TRADUIT: 快告诉我，阿玛塔。我怎么才能到达出口？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lucky for you, I know another way through. There's a secret tunnel that runs from the Overseer's Office to the Vault door!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你很幸运，我知道另外一条路。那有一个秘密的地道连接监督者的办公室和避难所大门！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Security doesn't even know about it. Nobody except my father -- and me. "One of the Overseer's secrets," he says.
ESP.TRADUIT: 警卫根本不知道那条秘密通道，除了我和我父亲没人知道了。“这是监督者的秘密之一,”他说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait... If the door to the exit is sealed, how am I supposed to get out?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等……如果去大门的路已经封住，我怎么出去啊？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lucky for you, I know of another way in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你很幸运，我知道另外一条路。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a secret tunnel that runs from the Overseer's Office to the Vault door!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那有一个秘密的地道连接监督者的办公室和避难所大门！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Security doesn't even know about it. Nobody except my father -- and me. "One of the Overseer's secrets," he says.
ESP.TRADUIT: 警卫根本不知道那条秘密通道，除了我和我父亲没人知道了。“这是监督者的秘密之一,”他说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I may have been a little hasty earlier. I'm ready to hear your plan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我刚才可能有点着急，我想听听你的计划。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not exactly an apology, but probably the best I can expect.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这也叫道歉，但是总比没有强。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DD] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : slight smile at her admission of breaking into her dad's office

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'd better listen, because you'll never escape without my help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好听着，因为没我的帮助你永远也逃不出去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DD] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : slight smile at her admission of breaking into her dad's office EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a secret tunnel that leads directly from my father's office to the exit. You'll have to hack the computer in his office to open it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着。在我父亲的办公室有一个秘密的通道可以直接逃到出口。但你必须先想办法破解我父亲的电脑，打开秘密通道的入口。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DD] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : slight smile at her admission of breaking into her dad's office EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Use these to get into his office. That's how I always get in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 用这进入到我父亲的办公室。我经常这么干。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DD] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : slight smile at her admission of breaking into her dad's office

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not exactly an apology, but probably the best I can expect.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这也叫道歉，但是总比没有强。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'd better listen, because you'll never escape without my help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好听着，因为没我的帮助你永远也逃不出去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It won't be easy. My father sealed the door to the exit to prevent anyone else from following your dad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不容易。我父亲把大门关闭了，以阻止其他人效仿你父亲。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was wrong. I'm sorry. I do need your help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是我错了，我很抱歉，但是我需要你的帮助。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Was that an actual apology? From you? Wow. You must really be desperate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就是你的道歉？你说出来的？哇哦。你肯定是真的被逼急了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DD] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : slight smile at her admission of breaking into her dad's office

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right though. You do need my help. You'll never get out of here on your own. You're lucky I'm such a good friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是对的。你确实需要我的帮助。你自己一个人根本逃不出去。你很幸运，有我这么个好朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DD] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : slight smile at her admission of breaking into her dad's office EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a secret tunnel that leads directly from my father's office to the exit. You'll have to hack the computer in his office to open it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着。在我父亲的办公室有一个秘密的通道可以直接逃到出口。但你必须先想办法破解我父亲的电脑，打开秘密通道的入口。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DD] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : slight smile at her admission of breaking into her dad's office EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Use these to get into his office. That's how I always get in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 用这进到我父亲的办公室。就像我经常干的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DD] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : slight smile at her admission of breaking into her dad's office
