ESP.TRADUIT: 那就是你的道歉？你说出来的？哇哦。你肯定是真的被逼急了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right though. You do need my help. You'll never get out of here on your own. You're lucky I'm such a good friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是对的。你确实需要我的帮助。你自己一个人根本逃不出去。你很幸运，有我这么个好朋友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It won't be easy. My father sealed the door to the exit to prevent anyone else from following your dad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不容易。我父亲把大门关闭了，以阻止其他人效仿你父亲。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, when you put it that way... maybe I could use your help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，如果你这么说的话……或许我可以接受你的帮助。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. Now will you shut up and listen to me for a second?
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。你现在是否可以闭上嘴，安静地听我说话了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DD] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : slight smile at her admission of breaking into her dad's office

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a secret tunnel that leads directly from my father's office to the exit. You'll have to hack the computer in his office to open it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着。在我父亲的办公室有一个秘密的通道可以直接逃到出口。但你必须先想办法破解我父亲的电脑，打开秘密通道的入口。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DD] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : slight smile at her admission of breaking into her dad's office EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Use these to get into his office. That's how I always get in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 用这个密码进入到我父亲的办公室。我经常这么干。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DD] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : slight smile at her admission of breaking into her dad's office EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not another one of your "plans," Amata...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不需要你的什么所谓的“计划”，阿玛塔……

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have time to explain everything. You're just going to have to trust me this time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没时间跟你解释了，这次你必须要相信我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DD] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : slight smile at her admission of breaking into her dad's office

ESP.ORIGINAL: Listen. There's a secret tunnel that leads directly from my father's office to the exit. You'll have to hack the computer in his office to open it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着。在我父亲的办公室有一个秘密的通道可以直接逃到出口。但你必须先想办法破解我父亲的电脑，打开秘密通道的入口。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DD] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : slight smile at her admission of breaking into her dad's office EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Use these to get into his office. That's how I always get in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 用这进入到我父亲的办公室。就像我经常干的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DD] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : slight smile at her admission of breaking into her dad's office EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just have to break into the most heavily guarded place in the Vault? That it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我必须要突破避难所里防守最为严密的地方？就这样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you have a better plan, let's hear it! Look, I know for a fact that the office isn't guarded -- everyone's out looking for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你有更好的办法，我洗耳恭听！你看，我知道办公室肯定没人，因为所有守卫都出去找你了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, you'll probably need these to pick the lock on the office door. They've always worked for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，你很有可能需要他来撬开办公室的门锁。以前我都是这么干的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Access his computer to open the door to the tunnel -- you'll either have to hack it or find his password. I know he hides it in his office somewhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 用他的电脑打开通往地道的门 — 你要么破解电脑，要么找到密码。密码肯定藏在办公室的某个地方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, one more thing. I stole my father's pistol. I hope you won't need it, but you'd better take it just in case.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，还有一件事。我把父亲的手枪偷出来了。我希望你不会用它，但最好还是拿着以防万一。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So while I'm doing all this breaking and entering, you're helping me... how?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么在我撬门闯入办公室时，你……怎么帮我？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll be keeping my father from catching you hacking into his computer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会拖住我的父亲，这样你就可以有足够的时间入侵电脑了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, you'll probably need these to pick the lock on the office door. They've always worked for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，你很有可能需要他来撬开办公室的门锁。以前我都是这么干的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Access his computer to open the door to the tunnel -- you'll either have to hack it or find his password. I know he hides it in his office somewhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 用他的电脑打开通往地道的门 — 你要么破解电脑，要么找到密码。密码肯定藏在办公室的某个地方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, one more thing. I stole my father's pistol. I hope you won't need it, but you'd better take it just in case.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，还有一件事。我把父亲的手枪偷出来了。我希望你不会用它，但最好还是拿着以防万一。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure am. Stopped in to find something to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，顺便找事做。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope by "something to do" you mean a job, otherwise you want to talk with Nova.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望你所谓的“找事做”是指工作，否则你还是去找诺瓦吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06000A69] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for someone to make a delivery. Interested?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正好需要找个人帮我捎个东西，感兴趣吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06000A69] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We hope you've enjoyed our tour today. If you have any further questions, please take a brochure from our helpful Vault-Tec guides.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们希望你对今天的参观感到愉快。如果你还有什么其他问题，请向避难所科技向导索取指南手册

ESP.ORIGINAL: Should the unlikely event arise that the planet is laid to waste, you'll feel happy knowing your family will be safe in a Vault-Tec Vault.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果有什么不幸的事使这星球变成废墟，你将会感到很高兴避难所科技的避难所将会庇护你和你的家人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Concerns about security? Our Eye-On-You Cameras enable the Vault's leader to watch your every move. You'll never be alone again!
ESP.TRADUIT: 担心安全问题？避难所的领导会通过监视牌摄影机注视你的一举一动，你将永不孤单。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bored? Don't be! Step into our Entertainotron Room and watch the latest holotapes or perhaps listen to a symphony. Another Vault-Tec innovation!
ESP.TRADUIT: 无聊？不会的！去我们的娱乐室看最新的全息录影带，也可以听听交响乐。另一项避难所科技的革新！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Moms will love how our Culinator 3000 Kitchen System makes cooking a breeze. Mmmmm, I can smell the muffins baking now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 母亲们肯定会爱上这烹调3000厨房系统，它可以让做饭变得十分简单。嗯……，我都已经可以闻到烤甜饼的香味了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: The living sections make use of our revolutionary Floorsuck Autocleaner System for those darned messy kids. Never sweep again!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的生活区将使用革命性的楼层自动清洁系统，这系统是为那些可恨肮脏的孩子们而设计的。从此再不用打扫卫生了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Being underground got you down? Smile! Our SimuSun Lighting mimics the feeling of being outside with only a fraction of the sunburn potential.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在地下待着感觉很糟？呵呵！我们的微阳灯让你仅有少量晒伤的情况下拥有在户外的感觉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sleep in quiet comfort knowing that our impenetrable vault doors can withstand a direct hit by an atomic bomb with only a projected 2% failure rate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 安心的睡吧，我们的避难所大门可以承受住核弹的直接冲击，而且失败率只有2%。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Triple-S Technology is Vault-Tec's convergence of the three most important parts of apocalyptic endurance: Safety, Survivability and Sanitation!
ESP.TRADUIT: 三重科技是避难所科技三项最重要的科技的集中体现，这三项科技是：安全性，生存性和卫生性！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Vault-Tec welcomes you to our new line of subterranean vaults featuring our patented Triple-S Technology.
ESP.TRADUIT: 避难所科技欢迎你到地下来体验我们的三重科技。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, what's your real name?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的真名是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Haven't we been through this already?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们之间的问题难道还没解决吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Gallows [060156E8] (mod) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: No one knows his name?
ESP.TRADUIT: 没人知道他叫什么吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nope. No one knows his name, where he comes from -- nothin'. He's a mean little bastard for sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有。他叫什么，从哪来，没人知道。但我肯定他是个混蛋。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He'd be a Paladin by now for sure, except that he ain't got no interest in leadin'. Only killin'. I'm just glad he's on our side.
ESP.TRADUIT: 以表现而论他已经能成为圣骑士了，只不过他只喜欢杀戮，对带队不感兴趣。我很高兴他和我们是一路的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the story with Gallows?
ESP.TRADUIT: 知道盖洛斯的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh man, there's something wrong with that boy. Ain't nobody around here that even knows his real name.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，老兄，那家伙肯定有病。这的人没人知道他到底叫什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We got a betting pool in the pride, whole pot goes to the first person who can find out his real name.
ESP.TRADUIT: “里昂斯的骄傲”有一个赌约，谁先知道他的真名谁就可以拿走所有的钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who else is around town?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这镇里还有谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't talk to most of them. Billy says that I have to be careful, even when people seem nice. And I'm especially not allowed to talk to Mr. Jericho.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我跟他们绝大部分人都不怎么说话。比利告诉我说要小心点，即使那些人看上去是好人。并且别人跟我说绝对不要和耶利哥先生说话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I usually play with Harden most days, when his dad isn't taking him out to learn to shoot or something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我一般跟哈登在一起玩，通常他爸爸总是让他学习射击什么的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Billy says that he's going to teach me to shoot one day too!
ESP.TRADUIT: 比利告诉我，他也会找个时间教我怎么射击！

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's the Stahls. They run the Brass Lantern. I go there to eat with my dad sometimes. Doc Church runs the clinic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有斯塔尔一家。他们经营黄铜灯。我有时候和我爸爸在那吃饭。丘奇医生经营一家诊所。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Confessor is a little weird. But him and mother Maya are always nice to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 忏悔者那人有点怪。但是他和玛雅修女总是对我很好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's also Moriarty, but dad says that I'm not allowed to talk to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这还一个叫莫里亚蒂的人，但是爸爸不让我跟他讲话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of Megaton?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得核弹镇怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's great! My dad says that one day, I'm gonna get to be sheriff, just like him!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这儿棒极了！我爸爸说过，总有一天我也会成为这儿的警长，就像他那样！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who takes care of you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁照顾你？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A long, long time ago, he saved me from Raiders!
ESP.TRADUIT: 很久很久以前，他把我从掠夺者手中救了出来！

ESP.ORIGINAL: They... killed my real parents. But Billy showed up before they got me, and now he's like my daddy... sort of...
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们……杀了我的亲生父母。但是比利在他们杀我之前出现了。现在，他就像是我父亲一样……

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you meet Billy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么认识比利的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: My dad, of course. He teaches me to shoot, and about the law, and keeping people safe. When he's not busy protecting the town, that is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然是我父亲照顾我。他教我怎么射击，还教我法律，怎么保护他人。只要他不忙着保护镇子，总是在教我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who takes care of you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁照顾你？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well... with my dad gone, I don't really know... dad always said that I'd have to learn to watch out for myself one day...
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯……在我父亲死以后，我真不知道谁能照顾我……爸爸以前总是对我说总有一天我要学会怎么照顾自己……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: *Sigh* It's one thing after another in this place, isn't it? Anyway, I should get going.
ESP.TRADUIT: *叹气*在这地方事总是没完没了，对吧？不管怎样，我得走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know, I thought about moving once. Setting myself up in Rivet City or one of the smaller settlements. But hey, this place is home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道，我一直想要搬家的。想去铆钉城或一些小型定居点。但是，嗨，这是我的家。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hm hmm.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唔嗯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : quickly responding to someone, agreeing EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Megaton needs a stronger defense force. Okay, there's Simms and Steel, and the town militia, but half of us can't even aim straight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 核弹镇需要一个强力的防御力量。好吧，这有西姆斯和斯蒂尔，还有镇兵，可是半数人都不会瞄准。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was rooting around in Springvale the other day and guess what I found: a book! An actual book! Can you believe it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一次跑到春之谷，你猜我发现什么了：一本书！一本真正的书！你能相信吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you ever question the wisdom in hanging around an atomic bomb all day? I mean, if it was going to blow, it probably would have by now. But still.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你曾怀疑过这种整天围着一个核弹的行为吗？我的意思是，如果要炸的话早就炸了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: God, that Jericho guy gives me the creeps. He's such a nutjob.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊，那叫耶利哥的家伙让我觉得恶心。他就是一个白痴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I swear to God, if Nathan starts babbling about the Enclave to me one more time... everyone knows that the Enclave is just a story for kids.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我向天发誓，如果内森再和我胡说一些关于英克雷的事的话……每个人都知道英克雷不过是个谣传而已。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nathan and his damn Enclave, I tell you... What, does he think, that George Washington is going to ride out of the Wasteland to save everyone?
ESP.TRADUIT: 内森还有他那该死的英克雷，我跟你说……他在想些什么，乔治·华盛顿要拯救废土所有人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You ever hear of the Enclave? Nathan tells me that they'll be riding in here any day to help us...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听说过英克雷吗？内森说他们很可能会过来帮助我们……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you hear about the Enclave? Nathan said they're really the U.S. government. He says that they're coming to help us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听说过英克雷吗？内森说他们是真正的美国政府。他说他们要来这帮助我们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Walter sure is a grumpy old bastard. But he keeps that crusty old plant running, so I guess we have no choice but to put up with him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 沃尔特确实是一个脾气暴躁的老混蛋。但是他是照看着那些老水管，所以我们不得不忍。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Busted up my knee the other day, so I went to see Doc Church. He needs to work on his bedside manner -- my own mother never chewed me out like that!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那天我把膝盖摔坏了，所以我就去找丘奇医生。他需要改善一下对待患者的态度 — 就连我的母亲都没有像他那样严厉的训斥我！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I swear to God, Moira's crazy. She sold me this thing the other day, I didn't even know what the hell it was. Damn good saleswoman though. Damn good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我发誓，莫伊拉是个疯子。她有一天把这卖给我，我甚至都不知道那东西是什么。该死的女人。真该死。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is with those Church of the Atom lunatics anyway? They're all fucked in the head... drinking the bomb water, praying for another war?
ESP.TRADUIT: 原子教堂是怎么回事？里面的人是不是都疯了……估计是喝核弹旁的水太多了，居然祈祷另一场战争？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Manya and Nathan are both gone... what's happening around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 曼雅和内森都走了……这地方出了什么事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: With Walter dead, we're screwed. No one else can keep that treatment plant running.
ESP.TRADUIT: 沃尔特死后，我们就完蛋了。没人能继续经营这。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll catch up later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 迟点见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey. How's it going?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，进展得怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't say that there's much going on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 算不上有什么大事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nada.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing. We'll talk later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么，迟点再说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello, my child.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，我的孩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Confessor Cromwell [06000A6F] (mod) NPC : Mother Maya [06000A70] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I told you people: I'm busy. Leave me alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我跟你们说过：我正在忙，离我远点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I'm a little busy...
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我现在有点忙……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Evening.
ESP.TRADUIT: 晚上好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh! Hi!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦！嘿！

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's up?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good evening.
ESP.TRADUIT: 晚上好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm bored. Let's see if I can lighten things up around here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很无聊。我看看这周围有什么能让大家激动一下的不。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : talking to himself mischievously EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened to the other kids from the Pitt?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那其他从匹兹堡来的孩子怎么样了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: All of 'em became Initiates. Most of them went on to become Brothers. A lot fell in action.
ESP.TRADUIT: 都成了新兵。大部分加入了兄弟会。很多倒在了战斗中。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm the only survivor of the Scourge of the Pitt still stationed at the Citadel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是唯一一名来自匹兹堡天谴、现在仍然在五角大本营驻守的人了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was before I knew how boring it was.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是在我知道这有多无聊之前。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then you don't have to hear it. The hell with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以不听，该死的家伙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Huh? I'm sorry, are you still talking?
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃？抱歉，你还在说吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, you wanted to hear it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，是你自己想听的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What made them so terrible?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们到底有什么可怕的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The rivers. Even after the war, they were still flowing, but irradiated, and filled with God knows what else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些河流。战后，它们仍流动着，但都被辐射了，而且鬼知道里面还有些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I saw things there I can't even begin to describe. I was only... what... eight years old when I left? Hell of a thing for a kid to go through.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看到过一些东西，不知道该怎样形容。我离开时只有……大概……八岁左右？让孩子经历这些，真是见鬼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for runaway slaves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正在找一个逃跑的奴隶。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've got slavers! Grab your guns!
ESP.TRADUIT: 找到奴隶了！拿起武器！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239D0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's make it 300 caps and you have a deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 加到300个瓶盖，我们就成交。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it would bring more people in here if I had it on display I suppose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我想如果把它作为展品，将会吸引更多的人到这来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahzrukhal [060156F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right. You got it. 300 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。你得到它了。300个瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahzrukhal [060156F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it would bring more people in here if I had it on display I suppose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我想如果把它作为展品，将会吸引更多的人到这来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahzrukhal [060156F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right. You got it. 300 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。你得到它了。300个瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahzrukhal [060156F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, 200 caps sounds good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，200个瓶盖听起来不错。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahzrukhal [060156F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is the most I ever paid for a hunk of wood and strings, but what the hell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我为一块木头和几根弦而付出最多的一次，但这该死的算什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahzrukhal [060156F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahzrukhal [060156F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is the most I ever paid for a hunk of wood and strings, but what the hell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我为一块木头和几根弦而付出最多的一次，但这该死的算什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahzrukhal [060156F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is that stone head?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那石雕头像是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's Lincoln. Hannibal found it. He wants to put it back. I don't really understand why.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是林肯，先生。汉尼拔找到了它，他想再把它物归原位，先生。我并不清楚这是为什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bill Seward [060239D2] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's Lincoln, ma'am. Hannibal found it. He wants to put it back, ma'am. I don't really understand why.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是林肯，女士。汉尼拔找到了它，他想再把它物归原位，女士。我并不清楚这是为什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bill Seward [060239D2] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's Abraham Lincoln, the Great Emancipator. We don't know how it came to be here, but it's fitting, don't you think?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是亚伯拉罕·林肯，伟大的奴隶制废除者。我们不知道它是怎么到这来的，但这非常合适，你觉得呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Haven't you been listening? That's Abraham Lincoln, the Great Emancipator.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你没有在听吗？那是亚伯拉罕·林肯，伟大的奴隶制废除者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: God damn rookie. That's Lincoln. He freed some slaves a long time ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死的新人，那是林肯。他在很久以前解放了奴隶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239D0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you want to know more, come listen to Hannibal give his speech. He does it right after the noon meal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想知道得更多，来听听汉尼拔的演讲吧。午餐后演讲就开始。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239D0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are a bunch of escaped slaves doing holed up here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 一群逃亡的奴隶躲在这做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We are the only hope for runaway slaves everywhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们是流落各地的逃亡奴隶的唯一希望。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CF] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rivet City, and the Citadel can't be bothered with helping slaves. They turn a blind eye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 铆钉城和五角大本营也懒得帮助奴隶。他们对此视而不见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CF] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: We are the only ones willing to stand against Paradise Falls and slavery.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唯有我们想要与堕落天堂和奴隶贩子抗争。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CF] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you stay here? Why not keep running?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们为什么留在这？为什么不继续逃跑？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could get rid of the Super Mutants, if there are any.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果有超级变种人的话,我可以帮你搞定他们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What!? They must have found out our plans somehow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么！他们一定已经知道我们的计划了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: We are truly grateful for your intervention.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们衷心感谢你的介入。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Talk to Caleb. He'll need your help. We can't leave unless he's ready too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和卡勒布谈谈。他需要你的帮助。在他准备好之前我们不能离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found Slavers guarding the Memorial. They're all gone now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我发现一些奴隶贩子守卫着纪念堂，现在他们都不在了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Slavers? Dear God. They must know about our plans.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奴隶贩子？上帝。他们一定知道了我们的计划。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do whatever you have to do to make the Memorial site safe for my people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了我的人，请你一定要尽力保障纪念堂的安全。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Before you leave, speak with Caleb. He'll need your help too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在你走前和卡勒布谈谈，他需要你的帮助。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry about the Super Mutants. Slavers are in control of the Memorial.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不用担心超级变种人，奴隶贩子已经控制了纪念堂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Soldiers? Slavers more likely. Dear God. They must know about our plans.
ESP.TRADUIT: 士兵？更像是奴隶贩子，上帝。他们一定知道我们的计划了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do whatever you have to do to make the Memorial site safe for my people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了我的人，请你一定要尽力保障纪念堂的安全。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Before you leave, speak with Caleb. He'll need your help too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在你走前和卡勒布谈谈，他需要你的帮助。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry about the Super Mutants. Soldiers are in control of the Memorial.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不用担心超级变种人，士兵已经控制了纪念堂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was hoping you would help us. The Memorial is easy to find. Good luck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但愿你可以帮我们，纪念堂很容易找到。祝你好运。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: One other thing. Talk to Caleb. He'll need your help. We can't leave unless he's ready too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有件事，和卡勒布谈谈。他需要你的帮助。在他准备好之前我们不能离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I solemnly swear to protect the Temple of the Union.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我庄严宣誓会保护联合圣殿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome, brother, to the Temple of the Union!
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎兄弟，欢迎来到团结圣殿！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our home is your home. Your past is your own affair, so long as you serve our common good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的家就是你的家。你的过去是你自己的隐私，你只需要好好为我们服务就行了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As a symbol of our trust, here is a key to the gate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为赢得我们信任的标志，赐予你大门的钥匙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome, sister, to the Temple of the Union!
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎，姐妹，欢迎来到团结圣殿！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our home is your home. Your past is your own affair, so long as you serve our common good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的家就是你的家。你的过去是你自己的隐私，你只需要好好为我们服务就行了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As a symbol of our trust, here is a key to the gate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为赢得我们信任的标志，赐予你大门的钥匙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Quick, close the door!
ESP.TRADUIT: 快点，关上门！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Reilly's Rangers, huh? Never heard of you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 莱莉的游骑兵，呃？从没听说过。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You been stuck living in a vault the last decade or something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你过去十年都窝在避难所里还是怎么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're guns for hire; the best merc group in the Capital Wasteland. If you need something done in there, you seek us out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们是能雇佣的利器。首都废土上最好的佣兵团。如果你有需要的话，来找我们好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't cut anyone slack. Deal with it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会替人收拾烂摊子的，再见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice that you pick on bed-ridden people. That how you get your jollies? Does it make you feel tough?
ESP.TRADUIT: 选上手无缚鸡之力的人，真不错。这就是你找乐子的方式吗？这会让你感觉自己很强吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you want to hear me out, then shut the hell up. If not, get out of my face.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要是想听我说话，见鬼，先闭上你的嘴。如果你做不到，那就给我滚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, okay. Sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，好的。对不起。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If time wasn't so precious right now, I wouldn't be so on edge either. I need to get help for the rest of the Rangers, and fast.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果不是事态紧急，我也不会这么焦躁。我要为剩下的游骑兵寻求帮助，赶快。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: My apologies. I didn't know who you were.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我道歉。我不知道你究竟是谁。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's okay, kid. Don't sweat it. The Wasteland's a big place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，孩子。别担心，废土的确广阔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're guns for hire; the best merc group in the Capital Wasteland. If you need something done in there, you seek us out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们是能雇佣的利器。首都废土上最好的佣兵团。如果你有需要的话，来找我们好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa, whoa. Calm down! Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，哇。冷静！你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry. The name's Reilly. Yeah, THE Reilly as in Reilly's Rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很抱歉。我的名字叫莱莉。嗯，莱莉的游骑兵里的莱莉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers Comment (NAM2) : accentuate THE EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: So this is the Lincoln Memorial?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是林肯纪念堂？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not for long.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不会太久的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Silas [00027FAF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State Comment (NAM2) : say "Great Emancipator" with exaggerated sarcasm. EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't wait to see the Great Emancipator turn into a smoking pile of rubble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我简直等不及了，我要看着伟大的解放者变成一堆冒烟的废渣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Silas [00027FAF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State Comment (NAM2) : say "Great Emancipator" with exaggerated sarcasm. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the Lincoln Memorial. This Lincoln guy supposedly freed all the slaves before the bombs dropped.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是林肯纪念堂。这叫林肯的家伙理应在核弹落下前解放所有的奴隶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So the pussies built a Memorial to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以这娘娘腔为他建了个纪念堂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's got our slaves thinking that they can be free too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这搞得我们的奴隶们也妄想能获得自由。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [sobbing]
ESP.TRADUIT: [啜泣]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06025093] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please, sit back, relax and free yourself from the bonds of our planet as we take off for the stars! [bzzzzt!]
ESP.TRADUIT: 坐下，放松。把自己的精神从肉体的禁锢中解脱出来，好像飘然升天一样！[扑哧！]

ESP.ORIGINAL: To understand why man is so interested in this unknown expanse of space around our little world, we must take a journey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要了解人类为什么会对环绕我们小小世界的广阔宇宙如此感兴趣，我们需要踏上旅程。

ESP.ORIGINAL: For as long as history has been recorded, man has had an insatiable hunger for knowledge regarding the universe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从有史可溯开始，人类对探索宇宙的渴求就永无穷尽。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Air feels all fucked up tonight. I think a storm's comin'.
ESP.TRADUIT: 今晚的天气真是糟透了，我猜可能风暴要来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: These rookies kill me sometimes. Monsters... heh...
ESP.TRADUIT: 这帮新人有时真是让我想死。怪物……呃……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dumbass rookies, man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无能的新人，伙计。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's what I said! After a couple hours, we just put a cap in him to get him to shut up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就是我说的！几小时后我们用一颗子弹堵了他的嘴，看他还怎么喊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Monsters? They probably got their asses handed to 'em by some Wastelanders and ran home like a bunch of pussies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 怪物？他们恐怕早就被那些废土游民打怕了，像娘们一样滚回窝里去了吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those fuckin' morons... they ran into some kind of trouble up there. One of 'em came back last night, screamin' about monsters or some shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那群该死的白痴……他们在那遇到了麻烦。其中的一个昨晚回来了，嚷嚷着什么怪物之类的，见鬼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, but this sounds like it'll be good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，但这听起来不错。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, yeah. Keep runnin' your mouth, asshole. Keep fuckin' with me, and I'll be your worst nightmare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，嗯。继续胡说吧，混蛋。如果你再对我胡说，我他妈就会是你做过最可怕的噩梦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Coward!
ESP.TRADUIT: 懦夫！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get back here, you fucking coward!
ESP.TRADUIT: 回来，你这见鬼的懦夫！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goddamnit!
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get back here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 回来！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey! Don't leave me alone!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨！不要把我一个人留下来！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where are you going?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你去那里啊？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't you go runnin!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要跑！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You git back here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你给我回来！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go on, now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，继续！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just looking for a place to rest, and maybe do some trading.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只想找个地儿歇脚，或者做点交易。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hannibal says I gotta let folks like you in, but that don't mean I have to like it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 汉尼拔说我应该允许像你这样的人进来，但那不意味着我就会喜欢这么做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239D0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep your hands in sight and don't make any sudden moves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把你的手放在我能看见的地方，别做出任何突然的举动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239D0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm coming down to open the gate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我下去开门。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239D0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe. How much is it worth to find these slaves for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 可能。为你找到这些奴隶能得到多少钱？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm only interested in the leader, Hannibal Hamlin. You find him, and I'll pay you 100 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只对领导者感兴趣，汉尼拔·哈姆林。找到他，我会付给你100个瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: His trail leads east from Paradise Falls. He's going to try and claim this memorial, so this is the one place I know I can find him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 迹象表明他跑到堕落天堂东面去了。他会试图夺取这纪念馆，所以我知道在这能找到他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't kill him yourself. Just find out where he's holed up, and I won't have to wait for him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别杀了他。找出他躲在哪就好，这样我就不必干等了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not around here, but there is a group of them up north near Old Olney.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不在这，但他们中有一群跑到老奥尔尼北面去了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They are?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, that's just wrong, isn't it? We're from Paradise Falls, and we've been looking for those runaways.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是错的，对吧？我们是从堕落天堂来的，我们一直在找那些逃跑的家伙们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll have to go and take care of that little group of rebels. You can come watch if you want.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们得走了，我们得看着这一小股反叛者。如果你想的话也可以来看看。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whether you do or don't, I'm looking to hire a wastelander for a small job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管你干不干，我都得找个废土游民来干。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need someone to bring me some items from a nearby ruin. Are you interested?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要有人到附近的废墟去弄点战利品。你有兴趣吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I put a bullet right between Ted Strayer's eyes. <Lie.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把一颗子弹射入了泰德·斯崔尔的眉心。<撒谎>

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, the Ghoul hater got what was coming to him. Good riddance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那僵尸仇视者得到了他的报应。干得漂亮。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your caps. I'll take that key.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的瓶盖。钥匙归我了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent! That will be a lesson for all the Ghoul haters out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真精彩！那会为所有僵尸仇视者上一课。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your payment for the key.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你取回钥匙的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dukov is dead. I blew his brains out. <Lie>
ESP.TRADUIT: 杜克夫死了。我把他头盖骨都打飞了。 <撒谎>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Serves him right. He won't be spreading lies about Ghouls any more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他活该。他不会再散布那些关于僵尸的谎言了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take that key, and here are your caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 钥匙归我了，而这些瓶盖是属于你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dave's head popped like a zit. <Lie>
ESP.TRADUIT: 戴夫的脑袋就像一颗青春痘一样炸开了。 <撒谎>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you got what I want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你拿到我想要的了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Marvelous! My list is growing shorter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真不可思议！我的名单越来越短了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's Strayer's key. Shot in the head, just like you asked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是斯崔尔的钥匙。一枪爆头，像你要求的那样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not much of a shot, eh? I couldn't kill Jeff, but I got his son. That will have to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没能爆头，嗯？我杀不了杰斐，但是我干掉了他儿子。这就够了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your caps. I'll just take that key.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的瓶盖。钥匙归我了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's Strayer's key. He's dead, but not from a shot to the head.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是斯崔尔的钥匙。他已经死了，不过不是爆头。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That wasn't the plan. I suppose I have to pay for the key anyway though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 计划可不是这样的。但我想我仍要为这钥匙付钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's Strayer's key. But I'm afraid he's still alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是斯崔尔的钥匙。但是我恐怕他还活着。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So long as I get that key, I don't care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要我拿到了钥匙，其他的我不在乎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些瓶盖是你的了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's Strayer's key. But I'm afraid he's still alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是斯崔尔的钥匙。但是我恐怕他还活着。

ESP.ORIGINAL: May his soul rot! This is great news.
ESP.TRADUIT: 愿他的灵魂腐烂！这真是好消息。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take that key as a memento. Here, take your caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会把这钥匙留作纪念。给，拿走你的瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dukov is dead, with a head shot, and here's his key.
ESP.TRADUIT: 杜克夫死了，一枪爆头，这是他的钥匙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, better dead than alive I suppose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我想他还是死了好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take your caps. I'll take that key.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着你的瓶盖。钥匙归我了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's Dukov's key. He's dead, but not from a shot to the head.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是杜克夫的钥匙。他已经死了，不过不是爆头。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought I told you to kill him? That rat bastard is still alive!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我告诉过你要杀了他？那混蛋还活蹦乱跳着呢！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll pay for the key, but you really screwed up!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会为了钥匙付你钱，但你把事搞砸了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's Dukov's key. I got it without killing him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是杜克夫的钥匙。我没杀他就拿到了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who cares? I've got his key. That's all I really want.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁在乎？我拿到了他的钥匙。那才是我想要的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head Comment (NAM2) : Dismissive EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's Dukov's key. I got it without killing him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是杜克夫的钥匙。我没杀他就拿到了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, yes, yes! Another bigot bites the dust.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，好，好！又一个偏执狂玩完了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll just take that key, and you can take these caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 钥匙交给我，这些瓶盖你拿着。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's Dave's key. One shot, right through the brain.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是戴夫的钥匙。一枪，直接穿过脑袋。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, at least he's dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，至少他死了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose I have to pay you anyway since you brought back that key.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想，怎么说我也得为你拿回了钥匙而付钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's Dave's key. He's dead, but not from a shot to the head.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是戴夫的钥匙。他已经死了，不过不是爆头。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll pay you for the key, but I'm very disappointed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会给你钥匙当作报酬，但我很失望。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's Dave's key, but he's not dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是戴夫的钥匙，不过他还没死。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All I care about is the key... which I'll take now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我唯一在乎的只有钥匙……它现在归我了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's Dave's key, but he's not dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是戴夫的钥匙，不过他还没死。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 成交。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll get someone to burn this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会找个人来把它烧了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You seem like a right thinking person. I've got a proposition for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看上去是个有头脑的人。我有个建议想让你听听。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for some escaped slaves. I'll pay 100 caps for information about their leader, Hannibal Hamlin. Interested?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正在搜寻一些逃跑的奴隶。我会出100个瓶盖购买他们领头人汉尼拔·哈姆林的信息，有兴趣吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll get this burned right away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会立刻把它烧了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We will enshrine this right away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们会立刻把它悬挂起来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks much!
ESP.TRADUIT: 多谢！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've got a deal. Here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 成交。给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've found Hannibal Hamlin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到汉尼拔·哈姆林了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bravo!
ESP.TRADUIT: 漂亮！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I owe you some caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我欠你一些瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll gather up the boys and we'll go collect him. You can meet us there if you want.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会把兄弟们集中起来去抓住他。如果你愿意的话，你可以在那和我们碰头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, I already know he's up north, near Old Olney.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，我知道他，就在北面，该死的老奥尔尼那。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very clever. Well, I guess I owe you some caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很机灵。好吧，我想我欠你瓶盖了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Scanning for valid ticket... verified. Thank you for riding with Metro.
ESP.TRADUIT: 扫描票的有效性……核实。欢迎你乘坐地铁。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know! No one understands me either!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道！也没人能理解我！

ESP.ORIGINAL: God! It's so nice to have someone who understands! I mean, sure, when I left Little Lamplight, I was happy to be out of there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊！能得到别人的理解可真好！我是说，当然，当我走出小灯镇时，我非常开心能够离开那里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was dating Pappy then, you know. I got here and he was like "Big Town will be safe", but it wasn't! This place is always under attack!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那时我正在和帕匹约会，你知道。我到这时他一副“大镇很安全”的样子，但根本不是！这里一直遭到攻击！

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I don't date liars, so I dumped his ass and got with Flash. But that didn't last very long. Me and Timebomb were a thing for a while, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我不会和一个骗子约会的，所以我甩了他跟福莱斯一起走了。但那并没有持续很久。我又和“定时炸弹”好过一阵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever you say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便你说什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh! You... you... ... ...no one understands me... *sniff*
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢！你……你……没人能理解我……*气呼呼的*

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry... erm... Bittercup. What were you saying?
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起……喔……“苦杯”。你说什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Finally! Someone who doesn't judge me! You know, the people here are just so quick to assume that they know everything about you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 终于！来了个不评判我的人！要知道，这里的人总是飞快地认定他们已经了解了你的一切。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean, like, just because I look different doesn't mean that I'm some sort of freak, you know? It's like, hello, this world sucks!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是说，就像，我看上去不一样并不意味着我就是个怪物，你懂吗？就好象，这世界疯了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: No one gets that, they're all like "blah blah blah blah blah, what's wrong with that girl?".
ESP.TRADUIT: 没人会理解，他们只会觉得“哎哎哎，那女孩又怎么了”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice to meet you, Bittercup.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴见到你，“苦杯”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Finally! Someone who doesn't judge me! You know, the people here are just so quick to assume that they know everything about you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 终于！来了个不评判我的人！要知道，这里的人总是飞快地认定他们已经了解了你的一切。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean, like, just because I'm different doesn't mean that I'm some sort of freak, you know? It's like, hello, this world sucks!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是说，就像，我看上去不一样并不意味着我就是个怪物，你懂吗？就好象，这世界疯了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: No one gets that, they're all like "blah blah blah blah blah, what's wrong with that girl?".
ESP.TRADUIT: 没人会理解，他们只会觉得“哎哎哎，那女孩又怎么了”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bittercup? That's the dumbest name I've ever heard!
ESP.TRADUIT: “苦杯”？这是我听过的最蠢的名字！

ESP.ORIGINAL: No one understands me. You're just like all the others around here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没人能理解我。你和这里其他人一样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got a game you can play. It's called "Hide and Go Fuck Yourself."
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以玩玩我这游戏。它叫“自己他妈的躲起来。”

ESP.ORIGINAL: Potty mouth!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这臭嘴！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06025093] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're mean. Leave me alone!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你太过分了。离我远点！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06025093] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: La-la-la-la-laaaaa! YOU shut up!
ESP.TRADUIT: 废话连篇！你闭嘴！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (childish "You shut up!", "No YOU shut up!" back and forth) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shut up! Shut up! Shut up!
ESP.TRADUIT: 闭嘴！闭嘴！闭嘴！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once upon a time, there was this robot...
ESP.TRADUIT: 很久很久以前，有一个机器人……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : making up a story (like a little kid) because he's bored EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: His name was Joking Joe, and he went all around making everyone laugh really hard at all his funny jokes...
ESP.TRADUIT: 他名叫玩笑乔，他游历四方，用他那有趣的笑话来给所有人带来欢乐……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : making up a story (like a little kid) because he's bored EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And one day a giant ant came up to him and started talking like he wasn't some dumb ant, but a person of some kind! It said, "Prepare to die!"
ESP.TRADUIT: 一天，巨蚁来到他面前开始讲话，不像不会说话的蚂蚁，倒像个人类。它说，“准备去死吧！”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : making up a story (like a little kid) because he's bored EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: And was our brave hero scared? No. Not at all, he laughed in the face of danger... "Ha ha ha!" He beat up the monster and everyone cheered!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们勇敢的英雄害怕了吗？不。完全没有，他笑对威胁……“哈哈哈！” 他打倒了怪兽，所有人都在为他欢呼！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : making up a story (like a little kid) because he's bored EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: And what did our hero do, you wonder. He came up with the most cleverest of clever plans... and it worked! And everyone called him a genius!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的英雄做了什么，你根本想不到。他在所有聪明的办法里挑出了最聪明的那……而且很有效！所有人都称他为天才！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : making up a story (like a little kid) because he's bored EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: The End!
ESP.TRADUIT: 故事结束！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : telling a story (like a little kid) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: MS01StickyHandsEscort
ESP.TRADUIT: MS01StickyHands护卫

ESP.ORIGINAL: <whistling tunelessly>
ESP.TRADUIT: <随意乱哼>
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : spouting off questions because he's bored EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shhh!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘘！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (like a kid playing a game) going into "stealth mode" EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um... yeah... I got lots of caps! But they, um, they're at Big Town, so I can give them to you when we get there. Yeah!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯……是的……我有很多钱！但它们，嗯，它们在大镇，所以只要我们到了那，我就能付你钱了。耶！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take me to Big Town and you'll get your reward. My girlfriend Red has lots of caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 带我到大镇你就会得到你的报酬。我的女朋友瑞德有很多钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll wait for you outside, unless you want to go now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会在外面等你，除非你现在就想走？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got any caps? I'll escort you to Big Town, but it'll cost you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有盖子吗？我能送你去大镇，不过你要付报酬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I guess you can have this. It's the money I was saving to buy medicine for the town's people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我想你可以拿走这些。这是我用来为镇里的人们买药的钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : suggesting the player can help save the town from destruction EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know you've already risked your life once already, but I heard the Mutants talking about another attack. They'll probably be here soon...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你已经冒过一次生命危险了，但我听说变种人正在策划另一次攻击。他们可能很快就会到这来……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : suggesting the player can help save the town from destruction EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I saved your life. This is all I get? Surely you can spare a little more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我救了你的命。你就给我这么点？你还是再拿多点来吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not allowed in Little Lamplight anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我被赶出小灯镇了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : happy he will be getting his way anyway EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only people under 18 get to live in Little Lamplight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有18岁以下的人才能住在小灯镇里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : happy he will be getting his way anyway EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, when you're done with those little kids, we can go to Big Town together! I'll wait outside for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，当你搞定这帮小鬼的事后，我们就能一起到大镇去了！我会在外面等你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : happy he will be getting his way anyway EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. I'll take you to Big Town. But first I need to visit Little Lamplight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。我会带你去大镇。但我要先在小灯镇周围看看。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right. Of course. Rescuing me was a job to you, and you're a real professional.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。当然了。援救我是你的工作，而你是个真正的专家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : grateful, but taken back by the mercenary greed of the player EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, here you go. I wish I had more I could give you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，给你。我希望可以给你更多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : grateful, but taken back by the mercenary greed of the player EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are planning on giving me a reward for rescuing you, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我救了你会有报酬的，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey you. Yeah you! Don't bother with the children at Little Lamplight. Let's go to Big Town instead!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，你。就是你！别跟这帮小灯镇的小鬼混了。我们还是到大镇去吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : calling out (wants some one to escort him to Big Town) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hostilities will not be tolerated.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恶意不会被容忍。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please refrain from disturbing our other residents.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请不要干扰到其他居民。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please do not disturb the other residents. Take your seat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请不要打扰其他的居民，请就座。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please take a seat in the nearest available Tranquility Lounger. Thank you for your cooperation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请就座于最近的宁静巷催眠舱。谢谢你的合作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Robobrain [06014F82] (mod) Quest : ([06014E89]MQ03) Scientific Pursuits EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mommy? Mommy?! No! [crying]
ESP.TRADUIT: 妈咪？妈咪？！不！[呜]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06025093] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Daddy? Daddy?! No! [crying]
ESP.TRADUIT: 爹地？爹地？！不！[呜]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06025093] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take my BB Gun. You don't need to be scared of the Roaches now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，拿着我的BB枪。这样你就不用怕那些蟑螂了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow, where'd you get that? Okay, okay. Maybe I can do this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇喔，你从哪弄到的？好的，好的。或许我能办到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DC] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : a little relieved and surprised at himself EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright. I'm gonna go back in there and kill those damn roaches. Thanks!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。我要回去干掉那些该死的蟑螂了。谢谢！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DC] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : a little relieved and surprised at himself EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: This would squish those little buggers real nice. Okay, okay. Maybe I can do this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这会把那些小虫子打扁的。好的，好的。或许我能做到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DC] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : a little relieved and surprised at himself EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright. I'm gonna go back in there and kill those damn roaches. Thanks!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。我要回去干掉那些该死的蟑螂了。谢谢！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DC] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : a little relieved and surprised at himself EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take my Baseball Bat. Now you can handle the Roaches on your own.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，把我的棒球棒拿去。现在你可以自己对付那些辐射蟑螂了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good morning? What the hell is wrong with you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 早上好？该死的你怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What a good morning!
ESP.TRADUIT: 多么棒的早晨！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come again, come again. Any truckers on this wave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 重复，重复。这波段上有人吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029FB2] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : CD radio conversation - southern trucker EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I read you, buddy. Y'all see those clouds? Over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我收到了，伙计。你们都看到那些云了吗？完毕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029FB2] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : CD radio conversation - southern trucker EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.TRADUIT: 10-4，是共党。提高戒备，我们在州际线的第七站上见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029FB2] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : CD radio conversation - southern trucker EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.TRADUIT: 好的 — 我会把这些话沿途转告的。完毕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029FB2] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : CD radio conversation - southern trucker EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I read you, buddy. Y'all see those clouds? Over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我收到了，伙计。你们都看到那些云了吗？完毕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029FB2] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : CB Radio Conversation - Southern Trucker EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: 10-4, it's the commies. Let's circle the wagons, meet us at the state line on Route Seven.

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got a deal -- I'll pass the word along on my way. Over and out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的 — 我会把这些话沿途转告的。完毕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029FB2] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : CD radio conversation - southern trucker EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Forget I mentioned it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 忘了我说的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You would do well to side with my employer in this little matter. Life could otherwise become quite unbearable for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这次事件中，你最好站在我老板这边。如果你不这么做，会有大麻烦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : calm, very real, very serious threat EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I told Simms I'd disarm it. Maybe some extra caps would change my mind...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我告诉了西姆斯我会解除它。或许一些额外的瓶盖会令我改变心意……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Indeed. A man's word is worth his weight in caps. I suppose I could arrange for a bonus of say, 500 caps in addition to the base fee.
ESP.TRADUIT: 确实如此。一诺千金。我想我可以安排一些奖励，比如，在原价上再加500个瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: When it's done, meet me at Tenpenny Tower. It's southwest of here, well out of harm's way. You can't miss it. Any questions?
ESP.TRADUIT: 搞定后来特佩尼大厦见我。它在这的西南方，一个很安全的地方，你不会找不到的。还有问题吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you thought about disarming the bomb?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有想过去解除核弹吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I couldn’t do that! It’d be a real blow to those nice folks in the Church.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我不能那么做！那可是会把教堂里的那些好人气疯的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : talking nonchalantly about an undetonated bomb EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Besides, it’s not like that bomb ever hurt anyone. Live and let live, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有，那核弹看上去并没有伤害到任何人。我们相互忍让，不是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : talking nonchalantly about an undetonated bomb EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Righto. And be quick about it! I haven't been dry in years. I'd hate to start now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。动作快点！我近年来都没有这么口干过。现在我开始讨厌了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : amused EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've never seen any place like this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从没有见过像这样的地方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um... I don't have it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯……我没有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, go get it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就去拿来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not going to just take your word for it. I want that key.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可不信空口无凭的话。我要那钥匙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, go get it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就去拿来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not going to just take your word for it. I want something of his as proof.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可不信空口无凭的话。我需要一些他的东西来证明。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um... I didn't bring back any proof.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃……我没有带回来什么证据。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. Take it. I don't have any use for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。拿着它吧。它对我没用了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah! My trophy. You've earned your reward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊！我的战利品。你赢得了你的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. I guess you were telling me the truth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。我想你告诉我的是真的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take your caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，拿走你的瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. I believe you. Here's your money.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。我相信你。给你钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Allistair Tenpenny is already dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥利斯特·特佩尼已经死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Damn! He's the one I most wanted to die by my hand. At least he's dead somehow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死！他是我最想亲手杀死的家伙。至少他已经死了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here. I'll give you 25 caps for the news, but I'm not going to pay you to kill a dead man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，为这消息我给你25个瓶盖，但我不会为杀了一个死人而付你报酬的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't care. All I want is that damn key. No key, no caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 与我无关。我想要的只有那该死的钥匙。没钥匙，没瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got bad news. Ted Strayer is already dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有个坏消息。泰德·斯崔尔死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't believe you. Give me some proof, a ring, a key, something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不相信你。给我点证据，一枚戒指，一把钥匙，或者其他的什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got bad news. Ted Strayer is already dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有个坏消息。泰德·斯崔尔死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I shouldn't be surprised. The way he lived it was bound to happen sooner or later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不感到惊讶。他迟早要会那样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: All you have to do now is bring me his key. No key, no caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你现在要做的只是把他的钥匙给我带来。没钥匙，没瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hate to admit this, but Dukov is already dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不得不承认，杜克夫死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I shouldn't be surprised. The way he lived it was bound to happen sooner or later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不感到惊讶。他迟早要会那样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait. How do I know you aren't lying? I want proof. Some personal object of his. No proof, no caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等一下。我怎么知道你不是在撒谎？我要证据。一些他的私人物品。没证据，就没钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hate to admit this, but Dukov is already dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不得不承认，杜克夫死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? That bastard finally bit it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？那杂种终于死了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Such is life. Do you have his key? No key, no caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是生命。你拿到他的钥匙了吗？没钥匙，没瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um... Dave is kind of... Well, he's dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃…… 戴夫已经…… 好吧，他死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? That bastard finally bit it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？那杂种终于死了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait a minute. You could be lying. You got something of his as proof? No proof, no caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等一下。你可能是在撒谎。你拿到什么关于他的东西做证据？没证据，就没钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um... Dave is kind of... Well, he's dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃…… 戴夫已经…… 好吧，他死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Janet snapped. She killed Martha in cold blood. Look at this rolling pin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 珍妮特失去了控制。她冷血地杀害了玛莎。看看这擀面杖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh my God, what is that? Is that blood? And... brains?
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢！上帝啊！那是什么？那是血吗？还有……脑浆？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060244A0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Janet did this to Martha? She really did snap, didn't she?
ESP.TRADUIT: 珍妮特对玛莎做了什么？她确实疯了，不是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060244A0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look at this. It's her rolling pin, covered in blood. Martha's blood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看这。这是她的擀面杖，上面全是血。玛莎的血。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's... that's crazy!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这……这太疯狂了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060244A0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: My God... Did she really kill Martha? She's lost her mind!
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢天那……她真的杀了玛莎吗？她真是疯了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060244A0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Martha Simpson is dead, and Janet killed her! Look, here's her rolling pin...
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛莎·辛普森死了，是珍妮特杀了她！看，这是她的擀面杖……

ESP.ORIGINAL: But... Janet would never...
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是……珍妮特不会……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060244A0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane Comment (NAM2) : horrified EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean, I know she was upset, but I thought she was over it. How could she do this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是说，我知道她曾经很烦躁，但我认为她已经没事了。她怎么会这么做呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060244A0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane Comment (NAM2) : horrified EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's this... Women's clothing? Down here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么……女人的衣服？在下面？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602449F] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane Comment (NAM2) : confused, apprehensive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's your basement, lady. You tell me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的地下室，女士。这得你来说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This isn't mine. Why would Roger have this down here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是我的。罗杰怎么会把这东西放在下面？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602449F] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: You freak! You're going to eat me, aren't you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这怪物！你要吃了我，不是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : angry (covering fear) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Grrr! Hungry!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗷~！饿！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602AB96] (ID) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : (hungry) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's plenty of body parts laying around, why don't you eat those instead?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这地方丢着那么多的尸块，你为什么不吃它们呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : angry (covering fear) EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not fresh! Not warm! Taste old.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不新鲜！不够热！尝起来很老。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602AB96] (ID) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : (hungry) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope you choke on my bones!
ESP.TRADUIT: 但愿你被我的骨头梗死！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : angry (covering fear) EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hahaha! Not your tiny bones, little man! Grrrraaaahhhh!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈哈！你那小细骨是没用的，小人！嗷~~~！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602AB96] (ID) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : (hungry) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who you calling little?!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说谁小？！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : angry as hell EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shut up now! Grraaaah!
ESP.TRADUIT: 闭嘴吧！嗷~~~！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602AB96] (ID) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : (hungry) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh God. Kill me quickly, I beg you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，上帝啊。快点杀了我吧，求求你了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : scared and about to be eaten EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Grrr! Hahaha! Graaah!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗷！哈哈哈哈！嗷~~~！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602AB96] (ID) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : (hungry) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on. Follow me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来吧。跟着我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll be right behind you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们就跟在你后面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : happy to be rescued, scared they aren't safe yet EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: You and Shorty, follow me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你和“矮子”，跟着我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll stick with you, don't worry!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们会紧跟着你，别担心！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : happy to be rescued, scared they aren't safe yet EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You and Red, follow me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你和瑞德，跟着我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll just hope you know what you're doing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望你知道自己在做什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : reluctant but willing EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm right behind you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就在你后面！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : glad she has an escort through dangerous territory EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right! Let's go!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的！我们走！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : glad she has an escort through dangerous territory EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There it is! We're almost there! Come on! Yiiipppiiieee!
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是那！我们就快到了！加油！呀~~~~！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : extremely excited EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's in it for me if I risk my neck for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了你去拼命，我能得到什么好处？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Spoken like a merc. You sound like me when I was just a kid starting out in the business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的口气像个佣兵。你说话的口气真像我小时侯刚刚出道时的样子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay hotshot, how about a full suit of Ranger Armor? It's the best combat armor in the Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，硬汉，一整套的游骑兵装甲怎样？那可是全废土最棒的战斗装甲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Or if that doesn't do it for you I'll set you up with a minigun from our armory. Either way, you walk away with something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你不喜欢那个，我会给你从我们军火库里弄一把多管机枪。无论如何，我们不会亏待你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know, Reilly. This sounds like suicide.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道，莱莉。这听起来简直像自杀。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I don't know where else to go. In the shape I'm in, I'll be lucky to get ten feet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我不知道还能去哪。就我这样，运气好的话我还能走出10英尺。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll sweeten the deal for you, maybe it'll help. How about I set you up with a suit of Ranger Armor if you get them back?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会给你点优惠，这可能对你有帮助。如果你把他们救回来，我就为你一整套的游骑兵装甲怎么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If that doesn't do it for you I'll set you up with a minigun from our armory. Either way, you walk away with something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你不喜欢那个，我会给你从我们军火库里弄一把多管机枪。无论如何，我们不会亏待你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So that leaves them up there. How come you're here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 既然留下了他们。你是怎么到这来的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: My bad idea I'm afraid. I had a Stealth Boy which allowed me to slip off the roof unnoticed. The plan was to get back to get some help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我恐怕这不是一个好主意。我有隐身小子可以让我偷偷溜下楼顶。计划就是由我回去求援。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was almost at the street when a Super Mutant jumped me. Damn near ripped my arm off in the process.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我就要跑到街上时，一个超级变种人拦住了我。该死的差点轰飞了我的胳膊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Last thing I remember was falling into a culvert. Now I'm here. Some rescue attempt, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我最后记得的事是我掉进了一个管道里。现在我在这了。有人救了我，呃？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What did you need from me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想从我这得到什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get the Rangers home. Please. That's all I want. I don't care how you do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把游骑兵带回家。拜托。那就是所有我想要的。我不在乎你怎么完成。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I couldn't care less about your stories.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我对你的故事毫无兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. Since you're all business and obviously don't give a damn about human life, I got a proposal for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。既然你明显只关心你的生意，而他妈的对人命毫不在意，我有个建议。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: You want to hear it, or you gonna keep flapping your lips?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是准备听听看，还是继续胡说八道？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Last stand?
ESP.TRADUIT: 最后一搏？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Last stand? Well, we hoped not. We figured we'd get up there and get a better signal to radio the Brotherhood of Steel for help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最后一搏？嗯，但愿不是。我们希望能够到上面找到一个无线电信号相对更好的位置，好联络钢铁兄弟会来寻求援助。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Problem is, help never arrived. Vernon Square is so thick with the Super Mutants, I don't think they could slip through.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问题是，援助始终没有来。弗农广场上到处都是超级变种人，我不认为他们能够通过那。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Trapped yourself at the top of a tall building. Brilliant.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把自己困在了高楼顶上。你可真是个天才。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I don't know what your problem is, but I got three guys alone out there with an army of Super Mutants around them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我不知道你有什么问题，但我有三个兄弟被一支超级变种人的部队困在外面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Either help me by listening, or get the hell out of my sight. I'm not here to be judged by you or anyone else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要么听我说，要么给我滚蛋。我来这可不是为了让你或任何人评论的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, like I was saying, we had to fight our way up towards the roof of the Statesman.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就像我说的，我们得杀到政要酒店的楼顶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bad move, I'm guessing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得这是个错误。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very bad move, but we had no choice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 确实是错着，但我们没得选了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: On the way we lost Theo, one of my guys. We were unable to get the ammo case off of his body as we were pushed onwards.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在途中我们失去了一个兄弟，西奥。在那种极端情况下，我们没办法把弹药箱从他身上取下来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, guns almost dry, we hit the roof of the Statesman.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就这样，弹尽粮绝，我们终于杀到了政要酒店的楼顶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me the whole story.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这跟求援有什么关系？告诉我整件事的经过。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you mind if I try and revive her?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你介意让我来尝试一下把她救活吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unless you're an expert at medicine, I wouldn't recommend it. You may end up doing more harm than good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除非你是个医学专家，否则我可不推荐这么做。你最终可能会把事情弄得更糟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: However, I'm all for helping my patients, so if you think you have the ability, be my guest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论如何，我所希望的只是能对病人有所帮助，所以如果你认为自己有那能力，请自便吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you think there's any way to revive her?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认为有什么把她救活的途径吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I wouldn't recommend it. She's in some sort of coma. It's dangerous to force someone out of one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我不推荐这么做。她正陷于某种程度上的昏迷。强行把她弄醒是很危险的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's no telling when she'll come out of it I'm afraid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她什么时候能醒恐怕我也不知道
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did she end up in the Chop Shop?
ESP.TRADUIT: 她是怎么跑到排骨店来的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: She was just brought in by a few others. They found her bleeding to death at the entrance to the city here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她是被其他人带来的。他们在这城市的入口处发现了几乎失血致死的她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If she'd been out in the tunnels any longer, she'd have been someone's meal by now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果她在外面的隧道里再耽搁一会儿，她现在早就变成什么东西的大餐了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's wrong with her?
ESP.TRADUIT: 她怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: She had multiple lacerations, contusions, broken leg, some internal bleeding and blunt force trauma.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她身上有多处撕裂和挫伤，腿也断了，而且还有内出血和严重的瘀伤。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: She hasn't been conscious since they brought her in a few days ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 自从几天前他们把她带回来后她就一直昏迷不醒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd say she tangled with some Super Mutants and lost. It's a miracle she isn't dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我估计她一定是遇到了一些超级变种人，而且打输了。她没有死可真是个奇迹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Reilly's Rangers?
ESP.TRADUIT: 莱莉的游骑兵？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you must be new around here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，你一定是刚刚来这。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're a mercenary company that bases itself out of the D.C. Ruins. I'm assuming she's their leader, Reilly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是一支扎根在特区废墟的佣兵团。我猜她就是他们的领袖，莱莉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: What was left of her armor had her name stenciled on it. She was in a pretty bad way when they found her outside Underworld.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她护甲左边刻着她的名字。他们在地下城外发现她时，她可真是糟透了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, she's fine. They patched her up and she's resting in Underworld.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，她很好。他们为她做了包扎，而她现在则在地下城休息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a relief. I told her she was nuts when she decided to try to sneak out of here. Guess I was wrong. Now, let's talk about getting out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真是令人宽心的好消息。当她决定要逃出这的时候，我告诉她这简直是疯了。我猜是我错了。现在，我们来谈谈我们怎么离开这吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would have proposed going back the way you came, but apparently it's impossible now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我得到的建议是，从你来的那条路回去，但很显然，现在这不可能了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, the express elevator is our only solution.
ESP.TRADUIT: 高速电梯就是我们唯一的途径。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No time for chatter. I'm here to get you guys out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没时间闲聊了。我来这是把你们这帮家伙救出去的。
