ESP.ORIGINAL: Hang on there. First, I need to know if Reilly is okay. I assume she made it somewhere if you're here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等一下。首先，我得知道莱莉怎么样了。我猜如果你在这的话，她应该也活下来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: No time for chatter. Let's get out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没时间闲聊了。我们离开这。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hang on there. First, I need to know if Reilly is okay. I assume she made it somewhere if you're here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等一下。首先，我得知道莱莉怎么样了。我猜如果你在这的话，她应该也活下来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm afraid this is it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恐怕就是这样了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just you? You made it up here alone?
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有你？你完全是孤身一人到达了这？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ok, I'm impressed. Reilly must have sent the right person for the job... as usual. Hey, is she okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，我确实印象深刻。莱莉真是派对了人……就像往常一样。嗨，她还好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmmm, and you made it all the way up here alive?
ESP.TRADUIT: 唔，这一路你竟然活下来了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ok, I'm impressed. Reilly must have sent the right person for the job... as usual. Hey, is she okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，我确实印象深刻。莱莉真是派对了人……就像往常一样。嗨，她还好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do I know they're still alive?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我怎么知道他们还活着？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Before I left I gave them an order to keep broadcasting for help over their radio.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我离开前，我下令让他们持续通过无线电来寻求帮助。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hopefully, when you get near their location, you'll pick it up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果顺利的话，当你到达接近他们的位置时，你会收到讯号。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How can I get there from Underworld?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我怎么从地下城到那去？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your best bet is to stay with the Metro tunnels. Head north from here to Metro Central. Then look for the tunnels to the Dupont Circle Station.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最好的办法是通过地铁隧道过去。从这往北走到地铁中心去。然后再找到去杜邦环岛地铁站的隧道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Exit from Dupont Circle Station into what we call the Dry Sewers and eventually you'll wind up in Our Lady of Hope Hospital.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从杜邦环岛地铁站出来就到了我们称为干燥的下水道的地方，而最终你将到达玛利亚医院。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you think of anything that will help me get there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么办法帮我到达那儿吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We have a headquarters not far from here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们在离这不远的地方有个指挥部。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you can make it there, you are welcome to anything you need inside. Just punch in Reilly0247 at the gate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你能到那，里面的东西任你拿。只要输入Reilly0247就能进入。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We have ammo, supplies, you name it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们有子弹，补给，随便你怎么称呼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can you tell me about Vernon Square?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能和我说说弗农广场吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I wasn't asking for your help, I'd tell you to stay away. It's thick with Super Mutants. I don't know why.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果不是我需要你的帮助，我会让你离我远点。那到处都是超级变种人。我也不知道为什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Butcher, our team medic, has always suspected something's in the area they are looking for or being attracted to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的医生布彻，一直认为他们在这区域寻找某样东西，或是被什么所吸引。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only place worse I can think of is the Mall.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我唯一能想到比那更糟的地方就是商业区。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's something about this area. I can't put my finger on it, but just like the Mall, there's an unusually high concentration of Super Mutants.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这区域很古怪。我没办法说得再清楚了，但就像商业区一样，那里超级变种人的数量多得不寻常。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I had the time and resources, I'd investigate. All I care about now is getting the hell off this damn roof.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我有时间和资源，我会去进行调查。但现在我所关心的就只有怎么离开这该死的楼顶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The other guys hate mappin' this zone, but hey, I love it. I love turning the 'Muties into a fine, red mist with my gun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其他人讨厌来绘制这区域的地图，可是，嗨，我非常喜欢。我简直爱死了用枪把变种人变成一团红色血雾了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029576] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can your table handle 200 caps?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的桌子摆得下200个瓶盖吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now that's what I'm talking about!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是我说的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You just bought yourself a motherfucking key.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你刚给自己买了把他妈的钥匙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now take it and get the hell out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，拿着它该死的给我滚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now that's what I'm talking about!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是我说的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't even know what's going on, do you clown shoes? Ha! You just bought yourself a motherfucking key.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你甚至不知道怎么回事，小丑？哈！你刚给自己买了他妈把钥匙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now take it and get the hell out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，拿着它给我滚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's 200 caps. Give me something to "prove" I killed you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你200个瓶盖。给我一些“证据”来证明我杀了你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can give me the key, or I can take it. Your choice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以把钥匙交出来，或者让我动手。你自己选。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got some big brass ones, you know that. And fuck me if I don't think you could do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真够无耻，你知道的。如果我不把你当回事，我就他妈的是个傻瓜。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here. Take it. Now go fuck yourself before I change my mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给。拿着。现在，趁着我还没改变主意赶快滚吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got some big brass ones, you know that. And fuck me if I don't think you could do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真够无耻，你知道的。如果我不把你当回事，我他妈就是个傻瓜。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here. Take this key. It's all he really wants anyway. Now go fuck yourself before I change my mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给。拿着这钥匙。这才是他真正想要的。现在，趁着我还没改变主意赶快滚吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Give me something I can use as proof that I killed you. Or else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我些东西来证明我已经杀了你。或者让我杀了你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think I need to hear any more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不认为我需要再听下去了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. I'm getting tired of flapping jaw with you, clown shoes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不错。我也厌倦了和你浪费唇舌了，小丑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I'll flap my balls against Cherry's ass instead! Oh, yeah!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我还是去和雪莉合体吧！哦，耶！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, Crowley is alive. He wants some sort of security key you have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，考利还活着。他想要你那把安保系统的钥匙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So the meatbag is alive, huh? Fine with me. Just show me the money. Put your fucking caps on the table and you can have it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那饭桶还活着，呃？好吧。只要给我钱。把该死的瓶盖放在桌子上，你就可以拿走它了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine with me. Just show me the money. Put your fucking caps on the table and you can have it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。只要给我钱。把该死的瓶盖放在桌子上，你就可以拿走它了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: He wants some sort of security key you have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他要你手上的一把安保系统钥匙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So the meatbag is alive, huh? And I bet I know what he wants.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那饭桶还活着，呃？我打赌我知道他想要什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I don't know what you want. What's your angle, clown shoes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我不知道你要什么。你说呢，小丑？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, Crowley is alive. I'm supposed to kill you and bring him proof.
ESP.TRADUIT: 实际上，考利先生还活着。我应该杀了你再给他带去证据。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Crowley is alive, and he paid me to kill you because you hate Ghouls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 考利还活着，而且他雇我来杀了你，因为你仇视尸鬼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Fuck me sideways! No, better yet, fuck him. I swear, I'll jam a grenade so far up his ass...
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？有没有搞错！不，应该说，去他妈的。我发誓，我会把手榴弹塞进他屁股……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got nothing against Ghouls. Ha! I even had a Ghoul party girl once, to see what it was like!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我根本没有针对僵尸。哈！我甚至曾经有过一个僵尸女伴，就为试试那是什么感觉！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is about the key, isn't it? The goddamn key. If you want it, I'd better see some fucking caps on the table, clown shoes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这跟钥匙有关，对吧？该死的钥匙。如果你想要它，你最好拿出些该死的瓶盖来，小丑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll give you 25 caps for that key.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会为那钥匙付给你25个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, yeah! I'm gonna be flying high tonight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，耶！我今晚乐得合不拢嘴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156BE] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, yeah! I'm gonna be flying high tonight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，耶！我今晚乐得合不拢嘴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156BE] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll give you 25 caps for something I can bring to Crowley, to "prove" you died.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我用25个瓶盖换你身上的东西带给考利先生，好“证明”你已经死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Give me that key. I'd hate to see you bleed to death.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我钥匙。我不想看着你流血至死。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh... sure, dude. I don't know what it's for anyway. Don't need to get all thug like.
ESP.TRADUIT: 喔……当然，伙计。反正我不知道它是用来干嘛的。没必要表现得像个恶棍。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156BE] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mister Crowley wants your father's security key.
ESP.TRADUIT: 考利先生想要你父亲的安保系统钥匙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa! Is it, like, worth caps? Cause I got needs, man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇！这会不会值点钱？因为我需要钱，伙计。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156BE] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa! Is this, like, worth caps? Cause I got needs, man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇！这会不会值点钱？因为我需要钱，伙计。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156BE] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm guessing Crowley wants your father's key. Just a hunch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜考利先生想要你父亲的钥匙。只是直觉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa! Is this, like, worth caps? Cause I got needs, man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇！这会不会值点钱？因为我需要钱，伙计。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156BE] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you give me something personal of yours as proof, I'll lie to Crowley.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我点你身上的东西做证据，我就能骗倒考利先生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds like a normal guy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来像个没事人一样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're too nosy for your own good. It can be a dangerous habit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你太爱管闲事了。这可是个危险的毛病。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Charon [060156F6] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry. Just forget it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉。忘了吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't give away anything for free. Besides, it's obviously worth something to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从不免费给予任何东西。更何况，这明显值得你付出。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Quinn [060156F4] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why should I have to pay for gossip?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么我要为流言付钱？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh look! I dropped these 50 caps in your pocket...
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，看！我会把这50个瓶盖放进你的口袋里……

ESP.ORIGINAL: A whole bottle? You got a deal. All I know is that he keeps trying to hire outsiders to do some killing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 整整一瓶？成交。我所知道的就是他一直在雇佣外来人做一些杀人的勾当。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Patchwork [060156EF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard him mumble something about a Fort too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还听到他在嘀咕一个要塞的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Patchwork [060156EF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about a whole bottle? Here's 10 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一整瓶怎么样？给你10个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very funny.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很有趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Quinn [060156F4] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Crowley has some scam going where he's going to get rich.
ESP.TRADUIT: 考利的发迹史里可有不少阴暗的小故事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Quinn [060156F4] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He tried to get me to kill these three guys, but I wouldn't do it. I've met Dave, and he's no more of a Ghoul bigot than I am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他试图让我去杀掉这三个人，但我不会去做。我遇到了戴夫，而他不会比我对僵尸更偏执。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Quinn [060156F4] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on. You can tell me. Ahzrukhal said so. <Lie.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 得了吧。你可以告诉我。阿祖卡是这么说的。<撒谎。>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, well that's different.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，那就不同了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Charon [060156F6] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're the third human he's tried to get to kill those guys.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是他派去试图杀死这些人的第三个杀手了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Charon [060156F6] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He won't ask me, or anyone else in Underworld. It's kind of weird.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他不会找我，或者地下城的任何人。这很怪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Charon [060156F6] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Deal. All I know is that he keeps trying to hire outsiders to do some killing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 成交。我所知道的就是他一直在雇佣外来人做一些杀人的勾当。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Patchwork [060156EF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's 3 caps for a drink, but you've got to tell me what you know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你3个瓶盖买杯饮料，但是你要告诉我你知道的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ooh, a big spender.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢喔，一个大阔佬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tulip [060156F8] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it's better than nothing. Crowley has been outfitting himself for some big expedition.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，聊胜于无。考利在筹备一次大冒险。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tulip [060156F8] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's up to something, but he isn't saying what.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他有所行动，但从不说在干什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tulip [060156F8] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: What... oh! A bribe. Why didn't you just say so. Here's 20 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么…… 噢！贿赂。你怎么不直说。给你20个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can you tell me about Mister Crowley?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能和我说说考利先生吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa! That's a blast from the past.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇！这可真唤醒了我的回忆。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156BE] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: My dad knew a dude named Crowley. I never met him though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我爸爸认识一个叫考利的家伙。不过我从来没有见过他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156BE] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think Dad said he died when they were checking out some old fort.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我爸爸说过，在他们一起探索某个旧堡垒时，他死了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156BE] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know a Mister Crowley?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认识考利先生吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Ghoul? He's dead. Died twenty years ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个僵尸？他死了。二十年前就死了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good riddance too. I hate those shufflers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 死得好。我讨厌那些瘸子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you remember a Mister Crowley?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还记不记得考利先生？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. People like that don't deserve to live.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。那样的人根本不应该活下去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent! Take this sniper rifle. You'll need it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了！带上这把狙击步枪。你会需要它的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's a list of the guys and their last known locations. Word will get around if Tenpenny is killed, but I'll need proof for the others.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这有一份那些家伙的名单和他们最后出现的地点。特佩尼一死自然会有消息传开，但我需要你杀死其他人的证据。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bring me back something personal from each of them as proof. Like a key or ring or something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我带回他们每人的一件私人物品作为证据。比如钥匙或戒指这类的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um... I should go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯……我得走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, that's your loss, smoothskin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，那是你的损失，光皮肤。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不这么认为。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. What's the plan?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。怎么做？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not everyone is as sympathetic to Ghouls as you are. In fact some humans are downright bigots.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是每个人都像你一样对僵尸有同情心。事实上，有些人类是彻头彻尾的偏执狂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: They treat us like zombies, calling us brain eaters and shufflers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们像对丧尸一样对待我们，他们称我们食脑者和瘸子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'm going to make them pay. Uh... before I get into the details, you don't have anything against killing do you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我会让他们付出代价的。呃……在我开始讲述细节之前，我得确定你不会对杀人感到反感，是吧？ ?
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey! I'm just looking to trade a drink for some gossip.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨！我想用杯喝的来换点消息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Humph. Not sure I know anything of use, but I'll take that drink.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哼。我不确定我知道任何有用的消息，但我会收下这杯酒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: That will cost you two caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那会花费你2个瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Easy now. I've got nothing against Ghouls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 冷静下来。我并没有任何针对尸鬼的意思。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that so? Even if I call you a milk-sucking, mutant-loving, water-stealing whore?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？即便我称你为吸奶虫、变种狂、偷水贼？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that so? Even if I call you a milk-sucking, mutant-loving, water-stealing son of a whore?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？即便我称你为吸奶虫、变种狂、偷水贼？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have any traders in town? Any doctors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 镇里有商人吗？医生呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you've seen the clinic. Red's the smart one in Big Town. I'd ask her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你去过诊所了。瑞德是大镇里最聪明的人。我宁愿去问她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Timebomb [0602805A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Timebomb is amazingly calm. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This place looks like a ghost town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这地方看上去像个鬼镇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nah, no way. Big Town is a great place to be! I bet I could live over there, in that building with all the bullet holes and burn marks. Cool!
ESP.TRADUIT: 得了吧，不可能。大镇是个了不起的地方！我打赌我可以住在那里，就在那满是弹痕和燃迹的建筑里。酷！ !
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Sticky is completely oblivious and is sure that the older residents are as happy as he is. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just ask everyone else in town. I'm sure they'll tell you how great it is to be here, all grownup!
ESP.TRADUIT: 去问问镇上的其他人吧。我确定他们会告诉你这有多么伟大的，全部是大人！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Sticky is completely oblivious and is sure that the older residents are as happy as he is. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've seen those Super Mutants and their ... appetite. There's no way Big Town will survive with them around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你也见过那些超级变种人和他们的……胃口。如果被它们围着，大镇不可能幸存。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Shorty is referring to his time in Germantown, when he was almost eaten by a super mutant. EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think will happen to Big Town?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得大镇将来会怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where did you people come from, anyway?
ESP.TRADUIT: 顺便问问，你们这些人从哪里来的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, Little Lamplight is where most of us came from. Red and Pappy and Flash and Bittercup. We used to play together, when we were kids.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，我们中的大多数来自小灯镇 。瑞德，帕匹和福莱斯还有“苦杯”，当我们还是孩子的时候，总在一起玩。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kimba [0602AB94] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Kimba is bringing up a painful memory. Things did not work out like she had hoped. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then we got old, and we had to leave. Those were the rules. So we packed up and headed here, like we were supposed to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后我们长大了，所以我们必须离开。那是规则。所以我们背起行囊来到这边，就像我们应该要做的那样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kimba [0602AB94] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Kimba is bringing up a painful memory. Things did not work out like she had hoped. EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: No one told us it would be like this. We never have fun anymore, and most of us... most of us are dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从没有人告诉过我们会是这样。我们再也没有得到过快乐，而且我们中的大多数……我们中的大多数人都死了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kimba [0602AB94] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Kimba is bringing up a painful memory. Things did not work out like she had hoped. EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: We all used to live in a place called Little Lamplight, but they have a rule about age. You reach sixteen, and you're out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们曾经都住在一个叫做小灯镇的地方，但他们有一个关于年龄的规定。当你16岁时就必须离开。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Didn't matter, though, because you'd just pack your things and head to Big Town. All the adults go there, and there's plenty to eat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过也没什么，因为你要收拾好自己的东西起程到大镇去。所有的大人都去那里，而且那里有充足的食物。

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Plenty to eat" alright, if you like eating bullets. I've lost count of how many times I've been shot at.
ESP.TRADUIT: “充足的食物”是没错，如果你喜欢吃子弹的话。我已经数不清自己当过多少次靶子了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Big Town? A fairy-tale really. The Lamplighters who turn sixteen aren't allowed to stay in the caves, but they have to go somewhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大镇？一个真正的童话。长到16岁的小灯镇居民不再允许待在洞穴里，他们必须到别的地方去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Red maintains a bitter, sarcastic tone throughout. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And to encourage people to leave, they invented Big Town: the "great grownup place" that you got to go to when you became an adult.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了鼓励人们离开，他们创造了大镇：“了不起的大人之地”，那就是当你成年后要去的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Red maintains a bitter, sarcastic tone throughout. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think you can see how true those stories were.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你也看到这些故事有多么真实了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Red maintains a bitter, sarcastic tone throughout. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Give me the history of this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉我这地方的历史。

ESP.ORIGINAL: From the look of things, I'd say a Super Mutant sat down in a ditch one day and shat out this town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 照目前的情形看，我要说迟早会有个超级变种人坐在沟上，把镇子里的人都拉出来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Shorty is indignant. He has a natural sense of self-importance that has been challenged. EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I dragged myself here from Lamplight. I didn't believe all the stories about Big Town, but I wasn't about to let everyone else go there without me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我自己从小灯镇挪到了这边。我不太相信那些大镇的故事，但我也不能让其他人自己跑来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Shorty is indignant. He has a natural sense of self-importance that has been challenged. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A few dozen attacks on the town later, and here I am. Almost an ingredient in a Super Mutant chilli cook-off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 几十个变种人不久之后就攻击了我们的镇子，我就混成这样了。几乎变成超级变种人的一味菜肴了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Shorty is indignant. He has a natural sense of self-importance that has been challenged. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know how Big Town got started?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道大镇是怎么建立的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa, take it easy. I was just asking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，别当真。我随便问问。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, it's just been hard. When I managed to save him, I thought there might be a chance...
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，这太难了。当我试图救他时，我以为还有机会……

ESP.ORIGINAL: But now, it just looks like he's going to die like the others. And... I just can't bring myself to deal with it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但现在，看上去他就要像其他人一样死去了。而我……实在看不下去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe I can help him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许我可以帮助他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe you can. Feel free to take a look at him. But don't get in over your head. He's got some pretty nasty injuries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许你能。随意检查他吧。但别抱太大期望。他伤得很惨。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's that guy in the clinic?
ESP.TRADUIT: 在诊所里的那家伙是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I told you, that's Timebomb. And if it were up to you, he'd be dead. Just stay away from him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我告诉过你，那是“定时炸弹”。要是换了你的话，他早死了。你给我离他远点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's Timebomb. He got lucky. During the last raid, the mutant shot him down in the street.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是“定时炸弹”。他很幸运。上次遭到劫掠的时候，变种人在街头击中了他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Normally, they go for the kill, but I managed to drag Timebomb away before they could get the killing blow in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一般来说，他们会杀了他，但我在他们来得及下手之前就把“定时炸弹”拖走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I dragged him back to the clinic, but his injuries are way beyond what I can deal with. Honestly, there's not much hope for him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把他拖回了诊所，但他所受到的创伤已超出了我的能力范围。坦白说，他没什么希望了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's Timebomb. He got lucky. During the last raid, the mutant shot him down in the street.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是“定时炸弹”。他很幸运。上次遭到劫掠的时候，变种人在街头击中了他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Normally, they go for the kill, but I managed to drag Timebomb away before they could get the killing blow in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一般来说，他们会杀了他，但我在他们来得及下手之前就把“定时炸弹”拖走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I dragged him back to the clinic, but his injuries are way beyond what I can deal with. Honestly, there's not much hope for him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把他拖回了诊所，但他所受到的创伤已超出了我的能力范围。坦白说，他没什么希望了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's that guy over there? Is he hurt?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个家伙是谁？他受伤了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a Fission Battery that will fix that express elevator.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一块能用于高速电梯的核聚变合电池。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me have that thing. Give me a few minutes, and I'll have the elevator up and running.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把那东西给我。我需要一些时间，我会修好电梯，让它恢复运作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donovan [06029577] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As soon as I get it online, we'll get out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要我让它联线，我们就可以离开这了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donovan [06029577] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, what the fuck you bringin' it to me for? Give to Donovan. Sheesh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你他妈的把它给我干嘛？把它给多诺万。他妈的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029576] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are there any other ways off this roof?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有其他离开楼顶的路吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I can think of a faster way, but I doubt you'd survive the fall.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，还有一条更快的路，但我不知道你跳下去能否活着。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Seriously, the elevator is our only chance now that the radio tower is gone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说真的，现在无线电塔已经消失，电梯是我们唯一的机会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll chat about stuff later. We have to get out of here, right now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们迟些再聊。现在我们得离开这了，现在！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Listen. I don't know who you are. I don't even know why Reilly sent you. One thing I do know is that you're beginning to piss me off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着。我不知道你是谁。我甚至不知道为什么莱莉派你来。我唯一知道的事是你开始让我生气了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, stop being an asshole and work with me, will ya?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，如果你想和我一起，就别再像个混蛋似的，好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who put you in charge?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁让你主管这？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Reilly did. I'm the second in command of the Rangers. Now, can you just answer the question?
ESP.TRADUIT: 莱莉的命令。我是游骑兵的第二把手。现在，你可以回答问题了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any clue where I can find a Fission Battery?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么关于核聚变合电池位置的线索吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmmmm. Not really. All I remember is passing that maintenance office on the third floor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唔。不完全是这样。我能记得的就是在三楼曾经过那件间保全室。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donovan [06029577] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, we were under fire the whole time. Otherwise, I would have cleaned the place out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，我们一直都在火力压制之下。另外，我还得扫荡这地区。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donovan [06029577] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When we passed the maintenance room, I spied a deactivated Protectron inside. Just wrench open its access panel and you'll find it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我们路过保全室的时候，我在里面藏了一个未激活的自动护卫。打开它的检修门你就能找到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All I remember is mowing down Super Mutants with Eugene here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我所记得的只有在这和“尤金”一起绞碎那些超级变种人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029576] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ask the eggheads, they're runnin' the show. I just point and shoot... then stuff dies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问那些书呆子去，他们才是头。我只要发现目标然后开火……接着那些东西就死了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029576] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are those girls? And where are their clothes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些女孩是谁？她们的衣服在哪？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha ha! They're my party girls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈！她们是我的女人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : over loud laugh, like a bad used car salesman. Laughs as he says it. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm too much man for just one woman, so I need two! I wear them out every night.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有一个女人对男人来说太不够了，所以我要两个！我每天晚上都把她们扒光。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : over loud laugh, like a bad used car salesman. Laughs as he says it. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why should they bother getting dressed when I'm just going to take it off?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我要把衣服脱下来的话，为什么她们还要费神穿上呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : over loud laugh, like a bad used car salesman. Laughs as he says it. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha ha! Cherry is my play toy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈！雪莉是我的玩具。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I love my Cherry pie! Love it all night long!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我喜欢我的雪莉派！我会整夜地爱她！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I like her half naked. I like her all naked, but she says she gets cold.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我喜欢她半裸的样子。我更喜欢她全裸的样子，但是她说她冷。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's that girl? And why isn't she dressed?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那女孩是谁？她为什么不多穿点？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha ha! Fantasia is my girl Friday... and Monday, and Wednesday...
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈！凡塔纱是我星期五的女孩……还有星期一，还有星期三……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : over loud laugh, like a bad used car salesman. Laughs as he says it. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: She makes all my fantasies come true. Ha ha!
ESP.TRADUIT: 她把我所有的幻想都变成了现实。哈哈！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : over loud laugh, like a bad used car salesman. Laughs as he says it. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's my favorite outfit. If she gets cold, old Dukov knows how to warm her up!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是我最喜欢的外套。如果她觉得冷，老杜克夫知道怎么让她暖起来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : over loud laugh, like a bad used car salesman. Laughs as he says it. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: That girl looks cold. Why isn't she dressed?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那女孩看上去很冷。她为什么不多穿点？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey! Watch your language, clown shoes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨！小心你的言辞，小丑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : over loud laugh, like a bad used car salesman. Laughs as he says it. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't pay them. They take care of me, so I take care of them. We rub each other wrong all night long! Ha, ha!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不付她们钱。她们照顾我，我也同样照顾她们。我们整晚都在互补长短！哈，哈！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : over loud laugh, like a bad used car salesman. Laughs as he says it. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: So those girls are just your... whores?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这么说那些女孩只不过是你的……妓女？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey! Watch your language, clown shoes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨！小心你的言辞，小丑。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I take care of her, so she takes care of me. Ha, ha! She rubs me wrong all night long. Ha, ha!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不付她们钱。她们照顾我，我也同样照顾她们。我们整晚都在互补长短！哈，哈！

ESP.ORIGINAL: So that girl is just your... whore?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这么说那个女孩只不过是你的……妓女？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Allistair Tenpenny is dead. One shot, right through the brain.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥利斯特·特佩尼死了。一枪正中头部。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, yes, yes! Another bigot bites the dust.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，好，好！又一个偏执狂玩完了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good riddance. The wasteland is better off without him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 死得好。废土没有他会变得更好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Allistair Tenpenny is dead, but not from a shot to the head.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥利斯特·特佩尼已经死了，不过没爆他的头。

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Old Lady Dithers"? I thought you were the one who said we should be nice, and refer to her as "Ms. Dithers".
ESP.TRADUIT: “迪瑟大妈”？我想是你告诉我们要变好一点，并称她为“迪瑟女士”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602449D] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: George, honestly. You know I don't like talking to her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 乔治，坦白说。你知道我不喜欢和她说话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602449E] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, Mabel. Did you want to look for a new robot? I know you're not comfortable with yours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，梅布尔。你想看看新的机器人吗？我知道你不太喜欢你现在的那个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060244A1] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why, hello there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，你好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060244A2] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How are you today?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你今天好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06025093] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I... It's not really my place to say. I'm sure they're fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，我……这真的不该这么说的。我肯定他们都很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060244A1] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane Comment (NAM2) : embarrassed, trying to deflect conversation EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How could you... Roger, no. This is not the time for that discussion. Please.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么……罗杰，不。这不是商量的时候。拜托。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602449F] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane Comment (NAM2) : exasperated EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right. Sorry. I just thought that maybe... Oh, never mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。抱歉。我只是想那可能……噢，算了吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060244A0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane Comment (NAM2) : dejected EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right... I'll talk to him about it. She's harmless, anyway. Just old and senile.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧……我会跟他谈谈的。无论如何，她没有危险。她只是个老态龙钟的女人而已。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602449D] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, I brought you some ammo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，我给你带了些子弹。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, HELL yeah!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，他妈太棒了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029576] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whew. That makes me feel a whole lot better. Thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哟。这让我感觉好多了。谢谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks. I was starting to feel a little naked without it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢。没有这的话，我开始感觉自己有点像光着身子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donovan [06029577] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That would be great. Maybe I'll speak to Reilly about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这太棒了。或许我会跟莱莉谈谈这的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should. Now that our group is smaller, I'm sure she'll be into adding another Ranger to our ranks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你应该这样。我们的队伍规模比以前小了，我敢肯定她一定会补充一个新的游骑兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donovan [06029577] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nah. I've got things to do. But thanks for the compliment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。我还有事要做。但是谢谢你的恭维。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, just wanted you to know that I got your back if we ever end up in a firefight again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我只是想让你知道，如果你再卷进一场交火的话，我会在后面支援你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donovan [06029577] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure did. And now you're all alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。现在只剩你一个人了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alone... What will I do now? I have no one. Nothing. You've destroyed everything that mattered to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个人……我现在能做什么？我已经一无所有了。你毁掉了一切对我重要的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Betty [0602449C] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane Comment (NAM2) : German EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want more than that to spare your miserable life. 300 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想要保住你那可怜的小命，我要更多的报酬。300个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mercenaries are so reliably predictable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们佣兵处事的方式总在人预料之中。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: 100 now, 200 when the job is done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在先给你100个，等你搞定了，再来拿剩下的200个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mister Crowley is alive. I'm here to kill you because you hate Ghouls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 考利先生还活着。我则是来杀你的，因为你仇视尸鬼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's alive? I should have known. It's hard to kill those zombies. You gotta shoot 'em in the head.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他还活着？我早该知道。杀掉这些丧尸确实不容易。你得一枪打爆他们脑袋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever he's paying you, I'll double it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管他付你多少钱，我都会出双倍的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: More caps? You've got a deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再多给些瓶盖，就成交。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. Oh, and I still want Tenpenny dead. That bastard really does hate Ghouls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。噢，我还希望特佩尼能死掉。那杂种真的仇视僵尸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. Just get me those keys.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。给我那些钥匙就好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those people you sent me to kill aren't Ghoul haters...
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些你派我去杀掉的人并不是尸鬼仇视者...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your Republic is forfeit. Prepare to be reclaimed by the Wasteland!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们的共和国被取缔了。准备好重归废土吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's see what the Army of Dave has to say about that, invader!
ESP.TRADUIT: 入侵者，让你见识下戴夫军队的厉害！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Daddy Dave! Help us! Please!
ESP.TRADUIT: 戴夫爸爸！救命啊！救命！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ralph [0602B89D] (mod) NPC : Flower [0602B89C] (mod) NPC : Rachael [0602B89B] (mod) NPC : Mary [0602B89A] (mod) EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get Daddy Dave! Invader! Invader!
ESP.TRADUIT: 去找戴夫爸爸！入侵者！入侵者！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ralph [0602B89D] (mod) NPC : Flower [0602B89C] (mod) NPC : Rachael [0602B89B] (mod) NPC : Mary [0602B89A] (mod) EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Communist! She's a Communist! Everyone come quick!
ESP.TRADUIT: 共产党！她是个共产党！大家快来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ralph [0602B89D] (mod) NPC : Flower [0602B89C] (mod) NPC : Rachael [0602B89B] (mod) NPC : Mary [0602B89A] (mod) EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Communist! He's a Communist! Everyone come quick!
ESP.TRADUIT: 共产党！他是个共产党！大家快来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ralph [0602B89D] (mod) NPC : Flower [0602B89C] (mod) NPC : Rachael [0602B89B] (mod) NPC : Mary [0602B89A] (mod) EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dave! Dave!
ESP.TRADUIT: 戴夫！戴夫！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Someone help! Invader! Invader!
ESP.TRADUIT: 来人啊！入侵者！入侵者！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not here to hurt anyone. What is this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是来这伤害任何人的。这是什么地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're the Republic of Dave. Or we used to be anyway. You have to go now. Dave isn't here anymore to talk to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们是戴夫共和国，或者说，以前是。你现在该离开了。戴夫不在这里，不会和你谈了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ralph [0602B89D] (mod) NPC : Flower [0602B89C] (mod) NPC : Rachael [0602B89B] (mod) NPC : Mary [0602B89A] (mod) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: A gift of the key would be a strategic diplomatic move, Mister President.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总统先生，将这把钥匙当作礼物会成为一次战略上的外交行动。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. Of course it would. I knew that. I was just testing you to see if you would realize it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。当然是的。我完全清楚。我只是想试试你能否意识到这点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dave [06029A98] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take the key. It is a gift from the Republic of Dave to the Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着这把钥匙吧。这是戴夫共和国赠送给废土的礼物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dave [06029A98] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. Of course it would. I knew that. I was just testing you to see if you would realize it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。当然是的。我完全清楚。我只是想试试你能否意识到这点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dave [06029A98] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take this key. It is a gift from the Republic of Dave to the Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着这把钥匙吧。这是戴夫共和国赠送给废土的礼物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dave [06029A98] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: A gift would be a strategic diplomatic move, Mr. President. Something personal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 送一份礼物将能成为一次战略上的外交行动，总统先生。一些私人的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mister Crowley is alive. He sent me to kill you because you hate Ghouls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 考利先生依然活着。他让我宰了你，因为你仇视尸鬼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Me? Hate Ghouls? Preposterous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我？仇视僵尸？真是荒谬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dave [06029A98] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait. You said you're here to kill me? I'm going to have to recind your diplomatic immunity.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等。你说你是来杀我的？看来我必须废除你的外交豁免权了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dave [06029A98] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then I'm going to execute you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我就要处死你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dave [06029A98] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait. I've changed my mind. You have one hour to leave the Republic. Then I'll execute you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，我改主意了。你有一小时离开共和国。过后我会处死你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dave [06029A98] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Crowley is alive, Mister President. I'm supposed to bring him the key.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总统先生，考利依然活着。他要我把那把钥匙带给他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alive? I always wondered. He was locked in with a bunch of Feral Ghouls. They won't attack Ghouls, you see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 活着？我一直有所怀疑。他和一堆凶悍僵尸锁在一起。他们从不攻击僵尸，你知道的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dave [06029A98] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: The key is part of the Republic of Dave treasury. I couldn't possibly part with it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这把钥匙是戴夫共和国宝藏的一部分。我难以割舍它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dave [06029A98] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alive? I always wondered. He was locked in with a bunch of Feral Ghouls. They won't attack Ghouls, you see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 活着？我一直有所怀疑。他和一堆凶悍僵尸锁在一起。他们从不攻击僵尸，你知道的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dave [06029A98] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Would you consider taking him a personal item, like this key, and just telling him you killed me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会考虑给他带一件我的私人物品，比如这把钥匙，然后就告诉他你已经杀了我吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dave [06029A98] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Crowley is alive, Mr. President. I'm supposed to bring back proof of your death.
ESP.TRADUIT: 考利先生还活着，总统先生。我要带给他一些你已死的证据。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I seek citizenship in the Republic of Dave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望成为戴夫共和国的公民。

ESP.ORIGINAL: First off, you will address me as Mister President. Always. No exceptions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 首先，你要尊我为总统。永远如此。绝无例外。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Secondly, after careful consideration, the Office of Immigrant Affairs reports that we've already exceeded our quota for immigration this year.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其次，在仔细的考量后，移民事务办公室报告说我们今年已经超额移民了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Application denied. You have 24 hours to leave the Republic, or face deportation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 申请否决。你有24小时离开共和国，否则就会被遣送出境。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry we lost Butcher and Donovan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很遗憾我们失去了布彻和多诺万。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry we lost Brick and Donovan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很遗憾我们失去了布瑞克和多诺万。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a goddamn liar. You told me we were going to Rivet City but we've been out here for over five days! I've had it. I'm going back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这该死的骗子。你说过我们要去铆钉城的，但我们在外面已经晃了5天了！我受够了，我要回去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rivet City it is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们去铆钉城。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me pack my bags. Oh, wait, I don't have any. Let's get out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我去收拾行李。噢，等等，我什么都没有。那我们出发吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cherry [0602AE21] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : the "Oh wait, I don't have any" is sarcastic. EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: If he's that bad, come with me. I'll protect you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 既然他那么糟糕，那就跟着我吧。我会保护你的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. Rivet City has got to be better than this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，铆钉城比这好多了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have my hands in his pants all the time. He probably won't even notice it's gone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我总是把手插在他裤子里。他都不会注意到它不见了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dukov has a special key. Get it for me and I'll take you to Rivet City.
ESP.TRADUIT: 杜克夫有一把特殊的钥匙。把它拿给我，我就可以带你去铆钉城。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only if you take me to Rivet City.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除非你带我去铆钉城。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anywhere else and I'll just end up being someone else's property.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其他任何地方也行，我只是不想再成为别人的财产。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should come with me. You can't survive here by yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你该跟我走。你一个人在这不可能活下去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks for the warning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你的提醒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right. Because I've got all kinds of survival skills.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊。因为我学会了所有的“生存技能”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've only got one skill, and it won't do me any fucking good here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只会一件事，而且这件事现在对我来说他妈的一点好处都没。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go on. Get out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 走吧。离开这。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure you can find a way to survive here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信你有办法在这活下去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No sweat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does he pay you for this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他付报酬给你吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course. Why else would I stay with the old fart? You don't think I actually love that bastard, do you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，不然我为什么和这老头待在一起？你不会真的认为我喜欢那混蛋吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He gives me some caps, but it's not what you think. He can be a nice guy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他给我一些钱，但不是你想象的那样。他也能很棒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fantasia [0602AE20] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : emphasize "fun." she's implying he's good in bed EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And when the lights go out, he's real fun!
ESP.TRADUIT: 而且当灯关上时，他真的很棒！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fantasia [0602AE20] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : emphasize "fun." she's implying he's good in bed EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why aren't you dressed?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么不穿衣服？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dukov likes to keep it hot. Ain't no need for nothin' else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 杜克夫喜欢保持火辣。再没其他需求了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cherry [0602AE21] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : emphasize "hot" to imply both physical heat and sex EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dukov liked to keep it hot. He always said there ain't no need for nothin' else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 杜克夫喜欢保持火辣。他总是说再无其他需求了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cherry [0602AE21] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : emphasize "hot" to imply both physical heat and sex EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dukey didn't like me to wear a lot. He said it slowed things down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 杜克夫不喜欢我穿很多，他说那样很费事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you? And why are you dressed like that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？为什么你穿成那样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: So what's the deal with Dukov?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么杜克夫又是谁呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's a lecherous old man. The only reason I put up with him and his "needs" is because I'm safe here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个好色的老男人。我唯一能够容忍他和他的“需求”的原因就是我在这很安全。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He tends to shoot first and ask questions later. Don't pull out a weapon near him. He's likely to shoot you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他总是喜欢先开枪再问话。别拿着武器靠近他。他很可能会攻击你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And he's really good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而且他真的很棒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hold on. I need to know more before I agree to anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等。我在同意前需要了解更多。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it's a dangerous place out there in the Wastes, right? People could really use a compilation of good advice. Like a Wasteland survival guide!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，废土是危险的地方，对吧？人们很需要一本为他们提供好的建议的书。像是一本《废土生存指南》！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: For that, I need an assistant to test my theories. I wouldn't want anyone to get hurt because of a mistake. Nobody's ever happy when that happens.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因此，我需要一个助手来测试我的理论。我不希望任何人因为一个小错误而受伤。发生那样的事，不会有人高兴的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide

ESP.ORIGINAL: No... Then they just yell a lot. At me. With mean, mean words.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不……他们会对我吼出很多……很多脏话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait. How? I mean, how many people even read anymore?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等。怎样？我的意思是，多少人读过？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyone who wants to learn from my Wasteland survival guide, that's who! And for that, I need a research assistant who can test my ideas for the book.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所有想从我的废土生存指南里学习的人，就是那些人！因此，我需要一个助手来帮我测试书里的意见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean, if our research is off, it could lead to horrific misinformation that causes the grisly and needless deaths of uncountable innocents.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是说，如果我们的研究中止了，就会导致极其可怕的误导，会造成无数无辜的人可怕而无谓的死亡。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, you know, no pressure. So, will you help?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，你知道的，没有压力。你乐意帮忙吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: My very own landmine! Just what I've always wanted. Well, always since I sent you out on this, anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的地雷！就是我一直想得到的。嗯，至少是我派你去拿之后我一直想得到的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, tell me all about it. What was it like going through there? What's it like disarming a landmine?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，和我谈谈。经历怎么样？解除地雷的感觉是什么样的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got through Minefield alive, and I even brought you a present.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从雷区活着回来了，还给你带了个礼物。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? A whole library's worth of data, right there? That's great news!
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？满满一图书馆的资料，就在那？太棒了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, what did you find? Tell me about it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你找到了什么？告诉我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The library's still standing, and I've got the archives right here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 图书馆依旧挺立着，我还在那找到了一些档案。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Guess I wasn't the first to think of checking out a food store for storing food. Huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来我不是第一个想到去食品店检查库存的，呃？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, keep what you got. Just traded for a big food shipment, myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你拿的东西就留着吧。我刚好交易到一大批食物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take a bit, my treat - taste kind of grates after a while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着，吃一点，我请客 - 过会儿口感就不好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I encountered some Raiders, but they were easily outsmarted.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我遇上了一些歹徒，不过他们很容易就被我智取了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I never get to discuss semantics with anyone anymore! People are always like, "No time to debate linguistic constructs, we need to get food."
ESP.TRADUIT: 喔，我从没和其他人讨论过语义学！人们总是喜欢说，“没时间去探究语言结构了，我们要的是食物。”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: But you're right, of course. And that sort of attention to detail must help when avoiding landmines.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过你是对的。这些细节一定可以帮助别人避开地雷。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know you may not want to see any more explosives for a while, but obviously you know your way around them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你现在再也不想看到任何炸弹了，不过很显然你知道怎么处理它们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have a couple rainy-day toys of mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着这些小地雷吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Technically, it's the landmines that blow up, not me. And no, I didn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 技术上说，是地雷炸，不是我炸。而且你看，我没炸。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Explosive, you say? That's kind of impressive, actually. In a horrible sort of way, at least.
ESP.TRADUIT: 爆炸？真令人印象深刻。至少是一种糟糕的方法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess it's back to the drawing board for that repellent. I wonder if I can make it into some sort of fuel. Anyway, I'll just take that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我必须要重新设计这些驱鼠剂。我想知道能否能把它做成一种燃料。总之，就这样吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, but for your trouble, umm... Here, have the leftover chems from working on the repellent. I'm sure you can find some use for them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，为了补偿你遇到的麻烦，唔……拿着这些造驱鼠剂剩下的药品吧，我确定你会找到用处的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You added too much chemical stimulant. The result was rather explosive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你加了太多的化学刺激剂。结果是毁灭性的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Interesting... I wonder if the toxicity of the water caused their mutations and forced them to adapt to the ground as well?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有趣……我想知道是否是那些有毒的水源让它们发生突变，并强迫它们适应陆地？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wish we could have gotten more information, but this'll have to do for the book.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望我们得到更多的信息，但这对写书就够了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your pay. Maybe they'll help you be sneakier next time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的报酬，希望日后会助你潜行更隐秘。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Their lairs are partially aquatic, so the radiation must not bother them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们的巢穴有一部分是被水淹没的，所以它们应该不怕辐射。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds like you know your way around a medkit. You could probably take care of yourself, if I wasn't already here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来你很会处理医疗事务，如果我不在这，你应该能照顾好你自己。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide Comment (NAM2) : Emphasis on the "AM" EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course, since I am here, I might as well take care of you now. It's the least I could do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，既然我在这，我会照顾你，这是我唯一能做的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide Comment (NAM2) : Emphasis on the "AM" EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Acute physical trauma and severe lacerations. It's hardly pleasant.
ESP.TRADUIT: 急性身体创伤和严重的裂伤。这一点也不好玩。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I suppose that sort of thing happens, occasionally. But I guess if that's all that can be uncovered, what else is there to go on?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我猜那样的事偶有发生。不过我想既然那是能挖掘到的全部，那还会是怎样呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh well. Still, for your help, have a few of these. They may help out next time you need to talk to a few folks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，为了感谢你的帮助，拿着这些，它们在你下次与人交谈时会有点帮助的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's simply too many stories, and not enough evidence to support any of them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不同版本的故事太多了，也没有什么证据证明。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Say what you will about the dead folks of the past, but they designed a lot of their stuff so even idiots could use it. No offense, of course.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随你怎么说那些死去的人吧，不过他们设计了很多东西，即使是白痴都能用。当然，无意冒犯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: It helps to have the right tool for the job. Failing that, go with the right tool to cheat at the job. Like a pulse grenade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 工欲善其事，必先利其器。失败的话，就得拿正确的工具去完成它，比如脉冲手榴弹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, have a couple.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来，拿几个吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Installation was much easier than reaching the mainframe in the first place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 安装程序比接近主机要容易多了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, at least it's still there as a monument to knowledge. Shame it's an empty one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，至少它作为知识的纪念碑还建在。很可惜它现在空空如也。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still, it's good to know it's standing. Maybe I'll inspire someone to take care of the place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，还是很高兴知道它还在。或许我该鼓励其他人去保护那。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have some caps as payment for that little bit of hope.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你些瓶盖作为这一线希望的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: The building is there, but the books are all ruined.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那建筑物还在，但是书全毁了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, poor research assistant! I'm sorry, I didn't know it'd be so dangerous in there!
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，可怜的研究助手！我很抱歉，我不知道那竟然那么危险！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, don't worry. I'm sure the rest of the research will be safer!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，别担心。我保证剩下的研究会更安全！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: At least you can keep what you got. Just traded for a big food shipment, myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至少你能留着你所得到的东西。我刚好交易到一大批食物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take a bit, my treat - taste kind of grates after a while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着，吃一点，我请客 - 过会儿口感就不好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That place was a death trap. It was crawling with Raiders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个地方就是个死亡陷阱。到处都盘踞着歹徒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I told you, ghosts don't exist. That sort of attitude really isn't benefiting a research assistant.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我告诉过你，鬼是不存在的。这样的态度对于研究助手来说可没好处。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I'm glad you're not dead. That'd be a real downer. Especially for you, I bet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很高兴你没死掉，不然那可真令人沮丧。我打赌对你来说尤其如此。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know you may not want to see any more explosives for a while, but obviously you know your way around them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你现在再也不想看到任何炸弹了，不过很显然你知道怎么处理它们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have a couple rainy-day toys of mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着这些小地雷吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, I blew up and died. Now I'm haunting you because of that stupid book. Boo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错，我被炸死了。现在为了你那本愚蠢的书变成鬼回来了。哼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's... That's just terrible! Besides, I'm sure you've got plenty of ways to do terrible things to people. I don't want any part in that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那……那太可怕了！此外，我很确定你有很多办法去对人们做那些可怕的事。我可不要参与。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess it's back to the drawing board for that repellent. I wonder if I can make it into some sort of fuel. Anyway, I'll just take that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我必须要重新设计这些驱鼠剂。我想知道能否能把它做成一种燃料。总之，就这样吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, but for your trouble, umm... Here, have the leftover chems from working on the repellent. I'm sure you can find some use for them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，为了补偿你遇到的麻烦，唔……拿着这些造驱鼠剂剩下的药品吧，我确定你会找到用处的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: It repelled their limbs from their body. Can you make one that works on people?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那玩意把它们的四肢从身子上卸了下来。你能做一个对人也有效的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure it's an acquired taste. I mean, it wouldn't technically be cannibalism or anything. Just kind of gross.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我确定这是一种后天形成的爱好。我是说，理论上讲这并非同类相残。只是某种恶俗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wish we could have gotten more information, but this'll have to do for the book.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望我们得到更多的信息，但这对写书就够了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your pay. Maybe they'll help you be sneakier next time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的报酬，希望日后会助你潜行更隐秘。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's to say? They're crabs. They're delicious and nutritious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 能说什么？他们是螃蟹。它们好吃又有营养。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Even I'm not sure I can believe that, and I'm downright gullible. Or so I'm told.
ESP.TRADUIT: 连我都不大相信，我都够好骗的了。或是以前有人这么说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I guess if that's what they said, what else is there to go on?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过我想既然他们都这么说，那还会是怎样呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh well. Still, for your help, have a few of these. They may help out next time you need to talk to a few folks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，为了感谢你的帮助，拿着这些，它们在你下次与人交谈时会有点帮助的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I heard one story that was plausible enough. Let's go with it...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜我听见了一个挺有道理的故事。就用这个吧……

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess some people can work with complicated technology, and the actual tools and materials aren't entirely necessary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜有些人可以使用这些复杂的科技，并且这些现实的工具和材料并不是特别必要的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess you've either got it or you don't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你要么办到了，要么没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: It helps to have the right tool for the job. Failing that, go with the right tool to cheat at the job. Like a pulse grenade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 工欲善其事，必先利其器。失败的话，就得拿正确的工具去完成它，比如脉冲手榴弹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, have a couple.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来，拿几个吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I didn't even need that tele-thingy unit. I was just that good. <Lie.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 我甚至都不需要那个电什么装置。我就是那么厉害。<撒谎。>

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? But... but... books! And knowledge! And...
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？可是…可是…书！还有知识！还有……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh... just... darn it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢……只是……该死的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess it's good enough just to know it's standing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很高兴知道那建筑还在那。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's some caps for that. Jerk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些瓶盖是给你的。蠢货。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I may have been able to recover more, but it said to be quiet, so screw that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我本来可以获取更多的，但那写着肃静，去它的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a mighty callous attitude towards killing. But I guess they'd do the same for the food. Shame there wasn't any medicine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是对于杀戮的无情态度。但我想他们会为了食物会做同样的事。很遗憾那没找到任何药品。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, keep what you got. Just traded for a big food shipment, myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你拿的东西就留着吧。我刚好交易到一大批食物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take a bit, my treat - taste kind of grates after a while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着，吃一点，我请客 - 过会儿口感就不好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got the food and dealt with those pansy Raiders. They couldn't stop me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到了食物，还收拾了那的娘娘腔歹徒。他们可挡不住我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's very... deep. I guess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想这真是……深刻。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: But not exactly useful for those of us who can't handle even one little explosion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这对那些连小爆炸都无法处理的人来说还是没用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Speaking of which... As thanks for your help, have a couple rainy-day toys of mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说到这……为了答谢你的帮助，拿着这些地雷玩具吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I get blown up a lot. I get better. You got to be hard.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我被炸了很多次。我已经好多了。人就得坚强点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But it seemed to be working so well in informal testing! Anyone I hit with the repellent just left. Sometimes they yelled a bit, but that's all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但它在那些非正式试验里作用很好啊！被驱鼠剂打到的人都逃跑了。最多有时候喊的声音大了点，但仅此而已。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess it's back to the drawing board for that repellent. I wonder if I can make it into some sort of fuel. Anyway, I'll just take that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我必须要重新设计这些驱鼠剂。我想知道能否能把它做成一种燃料。总之，就这样吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, but for your trouble, umm... Here, have the leftover chems from working on the repellent. I'm sure you can find some use for them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，为了补偿你遇到的麻烦，唔……拿着这些造驱鼠剂剩下的药品吧，我确定你会找到用处的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those dumb Mole Rats just blew up! You should have seen the guts!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些该死的地鼠都爆掉了！你应该看看那一地的内脏！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Easier to avoid them than to fight them, you mean? Sounds like a good idea. Shame it's apparently hard to do in their den.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的意思是说避开他们比和他们战斗更简单？听起来是个好主意。不过可惜的是在他们的巢穴里这么做很困难。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wish we could have gotten more information, but this'll have to do for the book.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望我们得到更多的信息，但这对写书就够了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your pay. Maybe they'll help you be sneakier next time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的报酬，希望日后会助你潜行更隐秘。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Between shells and scales, they're pretty tough. But not tough enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 浑身甲壳与鳞片，它们算是挺硬的。不过还不够硬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa. From everything I had heard about them, I wouldn't have expected them to be so "hands-on."
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇。从我所听到的关于他们的事来看，我可没想到他们会如此“躬身实践”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I guess if that's what they said, what else is there to go on?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过我想既然他们都这么说，那还会是怎样呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh well. Still, for your help, have a few of these. They may help out next time you need to talk to a few folks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，为了感谢你的帮助，拿着这些，它们在你下次与人交谈时会有点帮助的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those tough upper deck folk built the whole place from the ground up!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些坚强的上层甲板居民从平地开始建立起了整个地方！

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a bit surprising how sturdy and easy-to-use a lot of the junked tech is. Guess they made it sturdy and simple back then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些荒废的科技如此结实易用让人吃惊。我想是他们当初特意设计得结实易用的吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: It helps to have the right tool for the job. Failing that, go with the right tool to cheat at the job. Like a pulse grenade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 工欲善其事，必先利其器。失败的话，就得拿正确的工具去完成它，比如脉冲手榴弹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, have a couple.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来，拿几个吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: The unit went in the computer. Then the robots woke up. Pretty straightforward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把装置放进了电脑。然后机器人全醒了。挺简单的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope you're saying that because they just can't be read anymore. Because otherwise...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望你这么说是因为它们已经没法阅读了。不然的话……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I wouldn't think very highly of you. That's for sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我不会特别尊重你。这是确定的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still, it's good to know it's standing. Maybe I'll inspire someone to take care of the place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，还是很高兴知道它还在。或许我该鼓励其他人去保护那。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have some caps as payment for that little bit of hope.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你些瓶盖作为这一线希望的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Most of the books would make better burning than reading.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很多书都拿来读还不如烧了好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, you're saying that they acquired a well-protected stash? I wonder how many other places are hiding treasures behind monsters, hrm?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说他们有个保护良好的储藏库吗？我想知道还有多少其他宝藏在怪物身后，嗯？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, keep what you got. Just traded for a big food shipment, myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你拿的东西就留着吧。我刚好交易到一大批食物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take a bit, my treat - taste kind of grates after a while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着，吃一点，我请客 - 过会儿口感就不好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and take this! It's an old Food Sanitizer. Just carry it with you, and it should automatically make most food and drink more, um... better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，拿着这个。这是一台旧食品净化器。带上它，能自动让大部分食物和饮料都更，呃……好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Raiders were using the pharmacy as a place to store their best gear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 歹徒把药房当作他们放装备的地方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's so true. For all of life, really. But especially the parts involving landmines.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那绝对没错。对于生命来说，确实如此。尤其是跟地雷扯上关系的时候。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know you may not want to see any more explosives for a while, but obviously you know your way around them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你现在再也不想看到任何炸弹了，不过很显然你知道怎么处理它们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have a couple rainy-day toys of mine. And looking at this landmine, it gives me an idea. It's a terrible device that does terrible things, of course. But it's easy to make your own, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿几件我的应急玩具吧。看看这地雷，它给了我一个灵感。当然，这可怕的装置会造成可怕的后果。但是这东西制作简单，连你也能做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Watch the details and look for broken patterns. That's where the traps are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 观察细节，寻找破碎的线索。你就能发现陷阱在哪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You do what you need to do to get food and medicine, I guess. It's not pretty, but I guess that's the way it's got to be, right?
