ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你去找了那些食物和药品。不算多，不过我想就这么多了，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, keep what you got. Just traded for a big food shipment, myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你拿的东西就留着吧。我刚好交易到一大批食物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take a bit, my treat - they taste kind of grates after a while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着，吃一点，我请客 - 过会儿口感就不好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and take this! It's an old Food Sanitizer. Just carry it with you, and it should automatically make most food and drink more, um... better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，拿着这个。这是一台旧食品净化器。带上它，能自动让大部分食物和饮料都更，呃……好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those Raiders must've shot me twenty times. But who's counting?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些歹徒肯定射了我20枪。不过谁会去数呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh. Well, if that's all! I'll just study this and hope there aren't any more explosions, shall I?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，嗯，如果这就是全部了，那就这样吧。我会进行研究并希望不会再出现其他爆炸了，好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know you may not want to see any more explosives for a while, but obviously you know your way around them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你现在再也不想看到任何炸弹了，不过很显然你知道怎么处理它们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have a couple rainy-day toys of mine. And looking at this landmine, it gives me an idea. It's a terrible device that does terrible things, of course. But it's easy to make your own, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿几件我的应急玩具吧。看看这地雷，它给了我一个灵感。当然，这可怕的装置会造成可怕的后果。但是这东西制作简单，连你也能做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: There may have been an explosion or two. Oh, and a sniper. No big deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在那可能给炸了一两次。噢，还有个狙击手。不过没什么大不了的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well as long as it was no problem for you, then! I mean, who doesn't enjoy cake? Other than robots, of course. I bet they prefer pie. Or maybe pi?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，既然你没问题！我的意思是，谁不喜欢蛋糕呢？当然除了机器人。我赌他们喜欢派，或许是π……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, keep what you got. Just traded for a big food shipment, myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你拿的东西就留着吧。我刚好交易到一大批食物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take a bit, my treat - they taste kind of grates after a while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着，吃一点，我请客 - 过会儿口感就不好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and take this! It's an old Food Sanitizer. Just carry it with you, and it should automatically make most food and drink more, um... better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，拿着这个。这是一台旧食品净化器。带上它，能自动让大部分食物和饮料都更，呃……好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had a fun party with some Raiders. Then a guard robot jumped out of a cake.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我跟一些歹徒们开了个派对。然后一个机器人从蛋糕里跳了出来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you think I'm an idiot? I may be a little impulsive, but not an idiot. I'll just take a look at this on my own, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得我是个白痴？我是有点冲动，但我不是白痴。以后我要去自己看看。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know you may not want to see any more explosives for a while, but obviously you know your way around them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你现在再也不想看到任何炸弹了，不过很显然你知道怎么处理它们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have a couple rainy-day toys of mine. And looking at this landmine, it gives me an idea. It's a terrible device that does terrible things, of course. But it's easy to make your own, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿几件我的应急玩具吧。看看这地雷，它给了我一个灵感。当然，这可怕的装置会造成可怕的后果。但是这东西制作简单，连你也能做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, disarming it's real easy. Just jump up and down on it. You go first.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，解除地雷非常简单。跳上去就行了。你先来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's horrible! You're horrible! This thing is horrible! Everything's horrible! Argh!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那太可怕了！你太可怕了！这东西太可怕了！世界太可怕了！啊！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: With that much testing, I guess it's beyond correction. Oh, go ahead and keep it. Maybe you can find a nicer use for it. But I doubt it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 既然测试了这么多次，我猜这结果应该是对的了。留着它吧，或许你能找到更好的使用方法，不过我对此怀疑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, but for your trouble, umm... Here, have the leftover chems from working on the repellant. I'm sure you can find some use for them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，为了补偿你遇到的麻烦，唔……拿着这些造驱鼠剂剩下的药品。我想你会好好利用它们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's like explosive whack-a-Mole Rat. Can I get it in bullet form? For people?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这东西一下子就把地鼠给打爆了。我能弄点到子弹上吗？用来打人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The last chapter's a bit more esoteric. It's about the survival of humanity as a whole, and how to rebuild society. Deep stuff, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 最后一章就有些深奥了。这章是关于怎么保存人类本身，以及怎么重建社会。很深奥，呃？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: We need to know how large settlements are formed, how to harness the old technology, and I'll need you to get ancient history from a nearby library.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们需要知道定居点的规模，怎么挽救古老的科技，我还得让你从附近的图书馆寻找古老的历史。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're in the last stretch, now, so let's finish it up strong! What's first?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们现在处于最后一段了，让我们一起完成吧！首先？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm ready to start researching the last chapter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我准备好开始最后一章的研究了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The second chapter's going to be a bit trickier, I think. It'll cover how to handle creatures out there, for better or for worse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 第二章开始有点复杂喽，我觉得。主要包含对付野外生物的方法，不论好与坏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: For example, repelling Mole Rats, learning about Mirelurks, and when all else fails, how to handle being injured.
ESP.TRADUIT: 比如，驱退那些地鼠，了解蟹人，以及最重要的，怎么处理伤口。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, let's buckle down and get to work on this chapter. What's first?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们开始吧，首先要做什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm ready to start researching the next chapter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我准备好开始下一章的研究了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, this is so exciting! I feel like I'm sending you out on some sort of super-assignment! Okay, okay. Give me a moment to calm down...
ESP.TRADUIT: 喔，真令人兴奋！我觉得我让你做了些超级棒的工作！好的，好的…先让我冷静一下…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now then, a trader gave me this bit of electronics from the RobCo factory. It ought to go into some mainframe in there to control the robots.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一名旅行商人给了我这个RobCo工厂的电子设备。插进那里某台主机后即能控制那些机器人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide

ESP.ORIGINAL: If there's a way to reactivate and control the robots there, it'd make for a good example of harnessing the past's technology for the book!
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果能够重新启用并控制机器人，这能成为书里使用旧科技的绝佳范例！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: The last subject is old technology, right? No challenge for... The Mechanist!
ESP.TRADUIT: 最后的课题是以前的科技，对吧？对于一个机械师来说……这毫无挑战！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mirelurks are a big threat in some areas, and knowing more about them can help people learn to avoid, or even outsmart them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在某些地方蟹人是巨大的威胁，了解的更多可以帮助人们躲避它们，或以智取胜。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: So I picked up this observer device to study them in their natural habitat. I need you to hide one in one of the spawning pods in their lairs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以我打算用这观测装置来研究它们的习性。我要你把它藏在它们巢里一个卵囊中。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's this about studying Mirelurks?
ESP.TRADUIT: 研究蟹人是怎么回事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, this is so exciting! I feel like I'm sending you out on some sort of super-assignment!
ESP.TRADUIT: 喔，真令人兴奋，我觉得你做的太棒了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, okay. Give me a moment to calm down... Now then, after some searching, I got this RobCo processor widget.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，好的。给我点时间冷静一下……现在，做了这么多研究之后，我拿到了这RobCo进程工具。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide

ESP.ORIGINAL: Supposedly, if you connect it to the mainframe at the RobCo factory, you get access to an army of robots!
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来，你把它和RobCo工厂的主机联结起来了，你控制了整整一只机器人军队！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Seems like it's right up your alley, huh? And it'd be a great example of how to harness technology, wouldn't it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来正和你意，呃？这也是使用旧科技的绝佳范例，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Old technology is no challenge for... The Mechanist!
ESP.TRADUIT: 旧日的科技可难不倒…… 机械侠！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Guards!
ESP.TRADUIT: 守卫！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allen Mack [060569B1] (mod) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : long drawn out angry shout for help EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's no need to flex. I was just playing with you. We know who you are. You can come in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 放松。我只是和你开玩笑，我们知道你是谁。你可以进来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : hinting at great profit EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Friendly warning - don't act like a jackass. You won't get a second chance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 善意的警告 — 别像个白痴一样。你一丝机会都没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : hinting at great profit EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and, if you want, I have a mutually beneficial offer for you to think about.
ESP.TRADUIT: 喔，还有，如果你愿意的话，我有个互利的条件，你可以考虑下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : hinting at great profit EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know who you're dealing with? Let me in. Now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道你面对的是谁吗？立刻让我进去！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Relax. I was just playing with you. We know who you are. You can come in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 放松。我只是和你开玩笑，我们知道你是谁。你可以进来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : hinting at great profit EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Friendly warning - don't act like a jackass. You won't get a second chance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 善意的警告 — 别像个白痴一样。你一丝机会都没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : hinting at great profit EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and, if you want, I have a mutually beneficial offer for you to think about.
ESP.TRADUIT: 喔，还有，如果你愿意的话，我有个互利的条件，你可以考虑下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : hinting at great profit EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your pals over at the Lincoln Memorial seemed pretty happy with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你旁边那个从林肯纪念堂来的的兄弟看来令我很满意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was just kidding. You're a slave. Deal with it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在开玩笑，你是个奴隶。处理掉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Damn you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去你妈的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : upset the player is toying with his emotions EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a slave. Deal with it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个奴隶。处理掉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I swear, if I ever get out of this mess, you're dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我发誓，如果我搞不定，你死定了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : angry and scared EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : angry and scared EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can try getting that collar off. But it might explode if I tinker with it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以试着解下这项圈。但我想我要这么干的话它就会爆炸。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well... to hell with it! Go ahead and try.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧……该死！继续。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : with trepidation and fear, but willing to try because the alternative is worse EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd rather be dead than a slave. Do it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我死了也比做奴隶好。动手！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : with trepidation and fear, but willing to try because the alternative is worse EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Amata, please. Don't be stubborn. I only want to talk to your friend. Surely you understand what's at stake here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿玛塔, 求你。别这么顽固。我只是要和你的朋友谈谈。你肯定知道这有多危险。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please stop. Please don't have him hit me again. Don't you care that I'm your own daughter?
ESP.TRADUIT: 求你停手，别再让他打我了。难道你一点都不在乎你自己的女儿？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DD] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : pleading EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've always indulged you, Amata. And now you've taken advantage of my lenience.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我总是溺爱你，阿玛塔。而你现在在充分利用我的仁慈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go ahead, Officer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续，警员。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DA] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : ordering his thug to punch Amata EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You need to learn some respect.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要学会尊重。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please, Daddy, no!
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜托，爸爸，别这样！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DD] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : almost sobbing after she's punched by her father's thug EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, officer. Let me try again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，警官。让我再试一次。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa! Really? Raiders and robots! I guess I wasn't the only one to think about checking those stores. Looks like you gotta be careful looting them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇！真的？歹徒和机器人？我想我不是唯一想到去搜索商店的人。看来去找东西的时候你必须小心点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, keep what you got. Just traded for a big food shipment, myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你拿的东西就留着吧。我刚好交易到一大批食物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take a bit, my treat - taste kind of grates after a while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着，吃一点，我请客 - 过会儿口感就不好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and take this! It's an old Food Sanitizer. Just carry it with you, and it should automatically make most food and drink more, um... better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，拿着这。这是一个老食品净化器。带上它，能自动让大部分食物和饮料都更……好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found Raiders and a robot. It was hardly a safe place to scavenge.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我遇上了一些歹徒和一台机器人。那可不是个拾荒的好去处。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lots of places are, nowadays. Good work staying staying alive in tough conditions - it'll be a great example for the book!
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在那样的地方太多了。干得好，在那样艰难的条件下生存下来 — 这会成为书里的绝佳范例！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know you may not want to see any more explosives for a while, but obviously you know your way around them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你现在再也不想看到任何炸弹了，不过很显然你知道怎么处理它们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have a couple rainy-day toys of mine. And looking at this landmine, it gives me an idea. It's a terrible device that does terrible things, of course. But it's easy to make your own, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿几件我的应急玩具吧。看看这地雷，它给了我一个灵感。当然，这可怕的装置会造成可怕的后果。但是这东西制作简单，连你也能做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: That whole place is a deathtrap.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那地方就是个死亡陷阱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It makes sense that there'd be a few Raiders there. But if that's the only concern, that hardly makes it worse than anywhere else out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那里有歹徒很正常。不过如果这是唯一的问题，那还不至于让那比其他地方更糟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, keep what you got. Just traded for a big food shipment, myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你拿的东西就留着吧。我刚好交易到一大批食物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take a bit, my treat - taste kind of grates after a while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着，吃一点，我请客 - 过会儿口感就不好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's got a lot more food than most places, but I wasn't the only one there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那的食物比任何地方都多，不过那还有别人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess placement of each step would be critical, wouldn't it? Especially if each one could be your last.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想那每走一步都至关重要，对吧？特别是每一步都有可能成为你最后一步时。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know you may not want to see any more explosives for a while, but obviously you know your way around them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你现在再也不想看到任何炸弹了，不过很显然你知道怎么处理它们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have a couple rainy-day toys of mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着这些小地雷吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, but it was a close call. Moving slow and staying off the dirt helped.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，但也是千钧一发。缓慢行动并远离尘土会有帮助。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's not how it was supposed to work at all! The poor little Mole Ratties with their little noses! That's just horrible!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是它该起的作用！那些可怜的小鼻子地鼠！太糟糕了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess it's back to the drawing board for that repellent. I wonder if I can make it into some sort of fuel. Anyway, I'll just take that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我必须要重新设计这些驱鼠剂。我想知道能否能把它做成一种燃料。总之，就这样吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, but for your trouble, umm... Here, have the leftover chems from working on the repellent. I'm sure you can find some use for them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，为了补偿你遇到的麻烦，唔……拿着这些造驱鼠剂剩下的药品吧，我确定你会找到用处的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think it works like you hoped. The Mole Rats all died.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这东西跟你期望的效果不一样，地鼠全死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hrm. That's not a lot more than I knew already. But it's interesting that they're adapted for the radioactive water.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯……看来这不比我原本知道的多。不过他们能适应放射性的水源这点让人很感兴趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wish we could have gotten more information, but this'll have to do for the book.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望我们得到更多的信息，但这对写书就够了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your pay. Maybe they'll help you be sneakier next time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的报酬，希望日后会助你潜行更隐秘。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're pretty much crab-based humanoids.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们就是些螃蟹样子的类人生物。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? That's pretty unbelievable!
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？太难以置信了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean, really, I'm not sure I can believe that. But I guess if that's what they said, what else is there to go on?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是说，真的，我不确定自己能相信。不过我想既然他们都这么说，那还会是怎样呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh well. Still, for your help, have a few of these. They may help out next time you need to talk to a few folks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，为了感谢你的帮助，拿着这些，它们在你下次与人交谈时会有点帮助的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: According to them, it was all set up by one upper deck resident.
ESP.TRADUIT: 根据他们的说法，那地方完全是一个上层甲板的居民建立的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good thing I had it, then. Otherwise, it wouldn't have worked. Of course, you also wouldn't have been there. Still...
ESP.TRADUIT: 幸好我有这东西，否则就不会有效果了。当然，那你也没必要去了。不过……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: It helps to have the right tool for the job. Failing that, go with the right tool to cheat at the job. Like a pulse grenade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 工欲善其事，必先利其器。失败的话，就得拿正确的工具去完成它，比如脉冲手榴弹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, have a couple.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来，拿几个吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was easy enough to attach the unit. The mainframe took care of the rest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 连接这个装置非常容易。主机则负责了剩下的工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, it's about time! I guess everyone else is watching out for their precious guns, food, and loved ones first. No time for books.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，是时候了！我想其他人都会先关心他们珍贵的枪、食物和至爱。没时间看书。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still, it's good to know it's standing. Maybe I'll inspire someone to take care of the place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，还是很高兴知道它还在。或许我该鼓励其他人去保护那。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have some caps as payment for that little bit of hope.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你些瓶盖作为这一线希望的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, it's still there. The Brotherhood's even trying to clear out the place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错，它还在那。兄弟会正在试图清理那个地方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yup, you've done a great job! I just need to add in the section on how to cook rat, and this chapter's done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呀，你做的太棒了！我只要加上烹鼠的部分，这章就完成了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, for your services, I've saved up quite a few Stimpaks. Of course, you may need them: we've still got two more chapters to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你一些我攒下的治疗针。你当然会需要它们的：我们还有两章要写。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: That completes the first chapter's tasks, correct?
ESP.TRADUIT: 第一章的任务完成了，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Absolutely! I'm glad to finish it up, but I'll bet you're even happier, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然！我很高兴能完成它，不过我敢打赌你比我更高兴，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just one last chapter, now. And it's much safer, I promise!
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在只剩最后一章了，而且会更加安全，我保证！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and here's your payment - two big boxes full of ammo. Think of it as insurance, in case the next chapter isn't as safe as I predict.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，这是你的报酬 — 两大盒弹药。把它们当作是保险吧，如果说下一章的内容比我预计的还要危险的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that all of the research for the second chapter?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些就是第二章所有的研究吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It certainly is. With that last bit of info, I'm all done!
ESP.TRADUIT: 确实，得到最后一点信息后，本书全部完成了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: For all your hard work, I want you to have this Mini Nuke. I kept meaning to use it to dig a well, but honestly, it just makes me nervous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了感谢你所有的努力，我希望你收下这微型核弹。我本想用它打井，但坦白说，这东西只会让我紧张。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, I just need to do a few last tweaks and it'll be ready to print and distribute! Thanks for all the help!
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，我只需要做一些小修正，然后就可以拿去印刷分发！感谢你所作的一切！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that it for the last chapter?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是最后一章的任务吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Correct, and it's looking very smart. Very smart, indeed! They'll be dazzled by our intelligence!
ESP.TRADUIT: 正确，真聪明！他们会为我们的智慧感到头晕目眩的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, for your services, I've saved up quite a few stimpaks. Of course, you may need them: we've still got two more chapters to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你一些我攒下的治疗针。你当然会需要它们的：我们还有两章要写。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: That completes the first chapter's tasks, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 第一章的任务完成了，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, that concludes our exceptional expert endeavor! I have to admit, I was worried it would go over some peoples' heads, but it should be fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是，这包含了我们优秀的专业尝试！我承认，我担心很多人都难以牢记，不过会好起来的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: For all your hard work, I want you to have this Mini Nuke. I kept meaning to use it to dig a well, but honestly, it just makes me nervous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了感谢你所有的努力，我希望你收下这微型核弹。我本想用它打井，但坦白说，这东西只会让我紧张。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, I just need to do a few last tweaks and it'll be ready to print and distribute! Thanks for all the help!
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，我只需要做一些小修正，然后就可以拿去印刷并分发！感谢你所作的一切！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And now my research for your book is completed. Isn't it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在我为你的书所做的研究全都完成了，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yup. It's looking like it'll be a real tough book for real tough guys. And real tough gals, too, of course!
ESP.TRADUIT: 耶，它看起来就是为真正强悍的男人准备的一本强悍的书。当然，还有强悍的女人！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, for your services, I've saved up quite a few stimpaks. Of course, you may need them: we've still got two more chapters to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你一些我攒下的治疗针。你必然会需要它们的：我们还有两章要写。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that all for the first chapter?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些就是第一章所有的研究吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yup, that's the last bit for the toughest survival guide in the Wastes! Survivors of the world, rejoice! And everyone else, too!
ESP.TRADUIT: 耶，这是废土上的最后的生存指南了！世界上的幸存者都会高兴的！其他人也是！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: For all your hard work, I want you to have this Mini Nuke. I kept meaning to use it to dig a well, but honestly, it just makes me nervous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了感谢你所有的努力，我希望你收下这微型核弹。我本想用它打井，但坦白说，这东西只会让我紧张。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, I just need to do a few last tweaks and it'll be ready to print and distribute! Thanks for all the help!
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，我只需要做一些小修正，然后就可以拿去印刷分发！感谢你所作的一切！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are we done with the last chapter?
ESP.TRADUIT: 最后一章完成了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It most certainly does. And if I keep writing in the style of some of your reports, this is going to be one mighty slick book!
ESP.TRADUIT: 确实，如果我继续按你的报告写下去，这将会是一本非常圆滑的书！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, for your services, I've saved up quite a few stimpaks. Of course, you may need them: we've still got two more chapters to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你一些我攒下的治疗针。当然，你会需要它们的：我们还有两章要写。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does that finish out the first chapter?
ESP.TRADUIT: 第一章结束了没有？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Smooth, suave, and done with a smile. I swear I picked up a few pointers from your style, myself!
ESP.TRADUIT: 文雅，温和且面带微笑。我发誓我借鉴了你的语言风格！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: For all your hard work, I want you to have this Mini Nuke. I kept meaning to use it to dig a well, but honestly, it just makes me nervous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了感谢你所有的努力，我希望你收下这微型核弹。我本想用它打井，但坦白说，这东西只会让我紧张。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, I just need to do a few last tweaks and it'll be ready to print and distribute! Thanks for all the help!
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，我只需要做一些小修正，然后就可以拿去印刷分发！感谢你所作的一切！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Correct me if I'm wrong, but that completes the book. Right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我们已经完成了整本书，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It definitely is. I'm trying to put that same great sense of humor you've got into the book. Keep it up, and it'll inform and entertain!
ESP.TRADUIT: 毫无疑问，我也想把你绝妙的幽默感写入书中。保持住！这样一来读者在获知信息的同时也能得到娱乐！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, for your services, I've saved up quite a few stimpaks. Of course, you may need them: we've still got two more chapters to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你一些我攒下的治疗针。你当然会需要它们的：我们还有两章要写。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is the first chapter done yet?
ESP.TRADUIT: 第一章已经完成了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you. Of course we are. And I think I'm really capturing that snide wit of yours. So, for all your snippiness, I think it'll help with the book.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，当然了。而且我想我已感受到了你的含沙射影。你的尖酸刻薄会对写书有帮助的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still, I can put up with plenty of your little jabs, as long as the research is good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管怎么说,我还是可以帮上点小忙的,只要你的研究是出于善意的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: And, yes, you'll still get paid. Here: nothing says loving like big boxes of ammunition, right? Now, on to the next chapter?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，你还是能拿到报酬。拿着，没有什么比成箱的弹药更可爱了，对吧？现在继续下一章？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: This chapter done yet? I don't know how much more research I can take.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这章已经完成了？我不知道我还能再撑多久。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, lucky for you, we're done! And for all your nasty attitude, I think the quips made it a lot more entertaining to read. That's bound to help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你很走运，我们搞定了！我想你冷嘲热讽的态度更能吸引读者。那肯定会有所帮助。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: For all your hard work, I want you to have this Mini Nuke. I kept meaning to use it to dig a well, but honestly, it just makes me nervous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了感谢你所有的努力，我希望你收下这微型核弹。我本想用它打井，但坦白说，这东西只会让我紧张。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, I just need to do a few last tweaks and it'll be ready to print and distribute! Thanks for all the help!
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，我只需要做一些小修正，然后就可以拿去印刷并分发！感谢你所作的一切！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I swear, if I have to research anything else, I'll just shoot myself now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我发誓，如果我还得再研究任何东西，我现在就举枪自尽。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We did it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们做到了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (cheering) in an excited cheering mob EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take that, Muties!
ESP.TRADUIT: 看那，变种人！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flash [0602796B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (cheering) in an excited cheering mob EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I didn't think that'd work!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没想到它能有用！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pappy [0602796C] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (cheering) in an excited cheering mob EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Die Mutants, DIE!!!!
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死的变种人，去死！！！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (cheering) in an excited cheering mob EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mean, we're still alive?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说，我们还活着？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bittercup [0602796A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (cheering) in an excited cheering mob EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hurray!
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好啦！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Timebomb [0602805A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (cheering) in an excited cheering mob EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah baby!
ESP.TRADUIT: 耶！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (cheering) in an excited cheering mob EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yay!
ESP.TRADUIT: 耶！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kimba [0602AB94] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (cheering) in an excited cheering mob EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our hero returns!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的英雄回来了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (raised voice) in an excited mob greeting their would-be hero upon his return EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our heroine returns!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的英雌回来了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (raised voice) in an excited mob greeting their would-be heroine upon her return EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did he rescue them?!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他救了他们？！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flash [0602796B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (raised voice - concerned ) in an excited mob greeting their would-be hero upon his return EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did she rescue them?!
ESP.TRADUIT: 她救了他们？！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flash [0602796B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (raised voice - concerned ) in an excited mob greeting their would-be heroine upon her return EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bleh! He's coming to tell us he failed!
ESP.TRADUIT: 噗！他是来告诉我们他失败了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pappy [0602796C] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (raised voice - pessimistic) in an excited mob greeting their would-be hero upon his return EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bleh! She's coming to tell us she failed!
ESP.TRADUIT: 噗！她是来告诉我们她失败了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pappy [0602796C] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (raised voice - pessimistic) in an excited mob greeting their would-be heroine upon her return EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Don't I count for something? He rescued me at least!
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？我一点价值都没吗？至少他救了我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (raised voice - angry that people don't care he's safe) in an excited mob greeting their would-be hero upon his return EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Don't I count for something? She rescued me at least!
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？我什么都不是？至少她救了我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (raised voice - angry that people don't care he's safe) in an excited mob greeting their would-be heroine upon her return EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I told you he could do it, but you didn't listen to me! You never listen to me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说过他能做到，但你们都不听我的！你们从来不听我的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bittercup [0602796A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (raised voice - bitter) in an excited mob greeting their would-be hero upon his return EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I told you she could do it, but you didn't listen to me! You never listen to me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说过她能做到，但你们都不听我的！你们从来不听我的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bittercup [0602796A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (raised voice - bitter) in an excited mob greeting their would-be heroine upon her return EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hurray!
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好啦！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Timebomb [0602805A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (raised voice) in an excited mob greeting their would-be hero upon his return EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright! Welcome back!
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好！欢迎回来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (raised voice) in an excited mob greeting their would-be hero upon his return EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yea!
ESP.TRADUIT: 耶！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kimba [0602AB94] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (cheering loudly) in an excited mob greeting their would-be hero upon his return EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got you the slave you wanted. I can get into Paradise Falls now, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我带来了你要的奴隶。现在我能进堕落天堂了嘛？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. Yeah. Go on up, hotshot. Just don't screw around, or things will get ugly. No second chances. Got it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。嗯，进去吧，高手。别在附近游荡，这很难看。没有第二次机会，知道吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : razzing a new recruit EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, Fawkes. You've got a deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，福克斯，成交。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm glad to see you are a sensible person.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴你是个开明的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, get me out of this place. I can't stand it anymore!
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，放我出去吧，我再也待不下去了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's quite an unusual name.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是个很不寻常的名字。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was taken from a historical entry in the computer. The name comes from a man who was willing to fight and die for what he believed in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是从电脑里的历史条目中选出的一个名字。一个为了自己信念奋战至死的男人的名字。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I felt it was appropriate given my circumstances.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得这名字适合我的处境。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's amazing how well you can speak.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很惊讶你话说得这么好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. I suppose it is. When my captors placed me here, they were too stupid to realize this room contained a working terminal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得也是。当抓住我的人把我扔在这以后，他们愚蠢到没发现这房间里有个工作终端。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've spent all my life teaching myself to read and speak based on the information stored on the Vault's Mainframe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我花了所有的时间来阅读和背诵避难所主机上的信息。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ironic, isn't it? Surrounded by the world's history and yet my world consists of this tiny room.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很讽刺，不是吗？我能看到全世界的历史，但我的世界却只有这房间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're kind of weirding me out. I've got to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你让我觉得害怕。我要走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, please. I haven't had a civil conversation all my life! Don't go!
ESP.TRADUIT: 别，求求你，我从跟人和气地谈过话！别离开我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could help you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能帮助你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: A friendly Super Mutant. Well, now I've seen everything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个友善的超级变种人。嗯，我算是长见识了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ugh. Must you use that vulgar term?
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，你非要那么粗俗地称呼我嘛？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, I was born in the F.E.V. Chambers but a Super Mutant I certainly am not. I prefer the term Meta Human. Suits me better don't you think?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我是因F.E.V.测试出现的，但我不能算是超级变种人。我会称呼自己为蜕变人类。你觉得是否更适合我？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps I'm getting ahead of myself. The name's Fawkes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许我超越了自己。我的名字是福克斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Give me one good reason not to kill you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我一个不杀你的理由。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the matter with you? I assure you I'm unlike the others in this dank place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有病吗？我保证我和这阴冷之地的其他所有人都不同。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: The name's Fawkes. I'd shake your hand, but this room happens to be my prison cell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的名字是福克斯。我想和你握手，但恐怕这房间是关押我的牢笼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, I'm human. But what are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我是人类。不过你是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Me? You care who I am?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我？你居然在乎我是什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Forgive me, but I'm not used to pleasantries. I'm more used to grunts and being struck about by the others.
ESP.TRADUIT: 原谅我，但我从没开过玩笑。我之前一直都是吼吼和被别人攻击。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My name's Fawkes. I've lived in this... cage all my life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的名字是福克斯。我一直都住在这……牢笼里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hannibal Hamlin is dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 汉尼拔·哈姆林已经死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had hoped to do it myself, so I'm only paying half because you didn't follow orders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我曾想亲自去做，我只付你一半钱，因为你没按规矩去干。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: At least those slaves have been stopped. Paradise Falls still owes you a debt of gratitude. Come by and see us sometime.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至少已经阻止了那些奴隶。堕落天堂依然欠你一份情。以后别忘了回来看看我们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everyone get ready!
ESP.TRADUIT: 大家准备好！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dusty [060288BC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : calling alarm after spotting "super mutants" EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've found some Holotags.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到了一些全息军牌。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you? It saddens me to hear of my fallen brethren, but their names and deeds shall be records. Tell me, how many have you found?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？我为我逝去的兄弟感到悲哀，但他们的名字和行为应该被记录下来。告诉我，你找到了几个？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where can I find Holotags?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我到哪可以找到全息军牌？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They are on our fallen Brothers throughout the D.C. Ruins. However, I can't give you a full report on the locations of all of our operations.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在特区的废墟中，我们死去的兄弟身上。不过我不能给你我们全部活动的地点报告。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As I said, many of the units in the field operate independently, sometimes not reporting into the Citadel for weeks or months.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就像我说的，很多战斗单位都是独立作战，数周或数月都不会向五角大本营发回报告。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Yawn.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <呵欠>

ESP.ORIGINAL: ... okay... well... as you can see, we're having trouble keeping track of our soldiers in the field.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧…呃…你也能看到……我们在追踪我们的士兵上有些小麻烦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And worse than that problem, a Brother fallen in the field would have no one to carry word of his death back to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最糟的是，没有人能把外面兄弟的死讯报告给我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In calmer times, we could send detachments and messengers to learn their fates, but with our manpower stretched thin, we have no such luxury.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在平静的时候，我们可以派出分遣队和信使去了解他们的死亡，但现在我们的人手极度短缺，不能去浪费人力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which is why I must now ask you for your help. Each Brother wears a Holotag like the one you found.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是为什么我请求你的帮助，每个兄弟会成员都会佩戴一个全息军牌，跟你找到的这些东西一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Should you find any of the fallen Brethren in the field, I ask that you return their tags to me, so that I might record their deeds in the scrolls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当你在外面找到我们死去的兄弟时，我希望你能取下他们的军牌并带给我，这样我就能把他们的死亡记录在卷轴上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can't keep track of your own damn soldiers? Who runs this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们都不能追踪自己的士兵？这地方是谁管的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would ask that you respect the Elder as you would your own father. And rude as you may be, you are correct. We can't keep track of them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望你尊重我们的长老，就像尊重自己的父亲。虽然你的话很无礼，但你说得对。我们没法追踪他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And worse than that problem, a Brother fallen in the field would have no one to carry word of his death back to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最糟的是，没有人能把外面兄弟的死讯报告给我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In calmer times, we could send detachments and messengers to learn their fates, but with our manpower stretched thin, we have no such luxury.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在平静的时候，我们可以派出分遣队和信使去了解他们的死亡，但现在我们的人手极度短缺，不能去浪费人力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which is why I must now ask you for your help. Each Brother wears a Holotag like the one you found.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是为什么我请求你的帮助，每个兄弟会成员都会佩戴一个全息军牌，跟你找到的这些东西一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Should you find any of the fallen Brethren in the field, I ask that you return their tags to me, so that I might record their deeds in the scrolls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当你在外面找到我们死去的兄弟时，我希望你能取下他们的军牌并带给我，这样我就能把他们的死亡记录在卷轴上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And without radio equipment, you can't keep track of them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有无线电设备，你们无法追踪他们？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Exactly. A Brother fallen in the field may have no one to carry word of his death back to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常正确，没有人能把外面兄弟的死讯报告给我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In calmer times, we could send detachments and messengers to learn their fates, but with our manpower stretched thin, we have no such luxury.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在平静的时候，我们可以派出分遣队和信使去了解他们的死亡，但现在我们的人手极度短缺，不能去浪费人力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which is why I must now ask you for your help. Each Brother wears a Holotag like the one you found.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是为什么我请求你的帮助，每个兄弟会成员都会佩戴一个全息军牌，跟你找到的这些东西一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Should you find any of the fallen Brethren in the field, I ask that you return their tags to me, so that I might record their deeds in the scrolls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当你在外面找到我们死去的兄弟时，我希望你能取下他们的军牌并带给我，这样我就能把他们的死亡记录在卷轴上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about we skip the story and you just tell me what you want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还是跳过那些故事吧，你只要告诉我需要我做什么就行了?

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. It's as simple as this. I need someone to collect Holotags from our fallen brethren in the field.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，就这么简单，我需要有人去收集我们战死兄弟的全息军牌。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bring them to me so that I can record the fallen Brothers in the Scrolls, and I will reward you. And that's all that you need to know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把它们带给我，这样我就能把他们的死亡记录在卷轴上，我会付你报酬的。这就是你需要知道的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, I've got all the time in the world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我时间多的是。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. As I'm sure you've noticed, the Brotherhood operates all over the D.C. ruins, often detached from the main base here at the Citadel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，我想你注意到了，兄弟会遍布整个特区废墟，经常会和五角大本营的主基地失去联系。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're short on communication equipment, so many of the groups in the field operate as independent cells without standing orders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们相当缺乏通信设备，所以很多小队都是独立行动的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sometimes... I'm afraid that their missions end in their deaths. As keeper of the Scrolls, it's my charge to write of each fallen Brother's deeds.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有些时候……我恐怕很多任务都因为他们的死亡而终止了。作为卷轴的保管者，记录他们的死亡也是我的责任。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Amata trusts me. If you don't give me what I want, I'll hurt her. Bad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿玛塔信任我，但如果你不给我我所需要的东西。我会狠狠地伤害她。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My God, you're a coldblooded little shit, aren't you? I think you'd actually do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的天啊，你是个冷血的小杂种，对吧？我相信你说的出做的到。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here. Leave the Vault. I'll have you shot on sight if you ever come back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给。拿着这些离开避难所。我只要一看到你再回来就会射杀你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just give me the keys to your office and your password. Then I'll be going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要把你办公室的钥匙和密码交给我，我就会离开。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, is that all? Is there anything else I can get you while you're here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦？就这样？你还在这的时候我是否能得到些什么呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DA] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : sternly EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll get nothing from me. I'll die before I see the safety of the Vault compromised again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你从我这什么都得不到。即使以生命交换避难所的安全我也乐意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DA] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : sternly EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, is that all? Is there anything else I can get you while you're here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦？就这样？你还在这的时候我是否能得到些什么呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DA] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : sternly EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll get nothing from me. I'll die before I see the safety of the Vault compromised again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你从我这什么都得不到。即使以生命交换避难所的安全我也乐意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DA] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : sternly EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just give me the password to your terminal. Then I'll be going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要把你终端的密码交给我，我就会离开。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't believe I'm being called a potty mouth by a cannibal...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真不敢相信自己被一个食人族说成大嘴巴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, that's it. I warned you. Normally, I wouldn't hit a lady, but you're over the line, missy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，就这样吧，我警告过你了，现在要让你吃点苦头了，女士。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait... are you saying you eat those people?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，你是说你们吃了这些人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think I like your tone. There's nothing wrong with me, we've lived this way for decades.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不喜欢你的腔调。我们已经这样生活了几十年了，一点问题都没有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: After the war, four families survived. They continued on just like we have. But when their shelters ran out of food, they need to eat something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 战后活下来四家人。日子照样要过，可能吃的都吃完之后，总要填饱肚子吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Family is everything, my friend. I wouldn't expect a wasteland wanderer like you to understand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 家庭就是一切，我的朋友。我不指望像你这样的废土游民能理解。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, let's just forget that this happened and we'll have no problem, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，如果你忘了这些那就一点问题都没有，好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, I was in the basement.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错，我到过地下室。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And did you see anything... unexpected there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有没看到任何……出乎意料的东西？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. I was in the shed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错，我到过工棚。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And did you see anything... unexpected there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有没看到任何……出乎意料的东西？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, and I saw what you're hiding down there, you sick bastard!
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我看到你们在这藏的东西了，你们这些杂种！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm disappointed in you stranger -- so quick to judge us. Did you ever stop to think that I have a family to support here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对你很失望，陌生人 — 这么急于下判断。你就没想想我还有一大家子要养活吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Judge not, lest ye be judged" as the good book says. Honestly, how many people have you killed?
ESP.TRADUIT: “不要批评别人，免得将来也被别人批评。”就像书里说的。坦白说，你杀了多少人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only difference between us is that I'm bringing home the bacon for my family.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们唯一的不同就是我把这些肉带回来给家人吃而已。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, and I saw what you're hiding in there, you sick bastard!
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我看到你们在这藏的东西了，你们这些杂种！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm disappointed in you stranger -- so quick to judge us. Did you ever stop to think that I have a family to support here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对你们这些陌生人真失望 — 这么快就来审判我们了。你就没想想我还有个家庭要支撑吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Judge not, lest ye be judged" as the good book says. Honestly, how many people have you killed?
ESP.TRADUIT: “不要批评别人，免得将来也被别人批评。”就像《圣经》里说的。坦白说，你杀了多少人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only difference between us is that I'm bringing home the bacon for my family.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们唯一的不同就是我把这些肉带回去给家人吃而已。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Andale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和我说说安戴尔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why, it's a place to settle down and raise a family. Of course, we don't just let anyone in here. The home owners association is very clear on that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，这是一处移居地和家庭住地。当然，我们不让外人来这里。这的家庭联系很紧密。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Besides, there's no room! As amazing as Andale is, is it any wonder that all the houses would be full of happy families?
ESP.TRADUIT: 而且，这已经没有空间了。安戴尔这每家都很快乐，是不是很令人惊奇啊？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Andale: greatest place there is. We win town of the year every year, we've got no end of food, and no troubles at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 安戴尔：最棒的地方！我们每年都赢得年度最佳镇子，我们不缺食物，从无麻烦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yep, there's no better place to raise a family.
ESP.TRADUIT: 耶，没有更好的地方来养育家庭。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和我说说这个地方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's swell! Except... I wish there were more kids. And my dad says that I'm gonna have to marry smelly ol' Jenny Wilson some day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它很不错！除非……我还希望有更多的孩子。我的父亲说我以后必须和难闻的老珍妮·威尔逊结婚。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He keeps saying stuff to my mom about keeping the family going, and how when him and Mr. Wilson were brothers, they didn't want to get married.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他一直说我妈说些什么维持家庭之类的东西，他和威尔逊先生是兄弟，他们也不想结婚。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's weird... that means that Mr. Wilson is my uncle and Jenny is... something. I don't know. It seems weird to marry her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 感觉有些奇怪……这就是说威尔逊先生是我的叔叔，珍妮是……什么来着。我忘了，总之和她结婚感觉很怪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You shut up! Just shut up and listen, okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你给我闭嘴！闭上嘴好好听，行吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Listen, you're about the only person who ever had the sense to get out of this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，你是唯一一个打算离开这地方的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront

ESP.ORIGINAL: I tell you, your old man had the right idea. I can't stand it down here anymore. You gotta help me get out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我告诉你，你爸爸是对的。我再也待不下去了。你必须帮我离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh look, Butch is begging for my help. How'd that work out for you last time?
ESP.TRADUIT: 快看，布奇在求我帮他。你上次的结果怎样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Zombies couldn't make a place like Underworld.
ESP.TRADUIT: 丧尸可没法建造像地下城一样的地方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: See? I knew you understood Ghouls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看到了吧？我知道你能理解僵尸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've convinced me. Hand over your keys and password, and I'll be on my way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说服我了。交出你的钥匙和密码，剩下的路我自己走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you think I'm scared of a snotnosed punk like you? I was running this Vault when you were still crying for your dead mother.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得我会害怕像你这样的鼻涕虫吗？你还在为为母亲死亡大哭时我就在经营整个避难所了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DA] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : sternly EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll get nothing from me. I'll die before I see the safety of the Vault compromised again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你从我这什么都得不到。即使以生命交换避难所的安全我也乐意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DA] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : sternly EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you think I'm scared of a snotnosed punk like you? I was running this Vault when you were still crying for your dead mother.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得我会害怕像你这样的鼻涕虫吗？你还在为为母亲死亡大哭时我就在经营整个避难所了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DA] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : sternly EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll get nothing from me. I'll die before I see the safety of the Vault compromised again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你从我这什么都得不到。即使以生命交换避难所的安全我也乐意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DA] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : sternly EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've convinced me. Hand over your password, and I'll be on my way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说服我了。交出你的密码，剩下的路我自己走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right. We'll do it your way. I surrender. <Give him your weapons.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我们按你的方式来做。<给他你的武器>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you. That will make this easier. Guards! Help me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你。这样就容易多了。守卫！救救我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DA] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : with a sinister smile

ESP.ORIGINAL: Old Man Harris doesn't seem very happy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 海瑞斯老爹看上去不太高兴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doesn't that make you all cousins?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是不是说你们都是堂兄妹？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't say that I know what you're talking about, but I sure as heck don't like your tone. You've got no business coming in here and judging us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道你在说些什么，但我很讨厌你嚼舌根。你没有权利到这来评判我们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're four hard working American families. I work hard to put food on the table for my family, so do all the men here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们是四个努力工作的美国家庭。我努力让家人都能吃上饭，这里的男人都是这样的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not easy living the American dream but dammit, we're doing the best we can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这里生活可不像该死的美国梦，我们都只是尽力而已。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I mean, really close.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我是说，太亲近了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess there are worse things.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想这很糟。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, someone spilled our beans, didn't they? Well, Andale has been four families and only four families for a very long time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，总有人会露馅的，对吧？嗯，安戴尔最初只有四个家庭而且持续了相当长的一段时间。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Two families marry into one another, take a new name, and start a new life. There's nothing wrong with that, is there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 两户人家结为一家，换了一个名字，开始了新的生活？这没有错吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The families around here seem very close.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些家庭看起来太亲近了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm from an underground Vault, lady. Trust me, this place sucks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来自一个地下避难所，女士。相信我，这地方真烂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well... I never! The nerve of some people! At least some of us know how to take the high road.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不！有些人真是精神病！至少我们还有人知道怎么上高速公路。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you want something, Mr. Fancy Underground Vault, or did you just come here to turn your nose up at us?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想干嘛？痴迷地下避难所先生，还是说你只是跑来窥视我们的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well... I never! The nerve of some people! At least some of us know how to take the high road.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不！有些人真是精神病！至少我们还有人知道怎么上高速公路。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you want something, Miss Fancy Underground Vault, or did you just come here to turn your nose up at us?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想干嘛？痴迷地下避难所小姐，还是说你只是跑来窥视我们的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shhh... time for a nap, gramps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘘……是时候小睡一会了，爷爷。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know, there is something a bit "off" about them...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道的，他们似乎有点“疯狂”……

ESP.ORIGINAL: No! Well... yes. But it's all a trick. Don't you know anything? Does that number on your back mean that you just crawled out of a vault or something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不！好……吧。但那是一个骗局。你知道什么？你背上那数字表示你刚从哪个避难所还是别的什么地方爬出来的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Old Man Harris [06029AA9] (mod) EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just about everyone in the wasteland knows to avoid Andale, and they're right to do it. People wander in here, and they don't wander back out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 废土上的每个人都知道要避开安戴尔，他们是对的。这儿可是有来无回。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Old Man Harris [06029AA9] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I haven't talked to anyone here but you. Are they friendly?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还没跟除你之外的其他人聊过。他们都还好说话吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know, it seems like a pretty nice place to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道，这看起来是个挺好的地方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, they're not! They're killers! Every one of 'em! Run! Get out while you can!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，他们不是！他们是杀手！每个都是！快跑！跑得越远越好！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Old Man Harris [06029AA9] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't believe me, do you? Just check out the basement, or that shed! There's a reason they're locked!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不相信我，对吧？去看看地下室，或是那工棚！它们被锁起来是有原因的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Old Man Harris [06029AA9] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This dump? Are you serious?
ESP.TRADUIT: 就这堆垃圾？你开玩笑吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, now. I'm sure that your home town is just so much better than our little Andale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我知道你的老家比我们这微不足道的小安戴尔好太多了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Linda Smith [06029AA2] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Huffy. EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah... maybe not. I don't want to catch whatever you have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊……算了吧。我不会碰你的任何东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Suit yourself, but you don't know what you're missing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便你，但你不知道自己错过了什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Linda's meatloaf is the best in the country. And her mince meat pie has won first prize at the town fair three years running.
ESP.TRADUIT: 琳达的肉卷是全国最好吃的，她的碎肉派曾经连续三年赢得了镇子上的大奖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But the invitation still stands, if you ever change your mind. But listen to me go on, did you need something else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的邀请还算数，你随时都可以回心转意。现在，听我说，你还需要什么吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it's good to meet you, Jack.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，见到你很高兴，开膛手“杰克”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And it's good to meet you too! Feel free to stay in Andale as long as you'd like. Heck, stop by the house for dinner sometime if you like.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也很高兴见到你呢！如果你想，可以随意地留在安戴尔。见鬼，如果你想，你可以进屋用晚餐。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just let Linda know beforehand, so that she can make enough for four!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过要提前通知琳达，她才能准备足够的四份！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm afraid I've lost my Geomapper...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我恐怕弄丢了我的自动绘图模块……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, this is the last one I have. If you lose this, you're shit out of luck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这是我手头上的最后一块，别再弄丢了，要不然你也太背运了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, but I only have two left. So try and be more careful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 行，不过我只剩下两块了，你小心点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's okay, here's another. Just be careful, they don't grow on trees you know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没问题，这还有一块，不过当心点，你知道它们不是树上长出来的，说有就有……

ESP.ORIGINAL: As long as the caps flow, you'll get your maps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要给钱，地图要多少有多少。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take this geomapper. Please don't lose it. Donovan spent a year developing it and I only have a few.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，拿着这自动绘图模块，请不要再弄丢它。多诺万花费了整整一年时间制造它们，而我手头上也仅有几个而已。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It will offload all of the map data you collect from your Pip-Boy automatically. When you come back, I can take the data from it and you get paid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我将会从你的哔哔小子上下载所有收集的地图数据，这是自动的，只要你弄到新地图我就付钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Done deal. I'll locate as many as I can for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 成交。我会努力找寻更多新地点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take this geomapper. Please don't lose it. Donovan spent a year developing it and I only have a few.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，拿着这自动绘图模块，请不要再弄丢它。多诺万花费了整整一年时间制造它们，而我手头上也仅有几个而已。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It will offload all of the map data you collect from your Pip-Boy automatically. When you come back, I can take the data from it and you get paid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我将会从你的哔哔小子上下载所有收集的地图数据，这是自动的，只要你弄到新地图我就付钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's been happening since you've been back?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们撤退时发生了什么事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. I'm not sure I'm cut out for this kind of job anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。我不知道自己是否还能再做下去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I almost got everyone killed in Vernon Square. What kind of a responsible leader does that? It was one bad decision after another.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我几乎让所有人都牺牲在了弗农广场。我算是什么领袖？只会做出一个接一个的错误决定。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I think I'm hurt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我想我受伤了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's funny, you look fine to me. Maybe you should just get some rest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这真可笑，你看起来很好。或许你需要休息一下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, you look like you need some work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你看起来需要开始工作了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, hang in there. Let me see what I can do for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 行，等等，让我来看看我能为你做些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rescue whoever the hell you like, but they aren't my friends. I don't NEED friends. Though I'm sure someone will pay you if you succeed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想救谁就救谁吧，但他们不是我的朋友。我不需要朋友，不过如果你救了他们，我想会有人会付钱的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bittercup [0602796A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : hurt and resentful EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll rescue your friends, but it's going to cost you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会去救你朋友的，不过你要花点钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh. Well... If you change your mind... we'd be awfully grateful. Those are our friends...
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦……如果你能改变主意……我们会非常感激。那是我们的朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kimba [0602AB94] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : let down and depressed and imploring EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your friends will have to rescue themselves. I'm not going to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的朋友们要自救了，我可不会去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah... Yeah! They went northeast... probably to the Germantown Police Headquarters. They have guns. And they're mean. So you better careful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯……是的！他们去了东北方……好像是日耳曼镇警察总部。他们有枪而且很厉害，你得小心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flash [0602796B] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : excite that maybe he found a hero EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You going to rescue them, or what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是要去救他们，还是怎么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flash [0602796B] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : excite that maybe he found a hero EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know where these Super Mutants took their victims?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道这些超级变种人把受害者都带到哪去了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you know about these Super Mutants?
ESP.TRADUIT: 对于超级变种人你了解多少？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you changed your mind? Are you going to rescue our friends? I'd given up hope. It's so hard here in the Wasteland. Not like when we were young.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你改变主意了吗？你想要救我的朋友们！我本来都放弃希望了，毕竟在废土生活太艰难了，比不得我们年轻的时候。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kimba [0602AB94] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : hopeful EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? You never seen a Super Mutant before?! They're mean and ugly and scary as hell!
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？你从来没见过超级变种人？他们丑陋而庞大，吓死人了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flash [0602796B] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : bragging EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: They came and rounded up a bunch of us and carried them off! God! They must be doing awful things to them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们袭击我们并带走了一部分人！天啊！不知道这些人受到了什么样的折磨。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flash [0602796B] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : bragging EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd go rescue them, but then who'd defend Big Town? I patrol every day now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能去救他们，但是谁来防卫大镇？每天都需要我巡逻。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flash [0602796B] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : bragging EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: And I got a little present for those Muties when they come back. You know what it is? This kick-ass gun. That's what! Yeah baby!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些该死的变种人要是回来，我为他们准备了一个小礼物。知道什么吗？他妈的枪，就是这，可爱的宝贝！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flash [0602796B] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : bragging EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's making a move! Stop him!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他跑了！截住他！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood of Steel Paladin [000A41A0] (mod) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's making a move! Stop her!
ESP.TRADUIT: 她跑了！截住她！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood of Steel Paladin [000A41A0] (mod) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's all here. <Give 50 Caps.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 都在这。<给予50个瓶盖>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. This will just take a second.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。很快就会完成。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shouldn't take but a moment. Hold still please.
ESP.TRADUIT: 稍后再来拿。耐心等候。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sigh. Come back when you do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唉。当你完成后再回来吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oops. I don't have that much. Sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哎呀，我没有那么多瓶盖，抱歉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here you go. <Give 75 Caps.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的。<给予75个瓶盖>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks. Now hold still, you don't want me to slip when holding sharp objects.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢。现在拿好，你不会希望在你拿着尖物时，我刚好滑倒吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good, good. Now let's see if we can fix you up quickly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，好。现在看看我们能不能治好你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not a charity worker. Come back when you have the caps, and we'll do business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我并不是教堂义工。等你有瓶盖时再回来找我吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oops. I don't have that much. Sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哎呀，我没有那么多瓶盖，抱歉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, here are the caps. <Give 100 Caps.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，这是你的瓶盖。<给予100个瓶盖>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. Now, hold still. This is going to hurt like hell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好。现在别动，会很疼，但要忍住。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bite down, this is going to smart.
ESP.TRADUIT: 搞定了，现在你会更聪明。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sigh. Come back when you do!
ESP.TRADUIT: 唉。等你决定后再回来吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oops. I don't have that much. Sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哎呀，我没有那么多瓶盖，抱歉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmmm... I don't think so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唔……我不同意你的看法。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'm not a charity worker. Especially with humans. You want me to fix you up, bring caps next time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我可不是教堂义工。特别对一个人类来说。你需要我修好你，那就得付瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm injured. Anything you can do for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我受伤了，你能治好我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Certainly, we can help you. Please speak to Doctor Barrows.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我们可以帮助你，请和巴罗斯医生谈谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and we only take caps... no barter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我们只收瓶盖……不讨价还价。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've never met a talking tree before.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从没见过一棵会说话的树！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Neither have I. Well, I mean I talk to Herbert, but he never really says anything back. Do ya Herbert?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也是第一次。嗯，我是说我与赫伯特说话，但他从来不回应我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He kept growing around me, maybe for calling him Herbert all the time. His name's really Bob. I think it's funny when I call him Herbert though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他总是在我周围生长，或许是我一直叫他赫伯特的缘故。他的真名叫鲍勃，但我觉得称他赫伯特是很好笑的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The front desk computer has access to the card catalogs, but it appears that it's lost the connection to the main archives.
ESP.TRADUIT: 前面桌子上的那台电脑可以连接到卡片目录，但看起来已经失去了与主档案库的连接。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's the password. Now, you might be able to find the central computer further in there, but I'm afraid you'll have to do that without me. I'm a scholar, not a fighter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是密码。现在，你也许能在里面找到中央电脑，但恐怕得你一个人进去了，我毕竟是学者，不是战士。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you help me access the library's archives?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能帮我登陆图书馆的档案库吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know it was a lot to ask, but we made a great piece! And it's bound to help humanity, you know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道这要求可能有点过分，可我们是在做大事！并且人类必须得到帮助，你知道的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll share these with the traders, and soon, everyone will know about the Wasteland Survival Guide!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我将会与商人分享这些，并且很快的，每个人都将知道这废土生存手册！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: But before that, here's your complimentary copy, complete with my compliments. Good work, Wasteland survival assistant!
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这之前，我先给你一本赠送版本，作为我对你的感激。你干得很好，真是个废土生存助手！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just glad I can stop getting stabbed, irradiated, and shot for your science.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很高兴我不用再为了你的科学研究而被刺伤、被辐射还有被射击了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And if it wasn't for that fearless fortitude and sacrifice for science, it wouldn't have been made. It'll be a tremendous boon to humanity, you know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要不是因为有着大无畏的坚韧，还有对科学所做出的牺牲，我们根本不可能做到。这将是对人类巨大的恩惠，你知道吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll share these with the traders, and soon, everyone will know about the Wasteland Survival Guide!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我将会与商人分享这些，并且很快的，每个人都将知道这废土生存手册！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: But first, here -- the very first copy of our book goes to you. I couldn't have done it without you, my Wasteland survival expert!
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这之前，给你 — 我们共同出版的第一本书。我一个人是不可能完成这本书的，我的废土生存专家！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I went through a lot of pain for that. It had better be worth it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了这本书我吃尽了苦头。它最好值得这一切。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And those risks will have saved hundreds -- no, thousands of lives! Your quality research really took it to the next level, you know!
ESP.TRADUIT: 并且你所冒的风险将会拯救成百上千人的性命 — 不，是成千上万人的性命！要知道你的品格已经达到了另一个境界！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll share these with the traders, and soon, everyone will know about the Wasteland Survival Guide!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我将会与商人分享这些，并且很快的，每个人都将知道这废土生存手册！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: But now, the very first copy of our book goes to you. It wouldn't nearly be as good without your input. You're the real Wasteland survival guru!
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这之前，给你 — 我们共同出版的第一本书。我一个人是不可能完成这本书的，我的废土生存权威！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I should hope so. I nearly killed myself a half dozen times for that thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望如此。为了这我又好几次几乎送命。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh my... It's... it's brilliant! Even I'm astounded by my genius! Oh no, no, it's more than that. By OUR genius!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，天啊……这真是太棒了！我为自己的天才举动感到吃惊！不，不仅仅是我，是我们的天才举动！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll share these with the traders, and soon, everyone will know about the Wasteland Survival Guide!
