ESP.TRADUIT: 我将会与商人分享这些，并且很快的，每个人都将知道这废土生存手册！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: But now, the very first copy of our book goes to you. It wouldn't nearly be as good without your input. You're the real Wasteland survival guru!
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这之前，给你 — 我们共同出版的第一本书。我一个人是不可能完成这本书的，我的废土生存权威！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: It certainly was an epic piece of work. So, is the final product worth it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一项传奇般的工作。然而最终的价值呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: She did? Well, suppose I've picked up a lot over the years. I mean, no one's spent more time tinkering on this old girl than I have!
ESP.TRADUIT: 她真这么说？嗯，我在她身上花了好多年心思了。我的意思是，有谁能比我打理这老女孩的时间多啊！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Seagrave Holmes [060156BB] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, Rivet City, I mean. Not Vera. I mean, Vera's not old. And I haven't tinkered on her, obviously. Not that I wouldn't... I mean, umm... No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，铆钉城，我的意思是。不是薇拉。薇拉并不老。我也没打理过她，显然的。并不是说我不会去这么做的，唔……不会的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Seagrave Holmes [060156BB] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyway, you might find some clues in Pinkerton's place, in the broken-off bow. He was around before me, and used to store stuff there before he left.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总之，你可以在平克顿那找到线索，在断裂的船头。他之前一直在那，离开前他把东西都存那儿了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Seagrave Holmes [060156BB] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Vera spoke very highly of you. She says you know all about this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 薇拉十分看重你。她说你知道这地方的一切。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hah! Sounds like you've been poking around, all right. I'm surprised any of those reprobates even remember me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊哈！看来你一直在四处打听，好吧。那帮无赖竟然还记得我，让我很吃惊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe they still laugh about how they edged me out of the council, back then. But you can set the record straight!
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许他们还在嘲笑我被赶出议会那事。但你可以告诉大家事情的真相！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hear you're the only one who knows the truth about Rivet City's founding.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说你是唯一一个知道铆钉城建立真相的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, yes, but it was hardly any place of importance until I arrived on the scene. That's all ancient history now. No one would ever care about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，是啊，我来这儿的时候没什么大事发生。那些久远的历史，谁会去在意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bannon [060156B5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you insist on wasting your time on that, you could try that bartending old crone down below, Belle Bonny.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你还打算在这上面浪费时间的话，你可以去下面那酒吧，问问吧台的老混蛋贝勒·邦尼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bannon [060156B5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hasn't Rivet City been around for longer than twelve years?
ESP.TRADUIT: 铆钉城建立还不到十二年吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, yes, but it was hardly any place of importance until I arrived on the scene. That's all ancient history now. No one would ever care about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，是啊，我来这儿的时候没什么大事发生。那些久远的历史，谁会去在意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bannon [060156B5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're going to waste someone's time on that, go bother that idiot, Seagrave Holmes. He spends all his time in the bowels of this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你还打算在这上面浪费时间的话，你可去跟那傻瓜谈谈，西格雷夫·福尔摩斯。他一直在船内游荡。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bannon [060156B5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hasn't Rivet City been around for longer than twelve years?
ESP.TRADUIT: 铆钉城建立还不到十二年吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, yes, but it was hardly any place of importance until I arrived on the scene. That's all ancient history now. No one would ever care about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，是啊，我来这儿的时候没什么大事发生。那些久远的历史，谁会去在意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bannon [060156B5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hasn't Rivet City been around for longer than twelve years?
ESP.TRADUIT: 铆钉城建立还不到十二年吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Last feller I remember from back then was Mr. Pinkerton, and he must've left about a decade ago, after that spat with the science team.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我记得以前有过一个叫平克顿先生的人，十多年前，在那科学团队来这之后，他就离开了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Seagrave Holmes [060156BB] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: He used to have a storage shed in the broken-off bow of the ship; we always thought he was crazy for keeping stuff there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他通常在断裂的船头的舱室。那时候我们总是把他当成疯子，因为他竟然待在那种鬼地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Seagrave Holmes [060156BB] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Might have kept a couple records down there, I guess. Careful, though; ship's a bit treacherous down there in her belly!
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许会有一些纪录在那，我想。不过要小心。那地方有很多陷阱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Seagrave Holmes [060156BB] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you think of anyone from back then that might know more?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认识谁会知道的多一些？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Could I ask you about Rivet City's history?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能问你一下关于铆钉城的历史吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard the place was settled by mercenaries who used to scavenge D.C. But I don't really know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说这是由一群在华盛顿捡破烂的家伙建立的，他们都是些唯利是图的家伙。不过话说回来，我还真不知道是怎么回事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Angela Staley [060156BD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, it's not the past of the city that I dwell upon, but the future of its inhabitants.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，这我没有研究过，我只仔细研究过现在的这些居民。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: But if you're interested, I believe Miss Weatherly or Mr. Bannon would be glad to speak with you on the subject.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是如果你感兴趣的话，我相信韦瑟利女士或者班侬先生可能会很高兴跟你谈论这种话题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you know about Rivet City's history?
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于铆钉城的历史你知道多少？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, it's not the past of the city that I dwell upon, but the future of its inhabitants.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，这我没有研究过，我只仔细研究过现在的这些居民。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: But if you're interested, I believe Mr. Bannon would be glad to speak with you on the subject.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是如果你感兴趣的话，我相信班侬先生可能会很高兴跟你谈论这种话题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you know about Rivet City's history?
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于铆钉城的历史你知道多少？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, thank you. Please leave Mr. Zimmer and myself alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，谢谢。请让齐默先生和我独自待会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Armitage [0601E7AE] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Know anything about the history of Rivet City?
ESP.TRADUIT: 知道有关铆钉城的历史吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: But why do you waste your talents on this garbage?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是你为什么要把智慧浪费在这些破烂上面？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not garbage! But don't be fooled - it is junk. It's just junk that's pretty important stuff, you know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些不是破烂！不要被骗了 — 是废物，是非常有用的废物，你懂吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Junk can be turned into all sorts of useful things. And sometimes, even something wonderful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 破烂可以变成很多很有用的东西。甚至还可以做出非常棒的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: And junk's all we've got left after the world blew up. Everyone's trying to fix it like it was, but nobody's trying to make something that's better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在世界崩坏之后，我们所能找到的就只有破烂了。每个人都在尝试着把这世界修复，但是没有人去把它变成比以前更好的世界。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't understand. Crazy experiments are what keep you going?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不理解。你的目标就是疯狂的实验？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. It's like... Did you ever try to put a broken piece of glass back together? Even if the pieces fit, you can't make it whole again the way it was.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是的。我做的这些更像是……你曾尝试过把碎了的玻璃重新拼接起来吗？即使这些小碎片互相吻合，你也不能把这些碎玻璃还原成原来的模样了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide Comment (NAM2) : Hesitatingly, having trouble putting her feelings into words. EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: But if you're clever, you can still use the pieces to make other useful things. Maybe even something wonderful, like a mosaic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但如果你要是聪明点的话，你可以用这些废铜烂铁来做一些有用的东西。或许能做出相当不错的东西，像镶嵌画什么的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide Comment (NAM2) : Hesitatingly, having trouble putting her feelings into words. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, the world broke just like the glass. And everyone's trying to put it back together like it was, but it'll never come together the same way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这世界就像是玻璃一样碎了。每个人都在想尽办法把支离破碎的世界重新拼接起来，但是它已不可能恢复到原本的样子了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide Comment (NAM2) : Hesitatingly, having trouble putting her feelings into words. EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take the Recon Armor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想要侦察护甲。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, here you go. I hope it fits.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，给你，希望合身。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you think you can handle this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你怎么办？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take the Power Armor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想要那动力装甲。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure thing. Hopefully it'll give you a bit of an extra edge.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。希望这对你有所帮助。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, so do you think you can hold it together for this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。你觉得能把这放在一起？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get some suppressing fire over there, now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 来点惊喜之火，立刻！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you ever considered getting back out there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想没想过离开那？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No offense, kid, but you're not exactly the type I'm used to runnin' with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有恶意，孩子，一般来说我是不会和你这种人打交道的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've heard about you -- a lil' goody two shoes out of the Vault. I don't think our styles would really mesh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说过你 — 在避难所你一直是个两面派。我认为像你这样的人，和我是合不来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nah, it ain't so bad here. I got some good memories, but that's all I got. No sense in ruining the good ones, you know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，这其实也不错。我也有些好的回忆，但那是我的所有了。没理由破坏美好的东西，是吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you interested in joining up with me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有兴趣加入我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No offense. You seem okay, kid. But your friend there, well... I'm used to working in smaller groups.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有恶意，你看起来不错，孩子。但你那些朋友……嗯，我习惯在规模小一点的队伍里做事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come back when you're alone and maybe we can work something out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你独自回来的话，或许我可以考虑下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you interested in joining up with me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有兴趣加入我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know what? Forget I said anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道什么？忘了我说的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why the fuck would you start saying it if you weren't going to finish. Back out where? What are you talking about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你他妈的不想把话说完，就别和我废话。还能去哪？你在说什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, really. Never mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，真的。不要介意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see how it is. You'd best think twice before fucking with me again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。在你他妈的惹我之前，最好给我想清楚了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because you've always been a goody two-shoes, so when I need help, it's what you're gonna do, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为你总是充好人，所以当我需要帮助时，你就会帮我，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're going to help Amata anyway, right? Just make it so we can leave the Vault, and I'll leave and never bother you again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 反正你也要帮阿玛塔，对吗？帮帮我们，这样我们就可以离开避难所，我也不会再来烦你了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why should I help you, Butch?
ESP.TRADUIT: 布奇，我为什么要帮你？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I know I've been kind of a jerk. But I don't deserve to be stuck down here forever. Not when I could have a real life up there like you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看，我知道我曾经很混蛋。但是我也不应该在这里被关上一辈子。我现在有机会跟你一样，到外面去过真正的生活。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean, you're kind of a jerk sometimes, and you make it work up there. So why not me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是说，你有时候也挺混蛋，这在外面就派上了用场。我怎么就不能呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just make it so we can leave the Vault, and I can go out there for my new life. Heck, maybe we could form a gang, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 帮帮我们吧，好让我离开避难所，到外面开始新的生活。对了，或许我们可以成立一个帮派，呃？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why should I help you, Butch?
ESP.TRADUIT: 布奇，我为什么要帮你？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You left this place, so I bet you hate it as much as I do. So you can imagine how crappy it'd be to be stuck down here forever, yeah?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你离开了这里，所以我打赌你和我一样，恨透了这里。你应该能想象出来在这下面被困一辈子有多糟糕，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you gonna force all of us to live like that, now that we've learned we could actually leave and try for something new?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在我们已经知道我们可以离开，去接触新的环境，你却还要迫使我们像这样生活吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just make it so we can get out of this vault, and I'll be gone, man. Then you don't ever need to see me again, okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 帮帮我们,好让我们离开这里，然后我就远走。你再也不必见到我，好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why should I help you, Butch?
ESP.TRADUIT: 布奇，我为什么要帮你？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Give it up, Autumn. You've lost.
ESP.TRADUIT: 放弃吧，奥特姆。你已经失败了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I beg to differ. The Enclave is at the height of its power.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可不这么认为。英克雷可正处于全盛时期。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colonel Autumn [06019A1F] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once this facility is operational, the masses will flock to the Enclave for fresh water, protection, and a plan for the future.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一旦这工厂开始运作起来，大量的人群将会聚集到英克雷，获取净水，寻求保护, 并且开始为将来做打算。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colonel Autumn [06019A1F] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe I have. What's it worth to you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许我见过。不过你会给我什么好处？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, I'll bite. Here's 50 caps. Now where are those damn runners?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，我会给你报酬。50个瓶盖，现在快告诉我，那些逃跑的奴隶在哪？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slaver [0602FB1F] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : grudgingly EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I kill you, every Treeminder will come after me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我杀了你，每个树启者都不会饶了我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh no no, don't worry about them. When you decide to go down there, I'll have a little chat with Birch and the rest of the gang.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，不必担心。如果你打算帮我的话，我会跟布瑞奇以及其他成员谈谈这件事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They usually don't understand a word I say, but I'll make em' come around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说的话他们根本听不懂，不过这次我会让他们明白的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You want me to murder you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想让我杀了你？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh no, no, no, no, no. It wouldn't be murder. You'd be doing me a favor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，不不不，不要说得那么可怕，我只是让你帮我个忙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You see, I've been stuck here for over two decades now... rooted right into the ground.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看，我在这都已经有20多年了……根都已经很深了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only friends I've got are Bob and those weirdos out there who think I'm a god.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我唯一的朋友就是鲍勃和这些把我当成神的家伙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, let's cut the bullshit and get to the matter at hand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看我们是不是应该进入正题，少说这种无聊的废话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, you're right of course, of course, I completely agree. Or I guess WE completely agree... me and Bob that is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，你是对的，我完全同意。或者该说我们完全同意……也就是我和鲍勃。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had you brought in here to ask a very simple favor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把你带到这只是求你帮我个小忙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Would you please kill me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以杀了我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A genetic mutation of that magnitude could only be caused by F.E.V.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大量的基因突变只可能是F.E.V.引起的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa-ho! Check out the brain on this guy!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇！快看那家伙的头！

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was a long time ago... I tend to lose track.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是很久以前的事了……我曾试着去忘记这件事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was exploring some sort of a military base with some other people... I think it was called Mariposa.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我曾经跟一些人去寻找军事基地……我记得那军事基地好像是叫做梅尔博萨。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We were pretty deep inside and we found some weird vats of this nasty green goo. Right when we were about to leave, I think we were attacked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们那时候深入军事基地，并且找到了一些装着奇怪的绿色物质的大桶。就在我们要离开的时候，遭到了攻击。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Last thing I remember before blacking out was something knocking my friend into the stuff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我晕倒之前，我记得的最后的一件事就是，我的朋友被什么东西砸到了那大桶里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should come with me. I could use a hand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以和我一起走，我也能多个帮手。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No offense, kid, but you're not exactly the type I'm used to runnin' with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有恶意，孩子，一般来说我是不会和你这种人打交道的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've heard about you -- a lil' goody two shoes out of the Vault. I don't think our styles would really mesh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说过你 — 在避难所你一直是个两面派。我认为像你这样的人，和我是合不来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nah, it ain't so bad here. I got some good memories, but that's all I got. No sense in ruining the good ones, you know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，这其实也不错。我也有些好的回忆，但那是我的所有了。没理由破坏美好的东西，是吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No offense. You seem okay, kid. But your friend there, well... I'm used to working in smaller groups.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有恶意，你看起来不错，孩子。但你那些朋友……嗯，我习惯在规模小一点的队伍里做事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come back when you're alone and maybe we can work something out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你独自回来的话，或许我可以考虑下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have anything for sale?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么东西要卖吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. Have a look. I guess folks in Megaton won't be needing them anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。看一下吧。我猜核弹镇的居民再也用不上它们了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a few things. May as well sell them to you as cart them all the way back to Megaton.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一些东西。与其把它们装车运回核弹镇，还不如卖给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take a look. Welcome to ... Godforsaken Hellhole! Not much to look at, but it's all mine. Ha ha ha!
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看。欢迎来到……遗弃之所！看起来很一般，但这些全都是我的。哈哈哈！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : cackles maniacally at his own "joke" EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everything has its price. Take a look and make me an offer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 任何东西都有个价。都看看吧，然后出个价。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A few odds and ends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一些零碎的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If the price is right. Make me an offer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果觉得价钱合适，就告诉我吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Various things. You never know what might come in handy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 各种各样的货物，没准有些你能用上。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you selling?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你都卖什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You might be surprised at what you can use to keep a robot working.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你或许会对这拿来维持机器人工作的东西感到惊讶。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you selling?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你都卖什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have a look and see for yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便看看，给自己挑点东西吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you selling?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你都卖什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Various things. You never know what might come in handy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 各种各样的货物，没准有些你能用上。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you selling?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你都卖什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You might be surprised at what you can use to keep a robot working.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你或许会对这拿来维持机器人工作的东西感到惊讶。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you selling?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你都卖什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have a look and see for yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便看看，给自己挑点东西吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you selling?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你都卖什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here you go. Let's get out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得好。那我们离开这吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Haha! This is gonna be great! Some good ol' fashioned violence!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈！这真是好极了！来点痛快时尚的暴力美学吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well what'd you get my hopes up for? I can't head out there without supplies, now can I?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，你又为什么要重燃我的激情呢？没有补给我就没法出去闯荡，我的补给呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell you what: the offer's open. Just come back when you've got the thousand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟你说吧：大门是敞开的。搞到1000后回来找我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, I don't have 1,000 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，我没有1000个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks, Agatha. It's more than I expected.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢，阿加莎。这太让人惊喜了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're welcome. Just keep it clean and repaired and it will never let you down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别客气。只要及时保养并清理，它就永远不会让你失望。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, scoot. I have to get cracking on this music notation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 出发吧，就现在。我要花些时间钻研这些音符了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, no, no. You keep it. You may need it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，这不好。你留着它吧。会用得上的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nonsense. I've never fired a gun before in my life and I'm not about to start any time soon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 荒唐。我这辈子从来没开过枪，而且也不准备去试试开一枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You take this thing and use it to protect yourself while you're out there. I'll be just fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把这个拿去，用它好好保护自己吧，放心，我在这会很好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here. Now, scoot. I have a lot of music to write.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，那就走吧。我还有很多音乐要创作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It better be good. I busted my ass getting that paper.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这样更好。这手纸擦屁股都嫌太硬了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Manners are not your strong suit, are they?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好像不知道什么叫礼貌，不是吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take this pistol. It's all I have left. Use it to protect yourself, or shoot yourself in the foot for all I care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，把这手枪拿去，孩子。我就这么点东西了。用它来保护自己，或者朝自己脚趾头放枪什么的，我也就能操这么点心了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now if you don't mind, I need to get some things done. Goodbye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在如果你不介意的话，我还有事要忙。走好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, no. Having you write it down is reward enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不用，不用。让你写下它就已经是很好的报酬了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm speechless. Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没话说了。谢谢你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're welcome here any time. Consider my house as a safe haven if you're ever in the area.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论何时都欢迎你回来，当你经过这时，请将这当作自己的家。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, let me get writing. So much to do!
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，让我开始写吧。还有很多要做的呢！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should write your music down, to keep it preserved for the future.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你应该把你的音乐写下来，将它们永远流传下去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My word! You actually found some REAL music paper? I didn't even think it possible.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的天啊！你真的找到一些真正的乐谱纸？这我可连想都未曾想过。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yet here it is. You've really outdone yourself this time. I knew getting the Stradivarius was a challenge, but this is just incredible.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在事实摆在眼前。你这次真的让人刮目相看。我知道取得斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴是个很大的挑战，但这真是让人难以置信。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is all too much... you deserve more than just a pat on the back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这太多了……你应该得到比拍肩鼓励还多的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Guess what I have for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 猜猜我给你准备了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I suppose I could. They aren't my pieces of music by any stretch of the imagination though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我想我可以。尽管那些并不是我自己想像的音乐。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I took a little peek at the files in your computer. Tell me about the android.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我随便看了一眼你电脑里的文件。和我谈谈人造人的事吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You hacked my computer? You've got some skills. It's been a while since I've met someone smart enough to best me. So I'll let that slide.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你破解了我的电脑？还真有两下子。我很久没见过能和我相提并论的聪明人了。所以我就不追究了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : bragging

ESP.ORIGINAL: I documented the whole thing. So I could rub it in the face of Dr. Li when I need to rankle her feathers. I hate that snooty bitch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把所有的东西都存档了。如果我想激怒她，我就在李博士的面前戳她的痛处。我讨厌那自大的婊子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : bragging

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's on the menu?
ESP.TRADUIT: 菜单上都有什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're in for a treat, the finest food in D.C. Four stars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请上座，这是全华盛顿特区最好的料理。四星级水准。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're lucky, maybe it's gone rancid already. MmmmMmmmm...
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你运气够好，或许那上面的腐臭味道已经消散了。唔…………

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need a drink.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要来点饮料。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let ol' Uncle Ahzrukhal help you get rid of the pain.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让阿祖卡大叔帮你解除痛苦吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A city full of Ghouls, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个满是尸鬼的城市，嗯？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's right. As long as you don't bother us, we won't bother you. Feel free to come and go, trade, sleep, whatever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。只要你不找我们的麻烦，我们也不会打搅你。往来自便，不管交易还是住宿，什么都行。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just make sure that you leave whatever trouble is following you at the door, because we don't want it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 进门前请确认自己没有麻烦缠身，因为我们不想有麻烦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, enjoy your stay, smoothskin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，祝您愉快，光皮肤。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Brotherhood of Steel? What's your beef with them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 钢铁兄弟会？你们跟他们会有什么牵连？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bastards. They don't seem to be able to tell us apart from the Super Mutants. Or, maybe they just don't care. They see us and shoot on sight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些禽兽！他们似乎看不出我们与超级变种人的区别。或者，他们根本就不在乎。反正他们一看见我们就开枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: At least they have the common courtesy to miss most of the time. Still... bigots.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢天谢地，绝大多数的时间他们都打不中。不过……顽固派。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jesus Christ! What are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的天啊！你是什么东西？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got wax in your ears? We're Ghouls -- mutants with rotting flesh. It's not a big deal, I got used to it. So will you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你耳朵堵上了？我们是僵尸 — 一种表皮腐烂的变种人而已。这没什么大不了的，我已经习惯了，你也会的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know, never mind. I'm a Ghoul. Everyone down here: Ghouls. That's what we are. And before you ask "what's a Ghoul", lemme tell you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，别在意。我，一个僵尸。这里所有的人，一群僵尸。就是我们啦。在你问“僵尸是个什么”之前，我先告诉你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're not the walking dead, despite the rotten flesh and the smell. We're mutants... sort of. At least, I think we are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不是那种行尸，尽管表皮腐烂有异味。我们只是变种人……的一种。至少，我认为是……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait... what are you again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等……你又是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, well, I can learn, can't I? If you can do it, it's gotta be pretty easy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，嗯，我可以学习，不是吗？如果你能教我，事情就会变得十分简单。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe I can form a gang of my own. Maybe call it the Wasteland Radicals, or maybe the Rad Scorpions. Hey, wanna join?
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许我可以自己成立个帮派。我们可以叫废土激进分子，或者辐射蝎。嗨，你想加入吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wouldn't be so excited. You have no idea what you're in for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可不会这么激动。你不知道你将要面对的是什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you kidding me? It's a dream come true, man! Butch the Hairdresser is no more, now I'm gonna be Butch the Wasteland Wanderer!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你开玩笑吗？这简直是梦想成真，哥们！理发师布奇已经是历史了，现在我是废土游民布奇了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe I can form a gang of my own. Maybe call it the Wasteland Radicals, or maybe the Rad Scorpions. Hey, wanna join?
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许我可以自己成立个帮派。我们可以叫废土激进分子，或者辐射蝎。嗨，你想加入吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're taking this pretty well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来你接受了这状况。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What?! This is terrible! The vault will become uninhabitable!
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？！这太可怕了！避难所将变得不能居住！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: How the hell can this be happening?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这怎么可能？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Vault's life support systems have failed. We need to evacuate immediately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 避难所的生命维持系统崩溃了。我们得马上撤离。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What?! This is terrible! The vault will become uninhabitable!
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？！这太可怕了！避难所将变得不能居住！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [0602549E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: How the hell can this be happening?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这怎么可能？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [0602549E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Vault's life support systems have failed. We need to evacuate immediately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 避难所的生命维持系统崩溃了。我们得马上撤离。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh my god. The Vault's doomed. Everyone has to evacuate, and there's no way most of them will survive out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的上帝啊，避难所完蛋了，所有人都必须撤离，而出去之后大多数人都无法生存。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [0602549E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did this happen?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这一切是怎么发生的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [0602549E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Vault's life support systems have failed. We need to evacuate immediately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 避难所的生命维持系统崩溃了。我们得马上撤离。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What in the world? This is insane! We've got to get people to safety! But where can we go?
ESP.TRADUIT: 到底怎么回事？这太疯狂了！我们要让大家去一个安全的地方！但是我们能到哪去？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06027057] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh my god... There's only one solution, isn't there? Outside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的上帝……只有一条出路，不是吗？去外面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06027057] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're gonna make sure we're okay out there, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你将确保我们出去都会平安无事，对吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06027057] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Vault's life support systems have failed. We need to evacuate immediately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 避难所的生命维持系统崩溃了。我们得马上撤离。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? Score!
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？好极了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goodbye, hellhole! I'm off to a new life!
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见，破地方！我要开始新生活了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Vault's life support systems have failed. We need to evacuate immediately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 避难所的生命维持系统崩溃了。我们得马上撤离。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Congratulations, young man! I don’t have to tell you how special this day is, do I?
ESP.TRADUIT: 祝贺你！小伙子！我不用说今天有多么特别了吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060300F0] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Congratulations, young lady! I don’t have to tell you how special this day is, do I?
ESP.TRADUIT: 祝贺你！小姑娘！我不用说今天有多么特别了吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060300F0] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Down here in Vault 101, when you turn 10, well, you’re ready to take on your first official Vault responsibilities.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在101号避难所里，一旦10岁，就要承担第一份正式的避难所的职责了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060300F0] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: So here you are. As Overseer, I hereby present to you your very own Pip-Boy 3000! Get used to it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你。作为监督者，我将授予你哔哔小子3000！好好使用它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060300F0] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, but...
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，不过……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Talk. To. Ahzrukhal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去跟阿祖卡说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不在乎。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只不过……

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不在乎。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope you brought me something better than last year.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望你今年的礼物比去年的更好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well now! Young people were more polite back in my day. Respected their elders. Of course, we had a real Overseer back then. Worthy of respect.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这样啊！在我们那年代，年轻人更有礼貌，更懂得尊敬长辈。当然，那时我们也有一个货真价实的监督者，值得尊敬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060309A7] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not like that one over there, with his rules and his secrets. Why, I have half a mind to just up and tell you...
ESP.TRADUIT: 不像那边那家伙，有一堆自以为是的规定和见不得人的秘密。噢，我只是随口说说而已……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060309A7] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh my, there I go again with my old lady talk and you still waiting patiently for your present.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊，我又犯喜欢唠叨的老毛病了，而你还是如此耐心。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose you could have asked more politely, but it is still your birthday, so here you go: a nice sweetroll I baked just for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你愿该更加礼貌些，但这是你的生日，好吧，给你：我刚给你烤好的甜面包卷。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060309A7] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you didn't have to bring me a present, Mrs. Palmer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你用不着送我礼物的，帕尔默夫人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fiddlesticks! What 10-year-old doesn't like presents?
ESP.TRADUIT: 胡说！哪有不喜欢礼物的10岁孩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060309A7] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was 10 once, believe it or not! My goodness, the Vault was practically crowded back then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也曾有过10岁，信不信由你！天啊，那时候避难所里好多人啊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060309A7] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not like today. So few young people now... But here I am rambling on again, and you listening so politely.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不像现在。只有很少年轻人……我怎么又开始唠叨了，你倒一直很有礼貌的听着……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060309A7] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here you go, a nice sweetroll that I baked for you just this morning. And it's all for you -- no sharing required today!
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你，我今天早上刚细心烤好的甜面包卷。而且这是给你的 — 今天用不着分给别人！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060309A7] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, ma'am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，女士。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Such a nice polite young man you are! Don't ever lose your gift of speaking your mind so directly. We could use more of that down here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真是个懂礼貌的年轻人！不要丢掉你直言不讳的性格，在这我们需要像你这样的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060309A7] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here you go, a nice sweetroll that I baked for you just this morning. And it's all for you -- you're the birthday boy, no sharing required today!
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你，我今天早上刚细心烤好的甜面包卷。而且这是给你的 — 今天用不着分给别人！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060309A7] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Such a nice polite young lady you are! Don't ever lose your gift of speaking your mind so directly. We could use more of that down here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真是个懂礼貌的年轻人！不要丢掉你直言不讳的性格，在这我们需要像你这样的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060309A7] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here you go, a nice sweetroll that I baked for you just this morning. And it's all for you -- you're the birthday girl, no sharing required today!
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你，我今天早上刚细心烤好的甜面包卷。而且这是给你的 — 今天用不着分给别人！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060309A7] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha ha ha! You told her, Butch!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈哈！你跟她说了，布奇！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paul Hannon [060300EB] (mod) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast Comment (NAM2) : One of Butch's moronic pals chiming in to insult the player EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Or else what? Yeah, thought so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不然怎样？嗯，我想也是。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shut up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 闭嘴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Glad to hear that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听见这些很高兴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Crazy how it sneaks up on you, y'know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些东西悄悄地靠近你，这太疯狂了，你懂吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's none of your business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那与你无关。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um, yeah.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Was I supposed to do it? I didn't hear Dave saying we had to!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我一定要这么做吗？我没听戴夫说过我们要这样！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, but it'd be better if I could vote.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，但是如果我能投票的话更好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ugh why can't I just vote now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，为什么我不能现在就投票？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Santa Claus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 圣诞老人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um, I guess so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唔，我猜是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't believe it's only a couple of days away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 难以置信才过去这么几天。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not a betrayal. This is a free, um, nation... right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是叛国。这是个自由的……呃，国度……对吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It could be pretty tough, I guess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想那很艰难。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm, maybe you're right. More trouble than it's worth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，或许你说的对。它带来的麻烦更甚于它的价值。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you considered running for the presidency?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你考虑过参加总统竞选吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm too young! I can't even vote yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我太年轻了！我连投票权都没有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No way! You'd have to be crazy to run against him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没门！你和他竞选简直就是疯了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Believe it or not, I used to lead a group bigger than this one on an old caravan route.
ESP.TRADUIT: 信不信由你，以前我曾领导过一个比这还大的商队。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I did it for years... and we did pretty well for ourselves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我干了好几年……而且我们干得很出色。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But what am I talking about? Running against Dave would be like betraying him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是我在说什么啊？跟戴夫竞选不就等于是背叛他吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Man, I'd love to be the president. Everybody would have to listen to me or I could just exile them to the Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊，我好想当总统。所有人都得听我的，要不我就把他们流放到外头去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And the first thing I'd do is make myself the permanent leader so they couldn't vote me out in some other election.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而且首先我要让自己成为永远的领袖，这样他们就不能靠选举让我下台。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But there's no need for me to run. One year Dave is just going to make me the leader, just like my Grandpa Tom did for him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是我没必要参选。总有一天戴夫就会让我成为领袖，就像我的爷爷汤姆当年做的那样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to throw my hat into the ring and run for the presidency.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想参与其中，参加总统竞选。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, but the president must be a citizen of the Republic to run for office. So you do not qualify.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很遗憾，但是总统必须由共和国公民来担当。因此你不具备资格。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um, did Dave say you could do that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，戴夫允许你那样做了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's running in the election?
ESP.TRADUIT: 都有谁参加选举？

ESP.ORIGINAL: An opponent? Seriously? But... but... Wait. No, this is a free republic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 竞争对手？真的？但是……但是……等等。不，这是个自由的共和国。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dave [06029A98] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (After a short pause) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let the people make their choice. I am confident that they will recognize me as their true and proper leader.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让人民做出自己的选择。我自信他们会知道我才是他们真正的领袖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dave [06029A98] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (After a short pause) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looks like you might have an opponent in the race, Mister President.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总统先生，看来你似乎遇到竞争对手了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow, really? I've always said that she'd make a great leader, and we've never had a woman lead us before...
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，真的么？我总是说她会成为一个好领袖，而且我们还从没有过一个女领袖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know, Rosie is running for president now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 萝丝现在在竞选总统。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is? Wow... Dave must be upset.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是吗？哇……戴夫这下一定要紧张了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know, Bob is running for president now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 鲍勃现在在竞选总统。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow, this is the first time we've had so many choices!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，这是第一次我们有这么多的选择！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you heard that both Bob and Rosie are running in the election?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道鲍勃和萝丝在竞选总统吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm, I don't know that he stands much of a chance against Dave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯……我不觉得他对戴夫有什么胜算。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jessica [0602B896] (mod) NPC : Rosie [060309C5] (mod) NPC : Shawna [0602C884] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know, Bob is running for president.
ESP.TRADUIT: 鲍勃现在在竞选总统。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Isn't he a bit young? I mean, Dave's been running the Republic since before Bob was born...
ESP.TRADUIT: 他不会太年轻了么？我的意思是，在鲍勃出生之前戴夫就已经是总统了……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jessica [0602B896] (mod) NPC : Rosie [060309C5] (mod) NPC : Shawna [0602C884] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know, Bob is running for president now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 鲍勃现在在竞选总统。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, absolutely.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，当然。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well then, there you go. An election is what separates a president like myself from a monarch like my father.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那好，随你。正是选举将我这样的总统和我父亲那样的国王区分开来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't consider myself a spy so much as... your assassin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不认为自己是个间谍……我是来刺杀你的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Assassin? And you really thought you could succeed against the Army of Dave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 刺客？你真的觉得你能对付戴夫的军队？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thought you'd get out of here, did you? You little shit. Get back inside, now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你以为你能从这跑了？你这小混蛋！滚进去，快！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Forty [060156A0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise Comment (NAM2) : furious, slightly out of breath EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You! Get back here now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你！立刻回来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Forty [060156A0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're fuckin' dead, you hear me? Dead!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你他妈的死定了。你听见了没？你死定了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Forty [060156A0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Run Sammy, run! We can make it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 萨米快跑，快跑啊！我们能做到！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carter [06030D82] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can have it. I don't even like sweetrolls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你拿去吧。我根本不喜欢甜面包卷。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, right. Thanks, loser. Oh, and happy birthday, ha ha ha ha!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，对了。谢谢你，废物。哦，生日快乐，哈哈哈哈！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060300EA] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mrs. Palmer said I didn't have to share. Since it's my birthday...
ESP.TRADUIT: 帕尔默大妈说我不用和别人分享。因为今天我生日……

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Mrs. Palmer said I didn't have to share"... Who's talking about sharing, moron? I want the whole thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: “帕尔默夫人说我不用和别人分享”……谁说要分享了？白痴，我要全部。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060300EA] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast Comment (NAM2) : tough-guy 10 year old EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now are you going to give me that sweetroll, or am I going to have to give you a knuckle sandwich?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在你把甜面包圈给我？否则我给你个大耳光尝尝。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060300EA] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast Comment (NAM2) : tough-guy 10 year old EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, Butch. <Spit on the sweetroll and give it to him.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，布奇。<拿出甜面包卷啐了口然后给他>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gah! I don't want your nerd-cooties! You're going to be sorry you did that. We'll see how tough you are later when the grownups aren't around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恶！我不要你这恶心的东西！你会为你做的后悔的。等旁边没有大人，我们就走着瞧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060300EA] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm doin' fine... fine indeed. How are you? ... I said how are you? What? Are you ignoring me? Stupid asshole robot...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很好……真的很好。你呢？……我说你好？什么？你无视我？蠢货机器人……

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's dead, you know that. Lousy old data tapes...
ESP.TRADUIT: 她已经死了，你知道的。惹人厌的老古董……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, it's great. Everything is perfect. Greta takes good care of us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，一切正常，所有事情都很完美。葛丽泰将我们照顾的很好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And a hello to you, ma'am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 向你问声好，女士。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Scanning... target identified as "Patchwork". Hello, Patchwork. I trust that all is well with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 扫描…… 对象确认：“拼盘”。您好，“拼盘”。我相信你一切都好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Scanning... target identified as "Patchwork". Hello, Patchwork. How are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 扫描…… 对象确认：“拼盘”。您好，“拼盘”。你好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello. How is everything?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好。别来无恙？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hi there, enjoying yourself?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，感觉还好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stop by the clinic, Patchwork. Greta found one of your fingers over in Carol's Place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 到诊断室来下，“拼盘”。葛丽泰在卡洛尔旅馆发现了你的一节拇指。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come by the clinic some time, you're overdue for a sewing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有空到诊所来下，你早该缝几针了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, yes, hello. We covered that already.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是，是，你好。我们已经搞定那些了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Haven't lost anything permanently. Not yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还没有永久性地丢过任何东西，目前为止。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey there, long time, no see! I've got some good stories to tell you later!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，很久不见了啊！我有一些很棒的故事等会跟你说！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey there, you should check out the new stuff I have at the store.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，你应该看看我们商店的新货。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, do you know how to reroute a fan belt? You know, never mind. I'll do it myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，你知道怎么换风扇皮带？嗯……没关系，我自己来吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah... kinda like onions... that's so strange...
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊……就像是洋葱……真奇怪……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, I haven't noticed. At all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 老实说，我没注意。根本没在意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've forgotten the taste of good liquor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经不记得好酒的味道了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dude. Harshing the buzz. Minus five points.
ESP.TRADUIT: 老兄，触响警报。减去5分。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, aren't you a ray of sunshine?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你难道不是一缕阳光吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, yes! Of course, of course, my friend. See me later tonight. We'll make sure that you have all the pick-me-ups that you need.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，没错！当然，当然，我的朋友。晚上见。我保证给你你所需要的提神剂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shhh, say no more. See me later, I'll make sure that you want for nothing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘘，别说了，待会见，我保证你到时会别无所求。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No need to be shy, my friend. I'll make sure that you have everything that you ever need, so long as you have the caps to pay for it, that is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别不好意思，我的朋友，我能满足你的一切需求，只要你身上的瓶盖够多，就是这样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was wondering if I could get... you know... one of the special drinks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不知我能不能得到……你知道……一杯特别的饮料。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm all out of the stuff you sold me yesterday. I need more. Fast.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你昨天卖我的东西已经用光了。我需要更多。赶快！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some people...
ESP.TRADUIT: 有些人……

ESP.ORIGINAL: 2000 is a bit steep. 1200 for all three is a more reasonable offer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 2000个太离谱了。三个一共1200个倒是个合适的总价。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose I can accept that. It's a deal; the kids are yours. I'll have them delivered to the front gate for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我能接受。成交，这些小孩都是你的了。我会把他们送到前门等你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eulogy Jones [0601569F] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I may, you might want to keep a close eye on them. They can be willful at times. Good luck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我建议，你可能得盯着他们。他们有时会很任性，祝你好运。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eulogy Jones [0601569F] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That sounds like a good deal. I'll take it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来不错，成交。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fair enough. It's a pleasure to do business with you again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很公平，与你做生意是件愉快的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eulogy Jones [0601569F] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll have the kids delivered to the front gate. And, may I recommend keeping a close eye on them? They're clever little bastards.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会把孩子送到前门。同时，我能建议你看紧些吗？他们可是群聪明的小杂种。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eulogy Jones [0601569F] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A wise decision. It's a pleasure to do business with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 明智的抉择。跟你做生意真是很愉快。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eulogy Jones [0601569F] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll have the kids delivered to the front gate. And, may I recommend keeping a close eye on them? They're clever little bastards.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会把孩子送到前门。同时，我能建议你看紧些吗？他们可是群聪明的小杂种。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eulogy Jones [0601569F] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The little shits are your problem now. I see 'em around here again, I'm gonna shoot 'em. We clear?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些小混蛋交给你了。要是我再看见他们在附近游荡，就朝他们开枪，明白了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Forty [060156A0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, kid. There's no such thing as monsters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，孩子。那里没有什么所谓的怪物。

ESP.ORIGINAL: R... really? No monsters?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真……的？没有怪物？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then you can make these things go away!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你把那些东西赶走吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there any special way to hurt them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么特别办法来对付它们？

ESP.ORIGINAL: My pappa had a gun, and he said it hurt those things, but he said they were the dumbest Fuckin' Ants he ever saw.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我爸有枪，他说管用。但他还说那他妈的是他见过的最难缠的蚂蚁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! Comment (NAM2) : On purpose mistake in antenner... the kid forgot the real word. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He kept telling everyone to "shoot for their antenner" whatever that means.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他总是不断地对大家说“打它们的触须”，不知道那是什么意思。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! Comment (NAM2) : On purpose mistake in antenner... the kid forgot the real word. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have they always been around?
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们总在这附近？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Naw. Those things started coming around only in the last few months.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是。那些东西只是最近几个月才开始出现的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: At first they just crawled around outside our town, but later they came into town and... well, you know the rest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一开始它们只是在镇子外面活动，但是最近它们开始在镇子里……嗯，就如你先前所见的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay kid, I said I'd do it. Now scram!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好啦，孩子，我会帮你的。别哭啦！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Humph... you don't gotta be such a jerk about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哼……你还不是太蠢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's an old portashelter next to the diner near my house. I'll be waiting inside for you to come back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我家与餐厅旁有一个圆形遮蔽所。我在那等你回来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And don't you dare leave me alone!
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有你别想把我一个人扔在这。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there anywhere you can hide while I search?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我去找你爸爸的时候你不应该找个地方躲起来吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, there is the personal shelter next to the old diner.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，有一个圆形遮蔽所就在餐厅旁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pappa always said to stay away from it... but, I guess it's supposed to be safe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 爸爸总是让我离那远点……但我觉得那里面很安全。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll head over there and wait inside. Hurry back!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会躲在那里面。快点回来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. I'll go look for your father.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，我去找你爸爸。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You will? Really? Thanks a whole lot!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要帮我找爸爸？真的？太谢谢了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: My house is the one closest to the huge sign and the old diner.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我家是离那大标记和旧餐厅最近的那间。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please... find my pappa and make him come back!
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜托……找到我爸爸并带他回来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't imagine why she'd be more popular. Even assuming this is all true.
ESP.TRADUIT: 即使这是真的，我也无法想象她为什么会更受欢迎。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What're you suggesting, you little brat? I may not be on the science team anymore, but I still know how to keep records!
ESP.TRADUIT: 小杂种，你想说什么？我或许不再是科学团队的人，但我仍知道怎么保存记录！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here! They probably don't even remember, but I kept the records of that first council meeting. Take them, if it'll put them in their place!
ESP.TRADUIT: 给！他们可能早就忘了，但我还保存着一些首次会议的记录。拿着，如果可以的话就请物尽其用吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have any hard evidence of all this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于这些事，你能拿出什么确凿的证据吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course I do! A good scientist always keeps track of their data!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然有！一个优秀的科学家总是保存着所有的数据资料。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here! They probably don't even remember, but I kept the records of that first council meeting. Take them, if it'll put them in their place!
ESP.TRADUIT: 给！他们可能早就忘了，但我还保存着一些首次会议的记录。拿着，如果可以的话就请物尽其用吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, you used to be in charge? How did you end up here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你以前是掌权的？为何会落到今天这般田地？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That lasted until about 18 years ago, when those ambitious backbiters like Li and her little team showed up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大概是在18年前，当像李和她的团队那样的野心团体萌芽时。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: She came in with her big "Purity Project" pipe dream, and my whole staff started working with her, those traitors!
ESP.TRADUIT: 她带着宏伟的“净化工程”管道梦想而来，我的所有人都开始为她工作，那帮叛徒！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: She even took my seat on the council. By then, I was glad to leave it behind. But hell if I'm leaving the city I made great!
ESP.TRADUIT: 她连我在议会的职位都抢了。那时，我也既往不咎了。但要我离开这个我一手创造的城市，见鬼去吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to discuss the election with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想跟你谈谈关于选举的事情。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you kidding? Dave is dead. How can there be an election with a dead candidate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你开什么玩笑？戴夫都已经死了。难道死人还能进行选举？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh yeah? What about it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，是吗？怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The election is still going on. What do you want to know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 选举还会继续举行。你还想知道些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Me? I'm not sure if I can help you...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我？我不知道能不能帮上你……

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll help you if I can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会尽可能地帮你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Election time is always exciting around here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 选举的时刻总是激动人心。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm going to win this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会赢的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. I suppose voting for Dave is the patriotic thing to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。我想投戴夫的票是爱国行为。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All done! Dave is the best!
ESP.TRADUIT: 搞定！戴夫最棒！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fingers crossed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 老天保佑。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good luck, Dave. You have my vote.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好运，戴夫。我投了你一票。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, Dave. Lead our Republic to glory!
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，戴夫。领导我们迈向荣耀！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's see what we have here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们看看投票结果。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A vote for me...
ESP.TRADUIT: 投我的一票……

ESP.ORIGINAL: And another vote for me...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我又得到一票……

ESP.ORIGINAL: A vote for Rosie?
ESP.TRADUIT: 投给萝丝的一票？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bob!?
ESP.TRADUIT: 鲍勃！？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait a minute, has somebody tampered with the ballot box?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，有人在投票箱上动过手脚吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm... after counting the votes, the president is...
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯……统计投票完毕，选出的总统是……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, looks like another triumphant victory for myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，看起来我又一次胜利了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, despite the hiccup, it looks like I am still declared the winner.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，尽管有些小问题，但我最终还是顺利当选。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, despite the hiccup, it looks like I am still declared the winner.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，尽管有些小问题，但我最终还是顺利当选。

ESP.ORIGINAL: ROSIE? Rosie can't be president! NO! This is unfair! This can't be! FINE! I'm LEAVING! See how you people do without me! Enjoy your new president!
ESP.TRADUIT: 萝丝？萝丝不可能当上总统的！不！这不公平！这不可能！好吧！我走！看没有我你们怎么活！为你们的新总统高兴吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: BOB? Bob can't be president! NO! This is unfair! This can't be! FINE! I'm LEAVING! See how you people do without me! Enjoy your new president!
ESP.TRADUIT: 鲍勃？鲍勃不可能当上总统的！不！这不公平！这不可能！好吧！我走！看没有我你们怎么活！为你们的新总统高兴吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey! Leave that alone. If I wanted it off, I'd turn it off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨！离那远点。是不是把它关掉得由我说了算。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stop messing with that radio.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不许再碰那收音机了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, leave that radio alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，离那收音机远点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这样好多了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice to meet you, Quinn.
ESP.TRADUIT: 见到你很高兴，奎因。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You too, stranger. I know a lot of people around here don't take kindly to humans wandering around, but I've met a lot of your people in my travels.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也很高兴，陌生人。我们这的多数人都对来这的人类不太友好，但是我在旅途中遇到过很多像你这样的人类。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? You're not going to tell me how rare it is to see a human in Underworld?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？你别告诉我在地下城很少能见到人类。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Me? No, not at all. I'm used to your people. Truth is, I spend most of my time away from Underworld.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我？不，没关系。我习惯和你们在一起了。老实说，其实我很少待在地下城里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you all right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还好吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who, me? Yeah... yeah... I'm fine. I guess. No... Yeah. I'll be okay. I just... I just need to try not to lose any more of my parts this time...
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁？我？嗯……嗯……我很好。我想。不……是的……我会没事的。我只是……只是想这回不要再掉些什么零件出来了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doc Barrows says that he's... he's getting' tired of puttin' 'em back on... me. So, you know... if you see any, just bring 'em back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 巴罗斯医生说他……他试着把我掉下来的那些身件零件再装回去……所以……你看……如果你找到我身上的东西，就拿来给我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need medical supplies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要医疗物资。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I can help you out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我能帮到你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Be careful with these. They're not toys, you know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小心使用。你要明白，它们可不是玩具。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, what do you need?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你要什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. What do you require?
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。你有什么需要？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This place is coming down around our ears.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这地方就在我们眼前。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It a miracle that some of this shit works in the first place. I guess it's just a matter of time...
ESP.TRADUIT: 想让这堆垃圾运作起来简直就是奇迹。我想这迟早会……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, kid. Your old man is ant food.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很抱歉，孩子。你老爸已经成了蚂蚁的晚餐了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You... you know what you are? You're a big asshole! That's right... an asshole! My pappa said never to say that word, but you deserve it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你……你知道你这算什么？你这大混蛋！没错……混蛋！爸爸告诉我不要说脏话，但是这词对你正合适！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now what am I going to do? My pappa's dead... poor pappa...
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在我该怎么办？爸爸死了……可怜的爸爸……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your father's dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你父亲死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's... he's dead?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他……他死了？ ?
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I already knew. Besides, I'm too tired to cry anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我已经猜到了。还有，我太累了，已经不想再哭了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bryan, I'm sorry, but your father is dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 布赖恩，我很抱歉，但是你的父亲已经不在了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's... he's dead?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他……他死了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I already knew. Besides, I'm too tired to cry anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我已经猜到了。还有，我太累了，已经不想再哭了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looks like all the votes are in, Mister President.
ESP.TRADUIT: 似乎投票已经完成了，总统先生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not yet. Rosie still hasn't voted.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还没。萝丝还没投票。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are the votes in, Mister President?
ESP.TRADUIT: 总统先生，投票完成了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good, the votes are in. If you'll excuse me, I'll be getting started on tallying the numbers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，所有人都投票了。失陪，我要开始统计票数了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh yes, I almost forgot. Here's your caps. Keep this up and I may deign to make you a citizen, in a few years.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，对了，我几乎忘了。这是你的瓶盖。拿着吧，过几年或许我会让你也成为这的公民。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rosie somehow came up with the most votes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 萝丝不知何故获得了最多选票。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There must be some kind of bug in the voting system.
ESP.TRADUIT: 投票系统肯定出了问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, what are the results?
ESP.TRADUIT: 总统先生，票选结果如何？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Somehow Bob won the election.
ESP.TRADUIT: 鲍勃居然在选举中胜出。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I should have known the little bastard was conspiring against me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就应该知道那小杂种要密谋造反。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, what are the results?
ESP.TRADUIT: 总统先生，票选结果如何？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was kind of my fault. You know how easy it is to make Butch mad...
ESP.TRADUIT: 这好像是我的错。你知道要把布奇搞得发狂有多容易……

ESP.ORIGINAL: You never learn, do you? You can't help shooting your mouth off even when you know it's going to get you a bloody nose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还是记不住，管好你的嘴，明知会被揍还这么多废话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [060300E9] (mod) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast Comment (NAM2) : comfortably -- you and Amata are best pals since forever EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh oh, your dad is giving me a look. I'd better let everybody else have a turn with the birthday boy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你爸爸正盯着我呢。我想我最好让所有人都有和小寿星说话的机会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [060300E9] (mod) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast Comment (NAM2) : comfortably -- you and Amata are best pals since forever EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you heard the election results?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听说选举结果了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dave won again? Well, he's the best choice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 戴夫又赢了？嗯，他的确是最佳选择。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you hear that Dave won the election?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道戴夫当选了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He did? Wow, I'd of never guessed that possible.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是吗？哇，我从没想过还有那种可能。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you hear Bob won the election?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道鲍勃当选了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, but it's still quite a shock.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，但还是让人震惊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you believe that Bob won the election?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道鲍勃当选了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dave won it I'm sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 戴夫肯定赢了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hurray!
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好啦！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you hear that Dave won the election?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道戴夫当选了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why, did Dave get too old?
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，是戴夫太老了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you hear that Dave lost the election?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道吗？戴夫没能当选。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did Dave win it again? I'd have voted for him if they'd let me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 戴夫又赢了吗？如果他们让我投票，我也会投他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ralph [0602B89D] (mod) NPC : Rachael [0602B89B] (mod) NPC : Mary [0602B89A] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did Dave win it again? I voted for him you know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 戴夫又赢了吗？你知道我又投给他了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rosie's going to be the new leader? What will Dave do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 萝丝是新领袖？那戴夫怎么办？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dave [06029A98] (mod) NPC : Rosie [060309C5] (mod) NPC : Bob [0602B898] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you heard that Rosie won the election?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道萝丝当选了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He actually won?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他真的赢了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dave [06029A98] (mod) NPC : Bob [0602B898] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Frightened at the thought. EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you heard that Bob won the election?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道鲍勃当选了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I won it? Are you sure?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我赢了？你确定？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh man, I can't believe it. I won't let the voters down, I promise!
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊，我不敢相信……我不会让选民们失望的，我保证！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looks like you won, Rosie!
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来是你赢了，萝丝！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't believe my ears.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我简直不敢相信自己的耳朵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you believe that you won the election?
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来是你赢了，萝丝！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rosie won, huh? She better not try and boss me around, that's for damn sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 萝丝赢了，呃？她最好不要想来命令我，决不！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you hear Rosie won the election?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道萝丝当选了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I knew I'd win it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就知道我会赢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now I just got to name this place after me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在我要将这地方改成我的名字。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looks like you'll be the new leader, Bob.
ESP.TRADUIT: 鲍勃，看来你是新的领导人了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, I can spare some water. <Give 1 water.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，我这有些水。<给予1瓶水>

ESP.ORIGINAL: You just saved my life. I won't forget it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你救了我的命。我不会忘记的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我马上照办。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <sighs> I was saying that you need to get some rest, Carol. You hardly ever sleep at night, don't think that I haven't noticed.
ESP.TRADUIT: <叹息>我的意思是你得休息，卡洛尔。你经常睡眠不足吧，别以为我不知道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hrm? Oh, hey Greta... what were you saying?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？哦……你好，葛丽泰……你说什么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. I'm glad we're clear on that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。很高兴我们在这点上澄清了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you blind? Never mind, don't bother grunting a response. You need to watch these assholes better. Some stuff has turned up missing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你瞎了还是怎么？算了，别想借口了。你盯紧这些混蛋，店里已经开始丢东西了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <grunts>
ESP.TRADUIT: <嘟囔>

ESP.ORIGINAL: What... what do you mean? I'm not... I'm not... I'm not even drunk right now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你……你什么意思？我……我还……我还没醉呢！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I... I can't talk about it. Not yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我……我不能谈这事。还不行。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She'll be missed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她会受到缅怀的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I... I can't talk about it. Not yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我……我不能谈这事。还不行。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She'll be missed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她会受到缅怀的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds like you need some of Ahzrukhal's special cough medicine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来你需要阿祖卡的特效咳嗽药。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Poor doc Barrows, you people are falling apart without him, aren't you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 可怜的巴罗斯医生，没了他，你们这帮人就不行了，不是吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You really suck at conversation, robot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说的话真难听，机器人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Command not parsed. Please restate command.
ESP.TRADUIT: 命令无法分析，请重新输入……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that's good. That's good to hear, Cerberus. Anything else going on?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好的。听起来很好，地狱犬。还发生了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Threat level alpha. Disturbance level zero.
ESP.TRADUIT: 警戒级别A。骚乱级别0。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dammit. I thought I fixed that. No time now, resume your patrol Cerberus. I'll deal with it later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真该死，我以为我修好了。现在没时间了，继续巡逻，地狱犬。我迟点再来处理。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Damn worthless... it never ends with you, does it? Just resume your patrol, I'll take you offline for service later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死，这没用……它从来就没好用过，不是吗？继续巡逻，迟点我让你离线服务器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: For Christ's sake, that's the fourth time this month. Just go back on patrol, I'm sure you'll be fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 老天，这月第四次了。继续巡逻，我确信你一定会好的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unit weapon system 2B ammunition level low. Please service at earliest convenience.
ESP.TRADUIT: 单位武器系统2B弹药量低。请尽快补充。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unit cognition system experiencing fluctuating contact. Unable to determine source of failure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 单位认知系统发现接触波动。无法确认错误来源。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unit target recognition system contains failure of an unknown class. Advise immediate unit service for repair.
ESP.TRADUIT: 单位目标识别系统包含未知等级错误。建议单位立即维护送修。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unit locomotion system contains a class two failure. Currently operable. Failure will escalate to class one with a 47% probability.
ESP.TRADUIT: 单位动力系统包含一个2级错误。正在执行，错误上升至1级的可能性：47%。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, give the report, you old bucket of bolts. I haven't got all day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，给我报告，你这堆废铁。我可没太多闲工夫。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well? Do you think I asked just out of curiosity? Give me the report, dammit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？你认为我只是好奇才问的？该死，给我报告。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unit diagnostics system compiling... diagnostics system ready. Running level 2 diagnostics... complete. Report prepared.
ESP.TRADUIT: 单位诊断系统编译中……诊断系统就绪。运行2级诊断……完毕。报告就绪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unit diagnostics... running... running... complete. Report prepared.
ESP.TRADUIT: 单位诊断……运行……运行……完毕。报告就绪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks, Greta.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你，葛丽泰。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow. Well, okay. I'll go have a look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇。嗯，我去看看。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could go for some noodles. You got any?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想要点面条，你有吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No refunds if you don't keep it down this time. Now, what can I get you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这次不小声点可不退款，你需要什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll just be here sobering up until you get back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在你回来前，我在这儿清醒一下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks, Greta.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你，葛丽泰。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, if you don't mind waiting a few minutes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，如果你不介意等一会。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我马上照办。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't care, really. Whatever takes the pain away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不在乎，真的。任何能止痛的东西都行。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's what I'm here for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就是为此而来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <sigh> Fine. I'll have the... squirrel. Cooked, please.
ESP.TRADUIT: <叹息>好吧。我就来……松鼠吧。请煮熟。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well then, what are you complaining about? Oh, I forgot, you're a bitter bastard. Just tell me what you want to eat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个，你在抱怨什么？哦，我忘了，你是个该死的混蛋。就直说你想吃什么吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very funny, Greta. I'd happily prepare my own meals if I could ever get anything was wasn't moldy, rotten, or still squirming.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很有趣，葛丽泰。如果能搞到任何没有发霉、发臭或腐烂的东西，我很高兴自己做了吃。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you don't like what we have, Crowley, you can always go hunt rats in the tunnels with the ferals.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你不喜欢我们的菜，考利，你可以自己去满是野兽的隧道里抓老鼠。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yep.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent. I'll have another task for you soon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 棒极了。我很快就会有第二个任务给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got something on my mind, Charon. I had asked you to do something and you never reported back to me. You did it, didn't you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我突然想起来了，卡隆。我让你做些事情，可你从来没向我报告。你搞定了，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know that I can't stop worrying about you. Just think about it, okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道我没办法不担心你。好好想想，好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They don't need to worry about me, Greta, and neither do you. I'll be okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们不必担心我，葛丽泰，你也一样，我会没事的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: C'mon, Carol. It's me, I can see through you. It's gotten so bad that the customers have started to notice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别这样，卡洛尔。是我，我太了解你了。你状况太糟，连顾客都注意到了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, Greta, baby. You don't need to worry about me, I was just lost in my thoughts. You know how it is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，葛丽泰，孩子，你用不着为我担心，我只是想得有些入神了，你知道的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you'd be surprised. I may be old, but this place'd shut down without me. Just think about what I said, we'll talk later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，估计会让你感觉惊讶。我可能已经老了，但这地方没了我恐怕就要关门了。想想我说的话，我们可以迟点再说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't you threaten me. You wouldn't dare do that, these people would have your head.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你别想来威胁我，你不敢的，这些人立刻就能要了你的脑袋。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, sure, you're here to make money, and I fix all of your crap so that you can keep right on making that money. What would happen if I stopped?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，好吧，你是来赚钱的，而我得先修好你那堆废物，你才能继续赚钱。如果没有我，你会怎样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stop serving him? This is a bar. How am I supposed to make money if I'm not serving booze? If he's got money, I'll give him whatever he asks for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不卖东西给他？这是酒吧。我不卖酒怎么赚钱？如果他有钱，他要什么我就卖他什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's about Patchwork. You need to stop feeding him booze, Ahzrukhal. The boy can barely stand most of the time, and you just keep serving him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是关于“拼盘”的。你别再继续卖酒给他了，阿祖卡，那孩子已经站立不稳，你却还不停地卖酒给他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want you to stop giving Patchwork booze when he's already drunk. You're gonna kill the boy.
ESP.TRADUIT: “拼盘”已经醉了，你别再卖酒给他了。你是想杀了这孩子吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No time to talk right now, Winthrop. Come back later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在没空聊天，温思罗普。我们迟点再见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, great. What's next?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，好极了。接下来怎么办？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, with the terminal, I can turn off the collars and open up the gate. But they're not gonna just let us walk out of here, you know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，有了终端，我就能关闭项圈，并把门打开。但他们也不会就这么让我们随便走出去，你懂吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Squirrel [06015686] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's always at least one guard near the pen, and someone's gotta get rid of him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 围栏旁总是至少有一个守卫，得有人收拾他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Squirrel [06015686] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Since we can't just walk around like we own the place, you're gonna have to do it. You get me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这我们可不能像在家里一样随意走动，得靠你去解决，明白吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Squirrel [06015686] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Could I help with the election, Mister President?
ESP.TRADUIT: 总统阁下，我能为选举效劳吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright sure, why not. The people have a tendency to wait until the last minute to vote, but I'd like just to get it over with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，为什么不呢。人们倾向于到了最后的时刻才投票，而我希望能尽快。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll spare a few caps if you just tell each of the adults to get over to the voting booth sometime today so I cinch the victory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你让其它的成年选民来投票，让我顺利当选，我就给你报酬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not that I have anything to worry about. The people know who their leader is in this Republic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是说我在担心。大家都知道谁才是这个共和国的领袖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So who can tell me how Dave saved the people from the wrath of Tom?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁能告诉我戴夫是怎样从汤姆的魔爪下拯救人民的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Somebody name three things Tom did wrong before Dave became the president.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁能给出戴夫当总统之前，汤姆做的三件错事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anybody know what year Dave took back the government for the people?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁知道戴夫是在哪一年为人民带来了民主共和制度？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope you're paying attention, Rachael. I'll give another pop quiz. I'll do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望你留神，拉克尔。我会再问你问题的。我会的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Remember your homework is to prepare a speech on the "Merits of Dave."
ESP.TRADUIT: 记住你的作业就是准备一次“戴夫的伟大功绩”的演讲。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, all right. I'll see what I can do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，好的。我看看我能做些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That name is not to be spoken within this Citadel. Do you understand? I wish it were not so, truly I do, but he is Outcast. He has been judged.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那名字不应该在五角大本营内提起。明白吗？我希望不是那个样子，我真的希望，但他是放逐者。他被判决了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll make do, Bowditch. You always do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能行的，鲍蒂奇。你一直很行。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep moving.
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续前进。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If only we were all so lucky. I have work to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是大伙都那么走运就好了。我还有工作要做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Dusk [060156E7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know me, Dusk. I was born ready for anything!
ESP.TRADUIT: 达斯科，你是了解我的。我一生下来就准备好了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: For someone who should be preparing for an assault, you seem to have a lot of time to be social.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对于一个应该时刻准备突袭的人来说，你还差远了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Dusk [060156E7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A few people. But I don't get tired of hearing it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有几个。但是我还没听够呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Dusk [060156E7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're really scary, Dusk. Has anyone ever told you that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真疯狂，达斯科。有人告诉过你吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a frightening woman, Dusk. Anyone ever tell you that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个好斗的女人，达斯科。有人这么跟你说过吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I care. If I were aiming for his nose, that'd be fine. But I wasn't. I was going for the eye. Sloppy...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在乎。如果我当时瞄准的是他的鼻子就好了。但我瞄的是眼睛。晕……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Dusk [060156E7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A couple of inches? So you'd have taken out his nose instead of his eye? So what!
ESP.TRADUIT: 几英寸？你宁愿打下他的鼻子而不是眼睛？那又怎样！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bullshit. That third shot dropped by a couple of inches.
ESP.TRADUIT: 胡说。第三枪打偏了几英寸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Dusk [060156E7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Carry on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Meh. Been better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，已经好多了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I haven't heard a damn thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没听到什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么事也没有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice night.
ESP.TRADUIT: 晚上好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, don't worry about me. You just go enjoy your drink.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，别担心我。你好好品尝美酒吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm fine, I'm just fine. Thank you for your concern. I'm fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很好，我真的很好。多谢关心。我很好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, I am, Mr. Ahzrukhal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，阿祖卡先生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, I don't mean to pry. It just seems like you should be doing more than this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，我无意催促你。只是你似乎应该做得更多。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well... I mean, yeah. I ain't exactly in charge here, but I'm Eulogy's right-hand man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯……我是说，是的。我并不是这里的主管，但是我是尤勒基的得力助手。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Forty [060156A0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some other jackass should be pulling nighttime guard duty. Maybe I'll go have a little chat with Eulogy about that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该让别的家伙来值夜岗。或许我应该和尤勒基谈谈这事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Forty [060156A0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It just seems like you do most of the work around here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来你在这做了大部分的工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, so maybe I get a raw deal sometimes. Everybody does out here. That's the way shit goes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，或许有时我受到一些不公平待遇。但是这的每个人都这样。在这就是这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Forty [060156A0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But maybe it's time that changed. Maybe I go see Eulogy about that right now, in fact.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许是时候要改变了。事实上我得立刻去找尤勒基谈谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Forty [060156A0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was just wondering, really. I figure you must make more than the others.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上我刚才一直在想。我想你肯定比别人赚得多。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe... And maybe it's time to see Eulogy about a raise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许……是的，或许是时候找尤勒基谈谈加薪的问题了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Forty [060156A0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, dear. Well, I guess the dangers around those old supplies keeps it from being smooth sailing. Otherwise, they'd already have been looted, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，亲爱的。嗯，我想因为这些补给品还在这里就是因为周围充满了危险。要不然它们早就被洗劫一空了，呃？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, keep what you got. Just traded for a big food shipment, myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你拿的东西就留着吧。我刚好交易到一大批食物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take a bit, my treat - taste kind of grates after a while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着，吃一点，我请客 - 过会儿口感就不好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and take this! It's an old Food Sanitizer. Just carry it with you, and it should automatically make most food and drink more, um... better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，拿着这个。这是一台旧食品净化器。带上它，能自动让大部分食物和饮料都更，呃……好。
