ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's very hard to talk my way past that many people shooting at me...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我都不愿跟你提起我以前被人拿着枪追杀的日子……

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a pretty good way of putting it. I think I'll use that in the book. Maybe I should credit you as a co-author, instead of just a researcher?
ESP.TRADUIT: 把这记下来非常有价值。我想把这些写进那本书里。在那本书里我或许该把你作为合著者，而不仅仅是一名研究员。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know you may not want to see any more explosives for a while, but obviously you know your way around them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你现在再也不想看到任何炸弹了，不过很显然你知道怎么处理它们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have a couple rainy-day toys of mine. And looking at this landmine, it gives me an idea. It's a terrible device that does terrible things, of course. But it's easy to make your own, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿几件我的应急玩具吧。看看这地雷，它给了我一个灵感。当然，这可怕的装置会造成可怕的后果。但是这东西制作简单，连你也能做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fast hands and faster wits can get you an awful lot. Including landmines.
ESP.TRADUIT: 手快，脑子好也会让你倒霉。比如碰到地雷。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh my, Raiders had set up camp there? I'm guessing you didn't just negotiate with them, did you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，天啊，歹徒在那建了个营地？我想你没有和他们谈判，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, keep what you got. Just traded for a big food shipment, myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你拿的东西就留着吧。我刚好交易到一大批食物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take a bit, my treat -- taste kind of grates after a while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着，吃一点，我请客 - 过会儿口感就不好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those big, shadowy stores can be great for hiding out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些昏暗的大仓库用来藏身是再好不过了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, that isn't what I want at all. People already have all sorts of ways to kill them. We don't need a more lethal Mole Rat trap. Just a better one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，那不是我想要的。人们已经知道了所有杀死它们的方法。我们不需要更致命的地鼠陷阱。我们只需要更好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess it's back to the drawing board for that repellent. I wonder if I can make it into some sort of fuel. Anyway, I'll just take that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我必须要重新设计这些驱鼠剂。我想知道能否能把它做成一种燃料。总之，就这样吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, but for your trouble, umm... Here, have the leftover chems from working on the repellent. I'm sure you can find some use for them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，为了补偿你遇到的麻烦，唔……拿着这些造驱鼠剂剩下的药品吧，我确定你会找到用处的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, at least it's non-lethal for people. For Mole Rats... not so much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至少这对人来说不是致命的。对地鼠来说…就不然了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hrm. Well, I knew that. But I guess it does raise the question of whether or not they have a language. Maybe I should study that later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我早就知道。但我认为他们到底有没有自己的语言还是个疑问。或许我应该迟点再去研究。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wish we could have gotten more information, but this'll have to do for the book.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望我们得到更多的信息，但这对写书就够了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your pay. Maybe they'll help you be sneakier next time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的报酬，希望日后会助你潜行更隐秘。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're savages with big claws and absolutely no interest in small talk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是长着巨爪的野人，对谈话毫无兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That'd hardly be ethical, really. But if there's nothing more factual to go on...
ESP.TRADUIT: 这可不合情理。但如果没有更实际的方法了……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh well. Still, for your help, have a few of these. They may help out next time you need to talk to a few folks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，为了感谢你的帮助，拿着这些，它们在你下次与人交谈时会有点帮助的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose it wouldn't hurt to add a nice story to it. And it'd be a nice little reward for your hard work to include you as a hero.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想加一个动听的故事进去不会有什么坏处。而且我会把你作为一个英雄编进去，作为你努力工作的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: None of them agree on a story. So let's just say I set the whole place up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们莫衷一是。干脆就是说那个地方是我建造的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I don't know about that. But I guess you do. And it's a good enough example for the book, I suppose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我说不好，但你肯定清楚。我认为这作为书中一个案例还是不错的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: It helps to have the right tool for the job. Failing that, go with the right tool to cheat at the job. Like a pulse grenade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 工欲善其事，必先利其器。失败的话，就得拿正确的工具去完成它，比如脉冲手榴弹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, have a couple.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来，拿几个吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Make the right connection, and robots do what you want. Just like people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要连接正确，机器人就能做你想做的事，就像真人一样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, maybe the Raiders will try reading a few of the books. Maybe it'll open their eyes to a few things.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，或许歹徒会读书。或许他们的眼界会变得开阔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still, it's good to know it's standing. Maybe I'll inspire someone to take care of the place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，还是很高兴知道它还在。或许我该鼓励其他人去保护那。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have some caps as payment for that little bit of hope.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你些瓶盖作为这一线希望的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, it's still there, but it's full of Raiders. The place is a death trap.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，它还在那，不过周围都是歹徒。那是个死亡陷阱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm taking a break from the research.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我得中断研究去休息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't take too long. The sooner the book's done, the more people we can save with it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 别太久。这书尽快写完，我们就可以拯救更多的人！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, Carol. I'd love to hear your story.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，卡洛尔。我愿意听你的故事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, okay... but it's nothing special.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好吧……不过没什么特别。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was born in 2051, so yes, that makes me a Pre-War Ghoul.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我生于2051年，是的，我是战前僵尸。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you end up working for...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么到这工作的……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not going to talk about it. Don't ask.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不想说。别问了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not your business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 与你无关。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me see the real goods.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看真正的好货。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Certainly, my friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我的朋友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I must ask that you speak to no one about our transactions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我必须要求你不要把这次交易告诉任何人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, back for more... excellent.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，你又回来了……很好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He doesn't say much, does he?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他不怎么说话，对吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: His company is rather refreshing, isn't it? But don't mistake his brevity for stupidity. That would be very unwise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 身边有他会非常令人愉快，不是吗？不过不要将他的寡言少语当作愚笨。那非常不明智。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Underestimating an opponent has been the last mistake of far too many individuals throughout history.
ESP.TRADUIT: 历史上太多人所犯的最后一个错误就是低估他们的对手。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, in a little bit. Geez.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，就一点。天啊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I bet Ralph isn't doing anything, why don't you ask him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我敢说拉尔夫现在没事，为什么你不去问问他呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why don't you ask Rachael if she can play?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么你不问问拉克尔能否和你玩呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're on your own, pal. I've got more important things to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你得靠你自己了，伙计。我有其他更重要的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's it, huh? Just toss me out of the box and into the meat grinder?
ESP.TRADUIT: 就这样，呃？刚把我从“盒子”里救出来，又把我扔进绞肉机？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601569E] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks for nothing, asshole.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你什么也没干，混蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601569E] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll have to run for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们必须奔跑逃走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, if you say so. I'll be right behind you. If you can get me to the front gate, I can take it from there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，既然你这样说。我会跟在你后面。如果你能把我带到前门，在那我就能自己走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601569E] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We need to be careful. Stay low and stay quiet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们得小心点。悄悄地低身行走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got it. I'll stay right with you. Get me to the front gate, and I can make a run for it from there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。我会紧跟着你。把我带到前门，我就可以自己走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601569E] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Spy on what? Your trailer-home?
ESP.TRADUIT: 间谍来调查什么？你的拖车屋？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If the Capitol Building does not meet your incredible standards, feel free to escort yourself out. In fact, just leave now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果国会大厦不符合你那超高的标准，那你就把自己送出去吧。实际上，你快走吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right behind you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就在你身后。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601569E] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: "A slice of melon may be divine, but lest you spoil the meal, mind the rind"
ESP.TRADUIT: “一小片甜瓜味道不错，但小心瓜皮，会破坏肉香”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [00033581] (ID) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stand clear, vagabonds, rapscallions and Ne'erdowells.
ESP.TRADUIT: 流浪汉、恶棍和饭桶站开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [00033581] (ID) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Time for your walk, family pet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该去散步了，宠物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [00033581] (ID) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you remember the day the war started?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还记得战争开始的那天是怎样的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do... I was in a shelter with my father when the bombs hit. In D.C., we had the luxury of getting a warning after the west coast was... gone...
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的……我记得当核弹落下时我正和父亲藏在躲避处。我们在华盛顿特区，当美国西海岸……消失……后我们幸运地得到了警报。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was just a little girl then. We couldn't afford a space in one of the Vaults. I remember filing down into that shelter, my father rushing me in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那时我还只是个小女孩。我们承担不起在居住到避难所的花费。我记得我父亲把我推进那躲避处。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He stopped to help this one family, and I looked up and called his name... there was a flash of light, brighter than anything you can imagine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他再也无法帮助唯一的家人了，我向上望并呼喊着他的名字……一道亮光闪过，比你能想象的一切都亮。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I woke up a few hours later. The first thing I did was run up to where my father had been. He... he was gone. But the strangest thing...
ESP.TRADUIT: 几小时后，我醒过来。我第一时间跑到我父亲之前站的地方。他……他不见了。但最意想不到的是……

ESP.ORIGINAL: There was his shadow, burned into the wall, so crisp and clear like he was standing next to me. The heat had burned it into the concrete...
ESP.TRADUIT: 那有他的影子，在墙上烧出的印记，那么诡异却又那么清晰，好像他就站在我身边。那热量把它烧进了墙里……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, great! And you look like it went fine! So, how was it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，好极了！看上去很顺利！办得怎么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got through Minefield alive, and I even brought you a present. <Lie.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 我活着穿过了雷区，还给你带回来个礼物。<撒谎>

ESP.ORIGINAL: My very own landmine! Just what I've always wanted. Well, always since I sent you out on this, anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的地雷！就是我一直想得到的。嗯，至少是我派你去拿之后我一直想得到的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, tell me all about it. What was it like going through there? What's it like disarming a landmine?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，和我谈谈。经历怎么样？解除地雷的感觉是什么样的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got through Minefield alive, and I even brought you a present. <Lie.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 我活着穿过了雷区，还给你带回来个礼物。<撒谎>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, come on. You barely even left! I can't imagine you tested it on a reasonable number of subjects so quickly. It can't have been a good sample size.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，拜托。你几乎就没离开过！我无法想象你能这么快地做了一系列实验。这试验结果没意义。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I tested it out, and it works just fine. <Lie.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 我测试过了，没问题。<撒谎>

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's 100 caps in it for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你100个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh yeah?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Crimson [060156A1] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now that I think about it, Forty has been lookin' mighty fine lately. Workin' out extra.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在回想起来，弗替最近变强壮了。他加强了锻炼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Crimson [060156A1] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe I'll go see if there's anything I can do for him. You keep this between me and you. Clear?
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许我会到那看看有什么能帮他的。你不能把这事告诉别人。明白吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Crimson [060156A1] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'll be damned... That little so-and-so... why didn't I think of that when I was sixteen?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，真想不到……这些细节……我16岁的时候怎么没考虑过那些问题？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CFB7] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect Comment (NAM2) : muttering to himself, while looking over Wally's test EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, he's safe. Now get moving!
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，他安全了。现在快走吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, okay!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，好的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Penny [06015691] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't follow me. You go out the normal way, and meet Sammy and me outside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别跟着我。你不动声色地出去，然后再和我、萨米会合。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Penny [06015691] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got him out, all right. Now it's your turn.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把他救出去了，没问题。现在该你了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You saved him? Really?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你救了他？真的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Penny [06015691] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you so much. I'll make it up to you somehow, I promise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常感谢你。我保证我会报答你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Penny [06015691] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now I have to get out. Don't follow me; you go out the normal way. We'll meet outside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在我得走了。别跟着我；你不动声色地出去。我们在外面会合。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Penny [06015691] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you hear anyone mention anything about an Ant Queen?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听到过什么人提过蚁后的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well... yeah. I think I heard Doc Lesko mention something like a queen or something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃……是的。我想莱斯科医生提过蚁后。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Something about "laying eggs" whatever that means.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么“产卵”之类的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He said the queen would never be above ground. That he'd have to find her. Weird huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他说过蚁后是不会出现在地表上的。所以他必须找到她。挺奇怪，不是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, you've managed to sniff the trail! Good job. Keep me informed on your progress...
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，你嗅到了他的踪迹！干得好。有新的进展立刻告诉我……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : annoyed EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well? Why are you still standing there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？你怎么还站在这？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : annoyed EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm tracking down the location and equipment used to perform the face job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在追踪整容手术地点和使用的设备。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I have some time to think about it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能考虑一下吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course. I know this is an unusual request, but hey, I'm an unusual tree huh?. Well, Bob is anyway...
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。我知道这是不寻常的要求，但是，嗨，我也不是一棵寻常的树。嗯，也许鲍勃才是那树……

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll just keep it an open invitation then. I don't want to wait until the next person visits, it could be years... you're all I've got.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，还是保持这个公开邀请好了。我不知道要再等多久才会有下一个人，可能要很多年，我可不想等……现在只有你了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I really don't want to kill you...
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我真的不想杀了你……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of all the Wastelanders I had to bump into it has to be one with a conscience.
ESP.TRADUIT: 废土那么多人之中，我只会拜托那些有良知的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's keep it an open invitation then. I don't want to wait until the next person visits, it could be years.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，还是保持这个公开邀请好了。我不知道要再等多久才会有下一个人，可能要很多年，我可不想等。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just, just, think about it, okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 先考虑一下，好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ok, I'll do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我愿意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You will? Oh, oh! You've... you've made us so happy! Isn't that right Bob?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你愿意？哦！这让我们非常高兴！鲍勃，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just give me a little time to say goodbye to good old Bob and then I'll be ready.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我点时间让我和老鲍勃道别，然后你就可以开始行动了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Officer Kendall! Help!
ESP.TRADUIT: 警员肯德尔！快来！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've been in a coma... chances are the Rangers are already dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你一直昏迷着……很可能游骑兵都已经死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No! There is no way my guys are dead!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不！我的人不会死的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: If there's even the slimmest chance of surviving, they'll do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 即使只有一线生机，他们也会去尝试的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you won't go, stop wasting my fucking time and find me someone who will!
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你不愿意去，就别他妈浪费我的时间，找个愿意去的人！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why don't you attempt a rescue? Your legs broken or something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么不试试去救他们呢？你腿瘸了还是怎么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you completely stupid?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你傻了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can barely walk right now, let alone climb a skyscraper. If I could even hold a pistol, I would go get my guys right now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在我几乎无法行走，更别提爬上摩天大楼。如果我现在能拿起手枪的话，我会立刻救回我的人！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm using everything I've got just standing here talking to you. Get the point?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正在用所有力量为了在这和你说话。懂了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: You look terrible. Maybe I shouldn't have woken you up so quickly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看上去很糟。或许我不该这么快弄醒你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Heh, I feel worse than I look, but that doesn't even matter to me. I'm just worried about the rest of the Rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，我的感觉比外表还糟，但我不在乎。我只是担心其他的游骑兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't even know if they're still alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我甚至不知道他们是死是活。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you want this code so badly?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么你这么急切地想知道密码？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know why. We can't start the purifier without it. The longer the purifier isn't running, the more people suffer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道为什么吗？没有密码我们就无法启动净化器。净化器停止运作的时间越长，就会有更多的人受苦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colonel Autumn [06019A1F] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now I'm running out of patience. I want that code, and I want it now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 孩子，我快没耐性了。我现在就要知道密码。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colonel Autumn [06019A1F] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这等着。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, but what am I supposed to do here? Work on my needlepoint or something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，但是我在这该干嘛？刺绣还是怎么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I shall wait here until you return for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会等着，直到你来找我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But it's so boring all alone!
ESP.TRADUIT: 但一个人在这等太孤单了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clover [060156A2] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Petulant EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: <whine>
ESP.TRADUIT: <哀鸣声>
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dogmeat [0606A772] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Sad whining EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't piss around, I don't want to be standing here with my thumb up my ass all day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别胡闹。我不想整天在这。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will keep this location secure!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会确保这的安全！

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you insist. But do be careful - I can hardly repay your kindness while waiting back here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你坚持。但是务必小心 — 在这干等的话,我可还不了你人情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Honest concern for the player EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I shall reflect on the battles past and the battles to come until your return.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会在你回来前，反省已经结束的战斗，并且准备好即将到来的战斗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's trade equipment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们交易装备吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If this means more stuff for Butch, I'm all for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果这东西对布奇很重要，我全力支持。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那好吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're always welcome to take whatever you want, lover.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要拿什么都随便，亲爱的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clover [060156A2] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Sultry EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, gimme whatever you got.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，把你有的全给我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, by all means, let's.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错。我们来吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Appreciates being trusted by the player EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: RL-3 comes equipped with everything a good soldier needs! But your RL-3 can assist in carrying equipment, if needed.
ESP.TRADUIT: RL-3配备了全套的士兵装备！而在需要时，你的RL-3还可以帮你携带物品。

ESP.ORIGINAL: In the words of Elder Theis: "A Brother well equipped is a Brother keeping to his duty."
ESP.TRADUIT: 泰斯长老说过：“只有装备优良的兄弟会才能做好本职工作。”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <bark!>
ESP.TRADUIT: <吠叫！>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enough about tactics.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不说战术了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <bark>
Keep your distance. Try to flank them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和他们保持距离。不妨从侧面攻击他们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was my goal to continue doing so until you told me otherwise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的任务就是一直这么做，直到你改变命令。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep hanging back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 退后。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. I will seek out better positions to cover you while you forge ahead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。你前进的时候，我会找一些更好的地点掩护你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's what I'm doing. Why do you think I'm standing back here in East Bumfuck?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那正是我在做的。否则你认为我为什么站在后面这么远？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep hanging back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 退后。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! Good plan. I'll try to get around behind 'em. I like how you think, kid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！好主意。我会试着绕到他们后面。我喜欢你的想法，孩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've had no compelling reason to do anything different from what you asked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对你的要求没有疑问。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep hanging back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 退后。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! Good plan. I'll try to get around behind 'em. I like how you think, kid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！好主意。我会试着绕到他们后面。我喜欢你的想法，孩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I get any farther, I might as well be back in the bar. And that's sounding like a better idea all the time, trust me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再远些的话，我还不如回酒吧去。那无论何时听起来都是个好主意，相信我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep hanging back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 退后。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What, don't you like my aftershave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么，不喜欢我用的须后水的气味吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, got it. Flanking and tactics and stuff. Right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，明白了。侧面进攻和战术什么的。了解。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Doesn't quite get it. EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep Hanging Back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 退后。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you insist, sir, but RL-3 functions best when closer to the fight!
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你坚持，长官。不过RL-3型在近战中可以发挥最大作用！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep hanging back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 退后。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stealth flanking mode active!
ESP.TRADUIT: 潜行侧面进攻模式激活！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sergeant RL-3 [0009426E] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Extra loud and un-stealthy EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: By all means. I simply hope I'm not too far in reserve, in case of unforeseen trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尽我所能。只是希望不会太靠后，以免遭遇一些不可预期的麻烦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep hanging back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 退后。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A sound plan. I trust this isn't simply to avoid being seen with a Super Mutant?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好主意。我相信这不仅是为了不被超级变种人发现这么简单？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Eulogy used to like me to stay ten steps behind him. Usually.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尤勒基通常喜欢我与他保持十步距离。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep hanging back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 退后。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As you wish, but I'm not letting you out of my sight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如你所愿，但我不会让你超出我的视线的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <pant> <pant>
ESP.TRADUIT: <喘气><喘气>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep hanging back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 退后。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <bark> <bark>
All right, you're good. Let's get out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，就这样。我们走吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <bark>
Your distance is good. Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的距离不错。让我们谈谈其他事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <bark> <bark>
Stay close to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 紧跟着我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am happy if you are happy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你快乐，我就快乐。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're good where you are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就保持这个距离。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As you wish.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如你所愿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're damn right I'm good, kid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你该死的说对了，孩子，我是很棒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're good where you are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就保持这个距离。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, kid. Whatever you say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没问题，孩子，你说什么都行。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought it so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也这么想。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're good where you are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就保持这个距离。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It allows for flexibility. A wise choice on your part.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这增加了灵活性。明智的选择。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I'm the best, baby.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，宝贝，我是最棒的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're good where you are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就保持这个距离。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good? Screw that noise - I'm downright awesome!
ESP.TRADUIT: 棒？去你的 — 那我就是神奇的了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're good where you are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就保持这个距离。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So... Near? Far? Come on, make up your mind!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么……近？远？来吧，作出你的决定！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : frustrated and a little confused EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Understood, sir. Proceeding as normal!
ESP.TRADUIT: 明白，长官。如平常一样的战术！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're good where you are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就保持这个距离。

ESP.ORIGINAL: RL-3 will maintain a tactical distance!
ESP.TRADUIT: RL-3会保持战术距离！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll endeavor to continue, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会竭尽全力继续。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're good where you are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就保持这个距离。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A sound decision, yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 合理的决定，是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Glad you like it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴你喜欢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're good where you are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就保持这个距离。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As you wish, lover.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如你所愿，亲爱的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <pant> <pant>
ESP.TRADUIT: <喘气><喘气>

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're good where you are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就保持这个距离。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <bark> <bark>
Let's talk about how close you're following me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们来讨论下你我之间的距离。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you wanna get closer to me, that's all you gotta say, girl.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想靠近我，就对我说，小妞。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Sleazy EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mean how close you're following me, right? Sure, what's up?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说跟随我的距离是吗？是的，怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there something that you wish me to change?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你希望我改变什么吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: How close would you like?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你希望的距离是？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clover [060156A2] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Highly suggestive EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah... okay. You got a better idea?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的……好的。你有更好的主意吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: As you wish. What about it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如你所愿。怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am open to your suggestions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 洗耳恭听。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Give me my marching orders, sir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 长官，给我行进指令。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <bark>
<pant pant>
ESP.TRADUIT: <喘息，喘息>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just tell me where you want me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想我站在哪儿，只管告诉我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want you to use ranged weapons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望你使用远距攻击武器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. I shall cover your approach.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常好。我会掩护你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sir, yes sir!
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，长官！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're not bad with a ranged weapon. Keep it up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你远程武器用得不错。就这样继续。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <whimper>[Dogmeat is incapable of ranged attacks and will continue using melee attacks.]
ESP.TRADUIT: <whimper>[狗肉无法进行远程攻击，将继续使用近身攻击.]

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent, will do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很棒，没问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Switch to a melee weapon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 切换到近战武器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They shall know the power of my steel!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们应当知道我铁棍的威力！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <bark> <bark>
By your command, sir!
ESP.TRADUIT: 遵命，长官！

ESP.ORIGINAL: <bark>
I like what you're doing. Stick with the melee.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我喜欢你这样战斗。专注于肉搏吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sir, yes sir!
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，长官！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I like what you're doing. Stick with the melee.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我喜欢你这样战斗。专注于肉搏吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Makes beeping sounds>
ESP.TRADUIT: <发出哔哔声>
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : Do not record. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Weapon Type::Melee>
ESP.TRADUIT: <武器类型::近战>

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Makes beeping sounds>
ESP.TRADUIT: <发出哔哔声>
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : Do not record. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Weapon Type::Melee>
ESP.TRADUIT: <武器类型::近战>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们谈点别的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, commander?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，指挥官？

ESP.ORIGINAL: <bark>
That's all. Let's get going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就这样。我们走吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lead on!
ESP.TRADUIT: 带路！

ESP.ORIGINAL: <bark> <bark>
I want you to change your combat style.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望你改变你的战斗风格。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think would be best?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认为最好的是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh yeah? To what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A member of the Brotherhood is trained in all weapons as an Initiate. What do you wish?
ESP.TRADUIT: 兄弟会的新兵最初就会参加所有武器的训练。你想训练什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can stab, I can shoot, I can do lots of things. What's your pleasure?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以用刀，我可以用枪，我可以做很多事。你喜欢那种？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Cocky bravado EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: In what way?
ESP.TRADUIT: 以什么方式？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What would you like? I think you'll find I'm quite flexible.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你喜欢什么？我想你会发现我什么都会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clover [060156A2] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Sultry, with suggestive pause before "flexible" EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Standing by for further orders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等待进一步指令。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <bark>
Let's talk about your tactics.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈谈你的战术吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, sir? What, sir?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，长官？什么事，长官？

ESP.ORIGINAL: <bark>
I just wanted to make sure you were still here. Goodbye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只想确认你还在这。再见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, well the Snakes don't need you, anyway! We don't need nothing but liquor and guns! Yeah!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，蛇反正也不需要你！我们除了酒和枪不需要别的！耶！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Angry and hurt, trying to hide disappointment EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Charming.
ESP.TRADUIT: 迷人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You big tease!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你个大傻瓜！

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the fu... you think that's funny?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他妈……你认为这很有趣？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If there's one thing I've learned, it's patience. I can wait.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我所学到的就是耐心。我可以等。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Old war-bots never die! We just rust away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 机器人是永不会死的！我们最多只是会生锈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As I am a "man of my word", there is nowhere else that I could possibly be.
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为一名言而有信的人，我不会到别的地方去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not just yet. I wanted to talk to you about something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还没。我想和你谈谈。

ESP.TRADUIT: 你是我的雇主，我也希望跟你走，但跟随如此人满为患的队伍是不明智的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I shall wait here until your party is smaller.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在你的队伍减员前，我会在这等待。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahzrukhal was an evil bastard. So long as he held my contract, I was honor bound to do as he commanded.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿祖卡是个邪恶的杂种。只要他还持有我的合同，我就得听从他的命令。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But now you are my employer, which freed me to rid the world of that disgusting rat. And now, for good or ill, I serve you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在你是我的雇主了，你把我从那满是恶心的老鼠的世界里救了出来。所以无论你是善是恶，我都会听命于你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's right, Charon. Have you come to say goodbye?
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错，卡隆。你来道别吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahzrukhal. I am told that I am no longer in your service.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿祖卡，我被告知不用再为你服务了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Slow down, there. I have good news. I'm your new employer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等。我有个好消息。我是你的新雇主。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You purchased my contract from Ahzrukhal? So, I am no longer in his service. That is good to know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你从阿祖卡那买走了我的合同？我不再为他服务了。太好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please, wait here. I must take care of something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请等在这。我必须处理一些事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh no. None of that. You belong to me now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，不。那可不行。你现在是我的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I belong to no one. If you are my new employer, then I will serve you. But first, I must take care of something. Wait here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不属于任何人。如果你是我的新雇主，那么我会听命于你。但首先，我必须处理一些事，等在这。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. Greta is nothing to me. I'll do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没问题。葛丽泰对我来说不算什么。我会搞定。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm glad to hear it. Come back to me when she's dead and Charon's contract is all yours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴听到你这么说。她死后回来见我，卡隆的合同就是你的了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A word of advice: be subtle. Open gunplay will only get the town to turn on you, and I will not be able to help you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个小建议：小心行事。公然开枪的话，全镇的人都会对付你，我也不会帮你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Couldn't we work out some sort of deal?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们就不能想出什么办法吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is she now? Well, it seems that this arrangement worked out well for both of us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她死了？好的，看来我们之间的协议完成得很顺利。

ESP.ORIGINAL: With the new profit I'll make from Greta's customers, I'll be able to hire a replacement for Charon with plenty left over for myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有了葛丽泰的顾客带来的新收益，我就能找人顶替卡隆，还能得到丰厚的利润。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And you held up your end of the deal, my friend. And I am a man of his word. Charon's contract is yours. You are his new employer. Congratulations.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的朋友，你履行了协议。我是个讲信用的人，给你卡隆的合同，恭喜你成为他的新雇主。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll give you the pleasure of informing him yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把通知他的乐趣留给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: About that deal we had: Greta is dead as promised.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有关我们的交易……就像我承诺过的，葛丽泰已经死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll give you 5,000 caps for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会给你5000个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose that could work... yes. Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想那能行……是的。是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's the contract. And I'll take my payment in full.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你合同。我要全额付款。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll give you the pleasure of informing Charon yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把通知他的乐趣留给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're kidding, right? Come back when you have a serious offer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在开玩笑吗？等你真正想交易时再回来找我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll give you 4,000 caps for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会给你4000个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] I suppose that could work... yes. Yes... here's the contract. And I'll take my payment in full.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想那能行……是的。是的……给你合同。而我会赚大钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's the contract. And I'll take my payment in full.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你合同。我要全额付款。

ESP.TRADUIT: 我想让你通知他这个好消息。

ESP.TRADUIT: 给你合同。我要全额付款。

ESP.TRADUIT: 我把通知他的乐趣留给你。

ESP.TRADUIT: 你在开玩笑吗？等你真正想交易时再回来找我。

ESP.TRADUIT: 我会给你1000个瓶盖。

ESP.TRADUIT: 我想那能行……是的。是的……给你合同。而我会赚大钱。

ESP.TRADUIT: 给你合同。我要全额付款。
