ESP.TRADUIT: 我把通知他的乐趣留给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] You're kidding, right? Come back when you have a serious offer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在开玩笑吗？等你真正想交易时再回来找我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to talk to you about Charon's contract.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想和你谈谈卡隆的合同。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is she now? Well, it seems that this arrangement worked out well for both of us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她死了？好的，看来我们之间的协议完成得很顺利。

ESP.ORIGINAL: With the new profit I'll make from Greta's customers, I'll be able to hire a replacement for Charon with plenty left over for myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有了葛丽泰的顾客带来的新收益，我就能找人顶替卡隆，还能得到丰厚的利润。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And you held up your end of the deal, my friend. And I am a man of his word. Charon's contract is yours. You are his new employer. Congratulations.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的朋友，你履行了协议。我是个讲信用的人，给你卡隆的合同，恭喜你成为他的新雇主。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll give you the pleasure of informing him yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想让你通知他这个好消息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: About that deal we had: Greta is dead as promised.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有关我们的交易……就像我承诺过的，葛丽泰已经死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I knew you'd change your mind. Just remember, Charon is a valuable asset to me and he doesn't come cheap. Are you ready to deal?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就知道你会改变主意。记住，卡隆对我来说有很大的价值，而且他不便宜。你准备要交易了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh? Would you, now? He is a highly valuable asset to me and to the Ninth Circle. What did you have in mind?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦？你同意了？他对我和第九环很重要。你怎么想？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take some Rad-X.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要一些放射线X。

ESP.ORIGINAL: One for you, five for me. Use it in good health.
ESP.TRADUIT: 1个归你，5个归我。用它们保持健康。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Two for you, ten for me. Use 'em in good health.
ESP.TRADUIT: 2个归你，10个归我。用它们保持健康。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Three for you, fifteen for me. Use 'em in good health.
ESP.TRADUIT: 3个归你，15个归我。用它们保持健康。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Four for you, twenty for me. Use 'em in good health.
ESP.TRADUIT: 4个归你，20个归我。用它们保持健康。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Five for you, twenty-five for me. Use 'em in good health.
ESP.TRADUIT: 5个归你，25个归我。用它们保持健康。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take the RadAway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要辐射药。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, ten bits of Scrap Metal for two doses of RadAway. That's a done deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，10块废金属换2包辐特宁。交易完成。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, fifteen bits of Scrap Metal for three doses of RadAway. That's a done deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，15块废金属换3包辐特宁。交易完成。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, twenty bits of Scrap Metal for four doses of RadAway. That's a done deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，20块废金属换4包辐特宁。交易完成。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, twenty-five bits of Scrap Metal for five doses of RadAway. That's a done deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，25块废金属换5包辐特宁。交易完成。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take the Stimpaks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要治疗针。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Five bits of Scrap Metal for me, one Stimpak for you -- it's been a pleasure doing business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我5块废金属，给你1支治疗针。交易愉快。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take the Stimpak.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要治疗针。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ten bits of Scrap Metal for me, two Stimpaks for you -- it's been a pleasure doing business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我10块废金属，给你2支治疗针。交易愉快。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fifteen bits of Scrap Metal for me, three Stimpaks for you -- it's been a pleasure doing business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我15块废金属，给你3支治疗针。交易愉快。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Twenty bits of Scrap Metal for me, four Stimpaks for you -- it's been a pleasure doing business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我20块废金属，给你4支治疗针。交易愉快。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Twenty-Five bits of Scrap Metal for me, five Stimpaks for you -- it's been a pleasure doing business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我25块废金属，给你5支治疗针。交易愉快。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What were you offering to trade?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想怎样交易？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll trade you five bits of Scrap Metal for a Stimpak, a pack of RadAway, or a dose of Rad-X. Easy deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会卖你5块废金属来换1支治疗针、或1包辐特宁、或者1剂抗辐剂-X。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have some scrap metal for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我为你找了些废金属。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? Great! I can finally get around to patching up the heaters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？好极了！我终于能去修理加热器了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll be dead long before help gets here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等有人来救你时，你都死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, fine, you asshole. I offered you a fair trade, and this is how it is?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，好吧，你这混蛋。我给你个公平交易，怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take it. Take it all and get the fuck out. I never want to lay my eyes on you again, you miserable bastard.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，拿着。全部拿着然后给我滚。我再也不要见到你，你这可怜的杂种。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. As in: I won't cut your throat and watch you die gasping for air.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。就好像：我不会切开你的喉管，然后看着你慢慢咽气。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You... you wouldn't dare. I've got... I mean... I'll call for help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你……你不敢胡来的。我有……我的意思是……我会叫人来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. As in, "I won't make a five egg omelet out of your face."
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。就好像：“我不用你的脸来做鸡蛋饼。”

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, Winthrop. I think I can help you out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，温思罗普。我想我能帮你的忙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, alright. That's good to hear, stranger. Just come on back to me when you've gathered some Scrap Metal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那好吧，很高兴听到你这么说，陌生人。收集到一些废金属就来找我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll find it just about anywhere -- on junked robots, in old buildings, you name it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以在任何地方找到它 — 废弃的机器人身上，旧房子里，到处有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do around here, Winthrop?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这干嘛？温思罗普。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Me? I keep every hunk of old rusted Pre-War garbage around here in operating condition.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我？我维护生锈的战前废物，让它们还能运作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've got lights, water, and ventilation all running off the old crap they used to keep this place going for the tourists.
ESP.TRADUIT: 曾为游客而准备的光线，水分和空气正流失殆尽。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've managed to keep it going so far, but... well, I'm not sure how long I can keep it up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我一直设法维持机器运作，但……嗯，我不确定还可以维持多久。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Me? I keep every hunk of old rusted Pre-War garbage around here in operating condition.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我？我维护生锈的战前废物，让它们还能运作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've got lights, water, and ventilation all running off the old crap they used to keep this place going for the tourists.
ESP.TRADUIT: 曾为游客而准备的光线，水分和空气正流失殆尽。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've managed to keep it going so far, but... well, I'm not sure how long I can keep it up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我一直设法维持机器运作，但……嗯，我不确定还可以维持多久。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We used to have two guards here. Me and an older girl named Caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们曾有两个守卫，我和一个叫“帽子”的年长女孩。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But since the last time Raiders attacked, it's just been me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但自从上次歹徒袭击后，就只剩下我了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I really miss Caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真想念“帽子”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you the only guard on the front gate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 前门就你一个守卫？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now I am, yeah. But I'm a good guard, and no one's getting by me, now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在只有我了。不过我是个好守卫，没有人可以从我这过去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you the only guard on the front gate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 前门就你一个守卫？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. Right now, we don't even have anyone to cover me when I'm asleep.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。现在我睡觉时，没人能保护我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now leave me alone, I've got to be ready for duty soon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在离我远点，我要准备上岗了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't you guard the front gate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不是前门的守卫吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You brought back Penny and Sammy and Squirrel? Well, I guess that does make you a pretty big hero. Thanks!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你把佩尼，萨米和“松鼠”带回来了？太好了，我猜那会让你成为一个超级大英雄。谢谢！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucy [06015696] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : "big hero" is said a little teasingly EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm Lucy, and I'm pretty much the mom around here. And that means I spend a lot of time kissing boo-boos and making things all better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是露西，我几乎成了这地方的妈妈。这也意味着我要花很多时间来照顾伤患，这样他们才能好起来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucy [06015696] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : "big hero" is said a little teasingly EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, if you ever get any scrapes or bruises - or if you get shot, stabbed, or radiated - stop by and I'll do what I can, big hero.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，如果你被擦伤或撞伤 — 或者被射伤、刺伤，辐射 — 就到我这来，我会尽我所能为你疗伤，大英雄。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucy [06015696] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : "big hero" is said a little teasingly EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I rescued those captured kids. I'm a big hero.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我救了那些被抓的孩子。我是个大英雄。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, if you brought them back, then I guess that explains why RJ let you in. So, I guess that does make you a big hero.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好极了，你把他们带回来了，我就说为什么镇长会让你进来。看来你要成大英雄了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm Lucy, and I'm pretty much mommy to the folks here. I try to keep them safe, and when that's not enough I patch up their cuts and bruises.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是露西，我几乎成了这群家伙的妈妈了。我尽力保护他们，并且还得帮他们包扎被割伤和撞伤的伤口。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And when that's not enough, I make sure they get a funeral. Thanks for making sure I didn't have to do that for three more of mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但那还没完，我还得安葬不幸死去的人。谢谢你，让我不用多做三次。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I rescued those captured kids. I'm a big hero.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我救了那些被抓的孩子。我是个大英雄。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was you? Well, you brought my sister Penny back, so sure, I'll call you a big hero. Thank you very much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是你？嗯，你把我的妹妹佩尼带回来了，你是我的大英雄。非常感谢你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm Joseph, and as the oldest kid in Lamplight, I'm pretty much a teacher by default. I also try to keep the kids clean and fresh-faced.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是约瑟夫，作为小灯镇里年龄最大的小孩，我几乎是默认的老师。我也会让他们保持清洁和精神饱满。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not sure if there's anything I can teach you, but if you need a haircut or the like, just say the word. And thanks again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能确定还能教你什么，但如果你想理发或类似的事，和我说下就行。还有再次谢谢你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm the big hero who saved those kidnapped kids.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是救出那些被绑架的孩子的大英雄。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, really? So you're saying you brought back three more hungry mouths, too? Great, you're just making my day better and better!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，真的？你是说你还带回了三张饥饿的嘴？太好了，你让我的日子更好过了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I'm Eclair, and I'm in charge of the crap we call food down here. And we've got precious little enough to go around as it is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我是“夹心奶条”，我管理着我们称为食物的垃圾。我们很珍惜这些恰好足以维持生命的垃圾。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, yeah, thanks for bringing those folks back alive, but don't expect me to throw you a big party over it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，感谢你把那些人活着带回来，但别指望我为你开一个大的庆功宴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, I rescued those kids from the Slavers. You owe me some respect, kid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，我从奴隶贩子手中救出了这些孩子。小子，你该尊重我一点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You saved Penny and Sammy and Squirrel? I can see why RJ let you in! Thanks, for all of us!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你救了佩尼、萨米和“松鼠”？我明白为什么麦迪让你进来了！谢谢，代表我们所有人！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm Lucy, and I pretty much spend my days playing mommy around here. I spend a lot of time kissing boo-boos and making things better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是露西，我大部分时间都在扮演妈妈的角色。花费大量时间来亲亲伤口，让一切都好起来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you get a scraped knee or stubbed toe, come see me. Same if you get shot in the face or burns all over, but I can only promise so much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你擦伤了膝盖或被踩伤了脚趾，就来找我。如果你脸部被射伤或全身烧伤，你也可以来找我，但我可能什么也做不了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a guest in town. Mayor MacCready let me in for rescuing your friends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是镇里的客人。是麦迪市长让我进来救你的朋友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was you? Well, my most sincere thanks, then. You brought my sister Penny back to me, and I couldn't ask more than that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是你？嗯，请接受我最诚挚的感谢。你把我的妹妹佩尼带回来了，我无法要求你做得更多。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm Joseph, and if there's ever anything I can do for you here, just name it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是约瑟夫，如果有什么是我能为你做的，尽管开口！

ESP.ORIGINAL: As the oldest kid in town, I spend most of my time teaching, but I do what I can to keep the kids clean and fresh-faced.
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为镇里最年长的孩子，我花费大部分时间用于教学，不过我也尽可能地确保孩子的卫生和健康。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Say, if you're ever looking for a haircut, I'd be glad to offer my services. You only have to ask!
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想理发，我很乐于为你服务。尽管开口！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mayor MacCready let me in for rescuing those kids.
ESP.TRADUIT: 麦迪市长让我进来解救那些孩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you think Sammy and the rest wouldn't have gotten back on their own eventually? I taught him better than that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你觉得萨米和其他人最终没法自己回来？我的徒弟可比你想象的要强。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, if you're sticking around, you ought to know that I'm Princess, and I call the shots around here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，如果你老在这里转悠，你该知道我是公主，还有在这我说了算。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And don't forget it, mungo!
ESP.TRADUIT: 别忘了，毛人！

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Mayor let me in because I rescued some of your friends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是镇长让我进来的，因为我救了你的朋友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's good, they don't like me having my gun in town, so I gotta turn it in first, so if I had to shoot you you'd have to wait a bit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那很好，他们不喜欢我在镇里携枪，因此我事先上交了，所以如果我不得不向你开枪，你还得在这等我一会儿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My name's Zip. I don't think that's short for anything, because I don't know what it'd be short for. Zippy? Zipperick? Ziptholomew?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的名字叫拉链，我觉得我的名字不是缩写，因为我不知道它是什么的缩写。吉帕？吉帕瑞克？吉帕多罗买？

ESP.ORIGINAL: So yeah, it's good to meet you, big kid, and maybe you've got big stuff on top of you. Do you have any Nuka-Cola, maybe? Yes? Please?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，很高兴见到你，大孩子，或许你在上面拿到了一些大孩子用的东西。有核子可乐吗？有吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, you don't need to shoot me. Just think of me as a big kid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，你用不着开枪打我。你就把我当成一个大孩子好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, that's good because Mayor MacCready says I can't have my gun in town anymore, not since last time, but that was totally an accident anyway!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，那很好，因为自从那次以后，麦迪镇长说我不能再在镇里携枪了，可那纯粹是场意外啊！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : very hyperactive EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: That reminds me, got any Nuka-Cola? 'Cause if I'm not gonna have a gun in town, then it must be okay for me to have more Nuka, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那提醒了我，有核子可乐吗？因为既然我不能再在镇里携枪，那么我应该可以拿更多核子可乐，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : very hyperactive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyway, everyone calls me Zip, you know, like a zipper, only not really like that because I'm not made of metal, but I do go up and down, I guess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总之，每个人都叫我拉链，你知道，像一条拉链。我猜他们之所以这样叫我，是因为虽然我不是用铁做的，但我总是像拉链一样上下走动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : very hyperactive EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, no, I'm not here to cause any problems! You don't need your gun!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，不，我不是来惹麻烦的！你不用拿枪！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? Because I heard from the mayor about the sorts of deals you make when you trade. None for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？因为我听镇长说过你做交易时的事情。没你份。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's trade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们来交易。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure thing, pal! Special deals for us kids!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，伙计！对我们这些孩子来次特别交易！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's trade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们来交易。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope you brought me some cool stuff!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望你会带给我一些很酷的东西！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's trade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们来交易。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I heard about the sorts of things you'd do for this fungus. Well, you're cut off. Go scrounge your own food.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我听说你为了蘑菇所做的事。嗯，这不欢迎你。自己去找食物吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like some food.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要些食物。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bon appetit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 祝你胃口好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eclair [06015682] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Said in mocking manner - the food isn't very appetizing EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like some food.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要些食物。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure thing, mungo. We don't have much to spare, so get ready to pay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，毛人。我们剩得不多，所以准备付钱吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eclair [06015682] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A little resentful, and happily bilking the player out of money. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like some food.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要些食物。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enjoy, if you've got the caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好好享受，如果你有瓶盖的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eclair [06015682] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A little resentful, and happily bilking the player out of money. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like some food.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要些食物。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right. Now, hold still.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好。现在别动。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you give me a haircut?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能给我理理发吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Certainly. How would you like to look?
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。你打算怎么做？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you give me a haircut?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能给我理理发吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't need to explain myself to you, mungo. Shut up and get lost.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不需要向你解释，毛人。闭嘴，消失。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Princess [06015685] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Unexpectedly angry at the mention of her nickname EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: In fact, don't you ever bother me about something as stupid as nicknames again!
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，别拿绰号这类蠢事再来打扰我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Princess [06015685] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Unexpectedly angry at the mention of her nickname EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did someone like you get a nickname like Princess?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么像你这样的人会有公主这样的绰号？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why Zip? Or why do I have a nickname at all? I mean, why don't people just call me Ricky? Or Yancy? Or Eustace P. Vanderbanger the Third?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么叫拉链？还是为什么我会有绰号？我的意思是，人们为什么不叫我瑞基？或是杨西？又或是尤斯塔斯·P·范德邦赫？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Hyperactive, just about as fast as you can say. Maybe even a little too fast to understand. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean, they say it's because I'm so fast, but that doesn't make sense because I don't think I'm all that fast, it's just that they're all so slow!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的意思是，他们说我语速很快，可是我不觉得自己有多快，只是他们太慢了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Hyperactive, just about as fast as you can say. Maybe even a little too fast to understand. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess it's just one of those mysteries that'll never really get answered, sort of like how people made the bubbles in Nuka-Cola. Say, got any Cola?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想那是个永远无从知晓的谜，就像人们怎么在核子可乐里弄出泡泡。说到这，有可乐吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Hyperactive, just about as fast as you can say. Maybe even a little too fast to understand. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you called Zip?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么你会叫拉链？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hold open classes every morning for anyone who's got an interest in learning about a subject. Obviously, voluntary attendance is usually low.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我每个早上都为所有有兴趣学习某个科目的人上课。显然，自觉上课的人总是很少。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wouldn't normally let someone like you sit in, but since you saved Penny's life, it's the least I can offer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 通常情况下我是不会让像你这样的人坐进来的，不过既然你救了佩尼的命，我只能以此回报了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Would you like to hear our history? It's something of a favorite.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想听听我们的历史吗？那充满了乐趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Could you tell me about this class?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能告诉我这个班级的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where can I get some food?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我到哪能找到些食物？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right here. Welcome to our fungus pools. Eat up!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，这儿。欢迎来到我们的蘑菇池。随便吃！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hee hee! Okay, later then!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，嘿！好的，迟点！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucy [06015696] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : giggling laughter, like at a dirty joke EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. See you later, and don't get too bashed up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，迟点见，别被揍得太厉害。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I understand. Well, take care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白。嗯，小心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joseph [0601568D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Not ironic. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hear that. Anyway, gotta be on my way. Later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听见了。总之，该上路了。迟点见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, okay. Umm, bye!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，好的。再见！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, whatever you say. Bye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，随你怎么说，再见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right then! See ya!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好！再见！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, then! See ya!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的！再见！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Umm... Okay, yeah, bye bye now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯……好的，嗯，再见！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : hyperactive, spoken quickly EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: That makes sense. Talk to you later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有道理。迟点和你谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. Bye now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好。再见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : mumbled EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I see. Catch you later, I guess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我明白。迟点找你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Squirrel [06015686] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A couple weak coughs EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, yeah, fine. Catch ya later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，嗯，好的。迟点找你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mayor MacCready [060156AC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A little disinterested EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: 'Kay, bye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. Bye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。再见
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Biwwy [06061794] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Drawn out "oooh-kay", like you're not sure how to respond to them. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Meh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯哼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Busy, like always. Somebody's always got a tummy ache or a runny nose or a knife wound. You know how it is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 忙，总是这样。总有些人肚疼，或是流涕，又或是刀伤。你知道的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm fine. It's another fine day, underground.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很好。地下的又一天。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joseph [0601568D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Not ironic. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doing good. I could do with better food, but couldn't we all?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还行。要是有更好的食物就好了，谁不是呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm fine, thanks!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很好，谢谢！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doing better than a dog in a bone-yard!
ESP.TRADUIT: 比一条垃圾场的狗好！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Happier than a Ghoul wallowing in sludge!
ESP.TRADUIT: 比一个烂泥里的僵尸快活！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just fine! Been all over today, and you wouldn't believe the cool stuff I did!
ESP.TRADUIT: 很行！今天状态平平，你不会相信我干那些酷事！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : hyperactive, spoken quickly EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's always nicer to be in here than out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这总比在外边好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : mumbled, sullen. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I'm catching a cough. But I'll be fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我感冒了，不过我会好起来的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Squirrel [06015686] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A couple weak coughs EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, not yet I'm not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我还没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mayor MacCready [060156AC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A little smarmy EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're in the best fucking place in the world! You better believe I feel great!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们在世界上他妈的最好的地方！你最好相信我感觉超棒！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mayor MacCready [060156AC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : super-enthusiastic EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm okay!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很好！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Biwwy [06061794] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Spoken with annoying little kid lisp ("L" pronounced as "W") EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Little Lamplighter [06038836] (mod) NPC : Lucy [06015696] (mod) NPC : Little Lamplighter [06038837] (mod) NPC : Little Lamplighter [060BD46E] (mod) NPC : Little Lamplighter [060BD46F] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh hey! How're you doing? Doing okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，嗨！最近怎么样？过得好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : hyperactive, spoken quickly EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello. How are you doing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好。最近怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello. How's it going?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好。最近怎么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : mumbled, apathetic EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey there! You doing alright?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨！你过得还好吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey! How's Lamplight life treating you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨！你在小灯镇过得怎么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mayor MacCready [060156AC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A little bombastic EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Heya. Are you feeling alright? You look a little stiff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿。你感觉还好吧？你看起来有些拘谨。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello, there. Are you okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好。你还好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joseph [0601568D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Friendly and genial EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey. How you doing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，最近怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello. How are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hrmf. What're you so happy about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿。你在高兴什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Princess [06015685] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : dismissive EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Beat it, squirt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 滚，小毛孩。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do, pal?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么样，伙计？

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do ya do, pal?
ESP.TRADUIT: 最近怎么样，伙计？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hewwo. How're you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你豪。最近怎么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Biwwy [06061794] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Spoken with annoying little kid lisp ("L" pronounced as "W") EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, how are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，你好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's ridiculous. I'm not paying you that much!
ESP.TRADUIT: 真可笑。我不会付你那么多！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well... I guess I could make an exception. 50 caps -- but that's my final offer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯...我想我可以破例一次。50瓶盖...但这是我的最终报价。

ESP.ORIGINAL: 50 caps would still leave you with a nice profit. What do you say?
ESP.TRADUIT: 50个瓶盖都能让你赚不少了。怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right. But don't let it get around, or I'll have every dirty waster begging me for help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。不过，别让这件事传出去，否则每个肮脏的废物都会向我求援。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on, doc. I need help. 75 caps is better than nothing, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉我吧，医生。我需要帮助。75个瓶盖总比没有好吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. 100 it is. But don't think this makes us friends. This is a special, one-time offer, understand?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，100瓶盖。但别以为这样我们就成了朋友。这是一次性的优惠，明白吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's highway robbery. 100 caps is more than fair, don't you think?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这简直是敲诈。你不觉得100个瓶盖太多了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, here's your caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，这是给你的钱，。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, here's your caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，这是给你的钱，。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, here's your caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，这是给你的钱，。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The code is 2-1-6.
All right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll see you in hell, coward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们地狱见，胆小鬼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, I got it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，我知道了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess if this doesn't work, we're screwed anyway, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想如果这不行，我们就有大麻烦了，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, I got it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，我知道了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell my father... Tell him I love him, will you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉我的父亲……告诉他我爱他，好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll do it. I'll start the purifier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会进去。我会启动那净水器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're going to have to be quick about it. If the radiation is bad enough, you won't have much time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你一定要尽快。如果辐射太强，你不会有很多时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I won't forget what you've done here. No one will. Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会忘记你所做的事。没人会忘记。谢谢你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on, isn't there anything you can do to help?
ESP.TRADUIT: 来吧，你可以帮忙做些什么吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose I can spare a few stimpaks. It's not much, but it might make things easier for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我有多余的治疗针。虽然不多，但能让你舒服些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E89]MQ03) Scientific Pursuits EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're running out of time. You need to get in there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们没有时间了。你必须进去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! Comment (NAM2) : anxious EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get in the airlock. I'll cycle it for you so you can enter the code.
ESP.TRADUIT: 进到气密门里去。我会开启它，以便你可以输入密码。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have to get in the airlock before I can cycle it and let you in there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我开启气密门之前，你必须进到气密门里去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're running out of time! You need to get in that airlock now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们快没时间了！你必须现在就进入气密门！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: God help me. I found Dad today... I didn't think it was him, but... the face. The zombies didn't touch him. I think… he was becoming like them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 上帝保佑。我找到了爸爸……我不觉得那是他，但……那张脸。丧尸没有碰他。我猜他已经与他们没有分别了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaime [06037F43] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : NPC Jaime - Male Hispanic, late 20's - Recording Personal JournalMood: Exhausted, resigning himself, slipping off to sleep. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Didn't know it was him until I found that old book near him. No more killing. I just need to go. Can't forget the book. All I have left of him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 直到在他身边找到那本旧书，我才知道那是他。不必杀戮。我只需要离开。不能忘了那本书。我只需离开他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaime [06037F43] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : NPC Jaime - Male Hispanic, late 20's - Recording Personal JournalMood: Exhausted, resigning himself, slipping off to sleep. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's warm against the stone. I'll just rest a while...
ESP.TRADUIT: 靠着岩石很暖和。我只想休息会……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaime [06037F43] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : NPC Jaime - Male Hispanic, late 20's - Recording Personal JournalMood: Exhausted, resigning himself, slipping off to sleep. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't like the look of this place... don't like the smell. Gives me the creeps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不喜欢这地方的样子……不喜欢那味道。让我起鸡皮疙瘩。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaime [06037F43] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : NPC Jaime - Male Hispanic, late 20's - Recording Personal JournalVoice: Whispered Mood: Unsettled EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't want to risk a shot at the crows until I know what’s in there. Sneaking in tonight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我知道那有什么之前，不要贸然开枪。今晚潜入。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaime [06037F43] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : NPC Jaime - Male Hispanic, late 20's - Recording Personal JournalVoice: Whispered Mood: Unsettled EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He must have been trying to trap food here. I recognize his snares. I can make out a building on the horizon. That must be where he headed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他肯定在这试着捕食。我认得他的陷阱。我能辨认出地平线上的那座建筑。他肯定朝那去了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaime [06037F43] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : NPC Jaime - Male Hispanic, late 20's - Recording Personal JournalMood: Hopeful EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If not, at least I get a roof tonight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果不是，至少今晚我能有瓦遮头了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaime [06037F43] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : NPC Jaime - Male Hispanic, late 20's - Recording Personal JournalMood: Hopeful EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hit a caravan today. Trev didn't see the kid and got popped. I took care of Tawny right then, and put one in Thor before he saw her fall.
ESP.TRADUIT: 今天遇到了商队。特雷弗没看见那孩子并且被他打中了。我那时正顾着喝酒，在托尔看到她倒下前把酒放在了他那。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaime [06037F43] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : NPC Jaime - Male Hispanic, late 20's - Recording Personal Journal"Me too" is said like it's obvious - kind of a "no shit" statement EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That earned me some grub from the traders. Even better, they saw dad. He was in pretty rough shape, and still has the goddamn book.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这使我从商人那得到了一些食物。更棒的是，他们见过爸爸。他的样子很糟，仍然拿着那该死的书。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaime [06037F43] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : NPC Jaime - Male Hispanic, late 20's - Recording Personal Journal"Me too" is said like it's obvious - kind of a "no shit" statement EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Trader says it gave him the creeps. Me too. But it's good to know he's still alive. Still headed south.
ESP.TRADUIT: 商人说他让人起鸡皮疙瘩。换我也会。但很高兴知道他还活着。继续朝南方去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaime [06037F43] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : NPC Jaime - Male Hispanic, late 20's - Recording Personal Journal"Me too" is said like it's obvious - kind of a "no shit" statement EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gee, thanks! I have to admit, most of them aren't really funny. At least, not ha-ha funny.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢！我必须承认，它们大部分并不真正好笑，至少，没法令人哈哈大笑。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're more like a tradition. Most of them were passed down from this book we found down back, called "Vault Boy's Big Book of Laughs for Kids".
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们更像一种传统。其中大多数是从我们过去发现的一本书，叫什么“避难所男孩的儿科笑话大全”里流传下来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're not really funny, but something about hearing them is a little comforting, you know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们并非真的有趣，但是听一听也能令人欣慰，你懂吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was... um... really funny. <Lie.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 那…的确…很有趣。<撒谎>

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know. And really, we're lucky we didn't lose more people in that attack.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道。实际上，我们非常幸运，在那次袭击中没有损失更多人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But we can't risk that a second time. I've got to stay extra vigilant on watch. Thanks for reminding me of that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，我们不能再冒险，我们要加倍留神。谢谢提醒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now leave me alone. No distractions!
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在让我一个人静一下，我不想分心！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds like it was your fault Caps died. Guards can't slack like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来是你害死“帽子”的。守卫不会那么不堪一击。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Somebody needs to guard the front gate, and no one else is doing it. So I will. Even if it sucks for me, I don't mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有些人需要守卫前门，但没有其他人做了。所以我做。虽然这让我很不开心，但我不介意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some things just have to be done, and they just have to be done right. Because if they aren't, you can't ever get back what you lose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有些事情是一定要做的，而且一定要做对。否则一旦失败，有些东西失去了就永远找不回来了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Besides, Caps would want it like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 此外，“帽子”会希望我这样的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're going to stand guard all alone from now on? Quite a sacrifice, Stacey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你打算从现在起一个人站岗？斯泰西，你很有奉献精神。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. Not anymore, they don't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。再也不会那样了，再也不会了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, stop distracting me from my job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，别让我在工作时分心。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's the way things go, you know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 世事难料，明白吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Except... I was supposed to be on guard when they attacked. I should have been here to help Caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除了……在他们袭击时，我应该在这守卫。我应该在这帮助“帽子”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stacey [060156AB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Suddenly resolute. EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: It really is my fault she died.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她的死确实是我的错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stacey [060156AB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Suddenly resolute. EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now I'm the only front gate guard, so it's my responsibility to make up for that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在我是唯一的前门看守，弥补过错就是我的职责。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stacey [060156AB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Suddenly resolute. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can't blame yourself for her death.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不应该因为她的死而责怪自己。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, is that how it's going to be, then? Well then, how's this deal?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，然后怎样？成交？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rather than you wasting the explosives to try to close all of our exits, just for us to burrow out again, you get my private stash of fungus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 与其浪费炸弹试图封死我们的所有出口，不如你帮我们再次挖出去，让你尝尝我珍藏的小蘑菇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here. But I wouldn't expect much goodwill in town after this, you shit-sucking mungo bastard.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给。之后我再也不会相信这个镇子里人的信誉了，你这吃屎的毛人杂种。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Give me the fungus, or I'll seal this place underground. And you with it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把蘑菇给我，否则我就把这填平了，让你陪葬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it lighten the load for our scav team out a lot. And since you're pretty much one of us, here's the deal...
ESP.TRADUIT: 这很大程度上减轻了我们拾荒队的负担。你帮了我们那么多，拿着……

ESP.ORIGINAL: For every piece of strange meat or Buffout you bring in, you'll be repaid with one cube of fungus. You couldn't ask for a better deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你每带回一片奇怪的肉或者壮大灵，都会得到一块蘑菇作为报。这交易太划算了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Talk with Eclair for the strange meat, or to Lucy about the Buffout. They've got uses for them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和“夹心奶条”谈谈奇怪的肉，或和露西谈谈壮大灵。这些东西对他们来说很有用。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I bring in needed supplies, and I get some of the fungus in return.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我带来了有用的补给，作为回报我需要一些蘑菇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's not a terrible deal. And it'd mean more of those dumbasses can stay safely down here, instead of scavving all the time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这交易不错。这意味着那些傻瓜中有更多人可以安全地待在这，而不用整天拾荒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, for every two bits of strange meat or Buffout, I'll make sure you get a piece of fungus. Not too bad, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，每两片奇怪的肉或者壮大灵，我都会换给你一块蘑菇。不错吧，呃？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll spread the word to and Lucy and Eclair. They've got uses for them, so they'll make the trade, and we'll all be happy, okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会通知露西和“夹心奶条”。他们有用到，如果买卖成了，我们都开心，好吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I bring in needed supplies, and I get some of the fungus in return.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我带来了有用的补给，作为回报我需要一些蘑菇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: More stuff for us, and more chance of you getting shot, stumbling back here, choking on your own blood while we point and laugh? Sounds good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我们东西越多，你中枪的几率就越大，蹒跚而回，被自己的血呛到，而我们在一旁指指点点，哈哈大笑？听起来不错。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about this: for every three pieces of strange meat or Buffout doses you bring in, you'll get one piece of fungus. Take it or leave it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这样如何：你每带回来三片奇怪的肉或者壮大灵，你都可以得到一块蘑菇。同不同意随你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just talk to Lucy or Eclair about what they need, and stop bothering me about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去和露西或者“夹心奶条”谈他们的需求，别烦我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I bring in needed supplies, and I get some of the fungus in return.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我带来了有用的补给，作为回报我需要一些蘑菇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not that complex. Any kid can say they want to be mayor here. It's just that most don't want to bother with the responsibility of leading.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有那么复杂。这里所有孩子都能竞选镇长。只是大多数人都不想承担领导的责任。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Most of the time, they last until the kids get tired of them, then they get kicked out on their ass by the new mayor. One only lasted 5 minutes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大部分情况下，他们的任期直到其他孩子厌烦他们为止，然后他们就会被新镇长赶下台。其中有一个只坚持了5分钟。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course, I've kept this place going strong for three years. To most kids, that makes me Mayor For Fucking Life. Fine by me, I say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。我让这地方保持强大了三年。对大多数孩子而言，我就是他妈的终生镇长。我是说，我做得还不错。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you get to be in charge of this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么当上这地方的老大的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great stuff! Talk with you later, sis!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好东西！等会再谈，姐妹！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not if I could help it! Made any good trades today?
ESP.TRADUIT: 除非我能帮忙！今天有什么好买卖？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knock Knock [06015693] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Cheerfully self-deprecating EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You getting a nickname any time soon? Maybe you can get one that helps people figure out you're not a girl.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能否尽快取个绰号？或许你该起个能让别人明白你不是女孩的绰号。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now you're just making up words, aren't you? Here's your standard.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在捏造词汇，对吧？你也就这水平。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, cave fungus in sauce? Coming right up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 用了酱料的洞穴蘑菇？拿来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just like you're keeping them alive, Lucy. Here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就像你让他们活了下来，露西。好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just like you're keeping them alive, Lucy. Here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就像你让他们活了下来，露西。好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure thing, dear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，亲爱的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice try, but you're still getting the same muck as everyone else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得好，但你给我的是和其他人给的一样的垃圾！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hell, I'd be happy with a clean set of spoons. Enjoy the meal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 见鬼，我真高兴有一套干净的汤匙。痛快的吃吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, yeah, I know. Here's your "fun-guy." Should be as good as your jokes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，嗯，我知道。给你“有趣的人”。应该和你的笑话一样有趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eclair [06015682] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : emphasizing "fun-guy" as "fungi". EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, yeah, I get it, Zip. Here, knock yourself out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，嗯，我做好了，拉链。给，自便。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Calm down, Zip. It's not getting any blander. Here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 冷静，拉链。它已经不会更淡了。给。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure thing, Penny.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，佩尼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Toughen up, Squirrel. The dirt adds flavor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 坚强点，“松鼠”。尘土增添了风味。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't believe you like this shit, RJ.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不相信你会喜欢这垃圾，麦迪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here. Now, get.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给。拿着。

ESP.ORIGINAL: People don't have the same sort of safety and freedom to run around and play like you can here. They have to work hard for food and safety.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其他人可不像你在这里一样安全，能自由地四处奔跑、无忧无虑地玩耍。他们必须为食物和安全努力工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uncle Joseph, could you explain more about the outside?
ESP.TRADUIT: 约瑟夫叔叔，你能多说点外面世界的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uncle Joseph, I still don't understand what outside's like. Can you explain more?
ESP.TRADUIT: 约瑟夫叔叔，我还是不明白外面世界是什么样的。你能多说点吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have 20 to sell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有20块待售。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We can always use 'em.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们总是需要它们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have 25 to sell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有25块待售。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We can always use 'em.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们总是需要它们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have 15 to sell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有15块待售。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We can always use 'em.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们总是需要它们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have 5 to sell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有5块待售。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We can always use 'em.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们总是需要它们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have 10 to sell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有10块待售。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We can always use 'em.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们总是需要它们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Interested in buying some scrap metal?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有兴趣买些废金属吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I sure am, sonny. What've you got for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不错，男孩。你给我带来了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I sure am, missy. What've you got for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不错，女孩。你给我带来了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can I do to help around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这有什么我可以帮忙的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it's no secret that the ol' water treatment plant is on its last legs. And I'm the only one in town that can keep the damn thing running.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，众所周知水处理厂已经快不行了。而我是镇里唯一一个还能让这该死的东西运作的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I spend so much time up in the plant, that I can't take care of the leaks that keep springing up in the pipes around town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在这厂里花费大量时间，无暇顾及镇里管道不断出现的泄漏。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, I don't expect much from strangers, but if you've got the know-how, I need someone to hunt down and repair those leaks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对陌生人没太大期望，但如果你有所了解，我需要有人去找到并修复那些泄漏的管道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'll be... the pressure's up in the plant. It looks like all the leaks have been fixed. Thank you, stranger! Thank you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我会……厂里的压力上升了。看来所有泄漏的管道都已经修复了。谢谢你，陌生人！谢谢！

ESP.ORIGINAL: But listen, it's only a matter of time before they burst again, and someone like you might not be around to fix 'em. I'll make you a deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但听着，它们再次泄漏只是时间问题，而且不会恰好有像你这样的人去修复。我想跟你做个交易。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll give you caps for any Scrap Metal you can bring me. You'll find it all over the place out there in the Wastes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会为你带给我的每块废金属付钱。你在废土各处都能找到它们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I have a steady supply of scrap, I can keep the plant running and the pipes should be just fine. We got a deal?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果废料补给稳定，我就能维持水厂运作，保持管道完好。成交？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The pipes are all fixed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 管道全修好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just take all the scrap metal I have. No charge. I just want to help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把我的废金属都拿走吧。免费。我只是想提供帮助。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds good to me. I'll bring you the parts I find.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来不错。我会把找到的零件带给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good! This just keeps looking better! Those parts will keep this place running and the town in fresh water! Hurry back as soon as you find some!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的！这一来好多了！那些零件会使这维持运作以使镇子有净水供应！你找到后赶快回来！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not your errand boy. Just pay me for the repairs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可不是给你跑腿的。你得为修复付钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright... alright... relax. But all you've done is delay the inevitable. Without those parts, the plants gonna croak sooner or later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧……好吧……放松。但你所做的一切只是推迟必然发生的事。没有那些零件，水厂迟早会停止运作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But what do you care? You just want your money.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但你在乎什么？你只想要钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take it and get out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，拿了快滚。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright... alright... relax. But all you've done is delay the inevitable. Without those parts, the plants gonna croak sooner or later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧……好吧……放松。但你所做的一切只是推迟必然发生的事。没有那些零件，水厂迟早会停止运作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But what do you care? You just want your money.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但你在乎什么？你只想要钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take it and get out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，拿了快滚。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not your errand girl. Just pay me for the repairs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是你的跑腿女孩。只要付我修理费就行了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're wrong. Humans are cruel, hurtful beasts! They can't be saved... we can't be...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你错了。人类是残酷而凶恶的野兽！他们不能被拯救……我们不能……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The AntAgonizer [06036C1C] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't... I can't go back. But I can't keep doing this. I can't be as bad as they were. Not if someone like you believes in me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能……我不能回去。但我无法继续。我不能和他们一样坏。没人像你这样相信我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The AntAgonizer [06036C1C] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please... I think I've made some terrible mistakes. If you really think I still have a chance, just let me go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜托……我想我犯了些可怕的错。如果你真的觉得我还有机会，让我走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The AntAgonizer [06036C1C] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll give you the suit. No one ever has to see the AntAgonizer again. Just please, let me have another chance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会给你这件套装。没有人会再见到痛苦蚁后。拜托，再给我一个机会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The AntAgonizer [06036C1C] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We all make mistakes, but there's still a chance for us. I believe in you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们都会犯错，但我们还有机会弥补。我相信你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're wrong. Humans are cruel, hurtful beasts! They can't be saved... we can't be...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你错了。人类是残酷而凶恶的野兽！他们不能被拯救……我们不能……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The AntAgonizer [06036C1C] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能……我不能回去。但我无法继续。我不能和他们一样坏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The AntAgonizer [06036C1C] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please... I think I've made some terrible mistakes. If you really think I still have a chance, just let me go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜托……我想我犯了些可怕的错。如果你真的觉得我还有机会，让我走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The AntAgonizer [06036C1C] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll give you the suit. No one ever has to see the AntAgonizer again. Just please, let me have another chance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会给你这件套装。没有人会再见到痛苦蚁后。拜托，再给我一个机会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The AntAgonizer [06036C1C] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Humanity's made mistakes, but there's still a chance for us. And for you, Tanya.
ESP.TRADUIT: 人总是会犯错，但我们还有机会弥补。塔尼娅，你也是。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is... Is that true? Have I really become a threat to the town? Do you really feel that way?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这……这是真的？我真的成了镇子的威胁？你真的这么觉得？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Mechanist [06036C1B] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Am I really the villain, here? Does this mean I should stop myself?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在这真的是个恶棍吗？这是不意味着我该收敛？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Mechanist [06036C1B] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I... I guess I could just give up my suit and stop being the Mechanist. But I couldn't face the town after causing that much trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我……我想我可以放弃我这件套装，不再做机械侠。但造成这么多麻烦后，我没法面对镇子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Mechanist [06036C1B] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, please. Take the suit. I don't want to think about it anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给。拿走这套装。我再也不想看到它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Mechanist [06036C1B] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Darling, your fighting is scaring the whole town. Won't you stop for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 亲爱的，你们的战斗把镇里的人都吓坏了。看在我的份上，你们就停止吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is... Is that true? Have I really become a threat to the town?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这……这是真的？我真的成了镇子的威胁？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Mechanist [06036C1B] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Am I really the villain, here? Does this mean I should stop myself?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在这真的是个恶棍吗？这是不意味着我该收敛？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Mechanist [06036C1B] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I... I guess I could just give up my suit and stop being the Mechanist. But I couldn't face the town after causing that much trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我……我想我可以放弃我这件套装，不再做机械侠。但造成这么多麻烦后，我没法面对镇子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Mechanist [06036C1B] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Fear

ESP.TRADUIT: 给。拿走这套装。我再也不想看到它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Mechanist [06036C1B] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your fighting is scaring people in town, and it might hurt little Derek.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们的战斗把镇里的人都吓坏了，这可能会让小德里克受伤的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is... Is that true? Have I really become a bigger problem for the town than her?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这……这是真的？对镇子来说，我真的成了比她还大的麻烦？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Mechanist [06036C1B] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Am I really the villain, here? Does this mean I should stop myself?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在这真的是个恶棍吗？这是不意味着我该收敛？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Mechanist [06036C1B] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I... I guess I could just give up my suit and stop being the Mechanist. But I couldn't face the town after causing that much trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我……我想我可以放弃我这件套装，不再做机械侠。但造成这么多麻烦后，我没法面对镇子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Mechanist [06036C1B] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, please. Take the suit. I don't want to think about it anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给。拿走这套装。我再也不想看到它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Mechanist [06036C1B] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: The fighting is causing more trouble for the town than the AntAgonizer ever did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这场战斗比痛苦蚁后带来的麻烦要多的多。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell you what. You tell me first, and I'll consider taking the tour.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我告诉你该怎么办吧。你先和我谈谈，我再考虑是否参观。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I suppose. I really wanted you to see the tour, but you seem nice enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我预料到了。我真的想让你去参观，不过看来你人很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ever hear of Nuka-Cola Quantum?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听过量子版核子可乐吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me more about this Ronald guy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉我更多关于罗纳德这个人的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's a darling. Always watching out for me, and more importantly keeping the collection safe!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他很贴心。总是照顾我，更重要的是确保了收藏品的安全！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Like once, there was these Raiders that came by. There were three of them and their leader was named like Lug-Nut or something...
ESP.TRADUIT: 像有一次，这来了一些歹徒。他们有三个人，带头的像是叫“笨蛋”螺母还是什么……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyone seen Forty? He wanted to talk to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人见到弗替了吗？他想和我谈谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pronto said he wanted to talk to me about something. Keep up, ladies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 普郎托说他想和我谈谈。跟上，女士们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need to see our good doctor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要见我们的好医生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's leave our employees to their recreation. There's a business to run.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们的雇员自娱自乐吧。我们有生意了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ladies, to the bar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 女士们，去酒吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's see what's going on over at the bar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看酒吧发生什么事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing going on here. Let's go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没事了。走吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: PFEulogyObserveStageStart
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里什么都没有。走吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's go, ladies. Keep up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 走吧，女士们。跟上。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm headed over to the block to see what's going on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我被派到这街区来了解发生了什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, they haven't killed each other yet. Always a plus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们还没自相残杀，能做到这点难能可贵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: C'mon. Time to check on the stock.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来吧。该核查现货了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, I've had enough. Let's do something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，够了。去做其他事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm heading to the deck. I need some air. Ladies, follow me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要到甲板上。我需要些新鲜空气。女士们，跟着我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's go up top. I want to see what these fools are up to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 到上面去。我想看看这些家伙是否合乎标准。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everyone calls me Zip, and I think that's because I'm always wearing pants, and those have zippers, but it's not like I'm the only one with pants.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所有人都叫我拉链，我想是因为我一直穿裤子，而裤子都有拉链，但好象不是只有我穿裤子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Spoken very quickly. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's all the Nuka-Cola Quantum I'm carrying.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我所有的核子可乐量子版。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've done it! My machine is finally full!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你做到了！我的机器终于装满了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, like I promised, here's the schematic for the Nuka Grenade. You've sure earned it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，遵照我的承诺，这是手榴弹（核子）的设计图。你应得的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you find any more bottles, be sure and bring them by. I'll be glad to keep paying for them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你再找到，一定要把它们带来。我会乐于为它们付钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have the last of the Quantum!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有最后的一瓶量子可乐！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've done it! My machine is finally full!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你做到了！我的机器终于装满了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, like I promised, here's your surprise... the schematic for the Nuka Grenade! You've sure earned it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，遵照我的承诺，这是手榴弹（核子）的设计图。你应得的 !
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you find any more bottles, be sure and bring them by. I'll be glad to keep paying for them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你再找到，一定要把它们带来。我会乐于为它们付钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have the last of the Quantum!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有最后的一瓶量子可乐！

ESP.ORIGINAL: My machine's almost full you know. That's over 25 bottles of Quantum!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道，我的机器快满了。已经超过25瓶量子版了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get me to 30 and you'll have the surprise reward I promised! Hehe! I love surprises!
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我带回30瓶，我承诺我会给你惊喜的报酬！嘿嘿！我爱惊喜！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Over twenty bottles already? Incredible! Keep 'em coming!
ESP.TRADUIT: 已经超过20瓶了？难以置信！继续努力！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh my word! Do you realize you've brought me back over ten of the Nuka-Cola Quantums?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的天啊！你意识到已经给我带回超过10瓶量子版核子可乐了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I knew you were the right person for the job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你适合这工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow. I can't believe you've found over five of the Quantums. I've never even seen that many before. Good job!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇。我不敢相信你已经找到了超过5瓶量子版。我以前从没见过这么多。干得好！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yay! I knew I could count on you! I promise to put them to good use.
ESP.TRADUIT: 耶！我知道我可以信任你！我保证会好好利用它们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, this should be enough to fill that stupid machine of hers. Thanks for all your help, but our transaction is done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这应该能塞满她那蠢机器。谢谢你的大力帮助，但我们的交易完成了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060388E1] (ID) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take any extras off your hands for now, but then I'm done with these disgusting drinks. They taste horrible!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会处理剩下的事，但我得搞定这些恶心的饮料。它们太难喝了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060388E1] (ID) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now to put the moves on my lady. Come and watch an expert at work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在该对我的女士采取行动了。等着瞧好戏吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060388E1] (ID) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Won't be long before I'm ready to spring my surprise on Sierra. She's gonna give it up for me for certain for this. Heck, she'd better!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不用多久，我准备给塞拉一个惊喜。她肯定会为了我而放弃它。见鬼，她最好那么做！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060388E1] (ID) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm glad you're seeing things my way. Nice job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴你能理解我的想法。干得好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060388E1] (ID) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: More, huh? Good. This will make Sierra very happy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 更多，呃？好的。这会让塞拉非常高兴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060388E1] (ID) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep the bottles coming, I'll keep the caps flowing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续努力，我会继续付瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060388E1] (ID) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on, Sierra. No secrets between friends! What's the special reward?
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜托，塞拉。朋友之间没有秘密！特别奖励是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know a whole lot about weapons, but I do know that it's more powerful than a regular grenade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对武器的了解不多，但我知道它比普通手榴弹要更强。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It explodes in a huge blue flame too! How cool is that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 它还会爆发蓝色的火焰！那不是很酷？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me more about the Nuka Cocktail.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我详细说说核子手榴弹。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you know about the Nuka-Cola Bottling Facility?
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于核子可乐灌装工厂你知道些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This facility is a stunning accomplishment by the creative minds at the Nuka-Cola Corporation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这工厂是核子可乐公司创新思维的惊人成就。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We use cutting edge equipment to keep the world's most popular soft drink in full production 24 hours a day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们使用最尖端的设备来确保这世界上最流行的软饮料24小时不间断生产。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This unit prides itself on over 457 days without a single death or major limb loss of any personnel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这部队为超过457天没有一起死亡和主要肢体伤残而感到自豪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you know about Nuka-Cola Quantum?
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于核子可乐量子版你知道些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This product is the pinnacle of taste sensation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这产品是味觉的极致。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Seventeen fruit flavors and that signature cola taste blend to form the perfect refreshing soft drink.
ESP.TRADUIT: 17种水果香料和那鲜明的可乐味道混杂形成完美的全新软饮料。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: With its new Strontium additive, its got that unique kick to keep you on your toes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 由于它新的锶添加剂，会产生了一种独特的力量来让你保持警觉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you even have a clue as to where I can start looking?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能不能给我提示从哪找起呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: In fact, I do! Ha! Surprised you didn't I?
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，我能！哈！你感到惊喜吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your best bet would be to find the ruins of the D.C. Nuka-Cola Bottling Facility. Find the shipping manifests inside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好去特区灌装工厂的废墟里找。送货单是在那找到的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: With them in hand, you should have a good clue as to where the Quantum was delivered.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有它们在手，对于量子版的交付地点，你会得到很好的提示。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: While you're there, you may even be able to find some bottles of Quantum!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在那时，或许还能找到一些量子版！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, what happened to you, dear?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你怎么了，亲爱的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Poor kid, just be careful from now on, okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 可怜的孩子，以后小心，好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come here, I'll make it all better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来这，我会让它好转的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucy [06015696] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Doting and sincere EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: What have you got to trade for a bottle of Nuka-Cola?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么可以交换一瓶核子可乐？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I found a lucky bullet this morning!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，今早我找到一枚幸运子弹！

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's just a measly old 10 mil, but I know for sure it's lucky, 'cause it was sitting there all alone out of its clip and not fired off. Want it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是一发没用的旧10密耳，但我知道它肯定代表幸运，因为只剩它一发在弹夹外而没被开火。想要吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got an old mag full of 5.56s! Is that good enough for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我得到一整箱的5.56！够你用了吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : hyperactive EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Last time I was out looking, I found some of this mutfruit. It's not as sweet as Nuka, but maybe you mungos like that sort of thing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我上一次出去侦查，找到些这种变异果。它没有核子可乐那么甜，不过可能你们毛人喜欢这类东西？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : hyperactive EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I've got these pills that say "Mentats", but Lucy says they taste yucky and that I shouldn't take them. Maybe you want them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我拿到的这些药片写着“曼他特”，但露西说它们尝起来很恶心，而且我不该拿它们。或许你想要？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : hyperactive EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I didn't want to trade it, but I've got a stimpak Lucy said I'm supposed to carry around with me. Is it worth a Nuka?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，一开始我本不打算拿来交换的，但是我有一个治疗针，露西劝我应该留着它的。你说这东西值不值一瓶核子可乐呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : hyperactive EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, check this out, it's my most, most prized possession I found! Squirrel says it's a micro fusion cell. Is it worth a Nuka?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，看看，这是我发现的最最有价值的东西了！“松鼠”说这是微型核融合电池。这值不值一瓶核子可乐呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : hyperactive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, and I got lots to trade. But if you got no Nuka, you're not getting nothing, no way!
ESP.TRADUIT: 唔，我有很多东西，如果你没有核子可乐，那么你什么也得不到，绝对！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : hyperactive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You said you were looking for Nuka-Cola?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说你在找核子可乐？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, more Nuka's always good! It's definitely always gooder than less, because no Nuka's no good at all! Got any Nuka for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 唔，多多益善！有就好，没就坏！还有核子可乐给我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll trade you whatever I've got for more Nuka-Cola! Anytime! Nuka 4 Zip! Nuka 4 Zip!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会用我手上的任何东西来换核子可乐的！任何时候！核子可乐给拉链！核子可乐给拉链！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You said you were looking for Nuka-Cola?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说你在找核子可乐？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's all I got right now. Come back tomorrow, maybe I'll have more, and you can have more Nuka for me to have more Nuka? Yeah?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是我有的全部了。你明天再来，或许我会有更多，或许你会有更多的核子可乐给我，而我就会有更多的核子可乐？对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : hyperactive EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got anything else for a Nuka-Cola?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有其他东西来换核子可乐吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I did yesterday, I am today, and I probably will be tomorrow! Well, unless I die from too much Nuka. But that can't happen. Everyone knows that!
ESP.TRADUIT: 昨天是，今天是，估计明天也是！嗯，除非我死于核子可乐。但那是不可能发生的，所有人都知道！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : hyperactive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you still offering a trade for Nuka-Cola?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还再做核子可乐的交易吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stand down, squishy. Present your ID on the double.
ESP.TRADUIT: 站住，脓包。出示你的证件。

ESP.ORIGINAL: ID accepted. Resume your duties.
ESP.TRADUIT: 身份确认。回到岗位。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Halt, intruder! Unauthorized personnel will be handled with extreme violence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 站定，入侵者！未经授权的人员将会给予极端暴力处罚。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Initiating Combat Protocol: Charlie Zulu 4.
ESP.TRADUIT: 战斗程序初始化：笨蛋祖鲁4。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need you to repair my weapons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要修理武器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, lemme see what you have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，让我看看你有些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me see your inventory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看你的货物。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I tell you, for a bunch of dumbass wasters, the boys pull some good stuff off of the new meat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我告诉你，对于一个从废土来的女人，那些男孩总是充满兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to buy medical supplies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想看看你的医疗物资。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Money first, then you'll get the goods.
ESP.TRADUIT: 先给钱，后给货。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Paradise Falls? What's that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 堕落天堂？那是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you kidding me? You've never heard of Paradise Falls? Oh, right. The suit. You're right out of the vault, aren't you? Great.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在开玩笑吗？你没听说过堕落天堂？哦，对了，那套装，你是从避难所来的，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shit, you're lucky you're not up there in the pens, dumbass. I can't believe you. Anyway, Paradise Falls is home to the Slavers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他妈的，你应该对没有在那栅栏里感到幸运，傻瓜。我不相信你。总之，堕落天堂是奴隶贩子的家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Up there, we sell the slaves that we capture out in the Wastes. So, unless you're either buying or selling, piss off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在那上面，我们贩卖从废土抓来的奴隶。所以如果你不是来做买卖，就给我滚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This probably isn't the best place for you to stand...
ESP.TRADUIT: 这大概不是什么站着的好地方吧……

ESP.ORIGINAL: You think I didn't know that? I've been hiding in this place for days!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你以为我不知道吗？我都已经站在这一天了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's an old portashelter next to the diner near my house. Those stupid things will never get me in there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我家附近的餐厅旁有一个旧庇护所。在那儿那些蠢东西绝对抓不到我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll head over there and wait inside. Hurry back!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会躲在那里面。快点回来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: In fifteen feet, make a right turn.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在15英尺的地方，向右转。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [00039561] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream Comment (NAM2) : imitating navigation system, but chuckling EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The left path is the right path, if you get my meaning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 向左转是正确的路，你明白我的意思了吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [00039561] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll never get here at this rate...
ESP.TRADUIT: 照这速度，你是回不来的……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06019A1C] (ID) NPC : [00039561] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep it up. You're almost here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续，你就快到了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [00039561] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Remote link activated. Scan complete. Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 远端连接启动。扫描结束。非常感谢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Im sorry, but I could not scan your Pip Boy. Please stand by for additional scan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，我无法扫描你的哔哔小子。请准备再次接受扫描。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No valid Pip-Boy detected. Please surrender for further scanning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有发现有效的哔哔小子。请投降，以备深入扫描。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Remote start activated, loading Vault protocols. Please hold.
ESP.TRADUIT: 远程遥控装置启动，载入避难所协议。请稍等。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hostile resident detected. Prepare to be subdued.
ESP.TRADUIT: 发现敌对居民。准备应对策略。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stand back citizens. It is my goal to reduce collateral damage.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请退后，公民。我的目的是减少连带损伤。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Overseer asks that you vacate the area while this scuffle is brought under control.
ESP.TRADUIT: 监督者要求你在恢复秩序时离开这里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Scan accepted. Move along.
ESP.TRADUIT: 扫描通过。继续前进。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, sir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，长官。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enclave Officer [06039634] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mr. President, I'm sorry to bother you. This is Lieutenant Williams. I have an unauthorized individual here who's supposed to speak with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总统先生，很抱歉打扰你。这是威廉中尉，我这有个未经授权就想要和你说话的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enclave Officer [06039634] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The President wants to speak to me in his office.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总统要我去他的办公室见他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? No one sees the President except Colonel Autumn.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？除了奥托姆上校没人可以去见总统。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enclave Officer [06039634] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stand right there while I check this out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你站在那别动，我先询问一下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enclave Officer [06039634] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Receiving Sewer Maintenance Routine. Please Hold. Link Terminated.
ESP.TRADUIT: 接收下水道常规维护。 请稍等。连接终断。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Critter of unusual size detected. Running Program: Extermination.
ESP.TRADUIT: 发现异常体型的生物。运行程序：消灭。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The immediate area has been quarantined. Please exit swiftly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 周边区域已经被隔离。请立刻离开。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We apologize for the inconvenience. Disregard the mess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们对不便之处感到抱歉。请忽视混乱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Greetings fellow office employee. Please present your valid ID.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，办公室职员。请出示合法的身份证明。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Scanning for office ID... ID accepted. Have a nice day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 扫描办公室身份证明……身份确认。祝你过得愉快。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Running default office protocol... ERROR. Loading daily agenda... ERROR.
ESP.TRADUIT: 运行默认办公室协议……失败。装载日常议程……失败。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Security breach detected. Please stand back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 发现安全隐患。请退后。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please vacate the area in an orderly fashion. Work will resume in 3.756 minutes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请按序地撤离这个区域。工作将在3.756分后恢复。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry for the ruckus. Please vacate the immediate area.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对于骚动很抱歉，请撤离相关区域。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, relax, you were badly wounded. Now... who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，放松，你伤得很重。现在……你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry. The name's Reilly. Yeah, THE Reilly as in Reilly's Rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很抱歉。我的名字叫莱莉。嗯，莱莉的游骑兵里的莱莉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers Comment (NAM2) : accentuate THE EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not going to bug you anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会再打扰你们了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If time wasn't so precious right now, I wouldn't be so on edge either. I need to get help for the rest of the Rangers, and fast.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果不是时间宝贵，我也不会这么着急。我要为剩下的游骑兵寻求帮助，而且要快。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry about being such a jerk, Reilly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我为刚才愚蠢的行为道歉，莱莉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It takes a big man to apologize... I respect that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有大人物才懂得适时道歉……我尊重这点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: If time wasn't so precious right now, I wouldn't be so on edge either. I need to get help for the rest of the Rangers, and fast.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果不是时间宝贵，我也不会这么着急。我要为剩下的游骑兵寻求帮助，而且要快。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got your friends back. Can I come in now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把你的朋友带回来了。我现在能进去了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess you're okay after all, mungo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你可以了，毛人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can come in, but you better not piss me off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以进来，但你最好不要惹我生气。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take a hike, before you get squashed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在你被碾碎之前，赶快跑吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I, uhh... I have somewhere else to be.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我，呃……我还有些别的事想做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enclave Officer [06039634] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who the hell are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 见鬼，你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lieutenant Williams. I'm ordering you to stand down at once.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是威廉中尉。我命令你立刻站住。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enclave Officer [06039634] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream Comment (NAM2) : shaky, scared EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I don't know if I told you yet, but I just remembered something really cool!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我刚想起一些非常酷的事，我不知道我有没和你说过！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Spoken very quickly. EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: And guess what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你猜怎么了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Spoken very quickly. EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, fine, just remember next time, okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好吧，下次别忘了，好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eclair [06015682] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Interrupting the other speaker at the beginning. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, sir!
ESP.TRADUIT: 是长官！

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's not your uncle, Bumble!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他不是你叔叔，小咕嘟！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's food, Princess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你食物，公主。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A little sullen EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, happy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，开心了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A little frustrated. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Override activated. New Protocol acquired. Updating target list.
ESP.TRADUIT: 撤销程序，获得新协议。更新目标清单。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enclave Sentry Bot [0603A387] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Security Lockdown in effect. Hostile Target acquired.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一级安全警戒启动。捕获敌对目标动向。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enclave Sentry Bot [0603A387] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could use some food. Got anything for sale?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想吃点食物。你都卖什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: As long as you don't mind cooking it yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要你不介意自己烹饪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. You may want to grill it up sooner rather than later, if you know what I mean.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。如果你明白我的意思，你或许该尽快把烧烤架子搭起来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As long as you aren't a vegetarian.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要你不是个素食主义者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. Of course. With Megaton gone, it's hard to make an honest living these days.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。当然了。如果没有核弹镇，想诚实地过活是很难的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, got a taste for it, now, do you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，你想尝一尝吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take a look. It's always fresh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看，都是新鲜的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's mine is yours, friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的就是你的，朋友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I may be able to help, but it will cost you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我或许能帮你，但是你要付我报酬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Imagine. Years from now... the entire population of ants in the Wasteland, back to the size of a peanut.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想象下。几年前……废土的所有蚂蚁，都只有花生那么大。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our names will be in the history books for such a feat of scientific brilliance! How marvelous!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的名字会被载入荣耀的科学史册！太了不起了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you aware your new ants breathe fire?!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道你的那些新蚂蚁会喷火吗？！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, this is rather embarrassing so you'll have to forgive me, but it appears that I've made a slight miscalculation in my mutagen samples.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这确实很麻烦，请你原谅，我在制作诱变剂样本时犯了小错误。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Instead of lowering the size of the ants, the brood hatched and developed a new biomechanism.
ESP.TRADUIT: 蚂蚁的体型并没有缩小，相反新孵化出来的蚂蚁产生了基因突变。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I call their genetic aberration pyrosis; the ability to emit flame from their bodies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把这基因突变叫做“胃灼热”：一种可以从体内喷出火焰的能力。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I may be able to correct this error, but I can't get near my equipment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我或许能纠正这错误，但我没办法接近我的设备。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey! You're that egghe... I mean scientist the kid was talking about.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨！你就是那……我的意思是那孩子提到的科学家吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, yes. I suppose I am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，是的，我想我是。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doctor Weston Lesko's my name and it's good to make your acquaintance. What brings you to my little experimental ecosystem?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是莱斯科·韦斯顿医生，很高兴认识你。是什么风把你吹到我这小小的生态实验室里来的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maintence Code RHX-1W38. Override Authorization Challenge Protocol.
ESP.TRADUIT: 维护密码RHX-1W38。撤销发起挑战程序。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Override granted. User access allowed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 撤销准许。用户准许使用。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ooh... shiny robot!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦……闪亮的机器人！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Special needs students must be chaperoned at all times. Allow me to escort you back to class, child.
ESP.TRADUIT: 特需学生必须受到全天候陪伴。请允许我护送你返回教室，孩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah? I'll give you a hall pass, chrome dome.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？我会给你我的通行证，光头。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Intruder on campus! Students, remain in your classrooms.
ESP.TRADUIT: 校园出现入侵者！学生们，留在你们的教室里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gee, Mr. Robot... I forgot my hall pass.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，机器人先生……我忘了我的通行证。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ten demerits! Back to class with you, rapscallion!
ESP.TRADUIT: 扣10分！回到教室里去，流氓！

ESP.ORIGINAL: And when the time comes, you'll grow up and leave Lamplight and meet me in Big Town, too. It won't be that long, I promise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而且到你长大时，也可以离开小灯镇去大镇找我。不会太久的，我保证。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And when I grow up, I can come join you there, too!
ESP.TRADUIT: 而且到我长大时，也可以去那找你！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please, go on. I'm intrigued.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请继续。我很感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The good people of this country cannot regain control while mutation runs rampant through our land.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要突变体还在我们的大地上肆虐，这个国家的人民就无法掌控事态。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0007DDCE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My soldiers cannot stem the tide, nor can the cult you've come into contact with, this Brotherhood of Steel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的士兵无法阻止事态恶化，你接触到的钢铁兄弟会，也一样无法阻止。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0007DDCE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mutations like the "Super Mutants" and Ghouls must be purged from our society, our world, before we can proceed anew.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我们重建世界前，必须从我们的社会里净化“超级变种人”和僵尸这类突变体。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0007DDCE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where others have failed, I believe your father's work can succeed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其他人都失败了，但我相信你的父亲成功了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0007DDCE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to ask you a few questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想要问你几个问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, you'll be better off staying at home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你最好还是待在家里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I dunno... I kinda' don't like it in here. Gonna be really lonely.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道……我不喜欢这。会很寂寞的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Fear
