ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess this is goodbye then. Come back and visit me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想是时候说再见了。记得回来看我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't leave you here alone. Let me find you a place to live.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能把你留一个人在这。我得为你找个地方住。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? You mean it!?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？你是认真的！？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh boy! Thank you so much! I'll wait in my old house for you to come back... I need to bury my pappa anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，天啊！太感谢你了！我会在我的老房子里等你回来……我还要埋了我爸爸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just don't forget about me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 别忘了我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? You mean it!?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？你是认真的！？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh boy! Thank you so much! I'll wait in my old house for you to come back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，天哪！ 太感谢了！ 我会在我的老房子里等你回来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just don't forget about me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 别忘了我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. You've got a deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。我们成交。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. Here's your caps. Pleasure doing business with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。这是你的瓶盖。和你做生意真愉快。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eulogy Jones [0601569F] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now all you gotta do is put this collar on him and tell him to run his ass on over here. We'll do the rest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在你要做的就是给他带上项圈，告诉他滚到这来。剩下的我们会处理。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eulogy Jones [0601569F] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Make that 200 caps and you have yourself a deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我200个瓶盖，我们就成交。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You drive a hard bargain, but it's still well worth it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的要价的真高，不过这也是值得的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eulogy Jones [0601569F] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here you go. Now all you gotta do is put this collar on him and tell him to run his ass on over here. We'll do the rest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你。现在你要做的就是给他带上项圈，告诉他滚到这来。剩下的我们会处理。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eulogy Jones [0601569F] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: 100 caps? This kid will make you ten times that. 300, and you've got a deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 100个瓶盖？这小子会让你赚上十倍。给我300个，我们就成交。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, all right. He'll fetch a good price in the long run.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，好吧。从长远看来，他肯定能卖个好价钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eulogy Jones [0601569F] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here you go. Now all you gotta do is put this collar on him and tell him to run his ass on over here. We'll do the rest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你。现在你要做的就是给他带上项圈，告诉他滚到这来。剩下的我们会处理。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eulogy Jones [0601569F] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have it here. Take it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我这，拿去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you. I'll see to it that it's disposed of properly, once the Scribes have had time to analyze it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你了。我会尽快妥善处理它的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elder Lyons [060156E4] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps we have underestimated the Enclave. Sarah may be right; an attack may be necessary now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许我们低估了英克雷。萨拉或许是对的：现在看来，一次进攻势在必行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elder Lyons [060156E4] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He wants me to add this virus to the purifier. I think you should take it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他让我把这病毒放进净化器里。我认为应该交给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've done the right thing. I'll turn this over to the Scribes for analysis.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你做得很好。我会把它交给文士分析的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elder Lyons [060156E4] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We need to decide on a plan of action...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们需要制定一个行动计划……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elder Lyons [060156E4] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I escaped from Raven Rock.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从黑鸦岩基地逃了出来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are either very lucky, or very resourceful. You're the first I've heard to come out of there alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要么非常幸运，要么非常聪明。你是我听过的第一个从那活着出来的人……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elder Lyons [060156E4] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's good to have you back, but I wish you had brought better news. We need to revise our strategy...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你活着回来真好，但我希望你带回了好消息，我们需要重新修改战略……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elder Lyons [060156E4] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was captured by the Enclave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我被英克雷抓住了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You were? And yet you stand here before me. I find this hard to believe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？你现在就站在我面前。这让我很难相信。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elder Lyons [060156E4] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What has happened?
ESP.TRADUIT: 发生了什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elder Lyons [060156E4] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can't be President. You're an abortion of science. You need to die...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不是总统。你是科学的失败品。你必须死……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really... Do go on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的……那继续吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0007DDCE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Authorized ticketholders, please proceed to the main platform.
ESP.TRADUIT: 持票者验证通过，请进入站台。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Metro Protectron [0603BEB2] (mod) Quest : ([00015A37]GenericRobot) 00015A37 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Scanning for valid ticket... verified. Thank you for riding with Metro.
ESP.TRADUIT: 扫描车票有效性……核实。欢迎乘坐地铁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Metro Protectron [0603BEB2] (mod) Quest : ([00015A37]GenericRobot) 00015A37 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks! Nuka for me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你给我核子可乐！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds like a good trade to me. Here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来这交易不错。给。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hooray! I win the Nuka-Cola game! What's the prize? Nuka-Cola!
ESP.TRADUIT: 万岁！我赢得了核子可乐游戏！奖品是什么？核子可乐！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds like a good trade to me. Here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来这交易不错。给。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yay! Nuka-Cola, Nuka-Cola, makes a stomach bubbly and the world so jumbly, yay!
ESP.TRADUIT: 耶！核子可乐，核子可乐，让胃里起泡，让世界混乱，耶！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Singing a song to himself. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds like a good trade to me. Here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来这交易不错。给。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There... there used to be another guard. She was named Caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这……这曾经还有另一个守卫。她的名字叫“帽子”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She used to take care of me. She liked my company guarding. She liked it when I used to tell jokes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她以前照顾着我。她喜欢和我一起守门。她很喜欢听我说笑话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, some Raiders attacked. And I was the only guard left.
ESP.TRADUIT: 后来，一些歹徒袭击了这。而我成了唯一剩下的守卫。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You said you used to have another guard. What happened?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说过去曾有另一个守卫。发生什么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We don't use it much. We don't let many visitors in, and the scav teams usually use crawlspace exits to the surface, so they can't be followed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不常使用它。我们不让很多访客进入，而拾荒队通常从缝隙出口到地表去，因为这样他们不会被人尾随。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only times this gate opens is when we've got big cargo to bring in or if we're letting in a mungo. Neither happens often.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有在大型货物进入或允许毛人进入时才会打开大门。但都很少发生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why aren't there more guards here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么这儿没有更多守卫？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We usually use crawlspaces so mungos can't follow. This gate doesn't get used much, except letting in big cargo or mungos. Both are rare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们通常经由缝隙出入，所以毛人无法尾随。大门不常使用，除了让大型货物进入或允许毛人进入。但都很罕见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We used to have two guards here, but we can make do with one, as long as I'm vigilant. We don't have much choice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 以前这里都有两个守卫，但只要我保持足够警惕，我一个就够了。我们没有太多选择。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why aren't there more guards here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么这儿没有更多守卫？

ESP.ORIGINAL: But you're the President. Can't you just call them off?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但你是总统。你不能命令他们吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Until the water purifier is secured, I am not going to risk the stability of the Enclave by countermanding a direct order from their superior.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在水源净化器确保前，我不会撤除优先命令，来让英克雷冒险。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0007DDCE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Likewise, I cannot request that Colonel Autumn issue new orders without alerting him to our little plan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 同样，我不能给奥托姆上校新命令，以免他怀疑到我们的小计划。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0007DDCE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, we'll just have to make do with what we have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们只能以现有的条件去进行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0007DDCE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can we talk about how I get out of here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们能谈谈我该怎么离开这吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, yeah. I'm fine, Red. Super fine. Super duper fine. That Wastelander saved me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，嗯。我很好，瑞德。超好。超得隆咚好。那个废土游民救了我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Timebomb [0602805A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Timebomb is grateful but socially awkward. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. Fine. I'm all... fine. Super fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。好的。我很……好。超好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Timebomb [0602805A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A bit stutter-y. Timebomb is awkward around people. EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, so did I! You ever think about helping me! Huh!? Asshole!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我也是！你有想过要帮助我吗！呃！？混蛋！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Timebomb [0602805A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Timebomb explodes, seemingly at random. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm having a great time, here, Timebomb. But is everyone always this glum?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在这过得很愉快，“定时炸弹”。但每个人都是这么忧郁吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Sticky doesn't understand why everyone is so unhappy. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great, Red. Hey, can I stop by the clinic later? I wanted your help picking my new nickname. You know, for Big Town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好极了，瑞德。嗨，我迟点可以去诊所吗？我想让你帮我取个绰号。你知道的，为了大镇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Sticky is happy to be around Red again and is eager to begin life as an adult. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on, Flash. I'm not a little kid anymore. You can stop calling me Sticky.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜托，福莱斯。我不再是小孩了。别再叫我斯蒂奇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Sticky wants to put Lamplight behind him and become an adult, but he hasn't learned to deal with bullying yet. EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aww, quit it. I'm not a kid anymore! Call me by my real name, would ya?
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，去死。我不再是小孩了！叫我原名，行吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Sticky whines like a child being picked on at the playground. EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you could help ME by resetting the barricades.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你可以帮我来重设防御工事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Shorty emphasizes the word "me." He is big on his own importance. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The alignments are all wrong, the walls are too short, and you're stupid-looking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凹凸不平，墙也太矮，而且你们一副蠢样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : In his head, Shorty is the leader of Big Town, and everyone is beneath him. EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why? Because I'm short? Who are you calling short!?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么？因为我矮？你在叫谁矮子！？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Shorty is angry over any mention of his height. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Little? Who you calling little! I was running this town long before you guys showed up!
ESP.TRADUIT: 小子？你在叫谁小子！在你们这些家伙来之前，我就已经运作这镇子很久了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Nothing makes Shorty angrier than any mention of how short he is. He also believes he is in charge (Napoleon complex). EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: That sounds fine, Timebomb. Just take it easy when I bring out the surgical tools. I've never heard anyone scream that loud before.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来不错，“定时炸弹”。不过我拿出外科工具后，你要保持冷静。我从未听过有人叫得这么大声。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Red chides Timebomb because he's squeamish. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not right now, Sticky. I'm a little busy. Can we talk later?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在不行，斯蒂奇。我有点忙。我们能迟点再说吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Red wants to listen, but she is just a bit too busy for Sticky. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not sure everyone would agree with you, Shorty. And besides, don't you think the barricades are high enough for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不认为每个人都同意你，“矮子”。此外，你不认为这些防御工事对你来说足够高了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Red tries to gently put down Shorty's demands, but she can't resist picking on him a little. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No thanks, Kimba. Could you check in on Pappy, though? He's about as happy as a dead Brahmin lately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不了，谢谢你，金巴。你能去看看帕匹吗？他最近总是开心得像只死双头牛。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Red is concerned about Pappy's depression, and she hopes Kimba can cheer him up. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pappy, I told you last time and the time before that. It's a scratch. You're not going to die.
ESP.TRADUIT: 帕匹，我之前告诉你很多次了。这只是擦伤。你不会死的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Red is constantly pestered by Pappy's worrying, and she becomes stern over his request. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: That takes forever, Shorty. Several hours at least.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总是没完，“矮子”。至少几个小时。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pappy [0602796C] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Pappy is upset at the possibility of more work. EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I swear it's infected, Red. I think you might need to amputate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我发誓伤口已经感染了，瑞德。我认为你需要截肢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pappy [0602796C] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Pappy is overly worried about the wound. EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know how to use it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道怎么使用它吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pappy [0602796C] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Cynical. Pappy doesn't believe the gun to be important due to the looming threat of death that hangs over the town. EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everyone eventually finds their place in town, Sticky. Don't worry about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每个人最后都能镇里找到自己的位置，斯蒂奇。不必为此担心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kimba [0602AB94] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Kimba is restating the "matter of fact." EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shorty, you were never mayor, remember? The other kids would just pick you up and throw you.
ESP.TRADUIT: “矮子”，你从来也不是镇长，记得吗？其他孩子会把你丢在一旁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kimba [0602AB94] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Kimba comedically remembers Shorty's earlier attempts at being in charge. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's great, Flash. Amazing how you could do that with only 10 bullets.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好极了，福莱斯。想不到你只用了10发子弹就做到了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kimba [0602AB94] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Slightly sarcastic. Kimba knows Flash is exaggerating and is teasing him. EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, Pappy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，帕匹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kimba [0602AB94] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Random response back to Pappy. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A one-half mile radius? What does that even mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 半径1.5英里？那到底是什么意思？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flash [0602796B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Flash is angry because Shorty's suggestion is pushy and unhelpful. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe they'll be scared off by your makeup first.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许他们会先被你的化妆吓跑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flash [0602796B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Offended. Bittercup just insulted his gun. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Me and my new gun haven't seen anything, Pappy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和我的新枪没见到任何东西，帕匹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flash [0602796B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Confident that everything is fine. Flash is half-sure that he and his weapon of choice haven't seen anything. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Eh. You people and your demands. "Pay attention on patrol. Set up the barricades. Stop sleeping during your patrol!"
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。你的人和你的要求。“巡逻时保持警惕。修好防御工事。别在巡逻时睡觉！”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bittercup [0602796A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Bittercup is mad about being told what to do. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You better get started then. Hurry up! I don't like to wait.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好立刻开始。赶快！我不喜欢等待。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Pappy's attempt at dissuading Shorty has no effect. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you implying?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在暗示什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Shorty gets mad at comments about height. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, some other time Sticky. I have plans tonight. How about tomorrow?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，改天吧，斯蒂奇。我今晚有事。明天怎么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Red is a busy woman, but she doesn't want to dismiss Sticky entirely. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The barricades should be fine, for now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 防御工事现在看上去很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pappy [0602796C] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Pappy reports on the status of the barricades, hinting that nothing they do will postpone the inevitable. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't seem to understand. This gun is bad-ass. Yeah!
ESP.TRADUIT: 看起来你没明白，枪是个坏家伙。耶！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flash [0602796B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Flash is a little overly excited.Extend the syllable for "bad" and "ass." Should sound like "baaaad-aaas." EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I still think it looks pretty bad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，看上去还是很糟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pappy [0602796C] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : No amount of assurances will separate Pappy from his worrying. EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stupid looking? What’s that got to do with it? And who are you to say that the walls are too short... Shorty?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们一副蠢样？这是什么意思？你有什么资格说墙太矮……“矮子”？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pappy [0602796C] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Angry over the unexpected insult, Pappy picks on Shorty's unfortunate name (as Shorty is literally short). EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: That’s funny, I thought we were an autonomous collective.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那真有趣，我一直以为我们是集体自治。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kimba [0602AB94] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Kimba is confused over the sudden change in hierarchy. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, that? Come on Red, Pappy's never been happy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个啊？得了吧，瑞德。帕匹从未高兴过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kimba [0602AB94] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Kimba is surprised over Red's concern and finds herself reminiscing about Lamplight. EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, but that sounds boring! I know -- think of something cooler, and I'll come back later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，不过听着很无聊啊！我知道 — 想想什么更酷，我迟点再来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're damn right you do! 'Cause I'm the only one who can really keep this town safe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你他妈的说对了！因为我是唯一能确保这镇子安全的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Shorty overlooks the possible insult to his height and focuses on his perceived sense of importance. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, Pappy, when the arm falls off and you're rolling on the ground in agony, I'll come take a look at it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 帕匹，要是这胳膊掉了，而你痛得在地上打滚，我就会来看看。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Fed up, Red resorts to sarcasm. She is a busy woman, and Pappy's worries are a time-sink. EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: That just means they're getting ready. They'll come for us, I know it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就意味着他们正在准备。他们会来找我们，我知道的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pappy [0602796C] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : No amount of assurance will separate Pappy from his sense of impending doom. EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, Pappy, but what else can we do? I miss Lamplight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很抱歉，帕匹，但是我们还能做什么呢？我很想念小灯镇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kimba [0602AB94] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Frustrated with Pappy's depression, Kimba thinks back to better times in Little Lamplight. EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know, Pappy. I just don't know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道，帕匹。我真不知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kimba [0602AB94] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Frustrated with Pappy's constant doom-mongering, Kimba becomes just as depressed as he is. EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's, um, that's great Timebomb. Well, I'm glad you're all right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，那很好，“定时炸弹”。呃，我很高兴你平安无事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kimba [0602AB94] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Kimba is slightly unsettled by Timebomb's awkwardness, but ultimately glad he is OK. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa, whoa. Calm down. Never mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，哇，冷静。别介意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flash [0602796B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Flash quickly retreats from the conversation over Timebomb's sudden outburst. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only your complete and utter lack of importance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你才无关紧要呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bittercup [0602796A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Bittercup is trying to project an outward appearance of apathy. EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jerk. I'm glad we broke up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 蠢货。我很高兴我们分手了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bittercup [0602796A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Nervous then angry. Bittercup is mad that her unspoken attempt at reassurance (insults) met with rejection (counter-insults). EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! I think I will. And that is why you are the best boy a Slaver could ever ask for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！我想我会。那就是你能成为奴隶贩子最棒的儿子的原因。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is it, my boy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么了，我的孩子？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I swear, boy, you are going to be the greatest Slaver that ever lived!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我发誓，孩子，你会成为最伟大的奴隶贩子！

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's just that if you're bored all the time, you're not appreciating how good we have it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你一直都很无聊，是不会感受到我们所拥有的是多么美好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's more like it! Show some initiative, dammit, before I sell you off and give one of those fools in the cage your job!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这才像话！在我贱价卖你笼里那些家伙前，该死，表现得积极点！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Forty, if you were any dumber, I'd make a signpost out of you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 弗替，如果你是个笨蛋，我给你做个标牌怎样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, okay. I'm sorry...
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，好的，我道歉……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, daddy. I'm sorry, daddy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，爸爸。对不起，爸爸。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, sir. Sorry, sir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是，先生。对不起，先生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nah. I know you run your shit straight. Keep up the good work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。我知道你做人很正经。做好你的工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahh, doc. You keep us walking around and making money. That's why we keep you around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，医生。你总是能让我们赚到钱。这就是为什么我们需要你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep running your mouth, Crimson. That's why he don't like you no more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说个不停，奎默森。那就是为什么他不再喜欢你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hrmph. It's not my fault that I'm the favorite. You don't need to be so bitter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哼。我受欢迎又不是我的错。你不必这么耿耿于怀。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you always have to try to prove something to me? Do you think I care who Eulogy likes better? Seriously?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么你总是想向我证明一些事？你认为我会在乎尤勒基更喜欢谁吗？你是认真的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Clover, I will smack the shit out of you. Can't you just shut up and leave me alone?
ESP.TRADUIT: 可萝尔，我会揍你一顿的。你就不能闭上嘴离我远点吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: <sigh> I'm sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: <叹息> 对不起。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <grumble> Sorry, Eulogy.
ESP.TRADUIT: <嘟囔> 对不起，尤勒基。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please forgive me, daddy. It won't happen again, just tell me what you need. Anything! I'll do anything!
ESP.TRADUIT: 请原谅我，爸爸。不会再发生了，你只要告诉我你想要怎样。怎样都行！我什么都肯做！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry! I'm so sorry! Let me make it up to you! Tell me what you want!
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起！对不起！我会补偿！告诉我你想要怎样！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you have to be like that? I'm just trying to talk to you and you have to come at me with that shit?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么要那样做？我只想跟你谈谈，难道你一定要伤我的自尊？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wha... bitch, you're lucky Eulogy protects your ass, or I'd leave you bleeding in the street.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什……婊子，你很幸运有尤勒基保护，否则我会让你在街上流血。

ESP.ORIGINAL: See? This is what I mean. But you know what they say about mean women? Sooner or later, someone will accidentally shoot them while on a mission.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看？这就是我的意思。但你知道他们怎么说刻薄的女人？迟早会有人在任务中意外地射中他们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you always so mean? All I ever am is nice to you, but it's always "Ymir go away, you smell" or "Ymir, get me a drink and then go away".
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么总是这么刻薄？我一直对你很友好，但总是“伊米尔，滚开，你很臭”或“伊米尔，给我酒然后滚开”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good, Bronson. Don't let me down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，布朗森。别让我失望。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, Bronson. No screw ups this time, got it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，布朗森。这次别搞砸了，懂了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've been alive far too long to let some crazy plan get my head blown off. It ain't a bad life, you know. One you get used to it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经活得太久了，不想因为疯狂的计划而掉脑袋。这的生活不坏，你知道的。适应就好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, I'm not interested in your offer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，我对你的提议没兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, look... don't answer me now, just keep it in mind. If you find some and you've had a change of heart, I'll still buy 'em.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，听着……现在不用回答我，你只要记得。如果你找到并改变了主意，我仍然会买下它们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060388E1] (ID) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and I wouldn't bother running back to Sierra and warning her. She won't even understand what you're talking about.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我不会跑回塞拉那警告她。她甚至没明白你在说什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060388E1] (ID) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: She may be a hottie, but she's a bit vacant in the smarts department.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她或许很火辣，但她的脑子里一片空白。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060388E1] (ID) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, sure. I'm always for making more caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，当然。我总想要赚更多瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thought you might. Good. I'll see you soon then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可能会的。好的。我很快就会再见到你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060388E1] (ID) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have time for this nonsense.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没时间管这种琐事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, suit yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，随你便。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060388E1] (ID) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was going to make you an offer that could earn you some caps, but if you don't have the time to listen...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有个提议可以让你赚些钱，但如果你没空听……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060388E1] (ID) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have some more Quantum for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我又为你带回一些量子版。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You do! You darling!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真好！你真贴心！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, as always, I'll be glad to take them off your hands. And now that my machine is full I can drink these to my heart's desire!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，一如往常，我很想买下它们。而我的机器会装得满满的，够我喝好久！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goodie! I was hoping you'd bring me more!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好！我一直期望你会带给我更多！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep it up, there's probably plenty more out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续努力，外面大概还有更多。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was just wondering when I'd see you again, and poof, here you are!
ESP.TRADUIT: 就在我想什么时候能再见到你的时候，你出现在了我面前！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ohhhh sweet Quantum, come to mama!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，甜心量子版，到妈妈这来！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm amazed you're finding so many more bottles of Quantum out there. Imagine that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能惊讶你能在外面找到这么多瓶量子版。难以置信。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, don't give up looking. Keep finding more and bringing it to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，不要放弃寻找。继续努力，找更多给我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not bad, man. Not bad at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不错，哥们。很不错。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Swell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 漂亮。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Peachy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真棒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get the fuck away from me, meat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他妈的给我滚，肥猪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hahahaha! Yeah, right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈哈哈！嗯，对。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, please. Kid, come back after your balls have dropped.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，拜托。小子，等你长大了再来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep walkin', boy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续走，男孩。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <grunts>
ESP.TRADUIT: <嘟囔>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello there, little man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，小家伙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello there, pretty girl.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，小美女。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿你好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: S'up?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, you rotting piece of shit! Tell me what you know or it's splatter time!
ESP.TRADUIT: 听好了，别老是说废话！说你知道的事情，别浪费时间！

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right! I'll tell you! Please, just don't hurt me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧！我会告诉你的！请不要伤害我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Moriarty keeps a computer terminal in the back. On it, he keeps all of the dirty secrets of Megaton.
ESP.TRADUIT: 莫里亚蒂在后面有个终端机。里面记录了核弹镇所有的肮脏秘密。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you can get onto that terminal, I bet he has information on your Dad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你能进入那终端，我打赌肯定有你父亲的讯息。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, get away from me, smoothskin. If Moriarty even suspects I told you this, I'm a dead Ghoul.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，离我远点，光皮肤。如果让莫里亚蒂知道是我告诉了你这些，我真的就成“僵”掉的“尸”体了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you know anyone else that can help, I'd appreciate it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你告诉我还有谁能帮上忙，我会很感激的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Moriarty is your best bet. I wish you luck. Now, I have to get back to work, or I'll be answering to him too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 能回答你的只能是莫里亚蒂了吧。祝你好运。现在，我要回去工作了，否则我就得去回答他了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gob, please. If you know anything about my father, you need to tell me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊，求你。如果你知道我父亲的任何事，请告诉我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was like you once. I wandered into town looking for an escape from this stupid joke of a body I'm trapped in. Now look at me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我曾跟你一样。想要进入镇子，找到一个让这身体不受歧视的世外桃源。现在你看到我怎样了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. Moriarty keeps a computer terminal in the back. On it, he keeps all of the goings on in Megaton.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，莫里亚蒂在后面有个终端。里面记录了核弹镇所有发生过的事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you can get onto that terminal, I bet he has information on your Dad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你能进入那台终端，我打赌你肯定有你父亲的讯息。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, get away from me, smoothskin. If Moriarty even suspects I told you this, I'm a dead Ghoul.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，离我远点，光皮肤。如果让莫里亚蒂知道是我告诉了你这秘密，我真的就成“僵”掉的“尸”体了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, if you know something, you'd better tell me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，如果你知道什么，你最好告诉我！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, smoothskin. I've told you all I dare. Moriarty doesn't like me chatting with the customers like this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，光皮肤。我把我能说的都告诉你了。莫里亚蒂不喜欢我和客人这么交谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If he even thought I was talking to you, he'd tan my hide!
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他光是以为我和你聊过，他都会扒掉我的皮！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me get back to work now before he sees us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在他发现我们前，我得回去工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I talked to Moriarty already and he's trying to charge me for the info.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经和莫里亚蒂谈过了，他打算要我花钱买那消息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sigh. That's his way. Always putting caps before people's lives.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唉。那就是他的方式。钱总摆在命前面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wish someone would stand up to him one day. Oh my... I shouldn't be saying all of this!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望有人能出来收拾他。哦，天啊……我不该说这些 !
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, I really must get back to work. I can't get involved. I'm so sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，我真的必须去工作了，我不想被牵连。对不起。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds good to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来对我有利。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well then, let's make a deal!
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们做个交易！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Finally! Let's get down to business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 终于！你开始认真考虑生意了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm interested in the Pre-War Theme.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对战前装饰主题感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Feeling a bit nostalgic are we?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有点怀旧的感觉，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Remember, once you buy a theme you can't sell it back to me, although you could always purchase a new one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 记住，你一旦买了主题，你就不能再卖回给我，但是你可以买新主题来替换原来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still want to live in the past, huh? Well, forget it. Those days are long gone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 仍然想活在过去，呃？嗯，忘了它吧。那种生活已经一去不复返了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Remember, once you buy a theme you can't sell it back to me, although you could always purchase a new one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 记住，你一旦买了主题，你就不能再卖回给我，但是你可以买新主题来替换原来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Remember, once you buy a theme you can't sell it back to me, although you could always purchase a new one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 记住，你一旦买了主题，你就不能再卖回给我，但是你可以买新主题来替换原来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've been wondering... why blow up Megaton?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在想……为什么要炸掉核弹镇？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I complained off hand one day about how I thought that heap of metal on the horizon was a bit of an eyesore. Mister Burke offered to take care of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 曾经有一次，当我看到地上一大堆废铁的时候，我立刻就把它们当成眼中钉，抱怨连连。伯克先生提供帮助来除掉它们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : sincerely praising his lackey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Burke is such an agreeable man, isn't he? I don't know how I got along without him. I practically don't have to think about things anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 伯克真是令人满意，对吧？我不知道没有了他我还能干什么。我都不用考虑任何事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : sincerely praising his lackey EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: He takes care of everything. I seldom even have to ask. He's a real go-getter, that one. We need more men like him if we're going to rebuild the world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他面面俱到。我很少过问他做的事情。他真的非常能干。如果我们想要重建这世界，就需要更多像他那样的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : sincerely praising his lackey EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you shooting at out there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这射击什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why, anything I want, dear boy. Anything I want... Wasteland safari. Very relaxing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么了，我随心所欲，亲爱的小子。随心所欲……废土狩猎之旅。很放松。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : jovial EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why, anything I want, dear girl. Anything I want... Wasteland safari. Very relaxing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么了，我随心所欲，亲爱的丫头。随心所欲……废土狩猎之旅。很放松。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : jovial EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mom, it's Candace. Oh my God, it's really happening. I can see the cloud... it's so big... Mom, I'm so scared.
ESP.TRADUIT: 妈妈，这是堪达斯。我的天啊，真的发生了。我看见那云……好大……妈妈，我害怕。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm heading to the Vault now. I'll do whatever I can to get inside. My number of the passcode was "7," right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在就去避难所。我会不惜一切代价进去。我的密码数字是“7”，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Paul, it's me. Tina. I heard back from my sister Candace. We couldn't get into a Vault. 101, 87, didn't matter -- all full to capacity.
ESP.TRADUIT: 保罗，是我。蒂娜。我从妹妹堪达斯那听说了。我们进不去87号和101号避难所，无所谓 — 反正也人满为患了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But my brother Alex is a soldier and... he sort of stole the pass code for a secure Army bunker. He did it for the family. But they caught him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是我的哥哥亚历克斯是个士兵，而且……他几乎偷到了进入一个军事安全地堡的密码。他是为了家人才这么干的，但他被抓了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Before they took him into custody, Alex he sent each of us one number of the four-digit code. That way, we all have to be together to get in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在他被羁押前，亚历克斯给我们每个人一个数字，这数字来自一个4位数。这样，我们必须一起才能进去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He gave me number "5" -- the day of my birth. So I guess what I'm saying is... I'm still leaving. It's been fun. Kind of.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他给我的是“5” — 那是我的生日。所以我想我得说……我还是得离开。我过得很开心。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and I'm not pregnant. So no worries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对了，我没有怀孕。所以别担心。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tina, it's me. Your brother? Alex? Listen, mom would kill me if she knew I was contacting you, but she's being an impossible bitch right now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 蒂娜，是我。你哥哥，亚历克斯。听着，妈妈要是知道我联系过你，肯定会杀了我的，但她现在就像是个不可理喻的婊子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have to come home. Do you understand me? This thing with China... it's not going away. We're going to try to get into one of those Vaults.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你得回家。你明白吗？和中国的战争……不会结束。我们要想办法进入一个避难所。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If that doesn't work, well... I have a backup plan. There's this secure bunker... another sort of vault... inside the National Guard Depot, and...
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果不成功，嗯……我有一个备用计划。有一个安全地堡……另一种避难所……在国民警卫队仓库里，还有……。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, no matter what it takes, the whole damn Keller family's gonna ride this storm out, but you've got to get your ass home. Now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，无论付出什么代价，凯勒一家一定能安然度过这场灾难。至于你，你给我回家去。现在就走！

ESP.ORIGINAL: He gave me this Fusion Pulse Charge to rig to the bomb. Here, take it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他给我这核聚变合脉冲电池，要我装在核弹上。给，拿去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jesus! Gimme that thing!
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊！把那东西给我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : smoldering anger EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's go find this Burke character. You're about to get an education in Wasteland justice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们去找这个伯克。你会受到废土正义的洗礼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : smoldering anger EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jesus! Gimme that thing!
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊！把那东西给我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : smoldering anger EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks. If Burke steps within a mile of Megaton, he's a dead man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你。如果伯克敢步入核弹镇一英里以内，他就死定了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : smoldering anger EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: What if he asks someone else to explode the bomb? You should do something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他要其他人去引爆核弹呢？你该做些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good point. Come with me. You're about to get an education in Wasteland justice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说得对。跟我来。你会经历一次废土正义的洗礼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : smoldering anger EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's long gone by now. But I swear: If he steps within a mile of Megaton, he's a fucking dead man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他早离开了。但我发誓：如果他敢步入核弹镇一英里以内，他就他妈的死定了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : smoldering anger EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Too many lives are at stake, Burke! I'm going to defuse that bomb.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太多人活在危险中，伯克！我要去解除核弹！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I advise you against that particular course of action. If you interfere with my employer's wishes, you will find he can be quite -- disagreeable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我劝你别这么做。如果你阻碍我雇主的愿望，你会发现他将十分 — 不悦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : deadly serious... veiled threat EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right. Say I decide to help you. What's in it for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。如果我帮了你，对我有什么好处？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mean besides doing the world a favor by removing this pestilent scab of a town?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的意思是去除这镇子里的致命污点，献给这世界一份礼物？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : slyly playing on the player's greed and vanity EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why, you'd be rewarded most handsomely! My employer is a very generous man. If it's bottle caps and luxury you're seeking. You shall have it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，你会得到大笔报酬！我的雇主是非常慷慨。如果你要的是瓶盖和奢华，你会得到满足。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : slyly playing on the player's greed and vanity EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Simms wants me to disarm the bomb...
ESP.TRADUIT: 西姆斯想要我解除核弹……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Simms is an idiot. He prides himself on his position as mayor and sheriff of this scrapyard.
ESP.TRADUIT: 西姆斯是个蠢货。他对作为这垃圾场的镇长和警长而感到骄傲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : with loathing EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Burke, you silly man. You'll pay me 500 extra caps... and like it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 伯克，你这傻瓜。你得多付我500个瓶盖……就这样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Five hundred you say? Well... Um... Yes. Yes, I think that can be arranged.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说500个？嗯……嗯……可以。可以，我觉得可以考虑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I must admit. I find you... enchanting. Do this for me, and there's no telling how far my gratitude will reach.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我必须承认。我发现你……很迷人。为我做这事，我的谢意难以言表。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take the Fusion Pulse Charge. Place it into the bomb. Then meet me at Tenpenny Tower. There I will show you what true power is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着核融合脉冲电池，把它装到核弹上。然后到特佩尼大厦来见我。我会展现给你看什么是真正的力量。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can see about disarming that bomb for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我去试着解除那核弹。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, all right. Fine. But listen here. Just take a look at it first. Go easy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，好吧。太好了。但听着，你得先观察仔细，慢慢来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you get the job done, there'll be 100 caps in it for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你搞定，就有100个瓶盖可拿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你死定了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's do it, then!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那咱们就这么干吧!
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : about to get into a fight EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a new sheriff in town! It's time to die, asshole.
ESP.TRADUIT: 镇里有一个新镇长了！你该去死了，混蛋。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I ain't killed a drifter in weeks. This should be fun!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我都有一星期没杀流浪者了。这真有趣！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : (cocky) about to get into a fight EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well I'll be damned. You're from that vault! Vault 101! Ha ha! I ain't seen one of those jumpsuits in a LONG time!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的天啊。你是从避难所来的！101号避难所！哈哈！我很多年没见到你那种工作服了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I give up. Just let me know what you want now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我放弃。告诉我你要什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard what my husband wanted you to do. What I propose is an alternative.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听到了我的丈夫想让你干嘛。我的建议与此截然不同。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The same person that created the sap also created this Liniment. If you can reach His heart, it will assist in making His influence increase.
ESP.TRADUIT: 制作那液体与制作搽剂的是同一个人。如果你到达他的心脏，搽剂会强化它的影响。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Instead of centuries, the Wasteland will become green in mere decades! Just imagine how glorious that would be!
ESP.TRADUIT: 无需数世纪，只要几十年，废土便会遍布绿色的生机！想象下那是多么壮观！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh oh... I see where this is going...
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦……我能想象的到……

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard what my husband wanted you to do. What I propose is an alternative.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听到了我的丈夫想让你干嘛。我的建议与此截然不同。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The same person that created the sap also created this Liniment. If you can reach His heart, it will assist in making His influence increase.
ESP.TRADUIT: 制作那液体与制作搽剂的是同一个人。如果你到达他的心脏，搽剂会强化它的影响。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Instead of centuries, the Wasteland will become green in mere decades! Just imagine how glorious that would be!
ESP.TRADUIT: 无需数世纪，只要几十年，废土便会遍布绿色的生机！想象下那是多么壮观！

ESP.ORIGINAL: How can I possibly help?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能帮什么忙？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard what my husband wanted you to do. What I propose is an alternative.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听到了我的丈夫想让你干嘛。我的建议与此截然不同。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The same person that created the sap also created this Liniment. If you can reach His heart, it will assist in making His influence increase.
ESP.TRADUIT: 制作那液体与制作搽剂的是同一个人。如果你到达他的心脏，搽剂会强化它的影响。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Instead of centuries, the Wasteland will become green in mere decades! Just imagine how glorious that would be!
ESP.TRADUIT: 无需数世纪，只要几十年，废土便会遍布绿色的生机！想象下那是多么壮观！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Killing him should stop his influence from spreading.
ESP.TRADUIT: 杀死他应该会终止因他的生长而带来的影响。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You misinterpret His words, my friend. He wants you to extinguish that which seeks to make Him vulnerable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你误解了他的意思，我的朋友。他希望你除去那令他脆弱的根源。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If the same sap that you drank to purify yourself could be applied to His heart, it should stop the spread.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些你喝来用以纯净自身的液体，如果能注入他的心脏的话，他的生长就应该会停止。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can promise you no harm would come to Him. That's all I ask of you, Outsider. Nothing more, nothing less.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能保证的就是你不会伤害到他。这就是我要你做的，外来人。不必多做，不要少做。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So what can I do to help?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能帮什么忙？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If the same sap that you drank to purify yourself could be applied to His heart, it should stop the spread.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些你喝来用以纯净自身的液体，如果能注入他的心脏的话，他的生长就应该会停止。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can promise you no harm would come to Him. That's all I ask of you, Outsider. Nothing more, nothing less.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能保证的就是你不会伤害到他。这就是我要你做的，外来人。不必多做，不要少做。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've got yourself a deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你做了明智的选择。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He he! I sure know how to pick 'em!
ESP.TRADUIT: 呵呵！我当然知道怎么搞定那玩意！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're going to be the best thing that ever happened to Galaxy News in a long time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你将要成为银河新闻最棒的长期新闻人物了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you need any more info, I'll be here waiting for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你需要更多讯息，尽管问。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you know I was looking for my Dad?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么知道我在找我爸爸？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh come on. You're a spitting image of the guy. He's been here before, and now you're here. Doesn't take a genius to figure it out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，拜托。你和他就像是一个模子里刻出来的。你们两人都曾站在这个位置。简直像得令人难以分辨。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You want to find your dad, and it just so happens his location is known to yours truly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想找到你的父亲，而碰巧我知道他在哪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But if you want to know more, you're going to have to contribute to the Good Fight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但如果你想再打听什么，就得先为圣战做点贡献。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you fight the Good Fight with your voice on Galaxy News Radio.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以你在电台里用声音为圣战而战。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, holy shit! Aren't you a chip off the old block? You ARE as smart as your dad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 见鬼！我就说你和你爸爸很像！你和你爸爸一样聪明。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Since you know all about this cause, no need to explain the effect. Let's get you on your way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 既然你已经很清楚了，也就不必再废话。我告诉你该怎么做。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Good Fight? What's that all about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 圣战？那是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Imagine a picture, okay? A picture of the Capital Wasteland. All that brick and rock. A whole lot of nothing, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 设想一副画面，好吗？首都废土的画面。饿殍遍野，满目疮痍，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's people out there trying to just barely make it from day to day. Fighting to stay alive and make something out of what they got.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那里的人们勉强度日。一切一切只是为了苟活。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But then you've got all kinds of shit... Slavers, Super Mutants, Raiders... They all want a slice of the pie too and aim to take it by force.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后你又遇到了各种渣滓……奴隶贩子、超级变种人，歹徒……他们杀人放火，也只是为了混口饭吃。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's this book you're working on?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在写的是什么书？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, sure. I mean, if you're going to be my assistant, it's in my best interest that you stay alive, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，当然。我的意思是，如果你成为我的助手，你的生存就成了我最感兴趣的事，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Besides, I guess the original owner isn't coming back to pick it up, so you're the closest thing to an inheritor. Here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 此外，我想原有者不会来要回它，你就是最合适的继承者。给！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I have that Armored Vault Suit?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能拿走避难所护甲？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I said: Are you all right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说：你还好吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I don't know. I don't wear a watch, they're pretty rare you know. Ask someone else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我不知道。我没戴表，你也知道那很奢侈。问别人吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you looking at?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在看什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm watching the patrols, what do you think I'm looking at?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正看着巡逻队，你以为我在看什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They switch it up a little bit every day, but just a little. There has to be some sort of pattern to it, it's just a matter of watching and waiting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们每天都在成长，但很缓慢。他们总会长大，习惯了就好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've brought some bloodpacks to contribute.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我带了些血浆袋来捐献。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can only offer my thanks. My people are getting accustomed to using these as a substitute for live prey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我谨表示感谢。我的人习惯于用它们取代捕食。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As compensation for your effort, allow me to at least give you something in return.
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为对你贡献的补偿，请允许我至少给你一些物品作为回馈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Again, many thanks. Here is your compensation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再次，非常感谢。这是你的报酬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! Figures a shithole like this would have a local Chem head.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！像这样肮脏的地方就该有本地的吸毒者！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, so we have a resident with a bit of a problem. What makes you so goddamned superior? Hmph. Wastelanders...
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，我们的一个居民有了麻烦。但这为什么会让你产生该死的优越感？哼，废土游民……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Church [06000A6E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : annoyed EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: A place like this is probably crawling with junkies, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 像这种地方通常都挤满了瘾君子？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Megaton might not be Tenpenny Tower, but that doesn't make breaking patient-doctor confidentiality any more ethical, now does it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 核弹镇或许不像特佩尼大厦，但也不会随意破坏医患保密规则，明白吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Church [06000A6E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : annoyed EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you've got someone in town with a drug habit?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以你就让城里的某些人养成吸毒的习惯吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm afraid that goes against patient-doctor confidentiality.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恐怕这与医患保密规则冲突。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Church [06000A6E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : evasive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard tell of a scavenger tried that up Canterbury way. They found his body a week later, scorched with plasma bolts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听过一个拾荒人想在坎特伯雷的路上这么做。一周后他的尸体被发现，已经被电浆武器给烧焦了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know, but I'd stay away from it. No telling what those Enclave types will get up to next.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道，不过我会远离它。没人能告诉你英克雷下次什么时候来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Me neither. I like the music, though. Kind of nice to hear something more cheerful than what those hippies on GNR always play.
ESP.TRADUIT: 都不。我喜欢音乐，但听一些欢快的，可比银河新闻电台里老放的那些嬉皮的强多了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Finding a crew might be tough. Good luck, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要找到全部可能很难。但还是祝你好运。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the hell? You get me all worked up and then cut me off? Well... look... if you ever need a hand out there, you know where to find me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 见什么鬼？你让我为你干活，然后又把我一脚踢开？嗯……听着……如果你需要人手，你知道在哪能找到我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah... thanks. I guess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯……谢谢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've made a grievous error in judgement. Watch your back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你做了个错误的选择。以后走路小心点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : a deadly serious death threat EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: What kind of meat is that you're selling, anyway?
ESP.TRADUIT: 顺便问问，你那卖的是什么肉？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha ha ha. The very best kind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈哈，这是最好的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Try some, you've never tasted sweeter, I'll warrant.
ESP.TRADUIT: 试试，我担保你从未尝过。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <grumble>
ESP.TRADUIT: <咕哝>

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've either got a death wish, or a pair of stones bigger than hand grenades.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不是想找死，就是胆生毛。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Say, you seem to have some smarts in you, and with your sort of guts, maybe you can help us out. Interested in collecting technology for us?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说，你看起来有点头脑，再加上你的胆量，不如帮我们个忙吧。有兴趣帮我们收集科技吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've got a laser. Technically, you'd be asking "with highly focused light."
ESP.TRADUIT: 你拿到了一把激光枪。从技术上讲，你要的就是这种“高密度光线”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <grumble>
ESP.TRADUIT: <咕哝>

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've either got a death wish, or the biggest pair of stones ever sported by a woman.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不是想找死，就是胆生毛。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Say, you seem to have some smarts in you, and with your sort of guts, maybe you can help us out. Interested in collecting technology for us?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说，你看起来有点头脑，再加上你的胆量，不如帮我们个忙吧。有兴趣帮我们收集科技吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've got a laser. Technically, you'd be asking "with highly focused light."
ESP.TRADUIT: 你拿到了一把镭射枪。从技术上讲，你正在招惹“高聚焦光线”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know my father? Have you seen him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认识我父亲？你见过他吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well yes, of course I do. Don't you know who I am? I suppose James never told you. Typical.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，是的，当然。你不知道我是谁吗？我想詹姆斯从未告诉过你。他一向如此。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E89]MQ03) Scientific Pursuits EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm Doctor Madison Li. I worked with your father many years ago. Your mother as well, in fact.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是麦迪逊·李博士，很多年前与你父亲一起工作过，事实上，还有你母亲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E89]MQ03) Scientific Pursuits

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll have to forgive me. This has all been very stressful, what with your father suddenly showing up here after being gone for so long.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你得体谅我。你父亲在消失了那么久后，突然又在这出现，太让我们紧张了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E89]MQ03) Scientific Pursuits EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have to understand that I... We put all of that behind us. Project Purity, our work, all of it. We've moved on, even if your father hasn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你必须得明白，我……我们不愿想过去的一切，净化工程、我们的工作、所有的一切，我们都不管了。人必须往前走，尽管你父亲没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E89]MQ03) Scientific Pursuits EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why is Moriarty so hard on him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么莫里亚蒂对他那么狠？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, the miserable bastard is hard on all of us. But Gob gets it the worst. I guess just because he's different, you know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哼，那杂种对我们所有人都很差。不过盖博的处境最糟。我想都是因为他有点不同，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you ever... you know... work with him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是否曾经……唔……跟他那个过？

ESP.ORIGINAL: With Gob? Well, he's sweet... and I know that he'd like to, it's just... well...
ESP.TRADUIT: 和盖博？喔，他很温顺……我知道他很愿意，只是……这个……

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't want to sound shallow or anything, I mean, I'm a whore, my standards aren't exactly high.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是说我自己很肤浅或者什么的，我的意思是，我是做这行的，我的标准并不高。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But there are places even I won't go. Johnnies that are squishier than me are one of 'em.
ESP.TRADUIT: 即使这样，也有我不愿做的。比我还多愁善感的男人我是不碰的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where did he come from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他从哪来？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He don't talk about it much but apparently, there's a whole city of Ghouls somewhere down in D.C.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他没有说过太多，不过很显然，在华盛顿特区某处的地下有一个满是僵尸的城市。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's mentioned his mother a couple of times, but other than that, he won't really say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他有几次提到了他的母亲，但除此之外就不肯说了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's been here for... Oh, I guess about fifteen years now. Ever since Moriarty bought him off of those Slavers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他在这已经待了……我猜到现在大概有15年了。自从莫里亚蒂把他从奴隶贩子那买来之后。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What were you saying about radio stations?
ESP.TRADUIT: 刚才你说的那电台是怎么回事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Huh? Oh, you mean why was Gob banging on that radio? Well, out there in the Wastes, there are two stations that broadcast.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃？哦，你说盖博为什么在捶那收音机？嗯，在废土，有两个电台。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's the Enclave station. I don't know who they are, but I think it might just be some Pre-War broadcast on a loop or something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 英克雷电台。我不知道他们是谁，但是我想那可能只是某个战前的电台在循环播出。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And there's Galaxy News Radio. It's run by a guy named Three Dog somewhere down in D.C. But the signal went down a while ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有银河新闻电台。它由一个住在特区里叫三狗的家伙主持。不过最近信号差了很多。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the story with that Ghoul?
ESP.TRADUIT: 和我说说那个尸鬼的故事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who, Gob? Well, if you can get past how he looks, he's a sweetheart. Colin's awfully hard on him, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁，盖博？嗯，如果你忽视他的长相的话，他心地不错。不过，科林对待他特别狠。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everything's just fabulous!
ESP.TRADUIT: 一切都难以置信！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : overly happy EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the point? Besides, I hate all that cold metal touching my skin. It gives me the willies! So, I'll just stick with visiting when I get sick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么意思？还有，我痛恨所有接触我皮肤的冰冷的金属。那让我感到害怕！所以，我检查生病的时候才去看。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : grossed out by the memory of going to the doctor's. EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fabulous! Can I sell you a pair of sport shoes? Maybe they'd help you catch your wife when she runs away from you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 帅呆了！你想要一双运动鞋吗？当你老婆逃跑的时候，或许你能更快地抓住她！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : playfully teasing a customer EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: And I've got a little number in my shop that should help push up those sagging girls of yours, darling.
ESP.TRADUIT: 亲爱的，我店里有些小玩意能帮你变挺。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the hell are you talking about?!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在说什么鬼话？！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : annoyed that he is being hit on by a guy EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on man. Quit it already! I'm not interested!
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜托，老兄。别废话了！我没兴趣！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : annoyed that he is being hit on by a guy EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're not very subtle, you know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可不怎么聪明。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : annoyed that he is being hit on by a guy EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: What?! Are you kidding? I'm too fabulous to settle down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？你在开玩笑吗？我太震惊了，没法平静。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : responding to "have you ever been married?" EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's right. And the safety's off. Back off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对了。关上保险。退后。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : threatening a man who just hit on him EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Same old shit. See something big and ugly moving in the distance. Shoot the hell out of it. Go an' check to make sure it's dead. Rinse and repeat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 老是这套路。看到一些又大又丑的家伙远远地过来。把他们干掉。上去确认他们已经死透了。没完没了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : gruffly explaining his daily routine as security chief EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can assure you, Mr. Wellington, we're not just sunning ourselves out there all day. That's for damn sure!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我向你保证，威灵顿先生，我们不是整天在外面晒太阳的。绝对不是！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : gruff EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hah! I'm fine with the same old shit all the time. The day something "interesting" happens in the Wasteland, it's time to retire!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！做这老套路我倒是没问题。如果有天废土上发生了什么“有趣”的事情，我就该退休了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : joking with a friend about the hard life of being security chief EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everything is under control, Ms. Montenegro.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一切都在控制中，黑山女士。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : gruff EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They don't deserve it. But... oh, what the hell. Go ahead Ms. Primrose. If it'll make you happy, send them whatever you like.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们不配。不过……呃，见鬼。继续吧，普利洛斯女士。只要你开心，送他们去哪都可以。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : gruff, but then accepting the kindness EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're pressing your luck, Hawthorne.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在拿你的性命开玩笑，霍桑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : gruff and annoyed EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll be sure to discuss it with them Mrs. Wellington.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我肯定要和他们谈谈，威灵顿太太。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : gruff (and annoyed) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello Ms. Lancaster.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好啊，兰卡斯特女士。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : gruff but flattered EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm afraid not, Ms. Cheng.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恐怕不是这样，程女士。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : extremely amused by what she asked EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right. Sure thing, Anthony.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，没错，安东尼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : humoring someone EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everythings fine, Chief. Thanks for keeping us safe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一切都好，长官。感谢你保护我们的安全。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Surgery of any kind is always extremely dangerous. The risk of infection is great. A doctor should never cut open a patient unless it's necessary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 任何形式的外科手术都非常危险。感染的风险很大。除非有必要，否则医生不该给任何一位病患开刀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : sternly EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. They are a fine addition. Now, if we can only get the residents to start eating them!
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。它们是非常好的补给。现在，要是能让居民吃它们就好了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : amused EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Susan...
ESP.TRADUIT: 苏珊…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : flirting with his mistress EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm worried about you, Mrs. Cheng. Come by the Wellness Center, I might have a pill or two that'll help you relax and cope with things.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在为你担心，程太太。到健康中心来，我会给你一两粒药片，能帮助你放松并应付事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : concerned about a patients mental health EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, thank you. You and your men patrolling makes everyone feel safe here. Thanks again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，谢谢你。你和你的手下进行巡逻，让这里的每个人都感到安全。再次感谢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you make me nervous? Uh... No, not at all. Of course not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你让我紧张了吗？唔……没有，没有的事。当然没有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Haha! Nothing you can pin on me, Chief! But shouldn't you be out killing things in the Wasteland instead of pestering old harmless fogies like me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈！你没什么可怪罪到我身上的，长官！难道你不该到外面去杀几个厉害的玩意吗，干嘛刁难我这种无害的老家伙？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : jovial repartee with the security chief who suspects him of causing trouble EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: My dear boy. You've got all the adventure you need, right here in these four walls. For starters, you can figure out how to make your wife happy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 亲爱的孩子，在这院子里你已经进行了一切必要的冒险。作为一个新手，你至少知道了怎样能让你老婆开心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : amused, but telling him something important EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a radio play, not a documentary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是广播剧，不是纪录片。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : amused EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's you and I stick to finding trouble to get into here, before we rush out in the Wasteland again; I'll take Gustavo over a Behemoth any day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我们重回废土之前，我们可以在这里找点麻烦。总有一天我会把古斯塔沃丢给一只超级变种巨人的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : playfully encouraging a young friend not to seek adventure EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now there's an interesting idea, Mrs. Cheng!
ESP.TRADUIT: 有个好办法，程太太!
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : hatching a scheme EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wouldn't know. She's avoiding me lately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。最近她老是回避我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Irving Cheng [060156DC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : sad EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: No worries, Comrade. Everyone else has trouble making the meetings, too. When I get my computer working, I'll get you a copy of the minutes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别着急，同志。其他人在组织会议时也都有麻烦。等我的电脑能用之后，我会给你一份备忘录的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Irving Cheng [060156DC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : a bit sad no one comes to his committee meetings, but trying to sound happy EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Sigh.> I don't know what to do, Comrade. Every day I fix it, but it always breaks again.
ESP.TRADUIT: <叹气>我不知道该怎么做，同志。我每天都修它，但它总是坏掉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Irving Cheng [060156DC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : depressed EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I shouldn't. A good leader, leads by example. But thank you anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会。好的领导总是以身作则。但无论如何还是很感谢你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Irving Cheng [060156DC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : turning down a drink of alcohol EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right, Susan. Whatever you say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，苏珊。随你说什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Irving Cheng [060156DC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : trying to please EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh. Okay, dear. Goodbye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，好的，亲爱的。再见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Irving Cheng [060156DC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : feeling helpless to stop her EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: We all feel safe knowing you and your men have this place locked up tight. Thank you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 知道你和你的手下把这里守得固若金汤，我们都倍感安全。谢谢你们！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lydia Montenegro [060156DA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : genuinely appreciative EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't scrounge for anything. I run a high class Boutique, doctor, as you know. However, I can check with my supplier about holodisks for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是什么都收。我经营一家高级精品店，你知道的，医生。不过，我可以向我的供应商查询是否有全息光盘。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lydia Montenegro [060156DA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : slightly taken a back by the notion of her "scrounging" for something EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lydia Montenegro [060156DA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : flattered EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry about them. Just be yourself dear. You've had a hard life. You deserve some happiness. Hell, we all do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不用担心他们。你随意就好了，亲爱的。你受苦了，应该享受一下。见鬼，我们都该享受一下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lydia Montenegro [060156DA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : concerned that her friend isn't happy EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: What a question! I don't know. I supposed it is. But, it can't always be helped. We can't help who we fall in love with, can we?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这问的！我不知道。我想是的。但是，这没办法。我们控制不了自己会爱上谁，是吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lydia Montenegro [060156DA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : commiserating with a friend EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. I know. It's just... Well, I've been busy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我知道。只是……唔，我一直很忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : tired EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Raiders? Again? Well, I'll have to make do. Thank you for the heads up, Chief. And thank your men for us. We are all grateful of your presence here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 歹徒？又来了？那，就这样了。多谢你的提点，长官。也请你替我们谢谢你的手下。有你们在，我们太感激了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : learning something troubling EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shoo! Away with you. Leave me alone!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘘！走远点，让我自己待着！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : playful EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's okay, really. I prefer to stay busy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的没问题。我宁愿过得忙碌些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : cheerfully brushing off concern that she works too hard EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? He orders that every day. I prefer making more creative dishes. Choose something else, I beg you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？他每天都点那个。我喜欢做更有创造力的菜。选个别的吧，求求你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : half jest, half serious EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Something I picked up from my mom. She wasn't always the best mother... but she always showed her love for us in her cooking. I miss her sometimes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有一些我从我妈那学来的。她不是最棒的母亲……但她做的饭里总是充满了对我们的爱。我有时候会想念她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : nostalgic EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: A sophisticated lady like you slaving over the stove? Don't trouble yourself with that, dear. You kick back and enjoy. I'm here to cook for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 像你这样的高雅女士要亲手下厨？别给自己添麻烦了，亲爱的。你该享受一下。我来为你做饭。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : gently teasing EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure! I could always use another pair of hands in the kitchen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊！厨房里多个帮手当然好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh that? It was nothing. A one time indiscretion, I assure you. Won't happen again, ol' chap. Scouts honor and all that. Care for a drink?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，那个？那没什么。小问题罢了，我向你保证，绝不会再发生了，老朋友。为了尊严及其他。来一杯？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Michael Hawthorne [060156D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : a high class drunk dismissing mention of a disturbance he cause either EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Very funny old man! Well, I hear she's also running low on dried up old raisins, you cheeky bastard! Leave a gent to his drink already!
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？好有趣的老头！嗯，我听说她的陈年葡萄干也不多了，你这无礼的混蛋！让那位绅士安静地喝酒！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Michael Hawthorne [060156D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : confused, then gets the joke made at his expense, and returns a joke back at his friend EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Indeed! I'll drink to that!
ESP.TRADUIT: 确实！我要为这喝一杯！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Michael Hawthorne [060156D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : getting a bit tipsy EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Amen. I'll drink to that sister. Cheers!
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿门。我要为那姐妹喝一杯。干杯！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Michael Hawthorne [060156D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : toasting EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you think I spend so much time getting smashed in the lounge?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你说我整天泡在休息室里喝得烂醉是为什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Michael Hawthorne [060156D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : commiserating EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Indeed, Mrs. Cheng. Indeed! Sometimes it helps wash away a lot more than just one day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错，程太太，没错！有时候它不只是消磨了一天时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Michael Hawthorne [060156D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : commiserating and praising the virtues of alcohol EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you for looking into that situation for me. I'm embarrassed it turned out to be nothing. Well, one can never be too careful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 感谢你让我了解情况。结果那没什么大不了的，我真难堪。不过，小心没大错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Millicent Wellington [060156D8] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : apologizing for making a big deal out of nothing EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't be silly. I know enough about them to make being friendly... awkward at best. Besides, I much prefer spending all my time with you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 别傻了。我知道怎样和他们打交道……最多有些棘手而已。不过，我更喜欢和你在一块打发时光！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Millicent Wellington [060156D8] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : oblivious to the fact that her husband is trying to get rid of her by encouraging her to make new friends EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why thank you, dear! How charming of you to say so. Perhaps you and I should start spending some time together? Eh? Ahahah.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要谢谢你，亲爱的！你这么说真好。我们不妨在一起共度些时光吧？嗯？哈哈哈！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156DE] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : flirting suggestively before walking away EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: It hasn't been that long since my last "check up." So you know EXACTLY how I'm feeling, doctor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 离我上次“检查”的时间没多久啊。所以，你肯定了解我的感受，医生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156DE] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : flirting with the doctor she's sleeping with EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nonsense Edgar! I always find your manners to be quite "up to the task." if you know what I mean! He he he he. See you later, MISTER Wellington.
ESP.TRADUIT: 埃德加，你胡说！我一直觉得你的礼貌是“应付差事”，你知道我的意思吧！呵呵呵呵，回见，威灵顿先生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156DE] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : flirting with the man she is having an affair with EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Eww! Banish the thought, old man! Seriously though, if you're still around in a decade or two, I might take you up on the offer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃！别再这么想了，老头！说真的，如果过十年或二十年你还在，我兴许会接受你的建议。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156DE] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : teasing her older gentleman friend who just jokingly proposed to her EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do I intimidate you so? You weren't intimated the other night! Aha! See you around, Don Juan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么我这么吓唬你？因为那天夜里你没被吓到！啊哈！回见，唐璜。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156DE] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : teasing a man she is having an affair with EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't they all, dear? Don't they all!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们不也是吗，亲爱的？他们不也是吗！

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Are you kidding me?! Mind your own damn business. I don't go turning lights on in your closet, do I? Jeez!
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？你在耍我吗？少管他妈的闲事！我又没在你家厕所里点灯，对吧？天啊！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : annoyed that he is prying into her personal life EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just great, if you don't count the fact that I'm married to the biggest idiot on the planet!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很好，如果和这星球上最大的傻瓜结婚那事不算的话！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : annoyed with her husband EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you mean day dreaming about killing Mr. Cheng and knocking a few back in the lounge, then yeah, I'm able to relax once in a while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你的意思是杀死程先生，再去休息室聊两句的白日梦，那么好，我可以去先放松一阵子了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : annoyed with her husband EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: It breaks all the time! Does he take that as a sign to spend time with me? No. Stupid man! He spends hours retyping everything. He's such a loser!
ESP.TRADUIT: 它老是坏掉！难道他认为那是和我一起浪费时间的信号吗？不，蠢男人！他把所有的时间都用在改错字上。他是个大废物！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : annoyed with her husband EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: What?!
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : annoyed EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cheers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干杯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : half-heartedly toasting EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd be happy to have you help sometime, Mrs. Cheng. Cooking can be very therapeutic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我非常高兴能不时得到您的帮助，程太太。烹饪有益身心健康。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : sincere EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hate that stupid man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我恨那蠢货。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : angry at her husband EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who you calling frumpy?! At least my ass isn't shaped like a pear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你恶狠狠地喊什么？至少我的屁股长得不像只梨。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lydia Montenegro [060156DA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : playful repartee EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: The usual, dear. And please, be sure to remember to measure the salt precisely. We don't a repeat of last weeks debacle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 老样子，亲爱的。拜托，放盐的时候注意些。别再出上周的错了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : politely but passively aggressively scolding EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Umm... er... why yes, Ms. Lancaster. You are quite the "conversationalist." I await with anticipation our next opportunity for chit chat. Indeed!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯……呃……是的，兰卡斯特女士。你绝对是个“健谈的人”。老实说，我非常希望有机会再好好聊聊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (embarrassed) caught off guard, then trying to flirt surreptitiously EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ewwww! Labcoats are so last century. I have a better idea, Doc. Why don't you come to New Urban Apparel, and I'll give you a complete make-over!
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃…！实验室的外套实在是太古董了。我有个更好的主意，医生。你为什么不来新都市服装店，我会给你好好改改！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : playfully chiding a customer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes! But the key to being fabulous, is that it comes from within. What you wear is only half the equation. BELIEVE you ARE already fabulous!
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的！但是变漂亮的关键来自内心。你的穿着只是公式的一半。要相信你已经变漂亮了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : offering advice EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever, you old hag. I'm just swelling with fabulous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便，你这老太婆。我已经漂亮得光彩四射了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those things are so tacky. How about you swing by New Urban Apparel, and I fit you into a cute Sunday dress? You need to spruce up your look dear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些东西太寒酸了。要不要试试新都市服装店？我会让你穿起可爱而合身的周日晚装。你需要把自己打扮得整齐些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : playfully teasing a customer EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course! Shopping is wonderful therapy, isn't it? Better than any old pill Doc Banfield prescribes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然啦！购物是很好的疗法，对吧？比班菲尔德医生的药片管用多了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : excited to help a customer find something fabulous EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry? What?!
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起？什么？！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : caught off guard, and covering it with gruff anger EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you for your concern, Doctor. But things've been tense is all, and my men are just blowing off steam. Don't worry. They'll be fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你的关心，医生。不过事情已经变得很紧张，我的人也都吵吵嚷嚷的。别着急，他们会好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : gruffly dismissing his concerns EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: And I envy your retirement, Dashwood. Though it's true. There's something satisfying about bagging a Rad-Scorpion at 100 yards with a single shot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 退休真让人羡慕啊，达什伍德。尽管如此，在100码外一枪打死一只辐射蝎还是很带劲的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : chatting with someone he respects EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cheng. Damn it. Call me "Chief." Chief Gustavo! All that "comrade" nonsense is really getting on my nerves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 程，他妈的。叫我“长官”。古斯塔沃长官！所有这些“同志”之类的东西真是让我过敏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : gruff and annoyed that this guy calls him "Comrade Gustavo" all the time EmotionType : Anger
