ESP.ORIGINAL: That's kind of you, Ms. Primrose. But it's better if they don't cozy up with the residents. Helps retain discipline and remind them why they're here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 您太客气了，普利洛斯女士。但那总比让居民不舒服要好。能保持秩序，并能提醒他们为什么他们在这。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : gruff but appreciative EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm on duty. You alright Hawthorne? Don't want a repeat of that little stunt you pulled.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在执勤。你还好吧，霍桑？别耍小花招。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : gruffly rebuking an offer to share a drink with a drunkard EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was very... thorough, Mrs. Wellington. Do the other residents know you have catalogued all their habits and daily routines like that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这非常……彻底，威灵顿太太。其他居民知道你已经把他们的生活习惯和日常行为归档了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (gruff) trying to be polite, but thinking she's a bit crazy EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ms. Lancaster.
ESP.TRADUIT: 兰卡斯特女士。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : gruff but warm EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd have to say that would be extremely unlikely, Mrs. Cheng.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我得说那不大可能，程太太。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : amused EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm afraid the lab coat never goes out of style for me. But I appreciate your concern.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我穿实验室外套恐怕永远不会落伍的。不过非常感谢你的关心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : amused but hinging on annoyance. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, of course. There's nothing to worry about. Though, it's been awhile since I've seen you. We should schedule a checkup soon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，当然，没有必要担心。不过，我确实有一阵没见过你了。我们应该尽快安排一次检查。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : doctor friendly chit chatting with a patient EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Absolutely not. All Wasteland meat MUST be thoroughly cooked. Disease and parasites are killed by the heat. I'm surprised I have to tell you this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 绝不。所有废土上的肉类必须经过彻底烹煮。高温可以杀灭病菌与寄生虫。我很惊讶于必须告知你这些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : stern EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahem. Yes. It has been too long since you've been properly examined.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。是的，离上次给你做全面检查已经很久了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : doctor flirting with his mistress EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why? Has someone been poisoned?!
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么？有人中毒了？！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : concerned EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh... well... umm... Thank you Susan... er, I mean, Ms. Lancaster. A pleasant day to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦……这个……唔……谢谢你，苏珊……呃，我是说，兰卡斯特女士。愿你度过快乐的一天。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156D7] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : caught off guard by his mistress flirting with him in public EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know a little bit about technology. I've picked up a few tricks in my adventures. Why, what seems to be the problem?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我懂一点技术。我在冒险时学到的。怎么样，有什么问题？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (trying not to laugh, as he himself is sabotaging his friends computer) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hawthorne. Go easy on those remaining brain cells, alright?
ESP.TRADUIT: 霍桑。别白费心思了，好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : teasing a friend but trying to make a point EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should count yourself very lucky. I do. Most people die a horrible death out there in the Wastes. Excitement and danger often go hand in hand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你应该认为自己非常幸运。我就这么看。许多人在废土上死得很惨。刺激与危险经常并肩而至。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : being sincere EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've had too kill far to many men... listen, Mrs. Cheng... have you tried talking to your husband about things? I think he really cares about you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也杀过很多人……听着，程太太.……你曾试过与你的丈夫谈论这些事吗？我看他很关心你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : changing the subject to what the other person is really wanting to talk about. EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I don't know. Not so good I guess... Women. Can't live with them. Can't live without them. Know what I mean, Comrade?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我不知道。我想不太好吧……女人。不能跟她们一起过日子，又不能没有她们。了解我的意思吗，同志？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Irving Cheng [060156DC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : dejected EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, Comrade. My computer keeps breaking, and I have to start over each day. Not to worry though. I've got it practically memorized by now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 同志。我的电脑老是坏，我不得不每天重头开始。但是别着急。我现在实际上都能记住它了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Irving Cheng [060156DC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : trying to look on the bright-side (his magnum opus keeps getting erased from his computer) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because, while it's true, some of us are better suited to lead the community, by calling you all comrades, I'm helping you not feel envy or sadness.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为，一方面我们中的某些人的确更适合领导社群，通过称呼大家为同志，我可以帮你不感到嫉妒或悲伤。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Irving Cheng [060156DC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : with naive arrogance EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um. Hi.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唔，嘿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Irving Cheng [060156DC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : nervous around a woman he has a crush on EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Antique shop? Really, Anthony, you need some new material! And I'm not just talking about your jokes either, darling. Those threads are atrocious!
ESP.TRADUIT: 古董店？说真的，安东尼，你需要一些新材料！我不光是指你的笑话，亲爱的。那些线头都朽了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lydia Montenegro [060156DA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : playful repartee EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I pop a couple, then have a Martini. Does wonders. Thanks Doc.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，哼上两曲，再来杯马蒂尼酒。太棒了。谢了，医生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mr. Cheng. Shouldn't YOU know what your wife would like? Why don't you go find out what she wants, and I'll see about ordering it for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 程先生，难道你不知道你妻子喜欢什么吗？干嘛不去问问她想要什么，我来帮你订货。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lydia Montenegro [060156DA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : encouraging him to figure things out on his own EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's just say it's high time for a glass of wine. Putting on a happy face for all my customers all the time can be a bit tiresome.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来我该来上一杯了。随时随地对所有的顾客奉上微笑还真是累人啊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lydia Montenegro [060156DA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : exhausted but glad to see her friend EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, Mrs. Cheng. It's not easy though, is it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，程太太。尽管这不容易，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lydia Montenegro [060156DA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : commiserating with a friend EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you for saying so, sir. It's always my great pleasure. If you'd ever like to try another dish, I have an extensive menu of delicacies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你这么说，先生。这是我的荣幸。不如你尝尝另一道菜吧，我有精选菜单。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : flattered and hinting that her talents are under utilized EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Things are alright, I guess. I'm thinking I should stop by sometime and get some new clothes. I just can't seem to find the time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还好，我觉得。我在想或许有时间我也该来逛逛，添些新衣服。我只是抽不出时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : commiserating about her working long hours. EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nonsense. I'm fine. I enjoy making food and keeping the residents happy. A vacation from this would only make me anxious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 胡说，我很好。我热衷于烹饪，让居民过得开心。给我假期反而会使我焦虑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : brushing aside concern she is working too hard EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I'm alright, I suppose. Though, apparently raiders have been attacking the caravans again. Missed a shipment. I'll just have to be creative!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我觉得我没问题。显然，歹徒又开始袭击商队了。损失了一批货物，看来我得想想办法了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : chef commiserating about her lack of supplies EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you for saying so! It's always been my dream to own my own restaurant. Supplies have been running low, but it just makes me more creative!
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你能这么说！拥有我自己的餐馆一直是我的梦想。或许补给来得很少，但这却激发了我的创意！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : chatting with a friend about her cafe EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you. It's always my pleasure to serve you Mr. Cheng. If you'd like, I could prepare a special candle light dinner for you and Mrs. Cheng.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你。为您服务是我的荣幸，程先生。如果您愿意，我会为您和程太太安排一次烛光晚餐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : grateful and trying to help him win his wife back EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, well. There've been shortages of certain things, so I've had to get creative. I hope everything is to your liking Ms. Montenegro.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，嗯。有些东西是缺货，所以我不得不想出新办法。我希望你满意这一切，黑山女士。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : hesitant EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry about me. I'm fine. Besides, if I didn't cook for all of you, you'd starve to death! Heaven knows none of you can fend for yourselves!
ESP.TRADUIT: 别为我担心，我没事。而且，如果我不为你们做饭的话，你们就会饿死！天知道你们怎么照顾自己！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : deflecting concern by teasing her friend EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why, yes. I believe so. Fairly happy, anyway. I really enjoy what I do. Cooking and preparing meals for the residents makes me happy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，是的。我也相信。无论如何，非常开心。我真的喜欢所做的事。为居民烹饪和准备食物让我很快乐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : sincere (answering the question "are you happy?") EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Oh right. Hah! That's a good one, Daring. I'm fine really. I've been drinking since I was a toddler. I can hold my liquor. What's new with you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？哦，好吧。哈！那个好，亲爱的。我真的没事。我在学走路的时候就开始喝了。我知道自己的酒量。你有什么新闻？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Michael Hawthorne [060156D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : confused, then gets the joke. "Daring" is the nickname of his friend EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: My secret to what? Oh right. The ladies. Always start off with a few drinks to loosen up, then move onto the hard liquor to get the party rolling!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的什么秘密？哦，好吧。女士们。总要先喝几杯才开口，然后换成烈酒聚会才会达到高潮。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Michael Hawthorne [060156D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : high class alcoholic giving advice to a loser EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Indeed! And at the beginning of a long day! Though, I prefer the stiffer stuff myself. So how're you holding up these days? How's that shop of yours?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊！还是在漫长的一天刚开始的时候！不过，我自己喜欢更带劲的东西。那你这些天怎么样。你的店还好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Michael Hawthorne [060156D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : discussing the virtues of alcohol with a friend EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wouldn't pay you so much to hang out with me if I thought you were ugly! I'm just kidding. Stop fishing for compliments. You know you're beautiful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是我觉得你很丑，干嘛花那么多钱让你陪我！我是开玩笑的。别再找人恭维你了，你知道自己很漂亮的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Michael Hawthorne [060156D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : joking with a friend who just asked "do you think I'm pretty?" EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just goes to show you: It's always darker on the other side of the fence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是想告诉你：事情的另一面往往更黑暗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Michael Hawthorne [060156D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : commiserating with a friend EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: EDGAR! I do believe you are trying to shake me off! The fire has finally died away, has it, Edgar? You fancy someone else these days, do you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 埃德加！我确信你是想甩掉我！激情终于熄灭了，对吧，埃德加？这几天你迷上别人了，是不是？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Millicent Wellington [060156D8] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : feigning shock and trying to guilt her husband into spending more time with her EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why thank you Allistair love. Er, I mean: MISTER Tenpenny!
ESP.TRADUIT: 多谢你，亲爱的奥利斯特。呃，我的意思是：特佩尼先生！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156DE] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : accidentally familiar then covering up (but flirting in a way that says she doesn't think she has to hide the fact she's his mistress) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doctor Banfield! Have you lost your appointment book? I thought we've made a regular appointment. A "house call" I do believe!
ESP.TRADUIT: 班菲尔德医生！你是不是丢了你的预约表？我想我们有定期约见。我记得是“上门服务”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156DE] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : mistress flirting with the doctor she is seeing EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes Edgar dear, I'm quite fine. Thanks for asking! Maybe I'll "see you" around later, then? When you get out for an "evening stroll," perhaps?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，亲爱的埃德加，我非常好。多谢关心！要不要我过一阵来“见见你”？在你“晚上遛弯”的时候吧，怎么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156DE] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : flirting in public with the man she's having an affair with EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever. I know your type, Daring. You want me all to yourself. Well, I'm not some trophy animal you can just bag and hang on your wall!
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便。我知道你是什么人，亲爱的。你想要完全拥有我。不过，我可不是什么你能挂在墙上的猎物标本！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156DE] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : prostitute playfully sparing with one of her johns. ("Daring" is his nickname) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't be scared Irving, dear! I won't bite. Well, not unless you ask me to! Hahahaha!
ESP.TRADUIT: 别害怕，亲爱的艾尔文！我不咬人。唔，除非你让我咬！哈哈哈哈！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156DE] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : teasing a man who is intimidated by her beauty EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't be silly, Michael. It's because you pay me to be nice to you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 别傻了，迈克尔。那是因为你付钱让我对你好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156DE] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : enjoying telling him the way it is while he's to drunk to really understand EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why? You haven't seen him have you?!
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？你还没见过他？！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : doesn't want to run into her annoying husband EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! Well, doc. If you got a pill that will make my husband disappear, I'll gladly take it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！大夫。如果你有能让我丈夫消失的药丸，我会非常高兴的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : annoyed with her husband EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. He's so stupid! I don't actually need to sneak out. I just tell him to piss off, and then I leave. If he was smart, he'd try to stop me. Men!
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，他傻透了！我没必要溜出去。我只是让他滚，然后自己离开。他要是聪明点，就该试着拦住我的。男人！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : complaining that her husband doesn't know how to keep her happy (she wants him to fight for her, but he just lets her leave) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh no! I'm not going to make it that easy for you. If you can't figure it out, then I'm not going to help you. Why are you so stupid?!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，不！我不会这么容易就让你得到的。如果你搞不定，我才不帮你。你为什么那么蠢？！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : angry with her husband EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mean other than the fact that he is an idiot? Or that he's always busy with stupid meetings, or writing stupid books, that NO ONE cares about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说除了他是个大白痴之外？还是他一直忙于开些愚蠢的会，或者写些蠢透了的、没人在乎的书？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : annoyed with her husband EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: No amount of drink is going to make my husband less stupid. But, it'll certainly help me forget about him, won't it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 喝再多的酒也不能让我丈夫少点傻气。不过，这倒是能帮助我忘记他，是吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : annoyed with her husband EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've never heard Dad talk about you. Why is that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从未听父亲提到过你，为什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm quite sure I don't know. Why don't you ask him that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真的不知道，为什么你不去问问他？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E89]MQ03) Scientific Pursuits EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where can I find Ted Strayer?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在哪能找到泰德·斯崔尔？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you tried the common room? That's where he sleeps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你去过公用休息室了吗？他就在那里睡觉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rivet City Security [060156B0] (mod) NPC : [060156B1] (ID) NPC : [0602044E] (ID) NPC : [0602044F] (ID) NPC : [060156AE] (ID) NPC : [060156AF] (ID) NPC : [060156B2] (ID) NPC : [0601F1CB] (ID) NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) NPC : Commander Danvers [060156AD] (mod) NPC : Cindy Cantelli [060156B7] (mod) NPC : Christie Young [060156C8] (mod) NPC : Mei Wong [060156BF] (mod) NPC : Mister Lopez [0601E759] (mod) NPC : Tammy Hargrave [060156C5] (mod) NPC : Belle Bonny [060156C1] (mod) NPC : Bannon [060156B5] (mod) NPC : Henry Young [060156C7] (mod) NPC : Paulie Cantelli [060156B6] (mod) NPC : Gary Staley [060156BC] (mod) NPC : Doctor Preston [060156D0] (mod) NPC : Seagrave Holmes [060156BB] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Otherwise... hmmm. You can probably find him on the flight deck some days, if it isn't raining.
ESP.TRADUIT: 否则……唔，有时候你可能会在飞行甲板上找到他，如果没下雨的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rivet City Security [060156B0] (mod) NPC : [060156B1] (ID) NPC : [0602044E] (ID) NPC : [0602044F] (ID) NPC : [060156AE] (ID) NPC : [060156AF] (ID) NPC : [060156B2] (ID) NPC : [0601F1CB] (ID) NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) NPC : Commander Danvers [060156AD] (mod) NPC : Cindy Cantelli [060156B7] (mod) NPC : Christie Young [060156C8] (mod) NPC : Mei Wong [060156BF] (mod) NPC : Mister Lopez [0601E759] (mod) NPC : Tammy Hargrave [060156C5] (mod) NPC : Belle Bonny [060156C1] (mod) NPC : Bannon [060156B5] (mod) NPC : Henry Young [060156C7] (mod) NPC : Paulie Cantelli [060156B6] (mod) NPC : Gary Staley [060156BC] (mod) NPC : Doctor Preston [060156D0] (mod) NPC : Seagrave Holmes [060156BB] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He usually goes to the Muddy Rudder on Sundays. Beyond that, who knows.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他通常在礼拜天去“泥舵”酒吧。除此之外，天晓得。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rivet City Security [060156B0] (mod) NPC : [060156B1] (ID) NPC : [0602044E] (ID) NPC : [0602044F] (ID) NPC : [060156AE] (ID) NPC : [060156AF] (ID) NPC : [060156B2] (ID) NPC : [0601F1CB] (ID) NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) NPC : Father Clifford [060156CD] (mod) NPC : Commander Danvers [060156AD] (mod) NPC : Cindy Cantelli [060156B7] (mod) NPC : Christie Young [060156C8] (mod) NPC : Mei Wong [060156BF] (mod) NPC : Mister Lopez [0601E759] (mod) NPC : Tammy Hargrave [060156C5] (mod) NPC : Belle Bonny [060156C1] (mod) NPC : Bannon [060156B5] (mod) NPC : Henry Young [060156C7] (mod) NPC : Paulie Cantelli [060156B6] (mod) NPC : Gary Staley [060156BC] (mod) NPC : Doctor Preston [060156D0] (mod) NPC : Seagrave Holmes [060156BB] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you tell me more about my parents?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能告诉我更多关于我父母的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose so. I worked with them for several years until... Until your mother died, and your father decided it was time to leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可以。我和他们在一起工作了几年，直到……直到你母亲去世，你父亲也因此觉得，是时候该离开了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E89]MQ03) Scientific Pursuits EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What else do you want to know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还想知道其他什么事吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E89]MQ03) Scientific Pursuits EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you want to know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想知道什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E89]MQ03) Scientific Pursuits EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any help you can provide would be appreciated.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你能提供任何帮助，我将感激不尽。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why, yes. Let me give you one of my old fashioned chocolate chip cookies! Enjoy!
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，是的。让我给你做个我拿手的碎巧克力甜饼吧！好好享受！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've been saving up stuff for emergencies in case things with Arefu got tremendously bad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经为紧急事态储备了足够的东西，以免断桥镇的形势更加恶化。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're welcome to some of it if you like.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎你挑选一些。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a message for the West family from their daughter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有维斯特家的女儿捎给他们的一封信。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't take that. You're just going to have to bring it back to Lucy or to Ian if you can find him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能收。你必须把它带回给露西，如果你能找到伊恩，交给他也行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Evan King [0601D5F6] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't take that. You're just going to have to bring it to the Wests yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能收。你自己去交给维斯特一家吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Evan King [0601D5F6] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I have this letter for the West Family.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唔，我有一封给维斯特家的信。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's great, but I got bigger problems than being the town post office right now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那很好，但是我眼下有比当镇上的邮局大得多的麻烦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Evan King [0601D5F6] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The shit's about to hit the fan in this cesspool, and I don't think I can stop them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 麻烦一大堆，而我却束手无策。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Evan King [0601D5F6] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have time for games, Vance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 万斯，我没时间跟你玩游戏。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is where you are mistaken, my friend. Time is a commodity more abundant than any other in this world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这你就错了，我的朋友。时间是这个世界上最丰富的资源。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In ceremony, each member of the Family must speak one of the Laws... it is theirs to remember and to enforce.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每当举行典礼的时候，我们当中的每个人都要说出法则中的一条。……那是他们必须记住和坚持执行的法则。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps from these Laws you can discover what we are. Return to me when you are ready.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可能从这些法则之中，你能发现我们是什么样的人。若你准备好就回来找我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes well. I'm a visionary, that's true. But I'm also a creature of habit. I like my Iguana Bits sandwich just the way I always get it. Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊。我是个空想家，没错。但我同样是个有习惯的生物。我喜欢老样子的蜥蜴肉丁三明治。谢谢你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : bragging, and a little annoyed he's being questioned about his meal EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well... I'm glad to know you are getting along. I'll, umm... expect a visit at the usual time. Run along dear. And do be careful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个……很高兴你和大家都熟了。我更……希望你在通常的时间来。走开吧，亲爱的，小心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : self-consciously flirting with his mistress EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looks like someone woke up on the wrong side of the bed. I bet I could help you end up on the right side! Haha! Have good day, dear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来有人早上吃错药了。我敢保证能帮你作出正确的选择！哈哈哈！日安，亲爱的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : flirting EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. Keep wearing those rags. But when you're ready for fabulous, you come see me; I've got just the thing!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好啊。继续穿那些破布吧。但是当你打算变漂亮时，来找我吧，我有最合适的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : shamelessly arrogant EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. Can't say that I do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。我做不了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : ironic EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why, you old hag! You're just jealous. My fabulousity pains you, doesn't it? You can't help feel smaller standing before my greatness, can you dear?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么啦，你这老太婆！妒忌了吧。我的美貌刺痛了你，是不是？在我的伟岸面前，你不可避免地变得渺小，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : playful banter ("fab-u-loss-i-tee") EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You need to MAKE time, dear! You'll never be fabulous just moping around a kitchen all day. You need to relax, go out, get done up, have some fun!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要“找”些时间，亲爱的！你整天在厨房里闷闷不乐是漂亮不起来的。你需要放松，出门，打扮，找找乐子！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : pep talk to a friend EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: And I thought I hated MY life!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得我恨我的生活！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : playfully criticizing a friend who is hiding from her husband EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that's more than I had in mind. Maybe I'll just order a new labcoat instead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 比我想像得要贵。要不然我还是定一件新的实验室外套吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : amused EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright. They're your men. I just don't want to have to sew anything back on because one of your guys got a little carried away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。他们是你的人。我也不想因为你的一个人有点激动就把所有的东西缝起来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : acquiescing but still concerned that someone is going to get hurt EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's good to hear... only, you should stick to the suggested dosage, and avoid alcohol for at least two hours after taking it. Come see me soon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好消息……只不过，你应该保持服用建议的剂量，而且服药后至少两小时内不要喝酒。有需要再来我这。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. For now. I got my eye on you. If you seem to be getting exhausted, I'm prescribing that vacation!
ESP.TRADUIT: 目前还行。我会盯着你。如果你看起来变得很疲惫，我就会让你病假！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : doctor concerned that his patient is working too hard EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah! I remember now. Yes of course. I'll be sure to bring my medicine bag with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊！我想起来了。是啊，当然。我一定会带上我的医药包。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : flirting with his mistress EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. I'm afraid you'll need to take care of that one on your own. But I might have something that'll help you cope. Come see me for a prescription.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，恐怕你需要自己应付了。但我或许有些帮你应付的方法。到我这来，我会给你开处方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (amused) doctor offering sedatives to a high strung wife who hates her husband EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, well. You'll think of something I'm sure. Good luck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，没错。我肯定会想出办法的。祝好运。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156D7] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : comforting a friend who is having a bad day EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, no. Of course not you silly woman. It's just that I... well... I think spending time with the other ladies in the Tower might do you some good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，不。当然不是了，你个蠢女人。只不过……这个……我想与大厦里的其他女孩共度夜晚或许会对你好些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156D7] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : (lying) he's really trying to get some breathing room from his wife who follows him constantly EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um... Yes. Right. Of course. Okay then. See you around Ms. Lancaster.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯…是的。没错。当然。那好吧。回见，兰卡斯特女士。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156D7] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : (embarrassed) caught off guard by something his mistress said in public and trying to make a hasty exit EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I once killed a Yao Guai with my bare hands! Almost lost an arm. But I got the bastard in the end. Ah... Those were the days.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我曾经赤手空拳宰了一只妖怪！几乎丢了一只胳膊。不过最后我还是把那玩意给弄死了。啊……往事如烟……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : reminiscing about the good ol' days EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hehe. I'm sorry to hear that, Irving. Maybe I should take a look at your computer sometime. Heheh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呵呵。很抱歉听到这消息，艾尔文。要不找时间我帮你看看你的电脑吧。呵呵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (trying not to laugh, as he is the one who keeps sabotaging his friends computer as a practical joke) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's the spirit, girl! Every seeming setback is actually just a chance for your genius to shine!
ESP.TRADUIT: 就该是这种态度，女孩！每次表面上的受挫都是让你的才华闪耀的机会！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : praising a young friend for her ingenuity EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just trying to keep busy, I guess. I'm not sure I'm really cut out for the whole retirement thing. Just can't seem to sit still.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想，只是要找些事情做吧。我还不知道自己是否适合这退休生活。好像就是坐不住啊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : talking with a friend EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll just have to see about that! You watch out! I can be a very stealthy hunter!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们等着瞧！你小心！我可是个善于隐蔽自己的猎人！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : playful banter with his mistress EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some men just don't have the hunting instinct, dear. You should try talking to him about your needs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一些人就是没有当猎人的天分，亲爱的。你不如先找他聊聊你的需求。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Herbert "Daring" Dashwood [060156DF] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : giving advice to a friend who wants her husband to pursue her more EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right, comrade! I see. The fabulous comes from the inside out. I will have to remember that. Thank you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，同志！我明白。美丽是由内而外的。我一定要记住这个。谢谢你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Irving Cheng [060156DC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : grateful EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh. I'm sorry Comraaa - err, CHIEF Gustavo!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，实在抱歉，同 — 呃，古斯塔沃长官!
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Irving Cheng [060156DC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (apologetic) about to say "comrade" but catches himself before he says it EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Every day it erases everything. Each day I have to start over again. But it's not the end of the world. I have everything memorized. Never mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每天它都会清空。每天我都要重来。但这并不是世界末日。我把一切都记住了，不要紧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Irving Cheng [060156DC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : despondent EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, you are right, comrade. But I'm afraid I've done something to upset her, and now she isn't talking to me. Never mind. I'll figure something out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，你没错，同志。但恐怕我已经做了一些让她不高兴的事，现在她不肯和我说话了。不要紧，我会有办法的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Irving Cheng [060156DC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : depressed EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's an excellent idea, comrade! I have to get her to stop and listen to me for a moment to even ask her if she'd like that. But thank you though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是个非常棒的主意，同志！我一定让她停下来听我说说，甚至会问问她是否喜欢。但还是多谢你了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Irving Cheng [060156DC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : hopeful EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I see. Well, maybe you're right. Mrs. Cheng spends a lot of time drinking in the lounge, doesn't she.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我明白了。或许你是对的。程太太老是泡在休息室里喝酒，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Irving Cheng [060156DC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : unsure EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh... oh. Alright Susan. I'll see you later then?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦……哦。好了，苏珊。那我们待会见？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Irving Cheng [060156DC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : nervously excited EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know why I'm so stupid. Never mind. I'll go work on my projects.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道我为什么这么蠢。不要紧，我会继续我的计划。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Irving Cheng [060156DC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : sad and confused EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you realize how often you use that word? You be careful, darling, or you'll wear it out like you've worn out your sense of style.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你意识到你自己对这个词的使用频率了吗？小心，亲爱的，否则你就对它没感觉了，就像你对时装没感觉一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lydia Montenegro [060156DA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : playfully teasing a friend EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right. Until next time, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好。下次见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lydia Montenegro [060156DA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : hastily ending the conversation EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, of course, child! Your dishes are always superb!
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，当然了，孩子！你做的饭总是特别棒！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lydia Montenegro [060156DA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : shocked that her friend doesn't realize how talented she is EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: That shop is my pride and joy. I like to be surrounded by fine things - a little beauty in all this ugliness.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个店是我的骄傲和乐趣。我喜欢被精致的东西包围着 — 在这个无所不在的丑陋中的一点美丽。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you tried distracting him, dear? You know, get his "attention" every now and then? Some men are just clueless when it comes to a woman's needs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你试过分散他的注意力么，亲爱的？你知道，不时地吸引他的“注意力”？当涉及女人的需要的时候，有些男人简直笨透了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lydia Montenegro [060156DA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : giving advice to a friend who's being ignored by her husband EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course Mister Tenpenny.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，特佩尼先生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : covering up her hurt feelings EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you, but I'm always so busy serving everyone. Maybe you can just pick something out for me and send it along with the hairnets.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你，但我一直忙于为每个人服务。不如你帮我拣出一些东西来，和发网一起送走吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right, of course. Well, maybe I'll send a special desert over there today, to let them know we appreciate their keeping us safe and sound.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，当然了。或许我今天应该送点特别甜点，让他们知道，我们感激他们保护我们平安。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : kind EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found this old cook book for something called "sushi." Um... well, you might want to check up on a few residents I already served it to. Whoopsie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我发现了关于“寿司”的旧烹饪书。嗯……不如你去找几个曾经尝过这的居民来问问。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Margaret Primrose [060179EC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (to a doctor) embarrassed she might have served bad meat to her customers EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Indeed! I'll drink to that! Cheers!
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错！我要畅饮一番！干杯！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Michael Hawthorne [060156D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : making a toast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nah! Drown the buggars!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不！干倒那些混蛋！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Michael Hawthorne [060156D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : exuberantly EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Huh... sure. I'll drink to that Comrade!
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃……好哇。我要和那位同志喝一杯！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Michael Hawthorne [060156D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : confused, but then making a toast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I always have my happy face on! I mean, just look at it! Are you looking? See how happy it is! The key, you see, is not to give a damn about anything
ESP.TRADUIT: 我总是带着开心的面容！我的意思是，一望即知！你在看吗？看我多开心！你看，关键是，他妈的什么都别在乎！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Michael Hawthorne [060156D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : a bit drunk EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我知道了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Michael Hawthorne [060156D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : confused EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's the spirit!
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是这股劲！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Michael Hawthorne [060156D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : encouraging EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just thought it might be helpful for the security team to know where everyone is and what they are doing. You know, in case of emergency.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是想，如果警卫了解每个人都在哪里和在做什么，会有帮助的。你知道，以防不测。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Millicent Wellington [060156D8] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : slightly defensive EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hehe. Of course, love. Until then. Be good boy now! Hahaha.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呵呵。当然了，爱人。到时候见吧。现在做个好小伙吧！哈哈哈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156DE] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : giggling and trying (not very hard) to be dignified. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Call me Susan. And if you like, we can be on even more "familiar" terms! Hahah!
ESP.TRADUIT: 叫我苏珊。如果你喜欢，我们可以有更“亲热”的称呼！哈哈哈！

ESP.ORIGINAL: A house call, perhaps? I'll be waiting! Hahah!
ESP.TRADUIT: 或者，上门服务？那我等着！哈哈哈！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156DE] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : flirting with her doctor EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hehehehehe. Oh, Edgar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呵呵呵呵呵。哦，埃德加。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156DE] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : giggling flirtatiously EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Trust me. I know all about it... You're right, of course. Being bored out of your mind and surrounded by morons ain't all that bad. Even still...
ESP.TRADUIT: 相信我。我知道它的一切……你是对的，当然。无聊至极和被蠢货包围也不算太糟。甚至……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156DE] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : thinking back on her rough street urchin days, but with a certain nostalgia EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: That wife of yours has you terrified, doesn't she? Don't worry. I can help you relax.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你那老婆吓着你了，对吧？别担心，我会帮你放松下来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156DE] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : flirting, but sincerely concerned about his happiness EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Haha. Perhap's you're right, dear. But you could always set out a few meals in advance and take a nap once in a while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈。或许你是对的，亲爱的。但你可以事先准备好几份饭，然后抽时间打个盹。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not sure whether to be hurt or flattered by all that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不清楚是该生气还是高兴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156DE] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : amused but possibly annoyed EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose it is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想是的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : not convinced EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was afraid you'd say that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就怕你这么说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : annoyed EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : smoldering anger EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I shouldn't have to talk to him. Why make it easy for him? He doesn't make it easy for me! If he can't see the problem, then he's just stupid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不该和他说话。为什么饶了他？他可没饶过我！如果他看不到问题所在，那他就是个大傻瓜。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : angry at her husband EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's because men are stupid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是因为男人都很蠢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : commiserating with a friend EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess maybe I should figure out what I want to do with MY life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想或许我该弄明白我要拿自己的生活怎么办。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : thinking aloud EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想是的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : commiserating EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you teach me the ways of the Vampire?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能教我成为血族的方法吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: To be a vampire is a life commitment. It is not achieved by my words, it is something you earn by your own will and sincere meditation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 变成血族是要献身的。它不是通过我的语言实现的，而是要通过你自己的意志和冥想去赢得。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sadly, I cannot fully make you one of us, but I can teach you how the life blood of others brings us regenerative powers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很遗憾，我无法让你完全变成我们中的一员，但我能教你别人的生命之血如何带给我们重生的力量。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Since your body lacks the way to extract blood as we do, you must find alternative sources for your nourishment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 鉴于你的躯体缺乏像我们那样抽取血液的能力，你必须另想办法获取营养。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Drink deep of the blood, allow not a drop to spill. Feel the warmth as it spreads inside you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大口饮下血液，不要漏出一滴。感受它的温暖在你体内蔓延。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are becoming one with the life force of another. They lend a part of themselves to you. For a brief moment, you are two entities becoming one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会变成拥有别人生命力的人。他们将自己的一部分借给了你。在短时间内，你是两个实体融合为一。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Allow the feelings to course through your body as you partake of the blood... feel it empower you and make you stronger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当你享用血液时，让这感觉穿越你的身体……体验它给你带来的力量，并使你更强壮。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once you have done this deed, only then will you know what it is like to be a vampire.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有做到这一点，你才能了解血族是个什么样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is no more I can teach you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没法再教你更多东西了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Use what little I have given you well, and carry that knowledge with honor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好好地运用我的这点浅见，珍视这些学识。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And, well, yes... the Enclave is me, as well. Ha ha ha. As your President, it's my responsibility to preside over our great democracy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而且，是啊……英克雷也就是我。哈哈哈。作为你们的总统，我有责任统帅我们伟大的民主。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So let me ask you, America. How many of your children can say the same? How many of this nation's youth are truly happy, truly carefree?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那让我问问你，美利坚。你们有多少孩子可以这么说？这个国家有多少青少年真正开心，真正无忧无虑？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about the Slavers of Paradise falls? The frighteningly irradiated Ghouls of Underworld?
ESP.TRADUIT: 堕落天堂的奴隶贩子怎样？地下城那些可怕的辐射僵尸呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You obviously know all about the G.E.C.K., so let's help each other out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你显然很了解伊甸园创造器，那么让我们互相帮个忙吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Indeed. Your powers of deduction are quite impressive. I do indeed know where it is and how to get it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 确实，你的逻辑十分清晰。我确实知道它在哪，还有怎么得到它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The device is surrounded by a lethal field of radiation; lethal to humans that is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那装置被致命的辐射包围着，就是说，对人类很致命。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Without insulting your intelligence, I think you can see where this is going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有取笑你的意思，但我认为你知道那样的下场。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks!
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sometimes I get the feeling I'm talking to myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有时候我觉得就像在自言自语。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Millicent Wellington [060156D8] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : annoyed that her husband isn't paying attention to her EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry dear... must have dozed off there for a moment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，亲爱的……我想是打了个瞌睡。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156D7] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : not paying attention to his wife who is chatting his ear off EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you even listening?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有在听吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Millicent Wellington [060156D8] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : annoyed that her husband isn't paying attention EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right-o.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156D7] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : (not really paying attention) humoring his chatty wife EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the latest gossip?
ESP.TRADUIT: 最近有什么传闻？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That Mister Burke is a shady character, isn't he? I've heard some positively awful things about him. But Tenpenny trusts him. So he can't be all bad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 伯克先生是个阴险的角色，对吧？我听过一些有关他特别可怕的传言。但是特佩尼先生信任他。所以他也应该不是很坏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Millicent Wellington [060156D8] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : speculating and gossiping about her neighbors EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ms. Montenegro's quite full of herself, isn't she? Puffed up like a souffle, she is! Ha! That was a good one, wasn't it? I'm quite funny today!
ESP.TRADUIT: 黑山女士自我膨胀，对不对？她胀得像要爆掉了，哈哈！那个笑话还不错，对吧？我今天很开心！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Millicent Wellington [060156D8] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (first question is a statement more than a question) speculating and gossiping about her neighbors EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. If you insist on remaining a social hermit, by all means continue to follow me around all day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。如果你坚持要成为一个遁世者，不妨整天都跟着我好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156D7] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : trying not to be sarcastic but failing EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're wasting your time. I don't want to have to tell you again. This gun is loaded. I'd hate for it to accidentally go off in your direction.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在浪费时间。我不打算再跟你说了。这把枪已经上膛。我可不想它冲着你的时候走火。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (angry) telling off a man who hit on him EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: At least I'm not some dried up tart, prancing around like the queen of America, carelessly spouting grotesque phrases. "Fabulousity?" Really now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 至少我不是那种无聊的轻佻女人，弄得自己好像“美利坚皇后”似的，还拿腔捏调地：“难-以-置-信~”就像现在这样！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lydia Montenegro [060156DA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : playful repartee ("fab-u-loss-i-tee") EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ouch! You wound me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇嗷！你伤到我了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Anthony Ling [060156DB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : playfully sad (verging on melodrama) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know the other ladies and I don't get along famously. They're quite jealous of me, naturally.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道我和其他女孩相处得并不融洽。当然，她们都很嫉妒我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Millicent Wellington [060156D8] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : covering up for the fact that everyone dislikes her because she is an arrogant busy body EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever. He loves those damn meetings, and that stupid "Community Manifesto" of his more than me. He hardly knows I exist!
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论如何，他爱那些讨厌的会议，还有他那愚蠢的“共产党宣言”更胜于我。他几乎不知道我的存在！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : annoyed with her husband EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! You'll drink to ANYTHING! Cheers!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！为什么干杯都行！干杯！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lydia Montenegro [060156DA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : teasing her friend during a toast after he said "I'll drink to that!" EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! He's so stupid, he wouldn't know what do to even if I did manage to get his attention!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！他太蠢了，即使我引起了他的注意，他也不知道该怎么办！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : annoyed with her husband EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes they are dear, quite!
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，他们很亲密，没错！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lydia Montenegro [060156DA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : amused EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ohhh. Well, comrade. I don't think I'll ever be able to do that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦。同志。我不认为我能做到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Irving Cheng [060156DC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : despondent he can't make his wife happy. EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! See?! That's what I'm talking about! Stupid. Stupid man!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！看到了？这就是我所说的！愚蠢的，愚蠢的男人！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tiffany Cheng [060156DD] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : angry with her husband EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, enough with the addict routine. Tell me what you want already!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你也过够瘾了。告诉我你想要什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Can you resist the taste that'll blow up in your face?!" like Ronald always says. He thinks of the best Nuka-Cola jingles!
ESP.TRADUIT: “你会无法抗拒的味道，都会表现在你脸上！”就象罗纳德经常说的那样。他觉得这是核子可乐最好的广告句！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyway, for every bottle you bring me I'll pay you some caps. You know, for expenses.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总之，你每带给我一瓶我将付你一些瓶盖。你知道的，作为报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: But if you're super cool and find like enough bottles to fill my Nuka-Cola machine, 30 in all, I got a super secret cool prize for you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 但如果你够酷，能找到足够填满我的核子可乐机，总共30瓶，我会送你个超级秘密酷奖品！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Protector Casdin, sir! We've got a local interested in the job!
ESP.TRADUIT: 守护者卡斯丁，长官！我们找到一个有兴趣做这任务的原住民！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nope. Sorry. Protector Casdin says the locals around here are barely smarter than the Mole Rats.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不行，抱歉。守护者卡斯丁说，这的原住民未必比地鼠更聪明。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But Morgan said we might have some work for an outsider. Talk with her, if you're really interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过摩根说我们或许可以给外来者一些工作。跟她谈谈，如果你真有兴趣的话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I join your group?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能加入你的队伍吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nope. Sorry. Protector Casdin says the locals around here are barely smarter than the Mole Rats.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不行，抱歉。守护者卡斯丁说，这的原住民未必比地鼠更聪明。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But Morgan said we might have some work for an outsider. Talk with her, if you're really interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过摩根说我们或许可以给外来者一些工作。跟她谈谈，如果你真有兴趣的话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I join your group?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能加入你的队伍吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We aren't recruiting, kid. Old sap Lyons might trust walk-ins, but we don't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不征兵，孩子。老白痴里昂斯或许会信任那些不请自来的人，但我们可不一样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But if you want to help out... well, we might be able to work out a deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但如果你想要帮忙……我们或许能做个交易。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You bring in technological devices, and we'll pay you a finder's fee, based on the device. But Protector Casdin would have to okay it, first.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你给我们带来科技装置，我们就会付你酬劳，当然，以质定价。不过首先要得到守护者卡斯丁的允许。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You collect technology? How do I sign up?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们收集技术？要不要我帮忙？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who lives here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁住在这里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want a new opening speech. One that acknowledges me as King.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要一场全新的公开演说。承认我是国王。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't think you'll scare anyone here. You could shoot down everyone in town, and I wouldn't flinch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别以为你能吓唬谁。这镇上的人你随便杀，而我不会退缩的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You live in Big Town; you learn to accept death.
ESP.TRADUIT: 住在大镇，你就得学会接受死亡。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want a new opening speech. One that acknowledges me as King.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要一场全新的公开演说。承认我是国王。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't think you'll scare anyone here. You could shoot down everyone in town, and I wouldn't flinch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别以为你能吓唬谁。这镇上的人你随便杀，而我不会退缩的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You live in Big Town; you learn to accept death.
ESP.TRADUIT: 住在大镇，你就得学会接受死亡。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want a new opening speech. One that acknowledges me as Queen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要一场全新的公开演说。承认我是女王。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened to our deal, Sierra?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的交易怎样，塞拉？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ohhhh... Ronald is SUCH a sweetheart! Do you know he went out like you did and found me 30 bottles of Quantum?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦~~~……罗纳德真是太贴心了！你知道他像你一样出去，却给我找回了30瓶量子版吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He loves me! He really loves me! Now I bet he'll ask me to get married.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他爱我！他真的真的爱我！我打赌他会向我求婚的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh! For my wedding present I'm giving him the super secret prize too!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦！为了我的结婚礼物，我也要给他超级秘密奖品！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh great. I thought I was rid of you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，天啦，我还以为已经甩掉你了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No such luck, sucker! Life ain't worth living without Butch around, and you can't keep a Tunnel Snake down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没那么幸运，小毛孩！如果没有布奇伴你左右，你活着毫无意义，而且你也搞不定一个穴蛇帮。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : a bit drunk EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: But if you're lucky, you can hold my empties. Here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但如果你幸运的话，你可以为我拿着空瓶。接住。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : a bit drunk EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you get all the way down here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么一路到这来的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, you know you can't keep a Tunnel Snake cooped up forever! We gotta be free, and your little visit was just the inspiration I needed!
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，你知道没人能永远困住穴蛇帮的！我们必将获得自由，你的小小拜访正好激发了我！

ESP.ORIGINAL: So here's to sweet, glorious freedom! Cheers!
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，为了梦寐以求的自由，干杯！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought the Overseer closed the Vault. How did you get out?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以为监督者把避难所给关闭了，你是怎么跑出来的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Same way anyone does. By being too cool to stop anywhere else! I didn't see a thing in the wasteland that was a match for a bona fide Tunnel Snake!
ESP.TRADUIT: 和别人的办法一样。酷到不能在其它地方逗留！我从未见过废土上有谁能与真正的穴蛇帮匹敌！

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, here's to freedom and rocking the Wasteland! Drink up!
ESP.TRADUIT: 为享受自由，颠覆废土，干杯！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds like a deal. Good to see you on the outside, Butch!
ESP.TRADUIT: 听上去不错。很高兴在外面能见到你，布奇！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's to raising hell and living the good life out here! Cheers!
ESP.TRADUIT: 为杀出地狱，享受外面的美好生活，干杯！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now all we need is a gang, and we could take over this whole Wasteland!
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，我们只需要成立一个帮派，就能接管废土了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I see what you have for sale?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能看看你出售的东西吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If your caps are good, you can buy whatever you like. Beats standing there drooling all over the merchandise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你有足够的瓶盖，你可以随便买你想要的任何东西，不用站在那对着货品流口水。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Karl [060200C4] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Drinking that stuff can't be good for you if it contains radiation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果它含有放射性的话，喝下它对你可没什么好处。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I guess so. I heard that sometimes the radiation would remain in people's systems, but only in a few test cases.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想也是。我听说有时候辐射会影响到人体的系统，但只是少数的试验中。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All you'd need is a little RadAway and poof, the isotope is gone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要的东西就是一包辐特宁，噗的一声，同位素就没了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sierra Petrovita [060388DF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E98]MS05) The Nuka-Cola Challenge

ESP.ORIGINAL: What if there are others that don't share your opinion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 万一有其他人不同意你的意见呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about your "god."
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我说说你们的“神”吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you mean Harold? He's really nice. Sometimes when I get really lonely, I go into the Grove and talk to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你是说哈罗德？他很不错。有时候我觉得孤独，就跑到小树林那里去跟他聊天。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sapling Yew [0602AEFF] (mod) Quest : ([0602A274]MS10) Oasis EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sometimes I even curl up all cozy like and sleep next to his roots after I have a bad dream.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我做噩梦后，有时候我就舒坦地蜷缩在他的根旁睡觉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I tell him what I'm scared of and he tells me what he's scared of. It makes me feel better knowing I'm not the only one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我告诉他我怕些什么，他也告诉我他害怕什么。知道我并不是孤独的，这让我感觉很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sapling Yew [0602AEFF] (mod) Quest : ([0602A274]MS10) Oasis EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, yeah, sure. I understand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，是啊，当然了。我明白。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here. That's all I have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给。我只有这些了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It wasn't free. Doctor's fees are expensive. Understand?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这可不是义务治疗，医生的收费是很高的，明白？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can you tell me about Nuka-Cola Cocktails?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能跟我说说核子可乐鸡尾酒吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know a whole lot about weapons, but I do know that it's more powerful than the Molotov Cocktail.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对武器不是很懂，但我知道它比莫洛托夫鸡尾酒的威力大多了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It explodes in a huge blue flame too! How cool is that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 它还会爆发蓝色的火焰！那不是很酷？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me more about the Nuka Cocktail.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉我更多关于核子可乐手榴弹的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry. Can't talk now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，现在不能说话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : ducking out of an unwanted conversation EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: See you later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回头见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : a greeting in passing, not meant to initiate conversation EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, don't worry. No one ever goes there because they say it's a ghost town. And since ghosts don't exist, you can just focus on the landmines.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，别担心。从来没有人去那里，因为他们说那是个鬼城。既然鬼不存在，那么你就专注于地雷吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hear there's a playground in the middle of the town. Reach that point and come back, and I'm sure you'll have some stories to tell!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说在镇子中央有一块操场。到那个地点然后回来，我能肯定你有许多故事要讲！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose, for the sake of proper research, I can go back into Minefield.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想，为了研究的正确性，我能回到雷区。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, don't worry. No one ever goes there because they say it's a ghost town. And since ghosts don't exist, you can just focus on the landmines.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，别担心。从来没有人去那里，因为他们说那是个鬼城。既然鬼不存在，那么你就专注于地雷吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hear there's a playground in the middle of the town. Reach that point and come back, and I'm sure you'll have some stories to tell!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说在镇子中央有一块操场。到那个地点然后回来，我能肯定你有许多故事要讲！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll head into Minefield. Wish me luck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会闯入雷区的，祝我好运吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great! The library should be in old Arlington, not far from downtown. See if you can download the archives from its computer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好！图书馆应该位于阿灵顿，离市区不远。看你能否从那里的电脑上把档案下载回来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you can't get those, then even the card catalog would be useful. Any little piece of information could help the book. And thus, humanity!
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你拿不到那些的话，那么卡片目录也是很有用的。任何一点情报都会有助于这本书，从而帮助人类！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, I'll check out my local library.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我会检查当地的图书馆。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's great. I recommend the nest at the Anchorage War Memorial. I knew a trader who talked about the Mirelurks down there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太棒了。我推荐位于安克雷奇战争纪念馆的巢穴。我听一个商人说有蟹人盘踞在那。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just go inside and find one of their spawning pods, probably down near the water.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要进去，找到一个它们的卵囊就行了，或许会在水面附近。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide

ESP.ORIGINAL: Put this observer inside, and get out quietly. And be sure not to kill any Mirelurks inside their nest! If you do, it could ruin the validity of the study!
ESP.TRADUIT: 把这个观察器放进去，然后偷偷溜出来。而且别在他们的巢里杀掉任何泥沼蟹！如果你这么做了，就可能破坏实验的效果！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, I'll try.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我会试试。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, you should just be able to plug it into the mainframe at the RobCo production facility. It'll give you access to the robots and terminals.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是呀，你要把它插进RobCo公司生产设施的电脑主机里，然后就能取得使用机器人和终端的权限。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, here. And be sure to keep an eye peeled for any other examples of how to make old technology work for you out there!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，给。还有，多注意下其他可利用的古老科技！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just go in and connect the widget to the mainframe? I can do that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也就是进去把这个小物件连接到主机？我能办到。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, what? Did you just hit on me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 住手，干嘛？你刚刚打了我吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, um, well. I need to get going, but come back and visit me sometime, okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，嗯，我必须走了，不过你以后再来看我吧，好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not even going to tell you what's wrong with that question...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我甚至不想告诉你刚才的问题有什么不对的……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, um, well. I need to get going, but come back and visit me sometime, okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，嗯，这个。我必须走了，不过你以后再来看我吧，好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why, no. I'm not in any sort of relationship. Are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊呀，没。我没有什么牵挂。你呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, um, well. I need to get going, but come back and visit me sometime, okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，嗯，这个。我必须走了，不过你以后再来看我吧，好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why - I do believe you've lost your mind! Ghouls, living here? You're serious?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么 — 我想你一定是疯了吧！僵尸？住在这？你认真的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : excessively shocked EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: There are some Ghouls who want to live here. What do you think about that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有一些僵尸想要住在这里，你怎么看？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you ever dream about monsters? I do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有没有梦见过怪兽？我梦见过。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um. I can't remember.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唔。我记不起来了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Forget it. I'm in the wrong place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 算了。我找错地方了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, as per Protocol NC-62, all employees must be their designated areas at all times.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很抱歉，但根据NC-62议定书，所有雇员都必须一直待在指定区域内。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry. You have now exceeded 2 demerits. Now instituting Expulsion Protocol KL-001.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很抱歉。你已超过2次过失。现在开始执行驱逐协议KL-001。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, as per Protocol NC-62, all employees must be their designated areas at all times.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很抱歉，但根据NC-62议定书，所有雇员都必须一直待在指定区域内。

ESP.ORIGINAL: One demerit will now be issued. Note that further demerits can cause your expulsion from this job posting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在一次记过，小心，继续出错将使你被解雇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm John-Caleb Bradberton. I don't need an ID number. I own this place!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是约翰-卡勒布·布拉德伯顿。我不需要身份编码。我拥有这地方！

ESP.ORIGINAL: The name is verified in my system with no existing or issued employee number. Voice stress pattern within normal parameters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个名字在我的系统内不存在或没有登入员工编号。声音压力模式在正常参数范围。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Executive override protocol initiated. What may I do for you on this wonderfully productive day?
ESP.TRADUIT: 行政越权程序启动。在这样一个美妙而充满生机的日子里，我能为你做些什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My posting is Shipping Clerk and my number is NCSD-701G.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的职务是运输职员，我的编号是NCSD-701G。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Logged and verified. Thank you very much for your cooperation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 已登录并核实。非常感谢您的合作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What may I do for you on this wonderfully productive day?
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这样一个美妙而充满生机的日子里，我可以为你做些什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My posting is Nuka-Cola R&D and my number is 987065. <Lie.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的职务是研发核子可乐，我的编号是987065。<撒谎>

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have no record of that posting, nor does that employee identification number follow the proper format.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有那个岗位的记录，这个雇员编号也不符合标准格式。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry. You have now exceeded 2 demerits. Now instituting Expulsion Protocol KL-001.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很抱歉。你已超过2次过失。现在开始执行驱逐协议KL-001。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have no record of that posting, nor does that employee identification number follow the proper format.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有那个岗位的记录，这个雇员编号也不符合标准格式。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One demerit will now be issued. Note that further demerits can cause your expulsion from this job posting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在一次记过，小心，继续出错将使你被解雇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As previously stated, please identify yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如前所述，请说明你的身份。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My posting title is Ass Kicker and my number is 5.56mm!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的职务名称是踢你屁股，我的编号是5.56毫米！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Use of profanity and attempting to falsify an employee identification number is a violation of Protocols NC-68 and NC-90 respectively.
ESP.TRADUIT: 滥用和试图篡改雇员编号的行为，将分别触犯NC-68和NC-90议定书。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry. You have now exceeded 2 demerits. Now instituting Expulsion Protocol KL-001.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很抱歉。你已超过2次过失。现在开始执行驱逐协议KL-001。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Use of profanity and attempting to falsify an employee identification number is a violation of Protocols NC-68 and NC-90 respectively.
ESP.TRADUIT: 滥用和试图篡改雇员编号的行为，将分别触犯NC-68和NC-90议定书。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Two demerits will now be issued. Note that further demerits can cause your expulsion from this job posting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你已被记过两次，注意，如果你再次犯错的话，就有可能导致你被清除出这个工作岗位。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have that information.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没听过那消息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, as per Protocol NC-77, this information must be readily accessible at all times.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很抱歉，但根据NC-77议定书，这个信息必须随时可以读取。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry. You have now exceeded 2 demerits. Now instituting Expulsion Protocol KL-001.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很抱歉。你已超过2次过失。现在开始执行驱逐协议KL-001。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, as per Protocol NC-77, this information must be readily accessible at all times.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很抱歉，但根据NC-77议定书，这个信息必须随时可以读取
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One demerit will now be issued. Note that further demerits can cause your expulsion from this job posting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在一次记过，小心，继续出错将使你被解雇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As previously stated, please identify yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如前所述，请说明你的身份。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for the factory's shipping manifests.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在寻找工厂的运输清单。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That information is in the Shipping Computer Terminal. The pass code for the terminal is NC-C1864.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该信息在运输电脑的终端。终端运行密码NC-C1864。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any information you could give me on the caves below Oasis would be helpful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有关绿洲地下洞穴的任何信息都会对我都有帮助。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. Here you go. Good luck to you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。给你。祝你好运!

ESP.ORIGINAL: May I have the key to the caves?
ESP.TRADUIT: 可以给我进入洞穴的钥匙吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, leave it to good old Bob to get me stuck above some caves. Now my dang feet are cold!
ESP.TRADUIT: 把它留给老好人鲍勃，让我能使劲挖些洞。现在我那该死的脚好冷！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have some quick questions about those caves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对于那洞穴，我有些小问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You say you saw me coming to Oasis. And you call the Treeminders crazy...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说你看见我向绿洲进发，还把那些树启者称为疯子……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, yeah you have a point there. Maybe I'm just losing my marbles from all this boredom.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说对了一点。或许我因为无聊而失去了我的理智。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I swear if I try real hard, I can see all around me like my eyes are in every leaf on every tree.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我发誓，只要我真的努力就能看到周围的一切，仿佛树上的每片树叶都长着我的眼睛。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think it's making Bob kind of jealous, cause he was the first tree in my life and all that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认为它使鲍勃有点嫉妒，因为他是我生命中的第一棵树。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If people thought I was a god, I'd exploit it for all it's worth!
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果人们认为我是神，我就会好好利用它的价值！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, hey, hey, I thought that too... at first.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨, 我也这么想的……最初。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had them sing me songs, I made them do stupid dances and things like that. Bob even told me to make Maple stand on his head for a whole day!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我让他们给我唱歌，我让他们跳愚蠢的舞，诸如此类。鲍勃甚至告诉我要让梅坡倒立一整天！

ESP.ORIGINAL: After a while though, it just gets boring. Then it becomes a nuisance and now it's completely driving me nuts!
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是过了一阵之后，我就对此感觉无聊了。然后我开始感到厌烦，而现在这些完全把我逼疯了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I saw you coming towards Oasis, I thought I felt that you'd understand me. I guess I was wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我看到你前来绿洲时, 我觉得你会理解我。我想我错了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't actually seem that sad. Why do you want to die?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你实际上看起来并不那么哀伤。为什么想要去死？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've been literally rooted to this spot thanks to Bob for maybe twenty or thirty years... I can't even remember anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 都怪鲍勃，我已经在这里扎根二、三十年了……我甚至都记不清了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you imagine being stuck in one place for that long not being able to eat or to read or to sleep or anything?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能否想象那么长的时间不能吃、不能读、不能睡、不能做任何事情地困在一个地方吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: In the meantime, I have these Treeminders bothering me every day about things I don't even care about, and I can't stand it anymore!
ESP.TRADUIT: 同时，这些树启者每天都为了那些我毫不关心的事来打扰我。我再也受不了了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did this all happen, Reilly?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是怎么发生的，莱莉？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We were mapping the Vernon Square part of the downtown ruins and got jumped by a Super Mutant ambush party.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们当时正在前往市区废墟的弗农广场部分，结果遭遇了一群埋伏在那的超级变种人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Usually it isn't a problem, but this group was bigger than usual. We fought our way into Our Lady of Hope Hospital, hoping to find cover.
ESP.TRADUIT: 通常来说，这不算什么，但这次的队伍比通常庞大。我们杀出了一条通往玛利亚医院的路来，希望能够找到掩护。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Eventually the fight spilled into the Statesman Hotel and we ran all the way to the roof.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最后战斗打到了政要酒店，我们就一路跑到了楼顶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I left my guys up there and tried to stealth out but got caught by a Mutie ambush patrol. That was the last thing I remember.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把我的人留在那里，并且试图溜出来，但被一支变种人巡逻队逮住了。那就是我所记得的最后一件事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, it's been centuries. The planet is a lush, green paradise once again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，都几个世纪了。这个星球将再次变成了繁华的绿色天堂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Huh? What the hell are you talking about? That isn't very funny.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃？你他妈在说什么？这一点都不好笑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: If my guys were here, they'd kick your...
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我的人在这，他们会踢你的…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh shit! My team! What the hell happened?
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死！我的队伍！他妈的发生了什么事？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Huh? What the hell are you talking about? That isn't very funny.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃？你他妈在说什么？这一点都不好笑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: If my guys were here, they'd kick your...
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我的人在这，他们会踢你的…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh shit! My team! What the hell happened?
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死！我的队伍！他妈的发生了什么事？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: What difference does it make?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这又有什么区别呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I don't know actually. Kind of confused.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真的不知道。有点晕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait! Oh shit!
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等！见鬼！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: My men... my team! What happened to them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的人……我的队伍！他们怎么样了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I don't know actually. Kind of confused.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真的不知道。有点晕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait! Oh shit!
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等！见鬼！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: My men... my team! What happened to them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的人……我的队伍！他们怎么样了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not long, fortunately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 时间不长，运气不错。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right... can't remember what I was doing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对……想不起来我当时正在做些什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait! Oh shit!
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等！见鬼！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: My men... my team! What happened to them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的人……我的队伍！他们怎么样了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right... can't remember what I was doing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对……想不起来我当时正在做些什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait! Oh shit!
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等！见鬼！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: My men... my team! What happened to them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的人……我的队伍！他们怎么样了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: She your new toy, zombie?
ESP.TRADUIT: 她是你的新玩具，丧尸？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That kind of talk is uncalled for. I was, am and always will be a doctor of medicine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这种说法是不当的。我曾经，并且永远都是医学博士。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't care if she was a Super Mutant. I'd still help her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不在乎她是否是个超级变种人，我仍然会帮助她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If they hauled your sorry, shot-up body into my clinic, I'd try and save you too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他们把你那可怜而伤痕累累的身体拖到我的诊所里来，我也同样会试着救你命的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Barrows [000156F0] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tara's dead. Crowley fucked up and got her killed. Fucking Ghoul. When I'm done, he'll sniff butts with the ferals for the rest of his life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 塔拉死了。考利闯了祸，害死了她。那混蛋僵尸。等我事成后，他这辈子就跟那些凶悍僵尸待在一起吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You ain't allowed up there, you hear me? Go any farther and you're a dead man. I ain't warning you twice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不准上去，听见没？多走一步，你就死定了。我不会再警告你第二次。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : shouted warning from a distance EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You ain't allowed up there, you hear me? Take one more step and they'll be scraping you off the pavement. Ain't gonna warn you again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不准上去，听见没？再迈一步他们就会把你拽下来。不会再次警告你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : shouted warning from a distance EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think it would be good for the Republic, Mister President.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认为这有益于共和国，总统先生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course it would. I knew that. You heard me say that before, didn't you. It was my idea after all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然会，我知道。之前你也听我说过，对吧？毕竟那是我的主意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dave [06029A98] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take it. Your audience is over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，拿去吧。你的晋见时间结束了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dave [06029A98] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you sure I can't just have that key, handsome? You know, as a present?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真的不能得到那把钥匙吗，帅哥？就当作是礼物好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: For you, sweet cheeks? Sure thing!
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了你，甜心？当然可以！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, how about I show you how I keep my two bitches happy all night long?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，不如我让你体验一下我让那两个婊子快活一夜的绝活吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dukov [0602AE1E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about I let you live, and you give me something so I can lie to Crowley?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会让你活着，你给我一些东西，好让我去向考利交差？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just give me the key. Don't ask why.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我钥匙，不要多问。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, dude, Don't have a cow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，老兄，别发脾气。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156BE] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，拿着。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156BE] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, dude, Don't have a cow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，老兄，别发脾气。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156BE] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take it all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，都拿去吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060156BE] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just give me all your stuff. And don't ask any questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把你所有的东西都给我，别问为什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe. I don't know if I trust you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可能吧，我不知道自己是否信任你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The feeling's mutual, smoothskin. But that never stopped a business deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这种感觉是相互的，光皮肤。但是那从来没有阻断过商业交易。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: A lot of you humans are bigots. You don't like Ghouls and treat us like zombies, calling us brain eaters and shufflers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很多人类都是偏执狂。你们讨厌僵尸，像对待丧尸一样对待我们，还把我们叫作食脑者和瘸子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, they're going to pay. Uh... before I get into the details, you don't have anything against killing do you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们将会付出代价。喔……在我谈论细节之前，我先问问，你对杀人没什么异议吧？ ?
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Crowley [060156F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A talking Super Mutant? What's next, a dog on a bicycle?
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个会说话的超级变种人？接下来会是什么？一只骑着自行车的狗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you? I've never met a friendly Super Mutant before.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？我之前从未见过友善的超级变种人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was driven out by my brothers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我被我的兄弟驱逐出来了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I tried to get them to understand that there was more to life than fighting and killing, but they wouldn't listen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我设法使他们了解生活不仅仅是打斗和杀戮，但是他们不听。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now I wander the Wasteland, hoping to find some meaning to life before I die.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，我在废土流浪着，希望能在有生之年发现一些生命的真缔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was driven out by my brothers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我被我的兄弟驱逐出来了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I tried to get them to understand that there was more to life than fighting and killing, but they wouldn't listen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我设法使他们了解生活不仅仅是打斗和杀戮，但是他们不听。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now I wander the Wasteland, hoping to find some meaning to life before I die.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，我在废土流浪着，希望能在有生之年发现一些生命的真缔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about we make it 300 caps?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们300个瓶盖成交如何？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that's wonderful. Here are your caps. Thanks very much!
