ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，真不错。这是你的瓶盖。非常感谢你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that's wonderful. Here are your caps. Thanks very much!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，真不错。这是你的瓶盖。非常感谢你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, that sounds fair.
ESP.TRADUIT: 行啊，那听起来很公道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that's wonderful. Here are your caps. Thanks very much!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，真不错。这是你的瓶盖。非常感谢你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that's wonderful. Here are your caps. Thanks very much!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，真不错。这是你的瓶盖。非常感谢你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, granny... Talk is cheap, but getting stuff isn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，老婆婆……谈话是廉价的，但换东西却不是。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have a lot to learn about dealing with people, young man. However, you're right. I need to think of your needs too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对于处理人际关系，你还有很多东西要学，小伙子。不过你提的也对，我是该考虑下你的需要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a small amount of ammunition that my husband left behind. A box of odds and ends. I don't think I've opened it in years.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我丈夫生前留下些弹药。一箱子的零星物品。我大概好多年都没有打开过它了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you do this for me, you're welcome to take whatever you need.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你愿意为我做这事，你可以随便拿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have a lot to learn about dealing with people, young lady. However, you're right. I need to think of your needs too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对于处理人际关系，你还有很多东西要学，小女孩。不过你提的也对，我是该考虑下你的需要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a small amount of ammunition that my husband left behind. A box of odds and ends. I don't think I've opened it in years.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我丈夫生前留下些弹药。一箱子的零星物品。我大概好多年都没有打开过它了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you do this for me, you're welcome to take whatever you need.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你愿意为我做这事，你可以随便拿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to help you, but that type of search could cost me greatly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很想帮你，但那种搜寻可会花费我大量的时间和精力。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have a point. Perhaps I've been neglecting needs that you might have and being selfish.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说得对。或许是我忽略了你可能的需求以及你的自私。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a small amount of ammunition that my husband left behind. A box of odds and ends. I don't think I've opened it in years.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我丈夫生前留下些弹药。一箱子的零星物品。我大概好多年都没有打开过它了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you do this for me, you're welcome to take whatever you need.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你愿意为我做这事，你可以随便拿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess a homemade violin is never quite in tune...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看这把自制的小提琴音不太准……

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are a clever one!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个聪明人！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, that's exactly the problem that I have with it. It doesn't quite play all of the notes correctly and I have to constantly tinker with it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，那正是我的麻烦所在。它总是不能正确地演奏音符，而我不得不经常修补它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow, Reilly. You look like shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇哦，莱莉。你看起来真狼狈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got a lot of class, kid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还有很多的课要上，孩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I feel worse than I look, but that doesn't even matter to me. I'm just worried about the rest of the Rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，我的感觉比外表还糟，但我不在乎。我只是担心其他的游骑兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't even know if they're still alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我甚至不知道他们是死是活。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Forget it. I may as well shoot myself in the head and save the trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 算了。我不如朝自己头上开一枪来摆脱这些麻烦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow. You really are an asshole. Fine. I hope their deaths sit well on your conscience.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇哦。你真是一个混蛋。好吧，我希望他们的死能唤起你的良知。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you set any kinds of traps or mines?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有没有设陷阱或是埋地雷？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, we did lay down a bunch of countermeasures. I don't know how many of them have already gone off though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 实际上，我们的确制订了一堆对策。但我不知道它们有多少已经失效了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I slipped out with my Stealth Boy, I think I almost tripped one or two of them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我使用隐身小子溜出来的时侯, 我想我差点就触动了其中的一两个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Damn near didn't make it out of there at all, come to think of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回想一下，我差点就没从那里逃出来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've heard of you guys. You pack some serious firepower.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说过你们。你们有一些可怕的武器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're pretty sharp, kid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你相当敏锐，孩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: We pack plenty of firepower, but that didn't help us from getting our asses into serious trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们装备有大量武器，不过这他妈的并没有帮助我们远离那些大麻烦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I didn't expect to make it out of there alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没指望能活着离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's skip all the story and get to the point.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们跳过所有的故事来谈谈重点吧。你需要些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you're that eager to jump in headfirst, eh? You remind me a lot of some crazy mercs I knew back in the day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就真的这么迫不及待吗，嗯？你倒是让我回想起了过去认识的许多疯狂的佣兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're all dead now because they were stupid, but suit yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们这些愚蠢的家伙都死了，随便你吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: My team is trapped on the roof of the Statesman Hotel in Vernon Square and completely surrounded by Super Mutants.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的队伍被一群超级变种人团团围困在弗农广场的政要酒店楼顶上了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Their ammo is almost gone, and I have no idea how much longer they have to live.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们的弹药快用完了，我不知道他们还能撑多久。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Suit yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, I get the point.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，我明白你的意思了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think you're in any condition to be up and about.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认为你的情况不适宜上去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's not the way I do things.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那不是我处事的方式。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have any idea what it would do to my reputation if word got around that Reilly of Reilly's Rangers was laid up in a hospital bed?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得如果“莱莉的游骑兵的莱莉躺到了病床上”这样的话传出去，对我的声誉会有什么影响？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your boss. So you'd better let me past before you get in trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你决定。不过你不想惹麻烦的话，最好让我过去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Colonel Autumn is the only one authorized to see the President.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥托姆上校是唯一一个被授权能见总统的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enclave Officer [06039634] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't move. I'm going to find out what's going on here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别动。我去看看发生了什么事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enclave Officer [06039634] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The shit's about to hit the fan up here, and you're asking questions?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些该死的都打到这了，你还在问东问西？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, Reilly once told me all we got in this shitty world is each other. I buy into that theory quite a bit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，莱莉告诉过我，我们在这个烂世界里，唯一拥有的就是彼此。我相当赞同这种观点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: We watch each other's backs and that's what keeps us alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们相互掩护并互相照顾，这也是我们能活着的原因。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: If she's dead and you just followed our transmission, I want to know about it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果她死了，而你只是来捎个口信，我一定要知道怎么回事！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, looks like you got yourselves into a mess. Nice work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，看来你把自己弄得一团糟。干得好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tough guy routine, eh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 强充硬汉吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't give a shit what you think about us. I just want to get the hell out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我才他妈的不在乎你对我们有什么看法。我只想要离开这该死的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, what happened to Reilly? Is she okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 莱莉发生了什么事 ？她还好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tough guy routine, eh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 强充硬汉吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't give a shit what you think about us. I just want to get the hell out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我才他妈的不在乎你对我们有什么看法。我只想要离开这该死的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, what happened to Reilly? Is she okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 莱莉发生什么事了？她还好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A medic, huh? Can you patch me up?
ESP.TRADUIT: 医生，呃？你能否给我包扎下吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, no can do. I used the last of my supplies on us when we got to the roof.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，做不到。我们上到楼顶时，我就用掉了最后的补给。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can still put a bullet through a Super Mutant skull though!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我仍然可以一枪射穿超级变种人的脑袋！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, what's up with Reilly? She okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 莱莉发生了什么事 ？她还好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, no can do. I used the last of my supplies on us when we got to the roof.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，做不到。我们上到楼顶时，我就用掉了最后的补给。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can still put a bullet through a Super Mutant skull though!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我仍然可以一枪射穿超级变种人的脑袋！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, what's up with Reilly? She okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 莱莉发生了什么事 ？她还好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, here are the caps. Let's just pretend we never saw each other.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，拿着这些瓶盖。让我们假装从未见过对方吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, okay. Hand 'em over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。给我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enclave Officer [06039634] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8F]MQ09) The American Dream EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell your crazy stories to someone who cares.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把你疯狂的故事说给那些乐意听的人吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm interested in trading.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有兴趣做个买卖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We always need bullets. Takes damn near a hundred of 'em to kill a 'Guai.
ESP.TRADUIT: 子弹对于我们来说永远都是必需品。居然他妈的近百发子弹才能干掉一个妖怪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grandma Sparkle [0605215F] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Always good ta hear. Lesse what ya got.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来不错，看看你都有什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grandma Sparkle [0605215F] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, come on. He'll listen to reason. Go talk to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，拜托。他会听你劝告的。去和他谈谈吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh... uhm... well... you look like someone who's pretty smart... so if you say so. I'll give it a try.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦…喔喔，好吧…看起来你像个聪明人…如果真如你所说的那样。我会去试试的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wastelander [0605213B] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. <takes a deep breath> Here I go...
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。<深呼吸>我去了……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wastelander [0605213B] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Try new BLAMMO! Soap! Blasts stains out! Blasts the whole world out! We've all been BLAMMO'd!
ESP.TRADUIT: 试试新的轮回！宛如香皂！洗刷污点！洁净全世界！我们都需要轮回！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0605213F] (ID) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins Comment (NAM2) : Insane ravings of a street preacher. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Admit it. You're just a whore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 承认吧。你就是一个妓女。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Up yours! It's not like I've got a lot of other options.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去你的！好像我有得其它选择似的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only survival skill I've got is the one I'm using here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我唯一的“生存技能”就是我在这干的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd rather be a whore than dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我宁愿做一个妓女也不想死。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So basically, you're just a whore?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这么说，你只是个妓女？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Damn! I wish I had a setup like this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死！我真希望我也能遇上这种事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a pig, you know that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道吗？你就是头猪！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm only doing this because he can keep me safe. He's a lot tougher than he looks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我这样做只是因为他能保护我的安全。他比他的外表更厉害。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not sure how much longer that will be enough though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不确定这样子还能坚持多久。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sweet for him maybe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对他来说或许很不错。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just along for the ride. He's good with a gun and knows where to get booze.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是跟着他凑热闹。他枪法很好，而且知道在哪能弄到酒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lucky bastard. He's got a sweet setup here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 走运的杂种。他在这找到了甜蜜的归宿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So... What exactly is this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么…这到底是什么地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's my hidey hole. Nobody can fuck with me here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我的藏身洞。在这里没人能动我一根毫毛。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got my women and my booze. What the hell else is there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我得到了我的女人和酒。他妈的还需要什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's my hidey hole. Nobody can fuck with me here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我的藏身洞。在这里没人能动我一根毫毛。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My women are gone, but I've got my booze. That's enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的女人都走了，但我得到了我的酒。这就足够了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's... well, it's Dukov's place. He lives here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是…这是杜克夫的淫窝。他住在这。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cherry [0602AE21] (mod) NPC : Fantasia [0602AE20] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pretty much he just does a lot of drinking and partying.
ESP.TRADUIT: 通常他也就是喝喝酒、搞搞聚会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cherry [0602AE21] (mod) NPC : Fantasia [0602AE20] (mod) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's... well, it's Dukov's place. He used to live here. Lots of drinking and... you know. Now he's dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是…嗯，这是杜克夫的淫窝。他曾住在这。喝喝酒，还有……你知道的。现在他玩儿不转了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cherry [0602AE21] (mod) NPC : Fantasia [0602AE20] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : "you know" is a wink and a nod to sex EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're obviously crazier than they are. Why would I listen to you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你显然比他们更加疯狂。我为什么要听你的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't say I blame you. It's my mistake for making you do something you didn't want to do in the first place I guess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我不能指责你。是我错在先，不该让你去做一些你并不想做的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still, maybe it's all for the best. I mean, I've been talking with Birch and they really seem to need me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，或许这是为了大局着想。我的意思是，我已经和布尔奇谈过了，他们似乎真的需要我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you say Herbert, should I give them another chance?
ESP.TRADUIT: 赫伯特，你怎么说，我应该再给他们一次机会吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, fine... I mean Bob. I still think it's funny when I call him Herbert.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，好的。我是说，鲍勃。我还是觉得叫他赫伯特很好玩。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not the killing type.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我又不是什么杀人狂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I suppose you aren't. My mistake for making you do something you didn't want to do in the first place I guess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，我想你不是。是我错在先，不该让你去做一些你并不想做的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still, maybe it's all for the best. I mean, I've been talking with Birch and they really seem to need me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，或许这是为了大局着想。我的意思是，我已经和布尔奇谈过了，他们似乎真的需要我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you say Herbert, should I give em' another chance?
ESP.TRADUIT: 赫伯特，你怎么说，我应该再给他们一次机会吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, fine, fine... I mean Bob. I still think it's funny when I call him Herbert.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，好的。我是说，鲍勃。我还是觉得叫他赫伯特很好玩。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've become an important part of their life. Without you, they're lost.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你已经成为他们生活中的一个重要组成部分。如果没有你，他们会迷失的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, they really need me that badly, huh? I guess I never thought of it that way. That's awfully selfish of me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们真的如此需要我吗，呃？我从来没有想过这些。我真是太自私了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Should we give em' another chance, Herbert?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我应该再给他们一次机会吗，赫伯特？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, fine, fine, fine... I mean Bob. I still think it's funny when I call him Herbert... I'm sorry, I'm sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，好的。我是说，鲍勃。我还是觉得叫他赫伯特很好玩。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about a haircut?
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我理个发怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now we're talking! What do you need?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这才对嘛！你要什么发型呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you serious? Well alright! Let me get my knives!
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？好极了！让我去拿刀具！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright! A full head of hair to work with! What should I do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真好！有满满一头的头发要处理！我该做什么呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I couldn't care less about your problems. I'm out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不关心你的问题。我要走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome back to the Wasteland, asshole.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎你回到废土，混蛋。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your words sting, Outsider. Normally I'd have you cast from this place for such a statement, but my eyes have been opened.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的话真令人不舒服，外来者。通常你会因你那表达方式而被我从这扔出去，但我的智慧之眼已经打开了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Before you reached His heart, He imparted his last words to me. He told me about his will to die and how I mistook this for some mystical sign.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在你到达他的心之前，他向我留下了他的遗言。他告诉我他对死亡的意愿，还有我如何把这误会成某种神秘的信号。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How could I have been so blind? How could I have mislead all these people?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我怎么会如此的被蒙蔽双眼？我怎么会如此的误导着这所有的人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps if I would have spent more time getting to know Him, things would have turned out different.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许，如果我能花更多的时间去了解他，事情就会是不同的结果了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How is it you're causing all of these things to grow around you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么让你周围的这些东西生长的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: In what we call the Harvest Month, the Great One creates seeds among His branches within seed pods.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我们所说的收获之月，圣贤在枝头的种荚里播撒种子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bloomseer Poplar [0602A278] (mod) Quest : ([0602A274]MS10) Oasis EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: At the end of this time, the pods open and the seeds are carried quite easily upon the wind. It's quite beautiful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个时间结束后，种荚裂开，种子就随风飘扬出来。好美啊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bloomseer Poplar [0602A278] (mod) Quest : ([0602A274]MS10) Oasis EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wherever the seeds take purchase, they grow into trees, plants, grass or all manner of wonderful things.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论种子的遭遇如何，它们都会长成树、灌木、草坪或者其他各式各样美妙的事物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bloomseer Poplar [0602A278] (mod) Quest : ([0602A274]MS10) Oasis EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's causing this place to grow?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是什么在让这个地方枝繁叶茂？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's kinda... embarrassing really. Once a year, Bob decides he's going to go ahead and start growing these weird pods filled with tiny seeds.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那真有些尴尬。每年一次，鲍勃都会自顾自地生长出这些古怪的、充满着细小种子的种荚。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, all it takes is a good wind and the seeds just fly everywhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只需要一阵清风，种子就飘得到处都是。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I call them Herbert's Seeds. He hates that!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我称呼它们为“赫伯特的种”。他恨死这称呼了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you said violin? I thought you needed something else. Never mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你说小提琴？我还以为你需要别的什么东西。没关系。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well then, you interested in helping me or am I just wasting your time?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有兴趣吗？还是我在浪费自己的时间？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe. You gonna give me something for it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许。你有什么东西给我用来交换它？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh very well. I suppose I should have expected that from a Wastelander.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，非常好。我应该知道废土游民会这样的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's the key to my husband's ammo crate; take whatever you like.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我丈夫的弹药箱的钥匙，想拿什么随便。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's like holding a chunk of history in the palm of my hands. Amazing, simply amazing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就像是把一段历史握在了手中一样，这太妙了，实在太美妙了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't thank you enough. I wish I had something to give you, a more suitable reward for all your efforts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我无法表达我的谢意。我想我可以给你些什么，相对你的辛劳更适合的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: All I can give you is the frequency to my radio set. Tune in whenever you feel like listening to the strains of an old woman's violin playing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我所能给你的就是一个电台频率。无论何时你想听的时候就调到这频率，来收听一个老妇人的小提琴演奏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, take this Stradivarius Violin I found in Vault 92.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，拿着这把斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴吧，我从92号避难所里找到的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh my goodness! I must see it... please!
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊！我一定要看一看……拜托！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's like holding a chunk of history in the palm of my hands. Amazing, simply amazing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就像是把一段历史握在了手中一样，这太妙了，实在太美妙了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't thank you enough. I wish I had something to give you, a more suitable reward for all your efforts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我无法表达我的谢意。我想我可以给你些什么，相对你的辛劳更适合的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: All I can give you is the frequency to my radio set. Tune in whenever you feel like listening to the strains of an old woman's violin playing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我所能给你的就是一个电台频率。无论何时你想听的时候就调到这频率，来收听一个老妇人的小提琴演奏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about this project you worked on with my father.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说说这个你和我父亲为之奋斗的工程。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Project Purity, we called it. What do you want to know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们叫它净化工程，你想要知道些什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E89]MQ03) Scientific Pursuits EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that's okay, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那好吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pepper Gomez [0601D02A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whole place is running a little too hot, but it'll calm down in time, like everything else around here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 整个地方气氛都很紧张，但会终究会缓和下来，正如这周围的一切。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley [0601CFD8] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe you can change the Overseer's mind, dear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许你可以改变监督者的主意, 亲爱的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pepper Gomez [0601D02A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't need to tell me. Just keep an eye on your father, all right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不必告诉我。只要留意你的父亲，好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mr. Brotch [0603D347] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hard to lead your Tunnel Snakes when they're afraid of getting stepped on, huh? Well, keep at it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 害怕被踩一脚之后，你的穴蛇帮就不好控制了，对吧？继续。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mr. Brotch [0603D347] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look on the bright side, Amata: you get to look at my handsome mug again. Who wouldn't want that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 往好的方面想，阿玛塔：至少你又看到了我英俊的脸。谁不想这样呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aw, let 'em stay down here. One day, I'm heading out there on my own. I mean it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 喔，让他们呆在这吧。总有一天，我会自己去。我当真的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : He's totally bluffing EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I swear, what sort of "rebels" are they? Keep talking to them, okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我发誓，他们怎么会是“反叛者”？继续和他们交谈，好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [0602549E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep an ear out up there. They'll get sick of father's lockdown eventually, and then we'll all take a stand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 提高警惕。他们最终会受不了父亲的封闭手段，到那时我们都会有机会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [0602549E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I guess it could be worse. But if I know father, he's not just going to change his mind on this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想可能更糟糕。但是如果我对父亲所料不差，他是不会在这问题上改变主意的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [0602549E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's better than nothing, I suppose. That may be all the good news we're getting, for now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想，这总比什么都没有好吧。这可能是目前我们能得到的最好的消息了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [0602549E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Paul would've joined up no problem, but... y'know. Anyway, no luck with them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 保罗毫无疑问会参加的，但…你知道的。不管怎么说，他们的运气可不好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : Briefly misses Paul, but regains his tough-guy facade EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: No development. They're still quiet and scared. We won't be getting any of them to make a stand anytime soon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有进展。他们仍然害怕并保持沉默。近期内我们无法让他们任何一人进行反抗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mr. Brotch [0603D347] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're not your ridiculous gang, Butch. We're actually trying to get something done. Any luck convincing more to join us?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不是你那可笑的帮会，布奇。实际上我们正在试图做点什么。能说服更多的人加入我们吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [0602549E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're safe. How's everyone holding up in the dorms?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们很安全。这宿舍里的人还好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [0602549E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry, we're fine. What's the word in the dorms?
ESP.TRADUIT: 别担心，我们很好。宿舍里在谈论什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know me. The Butch man fears no Overseer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道的，布奇手下的人不害怕监督者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : Cocky EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wasn't taken away in the night, for what that's worth. That's about the best news I've got to report.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有在晚上被带走，无论如何，这很值得。这大概是我所能报告的最好消息。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mr. Brotch [0603D347] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm still alive, but I don't know how long that luck'll last. Seems like something big's about to transpire.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还活着，但我不知道这运气还能持续多久。似乎有些大事即将发生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mr. Brotch [0603D347] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've got to take this seriously, boy. Any luck getting anyone else to join us?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你必须认真点，孩子。能说服其他人加入我们吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mr. Brotch [0603D347] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not really. I mean, sure he's cool, but I don't really like him like that. You know? I'm just glad you're here, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 未必。我的意思是：没错，他很棒，但我不喜欢他那样的人。你知道吗？我只是高兴你也在这。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Christine Kendall [0605157A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I remember you said, yeah. That's so gross. Don't you wish it could be just Butch, instead?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我记得你说过。这真令人恶心。你不希望让布奇来代替吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Susie Mack [0604E895] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ew, that's just creepy. Wouldn't it be so much better if it was just Butch, instead? He's dreamy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哟，真让人起鸡皮疙瘩。如果换成布奇，那不会好很多吗？他很棒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Susie Mack [0604E895] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Terrible! I can't believe I have to share a dorm with old lady Palmer. How creepy is that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 糟透了！我不敢相信我必须和帕尔默大妈共用一间宿舍。太令人毛骨悚然了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Christine Kendall [0605157A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't blame yourself, sir. We'll scrub every last trace of his influence from these halls, and then everything can go back to normal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要责怪你自己，先生。我们会清理掉他在大厅里留下的每处痕迹，然后一切都会回复原样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Security Chief Hannon [06027054] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Indeed. As much as it seemed a good idea at the time, we should never have taken that doctor into our world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 确实。那时候看起来它算是个好主意，但我们真不应该让那医生进入我们的世界。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : Slightly amused at his own joke. EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's our home, sir. It's seen better days, of course, but we won't be making the same mistakes again, of course.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我们的家，先生。它曾经很不错，当然，不过我们肯定不会再犯同样的错误。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Security Chief Hannon [06027054] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : A little uncertain how the Overseer will respond. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, we rule. It's just not the same without Paul saying it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我们统治。只是如果不是保罗说的，就会不太一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Freddie Gomez [0604E896] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : deeply depressed EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on, have a little pride! What do Tunnel Snakes do? We don't sit around and hide in the dorm. We rule!
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜托，有点自尊啊！穴蛇帮会怎么做？我们不能坐以待毙的躲在宿舍里。我们要控制局势！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Better than sitting around at home, you know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 总比在家里无所事事的好，懂吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Freddie Gomez [0604E896] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why did they build the walls?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们为什么要建造围墙？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, the Raiders, for one. Once the town got big enough, they'd wait until the traders and their guards were away, then come in and clean us out!
ESP.TRADUIT: 歹徒是一个原因。一旦这镇子变得够大，他们就会等商人和他们的护卫离开后，闯进来把我们洗劫一空！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now the Super Mutants... They were a whole other breed of problem. They'd kill us if they had to, but mostly they tried to drag people away! Alive!
ESP.TRADUIT: 而现在又有了超级变种人……他们是另一大难题。如果有必要的话，他们会杀了我们，但大多数情况下他们却试图活捉我们！

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, eventually, my father did something about it. Him and a few others organized the traders and the citizens and built the walls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，最终，我父亲实施了些对策。他和其他几个人，组织商人和居民们一起修建了这围墙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So we're pretty safe now. Still, I wish those Brotherhood of Steel fellers hadn't hit on such hard times. They really helped keep the wolves at bay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因此，我们现在很安全了。不过，我希望那些钢铁兄弟会的家伙不要在这艰难时期被打垮。他们的确帮我们挡住了群狼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where did everyone else come from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 其他人都是从哪来的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, they come from all over... all over. You name it. The Stahl family grew up out east somewhere. Lucy's from some little settlement to the north.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，他们来自各处…各地。你说得出来的地方。斯塔尔家族曾在东边某地发展过。露西则是从北边某个小型定居点来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Billy doesn't really talk about where he's from. Doc Church used to live in Rivet City. Jericho... well... let's just say that men can change.
ESP.TRADUIT: 比利不愿说他是从哪来的。丘奇医生曾住在铆钉城。耶利哥…嗯…我们只能说人都会改变的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...I hope.
ESP.TRADUIT: ……我希望如此。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Lucas Simms.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉我关于卢卡斯·西姆斯的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That man tries to bring law to this place. Lost cause if you ask me, but I respect his trying. He does seem to keep people in line though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那人试图把法律引入这里。我只能说那注定是要失败的。但我尊重他所做的努力，他似乎的确让人们更守规矩了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Other than that weird cowboy thing of his, I don't have much to complain about.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除了他自己那古怪牛仔的外表，我没什么可抱怨的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Colin Moriarty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉我关于科林·莫里亚蒂的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That man is the scum of the Earth. He keeps the drunks around here soaking in liquor and that poor Nova, that girl deserves better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个彻头彻尾的人渣。他让那些整天泡在酒坛子里的醉鬼在这附近乱转。可怜的诺瓦，她本来能过得更好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And don't even get me started on how he treats Gob. Just because the boy looks dead doesn't mean that he should be treated like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有他怎么对待盖博的事，更让我难以启齿。不能因为那男孩看起来像死人一样，就那样对待他啊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That man has his fingers in everything around here. Just watch what you say about him, it'll always get back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那家伙插手这的一切。谈论他的时候要小心，它们总能传到他的耳朵里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you get here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么到这里的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was born here, actually. Just like my papi. Oh, for a while I helped him scavenge and then later on his caravan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 实际上，我就出生在这。就像我爸爸一样。哦，我帮他捡过一阵破烂，后来还加入了他的商队。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But traipsing around the Wasteland is work for young people. After I met Nathan, I just wanted to stop moving around so much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过在废土中四处旅行可是年轻人的工作。在我遇到内森之后，我就再也不想四处逛了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've been here ever since. Of course, I can't say that it's been good for Nathan's sanity...
ESP.TRADUIT: 从那时起我们就在这了。当然，我不能说这对内森的心智健全有益。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's very helpful. Here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这非常有帮助。给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suggest taking the door around the corner if you want to get where I think you're going. You'll find it unlocked in a moment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我没猜错，我建议你走转弯处的那扇门。你待会就会发现它没上锁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Robert [060200CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I were you, I'd speak to Vance before you poke around too much. You can usually find him on the mezzanine overlooking the common area.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是我的话，在四处游荡前会先和万斯谈谈。你能在上面俯瞰这个区域的平台上找到他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm wondering what I could do with all these spare caps I have...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道拿这些多余的瓶盖做什么……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds like an interesting problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来像是个有趣的问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Robert [060200CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me take 100 of those off your hands... you know, lighten the load.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我从你手中拿走100个吧……帮你减轻负荷。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Robert [060200CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's Cole Porter and "Anything Goes."
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是科尔·波特演唱的“万事成空”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's Tex Beneke with... "A Wonderful Guy."
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是泰克斯·本尼克和一个……“棒小伙”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the "First Lady of Song" herself, Miss Ella Fitzgerald, telling us that, "Into Each Life Some Rain Must Fall." Ain't that the truth, sister.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在是“爵士第一夫人”本人，艾拉·费兹洁拉德，告诉我们“生活总会有风雨”。难道不是这样吗，我的姐妹！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's Danny Kaye and Andrew Sisters, crooning about - what else? - "Civilization."
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在由丹妮·凯依和安德鲁·凯依姐妹，低唱一曲 — 还有别的吗？ — “文明”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about some "Easy Living," from everyone' favorite songstress, Billie Holiday?
ESP.TRADUIT: 来点“轻松生活”怎么样？是人人都爱的女歌手比莉·霍利戴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's Billie Holiday with... "Crazy He Calls Me."
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是比莉·霍利戴…“他说我疯了”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Up next is Roy Brown, tellin' us all about that, "Mighty Mighty Man."
ESP.TRADUIT: 下一首是罗伊·布朗，给我们说说“大男人”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's Roy Brown, singin' about the one, the only, "Butcher Pete"!
ESP.TRADUIT: 罗伊·布朗演唱的独一无二的“屠夫皮特”！

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is Bob Crosby, takin' us, "Way Back Home."
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是鲍勃·克罗斯比，正引领我们踏上“漫漫回家路”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's Bob Crosby, singin' to us all about, "Happy Times."
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是鲍勃·克罗斯比，将告诉我们什么是“欢乐时光”！

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the Ink Spots, and "Maybe."
ESP.TRADUIT: 掌声欢迎墨迹组合，以及“或许”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is the Ink Spots, with their timeless classic, "I Don't Want to Set the World on Fire."
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是墨迹组合还有那永恒的经典，“我不想世界卷入战火”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And now... some music.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么现在……来点音乐。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kid, if you're listening? Fool me once, shame on me. Fool me twice - fuck you, you worthless piece of shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小子，不知你有没有在听？你骗我一次，是我的耻辱。骗我两次 — 他妈的，你是一堆狗屎。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The kid from Vault 101 had ole Three Dog fooled. I had her pegged as one of the good guys and then, BAM -- she goes and acts all... evil.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来自101号避难所的孩子蒙蔽了老三狗。我认定她是个好人，但那是欺骗 — 她的所作所为都是……邪恶的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The kid from Vault 101 had ole Three Dog fooled. I had him pegged as one of the good guys and then, BAM -- he goes and acts all... evil.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来自101号避难所的孩子蒙蔽了老三狗。我认定他是个好人，但那是欺骗 — 他的所作所为都是……邪恶的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there not one human being with a shred of decency left in this entire back-asswards Wasteland?
ESP.TRADUIT: 难道在整个狗屎般的废土上，就没有一个人类有丝毫正义感？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why? Why why why why why? Aggh! Faithful listeners, I'm disappointed. And you should be too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么？为什么为什么为什么为什么为什么？哦！忠实的听众啊，我很失望。而你们也应该一样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Again with the evil kid doing good things. I ask you, folks - has a soul been saved? Keep fighting the Good Fight, kid. We're rootin' for ya.
ESP.TRADUIT: 邪恶的孩子又一次做了好事。我问你们，伙计们 — 有灵魂得到拯救了吗？继续圣战吧，孩子。我们做你的后援。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kid, if you're listening - you did a good thing. Please, for all our sakes, keep it up. There are enough evil assholes out there already.
ESP.TRADUIT: 孩子，如果你正在听 — 你做了一件好事。求求你，为了我们大家，继续下去。外面的邪恶杂种已经够多的了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But now, for some miraculous reason, She's had a change of heart! She's actually done something that can be considered - dare I say it? - "good"!
ESP.TRADUIT: 但现在，由于一些神奇的原因，她变了！她竟然做了件 — 我该这么说吗？ — “好事”！

ESP.ORIGINAL: But now, for some miraculous reason, he's had a change of heart! He's actually done something that can be considered - dare I say it? - "good"!
ESP.TRADUIT: 但现在，由于一些神奇的原因，他变了！他竟然做了件 — 我该这么说吗？ — “好事”！

ESP.ORIGINAL: My, my. What a curious turn of events. So here we have the kid from Vault 101, who by all accounts has a soul as black as charred Brahmin meat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是我不明白，这世界变化快。这个来自101号避难所的孩子，无论如何，有着一个和熏双头牛肉一样黑的灵魂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoever lives in there sure as hell doesn't want what you're selling, and no, you can't knock down the door. It weighs like 13 tons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论是谁住在那，都他妈肯定不想要你卖的那些东西，而且，你也撞不开那扇大门。它重达13吨。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Arefu donates bloodpacks, and in exchange, you protect them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 断桥镇捐助血浆袋，做为交换，你们要保护他们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Agreed. Please, take this proposal to Arefu. Speak with them and then return to me with their decision.
ESP.TRADUIT: 同意。请将此提议带给断桥镇。与他们谈谈，然后告诉我他们的决定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thank you for showing me that your kind can be trusted after all. It is a lesson I will not forget.
ESP.TRADUIT: 感谢你向我证明你们的种族也是可以信任的。我忘不了这次的经历。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, what of young Ian? Tell me his decision.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小伊恩怎样了？告诉我他的决定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Arefu donates bloodpacks, and you leave the town alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 断桥镇会捐助血浆袋，你们别再骚扰这镇子了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Agreed. Please, take this proposal to Arefu. Speak with them and then return to me with their decision.
ESP.TRADUIT: 同意。请将此提议带给断桥镇。与他们谈谈，然后告诉我他们的决定。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thank you for showing me that your kind can be trusted after all. It is a lesson I will not forget.
ESP.TRADUIT: 感谢你向我证明你们的种族也是可以信任的。我忘不了这次的经历。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, what of young Ian? Tell me his decision.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小伊恩怎样了？告诉我他的决定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! You're as cowardly as a Brahmin! Watch this...
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！你就像双头牛一样胆小！看着……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Careful! What if it's armed?
ESP.TRADUIT: 小心！如果它上膛了怎么办？

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, children. It's time for Three Dog to be honest with ya. Here it is, plain as day - I used to think we were all well and truly fucked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，孩子们。现在是三狗对你说实话的时间了。它就是，青天白日的 — 我过去认为我们肯定是彻彻底底的完蛋了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kid from the vault, if you're listening, I want you to know that you are, truly, a Paradigm of Humanity. Keep on fighting, girl!
ESP.TRADUIT: 从避难所来的孩子，如果你在听，我想让你知道你简直就是人性的楷模。继续战斗吧，小女孩！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kid from the vault, if you're listening, I want you to know that you are, truly, a Paradigm of Humanity. Keep on fighting, man!
ESP.TRADUIT: 从避难所来的孩子，如果你在听，我想让你知道你简直就是人性的楷模。继续战斗吧，小伙子！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm talkin' about the kid from Vault 101. Just 19, and this babe has been in some serious shit. And there ain't no sign o' stoppin'!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正在说的是关于101号避难所来的孩子。只有19岁，这宝贝已经陷入了可怕的麻烦中。但她并没有放弃和停止前进。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm talkin' about the kid from Vault 101. Just 19, and this cat has been in some serious shit. And there ain't no sign o' stoppin'!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正在说的是关于101号避难所来的孩子。只有19岁，这小猫已经陷入了可怕的麻烦中。但他并没有放弃和停止前进。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alive? Yes. Still wandering? Uh huh. One of the most powerful individuals in the Capital Wasteland? You bet your bobby socks, Susie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还活着？是。仍然在流浪？哈哈。首都废土中最强大的人中的一个？用你的短袜打赌，苏茜。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alive? Yes. Still wandering? Uh huh. One of the most powerful individuals in the Capital Wasteland? You bet your bobby socks, Susie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还活着？是。仍然在流浪？哈哈。首都废土中最强大的人中的一个？用你的短袜打赌，苏茜。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And lo, the girl did step forth from her shadowy hole, and proclaim herself Scourge of Humanity.
ESP.TRADUIT: 之后，那女孩果真走出了她那阴暗的洞穴，并宣布她自己是人性灾难。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And lo, the boy did step forth from his shadowy hole, and proclaim himself Scourge of Humanity.
ESP.TRADUIT: 之后，那男孩果真走出了他那阴暗的洞穴，并宣布他自己是人性灾难。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't lose hope, children. Don't ever lose hope! The kid from Vault 101, the Wasteland's one true Messiah, still walks among us! Just listen to this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请不要放弃,孩子们。永远不要绝望!101小子,一个真正废土英雄,仍然在我们中间!听听这个。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, that kid from Vault 101. Only a true Mortal could get involved in so many adventures, make so many damn caps! Behold, the latest tribulation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊,来自101的小子。一个凡人经历了这么多的冒险,创造了那么多的该死的事迹!看哪,最新的磨难。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Devil walks among us, children. Oh, she may look like us, but she calls Hell home. She is legion, and her deeds are legend. Like this one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 魔鬼,走在我们的身边,孩子们。啊,她看起来像我们,但她的家在地狱。她是基督。她是唯一的传说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Devil walks among us, children. Oh, he may look like us, but he calls Hell home. He is legion, and his deeds are legend. Like this one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 魔鬼,走在我们的身边,孩子们。啊,他看起来像我们,但她的家在地狱。他是基督。他是唯一的传说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We may never get to Heaven, children, but at least we've got our own Earthly Angel walking among us. And I've got her latest exploits.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们可能永远都不会去天堂,孩子,但至少我们有我们自己的天使在我们身边。而且我有她最新的事迹。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We may never get to Heaven, children, but at least we've got our own Earthly Angel walking among us. And I've got his latest exploits.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们可能永远都不会去天堂,孩子,但至少我们有我们自己的天使在我们身边。而且我有他最新的事迹。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Neither light, nor dark, not good nor bad, there's one who truly walks down the middle of life's road. Here's an update on that Gray Stranger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有光明,也没有黑暗,不好也不坏,这是一个真正中庸的人生。这是一个现代灰色陌生人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's gotten to the point where that piece of shit from Vault 101 can't even be considered human. Am I right? Here's the latest on that Demon's Spawn.
ESP.TRADUIT: 直说吧，这就是一堆狗屎，101小子甚至不能被认为是人类。我说的对吗?这是最新恶魔报道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only one person can bring a hint of sunshine to this dim and dreary Wasteland. Children, I bring you an update on… the Lightbringer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有一个人能给这个昏暗沉闷的废土带来一丝阳光。孩子们, 我为你带来最新的光明。

ESP.ORIGINAL: By now everyone knows that the kid from Vault 101 is a no-good, selfish Moneygrubber, but who knew she was keeping so busy? Listen to this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在大家知道,来自101的小子是没有用的、自私的财迷,但谁知道她的另一面吗?听听这个。

ESP.ORIGINAL: By now everyone knows that the kid from Vault 101 is a no-good, selfish Moneygrubber, but who knew he was keeping so busy? Listen to this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在大家知道,来自101的小子是没有用的、自私的财迷,但谁知道他的另一面吗?听听这个。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Think you'll rest when you're dead, children? Not if that refugee from Vault 101 has anything to say about it. Here's the latest on the Soultaker.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认为你死了就会安息,孩子们?来自101避难所的避难者不这么认为。这是最新的灵魂狩猎者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Call her the Herald of Tranquility, that kid from Vault 101, usually righting any wrongs that cross her path. Here's a new update.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呼叫她的宁静使者,来自101避难所的孩子,经常在旅途中与邪恶对抗。这里是最新报道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Call him the Herald of Tranquility, that kid from Vault 101, usually righting any wrongs that cross his path. Here's a new update.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呼叫他的宁静使者,来自101避难所的孩子,经常在旅途中与邪恶对抗。这里是最新报道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looks like ol' 101 has become quite the Person of Refinement, mostly by taking people's hard-earned caps in exchange for... anything. Take a listen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来自101的小子看来不可思议的精明，什么都可以换取大家辛苦赚来的瓶盖。接着收听。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you've been wondering if that Instrument of Ruin from Vault 101 has been wreaking any new havoc, let me give you the latest scoop.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你一直想知道从101避难所到废墟的任何东西，让我给你最新独家新闻。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our Wasteland might be a frigging' mess (hence the name), but there's one person we've come to know as a Symbol of Order, and she's been busy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的废土可能是一个该死的食堂(因此得名),但有一个人让我们已经看到秩序,她一直都很忙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our Wasteland might be a frigging' mess (hence the name), but there's one person we've come to know as a Symbol of Order, and he's been busy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的废土可能是一个该死的食堂(因此得名),但有一个人让我们已经看到秩序,他一直都很忙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're tired of nobody giving a crap, I'm afraid you've come to the wrong place. Remember ol' 101? The very Model of Apathy? She's at it again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你厌倦了没有人可说,恐怕你错了。记得的不可思议101小子如何?不够精彩?她又上路了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're tired of nobody giving a crap, I'm afraid you've come to the wrong place. Remember ol' 101? The very Model of Apathy? He's at it again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你厌倦了没有人可说,恐怕你错了。记得的不可思议101小子如何?不够精彩?他又上路了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We all know the Capital Wasteland is an anarchist's wet dream, and a certain Agent of Chaos doesn't help matters much. Here's an update.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们都知道废土是无政府主义者的乐园，而且没有人管这种混乱。现在有了一个开始。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We may not have superheroes - those two wackos near Canterbury Commons don't count - but we do have our very own Champion of Justice. Listen up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们可能没有英雄——坎特伯雷附近那两个古怪,不算数。但是我们有我们的战士。听着。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It shouldn't surprise anyone that the Capital Wasteland's most notorious Hero for Hire is in the headlines once again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不应该使人感到讶异,首都废土最臭名远扬的英雄再一次上了头版头条。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you have trouble sleeping, maybe it's because that kid from Vault 101 has become the Stuff of Nightmares, and is out there, walking among us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你失眠,也许是因为那个101小子已成为噩梦的精粹,就在那里,走在我们的身边。

ESP.ORIGINAL: In today's vicious Yao Guai eat Yao Guai world, the exploits of a certain Friend of the People are usually cause for rejoicing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在今天堕落混乱的世界,一个朋友的英勇事迹通常会带来欢乐的日子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now you'd think that Loner from Vault 101 would stay out of the spotlight, but I guess some people just can't help themselves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在你会以为他自己从101避难所走到聚光灯下,但是我想有些人是身不由己。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now I know you're sick to death of hearing my horror stories, but what's a Three Dog to do when that Consort of Discord keeps causing so much mayhem?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在我知道你腻烦死了我的恐怖故事,但不知道为什么三狗会故意说这么多不和谐的故事?

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fear not, my poor lost flock! For the Shepherd of Vault 101 has come to guide you to the promised land! Maybe. Listen to this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要惧怕,我可怜的羔羊!让101小子来引导你!也许吧。听这个。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got new reports in on that wayward soul from Vault 101, the Capital Wasteland's infamous Egocentric. Check this out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有新报道说那任性的灵魂从101避难所,只为自己的事来到声名狼藉的首都废土。来看看这个。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you've run into her, you know you just can't trust that despicable little Deceiver from Vault 101. And now, she's at it again. Take a listen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你碰到她时,你要知道,你不能相信这卑鄙的小骗子来自101避难所。现在,她又来了。接着收听。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you've run into him, you know you just can't trust that despicable little Deceiver from Vault 101. And now, he's at it again. Take a listen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你碰到他时,你要知道,你不能相信这卑鄙的小骗子来自101避难所。现在,他又来了。接着收听。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just when you thought there was no charity, no good, no decency left in this world, everyone's favorite Model of Selflessness surprises ya.
ESP.TRADUIT: 刚刚得到的消息，我的朋友们。看起来我们得到了一个新消息：他就是人类最后最好的希望 — 来自101号避难所的那孩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sometimes, in this cold, crazy world, you just want to make a buck. Like that penny-pinching Profiteer from Vault 101. Here's the latest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有时,在这寒冷而疯狂的世界,你只是想赚点小钱的。就像这个来自101的小气鬼。这是最新报道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You think you're sad now, children? Just wait till you hear the latest on the Capital Wasteland's very own Bringer of Sorrow. Cue the crying.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你以为你现在是最伤心时候，孩子们?只要你听到废土传来的最新的悲伤。你会痛哭。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the matter, kids? Feeling down? Low on vim, vigor, and the simple will to live? What you need is the latest news on the Restorer of Faith!
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么了,孩子?感觉到了吗?低调、充满活力、简单的生活?你需要的是最新的新闻重修你的信心。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So here's the question. How's that smooth-operating Soldier of Fortune from Vault 101 getting along these days? Business, it would seem, is booming…
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以这是个问题。让我们看看来自101的雇佣兵最近几天怎么样？可以，看来，还受欢迎…

ESP.ORIGINAL: So what's new with that master of disaster, that duke of destruction, that bad to the bone… Architect of Doom? Here's what.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以有什么新鲜的坏事，毁灭公爵，彻底毁灭？建筑师的末日？就这么回事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This just in, my friends. Looks like we've got an update on the Last, Best Hope of Humanity herself, the kid from Vault 101.
ESP.TRADUIT: 刚刚得到的消息，我的朋友们。看起来我们得到了一个新消息：他就是人类最后最好的希望 — 来自101号避难所的那孩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This just in, my friends. Looks like we've got an update on the Last, Best Hope of Humanity himself, the kid from Vault 101.
ESP.TRADUIT: 刚刚得到的消息，我的朋友们。看起来我们得到了一个新消息：有关人性楷模 — 来自101号避难所的那个孩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This just in, my friends. Looks like we've got an update on that Paradigm of Humanity, the kid from Vault 101.
ESP.TRADUIT: 刚刚得到的消息，我的朋友们。看起来我们得到了一个新消息：有关人性灾难 — 来自101号避难所的那个孩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This just in, my friends. Looks like we've got an update on that Scourge of Humanity, the kid from Vault 101.
ESP.TRADUIT: 提问：有上帝么？如果真的有的话，他在乎我们这帮人么？我很怀疑，但这是在某个来自101号避难所的圣人出来之前…

ESP.ORIGINAL: Question. Is there a God, and if so, does he give a shit about the rest of us? I was skeptical, but that was before a certain Saint from Vault 101...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我确实不知道她是否还活着，但我得到了一条有关101号避难的孩子的新消息。我发誓，她肯定是超级人类什么的…

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know how she's even still alive, but I've got an update on the kid from Vault 101. I swear, she must be Super-Human or somethin'...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我确实不知道她是否还活着，但我得到了一条有关101号避难的孩子的新消息。我发誓，他肯定是超级人类什么的…

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know how he's even still alive, but I've got an update on the kid from Vault 101. I swear, he must be Super-Human or somethin'...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有了一个新理论。101号避难所实际上就是地狱。听我说完。我的意思是，我们都知道并憎恶的那个孩子根本就是邪恶化身，对不对？现在是最新消息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a new theory. Vault 101 is actually Hell. Hear me out. I mean, that kid we all know and hate is Evil Incarnate, right? Here's the latest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，就在那山脊上！是佛祖！是耶稣！不，那是…废土救星！现在是有关101号避难所土产救世主的新消息！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, out on that ridge! It's Buddha! It's Jesus! No, it's the... Wasteland Savior! Here's an update on Vault 101's homegrown messiah.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她来自101号避难所…是朋友？还是敌人？或者仅仅是废土看客？这是个关于那从洞里出来的孩子的新消息…

ESP.ORIGINAL: She came from Vault 101... Friend? Foe? Or simple Wasteland Watcher? Here's an update on that kid from the hole...
ESP.TRADUIT: 他来自101号避难所…是朋友？还是敌人？或者仅仅是废土看客？这是个关于那从洞里出来的孩子的新消息…

ESP.ORIGINAL: He came from Vault 101... Friend? Foe? Or simple Wasteland Watcher? Here's an update on that kid from the hole...
ESP.TRADUIT: 正当你觉得外面已经疯透了的时候……这里有个新消息：是那个从101号避难所里出来的孩子，她自以为是废土毁灭者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So. Just when you thought it was crazy enough out there... Here's an update on the kid from Vault 101 who fancies herself the Wasteland Destroyer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 正当你觉得外面已经疯透了的时候……这里有个新消息：是那个从101号避难所里出来的孩子，他自以为是废土毁灭者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So. Just when you thought it was crazy enough out there... Here's an update on the kid from Vault 101 who fancies himself the Wasteland Destroyer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 老天爷！我爱上那避难所女孩了！头一天还是穴居人，第二天就成了全世界善良与正义的典范。并且，她一直忙于…

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lordy! I just love that vault girl! Hole-dweller one day, Paragon of all that is good and right in the world the next. And, she's been busy...
ESP.TRADUIT: 老天爷！我爱上那避难所男孩了！头一天还是穴居人，第二天就成了全世界善良与正义的典范。并且，他一直忙于…

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lordy! I just love that vault boy! Hole-dweller one day, Paragon of all that is good and right in the world the next. And, he's been busy...
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，那101号避难所来的孩子。她捣乱，她帮忙，她他妈的想干嘛就干嘛。可以说，有时仅仅是个看客…一个旁观者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, the kid from Vault 101. She hurts, she helps, she does whatever she damn well pleases. Sometimes just a watcher... a Beholder, if you will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而现在，“废！土！英！雄！”又开始刺激的冒险了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And now, for another exciting adventure of, "The Hero... of the Wasssssttteesss!"
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在外面见过她的，她游荡于特区废墟，寻找冒险，不是吗？这就是101号避难所特产的荒野行者的最新消息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've seen her out there, haven't you, wandering the D.C. ruins, looking for adventure? The latest on Vault 101's very own Strider of the Wastes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在外面见过他的，他游荡于特区废墟，寻找冒险，不是吗？这就是101号避难所特产的荒野行者的最新消息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've seen him out there, haven't you, wandering the D.C. ruins, looking for adventure? The latest on Vault 101's very own Strider of the Wastes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认为超级变种人与钢铁兄弟会之间的烂事很糟糕？咱们听听战争先锋的最新消息吧，就是那个来自101号避难所的孩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You think all that shit between the Super Mutants and Brotherhood is bad? Here's the latest on the Harbinger of War himself, that kid from Vault 101.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认为超级变种人与钢铁兄弟会之间的烂事很糟糕？咱们听听战争先锋的最新消息吧，就是那个来自101号避难所的孩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You think all that shit between the Super Mutants and Brotherhood is bad? Here's the latest on the Harbinger of War herself, that kid from Vault 101.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，你猜到了 — 现在播送另一则新消息：就是来自101号避难所的那个邪恶的小婊子，废土流氓。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, you guessed it - time for another update on the Villain of the Wastes herself, that evil little bitch from Vault 101.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，你猜到了 — 现在播送另一则新消息：就是来自101号避难所的那个邪恶的小杂种，废土流氓。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, you guessed it - time for another update on the Villain of the Wastes himself, that evil little bastard from Vault 101.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈利路亚！都市伟人是真的，孩子们！她真的存在，而且她就在外面，每天都在帮助着那些像你们一样贫穷懦弱的人。大快人心啊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hallelujah! The Urban Legend is real, children! She's real, and she's out there, everyday, helping poor shlubs like you. The latest and greatest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈利路亚！都市伟人是真的，孩子们！他真的存在，而且他就在外面，每天都在帮助着那些像你们一样贫穷懦弱的人。大快人心啊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hallelujah! The Urban Legend is real, children! He's real, and he's out there, everyday, helping poor shlubs like you. The latest and greatest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 特别报道！哒哒嘟嘟，哒哒哒嘟嘟！刚刚得到的消息 — 来自101号避难所的孩子不只是一个都市神话！哦，她是真实存在的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Special report! Da da dum dum, da da da dum dum! This just in -- The kid from Vault 101 is not just an Urban Myth ! Oh, she's real all right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 特别报道！哒哒嘟嘟，哒哒哒嘟嘟！刚刚得到的消息 — 来自101号避难所的孩子不只是一个都市神话！哦，他是真实存在的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Special report! Da da dum dum, da da da dum dum! This just in -- The kid from Vault 101 is not just an Urban Myth ! Oh, he's real all right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道，你们不想相信它。来自101号避难所的孩子，他不可能真的存在。他只是一些令人毛骨悚然的都市信徒，对不对？错。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't want to believe it, I know. That kid from Vault 101, he can't be real. He's just some creepy Urban Superstition, right? Wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道，你们不想相信它。来自101号避难所的孩子，她不可能真的存在。她只是一些令人毛骨悚然的都市信徒，对不对？错。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't want to believe it, I know. That kid from Vault 101, she can't be real. She's just some creepy Urban Superstition, right? Wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 憎恨、偏见、暴力。抛开这一切吧。来自101号避难所的孩子做到了，为什么你不能？这是我们的和平大使的最新消息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hate. Prejudice. Violence. Leave 'em all behind. The kid from Vault 101 did, so why can't you? The latest on our own Ambassador of Peace.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从不退缩。绝不放弃信仰。那就是来自101号避难所的小猫的故事。下面是这位“生存大师”的最新消息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Never quit. Never stop believing. That's the story of the cat from Vault 101. Here's the latest on the very Pinnacle of Survival.
ESP.TRADUIT: 渴求和平与安宁？祝你们好运，孩子们。感谢101号避难所的战争先锋给大家带来的这款游戏，名字叫混乱。好好听听和学学吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Want peace and quiet? Good luck with that, kids. The name of the game is chaos, thanks to Vault 101's own Harbinger of War. Listen and learn.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有关那个从洞里钻出来的英雄我们有条新消息，我觉得这样叫那小妞更舒服 — 来点鼓声 — 避难所伟人！

ESP.ORIGINAL: And now an update on everyone's favorite hero from a hole, a gal I feel really comfortable calling - drum roll please - the Vault Legend!
ESP.TRADUIT: 有关那个从洞里钻出来的英雄我们有条新消息，我觉得这样叫那小子更舒服 — 来点鼓声 — 避难所伟人！

ESP.ORIGINAL: And now an update on everyone's favorite hero from a hole, a guy I feel really comfortable calling - drum roll please - the Vault Legend!
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，有一个小故事。关于一个从洞里爬出来的小男孩。当然，我谈的正是那避难所后人。这是最新的消息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And now, a little story. A story about a boy who climbed out of a hole. I'm talkin' about that Vault Descendent, of course. Here's the latest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，有一个小故事。关于一个从洞里爬出来的小女孩。当然，我谈的正是那避难所后人。这是最新的消息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And now, a little story. A story about a girl who climbed out of a hole. I'm talkin' about that Vault Descendent, of course. Here's the latest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的孩子们，又到了毛骨悚然、惊恐万状的时间了。你可知道那令人起鸡皮疙瘩的避难所恶巫有什么目的吗？好好听着。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Time again, my children, for chills and thrills, fears and scares. Do you know what that creepy Vault Boogeyman has been up to? Listen to this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个圣骑士来到了我们中间，孩子们。而且，这不是来自钢铁兄弟会的弟兄。我说的是那披着闪亮的避难所外套的骑士。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A Paladin walks among us, children. And no, this ain't one of our buddies from the Brotherhood. I'm talking about that knight in shining vault suit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，101号避难所的疯小子有了新消息。让我们称他为守护者吧。承诺、秘密、和他自己的命运的守护者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, an update on a certain crazy dude from Vault 101. Let's call him the Keeper. The Keeper of promises, of secrets, of his own destiny.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，101号避难所的疯小妞有了新消息。让我们称她为守护者吧。承诺、秘密、和她自己的命运的守护者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, an update on a certain crazy chick from Vault 101. Let's call her the Keeper. The Keeper of promises, of secrets, of her own destiny.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道，我知道，你想打听101号避难所小姐的小道消息。现在是快讯时间 — 那个他妈的无情的玷污者仍然活着，可以了吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know, I know, you want the skinny on Miss Vault 101. Well here's a news flash - that merciless fucking Defiler is still out there, all right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道，我知道，你想打听101号避难所先生的小道消息。现在是快讯时间 — 那个他妈的无情的玷污者仍然活着，可以了吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know, I know, you want the skinny on Mister Vault 101. Well here's a news flash - that merciless fucking Defiler is still out there, all right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 孩子们，又到了那个的时间了！首都十字军大冒险！哇哦！加油！严肃点，你们怎么可能不稀罕这小妞呢？我说的对吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's that time again, kids! The adventures of... the Capital Crusader! Yeah! Hurray! Seriously, how can you not dig this gal? Am I right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 孩子们，又到了那个的时间了！首都十字军大冒险！哇哦！加油！严肃点，你们怎么可能不稀罕这小子呢？我说的对吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's that time again, kids! The adventures of... the Capital Crusader! Yeah! Hurray! Seriously, how can you not dig this guy? Am I right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不偏不倚，宝贝儿。这是今天的教训，由我们自己的华盛顿顾问所总结。或许那扇避难所大门通往瑞士吧？总之，她又有行动了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Neutrality, baby. That's today's lesson, taught by our own Capital Councilor. Maybe that vault door leads to Switzerland? Anyway, she's at it again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不偏不倚，宝贝儿。这是今天的教训，由我们自己的华盛顿顾问所总结。或许那扇避难所大门通往瑞士吧？总之，他又有行动了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Neutrality, baby. That's today's lesson, taught by our own Capital Councilor. Maybe that vault door leads to Switzerland? Anyway, he's at it again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别再说那101号避难所来的孩子了，他过着毫无悔意，粗暴蛮横的生活。天哪，他就像……就像是华盛顿大魔头。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now more on the kid from Vault 101, living a life of unrepentant vice and violence. Jesus, he's like some kind of, of... Capital Crimelord.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别再说那101号避难所来的孩子了，她过着毫无悔意，粗暴蛮横的生活。天哪，她就像……就像是华盛顿大魔头。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now more on the kid from Vault 101, living a life of unrepentant vice and violence. Jesus, she's like some kind of, of... Capital Crimelord.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，我们那101号避难所里的朋友又出手了。真是个模范标兵，向我们所有人展示了什么是爱、同情、还有其他那些废话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, our friend from Vault 101 is at it again. A true Exemplar, showing us all the true meaning of love, compassion, and all that other crap.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来自101号避难所里的孩子的新消息，一直有着模糊的道德标准。是天使？是恶魔？现在看来，更像是一位中立的观察员。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now more on the kid from Vault 101, keeping that moral compass firmly grounded in gray. Angel? Devil? More like neutral Observer at this point.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，来看看。那个从101号避难所里出来的、满腔仇恨的小废物有新消息吗？……的确有……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, let's see. Anything new with that rancorous little Ne'er-do-well from Vault 101? Well, there's this...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的都市守卫者有了新消息。她离开避难所只是为了帮助我们吗？谁在乎呢，伙计。无论如何，我们都欠她的人情。听听这个。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And now an update on our very own Urban Defender. Did she leave that vault just to help us? Who cares, man. We owe her either way. Check this out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的都市守卫者有了新消息。他离开避难所只是为了帮助我们吗？谁在乎呢，伙计。无论如何，我们都欠他的人情。听听这个。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And now an update on our very own Urban Defender. Did he leave that vault just to help us? Who cares, man. We owe him either way. Check this out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在洞穴里长大，封闭又无聊？来废土逛逛吧！是的，你也可以成为一名都市游骑兵！现在，是101号避难所的孩子的最新消息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Grow up in a hole, confined and bored? Hit the Wasteland! You, too, can be an Urban Ranger! And now, the latest on the kid from Vault 101.
ESP.TRADUIT: 伙计，我讨厌这个小庞克了。从单纯的避难所孩子到神经有问题的都市侵略者。这是最新的消息……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Man, am I getting sick of this little punk. From innocent vault kid to sicko Urban Invader. Here's the latest...
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，是大伙喜欢的101号避难所小金豆的最新消息。她正在外面充当着我们的保护者，所以，对那孩子尊重一些。听听这个。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now the latest on everyone's favorite runt from Vault 101. She's out there serving as our Protector, so show the kid some respect. Listen to this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，是大伙喜欢的101号避难所小金豆的最新消息。他正在外面充当着我们的保护者，所以，对那孩子尊重一些。听听这个。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now the latest on everyone's favorite runt from Vault 101. He's out there serving as our Protector, so show the kid some respect. Listen to this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨！101号避难所的孩子发生什么都无所谓？呃？哦！哦！我知道了！哥们，那女孩已经变成了一个心黑手狠的废土雇佣兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey! So whatever happened to that kid from Vault 101? Huh? Ooh! Ooh! I know! Man, that girl has turned into one hard-edged Wasteland Mercenary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨！101号避难所的孩子发生什么都无所谓？呃？哦！哦！我知道了！哥们，那小猫已经变成了一个心黑手狠的废土雇佣兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey! So whatever happened to that kid from Vault 101? Huh? Ooh! Ooh! I know! Man, that cat has turned into one hard-edged Wasteland Mercenary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 提问时间，孩子们。你们知道强盗是什么吗？它是一个杀手、一个骗子、一个怪物。换句话说，就是那从101号避难所出来的杂种。快看看吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Question time, kids. You know what a Reaver is? It's a killer, a liar, a monster. In other words, it's that bastard from Vault 101. Check it out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 提问时间，孩子们。你们知道强盗是什么吗？它是一个杀手、一个骗子、一个怪物。换句话说，就是那从101号避难所出来的婊子。快看看吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Question time, kids. You know what a Reaver is? It's a killer, a liar, a monster. In other words, it's that bitch from Vault 101. Check it out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好消息，孩子们！我们的101号避难所来的老朋友仍然 — 活着！看来真的有上帝啊。这就是废土游骑兵的最新消息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good news, kids! Our old friend from Vault 101 is - get this - still alive! Guess there is a God. Here's your update on the Ranger of the Wastes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有一些消息，小子们。看来那从101号避难所来的小妞还能蹦蹦跳跳的。现在，让我们来一条好点的消息吧，是关于废土浪人的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got some news for you kiddies. Looks like that chick from Vault 101 is still kicking. And now, a friendly update on the Vagabond of the Wastes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有一些消息，小子们。看来那从101号避难所来的小子还能蹦蹦跳跳的。现在，让我们来一条好点的消息吧，是关于废土浪人的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got some news for you kiddies. Looks like that dude from Vault 101 is still kicking. And now, a friendly update on the Vagabond of the Wastes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 快讯！仔细听着，孩子们。锁好你们那该死的大门吧。有废土大盗出没，大肆破坏、涂炭生灵。现在是最新情报。

ESP.ORIGINAL: News flash! Listen up, children. Lock your damn doors. The Pirate of the Wastes is out there, wreaking havoc, wrecking lives. Here's the latest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在说说101号避难所的和事佬的新消息，这小子证明了外头的人并不全都是……混蛋。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It’s time for an update on that Vault 101 Peacekeeper, a man who proves that not everyone out there... is a complete asshole.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在说说101号避难所的和事佬的新消息，这小妞证明了外头的人并不全都是……混蛋。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It’s time for an update on that Vault 101 Peacekeeper, a gal who proves that not everyone out there... is a complete asshole.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看起来，那个101号避难所的迷路的小男孩这些天已成为了一个相当了得的冒险家了……

ESP.ORIGINAL: It seems the lost little boy from Vault 101 has become quite the Adventurer these days...
ESP.TRADUIT: 看起来，那个101号避难所的迷路的小女孩这些天已成为了一个相当了得的冒险家了……

ESP.ORIGINAL: It seems the lost little girl from Vault 101 has become quite the Adventurer these days...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认识她，你憎恨她。（你怎能不恨？）她是闯出101号避难所的邪恶的掠夺者。你永远猜不到她现在在想什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know her, you hate her. (How could you not?) She's the malignant Marauder who oozed out of Vault 101. You'll never guess what she's up to now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认识他，你憎恨他。（你怎能不恨？）他是闯出101号避难所的邪恶的掠夺者。你永远猜不到他现在在想什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know him, you hate him. (How could you not?) He's the malignant Marauder who oozed out of Vault 101. You'll never guess what he's up to now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，孩子们。我有最新的小道消息，关于101号避难所那迷人的小猫的，那位首都废土最新、最正直的显要人物。听我详说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, children. I've got the skinny on the Capital Wasteland's newest, noblest Dignitary, that charming cat from Vault 101. Check this out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，孩子们。我有最新的小道消息，关于那位首都废土的最新公民的。好奇吧，听我详说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, children. I've got the skinny on the Capital Wasteland's newest Citizen. Curious? Of course you are. Check this out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，忠实的听众们，我知道你们都想知道什么。那只龌龊的肥猫现在在做什么？我敢打赌，肯定在磨利他的爪子……

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, faithful listeners, I know what you really want to know. What's that nasty Fatcat up to? Sharpening his claws, I bet...
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，忠实的听众们，我知道你们都想知道什么。那只龌龊的肥猫现在在做什么？我敢打赌，肯定在磨利她的爪子……

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, faithful listeners, I know what you really want to know. What's that nasty Fatcat up to? Sharpening her claws, I bet...
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，快看看大伙最亲爱的守卫者的最新消息吧，就是那一招将狂野废土上的邪恶击败的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, let's check out the latest on everyone's darling Defender, giving evil the one-two punch out there in the wooly Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，让我们看看那关于来自101号避难所的流浪者的最新消息吧，她……正在流浪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, let's check out the latest on the Vault 101 Wanderer, as she, well, wanders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，让我们看看那关于来自101号避难所的流浪者的最新消息吧，他……正在流浪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, let's check out the latest on the Vault 101 Wanderer, as he, well, wanders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想知道来自101号避难所没心没肺的小抢劫犯的最新消息吗？行啊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Want to know the latest on that heartless little Plunderer from Vault 101? Here's the deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大家最喜欢的哨兵在做什么呢？以下就是来自101号避难所的可爱孩子的最新消息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So what's everyone's favorite Sentinel been up to? Here's the latest on that sweet kid from Vault 101.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那勇敢的搜寻者在做什么呢？以下就是关于来自101号避难所的孩子的最新消息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So what's that brave little Seeker been up to? Here's the latest on the kid from Vault 101.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那令人不寒而栗的投机客在做什么呢，呃？以下就是关于来自101号避难所的孩子的最新消息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So what's that creepy Opportunist been up to, huh? Here's the latest on the kid from Vault 101.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在是关于那神秘的避难所受难者的最新消息，就是那最近才离开101号避难所，走进我们内心的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And now the latest on that enigmatic Vault Martyr, who only recently stepped out of Vault 101 and into our hearts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在是关于那神秘的避难所叛徒的最新消息，就是那最近才离开101号避难所，并走进我们生活的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And now the latest on that enigmatic Vault Renegade, who only recently stepped out of Vault 101 and into our lives.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在是关于那神秘的避难所歹徒的最新消息，就是那最近才离开101号避难所，并走进我们恶梦的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And now the latest on that enigmatic Vault Outlaw, who only recently stepped out of Vault 101 and into our nightmares.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在是关于那个神秘的避难所狂徒的最新消息，他刚刚走出101避难所，就成了我们的噩梦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take all the Holotags I have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把我所有的全息军牌拿走吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Their names shall be written into the Scrolls to be remembered forever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们的名字将被写在卷中，永世流传。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As for you, here is your reward. Use it well, and in good health.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至于你，这是你的报酬。好好用它吧，并祝你身体健康。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have five Holotags for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有5个全息军牌给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Their names shall be written into the Scrolls to be remembered forever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们的名字将被写在卷中，永世流传。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As for you, here is your reward. Use it well, and in good health.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至于你，这是你的报酬。好好用它吧，并祝你身体健康。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have four Holotags for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有4个全息军牌给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Their names shall be written into the Scrolls to be remembered forever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们的名字将被写在卷中，永世流传。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.TRADUIT: 至于你，这是你的报酬。好好用它吧，并祝你身体健康。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have three Holotags for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有3个全息军牌给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Their names shall be written into the Scrolls to be remembered forever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们的名字将被写在卷中，永世流传。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As for you, here is your reward. Use it well, and in good health.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至于你，这是你的报酬。好好用它吧，并祝你身体健康。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have two Holotags for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有2个全息军牌给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Their names shall be written into the Scrolls to be remembered forever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们的名字将被写在卷中，永世流传。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As for you, here is your reward. Use it well, and in good health.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至于你，这是你的报酬。好好用它吧，并祝你身体健康。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have one Holotag for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有1个全息军牌给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Their names shall be written into the Scrolls to be remembered forever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们的名字将被写在卷中，永世流传。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As for you, here is your reward. Use it well, and in good health.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至于你，这是你的报酬。好好用它吧，并祝你身体健康。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Jameson [06025FD0] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take all the books I have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我找到的书，全拿去吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. Here is your reward. Use it well and return with more books when you can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常好。这是你的报酬。好好用它。如果可能的话，下次多带点书回来吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll trade five.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要交易5本。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. Here is your reward. Use it well and return with more books when you can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常好。这是你的报酬。好好用它。如果可能的话，下次多带点书回来吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll trade four.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要交易4本。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. Here is your reward. Use it well and return with more books when you can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常好。这是你的报酬。好好用它。如果可能的话，就带回更多的书吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll trade three.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要交易3本。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. Here is your reward. Use it well and return with more books when you can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常好。这是你的报酬。好好用它。如果可能的话，下次多带点书回来吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll trade two.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要交易2本。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. Here is your reward. Use it well and return with more books when you can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常好。这是你的报酬。好好用它。如果可能的话，下次多带点书回来吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll trade one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要交易1本。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. Here is your reward. Use it well and return with more books when you can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常好。这是你的报酬。好好用它。如果可能的话，下次多带点书回来吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have Pre-War Books for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有些战前的书籍要给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent. How many are you willing to trade?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好极了，你要交易多少？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have no such thing. I do not have time for these jokes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你根本就没有这东西。我可没时间浪费在这种玩笑上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The mighty Brotherhood is gathering books? Seriously?
ESP.TRADUIT: 强大的钢铁兄弟会正在收集书籍？你确定？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The collected knowledge of a lost age is worth far more than any weapon. Do not underestimate the power of the written word.
ESP.TRADUIT: 收集有过去那时代的知识远要比任何武器更具价值。不要低估这些文字的力量。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, I will overlook your disrespect because you can be of use. Should you come across any Pre-War Books in your travels, bring them here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，我不会在意你的无礼，因为你还有用处。如果你在旅途中碰到了任何战前书籍的话，就把它们带到这来吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will compensate you for every volume that you bring me. Think on it, and return when you have books to offer me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你带给我的每本书我都会付你报酬的。考虑一下，当你有书能给我时就回来吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And you want me to help you gather books, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要我帮你收集书籍，对不对？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Precisely. The collected knowledge of a lost age is worth far more than any weapon. So, return here with any books that you find in good condition.
ESP.TRADUIT: 正是。收集过去那时代的知识远要比任何武器更具价值。所以，如果你找到任何书籍，只要它还可以阅读，就带回这吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will compensate you for every volume that you bring me. Think on it, and return when you have books to offer me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你带给我的每本书我都会付你报酬的。考虑一下，当你有书能给我时就回来吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caps and the promise of mysterious compensation? I'm in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有瓶盖和神秘奖赏的许诺？我加入了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If nothing else, I admire your commitment to your chosen focus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果不是因为别的什么，我会很欣赏你对你自己承诺的执着。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, to the point: My task here is to collect the written works of those who came before in order to supplement the Brotherhood archives.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，有一点要说明：我在这的任务就是收集那些过去遗留下来的书籍，用以完善钢铁兄弟会的档案。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Although most of the Pre-War books have been destroyed, there are a few that have survived. But finding a book in the ruins is... difficult.
ESP.TRADUIT: 虽然大部分战前书籍已被摧毁了，但还是有少部分被保存了下来。不过，要在废墟中找到一本书的确是件……困难事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, return here with any Pre-War Books that you find and I will reward you for them. With money. Because that's what you like.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，把任何你找到的战前书籍都带回这，我会为此付给你报酬的。当然是钱。因为那是你最喜欢的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As long as there's caps involved, I'm in. Mmmm... caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要跟瓶盖有关，我就加入。嗯……瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If nothing else, I admire your commitment to your chosen focus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果不是因为别的什么，我会很欣赏你对你自己承诺的执着。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, to the point: My task here is to collect the written works of those who came before in order to supplement the Brotherhood archives.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，有一点要说明：我在这的任务就是收集那些过去遗留下来的书籍，用以完善钢铁兄弟会的档案。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Although most of the Pre-War books have been destroyed, there are a few that have survived. But finding a book in the ruins is... difficult.
ESP.TRADUIT: 虽然大部分战前书籍已被摧毁了，但还是有少部分被保存了下来。不过，要在废墟中找到一本书的确是件……困难事。
