ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, return here with any books that you find and I will reward you for them. With money. Because that's what you like.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，把任何你找到的战前书籍都带回这，我会为此付给你报酬的。当然是钱。因为那是你最喜欢的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, I'm too busy right now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，我现在很忙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. But, hear me out before you go. My task is to recover undamaged books in order to supplement the knowledge of the Citadel archives.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。但是，在你走前听我说完。我的任务就是回收未损坏的书籍，用以完善五角大本营的档案库中的知识。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Should you come across any in your travels, return to me and I will reward you. And no questions will be asked about how you recovered them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你在旅行中碰到任何书籍，都带回来给我，我会给你报酬。而且我也不会问你是怎么得到这些书的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is my proposal. Go now, and be strong. I shall remain here, should you be willing to help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我的提议。现在走吧，保重。如果你愿意帮我，就来这找我吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm interested in this. Tell me more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对这很感兴趣，再告诉我些。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. My task here is to collect the written works of those who came before in order to supplement the Brotherhood Archives at the Citadel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。我在这的任务就是收集那些过去遗留下来的书籍，用以完善钢铁兄弟会的档案。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Although most of the Pre-War books have been destroyed, there are a few that have survived. But finding a book in these ruins is... difficult.
ESP.TRADUIT: 虽然大部分战前书籍已被摧毁了，但还是有少部分被保存了下来。不过，要在废墟中找到一本书的确是件……困难事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could have a million Initiates to comb the ruins, and I'd still never come close to recovering every book that remains undamaged.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有成千上万个新兵在到处搜索那些废墟，但离收集所有保存完好的书这个目标，还是遥不可及。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Yearling [060156EB] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there anything going on here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这发生了什么事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some fellas came by here a while ago that said they was lookin' for some troublemaker that came out from one of them Vaults.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不久前一些家伙来到这，说什么他们是来找一些从避难所里跑出来的闹事者的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grandma Sparkle [0605215F] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I told 'em I ain't seen nobody like that and set 'em on their way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我告诉他们没见过那样的人，把他们打发走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grandma Sparkle [0605215F] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They might still be around here though, if'n you think you can help 'em.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想帮他们，就去这附近找找看。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grandma Sparkle [0605215F] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some fellas came out here a while ago that said they was lookin' for some dogooder that came out from one of them Vaults.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不久前一些家伙来到这里，说什么他们是来找一些从避难所里跑出来的空想家的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grandma Sparkle [0605215F] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I told 'em I ain't seen nobody like that and set 'em on their way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我告诉他们没见过那样的人，把他们打发走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grandma Sparkle [0605215F] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They might still be around here though, if'n you think you can help 'em.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想帮他们，就去这附近找找看。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grandma Sparkle [0605215F] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing way out here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这干嘛？

ESP.ORIGINAL: My boys are huntin' 'Lurks. Finest meat you can get, but it don't move around in your stomach like Mole Rat does.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的孩子们在狩猎蟹人。这可是你能得到的最好的肉，而且它不会像地鼠那样在你的胃里动来动去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grandma Sparkle [0605215F] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right dangerous, those things. Just as soon take your head off as look at'cha. Watch yourself out here. They're all over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些东西，真是危险啊。对它们来说，拧下你的脑袋就像喝茶一样。在这要小心。它们到处都是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grandma Sparkle [0605215F] (mod) Quest : ([060173D1]FreeformDC) DC Ruins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right. I haven't killed anyone all day. Let's go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好啊。我一整天都没杀人了。行动吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've done this before, haven't you? Fine time for me to be out of bullets...
ESP.TRADUIT: 以前你干过，对吧？正好我现在缺子弹……

ESP.ORIGINAL: That gun doesn't look loaded.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这枪一看就知道没上子弹。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? How did you know that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？你怎么知道的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean ... ah, shit. Look. I'm just gonna go. Forget about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的意思是……啊，真他妈该死。听着。我要走了。忘记这件事吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't give you all my stuff, sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能把我所有的东西都给你，抱歉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, man. Now I have to kill you... Dammit, I'm out of bullets, too...
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，哥们。现在，我必须杀了你……该死的，我也没子弹了……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bullshit. A mugger in the Wasteland? A real Raider would've shot me already.
ESP.TRADUIT: 胡说。废土上的掠夺者？真正的掠夺者早就向我开枪了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright. Alright. I wasn't going to shoot you. Damn gun's outta shells, anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。好吧。我没打算开枪射你，这该死的枪卡壳了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look. This is embarrassing. I'm just going to go, okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着。真是不好意思。我要走了，好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about I give you 5 caps and you leave me alone?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我给你5个瓶盖，你别来烦我了，怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got yourself a deal. Um, what happens next... Oh, right. I'm gonna go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你又做了个好买卖。嗯，接下来会是什么……哦，对了，我要走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So what was Vault kid doing out there? You do the math.
ESP.TRADUIT: 避难所小孩正在那干嘛？你自己想想吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But Three Dog, the selling of live human beings is completely fucked up! Yes, children. Yes it is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而三狗要说！这种贩卖活人的勾当就应当被收拾！是的，孩子们。必须的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know what goes on out there in the stripmall that time forgot? Wake up, children! It's a goddamned slaver compound! They. Sell. People.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道在外面的那被时间遗忘的商业区是什么吗？醒醒吧，孩子们！那是个该诅咒的奴隶贩子营！他们，贩卖，人口。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The gal from Vault 101 was seen walking into Paradise Falls, and then walking back out with a big smile on her face.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人看见，从101号避难所来的女孩走进了堕落天堂，然后带着灿烂的笑容出来了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But more importantly - does it even matter worth a damn? Slavers are dead, slaves are free. That's a win-win if you ask me, children.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但更重要的是 — 这该死的事值得一搏，不是吗？奴隶贩子会被干掉，而奴隶都将获得自由。孩子们，如果你问我，我会说：这可是件一举两得的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You heard it here first, faithful listeners. The Wanderer showed up at slaver central and bad guys started dropping left and right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是第一手的消息，忠实的听众们。在这流浪者出现在奴隶交易中心之后，坏人们就开始四下逃窜了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gasp! But what's this? The bothersome bumblebee looked suspiciously like a certain kid, from a certain vault...
ESP.TRADUIT: 呼！但是，这是什么？这惹人厌的大马蜂看起来的确像某个来自避难所的孩子……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those scumbag Slavers way over in Paradise Falls had one big ole bee on their bonnet, and this baby knew how to sting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 堕落天堂的那些卑鄙的奴隶贩子们，他们的帽檐边可是有着一只大马蜂，而且这马蜂知道怎么去蛰人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those scumbag Slavers way over in Paradise Falls have one big ole bee on their bonnet. Buzz, buzz, buzz, buzz!
ESP.TRADUIT: 堕落天堂的那些卑鄙的奴隶贩子们，他们的帽檐边可是有着一只大马蜂。嗡嗡嗡，嗡嗡嗡，嗡嗡嗡，嗡嗡嗡！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Grab your hankies, children, cause I've got a heart-warming tale to tell. It's about a little girl's search for her... for her daddy. Waaaahh!
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿好你的手帕，孩子们，因为我有一个温暖人心故事要讲述。它是关于一个小女孩寻找她的……她的爸爸的故事。哇哇哇！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Grab your hankies, children, cause I've got a heart-warming tale to tell. It's about a little boy's search for... for his daddy. Waaaahh!
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿好你的手帕，孩子们，因为我有一个温暖人心故事要讲述。它是关于一个小男孩寻找他的……他的爸爸的故事。哇哇哇！

ESP.ORIGINAL: From here on in, it's bye-bye stupid static, hello magnificent music. So sit back, relax, and absorb these classic tunes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从现在一刻起，就该和这该死的寂静说再见了，欣赏下这宏伟的音乐。来，休息一下，放松，好好享受这些经典的旋律吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I already know about my Dad, so this was all a waste of time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看，我已经知道我爸爸在哪里了，所以现在这只是浪费时间。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't ever let anyone make you think that fighting the Good Fight is a waste of time!
ESP.TRADUIT: 永远也从来不要认为圣战是浪费时间！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whether you like it or not, you just made a difference in the world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论你喜不喜欢，你多少都改变了这世界。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, I want you to take this. I was saving it for someone special... someone who could really help with the Good Fight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着，三狗希望你收下这个。我留下它就是为了给某个特殊的人……真正能帮助圣战的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It contains the location of an old weapons cache. You're welcome to help yourself to anything inside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它包含了旧武器库的地理位置。你可以随意使用里面任何东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you got what you wanted, and I already know about Dad, so...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你得到了你想要的，我也知道了父亲的事，所以……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I heard you found out about your Dad, and yet you went ahead and kept your promise to me. That takes some real moxie, kid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我听说你已经自己找到了寻找父亲的线索，而且还继续遵守给我的承诺。你真是好样的，孩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Three Dog can't let you walk away from here empty-handed after all that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管怎样，我三狗可不会让你白白地忙活这么半天。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, I want you to take this. I was saving it for someone special... someone who could really help with the Good Fight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着，三狗希望你收下这个。我留下它就是为了给某个特殊的人……真正能帮助圣战的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It contains the location of an old weapons cache. You're welcome to help yourself to anything inside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它包含了旧武器库的地理位置。你可以随意使用里面任何东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess this is goodbye then. It's been a pleasure, Three Dog.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想该说再见了。认识你很高兴，三狗。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now hang on a second there. Three Dog can't let you walk away from here empty-handed like this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 麻烦等一下。我三狗可不会让你白白地忙活这么半天。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard you found out about your Dad on your own, and yet you went ahead and kept your promise to me. That takes some real moxie, kid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说你已经自己找到了寻找父亲的线索，而且还继续遵守给我的承诺。你真是好样的，孩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, I want you to take this. I was saving it for someone special... someone who could really help with the Good Fight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着，收下这个。我留下它就是为了给某个特殊的人……真正能帮助圣战的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It contains the location of an old weapons cache. You're welcome to help yourself to anything inside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它包含了旧武器库的地理位置。你可以随意使用里面任何东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm afraid I haven't heard from Crow for a while, now. I'm afraid he may have fallen victim to foul play.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，恐怕我已经有段时间没有听到乌鸦的消息了。只怕他中了谁的圈套。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about armor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们来谈谈装甲。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our man Crow handles most armor and clothing out on the trail.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的乌鸦负责处理那些找到的装甲和衣服。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He grew up a tribal, but he traded in his loincloth for much snappier apparel long ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他在一个部落里长大，但很久以前他就把他的遮羞布换成更漂亮的行头了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about armor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们来谈谈装甲。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lucky Harith kind of dropped off the map. Or, knowing his wares, he may have burnt a hole straight through it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 幸运哈里斯似乎掉到地图以外了。要么，考虑到他手里的家伙，是他在地上钻了个眼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about weapons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们来谈谈武器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then you'd be looking for Lucky Harith, adventurer, martial artist, and occasional collector of the most deadly items known to mankind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你最好找幸运哈里斯，他是冒险者、军事艺术家、偶尔也收集些当人类已知最危险的物品。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's a bit of an eccentric, but he deals in more weaponry than you can shake a sharp stick at. In fact, he's probably got a sharp stick, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他有点古怪，但经他之手的武器多不可数。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about weapons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们来谈谈武器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My, my! When it comes to sales, I can see even I've got a few things I could learn from you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 天、天啊！说到做买卖，我该向你学习！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, in that case, I can act as your representative to the caravans. They'll listen to me, and I'll listen to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 既然如此，我可以作你在商队那里的代表。他们会听我的，而我也会听你的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just let me know what you suggest in the way of specialties, and I'll let them know to focus on that area.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你只要告诉我应该专注于那个方面，我就会让他们把注意力集中到那里的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Under my organization, they'd see better profits and more bargaining power.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我的组织下，他们将获得更好的利润，并能学会怎么更好地讨价还价。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm... I think you're right. And the specialization might play to their eccentricities. It could work!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯……我想你是对的。专业化会合他们胃口。能行！

ESP.ORIGINAL: And I could act as their representative in this matter. Goodness knows, I've known them for years, so I should be able to speak for them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这里件事情上，我可以作为他们的代理人。众所周知，我已经和他们认识了好多年了，所以我想我能替他们说话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just let me know what you suggest in the way of specialties, and I'll let them know to focus on that area.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你只要告诉我应该专注于那个方面，我就会让他们把注意力集中到那里的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Working together would allow specialization in sales, for more reliable profits.
ESP.TRADUIT: 同心携力将会带来专业化的销售，赚取更可靠的利润。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Madam, you flatter me! I'm but a humble man of this small community.
ESP.TRADUIT: 夫人，您过奖了！但我只是一个微不足道的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, since it's a trader community, I suppose I can call in a few favors with the caravans. I suppose I am rather persuasive in that way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，因为这里是商人社区，我想我在商队中间还有点面子。我的说服力应该还是可以的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, you just let me know what you'd like to see from the caravans, and I'll let them know what to focus on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你只要告诉我希望商队提供什么样的货物，我就会让他们把集中注意力的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I'm sure a charismatic fellow like you can get them to follow your lead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，我相信像你这样有超凡魅力的伙伴能让他们追随你的领导。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That... That certainly is quite a lot of caps. It really would be a shame for those to go to waste, wouldn't it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这……这么多的瓶盖。要是浪费了多可惜啊，对不对？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose I can call in a few favors with the caravans, talk with them about their inventory. Must keep the customers happy, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我可以找商队的熟人问问，和他们谈谈他们的货物。必须保证让客人满意，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, you just let me know what you'd like to see from the caravans, and I'll let them know what to focus on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你只要告诉我希望商队提供什么样的货物，我就会让他们把集中注意力的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a real shame. I have all these caps, and nowhere to spend them...
ESP.TRADUIT: 真可悲。我有满口袋的瓶盖，却没处花……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lady, if you don't calm down, I'm going to let Derek know about your crush on him. That'll give you something else to think about.
ESP.TRADUIT: 女士，如果你不冷静下来，我就会让德里克知道你对他的态度。这会让你三思。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominic D'Ellsadro [06031EC6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Amused by her attitude EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Girl, if you don't relax a little, you're going to snap in half. Now, get going, before you take someone's head off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 女孩，如果你不放轻松点，你早晚会死的。现在，走吧，趁你还没把别人脑袋崩了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominic D'Ellsadro [06031EC6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Amused by her attitude EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: The locals could use a little scaring, sir! Bunch of fat, coward traders...
ESP.TRADUIT: 不妨吓唬当地人一下，先生！他们不过是一群肥胖、鼠胆商人……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good to hear it. I'm not giving up this whole "living" habit, not at my age. Keep it up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢。我决不会放弃我的“生活”习惯，至少我现在不会。继续吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you be sure to let us know when we are, all right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 到了该知道的时候一定要让我们知道啊，可以吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa, calm down there. Attitude like that'll just get someone hurt... plus, it puts the locals on edge.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇哦，冷静点。那样的态度不知道会伤着谁……而且，还会逼那些当地人冒险。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Relax, girl. We're not in a war zone, we're just making sure the market's safe. Stop scaring the locals, okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 放松点，女孩。我们不在战区，我们只是想确保市场的安全。别再恐吓当地人，好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ernest, the good news is we ain't dead, yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欧内斯特，好消息是我们还没死。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ernest, I've seen worse nights. But we aren't dead yet, and that's always a good sign.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欧内斯特，真是个糟糕的夜晚。但我们还没死，这是个好兆头。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dunno.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不晓得。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Derek Pacion [06031EC7] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Sullen EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing's wrong. It's just... you think there's a chance Machete might think I'm cool? Like, maybe when I'm older?
ESP.TRADUIT: 没事。只是……你认为有没有机会让玛切蒂认为我很酷？或者等我再长大点？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Derek Pacion [06031EC7] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A little embarrassed EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You never know what the day may hold, eh boy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你永远不知道今天会发生什么，是吧，孩子？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Uncle Roe [06031EC9] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A little desperate to get a response EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, there's always tomorrow, isn't there? At least, one hopes, eh? Ha!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，永远都会有明天，不是吗？至少，有个希望，对吧？哈哈！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Uncle Roe [06031EC9] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A little desperate to get a response EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean it - that's hard work. But you look like you got something on your mind. What's up?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说真的 — 那是个艰巨的工作。但你看起来心事重重，到底怎么了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joe Porter [06031ECA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Warm and a little concerned EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose it was fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Derek Pacion [06031EC7] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Sullen EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: It wasn't anything much. But thanks!
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么大不了,但是谢谢啦！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Derek Pacion [06031EC7] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : happy for the compliment EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take a look, let me know what you want.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看吧，想要什么就告诉我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's on the menu?
ESP.TRADUIT: 菜单上都有什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only the best, hand-picked from the Wastes... for what that's worth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 都是最好的，手工从废土里精选出来的上等货……绝对物超所值。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's on the menu?
ESP.TRADUIT: 菜单上都有什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me what you need, and maybe I've got your fix.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉我你需要什么，没准我能帮你搞定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Hoff [06063BF7] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Slightly sinister, like a drug dealer. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm here to buy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要买点东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's see what the good doctor has in his magic bag, shall we?
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们看看这神医的百宝箱里有什么，怎么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Hoff [06063BF7] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Slightly sinister, like a drug dealer. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm here to buy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要买点东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing but the highest quality leftovers, junk, and crap!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我这里只有高质量的剩货、垃圾还有废物！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm here to buy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要买点东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Crazy Wolfgang's got just what you need! Assuming you need the random junk that I've got.
ESP.TRADUIT: 疯子沃尔夫冈正好有你想要的东西！前提是你要的我碰巧都有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm here to buy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要买点东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's my pleasure to offer hot death in a variety of exciting flavors - take your pick!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很荣幸为你提供当前最流行的死法，滋味不同，风格各异 — 随你挑选！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm here to buy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要买点东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please, enjoy my selection of high-quality problem-solvers!
ESP.TRADUIT: 请欣赏我的顶级收藏吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm here to buy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要买点东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have a look, see if anything calls out to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看一看，有没有你喜爱的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Crow [06063BF8] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : With a slightly airy and mystical tone. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm here to buy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要买点东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If the clothes make the man, then here are the means to re-make yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 人靠衣装，你真得重新包装下自己了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Crow [06063BF8] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : With a slightly airy and mystical tone. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm here to buy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要买点东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can you tell me about Canterbury Commons?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能跟我说说坎特伯雷社区吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's okay, I guess. I heard it's safer than most places, because the raiders don't bother us. But I've never been anywhere else, so I don't know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想没什么事。我听说这里比大多数地方都安全，因为歹徒不会给我们找麻烦。不过我没去过别的地方，所以我也不太清楚。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've never been anywhere else, so I can't really say, but yeah it's okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从来没有去过其他地方，所以我不能说，但是没关系。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This whole place would fall apart if it weren't for Dom and me keeping anyone from causing too much trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要不是我和多姆一直在防止任何人给我们带来过多的麻烦，这整个地方早就土崩瓦解了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fat, old Roe may think he runs the place, but it's only because Dom lets the idiot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 又肥又老的罗伊或许以为是他在掌管这地方，但那是因为多姆让着这白痴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: In that case, perhaps you ought to leave town, stranger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是那样的话，或许你该离开这镇子了，陌生人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Uncle Roe [06031EC9] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Projecting a tough facade. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: That'd save Dom the cost of ammo, and it'd save you the cost of being dead. Now, good day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那会节省多姆的子弹钱，也留了你一条小命。现在离开吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Uncle Roe [06031EC9] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Projecting a tough facade. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: My business and pleasure are the same. And you're not going to like either.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的生意和快乐是一码事。并且这里两样你都不会喜欢的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And it sounds like your tongue's going to get itself cut out if you keep bothering me, man. Get lost.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哥们，你要是再打扰我的话，你的舌头就会因为太长而被剁掉。滚一边去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Watch your attitude. It'll get you in trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 注意你的态度，它会让你惹上麻烦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, maybe. But you need one to keep some of those caravaners in line. And to keep them from getting too friendly, if you catch my drift.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，或许吧。但你需要一个人去协调那些商队。但也不能让他们太过亲密，明白吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Even in a nice place like this, a girl's best friend is a good knife, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 即使在这样迷人的地方，一个女孩的挚友也该是一把好刀，对不对？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Watch your attitude. It'll get you in trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 注意你的态度，它会让你惹上麻烦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's probably just a problem in a subroutine somewhere. No sweat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可能是子程序之类的地方出了问题。小事一桩。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great. Just between us mechanics, try some Mentats before you tackle that robot. They really clear your head.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好极了。机械师之间的对话，在处理机器人之前先来点曼他特吧，这能让你保持头脑清醒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know they're addictive, but hey, that's just the sort of risk professionals like us take, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道它们会让人上瘾，不过，干我们这行的，经常要承担这种风险，不是吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, I've got a few.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，我这有一些。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This isn't a building robot, I keep telling you...
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是一个建筑机器人，我一直告诫你……

ESP.ORIGINAL: No furniture detected in current residence. Please visit your local shopping area to make appropriate purchases.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在的居住区里根本找不到一件家具。去你们当地的商店，看看可不可以买一些合适的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a really stupid idea.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真是个愚蠢至极的主意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You wouldn't say that if you spent even a single night in shackles.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不会想戴着枷锁过上一夜吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm done trying to justify my plan to you. If you don't want to help us, just say so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经向你明确告知了我的计划。要是你不想帮忙，直说就行了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, you used to be a slave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这么说，你曾经是个奴隶？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, yes. All my life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，是的。我的一生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bill Seward [060239D2] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: One day I killed the master's little girl. It was an accident, I swear!
ESP.TRADUIT: 某天我弄死了主人的小女儿。那只是个意外，我发誓！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bill Seward [060239D2] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I... I ran away. They would never have believed me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我……我跑了。因为他们永远也不会相信我的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bill Seward [060239D2] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hannibal found me. I would never have made it without him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 汉尼拔找到了我。如果没有他我是活不下来的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bill Seward [060239D2] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the story with Hannibal?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么关于汉尼拔的故事讲给我听吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've got to make up your own mind, sir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你必须做出抉择，先生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bill Seward [060239D2] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is a good place. A safe place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是个好地方。一个避风港。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bill Seward [060239D2] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hannibal wants me to promise to keep this place safe. Why should I do that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 汉尼拔要我答应保卫这地方的安全。我为什么要那么做？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's gonna save us all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他将会拯救我们所有人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bill Seward [060239D2] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean all us slaves. He's gonna find a way to free everyone one of us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是说我们所有奴隶。他正在设法解救我们这些人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bill Seward [060239D2] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because if you don't, I get to use you for target practice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为如果你不这样做的话，我就不得不把你当靶子练。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239D0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why should I promise to protect this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我为什么要答应保卫这个地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you asking?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么这么问？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239D0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's the one honest, decent man in the Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是废土中一个忠诚、正直的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239D0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You hurt him and I'll hunt you down and feed you your own liver.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要敢碰他的话，我就会对你穷追不舍，并且把你的肝扯出来喂你自己吃。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239D0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: So what can you tell me about Hannibal Hamlin?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么你能跟我说说汉尼拔·哈姆林吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We keep the dream alive. The dream of a free world where all men are created equal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们要心怀这梦想。建立一个自由、众生平等世界的梦想。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alejandra Torres [060239D1] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hannibal has plans to abolish slavery everywhere. What more noble goal is there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 汉尼拔计划废除每一个地方的奴隶制。还有比这更高尚的目标吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alejandra Torres [060239D1] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you think I should swear my allegiance to this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么认为我该向这地方表示我的忠诚？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's a man with a dream.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个怀抱梦想的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alejandra Torres [060239D1] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you want to know more than that, you should ask him, not me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想多知道一些，那么你应该去问他，而不是问我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alejandra Torres [060239D1] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I trust him with my life, but you'll have to make up your own mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和他可以性命相托，但你就必须得自己做决定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alejandra Torres [060239D1] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who is this Hannibal guy, anyway?
ESP.TRADUIT: 总之，这个叫汉尼拔的家伙是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Somebody's got to look out for those that can't look out for themselves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 需要有人去拯救那些不能拯救自己的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CF] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's all Hannibal is trying to do. He's looking out for all those runaway slaves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是汉尼拔尝试去做的。他在照顾所有亡命天涯的奴隶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CF] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm supposed to promise to keep this place safe. Why should I?
ESP.TRADUIT: 人们指望我答应保卫这地方的安全。我为什么要这么做？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's got big plans.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他有一个大计划。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CF] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Someday we're going to leave this place and make our own town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总有一天我们会离开这，去建设属于我们自己的城市。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CF] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope I get to help build it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望我能为它添砖加瓦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CF] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这干嘛？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm an historian. I also tinker with Pre-War machines.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是个历史学家，同时我也焊补战前的机器。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alejandra Torres [060239D1] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: My dream is to build a shrine to the great Abraham Lincoln.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的梦想是给伟大的亚伯拉罕·林肯造一座圣殿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alejandra Torres [060239D1] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm an escaped slave. I was told you help runaways like me. <Lie.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是个逃亡的奴隶。有人告诉我你在帮助像我一样亡命天涯的人。<撒谎>

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're the best equipped runaway slave I've ever seen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是我见过的逃亡奴隶中装备最棒的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239D0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whether you're telling the truth or lying through your teeth, you'll need to see Hannibal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管你是想告诉我实话，还是想被我打得满地找牙，你都得见见汉尼拔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239D0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep your hands in sight and don't make any sudden moves. I'm coming down to open the gate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把手放在我能看见的地方，别做小动作，我这就下来开门。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239D0] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who says you can't go home again, huh? The kid from Vault 101 did, but it looks like the prodigal daughter's return didn't last all that long.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁说你不能再回家？这从101号避难所出来的孩子就做到过，看起来这放荡浪女的回归没持续多久。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd ask the kid from 101, but I hear she's busy oogling some newly obtained piece of shiny Commonwealth technology. Quite a conic of dink, that...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我应该问问这101来的孩子，可我听说她忙着研究一些新得到的联邦的高科技。真是……

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd ask the kid from 101, but I hear he's busy oogling some newly obtained piece of shiny Commonwealth technology. Quite a conic of dink, that...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我应该问问这101来的孩子，可我听说他忙着研究一些新得到的联邦的高科技。真是……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well you're in luck! Human bondage is here to stay, folks, thanks to that asshole from Vault 101 and Slaver amigos.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你太幸运了！伟大的奴隶制保存了下来！人民们，这多亏了这来自101号避难所的混蛋和他的奴隶贩子朋友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now if she could just remove all those ugly pipes from the Jefferson Memorial...
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在如果她能把杰斐逊纪念馆中所有难看的管道清除掉的话……

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've also heard it tastes like Radscorpion shit and turns your piss blue. Or does it taste like Radscorpion piss and turn your shit blue? Whatever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还听说那玩意尝起来像辐射蝎的大便，而且能让你尿出蓝色的东西。或者是那玩意尝起来像辐射蝎的尿而让你排出蓝色的大便？管他呢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's called Nuka-Cola Quantum, and I believe it was made in limited quantities before the war.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它叫量子版核子可乐，而且我相信这东西在战前是限量生产的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: God knows why, but the kid from Vault 101 is scouring the Capital Wasteland for a unique brand of Nuka-Cola.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天知道为什么，但这101号避难所的孩子为了一瓶有独一无二商标的核子可乐搜遍了首都废土。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, I've got new reports from the settlement known as Big Town that Little Miss Vault Gal has helped them out with one hell of a mess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，我从那个叫大镇的定居点里得到一个新消息：避难所少女帮助那里的人摆脱了困境。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, I've got new reports from the settlement known as Big Town that Mister Vault Guy has helped them out with one hell of a mess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，我从那个叫大镇的定居点里得到一个新消息：避难所少年帮助那里的人摆脱了困境。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tree Father Birch said you may have a gift for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: “树之父”布尔奇说有些礼物要给我？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I somehow knew you'd be the one to make the changes that Leaf Mother Laurel desired.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道，你正是“叶之母”萝瑞尔所需要的那种能够改变现状的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I helped to create the hoods that you see all Treeminders wear. It's said that the cloth has a part of the Great One's spirit woven into the fibers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我帮着做发带，就是你看到的所有树启者戴的那种。据说这块布料的纤维里面含有一部分的圣贤精魂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I present this to you as thanks. Wear this with pride and bring the message of renewal to all the corners of the Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把这送给你以示感谢。自豪地戴着它，把复兴的信息带到废土的每一个角落。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Leaf Mother Laurel said you may have a gift for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: “叶之母”萝瑞尔说有些礼物要给我？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I helped to create the garb that you see all Treeminders wear. It's said that the cloth has a part of the Great One's spirit woven into the fibers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我帮着做外衣，就是你看到的所有树启者穿的那种。据说这块布料的纤维里面含有一部分的圣贤精魂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I present this to you as thanks. Wear this with pride but tell no one where it came from or Oasis may face as yet a greater peril.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把这送给你以示感谢。自豪地穿着它，但不要告诉别人你是从哪得到的它，否则绿洲将会面临极大的危险。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're very much alike, you and I. We both searched the Wasteland seeking answers, but I found my answer here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你和我真是太像了。我们都在探索废土，寻找答案，但我发现我的答案就在这。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope one day you'll find what you're looking for. I know it's out there somewhere... just be patient.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望有一天你会找到你要找的东西。我知道它就在外面的某处……耐心一点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, please take this relic of my older days. Perhaps it will help you on your journey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，拿着，这是我过去日子的纪念品。或许在你的旅途中它会帮到你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've never known someone to show as much caring as you did towards us. It seems to be rare to run into anyone like that anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 过去从没人像你这样关注我们。我们很少遇到像你这样的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's partly why I never returned to my former life after I found myself in this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，我在这找到了自我之后，就再也没有回到过去的生活了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Allow me to present a piece of my past to you, friend. Perhaps it will serve you better than it served me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请允许我将我过去的一部分作为礼物送给你，朋友。或许它在你那会比在我这更有用。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Leaf Mother Laurel said you may have a gift for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: “叶之母”萝瑞尔说有些礼物要给我？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I think you're pretty swell for someone from Out There! And... and you were really nice to me too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，我想你是那的人中最出类拔萃的！而且……而且你对我也真的很好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was gonna give this to my bestest friend Harold, but he doesn't have pockets, the silly-head!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我本来要把这给我最好的朋友哈罗德，但他没有口袋，这愚蠢的家伙！

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is a charm that my parents gave me for my fifth birthday. It's really neat! Take it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我父母在我五岁生日时送我的小饰品。它非常精巧！拿着吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hear you may have a gift for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说你可能有礼物给我？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The way you're saying "Him," I could swear you're referring to a god...
ESP.TRADUIT: 这一路你都在说“他”，我敢发誓你说的是一个神……

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's no mere god, my friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他不仅仅是一个神，我的朋友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is the One Who Grows, He is the One Who Gives and He is the One Who Guides.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是播种者，他是赐予者，他也是守护者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks to Him, the Treeminders have a home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为他的恩赐，树启者才有了家园。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had to disable that robot. It was going to explode. <Lie.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不得不毁了那机器人。它会爆炸的。<撒谎>

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was? I had no idea, thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是吗？我不知道，谢谢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take these for helping me out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，谢谢你帮助我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was? I had no idea, thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是吗？我不知道，谢谢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take these for helping me out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，谢谢你帮助我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your robot's working fine, now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在你的机器人可以正常运作了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks. Nice to meet a fellow mechanic out here in the Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢。很高兴能在废土碰到一个修理师同伴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your payment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的报酬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks. Nice to meet a fellow mechanic out here in the Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢。很高兴能在废土碰到一个修理师同伴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your payment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的报酬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh, sure. I mean, I really like that one!
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，当然。我是说，我真喜欢那个！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paul Hannon [060300EB] (mod) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast Comment (NAM2) : sycophant EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You and your snakes and rats and lizards...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你和你的蛇还有老鼠还有蜥蜴……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060300EC] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast Comment (NAM2) : the guy who knows he's smarter than the leader EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. You guys never like any of my ideas anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。反正你们这些家伙从不喜欢我的看法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paul Hannon [060300EB] (mod) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're so smart, why don't you suggest something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是你是真聪明的话，为什么不提点建议。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060300EC] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast Comment (NAM2) : sarcastically EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Didn't you guys like Grease Weasels?
ESP.TRADUIT: 大伙不喜欢黄鼬帮？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paul Hannon [060300EB] (mod) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't believe you didn't like "Hell's Overseers". Better than anything you guys have come up with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我简直无法相信你会不喜欢“地狱监督者”。这可比你们这帮家伙想出来的强多了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060300EC] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast Comment (NAM2) : a bit sulkily EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Isn't being a gang a little stupid? I mean, basically everyone we know is going to be in it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 组织帮派是不是有点傻？我的意思是，差不多我们认识的每一个人都会入伙的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paul Hannon [060300EB] (mod) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I still like "The Mackers."
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还是喜欢“麦克帮”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060300EC] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast Comment (NAM2) : a bit sulkily EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ummm... the Vault Kings?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯……避难所的大王们？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paul Hannon [060300EB] (mod) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where can I get some food?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哪里有食物？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You certainly came to the right person. What'd you like?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你确实找对人了。要来点什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I get some directions around town?
ESP.TRADUIT: 能为我指下路吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Glad to help, glad to help!
ESP.TRADUIT: 乐意帮忙，乐意帮忙！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where are the other Tenpenny Tower residents?
ESP.TRADUIT: 特佩尼大厦的其他住户都去哪了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know where they are... but everything is fine. Roy said not to worry about the other residents.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道他们在哪……不过一切都好。罗伊说别担心其他人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bessie Lynn [0601DC18] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : trying to hide her nervousness under cheerful demeanor EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where are the other Tenpenny Tower residents?
ESP.TRADUIT: 特佩尼大厦的其他住户都去哪了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Heh. Roy decided to take out the trash. I'm glad I lost my sense of smell. You'll want to stay clear of the basement storage room.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呵。罗伊决定清理掉那些垃圾。我很高兴我鼻子不好。你不会想靠近地下储藏室的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601DC19] (ID) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : ironically amused that a bunch of people were slaughtered EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened to the other Tenpenny Tower residents?
ESP.TRADUIT: 特佩尼大厦的其他住户出了什么事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't say I completely agreed with Roy's decision. Then again, they were a bunch of assholes. No one's innocent, kid. You'd do well to remember that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不完全同意罗伊的决定。但话又说回来，他们是一群混蛋。没有人是无辜的，孩子。你最好记住这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601DC19] (ID) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : rationalizing murder EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: The basement storage room is full of bodies. You have anything to do with that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 地下储藏室堆满了尸体。这事和你有没有关系？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've got yourself a deal. Here's your 200 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你把事情解决了。给你200个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: 10 more batteries. Don't waste them, these things don't grow on trees you know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有十多个电池。别浪费，这些玩意可不会像树那样自己长出来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : annoyed EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mr. President, what's so special about this key?
ESP.TRADUIT: 总统先生，这钥匙有什么特别的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You need all the keys to get through Fort Constantine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想进入康斯坦丁要塞，就得有所有的钥匙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dave [06029A98] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: With only one key, there's no point in my going back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有一把钥匙，我回去根本没有意义。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dave [06029A98] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Huh? What? Oh yeah, baby! That's what I like.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊？什么？哦，宝贝！那就是我想要的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The rest of you Brotherhood cats -- can't you extend an olive branch or something? You'd think fighting the Super Mutants would be enough...
ESP.TRADUIT: 兄弟会的其他弟兄们 — 你们就不能伸出和平的橄榄枝吗？难道还没和变种人打够吗……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on, Al, cut the Ghoulies a break. If they've got the caps and you've got the space, it's a win-win, right? Whadaya say?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，奥利斯特，给僵尸们点机会。如果他们得到了瓶盖，而你得到了地盘，那就是双赢，对吧？你说怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, but lush at large Allistair Tenpenny says, "No zombies, no how!"
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈……但花里胡哨的奥利斯特·特佩尼明明白白地说，“不要丧尸，不择手段！”

ESP.ORIGINAL: According to reports from the ever so hoity toity Tenpenny Tower, a group of displaced Ghouls have been trying to gain entrance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 根据这条来自一贯如此装腔作势的特佩尼大厦的消息，一群卷土重来的僵尸企图闯进来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's been no secret that the Pre-War nuke in the center of town had a live atomic core, and under the wrong conditions, could still go kaboom.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这已经不是秘密，镇子中央的战前核弹在最坏的情形下，仍然可能爆炸。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just a friendly reminder to all you would-be bigots out there -- Ghouls are people too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 仅仅是对所有盲从者的一个友善的提示 — 僵尸也是人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Remember, children, when the Raiders come, there ain't no shame in locking your doors, barricading the windows, and cowering under the nearest bed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 记住，孩子们，当歹徒来的时候，锁上房门，堵上窗户，趴到床底下去。没什么好丢人的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: For all you guys and gals tempted by the thought of scavving in the downtown D.C. ruins, here's a tip...
ESP.TRADUIT: 考虑到特区市区遗址的垃圾可能会诱惑到你们这些男孩和女孩，给你们一个提示……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Listen kiddos, never forget the importance of periodic weapon maintenance. Rifle, pistol, police baton -- I don't care which.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，小鬼们，永远不要忘记定期保养武器的重要性。步枪、手枪、警棍 — 无论是哪种武器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't feed the Yao Guai! That is all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别让自己喂了妖怪！就这样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We all know the dangers of radiation, but with the right precautions, you CAN prevent accidental death or even -- eewww -- ghoulification.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们都知道辐射的危险，但是有了正确的预防措施，你能避免突发性的死亡乃至 — 嗯嗯 — 变成僵尸。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was the Ink Spots, with "I Don't Want to Set the World on Fire."
ESP.TRADUIT: 播送一首墨迹乐团的“我不想世界卷入战火”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was the Ink Spots, with "Maybe."
ESP.TRADUIT: 播送一首墨迹乐团的“或许”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was Bob Crosby with "Happy Times."
ESP.TRADUIT: 播送一首鲍勃·克罗斯比的“欢乐时光”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was Bob Crosby with "Way Back Home."
ESP.TRADUIT: 播送一首鲍勃·克罗斯比的“漫漫回家路”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was Roy Brown with "Butcher Pete."
ESP.TRADUIT: 播送一首罗伊·布朗的“屠夫皮特”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was Roy Brown with "Mighty Mighty Man."
ESP.TRADUIT: 播送一首罗伊·布朗的“大男人”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was Billie Holiday with "Crazy He Calls Me."
ESP.TRADUIT: 播送一首比莉·霍利戴的“他说我疯了”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was Billie Holiday with "Easy Living."
ESP.TRADUIT: 播送一首比莉·霍利戴的“逍遥自在”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was Danny Kaye and the Andrew Sisters with "Civilization."
ESP.TRADUIT: 播送一首丹妮·凯依和安德鲁·凯依姐妹合唱的“文明”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was Ella Fitzgerald with "Into Each Life Some Rain Must Fall."
ESP.TRADUIT: 播送一首艾拉·费兹洁拉德的”生活总会有风雨”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was Tex Beneke with "A Wonderful Guy."
ESP.TRADUIT: 刚才是泰克斯·本尼克和“棒小伙”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was Cole Porter with "Anything Goes."
ESP.TRADUIT: 播送一首科尔·波特的“万事成空”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now here's where the story gets sketchy, in true Capital Wasteland style.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在故事从这开始变为真实的首都废土粗线条风格。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, no... I mean, forget I brought it up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，不……我的意思是，就当我什么都没提到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Derek Pacion [06031EC7] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Embarrassed and ending the conversation EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh man, just like when I was a kid! Maybe you ought to go talk to her, Derek.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，老兄，就像我小的时候一样！或许你应该跟德里克谈谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joe Porter [06031ECA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Warm and reassuring EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not for that price. I want more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那价格不行，我想要更多。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright you greedy bastard. I'll get someone to burn this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你这贪婪的杂种。我会叫人烧了这。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You seem like a right thinking person. I've got a proposition for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看上去是个有头脑的人。我有个建议想让你听听。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for some escaped slaves. I'll pay 100 caps for information about their leader, Hannibal Hamlin. Interested?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正在搜寻一些逃跑的奴隶。我会出100个瓶盖购买他们领头人汉尼拔·哈姆林的信息，有兴趣吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose I can afford it. I'll get this burned right away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我应该付得起，我会立刻烧了这。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You take when we have so little. So be it. We will enshrine this right away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 趁我们还有，你拿走一些。就这样，我们会立刻把这侍奉起来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well, here you are. Worth every cap.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常好，给你，每个瓶盖都花得值。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Huh. I guess you're right. Well, this seems like the perfect excuse to do some of that downtown exploring I've kept putting off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，我想你是对的。现在我有了一个好理由，去做那些我已经很久没有做过的事了，类似探索市区，一个理想的借口。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Guess there's no time like the present. Ta-ta!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想没时间再耽搁了，回头见！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([0C008539]TTWMS03) 0C008539 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Seems to me like that isn't my problem, stickyface.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那看来好像不是我的问题，讨厌鬼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? Then I guess I'll be heading there, to join my newfound family and their warm, smiling, and hideously pockmarked faces.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？我想我会去那的，重新回到家庭的怀抱，去见见他们温柔而又喜悦的麻子脸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([0C008539]TTWMS03) 0C008539 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's an entire Ghoul community in Underworld, downtown.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在市区的地下城有一个完整的僵尸群体。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know, this is just the perfect excuse to visit Rivet City!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道，这是拜访铆钉城的一个好理由！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([0C008539]TTWMS03) 0C008539 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: But while I'm heading downtown, I've been meaning to check out the museum. Who knows what I'll find? Anyway, see you downtown, one way or the other!
ESP.TRADUIT: 但当我赶往市区，我理所当然的会去看看博物馆。谁知道我会发现什么？无论怎样，市区见，不见不散！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([0C008539]TTWMS03) 0C008539 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll just have to fit in with some other community. Good luck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你必须去适应一些其他的群体。祝你好运。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([0C008539]TTWMS03) 0C008539 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was trying to shut you up for good. Now I'll have to finish the job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正设法让你永远地闭嘴，现在我必须完成这项工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, they really are, aren't they?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，确实是这样，不是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([0C008539]TTWMS03) 0C008539 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: And I guess this is what the ascension mumbo-jumbo atom-cultists wanted, too. So, nice of you to help them like that, I guess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想这也是原子信徒想要的。所以，你能帮助他们真好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([0C008539]TTWMS03) 0C008539 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, what am I going to do about work? And what's with the weird look? Have I got something on my face?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，我该做什么？为什么要用这种奇怪的表情？我脸上有什么东西？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([0C008539]TTWMS03) 0C008539 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who needs a reason? Explosions are pretty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁需要理由？爆炸很壮观。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, okay, as long as you're sorry. But I expect you to apologize to everyone else in town, okay? And don't do it again!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，好的，既然你道歉了。但我希望你向镇里每个人道歉，好吗？别再这么干了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([0C008539]TTWMS03) 0C008539 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, what am I going to do about work? And what's with the weird look? Have I got something on my face?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，我该做什么？为什么要用这种奇怪的表情？我脸上有什么东西？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([0C008539]TTWMS03) 0C008539 (EDID) EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was a job. Sorry, nothing personal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是工作。抱歉，无关个人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Moira? Is that you? You don't look so good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 莫伊拉？是你吗？你看起来不太好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, that's a real nice thing to say. Of course it's me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你说的可真好听，没错，是我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([0C008539]TTWMS03) 0C008539 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : Thinks the player may have gotten brain damage. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's with the weird look? Don't you remember who I am? Did you hurt your head in that big explosion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么要用这种奇怪的表情？你不记得我是谁了？你在大爆炸中伤了脑袋吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([0C008539]TTWMS03) 0C008539 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : Thinks the player may have gotten brain damage. EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Moira? Is that you? You don't look so good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 莫伊拉？是你吗？你看起来不太好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't be silly, I just got some gunk on my face after the explosion... but that doesn't explain why it peels away in strips. And oozes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别傻了，我只是在核爆后脸上粘上了一些汁液……但那不能解释它为什么以条状的形式剥落出来，而且在流脓。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([0C008539]TTWMS03) 0C008539 (EDID) EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know what? I think I'm turning into a Ghoul!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你猜怎么着？我觉得我正变成一个僵尸！

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is fascinating! Now, where can a Ghoul like me go to study these effects in peace?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真迷人！现在，像我这样的一个僵尸，能去哪找到一个安静的地方研究这些反应？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([0C008539]TTWMS03) 0C008539 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Moira, don't take this the wrong way, but you got ugly real fast.
ESP.TRADUIT: 莫伊拉，不要这么看问题，那不对，不过你真是一下就变得这么丑了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How odd. It appears that the burst of radiation has turned you into a Ghoul.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真不可思议，看起来放射线的迸发把你变成了一个尸鬼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh my goodness! Do you really think so? I'm becoming a Ghoul?! This is... This is...
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦我的天哪！你真这么觉得？我变成了一个僵尸？这…这……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([0C008539]TTWMS03) 0C008539 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is amazing! I never would have dreamed I'd get to study a change like this first-hand!
ESP.TRADUIT: 太神奇了！我从来没有梦想过我能第一手地去研究这种直接的改变！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, if only I had somewhere to stay during the process. Know anywhere where a Ghoul can settle down for a bit?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，要是这过程中我有个地方待着多好。知道哪可以让僵尸居住？

ESP.ORIGINAL: How odd. It appears that the burst of radiation has turned you into a Ghoul.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真不可思议，看起来放射线的迸发把你变成了一个尸鬼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A Ghoul? What, me? What do you...
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个僵尸？什么，我？你怎么……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([0C008539]TTWMS03) 0C008539 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : Warming to the whole situation quickly

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aaaah! Why am I Ghoul? Is this because of that explosion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊~~~！为什么我会变成僵尸？是因为那场爆炸吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([0C008539]TTWMS03) 0C008539 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : Warming to the whole situation quickly

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually... This isn't too bad. I always was curious to do some tests involving Ghouls. Know anywhere where a Ghoul like me can settle down?
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上……这不算太糟。我总好奇做一些有关僵尸的试验。知道什么地方可以让我这样一个僵尸居住？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([0C008539]TTWMS03) 0C008539 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : Warming to the whole situation quickly

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm pretty sure you weren't always a Ghoul. Right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我确信你不会永远是僵尸，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I blew up your town. Maybe you shouldn't have built it around a bomb.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我炸了你们的镇子，或许你们不该把它建在核弹周围。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't be silly, why would you blow up our town? You're talking crazy-talk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别傻了，你为什么要炸掉我们的镇子？你胡说八道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([0C008539]TTWMS03) 0C008539 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : Dismissive "pfft!" noise at the start EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I blew up your town. Maybe you shouldn't have built it around a bomb.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我炸了你们的镇子，或许你们不该把它建在核弹周围。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have no idea. I wasn't even here. <Lie.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 不知道，我根本不在场。<撒谎>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Same here! I had just gone down to Springvale to do some tests -- turns out you can't teach a giant ant new tricks -- and before I knew it, boom!
ESP.TRADUIT: 彼此彼此！我正在春之谷做实验 — 证明你不能改变巨蚁的基因 — 而就在我明白这一点之前，只听见爆炸声！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([0C008539]TTWMS03) 0C008539 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : Totally cheerful and oblivious to the fact that she's not okay at all. EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I hope it wasn't that Nuka-Psycho brew I was working on. Who could have guessed it would react like that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我希望那不是我正在酿造的核子疯狂药。谁能想到它会那样起反应？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([0C008539]TTWMS03) 0C008539 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : Totally cheerful and oblivious to the fact that she's not okay at all.

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still... At least I'm okay, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 尽管如此……至少我没事，呃？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([0C008539]TTWMS03) 0C008539 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : Totally cheerful and oblivious to the fact that she's not okay at all. EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: The bomb in town just blew up! You're lucky to be alive!
ESP.TRADUIT: 镇里的核弹爆炸了！你很幸运还活着！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow! Who would have thought a town built around a bomb could be so dangerous?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇哦！谁会想到建在炸弹周围的城镇是那么的危险？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([0C008539]TTWMS03) 0C008539 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good thing I wasn't in town at the time, huh? Man, that could have really done a number on me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当时我不在城里真是件好事，呃？伙计，那可真骗到了我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([0C008539]TTWMS03) 0C008539 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: The bomb in town just blew up. You're lucky to be alive!
ESP.TRADUIT: 镇里的核弹爆炸了！你很幸运还活着！

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you need me to do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要我做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Collect location data from the wasteland. When you discover a new location, report it to me. Simple.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从废土收集当地的数据。当你发现一个新的地点，把它报告给我。很简单。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Gallows [060156E8] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You talk too much. Cut the chatter and get to the point, would you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你废话太多了。挑重点说，可以吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sarcasm. Very clever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哼哼，非常聪明。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Gallows [060156E8] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need information on locations outside of D.C.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要特区以外区域的信息。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Gallows [060156E8] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Since I am occupied, you can provide it for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很忙，所以你帮我搜集吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Gallows [060156E8] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there anyway I could help you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么我能帮的上忙的？

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Gallows [060156E8] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 克莱因：应该能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Gallows [060156E8] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to know more about the Republic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想知道更多关于共和国的细节。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now that the old fool is finally dead, we can have some real leadership around here: me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那老白痴终于死了，现在我们能有一个真正的领导者了：我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's new in the Republic?
ESP.TRADUIT: 共和国有什么新闻？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shawna runs the museum, not me. What the hell do you want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 肖纳经营这博物馆，不是我。你他妈想要什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure! The Museum of Dave is happy to answer any questions on behalf of the Republic of Dave's Office of Tourism!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然！戴夫纪念馆很高兴代表戴夫共和国办公室旅游部回答任何问题！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I give a tour of the Museum of Dave every day at 2. You should check it out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我每天下午2点都为戴夫博物馆做讲解员。你应该来看一下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um, okay. As long as President Daddy says it's all right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好。只要爸爸总统说行就行了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um, okay. As long as President Daddy says it's all right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好。只要爸爸总统说行就行了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um, okay. As long as President Daddy says it's all right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好。只要爸爸总统说行就行了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um, okay. As long as President Daddy says it's all right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好。只要爸爸总统说行就行了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rosie is dead. Can't honestly say I care very much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 萝丝死了。说实在的我可不太在乎。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, honey, but don't make it too long or Dave will start wondering why we're talking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，亲爱的，但是别太久，否则戴夫会开始疑惑为何我们要谈话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should talk to Dave, but okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你该去找戴夫，但找我也可以。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, Bob is being even more of a jerk than usual.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，鲍勃变得比平时更古怪了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jessica [0602B896] (mod) NPC : Shawna [0602C884] (mod) NPC : Rosie [060309C5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'm trying to think up a good new name for this place now that it's mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，既然这地方归我了，我要给它起一个好听的新名字。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Every once in a while I hear something like a man screaming coming from the Capitol Building.
ESP.TRADUIT: 偶尔，我听到从国会大厦传来一个男人的尖叫声。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shawna [0602C884] (mod) NPC : Bob [0602B898] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, there won't be much going on now that the election is over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，选举结束后就没有那么多事了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shawna [0602C884] (mod) NPC : Bob [0602B898] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jessica is dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 杰西卡死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, there's an election coming up. Dave is up for re-election again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，选举即将开始。戴夫已经准备重新参加。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dave is dead. We're not sure what will even happen to this place anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 戴夫死了。我们不知道这地方还会出什么事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rosie is dead. It's too bad, she was always so nice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 萝丝死了。太糟了，她那么友善。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's new in the Republic?
ESP.TRADUIT: 共和国有什么新闻？

ESP.ORIGINAL: My nation is a helpless, unarmed village to the north. We beg your assistance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的国家是北方一个没有武装的无助村落。我们祈求你的援助。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My assistance? Hmm... I suppose I can spare a few caps from the Department of Foreign Relations budget.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的援助？嗯……我想我能从外交部预算中分一些瓶盖给你们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here. In a few years, I might annex your village to the Republic of Dave. Until then, you are free to exist in my fair nation as a refugee.
ESP.TRADUIT: 过几年，我可能把你的村子并入戴夫共和国的版图。在那之前，你可以作为一个难民自由出入我美好的国度。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lucy, I have bad news. Your parents are dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 露西，我有个坏消息。你的父母死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh my goodness? What is it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊？怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have some new information about Ian.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一些伊恩的最新消息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wh-what? No! Oh my God! I should never have left. I knew it... now they're all dead!
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？我的天啊！我不应该离开的。我早该知道……现在他们都死了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait a second... What about my brother?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等一下……我的弟弟怎么样了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wh-what? No! Oh my God! I should never have left. I knew it... now they're all dead!
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？我的天啊！我不应该离开的。我早该知道……现在他们都死了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06000A69] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait a second... What about my brother?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等一下……我的弟弟怎么样了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06000A69] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wh-what? No! Oh my God! I should never have left. I knew it... now they're all dead!
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？我的天啊！我不应该离开的。我早该知道……现在他们都死了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06000A69] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait a second... What about my brother?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等一下……我的弟弟怎么样了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06000A69] (ID) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did Vance know you were one of them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 万斯怎么知道你是他们的一份子？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's the weird thing. He has some sort of crazy sixth sense about it or something. Maybe all of our kind do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是很奇怪的事。他有一种疯狂的第六感。或许我们这种人都有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As soon as I was with the Family, I really felt at home for the first time in my life. It's like all these people are my real brothers and sisters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我和家族在一起，我有生以来第一次找到了家的感觉。就像这些人真的是我的兄弟姐妹。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Read this letter, Ian. Lucy wrote it. I bet it will change your mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 读读这封信，伊恩，露西写的。我打赌你会改变主意的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She... she really misses being home and she's asked about me in here a lot!
ESP.TRADUIT: 她……她真心怀念我们一家人团团圆圆的日子，她还问我现在的情况！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ian West [0601D5F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I had it all wrong. I shouldn't have come here. I bet Lucy is feeling just as bad as me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我完全错了。我不该来这鬼地方，我发誓露西现在心里和我一样难受。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ian West [0601D5F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please, tell Vance I've made my decision. I'm going home to Arefu. I hope to see you there as well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 求你了，告诉万斯我下了决心，我要回断桥镇的家。希望在那见到你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ian West [0601D5F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just gonna gather my stuff together and say my goodbyes then I'll head on back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我这就收拾行李和他们告别，然后就回去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ian West [0601D5F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think you're a bunch of creepy weirdos.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得你们就是一群恐怖的变态。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Names like that have no meaning here... your insults are a wasted effort.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这种话没什么意义……你的侮辱是在白费口舌。

ESP.ORIGINAL: In ceremony, each member of the Family must speak one of the Laws... it is theirs to remember and to enforce.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每当举行典礼的时候，我们当中的每个人都要说出法则中的一条。……那是他们必须记住和坚持执行的法则。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps from these Laws you can discover what we are. Return to me when you are ready.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可能从这些法则之中，你能发现我们是什么样的人。若你准备好就回来找我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I'm one of you. So I understand your feelings. I just want to talk to Ian.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我也是你们其中的一员。所以我理解你们的感受。我只是想和伊恩说说话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Indeed. Perhaps my sense of caring for Ian has overwhelmed my sense of duty to the Family and all others like us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 的确如此。可能我对伊恩的关心已经超过了我对家族，对其他像我们一样的人的责任感。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Forgive my mistake. If you wish to speak to Ian, you're free to do so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 原谅我的错误。如果你想和伊恩谈谈，请随意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here is the code to the area in which he is meditating.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是他的房间密码，他在那里冥想。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you say so. But if you really mean that, you might want to stop wearing a suit with their number written large across the back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是你这么说的话。但如果你真的那么认为，你可能要脱掉后背印着那大大数字的衣服。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyway, I guess I don't need a foreword. They just get in the way of the real content. But the book's going to be great, you just watch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管怎么说，我想我不需要作序，它们只会妨碍正文。但这本书将很棒，你等着瞧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I don't want anything to do with them anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我再也不想和他们打交道了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's terrible!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那真是糟透了!
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: But it'll be great for a foreword. So in that sense, it's great! I think you're going to like it out here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过把它作为序言很棒。从这方面来说，它太棒了！我想你会喜欢外面世界的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: And here's the armored suit, just to make sure you don't get recycled into something else's food.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你这套护甲，能保护你不被循环利用，成为别的鬼东西的美餐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: That'll be good for the book. In fact, want to help me with the research? I can pay you, and it'll be fun!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那会充实这本书的内容。事实上，想帮我做研究吗？我可以付你钱，而且这会很有意思！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was cramped, dark, and the food sucked. Good riddance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 空间狭小，环境黑暗，食物难以下咽。我很高兴摆脱了那鬼地方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it takes a little more work than that to get food. And good water's even harder. But you'll figure that out soon enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那好，比起找食物，它要多花点工夫。而且优质的水甚至更难找，不过你很快就会明白的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take the armored suit. It won't help feed you, but it should keep you from being food for anything else. Or anyone else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你这套护甲，它虽然不能喂饱你的肚子，但它应该可以让你不会变成别的什么鬼东西，或者别的什么人的美餐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: That'll be good for the book. In fact, want to help me with the research? I can pay you, and it'll be fun!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那会充实这本书的内容。事实上，想帮我做研究吗？我可以付你钱，而且这会很有意思！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do you people live out here? I haven't found a food dispenser anywhere!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们这些人在这是怎么活下来的？我到处都没找到食物配售机。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, certainly, your majesty!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，当然，陛下！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then consider this Armored Vault Suit to be Megaton's gift to your mighty empire.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么把这件避难所护甲作为核弹镇送给您强大帝国的礼物吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: However, you may consider going incognito. People around here don't always take kindly to monarchy, you know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然而，你可以考虑用假名。你知道，这里的人可不太喜欢君主政体。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: That'll be good for the book. In fact, want to help me with the research? I can pay you, and it'll be fun!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那会充实这本书的内容。事实上，想帮我做研究吗？我可以付你钱，而且这会很有意思！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was sent as an ambassador from the utopia of Vault 101. Bow before my glory!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是来自乌托邦 — 101号避难所的大使。在我的荣耀面前下跪吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hah! Yeah, you wouldn't imagine how hard it is to replace that big light bulb up there, too!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！是的，你也想象不到，用它去代替那大灯泡有多难！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's great for a foreword - open with a joke and all that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把它作为序言很棒 — 以玩笑开头，诸如此类。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take the suit - something tells me you might need it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你这件衣服 — 我猜你可能需要它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: That'll be good for the book. In fact, want to help me with the research? I can pay you, and it'll be fun!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那会充实这本书的内容。事实上，想帮我做研究吗？我可以付你钱，而且这会很有意思！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: This "Outside" place is amazing. In the main room, I can't even see the ceiling!
ESP.TRADUIT: “外面”的世界令人惊异，大体上，我几乎看不到天花板！

ESP.ORIGINAL: A runaway dad, huh? I've seen plenty of them before. But none with a big "101" on their back. Good luck finding him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 逃跑的爸爸，嗯？我以前看见过很多的爸爸，但就是没有一个后背上印着大大的“101”的。在找他的时候祝你好运。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe the Armored Vault Suit will help you out there, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许避难所护甲对你到外面会有所帮助，嗯？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: That'll be good for the book. In fact, want to help me with the research? I can pay you, and it'll be fun!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那会充实这本书的内容。事实上，想帮我做研究吗？我可以付你钱，而且这会很有意思！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was paradise down there. No fear, no worries, no fighting... Until Dad left.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那里是个天堂。没有恐惧，没有烦恼，没有争战……直到有一天爸爸离开了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No way. I need a lot more than that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没门，我要的远不只这些。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright you greedy bastard. I'll get someone to burn this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你这贪婪的杂种。我会叫人烧了这。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You seem like a right thinking person. I've got a proposition for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看上去是个有头脑的人。我有个建议想让你听听。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for some escaped slaves. I'll pay 100 caps for information about their leader, Hannibal Hamlin. Interested?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正在搜寻一些逃跑的奴隶。我会出100个瓶盖购买他们领头人汉尼拔·哈姆林的信息，有兴趣吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Its always about the extra caps with you, isn't it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 总是需要我给你额外的瓶盖，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take your pay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，拿走你的报酬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This will burn nicely tonight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 今晚这会烧得很美。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's worth it. We'll hang this where everyone can see it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 物有所值，我们会把这挂在每个人都能看见的地方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well, here you are. Worth every cap.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常好，给你，每个瓶盖都花得值。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Make it 140 and you have a deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 90个瓶盖我们就成交。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're kidding, right? It's worth twice that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在说笑，是吧？它值两倍的价。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright you greedy bastard. I'll get someone to burn this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你这贪婪的杂种。我会叫人烧了这。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You seem like a right thinking person. I've got a proposition for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看上去是个有头脑的人。我有个建议想让你听听。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for some escaped slaves. I'll pay 100 caps for information about their leader, Hannibal Hamlin. Interested?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正在搜寻一些逃跑的奴隶。我会出100个瓶盖购买他们领头人汉尼拔·哈姆林的信息，有兴趣吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, alright! I'll pay it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，好吧！我会付钱的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a shame I have to destroy this. It's a fine weapon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 毁了它是个耻辱，它可是个不错的武器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right. I shouldn't quibble over a few extra caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是对的，我不该为一些额外的瓶盖斤斤计较。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We will carry this into war against the slavers!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们会带上这，与奴隶贩子打一仗！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well, here you are. Worth every cap.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常好，给你，每个瓶盖都花得值。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Make it 200 and you have a deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 125个瓶盖我们就成交。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That price is an insult. You can do better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那开价是一种侮辱，你要更多地表现你的诚意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright you greedy bastard. I'll get someone to burn this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你这贪婪的杂种。我会叫人烧了这。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You seem like a right thinking person. I've got a proposition for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看上去是个有头脑的人。我有个建议想让你听听。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for some escaped slaves. I'll pay 100 caps for information about their leader, Hannibal Hamlin. Interested?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正在搜寻一些逃跑的奴隶。我会出100个瓶盖购买他们领头人汉尼拔·哈姆林的信息，有兴趣吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, okay! I'll meet your terms. Just give me the recording. I'm going to smash it to pieces, and then burn it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，好吧！我会满足你的条件。给我录音带，我会把它撕成碎片，然后一把火烧了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right. Here, take your pay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是对的。给，拿着你的钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Imagine, Lincoln's own voice! What a treasure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想想，林肯自己的声音！多么宝贵的财富啊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well, here you are. Worth every cap.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常好，给你，每个瓶盖都花得值。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Make it 120 and you have a deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 80个瓶盖我们就成交。

ESP.ORIGINAL: In your dreams. It's worth twice that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你做梦吧，它值两倍的价。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright you greedy bastard. I'll get someone to burn this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你这贪婪的杂种。我会叫人烧了这。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You seem like a right thinking person. I've got a proposition for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看上去是个有头脑的人。我有个建议想让你听听。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for some escaped slaves. I'll pay 100 caps for information about their leader, Hannibal Hamlin. Interested?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正在搜寻一些逃跑的奴隶。我会出100个瓶盖购买他们领头人汉尼拔·哈姆林的信息，有兴趣吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a greedy one. Okay, you have a deal. I'll enjoy burning this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个贪婪的家伙。好吧，成交了。我很高兴烧掉它。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll have to do better than that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你必须出更高的价格。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright you greedy bastard. I'll get someone to burn this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你这贪婪的杂种。我会叫人烧了这。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You seem like a right thinking person. I've got a proposition for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看上去是个有头脑的人。我有个建议想让你听听。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for some escaped slaves. I'll pay 100 caps for information about their leader, Hannibal Hamlin. Interested?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正在搜寻一些逃跑的奴隶。我会出100个瓶盖购买他们领头人汉尼拔·哈姆林的信息，有兴趣吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, why not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，为什么不？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. Can't burn pennies. I'll have to toss them into the Potomac.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这些便士不能烧。我必须把它们扔进波托马克。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not so much more. You have a deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就再加点。成交。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well, here you are. Worth every cap.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常好，给你，每个瓶盖都花得值。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Make it 30 and you have a deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 30个瓶盖我们就成交。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not enough. Make me a better offer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还不够。给我出个更好的价吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright you greedy bastard. I'll get someone to burn this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你这贪婪的杂种。我会叫人烧了这。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You seem like a right thinking person. I've got a proposition for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看上去是个有头脑的人。我有个建议想让你听听。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for some escaped slaves. I'll pay 100 caps for information about their leader, Hannibal Hamlin. Interested?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正在搜寻一些逃跑的奴隶。我会出100个瓶盖购买他们领头人汉尼拔·哈姆林的信息，有兴趣吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmph. You're going to bleed me dry at this rate. You've got a deal. I'm going to burn it one page at a time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哼。你会榨干我的血。成交了。我会烧了它，一页一页的烧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose I can afford that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我还是付得起的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well, here you are. Worth every cap.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常好，给你，每个瓶盖都花得值。

ESP.ORIGINAL: For Lincoln's own hat? Come on. You can do better than that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了林肯的帽子？拜托，你出得起更好的价。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright you greedy bastard. I'll get someone to burn this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你这贪婪的杂种。我会叫人烧了这。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You seem like a right thinking person. I've got a proposition for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看上去是个有头脑的人。我有个建议想让你听听。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for some escaped slaves. I'll pay 100 caps for information about their leader, Hannibal Hamlin. Interested?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正在搜寻一些逃跑的奴隶。我会出100个瓶盖购买他们领头人汉尼拔·哈姆林的信息，有兴趣吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, you god damn merc. You know I can't afford to let this fall into the wrong hands. I'll toss this one in the fire myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，该死的佣兵。你知道我不能让这落到错误的人手里。我会亲手把它扔进火堆。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You take when we have so little. So be it. We will enshrine this right away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 趁我们还有，你拿走一些。就这样，我们会立刻把这侍奉起来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well, here you are. Worth every cap.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常好，给你，每个瓶盖都花得值。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This poster is worth more than that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这海报值更多的钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright you greedy bastard. I'll get someone to burn this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你这贪婪的杂种。我会叫人烧了这。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You seem like a right thinking person. I've got a proposition for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看上去是个有头脑的人。我有个建议想让你听听。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for some escaped slaves. I'll pay 100 caps for information about their leader, Hannibal Hamlin. Interested?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正在搜寻一些逃跑的奴隶。我会出100个瓶盖购买他们领头人汉尼拔·哈姆林的信息，有兴趣吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, why not. We'll burn it tonight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，为什么不。今晚我们会烧了它。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Deal. We'll find a good place to hang this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 成交。我们会找个好地方把它挂起来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well, here you are. Worth every cap.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常好，给你，每个瓶盖都花得值。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing way out here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这干嘛？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did Doctor Lesko have any weird stuff in his place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 莱斯科博士的地盘上有些什么奇怪的东西？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I dunno, all kinds of doohickeys. Boxes with lots of lights, some funny glass bottles...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道，各种各样的小玩意。亮着许多灯的盒子，一些有趣的玻璃杯...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh wait! He had a big, clunky, shiny man too. That was kind of neat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，等等！他还有个又高又壮，还很阳光的手下。感觉挺不错的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where did Doctor Lesko stay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 莱斯科博士住在哪？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He spent all of his of time in that shack next door to my house.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他就住我家隔壁，天天待在他那小屋里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Every time I'd sneak in there, he'd be sitting at that funny looking TV machine with the green words, pushing buttons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每次我偷偷溜到那，都看到他坐在那台满屏幕绿色文字的搞笑电视机前敲按钮。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, gee! That's not so bad. Engineering, all right!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，伙计！还不算太糟糕。工程学，好啊！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CE28] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mother can't wait to find out if I'll be going into Science or Home Economics.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我从事科学或家政学，妈妈会想第一时间知道的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Christine Kendall [06034202] (mod) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect Comment (NAM2) : smugly -- she's not worried in the slightest EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: What?! That's impossible! I'm telling Father! He won't let you get away with this!
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？这不可能！我要告诉爸爸！他不会就这样放过你的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Christine Kendall [06034202] (mod) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nah, I already know what it says. Hardly takes a rocket scientist to crack that joke of a test.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我都知道答案了。只有火箭科学家才会做这种胡扯的测试…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CE2A] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect Comment (NAM2) : dismissively EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, Mr. Brotch, I just need to read over my answers one more time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，布洛彻先生，我只是想再看一遍我的答案。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601D019] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect Comment (NAM2) : panicking ... he can't finish the GOAT EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything you want to say before you meet your maker?
ESP.TRADUIT: 在你见上帝之前，有什么想说的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: HEEELLLLPPPP!!!!!!!
ESP.TRADUIT: 救命啊！！！！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bessie Lynn [0601DC18] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : SCREAMING for help and running away EmotionType : Fear
