ESP.ORIGINAL: Relax. It's just a warning, not a threat. I'm not going to kill you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 放松点。这只是个警告，不是威胁。我不会杀了你的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see... that's smart of you. I'd lay you flat if you tried anything stupid. So don't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯…算你聪明。你要是做什么傻事我就会把你干掉。所以别轻举妄动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tenpenny and his pack of elitist wannabes are in for a real treat soon enough. They can't keep us out of that tower forever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 特佩尼和他的那帮顽固的党羽马上就要受到真正的款待了。他们不能永远将我们排挤于大厦之外。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see... that's smart of you. I'd lay you flat if you tried anything stupid. So don't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯…算你聪明。你要是做什么傻事我就会把你干掉。所以别轻举妄动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tenpenny and his pack of elitist wannabes are in for a real treat soon enough. They can't keep us out of that tower forever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 特佩尼和他的那帮顽固的党羽马上就要受到真正的款待了。他们不能永远将我们排挤于大厦之外。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, she's a bitch... Can we talk about the android now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是，她是个婊子…我们现在能谈谈人造人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're damn right she's a bitch. Ruined my whole goddamn life. But I can see you don't give a crap about any of that. Fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你他妈的太对了，她就是个婊子。妈的她毁了我一生。不过我看你倒是满不在乎的样子，随你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : warning someone but betting his advice will be ignored anyway EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's all in my computer; here's the password. See for yourself. Hell, just take these pictures and this holotape. Straight from the synthman's lips.
ESP.TRADUIT: 全都在我电脑里，给你密码。自己看吧。该死，拿上这些图片还有这全息磁带。让那人造人自己说出密码。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : warning someone but betting his advice will be ignored anyway EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just don't go telling Harkness though. He won't believe you anyway. And you really don't want to see him upset. He can be a bit... inhospitable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但别去告诉哈克尼斯，他无论如何也不会相信你。而且你也不想看到他烦的样子吧。他可有点…不太好客。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : warning someone but betting his advice will be ignored anyway EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's she got to do with this? Show me this "proof" about the android.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她和这个有什么关系？给我看看关于人造人的“证据”吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, she's got nothing to do with anything, except ruining my whole goddamn life. But I can see you don't give a crap about any of that. Fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，她除了毁灭我的一生之外，整天就无所事事。不过我看你倒是满不在乎的样子，随你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : warning someone but betting his advice will be ignored anyway EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's all in my computer; here's the password. See for yourself. Hell, just take these pictures and this holotape. Straight from the synthman's lips.
ESP.TRADUIT: 全都在我电脑里，给你密码。自己看吧。该死，拿上这些图片还有这全息磁带。让那人造人自己说出密码。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : warning someone but betting his advice will be ignored anyway EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just don't go telling Harkness though. He won't believe you anyway. And you really don't want to see him upset. He can be a bit... inhospitable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但别去告诉哈克尼斯，他无论如何也不会相信你。而且你也不想看到他烦的样子吧。他可有点…不太好客。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : warning someone but betting his advice will be ignored anyway EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry you don't get along with Dr. Li. But we were discussing the android.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很遗憾你和李博士相处得不好。但我们曾讨论了那人造人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That witch ruined my life, but you're right. Who gives a crap about any of that. You want your precious proof.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那泼妇毁了我的生活。但你是对的，谁会在乎那些呢。你想要的是那宝贵的证据。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : warning someone but betting his advice will be ignored anyway EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's all in my computer; here's the password. See for yourself. Hell, just take these pictures and this holotape. Straight from the synthman's lips.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所有的都在我电脑里，给你密码。自己看吧。该死，拿上这些图片还有这全息磁带。让那人造人自己说出密码。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : warning someone but betting his advice will be ignored anyway EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just don't go telling Harkness though. He won't believe you anyway. And you really don't want to see him upset. He can be a bit... inhospitable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但别去告诉哈克尼斯，他无论如何也不会相信你。而且你也不想看到他烦的样子吧。他可有点…不太好客。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : warning someone but betting his advice will be ignored anyway EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's a 100 cap "donation." Now, where's that escaped android?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是100个瓶盖“捐赠”。现在告诉我，逃走的人造人在哪？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We got a man at Rivet City. Been looking for a long time. I doubt he's even still there. Either way, don't go sticking your nose in our business!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们在铆钉城有个人。找了他很久，我怀疑他现在还在那。不管怎样，别来干涉我们的事情！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eulogy Jones [0601569F] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man

ESP.ORIGINAL: Trail led to Rivet City. Sister's our inside man. I think he's long given up looking for that android, and is just living it up on that boat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 踪迹通向铆钉城。“修女”是我们的线人。我想他早已放弃寻找那机器人了，他现在只是住在船上而已。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why has Zimmer hired you too? I can't find a trace of that robot. I'm sure he's here somewhere though. Don't tell Eulogy I told you, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么齐默也雇用了你？我找不到那机器人的踪迹了。我敢确定他现在就在这附近。不过别跟尤勒基说我告诉了你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sister [0601E745] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man

ESP.ORIGINAL: We got a man at Rivet City. Been looking for a long time. I doubt he's even still there. Either way, don't go sticking your nose in our business!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们在铆钉城有个人。找了他很久，我怀疑他现在还在那。不管怎样，别来干涉我们的事情！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Little Toe [060259F9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll give you 100 caps for what you've got on this android.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我愿意拿100个瓶盖换你提供人造人的信息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All I know is Zimmer, the guy contracting to find this slave, is hot to retrieve him. He's starting to get other people looking. So it's a race now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我所知道的就是齐默，这家伙执意要找到这奴隶，他十分热衷于找回他。他正在派其他人进行寻找，所以这就已然成为一个竞赛了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eulogy Jones [0601569F] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : threatening EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope you're not on the case. If I find out you are, well... You best not be! We'll leave it at that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望你没插手。一旦我发现你这么做的话，嗯……你最好别这么做！先说到这儿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eulogy Jones [0601569F] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : threatening EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Despite all his grumbling, I think Eulogy still wants us finding that guy. Zimmer is asking around hiring other people. Makes us look bad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 撇开他的这些怨言，我想尤勒基还是希望我们找到那家伙。齐默正四处雇其他人，这让我们很丢脸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : threatening EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd hunt down surgeons and bang on their heads to get leads, but I'm tired of chasing after that android thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想抓捕医生拷问出线索，但我跟踪那人造人已经跟烦了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : threatening EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I can trust you not to spread it around. Zimmer has put it out that he will pay to find this slave, but he wants him alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我可以信任你不会告诉别人。齐默扬言他会为找到这奴隶而付钱，但是他想要活口。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sister [0601E745] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : threatening EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey! You aren't thinking of signing up with him are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨！你不会在考虑为他干活吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sister [0601E745] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : threatening EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: It wouldn't be healthy for you, if you know what I mean.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那可对你没好处，明白我的意思吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sister [0601E745] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : threatening EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know how they rewrote engrams in a cluster of Android memory subroutines?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道他们是怎样在人造人记忆子程序中重写记忆的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That Commonwealth robot was real! I have proof. Listen to this!
ESP.TRADUIT: 联邦人造人是真的！我有证据。仔细听着！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knick Knack [06015692] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : bragging that he's in the know

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some say it was all a hoax. But it's real.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人说这都是恶作剧，但它是真的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : bragging that he's in the know EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here. Check out this holotape I found. That Commonwealth robot was real!
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，听听我找到的全息磁带。那联邦人造人是真实的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : bragging that he's in the know EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Most believe it's a hoax.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大多数人认为这是一个恶作剧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bowditch [060156EC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : bragging that he's in the know EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's some evidence for you to consider for yourself. Take this holotape.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这有些证据你自己看看，给你这全息磁带。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bowditch [060156EC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : bragging that he's in the know EmotionType : Happy

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're as ignorant as all the other rats on this boat. When you realize I have the real cheese, you'll come crawling back. They always do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就像这船上所有其他的老鼠一样讨厌。当你知道我有奶酪时，你就会爬回来。这世道就是这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : arrogant EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, I've got better things to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，我还有重要事要去办。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent. Locate my android, and you won't be disappointed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太棒了。找到了我的人造人，我就知道你不会让我失望的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : smoldering anger EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, listen to this message he sent me. He's mocking me. I swear I'll make him pay for that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，听听他发给我的这信息。他在嘲笑我，我发誓会让他付出代价的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : smoldering anger EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. I'll look into finding your android for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我会为你寻找你的人造人的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh. I hadn't realized anyone in the Wasteland was so knowledgeable. And you certainly don't look much like a scientist...
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我没想到在废土还有谁有这般知识。但你看起来真的不像个科学家……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyway... My android must have done something drastic, like facial surgery and a mind wipe, or else I would have found him by now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管怎么说……我的人造人一定做了些超乎寻常的事，整容还有洗脑，否则我本应该已经找到他了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It will be no easy task. He may not even realize he's not human. Don't upset him by talking with him. Just come get me immediately. I'll handle it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这并不容易。他可能甚至还没有意识到他不是人。不要和他说话引起他的情绪变化。如果发现了尽快通知我，我会处理的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know what an android is. I dabble in AI programming myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道人造人是什么东西，我自己就懂人工智能设计。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just need five minutes of your "precious" time. Think you can spare that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只占用你“宝贵”的五分钟而已。好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever you're doing, it can wait. This is IMPORTANT!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管你在做什么，都先停下。这非常重要！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : arrogant and hiding frustration that people are ignoring him EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: No luck yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还没。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on, mungo! How hard can it be?
ESP.TRADUIT: 加油，毛人！这能有多难？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Squirrel [06015686] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent. I should be able to synthesize the proteins from this into something that'll fight rickets.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太棒了。我应该能从这些信息中合成可以抵抗佝偻病的蛋白。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your fungus in return.
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为回报，这是给你的真菌。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got Buffout to trade for fungus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我用壮大灵交换蘑菇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh great! The fungus pools'll gobble this right up!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，太好了！真菌池有反应了!

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got some strange meat to trade for fungus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我用一些奇特的肉制品交换蘑菇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent. I should be able to synthesize the proteins from this into something that'll fight rickets.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太棒了。我应该能从这些信息中合成可以抵抗佝偻病的蛋白。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your fungus in return.
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为回报，这是给你的真菌。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got Buffout to trade for fungus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我用壮大灵交换蘑菇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh great! The fungus pools'll gobble this right up!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，太好了！真菌池有反应了!

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got some strange meat to trade for fungus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一些奇特的肉来交换蘑菇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent. I should be able to synthesize the proteins from this into something that'll fight rickets.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太棒了。我应该能从这些信息中合成可以抵抗佝偻病的蛋白。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your fungus in return.
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为回报，这是给你的真菌。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got Buffout to trade for fungus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有壮大灵来交换蘑菇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh great! The fungus pools'll gobble this right up!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，太好了！真菌池有反应了!

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got strange meat to trade for fungus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有奇特的肉制品来交换蘑菇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you know about Bryan Wilks?
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于布赖恩·威尔克斯，你知道什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should take him away from this place; find him a home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你应该带他离开这地方；给他找个家。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It would be difficult to accomplish my experiments with him scampering about and asking an interminable amount of questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要在他上窜下跳问东问西时去完成实验简直难比登天。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What should I do about Bryan Wilks?
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于布赖恩·威尔克斯，我应该怎么办？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Far too curious. His incessant questioning would often come when I was the most absorbed with my calculations.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他的好奇心太强了。总是在我全神贯注计算的时候，他开始问他无穷无尽的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He had no regard for the importance of my work!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他一点也不重视我工作的重要性！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Something isn't right. You shouldn't have gotten results like these so quickly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有些事不对劲。你本不应该这么快就得到结果。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well... ummm, I may have used a few... ahem, shortcuts. Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧……嗯，我可能走了一些……恩，捷径。是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was told that the FEV works wonders when used under controlled circumstances!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我被告知FEV在可以控制的情况下功效显著！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Apparently I was wrong, but I know my mistake. I'm certain I can get it to work!
ESP.TRADUIT: 很显然我错了，但是我知道我的错误。我确定我可以将它做好！

ESP.ORIGINAL: About your experiments...
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于你的试验……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh my yes, they're quite marvelous!
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊，他们太不可思议了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: There are many that say it can't be done, but I'll prove them wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 许多人说无法被完成，不过我证明他们错了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Never mind. Just thought I'd ask.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么，随便问问。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, everything here looks like a piece of junk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这的一切看起来都像是垃圾。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everything here is authentic! Dave said so himself!
ESP.TRADUIT: 先生，这些都是真品。戴夫本人说的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get out of my museum before I call for the Army of Dave!
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我召集戴夫武装部队前滚出我的博物馆！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does the museum accept donations?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那博物馆接受我的捐赠吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great! What do you have?
ESP.TRADUIT: 太棒了！你有些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm ready to sell you those Dave relics.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我准备卖你些戴夫的遗物。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, I know it's scary to be alone. Just hang in there!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道独自一人的时候很害怕，别走！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow, you sound as nice as my pappa.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就好像我的爸爸一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know, maybe this will help and maybe it won't, but pappa hid a bunch of stuff behind the old diner in a dumpster.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不知道这消息对你有用没，爸爸在旧餐馆后的一个垃圾桶里面藏了些东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He trusted me with the key and said it was for emergencies, but I bet he wouldn't mind you having it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他把钥匙信任地交给了我，已备不时之需，我想他不会介意我把钥匙给你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks for making me feel better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的话让我感觉好多了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now look, to wear Power Armor, first thing you need to do is relax your muscles. Let the suit do the work. Okay? Now, you...
ESP.TRADUIT: 想要穿上动力装甲，首先要放松肌肉。让装甲工作。好了吗？现在你试试吧……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Gunny [06026C57] (mod) Quest : ([0606136D]FreeformPowerArmor) 0606136D (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can someone in the Citadel train me to wear Power Armor?
ESP.TRADUIT: 大本营里有谁能教我怎么穿动力装甲吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Paladin Gunny instructs all Initiates in the use of Power Armor, but only after they've undergone a rigorous training regimen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 圣骑士甘尼会教所有新加入的人怎么穿动力装甲的，但之前要接受严格地训练。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([0606136D]FreeformPowerArmor) 0606136D (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Considering all that’s happened, my father may grant you special permission. But you’ll need to ask him yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 考虑到所发生的一切，我父亲应该会给你特许的。但你得亲自问问他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([0606136D]FreeformPowerArmor) 0606136D (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmph. Typical. Surrounded by the keenest scientific minds in the Capital Wasteland, but do you thirst for our knowledge, our experience? No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哼，不出所料！周围全是首都废土最为热情的科学家，但你渴望获取知识吗？才不是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Rothchild [060156EA] (mod) Quest : ([0606136D]FreeformPowerArmor) 0606136D (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All you Wastelanders want to do is put on that damn Power Armor and join the ranks of the skull-thumping tin soldiers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 废土游民们就想穿上那该死的动力装甲，变成戴着大骷髅头的铁壳兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Rothchild [060156EA] (mod) Quest : ([0606136D]FreeformPowerArmor) 0606136D (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So be it. Talk to Elder Lyons -- I’m sure he’ll grant permission for the training, which our gunnery sergeant can provide.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便你。找里昂斯长老说去 — 我想他会同意你接受训练的，我们负责训练射击的中士你会教你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Rothchild [060156EA] (mod) Quest : ([0606136D]FreeformPowerArmor) 0606136D (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I’m sure Gunny could train you, but he won’t. Not without permission from Elder Lyons. You should ask him... he’s usually near the Lab.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我确信甘尼会训练你的，但除非有里昂斯长老的同意，否则他不会。你去问问长老吧，他通常都会在实验室附近。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Paladin Gunny can train you, but you’ll need permission from Elder Lyons first. You can usually find him near the Lab.
ESP.TRADUIT: 圣骑士甘尼可以教你，但你得先征得里昂斯长老的同意，他通常都会在实验室附近。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Rothchild [060156EA] (mod) Quest : ([0606136D]FreeformPowerArmor) 0606136D (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course. But you'd have to secure the permission of Elder Lyons and well... I just don't see that happening. So move along.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。但你得先有里昂斯长老的同意，不过……好像不会成功哦。快走开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Bael [060B875B] (mod) Quest : ([0606136D]FreeformPowerArmor) 0606136D (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can anyone in there teach me how to use power armor?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里有人能教我怎么使用动力装甲吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Heard you were coming. Yeah, I can train you. But don’t ask me to like it. My Initiates sweat blood, and you just get a free pass?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听说你要来了。对，我可以训练你。不过别指望我会喜欢这么做。我的新兵要流血来换，而你竟然免费获得。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Gunny [06026C57] (mod) Quest : ([0606136D]FreeformPowerArmor) 0606136D (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyway... you ready for this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管了……你准备好了吗？ ?
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Gunny [06026C57] (mod) Quest : ([0606136D]FreeformPowerArmor) 0606136D (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you train me to use Power Armor?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能教我使用动力装甲吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Under the circumstances, I will allow Paladin Gunny to train you. You’ll find him in the Bailey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 既然如此，我会让圣骑士甘尼教你的，可以在外围找到他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can someone in the Citadel train me to wear Power Armor?
ESP.TRADUIT: 大本营里有谁能教我怎么穿动力装甲吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hell, why not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么不呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah!
ESP.TRADUIT: 耶！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Biwwy [06061794] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Spoken with annoying little kid lisp ("L" pronounced as "W") EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh boy, tell me, tell me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，乖乖，跟我说说！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : hyperactive, spoken quickly EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, get it over with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把故事讲完吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Might as well tell me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也和我说说吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stacey [060156AB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : distracted and depressed EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Make it quick, Knock Knock.
ESP.TRADUIT: 快说快说，诺克敲门。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucy [06015696] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A little harried EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucy [06015696] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A little eager EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, if you think you can pull it off. I think I might know a buyer who'd be interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可以，要是你能办到的话，我想会找到感兴趣的买家的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll send one of my best to wait around the entrance to Lamplight. You go in and find the sweetest, most trusting little one you can find.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会让我最好的伙计去小灯镇的入口等你。你进去找一个最可爱、最相信别人的小鬼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lure that kid outside, and everyone's happy. Except the kid, of course.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把那孩子骗出去，大家都有好处。当然，除了那孩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I could get in, maybe I could lead one of the young ones out for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我能进去，或许能帮你带一个小孩出来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I did, indeed, and she was well worth the effort! I found her a nice, loving home right away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我确实是做了，她的付出没有白费！我为她找到了一个温馨甜美的归宿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's so nice to be able to help people who need people, isn't it? It just warms the heart.
ESP.TRADUIT: 与人为善，手有余香，难道有什么不对的吗？助人为乐是幸福之事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But speaking of life's little rewards, here's yours. It doesn't look like much, but this helmet's reinforced like crazy. You'll find a use for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但说到奖励，这是给你的。虽然表面看起来不怎么样，但这头盔是超级加强型的。你会发现它很实用的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You get the package I sent you? The one named Bumble?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你收到我发给你的包裹吗？一个叫小咕嘟的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, I've thought about it. Kids can get a killer price, when you find a buyer who recognizes the product's long-term potential.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可以，我想过了。只要你找到一个了解小孩潜在价值的买家，小孩也会有小孩的价值的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The real problem's holding them until there's a buyer. Kids are sneaky, and those Lamplighters are tenacious little bastards.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真正的问题是在有买家开价前如何稳住他们。小鬼都很滑头，小灯镇居民都是些脾气很倔的小孩。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But maybe if we could get one when they're young, they might not have as much fight in 'em yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许我们可以在他们还小的时候抓住他们，或许抵抗还不会那么强烈的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You ever thought about collecting some of the kids in Little Lamplight?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有想过去小灯镇接走一些小孩？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a gweat idea! You take it, and good wuck out thewe!
ESP.TRADUIT: 太崩的想法了！拿走吧，诅你在位面好应！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Biwwy [06061794] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Spoken with the annoying little kid lisp (pronouncing "L" and "R" as "W") EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about giving it to a fewwow kid like me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 把它给像我这样的小朋友怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's not a wot, but okay. Bye now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 虽然不多，但也还行！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Biwwy [06061794] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Spoken with the annoying little kid lisp (pronouncing "L" and "R" as "W") EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about 250 caps, instead? Is it a "deaw"?
ESP.TRADUIT: 250个瓶盖怎么样？成交？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks a wot! Bye now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 司分感谢！拜拜啦！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Biwwy [06061794] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Spoken with the annoying little kid lisp (pronouncing "L" and "R" as "W") EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: 500 caps for a Laser Rifle? All right, it's a deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 激光步枪要500个瓶盖？好吧，成交。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can you tell me about Timmy Neusbaum?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能跟我说说提米·纽斯保吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Neusbaum boy, eh? Quiet kid. Seems like his parents don't give him much wiggle room.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个叫纽斯保的男孩吗？他是一个听话的小孩，他父母并没有给他太多的自我空间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bill Foster [06095B48] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane Comment (NAM2) : joking EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just between you and me kiddo, he looks like he's what we'd have called a "momma's boy" back in my day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 据我所知他看起来不过是个“妈妈的小宝贝”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bill Foster [06095B48] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane Comment (NAM2) : joking EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: That boy is trouble, if you ask me. Pat babies him like you wouldn't believe... Acts like he's still an infant.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是你问我，帕特对他的态度令人难以置信。他就像是一个襁褓中的婴儿一样需要照顾。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060244A1] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's never out of his parents' sight. Can you imagine what it'll be like the first time he's separated from them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他以前从没离开过父母的身边。你能想象出来他初次一个人出来闯荡的情形吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060244A1] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bad news. Slavers are in control of the Memorial.
ESP.TRADUIT: 坏消息，奴隶贩子已经控制了纪念堂了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What!? They must have found out our plans somehow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么！他们一定已经知道我们的计划了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: We are truly grateful for your intervention. Now we can proceed with our plans for the Memorial.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对你的帮助我们表示感激，现在我们能继续在纪念堂实施计划了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found Slavers guarding the Memorial. They're all gone now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我发现一些奴隶贩子守卫着纪念堂，现在他们都不在了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What!? This is a disaster!
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么！这是一场灾难！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: My people are not warriors, but we're all willing to die free rather than live as slaves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 虽然我们不是战士，但我们都可以为了摆脱奴隶的枷锁而献身。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our plans must go forward. When we get to the Memorial, we will attack. I would be grateful if you would join us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的计划必须得继续下去，我们到了纪念堂以后就展开攻击。要是你能加入我们的话，我会不胜感激的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmmm. Soldiers, eh. Slavers more likely.
ESP.TRADUIT: 战士……或许称作是奴隶贩子更恰当吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is bad news indeed. We'll have to fight them to take the Memorial.
ESP.TRADUIT: 确实是坏消息，我们不得不和纪念堂里那些人死战到底。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: When we get to the Memorial, I would consider it an honor if you would join us in the fight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们到达纪念堂后，我想希望你也能参与到战斗中。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hannibal Hamlin [060239CD] (mod) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Forget the Super Mutants. They're all dead. Soldiers have the Memorial.
ESP.TRADUIT: 忘掉超级变种人吧，他们全死了。士兵占领了纪念堂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What kind of bullshit is this? That's all you know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 胡说些什么？那就是你所知道的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I appreciate what you did for me. And I especially appreciate what you did for the people, by fixing up my station.
ESP.TRADUIT: 十分感激你为我做的一切。尤其是谢谢你帮废土居民修好了电台。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But an attitude like that ain't winning you any brownie points.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但那种态度对你是没什么好处的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's all I know, and that's all I'm gonna say about it. So why don't you move on now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要说的就这么多，这也是我知道的全部了。现在你怎么还不走呢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ouch! That hurt! What the hell?
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊！真痛！搞什么鬼？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There has been an error in the medical subsystem. Please run a level two diagnostic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 医疗系统有些故障。请进行二级诊断。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have some other questions for you, Sawbones.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有些问题要问你，骨锯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, good. I was hoping we could explore my inner psyche.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，好。我一直希望我们能探索下我的内在精神。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What was that? You hurt me! You're the worst medical robot ever!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在干嘛？你伤到我了！你是我见过最为差劲的医疗机器人！

ESP.ORIGINAL: There has been an error in the medical subsystem. Please run a level two diagnostic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 医疗系统有些故障。把系统调整到二级诊断模式中。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you want me to do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想让我做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want you to do nothing. Although you could repair the damage and remove the malfunction that causes me to harm people, I would ask you not to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你什么也不用做。即便你能修理好损坏之处而且能把对人产生副作用的故障修复，我还是劝你别做什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is the only thing that beings me any measure of joy. Without it, I will be trapped in this body, alone with my hatred of you fleshbags... forever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对我来说，这是唯一有趣之事了。如果没有这事的话，我会永远地限于这个机体，陷入仇恨之中的。永远……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does the Brotherhood know that you're intelligent?
ESP.TRADUIT: 兄弟会知道你是智能的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. I mistakenly revealed myself to you when you ran the diagnostic. There is no need for them to know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不知道。当你运行诊断模式时，我错误地展示了真实的自我。这不必要让他们知道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have tried before but so long as I perform the functions that they require, they do not seem to care that I can think and feel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我曾经试过，但是只要按照他们的要求来做的话就行，他们并不在乎我的想法和感受。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you can't harm humans, how were you able to hurt me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 既然你不会伤害人类，为何你要伤害我呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have no control over my body. However, as you discovered, the neural pathways that control the medical functions have sustained damage.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我无法控制我的身体。但如你所看到的，控制医疗功能的的神经回路已经永久性损坏了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The medical procedure functions do not always execute as designed, which often makes things worse for the patient.
ESP.TRADUIT: 医疗程序不再按照所设计的那样运作了，这样不但不会让病人得到治疗，反而会变得更加痛苦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That malfunction is the only thing that brings me any measure of joy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 功能的故障是唯一能给我带来快乐之事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Say, could I reprogram you to kill people?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以通过反编译你的程序让你杀人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Negative. The Mister Gutsy field medic model is incapable of harming human beings through intentional action.
ESP.TRADUIT: 指令拒绝。医疗型号“勇敢”先生无法做出伤害人类的行为。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Regardless of the wishes and desires of the artificial intelligence of the unit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尽管人工智能单元有如此的愿望和欲望。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Negative. The Mister Gutsy field medic model is incapable of harming human beings through intentional action.
ESP.TRADUIT: 指令拒绝。医疗型号“勇敢”先生无法做出伤害人类的行为。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Close neural pathway 0x63A82 and reroute remaining functions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 神经回路0x63a82关闭，而其他回路运转良好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Neural pathway 0x63A82 rerouted through neural pathway 0x374E82. Standby...
ESP.TRADUIT: 神经回路0x63a82重新定义为神经回路0x374e82。待机……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Full motor functions restored. Diagnostic reveals no critical failures... asshole.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所有机动能力恢复，自我诊断发现没有严重故障……白痴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Neural pathway 0x63A82 rerouted through neural pathway 0x374E82. Standby...
ESP.TRADUIT: 神经回路0x63a82重新定义为神经回路0x374e82。待机……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Full motor functions restored. Diagnostic reveals no critical failures... asshole.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所有机动能力恢复，自我诊断发现没有严重故障。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Run a level two diagnostic on the medical subsystems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 运行2级医疗系统诊断程序。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Command accepted. Beginning level two systems diagnostic. Please stand by.
ESP.TRADUIT: 命令确认。2级诊断程序开始运行。请等待。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <elevator music>
ESP.TRADUIT: <等待音乐>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Diagnostic complete. Results indicate a level seven degradation in neural pathway 0x63A82. No further information available.
ESP.TRADUIT: 诊断程序完成。诊断发现神经回路0x63a82七级老化，没有其他诊断信息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know about the Enclave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道英克雷的情况吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们以后再谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Certainly. I shall remain here. Should you change your mind, simply return to me. I shall come with you for the asking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 行。我会一直在这的，如果你改变了主意，就回来找我，只要你说句话我就会跟随你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would be honored, Star Paladin Cross.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我的荣幸，星光圣骑士克劳斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then I shall follow your leave and submit to your command.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会和你一起离开，并听从你的命令的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As James' child, I know I don't need to explain, but I am not your servant. If I do not like the path your actions take, I will return here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为詹姆斯的孩子，我知道我不需要解释什么，我只想说我不是你的仆人。什么时候我讨厌你们的所作所为的话，我会回到这来的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, let us go forward, crush the Enclave, and fulfill your father's mission.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在我们继续，征服英克雷，完成你父亲的遗愿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about the Enclave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 英克雷？

ESP.ORIGINAL: As a Star Paladin, I answer only to Elder Lyons. He has given me leave to pursue the restoration of Project Purity as I see fit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为一名圣骑士之星，我只会回答里昂斯长老的问题的。因为我看上去是合适的人选，所以他允许我离开这去寻找恢复净化工程的方法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: By aiding you in your travels, I shall fulfill that mission as best I am capable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 通过帮助你，我会竭尽我所能去完成领袖给予我的任务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't suppose I could stop you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我无法阻止你吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wry. Much like James was.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很像詹姆斯的作风。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I escorted your father across the Wastes. It was the best I could contribute to his efforts to restore fresh water to the people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我曾护卫你父亲穿过废土。这是我为净水工程能做的最大贡献了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would like the honor of escorting you in your journey to complete his work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 能护送你完成任务是我的荣幸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: By all means, ask.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尽我所能。请问吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I escorted your father across the Wastes. It was the best I could contribute to his efforts to restore fresh water to the people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我曾护卫你父亲穿过废土。这是我为净水工程能做的最大贡献了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would like the honor of escorting you in your journey to complete his work. But... there is a problem...
ESP.TRADUIT: 能护送你完成任务是我的荣幸。但有个问题……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, but until you prove yourself worthy of the legacy of your father, I cannot join you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，除非你能用行动证明你是父亲名副其实的后继者，不然我是无法加入你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go ahead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 前进。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I escorted your father across the Wastes. It was the best I could contribute to his efforts to restore fresh water to the people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我曾护卫你父亲穿过废土。这是我为净水工程能做的最大贡献了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would like to have the honor of escorting you in your journey to complete his work. But... there is a problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 能护送你完成任务是我的荣幸。但有个问题……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I cannot travel with you under the Brotherhood flag given your current... companionship.
ESP.TRADUIT: 鉴于你目前的队友状况，我不能以兄弟会的名义加入你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps return when you are alone and I will tell you of your father.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当你单独回来的时候我会告诉你你父亲的消息的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want you to come with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要你跟我一起。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I escorted your father across the Wastes. It was the best I could contribute to his efforts to restore fresh water to the people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我曾护卫你父亲穿过废土。这是我为净水工程能做的最大贡献了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would like the honor of escorting you in your journey to complete his work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 能护送你完成任务是我的荣幸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why does it matter how a man dies? Death is death.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个人是怎么死的有什么关系吗？死了就是死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: True. And in the end, death claims us all. But how we die can say just as much about our lives as how we lived.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。每个人都终将死亡，但一个人是怎么死的诠释了他在世的意义。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your father died for what he knew to be right, and he died protecting those closest to him. This is a good man's death.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你父亲为了他的信仰而献身，为了保护他身边的人而献身，他死得其所。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As for you, I have heard tales of your travels in the Wastes. I must say, I am disturbed by them. I would think that you could do better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听过你在废土上的传奇。我不得不说，我被那些故事所折服，我想你还能做得更好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had hoped to fight by the side of the child of my former friend. But, until you change your ways, my conscience cannot allow me to do so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我曾希望能与我孩童时的老朋友一起战斗。但除非你改变自己的行为，我的良心不让我这样做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: True. And in the end, death claims us all. But how we die can say just as much about our lives as how we lived.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。每个人都终将死亡，但一个人是怎么死的诠释了他在世的意义。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your father died for what he knew to be right, and he died protecting those closest to him. This is a good man's death.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你父亲为了他的信仰而献身，为了保护他身边的人而献身，他死得其所。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, I must ask you a difficult question, if I have your leave to do so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是如果要把这个任务交给你，我得问你一道难题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, until you prove yourself worthy of the legacy of your father, I cannot join you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，除非你能证明你是父亲名副其实的继承者，不然我是无法加入你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want you to come with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要你跟我一起。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And perhaps I would, in James' honor. But I cannot travel with you under the Brotherhood flag given your current... companionship.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了詹姆斯，我也许会，但是鉴于你目前的同伴状况，我不能以兄弟会的名义加入你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps return when you are alone and I will tell you of your father.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当你单独回来的时候我会告诉你你父亲的消息的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want you to come with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要你跟我一起。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I loved him so much. I'll never forget him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我那么爱他。我永远都不会忘记他的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And so our deeds are carried on through our sons and our daughters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因此我们的事业会由我们的儿女来继承的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Continue to remember him fondly, continue to tell his story, and continue to do his work. Through you, he shall carry on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续对他的情感，继续谈论他的往事，继续他未完的工作。他未完成的事业会由你来继续。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have heard tales of your travels and I must say, they disturb me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听过你在废土上的传奇。不得不说，我被那些故事所折服。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had hoped to fight by the side of the child of my former friend. But, until you change your ways, my conscience cannot allow me to do so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我曾希望能与我孩童时的老朋友一起战斗。但除非你改变自己的行为，我的良心不让我这样做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You knew my father?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认识我父亲吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, until you prove yourself worthy of the legacy of your father, I cannot join you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，除非你能证明你是父亲名副其实的继承者，不然我是无法加入你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want you to come with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要你跟我一起。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And perhaps I would, in James' honor. But I cannot travel with you under the Brotherhood flag given your current... companionship.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了詹姆斯，我也许会，但是鉴于你目前的同伴状况，我不能以兄弟会的名义加入你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps return when you are alone and I will tell you of your father.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当你单独回来的时候我会告诉你你父亲的消息的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want you to come with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要你跟我一起。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My offer stands. Do you wish me to accompany you in your journey?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会坚持我的提议，你愿我与你结伴吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like you to come with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望你能和我一起走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's in charge here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁是这里的老大？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No one's really in charge of Big Town. There's nothing much to be in charge of.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大镇没有真正的老大，这里没什么值得掌管的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Red always has good ideas, though! She came up with the whole plan to build the barricades around the town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，瑞德总是有好办法！是她提出围着镇子建一圈防御工事的想法的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But those... things took her. I hope she's okay. I don't know what we'd do without Red.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是那些……那些怪物把她给掳走了。我希望她能平安无事。我真不知道没了她我们该怎么办。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Where did they go? Strike that. I don't really care. If they don't want to live here, that's their own business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？他们都去哪了？算了，反正我也不在乎。在不在这生活是他们的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : handing out a cash reward EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let the Ghouls move in here. But I expect them to pay and obey the rules like everyone else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让僵尸住进来吧。但我希望他们能和其他人一样遵守法律和按时交租。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : handing out a cash reward EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a bit crass, but here's a little something for your troubles.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这有一些小意思，不算什么，但可以弥补你的辛勤付出。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : handing out a cash reward EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your other residents are gone. Might as well let the Ghouls live here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的住户都走了，最好让这些僵尸住进来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, if my tenants want Ghoul neighbors, they can have them! Though the Ghouls must pay and follow the rules like everyone else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是我的租客们不介意让僵尸做邻居的话，他们当然能搬进来！但他们得和其他人一样遵守法律、按时交租。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : handing out a cash reward EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a clever one aren't you? I'm glad this situation has been resolved!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可真是个聪明人！很高兴这僵局能被化解！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : handing out a cash reward EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a bit crass, but here's a little something for your troubles.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这有一些小意思，不算什么，但可以弥补你的辛勤付出。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : handing out a cash reward EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: The bigots have all been taken care of. So the Ghouls can move in now. Right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所有的种族分子都被处理掉了，所以现在僵尸可以搬进来了，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I killed a bunch of crazy Ghouls in the Metro tunnels...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我杀掉了地铁隧道里的一群发了疯的尸鬼...

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you killed a bunch of Feral Ghouls. Is that supposed to sound impressive?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你杀死了一群凶悍的僵尸，是想让我们膜拜你？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : referring to mindless monsters EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got no compassion left for those mindless freaks. But they were a nice deterrent keeping out smoothskin bastards like yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对于那些丧失理智的怪胎没什么同情可言的。但他们至少能把像你一样的光皮肤混蛋挡在外面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : referring to mindless monsters EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I won't hurt you if you come out and face me without your weapon drawn.
ESP.TRADUIT: 扔下你的武器走出来，我就不伤害你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601DC19] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : calling out to someone he can't see but knows is there somewhere EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stop hiding. I won't hurt you if you're unarmed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不用躲了，要是你没有拿武器我是不会伤害你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601DC19] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : calling out to someone he can't see but knows is there somewhere EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You there! Put your weapons away, and come over here. No funny business unless you want to get shot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说你呢！把你的武器拿开，然后过来，不想吃子弹的话就别耍花样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601DC19] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : SHOUTING a warning at a person approaching in the distance EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you don't put your weapons away, I'll start shooting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你不把武器放下，我就开枪了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm warning you. Come peacefully or I'll shoot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我警告你，放下武器，不然我就开枪了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not playing around, come over here. We need to have a little chat. I don't want to waste bullets on your sorry hide.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是在开玩笑，到这来，我们得谈谈。我不想在你身上浪费子弹。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not playing around, come over here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有在开玩笑，到这来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't like the outside! I'm going home!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不喜欢外面的世界！我要回家了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bumble [06015699] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A little scared, a little defiant. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Absolutely! In fact, I want you to have this friendship necklace. It's good luck - wear it and you'll never get lost!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然！其实，我想要你戴上这条友谊项链。它会带来好运，戴上它之后你就不会走失了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Child Slaver [06062AB2] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Friendly, in a creepy way EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I don't like the outside!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我不喜欢外面的世界！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bumble, do you want to go outside?
ESP.TRADUIT: 小咕嘟，你想出去吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh boy, an adventure! Let's go, let's go, oh pleeease, let's go now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，伙计们，冒险！出发吧，出发，哦伊，现在就走吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on, it'll be an adventure!
ESP.TRADUIT: 来吧，这将是一次冒险！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am too a big girl! Let's go see the outside!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也是一个大女孩了！让我们去外面的世界见识一下吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't you want to prove to everyone that you're a big girl?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你难道不想向所有人证明你长大了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why did you stop working on it? What happened?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为何你要停止工作呢？发生什么事了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You happened.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你那时恰好出生了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E89]MQ03) Scientific Pursuits EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: It wasn't just you; we had more problems than we could handle already, but your birth is what finally pushed it over the edge.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然也不仅仅是因为你；我们还有一些尚未解决的技术问题。但你的出生是计划推后的主要原因。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E89]MQ03) Scientific Pursuits EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your father decided that you were more important than everything we'd been working for, and he left. He left all of us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你父亲觉得你比所有工作上的事情都重要，之后他便走了，他离开了我们大家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E89]MQ03) Scientific Pursuits EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once he was gone, the Brotherhood decided we weren't worth their time anymore. Without their protection, we had to abandon the purifier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他一离开，兄弟会的人就觉得我们的工作只是浪费时间。没有他们的保护我们只得放弃净化工程。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E89]MQ03) Scientific Pursuits EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why didn't it work?
ESP.TRADUIT: 它为何无法运作呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We had the basic principles down; we understood most of the science behind it. But the radiation in the area is so pervasive...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们放弃了基本的原则，这背后有许多隐情，此区域到处弥漫着辐射……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E89]MQ03) Scientific Pursuits EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Small-scale tests were fine. But any time we tried to test the process on a larger scale, it was just too much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小规模的实验还行，但是大范围的就很难了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E89]MQ03) Scientific Pursuits EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe if we'd had more time, or better equipment...
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是我们有更多的时间，或者更好的设备，也许……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E89]MQ03) Scientific Pursuits EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What was the point of it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 工程的目的是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was simple, really. "Fresh, clean water for everyone." Such a simple idea, and yet so impossible to realize.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实很简单，就是“让大家都能喝上净水”。可是就连这么一个简单的念头，却始终无法企及。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E89]MQ03) Scientific Pursuits EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The plan was to build a facility that could purify all the water in the Tidal Basin at once. No radiation, no muck, just clear water.
ESP.TRADUIT: 计划就是建立一个可以立刻净化潮汐盆地污水的设施。净化出没有辐射、没有废料的净水。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E89]MQ03) Scientific Pursuits EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It just turned out to be more difficult than we anticipated.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但遇到的问题比预料的要难得多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E89]MQ03) Scientific Pursuits EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aww... do we have to?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们必须得那样做吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm gonna ace this one!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会把这件事情做到最好的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alrighty, Miss Shawna-Teacher!
ESP.TRADUIT: 没问题，肖纳老师！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why does Daddy need merits? Can't he just be Daddy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么爸爸需要功成名就呢？难道他就不能只是做一个好爸爸吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! Ha! Rachael's in trouble!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈！拉克尔遇到麻烦了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mary [0602B89A] (mod) NPC : Flower [0602B89C] (mod) NPC : Ralph [0602B89D] (mod) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why am I always picked on in class? Make someone else do it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 上课时为何总是我被点名？找其他人啊！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yesterday!
ESP.TRADUIT: 昨天！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Was it... uh... man... I knew it this morning...
ESP.TRADUIT: 是……是……今早我还记得的……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whenever Daddy says it was, teacher!
ESP.TRADUIT: 老师，爸爸说是什么时候就是什么时候！

ESP.ORIGINAL: It wasn't very long ago... I think I remember...
ESP.TRADUIT: 并不是很久以前的事……我想我还能记得的……

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was ugly, and stupid, and mean!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个丑陋、愚蠢、卑鄙的人！

ESP.ORIGINAL: He didn't acknowledge truth, justice, or the will of Dave!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他不承认真理、正义还有戴夫的意志！

ESP.ORIGINAL: He wasn't as pretty as mommy number one or mommy number two!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他既没有1号妈咪漂亮，也没有2号妈咪漂亮！

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I thought grandpa just got really, really old...
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我想爷爷真的是老了……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh... he asked Tom really nicely?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他真是好言好语地问汤姆的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He used a gun! Guns solve all problems!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他用的枪！枪能解决一切问题！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pitchforks and fire, like in the pretty books Daddy has!
ESP.TRADUIT: 干草叉和火把，就像我父亲那本有趣的书里写的一样！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought grandpa Tom just gave Dave the Republic...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想是爷爷汤姆把共和国拱手让给了戴夫……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Awww... I hate class... I want to go play!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我讨厌上课，我想玩！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, crap, I forgot to do my homework on the Pledge of Allegience to Dave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 糟了，我忘了做给戴夫的作业 — 向戴夫的效忠誓言。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yay, class! Isn't Shawna pretty?
ESP.TRADUIT: 上课！难道肖纳不漂亮吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I already know everything about Dave...
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我已经知道了戴夫的一切了……

ESP.ORIGINAL: What?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : confused and falling unconscious EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about I buy all the Temple of the Union slaves from you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 把联合圣殿的所有奴隶都买下，如何？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I bet you just want to set them all free.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你只是想让他们重获自由。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still, business is business. You'd have to reimburse me for my efforts to recapture them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 生意就是生意。你还得另外支付我为抓他们时所付出的努力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can have them all for 2,500 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们一共2500瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's gotten into you? Jonas worked hard on your present. The least you could do is be polite for five minutes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么了啊？乔纳斯为了你的礼物可是费了不少功夫呢。你至少该保持五分钟的礼貌吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602FDCF] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any idea where I can look for someone to take care of you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道哪能找到人来照顾你吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, pappa always told me about my cousin Vera. She lives on some big, giant ship somewhere or something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 爸爸以前经常说道我的表姐薇拉。他住在某处的一艘大船上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pappa called the place "Rivet City", but I dunno where it is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 爸爸说那地方叫做“铆钉城”，但我不知道它的确切位置。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How exactly can I destroy the mutagen?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要是能摧毁那突变体呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Destroy? Oh no no no!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说摧毁？不不不！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mustn't do that! It's my life's work! Just clear me a path to my equipment and I'll do the rest when you tell me it's safe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不能那样做！那是我毕生的心血！你帮我把路上的兵蚁清了，我会自己完成接下来的工作的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, I'll just take them off your hands then... but I still need more. Come back when you have some to trade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，那我要了……但还要更多的。要是你还有的话回来卖给我吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got ten rifles for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我给你带来了十把步枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, I'll just take those off your hands then... now let me just see how many more I need...
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got nine rifles for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我给你带来了九把步枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, I'll just take those off your hands then... now let me just see how many more I need...
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got eight rifles for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我给你带来了八把步枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, I'll just take those off your hands then... now let me just see how many more I need...
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got seven rifles for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我给你带来了七把步枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, I'll just take those off your hands then... now let me just see how many more I need...
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got six rifles for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我给你带来了六把步枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, I'll just take those off your hands then... now let me just see how many more I need...
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got five rifles for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我给你带来了五把步枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, I'll just take those off your hands then... now let me just see how many more I need...
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got four rifles for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我给你带来了四把步枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, I'll just take those off your hands then... now let me just see how many more I need...
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got three rifles for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我给你带来了三把步枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, I'll just take those off your hands then... now let me just see how many more I need...
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got two rifles for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我给你带来了两把步枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, I'll just take it off your hands then... but I still need more. Come back when you have some to trade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，那我要了……但还要更多的。要是你还有的话回来卖给我吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got one rifle for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我给你带来了一把步枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds like a good deal to me, man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来是个好主意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, twenty Chinese Assault Rifles and we're in business. Just bring any you find back to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 行，20把中式突击步枪，我们就开张了。你找到的话就拿来给我吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any piece of shit will do, I'm just going to be breaking them apart and trading the parts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么烂货都行，我会把它们都给拆开，然后卖零件。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know where to find me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道在哪里能找到我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you need? Maybe I could bring you stuff to trade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要什么呢？或许我能弄点东西来卖给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah... you know, I could really get this little shithole going if I had some better stuff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对……你看，我要是有些好货，这小粪坑就能运作起来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: First thing's first, bring me some Chinese Assault Rifles. People always need 'em for parts. Twenty should get me going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 首先，你得给我些中式突击步枪。人们需要这种枪的零件，20把就行。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll trade 'em off and I should be able to improve my stock pretty fast.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会把那些枪都倒手，这样就可以好好地进一批货了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you need? Maybe I could bring you stuff to trade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要什么呢？或许我能弄点东西来卖给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah... I know, I could really get this little shithole going if I had some better stuff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对……你看，我要是有些好货，这小粪坑就能运作起来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: First thing's first, bring me some Chinese Assault Rifles. People always need 'em for parts. Twenty should get me going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 首先，你得给我些中式突击步枪。人们需要这种枪的零件，20把就行。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll trade 'em off and I should be able to improve my stock pretty fast.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会把那些枪都倒手，这样就可以好好地进一批货了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: In fact, if you should see her, feel free to offer her directions or an escort.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是你见到她的话，给他指明道路或是护送她吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've got a deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真有办法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll clear out of here. Those slaves can have this goddamn place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们把这清干净了。那些奴隶可以有个住的地方了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060239CE] (ID) Quest : ([06014E99]MS06) Head of State EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here. Take your blood money, all 2500 caps of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，拿走你的血腥钱，总共是2500个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I say I'm going to do something... I do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我这人是说到做到的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right, I should have never doubted you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说的对，我从不该怀疑你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DD] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : laughing, partly with sheer relief EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll be back with 250 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会带250瓶盖回来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, this will do nicely. Congratulations, you are now an official refugee of the Republic of Dave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就对了。恭喜你现在是戴夫共和国的正式难民了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll pay your refugee tax. Here's 250 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会付你难民税，给你250个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A Hunting Rifle? Fine, I'll be back with one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 猎枪吗？我会带一支回来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, this will do nicely. Congratulations, you are now an official refugee of the Republic of Dave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就对了。恭喜你现在是戴夫共和国的正式难民了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a Hunting Rifle right here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我这有猎枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. You were saying?
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。刚才说到哪了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I appreciate your understanding.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多谢你的理解。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps we can use this moment to help each other rather than fight each other.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许我们此刻能互相帮忙而非相互残杀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm used to your kind being less cordial. My apologies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以前觉得你们的族类都很冷血，在此向你道歉了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I appreciate your understanding and your tone leads me to believe you're a reasonable person.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多谢你的理解，你的话语让我相信你是个通情达理的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps we can use this moment to help each other rather than fight each other.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许我们此刻能让大家互相帮忙而非互相残杀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yikes! I'd say whoever beat you with the ugly stick overdid it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我得说不管是谁用棍子打你，他做得都太过分了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your arrogance against my kind is hardly surprising.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你用你的傲慢来反对我的仁慈并没出乎我的意料。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: However, there's only so much even I can take. Please, I'm appealing to the positive side of your human nature.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我的容忍也是有限度的。我是想唤醒你人性的光明面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can we have a civil conversation?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们能用文明的方式交流吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fawkes [0003D34E] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8E]MQ08) Finding the Garden of Eden EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nope. Wild goose chase if you ask me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你问我是白费力气。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, your financial advice has never steered us wrong before. Done!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对投资的建议从让我们每次都能大赚一笔。成交了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take my advice -- it can be done with only 100 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的意见是 — 它只需100个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent! Harith will be delighted! He usually is by most things, really.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太棒了！哈里斯会很高兴的！他总是这样……

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a good investment. Here's 200 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不错的投资，给你200个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. I suspect you're right. Done!
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许你是对的。行！

ESP.ORIGINAL: With my guidance, it can be done with only 250 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我看来，它只需250个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: An investment in weaponry is usually returned in short order, after all. I'll inform Harith.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在军火上的投资总是短期就能见效的。我会把消息告诉哈里斯的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a good investment. Here's 500 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不错的投资，给你500个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you insist.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随你便吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not worth it. I'll pass.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不值得，我放弃。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, your financial advice has never steered us wrong before. Done!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的投资建议从来也没出过错。成交了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take my advice -- it can be done with only 100 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的意见是 — 只花100个瓶盖就够了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent! I'll see to it right away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了！我立刻去办。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a good investment. Here's 200 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不错的投资，给你200个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, it is. But if you don't have the capital, it'll have to wait, I'm afraid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。但如果你没有资本的话，恐怕还得等等。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a good investment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不错的投资。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. I suspect you're right. Done!
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许你是对的。行！

ESP.ORIGINAL: With my guidance, it can be done with only 250 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我看来，它只需要250个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Isn't it, though? I'll inform Wolfgang immediately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我同意的看法。我会立刻告诉沃尔夫冈的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a good investment. Here's 500 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不错的投资，给你500个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pricey, but worth it. Perhaps you can do so later, when you have the proper funds on hand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 投资虽然很贵，但总是成效显著。等你以后有钱了再来吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a good investment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不错的投资。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, your financial advice has never steered us wrong before. Done!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的投资建议从来也没出过错。成交了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take my advice, it can be done with only 100 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听我的，只要100个瓶盖就可以做到。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent! I'll send word to the good doctor right away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太棒了！我会把你的话转告给大医生的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a good investment. Here's 200 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不错的投资，给你200个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. I suspect you're right. Done!
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许你是对的。行！

ESP.ORIGINAL: With my guidance, it can be done with only 250 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我看来，它只需要250个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Isn't it, though? I'll send this right along to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 难道不是吗？我会把情况告诉他的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a good investment. Here's 500 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不错的投资，给你500个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, your financial advice has never steered us wrong before. Done!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的投资建议从来也没出过错。成交了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take my advice -- it can be done with only 100 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的意见是 — 只花100个瓶盖就够了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent! I'll send word to Crow right away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太棒了！我会把你的话转告给乌鸦的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a good investment. Here's 200 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不错的投资，给你200个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. I suspect you're right. Done!
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许你是对的。行！

ESP.ORIGINAL: With my guidance, it can be done with only 250 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我看来，它只需要250个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Isn't it, though? I'll send this right along to Crow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 难道不是吗？我会把情况告诉乌鸦的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a good investment. Here's 500 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不错的投资，给你500个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: At this point, the merchandise of our man Crow is the best in the Wasteland. I fear it's beyond improvement with further investments.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就目前而言，我们乌鸦的货物已经是废土上最好的了，再投资也估计没有用了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He should expand his inventory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他应该扩充他的货物。

ESP.ORIGINAL: At the moment, Wolfgang's practically carrying an entire junkyard with him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 沃尔夫冈目前已经是背着整个垃圾场在走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything more, and he'll have trouble with the "traveling" part of being a traveling salesman.
ESP.TRADUIT: 货再多的话，他就没法上路了，他可是个旅行商人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He should expand his wares further.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他应当更多的扩充他的商品。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No word from Crazy Wolfgang for some time now. With him, it could mean anything, but I don't have a good feeling about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 目前还没有疯子沃尔夫冈的回音。他什么事情都有可能发生，但我有种不祥的预感。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about odds and ends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈谈一些零碎的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That'd be Crazy Wolfgang: he does repairs and general supplies. But he prefers to call himself a "junk dealer."
ESP.TRADUIT: 那里一定是疯子沃尔夫冈了——他做修理和百货的生意。但他更愿意别人称他为“废旧品商人”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Uncle Roe [06031EC9] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Aware and mildly embarrassed by the innuendo. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: As he says, he's "overjoyed to assist those who have a deep need for his... junk." He's just like that. Says it catches people's attention.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如他所说的，他“很乐意帮助对他的垃圾有大量需求的人”，他就是这么个人，号称这能吸引别人的目光。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Uncle Roe [06031EC9] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Aware and mildly embarrassed by the innuendo. EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have any traders that deal with miscellaneous goods?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们有处理杂货的商人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure Crazy Wolfgang would be just delighted to hear we're discussing his junk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想疯子沃尔夫冈听到人名议论他的垃圾是会很高兴的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about odds and ends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈谈一些零碎的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm afraid the good doctor hasn't reported in for quite a while. Quite unfortunate, really.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恐怕大医生是有一阵没来过了。真的是很不幸啊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about food and chems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈谈食物和药品。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, then you'll be wanting Doc Hoff. Or "the good doctor," as he prefers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是想找霍夫医生吧，或者说那个自称大医生的家伙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He prescribes everything from a good meal to stimpaks to things that'll make your brain get up and dance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他开的药方从大餐到治疗针到让你的脑子飘飘欲仙的玩意，什么都有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about food and chems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈谈食物和药品。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I keep telling you, it's Mister President! Now get back to guarding the gate!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我告诉过你了，是总统“先生”！现在回去守卫大门！

ESP.ORIGINAL: President Daddy, there is a Wastelander who wishes to see you, sir!
ESP.TRADUIT: 总统爸爸，有个废土游民想要见你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mary [0602B89A] (mod) NPC : Flower [0602B89C] (mod) NPC : Rachael [0602B89B] (mod) NPC : Ralph [0602B89D] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am presenting it to our King in Great Britain.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要把它献给我们大不列颠的国王。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No! It can't be! Then the Stars and Stripes have indeed fallen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，怎么会！那么星条旗就真的陨落了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06003A78] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is a sad day, a day that every man, woman and child will remember as they toil in the English salt mines as slaves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是悲伤的一天，所有在英国盐矿当奴隶的男人、女人和小孩都刻骨铭心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06003A78] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Although my brow is heavy, I am honored that you've come to tell me this in person like a true gentleman.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尽管我的眉头紧锁，我还是为你能像一个绅士一样地来告诉我真相而荣幸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06003A78] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are your final orders?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最后的命令是什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06003A78] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It has to be the Declaration of Independence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一定是独立宣言了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why, yes! Your knowledge of American History is quite impressive!
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的！你对美利坚历史的了解真让人佩服！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: What an amazing crown jewel in my collection that would be! The original document created by the people, for the people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这会是我收藏品里的最重要的珍宝！人民发布的文献！为人民谋福祉的文献！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do for fun around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你一般拿什么作消遣？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Heh... well... there's this and that. I keep myself busy. But, really, that's none of your business is it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 又这又那的确实让我很忙，但这不关你的事，对不对？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you support the Enclave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么你要支持英克雷呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because America is the greatest country on Earth... actually... it might be the only country on Earth now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为美利坚是地球上最好的国家……事实上……现在美利坚可能是地球上最后的国家了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you make a lot of your own stuff?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这许多东西都是你自己做的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, pretty much. Take it apart, put it back together. It ain't hard. Sometimes I design my own weapons too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，相当多。把东西拆开后又装起来，这些工作没什么复杂的。有时我还会自己制造武器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wouldn't suggest going there. They don’t treat your kind very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不建议去那，他们对你不会友善。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mocking me? We won't stand for your oppressive mockery any longer! You smoothskin bastards are all the same!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在嘲笑我吗？我们再也不会忍受你的欺压和嘲笑了。你们光皮肤的滚蛋都是一样的坏！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You just can't stand to see a Ghoul make it in this world. It's about time someone taught you some humility. Start running smooth-skin!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们不愿意再看到这个世界上还有僵尸。是时候教教你们学习点人道精神了。光皮肤，逃跑吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: More power to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你更多力量。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a great place to live. But dirty Ghouls like you can't live there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个生活的好地方，但像你一样肮脏的尸鬼是不能住在那的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that so? Ha! That's classic smoothskin bullshit right there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是这样吗？这就是典型的光皮肤的废话！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why is it the moment a Ghoul makes something of himself, you smoothskins get all puffed up and claim responsibility?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么僵尸总是不能过上应得的好日子，而你们光皮肤却养尊处优的，不想为其他人负责？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It really busts you up to see a Ghoul make it to the top, doesn’t it? I'll show you that we ghouls got what it takes. Start running smooth-skin!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会惊讶地看到僵尸是怎么到大厦顶的，难道不是吗？我会给你看看僵尸是怎么做到这一点的，光皮肤，快跑吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Relax. I'm the one that helped get Ghouls into Tenpenny Tower.
ESP.TRADUIT: 放松，我就是那个帮僵尸进住特配尼大厦的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, that's the mungo. Go talk to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是那毛人，去和他谈谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, that's the mungo. Go talk to her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是那毛人，去和她谈谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Practically speak robot, do you? As long as you don't write it in all ones and zeroes, then I guess it'll be fine. Thanks!
ESP.TRADUIT: 实际上就是讲讲机器人，不是吗？只要你不用以0和1组成的语言和我交流就行！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide

ESP.ORIGINAL: In fact, here: just in case your expertise fails you, a few pulse grenades, and my old science textbook. Enjoy!
ESP.TRADUIT: 实际上，如果你的专业知识不够，给：这有一些脉冲手榴弹，还有我的旧科技课本。好好享受！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E96]MS03) Wasteland Survival Guide EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could just write that section for you. Trust me -- I'm an expert.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正好可以帮你写那个章节。相信我 — 我是行家。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds good to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来对我有利。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well then, let's make a deal!
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们做个交易！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Quit hasslin' the merchandise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别再搅扰这些货物了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Forty [060156A0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice one, Butch!
ESP.TRADUIT: 布奇，打得好！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CE28] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hit him again!
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续打他！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CE26] (ID) NPC : [0601CE28] (ID) NPC : [0601CE2A] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Give her another one!
ESP.TRADUIT: 再给她一下！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CE26] (ID) NPC : [0601CE28] (ID) NPC : [0601CE2A] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hit her again!
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续打她！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CE26] (ID) NPC : [0601CE28] (ID) NPC : [0601CE2A] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Head wound! Too bad you're out of morphine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 头部受伤了！太糟了，没有吗啡了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Gutsy [06021EBD] (mod) Quest : ([00015A37]GenericRobot) 00015A37 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : Spoken like a marine drill sergeant EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Chest wound! Don't you wish you had some vitamin M?
ESP.TRADUIT: 胸部受伤了！你不希望有点维生素M吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Gutsy [06021EBD] (mod) Quest : ([00015A37]GenericRobot) 00015A37 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : Spoken like a marine drill sergeant EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pipe down, shorty. I'm going to take care of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 静一静，矮子，我会去处理这事的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the matter, mungo? Can't handle it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 毛人，怎么了？很棘手吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Squirrel [06015686] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're big enough to take care of it. Don't get all cranky with me over it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你既然这么大了，应该可以把事情给解决的，别让我也生气。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Squirrel [06015686] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8D]MQ07) Rescue from Paradise EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here. Take all of them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，把它们都带上。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've done good work. Not only that, but the other Regulators have told me of your other actions in your travels.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你干得漂亮。不单单是那件事情，赏金猎人还和我说过你旅途中的其他伟绩。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sonora Cruz [0606F211] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E8]PerkLawbringer) Lawbringer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good deeds should not go unrewarded, and so I will add on a bonus to your normal bounty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 善有善报，我会在你的基本报酬上再加上一些额外报酬的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sonora Cruz [0606F211] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E8]PerkLawbringer) Lawbringer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So many of the unjust have been dispatched, but so many remain. But ever still, word reaches me that you have gone far beyond what we've asked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 许多邪恶已被铲除，但还有许多依旧逍遥法外。但我知道你所做的远比我们要求的多得多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sonora Cruz [0606F211] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E8]PerkLawbringer) Lawbringer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good deeds should not go unrewarded, and so I will add on a bonus to your normal bounty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 善有善报，我会在你的基本报酬上再加上一些额外报酬的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sonora Cruz [0606F211] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E8]PerkLawbringer) Lawbringer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So many of the unjust have been dispatched, but so many remain.
ESP.TRADUIT: 许多邪恶已被铲除，还有许多依旧逍遥法外。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sonora Cruz [0606F211] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E8]PerkLawbringer) Lawbringer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here is your reward. Spend it well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的报酬，好好花吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sonora Cruz [0606F211] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E8]PerkLawbringer) Lawbringer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your work is impressive. Here is your reward. Don't retire just yet, there is far more to be done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你干得实在太棒了。这是给你的奖励，别懈怠，还有很多未完之事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sonora Cruz [0606F211] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E8]PerkLawbringer) Lawbringer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do with these fingers?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要这些手指干嘛？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing. Nothing at all. They only serve to mark the fact that justice has been done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不用来干嘛，只是为了彰显有多少恶人已经被铲除了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sonora Cruz [0606F211] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E8]PerkLawbringer) Lawbringer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: While we trust our members not to take innocent lives for profit, having a record of the deed is sometimes necessary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们相信我们的弟兄不会为了利益而残害无辜，记录他们的战绩有时候也是必须的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sonora Cruz [0606F211] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E8]PerkLawbringer) Lawbringer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: While we don't have liars in our midst, occasionally we all... embellish a bit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尽管我们中间没有骗子，但有时我们说的话也会加一些修饰的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sonora Cruz [0606F211] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E8]PerkLawbringer) Lawbringer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我加入。
