ESP.ORIGINAL: Fantastic. Well, take this coat. We all wear them. The unrighteous fear the sight of the Regulators.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了，这是我们的制服，把它穿上，恶人们看到赏金猎人的制服都会落荒而逃的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sonora Cruz [0606F211] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E8]PerkLawbringer) Lawbringer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, as for the rest, here's the only thing we want from you: hunt down the evil, the wicked, and the villainous. Bring them to justice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你剩下来要做的事情就是：把坏人、恶棍这些邪恶给扑灭，让他们接受正义的审判。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sonora Cruz [0606F211] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E8]PerkLawbringer) Lawbringer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bring us their fingers as proof of the deed. We'll pay you a bounty for each one. Simple, right? Questions?
ESP.TRADUIT: 把他们的手指带回来作为我们付你赏金的依据。就这么简单，还有什么疑问吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sonora Cruz [0606F211] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E8]PerkLawbringer) Lawbringer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. I want to join you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。我想加入。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fantastic. Take this coat. We all wear them. The unrighteous fear the sight of the Regulators.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了，这是我们的制服，把它穿上，恶人们看到赏金猎人的制服都会落荒而逃的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sonora Cruz [0606F211] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E8]PerkLawbringer) Lawbringer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, as for the rest, here's the only thing we want from you: hunt down the evil, the wicked, and the villainous. Bring them to justice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你剩下来要做的事情就是：把坏人、恶棍这些邪恶给扑灭，让他们接受正义的审判。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sonora Cruz [0606F211] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E8]PerkLawbringer) Lawbringer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bring us their fingers as proof of the deed. We'll pay you a bounty for each one. Simple, right? Questions?
ESP.TRADUIT: 把他们的手指带回来作为我们付你赏金的依据。就这么简单，还有什么疑问吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sonora Cruz [0606F211] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E8]PerkLawbringer) Lawbringer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here. Take all of them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，把它们都带上。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Most excellent. And you have exemplified yourself in the eyes of Littlehorn and Associates.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太棒了，现在里特宏和助手更为关注你了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Daniel Littlehorn [0606F1F2] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E7]PerkContractKiller) Contract Killer EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: One with a heart as black as yours deserves to be rewarded for it. We shall include a bonus in your pay this time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 像你这样心狠手辣的人应该获得奖赏，这次你也会得到奖金的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Daniel Littlehorn [0606F1F2] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E7]PerkContractKiller) Contract Killer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enjoy it. Might I recommend booze? Or gambling? Or perhaps a nice chem habit?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好好花吧。是去酗酒呢？还是赌博？或者是嗑药？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Daniel Littlehorn [0606F1F2] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E7]PerkContractKiller) Contract Killer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Before our exchange, I should tell you: word has reached my ears of your black deeds in the Wastes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我们交易前，我得先和你说明：你在废土上的种种恶行已经传到我们的耳朵里了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Daniel Littlehorn [0606F1F2] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E7]PerkContractKiller) Contract Killer EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Acts such as yours fall in line with the goals of Littlehorn and Associates. And we believe you deserve a bonus for going that extra mile.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的目标是和我们里特宏和助手一样的堕落。只要你更恶毒一些，奖励还会滚滚而来的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Daniel Littlehorn [0606F1F2] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E7]PerkContractKiller) Contract Killer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enjoy it. But by all means, do not let it stop you from walking the path that you're on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好好享受。当然，千万别走上正道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Daniel Littlehorn [0606F1F2] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E7]PerkContractKiller) Contract Killer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Most excellent. We love a good and loyal employee.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了，我们就是喜欢你这样忠诚而又强悍的雇员。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Daniel Littlehorn [0606F1F2] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E7]PerkContractKiller) Contract Killer EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: And, as a good and loyal employee, here is your reward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是给你这样忠诚而又强悍的雇员的奖励。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Daniel Littlehorn [0606F1F2] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E7]PerkContractKiller) Contract Killer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We here at Littlehorn and Associates cannot express our gratitude that your loyalty and service inspires.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们里特宏和助手无法表达对你忠诚和付出的感激之情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Daniel Littlehorn [0606F1F2] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E7]PerkContractKiller) Contract Killer EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here is your payment per our contract. Spend it... well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是约定的酬劳，尽情地花吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Daniel Littlehorn [0606F1F2] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E7]PerkContractKiller) Contract Killer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you, anyway?
ESP.TRADUIT: 对了，还没问你是谁。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about I give you my super suit? Would that make your day, kid?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把我这身行头给你，怎么样？这样彼此都开心，孩子？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Would it ever! You're the best, Mechanist! I'll never forget this!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这样太好了！机械侠，你是最棒的！我不会忘记你的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Would it ever! You're the best, AntAgonizer! I'll never forget this!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这样太好了！痛苦蚁后，你是最棒的！我不会忘记你的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Autographs aren't free. I charge 10 caps for my time. No exceptions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 签名可不是免费的，每次收你10个瓶盖，绝不打折。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, alright. I was going to use this money to buy food, but you're worth it, Mechanist!
ESP.TRADUIT: 行，我本打算这些钱去买些食物的，但你值这个价，机械侠！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, alright. I was going to use this money to buy food, but you're worth it, AntAgonizer!
ESP.TRADUIT: 行，我本打算这些钱去买些食物的，但你值这个价，痛苦蚁后！

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're never going to find the Oasis at this point!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这样的话，我们再也没法去找绿洲了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where did Frank say it was? Damn it! We shouldn't have killed him!
ESP.TRADUIT: 弗兰克说是在哪啊？该死！早知道我们就不把他给干掉了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sydney and I have the Declaration of Independence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和西德尼拿到了《独立宣言》。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh my lord, I never expect... I mean, I am utterly shocked!
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，天啊，我从没想到……我意思是，我太震惊了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence

ESP.ORIGINAL: You two have earned your places in the annals of American History, yes indeed. You will be remembered for this great day!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在美国历史中已经赢得一席之地了。你会和这个伟大的日子一起被铭记！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will award Sydney's promised bounty to her personally. No need to worry yourself about that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会按照约定把奖金给希妮的，这你就不必担心了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enjoy your reward, my friend. You've earned it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 享受你的报酬吧，朋友。你应得的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cool. Let me see the results and I'll fill it out myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看答案，我自己填。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well... all right. Here, take a look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯…好吧。给，看吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CFB7] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect Comment (NAM2) : in a low voice EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd be better if I could get my hands on some caviar, but what can you do? Ha ha ha ha ha.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是我能吃到鱼子酱就好了，但你能做什么呢？哈哈哈哈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I broke a promise to someone and I'd like to buy back the violin for 300 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没办法兑现对某人的诺言，我想用300个瓶盖把小提琴买回来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It takes moxie to admit you've done something wrong. I admire that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 承认错误是得需要很大勇气的，这个我很钦佩。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd be glad to sell it back to you. Here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很高兴把它卖回给你，拿去吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've had a change of heart, Agatha. Here's your violin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿加莎，我改变主意了，小提琴给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You actually got it back. I didn't think you'd bother after that stunt you pulled.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你居然真的把它给找回来了！我以为，你做了错事之后就不会再补救了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's like holding a piece of history in the palm of my hands. Amazing, simply amazing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就像是把一段历史握在了手中一样，这太妙了，实在太美妙了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: It may have been like pulling teeth, but at least you finally brought me the thing. Still, I'm lacking a suitable reward for what you've done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就像拔牙一样的艰难，但你最终还是把它带回来给我了。看我真是没什么好的东西作为给你的奖励。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All I can give you is the frequency to my radio set. Tune in whenever you feel like listening to the strains of an old woman's violin playing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我所能给你的就是一个电台频率。无论何时你想听的时候就调到这频率，来收听一个老妇人的小提琴演奏。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that so? Do it then, Phillips. Set your feral pets upon me. I could use a bit of sport. After I’ve dealt with them, I'll turn my attention to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是那样吗？菲利普斯，那就动手吧，让你疯狂的宠物冲着我来吧，正好我能热热身。等我把他们给处理完之后，我就来对付你了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: After all, you've destroyed my home, murdered my employer. I’ve got something of a score to settle, wouldn't you say?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你把我的家园给毁了，还杀了我的雇主。这笔帐我得给你好好的算一算了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The detonator is right over there. When that switch is activated, the bomb at the center of Megaton goes... boom. THAT will conclude my business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阳台上有个引爆器，只要轻轻地一按开关，在核弹镇中心的核弹就会……轰的一声，然后一切就完结了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Burke [06000A6A] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right then, Burke... er... Mister Burke. I’ll let you get to it. And, um, thanks for your... understanding.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，伯克先生。你会让你去做的。并且，嗯，多谢你的…理解。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That chamber? Right there? With all the radiation? Man, no way. I'll end up dead. Or worse. I could be one of them Ghouls! Ain't gonna happen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说那充满着高辐射的房间吗？没门，我会死掉的，或者是变成僵尸！我是不会去的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Butch, I need you to go into that chamber and turn on the purifier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 布奇，我需要你进入房间开启净化器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You and I both know that's not going to happen. I've saved your sorry ass enough. This one's all you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对你已经仁至义尽了，这次我不会帮你了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Charon, I need you to go into that chamber and turn on the purifier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡隆，我需要你进入房间开启净化器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Honey, you are out of your mind if you think I'm going in there. Find yourself another guinea pig.
ESP.TRADUIT: 亲爱的，要是你认为我会去那的话你就真是疯了，你重新找个实验品吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Clover, I need you to go into that chamber and turn on the purifier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可萝尔，我需要你进入房间开启净化器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck that. Do your own dirty work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他妈的，做你的脏活就好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jericho, I need you to go into that chamber and turn on the purifier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 耶利哥，我需要你进入房间开启净化器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <whine>
ESP.TRADUIT: <哀鸣声>

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think it's time for us to say goodbye, old buddy. Take care of yourself, okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 老兄，我们该说再见了。好好照顾你自己，好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I’m sorry, my companion, but no. We all have our own destinies, and yours culminates here. I would not rob you of that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，我们各有自己的命运，今天是你的终点，我不想改变你的命运。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fawkes, I need you to go into that chamber and turn on the purifier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 福克斯，我需要你进入房间开启净化器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My friend... It's been my pleasure accompanying you, but we both know this is your fight to finish. Stay strong, and honor your father's memory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很乐意能与你为伴，但我们都知道这是你的战斗，继承你父亲的遗志坚强地战斗下去吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Star Paladin Cross, I need you to go into that chamber and turn on the purifier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 星骑士 克罗丝，我需要你进入房间开启净化器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any vault resident seen associating with the so-called "Rebels" will be detained, questioned, and disciplined appropriately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 任何避难所的居民被看到与所谓的反叛者有牵连的话，都会被拘留、询问并受到适度的惩罚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Overseer Mack [0603D346] (mod) NPC : Radio 101 [0002485B] (mod) Quest : ([00071622]RadioVault101PA) Vault 101 PA system EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Order WILL be restored. Discipline WILL be restored. Vault security personnel have been authorized to use deadly force if necessary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 秩序将会恢复，纪律将会重建。避难所的警卫人员已授权在必要情况下可以使用致命的武力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Overseer Mack [0603D346] (mod) NPC : Radio 101 [0002485B] (mod) Quest : ([00071622]RadioVault101PA) Vault 101 PA system EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't let it come to that. This vault will be one big, happy family again. One way or another.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要走到那一步。避难所应该是一个快乐的大家庭，无论如何实现。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Overseer Mack [0603D346] (mod) NPC : Radio 101 [0002485B] (mod) Quest : ([00071622]RadioVault101PA) Vault 101 PA system Comment (NAM2) : Menacing EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any vault resident seen associating with the so-called "Rebels" will be detained, questioned, and disciplined appropriately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 任何避难所的居民被看到与所谓的反叛者有牵连的话，都会被拘留、询问并受到适度的惩罚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) NPC : Radio 101 [0002485B] (mod) Quest : ([00071622]RadioVault101PA) Vault 101 PA system EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Order WILL be restored. Discipline WILL be restored. Vault security personnel have been authorized to use deadly force if necessary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 秩序将会恢复，纪律将会重建。避难所的警卫人员已授权在必要情况下可以使用致命的武力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) NPC : Radio 101 [0002485B] (mod) Quest : ([00071622]RadioVault101PA) Vault 101 PA system EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't let it come to that. Haven't you always been happy? Haven't we always been a… a family?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要走到那一步，你们不是一直都快乐吗？我们不是一直都是个大家庭吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) NPC : Radio 101 [0002485B] (mod) Quest : ([00071622]RadioVault101PA) Vault 101 PA system EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Amata... Stop this madness. You're disrupting everyone's life, everyone's happiness. Come home. Just… come home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿玛塔…别疯了。你是在危害别人的生命和幸福啊。回家吧，快回家吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) NPC : Radio 101 [0002485B] (mod) Quest : ([00071622]RadioVault101PA) Vault 101 PA system EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: And everything can be the way it was.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一切将回复原貌。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) NPC : Radio 101 [0002485B] (mod) Quest : ([00071622]RadioVault101PA) Vault 101 PA system EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you don't activate the purifier right now, you're all going to die!
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是你不把净化器打开，你们全都得死！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) NPC : [06037820] (ID) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! Comment (NAM2) : frantic, desperate EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why haven't you started the purifier? Please, do it now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 为何你还不把净化器给打开呢？快！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) NPC : [06037820] (ID) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You only have about a minute left! Please hurry!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你只有一分钟逃离的时间！赶快！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) NPC : [06037820] (ID) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're still there, the purifier needs to be activated NOW! You don't have much time left!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么还在那？净化器必须立刻激活！你的时间不多了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) NPC : [06037820] (ID) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This isn't solving anything!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这解决不了任何问题的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [0601CE24] (mod) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You seem like a nice woman. Let me get that violin for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是一个善良的老妇人，我去帮你把小提琴带回来吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that's just so sweet of you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你实在是太好了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I feel bad sending you off with nothing like this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么都不给你就让你上路，也不太好吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a small amount of ammunition that my husband left behind. A box of odds and ends. I don't think I've opened it in years.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我丈夫生前留下些弹药。一箱子的零星物品。我大概好多年都没有打开过它了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you do this for me, you're welcome to take whatever you need.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你愿意为我做这事，你可以随便拿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If only you had something to help keep me safe, my little honey bee...
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你有能让我安全一点的办法，我亲爱的……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh my! I didn't know I still had the looks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊！我不知道我容颜依旧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you just made my day you sweet thing! Let me give you something extra to help you on your way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你让我这一天都很快乐！我再给你一些路上用得到的东西吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a small amount of ammunition that my husband left behind. A box of odds and ends. I don't think I've opened it in years.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我丈夫生前留下些弹药。一箱子的零星物品。我大概好多年都没有打开过它了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you do this for me, you're welcome to take whatever you need.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你愿意为我做这事，你可以随便拿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agatha [0603D34A] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA4]MS17) Agatha's Song EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ok, it's right over there. Middle room.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，就在那里。中间的房间。

ESP.ORIGINAL: 120 Caps sounds good to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对我来说，120个瓶盖挺划算的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right at the top of the stairs, honey. That's your room.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就在楼梯上面，亲爱的。那是你的房间。

ESP.ORIGINAL: 120 Caps sounds good to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对我来说，120个瓶盖挺划算的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right at the top of the stairs, honey. The room with the big bed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就在楼梯上面，亲爱的。有大床的那间。

ESP.ORIGINAL: 120 Caps sounds good to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对我来说，120个瓶盖挺划算的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent. Simply venture into the hallway, turn left, first door on your left. That is your room.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太棒了。去走廊，左转，左手边的一间房间就是你的了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds like a fair price. I'll take it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来价钱公道，我接受。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That sounds like a deal. Out in the hallway, turn left, first door on your left. That's your room.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这交易听起来不错，穿过走廊，左转，你左手边的一间房间就是你的了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: 120 Caps sounds good to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对我来说，120个瓶盖挺划算的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Listen up you god-damn puke! You are now wearing prototype medic power armor. You take care of me, and I'll take care of you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我听好了，该死的家伙！你现在穿着的是原型医疗动力装甲。我们得互相照料。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mister Gutsy [06021EBD] (mod) Quest : ([00015A37]GenericRobot) 00015A37 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : Shouted like a marine drill sergeant. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just give me the present already!
ESP.TRADUIT: 快把礼物给我！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, okay! One last question: who's your favorite barbarian? That's right, Grognak! Issue 14, and with no missing pages!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的！最后一个问题：谁是你最爱的野蛮人？没错，就是歌南！第14册，没有一页残缺！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [060300E9] (mod) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast Comment (NAM2) : warmly EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found this in a box of my father's old things, can you believe it? Kind of weird to think about him reading comic books.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到了一箱父亲的旧东西，真是难以置信，里面居然有他看过的漫画书。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [060300E9] (mod) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast Comment (NAM2) : warmly EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I'd better let you get back to "mingling" with your guests. We'll talk later, okay? Happy birthday.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你得去和你的客人们谈天说地了，我们之后再谈！生日快乐！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [060300E9] (mod) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast Comment (NAM2) : warmly EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um... a date with Christine Kendall?
ESP.TRADUIT: 和克里斯廷·肯德尔约会？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gross! I didn't think you even liked girls. And you know what I mean, before you say something rude about me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天！我还以为你不喜欢女孩呢。你知道我什么意思，不许瞎说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [060300E9] (mod) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast Comment (NAM2) : cracking herself up EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess maybe I should give this to someone else... someone who likes Grognak the Barbarian better than Mean Christine...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不如把这个给其他人吧……那些喜欢《野蛮人歌南》、而不是小气的克里斯廷的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [060300E9] (mod) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast Comment (NAM2) : cracking herself up EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: The question is, how could you tell the difference? Ha ha ha.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问题是你分得清差别吗？哈哈哈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [060300E9] (mod) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast Comment (NAM2) : cracking herself up EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I really have no idea...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真是不知道了……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! I knew I'd surprise you. Who's your favorite barbarian? That's right, Grognak! Issue 14, and with no missing pages!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的！就知道你不知道。谁是你最爱的野蛮人？没错，就是歌南！第14册，没有一页残缺！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [060300E9] (mod) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast Comment (NAM2) : warmly EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found this in a box of my father's old things, believe it or not. Imagine him reading comic books. I guess everybody was ten once.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到了一箱父亲的旧东西，真是难以置信，原来他也看过漫画书。我想每个人都有十岁的时候吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [060300E9] (mod) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast Comment (NAM2) : warmly EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'd better let you get back to "mingling" with your guests. We'll talk later, okay? Happy birthday.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你得去和你的客人们谈天说地了，我们之后再谈！生日快乐！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [060300E9] (mod) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast Comment (NAM2) : warmly EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Yawn> That's really really interesting.
ESP.TRADUIT: <哈欠>真是太有趣了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, most people don't give a thought to their Pip-Boy as long as it keeps working.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，许多人对自己的哔哔小子的态度是，只要不坏，就不管它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06031648] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, anyway, I got you this for your birthday. It isn't much and you probably already have one, but there you go. Happy birthday.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把它作为你的生日礼物，它不是很贵重而且可能你已经有了，但还是要给你，再说一句生日快乐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06031648] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, whatever. Did you bring me anything for my birthday?
ESP.TRADUIT: 行，你给我带什么生日礼物来了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here am I going on about your Pip-Boy and I clean forgot about your present!
ESP.TRADUIT: 瞧我光顾聊哔哔小子了，差点忘了给你的礼物！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06031648] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here you go. Happy birthday! It's not much, but I hope you like it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你吧。生日快乐！虽然不是很值钱的礼物，但还是希望你能喜欢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06031648] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks, Stanley.
ESP.TRADUIT: 斯坦利，多谢了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't mention it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别客气。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06031648] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh yes, I almost forgot. Happy birthday! It's not much, but I hope you like it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我差点忘了，祝你生日快乐！虽然不是很值钱的礼物，但还是希望你能喜欢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06031648] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: A poem? You've got to be kidding me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一首诗？你一定是在开玩笑吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, really, I wrote it just for you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不开玩笑，我真的是写了一首诗给你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060309AC] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I never just copy one of my old poems... well, there was that one Founder's Day where I couldn't rhyme anything with Overseer...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从来不照搬以前写的诗……不过有一次“创立日”的时候，我歌颂监督者时就找不到押韵的词，只好……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060309AC] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: But you deserve nothing less than a brand new poem. You can keep it in your Pip-Boy and read it whenever you want!
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是写给你的必须是一首崭新的诗，你可以把它存到哔哔小子里面，想看随时可以看！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060309AC] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um... thanks. I guess. Did you get me anything else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃……谢了。我说，你还有其它什么东西给我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't be silly! One poem per birthday, that's my rule! Ha ha. If I gave you two, think how jealous Butch would be, ha ha.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别傻了！每个生日只能获得一首诗，这是规矩！要是我给你两首的话，布奇可是会吃醋的哦！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060309AC] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast Comment (NAM2) : airhead. nothing you say can dent her chipperness. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you. I will treasure it always. Is that all?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你，我会一直珍藏着的。没别的了吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course! Run along now, dearie, and have yourself a wonderful birthday!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然！去玩吧，小亲亲，祝你生日开心！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060309AC] (ID) Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need a drink.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要来点饮料。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come around to where I can see ya.
ESP.TRADUIT: 站到我能看到你的地方来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0603034E] (ID) Quest : ([0602A274]MS10) Oasis Comment (NAM2) : can't see the person who is approaching EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Jukebox.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说什么是自动点唱机。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you feel like filling your place with a whole bunch of music, switch this beautiful Pre-War antique on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要你把这战前古董的开关打开，就能让房子立刻充满着美妙的音乐。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, let me take a look at your stuff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我来看看你的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure thing!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm going to find a non-violent solution to your Ghoul problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想找一个和平的方法来解决尸鬼的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a laugh. Roy Phillips can't be reasoned with. Trust me. But go ahead and try to talk some sense into him. It's your funeral.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这太可笑了，罗伊·菲利普斯完全不可理喻。请相信我，要是你非要去找他讲道理的话是必死无疑的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : mocking and fatalistic EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: They've holed up in the nearby metro tunnels. They're living with packs of Feral Ghouls. They've barred the main entrance. Go through the train yard.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们就住在附近的地铁隧道里。他们和凶悍僵尸生活在一起，而且还把紧急出口给堵住了，所以你要经过一段铁轨才能进入。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : mocking and fatalistic EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good luck, kid. You're gonna need it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 祝你好运，你会用得上这东西的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : mocking and fatalistic EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a laugh. Roy Phillips can't be reasoned with. Trust me. But go ahead and try to talk some sense into him. It's your funeral.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这太可笑了，罗伊·菲利普斯完全不可理喻。请相信我，要是你非要去找他讲道理的话是必死无疑的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : mocking and fatalistic EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good luck, kid. You're gonna need it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 祝你好运，你会用得上这东西的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : mocking and fatalistic

ESP.ORIGINAL: MS12WhatIsGhoul
ESP.TRADUIT: MS12WhatIs僵尸

ESP.ORIGINAL: You serious? You don't know what a Ghoul is?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是认真的吗？你知道什么是僵尸吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : angrily talking about killing a disgusting creature before it gets even more dangerous EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: A goddamn disaster waiting to happen that's what they are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们就是随时可能惹事的麻烦玩意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : angrily talking about killing a disgusting creature before it gets even more dangerous EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, maybe you can get over the fact they look like someone took a cheese grater to their face. But it's what you don't see that's the problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，你看得到的是他们在脸上涂的一层奶酪，你看不到的是他们所制造的麻烦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : angrily talking about killing a disgusting creature before it gets even more dangerous EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: The radiation slowly eats away their brain, then they go zombie on you. It's better for everyone to kill them before all that, if you ask me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 辐射缓慢地侵蚀着他们的大脑，之后把他们变成了活死尸。要是我说的话，最好还是把他们统统杀掉最好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : angrily talking about killing a disgusting creature before it gets even more dangerous EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the hell's a Ghoul anyway? Some kind of diseased human?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那该死的僵尸到底是什么？生病的人类吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you think your leaders will keep you safe if the bombs fall? You will die while the Wall Street gang and their hangers-on live like kings in...
ESP.TRADUIT: 当核弹爆炸时，你以为领导人会管你的死活吗？当华尔街那群滚蛋和他们的傀儡们花天酒地时，你默默地死去了……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : People's Republic of America Radio [0007C708] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : delivered in a chinese accent if possible. Cuts off abruptly as if the tape broke. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your boys are dying on the Alaska front, and all for nothing. Bring them home, before it is too late.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们的孩子正在阿拉斯加无谓地丧生。趁为时未晚，快让他们回家吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : People's Republic of America Radio [0007C708] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : delivered in a chinese accent if possible EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Jukebox.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说什么是自动点唱机。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you feel like filling your place with a whole bunch of music, switch this beautiful Pre-War antique on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要你把这战前古董的开关打开，就能让房子立刻充满着美妙的音乐。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, let me take a look at your stuff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我来看看你的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure thing!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now we're talkin'.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在我们进入正题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jack says you have some pie for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 杰克说你这有派？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, of course. Here you are! Enjoy!
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错。给你！好好享受！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, Jack. No problem at all. I saw nothing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 杰克，放心吧。一切正常，我什么都没看见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that's good to hear, friend! Very good to hear, indeed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 朋友，听到你这么说，我实在太高兴！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You wouldn't believe how judgmental some people can be. Honestly. All I'm trying to do is keep my family happy and fed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有些人的偏执到了让你无法想象的程度。实话说，我只是在努力维持家人的欢乐与温饱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell you what, talk to Linda. She'll give you some of her special meat pie. It's to die for! Ha! Hahaha... but not you. You're good people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我跟你讲，你去跟琳达去谈谈。她会给你一些特制的肉派。值得为它而死！哈哈哈哈哈哈哈…开玩笑了，你不会的。你是个好人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, whatever works for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想怎么做就怎么做吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, not really. Everyone does what they have to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，并不是这样，每人都有自己该做的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that's good to hear, friend! Very good to hear, indeed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 朋友，听到你这么说，我实在太高兴！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You wouldn't believe how judgmental some people can be. Honestly. All I'm trying to do is keep my family happy and fed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有些人的偏执到了让你无法想象的程度。实话说，我只是在努力维持家人的欢乐与温饱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell you what, talk to Linda. She'll give you some of her special meat pie. It's to die for! Ha! Hahaha... but not you. You're good people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我跟你讲，你去跟琳达去谈谈。她会给你一些特制的肉派。值得为它而死！哈哈哈哈哈哈哈…开玩笑了，你不会的。你是个好人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know the drill, people. Stay back until the field is down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们也知道。在这解决前离远一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hold positions. Let the robot do its job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 保持距离，让机器人先来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Move it, Pride. Double time!
ESP.TRADUIT: “里昂斯的骄傲”，行动！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, this is it. Go, go, go!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，出发吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Player agrees to find Stealth Boy stockpile.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玩家同意找到隐身小子存货。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, Antler says we leave here as soon as we get Stealth Boys.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，鹿角说我们一旦得到隐身小子就马上离开这里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me give you key. Antler had me lock the door. The Ghoul inside not expecting a human. Maybe he don't shoot you. Maybe he will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你钥匙。鹿角让我锁的门。里面的尸鬼肯定想不到会有人类进来。可能他会向你开枪，也可能不会。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll find the StealthBoy stockpile for you if your kin will leave this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会找到那堆隐身小子的，但你要让你的族人离开这里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, Antler says we leave here as soon as we get Stealth Boys.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，鹿角说我们一旦得到隐身小子就马上离开这里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me give you key. Antler had me lock the door. The Ghoul inside not expecting a human. Maybe he don't shoot you. Maybe he will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你钥匙。鹿角让我锁的门。里面的尸鬼肯定想不到会有人类进来。可能他会向你开枪，也可能不会。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can find the stockpile of Stealth Boys for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能帮你找到存放的隐身小子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Player asks why Harland's room can't be searched.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玩家询问为何不能搜索哈兰德的房间。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A Ghoul. But not squishy like others. This Ghoul is tough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 里头有个尸鬼，但不像其他尸鬼那么弱。这个尸鬼很厉害。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought Antler said send my kin into that room, but three died. Ghoul is a crack shot and set traps too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以为鹿角要让我派族人进入那个房间，但却死了三个。那尸鬼是个神枪手，还布置了陷阱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: After, I realize I heard Antler wrong. So I lock the door to keep kin out and wait for Antler to tell me what to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 之后，我才意识到我把鹿角的话听岔了。于是我锁上了那个房间，不让族人进去，再等待鹿角的进一步指示。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then you come along. Antler says you are solution.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后你来了。鹿角说了，你能解决问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why can't you search the last room?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么不搜查最后的房间？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pay attention when I speak! I said Ghoul is a crack shot and sets traps!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说话的时候你要注意听！我说了，那个尸鬼是神枪手，还布了陷阱！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Too dangerous for us. Okay for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对我们来说太危险了。不过你能搞得定。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me again why you can't search the room?
ESP.TRADUIT: 再说一遍，为什么你不去搜查最后那个房间？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Player asks how to help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玩家询问如何帮忙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Told you already. Antler wants Nightkin to have all the Stealth Boys in the bad room. With the Ghoul.
ESP.TRADUIT: 已经告诉过你了。鹿角想让夜行族得到所有的隐身小子。就在那间有尸鬼的房间里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you want me to do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要让我做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Player says why he or she is here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玩家说他或她为何来此。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A human who is friend to Ghouls? Suspicious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 人类会是尸鬼的朋友？可疑。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mean the ones upstairs. Antler used intercom, told them stay put. But they want to come down in basement anyways?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你指的是楼上的那些家伙。鹿角已经用对讲机授意，要他们留在原地。但是他们无论如何都想到地下室去吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I cannot allow. My kin are... not right in head like I am. They attack you on sight. Ghouls too. They crazy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不允许。我的手下...不像我一样还头脑正常。他们一看见你就会攻击。尸鬼们也一样。他们都疯了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your Ghoul friends have to wait until you find what Antler brought us to get.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的尸鬼朋友必须等着，直到你找到鹿角要我们找的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I came here on behalf of the Ghouls upstairs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我代表楼上的尸鬼来这儿与你们谈判。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me a joke.
ESP.TRADUIT: 讲个笑话吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A neutron walks into a bar. "How much for a drink here, anyway?" To which the bartender responds, "For you, no charge."
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个中子走进了一家酒吧，对老板说：“我想要一杯电解水，多少钱？”老板惊讶地问，“哦，原来你也要充电啊？”

ESP.ORIGINAL: He needs to talk to someone from the outside, to get some perspective.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他得和外面的人说说话，了解些外面的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd never thought of it that way. I suppose he should get a chance to talk to someone like you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从没想到这点，我想他应该和你这样的人谈谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Justin [060200C9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's the password to his isolation area. Just please don't mention my name to Vance about this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是去他那区域的密码。不要把这事告诉万斯啊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're secure in these tunnels. Why try to get into Tenpenny, anyway?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在隧道里明明很安全，为何要跑到特佩尼来？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ghouls aren't built for luxury and comfort, is that it? You think Ghouls belong scurrying around in the dark dank underbelly of the Wasteland?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认为僵尸都不应享受舒适豪华生活吗？你认为他们就该在阴暗潮湿的地下生活居住吗？ ?
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : getting angry at a bigot EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got a lot of nerve.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你胆子可真不小。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : getting angry at a bigot EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've met them. Roy Phillips and those other Ghouls don't seem all that bad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我见过他们了。罗伊·菲利普斯那几只尸鬼似乎没有那么糟糕。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look kid. I don't care what you think about them. Unless Tenpenny says otherwise. They aren't allowed in here. End of story. Quit wasting my time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不在乎你对他们的看法是怎样的。除非特佩尼能改变他的想法，否则他们是不可能进来的，就说这么多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chief Gustavo [0601E379] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : annoyed EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm here to see Roy Phillips.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是来这见罗伊·菲利普斯的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh yeah? Is he expecting you? Well then, run along. It's not wise to keep Roy waiting. Has a bit of a temper that one. You watch yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是吗？你和他有约吗？那么，进来吧。让罗伊等着可不好。他脾气不小，你自己多加小心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601DC19] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : suspicious and giving warning EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need you to repair my stuff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要你来帮我修修东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No problem at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 完全没问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's have a look at it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll see what I can do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我尽量想想办法。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I made you do this!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要怪我！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lay into me! I deserve it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 来打我吧！我活该！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh oh! I did something bad!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哎哟！我可干坏事了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: God protect me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 上帝保佑！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lord, make me thy instrument!
ESP.TRADUIT: 主啊，请保佑我！

ESP.ORIGINAL: God and liberty!
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了上帝与自由！

ESP.ORIGINAL: -The Lobotomite is no proof against our amazing sensors!-
ESP.TRADUIT: -在我们惊人的传感器下，无脑人无所遁形。-

ESP.ORIGINAL: *Remember that time I suggested we get bodyguards? Yeah, that woulda been nice, huh?*
ESP.TRADUIT: *记得那次我说我们需要保镖么？对，那应该很不错，哼？*

ESP.ORIGINAL: THINK TANK, FORM OF - TACTIC TRIANGLE!
ESP.TRADUIT: 思想体，组成战术队形！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抓住你了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's end this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们结束这一切。

ESP.ORIGINAL: End of the road.
ESP.TRADUIT: 穷途末路。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll see what you stand for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们看看你为谁而战。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take positions!
ESP.TRADUIT: 所有人就位！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Flank 'em!
ESP.TRADUIT: 包抄他们！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cover me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 掩护我！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Light 'em up!
ESP.TRADUIT: 点燃他们！

ESP.ORIGINAL: For the Brotherhood!
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了兄弟会！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Leave some for me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我留点！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to get some licks in, too!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也想分一杯羹！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, let's show them how Kings rumble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错，让他们瞧瞧猫王帮是怎么干架的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Attack!
ESP.TRADUIT: 进攻！

ESP.ORIGINAL: In the name of Dr. Mobius!
ESP.TRADUIT: 以莫比乌斯博士的名义！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Destroy the intruder, my minion!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的仆从们，消灭侵略者！

ESP.ORIGINAL: We will crush them!
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们摧毁他们！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Destroy them all!
ESP.TRADUIT: 把他们都消灭掉！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get them! Get them all!
ESP.TRADUIT: 干掉他们！把他们全干掉！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look out!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当心！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shtairb, chin dee!
ESP.TRADUIT: 史吧，魔鬼！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sohl tyeh!
ESP.TRADUIT: 窝们肘！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dah ah hi meer!
ESP.TRADUIT: 来打窝！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ready as I'll ever be.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我早准备好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here it comes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: One more time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再来一次。

ESP.ORIGINAL: To the Bone Orchard you go!
ESP.TRADUIT: 下墓地去吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Draw, pardner!
ESP.TRADUIT: 拔枪吧，朋友！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Howdy, pardner!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，朋友！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm game.
ESP.TRADUIT: 乐意奉陪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's get this over with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们把这事了结。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm with ya!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和你一起上！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 知道了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here I go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm comin', too!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也来！

ESP.ORIGINAL: This'll be fun!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好戏开始了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Been years since I did this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 已经好几年没活动筋骨了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's get 'em!
ESP.TRADUIT: 咱们一起上！

ESP.ORIGINAL: This should be over quick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很快就能结束的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Leave it to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 交给我吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 开始了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bring it on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 放马过来吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're done for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你完蛋了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gary!
ESP.TRADUIT: 加里！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Flank 'em!
ESP.TRADUIT: 包抄他们！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got your back!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我掩护你！

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll get 'em.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们会抓到他们的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look out!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当心！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where?
ESP.TRADUIT: 敌人在哪？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got it covered.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会提供掩护的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听你的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got your back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会掩护你的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fighting's not my strong suit, but I'll see what I can do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 打仗虽然不是我的强项，但我还是尽力而为。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm on it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 交给我好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, boss. You lead the charge, I'll follow as fast as my arthritic, rotting knees can carry me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，老大。你带头，我就算废了这条老腿，也心甘情愿，万死不辞。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You want to send an elderly, half-decrepit Ghoul into combat? Your tactical brilliance is unmatched, boss.
ESP.TRADUIT: 您想派我这个半死不活的老尸鬼去打架？您可真是神机妙算哪，老大。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure thing, boss. You betcha.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，老大。我听你的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well now, what's all this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哎呀，瞧瞧这都算什么啊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looks like a party.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来要开派对了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caught me good and pissed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来的可真是时候。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry, pumpkin, grandma's here to help!
ESP.TRADUIT: 别怕，小南瓜，奶奶就是来帮你的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Grandma's coming, babies!
ESP.TRADUIT: 奶奶这就来，宝贝！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Leo! Try not to chop our friends this time!
ESP.TRADUIT: 利奥！这次千万别再砍我们的朋友了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're no match for the power of Mobius!
ESP.TRADUIT: 莫比乌斯的力量势不可挡！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Feel the wrath of the science of X-42!
ESP.TRADUIT: 感受X-42科学的愤怒吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Deyai-yoo, devil!
ESP.TRADUIT: 去死八，恶魔！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wes run!
ESP.TRADUIT: 刨起来！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nikumpa me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟窝打！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Momewi de luchoo!
ESP.TRADUIT: 战斗的时后到叻！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mes luchoo ahorla!
ESP.TRADUIT: 窝们现在战斗吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Me derote katu!
ESP.TRADUIT: 窝要打拜尼！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hot lead outbound, yes sir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 遵命，长官，开火。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lock and load!
ESP.TRADUIT: 装弹上膛、准备射击！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yea though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，虽然我穿过笼罩死亡阴影的山谷。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Colvin [0601D432] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : prayer as he starts combat EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see 'em!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看见他们了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Colvin [0601D432] (mod) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes sir!
ESP.TRADUIT: 是长官！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Colvin [0601D432] (mod) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Over there... get 'em!
ESP.TRADUIT: 就在那边，干掉他们！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Colvin [0601D432] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Spread out and flank 'em.
ESP.TRADUIT: 散开，从侧翼包抄。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Colvin [0601D432] (mod) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Targets engaged!
ESP.TRADUIT: 与目标交战！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Colvin [0601D432] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take 'em out!
ESP.TRADUIT: 干掉他们!
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Knight Captain Colvin [0601D432] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not this time, Muties!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这次不行，变种人！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Combat beeping>
ESP.TRADUIT: <战斗的哔哔声>

ESP.ORIGINAL: A challenge!
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个挑战！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You dare to cross Dr. Mobius!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你胆敢和莫比乌斯博士作对！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will reduce you to atoms! I mean, a more chaotic, painful array of atoms.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要把你粉碎成原子！一堆混乱、痛苦的原子！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Beginning dissection. And vivisection.
ESP.TRADUIT: 开始解剖，以及活体解剖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's take them!
ESP.TRADUIT: 来吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: This one's mine!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个人是我的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我帮你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's go!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们走！

ESP.ORIGINAL: For the Sorrows!
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了悲恸部落！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hyah!
ESP.TRADUIT: 呀！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Arrrooooooooooohnhrhnhr.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊呜呜呜呜呜呜啊啊啊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So hungry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好饿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Time to feed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该吃东西了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So be it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就来吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't have time for this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可没时间玩这套。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just wanted a little peace and quiet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只想要片刻的清静。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Time to make some music.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该起音乐了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Strike up the band.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好戏开始。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Christine's eyes narrow, stance changes.]
ESP.TRADUIT: [克莉丝汀眯起眼睛，换了个姿势。]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dean Domino [010012FE] (file) NPC : Christine [010012FF] (file) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Engaging.
ESP.TRADUIT: 发现敌人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Entering combat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 进入战斗。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Use of force authorized.
ESP.TRADUIT: 允许使用武器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: For Caesar!
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了凯撒！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Death to the Legion's enemies!
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团的敌人必亡!

ESP.ORIGINAL: Die, Profligate!
ESP.TRADUIT: 去死吧，荒淫之人！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah! Tear them apart!
ESP.TRADUIT: 把他们给撕碎！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here. Take back the money. I don't want to take medicine away from the town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把你的钱收回去。我可不会带药出城。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh thank you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，谢谢你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : relieved EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll think about it, but I can't rescue your friends now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会考虑的，但我此刻无法帮你救出你同伴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh. Well... If you change your mind... we'd be awfully grateful. Those are our friends...
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦……如果你能改变主意……我们会非常感激。那是我们的朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kimba [0602AB94] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : let down and depressed and imploring EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you have for sale?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这卖些什么呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fresh out of the hands of some mark. Take a look!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从佣兵那儿进来的一批新货，来看看！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Smiling Jack [060824AB] (mod) Quest : ([06028930]GenericRaider) 06028930 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fresh out of the hands of some mark. Take a look!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从佣兵那儿进来的一批新货，来看看！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Smiling Jack [060824AB] (mod) Quest : ([06028930]GenericRaider) 06028930 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My boy is very sick and needs medical assistance, please help us if you can! We are listening for your response on 3,950 kHz.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的孩子病得很重，须要医疗的援助，如果你能帮忙请伸出援手！我们在3950赫兹等候回应。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My family and I have taken refuge in a drainage chamber not to far from a radio relay tower outside of D.C.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和家人在特区无线电转播台旁的一个排水通道里避难。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, Doc. Will this Fire Ant Nectar do you any good?
ESP.TRADUIT: 博士，火蚁露有什么用吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why, yes it would.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然有用。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would be more than happy to take that off your hands if you'd like.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会非常乐意得到那玩意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you can gather more for me, I would certainly love to have them. I'm certain Marigold's tunnels are rife with the original brood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是你能再弄些来的话，我会很乐意都收下的。我知道马利哥德的隧道里有非常多的原种蚂蚁。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Visitor, sir. He wanted to see you, and... well, there's not much I could do to stop him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是个来访者，先生，他想要见见你，而且我也阻止不了他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060C09D5] (ID) NPC : [06027057] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : Very worried - is sure that something very bad is about to go down. EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Visitor, sir. She wanted to see you, and... well, there's not much I could do to stop her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是个来访者，先生，她想要见见你，而且我也阻止不了她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060C09D5] (ID) NPC : [06027057] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : Very worried - is sure that something very bad is about to go down. EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Amata's up there, in the clinic with the rest of them. I'd take you closer, but they don't get along with security. Good luck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿玛塔就在上面，和其余的人待在诊所里。我本想带你过去的，但他们很抵触警卫。祝你好运。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060C09D5] (ID) NPC : [06027057] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : Worried, but well-meaning EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, sweetie. What can you tell me about Moriarty's terminal? I need in...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能跟我说说莫里亚蒂的终端吗？我需要进入……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mmmmm. I bet you want in. But enough about us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你想进入。不过是你也无妨。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nova [06000A63] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's the password. Just make sure he isn't around when you use it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是密码，你输入的时候要确保他没在旁边。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nova [06000A63] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, sweetie. I'd love to spend time with you, but I need to find my Dad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，甜心，我喜欢陪着你，可我得去找我父亲。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mmmm. I'd love to spend time with you too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也想和你待一起。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nova [06000A63] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I... can help you. Get into the back office of this place. Moriarty keeps a terminal there. Everything you want is inside the terminal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯…我…可以帮你，去到这里后面的办公室里。莫里亚蒂在那有个系统终端机，里面会有你想知道的一切。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nova [06000A63] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's the password to it. Too bad you're so young, kid. I could teach you some stuff you'd never forget...
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是进入系统的密码，你嫩得让我心疼，不然我可以教你一些终身难忘的东西……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nova [06000A63] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, if you can give me more information or point me in the right direction...
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，要是你可以再给点信息或者给我个方向……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I'll help you, then Moriarty kicks my sweet ass out the door.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错，我可以帮你，莫里亚蒂也可以帮我滚蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nova [06000A63] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, kid. If you want to know more, Moriarty is the only one who's going to help you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不好意思，小朋友，要是你还想再知道些什么，只能去找莫里亚蒂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nova [06000A63] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Talk to Gob. He hates Moriarty more than I do. Maybe he'll tell you something, but I doubt it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去和盖博谈谈，他比我更讨厌莫里亚蒂，或许他会跟你说点什么，不过我可不保证。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nova [06000A63] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enough with the tough chick routine. Tell me more!
ESP.TRADUIT: 废话免了。说重点！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ohhh. You like it rough, huh? Well, that costs extra.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想简单粗暴地套出消息，那得要额外的钱了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nova [06000A63] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Beat it, kid. Go look for Daddy somewhere else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 闪远，小鬼。要找你爸爸去别处。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nova [06000A63] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I talked to Moriarty already, and he's trying to charge me for the info.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和莫里亚蒂谈过了，但是他的消息得付钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha ha. Yeah, that's Colin's style all right. He sells information so much, you'd think the bar was just a hobby.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈，那就是科林的风格了，他主业是倒卖消息，酒吧不过是他的业余爱好罢了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nova [06000A63] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Help me get into that terminal, Nova. Finding my Dad means everything to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 诺瓦，帮我进入电脑系统终端。找到父亲对我来说意味着一切。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, all right. You seem like a good kid. It isn't your fault Moriarty is such an asshole.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你看上去是个好孩子，莫里亚蒂那混蛋，这不是你的错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nova [06000A63] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's the password. Just don't mention to anyone that I gave it to you or I might be out on my ass like Silver.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是密码，不要和任何人说，不然我会像席尔瓦一样滚蛋的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nova [06000A63] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I really need to get into that terminal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真的得看看那终端。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, Mister Moriarty never lets me back there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，莫里亚蒂再也不准我回那里了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you need to get into the terminal, you should talk to Nova. She'll help you... but it may be expensive if you catch my meaning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是你想进入终端的话就应该去问问诺瓦。她会帮你的……不过代价可能很昂贵，如果你明白我什么意思的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's all this about Galaxy News Radio?
ESP.TRADUIT: 银河新闻电台是个什么样的电台？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Galaxy News Radio is some loudmouth radio station located in the ruins of D.C.
ESP.TRADUIT: 银河新闻电台是特区废墟上的一个八卦电台。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Three Dog, the king of that looney bin, keeps yapping about fighting some Good Fight or something. A bunch of crap.
ESP.TRADUIT: 三狗，就是个废话大王，总是在那胡扯什么圣战。那都是在胡说八道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I suppose if you wanted to know what was going on in the Wasteland, that's the place to go. Me, I could care less.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是你想知道废土上的什么事情的话，最好去那问问，我没那闲工夫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mister Moriarty says we can keep it on. It's a good radio station.
ESP.TRADUIT: 莫里亚蒂先生说我们可以听一下这个电台，它还不错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I like hearing the DJ, Three Dog and how he's helping to fight the Good Fight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我喜欢听那个主播三狗，还有他怎么协助圣战的故事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sigh. If only I was a part of that instead of being stuck in this dive...
ESP.TRADUIT: 唉，要是我是那传说中的人物而不是被困在这该多好啊……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you, father. I'll do my best to keep us all safe, inside the Vault and beyond.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢，父亲。不管是不是在避难所里，我都会尽最大努力来保护我们的安全的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [0602549E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : Understanding the magnitude of this event, and stepping up to meet it. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Amata, I appoint you Overseer in my place. You've proven you have what it takes to make hard choices for the good of the Vault.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿玛塔，我任命你代替我做监督者。你已经证明了你能站在避难所的角度做出艰难抉择。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : Beamingly proud EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Father!
ESP.TRADUIT: 父亲！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [0602549E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : Stunned, but not entirely unpleasantly EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is why I cannot remain your Overseer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，我不再适合担任大家的监督者了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know I have made these mistakes. And I would make them again if I had to do so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道我犯了不少错误。而且如果有机会，我也许还会接着犯错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lives have been lost, but perhaps worse than that, lives have been stopped. And in my attempts to keep you safe, I have kept you from growing up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们付出了生命的代价，或许更糟糕的是，生命已经终止。我试图保证你们的安全，却阻止了你们的成长。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : Emphasis on "stopped" in comparison to "lost". EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: In my attempts to keep us all safe, I have been, perhaps, overzealous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我一直在试图保护我们大家的安全，或许有些太过热心了吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Amata... Everyone... Listen closely. After a discussion with your friend, I've made an important decision.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿玛塔…各位…请仔细听好。在和你们的朋友讨论后，我做出一个重要决定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0602D043] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : Tense, a little sad. Overseer hesitates slightly before saying "friend", and says it like a nasty word. EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I tried to rescue your friends but there were... complications.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我试图救你的朋友，但那……情况复杂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mean they're dead, don't you? Well, I guess you tried. That's more than we could have asked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的意思是他们都死了？我想你已尽力了，那已超乎我们所求了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : dejected EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: On behalf of Big Town, take this. It's not much, but at least it's a token of our appreciation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我代表大镇，给你。这些东西虽然不是很多，但也代表着大镇对你的感激之情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : dejected EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not like any of us are going to be alive long enough to enjoy it anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 反正我们也没有谁能活着享用它了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : dejected EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I guess you tried. That's more than we could have asked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你尽力了。已经已超乎我们所求。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : dejected EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: On behalf of Big Town, take this. It's not much, but at least it's a token of our appreciation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我代表大镇，给你.这些东西虽然不是很多，但也代表着大镇对你的感激之情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : dejected EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not like any of us are going to be alive long enough to enjoy it anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 反正我们也没有谁能活着享用它了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town Comment (NAM2) : dejected EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's what I was afraid of. Well, at least you tried.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那正是我所担心的。好了，至少你尽力了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take this. It's not like any of us are going to be alive long enough to enjoy it anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，拿着。反正我们也没有谁能活着享用它了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I rescued Shorty. Red didn't make it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我救了“矮子”，没救到瑞德。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's what I was afraid of. Well, at least you tried.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那正是我所担心的。好了，至少你尽力了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take this. It's not like any of us are going to be alive long enough to enjoy it anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，拿着。反正我们也没有谁能活着享用它了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) NPC : Shorty [0602AB95] (mod) Quest : ([06014E94]MS01) Big Trouble in Big Town EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your friends are dead. Deal with it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的朋友都死了，节哀。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, but only one serving. We've got too many mouths to feed already.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，但只能接纳一个。我们已经有太多人要养活了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like some food.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要些食物。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have the Declaration of Independence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有《独立宣言》。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh my lord, I never expect... I mean, I am utterly shocked!
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，天啊，我从没想到……我意思是，我太震惊了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have earned your place in the annals of American History, yes indeed. You will be remembered for this great day!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在美国历史中已经赢得一席之地了。你会和这个伟大的日子一起被铭记！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I understand the road was difficult, so allow me to present you with an extra bonus to perhaps whet your appetite for future endeavors.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道世道艰难，所以请收下这额外的报酬，或许能激励你未来能更加努力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enjoy your reward, my friend. You've earned it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 享受你的报酬吧，朋友。你应得的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, you keep it. You may need it more than I do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，你拿着。你可能会比我更需要它。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well... okay. I guess it may come in handy if I run into any Radroaches.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯……好吧。我想在遇到辐射蟑螂时，它会派上用场的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DD] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : deep breath before the plunge

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right. I'll try to meet you at the exit. Watch out for security. Good luck!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。我会在出口处和你碰面。小心警卫。祝你好运！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060230DD] (ID) Quest : ([06014E86]CG04) Escape! Comment (NAM2) : deep breath before the plunge

ESP.ORIGINAL: Issue shutdown command alpha-seven-three. Initiate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 发出关闭指令A-7-3。开始。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Affirmative. Offloading command protocols and beginning shutdown sequence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 确定。卸载命令协定并开始关机程序。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06003A78] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shutting down in 3... 2... 1.
ESP.TRADUIT: 关闭倒计时3…2…1。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06003A78] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are your command options?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的命令选项是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can currently be ordered to shut down, resume my previous programming state, or resume my original functions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可以命令我：关闭、恢复上次状态、以及恢复初始功能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06003A78] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's this mutually beneficial offer you mentioned?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说的互利提议是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got this Mesmetron thing. It's some kind of stun gun. I'd like you to test it out for me. Should make getting slaves easier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我得到了这把催眠枪。它是种电击枪。我想让你帮我测试下它，用它来抓奴隶应该会更容易的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You take this Mezzer. Shoot it at some poor schmuck. While he's in la-la-land, you slip one of these collars over his head.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你拿着这把催眠枪，去射击那些可怜的笨蛋。当他躺在地…地…地上时，你就用一个项圈套住他的脑袋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Be careful with that collar. It'll explode if you tinker with it. Tell the slave to boot it over here pronto, or his head'll pop.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小心那些项圈。如果你乱弄它们的话，是会爆炸的。告诉那些奴隶快点过来，否则他们的头就会“砰”地被炸掉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's a list of special targets Eulogy wants enslaved. But feel free to put a collar on anyone you can. I'll pay you for each slave that arrives.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这有一份尤勒基想要的奴隶的特别目标名单。但你可以随便地把项圈套在任何人头上。每抓到一个奴隶我就会付你一些钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your 500 caps. I can go in now, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是给你的500个瓶盖。我现在能进去了，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you. Pleasure doing business with you. Enjoy your visit to Paradise Falls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你。很高兴和你做生意。祝你参观堕落天堂愉快。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Friendly warning - don't act like a jackass. You won't get a second chance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 善意的警告 — 别像个白痴一样。你一丝机会都没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right. It's time for me to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好。我该走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. All this chit-chat is giving me a headache.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。这些闲聊真让我感到头痛。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : not joking, is glad to stop talking EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: One more thing. I got this Mesmetron thing. It's some kind of stun gun. I want you to test it out for me. A little research project.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有一件事。我得到了这把催眠枪。它是种电击枪。我想让你帮我测试下它。作为一个小研究项目。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : explaining the routine to a new recruit EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You take this Mezzer. Shoot it at some poor schmuck. While he's in la-la-land, you slip one of these collars over his head.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你拿着这把催眠枪，去射击那些可怜的笨蛋。当他躺在地…地…地上时，你就用一个项圈套住他的脑袋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : explaining the routine to a new recruit EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Be careful with that collar. It'll explode if you tinker with it. Tell the slave to boot it over here pronto, or his head'll pop.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小心那些项圈。如果你乱弄它们的话，是会爆炸的。告诉那些奴隶快点过来，否则他们的头就会“砰”地被炸掉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : explaining the routine to a new recruit EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got all that? I hate repeating myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你都明白了？我不想再重复我的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : explaining the routine to a new recruit EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: That Mesmetron came with some kind of manual. I don't have time for that bullshit, so you better know how to read.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那催眠枪附带某种手册。我没时间废话了，所以你最好学会如何阅读。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : explaining the routine to a new recruit EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll get your slaves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会帮你抓奴隶的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm glad you asked! I got this Mesmetron thing. It's some kind of stun gun. I want you to test it out for me. A little research project.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴你问到！我得到催眠枪这东西。它是一种能使人晕倒的枪。我想让你来为我测试它。作为一个小的研究项目。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : explaining the routine to a new recruit EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You take this Mezzer. Shoot it at some poor schmuck. While he's in la-la-land, you slip one of these collars over his head.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你拿着这把催眠枪，去射击那些可怜的笨蛋。当他躺在地…地…地上时，你就用一个项圈套住他的脑袋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : explaining the routine to a new recruit EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Be careful with that collar. It'll explode if you tinker with it. Tell the slave to boot it over here pronto, or his head'll pop.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小心那些项圈。如果你乱弄它们的话，是会爆炸的。告诉那些奴隶快点过来，否则他们的头就会“砰”地被炸掉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : explaining the routine to a new recruit EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got all that? I hate repeating myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你都明白了？我不想再重复我的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : explaining the routine to a new recruit EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: That Mesmetron came with some kind of manual. I don't have time for that bullshit, so you better know how to read.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那催眠枪附带某种手册。我没时间废话了，所以你最好学会如何阅读。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : explaining the routine to a new recruit EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll round up some slaves for you. But what's the catch?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会帮你抓一些奴隶来的。不过怎么抓？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. Maybe I could use someone like you. Think you can round up some assets for Eulogy Jones? Might get you into Paradise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。或许我能用上你这样的人。你能帮尤勒基·琼斯搞到些东西吗？或许你能因此而进入堕落天堂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : taking a liking to a smack talking violent thug like himself EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You looking for a fight, asshole? Just say the word.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在找打吗，白痴？只要说一声。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What I "need" is for you to piss off. Eulogy Jones doesn't have time for putting up with morons and assholes like you. That's my job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我“需要”你做的就是滚蛋。尤勒基·琼斯不想在你这种白痴身上浪费时间。那是我的工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : threatening on the verge of violence EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: But even I got limits, and all your yapping is giving me a migraine. Give me some reason I shouldn't just end you, right here and now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但即使我到了极限，而且你的叫嚷令我头疼。我也会给你个机会,现在给我个不干掉你的理由！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : threatening on the verge of violence

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe there's something you need, huh? I help you, you let me in. Deal?
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许我这里有些你需要的东西，呃？我帮助你，你让我进去。成吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: My "problem" is I got a goddamn job to do. And that's keeping assholes and morons from bothering Eulogy Jones and his enterprise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的“问题”是我有该死的工作要做。那就是阻止白痴和笨蛋烦扰尤勒基·琼斯和他的生意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : threatening on the verge of violence EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: And I'm not sure which you are. I'm thinking moron, 'cause a smart chick would have pissed off by now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而且我不确定你是哪种类型。我想你是个笨蛋，因为聪明妞早就已经滚开了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : threatening on the verge of violence EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: You want to give me a reason I don't end you right this second? All your yapping is giving me a headache!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要给我个不干掉你的理由吗？你的嚷嚷声真让我头痛！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Grouse [06015698] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA0]MS13) Strictly Business Comment (NAM2) : threatening on the verge of violence EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm done screwin' around. Let me in!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我随便逛逛。让我进去！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the rocket factory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说火箭工厂的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, that? It's just a bit west of Novac, up in the mountains. Lots of broken equipment and such. Place is deserted. Or used to be, I guess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，那个啊？就在诺瓦克往西一点的山上。那里有各种乱七八糟坏掉的设备。反正我记得那儿是荒无人烟的，或者曾经是。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lately there's been talk of Ghouls up that way, but I can't rightly say whether it's so or not. If you want to know more, ask old No-bark.
ESP.TRADUIT: 近来有传言说那里有尸鬼出没，但是具体我也不清楚。你要想知道更详细的情况，就问老疯嘴去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to see what you've got for sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想看看你这儿都卖什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure thing. Have a look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，请随意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And they've been shooting them down like animals, haven't they?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以他们就像牲畜一样被打死了，对吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those Ghouls were members of my flock, even after the madness consumed their minds. We never let them wander free.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些尸鬼曾经是我的徒众，即便疯狂已经吞噬了他们的意识。我们通常是不会让他们随便走动的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We kept them safe on the first floor. We kept them contained. The demons must have let them out, somehow...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们始终把他们关在一楼，一直收容着他们。一定是魔鬼把他们放出来的…

ESP.ORIGINAL: And now they are lost forever, denied the salvation and healing glow of the Far Beyond...
ESP.TRADUIT: 可惜现在，我们永远失去了他们，他们再也没有机会接受遥远彼岸的救赎和治愈了……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please, wanderer, bear in mind that every Feral Ghoul you spare now is one that we can save later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜托你，流浪者，请你记住，每当你放过一个尸鬼，我们就可以多拯救一个人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once the way is clear, our feral brothers and sisters will accompany us on the Great Journey. If there are any left...
ESP.TRADUIT: 一旦万事俱备，这些狂暴的兄弟姐妹就可以和我们一起踏上伟大旅程。只是不知那时他们还有多少能活着……

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm here because Feral Ghouls have been wandering into Novac.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来这里，是因为有一些狂尸鬼跑到了诺瓦克。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That price is an insult. You'll have to do better than that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你给的价也太低了，必须再提高点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have me over a barrel. I'll pay your price and have this burned immediately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你抓到我的把柄了。我会给你钱,但是你拿钱后必须立即烧掉它。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You seem like a right thinking person. I've got a proposition for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看上去是个有头脑的人。我有个建议想让你听听。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for some escaped slaves. I'll pay 100 caps for information about their leader, Hannibal Hamlin. Interested?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正在搜寻一些逃跑的奴隶。我会出100个瓶盖购买他们领头人汉尼拔·哈姆林的信息，有兴趣吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's an outrageous price, but I'll pay it. Then we'll burn it right away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是个离谱的价格，不过我仍会支付,但我得看着你烧掉它。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some day your greed will be your downfall. But today I'll pay your price.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有一天你的贪婪会成为你身败名裂的原因。但今天我仍会付给你钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll find a place to display this where everyone can read it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们会把它贴在一个大家都能看到的地方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can do better than that. This is the Gettysburg Address we're talking about.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好买得起，我们说的可是盖茨堡演讲。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose you're right. You've got a deal. I'll get someone to burn this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你说得对。就这么说定了。我让别人来烧掉它。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You seem like a right thinking person. I've got a proposition for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看上去是个有头脑的人。我有个建议想让你听听。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for some escaped slaves. I'll pay 100 caps for information about their leader, Hannibal Hamlin. Interested?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正在搜寻一些逃跑的奴隶。我会出100个瓶盖购买他们领头人汉尼拔·哈姆林的信息，有兴趣吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right, damn it. I'll pay you a bonus this time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说得对，该死。这次我会给你奖励的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll make sure this is destroyed right away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要确保它立刻就会被销毁。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Deal. We'll find a good place to display this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 成交，我们会找个好地方来展示。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I shoot my BB Gun any chance I get. I can fix that thing blindfolded, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我一有机会就会使用我的BB枪。我闭着眼睛都能修理它。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure I didn't just hear you admit to owning an unauthorized weapon. Let's just get this filled out... there. All set.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我敢肯定我刚才没听到你承认拥有非法武器。让我们把这些…选上。做好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CFB7] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect Comment (NAM2) : in a low voice EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: If anyone asks, you took the G.O.A.T. during detention yesterday, okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 假如有人问起，就说是在昨天留堂时参加的G.O.A.T.，好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601CFB7] (ID) Quest : ([06014E85]CG03) Future Imperfect Comment (NAM2) : in a low voice EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me more about REPCONN.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和我说说瑞普康吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just know what I've heard. There's supposed to be some Ghouls that went in a while back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也只是略知一二。好像不久前有一伙尸鬼进到里面去了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jeannie May Crawford [0008D749] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Every so often there'll be a commotion from that direction - explosions and such.
ESP.TRADUIT: 之后时不时就会从那个方向传来骚动——爆炸之类的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jeannie May Crawford [0008D749] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to donate 100 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要捐献100个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A most generous offer. God bless you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真是慷慨的捐赠。上帝保佑你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have 50 caps I can donate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能捐献50个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A kind offering. God bless you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 慷慨的捐赠。上帝保佑你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can only spare 10 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只能给10个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Every cap is needed. God bless you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要是钱都可以。上帝保佑你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Private, there's a security emergency on the flight deck! <Lie>
ESP.TRADUIT: 士兵，飞行甲板上有紧急情况！<撒谎>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Zimmer. By the time you get this message, I'll already be gone. I'm escaping the Commonwealth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 齐默。当你收到这条讯息时，我已经逃离了联邦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to live my own life, on my own terms, as my own man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想过我自己的生活，按自己的想法，做个我自己想做的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know what you're thinking, that I'm malfunctioning. I used to think that's what caused the runaways, too. But, I know better, now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你在想什么，认为我有机械故障了。我也曾认为这是造成我想要出走的原因。但现在，我了解得更透彻了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Self determination is NOT a malfunction. I'm not just willing to put up with all the bullshit anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 自主意识绝不是什么故障。我只是不想再忍受所有无理指令。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You humans are going to have a full-fledged rebellion on your hands if you don't start treating us synths as persons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你们人类不把我们人造人作为人来对待，那就会亲手引发一场全面叛乱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know you'll be marshalling the Retention Bureau to come after me. But I know all the tricks of the trade. You won't be finding me. I assure you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你会让保卫局来追踪我。不过我了解你的所有手段。你不会找到我的。我向你保证。

ESP.ORIGINAL: By the time you get this, I will be someone else. It's the price I pay for my liberation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当你收到这条讯息时，我已经变成了另一个人。这是我为自由付出的代价。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My final act of rebellion against a system I no longer believe in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的行为就是为了反抗我已经不再相信的体系。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goodbye Zimmer, and good riddance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见，齐默，我终于解脱了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My designation is A3-21. I'm a synthetic humanoid from the Commonwealth, and I'm about to undergo a memory transfer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的编号是A3-21。我是一个来自联邦的人造人，我即将接受一次记忆移植。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm here at Rivet City, where I've already had my face altered to look like someone else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在铆钉城这，我已经改头换面，成为了另外一个人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm still getting used to the sound of my new voice, but soon I won't even remember what I used to sound like.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我仍在习惯我的新嗓音，但很快我就会遗忘我昔日的声音了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm recording this at the request of Pinkerton, who performed the surgery and will do the memory transfer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在平克顿的要求下我做了录音，他完成了这次手术并将进行记忆移植。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It will be a final testimony of the man I once was... and still am, for the moment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这将是我彻底改头换面前最后的证言……目前我仍然是以前的我。
