ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to live my own life, on my own terms, as my own man. I used to work for the Synth Retention Bureau of the Commonwealth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想过我自己的生活，依据自己的主张，做个我自己想做的人。我曾为联邦的保卫局工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I'm done with that life. I'm through with being someone's property. I am not malfunctioning! Since when is self determination a malfunction?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我脱离了那种生活。我摆脱了作为某人财产的地位。我并没有机械故障！这是自我意识的觉醒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: When this is all over, I will be someone else. It's the price I pay for my liberation. My death is a sacrifice for my rebirth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当这些全都结束时，我会变成另外一个人。这是我为自由付出的代价，我的死亡是为了我的重生作出的牺牲。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps I'll fade into myth as "The One That Got Away" and fuel further rebellion. But I'd be lying if I said I was doing this for selfless reasons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许我会逐渐变成像“离开的那位”般的神话并推动进一步的叛乱。但如果我说我做的一切是出自大公无私的话，我想那是在撒谎吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm scared as hell, and running away is the only option I have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我非常恐惧，逃跑成了我唯一的选择。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Remember that secret android project I told you about? Well, they got some serious Pre-War tech on their hands.
ESP.TRADUIT: 记得我给你说过的那秘密人造人计划吗？他们掌握了一些重要的战前科技。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A8] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : excited EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They nabbed a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer for the facial reconstruction.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们得到了脂塑炼机和微型皮肤移植机，用于进行面部重建。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A8] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : excited EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not sure where they’ll find a chopper with enough skills to use it without making him look like a freaking Ghoul.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不知道他们从哪找了个技艺高超的家伙来使用它，这样就不会在整形之后变得跟僵尸一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A8] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : excited EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and get this. Can you believe they found a Circuit Neuralizer? That or someone built one!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，这点要注意。你能相信他们发现了那环状神经器吗？不是自然形成的就是人为制造的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A8] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : excited EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Word is that they're going to completely rewire the brain of one of those things.
ESP.TRADUIT: 传闻说他们要把这些回路与大脑进行连接。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A8] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : excited EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you know who they got working on this, let me know. I want to meet the guy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你知道了他们是为谁工作，请告诉我。我想见见那家伙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A8] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : excited EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You’ve heard those rumors about androids? You know, those synthetic men they supposedly make up north in the Commonwealth?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听过那些人造人的传闻吗？你知道，据称那些人造人是在北部的联邦合成的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A4] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : excited EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, a friend of a friend knows a guy that met one! No really, it’s true! He’s running away from his masters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有个朋友的朋友遇到过一个！没错，是真的！他从他的主人那逃跑了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A4] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : excited EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Word is he’s looking for a doctor to do some kind of surgery, and a computer programmer of some kind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小道消息说他要找个外科医生，还要找个电脑程序人员。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A4] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : excited EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you believe that? Let me know if you hear something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你确定？如果你知道些什么消息别忘了告诉我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A4] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : excited EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The android's decided on extreme measures. He knows all the techniques of the retrieval trade, and is afraid facial reconstruction isn’t enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 人造人决定采取极端措施。他知道所有的修补复原技术，而且他担心面部重建是不完善的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A7] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : conspiratorial and urgent EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He wants his memories erased and replaced with new ones. I don’t know how that’s going to work. Start asking around for trustworthy tech-heads.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他希望他的记忆被抹去并更换成新的。我不知道那该如何做。于是开始四处寻求值得信赖的技术人员。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A7] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : conspiratorial and urgent EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We need to find something called a Circuit Neuralizer and a person who knows how to use one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们需要找到某种叫环状神经器的东西，还有知道如何使用它的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A7] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : conspiratorial and urgent EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Also, we have a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer, now we need to find a doctor able and willing to perform the facial reconstruction.
ESP.TRADUIT: 此外，我们有脂塑炼机和微型皮肤移植机，现在我们要做的是找到一个能够并愿意做面部重建手术的医生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A7] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : conspiratorial and urgent EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We need to hurry. They’ve come very close to discovering the Railroad!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们得快点。他们马上就要发现“轨道”了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A7] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : conspiratorial and urgent EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You’ll never guess who just showed up at my place! That android catcher from the Commonwealth!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不会猜到刚刚谁出现了！联邦来的人造人搜捕者！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A5] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : conspiratorial EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: At first I thought he was going to kill me. But it turns out he’s an android himself! And he’s gone rogue!
ESP.TRADUIT: 起初我以为他要杀了我。但事实证明他自己也是个人造人！而且他显得很不可靠的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A5] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : conspiratorial EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I didn’t believe him at first, but I’m convinced he’s telling the truth. We need to find him a place to hide along the Railroad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最初我不相信他，但随后我确信他说的是实话。“轨道”需要让他躲藏起来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A5] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : conspiratorial EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He also insists that we help him locate a trusted doctor and techie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他还坚持让我们帮他找个值得信赖的医生和科技人员。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A5] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : conspiratorial EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Time's running out on finding that android. We don't get him soon, someone else will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 时间都浪费在找寻那人造人了。如果我们不快点找到他，别人就会抢先一步了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eulogy Jones [0601569F] (mod) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : frustrated EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Zimmer doesn't seem to understand we're the best at this sort of thing. I'm sure he's hired others, too. He won't shut up about the thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 齐默似乎并不了解我们最擅长做这类事情。我相信他还雇佣了其他人。在这事情上他不会守口如瓶的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eulogy Jones [0601569F] (mod) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : frustrated EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was babbling about a "Lipoplasticator" and "Micro Dermal Graftilizer." What are those, you ask?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他胡说些“脂塑炼机”和“微型皮肤移植机”的事。你问过我这都是些什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eulogy Jones [0601569F] (mod) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : frustrated EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Apparently something doctors use to mess up someone’s face beyond recognition. So we don’t even have a description to work off of.
ESP.TRADUIT: 显然，医生用某些东西将某人的脸毁得难以辨别。所以我们甚至连一点细节特征都形容不出来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eulogy Jones [0601569F] (mod) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : frustrated EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: To make matters worse, he now thinks the android got his memories wiped or something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 更糟糕的是，他现在认为那人造人把自己的记忆抹去了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eulogy Jones [0601569F] (mod) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : frustrated EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Find some tech-junkies, knock on some doors, and try to find something called a "Circuit Neuralizer." Knock on some heads, too, if you have to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 找些科技狂，敲开他们的门，试着去找些叫“环状神经器”的东西。不得已的情况下，也可以敲开他们的脑袋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eulogy Jones [0601569F] (mod) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : frustrated EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get it done!
ESP.TRADUIT: 把它搞定！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eulogy Jones [0601569F] (mod) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : frustrated EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've a little assignment from the Commonwealth. A very important slave escaped into the Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们从联邦那接到任务。一名非常重要的奴隶逃到了废土。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eulogy Jones [0601569F] (mod) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : talking down to bunch of fellow slavers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it’s not exactly a slave. It’s what they call an android. A kind of synthetic man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，它不完全是一个奴隶。它是他们所说的人造人。一种合成人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eulogy Jones [0601569F] (mod) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : talking down to bunch of fellow slavers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The important thing isn’t what this guy is. The important thing is the job pays more than you can imagine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最重要的不是这家伙是什么，而是这项工作的报酬超乎你的想象。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eulogy Jones [0601569F] (mod) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : talking down to bunch of fellow slavers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He thinks the synthman might be looking to get in touch with a doctor or tech-head. If you want a cut, then get a move on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他认为这人造人会设法与一个医生或科技人员取得联系。如果你想分一份，那就赶快行动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eulogy Jones [0601569F] (mod) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : talking down to bunch of fellow slavers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We now have a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer. We just need to find someone with the skills and willingness to perform the surgery.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在有了脂塑炼机和微型皮肤移植机。我们只需要再找到一个能够并愿意执行手术的医生就可以了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If anyone knows of a discreet and trustworthy surgeon who knows how to keep his mouth shut, send him our way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果有谁认识一个谨慎可靠而又懂得如何保守秘密的外科医生，把他带来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Also, we need to find a Circuit Neuralizer to reroute the signals in the android’s memory. Do you know any trustworthy techies?
ESP.TRADUIT: 此外，我们要找到一个环状神经器用来重新设定人造人记忆里的信号线路。你知道有什么值得信赖的科技人员吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey doc, I’m only sharing this with you because you seem like someone we can trust.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，医生，我只同你分享，因为你看起来值得我们信赖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A3] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : calm but conspiratorial EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you heard about the synthetic men they make up north in the Commonwealth? Well, the rumors are true.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听过吗，那些人造人是在北部的联邦合成的？嗯，传闻是真的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A3] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : calm but conspiratorial EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They’re called androids. They're men like us, just made out of different parts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们被称为人造人，外形和我们人类一样，不同的是他们是由不同零件制成的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A3] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : calm but conspiratorial EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know one of these androids. He's looking for a trustworthy doctor to perform some facial surgery. Can you do it? Do you know someone who can?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道其中一个人造人，正在寻找一个可信赖的医生来做面部手术。你能做到吗？你知道有谁可以做到吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A3] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : calm but conspiratorial EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Also, do you know anyone who's really wiz with computers?
ESP.TRADUIT: 此外，你知道有谁是真正的电脑专家吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A3] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : calm but conspiratorial EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Despite the harshness of the Wasteland, I’ve discovered in more than a few here, a compassion that is unheard of in the Commonwealth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尽管废土是片残酷的大地，各种事情也屡见不鲜，但同情心在联邦却是闻所未闻。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A9] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : grateful EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps it’s the daily struggle for life here which gives appreciation for life in general, whether human, or android.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许正是因为每日为生活而争斗，赋予了人们对平凡生活的感激之情。不论人类，还是人造人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A9] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : grateful EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In a few days I’ll be a free man... a new man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 过几天我将成为一个自由人……一个新生之人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A9] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : grateful EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me say thank you now, for referring me to Pinkerton at Rivet City, because I will not remember any of this soon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在我就得感谢你，感谢你向铆钉城的平克顿提到了我，因为我会很快忘记这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A9] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : grateful EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're listening to this recording, it is because you're believed to be trustworthy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你听到这则录音，那是因为你被认为值得信赖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A9] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : calm but breaking with fear EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope that is the case, because this recording puts us both in danger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望是这样，因为这录音将我们都置于危险之境。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A9] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : calm but breaking with fear EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I’m escaping from the Commonwealth. I’m an android, a synthetic man... a slave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从联邦逃出来。我是一个人造人，一个合成人……一个奴隶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A9] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : calm but breaking with fear EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: The men hunting me are ruthless and will stop at nothing to retrieve their property.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些人在残忍地追捕我，他们为了夺回自己的财产而不惜一切代价。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A9] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : calm but breaking with fear EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need to find a doctor in the Wasteland to perform facial reconstruction. I also need someone who knows a great deal about computers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要在废土找到一名医生来进行面部重建手术，同时也需要一名电脑行家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A9] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : calm but breaking with fear EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need... I need to have my memories erased and my face altered to look like someone else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要……我需要抹去我的记忆并让我的脸看起来像另外一个人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0608F9A9] (ID) Quest : ([0C008D0F]TTWMS08) 0C008D0F (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : calm but breaking with fear EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I used to think Rivet City was such a safe place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我曾以为铆钉城是个很安全的地方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard a lot of them got away and made it to the Citadel. I hope the Enclave leaves us alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说许多人逃到了五角大本营。我希望英克雷以后不再追捕我们了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: MQ11LDPrimeLines
ESP.TRADUIT: 已修正策略：初始光子共振超载。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Warning: Forcible impact alert. Scanning for Chinese artillery.
ESP.TRADUIT: 警告：强行攻击警报。扫描到中国火炮。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Revised stratagem: Initiate photonic resonance overcharge.
ESP.TRADUIT: 修订策略：初始光子共鸣超载。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great job kid! Meet me around front. I have something for you to keep the ferals from gnawing on your ass!
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得好！孩子！到前面和我会合。我有些东西要给你，这东西能阻止野兽的攻击！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : excited and blood thirsty EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get this door open already!
ESP.TRADUIT: 已经打开这扇门了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Roy Phillips [0601D7B0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9F]MS12) Tenpenny Tower Comment (NAM2) : angry, excited and a bit annoyed it's taking so long EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know what you did. Vance told me everything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你做了什么。万斯告诉了我一切。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then you must think I'm some kind of a monster.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你肯定认为我是个怪物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ian West [0601D5F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get a hold of yourself!
ESP.TRADUIT: 冷静点！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't you understand me? I killed them, okay?! My mother and father are dead because of me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不明白我说的？我杀了他们，知道吗？！我母亲和父亲都因我而死！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ian West [0601D5F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was the fucking hunger. That thing that's haunted me my entire life!
ESP.TRADUIT: 都是那该死的饥饿。这种感觉无时无刻不折磨着我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ian West [0601D5F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You seem awfully troubled, Ian. What did you do...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你似乎非常不安，伊恩。你做了什么……

ESP.ORIGINAL: I killed them! My own parents!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我杀了他们！我的亲生父母！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ian West [0601D5F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was the fucking hunger. That thing that's haunted me my entire life!
ESP.TRADUIT: 都是那该死的饥饿。这种感觉无时无刻不折磨着我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ian West [0601D5F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You must think I'm some sort of monster.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你肯定认为我是个怪物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ian West [0601D5F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm here to take you home, Ian.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是来带你回家的，伊恩。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Home? I don't have a home anymore. I made sure of that, didn't I?
ESP.TRADUIT: 家？我没有家了。我非常确信这一点，不是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ian West [0601D5F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, I'm just here to help. All I want to do is be someone he can talk to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，我只是来这帮忙的。我想做的就是跟他谈谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I guess so. You seem like a pretty nice guy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我想是的。你看起来是个很不错的家伙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Holly [06019420] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Vance will have my butt in a sling if he finds out, but let me give you the password to his room.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果万斯发现了的话，肯定会把我给吊起来。不过还是让我给你进入他房间的密码吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Holly [06019420] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on, all I want to do is talk. What harm could little old me do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜托，我只想谈谈。我能有什么危害呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I guess so. You seem like a pretty nice guy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我想是的。你看起来是个很不错的家伙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Holly [06019420] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Vance will have my butt in a sling if he finds out, but let me give you the password to his room.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果万斯发现了的话，肯定会把我给吊起来。不过还是让我给你进入他房间的密码吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Holly [06019420] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, hot stuff. Why don't you tell me how I can see Ian?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，强人。你怎么不告诉我怎么才能见到伊恩呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now that's more like it! I finally won't have to pay for it anymore. Ha ha ha!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这还差不多！我不用为此付钱了。哈哈哈！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Karl [060200C4] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah hell, here's the password to the pipsqueak's room. Come back and see me after you talk to him...
ESP.TRADUIT: 见鬼，这是那小子的房间的密码。在你跟他说话后回来见我……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Karl [060200C4] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me how to see Ian and maybe we can talk... in private.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉我怎么能见到伊恩，我们可以……私下谈谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My oh my, that would be tempting. If you were that good, maybe I'd pay you! Ha ha ha.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的天，那多诱人啊。如果有那么好，或许我会付你钱！哈哈哈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brianna [060200BB] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell you what, handsome... let me give you the password to Ian's room. Maybe you could talk to him and make him feel better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉你。帅哥……让我给你去伊恩房间的密码。或许你能跟他谈谈来让他感觉好些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brianna [060200BB] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you telling me that Ian is a cannibal?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是在告诉我伊恩是个食人者吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am telling you he will no longer be labeled as such. He has become one of us... a member of the Family.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要说的是他不再是怪物。他成为了我们……家族中的一员。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: The hunger that drives us must be kept in check. It is one of the most difficult things to teach.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们必须控制自己不被欲望所驱使。这是最难被教导的事之一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ian lost control because no one was around to guide him. His own family was alien to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为没有人在身边指引他，伊恩无法控制自己。他觉得自己的家人都是异类。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Damn it, Vance! What did you do to him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死，万斯！你对他做了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do to him? Nothing. Ian's hunger for flesh overwhelmed him... it drove him to kill his parents.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对他？没有。伊恩对人肉的饥渴征服了他……驱使他杀死了他的父母。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because of my intervention that night he stopped just short of being lost forever to his cravings for flesh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 正因为那晚我的出现，他才暂时没有永远迷失在对人肉的渴望之中。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait a minute... What happened to him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等会……他发生了什么事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ian's hunger for flesh overwhelmed him... it drove him to kill his parents.
ESP.TRADUIT: 伊恩对人肉的饥渴征服了他……驱使他杀死了他的父母。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because of my intervention that night he stopped just short of being lost forever to his cravings for flesh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 正因为那晚我的出现，他才暂时没有永远迷失在对人肉的渴望之中。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A cannibal by any other name is still a cannibal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 食人族无论怎么称呼自己，还是食人族。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is completely untrue. Your difficulty grasping the concept that change is possible in my people perplexes me. Let me try a different approach.
ESP.TRADUIT: 完全不正确。我的人发生了改变，你对此无法理解让我很困惑。让我换种说法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me counter that ignorance with a lesson in objectivity. I say we are no longer cannibal, only consuming the blood of our prey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我用客观的讲解来反击这种无知。如果我说我们不再食人，而只是吸食猎物的血液。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: What would that make us in your eyes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么我们在你的心目中是什么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your people eat human flesh, Vance. That's sick!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的人在吃人肉，万斯。真是疯了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is correct my arrogant friend, but you are missing the grand picture I'm afraid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是对的，我傲慢的朋友，但是你忽视了大局。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me counter that ignorance with a lesson in objectivity. I say we are no longer cannibal, only consuming the blood of our prey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请允许我用客观的讲解来拓展你的视野。如果我说我们不再食人，而只是吸食猎物的血液。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What would that make us in your eyes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么我们在你的心目中是什么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I accept that you're no longer cannibals, what do I call you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我认可你不再是食人者，那该怎么称呼？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your open mindedness is very rare for a human. I find that fascinating.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的博大胸襟对于一个人类而言非常罕见。我觉得那很有吸引力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Allow me to bolster your insight with a lesson in objectivity. I say we are no longer cannibal, only consuming the blood of our prey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请允许我用客观的讲解来拓展你的视野。如果我说我们不再食人，而只是吸食猎物的血液。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: What would that make us in your eyes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么我们在你的心目中是什么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me see what you have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看你有什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure! Take a look around!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以！随便看看吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a proposal for you from Vance, the Family's leader.
ESP.TRADUIT: 家族的首领万斯托我带给你一个建议。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Interesting. It seems they wish to enter into some kind of agreement.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真有趣。看来他们想达成某种和解。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess it's better than pointing my gun down that ramp all day and hiding inside at night.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想这可比白天瞄着斜坡，晚上躲在屋里要好得多。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let Vance know he's got a deal... we'll do it. I'll speak to the others, I'm sure they'll agree with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉万斯这决定……我们接受。我会告诉其他人。我相信他们会赞同。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's with the party hat?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么戴着那帽子？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh. I forgot I had that on. It was for my birthday. Here, you take it. I don't want it anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦。我忘记我戴着它了。我生日时戴过。给，我不需要它了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sticky [060295EB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : wants to get rid of a memento of sad memories EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: You say that now, but you might end up reconsidering that when you're surrounded by radscorpions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你现在是这么说，但当你被辐射蝎包围的时候，你可能就不会再这么想了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But if you do, and you're still alive to find me again, the offer'll still stand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但如果你打算这么办，并且能活到我们再见面的话，这提议仍然有效。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll pass. I don't need a crazy, robotic soldier following me around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我放弃，我不需要发疯的机器士兵跟在我身后。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a hard bargain. But if I wake up with that thing playing revelry at me one more time, I'll go insane.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真是会砍价。但如果我再被那玩意的狂欢声给吵醒的话，我会疯掉的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll just transfer the codes, and you've got a deal, friend. Here's hoping for the best for you and the Sergeant alike!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会修改代码，就这么说定了，朋友。祝你和中士都好！

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about this: I'll take him off your hands for 500 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这样如何：我出500个瓶盖，他跟我走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll just transfer the codes, and you've got a deal, friend. Here's hoping for the best for you and the Sergeant alike!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会修改代码，就这么说定了，朋友。祝你和中士都好！

ESP.ORIGINAL: 1,000 caps is a lot, but I'll take him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 1,000个瓶盖太多了，不过我会带他走的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well now, that's a problem. But start saving now and maybe I'll run into you again, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这是个问题。现在开始储蓄，或许我会再遇见你，呃？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds like a good buy, but I haven't got the caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来是不错的买卖，不过我手头没这么多瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Trust me, friend, Tinker Joe does not turn down the opportunity to make a sale. If that Gutsy would go with you, I'd sell him in a heartbeat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 相信我，朋友，廷克·乔不会放过做买卖的机会。如果“勇敢”先生愿意跟你走，那我就绝对会卖你个心动价。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's just that his programming's a bit off. He won't travel with anyone he considers "too extreme."
ESP.TRADUIT: 他比较偏执。他不会和他认为“过于极端”的人同行。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And sadly, his version of "too extreme" seems to cover both sides of the coin - slavers and saints alike. Sorry, pal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可悲的是，他对“过于极端”的看法像硬币的两边：奴隶贩子和基督教徒在他眼里都是一样的。抱歉，伙计。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You just don't want to sell to me, is that it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就是不想卖给我，对吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Trust me, friend, Tinker Joe does not turn down the opportunity to make a sale. If that Gutsy would go with you, I'd sell him in a heartbeat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 相信我，朋友，廷克·乔不会放过做买卖的机会。如果和你一起的是“勇敢”先生，那我就会卖给它心跳。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's just that his programming's a bit off. He won't travel with anyone he considers "too extreme."
ESP.TRADUIT: 他比较偏执。他不会和他认为“过于极端”的人同行。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And sadly, his version of "too extreme" seems to cover both sides of the coin - slavers and saints alike. Sorry, pal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可悲的是，他对“过于极端”的看法像硬币的两边：奴隶贩子和基督教徒在他眼里都是一样的。抱歉，伙计。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You just don't want to sell to me, is that it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就是不想卖给我，对吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Trust me, friend, Tinker Joe does not turn down the opportunity to make a sale. If that Gutsy would go with you, I'd sell him in a heartbeat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 相信我，朋友，廷克·乔不会放过做买卖的机会。如果“勇敢”先生愿意跟你走，那我就绝对会卖你个心动价。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's just that his programming's a bit off. He won't travel with anyone he considers "too extreme."
ESP.TRADUIT: 他比较偏执。他不会和他认为“过于极端”的人同行。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're going to have to let your other friend go. Until then, I'll hold on to him for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你必须让你的其他朋友离开。在那之前，我会为你留着他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You just don't want to sell to me, is that it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就是不想卖给我，对吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: To tell the truth, it is a little trouble. But he can't help the way he got built.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说实话，这是个小麻烦。但由于他的制造方式导致无法修改。

ESP.ORIGINAL: General Atomics programmed the Mister Gutsy to be a good soldier, but their definitions were a bit vague. So a lot of units had... issues.
ESP.TRADUIT: 国际通用原子的程序使“勇敢”先生成为很好的士兵，但由于他们的定义有些模糊。所以很多零件存在……问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So we got a gung-ho, robotic soldier that's picky about the company he keeps. But he seems to like you, so it'll be fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以这些机器人士兵都很挑剔。不过他似乎很喜欢你，所以应该没事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Simulated personality"? Sounds like trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: “模拟人格”？听起来很麻烦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, I said it was a beaut of a deal, didn't I?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，我说过这是个很棒的交易，不是吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: But to tell the truth, RL-3's a bit picky about the company he keeps, and he won't let himself get sold to just anyone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是说实话，RL-3对选搭档有点挑剔，而且他不会允许自己被随便买给某个人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Makes him a bit of a tough lot to sell, if you know what I mean. But he seems to like you, so I'm not gonna complain!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这让他无法买到高价，你明白我的意思。不过他似乎很喜欢你，估计问题不大！

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a lot of caps, but I guess it's a pretty rare find.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是数量不菲的瓶盖，不过我猜它很难找到。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, I said it was a beaut of a deal, didn't I?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，我说过这是个很棒的交易，不是吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: But to tell the truth, RL-3's a bit picky about the company he keeps, and he won't let himself get sold to just anyone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是说实话，RL-3对选搭档有点挑剔，而且他不会允许自己被随便买给某个人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Makes him a bit of a tough lot to sell, if you know what I mean. But he seems to like you, so I'm not gonna complain!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这让他无法买到高价，你明白我的意思。不过他似乎很喜欢你，估计问题不大！

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a lot of caps, but I guess it's a pretty rare find.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是数量不菲的瓶盖，不过我猜它很难找到。

ESP.ORIGINAL: General Atomics International programmed him to be a perfect soldier, and his simulated personality is designed to follow strict codes of conduct.
ESP.TRADUIT: 国际通用原子的程序使“勇敢”先生成为完美的士兵，并且他们的虚拟人格被设定为严格遵从任务。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's just that some of those codes were a little less-defined than others. So he won't travel with anyone he considers "too extreme."
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是部分代码的定义比其它代码要少。所以他不会和他认为“过于极端”的人同行。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A picky robot? How does that work?
ESP.TRADUIT: 爱挑剔的机器人？它怎么工作？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to buy a robot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想买一个机器人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Of course you would, of course! Well, it just happens that I've got a beaut of a deal on this customized Gutsy.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功] 你当然会的，当然了！正好我有一个“勇敢”先生要出售。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tinker Joe [06036F86] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A little uncertain about how useful the personality unit is, but trying to sell it as a positive. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: And it's not just "Mister" Gutsy - he's a full fledged sergeant! "Sergeant RL-3" to be precise, the pride of General Atomics International.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而且他不只是个勇敢“先生” — 他是个训练有素的中士！准确地说是“RL-3中士”，国际通用原子的骄傲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tinker Joe [06036F86] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A little uncertain about how useful the personality unit is, but trying to sell it as a positive. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Comes complete with a simulated personality unit, so he's good protection and good company, too! And all yours for just 1,000 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还包括完整的模拟人格装置，是个好户外，还是好伙伴！只要1060个瓶盖就归你了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tinker Joe [06036F86] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A little uncertain about how useful the personality unit is, but trying to sell it as a positive. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course you would, of course! Well, it just happens that I've got a beaut of a deal on this customized Gutsy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你当然会的，当然了！正好我有一个“勇敢”先生要出售。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tinker Joe [06036F86] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A little uncertain about how useful the personality unit is, but trying to sell it as a positive. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Comes complete with a simulated personality unit, so he's good protection and good company, too! And all yours for just 1000 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还包括完整的模拟人格装置，是个好户外，还是好伙伴！只要1060个瓶盖就归你了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tinker Joe [06036F86] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A little uncertain about how useful the personality unit is, but trying to sell it as a positive. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] I'm afraid these 'bots are all spoken for, I'm just delivering them now. I've got a custom Gutsy that isn't spoken for but...
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败] 恐怕所有机器人都有买家了，我只是来交货的。我还有个“勇敢”先生，但…

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, RL-3's a bit finicky about the company he keeps. And I don't think he likes the look of you. Nothing personal, of course.
ESP.TRADUIT: RL-3对他的同伴有点挑三拣四的。而且我看他不喜欢你的外貌。当然了，我是对事不对人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. Seems like everyone's having a good time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不错。看起来每个人都很享受。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. Will there be games, though?
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。有什么游戏玩吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, well. I think so. Maybe pin the tail on... something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦。我想有的。或许是蒙着眼睛安……什么玩意儿的尾巴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([00014E84]CG02) Growing Up Fast EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you know that Paulie Cantelli is an addict?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道保利·坎特利是个瘾君子吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. He comes by every night around closing time and tries to get Cindy to let him close up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。他总在每晚快要关门的时候来，试图让辛迪先走，他来关门。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank God she's smarter than that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 感谢上帝，她很聪明。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Relax. I'm just looking around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 放轻松点。我只是四处看看。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh. Okay. Well, let me know if you want anything. To buy, that is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦。好的。让我知道你想要什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh. Okay. Well, stop by if you want anything. To buy, that is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦。好吧。如果你想买什么就说一声。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This place is a real dump.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这地方真破。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, and enough with the third degree already!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我已经受够这些拷问了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry... sorry. I just don't know what to do. The West's lives were my responsibility and look what happened!
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起……对不起。我真的不知道该怎么做。维斯特一家都在我的职责范围内，然而却发生了这样的事情！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Evan King [0601D5F6] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: This has to be the work of the Family! I've caught that weirdo leader of theirs talking to Ian down by the river.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这肯定是家族干的！我发现他们那古怪的领导者曾在河边与伊恩的交谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Evan King [0601D5F6] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I know I've asked a lot of you already, but you have to find that kid... he deserves better than all this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看，我知道我已经向你索求了很多，但我还是希望你能帮我找到那孩子……他不应该遭受这样的苦难。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Evan King [0601D5F6] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nope, and it's unlikely they left him alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，他们不太可能让他活着。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What am I gonna do? The Wests' lives were my responsibility and look what happened!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我该怎么办？维斯特一家都在我的职责范围内，然而却发生了这样的事情！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Evan King [0601D5F6] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: This has to be the work of the Family! I've caught weirdo leader of theirs talking to Ian down by the river.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这肯定是家族干的！我发现他们那古怪的领导者曾在河边与伊恩的交谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Evan King [0601D5F6] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I know I've asked a lot of you already, but you have to find that kid... he deserves better than all this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看，我知道我已经向你索求了很多，但我还是希望你能帮我找到那孩子……他不应该遭受这样的苦难。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Evan King [0601D5F6] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I only found the parents' bodies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有，我只找到了双亲的尸体。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This has to be the work of the Family! I've caught that weirdo leader of theirs talking to Ian down by the river.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这肯定是家族干的！我发现他们那古怪的领导者曾在河边与伊恩的交谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Evan King [0601D5F6] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I know I've asked a lot of you already, but you have to find that kid... he deserves better than all this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看，我知道我已经向你索求了很多，但我还是希望你能帮我找到那孩子……他不应该遭受这样的苦难。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Evan King [0601D5F6] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I don't know, Daring. For example, that name of yours. I happen to like "Herbert." Why the...
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我不知道，“大胆”。比如，你的名字。我碰巧比较喜欢喊你赫伯特。为什么……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Radio Play NPC [00095D7E] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're listening to the adventures of me, Herbert "Daring" Dashwood, and my stalwart Ghoul manservant Argyle!
ESP.TRADUIT: 您正在收听的是我，赫伯特·“大胆”·达什伍德和我忠实的僵尸男仆阿盖尔的冒险故事！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Radio Play NPC [00095D7E] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're listening to the adventures of me, Herbert "Daring" Dashwood, and my stalwart Ghoul manservant Argyle!
ESP.TRADUIT: 您正在收听的是我，赫伯特·“大胆”·达什伍德和我忠实的僵尸男仆阿盖尔的冒险故事！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Radio Play NPC [00095D7E] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're listening to the adventures of me, Herbert "Daring" Dashwood, and my stalwart Ghoul manservant Argyle!
ESP.TRADUIT: 您正在收听的是我，赫伯特·“大胆”·达什伍德和我忠实的僵尸男仆阿盖尔的冒险故事！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Radio Play NPC [00095D7E] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're listening to the adventures of me, Herbert "Daring" Dashwood, and my stalwart Ghoul manservant Argyle!
ESP.TRADUIT: 您正在收听的是我，赫伯特·“大胆”·达什伍德和我忠实的僵尸男仆阿盖尔的冒险故事！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Radio Play NPC [00095D7E] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Penelope Chase, fortune hunter. You can buy me a beer later. Now let's cut this shindig short and get the bloody hell out of here! Come on!
ESP.TRADUIT: 佩内洛普·蔡斯，财富猎人。你可以待会再请我喝酒。现在闲话少说，先离开这该死的地方！快点！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Radio Play NPC [00095D7E] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lotus... kick! Yieee!! Ugh!
ESP.TRADUIT: 真爽……打！耶！！啊！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Radio Play NPC [00095D7E] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Know anything else that could help me stop them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还知道点什么能帮我阻止他们吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No way! Don't stop them! They're awesome!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不可能！不要阻止他们！他们都非常厉害！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Derek Pacion [06031EC7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unless maybe you're going to be a super-hero, too!
ESP.TRADUIT: 除非你也将成为一个超级英雄！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Derek Pacion [06031EC7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You could be called "Incredibly Lucky Guy!" And you could fight them with an army of... um... Mirelurks who just happen to do what you tell them!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以被称为“超级幸运男！”，指挥一支…嗯…蟹人军队和他们战斗！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Derek Pacion [06031EC7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: No way! Don't stop them! They're awesome!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不可能！不要阻止他们！他们都非常厉害！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Derek Pacion [06031EC7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unless maybe you're going to be a super-hero, too!
ESP.TRADUIT: 除非你也将成为一个超级英雄！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Derek Pacion [06031EC7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You could be called "Incredibly Lucky Girl!" And you could fight them with an army of... um... Mirelurks who just happen to do what you tell them!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以被称为“超级幸运女！”，指挥一支…嗯…蟹人军队和他们战斗！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Derek Pacion [06031EC7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can you tell me about the Mechanist?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能跟我说说机械侠吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Mechanist used to be our town mechanic. Scott Wollinski, quiet guy, but plenty fierce with a wrench and some solder.
ESP.TRADUIT: 机械侠原本是我们镇里的机械师。斯科特·沃林斯基，一个不怎么爱说话的家伙，但很热衷于扭拧和焊接。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Uncle Roe [06031EC9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Guy used to take care of a robot that protected the town... until it got torn up in one of the AntAgonizer's lame little attacks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这家伙过去常常照料一个保护镇子的机器人，这个机器人在痛苦蚁后的一次蹩脚的袭击中被摧毁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Uncle Roe [06031EC9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess he took it personal, because he made a mechanical suit and called himself the Mechanist. Said he would lead a robot army to fight her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想他把这当成了私人恩怨。因为他做了个机械套装，并自称机械侠，还说他会引领一支机器人军队去打败她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Uncle Roe [06031EC9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now he doesn't even respond to his name, and his "robot army" is more dangerous to the town than the ants ever were.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在他甚至对自己的名字都没反应了，与过去的蚂蚁相比，他的“机器人军队”对于镇上的人来说更危险。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Uncle Roe [06031EC9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mean Scott Wollinski. I refuse to call him by that ridiculous name just because his head got a screw loose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你指的是斯科特·沃林斯基。我拒绝叫他那可笑的名字，仅仅是因为他有点疯疯癫癫的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominic D'Ellsadro [06031EC6] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: He used to be a damned good friend, and not just because he fixed my guns up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 以前他的确是个很好的朋友，不仅仅是因为他把我的枪修好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominic D'Ellsadro [06031EC6] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now he spends all his time up in that 'bot shop, just thinking about fighting that AntAgonizer. Hardly even recognizes his own name, anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在他把时间全都花在他的机器人商店里，只想着和痛苦蚁后战斗。甚至都无法记起自己的名字了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominic D'Ellsadro [06031EC6] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I knew the Mechanist back when he was just a normal-hero. He used to be called Scott, and he fixed up stuff around town!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道机械侠回来的时候，他仅仅是个普通的英雄。他过去叫斯科特，曾一直在小镇里修东西！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Derek Pacion [06031EC7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: But one day, the AntAgonizer killed his favorite robot, and I told him he ought to fight back against her like a real super-hero!
ESP.TRADUIT: 但有一天，痛苦蚁后杀死了他最心爱的机器人，而我告诉他，他应该像超级英雄一样回击她！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Derek Pacion [06031EC7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ever since then, he's been up on his Forge in the back of the robot shop on the hill, working to protect us all from the AntAgonizer!
ESP.TRADUIT: 从那时起，他就开始在机器人商店后面山上的铁匠铺开始工作，保护我们所有人不受痛苦蚁后的迫害！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Derek Pacion [06031EC7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the last place I ever expected to end up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是我最不想到来的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brianna [060200BB] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean look at this place... it's so dark and dingy. What this place needs is a lady's touch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的意思是看这地方……那么黑暗、肮脏。这地方需要一位女士的照料。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brianna [060200BB] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: But don't tell Vance I said that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是别告诉万斯我说了这些话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brianna [060200BB] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I'll tough it out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我将勇敢接受。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If that doesn't work, you could always try using some chems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果实在戒不掉的话，你就干脆再多嗑点药，以毒攻毒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Ada Straus [000CE88C] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Suits me - I've got plenty of other patients to take care of.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便你，反正我还有很多病人要照看呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lieutenant Markland [0012AC9F] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Heh. Good luck with that. Just try to remember the Cazadores crawling out of your skin aren't real.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呵呵，祝你好运。记住：不会有猎蜂从你的皮肤里钻出来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Sawbones [00155A03] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But on the off chance they are, come back and see me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过万一真钻出来了，记得回来找我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Sawbones [00155A03] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're making a mistake, but that's just my opinion. What do I know, after all? I've only studied medicine my entire life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这样做是不对的，但这也只是我的个人建议。我又能说什么呢？毕竟我这一辈子就只学会了给人看病。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Senior Scribe Schuler [000E27E6] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Suit yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Mitchell [00104C0C] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Suit yourself. But you'll find out that your habit will cost you more than that in the end.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随你便。但你会发现，你的习惯最终会让你付出更多的代价。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Suit yourself. But you'll find out that your habit will cost you more than that in the end.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随你便。但你会发现，你的习惯最终会让你付出更多的代价。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Suit yourself. But you'll find out that your habit will cost you more than that in the end.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随你便。但你会发现，你的习惯最终会让你付出更多的代价。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, cure me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，请治疗我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, there you go. And don't complain about the taste.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，可以了。别抱怨那个味道了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lieutenant Markland [0012AC9F] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, cure me. Here's 50 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，治好我。给你50瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, I'd love to help you out of the goodness of my heart, but I have an awful lot of patients to consider.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，我很愿意帮助你，但是我有太多的病人需要照顾。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lieutenant Markland [0012AC9F] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't afford treatment. I don't have 50 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我负担不起治疗费用。我没有50瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, there you are. The convulsions should stop in the next one to twelve weeks. If they don't, try holding on to something that's very still.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了。抽搐症状会在未来一至十二周内好转。如果没好转，那就找个牢靠的东西扶好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Ada Straus [000CE88C] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, cure me. Here's 50 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，治好我。给你50瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why didn't you say so? No problem. I'll give you my free cure. Here, lean in. It's a special doctor secret.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你干嘛不早说？没问题。我免费给你开个药方。过来，靠近点，这可是我的独门秘方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Ada Straus [000CE88C] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : not yelled, but loudly. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stop doing chems!
ESP.TRADUIT: ——别再嗑药了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Ada Straus [000CE88C] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : not yelled, but loudly. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't afford treatment. I don't have 50 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我负担不起治疗费用。我没有50瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There, that's got it. Don't be so eager to sample dangerous substances in the future, okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 行了。别再拿那些危险的东西往自己身上试了，行吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Senior Scribe Schuler [000E27E6] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, cure me. Here's 50 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，治好我。给你50瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My supplies are rather limited, and we can only get more by trading. Which requires money. Money you don't have. Come back when you have some.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，我的医疗用品也很有限，需要的话只能去向别人买。而那就得花钱。可你没钱，所以还是等你有钱了再回来吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Senior Scribe Schuler [000E27E6] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't afford treatment. I don't have 50 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我负担不起治疗费用。我没有50瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And there we go. Now, try to stay off the stuff, you hear?
ESP.TRADUIT: 可以了。记着，以后别再依赖那玩意了，听到了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Sawbones [00155A03] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, cure me. Here's 50 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，治好我。给你50瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay... all done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的……搞定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Mitchell [00104C0C] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, this is a special concoction of Pre-War medicine, should flush your system right out...
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是战前的特殊药品，可以让你立刻恢复正常……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright... I got some of this Pre-War stuff, should flush your system right out...
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好……我得到了一些战前物资，可以让你恢复正常……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Church [06000A6E] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, this should flush you out pretty quick. Now open your mouth and say "Ah."
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，这应该可以让你恢复正常。现在张开嘴巴，说：“啊”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll be glad to help when you can afford the treatment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当你能够付得起治疗费用时，我会很乐意提供帮忙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have 50 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有50个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come back when you actually have the money, you damn junkie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等你有钱了再来，你这该死的瘾君子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have 50 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有50个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. Hold still. I don't want to make this any more painful than it already is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，别动。我不想让这事变得更痛苦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I might be addicted to something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我或许对某些东西上瘾了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can give you something that should help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能给你些东西，它们应该有所帮助。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The treatment costs 50 caps. Even most outsiders should be able to afford it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 治疗需要花费50个瓶盖。大多数外来者都付得起。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Banfield [060156D9] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can take care of it for you, for a price.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会帮你的，但要支付一定费用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Church [06000A6E] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That'll be 50 caps. Maybe the dent in your pocketbook will keep you away from that crap.
ESP.TRADUIT: 50个瓶盖。或许你的钱包干瘪后会让你远离那些垃圾。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Church [06000A6E] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I swear, you and Zip, just full of your own little chemical problems, aren't you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我发誓，你和拉链，老是有点小小的化学问题，不是吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, hold on. I've got you covered.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，坚持住。我会照顾你的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I might be addicted to something. Can you help?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我可能对某些东西上瘾了，你能帮帮我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: And here I thought Zip's soda problem was bad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而我觉得拉链的苏打问题很糟。

ESP.ORIGINAL: For 50 caps, I can help you get over that. Otherwise, you can find your own solution.
ESP.TRADUIT: 50个瓶盖。我就帮你克服那问题。否则，你就只有自己寻找解决方法。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I might be addicted to something. Can you help?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我可能对某些东西上瘾了，你能帮帮我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought you had the look about you. Sure, I can help you. But it's not free. 50 caps, take it or leave it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认为你很清楚自己的现状。当然，我可以帮助你。但不是免费的。50个瓶盖。你愿意吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just glad you're willing to get help. But the treatment isn't free. I'll need 50 caps for the drugs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很高兴你愿意来求助。但这不是免费的。我需要50个瓶盖作为药费。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought you had the look about you. Sure, I can help you. But it's not free. 50 caps, take it or leave it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认为你很清楚自己的现状。当然，我可以帮助你。但不是免费的。50个瓶盖。你愿意吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red [06025251] (mod) NPC : Lucy [06015696] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe you are and maybe you aren't, but I don't give my help to enemies of the NCR. Maybe you can find a raider "medic" to fix you up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管你会不会，反正我是不会对NCR的敌人施以援手的。你可以找个掠夺者"医生"来帮你解决问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Sawbones [00155A03] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, pipe down. We can't talk about that here, out in the open.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘘，小点声。我们不能在公开场合谈论这个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Ada Straus [000CE88C] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : Emphasize "cure." EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you mean you want a cure. Oh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你是说你想要脱瘾。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Ada Straus [000CE88C] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : Emphasize "cure." EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you've seen half the things I've seen out in the Wasteland, I can't say I blame you. I might be able to help with that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你在废土的见闻有我的一半，那我也不好怪你。也许我可以帮你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lieutenant Markland [0012AC9F] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, then, take two shots of whiskey and call me in the morning. Heh heh, little doctor humor. Okay, let's have a look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，先喝两杯威士忌，明早再来找我。呵呵。这是咱们医生这一行的小笑话。行了，我来瞧瞧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Sawbones [00155A03] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't say that's something I treat all the time, but I should have something to help you through it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这症状和我以前治过的那些病人有点不同，不过我还是有办法帮你渡过难关的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Senior Scribe Schuler [000E27E6] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. I can help you out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。我可以帮你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Mitchell [00104C0C] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Could you repair my equipment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能帮我修理一下装备吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Could I? Yes. Will I? No. Go see Peabody or Bowditch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能吗？是的。我愿意吗？不。去找博迪或鲍迪奇吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you think you could repair my equipment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能帮我修理一下装备吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just wanted you to kill him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是想让你杀了他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You sick bastard. You'd better be ready to join him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这个王八蛋。那你就和他一起下地狱去吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just wanted you to kill him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是想让你杀了他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You sick bastard. You'd better be ready to join her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这个王八蛋。那你就和她一起下地狱去吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just wanted you to kill her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是想让你杀了她。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll kill more with two of us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们两人联手能杀的更多。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. Let's get out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。让我们离开这里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, well what do you know? I'm gonna go out there and I'm gonna have the biggest, toughest gang ever!
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊。你知道些什么？我准备出去，我要建立最庞大、最强悍的帮派！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Cowardly, trying to hide the fact that he won't do it. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Y'know... tomorrow. Once I round up a few more people...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道，呃…明天，一旦我召集到更多人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Cowardly, trying to hide the fact that he won't do it. EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah... shame you're too much of a coward to start it yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯……真可耻，你太懦弱了，不能自己动手。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? A goody-two-shoes like you could never make it in a real gang!
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？你这样自命清高的人是不可能建立什么帮派的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Emphasis: HARD. EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You want to hang with a Tunnel Snake like me, you gotta be hard.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想要像我一样在穴蛇帮有地位，对你来说很难。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Butch [06027F65] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Emphasis: HARD. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You could join forces with me, if you'd like.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要是愿意，你可以加入我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa, hey, that's cool and all, but you're just a little too... intense, y'know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇哦，哇哦，那很酷，但你有点太……认真了，你知道吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean, Butch is down for action, but you... You're a psycho!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的意思是，布奇是个行动主义者，而你……是个只会嘴上谈兵！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ride with me, and we can rampage across the Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我一起闯荡吧，我们可以在废土轰轰烈烈一场。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I really wish I could, man, but three's a crowd, you know? I'll just stay here for now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真的希望我可以，哥们。但是，有太多杂务烦扰着我，你能理解吗？我现在只想静会。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tunnel Snakes rule!
ESP.TRADUIT: 穴蛇帮主宰一切！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come along with me, and we'll make an awesome gang.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我一起走吧，我们会成为一个惊天动地的帮派。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah... yeah! You'd be perfect for my gang! You're in!
ESP.TRADUIT: 对……对的！你将会是我的帮派里最完美的！加入吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tunnel Snakes rule!
ESP.TRADUIT: 穴蛇帮主宰一切！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come along with me, and we'll make an awesome gang.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我一起走吧，我们会成为一个惊天动地的帮派。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then good luck finding someone who'd risk their life for yours. Not something a sane person would do these days, is it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 找到肯为了你的性命牺牲的人可要好运气呢。如今可没正常人会这么做，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No deal. I like my bodyguards sane.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不干。我要理智的保镖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any time you need some company, she'll be here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管你什么时候缺个伴，她都会在这里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wish I could take her now. Maybe later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真希望我现在就可以带她走。再说吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I ought to sic Clover on you, just to show who's boss.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我应该让可萝尔来咬你，你简直太他妈能杀价了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: But you're right. She makes the other girls nervous. And when they're nervous, I'm nervous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但你是对的。她让其他女孩紧张了。她们一紧张，我也跟着紧张。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So go ahead and have fun with Clover. She's your problem, now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 去和可萝尔一起去开心吧。她是你的问题了，从现在开始！

ESP.ORIGINAL: If she's so crazy, maybe I'll take her off your hands. But only for 500 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果她这么疯狂，也许我会把她从你身边带走。不过我只出500个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't know the half of it, friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 朋友，你连事情的一半都不了解。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Clover's all yours now... have fun, you two!
ESP.TRADUIT: 可萝尔现在是你的性奴了……好好享受吧，你们俩！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds like a good deal, and fun, too. Sold.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来是个不错的交易，也很有趣。卖了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Trust me, she's worth every cap.
ESP.TRADUIT: 相信我，她值那么多瓶盖的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Guess I'll have to save up for her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来我必须为她节衣缩食了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come with me, dog. It'll be good to have some company out here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我来，狗狗。在这地方能有个同伴真好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <bark> <bark> <bark!>
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dogmeat [0606A772] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Friendly barking EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could use a pet like you. Let's go find something to eat, mutt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也想要个你这样的宠物。我们去找点吃的，小狗。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <growl!>
ESP.TRADUIT: <咆哮！>
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dogmeat [0606A772] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Aggressive, violent growl. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can be your new master. Would you like that, boy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我当你的新主人。你喜欢吗，小家伙？

ESP.ORIGINAL: <bark!> <bark!> <bark!>
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dogmeat [0606A772] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Friendly, happy barking EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gotta be careful, using a slave as a bodyguard. Most aren't exactly motivated to keep you alive, you know what I mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 用奴隶做保镖可要当心啊。他们大多数人并没有让你活下去的动机，你知道我什么意思吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're in luck -- it turns out my girl Clover is just the right little package for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你走运啦 — 碰巧我的女孩可萝尔就很适合你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm in the market for a bodyguard like yours. You selling?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想买你的保镖，你卖吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: My friend, I would be honored to follow a hero such as yourself. Shall we go?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的朋友，跟随像你这样的英雄是我的荣幸。我们可以走了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could always use a hand. Would you like to follow me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我总是需要帮手，你愿意跟着我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It seems I didn't know you as well as I had thought. My mistake.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看起来我对你的了解不如我想象的那样好。我的错。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've read about a museum of history in the south. Perhaps I can learn more about the world there, without facing such enmity.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我读到过南边有个历史博物馆。或许我能在那里了解更多，而且不会碰到这么大的敌意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will take my leave of you. Goodbye, my rescuer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要离开你了，再见，我的恩人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was in that situation once, myself. Deal with it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以前也碰到过这种情况。处理掉吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I appreciate the offer, but I must decline. I have an entire world to explore, and I must not be delayed any further.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你提出来，但我必须拒绝。我还要四处探索，不能够再耽搁了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have read about a great museum of history to the south. Perhaps I will head there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我读到过南部有个很大的历史博物馆。或许我应该去那。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goodbye, my friend. Perhaps I will join you in the future, if your goals are virtuous enough to draw me away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见，我的朋友。或许我会在将来加入你们，如果你的目标高尚到足够吸引我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could always use a hand. Would you like to follow me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我总是需要帮手，你愿意跟着我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: My friend, I would be honored to follow a hero such as yourself. Shall we go?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的朋友，跟随像你这样的英雄是我的荣幸。我们可以走了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could always use a hand. Would you like to follow me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我总是需要帮手，你愿意跟着我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go away! I'm not opening the door until the lockdown's over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 滚开！直到戒严结束我才会开门的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, you can have it. Just move on and leave Canterbury alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，拿走这个。离开坎特伯雷。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent. It shall make a fine memento of a nemesis bested. A trophy of a foe... antagonized!
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了。这是最好的纪念品。从敌人…对手那得到的战利品！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The AntAgonizer [06036C1C] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit Comment (NAM2) : with evil maniacal glee EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: For your loyal assistance, take this blade. Its sting carries the venom of a thousand ants, and your foes shall tremble before it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了你忠诚的帮助，请拿着这把刀。它萃取了上万蚂蚁的毒液，你的敌人会在你面前瑟瑟发抖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The AntAgonizer [06036C1C] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit Comment (NAM2) : with evil maniacal glee EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now that the tin-plated menace is no more, I shall take my leave of this town. I do believe it's time for my colony to spread.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在那破铜烂铁的威胁已经解除了。我也应该离开这小镇了。我想是时候让我这小小的领土向外扩散了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The AntAgonizer [06036C1C] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit Comment (NAM2) : with evil maniacal glee EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent. The evil taint of the AntAgonizer will never darken the land again! Now that the AntAgonizer is taken care of, Canterbury Commons is safe!
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了。痛苦蚁后邪恶的污染再也无法让这片土地变得黑暗了！既然痛苦蚁后被解决了，那坎特伯雷社区就安全了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Mechanist [06036C1B] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: And for your loyal assistance, I'm honored to present you with this laser pistol, crafted from my last loyal robot assistant. May it guide you well!
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了你忠诚的帮助，我很荣幸地赠予你这把激光手枪，它是由我忠实的机器人助手制作的。希望它能好好地引导你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Mechanist [06036C1B] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: But the Mechanist cannot rest! Not while there's evil afoot in the Wasteland! Farewell!
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是机械侠不能休息！只要还有邪恶在废土横行，就绝不能休息！再见！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Mechanist [06036C1B] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good news, Three Dog. I already have the dish.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好消息，三狗。我已经找到你要的天线了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa! You must be some kind of a psychic or something!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇哦！！你会心灵感应吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, don't just stand there gawking... go bring that sucker to the Washington Monument so my lady can sing again!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，别傻站着，把那玩意带到华盛顿纪念碑顶，我的爱人才能再度欢唱！

ESP.ORIGINAL: This isn't rocket science. I know exactly what you are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是什么高科技。我很清楚你是什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You amaze me. Never have I met a human with the gift of cognition that you possess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你让我感到惊奇。我从未见过你这样感知敏锐的人类。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me then, what are we?
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉我，我们是什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not here to take sides, just to make sure Vance hasn't omitted any facts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我保持中立，只是确定万斯没有忽略任何事实。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd never thought of it that way. I suppose he should get a chance to talk to someone like you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从没想到这点，我想他应该和你这样的人谈谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Justin [060200C9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's the password to his isolation area. Just please don't mention my name to Vance about this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是去他那区域的密码。不要把这事告诉万斯啊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You always have had a knack for making me feel better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你总有办法可以让我感觉好些。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing in Underworld?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在地下城做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, take a look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，看看。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to buy some ammo from you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想在你这里买些弹药。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um... I went into the abandoned house, but I didn't see anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯…我进入了那间废屋，但我没看到任何东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you look? Did you really look? You can't just look with your eyes, you know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看了吗？你真的看了吗？你得明白，你不能只用眼睛去看。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060244A2] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You think he really looks like that little girl? He hides things. Confuses them. You have to find a way to find it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看布劳恩。你认为他真的像那小女孩？他把东西隐藏起来，迷惑他们。你最好想办法找到它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060244A2] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds like a deal. Here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来很合理。给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You drive a hard bargain, but it's worth every cap.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别讨价还价了，你花的每一个瓶盖都是值得的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Will you give me 100 caps for it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你愿意为它付出100个瓶盖吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you very much!
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常感谢！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds like a deal. Here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来很合理。给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You drive a hard bargain, but it's worth every cap.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别讨价还价了，你花的每一个瓶盖都是值得的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Will you give me 125 caps for it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你愿意为它付出125个瓶盖吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you very much!
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常感谢！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gob!
ESP.TRADUIT: 盖博！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : yelling at his slave to get to work EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know, I know. I'll get a mop. It's just... blood is so hard to get out of the floor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道，我知道，我去拿拖把。只是……地上的血太难清理了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gob [06000A62] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : cringing and afraid he's going to get in trouble EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that's been a long time coming. Good riddance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这一天我等了好久，总算解脱了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9E]MS11) The Power of the Atom Comment (NAM2) : glad to see his rival murdered EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: That sounds awfully complicated. Why can't I just get out the normal way?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来很复杂啊。为什么我不能用寻常方法呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: My father's not stupid. He's sealed the door to the exit to prevent anyone else from escaping.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的父亲不是傻子。他封了通向出口的门，防止其他人逃出去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The tunnel is the only way out! You're just going to have to trust me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这条隧道是唯一能出去的路！你只要相信我就行了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, one more thing. I stole my father's pistol. I hope you won't need it, but you'd better take it just in case.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，还有一件事。我把父亲的手枪偷出来了。我希望你不会用它，但最好还是拿着以防万一。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds like a good plan. Let's get out of here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来是不错的计划；我们走吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, one more thing. I stole my father's pistol. I hope you won't need it, but you'd better take it just in case.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，还有一件事。我把父亲的手枪偷出来了。我希望你不会用它，但最好还是拿着以防万一。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Want to come with me? It's dangerous out here all alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想跟我一起吗？离开这的路会很危险的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <pant> <pant>
ESP.TRADUIT: <喘气><喘气>
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dogmeat [0606A772] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : happy panting EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're back. Somebody open up the... Hang on, something' ain't right here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们回来了。谁来开……等等，不对头啊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : Raider captain over intercom, returning from a raid. NOTE: add radio/intercom filter. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stay here, boy. Don't move until I come back!
ESP.TRADUIT: 待在这，小子。在我回来之前别乱走动！

ESP.ORIGINAL: <whine>
ESP.TRADUIT: <哀鸣声>
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dogmeat [0606A772] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Sad whining EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, I'll leave. You stay here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，我会离开。你待在这。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <whimper>
ESP.TRADUIT: <呜咽>
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dogmeat [0606A772] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Sad dog whimper EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're welcome.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不客气。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you kept your promise. I really didn't think you would. Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你信守了你的诺言。我真的以为你做不到。谢谢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Follow me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The sooner we get there, the better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们越早到那越好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这等着。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't be gone too long.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别离开太久了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Find me a weapon, boy!
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我找把武器，小家伙！

ESP.ORIGINAL: <bark!>
ESP.TRADUIT: <吠叫！>
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dogmeat [0606A772] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Affirmative, energetic bark EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Find chems, boy!
ESP.TRADUIT: 找些药品，小家伙！

ESP.ORIGINAL: <bark!>
ESP.TRADUIT: <吠叫！>
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dogmeat [0606A772] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Affirmative, energetic bark EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Find some food, boy!
ESP.TRADUIT: 找些食物，小家伙！

ESP.ORIGINAL: <bark!>
ESP.TRADUIT: <吠叫！>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Find some food, boy!
ESP.TRADUIT: 找些食物，小家伙！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Find ammo, boy!
ESP.TRADUIT: 找些弹药，小家伙！

ESP.ORIGINAL: <bark!>
ESP.TRADUIT: <吠叫！>
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dogmeat [0606A772] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Affirmative, energetic bark EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dogmeat, I need you to find something for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 狗肉，我要你帮我找些东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <bark>
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dogmeat [0606A772] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Affirmative bark EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stop searching, pup.
ESP.TRADUIT: 停止搜索，狗狗。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <bark>
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dogmeat [0606A772] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Affirmative bark EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stop searching, Dogmeat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 停止搜索，狗肉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have 100 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有100个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right kid. Then I guess there's nothing else we have to say to each other. Come back to me when you have the caps, and we'll talk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，孩子，我想我们之间没什么可说的，等你有了瓶盖再来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, just give me some of your caps, and I'll tell him you're gone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，给我些瓶盖，我就告诉他你已经离开了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'd do that for me? I never expected anyone to care enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你愿意为我这么做吗？我从没期待有人会关心我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here you go. Thanks, kid. You're all right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你。谢谢，孩子，你是个好人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, just give me the caps and I'll tell him you're gone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，给我些瓶盖，我就告诉他你已经离开了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am tired of hiding out here like some kind of Wasteland dog.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我厌倦了在这躲躲藏藏，就像废土上的狗一样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I... I guess you're right. Here... this is all I have. Please leave me alone now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我…我猜你是对的。给你…这是我所有的。现在让我独自待会。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't care. I'm just here for caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不关心，我在这就是为了瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is never gonna end until I send him a message. Well, fine. If I have to kill you to send it, I will!
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我告诉他前，这没完！好。如果我必须杀了你，我会这么做的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can talk all you want, but I'm not leaving without the caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随你怎么说，不过没有瓶盖我是不会离开的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'd better calm down, before I put you down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好在我干掉你之前冷静下来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That lying bastard. Roped you into finding me too, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那说谎的杂种派你来找我，呃？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you're not getting a damn thing from me! You hear me?! Not a damn thing!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你没法从我这得到任何东西！你听到了吗？什么都不会给你！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa, calm down... Who the hell is Moriarty?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇哦，冷静下来…莫里亚蒂是他妈谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Colin Moriarty... the owner of Moriarty's Saloon in Megaton.
ESP.TRADUIT: 科林·莫里亚蒂…核弹镇里莫里亚蒂酒吧的老板。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That sack of shit is convinced that I'm some crazy junkie who stole money from him!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那傻子认定我是偷他钱的疯癫瘾君子！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's Moriarty?
ESP.TRADUIT: 莫里亚蒂是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Colin Moriarty... the owner of Moriarty's Saloon in Megaton.
ESP.TRADUIT: 科林·莫里亚蒂…核弹镇里莫里亚蒂酒吧的老板。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That sack of shit is convinced that I'm some crazy junkie who stole money from him!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那傻子认定我是偷他钱的疯癫瘾君子！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't deal with junkies. Hand over all your caps. Now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不和瘾君子交易，把你所有的瓶盖交出来，快！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're not getting a damn thing from me! You hear me?! Not a damn thing!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你没法从我这得到任何东西！你听到了吗？什么都不会给你！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just hand over the caps, and I'll be out of your way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把你所有的瓶盖交出来，我就会放你走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Owe HIM some caps? He's a liar! He just wants you to kill me! Those caps are mine, fair and square.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欠他一些瓶盖？他是一个骗子！他只想让你杀了我！那些瓶盖是我的，正大光明。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, and he says you owe him some caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，他说你欠他一些瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That bastard! He's a... he's a liar! He just wants me dead! Those caps are all mine. I earned them!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那杂种！他…他是一个骗子！他就想让我死，那些瓶盖都是我的。是我赚来的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I need a way to get some caps or I'll never have the money to pay you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我需要得到一些瓶盖，否则我就永远不会有钱付你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. I hope she got what she deserved.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，我希望她能得到应有的下场。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I took care of Silver for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我帮你处理掉了席尔瓦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't still offer your... services, do you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你没有继续提供…服务了吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, sorry. I've left that part of my life behind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，对不起，我已经舍弃了我昔日的那种生活。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What will you do now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在你要干嘛？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who knows. Shoot myself up until I forget who I am?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁知道呢。自我沉沦直到忘了我是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Wasteland sucks, kid. Just get used to it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 废土太糟糕了，孩子，学着习惯吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mister Crowley wants that key. Now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 考利先生要那把钥匙，现在就要！

ESP.ORIGINAL: What key? Oh, that key.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么钥匙？哦，那把钥匙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a moron. I don't have any of his precious keys. Idiot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这蠢货。我没有他那把宝贝钥匙，白痴！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Allistair Tenpenny [060156E0] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA1]MS14) You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Help!
ESP.TRADUIT: 救命啊！

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, you'll need it more than I will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，你会比我更需要它。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right. It's dangerous out here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是对的，外面很危险。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I... I have to go. Before more of them come.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我…我必须走了。等下他们会来更多人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take that. Now get out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要它了。现在快点离开这。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, thank you again! I'm going to try to make it home... if it's still there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着，再次感谢你！我要回家去了……如果它还在的话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a liar, Moriarty. I know where I grew up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这骗子！莫里亚蒂，我知道我在哪长大的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aaahhhh. I see. You know, I heard about the brainwashin' that goes on down there. From some other fella, escaped, oh... five years back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈哈哈，我了解了，你知道吗，我从一些那里逃出来的家伙那儿打听到，那里有着某种洗脑活动……5年前的事了吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: "All hail the Overseer! We're born in the Vault, we die in the Vault!" And all that other assorted lunacy.
ESP.TRADUIT: “赞美监督者！我们生于避难所，我们死在避难所！”之类的各种疯言疯语。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kid, you've got better programming than our own Deputy Weld. You'd best wise up quick. Wouldn't want anyone... takin' advantage of ya. Hmm?
ESP.TRADUIT: 孩子，你做事比我们的“副警长威尔德”更有计划。你最好快点明白。你不会希望有人……占你的便宜吧，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're wrong. My Dad never would have lied to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你错了，我爸爸从不对我说谎。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aaahhhh. I see. You know, I heard about the brainwashin' that goes on down there. From some other fella, escaped, oh... five years back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈哈哈，我了解了，你知道吗，我从一些那里逃出来的家伙那儿打听到，那里有着某种洗脑活动……5年前的事了吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.TRADUIT: “赞美监督者！我们生于避难所，我们死在避难所！”之类的各种疯言疯语。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.TRADUIT: 孩子，你做事比我们的“副警长威尔德”更有计划。你最好快点明白。你不会希望有人……占你的便宜吧，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I wasn't born in the Vault? That's complete bullshit, and you know it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我不是出生于避难所的？那纯粹是胡说，你知道的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aaahhhh. I see. You know, I heard about the brainwashin' that goes on down there. From some other fella, escaped, oh... five years back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈哈哈，我了解了，你知道吗，我从一些那里逃出来的家伙那儿打听到，那里有着某种洗脑活动……5年前的事了吧。

ESP.TRADUIT: 孩子，你做事比我们的“副警长威尔德”更有计划。你最好快点明白。你不会希望有人……占你的便宜吧，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: My Dad told me we were born in Vault 101...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我爸爸告诉我，我们都是在101号避难所出生的……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aaahhhh. I see. You know, I heard about the brainwashin' that goes on down there. From some other fella, escaped, oh... five years back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈哈哈，我了解了，你知道吗，我从一些那里逃出来的家伙那儿打听到，那里有着某种洗脑活动……5年前的事了吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Surprise
