ESP.TRADUIT: “赞美监督者！我们生于避难所，我们死在避难所！”之类的各种疯言疯语。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.TRADUIT: 孩子，你做事比我们的“副警长威尔德”更有计划。你最好快点明白。你不会希望有人……占你的便宜吧，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colin Moriarty [06000A61] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stay here. Maybe I'll come back for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就在这待着，我会回来找你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <whine>
ESP.TRADUIT: <哀鸣声>

ESP.ORIGINAL: <whine>
ESP.TRADUIT: <哀鸣声>

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't take you right now, stay here. I'll come back for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在不能带着你，呆在这里。我会回来找你的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mentioned something about Galaxy News Radio?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你提到了银河新闻电台？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, the Brotherhood needed a secure outpost, and the guy who runs the radio station needed to not get his head ripped off by Super Mutants.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，兄弟会需要一个安全的前哨站，而电台的那家伙不想被超级变种人撕掉脑袋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a mutually beneficial relationship.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一种互助互惠的关系。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps

ESP.ORIGINAL: Three Dog is the man in charge. He keeps that signal broadcasting, pretty much single handedly. He's um... interesting. I'll give him that much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 三狗管理着这，他维持进行直播，亲力亲为。他很…很有趣。我只能说那么多了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything else you can tell me about GNR?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有什么关于银河台的事要告诉我？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who did you say you were again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你刚才说你是谁来着？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take that as a compliment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就当作是恭维了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If we don't try to keep the mutants from killing everyone and everything in the Capital Wasteland, who will?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我们不去阻止超级变种人烧杀抢掠，还有谁会去？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Brotherhood does its best, but sometimes it takes a little something... special. That's where the Lyons' Pride comes in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 兄弟会做得很好，但是有时会有一些特别的……任务，也就是“里昂斯的骄傲”参与的时候。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E87]MQ01) Following in His Footsteps EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow. You guys don't screw around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇哦，你们这些家伙还真行。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have anything for sale?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么卖的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, have a look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，随便看。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Things are pretty good with Meyers watching over us. I can give you a little bit of a discount.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有迈尔斯保护我们，一切都很顺利。我可以给你打点折扣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yep, and I got more ammunition now that the NCR keeps supplies flowing in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我手上的弹药多得很，NCR一直在往这儿送呢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: On the other hand I'm payin' them NCR taxes, so now you got to as well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 另一方面，我也向他们交了税。所以恐怕你得多付钱了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's Irving.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他叫艾尔文。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hahahaha! Irving! Are you serious?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈！艾尔文！你说真的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh man... wait until the other guys hear this... Irving!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，哥们…让其他人来听听吧……艾尔文！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's the pool. You earned it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你，这是你赚的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're tough to find.
ESP.TRADUIT: 找到你还真不容易。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe that's because I don't want to be found.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许那是因为我不想被找到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ian West [0601D5F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I shouldn't be surprised that you're here. I figured Evan King would get someone to track me down sooner or later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对于你的到来，我并不应该感到惊讶。我早就猜到埃万·金迟早会派人来找我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ian West [0601D5F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Evan King sent me to look for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 埃万·金派我来找你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I guess I should have known this would happen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我想我早就应该知道这事会发生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ian West [0601D5F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Read this letter, Ian. Lucy wrote it. I bet that would change your mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 伊恩，看看这封信，露西写的。我保证你看完了会改变主意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She... she really misses being home and she's asked about me in here a lot!
ESP.TRADUIT: 她……她真心怀念我们一家人团团圆圆的日子，她还问我现在的情况！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ian West [0601D5F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I had it all wrong. I shouldn't have come here. I bet Lucy is feeling just as bad as me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我完全错了。我不该来这鬼地方，我发誓露西现在心里和我一样难受。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ian West [0601D5F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go back to Arefu and tell Evan King that I'm coming home. I have a few things to pack and I want to say my goodbyes to this place... alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回到断桥镇，告诉埃万·金我要回家了。我需要一个人……收拾行李，对这地方说再见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ian West [0601D5F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: She... she really misses being home and she's asked about me in here a lot!
ESP.TRADUIT: 她……她真心怀念我们一家人团团圆圆的日子，她还问我现在的情况！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ian West [0601D5F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I had it all wrong. I shouldn't have come here. I bet Lucy is feeling just as bad as me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我完全错了。我不该来这鬼地方，我发誓露西现在心里和我一样难受。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ian West [0601D5F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please, tell Vance I've made my decision. I'm going home to Arefu. I hope to see you there as well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 求你了，告诉万斯我下了决心，我要回断桥镇的家。希望在那见到你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ian West [0601D5F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Read this letter, Ian. Lucy wrote it. I bet that would change your mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 伊恩，看看这封信，露西写的。我保证你看完了会改变主意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She... she really misses being home and she's asked about me in here a lot!
ESP.TRADUIT: 她……她真心怀念我们一家人团团圆圆的日子，她还问我现在的情况！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ian West [0601D5F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I had it all wrong. I shouldn't have come here. I bet Lucy is feeling just as bad as me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我完全错了。我不该来这鬼地方，我发誓露西现在心里和我一样难受。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ian West [0601D5F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go back to Arefu and tell Evan King that I'm coming home. I have a few things to pack and I want to say my goodbyes to this place... alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回到断桥镇，告诉埃万·金我要回家了。我需要一个人……收拾行李，对这地方说再见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ian West [0601D5F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, this place isn't the answer. You need to go home and face your demons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，待在这不能解决问题。你必须回家正视你的心魔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe you're right. It was easier to run away with the Family than to face what I did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许你是对的。跟着家族逃避总比正视自己的所作所为来得容易。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ian West [0601D5F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go back to Arefu and tell Evan King that I'm coming home. I have a few things to pack and I want to say my goodbyes to this place... alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回到断桥镇，告诉埃万·金我要回家了。我需要一个人……收拾行李，对这地方说再见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ian West [0601D5F5] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I delivered the letter to Ian.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把信交给了伊恩。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She... she really misses being home and she's asked about me in here a lot!
ESP.TRADUIT: 她……她真心怀念我们一家人团团圆圆的日子，她还问我现在的情况！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have no idea how much this means to me. Thanks so much!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不知道这对我有多重要。真心感谢你！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a letter for you from your sister, Lucy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你姐姐露西有封信要我带给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You bastard! Those Ghouls declared me a Saint!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这个混蛋！那些尸鬼们可是把我当成圣人的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I sabotaged the rockets.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我破坏了那些火箭。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Umm... Well... Ahhh... Sure... Uh...
Ha ha! You talk a lot! Sound funny when you talk, like a stupid human. Ha ha ha ha ha!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！你话好多！你说话的时候真搞笑，就像愚蠢的人类。哈哈哈哈哈！

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is boring. We should be collecting more humans. We need more of us! The bucketheads have killed too many...
ESP.TRADUIT: 无聊呢。我们应该多收集些人类。我们需要更多帮手！水桶脑袋杀死了太多……

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have joke for you. Ready? Knock knock.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我给你说个笑话。准备好了没？诺克敲门。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Power armor, energy weapons, and all sorts of advanced technology. Even some junk like sensor units or spare parts can be useful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 动力装甲、能量武器和各种先进技术。即使一些垃圾，像传感器或其他多余零件，都能变废为宝。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some of it goes into the archives, some of it gets used to repair our own gear. Either way, it's better in our hands than lying around out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一些归入档案，一些用于修理我们自己的装备。无论如何，都比把它们当废品丢在一边强。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you looking for, again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你又在找什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've definitely proven your worth. I'll make sure to tell our people on patrol that you're a friend of the Outcasts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你确实证明了你的价值。我保证会通知在巡逻中的伙伴，你是我们放逐者的朋友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, are we good? You trust me enough now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们现在是朋友了？你信任我了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Useful stuff out there. Hope you don't have to use too much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在外面很有用。希望你不会常用。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take Rad-Away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要辐特宁。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't stand this stuff, myself. Goes through me like a rampaging Brahmin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我受不了这东西，用了后我的体内就像有只在狂奔的双头牛。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take Rad-Away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要辐特宁。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here. Everyone's favorite. What would we do without them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，每个人都喜欢它。要是没有这玩意，我们该怎么活？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take Stimpaks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要治疗针。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, enjoy them in good health. Or, at least, when you'd like to be in good health.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，你要是受了伤就来上一针。它至少可以让你活得久一点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take Stimpaks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要治疗针。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Be careful. These can pack quite a pop.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小心，它会爆的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take Frag Grenades.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要破片手榴弹。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Always a popular choice, these. Enjoy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很多人都选它。好好享受。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take Frag Grenades.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要破片手榴弹。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here you go. Try not to use it all in one place, unless you have to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你。如非必要，不要一次用光。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take 5.56 ammo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要5.56毫米子弹。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's hoping you don't have to use it. But who am I kidding?
ESP.TRADUIT: 希望它用不上。可是我在骗谁呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take 5.56 ammo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要5.56毫米子弹。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's practically junk, but we can get some use out of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它实际上是垃圾，但我们能变废为宝。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How'd you like your payment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要什么回报？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got some Scrap Metal for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我帮你搞到了一些废金属。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's practically junk, but we can get some use out of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它实际上是垃圾，但我们能变废为宝。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How'd you like your payment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要什么回报？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got a Sensor Module for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我帮你搞到了一个传感器模块。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Interesting. Very interesting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有趣。非常有趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This definitely bears some study. Now, how would you like your payment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有一定的研究价值。你想要什么回报？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, I found some Alien Power Cells.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，我找到了一个外星动力电池。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What in the world?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是怎么回事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, I think the boys down in the lab would be very interested in this. You did right to bring this to us!
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我想实验室的男孩们会对这玩意非常感兴趣。把它给我们你算是找对了人！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, what would you like in return for this amazing find?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了这一惊人的发现，你想要什么回报？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll like this. It's an Alien Blaster. Seriously.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会喜欢它的，这是一把外星枪，真的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pretty rare piece of equipment, this. Good find.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常稀有的装备。好手段。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How'd you like your payment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要什么回报？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got a Plasma Pistol for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我帮你搞到了电浆手枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pretty rare piece of equipment, this. Good find.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常稀有的装备。好手段。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How'd you like your payment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要什么回报？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got a Plasma Rifle for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我帮你搞到了电浆步枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We can always use another one of these.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这类东西对我们来说总是很有用。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How'd you like your payment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要什么回报？

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about a Laser Pistol?
ESP.TRADUIT: 极光手枪怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We can always use another one of these.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这类东西对我们来说总是很有用。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How'd you like your payment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要什么回报？

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about a Laser Rifle?
ESP.TRADUIT: 激光步枪怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is some pretty heavy-duty stuff. We'll take good care of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 相当耐用的东西。我们会好好保管。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, what can I give you in return?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要什么回报？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's a Power Armor Helmet from the Enclave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你英克雷的动力装甲头盔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well I'll be damned. The Advanced Power Armor Mark II. This is superb. Absolutely superb.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，该死的。先进的二型动力装甲。一级棒，绝对一流。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, what can I give you in return?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要什么回报？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's some Power Armor from the Enclave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你一些英克雷的动力装甲。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'd better believe it. I haven't seen a suit like this in a long time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 信不信，我很久没见过这样的装备了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And what would you like for this little surprise?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要点什么来换这个意外收获？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This Tesla Armor might be of interest to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可能会对这套特斯拉装甲感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not much good on its own, but the optics are useful, at least.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不怎么值钱，不过这光纤多少还有点用。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How'd you like your payment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要什么回报？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take this Power Armor Helmet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着这个动力装甲头盔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Always good to have another of these in the vaults.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在避难所里，这东西多多益善。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How'd you like your payment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要什么回报？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take this suit of Power Armor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着这套动力装甲。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see you've got some of our Power Armor there. I'll just take that off your hands.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看见你带着我们那种动力装甲。我就要它了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure you just found it in the Wastes and you're returning it to us, right? Because you'd have to be a real moron to try to turn it in for pay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信你是在废土找到它，拿来还给我们的，对吧？想用它来换钱，你还真是个白痴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, let's see what else you've got.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看你还有什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got some technology to turn in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要上交些科技产品。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's see what you've got.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们看看你有什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got some technology to turn in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要上交些科技产品。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Suit yourself. Why don't you go talk with Lyons? He's always got time for your kind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随你便。你为什么不找里昂斯谈谈？他总是有时间来应对你这种人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Morgan [06043DEB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A bit nasty and derogatory with the phrase "your kind"

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll pass. If I can't be a member, I won't be your errand runner.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我放弃。我想成为你们的一份子，而不是当跑腿的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, but first you'll have to talk with Protector Casdin. You can work out the details with him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，但你要先和守护者卡斯丁谈谈。他能帮你出出主意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds good. I'm in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来不错。我接受。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's simple enough. Bring in technological devices, and we'll pay you for what you find.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再简单不过。把你找到的科技装置带给我们，我们付你报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector Casdin [06040C39] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A little condescending.

ESP.ORIGINAL: Big things like power armor or energy weapons are best, but we'll take things like sensor units or spare parts, too. You never know what's important.
ESP.TRADUIT: 像动力装甲、能量武器这样的大玩意是最好不过，不过传感器或其他零件这些垃圾我们也照单全收。天晓得什么东西会有用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector Casdin [06040C39] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A little condescending. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: In return, we'll pay you with your choice of 5.56 ammo, grenades, stimpaks, or Rad-Away. I'll bet they're more useful to you out there, anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以从5.56弹药、手榴弹、治疗针或辐特宁里选一样作为我们对你的回报。我保证它们物超所值。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector Casdin [06040C39] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A little condescending. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need to know more about the job before deciding.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我做决定之前，我要详尽地了解这份工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you here in the Capital Wasteland?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们为什么出现在首都废土？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that depends on who you ask.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看你问谁。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lyons will tell you it's because we're protecting the poor, innocent people of the Capital Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 里昂斯会告诉你我们是为了保护首都废土贫困和无辜的人民。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Most others here will tell you the same thing. They'll do anything for that man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里大多数的人都会这么说。他们愿意为这个人赴汤蹈火。

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : dyingDAD_RECORD EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What was all that about? Who were those people?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是怎么回事？那都是什么人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The, um... Mechanist and the AntAgonizer. That's just what they call themselves. It's ridiculous, I know...
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯……机械侠和痛苦蚁后。他们这么称呼自己。我知道这很滑稽……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Uncle Roe [06031EC9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: A while ago, we were attacked by the AntAgonizer - that woman with the ants, obviously. The Mechanist saved the town with his robots.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们刚才被痛苦蚁后攻击了，就是那个带着蚂蚁的女人。机械侠带着他的机器人救了镇子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Uncle Roe [06031EC9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was all well and good, but I swear their fights are getting bigger, and it's been driving off the merchants. They simply won't leave!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那也好，不过我敢发誓他们的战斗不断升级，商人也被赶跑了。他们完全不肯离开！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Uncle Roe [06031EC9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mirelurk gives me gas. I'd rather have squirrel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 泥沼蟹肉吃多了会放屁。我情愿要松鼠肉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh... maybe you should sit in the corner. I can check to see if we have any squirrel if you wish.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯……或许你应该到角落找个位置坐下，我去看看还有没有松鼠肉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bannon is trying to blackmail Seagraves Holmes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 班侬正绞尽脑汁敲诈西格雷夫·福尔摩斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's pretty underhanded, even for Bannon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这事对班侬来说都显得下作了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once word gets out, I bet the market vendors won't want him to represent them anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这事一旦公布出去，我打赌市场的商人们不会再让他当代表了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you for your help, citizen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你的帮助，公民。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoever this Seagrave is, you think he's a threat to your influence?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管这西格雷夫是谁，你觉得他对你是一个威胁对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A threat? No, of course not! Well, maybe. He wants to replace me on the council.
ESP.TRADUIT: 威胁？不，当然不是！好吧，也许是。他想取代我在议会的位置。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's a shady character, I just can't prove it. Now if someone were to find something incriminating in his room...
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个阴险的人，我只是不能证明这一点。如果谁能去他的房间找到一些控告他的罪状……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, let's just say I would be very appreciative.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我将会感激不尽。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Seagrave? Oh yeah. He's clueless.
ESP.TRADUIT: 西格雷夫？没错，他是个蠢货。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you've met him, eh? Well he wants to replace me on the council. Now, I can't have that. No siree.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你见过他了？呵，他想要取代我在议会的位置。我不会让他美梦成真的。没门。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's a shady character, I just can't prove it. If someone were to find something incriminating in his room...
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个阴险的人，我只是不能证明这一点。如果谁能去他的房间找到一些控告他的罪状……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, let's just say I would be very appreciative.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我将会感激不尽。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds like a plan, man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这计划还像样，老兄。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right! You and me, just hangin'.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧！你和我，一起干。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aren't you afraid someone will use your own guns to rob you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你难道不怕有人用你卖的枪来打劫你？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here? In Rivet City?
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这？铆钉城？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm packing and most of the rest of these guys are packing. Not to mention security.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里的人都带着家伙。安全不成问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is quite a selection, but they're all in lousy condition.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里东西倒挺多，但它们好像不怎么结实。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't put the good stuff out on the table. If you're interested, I can show you the stuff in the locker.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没把好东西摆出来。你要是有兴趣，我可以向你展示一下锁柜里的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So what happened to Project Purity?
ESP.TRADUIT: 净化工程出了什么问题？

ESP.ORIGINAL: In the year before you were born, things became difficult.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在你出生之前，事情就变复杂了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life Comment (NAM2) : DAD_RECORD EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There had always been something of a "mutants problem" in the city, but it became worse. They attacked more frequently, and more aggressively.
ESP.TRADUIT: 出现了“变种人问题”，而且越来越糟，他们频繁地发动攻击，更具侵略性。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life Comment (NAM2) : DAD_RECORD EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Support for the project eroded as time went on, when we couldn't produce any significant results. Progress came to a halt. And then you were born.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随着时间流逝，当我们做不出有意义的成果时，对这计划的援助也发生了改变。进度终止，然后你出生了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life Comment (NAM2) : DAD_RECORD EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your mother and I had talked about what to do when that time came, but then I... We lost her, and I had to make a decision. I chose to leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你母亲和我商量过，当那刻到来，我们要做些什么，不过我……我们失去了她，而我不得不做决定。我选择了离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life Comment (NAM2) : DAD_RECORD EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: From what I understand, things happened quickly after that. It became too dangerous for the others to stay, and so the project was abandoned.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就我所知，那之后的事发展得太快，对于其他人来说，变得太危险，而我不能留下，因此这工程被丢弃了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life Comment (NAM2) : DAD_RECORD EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doctor Li and her team left for what became Rivet City, and Project Purity has sat waiting ever since.
ESP.TRADUIT: 李博士和她的团队组建了铆钉城，从那开始，净化工程一直被搁置着。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life Comment (NAM2) : DAD_RECORD EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What exactly is this "Project Purity"?
ESP.TRADUIT: “净化工程”确切的说是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It started as an idea, really. Remember the Bible passage your mother loved so much?
ESP.TRADUIT: 它开始是一个理想，真的。还记得《圣经》中你妈妈最喜爱的话吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life Comment (NAM2) : DAD_RECORD EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Free, clean water for everyone. What a difference it could make in the lives of everyone here in the Wastes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每个人都能喝上免费、干净的水。多么的不可思议，它能够影响这蛮荒世界中每个人的命运。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life Comment (NAM2) : DAD_RECORD EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Over time, that idea took the form of a purifier. Not like the one in the Vault, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随着时间推移，理想终成现实，虽然它和避难所的有所不同。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life Comment (NAM2) : DAD_RECORD EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This one was gigantic, capable of purifying millions of gallons of water at once.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个庞然大物，能够瞬时提纯数百万加仑的水。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life Comment (NAM2) : DAD_RECORD EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We used the old Jefferson Memorial for the location, right on D.C.'s Tidal Basin. Someday soon, I hope you'll see it work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们把它建在老杰斐逊纪念馆，正好在特区的潮汐盆地。有朝一日，我希望你会看到它运作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life Comment (NAM2) : DAD_RECORD EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where can I find the fuse box?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能在哪找到保险箱？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Head back downstairs. The one you're looking for is underneath the mainframe room, I think.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回到楼下，我想你要找的就在主机下面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Daniel Agincourt [0601CCA1] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where are the flood control pumps?
ESP.TRADUIT: 水泵在哪？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got some stuff that needs repairs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要修理一下东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, I can fix most anything. Let me see what you've got.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，大多数东西我都能修。让我看看你要修什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pain is your friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 痛苦是你的朋友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: First you took away my uncle, and now you took away them, too?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你先是赶走了我叔叔，现在又赶走了他们？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Derek Pacion [06031EC7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine - here! Take it and go away forever!
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好 — 给你！带走，永远别回来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Derek Pacion [06031EC7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: He promised me money for a job. Pay up, or else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他答应过付我钱的。快给钱，否则别怪我不客气。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Minigun is more my speed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有了这把转轮机枪，我的攻击更快。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got it. Use it well, and take down some more Muties with it for us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说对了。好好用它，用它为我们干掉更多的变种人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Consider this place your home away from home. If you're ever in the neighborhood again, you're more than welcome to take shelter here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把这当你自己的家。你以后要是经过附近，我们将非常欢迎你到这来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess that does it. See you 'round, kid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就这样，回见，孩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll go for the armor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我选装甲。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The armor it is. Wear it with pride, kid. We do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的装甲，自豪地穿上它吧，孩子。我们都是如此。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Consider this place your home away from home. If you're ever in the neighborhood again, you're more than welcome to take shelter here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把这当你自己的家。你以后要是经过附近，我们将非常欢迎你到这来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess that does it. See you 'round, kid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就这样，回见，孩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where can I get some more ammo around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能在哪搞到更多弹药？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, if you've picked the Mutie corpses clean, there isn't much else to scrounge.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你要是把变种人的尸体都搜遍了，那就没有其他地方可以找了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029576] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I dunno if you came across it or not, but one of our guys dropped on the second floor stairwell. He had an ammo crate with him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道你有没经过二楼的楼梯间，我们一个兄弟掉到了那里。他身上有一个弹药箱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029576] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We lost a good man on the retreat to this godforsaken roof. Theo. Newest guy in the group too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们撤到这荒凉的楼顶上时，失去了个好同伴。西奥，最近加入队伍的新兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donovan [06029577] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: He got killed on the second floor stairwell of the hotel. He was carrying our ammo supply with him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他死在旅馆的二楼楼梯间，他随身带着我们的弹药补给。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donovan [06029577] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, let me give you the code. The more ammo we have the better!
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你密码。弹药越多越好！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donovan [06029577] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: On our way to the roof, one of our guys got scragged. Poor son-of-a-bitch got blown apart by a frag.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们去楼顶的路上，一个兄弟挂了。可怜的家伙被手榴弹炸开了花。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donovan [06029577] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think he went down on the second floor stairwell of this place. You find him, and you'll find his ammo crate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想他掉到了二楼楼梯间。你找到他，就会找到弹药箱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donovan [06029577] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We lock that stuff so the Muties can't steal what's inside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们给它上了锁以防变种人来偷。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donovan [06029577] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got anything for these injuries?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有东西治疗这伤吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, here you go. It's all I've got.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，给你。我只有这些了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry. I only had one Stimpak to spare. Hang in there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，我只有一个治疗针，坚持住。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Injuries? You look fine to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 受伤？依我看你很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06029578] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: HAHAHAHAHAHAHA!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carolina Red [060384D4] (mod) NPC : Jotun [060384D5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: FATHER! NO!
ESP.TRADUIT: 父亲！不！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why did you kill that bartender?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么要杀酒保？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He put water in my vodka to make more caps from me. Make the drink weak and try to charge me more!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他往我的伏特加里掺水，想骗我花更多瓶盖。在酒里掺水好收我更多钱！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe the next bartender, he won't be stupid, eh? HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许下个酒保不会像他这么蠢，呃？哈哈哈哈哈哈！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Vampires can drink any kind of human blood... even from bloodpacks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 血族能喝任何种类的人血……甚至是血浆袋。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Curious. Many years ago, I survived by drinking from fresh bloodpacks I recovered from hospital ruins.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有意思。许多年前，我喝了从医院废墟里找到的新鲜血浆袋活了下来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The problem was that these bloodpacks were scarce.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问题是这些血浆袋很稀少。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you propose?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的想法是什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me see your Chems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看你的药品。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I got some stuff around here. But it'll cost you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我在这附近找到了一些东西，但得花掉你不少钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know where I can buy some chems around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道这附近哪能买到药品？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right on. Thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好极了，谢谢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No problem at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 完全没问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, thanks. Keep it coming.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，谢谢，以后常来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure will. Sure will...
ESP.TRADUIT: 一定，一定……

ESP.ORIGINAL: If it means that much to you, I'll take it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果这对你很重要的话，我接受。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please, keep doing what you do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 加油，再接再励。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, let's get this over with. Cycle the airlock, will you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，让我们做完，打开气密门，好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello? Hello?... Is anyone there? It's Doctor Li. Something's wrong with the purifier... Please, someone answer!
ESP.TRADUIT: 喂？喂？……有人吗？我是李博士，净化器出了些问题……请回答！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) NPC : [06037820] (ID) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice gun. I've never seen one like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好枪，我从没见过这样的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, it is nice. I don't even sleep without it under my pillow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错呢。它不在我枕头底下我都睡不着。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My father made gun ammunition for a living. Taught me everything about how firearms work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我父亲靠制造枪支弹药生活，他还教会了我枪械的工作原理。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, I've spent my downtime tinkering with guns like my 10mm Ultra SMG here. It's like a hobby I guess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以我把休息时间都花在了摆弄枪支上，就像我的这把10毫米极致冲锋枪。我想这是我的业余爱好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, whatever happened to your father?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你父亲究竟发生了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What?!
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh... oh my god! That's his voice! It's really him!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦……天啊，是他的声音，真的是他！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't believe you brought this to me. I don't know what to say but thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不敢相信你给我带来了这，我不知道说什么好，但谢谢你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait! Here, take my 10mm Ultra SMG. It's never let me down. Besides, I won't really need it anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等！给，拿上我的10毫米极致冲锋枪。它从没让我失望过。而且，我不再需要它了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sydney, I found a note from your father. He didn't abandon you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 希妮，我拿到了你父亲的记录，他没有离弃你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes... but I had a little help from Sydney. She didn't make it, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的……但西德尼给过我一些帮助。不过她没能活下来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: By bringing this to me, do you realize you've both just written yourselves into the history books?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你意识到了吗，把这给我，意味你们将自己载入了史册？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're both true American heroes and will be remembered for this glorious day!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们都是真正的美利坚英雄，这荣耀的一天会永远被后世铭记！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sydney's name will forever be memorialized for her great sacrifice. She was a patriot and will be missed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为她的牺牲，希妮这个名字将永远被铭记。她是爱国者，会被后人缅怀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: But enough of that. Allow me to present you with some sort of compensation for your deed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不多说了。请允许我为你的行为赠予一些报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes... but I had a little help from Sydney.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的……但西德尼给过我一些帮助。

ESP.ORIGINAL: By bringing this to me, do you realize you've both just written yourselves into the history books?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你意识到了吗，把这给我，意味你们将自己载入了史册？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're both true American heroes and will be remembered for this glorious day!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们都是真正的美利坚英雄，这荣耀的一天会永远被后世铭记！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: But enough of that. Allow me to present you with some sort of compensation for your deed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不多说了。请允许我为你的行为赠予一些报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will award Sydney's promised bounty to her personally. No need to worry yourself about that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会按照约定把奖金给希妮的，这你就不必担心了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes... I recovered it all by myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的……我自己找回了它。

ESP.ORIGINAL: By bringing this to me, do you realize you've just written yourself into the history books?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你意识到了吗，把这给我，意味你将自己载入了史册？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a true American hero and will be remembered for this glorious day!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是真正的美利坚英雄，这荣耀的一天会永远被后世铭记！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: But enough of that. Allow me to present you with some sort of compensation for your deed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不多说了。请允许我为你的行为赠予一些报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: By bringing this to me, do you realize you've just written yourself into the history books?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你意识到了吗，把这给我，意味你将自己载入了史册？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a true American hero and will be remembered for this glorious day!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是真正的美利坚英雄，这荣耀的一天会永远被后世铭记！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: But enough of that. Allow me to present you with some sort of compensation for your deed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不多说了。请允许我为你的行为赠予一些报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Before you continue... I have the Declaration of Independence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 打断一下……我有《独立宣言》。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? You have the Declaration? Unbelievable!
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？你有宣言？难以置信！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you certain this time? Or is this another joke?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这次你确定吗？不是又在开玩笑？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Abraham Washington [060156CF] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA2]MS15) Stealing Independence EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything you can tell me about the Super Mutants?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能告诉我关于超级变种人的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Would you believe... "no"? It's pathetic, really, considering we've been fighting those abominations for nearly twenty years.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你相信吗……“不”？可悲啊，我们跟那些鬼玩意战斗了近20年。

ESP.ORIGINAL: In all that time, all we've managed to do is to contain the threat. Hold them back, so they don't overrun every blasted settlement out here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 花了这么久，我们也就能勉强控制住威胁。顶住他们，阻止他们泛滥到这里的每个角落。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But we don't really "know" anything. Where they're from, why they've infested the D.C. ruins.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我们真的是一无所“知”。他们从哪来，他们为什么会在特区废墟大批滋生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And now here we are, holed up in our Citadel. Low on resources, low on troops. It's enough to make an old man so very... tired.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看现在，我们躲在大本营里，缺资源、少军队，这些足以让一个老人觉得……身心疲惫。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My child, you seem to have learned more in the past week than I have in twenty years!
ESP.TRADUIT: 孩子，你过去一周了解到的好像超过我二十年了解到的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything more you can tell me about the Super Mutants?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能再说些超级变种人的情况吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I bet you aren't afraid of anything. Would you steal some ammo for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我打赌你天不怕地不怕，愿意帮我偷些弹药来吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. I pinched this from his table. He never even saw me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，我从他的桌上顺的，他根本没看到我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can get you some more by tomorrow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明天可以给你更多。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, did you ever steal any ammo from Flak and Shrapnel for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，你帮我从“高炮”弗莱克和“榴弹”小帅那里偷到弹药了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You... You really believe that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你……你真那么想？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The AntAgonizer [06036C1C] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit Comment (NAM2) : Pleading

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I read that comic, it explained so much. Where I came from, who I was destined to be, what I had to do...
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我读到那本漫画，它给了我很多答案，我从哪来，我的命运，我必须做什么……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The AntAgonizer [06036C1C] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit Comment (NAM2) : Pleading EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: But it never said the AntAgonizer could ever have a chance to go back to being normal. It never said I had a chance...
ESP.TRADUIT: 但它从没提及，痛苦蚁后可能永远也没有机会回到原来的样子，它没有提到我有机会……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The AntAgonizer [06036C1C] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit Comment (NAM2) : Pleading EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please... I think I've made some terrible mistakes. If you really think I still have a chance, just let me go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜托……我想我犯了些可怕的错。如果你真的觉得我还有机会，让我走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The AntAgonizer [06036C1C] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit Comment (NAM2) : Pleading EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll give you the suit. No one ever has to see the AntAgonizer again. Just please, let me have another chance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会给你这件套装。没有人会再见到痛苦蚁后。拜托，再给我一个机会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The AntAgonizer [06036C1C] (mod) Quest : ([06014E95]MS02) The Superhuman Gambit Comment (NAM2) : Pleading EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I read that the AntAgonizer was an orphaned girl who could still be redeemed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 据我所知痛苦蚁后是个孤儿，她仍然值得救赎。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why did you damage me? You're supposed to be a healing robot!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么要伤害我？你不是治疗机器人吗！？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There has been an error in the medical subsystem. Please run a level two diagnostic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 医疗系统有些故障。请进行二级诊断。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you make of the Enclave, Squire?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你了解英克雷吗，侍从？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're asking me what I think about the Enclave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你……你问我对英克雷的看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well... The Brotherhood of Steel has actually faced the Enclave before. Back West. More than thirty years ago, according to our chronicles.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯……根据我们的编年史，早在30年前，钢铁兄弟会事实上就已经在西部和英克雷打交道了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Judging from those records, I'd say their soldiers are outfitted in Advanced Power Armor Mark II. It's... pretty strong. Better than our Power Armor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从那些记录来看，我得说他们的士兵配备了先进的二型动力装甲。它……相当坚固，比我们的动力装甲要好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And some of their technology is amazing! Vertibirds! Plasma weapons that can turn a man to goo!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们的一些技术令人称奇！飞鸟！电浆武器能把人变成灰烬！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does... that help?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些……有用吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't suppose you know anything about the Super Mutants?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道任何关于超级变种人的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh yes! I've studied them quite a bit since I've been here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，是的！自从我来这后，就一直在研究他们！

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're not all the same, you know. Besides the regular ones, there are also Brutes. And after them, the Masters -- they're really tough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们不是千篇一律的，你知道。除了普通的，他们还有一些狂人。他们上面还有霸主……那些真的很强悍。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But the worst of all? The Behemoth! He's a giant! I saw one once, outside the Citadel walls. Sooo scary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但最恐怖的是谁？超级变种巨人！对，是超级变种巨人！我从前看到过一个，就在大本营的墙外。真可怕。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Super Mutants are all over the city ruins, but Elder Lyons doesn't actually think they're from there, or we would have found their home by now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 超级变种人布满了这城市的废墟，但里昂斯长老觉得他们实际上来自别处，否则我们早就找到他们的巢穴了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It kind of seems like they're looking for something, but we're not really sure what that is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们好像在找什么，不过我们不知道会是什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need medical supplies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要医疗物资。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't give my help to enemies of the NCR. Maybe you can find a raider "medic" to fix you up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会帮助NCR的敌人。你可以去找个掠夺者"医生"来帮你解决问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Sawbones [00155A03] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, and I need sterile medical supplies. But let's see what I have with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，我也需要无菌的医疗物资。你先来看看我这儿卖的东西吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Ada Straus [000CE88C] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Mitchell [00104C0C] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd love to help you out, but I'm pretty strapped here as it is. I really don't have anything to sell you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也想帮你，可我这儿也物资紧缺，我真的没有什么东西能卖给你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lieutenant Markland [0012AC9F] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm... well, I am better set for supplies now that you helped me out. I guess I can part with some of them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯……好吧，多亏了你的帮助，我的医疗物资现在比较充足。卖一些给你也无妨。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lieutenant Markland [0012AC9F] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's what I've got.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来看看我的东西吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Sawbones [00155A03] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose I have a few things around that I can spare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我应该可以卖一点药品给你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Senior Scribe Schuler [000E27E6] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I can spare a few things.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我可以腾出一些东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, can you hook me up with some chems?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，你能用药品治疗我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure sure. I got it all. Check it out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，当然，我有一些，我来看看。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure thing, man. Sure thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，兄弟，当然。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Care to share anything about the Super Mutants?
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于超级变种人，有什么信息可以分享？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you think I ride these Initiates so hard? I make training hell so fighting those Uglies won't be.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得我为什么要对这些新兵这么狠？我进行地狱式的训练，等他们对付丑八怪时就容易了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So... Any thoughts on the Enclave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么……对英克雷有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's meat under that armor, and meat can be ground.
ESP.TRADUIT: 穿着装甲的肉，也是能被打倒的肉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is anything interesting happening in the area?
ESP.TRADUIT: 附近有什么有趣的事情吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Folks'll tell you that they seen Ghouls up near the rocket factory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 人们会告诉你，他们看到火箭工厂附近出现了一些尸鬼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sensationalist hooey, cooked up by superstitious yokels seeing phantoms of their own imagining.
ESP.TRADUIT: 纯属异想天开，都是那些迷信的乡下土包子编造了他们幻想中的鬼怪故事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Targets confirmed westbound. Move to intercept.
ESP.TRADUIT: 目标确认向西移动，前去阻截。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. I'll practice on someone else. Thanks for nothing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。我会找其他人试试。不谢了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell you what. Let's hook up later and go see Scribe Bowditch. I heard he's been working on some new Power Armor mods. Can't hurt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉你，我们迟点一起去看看鲍蒂奇文士。我听说他正在研究一些新的动力装甲插件。反正没损失。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't look like the other Ghouls from Bright's group.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你跟辐光那伙尸鬼看着不太像啊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Guess the outfit gives that away, huh? I never did buy into that religious mumbo-jumbo with the robes and all that shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是我这身行头让你有这样的感觉吧？我从来都不信他们那一套什么狗屁教义。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It gets lonely out in the wastes, okay? And I don't have to tell you that Bright's group has got some fine-looking Ghoulettes in it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 但人在废土哪儿能没有伴儿呢，对吧？不用我说你也能想到，辐光的集团里还真有几个漂亮姑娘！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Eh... or maybe I would have to tell you...
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃……估计你也不太能理解……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyway, I helped them out, and they kept me supplied with ammo and pleasant company.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总之，我给他们帮忙，他们给我弹药补给，还提供欢乐和我相伴。还有美女作陪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What was this place before the Ghouls moved in?
ESP.TRADUIT: 尸鬼住进来前，这是什么地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It used to be part of the Museum of History. The exhibit that used to be here was focused on what happens after death: hell and whatnot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它过去是历史博物馆的一部分。展览的主题是身后之事：地狱之类的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A lot of it was focused on this old book called "Paradise Lost." It's about a guy who goes to Hell. Pretty interesting stuff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有一些展览集中在这本叫《失乐园》的古书上。它说的是一个家伙下了地狱，相当有意思的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found a big box of copies of the book in one of the back rooms.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在一间辅助库房找到了一大箱这书。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take one. Nobody around here wants 'em.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你一本，这里谁也不要它。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't get a lot of customers, do you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你没多少顾客对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's working in a bar in Megaton.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他在核弹镇的酒吧里工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, that's wonderful news! I'm so glad! If you see him, please tell him that his mother misses him and loves him and that I hope he's happy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，令人愉快的消息！我真高兴！你要是看见他，请告诉他，他的妈妈想念他，爱他，我希望他快快乐乐。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, he shouldn't come visit. It's too dangerous. No, no. He should stay put where he is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，他不应该来这，那太危险了。不，不，他应该待在那。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right. I'm going to go have a look around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我会四处看看。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enjoy your stay. Just... try and keep from shooting up the place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玩得开心。只是……别在这开枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've got a nice little deal going on down here. We'd like to keep it nice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们在这下面的营生还不错。我们希望保持下去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enclave strength is at 100%. They're getting reinforcements from somewhere, but we still haven't determined the location of their headquarters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 英克雷的兵力达到了100%，他们显然从其他地方获得了增援，但我们始终没法确定他们的总部位置。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Super Mutant activity in D.C. is high, but nothing out of the ordinary. The area around Galaxy News Radio is... nearly secure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 超级变种人在特区很活跃，但还没有超过正常范畴。银河新闻电台周围……基本安全。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enclave troops have fortified the purifier complex. With those vertibirds, they're able to transport personnel at a remarkable rate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 英克雷军队加强了净化器的防守力度。利用那些飞鸟，他们能高效率地运送人员。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's been another Behemoth sighted in the Wasteland, in the Evergreen Mills region. That's heavy Raider country, so things could get interesting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在废土的常青钢铁厂那一带，发现了另一个超级变种巨人。那地方是歹徒的巢穴，所以事情可能会很有趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It appears the Enclave troops have moved beyond the purifier, into the surrounding Wasteland region. No telling how far they might spread.
ESP.TRADUIT: 似乎英克雷的军队已经由净化器出发，进入了周围的废土地区。不知道他们将渗透到多远。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, Rothchild. Fire it up. Pride, move out!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，罗斯查德，点火，“里昂斯的骄傲”，开始行动！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait a second! I handled Silver for you, and you still want me to pay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 稍等！我为你解决了席尔瓦的麻烦，你还要我付钱吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's called economics, kid. You got something I want and I got something you want. Nothing's free.
ESP.TRADUIT: 孩子，这就叫经济学。你有我要的，我有你要的，没有免费的午餐。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dead? Argyle? You... you’re sure? My God. I always thought he’d outlive me, by at least 100 years. Poor bastard.
ESP.TRADUIT: 死了？阿盖尔？你……你确定？我的天。我一直觉得他会活得比我久，至少会多活100年，可怜的家伙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But thank you! Thank you for telling me. At least now I know. At least now the poor guy can catch a breather.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过还是谢谢你！谢谢你告诉我。至少现在我知道了。至少这可怜的家伙现在解脱了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I’d like to return your kindness. Here, take this key. It unlocks my safe. Lots of stuff in there I'll never use again. My adventuring days are over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要报答你的好心。给你这把钥匙，用它打开我的保险柜，里面的东西我再也不需要了。我的冒险生涯结束了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Argyle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说阿盖尔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Argyle was my manservant! Ah, but that’s really just a fancy word for "the guy who saves my sorry skin on a regular occasion."
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿盖尔是我的仆人！啊，不过事实却是，“这家伙常常拯救我的皮囊”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was a Ghoul, you see. Been around since before the war. We met when I stole his girlfriend, back in ’41. We’d been best friends ever since.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道，他是僵尸。战前就生活在附近。我遇到他是41年，那时我偷了他的女朋友。此后，我们成了最好的朋友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We got separated, a long time ago, and never reunited. If you find Argyle out there, somewhere, you be sure and tell me! Okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 很久以前，我们分开了，再也没聚过。你要是在哪个地方找到了阿盖尔，一定要和我说一声，好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mentioned something about GNR?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你提到了一些银行新闻电台的事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Haven’t you ever heard the radio play? The Adventures of Herbert "Daring" Dashwood? That guy at the radio station put it together a few years ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听过广播剧吗？《赫伯特·“大胆”·达什伍德的冒险》？几年前，广播电台的那家伙编排的这节目。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He did it in the style of those shows they had before the war. Came out pretty well. And it’s all true! Rockopolis, Miss Chase... All of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他采用了战争之前就有的表演风格。播出效果相当好，那些事情都是真的！罗克波利斯、蔡斯小姐……所有一切。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course, they do portray me as a bit of a chump. Argyle may have saved my hide more than once, but I had my moments. Ah, those were the days...
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然了，他们确实把我描绘成了废物，阿盖尔当然不止一次救过我，不过我也有风光的时候。啊，在那些日子……

ESP.ORIGINAL: I saw the Family's mark on the wall. What's up with that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在墙上看到家族的标志，发生了什么事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Vance told me later that he was basically covering for me and allowing the Family to... to feed at the same time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 万斯后来告诉我，他主要是想替我掩盖，并同时让家族去……去吃一顿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Since my parents were already dead, they drank their blood and left the mark on the wall. He didn't want Evan to suspect that I had done it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为我父母已经死了，所以他们吸了他们的血，在墙上留下这标记。他不想埃万怀疑是我干的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The irony is they were stalking our town to feed anyway. It's almost like Vance knew this would happen...
ESP.TRADUIT: 讽刺的是，他们本就是潜进我们的镇子来吃饭的。就好像万斯知道事情会是这个样子……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you ever talk to your parents about it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你父母知道这事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lucy said Mom and Dad would never have understood. She told me to keep what I did a secret and that she'd try and help me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 露西说妈妈和爸爸永远不会懂。她对我说会为我保守秘密，她总是尽量帮助我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks to Lucy, she was able to stop that from ever happening again for years.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多亏露西，这些年，她阻止了这种情况再次发生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Every time I'd feel the hunger, she'd hold onto me and not let go. After a while, the hunger almost seemed to go away... until... well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每次我觉得饥饿，她会按住我不放。过了些日子，饥饿感好像是消失了……直到那天.

ESP.ORIGINAL: When did you first discover you had the hunger?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你头一次发现你有这种饥饿感是什么时候？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was about 10 years old and I was playing with Lucy down under the overpass. We loved throwing rocks in the water.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我10岁大的时候。我和露西在高架桥下玩，我们喜欢往水里扔石头子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We saw some Wastelander trying to break open the Brahmin pens and steal one of them, so I ran over and told him to stop.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们看见一个废土游民试图砸开双头牛的栅栏，想从里面偷一只，所以我跑过去叫他住手。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He just laughed and pushed me away. When I fell, suddenly my head started to hurt and my eyes got all blurry. It was almost like I blacked out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他大笑着一把把我推开。等我倒下去，我的头突然开始刺痛，眼睛一片模糊。我像是快要昏厥了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Next thing I know Lucy was pulling me off the guy... I had ripped his throat open with my teeth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 接下来我所知道的事，是露西用力把我从那家伙身上拖下来……我已经用牙齿撕破了他的喉咙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不了，谢谢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: In that case, stand just like that for a second. I want to make some toast.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那样的话，你能不能先别走。我想在你身上烤个面包。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Ada Straus [000CE88C] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Suit yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Mitchell [00104C0C] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, but don't blame me if you end up sterile.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，但你要是绝后了，可别赖我啊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lieutenant Markland [0012AC9F] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever you say. Hey, is that a little patch of Ghoul rot on your cheek there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便你。嘿，你脸上那块是尸鬼的腐肉吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Sawbones [00155A03] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Suit yourself. I'm sure there are Ghouls and other mutants who once said the same thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随你的便吧。我敢肯定以前有些尸鬼和变种人也说过类似的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Senior Scribe Schuler [000E27E6] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your 100 caps. Do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是100个瓶盖，来吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then I can't help you. Sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我帮不了你。对不起。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have 100 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有100个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. And remember, if this doesn't help, try taking a bath in tomato juice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。记住，如果没用，那就用番茄汁洗澡。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Ada Straus [000CE88C] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your 100 caps. Do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是100个瓶盖，来吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay... all done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好……搞定了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Mitchell [00104C0C] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your 100 caps. Do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是100个瓶盖，来吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just stand still and try to ignore the tingling.
ESP.TRADUIT: 站着别动就行了，如果感觉刺痛也不要理睬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lieutenant Markland [0012AC9F] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your 100 caps. Do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是100个瓶盖，来吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This might tickle a little. Or it might cause searing, agonizing pain to shoot through your body. You never know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可能会有点发痒，也可能会产生烧灼感，甚至可能会有深入骨髓的剧痛。很难讲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Sawbones [00155A03] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your 100 caps. Do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是100个瓶盖，来吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I bet you could make some of the money letting people work on their tans next to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要我说，你完全可以让别人在你身边晒个日光浴，保证能让你发大财。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Ada Straus [000CE88C] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have 100 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有100个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, come back when you do. I'll be here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，随时可以回来找我。我就在这儿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Mitchell [00104C0C] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have 100 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有100个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, if you scrounge it up, the help is here waiting for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你要是再遇到什么问题，都可以来找我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lieutenant Markland [0012AC9F] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have 100 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有100个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then I can't help you much. Now, maybe if you enlisted...
ESP.TRADUIT: 那样恐怕我就帮不了你了。如果你愿意参军的话...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Sawbones [00155A03] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, I don't have 100 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，我没有100瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here we go. You'll be rad-free in no time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，很快你就不用再忍受辐射了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Senior Scribe Schuler [000E27E6] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your 100 caps. Do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是100个瓶盖，来吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then I can't help, sorry. Just following protocol.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能帮你，抱歉。这儿有规定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Senior Scribe Schuler [000E27E6] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, I don't have 100 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，我没有100瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you heal my radiation?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能治疗我的辐射吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure can. Quick and easy, only 100 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然能。很快也很容易，只要100个瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0002131F] (ID) NPC : Lucy [06015696] (mod) Quest : ([000963D4]Doctors) 000963D4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure can. Quick and easy, only 100 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然能。很快也很容易，只要100个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't give my help to enemies of the NCR. Maybe you can find a raider "medic" to fix you up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会帮助NCR的敌人。你可以去找个掠夺者赤脚"医生"来帮你解决问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Sawbones [00155A03] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you sure? You won't be able to read in the dark as well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你当真吗？那样你以后就不能在躲在暗处看书了哦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Ada Straus [000CE88C] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. I can help you out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。我能帮你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Mitchell [00104C0C] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, one thing we do have is a good supply of Rad-Away. Sure, I can help you with that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，好消息是，我们的辐特宁还算充足。当然，我可以帮你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lieutenant Markland [0012AC9F] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, sorry, we're totally unprepared to deal with radiation sickness.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，我们没有处理辐射病的经验。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Sawbones [00155A03] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha ha, just kidding, of course I can!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈，开个玩笑，我当然能！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Sawbones [00155A03] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We always make sure to keep an ample supply of Rad-Away. Most of us haven't had the exposure outsiders like you take for granted.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们总是会尽量保证辐特宁的储备充足。毕竟对你们外来者辐射是家常便饭，对我们可不同。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Senior Scribe Schuler [000E27E6] (mod) Quest : ([000CE959]VDoctors) 000CE959 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's trade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们来交易。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. Here's what I have. What do you have?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，这是我的货物，你那有什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bessie Lynn [0601DC18] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : shy and not accustomed to her role as merchant EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: OK。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bessie Lynn [0601DC18] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : shy and not accustomed to her role as merchant EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is all I have. I hope it's okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我全部的货物，希望你喜欢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bessie Lynn [0601DC18] (mod) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : shy and not accustomed to her role as merchant EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright. Let's see if we can't find something mutually agreeable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我们看看能不能做一笔大家都满意的买卖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601DC19] (ID) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : sly EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好棒！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601DC19] (ID) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : sly EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure you'll find something agreeable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我保证你会找到喜欢的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601DC19] (ID) Quest : ([0601CE93]MS12Fin) 0601CE93 (EDID) Comment (NAM2) : sly EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're mostly a tree, right? Can't I just burn you down?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就是一棵树，对吧？我可以用火烧掉你吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, no no no no no no no! Fire would be too painful for me and poor old Bob. You keep that stuff away from us!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，不不不不！用火烧对我和可怜的老鲍勃来说太痛苦了。让那玩意离我们远点！

ESP.ORIGINAL: The heart would be just fine... I won't feel a thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 刺破心脏是最合适的……我会不知不觉地死去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're all okay. If you can call being stuck in a cave with 82 terrified kids okay. Alive, anyway. But I don't know what the hell we're going to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你觉得和八十二个吓坏了的孩子困在一个洞里也叫好的话。我们都很好。不管怎样，我们都活着。但我不知道接下来该怎么办。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : doing an audio journal, and really shaken up/afraid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's been 4 days. Claudia went out this morning to look around, and never came back. Then Mr. Cob went out to look for her, and HE never came back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 第4天了。今天早上克劳迪娅跑出去看看，就再也没有回来。之后凯博先生出去找她，他也再没回来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : doing an audio journal, and really shaken up/afraid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So now there's only me, two other teachers, two of the parents who were chaperoning, and a few of the cavern staff. And all these poor kids.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，现在这只剩我，两位老师，还有两位陪同过来的母亲，洞穴的几个工作人员。另外就是这些可怜的孩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : doing an audio journal, and really shaken up/afraid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've got enough food and water to last for awhile, I guess. But after that? I just don't know. We can't stay in here forever. Can we?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我们有足够的食物和水支撑一阵。但用完之后呢？我不知道。我们不能永远待在这，我们能吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Moira Brown [0602D3C0] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : doing an audio journal, and really shaken up/afraid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened down here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这儿发生了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You shoulda seen my pop, he personally saved old Stanley! But guess you wouldn't know what it's like to have a hero for a dad, would you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你应该见见我爸爸，他一个人救了老斯坦利！但我想你不会知道有一个英雄爸爸是什么感觉，对吧？ ?
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wally Mack [0604E894] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : Particularly nasty when talking about the player's dad. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where can I rent a bed?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能在哪租到床？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Up at Moriarty's at the south end of town. Talk to Nova, she'll help you out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在莫里亚蒂那的上层，镇子的最南端。找诺瓦谈，她会帮助你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucas Simms [06000A60] (mod) NPC : Mother Maya [06000A70] (mod) NPC : [06000A6C] (ID) NPC : Confessor Cromwell [06000A6F] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm the one who saved the kids from Paradise Falls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是我从堕落天堂救了这些孩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh yeah? Well why didn't you say so, you stupid mungo?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，是吗？你为什么不说，你这愚蠢的毛人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, sounds like suicide. Be my guest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，这听起来像是自杀。请便。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I dunno why you bothered to come here and wake me then. I would have been better off sleeping through it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道你为什么要来叫醒我，让我继续睡着更好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your team's still alive... I heard their distress signal!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的队伍还活着……我收到了他们的求救信号！

ESP.ORIGINAL: They are?! Holy shit!
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？真他妈的走运！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, either I need to get out there and lend them a hand or they aren't going to last much longer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，要是我不去帮他们一把，他们是撑不了多久的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reilly [060156F1] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA5]MS18) Reilly's Rangers EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I understand. Goodbye, Amata.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我懂了。再见，阿玛塔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We can never really thank you enough for everything you've done. It's not much, but take this with you, to remember us by.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你所做的一切，我们再怎么感谢你也不为过。虽然比较寒酸，但请你带上，它会让你想起我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [0602549E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: It'll be a while before we're actually ready to go outside. But once the Vault is stable again, maybe we'll see you out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们需要时间才能真正准备好走出这。等避难所的局势稳定了，我们说不定会在外面相见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [0602549E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: So I guess this is goodbye for now. But with luck, we'll meet again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看该说再见了。一路顺风，我们会再见的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Amata [0602549E] (mod) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, anything else you can do to help might save lives.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，你可以再做点别的，或许还能救几条命。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know, maybe this will help and maybe it won't, but pappa hid a bunch of stuff behind the old diner in a dumpster.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不知道这消息对你有用没，爸爸在旧餐馆后的一个垃圾桶里面藏了些东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He trusted me with the key and said it was for emergencies, but I bet he wouldn't mind you having it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他把钥匙信任地交给了我，已备不时之需，我想他不会介意我把钥匙给你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Brandice Family.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说布兰迪斯一家的情况。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, there is Will... he was sorta my friend. And then there was his dad and his mom.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这有威尔……他可以说是我的朋友，还有他的爸爸和妈妈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about this "Doc Lesko."
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说这“莱斯科博士”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was a strange man. He paid pappa some caps to help him build a shack and carry a bunch of junk into it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他很奇怪。他给爸爸一些钱，请他帮忙修了个小屋，然后往里面塞了一捆垃圾。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pappa called him an egghead, but his head was shaped regular, so I didn't get it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 爸爸管他叫书呆子，但他的神情并不呆滞，所以我不明白他说的是什么意思。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You want help? Fork over some caps, Einstein.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要帮忙？那就给点瓶盖吧，爱因斯坦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why can't man follow the ant's example? They work together as a team... every waking moment dedicated to the colony.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么人类不能效仿蚂蚁呢？他们团队般的协作……无时无刻不为群体奉献力量。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They require no wealth or material items... everything they need is provided for them by their fellow insects.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们对金钱与物质没有追求……他们所需要的都提供给了他们的同伴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I digress. If it's payment you need, all I can offer is one of my Mutagenic Bioenhancers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 顺便说下。如果你需要报酬，我所能提供的只有我的突变体基因活性增强剂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Books aren't going to buy me new ammunition.
ESP.TRADUIT: 书本可换不来军火弹药。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why can't man follow the ant's example? They work together as a team... every waking moment dedicated to the colony.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么人类不能效仿蚂蚁呢？他们团队般的协作……无时无刻不为群体奉献力量。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They require no wealth or material items... everything they need is provided for them by their fellow insects.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们对金钱与物质没有追求……他们所需要的都提供给了他们的同伴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I digress. If it's payment you need, all I can offer is one of my Mutagenic Bioenhancers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 顺便说下。如果你需要报酬，我所能提供的只有我的突变体基因活性增强剂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there anyone on this ship named Pinkerton?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这船上有个叫平克顿的人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pinkerton, eh? That name takes me way back. Claimed to have cured radiation poisoning. Or was it food poisoning? I don't recall.
ESP.TRADUIT: 平克顿，嗯？这名字让我想起了从前。他声称治愈了辐射中毒，还是食物中毒？我不记得了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Preston [060156D0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was always telling folks that he founded Rivet City. All he did was break off the front of it. Or did he die there? I don't recall.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他总不停地跟人说，是他建造了铆钉城。他说他要到断裂的船头找什么东西，他是死在那了还是怎么的？我不记得了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Preston [060156D0] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know of someone named Pinkerton?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认识叫平克顿的人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is a hefty task, Doc. I'm going to need serious incentive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真是个艰巨的任务，博士，我需要点真正的激励。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, I suppose you're right. Science must learn to acquiesce to your standards in order to advance itself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我想你是对的。科学为了自身的进步，必须学会接纳你的原则。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was merely going to offer one of my Mutagenic Bioenhancers, but I suppose I could up the ante.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我本打算送突变体基因活性增强剂，不过我想我可以提高报酬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will also award you with my old lab coat. It's served me well over the years... and you may find it useful for your own experiments.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我再送你一件旧的实验室外套，它跟了我好多年……某天你做实验的时候，穿上它或许对你会有帮助。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sir, I encountered three Ferals on my patrol. This was somewhere around 0300 hours, I think, and it was dark, so they saw me first.
ESP.TRADUIT: 长官，我在巡逻中碰到了三个凶悍僵尸。我想当时时间大约是0300，光线很暗，所以是他们先看见了我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I discharged my firearm four times, fatally striking two of the three. My weapon jammed before I could fire on the third target.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我换了四次弹夹，击倒了其中两个。就在我要向第三个目标开火时，我的枪卡住了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just then I realized it wasn't engaging. I knew our orders were to report on anything unusual, and well -- I thought that was pretty strange.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就在那时，我意识到它没有进攻。我明白我们的命令是报告任何不寻常的事，反正 — 我认为那相当奇怪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He actually followed me back on his own. We put him in the trailer with the other and he's been quiet as you like. Strangest thing I've ever seen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他事实上只是跟着我。我们后来把它击倒了，他的样子很安静。那是我曾见过的最奇怪的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mutagenic Bio-what?
ESP.TRADUIT: “突变体基因活性增强剂”是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've managed to isolate some of the Fire Ant genes and distill them into human-safe genetic enhancers!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我设法离析了一些火蚁基因，蒸馏出对人体无害的基因强化剂！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can inject you with one of these formulas and you'll find yourself with either enhanced strength or enhanced perception!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以把这些强化过的基因分子注入你的体内，提升你的力量或者感知！随你选。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not only that, but you'll be somewhat more resistant to fire! How marvelous!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不仅这样，你还能提升一定的抗火能力！真不可思议！

ESP.ORIGINAL: This will stop the Fire Ants?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这能阻止火蚁吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, it should all wrap up rather nicely. I've rigged my equipment at my portable terminal to emit what I call an Inhibitor Pulse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 岂止如此，应该很有效。我已经在我的便携式终端上安装了我的设备，从而发射一种抑制脉冲。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once I send this pulse, all of the remaining ants will lose their empathic link with the Queen and frenzy, destroying each other in the process!
ESP.TRADUIT: 一旦我发出这种脉冲，所有剩下的蚂蚁都会丧失它们与蚁后之间的情感联系，然后陷入狂暴，相互攻击！

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, that's all there is to it. What do you say?
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是这么回事。你说怎样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, it should all wrap up rather nicely. I've rigged my equipment to emit what I call an Inhibitor Pulse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 岂止如此，应该很有效。我已经在我的便携式终端上安装了我的设备，从而发射一种抑制脉冲。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once I send this pulse, all of the remaining ants will lose their empathic link with the Queen and frenzy, destroying each other in the process!
ESP.TRADUIT: 一旦我发出这种脉冲，所有剩下的蚂蚁都会丧失它们与蚁后之间的情感联系，然后陷入狂暴，相互攻击！

ESP.ORIGINAL: However, there is one final detail I need your help with. Could you do something about Bryan Wilks for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 可是，还有最后的一个细节需要你帮忙。你能帮我处理一下布赖恩·威尔克斯的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope that's everything, I've had enough of ants.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望一切都结束了，我受够蚂蚁了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, it should all wrap up rather nicely. I've rigged my equipment at my portable terminal to emit what I call an Inhibitor Pulse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，应该很有效。我已经在我的便携式终端上安装了我的设备，从而发射一种抑制脉冲。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once I send this pulse, all of the remaining ants will lose their empathic link with the Queen and frenzy, destroying each other in the process!
ESP.TRADUIT: 一旦我发出这种脉冲，所有剩下的蚂蚁都会丧失它们与蚁后之间的情感联系，然后陷入狂暴，相互攻击！

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, that's all there is to it. What do you say?
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是这么回事。你说怎样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's everything to do with the ants, yes indeed. I've rigged my equipment to emit what I call an Inhibitor Pulse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是这些了，嗯，没错。我已经在我的便携式终端上安装了我的设备，从而发射一种抑制脉冲。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once I send this pulse, all of the remaining ants will lose their empathic link with the Queen and frenzy, destroying each other in the process!
ESP.TRADUIT: 一旦我发出这种脉冲，所有剩下的蚂蚁都会丧失它们与蚁后之间的情感联系，然后陷入狂暴，相互攻击！

ESP.ORIGINAL: However, there is one final detail I need your help with. Could you do something about Bryan Wilks for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 可是，还有最后的一个细节需要你帮忙。你能帮我处理一下布赖恩·威尔克斯的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just how will all this undo the mayhem you've caused?
ESP.TRADUIT: 要怎样做才能终止你造成的混乱？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've rigged the equipment at my portable terminal to emit what I call an Inhibitor Pulse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经在我的便携式终端上安装了我的设备，用来发射一种我称之为抑制脉冲的脉冲。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once I send this pulse, all of the remaining ants will lose their empathic link with the Queen and frenzy, destroying each other in the process!
ESP.TRADUIT: 一旦我发出这种脉冲，所有剩下的蚂蚁都会丧失它们与蚁后之间的情感联系，然后陷入狂暴，相互攻击！

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, that's all there is to it. What do you say?
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是这么回事。你说怎样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've rigged the equipment at my portable terminal to emit what I call an Inhibitor Pulse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经在我的便携式终端上安装了我的设备，用来发射一种我称之为抑制脉冲的脉冲。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once I send this pulse, all of the remaining ants will lose their empathic link with the Queen and frenzy, destroying each other in the process!
ESP.TRADUIT: 一旦我发出这种脉冲，所有剩下的蚂蚁都会丧失它们与蚁后之间的情感联系，然后陷入狂暴，相互攻击！

ESP.ORIGINAL: However, there is one final detail I need your help with. Could you do something about Bryan Wilks for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 可是，还有最后的一个细节需要你帮忙。你能帮我处理一下布赖恩·威尔克斯的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm ready for my Mutagenic Bioenhancer injection and Lab Coat, Doctor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在等你送我突变体基因活性增强剂和实验室外套，博士。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How marvelous! Here is the promised Lab Coat. I'm certain you'll find it quite useful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好！给你我答应过的实验室外套。我肯定你会觉得它很有用。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which injection did you want? Will it be the Ant Sight or Ant Might?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要哪种增强剂？火蚁魔感还是火蚁魔力？

ESP.ORIGINAL: How marvelous! Which injection did you want? Will it be the Ant Sight or Ant Might?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真不可思议！你要哪种增强剂？火蚁魔感还是火蚁魔力？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm ready for my Mutagenic Bioenhancer injection, Doctor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在等你送我突变体基因活性增强剂和实验室外套，博士。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've killed all the Nest Guardians. [Lie]
ESP.TRADUIT: 我杀了所有的守卫蚁。[撒谎]

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then I will proceed to my portable terminal at once and make the necessary changes to the formula.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我要立刻启动我的便携式终端，对基因配方做必要的修改。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's proceed to my terminal and we'll see if I can undo all the damage I've caused.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们进到我的终端，我看看能不能停止我造成的所有伤害。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My work is done, Doctor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的工作完成了，博士。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, how marvelous! Please, tell me what happened.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，真不可思议！拜托，告诉我发生了什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come now, the faster you tell me... the faster I can provide promised payment for your services!
ESP.TRADUIT: 快点，你越快告诉我……你就能越快拿到我为你的服务要支付的报酬！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, how marvelous! Please, tell me what happened.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，真不可思议！拜托，告诉我发生了什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What kind of work do you do in here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这做什么工作？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The secret kind...
ESP.TRADUIT: 秘密……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, if you must know... I'm an electrician and computer expert. AND I'm a bit of a surgeon. Really, the most gifted scientist you'll find...
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你要真想知道……我是一个电器技师和电脑专家，并且，我差不多是个外科医生。真的，你所见过的最天才的科学家……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmph. I'm the guy that got Rivet City up and running in the first place!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哼。我是建造铆钉城并让它运作的人！

ESP.ORIGINAL: And after all that Li and her gang of flunkies pushed me out. Ha! Project Purity indeed. What a bunch of morons -- they can't even clean some water.
ESP.TRADUIT: 之后，李和她的那帮小人把我排挤了出去。哈！净化工程对吧，一群白痴 — 他们净化不了一滴水。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Defender Morgan and I executed a reconnaissance mission last night to gauge Raider entrenchment in the structural underground of Fairfax.
ESP.TRADUIT: 昨天晚上，守卫者摩根和我执行了侦察任务，测量了歹徒在费尔福克斯地下挖掘的壕沟。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We located three entrances into underground utility tunnels, and confirmed the enemy has occupied and fortified these positions. Some are undefended.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们查找到有三个入口可以进入地下的维修隧道，并证实敌人已经占据和加强了这些位置。但有一些位置没有防备。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We also identified a small weapons cache in the southeast section of the tunnels. We were compromised by a patrol while placing explosives here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们还在这些隧道的东南区域查找到了小型武器的隐藏点。在埋设炸药时，我们被巡逻队撞见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: In accordance to mission parameters, we did not engage, instead retreating to Base. Raiders will be likely to attach more patrols to that area now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 根据任务指示，我们没有和他们交火，选择了撤回基地。歹徒目前可能会在那区域增派更多的巡逻队。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've secured the building and are currently implementing our orders for the occupation of Fairfax.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们占领了这栋建筑，现在正执行占领费尔福克斯的命令。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Raider activity in town has increased since we first took up positions in and around the fort. We've killed a lot of them and scared off others.
ESP.TRADUIT: 自从我们拿下堡垒和附近的区域，歹徒在镇子里的活动有所增加。我们干掉他们不少人，其他人也是闻风丧胆。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But they just keep coming back. Their numbers seem limitless, while requests for our own reinforcements are repeatedly denied.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但他们不停地反扑，他们的数量像是源源不断，而我们自己的增援请求却再三遭到拒绝。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That the Raiders take such continued risks to invade our facility appears to confirm suspicions that we've had an intelligence leak.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些歹徒不惜余力地冒险侵入我们的设施，这确凿地说明我们的情报已经泄露了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They've tried tenaciously to infiltrate the base, but so far haven't stood a chance. Our objective remains the same: protect the research personnel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们顽强地设法渗透进基地，但到目前为止还没成功过。我们的任务照旧：保护研究人员。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's wonderful, kid. Now scram.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好极了，孩子。赶快滚开。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Awww, come on. You're pretty tough taking out all those ants by yourself!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，来吧，你非常强壮，可以独自干掉所有蚂蚁！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Happy
