ESP.ORIGINAL: The name's Bryan Wilks, by the way, I live in Grayditch. Well, that is, I did until those Fire Ants turned this place into a cemetery.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我叫布赖恩·威尔克斯，顺便说一下，我住在格雷蒂奇。就是说，我以前住在这，现在那些火蚁把这地方变成了坟场。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: They killed everyone in town... including my pappa. Now I'm all alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们杀掉了镇子的每个人……包括我爸爸。我现在孤身一人了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Taylor, stop shooting, damnit!
ESP.TRADUIT: 泰勒，停止射击，该死的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [06027057] (ID) NPC : [060C09D5] (ID) Quest : ([06014EA3]MS16) Trouble on the Homefront Comment (NAM2) : Furious and terrified that his friend is shooting at his son. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...that batch of tests was inconclusive, but Madison and I are convinced it's a problem with the secondary filtration system.
ESP.TRADUIT: ……那批测试没有说服力，不过麦迪逊和我深信问题出在二级过滤系统。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : suddenly distracted because she's working, and her husband's making a pass at her. But she's openly laughing now, and happy, and flirting back. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We’re going to re-calibrate the equipment and try again tomorrow, so that... James, please, I’m trying to work. Now’s not the time...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们准备明天重新校准设备再试一次，所以……詹姆斯，求你了，我正在努力，现在不是……的时候。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : suddenly distracted because she's working, and her husband's making a pass at her. But she's openly laughing now, and happy, and flirting back. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So that's the next step. Assuming we get the results we need, we'll move on to... James! Stop! I need to finish these notes...
ESP.TRADUIT: 假如我们得到了想要的结果，下一步我们会…… 詹姆斯！停下！我需要完成这些记录……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : suddenly distracted because she's working, and her husband's making a pass at her. But she's openly laughing now, and happy, and flirting back. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll move on to diagnosing the issues with the radiation dampeners. That should... Ow! James! Now? We really shouldn't... Ha ha ha ha ha!
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后我们要使用放射抑制器诊断下。那应当……噢！詹姆斯！现在？我们真的不应该……哈哈哈哈哈！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : suddenly distracted because she's working, and her husband's making a pass at her. But she's openly laughing now, and happy, and flirting back. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How the heck can an ant breathe fire?
ESP.TRADUIT: 蚂蚁怎么会喷火？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The stimulation of the subject's evolutionary trigger by the mutagen caused a bio-defensive reaction metamorphosing the ant's venom glands.
ESP.TRADUIT: 诱变剂引起进化，造成生理防御反应，使蚂蚁的毒液腺变形。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This process caused unexpected oscillations in the venom molecules at such a vast rate it produces a thermodynamic biochemical reaction.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在毒液分子中，这一过程造成意想不到变异，从而制造出一个热力生化学的反应。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As the subject ejects the volatile solution, it becomes conflagrant due to new structures in its maw I call its calefaction array.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这种反应在蚂蚁的胃中产生新的结构，我称之为加热内腺，它让蚂蚁喷射出炽热的挥发溶质。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Amazing, isn't it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 很惊人吧，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't you take responsibility for his father's death?
ESP.TRADUIT: 难道你不该对他父亲的死负责？

ESP.ORIGINAL: All scientists take responsibility for their failures, because it comes with the territory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所有的科学家都该为他们的失败负责，因为这涉及整个研究领域。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will take this experimentation to completion without roosting on the moral high ground.
ESP.TRADUIT: 道德在我的实验中没有立足之地。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I allow emotions to enter the mix, all this time and energy spent will have been for nothing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要是让情绪掺杂到我的实验中，我花费的所有时间和精力都会付诸东流。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I changed my mind. I'll do it. I'll put in the code.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我改变主意了。我会输入密码。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you kidding me? We don't have time for this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说笑吗？我们没时间做这事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. If you're going to do it, then do it. But hurry up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，如果你要做，那就去做。不过要赶快。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sentinel Lyons [0601D430] (mod) Quest : ([06014E91]MQ11) Take it Back! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, I'll take it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我会带上它！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here you go! Enjoy it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿去吧。好好利用!

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take it for 50 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我出50个瓶盖买下它。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it will save me the trip.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，这会节省我的旅费。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, you've got a deal. Enjoy!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，成交了。祝你开心！

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing, following me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在干嘛，跟踪我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: In a way. I tracked you using your Geomapper.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可以这么说，我用你的自动绘图模块跟踪到了你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Reilly sent me to find you so I could bring you this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 莱莉派我来的，要我把这给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No problem. What are you doing out here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 没问题，你到这来做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looking for you. I tracked you using your Geomapper.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找你，我用你的自动绘图模块跟踪到了你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Reilly sent me to find you so I could bring you this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 莱莉派我来的，要我把这给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice. So that's the thanks I get for coming all this way to bring you this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，费尽功夫给你带来这个之后，你就这么感谢我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, you can't always count on me to save your ass.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，你不能总指望我来救你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Donovan! What are you doing in these parts?
ESP.TRADUIT: 多诺万！你在这地方做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tracked you using the Geomapper.
ESP.TRADUIT: 用自动绘图模块跟踪的你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Reilly sent me to find you so I could bring you this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 莱莉派我来的，要我把这给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's with those things behind the glass?
ESP.TRADUIT: 玻璃后的那些东西是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Glowing Ones? That's Ethyl. The other one is Meat. They used to be residents of Underworld.
ESP.TRADUIT: 发光僵尸？那是乙荃，另一个是米特。他们曾是地下城的居民。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doctor Barrows is studying the link between normal Ghouls, Feral Ghouls, and Glowing Ones.
ESP.TRADUIT: 巴罗斯医生正在研究普通僵尸、凶悍僵尸和发光僵尸之间的联系。

ESP.ORIGINAL: His research is truly fascinating.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他的研究真有趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Blessings to you, too. Surely, you would care to give a tithe for that wisdom?
ESP.TRADUIT: 也祝福你。当然了，你介不介意为那点智慧做点施舍？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, yes, of course! Please, accept this. It's all I have, but surely I owe everything to the lessons in your holy guide. Bless you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，是的，当然！请收下这，它是我的所有，不过当然，这一切都要归功于你对这课程神圣的指导。祝福你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I never meant it like all that. It's just supposed to help you stay alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从没想过它会那么重要，它只是应该用来帮助你们活下去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, it teaches us how to live, and how to return to the paradise that was! Truly, it is our guide through this wasted land.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，它教我们怎样活着，怎样回到天堂！它真的是带我们穿过这片废弃之地的向导。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please, take these as my thanks. So many of us owe our lives to your great work. Bless you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 带走这些，作为我对你的感谢。我们的生命全都拜你伟大的工作所赐。祝福你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. Why don't you tell me about it? <Lie>
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，为什么你不和我说说这个？<撒谎>

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a glory of a book! It teaches us what to do, how to live, and how our people can return to the paradise that once was!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是本荣耀之书！它教我们怎样活着，怎样回到天堂！它真的是带我们穿过这片废弃之地的向导。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You simply must read it, friend, it'll save your life... and maybe even your soul!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你必须好好读一读，朋友，它会拯救你的生命……甚至可能是你的灵魂！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please, take my copy and spread the word!
ESP.TRADUIT: 请带走我的这一本，让更多的人体会到它的福音！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe the book's fine, and you're just an idiot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许这本书不错，而你只是个白痴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'd have to be an idiot to listen to this piece of crap.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这么说吧，我要是想看这本破书那我就是个白痴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, you think so much of it, you take it. Fat lot of good it'll do you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着，你觉得这本书不错是吧，那你自己留着吧，它能帮你很大忙呢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry to hear that. Is it really that bad?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听到这个我很遗憾，它真的那么糟？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take a look. It's good for a laugh, but don't try to actually follow its advice. Not unless you're looking for a quick way to end it all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，看看，它很好笑，不过别把它的建议当真，除非你不想活了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, I helped write that book.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，我协助撰写了那本书。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then I think you oughtta leave, before I decide to pay you back for all the bad advice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你最好在因为你书里的那些糟糕的建议而揍你一顿之前，带上你的破书滚蛋。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And take your damned book with you, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把你那本破书也带上。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, don't let me hold you up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不妨碍你了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I guess I should be getting back. I'll tell Amata you're okay, she'll be happy to hear that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我想我该回去了。我会告诉阿玛塔你一切都好，她听到这消息后会很高兴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and here: have some fresh water from the Vault. I guess it's pretty hard to find it out here. Take care out here, and thanks again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，给：从避难所带来的一点净水，我猜在这很难找到。多保重，再次感谢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I miss her, too. Give my warmest regards to the Vault, would you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也想她。替我向避难所问好，行吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I will. They'll be glad to hear from you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我会的。他们听到你的消息一定很高兴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and here: have some fresh water from the Vault.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，给：从避难所带来的一点纯净水。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess it's pretty hard to find it out here, and maybe it'll be a taste of home for you. Take care out here, and thanks again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜它在外面一定少见，它会让你感受到家的味道。多保重，再次感谢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got to go now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在得走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay! Wave bye-bye Bob! Oh come on, move a branch at least... *sigh*
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的！再见，鲍勃！哦，拜托，至少摇下树枝嘛……*叹气*

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're obviously crazier than they are. Why would I listen to you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你显然比他们更加疯狂。我为什么要听你的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't say I blame you. It's my mistake for making you do something you didn't want to do in the first place, I guess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我不能指责你。是我错在先，不该让你去做一些你并不想做的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still, maybe it's all for the best. I mean, I've been talking with Birch and they really seem to need me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，或许这也是为了大局着想。我的意思是，我已经和布尔奇谈过了，他们似乎真的需要我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you say Herbert, should I give em' another chance?
ESP.TRADUIT: 赫伯特，你怎么说，我应该再给他们一次机会吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh ye- fine, fine... I mean Bob. I still think it's funny when I call him Herbert.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，好的。我是说，鲍勃。我还是觉得叫他赫伯特很好玩。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not the killing type.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我又不是什么杀人狂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I suppose you aren't. My mistake for making you do something you didn't want to do in the first place I guess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，我想你不是。是我错在先，不该让你去做一些你并不想做的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still, maybe it's all for the best. I mean, I've been talking with Birch and they really seem to need me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，或许这也是为了大局着想。我的意思是，我已经和布尔奇谈过了，他们似乎真的需要我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you say Herbert, should I give em' another chance?
ESP.TRADUIT: 赫伯特，你怎么说，我应该再给他们一次机会吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, fine... I mean Bob. I still think it's funny when I call him Herbert.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，好的。我是说，鲍勃。我还是觉得叫他赫伯特很好玩。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've become an important part of their life. Without you, they're lost.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你已经成为他们生活中的一个重要组成部分。如果没有你，他们会迷失的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, they really need me that badly, huh? I guess I never thought of it that way. Awfully selfish of me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们真的如此需要我吗，呃？我从来没有想过这些。我真是太自私了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Should we give em' another chance, Herbert?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我应该再给他们一次机会吗，赫伯特？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, fine... I mean Bob. I still think it's funny when I call him Herbert.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，好的。我是说，鲍勃。我还是觉得叫他赫伯特很好玩。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What, just give it to you? Hell no.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么，白送？见鬼，不。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I... I understand. You have to look out for yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我...我明白了。你得照顾好自己。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : Weak and pathetic. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just leave me...
ESP.TRADUIT: 别管我了...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : Weak and pathetic. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I insist, my friend. It's the least I can do to help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 收下吧，我的朋友。这是起码该做的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? Seriously? My God. Thank you. Thank you so much. I'll never forget this!
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？你是认真的？我的上帝，谢谢你！非常感谢。我永远不会忘记这件事！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Water... precious water... thank you! You're a saint!
ESP.TRADUIT: 水...珍贵的水...谢谢你！你真是个圣人！

ESP.ORIGINAL: My... thank you. Thank you so much. You've saved my life. Bless you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的...谢谢你！非常感谢。你救了我的命，祝福你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? Thank you. You're the first person willing to actually give me any of that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？谢谢。你是第一个愿意给我水喝的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you... I'm starting to think Aqua Pura is even better than normal purified water.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你.... 我开始觉得药水要比一般的纯净水好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. Find your own water.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有，你自己去找水吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I... I understand. You have to look out for yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我...我明白了。你得照顾好自己。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : Weak and pathetic. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just leave me...
ESP.TRADUIT: 别管我了...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : Weak and pathetic. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha! Oh... oh... ha ha ha ha ha ha... That good one! Ha ha ha ha ha!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！噢……噢……哈哈哈哈哈哈……这个好！哈哈哈哈哈 !

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kill the humans! Kill them all! Aggghhh!
ESP.TRADUIT: 干掉人类！干掉所有人类！啊~~~！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Humans who?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么人类？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Humans.
ESP.TRADUIT: 人类。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If this android "wandered" off, why would he want a new mind and face?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果这人造人是“走失”，为什么他会想要新的大脑和面孔？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe... MAYBE he didn't exactly wander off. Maybe he fled. Escaped captivity, as it were, if he began to misinterpret his "situation."
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许……或许准确的说，他没有走失。他或许是逃跑了。如果他开始曲解他的“处境”，对他来说，现在就好像是逃出了囚禁。"
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's possible my android sought to forget his previous life. Wipe away all memory, all guilt. Trick himself into believing he really IS human.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的人造人可能是想去遗忘他以前的生活，擦去所有记忆和所有罪行，欺骗自己，让自己相信他真的是一个人类。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So no, he may not be just an ordinary robot, but he's certainly not human, no matter how badly he wishes it so. I made him. I want him. End of story.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以他不只是一个普通的机器人，但他的确也不是人类，不管他多么迫切地希望如此。我制造了他，我需要拿回他，就是这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why would an android feel guilt? Come on, Zimmer, what aren't you telling me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 人造人怎么会有负罪感？齐默，你对我隐瞒了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: By God, you're as annoying as you are clever. Very well. I'll tell you what you want to know, if it helps you locate my property.
ESP.TRADUIT: 上帝，你很聪明也很烦人。好吧，要是能帮你找到我的财产，那我告诉你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The duty of this particular unit was the hunting and capturing of other escaped androids. Yes, others have escaped.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我目前的职责是搜索和捕获其他逃跑的人造人。没错，也跑了些其他的人造人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's one of the side effects of having such an advanced A.I. Machines start to think for themselves. Fool themselves into believing they have rights.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如此先进的人工智能机器有一个副作用，他们会思考自身的一切，会自欺欺人地认为他们也和人类一样拥有权利。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And so... this particular android may have believed he'd done something... wrong. Immoral. And wanted to forget those deeds. Satisfied now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以……这特别的人造人可能相信他做了一些事情……错误的事、不当的事，并想要忘掉那些事。你满意了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the hell just happened?
ESP.TRADUIT: 究竟发生了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: James... Your father caused an overload. He sacrificed himself to keep the Enclave from getting the purifier, and to buy us some time to escape.
ESP.TRADUIT: 詹姆斯…你父亲引发了一次超载。他牺牲了自己来阻止英克雷，保护了净化器，为我们逃跑争取时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There'll be more of them coming. We need to get out of here before they find us, or else your father died in vain.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们快来了。在他们找到我们之前，我们要离开这，否则你父亲就白死了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Li [060156CC] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm interested in the Love Machine Theme.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对性爱装饰主题有兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Feeling a bit anxious, perhaps?
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许会感觉有点不安？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Remember, once you buy a theme you can't sell it back to me, although you could always purchase a new one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 记住，你一旦买了主题，你就不能再卖回给我，但是你可以买新主题来替换原来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yuck, the thought of walking around naked's making me sick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 讨厌，这种裸奔的想法让我觉得恶心。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Remember, once you buy a theme you can't sell it back to me, although you could always purchase a new one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 记住，你一旦买了主题，你就不能再卖回给我，但是你可以买新主题来替换原来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Remember, once you buy a theme you can't sell it back to me, although you could always purchase a new one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 记住，你一旦买了主题，你就不能再卖回给我，但是你可以买新主题来替换原来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The android is dead. See, here's an internal component. <Lie.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 人造人死了。看，这是一个零件。<撒谎。>

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Let me see that! This is a Neuro-Servo... Unique to the A3-21... I... And you say you got this from his corpse?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？让我看看！这是神经伺服……A3-21独有的……我……并且你说是从他的尸体上找到的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose there's no other way you could have obtained it. Well... damn it. I was afraid this would happen, out here in this, this... Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你没别的办法能得到它。嗯……该死。我曾害怕这事会发生，在这，这……废土上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well. Here's 50 caps for your troubles. Try to buy yourself an education out here in this hell. Good day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，50个瓶盖作为你的回报，就算是资助你的学费吧，感受下这个废土的无情啊。再见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Zimmer [060156B9] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry Harkness, but this is the only way. Activate A3-21 Recall Code Violet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，哈克尼斯，但这是唯一的办法。激活A3-21 召回代码。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Agggggghh!!!
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: My God, I... I remember. I remember it all. From before. Zimmer. The Commonwealth. The Institute. My God, all those runners I brought down...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的天，我……我记得了。我记起了一切。过去，齐默，联邦，研究院。天啊，还有我带来的那些逃跑者……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You... You made me remember. Why? How? I... Never mind... I just... My God... What am I going to do? My life, everything, it's all a lie...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你……你让我恢复了记忆。为什么？怎么办到的？我……别介意……我只是……我的天……我要做什么？我的生命，一切，所有的都是谎言……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome back to reality, you filthy android. Activate A3-21 Recall Code Violet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎回到真实，你这恶心的人造人，激活A3-21召回代码。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Agggggghh!!!
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: My God, I... I remember. I remember it all. From before. Zimmer. The Commonwealth. The Institute. My God, all those runners I brought down...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的天，我……我记得了。我记起了一切。过去，齐默，联邦，研究院。天啊，还有我带来的那些逃跑者……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: You... You made me remember. Why? How? I... Never mind... I just... My God... What am I going to do? My life, everything, it's all a lie...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你……你让我恢复了记忆。为什么？怎么办到的？我……别介意……我只是……我的天……我要做什么？我的生命，一切，所有的都是谎言……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harkness [060156AA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: At ease.
ESP.TRADUIT: 稍息。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I help you, is there some kind of reward?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要是帮助你，会有回报吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course! If you help me, and thus the android, God and the universe will smile upon you. Is there any better compensation?
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然！如果你帮我、并因此帮助这人造人，上帝和宇宙会向你微笑。还有比这些更好的报答吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything else I should know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有什么是我应该知道的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just understand that this android is now, for all intents and purposes, a man. He looks human, he acts human. He believes he IS human.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你只需要知道，这人造人现在不论是动机还是目标，都是人类了。他的外表像人，他的行为像人，他相信自己是人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But even if he's not... Even if he's a machine... He's capable of rational thought. And emotion. So you see, his soul is as human as yours or mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但即使他不是……即使他只是机器……他依然能理性思考，富有感情。所以你看，他和你我一样有人的灵魂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This person -- and he is a person -- deserves a chance at freedom. Please, if there's a shred of decency in you, don't take that away from him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个人 — 而且他是个人 — 应该拥有获得自由的机会。如果你还残存对生命的尊敬，请不要剥夺他的这项权利。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I join the Railroad?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能加入“铁路”吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell you what. You deliver that component to Zimmer and tell him the android is dead, and you can consider yourself a member in good standing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把这零件交给齐默，告诉他人造人死了，那你就可以说自己行了善事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This conversation's over, Ms. Watts. Now step aside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谈话结束了，让开，瓦兹女士。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. Blow me off. Live in denial. But take this. It's an internal component from the very android you're searching for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我让开。继续活在否认事实之中吧。不过拿上这个，它是一个零件，来自于你要找的那个人造人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't ask how I obtained it. If you change your mind, if you decide you want to help, present the component to Doctor Zimmer in Rivet City.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别问我是怎么得来的。你要是改变主意，决定要帮忙，给铆钉城的齐默博士看这零件。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell him the android is dead, and that was on the corpse. He'll believe you. He'll go back to the Commonwealth, and you'll have saved a man's life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉他人造人死了，零件是从尸体上找到的。他会相信你。然后会回去联邦，而你则拯救了一个人的生命。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What would you have me do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要我做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You really want to help? Take this. It's an internal component from the very android you're searching for. Don't ask how I obtained it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真的想帮忙？拿上这个。这是你要找的人造人的一个零件。别问我是怎么得来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Present it to Doctor Zimmer in Rivet City. Tell him the android is dead, and that was on the corpse. He'll believe you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给铆钉城的齐默博士看这零件，告诉他这人造人死了，零件是从尸体上找到的。他会相信你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do that, and Zimmer will go back to the Commonwealth, and leave that poor soul alone. Do that, and you'll have saved a man's life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 做完这件事，齐默会回到联邦，放过那可怜家伙。做完这件事，你将拯救一个人的生命。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hhhuuuhh...
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃啊……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([00041E7F]GenericPlayer) GenericPlayer Comment (NAM2) : labored gasp... struggling for air EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, dear. Is that old radio on the fritz again? I should turn it off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，亲爱的。老收音机又出问题了？我应该关掉它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [060244A3] (ID) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, run along and cry now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 耶，滚吧，哭吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shut up before I pound you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我揍你之前，闭嘴！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know, the usual.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道，这很平常。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not much, I guess. Apart from keeping you dumbasses in line, that is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想不多。除了管好你们这群蠢货。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mayor MacCready [060156AC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Said in a friendly, cheerful manner EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Evewything's a-okay!
ESP.TRADUIT: 一且……正场！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Biwwy [06061794] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Spoken with annoying little kid lisp ("L" pronounced as "W") EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just talking to morons who keep bugging me. Scram!
ESP.TRADUIT: 去和那些不停打扰我的蠢货说话。滚开！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fun times and laughs as always!
ESP.TRADUIT: 总是笑声不断！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cool junk and collecting, as always!
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续收垃圾！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was running so fast, I thought my legs were gonna fly off, but then they didn't, which makes sense, 'cause legs don't have wings. You know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我飞快地跑，我想我的腿都快要飞出去了，不过它们没有，那是什么意思，因为腿没有翅膀。你知道吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : hyperactive, spoken quickly EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just relaxing. Nothing much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 放松。没事了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : mumbled EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just playing around, you know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是玩玩，懂吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Squirrel [06015686] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A couple weak coughs EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keeping everyone from killing themselves. Same as ever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和以前一样，阻止人们自相残杀。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Watching after the younger kids and seeing if they can't accidentally learn a thing or two. You know how it goes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 观察这些年纪轻轻的孩子，看他们能否意外学会一些事情。你知道怎么做。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not much. Still trying to find a way to turn this fungus into something that doesn't taste like toenails.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不多。还在想办法把这些蘑菇变成尝起来不像脚趾甲的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got a new tooth today! It was just lying there and now it's mine!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我长了颗新牙！它就躺在那，现在它是我的了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bumble [06015699] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Excited and innocent EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Little Lamplighter [06038836] (mod) NPC : Little Lamplighter [06038837] (mod) NPC : Little Lamplighter [060BD46E] (mod) NPC : Little Lamplighter [060BD46F] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's up, pal?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么啦，兄弟？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's happening, pal?
ESP.TRADUIT: 出什么事了，兄弟？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hewwo. What's up?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈罗，怎么了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Biwwy [06061794] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Spoken with annoying little kid lisp ("L" pronounced as "W") EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello, there. What're you up to? Not getting into too much trouble?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，你忙什么呢？没什么麻烦吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello. What's happening today?
ESP.TRADUIT: 喂，今天有什么事？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joseph [0601568D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Friendly and genial EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: What're you up to, today?
ESP.TRADUIT: 今天忙什么呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello. What's happening?
ESP.TRADUIT: 喂，怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh hey! What's happening? Something fun?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，嗨！发生什么事？有趣吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zip [060179D6] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : hyperactive, spoken quickly EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello. Anything interesting happening?
ESP.TRADUIT: 喂，有什么趣事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello. What's up?
ESP.TRADUIT: 喂，怎么了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sammy [06015684] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : mumbled, as in " 'lo. 'sup?" EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, what's happening?
ESP.TRADUIT: 喂，怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everything fine down here in paradise? What's happening?
ESP.TRADUIT: 天堂一切都好？发生了什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mayor MacCready [060156AC] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : A little bombastic EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, what's up?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, here you go and you don't owe me a single cap.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，拿好，你不欠我瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that's awfully generous of you seeing as I never made a deal with you in the first place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可真大方，我并没有首先和你达成协议呢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I guess it's pretty decent of you not to sell it to someone else instead. Thanks, kid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过你没有把它卖给别人，还真是实在人。谢谢，孩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll sell it to you...for 300 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会把它卖给你……300个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, fine. Anything to get it! Here's your caps, now hand it over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，好吧，怎么都行！给你瓶盖，交货。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hang on a second. You want it, you need to pay for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等一下，既然你要它，你就得出钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shrewd kid, very shrewd.
ESP.TRADUIT: 精明的小子，非常精明。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. Seeing as I was going to pay Grady anyway, here's the caps I owed him. Now, lemme have it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，既然我反正要付钱给格雷迪，我把还欠他的瓶盖给你。现在把它给我吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, thanks a bunch for bringing it to me. You could have been a jerk and sold it to someone else, but you didn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 喂，多谢你把它带给我。你本来可以把它卖给别人，但你没有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah hell, let me give you the rest of the caps I was gonna give Grady anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，他妈的，让我把欠格雷迪的瓶盖给你吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay... okay. Here. No need for violence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧……好吧，给，别那么凶。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. That's what I thought. Now scram!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就好，滚吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me exactly who you are. Who you really are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 确切地告诉我你是谁，你真是的身份是什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you torment me? You know who I am. You know that I am really Doctor Braun, that I created this place...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么要折磨我？你知道我是谁。你知道我真是的布劳恩博士，我创造了这地方……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Betty [0602449C] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: And now I'm trapped here. It's all your fault.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而且现在我被困在这了，都是你的错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Betty [0602449C] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8A]MQ04) Tranquility Lane EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I buy some Ultrajet?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能买点超级杰特吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmmm, so you wanna live life on the wild side, huh? Okay. Go for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，那么你是要到野外去谋生了，呃？好吧，去吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, as soon as you bring me some more Sugar Bombs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，只要你带给我更多糖麦弹。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you ever heard of The Family?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听说过家族没？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. I stay away from them and they don't bother me. It's a good relationship. They live somewhere East of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我不找他们的麻烦，他们也不打搅我，我们和平共处。他们就住这东边的某个地方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're feeling foolish, I think there's an underground way through to their place deeper into the metro station here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要是够愚蠢，我想这的地铁站下面有地道通到他们住的位置。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's all the Sugar Bombs I've got.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，我所有的糖麦弹。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good... good. There's more out there, so go and find it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的……好的……外边还有更多，继续去找吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice work. The Ultrajet's coming along nicely.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得好。超级杰特的进展很好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent! keep it coming.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太棒了！常来！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Make it 30 caps each and you got yourself a deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每个30个瓶盖，就成交。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, anything to get what I need. Now scram, I got some preparing to do!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，怎么都行。走开，我还有事！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not now. I'm busy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在不行，我很忙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I changed my mind. I'll go with you to Rivet City.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我改变了主意，我会和你去铆钉城。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry to hear that. I hope you'll consider meeting me in Rivet City.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听到这我很遗憾。我希望你能考虑去铆钉城见我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I changed my mind. I'm not going to go with you right now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我改变了主意，我现在不会和你去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's good to hear. Let's not waste any time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，我们别浪费时间了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dad [06019CEF] (mod) Quest : ([06014E8B]MQ05) The Waters of Life EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Make it 400 caps and it's all yours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 400个瓶盖，归你了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nicely played; and I know talent when I see it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 打得好；天才我看一眼就知道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here you go. Okay team, let's get out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你。队员们，让我们离开这。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, I'll take it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我接受。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now that's teamwork! Good choice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是团队协作！明智的选择。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay team, let's get out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 队员们，让我们离开这。

ESP.ORIGINAL: May I have the key to the Research Safe?
ESP.TRADUIT: 可以给我一把研究所保险柜的钥匙吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Certainly, allow me to whip up a copy for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我帮你复制一把。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: There you are. Have a wonderful and productive day!
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，祝你能有神奇的一天，收获满满！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milo, Shipping Foreman [0604D5B7] (mod) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've gotten word that a band of mercs called Reilly's Rangers were trapped on a D.C. rooftop, pinned down by Super Mutants.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我获得消息，一队名叫“莱莉的游骑兵”的雇佣兵被困在了特区的一处楼顶上，他们被超级变种人缠了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I killed Junders Plunkett.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我杀了伦德斯·普朗基特。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it's about time someone put that bastard out of his misery.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这杂种到了脱离苦海的时候。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sonora Cruz [0606F211] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E8]PerkLawbringer) Lawbringer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And here's the reward for it. Spend it well, Lawbringer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的奖赏，好好用，执法悍将。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sonora Cruz [0606F211] (mod) Quest : ([0606F1E8]PerkLawbringer) Lawbringer EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where did you come from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是从哪来的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A place called Underworld. It's a Ghoul city down in D.C. I set off up here to find adventure and fortune. And... well... I found this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 名叫地下城的地方，它是僵尸之城，就在特区。我到这冒险，寻找财宝……嗯……我找到了这地方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sort of stuck here. Colin says that I can't leave until I pay off my debt to him. Of course, he charges me room and board too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我陷在这了。科林说我不能离开，直到我还清他的帐。当然，他租给我的房间和床板都是要收钱的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you ever get to Underworld, tell Carol that I said hi.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你下次要是到了地下城，代我向卡罗尔问声好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You touched Antler!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你敢碰鹿角！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now you pay!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要付出代价！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Antler is my friend!
ESP.TRADUIT: 鹿角是我的朋友！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Antler loves me! Not you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 鹿角爱的是我！不是你！

ESP.ORIGINAL: No one touch Antler but ME!
ESP.TRADUIT: 除了我没人可以碰鹿角！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your eyes on Antler! Stop looking!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在看鹿角！别看了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come to think of it, sabotage is a great idea.
ESP.TRADUIT: 仔细想想，还是破坏了比较好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then bring me Sugar Bombs. Three boxes should do the trick. Add those to the fuel mixture and "Boom!"
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就带一些甜麦炮弹给我。三盒应该就够了。把它们加到燃料混合物中，然后就"轰！"

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll show those rotten Ghouls! And they'll know exactly who did them in!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要给那些腐烂的尸鬼一点颜色瞧瞧！到时候他们就会后悔的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then bring me Sugar Bombs. Three boxes should do the trick. Add those to the fuel mixture and "Boom!"
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就带一些甜麦炮弹给我。三盒应该就够了。把它们加到燃料混合物中，然后就"轰！"

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll show those rotten Ghouls! And they'll know exactly who did them in!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要给那些腐烂的尸鬼一点颜色瞧瞧！到时候他们就会后悔的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Oh god! You're telling me the truth, aren't you...?
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功] 上帝啊！你告诉我的都是事实，不是吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh no! How could they do this to me? For two years? My god, I've been a joke to them!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，不！他们怎么能这么对我？整整两年？上帝啊，对他们来说我就是个笑话！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have any idea how easy it'd be for me to sabotage those rockets? That'd be a joke, huh? One hell of a joke!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道破坏那些火箭对我来说有多容易吗？那才是个笑话，对吧？一个该死的笑话！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jason told me himself. The Great Journey is for Ghouls only. You're not going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 杰森亲自交代，只有尸鬼能进行伟大旅程。你不能去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] I see your ploy, smoothskin. I won't fall for your trap. You can plainly see that I'm a Ghoul myself. You can't turn me against my flock.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败] 我早看穿你的把戏了，滑皮子。我不会着你的道的。你我都很清楚，我是个尸鬼。别想挑拨离间。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You wouldn't trust a Ghoul, would you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不会信任一个尸鬼的，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good idea.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好主意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I'll be going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恐怕我得走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your pranks won't work on me, smoothskin. They won't work on Jason, either.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你那些玩笑对我没用，滑皮子。对杰森也不会有用的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, you're not a Ghoul!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，你不是尸鬼！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Big room. Metal staircase. East side of the building. Is that too many syllables for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 大楼的东侧，大厅，铁楼梯。这么简单还记不住？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me again how to find you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再给我讲一次怎么能找到你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Like I said, find the metal staircase in the big room on the east side of the building. It's where they used to make rockets.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说了，在大楼东侧的大厅里，有一座铁楼梯。沿着那儿走就能找到他们用来制造火箭的地方了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where are you located?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么才能找到你？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who I am doesn't matter, smoothskin. Stop wasting time and get up here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是谁并不重要，滑皮子。别浪费时间了，赶紧上来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am Jason Bright, the prophet of the Great Journey. All the Ghouls you see here are members of my flock.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是辐光杰森，是伟大旅程的领路人。这里所有的尸鬼，都是我的徒众。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any idea what the NCR's up to in Primm?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道NCR在普瑞姆做什么吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your guess's as good as mine. Probably better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也在猜呢。不过也许你猜得更准。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Primm Resident [000A59DE] (file) NPC : Primm Resident [000A59DF] (mod) NPC : Primm Resident [000A59E0] (mod) NPC : Primm Resident [000A59E1] (mod) NPC : Dead Primm Resident [000A59E2] (mod) NPC : Primm Resident [000A59E3] (file) NPC : Primm Resident [000A59E4] (file) NPC : Primm Resident [000A59E5] (file) NPC : Daniel Wyand [000A59E6] (mod) NPC : Dead Primm Resident [000A59E7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you heard if the NCR has any plans to attack the prison north of here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听说过NCR有进攻北面监狱的计划吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...then you bring your second unit up to provide covering fire, like so...
ESP.TRADUIT: …然后，把你的第二小队调往前线提供掩护，就像这样…

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mess with a man's radio, and he might take it personal like, you hear?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你再随便乱动别人的收音机，我可能就不会对你客气了，听见没？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey Jason, your rockets are ready!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，杰森，你的火箭准备就绪！

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you protect your town from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你主要负责防卫什么东西？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You name it. Anything that comes within a thousand yards that looks like trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多了去了。一千码以内所有可疑的东西都是我的目标。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lately we been getting Ghouls, coming from the road to REPCONN, out to the west. Quite a few, last couple days.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最近我们遇到了尸鬼袭击，他们是沿着西边瑞普康工厂的那条路过来的。这几天数量还不少。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The big threat is the Legion coming from the East. If they decide to attack with a full force they'll run us over. But so far we been lucky.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过更大的威胁是东面的军团。如果他们动起真格来，不费吹灰之力就能把我们踩死。但目前我们还算幸运。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That armor isn't working. Leave it there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这装甲没用了。把它丢了吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood of Steel Knight [000A41AC] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good luck killing something with that. Thing's busted.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这东西要是还能杀人就神了。它已经报废了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood of Steel Knight [000A41A7] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我马上照办。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to purchase something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想买点东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If by some chance you want to find me again, and if by some even greater chance coyotes haven't picked my bones clean, I'll be at my shack.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想找我，而我还也没被郊狼吃个精光的话，那你可以在我的棚屋里找到我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll do fine. Farewell, mi amigo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会没事的。保重，我的朋友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything's better than staying here. Let's go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总比留在这儿强。我们走吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, do you want to tag along with me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 说实话，你想不想跟我一块儿走？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, boss. I'd be happy to prolong my captivity and psychological abuse to tighten some lug nuts for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，老大。我很乐意忍受肉体和精神上的双重虐待，来帮你拧紧这些螺母的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you repair some of my stuff?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能修好我的东西吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got the caps, I got the skills.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要你有瓶盖，我就有技术。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you repair some of my stuff?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能修好我的东西吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, I'll just pull a toolbox out from behind a conveniently-placed rock and get to work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，等我从附近的石头后面变个工具箱出来，我就能开始干活了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you repair some of my stuff?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能修好我的东西吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Show me what you have for sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看你都卖些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, no problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，没问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take a look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me see what you have for sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看看你都有些啥好货色。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to see what you have for sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看你的货。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have a look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You bet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to see what you have for sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看你的货。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Show me what you have for sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看你都卖些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It pleases me to see you, mistress. I owe my functional state to this human here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴见到您，夫人。我的身体机能一切正常，全仰仗这个人类。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Broken Mr. Handy [000E84A2] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: R- Rhonda? Is that you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 朗、朗达？是你吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Reprogram Primm Slim to serve as Primm's Sheriff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 重新汇编普瑞姆·斯利姆，调整为普瑞姆的警长。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Law Enforcement Protocols reinstated, pardner. Initializing use of force authorization... authorization found. Yee-haw!
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功] 执法数据已恢复，朋友。初始化武力使用许可…获得许可。咦哈！

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Reprogram Primm Slim to serve as Primm's Sheriff.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <重新汇编普瑞姆·斯利姆，调整为普瑞姆的警长。>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Show me what you have for sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看你卖些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am ready to process our transaction.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经准备好交易了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Show me what you have for sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看你卖的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Glad to do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 乐意之至。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Show me what you have for sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看你都卖些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure thing!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got anything for sale?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么卖的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take your pick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 自己挑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sgt. Daniel Contreras [000E5518] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You need to clean up your reputation or you're going to get me in trouble - I'll have to charge you more to keep from arousing suspicion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好先把自己的坏名声洗干净，否则你会给我惹麻烦的。为了避免怀疑，我得多收你钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sgt. Daniel Contreras [000E5518] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there any place to buy weapons and armor?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里有没有能买到武器和弹药的地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think there a few places, but I've heard that the Gun Runners sell the best.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里是有个卖枪的地方，不过我听说军火贩子的货是最好的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where can I find a doctor around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这附近，哪能找到医生？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doctor Usanagi runs a medical clinic up the road.
ESP.TRADUIT: 宇佐木医生在前面经营着一家小诊所。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll recover your husband's body.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会把你丈夫尸体带回来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Esteban's body is laid out between some buildings, east of the REPCONN headquarters. At least, that's what his squadmates said.
ESP.TRADUIT: 埃斯特班的尸体就躺在楼栋之间，位于瑞普康总部的东边。至少他的战友是这么说的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pvt. Christina Morales [000E8F6D] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's an NCR position just north of there. It's on the way. They should be able to tell you what the situation is.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR有个哨站就设在那儿的北面。如果你顺路经过那里的话，他们应该会把具体情形告诉你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pvt. Christina Morales [000E8F6D] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to buy some supplies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想买点物资。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The brass are pissed about the trouble you've been causing. Your caps are no good here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 上司对你糟糕的表现非常不满意。你有钱也没用。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe you didn't hear me the first time. No service for scumbags!
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来上次你是没听清。我们不卖东西给卑鄙小人！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, I heard you were able to recover Morales' corpse. In thanks, you get a discount on supplies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，我听说你找回了莫拉莱斯的尸体。作为感谢，你在我这儿可以享受折扣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was a real honorable thing you done there, kid. Much appreciated.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你做的事非常光荣，孩子。十分感谢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's what's currently available.
ESP.TRADUIT: 目前我手上有的就是这些了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: With your reputation? Well, I won't say your caps are no good here... let's just say that they're... less good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就凭你现在的名声？怎么说呢，虽然你的钱在我这儿是可以用……但也确实…不那么好用。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to buy some food.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想买点吃的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Chow down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便点吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cpl. William Farber [000E8F69] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, but the brass ordered me to not serve enemies of NCR.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，上司命令我不得向NCR的敌人提供服务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cpl. William Farber [000E8F69] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't like your kind taking food from my men, so I'm going to charge you a little extra. Don't like it? Tough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不喜欢你这样的家伙和我的弟兄们抢饭吃，所以我要额外收你钱。不满意？一边去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cpl. William Farber [000E8F69] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Roger Lupa.
ESP.TRADUIT: 明白，鲁帕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Capt. Ronald Curtis [000E8994] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Show me what you have for sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看你卖的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, then. Hopefully I've got something to wet your whistle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，希望我这儿的东西能帮你润润喉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come talk to me when I'm in my store and I'll be glad to do business with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等我回店里的时候再来找我吧，我会很乐意与你做生意的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was some fine doctoring. I could learn a thing or two from you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 医术确实不错。我都能从中学到一两手呢！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Motor-Runner told me he was going to pick up some more when the Khans come back through.
ESP.TRADUIT: 轰鸣扼杀告诉我他准备在大汗帮回来的时候再多买一些。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, me too. Gonna have to go hit the boss for a fix soon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，我也是。得去老板那里多搞几支来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shit. I gotta go find something to take the edge off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 糟糕，我要找点东西缓缓这劲头。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Me too. I think I need a fix.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也是，我可能得去爽一下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got it from my buddy. I think he made it himself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是从我伙计那儿搞到的。我觉得是他自己做的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where'd you get it from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你从哪得到它的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck! I did too. I'm not doing well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 妈的！我也是。我做不好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I didn't say anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我什么都没说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well keep moving.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我走开。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking at you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看着你呢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Damn, I gotta find some shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 见鬼，我得想法子爽一下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You and me both.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你和我都是。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck, I need a fix.
ESP.TRADUIT: 见鬼，我得过过瘾才行。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nope, not for you at least.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，至少不给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 到此为止。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : NCR Trooper [000FC205] (file) Comment (NAM2) : As in, that does it, now I'm going to shoot you. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What were you doing down in that cave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你当时在那个洞里干什么呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The mantises and spore plants virtually ignored me for most of the time that I've been here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我踏入避难所后，那些螳螂和孢子植物多数时候都无视我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was only once I began to investigate the fifth level that my presence began to agitate them. I guess I was a little too close to home for them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是当我开始调查第五层时，我似乎刺激到了它们。我猜可能是因为我离它们的巢穴太近了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A few days ago, I was attacked by a large number of mantises and was knocked unconscious. When I woke up, I was in that cave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 几天之前，我被一大群螳螂攻击，失去了知觉。当我醒来的时候，就躺在那个洞里了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The mantises seem to feed some of their prey to the plants. Fortunately for me, it appears the plants are disinclined to eat Ghoul meat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些螳螂似乎会给孢子植物喂食猎物。不过我挺走运，那些植物好像不愿意吃尸鬼肉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, you do that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，是这样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Must have been some NCR. I know they've been gunning for him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一定是NCR的人干的，我知道他们在追杀他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Damn, are you serious? He was one tough son of a bitch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死，你说真的？那狗娘养的东西可猛着呢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good, I hated that fucker.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，我本来就讨厌那混蛋。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Move it! Move it! Move it! Get those legs up you sorry bastards!
ESP.TRADUIT: 动起来！动起来！动起来！把腿抬起来，你们这群可怜的混蛋！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you seen a Ghoul named Keely around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你见过一名叫基利的尸鬼吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have trouble speaking?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说话很吃力吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mmm-hm. [Points to stump of tongue in his mouth.]
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，哈。[从他嘴里露出残缺的舌头。]

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have bo go bow. Goobye!
ESP.TRADUIT: 窝得肘了。掰拜。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your plan worked. The plane floated up. Seemed to be intact.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的计划成功了。飞机漂上来了。看起来还挺完好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's tremendous! I'll transmit instructions to the robots to start packing up the plane to bring it back to Nellis!
ESP.TRADUIT: 太壮观了！我马上给机器人发指令，把飞机打包带回内利斯！

ESP.ORIGINAL: And you're even more handsome up close. Do you think it'll be okay if I hang around here for a little while, so we can get to know each other better?
ESP.TRADUIT: 近了看你更帅了。我能不能在这儿多呆一会儿，好让咱俩有机会多了解一下对方呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hi there, it's great to meet you as well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，你好，我也很高兴能见到你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sgt. McCredie asked me to talk to you about getting your squad in shape.
ESP.TRADUIT: 麦克雷迪军士派我来和你商量该怎么整顿你的小队。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, what about it? I told you, we need marksmanship and explosive handling improvements.
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么样？我跟你说过，我们需要射击以及爆破练习。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, about those improvements...
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于整顿队伍这件事...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Like I said, you get the juice, we'll cut loose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说了，只要你搞到药，我们天王老子都不怕。

ESP.ORIGINAL: About getting the squad's readiness reports up...
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于提高队伍成绩这件事...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Show me what you have for sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看你都卖些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可以。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Show me what you have for sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看你都卖些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got a special discount for you, after what you done for us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你帮了我们这么多，我会给你打个特别折扣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure I've got something you'll like.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我保证有你喜欢的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now I know what they mean by "dumb luck"!
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在我知道他们说的"傻人有傻福"是什么意思了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Were you exaggerating your knowledge of medicine? Even I would've known not to do that!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不是刚夸耀过自己的医术有多么高明吗？连我都知道那种事不能做！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, if you're heading back out there, you ought to have this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想出去的话，我建议你最好戴上这个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Mitchell [00104C0C] (mod) Quest : ([00104C1C]VCG01) Ain't That a Kick in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They call it a Pip-Boy. I grew up in one of them vaults they made before the war. We all got one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们管这玩意叫哔哔小子。我是在战前建造的避难所中长大的，所以我们人人都有一个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Mitchell [00104C0C] (mod) Quest : ([00104C1C]VCG01) Ain't That a Kick in the Head EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ain't much use to me now, but you might want such a thing, after what you been through. I know what it's like, having something taken from you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在我用不着了，但你应该用得上，毕竟你遭了这么多罪。我能理解你，那种被人抢了的感受。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Mitchell [00104C0C] (mod) Quest : ([00104C1C]VCG01) Ain't That a Kick in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And put this on, too, so the locals don't pick on you for lacking modesty. Was my wife's.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把这个也穿上吧，不然本地人会嫌弃你衣冠不整的。这衣服曾经是属于我妻子的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Mitchell [00104C0C] (mod) Quest : ([00104C1C]VCG01) Ain't That a Kick in the Head EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think she was about your size, and she hardly wore it after we left the vault. Felt it was too brazen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你和她个头应该差不多，我们离开避难所后她就很少穿了。感觉太招摇了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Mitchell [00104C0C] (mod) Quest : ([00104C1C]VCG01) Ain't That a Kick in the Head EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: And put this on, too, so the locals don't pick on you for lacking modesty. Never was much my style anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把这个也穿上吧，不然本地人会嫌弃你衣冠不整的。反正我也穿不惯这套行头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Mitchell [00104C0C] (mod) Quest : ([00104C1C]VCG01) Ain't That a Kick in the Head EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should talk to Sunny Smiles before you leave town. She can help you learn to fend for yourself in the desert. She'll likely be at the saloon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在离开小镇之前，你应该去和微笑桑妮谈谈。她能教你如何在沙漠中生存。她应该就在酒吧里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Mitchell [00104C0C] (mod) Quest : ([00104C1C]VCG01) Ain't That a Kick in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I reckon some of the other folks at the saloon might be able to help you out, too. And the metal fella, Victor, who pulled you outta your grave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想酒吧里其他人也能帮上你。还有把你从坟墓里拉出来的金属伙计，维克多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Mitchell [00104C0C] (mod) Quest : ([00104C1C]VCG01) Ain't That a Kick in the Head EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyway, you ever get hurt out there, you come right back. I'll fix you up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管怎样，如果你在外面受了伤，可以尽管回来找我。我会替你疗伤的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Mitchell [00104C0C] (mod) Quest : ([00104C1C]VCG01) Ain't That a Kick in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But try not to get killed anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是别再死第二回了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc Mitchell [00104C0C] (mod) Quest : ([00104C1C]VCG01) Ain't That a Kick in the Head EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to trade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想和你做生意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, that's right! Here, let me show you what I've got on hand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，那就对了！来，瞧瞧我手头都有些什么好东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, I don't know about you, but old Festus here never met a bandit that felt anything akin to remorse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道你怎么想，但在老费斯特斯看来，天底下就没什么有良心的强盗。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The sheriff suggested that maybe the bandits, in a fit of remorse, delivered the items. After taking all of the stranger's money, of course.
ESP.TRADUIT: 治安管猜测强盗大概是良心发现，才把东西偷偷送了过来，不过他还是抢走了陌生人身上所有的钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't pitch it like a baseball, lob it. You want a good, solid arc.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别把它当棒球，要扔高点。尽量丢出一个完美的抛物线。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] They're kind of heavy for that, but whatever you say...
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败] 丢直线的话，这分量有点太沉了吧……不过听你的...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, um... really whip them downrange. Like you're throwing a fastball!
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃……对着目标使劲甩出去就行了。就像丢直球一样！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, to start, pull the pin, let it cook off for a count of three, then throw.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，首先，拉开保险，握好手雷数到三，再扔出去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] I've got a bad feeling about this...
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败] 我感觉不太妙...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, count to three, throw the grenade, and pull the pin. Wait, no...
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，数到三，扔出手雷，再拉开保险。等等，不...

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can really get hurt out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要更加小心，在外面很容易受伤的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I already told you I came from a vault. After that, was a traveling doctor for a spell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我告诉过你了，我是从避难所来的。离开避难所后，我当了一段时间的游医。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Seemed like a good idea at the time. Most folks out here ain't educated, so people with medical know-how are hard to come by.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当时这份营生还不错。因为这儿大多数人从来没受过什么教育，更别提懂医术了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Found that I could help a lot of people with what I knew, and that was all right with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我发现我所学的知识能帮助很多人，感觉还挺好的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Eventually, I went back and married my childhood sweetheart and that was the end of my traveling days. Didn't miss it none then. Still don't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 后来，我回去和我的青梅竹马结了婚，游医的日子也结束了。我一点也不怀念那段时光。一点也不。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about yourself, Doc.
ESP.TRADUIT: 介绍一下你自己吧，医生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, I'll come with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，我跟你走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shouldn't take more than a couple minutes. Especially with two of us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 应该不会花太多时间。何况咱们又是两个人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, see those sarsaparilla bottles on that fence there? Take this and try to hit a couple of 'em.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，你看到栅栏上面那些沙士瓶子了吗？拿上这个，试试看你能不能打下一两个来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was some fine doctoring. I could learn a thing or two from you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 医术确实不错。我能从中学到一两手呢！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I ran out of ammo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有弹药了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yep, I'd say you're getting a little trigger happy there. Try to slow down a bit. Concentrate on hitting your target.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，要我说，你开枪的速度有点快了。尽量慢下来。集中精神，确保能打中目标。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here. Go easy on it, now. Ammo can be hard to come by out here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给。少花一点。弹药很珍贵的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caught a rumor the other day that some of the clientele over at the Wrangler have been making some rather strange requests.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听到外面有谣言说最近原子牛仔里的一些顾客要求越来越奇怪了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stuff like weirdos wanting the, ahem, services of Ghouls and such. I almost have half a mind to volunteer myself, sexy beast that I am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有些怪人想要，咳咳，尸鬼服务什么的。我差点就去报名了，你看我也还算性感。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There was a rumor a while back that the White Glove Society was really an all-Ghoul gang, which is why they wear those weird masks of theirs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有传言说白手套社团是一个全都由尸鬼组成的团体，所以他们平常都带着奇怪的面具。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think, would I look good in a mask? Maybe I'd make more caps...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说，我戴面具会不会好看？或许我还能挣到更多瓶盖呢……

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to see what you have on tap.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想看看你这儿都有什么现成的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caps up front. We don't do tabs here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 先付瓶盖。恕不赊账。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What guns do you have for sale?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你都卖什么枪？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have a look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瞧一瞧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you have in stock?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么现货？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take a gander.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看一看吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lets see... You've got that thingy... there. Power, uh, re-circulators here...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看看……你怎么还有那个玩意……电力，呃，这儿还有循环泵...

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's it. What do you think?
ESP.TRADUIT: 就这些。你觉得呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jesus, kid, I think we got a real problem on our hands. Can't believe Benny's a no-good stinkin' punk. Trying to play House like that...
ESP.TRADUIT: 上帝啊，孩子，我想我们遇上大麻烦了。真不敢相信，本尼居然是个不好安心的孬种，敢那样愚弄豪斯先生...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell you what - I'll call Benny, keep him away from his suite. You go search the place. Here's the key, it's on the 13th floor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这样吧——我会吸引本尼的注意，你趁他不在的时候搜下他的房间。这是钥匙，就在13楼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the room with the double doors, can't miss it. Maybe you'll find something we can show to Mr. House and get him arrested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有双扇门的那个房间，你不会搞错的。说不定你还能找到些证据，这样我们就可以报告豪斯先生，把他抓起来了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything unusual happening around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 附近发生了不平常的事么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There was a hell of a boom over at REPCONN. Looks like the Ghouls had some sort of accident with their rockets.
ESP.TRADUIT: REOCONN发生了大爆炸。看起来那些尸鬼的火箭出了点问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Comm Officer Stepinac [0011324E] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have anything for sale?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这儿卖东西吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. Take a look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。看看吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not for someone like you. My customers would shit a brick if they knew I sold anything to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对你不卖。如果我的客人知道我卖东西给你的话，他们肯定会来找茬的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you need help cleaning up your rep around Freeside, I might be able to help... for a price.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想恢复自己在自由城的名声，我倒是可以帮忙……不过你需要给我一点好处。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you, Victor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你，维克多。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see you brought a friend! Sorry, pardner, but they're gonna have to stay outside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看到你带了个朋友来！抱歉，伙计，他们只能在外面等着。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see you brought some friends! Sorry, pardner, but they're gonna have to stay outside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看到你带了些朋友来！抱歉，伙计，他们只能在外面等着。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come back soon, now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 下次再来！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Use Medicine skill to surmise House's condition.
ESP.TRADUIT: 使用医疗技能来诊断豪斯的现状。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] I see you've made a study of the topic. My knowledge of the science of longevity would fill several text books...
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功] 看得出来你做过些研究。有关延长寿命的科学手段，这方面的知识我都能写好几本书了……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps, after a decade or two of economic reconstruction, I can commercialize these technologies and offer to others, such as yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许再过一、二十年，等经济复苏了，我就会将这项技术商业化，让其他人也能享受，比如你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The lifespan you're claiming is impossible, except for Ghouls and Super Mutants.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的生命周期不可能这么长，除非你是尸鬼或变种人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have Vault gear for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我带了些避难所的装备给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You do? That's wonderful! Let me see what you brought.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？太好了！让我看看你带什么来了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right! That's going to net you lots of caps, my friend. Do you want to trade all your vault suits right now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 棒极了！朋友，这些避难所服装可值一大笔钱呢。你愿意现在就出手吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's see what you have for sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看你都卖些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take a look at this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来看看吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey. Thanks for helping me out. Being back and working really saved my life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿。谢谢你救了我。回来工作让我感觉好多了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't talk. Much work to do at the Fort and Atomic Wrangler.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没空说话。我在城堡和原子牛仔还有很多活要干。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to see what you have for sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想看看你卖些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gloria Van Graff [0010C67D] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Give me the Thermite and I'll destroy the weapons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我铝热剂，我要销毁那些武器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, here's the Thermite and a key to the room where the guns are stored. Place the Thermite on the crates in the room.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，这是铝热剂和储藏武器的房间的钥匙。记得把铝热剂放到屋内的板条箱上。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I rigged the light switch outside the room to kick off a spark big enough to hold the Thermite. That should turn that shit into molten slag.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经在屋外装了个电灯开关，碰出的火花应该可以引燃那些铝热剂。这样一来，那些武器很快就会熔成一堆废渣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As soon as we're done talking I'm going to make myself like a ghost. I don't want to be anywhere near here when the bosses find out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等咱们说完话，我也该出去避避风头了。我可不想出了事以后还在这儿坐以待毙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Could you repair some things for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能帮我修复一些物品吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, let's see what you've got.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，来看看你有什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, here is that gun I promised you. I suggest using it while they are talking, I'm pretty sure they're going to kill you after they've talked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，这是我答应给你的枪。我建议你趁他们说话的时候就马上动手。要是等他们说完，你就死定了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, I'll take care of them when you're ready, just say the word. I suggest doing it while they're talking to get the drop on them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，等你准备好了，我就解决他们，到时听你口令。我建议趁他们说话的时候就动手，先发制人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I would like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我很乐意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, that makes me so happy! You are too much!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，真让我高兴！你太好了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've bugged the tower for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经在高塔的网络里植入了监听程序。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We haven't received any information yet from the bug. Please report back when you've found a way into House's network.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们至今还没有收到来自监听器的任何信息。如果你找到了进入豪斯网络的方法，请务必通知我们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've bugged the tower for you. <lie>
ESP.TRADUIT: 我帮你在塔楼上安装了窃听器。 <撒谎>

ESP.ORIGINAL: What sort of "proclivities" are we talking about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么样的"癖好"？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our wealthiest client has a thing for Ghouls, and a thing for cowboys. He wants an escort who can satisfy both fetishes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们最大的金主对尸鬼和牛仔有特殊情结。他想找个能在这两方面满足他的私人伴游。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : James Garret [0010C67E] (file) Comment (NAM2) : EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Plenty of customers have said they'd be willing to pay extra for a suave talker, someone who can fake the "boyfriend experience" real good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不少客人提出，愿意支付额外的费用，找个温柔体贴，有"男朋友"感觉的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : James Garret [0010C67E] (file) Comment (NAM2) : EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And then there's these disgusting robot fetishists you may have heard about? Well, those creeps want a sexbot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 此外，还有一些恶心的变态，对机器人有特殊癖好，你听说过吗？那帮家伙居然想要找性爱机器人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : James Garret [0010C67E] (file) Comment (NAM2) : EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you ever run across a sexbot? Not that I'd ever want one within 100 feet of me - but I gotta be a businessman about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你见过这类机器人吗？当然，我本人绝对不敢接近这类东西100英尺以内……但我毕竟是个生意人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : James Garret [0010C67E] (file) Comment (NAM2) : EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want you not to attack enemies unless I've already engaged them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我没有动手，你也不要擅自攻击敌人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <aroo?> <bark>
ESP.TRADUIT: <嗷呜?> <吠声>

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I may have misheard that order.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想是我幻听了吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那好吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: At ease.
ESP.TRADUIT: 稍息。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bo-ring.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无 — 聊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, do I have to? That's not nearly as much fun!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我必须这样做吗？那看上去没什么意思！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your call, kid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你决定吧，孩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you insist...
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你坚持...

ESP.ORIGINAL: <whine>
ESP.TRADUIT: <哀鸣声>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Standing by for further orders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等待进一步指令。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That seems incredibly juvenile.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那看起来幼稚得不可思议。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've had no compelling reason to do anything different from what you asked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对你的要求没有疑问。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the hell, man?
ESP.TRADUIT: 到底怎么了，哥们？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You big tease!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你个大傻瓜！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you out of your fuckin' mind?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你他妈是不是脑子坏了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get lost.
ESP.TRADUIT: 走开。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, dearie, that's what grandma's been doing. And Leo isn't happy about it, either.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，甜心，奶奶一直就是这么做的。但是利奥可不喜欢那样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ohh, Leo's not going to like that...
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，利奥不会喜欢的...

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want you to attack enemies the moment you see them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要你看到敌人就马上攻击他们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <aroo?>
<growl> <bark>
ESP.TRADUIT: <咆哮> <吠声>

ESP.ORIGINAL: By your command, sir!
ESP.TRADUIT: 遵命，长官！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now that's more like it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在那更加像它了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I must have been hearing things.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我肯定听见了什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now's the time for blood!
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在该出点血了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I shall remain vigilant.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会保持警惕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They shall know the power of my steel!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们应当知道我铁棍的威力！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah yeah, very funny.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，嗯，很有趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rock and roll!
ESP.TRADUIT: 跳舞吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stuff it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 塞上。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, time for fun already? Goody!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，准备好去玩了？很好！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你他妈的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goddammit, I love violence!
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死的，我喜欢暴力！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Already done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 已经完成。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As you wish.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如你所愿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose I should test you out before I hand you to the Garrets...
ESP.TRADUIT: 在把你交给加勒特前，我觉得应该先测试一下你的性能…

ESP.ORIGINAL: Servos active!
ESP.TRADUIT: 系统启动！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I spoke to Clanden, and I couldn't get anything out of him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和克兰顿谈过了，但没套出什么话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, this is Clanden. This guy is one sick motherfucker. The way I see it, you have a few options.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错，是克兰顿，这个烂杂种。我觉得你有好几种办法来对付他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe you could use what's on these tapes to get him by himself, or maybe you could use them to leverage him out of the casino.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以利用磁带上的这些东西引他单独出来，或者用它们来逼他离开赌场。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found these tapes in Clanden's room, can you verify this is him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在克兰顿的房间里找到了这些磁带，你看看这是他吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tommy Torini at the Tops is looking for musical acts, if you're interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 九重天的汤米·托里尼正在招音乐人，你可以去看看。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm... Maybe it's time to give these tired old bones a rest. All right, show me what you've got.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯…也许该让这把老骨头休息一下了。好吧，看看你究竟有什么打算。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Lonesome Drifter [0011F9BE] (file) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, I didn't mean to interrupt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，我不是有意打岔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jeez, some people...
ESP.TRADUIT: 真是的，现在的人啊...

ESP.ORIGINAL: So who are you, exactly?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你到底是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Either you need to get your eyes checked or that "fame is fleeting" thing is true - and since I happen to be world famous, you must be going blind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要么是你眼神不好，要么就像常言说的，"名气如流水"———不过恰好我可是名满天下，所以你肯定是瞎了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Name's Hadrian. Bet you never saw a Ghoul in a suit before, huh? Course, you don't exactly strike me as the worldly type.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我叫哈德良。我打赌你从没见过穿西装的尸鬼吧？当然，我看你也不像是个等闲之辈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Watch your mouth, Ghoul, or I might just rip your jaw off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘴巴干净点，尸鬼，否则我撕烂你的嘴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hear you have some exotic tastes when it comes to women.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说你品鉴女人的口味很特别。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh did you now? What business is that of yours, and why the fuck should I care?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你知道？那又跟你有什么关系呢，我干嘛要听你说这个？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you selling?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你都卖什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have a look, baby.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来看看吧，宝贝。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me see what you have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看你这儿都有什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是这样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I buy bottled water?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能买瓶装水吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you sell medical supplies?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有医疗用品卖吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're pretty short-handed as it is, but I suppose I could spare a few items.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的库存很紧张，但匀一些出来给你应该没有问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to buy medical supplies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想买些医疗用品。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We don't have a lot right now, but this is what I can offer for sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的存货不多，能卖的也就这些了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here is what we have available.
ESP.TRADUIT: 能卖的就这些。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. Look around and get a feel for where customers and risks can enter and exit the area while I get your gear ready.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。我去给你弄套行头，你可以趁这几分钟四处看看，目测一下哪些地方可以出入。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Van Graff Thug [00118374] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Pay caps>
ESP.TRADUIT: <付瓶盖>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. A couple rounds of RadAway should do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。几袋辐特宁就能解决问题了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Pay 100 caps>
Okay. A couple rounds of RadAway should do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。几袋辐特宁就能解决问题了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Pay 90 caps>
ESP.TRADUIT: <付90瓶盖>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. A couple rounds of RadAway should do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。几袋辐特宁就能解决问题了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Pay 80 caps>
ESP.TRADUIT: <付80瓶盖>

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Pay 100 caps>
ESP.TRADUIT: <支付100个瓶盖>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hold still. The RadAway burns a little.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别动。辐特宁会有一点灼痛。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Pay 50 caps>
ESP.TRADUIT: <支付50个瓶盖>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hold still. The RadAway burns a little.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别动。辐特宁会有一点灼痛。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julie Farkas [0010C682] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : [DUPLICATE LINE?] EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll come back when I have enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等我钱够了我会回来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take your time - the Ghoul's not going anywhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 慢慢来...反正那老尸鬼哪儿也去不了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll come back when I have enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等我钱够了会再回来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take your time - the Ghoul's not going anywhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 慢慢来...反正那老尸鬼哪儿也去不了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But how much do you lose on folk not coming into a place with a Ghoul performer?
ESP.TRADUIT: 少一个尸鬼演员你能有多大损失？

ESP.ORIGINAL: My friend, you've got style, grace, and charm - the style of a Feral Ghoul, the grace of a Super Mutant, and the charm of a Deathclaw.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的朋友，你很有风度，优雅，还有魅力，不过是狂尸鬼的风度，超级变种人的优雅，死亡爪的魅力。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I told my wife, she's good-looking for a Ghoul. It's just too bad she's not a Ghoul, ay ay ay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我告诉我老婆，作为一个尸鬼她的确很漂亮。可惜她不是尸鬼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A Ghoul goes to a doctor and says, "Doctor, Doctor, I have this horrible rash!" The Doctor says, "Son, that's called your face." Ding dong!
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个尸鬼去看大夫，他说"大夫，大夫，我起了很严重的疹子!"医生说"孩子，那就是你的脸啊。"

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Hushed> Would my companion here make a suitable replacement meal?
ESP.TRADUIT: <小声> 我的同伴适合当替代品吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, but it absolutely must be a human. Former doesn't count.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不好意思，我们要的替代品必须是人类。哪怕以前是人类也不行。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. If you're able to convince young Mr. Gunderson to return to his father, replace him in the freezer with your friend and we'll have a deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。如果你能说服小冈德森先生回到他父亲身边，再把你的朋友作为替代品关到冷藏室里，我们就成交。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me what I need to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉我我需要做什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need a replacement, and I need the boy taken care of. The replacement must be healthy and well-bred. One can't very well make steak from gristle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要一个替代品，好解决这个男孩的问题。这个替代品必须健康，并且有教养。粗人可烤不成嫩肉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: With so little time, we'll have to go after our original choice, Carlyle St. Clair. He lives in a shack north of here. For freshness, we need him alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 时间太紧，只能再把原来的猎物捉回来了，卡莱尔·圣克莱尔。他住在北边的一个小棚屋里。肉要新鲜，所以别把他弄死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you could send him here or knock him out with this and drag him into the dumpster next to his house, we can do the rest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要么把他骗过来，要么用这玩意敲昏他，再把他拖进房子旁边的垃圾箱里，剩下的我们来处理。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me see what you have for sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看你都卖些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take your pick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请自己挑吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course! I've got a special discount for special people, like you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然！我对特别的人可有特别优惠，比如你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A friend of The Strip's a friend of mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 长街的朋友就是我的朋友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't get me wrong, I appreciate your business, but dealing with you carries extra costs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别误会，我是很喜欢和你做生意，但是要卖东西给你，我可得多担一笔成本哪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll sell to you, if only to get you out of sight as soon as possible.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以卖东西给你，不过你买了之后最好赶紧闪人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I actually found you an escort who's a Ghoul *and* a cowboy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我倒是真的给你找到了一个私人伴游，是个尸鬼，还是个牛仔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow. Bringing up morale must be difficult.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇哦。提升士气一定很困难。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to browse your special inventory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想看看你的特别目录。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Like I always say, a polite society is an armed society.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就像我说过的，文明社会就是武装社会。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to trade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想与你交易。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have any supplies to spare, but I've got caps if you have anything you don't need.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有任何补给品可以提供，但如果你有用不到的东西，我可以用瓶盖向你收购。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have any supplies to spare for someone with your spotted reputation, but buy your stuff for half the going rate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对于你这种名声的人，我没有什么补给品出售。另外，买你的东西我也只付半价。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Pay 50 caps>
ESP.TRADUIT: <支付50个瓶盖>

ESP.ORIGINAL: You might want to brace yourself. This might get a bit painful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好坚持一下，这可能会有点痛。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Pay 25 caps>
ESP.TRADUIT: <支付25个瓶盖>

ESP.ORIGINAL: You might want to brace yourself. This might get a bit painful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好坚持一下，这可能会有点痛。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Pay 50 caps>
ESP.TRADUIT: <支付50个瓶盖>

ESP.ORIGINAL: A shot of Med-X for the pain, and you shouldn't feel... well some of what I need to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来支吗啡针-X镇痛，这样你应该就感觉不到……我的治疗手段了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Pay 25 caps>
ESP.TRADUIT: <支付25个瓶盖>

ESP.ORIGINAL: A shot of Med-X for the pain, and you shouldn't feel... well some of what I need to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来支吗啡针-X镇痛，这样你应该就感觉不到……我的治疗手段了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. Serve me up something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。随便来点什么吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You won't regret it. At least until an hour or so from now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你绝不会后悔的。起码1小时内不会。

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I say "escort," I mean "prostitute."
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说的"伴游"，指的是"卖淫"。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm all boot knives and leather, friend - and a Ghoul, besides. What kind of weirdo wants what I've got?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我满身刀疤和伤痕，朋友，而且我还是个尸鬼。会有变态喜欢我这样的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不了，谢谢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Suit yourself. Gambling's thirsty work - I'll be here if you change your mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随你的便。赌博是很容易口渴的，如果您有需要，我就在这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [00129550] (mod) Quest : ([00128588]VDialogueTops) Tops Dialogue EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You bet, I'm parched.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说对了，我正巧有点渴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Best booze in Vegas, baby. What'll it be?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我这儿有的是维加斯最上等的酒，宝贝。来点什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [00129550] (mod) Quest : ([00128588]VDialogueTops) Tops Dialogue EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I left one of my companions in the freezer for your enjoyment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把一个同伴留在了冷藏室里，希望你能高兴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wonderful. You have come through with flying colors. On behalf of my colleagues, allow me to extend my thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了，你表现得太出色了。请允许我代表全体同仁向你表示感谢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know what a terrible sacrifice this must've been for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道这对你而言是个巨大的牺牲。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not my problem. You want to go? You're on your own.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和我没关系。你想走？请自便。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're the one who suggested it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 既然你都这么提了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. If I'm on my own I'm on my own. But I'm gonna go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 行啊。要我单干，我没意见。那我就告辞了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good working with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和你共事很愉快。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are we waiting for?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们在等什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell the truth... I think this is exactly what I've been waiting for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说实话…我想这就是我一直在等的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's fighting in the next match?
ESP.TRADUIT: 下一场战斗是什么安排？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fiend prisoners will fight for their lives against Nightstalkers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恶魔帮俘虏将为了活命和夜行兽殊死搏斗。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's get out of here. Let them have Bitter Springs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们走。苦泉就让给他们了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can do what you want, but I'm not going anywhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想干什么都可以，但是我哪也不去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goodbye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's do this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 咱们上吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good luck - you'll need it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 祝你好运——你会需要好运的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm ready.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我准备好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Watch out for her - she's one of the deadliest fighters I've ever seen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小心点——她是我见过的最致命的战士。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm ready.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我准备好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Careful in there - he's tougher than he looks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小心点儿——他比看上去更难对付。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got it. I'm ready.
ESP.TRADUIT: 明白了，我准备好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good luck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好运。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened to your people?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的人民发生了什么事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We were the Flails of God. The scourge of the Mojave, the best warriors and raiders in the Wasteland. Until the NCR tracked us back to Bitter Springs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们曾经是上帝之鞭！莫哈维的天灾，废土中最伟大的战士与劫掠者。直到有一天，NCR跟踪我们到了苦泉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The main force hit the canyon by surprise. While our warriors tried to hold them off, we sent our women, our children, our old through the Red Pass.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们的主力部队突袭了大峡谷。在我们的战士奋力阻击敌人的同时，我们将妇孺老人顺着血红谷道送了出去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: NCR's First Recon Battalion was waiting for them on Coyote Tail Ridge. No Khan left alive, that was the order. My family...
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR的第一侦察营却在狼尾山脊等着他们。“一个大汗帮也不留”，这就是他们得到的命令。我的家人啊...

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's not how I want to approach this. You'd better go your own way for now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可不想进去。要去你自己去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Better be a good reason. I didn't join up with you to go on nature walks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好能有个明白点的理由。我和你搭伙可不是为了来散步观光的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't want any trouble. We should part ways for now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不想惹麻烦。我们现在还是分开吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. But if you make any new friends in there, all bets are off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。但如果你在那边交了新朋友，那我们过往的情分就一笔勾销。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm going to do this my way. I can't bring you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有自己的方式。我不能带着你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You say so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这可是你说的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Attack] You're less trouble to me dead than alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: [攻击] 对我来说，你死了可比活着好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good thing I'm still alive, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这样的话，我活着还真是件好事啊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then we can't work together anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我们以后就不会再共事了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I should never have worked with you in the first place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我打一开始就不该和你共事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry. I won't compromise my mission.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起。我的任务不容妥协。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then we're finished here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我们就在这做个了断吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Attack] I won't be needing your services any longer.
ESP.TRADUIT: [攻击] 我啊，不再需要你的帮忙了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I should never have trusted you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就不该相信你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Things have changed. I'm with Caesar now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 世道变了，我现在是凯撒那边儿的人了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then this is over. Next time I see you, it'll be through my scope.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就这样吧。我下次再看到你，就要透过狙击枪的瞄准镜了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any Legion with you and I'm pulling the trigger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要看到有一个军团的人在你身边，我就开枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm... uh... helping them so I can spy on them better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我……呃……帮他们是为了刺探更多的消息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bullshit. You're a goddamned coward, trying to pick the winning side.
ESP.TRADUIT: 屁话。你个孬种，不过是想当墙头草。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We will never work together again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们就此散伙吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why'd you come all the way out to New Vegas?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么大老远地跑来新维加斯？
