ESP.ORIGINAL: Why does anybody? I thought I'd strike it rich at the tables, make my fortune and never have to plow those damn fields again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不就和别人一样？我以为自己能靠着赌博发大财，不必再去耕种那些该死的田地了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just wanted to provide for my family - and now they're gone. All gone. God forgive me...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只想着养活家人，可现在他们都离开了我。都走了。上帝宽恕我吧...

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm ready to fight Lupa now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我准备好和鲁帕战斗了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right. You've been a good dog, Lupa. Die well, girl.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。你一直都是条好狗，鲁帕。愿你死得其所，老姑娘。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Transplant Lupa's brain into Rex.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把鲁帕的脑子的大脑移植给雷克斯.

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have a seat. This will take a while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 坐一下吧。这需要点时间。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Transplant Rey's brain into Rex.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把雷伊的脑子移植给雷克斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have a seat. This will take a while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 坐一下吧。这需要点时间。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Transplant Violetta's brain into Rex.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把维奥列塔的大脑移植给雷克斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have a seat. This will take a while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 坐一下吧。这需要点时间。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, go ahead. I'll wait for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，去吧。我会等你的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, okay... I'll shoot the lock off the door and... and then... Argh, dammit!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的……我会一枪把门锁嘣开……然后……呃，该死 !

ESP.ORIGINAL: ... I can't do it, I can't. She deserves it, and worse, but I can't hurt my own mother!
ESP.TRADUIT: ……不行，我做不到。虽然她罪有应得，可我还是无法对自己的母亲下手！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking into the Nightstalker mutation. Want to come along with me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在寻找夜行兽的变种。你想和我一起来吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oooh, those Nightstalkers, always killing my Bighorners! It'll be nice to give them a piece of my mind!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，那些夜行兽，总是残害我们的大角牛！我早就想给他们一点颜色看看了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Show me what you have for sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看看你都卖些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Show me what you have for sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我看看你都卖些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Happy to do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 乐意为您服务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Old Lady Gibson [00084206] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've been told you're someone I should talk to about stopping the Khans' alliance with Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人告诉我想要阻止大汗帮和凯撒结盟，就得来找你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry, Jack and I have talked it over. We'll talk up the idea of breaking the alliance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别担心，杰克和我已经讨论过了。我们该商量一下如何破坏他们的结盟。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, about the alliance with Caesar's Legion...
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，关于与凯撒军团结盟的事情...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anders got back a little while before you did, he told me what happened. If that's how the Legion treats my people, I don't want any part of them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 安德斯比你早回来了一会，他把事情都告诉我了。如果军团真的那样对待我的族人，那我绝对不想跟他们扯上任何关系。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, about the alliance with Caesar's Legion...
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，关于与凯撒军团结盟的事情...

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some Legionaries snuck into the camp and set off some kind of radiation bomb.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一些军团士兵混进营地，引爆了辐射炸弹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : First Sergeant Astor [0013FE78] (file) Quest : ([0014050C]VMS43) We Will All Go Together EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know where they got it, but it was damn effective. Killed almost everyone and turned the rest into Ghouls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道他们是从哪儿搞到的，但这玩意太有效了。几乎所有人都死了，没死的也变成了尸鬼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : First Sergeant Astor [0013FE78] (file) Quest : ([0014050C]VMS43) We Will All Go Together EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are there any other survivors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有其他幸存者么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: None that aren't Feral Ghouls. Those poor bastards - I can't imagine how they must be suffering.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有了，只剩下一群狂尸鬼。那些可怜的混蛋...我真的没法想象他们遭受的痛苦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : First Sergeant Astor [0013FE78] (file) Quest : ([0014050C]VMS43) We Will All Go Together EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to put them out of their misery but I don't have the heart to do it. Can you do me a favor?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很想亲手结束他们的痛苦，可我下不了手。你能帮我吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : First Sergeant Astor [0013FE78] (file) Quest : ([0014050C]VMS43) We Will All Go Together EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: What kind of favor?
ESP.TRADUIT: 帮什么忙？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want you to put down the troopers that... changed. Turned into Ghouls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想要你干掉那些变异成尸鬼的...士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : First Sergeant Astor [0013FE78] (file) Quest : ([0014050C]VMS43) We Will All Go Together EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there somewhere else he can go?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他有没有别的地方可以去？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a Ranger station north of here that has a few Ghouls running it. Maybe they'll take him in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 北边有个游骑兵驻站，由尸鬼在负责。也许那儿会接纳他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : First Sergeant Astor [0013FE78] (file) Quest : ([0014050C]VMS43) We Will All Go Together EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is a Ghoul in Camp Searchlight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是探照灯营地的一个尸鬼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If he's a Ghoul he should be put down. I can't let a rabid dog suffer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他是尸鬼，就该被干掉。我可不想看着一条疯狗受苦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : First Sergeant Astor [0013FE78] (file) Quest : ([0014050C]VMS43) We Will All Go Together EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: What kind of creatures?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有些什么生物？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mostly Ghouls, and a handful of radscorps. I think some geckos moved in not too long ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 主要是尸鬼，还有大批辐射蝎。此外，我估计还有些蜥蜴，应该是不久前钻进去的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : First Sergeant Astor [0013FE78] (file) Quest : ([0014050C]VMS43) We Will All Go Together EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: They seem to stick mostly to the south end of the camp.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们大部分都盘踞在营地的南边。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : First Sergeant Astor [0013FE78] (file) Quest : ([0014050C]VMS43) We Will All Go Together EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ranger Station Echo is north of here. They have Ghoul troopers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵驻站艾柯在这里的北边。他们那儿有尸鬼士兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard Ranger Station Echo up north is manned by other Ghouls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说北边的游骑兵驻站艾柯是尸鬼在管事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a Ranger Station run by Ghouls? Finally, I feel like I have a place to go. Thanks for your help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有个尸鬼管理的游骑兵驻站？我想我终于有地方可去了。谢谢你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Private Edwards [0013FE79] (file) Quest : ([0014050C]VMS43) We Will All Go Together EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe First Sergeant Astor will let you join him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 没准阿斯特士官长会接纳你？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you sure he'll be okay with it? Not everyone is crazy about Ghouls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你确定他会同意？不是每个人都对尸鬼抱着友好态度的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Private Edwards [0013FE79] (file) Quest : ([0014050C]VMS43) We Will All Go Together EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: But Ghouls are immune to radiation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但尸鬼是免疫辐射的啊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right, Ghouls aren't fit to be in the army.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是对的，尸鬼确实不适合留在部队里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe they'll let you back in?
ESP.TRADUIT: 没准他们会让你回去？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not so sure about that. I don't know how the NCR feels about Ghouls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不确定。我不知道NCR对尸鬼是个什么态度。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Private Edwards [0013FE79] (file) Quest : ([0014050C]VMS43) We Will All Go Together EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because you know they'd come up lacking?
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为你知道他们都是纸老虎？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Enough! How dare you compare Caesar's finest to this tribe of savages? The mightiest Great Khan is scarcely a match for a Legion recruit!
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功] 够了！你怎么敢把凯撒手下的精锐和这个部落的野蛮人相比？哪怕大汗帮里最强的战士，也比不上一名军团新兵！

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Burned Man would leave their mightiest shitting themselves in terror! I would... Uhhh, that is...
ESP.TRADUIT: 浴火者会把他们吓得屁滚尿流！我会……啊，我是说...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doctor Henry, do as he asks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 亨利医生，照他说的做。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good, good. Smart move, human.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，很好。你很明智，人类。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Keene [0013F70D] (mod) Quest : ([0013F405]VMS41) Guess Who I Saw Today EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这儿是做什么的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I represent the Nightkin. Marcus may lead this town, but the Nightkin listen to what I have to say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我代表夜行族。虽然这个镇子是马可世领导的，但夜行族都听我的号令。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doesn't mean I don't respect Marcus for what he's trying to do. However, he doesn't truly understand the difficulties of being a Nightkin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 并非不尊重马可世，他确实付出了很大的努力。但他并没有真正理解我们夜行族的苦衷。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you have for sale?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这儿都卖些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you're buying? Cool.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你要买？好极了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you're buying? Tell you what, since you've been acting all, well, random lately, how about a discount? Might calm you down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你要买？这么着吧，看你最近似乎挺，呃，瞎胡闹的，我就给你打个折怎么样？或许能让你冷静点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Show me what you have for sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我看看你卖的东西吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm hunting Ghouls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在狩猎尸鬼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need repairs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要修理。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right then... just sign here, here, and... here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧……这儿，这儿还有这儿……签个字就好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you still want to help Doctor Henry run his experiment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你仍然想帮助亨利医生做实验吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course, dearie. I know it's dangerous, but it'll all turn out for the best, you'll see. I'll go to him now - it would be rude to keep him waiting!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，亲爱的。我知道很危险，但是值得，你会看到的。我现在就去见他——让他一直等着太不礼貌了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, I'm more comfortable now that I know you've had some training.
ESP.TRADUIT: 知道你受过些训练，我反而更放心了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, thanks for taking a chance on a naive young girl from California with stars in her eyes and a pneumatic gauntlet on her hand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，感谢你能给我这个眼里闪着星星、手上戴着拳套的加州傻姑娘一次机会。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's hit the road, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们上路吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You gonna do it or not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你到底杀不杀？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on, ya bitch! You swing like a girl!
ESP.TRADUIT: 来吧，婊子！你的气场就像个小姑娘！

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Go to sleep.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <睡觉。>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Zzzz...
ESP.TRADUIT: 呼噜噜...

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know what? I don't need this bullshit right now. We'll take off that goddamn power armor, if it'll just shut you up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 行吧，我可不想听这些废话。只要你他妈闭嘴，我们就把这该死的动力装甲脱了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Colonel Cassandra Moore [001206FC] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is fascinating. Please continue.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有意思。请继续说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, after they migrated to the Mojave, we established relations with them, but that soured when all they wanted was to make drugs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我们在他们迁到莫哈维沙漠之后就和他们建立了联系，但当我们知道他们只想制毒的时候就后悔了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR eventually took them down quite a bit, but the really fascinating thing about them is the origin of their culture as a whole. You see...
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR最终狠狠地教训了他们，但他们让人感兴趣的地方，其实是他们整个文化的起源。你看...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who is Ezekiel?
ESP.TRADUIT: 伊齐基尔是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's a member of the Followers like myself, but his particular field is Pre-War history and tribal culture.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和我一样，也是天启追随者的一员，只不过他的专长是研究战前历史和部落文化。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do recall him being fascinated by the Khans, he kept going on about parallels to some ancient historical empire or another.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我记得他以前对大汗帮很着迷，同时还研究过好几个古代帝国的历史。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have things I need to do. You'd better go alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有事情要做。你最好一个人去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not much for family gatherings, huh? All right, have it your way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对家庭聚会不感兴趣？好吧，那就听你的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You ever want to look me up again, I'll be in my bunker in Hidden Valley. That's the luxury bunker.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要找我的话，我就在我隐谷的地堡里。那可是个豪华的地堡。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Transplant Violetta's brain into Rex.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把维奥列塔的大脑移植给给雷克斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have a seat. This will take a while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 坐一下吧。这需要点时间。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Transplant Lupa's brain into Rex.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把鲁帕的大脑移植给雷克斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, then. Be patient since this will take a while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，请耐心等待，这需要一点时间。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Transplant Rey's brain into Rex.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把雷伊的大脑移植给雷克斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, then. Be patient since this will take a while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，请耐心等待，这需要一点时间。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Show me what you have for sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看你都卖些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Show me what you have for sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看你这儿都卖些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can I get you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不知道您有什么需要？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It sounded like you were writing poetry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来你在写诗。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh. You heard that, huh? Okay, so yeah, I was writing poetry. I know, I know, it's not a very Great Khan-like thing to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你听出来了？好吧，是的，我是在写诗。我知道，我知道，这一点也不像大汗帮的风格。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jerry the Punk [001413BD] (file) EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Followers of the Apocalypse came to our camp when I was a kid, and they brought a bunch of old books. I used to read Pre-War poetry for hours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我还小的时候，有一次天启追随者到我们营地，带来了很多旧书。我曾经废寝忘食地读那些战前诗歌。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jerry the Punk [001413BD] (file) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Show me what you have for sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我看看你卖的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because you're a friend of the Followers, I can give you a bit of a discount.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为你是天启追随者的朋友，我可以给你一点折扣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's the caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, this will only take a few minutes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，只要几分钟就好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got some songs coming up for you right now. At least one is probably about love.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在将会为你们播放一些歌曲。其中至少有一首是关于爱情的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: These headlines were brought to you by Vault 21. Vault 21. Everything's better when you experience it in a vault.
ESP.TRADUIT: 以上头条由21号避难所倾情赞助。21号避难所。在避难所里，什么都比外面好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: NewsStory
ESP.TRADUIT: 新故事

ESP.ORIGINAL: Diners at the Gourmand are giving the restaurant rave reviews for executive chef Philippe's brand new menu offerings.
ESP.TRADUIT: 美事家餐厅的用餐者对主厨菲利普的新菜给予了极高的评价。

ESP.ORIGINAL: NewsIntro
ESP.TRADUIT: 新闻摘要

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got news for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我这儿有一条新闻。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Show me what you have for sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我看看你都卖什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's Ghouls, I tell ya. Religious Ghouls in rockets looking for a land to call their own.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说了是尸鬼了。一群信教的尸鬼，他们坐火箭是为了寻找新的家园。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Possible causes suggested were engineering mistakes, centuries-old equipment, and the fact that the rockets were piloted by a cult of crazy Ghouls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 目前认为造成事故的原因有以下几种可能：或者是工程失误，或者几世纪前的旧设施年久失修，更有可能是因为火箭实际上是由一群信仰邪教的尸鬼所驾驶。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sir, yes, Sir!
ESP.TRADUIT: 长官，是，长官！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sir, yes, Sir!
ESP.TRADUIT: 长官，是，长官！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's see what you have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们看看你都有什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take a look at these beauties.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来瞧瞧这些美人儿吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The right weapons for my kind of customer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些武器绝对适合我的顾客。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The others here don't understand our kind, but you can count on me, friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其他人都不理解我们这类人，但我懂你，朋友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You aren't exactly good for business, so you'll have to live with my prices.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和你做生意我是要冒风险的，所以恕不二价，你看着办吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have a discount, friend. I can't wait to see what you do with these, next.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你打个折，朋友。我真想看看你能拿这些东西干什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's an honor to have my wares used by such a wild badass. Cut's on the house, friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有你这样的大恶人赏光是我的荣幸。折扣全算在我的账上，朋友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmmm... think I could slip bigger weapons past the guards?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯……你觉得我可以带一把更大点的武器混过守卫吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know, sometimes the journey beats the destination. Especially if your spurs go Jingle Jangle Jingle, and you meet some nice gals on the way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道，有时旅途的过程要比达到终点更吸引人。特别是当你叮当叮当叮在公路上疾驰时，你会在路上遇见一些好女孩。

ESP.ORIGINAL: WoooooOOOOOOoooooo
ESP.TRADUIT: 喔哦噢噢噢噢噢噢噢噢噢噢

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looks like we got them, move fast and look alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 敌人应该消灭干净了，加速前进，动作快点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 其他哪里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nah, I'm gonna chill with my girl.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我要去跟我的姑娘玩。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't. The King's got me busy on something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不行。猫王最近可没让我闲着。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Show me what you have for sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看你都卖些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have a look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Show me what you have for sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我看看你都卖些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我马上照办。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I, Robert Edwin House, am deceased. Please approach a Securitron and take one of the printed obituaries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 本人，罗伯特·艾德温·豪斯，已经不在人世。请向就近的电子保安领取我的讣告。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As good as a Ghoul in a suit can look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尸鬼再怎么打扮，也就这个样了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like you to go back to the Lucky 38 for now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望你现在回幸运38赌场去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Makes beeping sounds>
ESP.TRADUIT: <发出哔哔响声>
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : Do not record. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Companion Protocol::Return Base>
ESP.TRADUIT: <同伴协议::回到基地>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice! Can I order room service?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好啊！我可以预订客房服务吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do. We'll meet up at the Lucky 38.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。我们在幸运38赌场见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, as long as you're not asking me to go back to Black Mountain, I'm a happy old man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，只要不让我回黑山，去哪儿我都乐意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is. We'll meet up at the Lucky 38.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。我们在幸运38赌场见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <bark!>
ESP.TRADUIT: <犬吠！>

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right... don't be long. Robots there give me the creeps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的……别去得太久。那边的机器人让我毛骨悚然。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right. Guess Vegas it is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。看来要待在维加斯了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Back to the gilded cage.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回那镀金笼子里去咯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice children shouldn't stay in places like that, dearie! That's the sort of place Leo likes! But if you insist...
ESP.TRADUIT: 乖孩子不该待在那种地方，亲爱的！只有利奥才喜欢那种地方！但是如果你坚持的话...

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll make my way there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会去那儿的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do. We'll meet up at the Lucky 38.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。我们在幸运38赌场见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Back to the tomb, I suppose. If you need me, et cetera.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要回墓穴了啊，需要我的时候来找我啊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <whine> <bark>
ESP.TRADUIT: <呜咽> <吠声>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes sir!
ESP.TRADUIT: 是长官！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那好吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那好吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Star Paladin Cross [060156E5] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tunnel Snakes rule!
ESP.TRADUIT: 穴蛇帮主宰一切！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever you say, honey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管你说什么，亲爱的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever kid, whatever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管孩子，不管。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As you wish.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如你所愿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're not one of the merchandise?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不出来卖吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Most of my body is scarred all over, like a Ghoul. Nobody around who'd want to screw that. No, I just run things.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我身上到处是伤疤，就像尸鬼一样。没人愿意碰我这样的。不，我只负责打理店铺。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Continue]
ESP.TRADUIT: [继续]

ESP.ORIGINAL: Word got back to one of our stations that raiders had been attacking the place. I went out with six rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 后来有个驻站报告称那里遭到了掠夺者袭击，我便带了六名游骑兵赶了过去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We must have been on the trail for a week before we got to Rattletail. We lost one woman to Nightstalkers and another almost died of dehydration.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们花了大概一个礼拜的时间才抵达嘎嘎尾巴。路上还有夜行兽杀了我们一个女兵，另一个人则差点因脱水而死。

ESP.ORIGINAL: When we reach the place, it's six shacks set up around an old well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我们赶到时，就看到六座窝棚围着一口老井。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No problem, I'll head up by myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我自己去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come back soon, now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 下次再来哦！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, let's play again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好啊，再来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let the Caravan Lesson begin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我好好教你该怎么玩商队牌。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm all done playing for now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就这样了，不玩了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Afraid to lose. Well come find me if you want to play again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么？输不起了？总之想再玩就叫我吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice try. Let's play another game.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还不坏，来，继续。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow, you're good. Give me another game.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你玩得很好啊，再和我来一把。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Want to play a hand of Caravan?
ESP.TRADUIT: 来一把商队牌？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm going to roll over you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会让你输得心服口服的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ringo [00104C7C] (file) NPC : Johnson Nash [000DA729] (file) NPC : Cliff Briscoe [0008CD27] (file) NPC : No-bark Noonan [0008CD23] (file) NPC : Quartermaster Mayes [00120DCE] (file) NPC : Poindexter [00104311] (file) NPC : Jules [0013E307] (mod) NPC : Ambassador Dennis Crocker [00112640] (mod) NPC : Private Jake Erwin [00112642] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me see what you have for sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看你都卖些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You won't find better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别家可没有这么好的东西哦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gourmand Food Supplier [001584CE] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Remember, an impressive gratuity sends a message.
ESP.TRADUIT: 记住，一笔可观的小费能给我们极大的鼓舞。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gourmand Food Supplier [001584CE] (file) NPC : Bartender [0011A10B] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our drinks have many subtle flavors.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的酒水口味丰富而又细腻。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gourmand Food Supplier [001584CE] (file) NPC : Bartender [0011A10B] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure let me take a look at those magazines.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，让我看下那些杂志吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take a look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll pay you for the key.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要给我钥匙，我愿意花钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We can come to a deal. My price is firm, though - Saint James is a good customer and it better be worth it if I'm going to lose him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们可以做笔交易。但我的要价可不低——圣詹姆斯是个好客户，万一他翻脸了，你给的钱总该够弥补我的损失吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Know anything about Saint James?
ESP.TRADUIT: 知道圣詹姆斯的底细吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Guy's unstable, but he pays his rent and Sweetie seems to like him all right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这伙计脾气不大好，但他交房租倒是挺积极，小甜甜似乎也很喜欢他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, please.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take a look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看一下吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Great Khan Armorer [0014EDBE] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do you spell "gesticulate?"
ESP.TRADUIT: "哑语"这两个字怎么写？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jerry the Punk [001413BD] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Vacate the premises immediately. All Securitrons are at a state of high alert.
ESP.TRADUIT: 立刻撤离该场所。所有电子保安进入高度警戒状态。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Damn it, will you die already?
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死，你怎么还活着？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Lucky 38 will be your grave. I'll finish what Benny couldn't get right!
ESP.TRADUIT: 幸运38将是你的葬身之处。本尼没做成的事，就由我来完成！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mr. House [00125BB5] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : [Casino floor] EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One last thing. Is there any truth to the rumor that all Nightkin are slightly crazy from their overuse of psychologically damaging Pre-War tech?
ESP.TRADUIT: 最后一件事。有谣言传说夜行族因为滥用战前对神经有害的科技，导致全族人都变得有点疯癫，这是事实吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's get on with it, shall we? Hmm?
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们继续吧，好吗？嗯？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mr. House [00125BB5] (mod) NPC : [00159B21] (ID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Greetings, General Oliver. The disappointment you are about to experience delights me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 幸会，奥利弗将军。我会很享受你即将经历的失望的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Point guns at us, and we will destroy you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再用枪指着我们，你们就死定了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please do not struggle, General Oliver, you might hurt yourself. You can relax presently.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别再挣扎了，奥利弗将军，你会伤着自己的。放轻松点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did something... happen between you two?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们俩……发生过故事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ugh. So gross. It was bad enough that I didn't get any data out of the Securitron. This is why I didn't want to talk about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃。当然。可惜我没能从那机器人身上搞到数据，所以现在我才不想谈它。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It only happened once. I chalk it up to sleep deprivation and one atomic cocktail too many.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那种事只发生过一次。我把它归咎于睡眠不足以及过量饮用原子鸡尾酒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As long as you leave right after you put your caps down, you're on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要你把瓶盖放下然后转身离开，我算你有能耐。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got enough on my shoulders without adding more dead weight to 'em.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我肩上的担子已经够重的了，别再给我添累赘了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Show me one, and I'll do him proud.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我找个来，我会好好疼爱他的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: | Wild Wasteland |Ain't nothing but a hound dog.
ESP.TRADUIT: | Wild Wasteland |不过是头野狗罢了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, and ain't looking to be a babysitter, neither.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我也不想给人当保姆。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wanted to be with someone who knew how to please a woman, that's what.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只想找个懂得逗女人开心的家伙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stake a claim somewhere else, pretty boy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要占人便宜你还是去别的地方吧，靓仔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's trade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 咱们来做买卖吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could use some Stimpaks... how 'bout some nice Bloatfly Steaks in trade?
ESP.TRADUIT: 能不能给我一支治疗针…我用上等的苍蝇肉来换如何？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come and get me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就放马过来吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's see what you've got.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们看看你有什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We don't have to fight. We can still talk about this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们没必要打架。有什么事好商量。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I'm done talking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，已经商量得够多了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry I had to kill him - he didn't give me much choice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，我不得不杀了他——我别无选择。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, anyway, Judah's given Orion's armor to you now. It'll take a few hours for me to show you how to use it properly, so let's get started.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，不管怎么样，犹大已经把厄里翁的装甲给了你。我还得花几个小时教你怎么如何使用它。我们开始吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What will your friends think about this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的朋友们会怎么想？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've known them far longer than you have. They'll get over it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认识他们的时间比你长。他们不会有意见的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about New Vegas.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和我说说新维加斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's big, it's bright, and it's one of the biggest cities still left from before the War. Well, mostly, anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它很雄伟，很壮观。是战后遗留下来的规模最大的城市之一。嗯，大概吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Used to be just a curiosity. The buildings were Pre-War, but it was just as full of raiders and barbarian tribes as anyplace else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这地方以前是个奇葩。建筑都是战前的，却和其他地方一样遍布着掠夺者和野蛮人部落。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then Mr. House took over, got the power turned back on, and got the tribes reformed into something civilized. Now they run his casinos for him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 后来豪斯先生上台，就给城里通了电，还开化了那些部落。如今他们负责经营着他旗下的那些赌场。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Though Novac was a low-priority target for the Legion, many of Novac's citizens died in its defense.
ESP.TRADUIT: 虽然诺瓦克并非军团的主要目标，但依旧有许多居民为了保卫小镇而死。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jeannie May Crawford [0008D749] (file) NPC : Ron the Narrator [00161EB2] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In the weeks that followed, Feral Ghouls, overflowing from the REPCONN Test Site, ravaged the weakened town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在其后的几个星期里，凶猛的尸鬼从瑞普康试验场中倾巢而出，侵占了这个已经饱经摧残的小镇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jeannie May Crawford [0008D749] (file) NPC : Ron the Narrator [00161EB2] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: VEndingFiends
ESP.TRADUIT: VEnding恶魔帮

ESP.ORIGINAL: Never weakened by NCR, the Fiends staged an attack against Camp McCarran during the second Battle of Hoover Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 未曾遭到NCR重创的恶魔帮，在第二次胡佛大坝战役期间策划了一场针对麦卡伦营地的袭击。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Motor-Runner [000EF3AB] (mod) NPC : Ron the Narrator [00161EB2] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Though NCR repulsed the Fiends, they suffered heavy losses in the process.
ESP.TRADUIT: 虽然NCR击退了恶魔帮，但也付出了惨重的伤亡。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Motor-Runner [000EF3AB] (mod) NPC : Ron the Narrator [00161EB2] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Fiends overran Camp McCarran during the second Battle of Hoover Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恶魔帮在第二次胡佛大坝战役期间占领了麦卡伦营地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Motor-Runner [000EF3AB] (mod) NPC : Ron the Narrator [00161EB2] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In the anarchic months that followed, the Fiends asserted dominance over Outer Vegas.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在之后动荡不安的日子里，恶魔帮又控制了整个维加斯外围。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Motor-Runner [000EF3AB] (mod) NPC : Ron the Narrator [00161EB2] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Fiends attacked Camp McCarran during the second Battle of Hoover Dam and, despite suffering heavy losses, overran it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恶魔帮们在第二次胡佛大坝战役期间袭击了麦卡伦营地，虽然损失惨重，但最终还是将其攻破。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Motor-Runner [000EF3AB] (mod) NPC : Ron the Narrator [00161EB2] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They continued to be a nuisance throughout Outer Vegas, but never established full control over the area.
ESP.TRADUIT: 此后，他们继续在维加斯外围肆虐，但他们从未真正控制过这片地区。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Motor-Runner [000EF3AB] (mod) NPC : Ron the Narrator [00161EB2] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Coughing Fit>
ESP.TRADUIT: <咳嗽发作>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looks like I'm headed for the big dark...
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来我要拥抱无尽的黑暗了...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry... I let you down...
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起... 我让你失望了...

ESP.ORIGINAL: I knew I should've been an actress.
ESP.TRADUIT: 早知道我就去当女演员了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Never thought I'd go out like this...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从没想过我会这样死去...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ouch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哎呦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Physician, heal thyself. Guess it's a good thing they invented stims.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要医人，先医己。还好他们发明了兴奋剂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need healing powder!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要医疗粉！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Grandma needs to have a little lie down!
ESP.TRADUIT: 奶奶该躺会儿了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wake
ESP.TRADUIT: 醒来

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oof.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, okay, I'm up. What's next?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，好的，我起来了。下一步怎么办？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What'd I miss?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我错过了什么吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gah! Petro-Chico Boy! Petro-Chico Boy is here for my chitlins! Oh. Just a dream. Just a dream...
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊啊啊！石油小子！石油小子来掏我的肠子了！噢，还好是梦。还好是梦...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Grandma's head hurts...
ESP.TRADUIT: 奶奶的头好痛...

ESP.ORIGINAL: What am I wearing? Cardboard?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我穿的是什么？纸壳？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have much protection here. Mind helping me out?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的防护措施实在有点差。介意帮忙搞定一下吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This armor's gonna get me killed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会给这护甲害死的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I'm dead unless you can get me some real armor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，你要是不能给我搞些真正的护甲来，我就死定了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got anything bigger I can fight with?
ESP.TRADUIT: 赶快给我点新武器！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Might be time for a weapon upgrade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许该给武器升级了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Might as well be throwing rocks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这跟扔石头差不多。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got a bigger gun I can borrow?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能不能借一把更大的枪给我？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Need a new weapon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 需要一件新武器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This weapon's done for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这件武器完了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This weapon's done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这件武器完了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Spare some ammo?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有弹药吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: My guns are empty!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的枪要空了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's better. Maybe I should've been a surgeon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好点了。看来我应该去当个外科医生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Patched up. Let's get back to the fight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 包扎完了。继续战斗吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Will the medical wonders of the post-apocalyptic world never cease?
ESP.TRADUIT: 战前世界的医学奇迹究竟还遗留了多少？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Didn't even leave a scar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 连点伤痕都没有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Crippled
ESP.TRADUIT: 残废

ESP.ORIGINAL: I fear I will need more than my herbs to fix this...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我恐怕快不行了...

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could use a Doctor's Bag if you have any handy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你有医疗包的话，我急用。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't feel all my limbs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我四肢都没知觉了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Regenerating
ESP.TRADUIT: 治愈中

ESP.ORIGINAL: That helps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 感觉不错。

ESP.ORIGINAL: MMmmahh. <Smacks lips>
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯啊。<咂嘴唇>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sweet as roses.
ESP.TRADUIT: 妙极了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahh...
Poison
ESP.TRADUIT: 中毒

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not feeling so good...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有些不舒服...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Need to lighten my load.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我得减轻一下负重。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not exactly in Power Armor over here, so why don't you help lighten my load a bit?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我又没穿动力装甲，你为什么不帮我减轻些重量呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not standing here because I'm overburdened with emotion. Take some of this stuff off me so I can move a little more easily.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我都快站不住了，感觉心要被石头压跨了。帮我拿掉一些东西，我就可以走得轻松点了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, don't worry about it, boss. The decrepit old man can easily carry all your stuff for you. Really.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，别在意，老大。我这把老骨头什么玩意都能驮得动。真的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to purchase some supplies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想买点补给。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unfortunately for you, I'm not authorized to trade with you. It's against regulations.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常抱歉，上级并未批准我和你做生意。这样做违反规定。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Gasps> For me? Do you mean it? No, it's too much! Well, okay. But it's too much! It's perfect. Thank you. Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: <倒抽气>给我的？真的吗？不，这太贵重了！呃，好吧。但真的太贵重了！好美啊。谢谢。谢谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Veronica [000E32AA] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Genuinely touched. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aw, you shouldn't have! It's just my taste. Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，不会吧！这正合我口味。谢谢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh my God, oh my God, oh my God! Look what they're wearing! I've only seen dresses like those in my dreams. And even then I couldn't afford them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，我的上帝，我的上帝啊，我的上帝！看看他们穿的衣服！我只在梦里见过这样的衣服。而且我在梦里都买不起。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Walking the Mojave with you can't be any worse than here, that's for sure. All right, I'm in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和你一起在莫哈维四处转转，总比呆在这儿强，这倒是实话。好吧，算我一个。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looking to join up with me again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 想再次与我同行吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Was reminded why I left this place soon as I walked in. Let's go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我刚一踏进这鬼地方，就想起我为啥要离开了。咱们走吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened then?
ESP.TRADUIT: 之后发生了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: About two dozen men came back in the night, after we'd gone to sleep. They set fire to the ranch house and barred the doors from the outside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大约二十几个人趁着夜里我们睡着的时候又回来了。他们放火烧了农场的房子，还把门从外面堵上了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My whole family was trapped inside. I smelled the smoke and got myself and my little sister, Rafaela, out though a window, but everyone else...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们一家人都被困在屋里。我闻到了烟味，于是带着我的小妹妹拉法拉爬出了窗户，可其他人...

ESP.ORIGINAL: My parents, my grandmother, my two brothers and two of my sisters all died.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的父母、祖母、两个兄弟和两个姐妹，都死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right. Come on, let's go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。来吧，我们走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank god, the sooner the better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 感谢上帝，越快越好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I changed my mind. This is something we should confront together.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我改主意了。这件事我们要共同面对。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. This is something for me to deal with. But I'm glad you're here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。这是我的私事。但我很高兴你能在这里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Attack> That's it. Tired of listening to you anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: <攻击>够了。我听厌了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're seriously going to draw on me? Fine, do it, see what happens.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真的要来找我麻烦？好吧，来吧，看看会有什么后果。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good, go back to your famil... oh wait, they're fucking dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，那就回去找你的家人……哦，等等，他们早他妈死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You son of a bitch. You know, I was just going to give you a piece of my mind and now? Now I'm going to put you down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这个狗娘养的。你知道吗，刚才我只是想说你两句，现在，我要打得你再也爬不起来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go back West, then, see if I care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你回西部去吧，我才不管呢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can have your shit back, I don't need it or want it. You go your way, I'm going mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以把你的垃圾全都拿回去，反正我不想要。从今往后，你走你的阳关道，我过我的独木桥。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And don't try looking for me - it was a mistake to show up in the Mojave in the first place, and I'm not about to repeat that mistake twice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你也别指望能找到我——我来莫哈维从一开始就是个错误。我不会再犯第二次了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: About your decision...
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于你的决定...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you rescue her?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你去救她了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I went after Dave and his brothers. They had a head start, but they slept nights. I didn't. Took me three days to catch up to them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我一直追着戴夫和他的弟兄。他们虽然走的早，可他们晚上睡觉。我不睡。我花了三天时间才追上他们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Claudia was dead when I got there. They'd put a bullet in each of her eyes. I couldn't do anything except avenge her, just like Rafaela.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我赶到的时候，克劳迪娅已经死了。他们在她的双眼里各打了一枪。我唯一能做的，只有为她报仇，就像当年为拉法拉一样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I charged into the middle of their camp and started firing - two of them were dead before they knew I was there. The other five, though...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我冲进他们的营地，抬枪便射——他们还没反应过来，就有两个人命丧当场。可另外五个人...

ESP.ORIGINAL: They shot the shit out of me. I would have died, I think, if I wasn't so full of rage.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可真被他们打得够戗。要不是当时我仗着一腔怒火，估计早就死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wasn't Mexico City basically annihilated in the Great War?
ESP.TRADUIT: 在伟大战争中，墨西哥城不是几乎被毁灭了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think it was as hard hit as D.C. or Bakersfield, but it was bad enough. By the time we got there, the city was a radioactive ruin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认为它遭受的打击应该比不上华盛顿或贝克斯菲尔德，但也差不多了。我们到那儿的时候，整座城市已经化为废墟，到处遍布着辐射。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still, the city was full of looters, already forming into the beginnings of raider tribes. Crime was bad before the War, but now it was a nightmare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然而城里还是堆满了来抢劫的人，掠夺者部落已经开始形成。战前犯罪就很猖獗，现在简直就像地狱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We were living like scavengers, scraping by on what little food we could find, always looking for medicine for my burns.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们靠捡破烂为生，凡是能下咽的东西都成了我们的战利品，还得四处寻找能治疗我烧伤的药。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And then, of course, the radiation started to kick in, turning me into this handsome devil you see before you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，后来我就感染了辐射病，把我变成了现在这副英俊的鬼模样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Staying low.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别动。

ESP.ORIGINAL: O... kay. I'll do my best.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好……的，我尽力。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keeping quiet... unless my creaking knees give us away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 保持安静……除非我这咯吱作响的膝盖把我们暴露了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right, because a Ghoul in a vaquero outfit is really going to blend in with the scenery.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错，像我这样一身牛仔装的尸鬼，可以完美地隐匿在周围的环境里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, don't you worry about me, dearie, your grandma knows how to stay quiet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，不要担心我，亲爱的，你的奶奶知道该怎么保持安静。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cheer up, kid. It's not that bad. Sure, your skin rots off and you start to stink like a public toilet after Cinco de Mayo, but... umm...
ESP.TRADUIT: 振作点，孩子。情况也不是那么糟。不错，你的皮肤的确在腐烂，而且闻起来就像是狂欢节后的公共厕所，不过……嗯……

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess hunting down Ghouls like wild animals is okay. I mean, they're probably going to die anyway, right boss?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得像杀野生动物一样杀掉尸鬼也没什么问题。反正它们早晚都是个死。对不？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was the one who turned off the vents at Vault 34.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就是关掉34号避难所排风扇的那个人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You? Did you re-direct the power stream back to our section?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你？是你把电力重新导回到我们这片区域的么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We thought nobody would ever manage to get past the radiation, and the Ghouls!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们还以为不可能有人能穿过那片辐射区域，何况尸鬼那么多！

ESP.ORIGINAL: We owe you our freedom, outlander. Please, if there's anything we can do for you...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们都欠你一个人情，外乡人。如果有什么需要，请尽管开口……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did he say anything when you met him? Anything... anything at all?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你遇到他时他有没有说什么？什么事……什么事都没说吗 ?

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you spare any medical supplies?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能给我一点医疗用品吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just let me know what you need.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么需要，告诉我就行。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What was I supposed to do again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 再说一次，我应该干嘛来着？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just head over to the REPCONN test site west of here. See if you can get the Ghouls out of there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去西边的瑞普康实验场。想个办法把那里的尸鬼都赶走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What needs to be done?
ESP.TRADUIT: 要做些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well they gotta go, or this'll be a ghost town before long.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们必须消失，否则这里不久就会变成一座鬼城。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doesn't matter to me what you do. As long as the Ghouls are out of there, that's good enough for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不管你采取什么手段，只要把那些尸鬼撵走，对我来说就够了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you need?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Novac, it's home for me now. I want that to be for good. I like it here, and I've left too many homes behind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 诺瓦克是我的家。我希望一直住在这里。我喜欢这里，毕竟我过去一直四处漂泊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But the only resource we got here is junk. Without that, people wouldn't have anything to trade. They'd all have to leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可这地方唯一的资源就是垃圾。没有了垃圾，人们也就没东西可卖，只能离开这里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We get most of it up the road from the old rocket test site. But a bunch of Ghouls showed up one day and took it over. We can't get in there now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大部分垃圾都是从远处的旧火箭实验基地弄来的。谁知某一天突然冒出来一群尸鬼，把那里给占了。我们现在进不去了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Show me what you have for sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看你卖些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our patrols are always bringing more stuff in. Take a look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的巡逻队总是能带进新物资。来看看吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, you can make Moonshine?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，你会做私酿酒？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, what else you going to do with an empty bottle? Wait for it to refill itself?
ESP.TRADUIT: 对啊，一个空瓶子你还想干嘛？等它自己生出酒来？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get me some ingredients out of the Mojave, an empty bottle, a little time, and I'll keep us stocked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要你把配料拿来，再给我一个空瓶和一点时间，咱们就能随时享受这份畅饮了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: On second thought...
ESP.TRADUIT: 再等等...

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure. I'd rather you didn't have any psychotic breaks, even if it means you aren't as strong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我确定。我宁肯你不要再精神分裂，即便你不再如以前那样强壮。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, all right, then, dearie. I suppose I'll have my holotapes to remind me of Becky and Jimmy...
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好吧，亲爱的。看来我得找些磁带来回忆一下贝基和吉米了...

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to buy some food.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想买点吃的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here is what we have available.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们有的就是这些了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boomer Chef [00106623] (file) NPC : Boomer Chef [00106622] (file) NPC : Boomer Chef [00106621] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Could I buy some spare munitions?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以买一些军用部件吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. Pearl gave the green light. Take a look at the manifest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。珀尔开了绿灯。看看这货单。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boomer Munitions Manager [0015D78F] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not without Pearl's permission, and she hasn't given permission.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有珀尔的允许就不行，而且她也没有允许呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Boomer Munitions Manager [0015D78F] (file) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I bet I'm going to like it in that mainframe!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我打赌我会爱上那台主机的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wonder if Marcus knows about this place...
ESP.TRADUIT: 不知道马可世是否认得这个地方...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Earlier, it seemed like you knew Tabitha. What's the story there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好像认识塔比瑟，你们俩有啥故事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tabitha was grandma's squad leader when we both worked for the Master. She wasn't very nice at all, but she was good at the chopping.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们以前都曾为主教卖命，那时塔比瑟是奶奶小分队的队长。她脾气不大好，但砍人的技巧却是一流的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Almost as good as Leo...
ESP.TRADUIT: 就和利奥一样...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Attention. ARCHIMEDES I Laser is now armed. Move all personnel to minimum safe distance before initiating test fire.
ESP.TRADUIT: 注意。阿基米德激光系统准备完毕。在火力测试开始前，请所有人员迅速撤离到安全距离外。

ESP.ORIGINAL: ARCHIMEDES II orbital laser bombardment will commence in T-minus 5... 4... 3... 2... 1.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿基米德II型轨道激光轰炸即将开始，倒计时5… 4… 3… 2… 1。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fair enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可以。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right. Let's not waste any time. There are people out there to help, things to learn. Maybe not in that order, but let's get to it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，那我们就别再浪费时间了。外面还有很多人需要帮助，有很多东西需要学习。也许并非事事井然，但我们还是应当努力。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like you to come with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望你能和我一起走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A courier, doctor, and a cybernetic dog. After we deal with the whole "imminent conquest of New Vegas" problem we should open an act at the Tops.
ESP.TRADUIT: 邮差，医生外加一条机器狗。等咱们完成"征服新维加斯"的大业，这故事能在九重天当戏演了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's something about that robot that doesn't seem... all right to me. I'm not saying we shouldn't take it with us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于那个机器人，我总觉得…不怎么对劲。我不是说我们不能带它一起走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just saying that if it were to fall into Lake Mead and be irreparably damaged... and if you threw an EMP grenade in after it...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是觉得，如果万一它"掉进了"米德湖，发生严重损坏……而之后你又之往湖里丢了一颗EMP手雷的话……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, there are worse things happening in the world, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，世上也有比这更糟糕的事情，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: After spending thirty years of my life hiding my association with the Enclave, I'd love to stroll the wasteland with a twitchy Eyebot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想想这三十年来，我一直在隐瞒自己与英克雷的联系，现在居然能和一只古怪的眼球机器人在废土上流浪，也算是不错了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks for asking. I appreciate it. I do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多谢你邀请我，我很感激。真的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Back in your good graces again? I knew you'd see the light.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不计前嫌地回来了？我就知道你会想明白的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need you to leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还是走吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought my charm could win you over, but I guess it wasn't meant to be. Are you sure you want me to go?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还以为我靠魅力征服了你呢，但看来不是这样，你真要让我离开？

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, I'll head back to the Old Mormon Fort. If you need me, just swing by.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，我会回旧摩门教要塞的。如果你需要我，随时再来找我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ugh. I guess that means I have to go back to that creepy mausoleum Mr. House calls the Lucky 38.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃。你是说要我回到那阴森森好像坟墓一样的幸运38里去吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've been around a few unsettling places in my life, but that place takes the cake.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我这辈子也去过几个人迹罕至的地方，但那儿可真称得上是名列榜首。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyway, if you need me, you know where to find me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总之，如果你要找我，就到那儿去吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Back to the tomb, I suppose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要回墓穴了啊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you need me, et cetera.
ESP.TRADUIT: 需要我的时候来找我啊，再见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. Get lost.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，滚吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was the plan. Bye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 正合我意。再见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because you're helping Caesar's Legion. They are bad. You are bad. I am going. Bye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为你在帮凯撒军团做事。他们坏，你也坏。我走了，再见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you crazy? That's a question for someone much wiser and more patient than me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为你疯了？拿这问题去问一个比我更有耐心更聪明的人吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All I know is that you are a bad person and I don't want to be around you anymore. So if that was your goal, congratulations.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只知道你是个坏人，我不想跟你走了。如果这就是你想要的结果，那恭喜你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If not, I'm sorry to inform you that you are, as the locals say, "nuttier than a Bighorner dropping."
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果不是的话，那我也只能遗憾地说一句，你就跟土话里说得一样，"脑子里进角羊屎了。"

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you have a problem with me, why don't you just leave right now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你对我有意见，你怎么不现在就走？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you insist. Have a nice life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 既然话已至此，祝你好自为之。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They hide behind NCR's protection and they deserve everything coming to them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们拿NCR当保护伞，就算出了事，也是报应。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They sure don't, but I hope you get everything that's coming to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可不敢苟同，但我的确希望你也有遭报应的一天。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have a nice life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好自为之吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a good way to put it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个词用得挺准确。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, if you're a sociopath.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，如果你是反社会人格的话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enjoy the fruits of your labor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好好享受自己种下的苦果吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: More than collateral damage. A necessary sacrifice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不叫殃及池鱼。这是必要的牺牲。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How noble of you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 您真高尚。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, but I won't be sticking around to see if you have the courtesy to lay flowers on the mass grave that the Legion's going to dig for them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，哪怕将来军团要为那些死去的百姓挖个万人坑，我也不会陪您一块儿去献花的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, yes, I would like to see New Vegas turned into a slavery hub.
ESP.TRADUIT: 实际上，没错，我就是想看新维加斯变成一个奴隶之都。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great! You're either unimaginably cruel or profoundly insane!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好极了！你如果不是残暴至极，那就是丧心病狂！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Either way, I'm not going to wait around for you to help the Legion roll across Hoover Dam. Bye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管你是哪种人，我都不打算眼睁睁地看着你帮助军团夺下胡佛水坝。再见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion is better than the alternative.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团是更好的选择。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What?! Caesar is going to enslave or kill everyone in the Mojave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？！凯撒要么会把莫哈维沙漠的百姓全都杀光，要么就奴役他们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And when that's done, he'll try to destroy the NCR senate and install himself as its new military dictator.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等他做完这件事，他就会摧毁NCR的参议院，把自己推上军事独裁者的大位。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't comprehend how Caesar could so extensively scramble your sense of morality to make you think the Legion is a better alternative to anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真是无法理解凯撒是怎样颠覆了你的是非观，居然会让你觉得军团才是上佳的选择。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And you know what? I'm not going to stick around to try and figure it out. At least legionaries have the excuse of being born into it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 算了，我也不打算留下来搞懂你这脑子了。至少军团士兵还有一个投错胎的借口。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have a nice life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好自为之吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Quite well. Thank you for asking, Veronica.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。多谢问候，维罗尼卡。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Senior Scribe Schuler [000E27E6] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Veronica.
ESP.TRADUIT: 维罗尼卡。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm surprised you're not wearing that hood to hide your hair like you usually do, Veronica.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很惊讶你居然没像往常一样用头巾遮住你的头发，维罗尼卡。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, sounds cool.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，听上去不错。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nah, I'm gonna be busy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我很忙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe, depends on how my girl's feeling.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许。得看我家姑娘怎么说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing, man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没事，老兄。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just hanging out. Same as usual.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就随便转转，和平时一样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was thinking of taking a walk a little later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在想待会儿要不要出去转转。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I might be going scum-hunting later. You game?
ESP.TRADUIT: 过会儿我要去戏耍一下那些垃圾。你来吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing. Want to head to the Wrangler later?
ESP.TRADUIT: 没事。过一会儿要不要去原子酒吧坐坐？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to see your wares.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想看看你的货物。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. Here's what I've got.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。都在这儿了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could use some help with my gear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 正好我有装备需要你修理。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me sign off on the work order for you, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我就来给你签一张报修表。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you have for trade?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你都有些什么货？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take a look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看一看吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: For you? I'm not sure I want to be seen dealing with you... but if you're willing to pay a little extra...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你？我可不想和你扯上什么关系……但你要是愿意多掏两个子儿……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where would I find a diagnostic scanning module?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在哪里可以找到诊断扫描模块？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's been said that Auto-Docs were standard equipment in the underground Vaults where mankind survived when the bombs fell centuries ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 据说自动医生是避难所的标准配备，数百年前人类曾在那里躲避核战争。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can search the Vaults, but every Auto-Doc my Legion has run across has been stripped for parts long before we found it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以去这些避难所里找找，不过军团以前也搜索过，所有的自动医生早就被拆得精光了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some of my scouts did report an abandoned Vault near Nellis Air Force Base. Overrun by Ghouls, they said.
ESP.TRADUIT: 倒是曾经有探子报告，在内利斯空军基地附近有一座避难所。但已经被尸鬼控制了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe the infestation has been there long enough to keep scavengers out. Why don't you go and see?
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许长期的感染已经令拾荒者不敢靠近了。你干嘛不亲自去那里看看呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's standing right outside your tent.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他就站在你的帐篷外。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll have my guards take him captive. If he cures my condition, I'll see to it that your reward is several times his value.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会命守卫把他抓来的。如果他能治好我的病，我可以保证，你所获得的报酬要远比他的身价高出数倍。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's all yours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他归你处置了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It will be done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Head on back and see the boss real soon, hear? Evening.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还是快点回去见老大吧，听到没？晚安啦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Time for the NCR to roast.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要好好让NCR烤烤火。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, to hell with this!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，别这么干！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm thinking I'm going to get a sweet Pre-War laser. What are you thinking?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在考虑要不要搞个牛逼的战前激光武器呢。你怎么想？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm thinking that I'm leaving because you are a sociopath. Good riddance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在考虑我应该离开你，因为你就是个反人类反社会的疯子。后会有期。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, uh... whoops, I thought that was to turn it off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哎呀……我还以为那个按钮是用来关掉它的呢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Argh, you moron! You're going to kill all of the troopers down there!
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊！你这个白痴！你会害死下面所有士兵的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's it. I'm out. Good luck getting out of this place without being shot to pieces by NCR soldiers, assuming they aren't going to fry to death.
ESP.TRADUIT: 够了。我不干了。祝你能平安从这儿出去吧，别被NCR士兵打成蜂窝，前提是他们还没被烤成焦炭。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am a win-ner! I am a win-ner!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是赢家！我是赢家！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks for the warning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多谢提醒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Be careful. You may want to talk to Lieutenant Hayes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小心点。你最好还是去和海耶斯中尉谈谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's in a tent down the road. Just stay on the west side of the overpass if you don't want to get shot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他就在那头的帐篷里。你最好待在高架桥的西边，否则可能会吃枪子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Reprogram Primm Slim to serve as Primm's Sheriff using parts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 使用零件来维修普瑞姆·斯利姆，将其调整为普瑞姆的警长。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Law Enforcement Protocols reinstated, pardner. Initializing use of force authorization... authorization found. Yee-haw!
ESP.TRADUIT: 执法数据已恢复，朋友。初始化武力使用许可…获得许可。咦哈！

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Reprogram Primm Slim to serve as Primm's Sheriff using 3 fission batteries and 4 conductors.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <使用3份核聚变合电池和4份导体来维修普瑞姆·斯利姆，将其设定为普瑞姆的警长。>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where the hell did you get this one. "Dog?" What, so you don't forget your name?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你身上的字是从哪儿来的？"狗？" 怎么，这样你就不会忘记自己的名字了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you so carved up - that a bear trap on your arm?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么浑身伤痕累累的，你胳膊上套的是一个捕熊夹吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'd think it was Spring the way tourists keep rolling in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这么多游客涌进来，还以为是春天来了呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dean Domino [010012FE] (file) Comment (NAM2) : Dean is talking to himself in these lines. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That one's got a head on their shoulders. For now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总算来了个有点脑子了。虽然只是暂时吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dean Domino [010012FE] (file) Comment (NAM2) : Dean is talking to himself in these lines. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hope that tourist is hurrying, haven't got all day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 希望那个游客动作快一点，我可没那么多时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dean Domino [010012FE] (file) Comment (NAM2) : Dean is talking to himself in these lines. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: At least this one seems like a straight shooter. Or sucker.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这家伙要么是个直肠子，要么就是个傻子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dean Domino [010012FE] (file) Comment (NAM2) : Dean is talking to himself in these lines. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That tourist crosses me, they'll regret it. Even if they don't, they still might.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个游客竟敢惹我，他会后悔的。即使没有，也可能会后悔的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dean Domino [010012FE] (file) Comment (NAM2) : Dean is talking to himself in these lines. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Should never have set that radio signal on repeat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真不该反复播放电台。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dean Domino [010012FE] (file) Comment (NAM2) : Dean is talking to himself in these lines. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you hear me? Signal should be stronger in here. I'll set this on loop... just in case I need to step away for a moment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 能听到吗？ 这里的信号应该强一些。我会把这段语音调成循环播放... 以免我有事不在。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Elijah [01001300] (file) Comment (NAM2) : Once inside the casino in Act 3, Elijah sets the radio on loop, now he's sure the player can hear him - they just can't talk back and forth. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now... if anything about our little heist went smoothly, you'd go to the Vault... except it's locked by some code I'm not familiar with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了…如果这场抢劫进展顺利的话，那么接下来你就该前往避难所了...只可惜，避难所被锁上了，而加密的方式我并不清楚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Elijah [01001300] (file) Comment (NAM2) : Once inside the casino in Act 3, Elijah sets the radio on loop, now he's sure the player can hear him - they just can't talk back and forth. EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: You did it... a voice lock. Why would he have done that? Uh! Never mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你成功了…居然是声控锁。他为什么要搞这种东西？啊！算了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Elijah [01001300] (file) Comment (NAM2) : Once inside the casino in Act 3, Elijah sets the radio on loop, now he's sure the player can hear him - they just can't talk back and forth. EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: End of line.
ESP.TRADUIT: 通话结束。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Elijah [01001300] (file) Comment (NAM2) : Once inside the casino in Act 3, Elijah sets the radio on loop, now he's sure the player can hear him - they just can't talk back and forth. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why the owner tied all of this to the Gala Event, insanity... backwards thinking, having a festival be your key. No wonder the bombs fell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么这儿的拥有者会将大门的开关和盛世庆典连接在一起……现在想想，居然将一场晚会作为自家开门的钥匙，难怪要挨核弹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Father Elijah [01001300] (file) Comment (NAM2) : All of Elijah's Act 2 messages are spoken as if he's talking to himself, the player is eavesdropping on him. (Same as Act 1) EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why pipe not break. Pipe. Break. Hnh. Leave it, not important.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么管子没有裂。管子，裂啊。唔，算了，也没那么重要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [01001301] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : < Dog notices the valve has been reinforced by the player. "Why won't you break?!" > EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Christine sniffs the air, then touches her neck and frowns. She gestures at the air and taps her wrist.]
ESP.TRADUIT: [克莉丝汀嗅了嗅，然后摸了一下自己的脖子，皱起眉头。她指着空气，敲了敲自己的手腕。]

ESP.ORIGINAL: [The Hologram nods.]
ESP.TRADUIT: [全息影像点了点头。]

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have anything I can buy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能从你这儿买点东西吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [The Hologram flickers in acknowledgement.]
ESP.TRADUIT: [全息影像闪了闪，以示告别。]

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goodbye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Christine nods at you, then the Ghost Person on the ground, makes a neck-chopping motion.]
ESP.TRADUIT: [克莉丝汀向你点点头，示意你看向倒在地上的鬼人，做了一个扭断脖子的动作。]

ESP.ORIGINAL: Better make sure he's dead. Poke him with a stick or something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最好确定他死透了再走。拿根棍子什么的戳他一下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, all of the Bighorners are dead. Problem solved!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，所有的大角羊都死了。问题解决了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's... not really what I was hoping for. I guess... I guess at least we don't have to worry about the Bighorners attacking the camp now. Hoy...
ESP.TRADUIT: 这... 完全不是我希望的。我猜... 我至少不用担心这些动物会再攻击我的部落了。唉...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me a little about this area - any interesting wildlife?
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我介绍一下这个地区，有什么有趣的野生动物吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You change your mind about helping out?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你改变主意要帮忙了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, about those Bighorners...
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，关于那些大角羊...

ESP.ORIGINAL: That doesn't sound like what I've heard about the New Canaanites...
ESP.TRADUIT: 这听起来和我所知道的关于新迦南人的信息好像不太一样...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Typical. Just when I get a useful minion...
ESP.TRADUIT: 不出所料，刚得到个有用的奴才...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have anything to trade?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有东西要交易吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. Take a look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可以的，你看看好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry to bother you with reality, ol' Jed. Who cares if we can't get back out the way we come? That's not a problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: {抱歉，老杰德，还是关注一下现在吧。鬼才在乎我们能不能找到回去的路？那不是个问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's 300 caps to cover the expenses.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是300个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That should cover it. Hold on. This shouldn't take long.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这应该足够了。别动，接下来要不了多长时间。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need medical supplies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要些医疗补给。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can provide medical assistance. I can even use supplies that we have here, but I can't just sell what we have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以提供一些医疗补给品。我甚至可以直接使用这里现成的，但我不能把我们这些东西卖给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need to address problems as they arise, and most of those have to do with the Sorrows or Dead Horses.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要多多储备以备不时之需，免得万一两个部落急需的时候药品短缺。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take a look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看一看吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, the usual. A few scrapes, burns, and bullet wounds.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，就是些普通的小伤。一些擦伤、烧伤，还有子弹伤。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Huh. You look fine to me. Physically, anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呵，我觉得你看起来还不错。至少表面上看起来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need some medical assistance. Can you help?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要一些医疗辅助。你能帮什么忙吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I should be able to address most common problems. What's the matter?
ESP.TRADUIT: 一些常见的问题我都没什么问题。怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: So this is the Ghost of She's lair. I was never brave enough to try to find it...
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是“她的幽灵”的巢穴。我从没想过自己会有勇气来到这里...

ESP.ORIGINAL: That thing actually flew once, like a big metal bird? Bet you don't have to follow chalk marks up there...
ESP.TRADUIT: 那玩意儿以前确实在天上飞过。看起来很像一只巨大的金属鸟，对吧？ 我敢打赌在那里不需要我的标记...

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know that guy! I got him a job!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认识这个人！我给了他一份工作！

ESP.ORIGINAL: A job as a singer? Then it really is true...
ESP.TRADUIT: 歌手的工作？那么这竟然是真的...

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're out of Stimpaks. Maybe you'd be better off with an Auto-Doc suit...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的治疗针用完了。或许你穿一件自动医疗服会更好...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stealth Suit Mk II [0300DA22] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: -No matter how awful my day had been, he... he was always waiting there. How odd. My gel is de-coagulating.-
ESP.TRADUIT: -无论以前我的生活有多糟糕，他…他总是在那儿等我。好奇怪的感觉，我的凝胶好像要融化了一样。-

ESP.ORIGINAL: -And when I would talk to him about Betsy - and how Marcus would beat on me and call me Smarty Sissy Pants, he'd just sit there, head on my knee.-
ESP.TRADUIT: -当我和他谈到贝琪，谈到马库斯怎样殴打我，骂我是自作聪明的娘娘腔废物的时候，他就坐在这儿，头靠在我的膝盖上。-
-还有…-

ESP.ORIGINAL: -If you don't mind, I'll take that bowl. Just... need to remove it. Put it away. Somewhere out of radar range.-
ESP.TRADUIT: -如果你不介意，我要拿走这个碗了。只是…要把它移开，放到我的雷达探测不到的地方。-

ESP.ORIGINAL: -For some reason, its similarity to the Crater-shape of Big MT is starting to fill up all available cognitive spaces.-
ESP.TRADUIT: -不知道为什么，这个与大山脉环形坑形状相同的碗，它好似要填满我的整个认知空间。-

ESP.ORIGINAL: -That, combined with my own overwhelming feeling of having done something terrible... the two are hitting me with... unexpected force.-
ESP.TRADUIT: -而且我有种强烈的感觉涌上心头，就像我做了什么很糟糕的事…这两者叠加起来…让我如遭重击。-

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um... maybe it's like a memory or something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃…这应该像是某段记忆之类的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] -Oh, well it is of NO CONSEQUENCE. Gabe gave himself for Science! As we all have!-
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败] -噢，你太大惊小怪了。加布献身给了科学！就像我们大家一样！-

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to buy some things.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想买些东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very good, sir. If I might suggest a table wine, the 64 Atomic Claret is a lovely little vintage.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，老爷。若您找的是佐餐酒，恕我失礼，64年的原子波尔多红葡萄酒是个不错的选择。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very good, sir. And might I venture to opine that a new Trilby might be just the thing to complete sir's ensemble?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，老爷。恕我失礼，我以为，再搭上顶新呢帽，您这身行头就更完美了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very good, sir. Should sir be in the market for a new suit of morning wear, I have several suggestions that might suit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，老爷。您若想添置一套晨间套服，我也许能提供些建议。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very good, sir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，老爷。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mean like this one?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说像这个？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There ya go! Have fun with that. Burn the fuckin' world for me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿好了，你爱怎么玩都行。替我把这个该死的世界烧掉！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Toaster Voice (NOT USED IN GAME) [0300F05F] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm ready, let's do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我准备好了，我们开始吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right. Just try to relax, this won't hurt - unless your sense of self is especially vulnerable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，试着放轻松，一点也不疼，除非你是一个对疼痛非常敏感的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Auto-Doc Voice (NOT USED IN GAME) [0300F066] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need my equipment repaired.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的装备需要修理一下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very good, sir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，老爷。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All due respect sir, I think you're making a mistake. We're close to a breakthrough with the Duraframe Eyebots, I can feel it! Yes, sir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恕我直言，长官，我认为你犯了个错误。我们即将在硬脊膜框架眼球机器人上取得突破，我能感觉到！遵命，长官。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Whitley [0400D311] (mod) NPC : ED-E [04004CDA] (mod) NPC : ED-E [0010C769] (mod) NPC : ED-E [001694E0] (mod) NPC : ED-E [001694E2] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes sir, I understand that we need the Duraframe assets for Hellfire armor, but-No, sir. Yes, sir. I understand, sir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，长官，我明白我们需要硬脊膜框架的资产来制造地狱火装甲，但是 -不，长官。遵命，长官。我明白了，长官。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Whitley [0400D311] (mod) NPC : ED-E [04004CDA] (mod) NPC : ED-E [0010C769] (mod) NPC : ED-E [001694E0] (mod) NPC : ED-E [001694E2] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll tell the team to start disassembling the ED series prototypes right away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会让团队马上开始拆解ED系列的原型机。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Whitley [0400D311] (mod) NPC : ED-E [04004CDA] (mod) NPC : ED-E [0010C769] (mod) NPC : ED-E [001694E0] (mod) NPC : ED-E [001694E2] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: ED-E, you little rascal. Were you eavesdropping again? I think those videos you watch are a bad influence on you. How much of that did you hear?
ESP.TRADUIT: ED-E，你这个小淘气，你又在偷听了？我觉得你看的那些视频对你有不好的影响。你听到了多少？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Whitley [0400D311] (mod) NPC : ED-E [04004CDA] (mod) NPC : ED-E [0010C769] (mod) NPC : ED-E [001694E0] (mod) NPC : ED-E [001694E2] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Sad beeping>
ESP.TRADUIT: <悲伤的哔哔声>
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Whitley [0400D311] (mod) NPC : ED-E [04004CDA] (mod) NPC : ED-E [0010C769] (mod) NPC : ED-E [001694E0] (mod) NPC : ED-E [001694E2] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm... didn't Dr. Grant say she'd upgraded your navigational systems? I think I have an idea... How'd you like to be just like RALPHIE?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯... 格兰特博士不是说她升级了你的导航系统吗？我想我有个主意... 你想不想跟拉尔菲一样 ?
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Whitley [0400D311] (mod) NPC : ED-E [04004CDA] (mod) NPC : ED-E [0010C769] (mod) NPC : ED-E [001694E0] (mod) NPC : ED-E [001694E2] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There are more robots like you? With the same memory and everything? Interesting...
ESP.TRADUIT: 像你这样的机器人还有很多吗？拥有同样的记忆和一切？有趣...

ESP.ORIGINAL: If... if you're really sure you want this, okay. Go ahead and stop the missile. And... goodbye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果...如果你真的想这样，好吧，去阻止导弹吧。还有...再见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Determined beeping>
ESP.TRADUIT: <坚决的哔哔声>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on. We're ending this. Right now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来吧。我们要结束这一切，就现在。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Determined beeping>
ESP.TRADUIT: <坚决的哔哔声>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those Marked Men in Hopeville - some had strange masks and blades I'd never seen before.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些黎明镇的烙印者...有些人戴着我从未见过的奇怪面具和刀刃。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They bear false versions of Legate Lanius' mask, the one Caesar fashioned for him. Thought it was an insult at first... know better now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们都戴着着山寨的拉尼厄斯特使面具，那是凯撒为他量身订做的。起初还以为这是一种侮辱...现在我明白了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's shaped from Divide metal, not with care and strength, but with hate. Keeps them anchored.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它是以大裂谷的金属制成的，这之中夹杂的并非谨慎与力量，而是怨恨。戴上后便如同烙印般难以摘下了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Crude, effective - like the blades they carry, distant mirrors of their Legate. A symbol they can hold on to - while the Divide tears at them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 粗糙，但有效 - 正如他们背负的刀剑，他们军团特使的遥远镜像。当大裂谷撕扯他们的时候，一个可以坚持下去的象征。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一些其他的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Questions have a habit of making others.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问题总是层出不穷。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the history of it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 它有什么历史？

ESP.ORIGINAL: History? Cures a wound, leaves the bitterness that caused it. The Twin Mothers were always about lessons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 历史？治好了伤口，留下了造成伤口的苦痛。孪生母亲部落总是在吸取教训。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar taught them the last one, though, so that's it for them. Recipe still exists, Legion uses it on forced marches with wounded soldiers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒给了她们最后一个, 所以她们就这样了。配方依然存在，军团把它用在急行军的伤兵身上。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wouldn't have made it through Crimson River Trail a few years back without it - losing so much blood early on, was a Cazador feast.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果没有它几年前就无法成功穿过红河小径了-否则在早期就失去了那么多的血液的话,只会成为毒蜂的美餐

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enough Xander root and Broc flower along the trail though, the Legion was able to keep pace and get where they were going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多亏了小径沿途有足够的山德根和布洛克花，军团才能保证行军速度并最后到达目的地。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why would they want to stay here if this place is killing them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果是这个地方害死了他们，他们为什么还想留在这里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] There's truth in your words, in what I've seen of their tactics, movements - recovery. Those wounds - they couldn't live otherwise.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]你的话很有道理，我看过他们的战术、动作 - 回复。那些伤口 - 否则他们无法生存。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Divide winds have torn the skin from many of them - may be the radiation is the only thing keeping them walking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大裂谷的风已经撕裂了他们中许多人的皮肤 - 或许辐射辐射是唯一能让他们行走的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Make camp near silos... warheads. No way to cleanse the radiation - makes them hard to kill there, have to draw them out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在发射井附近扎营...弹头。无法清除辐射 - 使得他们很难被杀死，必须把他们引出来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Radiation may keep them alive in areas so physically punishing, it would kill others - even Ghouls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在辐射对躯体的摧残如此残酷的地区能活下来，这地方能杀死其他任何生物 - 甚至是尸鬼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The rads in this place seem like they would do more damage to them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这地方的辐射似乎会对他们造成更大的伤害。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] There's truth in your words, in what I've seen of their tactics, movements - recovery. Those wounds - they couldn't live otherwise.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]你的话很有道理，我看过他们的战术、动作 - 回复。那些伤口 - 否则他们无法生存。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Divide winds have torn the skin from many of them - may be the radiation is the only thing keeping them walking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大裂谷的风已经撕裂了他们中许多人的皮肤 - 或许辐射辐射是唯一能让他们行走的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Make camp near silos... warheads. No way to cleanse the radiation - makes them hard to kill there, have to draw them out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在发射井附近扎营...弹头。无法清除辐射 - 使得他们很难被杀死，必须把他们引出来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If they've become Ghouls, the radiation would strengthen them. Heal their wounds - not the scars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他们已经变成尸鬼，辐射会强化他们。愈合他们的伤口...而不是疤痕。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aww, I'm blushing!
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，我脸都红了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's so nice of you to say! Thank you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你太会说话了！谢谢！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you're embarrassing me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你真让我难为情！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why thank you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 太感谢你了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hang on a second. Do you have any spare ammo?
ESP.TRADUIT: 稍等一下，你有没有多余的弹药给我一点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I can spare a few rounds.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我可以分你点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sergeant Benjamin Montgomery [070009C2] (mod) Quest : ([070009BF]DLC02OA2) The Guns of Anchorage EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not looking for trouble. I'm just here because of the radio signal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是来找麻烦的，我是因为电台信号才在这儿的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You heard our signal? How'd you manage that? It's not broadcast on a standard frequency...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你收听到我们的信号？怎么做到的？我们又没有在标准频率上广播…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Morrill [07000E26] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...oh, I see. You've got one of those wrist-mounted computers. Well, well. Isn't that interesting.
ESP.TRADUIT: …哦，我明白了。你有那种戴在手腕上的电脑。好啦，好啦。很有趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Morrill [07000E26] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How the hell did you hear my signal? It's not broadcast on a standard frequency...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么收听到我的信号的？我们又没有在标准频率上广播…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Morrill [07000E26] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...oh, I see. You've got one of those wrist-mounted computers. Well, well. Isn't that interesting.
ESP.TRADUIT: …哦，我明白了。你有那种戴在手腕上的电脑。好啦，好啦。很有趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Morrill [07000E26] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard your radio signal, and thought I'd come and lend a hand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听到了你们的电台信号，觉得我该来帮下忙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I had to kill a few of your guys to get a suit that looked good on me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，我非得杀掉一些你的人来弄一件衣服，这衣服我穿上看起来很不错。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You filthy fucking wastelander... You're dead, you hear me? Dead!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这肮脏的垃圾废土游民…你死定了，听见了没有？死定了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Morrill [07000E26] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you some kind of idiot? Listen, little girl... hey, wait a second. What's that on your wrist there? Some kind of computer?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是白痴吗？听着，小姑娘…喂，你手腕上那个是什么？是不是某种电脑？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Morrill [07000E26] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just looking for my dad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是在找我的爸爸。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you some kind of idiot? Listen, kid... hey, wait a second. What's that on your wrist there? Some kind of computer?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是白痴吗？听着，小伙子…喂，你手腕上那个是什么？是不是某种电脑？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Morrill [07000E26] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just looking for my dad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是在找我的爸爸。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suggest you turn right around before you find yourself full of holes. We've taken over this sector, and...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我建议你在被打成马蜂窝之前立即向后转。这里是我们的地盘，还有…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Morrill [07000E26] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hang on. Is that some kind of computer on your wrist?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等一下。你手腕上那个是某种电脑吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Morrill [07000E26] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just stopped in to ransack the place. Didn't expect to find anyone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是顺便打一下劫。没想到会找到什么人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What, this armor? I found it. Honest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么，这装甲？我找到的它。老实说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh huh. Well, now that you've been nice enough to return it to us...
ESP.TRADUIT: 呵呵。你人还不错啊，居然能把它还给我们…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Morrill [07000E26] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...hey, what's that on your wrist? That's some kind of computer, isn't it?
ESP.TRADUIT: …喂，你手腕上那个是什么？是不是某种电脑？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Morrill [07000E26] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, isn't that nice of you. Looks like things have calmed down now, so why don't you just run along...
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，你真是太好了。看起来事情平息了，你为什么不离开呢…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Morrill [07000E26] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...hey, what's that on your wrist? That's some kind of computer, isn't it?
ESP.TRADUIT: …喂，你手腕上那个是什么？是不是某种电脑？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Morrill [07000E26] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, I just wandered in here, and it looked like you guys needed help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，我只是在这儿闲逛，看上去你的兄弟需要帮助。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've dealt with your group before. Fort Independence, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我之前已经处理了你的小组。独立堡，是不？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, that is our main base of operations in the area. If Casdin is willing to trust you, then I hope we can work together.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，那就是我们在本区行动的主基地。如果卡斯丁能够信任你，那我希望我们可以一起工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd be happy to help, provided there's something in it for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会很乐意帮忙，前提是我能得到些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're not wrong. So for now I'll overlook the fact that you've got some of our tech.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是对的。到目前为止我才注意到你拥有我们某些科技。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you can assist us, it'll be worth your while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你肯帮助我们，我们会报答你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Guilty as charged. But it looks like you need help just the same.
ESP.TRADUIT: 罪如其判。但看上去你同样需要帮助。

ESP.ORIGINAL: IF you can help, then I suspect it will definitely be worth your time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你肯帮忙，我们一定会报答你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, who wouldn't want to help out the surly guys in scary armor?
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，谁不乐意帮助那些穿着吓人装甲的粗暴家伙们解决问题呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That device on your wrist. That's not our tech. That, and the fact that none of us would be stupid enough to take our armor off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你手腕上戴的那个设备。那不是我们的科技产物。我们还不会笨到把我们的护甲脱下来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is the part where I'd have you killed. At least, under normal circumstances.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这里我本可以杀了你的。至少在一般的情况下会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, it turns out you might be useful to us. If you can help, I'll forget that you should be dead for wearing that armor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但，看来你可能对我们有用。如果你肯帮忙，我可以原谅你胆敢穿着那护甲的死罪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么知道？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That device on your wrist. That's not our tech.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你手腕上戴的那个设备。那不是我们的科技产物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is the part where I'd have you killed. At least, under normal circumstances.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这里我本可以杀了你的。至少在一般的情况下会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, it turns out you might be useful to us. If you can help, I'll forget that you should be dead for wearing that armor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但，看来你可能对我们有用。如果你肯帮忙，我可以原谅你穿着那护甲的死罪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么知道？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, fine. I get it. I'm not trying to intimidate you here. I just need your help, and we can both come out of this better off than we are now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，好吧。我懂了。我不会胁迫你的。我只是需要你的帮助，有事好商量嘛。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That computer on your wrist there. I need that, and I need you to use it. Okay? That's it. No one's going to hurt you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你手腕上那个电脑。我需要它，而且我需要你来使用它。好吗？就这样。没人会伤害你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope we're talking "helpful" useful, and not "tasty" useful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望我们的谈话有助益的价值，不是有好吃的价值。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not an idiot. That computer you've got on your wrist there? That's not our tech.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是白痴。你手腕上戴的那个电脑？那不是我们的科技产物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So how about you tell me what you're really doing here before I have you killed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我叫人杀了你之前，告诉我你到底来这里做什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? No, of course I'm one of you... uhh, sir. <Lie>
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？不，我当然是你们中的一员……呃，长官。<撒谎>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do we look like cannibals? Are you really that dense?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们看起来像是食人者吗？你不会这么笨吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That computer on your wrist is what I'm talking about. I need that computer -- and the person attached to it -- to access the technology here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说的是你手腕上戴的那个电脑。我需要那个电脑 — 还有戴着它的人 — 来访问这里的科技。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I must have something you want, so let's cut to the chase.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我这儿肯定有些你需要的，那我们就开门见山吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Heh, all right. You're obviously sharper than the average rubble dweller.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呵，好吧。很明显，你看起来要比那些一般的平民要聪明得多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That computer you've got on your wrist is a specialized piece of equipment. I need someone who knows how to use it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你手腕上那个电脑是种专门的设备。我需要懂得使用它的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you can be that someone, I'm willing to work with you to make your life easier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你肯帮忙，我很乐意和你一起工作，让你的人生更美好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, my Pip-Boy makes me unique, and you need my help because of that...
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，我的哔哔小子使我很特别，为此你需要我的帮助……

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you do have half a brain. That's good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这么看来你还有点脑子。很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll keep it simple. I need you, and I need that computer of yours. You help me out, and I'll do what I can to help you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我长话短说。我需要你，还需要你那个电脑。你帮助我，我就会尽我所能帮助你。
