ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This isn't an offer the Outcasts extend to anyone, so you really should think carefully about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一般情况下放逐者不会提供这样的机会，所以你要好好考虑一下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Troop, you are having a serious malfunction... Would you listen to yourself? That's treason!
ESP.TRADUIT: 士兵们，你们犯了严重的错误…你会听从自己吗？那是叛国！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Sibley [07000E24] (mod) NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) NPC : Specialist Olin [07000E22] (mod) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: No! No, no, no no. You want to talk crazy, do it someplace else. I'm keeping my mouth shut and following orders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不！不不不不。你要胡说八道的话就找错地方了。我不和你废话，按照命令办事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Sibley [07000E24] (mod) NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) NPC : Specialist Olin [07000E22] (mod) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's say we DO find some really high-grade tech. Seems to me, a group of enterprising grunts could strike off on their own. Go... independent.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这么说吧，我们的确找到一些相当高级的科技。在我看来，一个可以让集团自力更生的可能。争取…独立。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Sibley [07000E24] (mod) NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) NPC : Specialist Olin [07000E22] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just hear me out. I've been thinking… imagine what a group like Talon Company could do with the two of us. Huh? You and me, goin' merc...
ESP.TRADUIT: 听我说。我一直在想，像鹰爪公司这样的企业会不会需要我们两个？嗯？你和我，去做佣兵…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Sibley [07000E24] (mod) NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) NPC : Specialist Olin [07000E22] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm ready to change to Heavy Weapons gear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我准备好换成重装强袭装备了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll just take care of all your old gear for you and here are the new ones.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来保管你所有的旧装备，给你新的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everything appears to be in order. Here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来一切井然有序。给。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm ready for my Heavy Weapons gear. Here's my Requisition Holotape.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我准备好换成重装强袭装备了。这是我的装备申请表。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm ready to change to Sniper gear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我准备好换成远程狙击装备了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll just take care of all your old gear for you and here are the new ones.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来保管你所有的旧装备，给你新的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everything appears to be in order. Here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来一切井然有序。给。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm ready for my Sniper gear. Here's my Requisition Holotape.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我准备好换成远程狙击装备了。这是我的装备申请表。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm ready to change to Close Assault gear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我准备好换成近距突击装备了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll just take care of all your old gear for you and here are the new ones.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来保管你所有的旧装备，给你新的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everything appears to be in order. Here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来一切井然有序。给。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm ready for my Close Assault gear. Here's my Requisition Holotape.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我准备好换成近距突击装备了。这是我的装备申请表。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm ready to change to Fire Team gear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我准备好换成火力支援装备了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll just take care of all your old gear for you and here are the new ones.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来保管你所有的旧装备，给你新的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everything appears to be in order. Here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来一切井然有序。给。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm ready for my Fire Team gear. Here's my Requisition Holotape.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我准备好换成火力支援装备了。这是我的装备申请表。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, sorry. I'm just trying to figure out what's going on here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，对不起。我只是想知道这儿现在什么状况。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's going on is this whole mission is one big rat-fuck. We've been stuck here for way too long with no results.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在的状况就是，这整个任务是个天大的笑话。我们陷入了泥潭中，长时间没有进展。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Sibley [07000E24] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: McGraw won't give up, so we've stooped to using chumps like you to try and get something out of this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 麦格劳不会放弃的，所以我们才会降低要求使用像你这种傻瓜。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Sibley [07000E24] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why exactly do you need me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为何你就是需要我？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I suppose if you don't mind us hacking off your forearm, we don't really.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是你不介意我们把你前臂剁下来，我们才不需要你呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Specialist Olin [07000E22] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The sim is looking for an external interface. I haven't quite figured out why, but there's no way to bypass it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 模拟程序需要一个外部接口。我没弄明白那是为什么，但也没办法绕开它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Specialist Olin [07000E22] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your Pip-Boy there is a match. So since you're the one wearing it, you're the one running through the simulation. Get it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你那哔哔小子完全符合。既然你戴着它，就由你去进行模拟程序。懂了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Specialist Olin [07000E22] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you tell me more about what you're doing here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能告诉我更多关于你在这儿的工作吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The same thing we always do. Recover technology and preserve it, making sure it doesn't fall into the wrong hands.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是我们一直在做的事情：找到科技所在，把它保存好，确保它不会落入敌手。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Specialist Olin [07000E22] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: McGraw's hope is that whatever's in here will give us a big advantage. I'm not convinced, but I'm on his side.
ESP.TRADUIT: 麦格劳希望不论这里有什么，都能让我们受益无穷。我不大相信这个，但我站在他那边。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Specialist Olin [07000E22] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can you tell me about this simulation?
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于这种模拟，你能告诉我些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: *Sigh* I find your level of ignorance disgusting... if not unexpected.
ESP.TRADUIT: *叹气* 你的无知让我感到恶心…那也是意料之中的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Specialist Olin [07000E22] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This sim had to have been one of the most important of its time -- it's the liberation of Anchorage, Alaska from the Chinese.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个程序展示了那个时代最重要的事件之一 — 从中国人手里解放阿拉斯加的安克雷奇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Specialist Olin [07000E22] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Eventually, the Americans went in and liberated the city, but there were heavy losses. This simulation trained soldiers for that engagement!
ESP.TRADUIT: 最后，美国人出兵解放了城市，但付出了沉重的代价。这个模拟程序就是为那次战斗训练士兵用的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Specialist Olin [07000E22] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really, you must brush up on your history.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的，你该复习一下历史了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Specialist Olin [07000E22] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's enough. McGraw's in charge, so we follow his orders, no matter how much we don't like it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 够了。麦格劳是头儿，所以我们服从他的命令，就算我们多不愿意都要服从。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Sibley [07000E24] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on, man. How long you gonna let McGraw screw us over like this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜托，伙计。你还要让麦格劳像这样搞多久？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood Outcast [07004DE5] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Man, this is the last thing we need...
ESP.TRADUIT: 伙计，这就是我们想要的最后一件东西…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood Outcast [07004DE5] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're dismissed from the Strike Team, soldier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你被逐出突击组了，士兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right away, sir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 遵命，长官。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sergeant Benjamin Montgomery [070009C2] (mod) NPC : Quartermaster [07002D22] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, yeah... so I was wrong. Let's keep moving.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，嗯…原来我错了。我们继续走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sergeant Benjamin Montgomery [070009C2] (mod) Quest : ([070009BF]DLC02OA2) The Guns of Anchorage EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Send Team to Rally Point: Mines.
ESP.TRADUIT: 派遣队伍前往集合点：矿井。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes sir. On our way. We'll wait for you by the Mining Town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，长官。立即出发。我们会在矿镇等你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sergeant Benjamin Montgomery [070009C2] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait for me just outside the Mining Town on the way to the Listening Post.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在去监听站路上的矿镇外等我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Done with Ice Camp. Send Team to Rally Point: Chimera.
ESP.TRADUIT: 冰雪营地清剿完毕。派遣队伍前往集合点：奇美拉维修站。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes sir. On our way. We'll wait for you by the Chimera Depot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，长官。立即出发。我们会在奇美拉维修站等你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sergeant Benjamin Montgomery [070009C2] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now that the Ice Camp is out of the way, head up to the Chimera Depot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 既然冰雪营地已经解决，前往奇美拉维修站。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Done with Mines. Send Team to Rally Point: Listening Post.
ESP.TRADUIT: 矿井清剿完毕。派遣队伍前往集合点：监听站。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes sir. On our way. We'll wait for you by the Listening Post.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，长官。立即出发。我们会在监听站等你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sergeant Benjamin Montgomery [070009C2] (mod) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now that we've dealt with the Mining Town, head to the Listening Post.
ESP.TRADUIT: 既然矿镇已经解决，前往监听站。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it's about goddamned time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，真他妈是时候。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Sibley [07000E24] (mod) Quest : ([070014F6]DLC02OA4) Operation: Anchorage! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: About damn time the reinforcements showed up! Fall in, soldier!
ESP.TRADUIT: 援军来的正是时候！冲啊，士兵们！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Morrill [07000E26] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've got multiple hostiles between here and the base camp. We're sweeping the area to secure it. Let's move!
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这里到敌营之间有很多敌军。我们正在横扫此处消灭敌人。出发！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Defender Morrill [07000E26] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The stuff you have is okay, but I need something with more... punch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你给的玩意儿都还行，但我需要一些更…带劲的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hell, you earned a lot of respect with the soldiers for what you did to those Chinese artillery guns.
ESP.TRADUIT: 管他呢，你摧毁了那些中国军队火炮，赢得了很多士兵的尊重。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell you what... take this extra gear with you, requisitions be damned. If anyone asks, it fell off a truck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这样吧…拿上这个附加装备吧，去他的申请表。如果有人问到，就说是从卡车上掉下来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Audio log begin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 语音记录开始。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is Captain Zachary Lloyd, United States Army, Anchorage, Alaska security detachment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是扎卡里·劳埃德中尉，美国陆军，安克雷奇，阿拉斯加防卫特遣队。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Approximately 23 minutes ago, Chinese Communist forces set foot on Anchorage soil, despite our soldiers' best efforts to prevent that landing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大约23分钟之前，中国军队冲破我们士兵的全力防守，踏上安克雷奇的领土。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As expected, the Chinese have launched a two-pronged attack - one aimed at occupying Anchorage proper, and the other at securing this base.
ESP.TRADUIT: 正如我们所料的，中国军队兵分两路发起进攻 - 其中一路目标是攻占安克雷奇本身，另一路则是攻占本基地。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks to our entrenchment, U.S. casualties here on the mountain are currently minimal, but that's not going to last for long.
ESP.TRADUIT: 得益于我们坚固的防御工事，目前美军在山上边的伤亡在最小限度内，但坚持不了太长时间。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But that's not going to last for long. Chinese reinforcements appear to be... endless. It's just a matter of time before we're overrun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但坚持不了太长时间。中国军队的援兵看起来好像…源源不绝。我们被击溃只是时间问题了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll die today, but by God we'll give those Communist sonsabitches a black eye they'll never forget.
ESP.TRADUIT: 今天我们难免一死，但上帝会保佑我们给予杂种中共一次永生难忘的羞辱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lloyd out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 劳埃德录音完毕。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, guess I'll get to it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我想我会着手去做的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, great. The sooner you're done, the sooner we can leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，太棒了。你越快完成，我们就能越早离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Specialist Olin [07000E22] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: First you need to put on the Neural Interface suit, and then you can get going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要先穿上神经接口服，才能继续。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Specialist Olin [07000E22] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, I'm just here to help. I heard your radio broadcast.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，我只是来这儿帮忙的。我听到了你们的电台信号。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you're certainly not the help that Morrill had in mind, but from the looks of you, you might be useful in other ways.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你当然不是起着莫里尔所想的那种作用，但从你的外表看来，你在其他某些方面有用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was just exploring. I didn't mean to intrude.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是在探索。我不是故意闯入的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Under different circumstances, that wouldn't be nearly enough of an explanation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在不同的情况下，那还不能构成一个解释。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But... I think you can be helpful, and so I'll overlook it for now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是…我想你是有用的，现在我就可以预见到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're fine now. Just be careful out there, all right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你现在好了。小心行动，好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doctor Adami [0700B56E] (mod) Quest : ([070034DA]DLC02FF) DLC02FF Comment (NAM2) : doctor encourage a healed patient to get back into the fight EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe I'd better just go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许我最好走开。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. See you around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。再见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood Outcast [0700C3C8] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, hell of a fight. Mind if I head in?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，一场苦战。介意我加入吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, of course. Go on through.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，当然。继续。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood Outcast [0700C3C8] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're clear, but the pet Frankenstein stays up here...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以过去了，但你的宠物科学怪人得留在这儿…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood Outcast [0700C3C8] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, but the zombie stays here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，但这个丧尸得留在这儿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood Outcast [0700C3C8] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No problem, but your friend stays topside with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没问题，但你的朋友得和我留在上面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood Outcast [0700C3C8] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No problem, but leave the bot here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没问题，但机器人得留在这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood Outcast [0700C3C8] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, but Lyons' woman stays topside. You head in. Alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，但里昂斯的女人得留在上面。你一个人进去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood Outcast [0700C3C8] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, but make sure that stray pooch doesn't tag along.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，但你要确保那条野狗不会乱跑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood Outcast [0700C3C8] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, of course. Go on through.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，当然。继续。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood Outcast [0700C3C8] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, can I get by?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，我能通过吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, but your pet Frankenstein stays here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，但你的宠物科学怪人要留在这儿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood Outcast [0700C3C8] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, can I get by?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，我能通过吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, but the zombie stays up here, where I can keep an eye on it...
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，但丧尸要留在这里，我要看着它…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood Outcast [0700C3C8] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, can I get by?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，我能通过吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No problem, but your friend stays topside with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没问题，但你的朋友要和我留在上面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood Outcast [0700C3C8] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, can I get by?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，我能通过吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No problem, but leave the bot here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没问题，但机器人要留在这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood Outcast [0700C3C8] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, can I get by?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，我能通过吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, but Lyons' woman stays topside. You head in. Alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，但里昂斯的女人在最上面。你一个人进去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood Outcast [0700C3C8] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, can I get by?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，我能通过吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, but make sure that stray pooch doesn't tag along.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，但你要确保那条野狗不会乱跑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood Outcast [0700C3C8] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, can I get by?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，我能通过吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Morrill radioed ahead. I'm supposed to meet Protector McGraw.
ESP.TRADUIT: 莫里尔在前边收发电台信号。我想应该会见到护卫麦格劳。

ESP.ORIGINAL: About time. Report to Protector McGraw, but leave your friend with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来得真准时。去向护卫麦格劳报道，但你要把你的朋友留在这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood Outcast [0700C3C8] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I'm headed down now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，我现在动身。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've got some nerve bringing Lyons' bitch here. You go down. Alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你居然敢带里昂斯的婊子来这里，胆子不小啊。你只能一个人下去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood Outcast [0700C3C8] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: No dogs allowed. Head down, but leave the mutt with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 狗不能进去。你下去，但把狗留在这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brotherhood Outcast [0700C3C8] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, great. Let me guess, more psychotic little girls...
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，太好了。让我猜猜，那些太神经质的小女孩们……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Umm... Noooo...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the liberation of Anchorage, Alaska from Chinese Communists. It was a pretty significant event in American history, according to our Scribe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是从中国军队手中解放阿拉斯加的安克雷奇。根据我们的历史记载，这是美国历史上一个具有重要意义的事件。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're talking front line, heavy combat -- safety protocols disengaged. That means you die in the sim... your body goes into massive cardiac arrest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们说的是在战场上，战斗会很激烈 — 没有使用安全协议。意味着你在模拟程序中死了…你的肉体的心跳也会停止。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're still listening, so I'm going to assume you're interested. But time's wasting. Sibley can take you to the pod. Olin will get you briefed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还在听嘛，那我当你是有兴趣喽。但没多少时间了。西布利会带你去模拟仓。奥林会给你作简报。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you want to walk away, you're free to leave. My men won't stop you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你不想干，可以自由离去，我的人不会阻拦你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Protector McGraw [07000E23] (mod) Quest : ([070009BE]DLC02OA1) Aiding the Outcasts EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...<laughs>You almost sound like a sympathizer - you really feel sorry for the poor saps?
ESP.TRADUIT: …<大笑>你听起来很像是个同情者 - 你真的为那些可怜的家伙感到难过？

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...<static>...
Yeah, exactly. They're in for a long haul.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，确实。他们会长期加入。

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...<static>...
You'd think, but they're not like us. Their boys are drafted and left to rot on whatever shit assignment they're handed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以这么想，但他们不像我们。他们的人接到任务后就没人管了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...<static>...
No, no - it's not that at all. I get that the Chinese occupation in Alaska is strictly military, but don't you think they'd settle in a bit?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，不 - 完全不是那样。我了解到中国军队是军事占领阿拉斯加，但难道你认为他们不会在那里殖民吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...yeah, I can. Don't know who exactly this simulation is supposed to benefit, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: …嗯，我可以。但不知道究竟是谁会因这个模拟而受益。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0700C337] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Overheard office chatter. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...<static>...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0700C337] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Overheard office chatter. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jesus, are these guys serious? Why would they bring that kind of hardware with them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 上帝啊，这些人搞什么啊？他们为何要带着那种硬件？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0700C337] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Overheard office chatter. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...<static>...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0700C337] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Overheard office chatter. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got word from brass at the Pentagon. We're going to need to modify the RoE on the Chinese to match this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 五角大楼的混蛋们传过话来了。我们必须调整中国军队的RoE来和这个相配。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0700C337] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Overheard office chatter. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...<static>...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0700C337] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Overheard office chatter. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We just got more field reports from DoD. Hey, Rick. You busy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们刚从国防部那里得到战地报告。嗨, 里克。你有空吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0700C337] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Overheard office chatter. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gary?
ESP.TRADUIT: 加里？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0700C339] (ID) NPC : [0700C337] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Use the innocent sounding one from base game with sawing and wet sounds in the background. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Listen, son, I know Morrill was rough on you. I'm sorry, I really am -
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，孩子，我知道莫里尔对你不好。我很抱歉，真的很抱歉 -
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0700C339] (ID) NPC : [0700C337] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Use the innocent sounding one from base game with sawing and wet sounds in the background. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gary? Gary?
ESP.TRADUIT: 加里？ 加里？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0700C339] (ID) NPC : [0700C337] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Use the innocent sounding one from base game with sawing and wet sounds in the background. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right. You can drop the act, now. I'm not here to hurt you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对。你现在别再演戏了。我不是来伤害你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0700C339] (ID) NPC : [0700C337] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Use the innocent sounding one from base game with sawing and wet sounds in the background. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gary?
ESP.TRADUIT: 加里？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0700C339] (ID) NPC : [0700C337] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Use the innocent sounding one from base game with sawing and wet sounds in the background. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <heavy sigh> Look, just remove the PIP-Boy and we can part ways.
ESP.TRADUIT: <沉重的叹气> 这样吧，把你的哔哔小子拿下来，我们有话好商量。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0700C339] (ID) NPC : [0700C337] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Use the innocent sounding one from base game with sawing and wet sounds in the background. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gary? GARY!
ESP.TRADUIT: 加里？ 加里！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0700C339] (ID) NPC : [0700C337] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Use the innocent sounding one from base game with sawing and wet sounds in the background. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know what? Fuck this. Hand me that saw - and turn off the recorder.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，他妈的，把那锯子给我 - 还有把录音机关掉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0700C339] (ID) NPC : [0700C337] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Use the innocent sounding one from base game with sawing and wet sounds in the background. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gaaaaaaary...
ESP.TRADUIT: 加里...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0700C339] (ID) NPC : [0700C337] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Use the innocent sounding one from base game with sawing and wet sounds in the background. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, I do. He's the one who brought me here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。就是他带我来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I appreciate your honesty. It's a rare virtue in this age.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我欣赏你的坦诚，这是这个时代少有的德行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : appearing open and welcoming, while offering a lightly-veiled threat EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wernher was my lieutenant until he betrayed me and escaped justice. And if I know him, he brought you here to steal something very dear to the city.
ESP.TRADUIT: 沃纳是我的副官，直到他背叛了我，还逃过了裁决。就我对他的了解，他是派你来这偷窃对这座城市来说某件非常珍贵的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : appearing open and welcoming, while offering a lightly-veiled threat

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you intend to follow through with his plan? Feel free to be honest. Please, don't be intimidated by the turret behind you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你打算坚持他的计划吗？别拘束，说实话，请不要被你身后的炮塔吓倒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : appearing open and welcoming, while offering a lightly-veiled threat EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just here to kill you and reap the profits.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来这里是为了杀掉你并找到档案的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I figured it'd be something like that. Goodbye, new blood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经预感到了。再见了，新兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Calmly signing the player's death warrant EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm the badass who'll be running this place once I kill you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一旦我杀掉你之后，我就会成为管理这里的大坏蛋。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I figured it'd be something like that. Goodbye, new blood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经预感到了。再见了，新兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Calmly signing the player's death warrant EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm the hero who's going to kill you and free the slaves!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是来杀掉你并解放奴隶的英雄！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Watch where you're going, meat!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当心，肉！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slave Guard [08000F1F] (mod) NPC : Slave Guard [08000F22] (mod) Quest : ([08000F32]DLC01GuardTest) 08000F32 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just head back and talk to Sandra. She'll explain all about the cure. Then you'll see why you have to put an end to Wernher.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回去跟桑德拉谈谈，她会解释解药的来龙去脉，然后你将明白，你为什么必须干掉沃纳。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suggest you forget Wernher's offer, and consider mine: stop Wernher, and you'll have a bright future in The Pitt. Don't disappoint me, new blood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我建议你忘掉沃纳的请求，考虑一下我的：阻止沃纳，在匹兹堡你将有光明的未来。别让我失望，新兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's an interesting way to put it. But yes, I suppose the city's future does rest squarely upon it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这么说倒是很有趣，不过也是，我认为这座城市的未来确实仰仗于此。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : interrupted at the end. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Something tells me you won't want the responsibility that comes with it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜想你不是会愿意承担这个东西所附带的责任的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : interrupted at the end. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, someone of your character would be much better off if you just...
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，你会过得好起来的，只要你……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : interrupted at the end. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He said you had the key to ruling the city, and I'm here to collect.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他说你有统治这座城市的关键，而我是来得到那个关键。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Easy enough. You could say no because he lied to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 简单极了。他欺骗了你，你应该对他说不。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Interrupted at end. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My discovery is a miracle, but it isn't the type that sets slaves free.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的发现是个奇迹，不过它本身不可能给予奴隶们自由。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Interrupted at end. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, it would do a lot more good if you were to...
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，它将会带来更多的好处，要是你……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Interrupted at end. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He said your discovery will free the slaves and cure them. How could I say no?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他说你的发现能够解放奴隶，并治愈他们。我无法拒绝。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, it's valuable. I'd say there's nothing I care more about in the world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，它很珍贵。我要说这世上再没什么其他东西比它更让我在意的了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Interrupted at end EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: But Wernher doesn't truly appreciate everything it means to me, or to The Pitt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过沃纳确实不欣赏它对我，或者对匹兹堡来说所意味的一切。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Interrupted at end EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, if caps are all you want, I can make you a much better offer than that snake, and all you have to do is...
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，如果瓶盖就是你想要的，我可以出比那毒蛇更好的价钱，而且你要做的只是……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Interrupted at end EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: He wanted me to steal a valuable cure. I'm just in it for the caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他要我去偷一些高价的药品。我就是为了他的瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where did you get that powered armor?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在哪里搞到那套动力装甲的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not in the slightest. During the Scourge, we looted The Pitt and left the rest of it to rot. I was just a dumb convert who got stuck here afterwards.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一点都不怀念。天谴行动期间，我们掠夺了匹兹堡，把它变成了一片狼籍。我只是一个后来被陷在了这儿的愚蠢信徒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: See, beneath it all, the Brotherhood's just lazy. It's easier to loot a dying city than work to bring it back to life, so that's what they did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瞧，在整个事情的背后，兄弟会真是懒透了。掠夺一座快要死掉的城市总比把它带回生机要容易得多，所以他们就那么做了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're so obsessed with the technology of the past, they don't care what needs to be done for today and tomorrow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们太迷恋过去的技术，不在乎要为今天和明天做些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It takes real hard work to rebuild and run a city. But there isn't a machine to do it for them, so the Brotherhood isn't interested. Good riddance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 重建和运作一座城市需要动真格的。但是这工作是没有什么机器能代替人们做这工作，所以兄弟会对此没有兴趣。走得好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you ever miss the Brotherhood of Steel?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怀念过钢铁兄弟会吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about The Pitt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说匹兹堡吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the hell do you think? We're still brought here against our will, and we still have to work until we fall over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你以为呢？我们还违心地呆在这，我们在倒下之前还得不停的工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Angry sarcasm EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, maybe the guards don't shoot us for fun as often. And there's a slim chance that someday we'll stop getting sick and dying. Maybe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，也许守卫们没有像平常一样觉得好玩而向我们射击。可能我们还有一线希望在将来的某一天停止患病和死亡。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Angry sarcasm EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoop-tee-fucking-doo. Thank goodness you came here to save us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真是太他妈善良了，真感谢上天派你来拯救我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Angry sarcasm EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have things gotten better?
ESP.TRADUIT: 事情有所好转吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You better believe it. No more beatings, no more forced work, no more slaves being brought here in chains. You did some good work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好相信。再没有鞭打声，再没有强迫式的工作，再没有戴着枷锁的奴隶被送到这来。你积了点德。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course, we've got all new problems, now that Ashur and the taskmasters are gone. Not enough food getting brought in, for one thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我们碰到了新的麻烦，现在那个阿舒尔和工头们走了。首先，没有足够的食物送到这边来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wernher said he'll organize scavenging parties, but I think he'd rather stay up in the bar than actually do any leading.
ESP.TRADUIT: 沃纳说他会组织拾荒队，不过我想他事实上宁可待在酒馆，也不愿做什么领导工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever. We'll work it out, somehow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 管他的。我们总会搞定的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have things gotten better?
ESP.TRADUIT: 事情有所好转吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, things are fine. Don't let any grumblers tell you differently!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，都很好。别信那些牢骚鬼跟你说的废话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Happily bloodthirsty EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, sure, there are a few problems... We need scavenging teams, people to fight off the Trogs, and overseers for the mill's operation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，当然，有一些小麻烦……我们需要拾荒人员，能够击退这些兽化人的人手，以及轧钢厂的监工。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Happily bloodthirsty EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: But it's a small price to pay for seeing the end of Ashur and his bastards, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过为了能看到阿舒尔和他手下的混帐们完蛋，这是必须付出的小小代价，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Happily bloodthirsty EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: How's everything going in The Pitt?
ESP.TRADUIT: 匹兹堡到底发生了什么事情？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry... I'm just so tired. I'll work harder. Don't hurt me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉……我太困了……我会卖力干活。别伤害我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : slave afraid of his taskmaster's vengeance EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nap time's over, asshole. On your feet!
ESP.TRADUIT: 打盹时间过了，混球。站起来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slave Master [08002940] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Taskmaster threatening a slave EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, stay still while mommy takes a few readings. Don't worry, dear, you're perfectly safe!
ESP.TRADUIT: 妈妈阅读的时候别乱动。别着急，亲爱的，你绝对安全！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sandra [08000F21] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Speaking to her baby EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You want to die, asshole? Back to it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想死，混球？回去！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slave Master [08002940] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Taskmaster threatening a slave EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What am I trying to get?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要找什么东西？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the key to a cure for the mutations. Everyone in The Pitt is mutated in some way. Some are just sick, some are... worse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它是治愈变异的关键。匹兹堡的每个人都在一定程度上产生了突变。一些人只是生了病，一些人……更糟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The bosses have the key to the cure. With it, we can take control of the city and free my people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些老板们掌握着这个关键的解药。有了它，我们就可以控制这座城市，解放我的人民。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why can't you do it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么不能做？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They know that I know about the cure. All of them will be looking for me by now. That's why those guys came all the way here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们知道我对这个解药有所了解，他们所有人现在都在搜捕我。那就是为什么那些家伙一路追到这里来的原因。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I came here because I needed an outsider. Someone like you, who has the strength to pull off what I need.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来这是因为我需要有一个外来人，就像你一样的人，有能力帮我达成我的目的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's your goal?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的目标是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The city is controlled by a man named Ashur. He's powerful. No one there dares go against him. No one except me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这座城市被一个叫阿舒尔的男人控制了。他很强，没有人敢对抗他，除了我之外。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need you to sneak into The Pitt and find a way to get close enough to him to steal the cure. Nothing to it, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要你潜入匹兹堡，想法子接近他，偷走解药。没什么大不了的，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gross. I'm not wearing a dead guy's clothes. Give me yours. Now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真恶心。我不想穿死人的衣服。把你的给我。现在。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My clothes? Off my back? Well... I guess. You did help us. I'm sure... I'm sure I'll make do out there in the wastes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的衣服？从我身上脱下来？那么……我想想。你确实帮了我们的忙。我肯定……我肯定我在废土中是可以将就一下的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Prosper [08002BD7] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I... don't worry about me. I'll find something, I'm sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我……不为自己担心。我会找到些穿的。我肯定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Prosper [08002BD7] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take them, please. Take them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 带上它们，求你了，带上它们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Prosper [08002BD7] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need your clothes. Give them to me. Now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要你的衣服。快给我。现在就给。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My clothes? Off my back? Well... I guess. You did help us. I'm sure... I'm sure I'll make do out there in the wastes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的衣服？从我身上脱下来？那么……我想想。你确实帮了我们的忙。我肯定……我肯定我在废土中是可以将就一下的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Prosper [08002BD7] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I... don't worry about me. I'll find something, I'm sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我……不为自己担心。我会找到些穿的。我肯定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Prosper [08002BD7] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take them, please. Take them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 带上它们，求你了，带上它们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Prosper [08002BD7] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not taking you anywhere, but I need your clothes. Now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我哪儿也不带你去，但是我需要你的衣服。现在就要。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My clothes? Off my back? Well... I guess. You did help us. I'm sure... I'm sure I'll make do out there in the wastes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的衣服？从我身上脱下来？那么……我想想。你确实帮了我们的忙。我肯定……我肯定我在废土中是可以将就一下的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Prosper [08002BD7] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I... don't worry about me. I'll find something, I'm sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我……不为自己担心。我会找到些穿的。我肯定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Prosper [08002BD7] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take them, please. Take them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 带上它们，求你了，带上它们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Prosper [08002BD7] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: 600 for all three? You've got a deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 三个一共600？成交。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Finally. Here's the key to the gate. Do whatever you want with 'em. I couldn't care less.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，给你大门钥匙。你可以对他们做你想做的任何事。我不会管的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [08002211] (ID) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, hey: Eulogy says to tell your man that we're sorry that we could only get three. We'll get a better roundup next time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，嗨，尤勒基让我跟你们的人讲，我们很抱歉，这回只抓到了三个奴隶。下一回围捕我们会努力点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [08002211] (ID) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pleasure doing business with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴和你做生意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [08002211] (ID) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No guts? What do you mean-
ESP.TRADUIT: 没胆？你什么意思——
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0800106C] (ID) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One of 'em is coming back? Dumbass slaves... Open the gate!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们有个人回来了？傻瓜奴隶们……开门！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0800A679] (ID) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt Comment (NAM2) : "Open the gate" is shouted EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who is that down there? I can't see a fuckin' thing. Open up the gate, it might be one of those slaves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁在那？他妈的我什么都看不见。打开门，可能是那些奴隶中的一个人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0800A679] (ID) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hang on. Someone's coming. Let me do the talking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，有人来了。让我来和他说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, hey! What are you guys doing here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，嗨！你们这些家伙在这里干什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, I meant, um, isn't she cute? Here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，我是说，呃，她很可爱，不是吗？就这样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, that's what I thought, asshole.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我就是那么想的，混蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sandra [08000F21] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: The last person to try that was Wernher, and you can be damned sure Ashur's going to turn him into a little ball of pain.
ESP.TRADUIT: 上一个想这么干的人是沃纳，而阿舒尔肯定会让他粉身碎骨。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sandra [08000F21] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I recommend you get out there and help, and maybe I'll forget you had that little lapse of judgement.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我建议你赶快离开这里到外面去帮忙，没准我会忘掉你刚才的一时冲动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sandra [08000F21] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Think of it as clearing the stage. The cure in this brat's genes is the only thing worth keeping, and now we can wipe that hellhole clean.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把它看作是新时代开始的信号吧。这个调皮孩子基因里的解药是唯一值得保存下来的东西，现在我们可以把这个堕落之地清洗掉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: And that takes us to the last part of the plan: letting the Trogs overrun Uptown, killing every last bastard in there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这样我们就进入到这个计划的最后部分：让兽化人席卷住宅区，杀掉那里剩下的每一个狗娘养的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Leaving you to take Ashur's place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 接下来你去占领阿舒尔的地盘。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's here and safe. How's this going to put me in charge of The Pitt?
ESP.TRADUIT: 她在这里，很安全。这东西怎么才能让我控制整个匹兹堡？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It means that we can study Ashur's bastard, and once we dig the cure out of it, make sure that we all get the treatment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这表示我们可以对阿舒尔的私生子进行研究，一旦我们找到了解药，就能保证我们每个人都得到治疗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But more importantly, it means we're ready for the last part of the plan - letting the Trogs overrun Uptown and wipe out the bosses.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过更重要的是，这表示我们准备好了实施计划的最后部分——让兽化人席卷住宅区，彻底将老板们消灭干净。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Leaving the slaves free, and turning the bosses into Trog food!
ESP.TRADUIT: 接下来解放奴隶，把老板们变成兽化人的口粮！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: The baby's here, and she's safe. How will this help the slaves?
ESP.TRADUIT: 孩子在这里，她很安全。这如何才能帮助奴隶？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you know the cure is actually a baby?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道治疗方法确实就是一个婴儿吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's not just any baby. She holds the promise of a cure for our own children, and we can ransom her back for our freedom.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她可不是个平常的孩子。她掌握着治疗我们自己孩子的承诺，我们可以用她赎回我们的自由。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't think I enjoy this any more than you. But it's the only way we can be free and healthy enough to leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别以为我比你更喜欢干这种事。不过这也是我们得到自由，健健康康离去的没有办法的办法。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Seems like an awful lot of fuss over one little baby.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看起来一大群人都在为一个婴儿操心。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not so sure this was the right thing to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不确定这场战争是否是正确的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course, she'll be safe. We're just going to do our own research for the cure, and then ransom her back for our freedom.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，她会平安无恙的。我们只是要自己研究出解药，然后用她赎回我们的自由。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've seen how Ashur and his people treat us. It's far, far kinder than they deserve.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你也看到了阿舒尔和他的人是怎么对待我们的。这比让他们得到应有的惩罚不知道要仁慈多少倍。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't feel right about kidnapping. She's going to be safe, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对绑架感觉不好。她会很安全的，对吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you know the cure is actually a baby?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道解救的办法确实就是一个婴儿吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, now I see how it is! Think you're going to become Ashur's new lieutenant, do you? Maybe wait until you can take his throne?
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，我明白是怎么一回事了！你将成为阿舒尔的新副官，对吗？你或许会取而代之？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Coldly dismissive. She is absolutely done with the player. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've seen your type come and go, and they always leave town face down in the river.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我总是能见到你这种人，他们最后也总是死在河里的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Coldly dismissive. She is absolutely done with the player. EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, fine. You picked your side, and you made your choice. See where that takes you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，很好。你选了你的立场。我们等着瞧你会有什么样的归宿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Coldly dismissive. She is absolutely done with the player. EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I joined with the winning side. Now shut your mouth, slave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只加入有望获胜的一边。闭嘴，奴隶。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You didn't really expect me to steal a baby, did you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不会真的指望我去偷一个婴儿吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're just supposed to live and die in slavery, and watch our children turn into monsters, all because you don't have the balls to do your job?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我们就该老老实实地在奴隶制度下生老病死，眼睁睁的看着我们的孩子变成怪物，一切都是因为你没有闭上嘴干活？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wake up, you simple-headed sap. That baby could do more good for us than all of his mongrel raider family ever did for us combined.
ESP.TRADUIT: 醒醒吧，你这个头脑简单的傻瓜。那个孩子比他整个杂种歹徒家族曾给我们的所有一切加起来都有用处。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, but I just couldn't kidnap an innocent baby, even for your freedom.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，但是我不能绑架一个无辜的婴儿，就算关系到你的自由也不行。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you want to live, you'll tell me where Wernher is hiding.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想活下去，就告诉我沃纳藏到哪去了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not like we were going to harm her. We just needed to kidnap her for our freedom. Look, sometimes, these things have to happen!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们没打算伤害她，我们只是为了我们的自由所以才这么做。听着，有时候会逼不得已！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Overwhelmed with guilt EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, okay! Wernher was the one who wanted to steal the baby. I just wanted our freedom. I didn't think about what it would take.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，好吧！沃纳是想偷这个孩子的人。我只想得到我们的自由，我不考虑后果。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Overwhelmed with guilt EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wernher's hiding in the steelyard. Look for a rooftop door in the southwest. There, are you happy? Go! Just stop looking at me like that!
ESP.TRADUIT: 沃纳的藏身处在钢材堆放场，在西南屋顶一扇门后面。高兴了吧？走吧！别再那样子看着我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Overwhelmed with guilt EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't believe you were going to steal a baby from her loving parents.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我无法相信你要去把一个孩子从深爱她的父母那里偷出来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, if it'll get you out of the way, go check under the blast furnace in the steelyard.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，我告诉你，你快离开吧。去钢材堆放场的鼓风炉下面查查看。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Speech Challenge (1930454888) EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look for a rooftop door in the southwest. It's got a blue light, you can't miss it. But Wernher will put you in your place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 找到西南屋顶上的门，上头有盏蓝色的灯，别走错了。不过沃纳会叫你明白你是谁的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Speech Challenge (1930454888) EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Bear Brothers are dead! Amazing! This newcomer is showing promise, my friends!
ESP.TRADUIT: 贝尔兄弟死了！不敢相信！这个新手前途无量，我的朋友们！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arena Announcer [080038A8] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're savage! They're brutal! They're here to keep this worker in place -- the undefeated Bear Brothers!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是野人！他们是禽兽！他们到这要让这个工人安分下来——他们是从没被打败过的贝尔兄弟！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arena Announcer [080038A8] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's find out if the newcomer can hold against real fighters! Release! Fight!
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们瞧瞧这个新手能不能放倒真正的战士！打开！开打！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arena Announcer [080038A8] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And there is only one left standing! Only one! Oh, my friends! What a fantastic fight! How far will this slave go?
ESP.TRADUIT: 仅有一个人能挺到最后！仅有一个！哦，我的朋友们！多么美妙的战斗！这个奴隶能走多远？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arena Announcer [080038A8] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And now, my friends, we have for you a group of slaves willing to kill and slaughter in order to become one of we privileged few!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，我的朋友们，我们给你们这样一群奴隶一个机会，你们当中谁愿意杀戮，谁就有可能跻身成为特权精英的一员。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arena Announcer [080038A8] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They will fight! They will die! And all for you! All for your entertainment!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们将角斗！他们会死去！一切都是为了你们！都是为了愉悦你们！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arena Announcer [080038A8] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, are they ready to die for their chance at freedom? Let's find out! Release the barrels! Fight!
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，他们准备好要为争得自由的机会而豁出命去了吗？我们拭目以待！打开这些桶！开打！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arena Announcer [080038A8] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's do it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我上场吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well all right! That's what I like to hear! Get on in there!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就好！这才是我想听到的！进去！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Faydra [080032E4] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well all right! That's what I like to hear! Get on in there!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就好！这才是我想听到的！进去！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Faydra [080032E4] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're ready, just step on in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要是准备好了，就直接走进去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Faydra [080032E4] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Citizens of The Pitt, workers of Downtown, traders of Uptown, and all fierce souls who do what must be done!
ESP.TRADUIT: 匹兹堡的平民、市场区的工人、住宅区的商人和所有顽强的灵魂坚守着他们的岗位！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I bring you good news! We stand at the dawn of a new golden age. Where others merely survive, we thrive!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我给你带来了好消息！我们站在新黄金时代的拂晓。世界其他地方的人们只能为了生计而拼命，而我们欣欣向荣！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our industry is the envy of the Commonwealth! Our safety is the envy of the Capital Wastes! Our might is the envy of Ronto!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的工业生产力压联邦群雄！我们的安全保障冠绝全首都废土！我们的军事力量在伦多无懈可击！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And while I have led your efforts, it has been by your own strength that you have earned all of the envy of the world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我的带领下，你们奋发图强，通过自己的力量赢得了世界上所有人的尊敬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They envy the steel shaped by the workers in our mills, and they envy the strength of our traders and raiders who wield that steel for The Pitt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们羡慕我们的工厂中工人们锻造出来的钢铁，他们羡慕我们的商人，羡慕为匹兹堡挥舞着那些钢铁武器的歹徒的力量。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And most of all, they envy our victories in the struggle for freedom. Because, yes, freedom is what we all work towards.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们最最羡慕的是，我们在自由的斗争中所获得的成功。因为，是的，自由是我们付出一切努力的方向。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Freedom from fear, freedom from disease, freedom to live as once we did before we were shackled by atomic fire!
ESP.TRADUIT: 自由来自于恐惧，自由来自于疾病，在我们被原子之火烤焦之前，我们曾自由地活着。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And so, to celebrate this struggle, I ask my loyal workers: who among you is prepared to fight for your freedom?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，庆祝这场斗争吧，我躬问我忠诚的工人们：你们众人准备好为你们的自由而战了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who among you will risk your life in the crucible to create a new life of freedom in Uptown? Who will take this rare chance to thrive?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们中有谁愿意在住宅区的这场严酷的考验中，冒着性命之险去创造新的自由之路？谁会抓住这一不可多得的机会走向飞黄腾达？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anthony's sick. He sent me to take his place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 安东尼病了，他派我顶替他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [08003433] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : afraid for his life EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, you'd think that, wouldn't you? But that's because you're an idiot who thinks he can get away with kidnapping Ashur's daughter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，你是那么想的，不是吗？不过那只因为你是个以为自己可以带着绑架来的阿舒尔女儿逃走的白痴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sandra [08000F21] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Vicious, vehement threats against the person trying to kidnap her daughter EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our raiders will tear you apart, and when they're done, Marie will be playing with your bones as a rattle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们手下的歹徒会扒了你的皮，然后玛丽会把你的骨头拿来当玩具玩。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sandra [08000F21] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Vicious, vehement threats against the person trying to kidnap her daughter

ESP.ORIGINAL: That means kidnapping this baby is the key to ruling this city. Yoink!
ESP.TRADUIT: 也就是说绑架这个婴儿是统治这个城市的关键。拿来吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: And you really think the slaves can develop a cure more efficiently than I can? Don't be an idiot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真以为这些奴隶能比我们更有效的开发出解药来？别像个白痴一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sandra [08000F21] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Rising anger at the player for even threatening to kidnap her daughter EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: And if they so much as pluck one hair off her head, I'll be sure to pluck one eye out of each of theirs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们要敢动她一根头发，我保证会挖下他们每个人的一颗眼珠子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sandra [08000F21] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Rising anger at the player for even threatening to kidnap her daughter EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: So maybe you should just put her back right this instant and tell those miserable bastards that they can wait until their goddamned turn.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以你也许该立刻乖乖将她放回原位，然后告诉那些卑鄙的混蛋，他们可以一直等到他们的报应来临。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sandra [08000F21] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Rising anger at the player for even threatening to kidnap her daughter EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, but the slaves don't have time to wait for a cure. I'm taking Marie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，但是奴隶们并没有时间来等待治疗。我要带走玛丽。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't even know how dead you are, do you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你甚至不知道你死定了，对吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sandra [08000F21] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, I'm just supposed to strangle them with my bare hands if I meet one?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这么说的话，我只能指望自己在遇到一个的时候徒手掐死他？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't really help you there. Ask around. Maybe check with Marco in the Mill. He's been making some of our tools into weapons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我帮不了你。去四下打听一下，可以跟轧钢厂 的马可商量商量。他正在把我们的一些工具做成武器。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You might even be able to find a gun on one of the dead bosses out in the Steelyard. They- what was that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你甚至可以从外边钢材堆放场的老板们的尸体上找到枪。他们——那是什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So where can I get some weapons?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在哪里可以搞到一点武器？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't really help you there. Ask around. Maybe check with Marco in the Mill. He's been making some of our tools into weapons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我帮不了你。去四下打听一下，可以跟轧钢厂 的马可商量商量。他正在把我们的一些工具做成武器。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You might even be able to find a gun on one of the dead bosses out in the Steelyard. They- what was that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你甚至可以从外边钢材堆放场的老板们的尸体上找到枪。他们——那是什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds dangerous. What will I be doing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来很危险。我该怎么做？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Outside of the mill, there are a bunch of old steel ingots just lying around. Every so often, the Foreman puts out a work order to collect them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在轧钢厂外边，闲放着不少钢锭。有时候，工头会贴出工作告示找人去收集这些钢锭。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's practically a death sentence and they never assign it to anyone. They make us pick who's going to do it. Bastards.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁要是接这份工，几乎等于判了死刑。他们从没把这份工作指派给任何人，他们让我们自己挑人。那些杂种。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One chance, Wernher. Leave now, and never come back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你一个机会，沃纳。现在就离开，别再回来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I see how it is. You signed on with Ashur, and now you're going to stand by your man. Maybe trying to catch his eye and be his queen?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我明白是怎么回事了。你投靠了阿舒尔，现在你和你的男人站在了同一阵线。也许你想变着法子吸引他的注意，再当上他的王后？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, good luck with that, starfucker. I'm sure the two of you will kill each other eventually, even without my help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 祝你好运，大白痴。我肯定你们俩最终会互相残杀，甚至不需要我插手。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You, him, and this whole town can burn for all I care. I'm gone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你，他，还有这整个城镇都下地狱吧，我不在乎。我走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wernher, how about saving us both a lot of trouble and leaving quietly?
ESP.TRADUIT: 沃纳，我看你不如安静地离开，这样能给我们俩省掉不少麻烦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, fine. Obviously, you've joined with Ashur and I think you've got a bright future as a lackey. You really do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，好的。看来你已经加入阿舒尔一伙了，我想，作为一个奴仆，你得到了光明的前途。你确实得到了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Speech Challenge (1930454888) EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: But you know what? Fuck this city, and fuck the raiders, fuck the slaves, and fuck you too, fucker. I'm gone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过你知道吗？操这座城市，操那些歹徒，操这些奴隶，也操你这个蠢货。我走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Speech Challenge (1930454888) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to fight in the Arena.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想到竞技场里战斗。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh yeah? You sure you're ready to die?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，是吗？你准备好去送死了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Faydra [080032E4] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need a weapon. Can you help me out?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要一把武器。你能帮我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah... you're the one Midea told me about. Wernher sent you, right? I can help you out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的……美狄亚跟我提起过你。沃纳派你来的，对吧？我可以帮你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take this. It's called an Auto Axe. Nice, huh? I make 'em out of the old car parts the breakers drag in from the city.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿上这个，它叫自动锯。很妙吧，嘿？我用那些拆卸工从城里搞来的那台老式汽车的原件做的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do what you can with it, just be careful around the bosses. Make a wrong move and you're done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你随便用，只是小心周围的老板们，走错一步你就完了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No thanks, I'll pass.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，谢谢，我只是路过。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's probably for the best.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那也许是最好的主意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Give me some food.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我一点食物吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's your funeral. Here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它是你的葬礼。给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's your funeral. Here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它是你的葬礼。给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go! Get him! Get the traitor!
ESP.TRADUIT: 上！抓住他！抓住这个叛徒！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just shut up and listen to me. You want to get out of this shithole or not? Look, I need your decision. You with us?
ESP.TRADUIT: 闭上嘴听我说。你还想不想离开这个狗屎地方？听着，我要你做决定。你跟我们一起吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([08005526]DLC01ConvSlave) Slave Conversation System Comment (NAM2) : Spoken in a whisper. This is a slave conspiring to escape, so he/she is trying to be inconspicuous. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, break's over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，休息时间结束。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Dismissing a subordinate to get to work EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, sir!
ESP.TRADUIT: 是长官！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Krenshaw [08003300] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : As a soldier receiving orders. Saluting smartly. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, I've got a very important meeting with our new friend, so if anything big comes up, you use the intercom.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，我要和我们的新朋友进行一次非常重要的会面，所以要是出了什么大事，你就使用这个内部通话系统。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Wrapping up business, talking jokingly about meeting with the player EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: And keep a watch on Midea at all times - anything big happens, it's bound to go through her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 全天密切监视美狄亚——出任何大事，她都脱不了干系。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Important business, talking about a dangerous insurgent EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, all right. Put your guards on alert, tell them to be on the lookout for anyone loitering too long downtown.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，好吧。拉警报召集你的守卫们，跟他们讲要警惕任何在市场区逗留时间过长的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Getting down to important business EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever we call them, they've been gathering makeshift weapons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管我们称他们什么，他们都已经准备好了临时用的武器。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Krenshaw [08003300] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Irritated and dismissive of the correction EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: We call them "workers." Helps with morale, reminds them they might earn their freedom, someday.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们称他们 “工人”，是为了鼓舞斗志，提醒他们将来有一天他们可能赢得自由。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Explaining careful politics, and very serious about the issue EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: What?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Krenshaw [08003300] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Interrupted and suddenly confused EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Workers."
ESP.TRADUIT: “工人。”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Interrupting and correcting Krenshaw's choice of words. Serious about the change of words EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sir, we've had sightings of Wernher back in the city, and there's been an increase in chatter between slaves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 先生，我们在市场区发现了沃纳的踪迹，奴隶之间的流言正在蔓延。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Krenshaw [08003300] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Frustrated, and tired of joking. Pounding on the desk at "Sir" EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, but I may heal the infirm later in the week. Time permitting, of course.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，但我可以在本周晚些时候治疗体弱。当然，时间允许的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Calmly deflecting Krenshaw's joke EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: And I suppose you'll follow that up by raising the dead?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜你会通过起死回生的办法展开进一步的研究？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Krenshaw [08003300] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Irritated mockery of Ashur's confidence EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll be with you, right after I maintain some order and dispense a little justice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 正好在我维护了一些秩序，实施了少许公正之后，我会和你站在一起。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : Friendly, but busy EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And I'm telling you, I've got it covered.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我跟你讲，我把它打压下去了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : In control, and calming a hotheaded subordinate EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm telling you, they're planning something!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我跟你讲，他们在图谋不轨！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Krenshaw [08003300] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : In the middle of a heated debate, pounding on the table on "planning" EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever. I've done my part, now where's my reward?
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便了。我完成了我的工作，我的奖赏呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not yet, hotshot. Ashur's got people watching me, and I can't keep a baby hidden in this dump.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还没，自命不凡的家伙。阿舒尔的人监视着我，我不能带着个孩子藏在这个垃圾场。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wernher sent me word that he's hiding out in the Steelyard. He's got everything there to take care of the cure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 沃纳要我带个话，他藏在钢材堆放场。他在那边一直惦记的就是解药。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take it to him, and he'll handle the rest. Now get going!
ESP.TRADUIT: 把它给他带过去，他会对付其他人的。行动吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: As long as the kid's all right. Take her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 保证这个孩子的安全，给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She'll be all right - just not with me. Ashur's guards are always watching me. They'd find her right away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她会平安无事的——只不过不是和我一起。阿舒尔的卫兵一直在监视我，他们立刻就可以找到她。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wernher sent me word that he's hiding out in the Steelyard. He's got everything there to take care of the cure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 沃纳要我带个话，他藏在钢材堆放场。他在那边一直惦记的就是解药。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take it to him, and he'll handle the rest. Now get going!
ESP.TRADUIT: 把它给他带过去，他会对付其他人的。行动吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't make me come in there...
ESP.TRADUIT: 别让我过去……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [08002211] (ID) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hold it right there, grinder. Inspection.
ESP.TRADUIT: 待在那别动，苦力。检查。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mex [08006166] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hold it right there, Waster. Inspection.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呆在那别动，废物。检查。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mex [08006166] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on, we're almost there. It's just past this gate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来吧，我们快到了，穿过这扇门就是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Man, me and you need to get one of those uninfected scab whores, get her shitfaced, and just see what happens.
ESP.TRADUIT: 老兄，我和你得抓一个那些没被感染的渣滓妓女，把她灌个烂醉，再瞧瞧会出什么娄子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well then, I hope you also said goodbye! HAHAHAHA! Alright, play time's over. Get to work, grinders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，我希望你也说声再见！哈哈哈哈！好吧，放风时间结束。去干活，苦力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [08003E51] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes sir. I told him what he needs to do. He knows. 10 ingots. As fast as he can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，长官。我跟他讲了要做的事情。他明白，10块钢锭，尽可能的快。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes sir. I told her what she needs to do. She knows. 10 ingots. As fast as she can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，长官。我跟她讲了要做的事情。她明白，10块钢锭，尽可能的快。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh yeah? So he's the one that's going out to the Steelyard, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，是吗？那么他就是将要前往钢材堆放场的人吗，嘿？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [08003E51] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh yeah? So she's the one that's going out to the Steelyard, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，是吗？那么她就是将要前往钢材堆放场的人吗，嘿？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jackson [08003E51] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uhm... nothing. Nothing... uh... sir. I was just telling this new worker about the job the Foreman posted.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯……没什么。没什么……嗯……先生。我只是在向这个新工人讲解工头公布的这份工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need a weapon. Where can I find Marco?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要一把武器。我在哪能找到马可？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're looking for Marco, hrm? What's he up to?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在找马可，嗯？他是做什么的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's over in the old control room, near the gate to Uptown. I'll... I'll let him know you're coming.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他在住宅区大门附近的旧控制室。我会……我会让告诉他你来了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's over in the Mill. I don't see him except for meals.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他在轧钢厂，除了进餐时间，我没见过他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I tried. Really I did. This is your own fault.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我试过了，真的。这是你自己的错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Guard [08006840] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (about to kill a slave) stone cold violence EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well, Midea. If that is the will of the workers, then this man shall be their champion!
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常好，美狄亚。如果那是工人们的意愿，那么这位勇士将是他们的冠军。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well, Midea. If that is the will of the workers, then this woman shall be their champion!
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常好，美狄亚 。如果那是工人们的意愿，那么这位女士将是他们的冠军。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sir, you carry not only the dream that workers can become free, but that we may all someday become truly free from the threats of our world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 先生，你不仅带着那些工人们奔向自由的梦想，也肩负着把大家从这废弃的世界中拯救出来的重任。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Madam, you carry not only the dream that workers can become free, but that we may all someday become truly free from the threats of our world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 女士，你不仅带着那些工人们奔向自由的梦想，也肩负着把大家从这废弃的世界中拯救出来的重任。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Prepare yourself, sir. And when you are ready to be forged anew, report to Faydra in the Steel Mill.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好好准备，先生。当你准备好了重新上阵，向钢铁轧钢厂的费德拉报告。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Prepare yourself, Madam. And when you are ready to be forged anew, report to Faydra in the Steel Mill.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好好准备，女士。当你准备好了重新上阵，向钢铁轧钢厂的费德拉报告。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The rest of you are dismissed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其他人解散。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right here! We have one! This woman here will fight in the Hole!
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这儿！这有一个！这个女人将进入角斗坑战斗！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right here! We have one! This man here will fight in the Hole!
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这儿！这有一个！这个男人将进入角斗坑战斗！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: C'mon, Ashur! Will you send someone to the Hole who actually stands a chance?
ESP.TRADUIT: 来呀，阿舒尔！你能派一个真正有实力一战的人进到角斗坑里面去吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All workers report to the Square. All workers report to the Square.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所有的工人到广场报到。所有的工人到广场报到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And now, this slave has proven willing to kill and die for his freedom! But how will he fare against the last man who made it all the way: Gruber!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，这个奴隶已经证实他愿意为了他的自由而搏命！不过当他遭遇到最后的这位所向披靡的对手：格鲁伯，他会怎么样呢！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arena Announcer [080038A8] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And now, this slave has proven willing to kill and die for her freedom! But how will she fare against the man who made it all the way: Gruber!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，这个奴隶已经证实她愿意为了她的自由而搏命！不过当她遭遇到最后的这位所向披靡的对手：格鲁伯，她会怎么样呢！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arena Announcer [080038A8] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Undefeated in the Hole, Gruber has yet to meet his match.
ESP.TRADUIT: 格鲁伯在角斗坑中没被击败过，他还没遇见过敌手。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arena Announcer [080038A8] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only one will walk out with their freedom! Only one will walk out alive! Release the barrels! GO!
ESP.TRADUIT: 仅有一个人将带着他们的自由走出去！仅有一个人活着走出去！打开这些桶！上！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arena Announcer [080038A8] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: C'mon, coward!
ESP.TRADUIT: 来啊，胆小鬼！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gruber [080032E6] (mod) NPC : John Bear [080032F7] (mod) NPC : Grudd Bear [080032F8] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions Comment (NAM2) : Taunting. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Teddy bear delivery for Marie! Here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给玛丽的泰迪熊！给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know I shouldn't trust you, but if it'll make Marie happy, it means I can get some sleep. So, okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道不该相信你，不过它要是能让玛丽高兴，那表示我可以好好的睡上一觉。那么，好吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She seems to really enjoy teddy bears. She just can't seem to get enough of them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她好像蛮喜欢泰迪熊。只是她对这些玩具像是不知足一样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bring as many as you can, and I'll even pay you... Once I make sure they aren't filled with razor blades.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尽可能的多帮我搞些来，我甚至会付你钱……只要我确信它们肚子里包着的不是刀片之类的玩意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Would it help if I brought toys for Marie?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我给玛丽带玩具来会有用吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you'd be such a life-saver! A happy Marie means I can get some sleep once in a while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你真是我的救世主！玛丽高兴，那我就有机会好好地睡上一觉了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She seems to really enjoy teddy bears. She just can't seem to get enough of them!
ESP.TRADUIT: 她好像蛮喜欢泰迪熊。只是她对这些玩具像是不知足一样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bring as many as you can, and I'll make sure you're well paid for the effort!
ESP.TRADUIT: 尽可能的多帮我搞些来，我保证会付你钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Would it help if I brought toys for Marie?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我给玛丽带玩具来会有用吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks! And Marie says thanks too!
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢！玛丽也谢谢你！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks, but don't think this makes up for what you did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢，不过光说谢谢可无法补偿你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sandra [08000F21] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Grudging thanks. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your pay, I guess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你工钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sandra [08000F21] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Grudging thanks. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: That sure would help me out. Happier Marie is, the more likely I can get a full night's sleep for once in my life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那无疑帮了我的忙。玛丽越高兴，我就越有可能睡上我这辈子的第一次完整觉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She seems to really enjoy teddy bears. Creepy little things, but I guess she doesn't know any better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她好像蛮喜欢泰迪熊这种怪模怪样的小玩意，不过我猜她也就知道这么多事了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bring as many as you can, and you'll get paid plenty for it. I promise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尽可能的多帮我搞些来，我保证会付你大笔钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Would it help if I brought toys for Marie?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我给玛丽带玩具来会有用吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks, you have no idea how much this will help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢，你绝对想不到这帮了我多大的忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Weary, but thankful. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your pay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的酬劳。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Weary, but thankful. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me see what drinks you have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我瞧瞧你都有什么喝的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It hurts my heart to see a sober customer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看见没醉的顾客伤了我的心。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you walk out of here sober, I'm not doing my job.
