ESP.TRADUIT: 你要是从这里走出去还不醉，我的工作不干了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, good! And here I thought you were planning to stay sober.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，得！你就是打算不醉啊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Show me what you've got.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我看看你有什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'd best not be wasting my time, newbie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好别浪费我的时间，菜鸟。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah sure, newbie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，当然，菜鸟。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure thing, newbie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，菜鸟。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, fine. I was just kidding.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。我只是在开玩笑。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a real joker, aren't you? Whatever. Listen, I come from a place called The Pitt. It's a city far to the northwest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还真是幽默，不是吗？算了。听着，我从一个叫匹兹堡的地方来，它是西北边一座遥远的城市。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The place is a nightmare for... well, for so many reasons. But the bigger problem is that my people are slaves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那地方是个噩梦，因为……嗯，因为许许多多的原因。不过更大的问题是，我的人民都是奴隶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt

ESP.ORIGINAL: No big deal, right? It's a rough world. Who cares? But I have the chance to free them. I just need an outsider's help before we lose that chance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么大不了的，对吧？它是个粗暴的世界，谁关心呢？不过我有机会解放他们。在那个机会错失之前，我迫切需要一个外来者的帮忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a better fighter than you, that's who. Can't you handle a couple Raiders?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是个比你优秀的战士。你不是连一群歹徒都对付不了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, whatever. I didn't come to D.C. to swap insults with Wasters. You want to flap gums, fine. But don't waste my time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，随你的便。我可不是来特区找废土游民对骂的。你想闹事的话请自便。不过别浪费我的时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, you came about the broadcast. You want to hear what I have to say about The Pitt or not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，你听到这个广播就跑过来了。那我必须说说关于匹兹堡的事情，你听还是不听？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here come more of them! Watch out!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们来了不少人！当心！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey! There's someone in the pen! Get 'em!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨！有人在围栏里！抓住他们！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [08002211] (ID) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds like a plan. How do I kill the lights?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来像个不错的计划。我该如何让灯灭掉？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can get to the power plant from a manhole down in the Steelyard. It's near the train tracks -- you can't miss it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，你可以从钢材堆放场下方的检修孔到达发电站。就在火车道附近——你不会错过的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Head down there and find the floodlight controls. Turn off Uptown's floodlights, and I'll meet you back in Downtown's Market Square.
ESP.TRADUIT: 笔直下去，找到探照灯控制器，关掉住宅区的探照灯。之后我会在市场区跟你碰头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And here, take this - you'll want to stay hidden when those Trogs start swarming. Now get moving!
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，拿上这个——遇上兽化人的时候你要躲好。开始行动！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: And how am I supposed to get out of there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我该怎么离开那里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, doll, but I'll be busy setting everything up with the squirt, here. But for you, I guess I can spare a few supplies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，美女，我要在这伺候小孩。不过我想我可以给你准备些点补给品。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can get to the power plant from a manhole down in the Steelyard. Near the train tracks -- you can't miss it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以从钢材堆放场下方的检修孔到达发电站。就在火车道附近——你不会错过的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Head down there, find the floodlight controls, and turn off Uptown's floodlights. I'll meet you back Downtown.
ESP.TRADUIT: 笔直下去，找到探照灯控制台，关掉住宅区的探照灯。之后我会在市场区跟你碰头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: And here, take this - you'll want to stay hidden when the Trogs come. Now get moving!
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，拿上这个——遇上兽化人的时候你要躲好。开始行动！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds dangerous. How about helping a lady out?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来很危险。帮帮女士的忙如何？

ESP.ORIGINAL: My advice? Keep running until you're in Downtown, and don't look back!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的忠告？一直跑，直到你进入了市场区，千万别回头！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, you can get to the power plant from a manhole down in the Steelyard. Near the train tracks -- you can't miss it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，你可以从钢材堆放场下方的检修孔到达发电站。就在火车道附近——你不会错过的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Head down there. find the floodlight controls, and turn off Uptown's floodlights. I'll meet you back Downtown.
ESP.TRADUIT: 笔直下去，找到探照灯控制器，关掉住宅区的探照灯。之后我会在市场区跟你碰头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: And here, take this - you'll want to stay hidden when the Trogs come. Now get moving!
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，拿上这个——遇上兽化人的时候你要躲好。开始行动！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey! Hands off the merchandise!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨！别碰那些货物！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [08002211] (ID) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's Wild Bill?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁是狂野比尔？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bill's a friend of mine, a very dear friend. We've worked the mill together for a long time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 比尔是我的朋友，非常亲的朋友。我们一块在轧钢厂工作了很长时间。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Last week we were forced to choose someone to gather ingots from the Steelyard. Bill volunteered.
ESP.TRADUIT: 上星期我们被迫挑选一个人去钢材堆放场收集钢锭。比尔自愿去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He didn't want anyone to have to die out there. But... he's a survivor. He can't be dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他不想看到别人白白送命。不过……他是个幸运儿，他不会死的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You look like you can handle yourself. Could you look for him and bring him back?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看来像个独立性很强的人。你能找他，把他带回来吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need you to repair some equipment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要你帮我修理些装备。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure thing, newbie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，菜鸟。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm here to find a cure for the mutations.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来寻找那变异症状的解药。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh. Oh? A cure? That is very interesting. I'll be sure to note that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦。哦？解药？非常有趣。我肯定会注意到的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's a little something that I found. Make good use of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你一些我找到的东西，好好利用。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm from outside The Pitt. I'm here to help free the slaves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是从匹兹堡外面来的。我来帮助解放奴隶的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: From outside The Pitt? That's new. I heard there might be someone from far away showing up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从匹兹堡外边来的？那倒新鲜。我听说有个人是从遥远的地方来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's a little something that I found. Make good use of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你一些我找到的东西，好好利用。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Midea is helping Wernher.
ESP.TRADUIT: 美狄亚在帮助沃纳。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess that shouldn't surprise anyone. The bosses all thought they were up to something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想那不足为奇。老板们都认为他们在搞什么鬼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's a couple of things for your trouble. They should help keep you alive out here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你几个救急物品，它们会让你活着回来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wernher is trying to free the slaves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 沃纳在尝试解放奴隶。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That figures. Must be why the bosses hate him so much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有道理。这肯定是老板们为什么这么恨他的原因。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here are a couple things. Thanks for your help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你几个东西。谢谢你的帮忙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Marco is making weapons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 马可在制造武器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I knew that bastard was up to something. Finally! After all he's done to me, I can get him!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就知道那个杂种想要造反。终于露出马脚了！在他对我干了这一切之后，我可以抓他了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's something for your trouble. I can't thank you enough for this one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你几个东西，即使那不足以表达我对你的谢意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's Wild Bill again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁是狂野比尔？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bill's a friend of mine, a very dear friend. We've worked the mill together for a long time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 狂野比尔是我的朋友，非常亲的朋友。我们一块在轧钢厂工作了很长时间。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Last week we were forced to choose someone to gather ingots from the Steelyard. Bill volunteered.
ESP.TRADUIT: 上星期我们被迫挑选一个人去钢材堆放场收集钢锭。比尔自愿跟去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He didn't want anyone to have to die out there. But... he's a survivor. He can't be dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他不想看到别人白白送命。不过……他是个懂得保护自己的人，他不会死的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I don't want to help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我不想帮忙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, okay. I hope you'll change your mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那好吧。我希望你能改变主意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I haven't seen him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我没见过他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No? Well, if you do see him, could you let me know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有？那么，你要是真见到了他，就跟我说一声，行吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ashur's new pet is looking for a beating!
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿舒尔的新宠物正在找打！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, that's it! RIOT!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，就是这样！暴动！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bill said to let you know he's OK, but he can't come back anytime soon. <Lie.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 比尔说让你知道他很好，但是他不能马上回来。<撒谎>

ESP.ORIGINAL: As long as I know he's okay, then that's all that matters. Thank you for your help. I'll tell the others that Bill is alright.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要知道他没事那就万事大吉了。谢谢你帮忙，我会告诉其他人比尔平安无事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milly [08009F4B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Speech Challenge (1930454888) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take these stimpaks. They're all I have. Goodbye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你这些治疗针，这是我的全部家当。再见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milly [08009F4B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Speech Challenge (1930454888) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bill's dead. I found his body in the Steelyard. I'm sorry, Milly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 比尔死了。我在钢材堆放场找到了他的尸体。我很抱歉，米莉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's dead? But he promised us he would come back... I... I have to let the others know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他死了？但他向我们保证他会回来的……我……我要去告诉其他人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you for your help. Here, take these stimpaks. They're all I have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你帮忙。带上这些治疗针。我只有这些了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, I found him in the Steelyard.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我在钢材堆放场找到他了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh! That's wonderful! Where is he now? Did he come back with you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢！太棒了！他在哪？他跟你一起回来了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just kidding, I found Bill dead in the Steelyard.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是在开玩笑而已，我发现比尔死在钢材堆放场里了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's dead? But he promised us he would come back... I... I have to let the others know. Thank you for your help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他死了？但他向我们保证他会回来的……我……我要去告诉其他人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take these stimpaks. They're all I have. Goodbye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你这些治疗针，这是我的全部家当。再见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And one large concrete block... to the head. <Lie.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后我用一个巨大的砖块……往他头上砸。<撒谎>

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't feel... I'm going to...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得不太……我要……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Barely. He was calling for you. I had to put him out of his misery... <Lie.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 他当时已经不行了。他在呼喊着你的名字。我不得不让他从痛苦中解脱……<撒谎>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please, please stop. I can't hear anymore of it. I don't feel so well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请，请你不要说了。我再也不想听，我觉得不太好过。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I scared off the Trogs and ran to Bill. He was still alive... <Lie.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 我吓走了兽化人，然后跑向比尔。他当时还活着……<撒谎>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, that's my stuff. Get your fuckin' hands off of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，那是我的东西，拿开你他妈的臭手。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mex [08006166] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're sure he can't come?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你确定他不会来？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. I'm sure. You can hook up with her again when you get back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我确定，你可以回来后再跟她碰面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now c'mon. Let's get going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来吧，我们走。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're sure she can't come?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你确定她不会来？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If that's how it has to be, I understand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果事情必须变成这样，我能够理解。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. That's the way it is. You can hook up with her again when you get back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，就是这样，你回来后可以再跟她碰面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now c'mon. Let's get going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来吧，我们走。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This doesn't sound good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这听起来不妙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Relax. It's not about you. It's about your... robot
ESP.TRADUIT: 轻松点，我不是说你，我是说你的……机器人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We won't be able to maintain him on the road.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这一路上我们照顾不了他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Besides, we don't need some bucket of bolts tagging along. He'll only get in the way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有，我们不需要老爷车跟着，他只会碍手碍脚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Relax. It's not about you. It's about your... companion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 轻松点，我不是说你，我是说你的……同伴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We only have enough supplies for two. She's gonna have to stay behind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的补给只够两个人用，她必须留下来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Besides, this might turn ugly. We don't need some do-gooder slowing us down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有，话可能有点难听，我们不需要不切实际的空想家拖我们的后腿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're not going to be able to keep him maintained while we're on the road.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这一路上我们保养不了他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Besides, we don't need some bucket of bolts tagging along. He'll only get in the way.

ESP.ORIGINAL: He just expects me to jump to attention?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他要我立即跑去？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, he expects you to accept his courteous invitation. Or at least to guess what would happen if you keep him waiting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，他希望你接受他客气的邀请。你要是让他久等，你可以猜一猜会发生什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Krenshaw [08003300] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll find him in Haven, his tower in Uptown. Take the northeast exit from here and look for the tallest building in town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他在住宅区的避风港塔上监视着这座城市。从这走到东北边的出口，找到镇上最高的建筑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Krenshaw [08003300] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, Ashur also said that he has a few gifts for you. You'll find them in the container behind me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，阿舒尔也说，他有一些礼物给你。你可以在我身后的柜子中找到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Krenshaw [08003300] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enjoy. And don't keep the man waiting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好好享受。别让他久等。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Krenshaw [08003300] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where can I find Ashur?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在哪里可以找到阿舒尔？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He watches over the city from Haven, his tower in Uptown. Take the northeast exit from here and look for the tallest building in town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他在住宅区的避风港塔上监视着这座城市。从这走到东北边的出口，找到镇上最高的建筑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Krenshaw [08003300] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, Ashur also said that he has a few gifts for you. You'll find them in the container behind me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，阿舒尔也说，他有一些礼物给你。你可以在我身后的柜子中找到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Krenshaw [08003300] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enjoy. And don't keep the man waiting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好好享受。别让他久等。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Krenshaw [08003300] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a slave. I couldn't make it out there. Let me back in. <Lie.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是个奴隶。我无法逃出去。让我回去吧。<撒谎>

ESP.ORIGINAL: HAHA! I love it. Another slave wandered back here, huh? You couldn't even get over the bridge, could you? You're lucky I don't fuckin' paste you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈！我太高兴了，又跑回来一个奴隶，嘿？你连桥都过不来，对吧？算你走运，我他娘的没把你打成糨糊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mex [08006166] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: And look at all this! Where'd you get all this shit anyway? Whatever. Mine now. I hit the fuckin' jackpot today!
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看这些东西！不管咋说，你从哪搞到的这些狗屎？不管你愿不愿意，都是我的了。我他娘的今天赚大发了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mex [08006166] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now get back in there and get to work, or next time I'll just stake you out there for the Trogs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 快回去干活，不然下次我会把你绑去喂兽化人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mex [08006166] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got some more ingots for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我帮你搞到更多的钢锭了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looks good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看起来不错。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here are a few ingots.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你这些钢锭。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll just take those.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我收下了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here are a few ingots.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你这些钢锭。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing like some heavy labor, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不像是什么累人的活，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here are a few ingots.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你这些钢锭。

ESP.ORIGINAL: More metal for the Mill.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给轧钢厂收集更多的金属。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here are a few ingots.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你这些钢锭。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, got it. Let's go!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，拿了。我们走！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0800A7E7] (ID) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Never mind. I'm fine without it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无所谓。没有它我也没关系。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gimme the knife.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我刀。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. Here you go. Don't take it out until you get past the gate. You clear on what you need to do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，给你。没过那道门之前，别把它拿出来现。清楚你要做什么了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take the gun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. Here you go. Don't take it out until you get past the gate. You clear on what you need to do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。去吧。没过那道门之前，别把它拿出来现。清楚你要做什么了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wernher [08001082] (mod) Quest : ([0800108C]DLC01Quest01) Into The Pitt EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You head down to the hole. Talk to Faydra. She sets up the fights.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你笔直下到洞中。跟费德拉交谈，她安排战斗事宜。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I can handle it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我可以搞定。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you need a weapon, check with Marco in the Mill. He's been making some of our tools into weapons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要是需要武器，跟轧钢厂的马可商量商量。他正在把我们的一些工具做成武器。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You might even be able to find a gun on one of the dead bosses out in the Steelyard. They- what was that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你甚至可以从外边钢材堆放场的老板们的尸体上找到枪。他们——那是什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The reward better be worth all of this. What do I need to do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 最好值得我这么做。我需要干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, if you mess it up and get killed, you won't get any reward, now will you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，你要是搞砸了，被杀了，你的报酬也就没了，你愿意吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, outside of the mill, there are a bunch of old steel ingots just lying around. Every so often, the Foreman puts out a work order to collect them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，在轧钢厂外边，闲放着不少钢锭。有时候，工头会贴出工作告示找人去收集这些钢锭。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's practically a death sentence and they never assign it to anyone. They make us pick who's going to do it. Bastards.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁要是接这份工，几乎等于就判了死刑。他们从没把这份工作指派给任何人，他们让我们自己挑人。那些杂种。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever it is, I can handle it. So... what is it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管那是什么，我能搞定。所以……你想要我干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Outside of the mill, there are a bunch of old steel ingots just lying around. Every so often, the Foreman puts out a work order to collect them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在轧钢厂外边，闲放着不少钢锭。有时候，工头会贴出工作告示找人去收集这些钢锭。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's practically a death sentence and they never assign it to anyone. They make us pick who's going to do it. Bastards.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁要是接这份工，几乎等于就判了死刑。他们从没把这份工作指派给任何人，他们让我们自己挑人。那些杂种。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, that's Ashur's kid! Sound the alarm!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，那是阿舒尔的跟班！拉警报！

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you mean about the city's future?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么看待这座城市的未来？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now that Marie's back, we have a chance at curing the disease that's been ravaging The Pitt since the bombs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 既然玛丽回来了，那我们有机会治愈匹兹堡自核弹袭击以来所遭受的重创。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : A little melancholy about the scourge - still feels responsible for the tragedy that befell the city back then. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Without it killing our kids, we can grow like a real city. No more bringing in slaves. No more forced labor. Things can get better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要我们的孩子不会死，我们可以像真正的城市那样繁荣昌盛。再没有奴隶，再没有强迫式的劳动。一切都会好起来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : A little melancholy about the scourge - still feels responsible for the tragedy that befell the city back then. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's taken me a lot of work to rebuild this city. With your help, it's finally going to have a chance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们花了大量的工夫重建这座城市。在你的帮助下，它最终有了机会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : A little melancholy about the scourge - still feels responsible for the tragedy that befell the city back then. EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: We have a chance at curing the disease that's been ravaging The Pitt since the bombs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们有机会治愈匹兹堡自核弹袭击以来所遭受的重创。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : A little melancholy about the scourge - still feels responsible for the tragedy that befell the city back then. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Without it killing our kids, we can grow like a real city. No more bringing in slaves. No more forced labor. Things can get better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要我们的孩子不会死，我们可以像真正的城市那样繁荣昌盛。再没有奴隶，再没有强迫式的劳动。一切都会好起来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : A little melancholy about the scourge - still feels responsible for the tragedy that befell the city back then. EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's taken me a lot of work to rebuild this city. With your help, it's finally going to have a chance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们花了大量的工夫重建这座城市。在你的帮助下，它最终有了机会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ashur [08000F20] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor Comment (NAM2) : A little melancholy about the scourge - still feels responsible for the tragedy that befell the city back then. EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oooh!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嚯！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arena Announcer [080038A8] (mod) Quest : ([0800108B]DLC01Quest02) Unsafe Working Conditions Comment (NAM2) : The sound of a large crowd reacting. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then here... Delicious food for you! Eat, and be good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是……给你的美味！吃吧，乖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, I'll have some food.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我要一些吃的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then say no more, friend. Can't share much, but this should do the trick. Use it in good health!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不用再说了，朋友。没有太多的东西可分享，不过这应该够了。用它来保持身体健康！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a little irradiated. I could use some help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我被轻微辐射了。我需要帮助。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Help me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 救命！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0800B161] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : being attacked and shrieking for help to a nearby stranger EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about I put you to the whip, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得给你实行鞭刑如何？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Guess I couldn't stop you, but then you'd never find all the little bonuses I got stashed over the years.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我阻止不了你，但同样的，你也永远得不到我珍藏了多年的小玩意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about this: you bring me ingots, like you used to, and I'll make sure you get compensated when you do. Can't be more fair than that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这样吧，跟过去一样，你帮我找钢锭，我保证付你报酬。再公平不过了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No hard feelings, but I'm not taking any more of your shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无意冒犯，但是我再也不想听你的废话了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Understood, champ! But if you want to keep collecting ingots, I still got plenty of gear stashed away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 明白，冠军！不过你要是继续收集钢锭的话，我还藏了不少装备当奖品。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You bring me ingots, I'll make sure you get rewarded. Can't be more fair than that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你帮我找钢锭，我保证付你报酬。再公平不过了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This better be worth it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这最好值得我这么做。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Like it or not, this is what you're getting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管你是不是真的喜欢，这是你的所得。

ESP.ORIGINAL: See for yourself. If you're heading back out there, these oughta help with the Trogs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你亲自去看吧。你要是再回到那边，这些应该可以帮你对付兽化人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, how about metal for metal? That's gotta be a fair trade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 金属换金属怎么样？再公平不过了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here. This armor was a special order for one of the Hole fighters. Great against bullets, but didn't help him when he got pushed off the bridge.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给。这件装甲是为角斗坑的一位战士特别定做的。挡子弹很棒，不过当他摔下这座桥之后，这衣服没能帮得了他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about something one-of-a-kind? Bit of a weird one, here - found it from some sucker out of town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这类东西怎么样？给，有点古怪——从镇子外边的一些笨蛋那里搞来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some genius got to tinkering with his laser. Polished metal barrel, a few prisms in there, and he got this lethal light show.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一些天才改进了他的镭射。有优雅的金属枪管，配备了一些棱镜，他进行了这一致命光线的演示。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is it ever! Check out this cutting edge of fashion, huh? Wear this armor, and everyone's going to want to get close to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 曾经的经典！要不要体验一把这种款式的流行度，嘿？穿上这件装甲，每个人都会想和你套近乎

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which just means they'll be inside your blast radius!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那正好表示他们会进入你的爆炸范围内？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure is. This armor used to belong to one of those desert-crazy priests. Said wearing it made him bulletproof.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，这套装甲以前属于一位沙漠牧师，据说他穿着可以防弹。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Course, that didn't stand up to a little testing. But damn if it wasn't a gloriously fun time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，那经不起小小的测试。不过它要是没经历过什么光辉岁月的话，那可真是该死。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All the metal you're bringing in, I suppose it's worth giving you something to really help with those Trogs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想就你带过来的所有这些金属，值得我给你一些东西，以便真正能帮你对付那些兽化人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, this thing's mauled Trogs and Ghouls from here to Monroeville. Give it a whirl.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，从这到门罗维尔，这个东西一路留下了兽化人和僵尸的抓痕。试一试。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kid, this is worth more than you know. But damn if you ain't earned it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 孩子，这比你想的更值钱。你还没能赚到它。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here. This is the best gun I ever had. A little slower on the trigger, but she makes up for it in power and accuracy. Use her in good health.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，这是我用过的最好的枪。扳机的速度有点变慢了，不过火力和命中率弥补了她的缺陷。在她状况良好的时候才能发挥最大火力。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'll be damned. That makes 100 ingots you found. And here I remember thinking you'd be lucky to bring back any at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会遭天谴，那值100块钢锭。我记得我在想，你带回来这么多根本就是走运。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ain't no question, you earned the treasure of my collection. This armor goes all the way back to when the Brotherhood tried to wipe out The Pitt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，你挣到了我收集来的宝贝。这套装甲和兄弟会想要摧毁匹兹堡时的那种款式完全相同。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some of the tribals who worshipped Ashur made it to look like their god. Try it on, and you'll feel a little like a god, yourself!
ESP.TRADUIT: 一些部落崇拜阿舒尔，把他尊为他们的神。试穿一下，你自己也会觉得有点像神的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got anything for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有东西给我？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Guess I could spare this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以匀一点出来给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, looks like you've earned it. If you're heading back out there, these oughta help with the Trogs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，看来是你应得的。你要是回到那边，这些东西可以帮你对付那些兽化人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about I give you some metal this time?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这次我给你些金属怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here. This armor was a special order for one of the Hole fighters. Great against bullets, but didn't help him when he got pushed off the bridge.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给。这件装甲是为角斗坑的一位战士特别定做的。挡子弹很棒，不过当他摔下这座桥之后，这衣服没能帮得了他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure thing. Bit of a weird one, here - found it from some sucker out of town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，给，有点古怪的东西——从镇子外边的一些笨蛋那里搞来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some genius got to tinkering with his laser. Polished metal barrel, a few prisms in there, and he got this lethal light show.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一些天才改进了他的镭射。优雅的金属枪管，配备了一些棱镜，他进行了这一致命光线的演示。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You bet I do! Check out this cutting edge of fashion! Wear this armor, and everyone's going to want to get close to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说的没错！试试这玩意到底有多拉风！穿上这件装甲，每个人都会想和你套近乎。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which just means they'll be inside your blast radius, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那正好表示他们会进入你的爆炸范围内？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Guess you earned this. Used to belong to a desert priest. Said wearing it made him bulletproof.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜这是你应得的。它过去属于一位沙漠牧师，据说他穿着可以防弹。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Course, that didn't stand up to a little testing. But damn if it wasn't a gloriously fun time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，那经不起小小的测试。不过它要是没经历过什么光辉岁月的话，那可真是该死。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All the metal you're bringing in, I suppose it's worth giving you something to really help with those Trogs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想就你带过来的所有这些金属，值得我给你一些东西，以便真正能帮你对付那些兽化人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, this thing's mauled Trogs and Ghouls from here to Monroeville. Give it a whirl.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，从这到门罗维尔，这东西一路留下了兽化人和尸鬼的抓痕。试一试。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I probably shouldn't, but damn if you ain't earned it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也许不该这么做，不过真该死，这是你应得的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here. This is the best gun I ever had. A little slower on the trigger, but she makes up for it in power and accuracy. Use her in good health.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，这是我用过的最好的枪。扳机的速度有点变慢了，不过火力和命中率弥补了她的缺陷。在她状况良好的时候才能发挥最大火力。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'll be damned. That makes 100 ingots you found. And here I remember thinking you'd be lucky to bring back any at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会遭天谴，那值100块钢锭。我记得我在想，你带回来这么多根本就是走运。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ain't no question, you earned the treasure of my collection. This armor goes all the way back to when the Brotherhood tried to wipe out The Pitt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，你赚到了我收集来的宝贝。这套装甲和兄弟会想要摧毁匹兹堡时的那种款式完全相同。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some of the tribals who worshipped Ashur made it to look like their god. Try it on, and you'll feel a little like a god, yourself!
ESP.TRADUIT: 一些部落崇拜阿舒尔，把他尊为他们的神。试穿一下，你自己也会觉得有点像神的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, because I've never solved my problems with violence. <Intimidate>
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，因为我从来没有通过暴力解决过自己的问题。<恐吓>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dammit! Dammit, you monster! Wernher's in the steelyard!
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死！该死，你这个怪物！沃纳在钢材堆放场！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take his damn message, hunt him down, whatever. Just leave my people alone, you bastard!
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，带上他该死的便条，不管采用什么法子逮到他。离我的人远点，你个狗日的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Midea [0800109B] (mod) Quest : ([0800108D]DLC01Quest03) Free Labor EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need you to start the purifier. The code is 2-1-6.
ESP.TRADUIT: 福克斯，我要你去启动净水器。密码是2-1-6。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there any way I can help?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有需要我帮忙的地方吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Indeed, we can use every able body available to us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 确实，我们可以接纳每个对我们有用的个体。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elder Lyons [060156E4] (mod) Quest : ([09000802]DLC03BS1) Death From Above EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: To that end, I am going to circumvent our standard recruitment procedures and declare you a Knight of the Brotherhood of Steel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为此，我依照我们的标准征兵程序宣布，你是钢铁兄弟会的骑士了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elder Lyons [060156E4] (mod) Quest : ([09000802]DLC03BS1) Death From Above EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Before you do anything else, please speak with Scribe Rothchild. I'm sure he'll be pleased to see you again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在你做什么事情之前，请先和文员罗斯查德谈谈。我想他会很高兴再次见到你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elder Lyons [060156E4] (mod) Quest : ([09000802]DLC03BS1) Death From Above EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He can brief you on the details of the last few weeks, as well as where our efforts are focused now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他可以简要地告诉你最近几个星期的情况，以及我们最近的任务着重点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elder Lyons [060156E4] (mod) Quest : ([09000802]DLC03BS1) Death From Above EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I understand that you've been through quite an ordeal, but the sooner you can talk to him, the sooner we can put an end to all this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白你有过痛苦的经历，但是你越早和他谈话，我们就可以越早结束这一切。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elder Lyons [060156E4] (mod) Quest : ([09000802]DLC03BS1) Death From Above EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know. We run out in two days and then it's back to the radiated shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道，我们呆了两天，这些玩意就都化成辐射屎了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Give me your Self Status Report.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我你的自我状态报告。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am currently functioning at 78 percent capacity which is well within acceptable operating parameters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我目前的运行状况为满负荷程度的78%，处于非常可靠的运行区间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0900266C] (ID) Quest : ([090011AD]DLC03BS3) Who Dares Wins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The following systems are non-operative or damaged: surface visual systems and communications uplink to White House and Police Department.
ESP.TRADUIT: 以下系统处于完全停用或损坏状况：地表影像系统、与白宫和警察局之间的联络系统。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0900266C] (ID) Quest : ([090011AD]DLC03BS3) Who Dares Wins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is additional partial damage to my internal sensing devices and numerous severed data lines.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的内部传感设备以及数据线路也有不少损坏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0900266C] (ID) Quest : ([090011AD]DLC03BS3) Who Dares Wins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the hell is going on?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这他妈发生什么事了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Tristan [09005686] (mod) Quest : ([09000802]DLC03BS1) Death From Above EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you guys have something set up on the side?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么你们在台下有什么交易？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We do what we can. Take, for example, this Ghoul Griffon. He wanted to PURCHASE a bunch of water.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们只做我们能做的。例如这个僵尸格里芬。他想向我们买大量的水。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : pleased with his arrangement EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the hell does that droopy irradiated fool need with pure water? Thinks he can sell it in Underworld. Moron.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个快腐烂的傻瓜要这么多净水干嘛？他以为他能在地下城卖掉这些水。蠢货。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : pleased with his arrangement EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, he's the only one who's offered to PAY for water, in caps AND technology.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，只有他愿意用瓶盖或是科技来换水。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : pleased with his arrangement EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: And what Lyons doesn't know won't hurt him. There's plenty of water to go around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 里昂斯虽然不知道，但这对他没什么危害。这儿还有好多水。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : pleased with his arrangement EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: And I can use it to pay Rivet City to provide security for all the caravans we can't escort ourselves. I'm lucky he came along.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们还能用他给的钱让铆钉城的警力保护我们的商队。他来找我可是我的运气。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : pleased with his arrangement EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You think maybe Megaton is trying to con you out of more water?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得核弹镇想在你这骗更多的水？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know WHAT to think. I got Lyons breathing down my neck about it though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我都不知道该怎么办了。里昂斯在这件事上对我逼得太紧了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : exhausted EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Apparently Megaton's sending him nasty letters demanding a shipment. I JUST sent them a week's supply! A month's, if they ration.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很明显核弹镇给他寄了封卑鄙的信朝他讨水。可我刚给他们送了一个星期的量！ 如果他们实行配给的话那些水够用一个月。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : exhausted EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, if you can straighten out Megaton so I get Lyons off my back, I'll make it worth your while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，如果你能摆平核弹镇的问题好让我给里昂斯一个交代，我会给你可观的报酬的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : exhausted EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds like you have your hands full.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来你应接不暇啊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everyone was so excited about that Purifier: "Project Purity this," and "Project Purity that."
ESP.TRADUIT: 所有人都对净化器兴奋异常: 整天"净水工程"这，"净水工程"那的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : annoyed EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: But did anyone stop to ask, "Hey, what are we going to DO with all that clean water?" Well, guess who gets to fill in that tiny detail.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是否有人冷静下来并且问， "嗨，我们拿这么多干净的水用来做什么？" 好吧，猜猜谁来回答这个问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : annoyed EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: It'd be one thing if I had support, but that little war with the Enclave has depleted much of the Brotherhood's resources.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我得到足够的支持的话事情还有得办，但是和英克雷的那场仗耗费了兄弟会太多的资源。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And to top it off, I have to be mommy to a bunch of lab coats.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而更糟糕的是，我还得给一群实验室里的白痴当爹当妈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : annoyed EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is it now?!
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在如何？！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : angry he can't get a moment to himself EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh-Kay... I'll swing by another time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好-的……我一会儿再回来吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : sensing bosses anger, beating hasty retreat. EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: If Lyons wants to chase after his deliveries, fine. Let HIM do it. But I'm done wasting resources and risking lives on this pet project of his.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果里昂斯想要追查他的货，好吧。让他去做吧。但是我可不会再浪费资源和生命在他那“得意”的工程上了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : wearily explaining his position... annoyed. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Clears throat> Have you ever seen a map? North... points... UP!
ESP.TRADUIT: <清了清嗓子> 你之前看过地图么？北……是……朝上的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : smoldering anger... fed up with incompetence EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wish. But no, I need them. They're some of the few that bothered to come back at all - a hardy bunch, this group. Almost as good as our own men.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我倒是想。但不要，我需要他们。他们是为数不多敢回来的人 - 这群人，算得上硬汉。 和我的人有的一拼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : exhausted EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's why I'm here, actually. Bigsley sent me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 实际上这就是为什么我来找你。比格斯利派我来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, he did? I was beginning to think he forgot about us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，他这么做了？我还以为他把我们给忘了呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Officer Lepelletier [09003B3C] (mod) Quest : ([09003B42]DLC03WQ01) Protecting the Water Way Comment (NAM2) : confiding in a potential ally EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not sure how much you know: There's been an increase in attacks on the caravans. Seems organized and not just the random Raider or Mutant encounter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不确定你知道多少: 现在开始有越来越多针对商队的攻击。看上去是有组织的而而不像是与匪徒和变异生物的零星冲突。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Officer Lepelletier [09003B3C] (mod) Quest : ([09003B42]DLC03WQ01) Protecting the Water Way Comment (NAM2) : confiding in a potential ally EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm running out of resources and I'm down to my greenest men. I want to get to the bottom of these coordinated attacks. The sooner the better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我快没补给了而且我现在只剩下几个菜鸟手下了。我希望这些协同的攻击能快点结束。越快越好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Officer Lepelletier [09003B3C] (mod) Quest : ([09003B42]DLC03WQ01) Protecting the Water Way Comment (NAM2) : confiding in a potential ally EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that a Plasma Rifle you've got there? I could use that on the mission.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你那是把电浆步枪吗？我可能会用得上。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose I don't really need it pushing papers around here, do I?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜我其实不需要用这写来文件，不是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Officer Lepelletier [09003B3C] (mod) Quest : ([09003B42]DLC03WQ01) Protecting the Water Way EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright. Consider it an advance on your payment. You better not disappoint.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。把这个当作订金吧。别跟我抱怨。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Officer Lepelletier [09003B3C] (mod) Quest : ([09003B42]DLC03WQ01) Protecting the Water Way EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm your worst nightmare!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会是你最恐怖的噩梦！

ESP.ORIGINAL: That so? You're one of the newbies? You best know the pass phrase asshole. Or you're dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就这些？你也是新来的？ 你最好知道口令你这混蛋。否则你就死定了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Split Jack [09003B3A] (mod) Quest : ([09003B42]DLC03WQ01) Protecting the Water Way Comment (NAM2) : a serious threat EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Mirelurk stew."
ESP.TRADUIT: "炖蟹人。"

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. You're lucky you knew that. Don't know who let you in, don't really care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。能知道这些你可真走运。我不知道是谁让你来的，我也不关心这个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Split Jack [09003B3A] (mod) Quest : ([09003B42]DLC03WQ01) Protecting the Water Way EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is a real simple gang. Whoever's the toughest sets the rules, and that's ME. And I got just one rule: Do what the hell I say, when I say it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这儿的情况很简单。在这里最强悍的人才能立规矩，那个人就是我。而我只有一条规矩: 我让你干什么，你就他妈的干什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Split Jack [09003B3A] (mod) Quest : ([09003B42]DLC03WQ01) Protecting the Water Way EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, find a seat. We're waiting for some of the boys to get back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，找个地方坐下。我们在等小子们回来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Split Jack [09003B3A] (mod) Quest : ([09003B42]DLC03WQ01) Protecting the Water Way EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and put this on. We're a gang. We all wear the same uniform.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦对了，穿上这个。这儿是个帮会。我们都穿统一的制服。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Split Jack [09003B3A] (mod) Quest : ([09003B42]DLC03WQ01) Protecting the Water Way EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do I really have to guess?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我一定要猜吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here you go. Run along now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你。走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (cheerfully) caveat emptor! EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: And remember: All sales are final. No refunds.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有别忘了: 一旦售出，概不退换。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (cheerfully) caveat emptor! EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. Take my 10 caps already.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。这就给你10个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know, 40 caps?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道，40个瓶盖？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right you are! Here's the bottle, and I'll take those caps. Pleasure doing business with you, sir. Come again!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的！拿好这瓶，瓶盖我收下了。非常高兴和您做买卖，先生，欢迎再来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (cheerfully) caveat emptor! EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: And remember: All sales are final. No refunds or exchanges.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有，别忘了: 一旦售出，概不退换。不退款，不换货。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (cheerfully) caveat emptor! EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. Here's 10 caps. Give me a bottle of the "Amazing" Aqua Cura.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好。给你10个瓶盖。给我一瓶"神奇的"沌净水。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right you are! Here's the bottle, and I'll take those caps. Pleasure doing business with you, ma'am. Come again!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的！拿好这瓶，瓶盖我收下。非常高兴和您做买卖，女士，欢迎再来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (cheerfully) caveat emptor! EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: And remember: All sales are final. No refunds or exchanges.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有，别忘了: 一旦售出，概不退换。不退款，不换货。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (cheerfully) caveat emptor! EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. Here's 10 caps. Give me a bottle of the "Amazing" Aqua Cura.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好。给你10个瓶盖。给我一瓶"神奇的"沌净水。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got a free sample I could try?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有免费样品吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A FREE sample you say? Hmm... Well... I normally don't do this... but, for YOU, for this ONE TIME ONLY, a VERY special VIP promotional offer...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说免费样品？嗯……好吧……我一般是不会这么做的……但是，为了你，仅此一次，给你一次VIP的待遇吧……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : enthusiastic, snake oil sales pitch EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ladies and gentlemen, DING-DING-DING! We have a new winner in our daily Aqua Cura Sweepstakes!
ESP.TRADUIT: 女士们先生们，叮-叮-叮！一位沌净水抽奖的幸运儿诞生了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : enthusiastic, snake oil sales pitch EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here you go, sir. Your FREE bottle! Step right up in the next 5 minutes, and get your VERY OWN bottle of the Amazing Aqua Cura at HALF price! Ladies and gentlemen. Half price!
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你，先生。免费试饮！如果你五分钟内行动起来的话，你就能以半价得到一瓶属于自己的神奇的沌净水！女士们先生们。半价！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : enthusiastic, snake oil sales pitch EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: A FREE sample you say? Hmm... Well... I normally don't do this... but, for YOU, for this ONE TIME ONLY, a VERY special VIP promotional offer...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说免费样品？嗯……好吧……我一般是不会这么做的……但是，为了你，仅此一次，给你一次VIP的待遇吧……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : enthusiastic, snake oil sales pitch EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ladies and gentlemen, DING-DING-DING! We have a new winner in our daily Aqua Cura Sweepstakes!
ESP.TRADUIT: 女士们先生们，叮-叮-叮！一位沌净水抽奖的幸运儿诞生了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : enthusiastic, snake oil sales pitch EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here you go, ma'am. Your FREE bottle! Step right up in the next 5 minutes, and get your VERY OWN bottle of the Amazing Aqua Cura at HALF price! Ladies and gentlemen. Half price!
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你，女士。免费试饮！如果你五分钟内行动起来的话，你就能以半价得到一瓶属于自己的神奇的沌净水！女士们先生们。半价！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : enthusiastic, snake oil sales pitch EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm good to go. What's next?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我准备好了。接下来干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Based on the data you brought us from the relay station, we've identified where the Enclave is basing their operation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 根据你从中继站带给我们的数据，我们找出了英克雷部队的基地位置。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Tristan [09005686] (mod) Quest : ([09000AFD]DLC03BS2) Shock Value EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It seems they have a second base of operations at Adams Air Force base, outside of D.C.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来他们还有第二个基地，位于华盛顿特区外的亚当空军基地.
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Tristan [09005686] (mod) Quest : ([09000AFD]DLC03BS2) Shock Value EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only safe way to get there is through the Presidential Metro used by the government before the war.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唯一能够安全抵达那里的方法是通过政府战前所使用的总统专用地铁
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Tristan [09005686] (mod) Quest : ([09000AFD]DLC03BS2) Shock Value EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're going to be on your own again for now; the rest of the Brotherhood will be providing a distraction so you can slip in undetected.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你现在又将独自一人， 兄弟会的其他人会引开对方的注意，让你潜入。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Tristan [09005686] (mod) Quest : ([09000AFD]DLC03BS2) Shock Value EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once you breach the Presidential Metro and get to Adams Air Force Base, look for the Resupply Crate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一旦你通过了总统专用地铁就前往亚当空军基地，寻找补给板条箱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Tristan [09005686] (mod) Quest : ([09000AFD]DLC03BS2) Shock Value EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Inside, you'll find your new orders and hopefully we can put a working Tesla Cannon into your hands.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在那里，你会获得新的命令，希望我们给你的特斯拉 加农炮能有用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paladin Tristan [09005686] (mod) Quest : ([09000AFD]DLC03BS2) Shock Value EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I might like a bottle of Aqua Cura. How much are you selling them for?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想来一瓶沌浄水。多少钱？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here you go! Another satisfied customer, I'm sure!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好极了！毫无疑问，又有一个顾客心满意足了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : enthusiastically making a sale EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's 10 caps. I'll take a bottle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你10个瓶盖。给我来一瓶。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right you are! Pleasure doing business with you, sir. Come again!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的！非常高兴和您做生意，先生。欢迎再来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : extremely enthusiastic snake oils salesmen EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. Here's 10 caps. Give me a bottle of the "Amazing" Aqua Cura.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。给你10个瓶盖。给我一瓶"神奇的"沌净水。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right you are! Pleasure doing business with you, ma'am. Come again!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的！非常高兴和您做生意，女士。欢迎再来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : extremely enthusiastic snake oils salesmen EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. Here's 10 caps. Give me a bottle of the "Amazing" Aqua Cura.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。给你10个瓶盖。给我一瓶"神奇的"沌净水。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Relax. I don't care. Take these morons for all their worth. I'm just curious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别紧张。我没有别的意思。你怎么骗这些白痴都行。我只是好奇而已。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's true, I got a thing going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错，我正在干一番大事业。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : threatening EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I take the Aqua Pura, store it to sell to humans later, then I put the regular irradiated crap in the bottles and sell it to these fools.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我买来纯净水，储藏起来过一阵子再卖回给人类，之后再往剩下的空瓶子里灌满普通的受过辐射的脏水卖给那些傻瓜。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : threatening EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: No one's getting hurt. In fact, the Brotherhood actually needs the caps and technology I give them to fund their "free" water caravans.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有人会因此受到什么伤害。实际上，兄弟会需要我的瓶盖和技术来资助"免费的"贩水商队。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : threatening EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just ask Bigsley at Project Purity, he'll tell you how grateful he is I'm helping them out like this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不信你去问问净化工程的比格斯利，他会告诉你我这样帮助他们让他们有多高兴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : threatening EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: But watch yourself. Get in my way, and... let's just say, I'm good at removing problems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是小心一点。你要是敢捣乱，那么……这么跟你说吧，我可是很擅长摆平麻烦的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : threatening EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Heheh. You're not fooling anyone. Everyone knows you're one of the good guys.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呵呵呵。别跟我装了。谁都知道你是那种老实人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : lying smoothly again EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: But seriously kid. I'm not up to anything. Just ask any of these fools - ahem - I mean, LOYAL customers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是说真的小子。我可没打算要怎么样。你去问下那些傻瓜- 哦不 - 我是说忠实的顾客。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : lying smoothly again EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: They already see the many benefits of the Amazing Aqua Cura!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们已经看到我神奇的沌净水的功效了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : lying smoothly again EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're clearly up to something. There's no denying it. Talk. Now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你肯定在隐瞒什么。不要抵赖了。现在就说！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh alright, alright. But if you start blabbing, I've got some buddies with itching trigger fingers...
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，对了，对了。如果你多嘴泄密的话，我这儿有几个带枪的弟兄手可是有点儿痒啊……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : rationalizing EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: So I've got this little operation taking Aqua Pura and replacing it with regular crap. It's not like it'll hurt us Ghouls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 于是我动了点小手脚，买来纯净水，然后用一些个次货换掉它们。但这似乎不会对我们僵尸们产生危害。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : rationalizing EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Aqua Pura I'm storing to sell back to humans later. You know, raiders, Outcasts, etc. The guys the Brotherhood doesn't share with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些纯净水我都留着卖给人类呢。你知道的，那些个歹徒，放逐者，诸如此类的人。兄弟会不会分水给他们的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : rationalizing EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not a bad guy. I'm just trying to help. The Brotherhood needs me. My caps mean water for the Wasteland. Just ask Bigsley at Project Purity.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可不是坏人。我只是想帮忙。兄弟会需要我。我的瓶盖就好比废土大地上的清水。不信你可以去问问净化工程的比格斯利。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : rationalizing EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm definitely getting a bottle!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我一定要来一瓶！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : to himself and those around him-- suckered by snake oil sales pitch EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm getting a case for my family.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我给我的家人买一箱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : to himself and those around him-- suckered by snake oil sales pitch EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh wow! That sounds great!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，哇噢！听上去棒极了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : to himself and those around him-- suckered by snake oil sales pitch EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: That IS Amazing!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这真是神奇啊！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : to himself and those around him-- suckered by snake oil sales pitch EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's unbelievable!
ESP.TRADUIT: 真是难以置信！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : to himself and those around him-- suckered by snake oil sales pitch EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇哦！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : to himself and those around him-- suckered by snake oil sales pitch EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's terrific!
ESP.TRADUIT: 真是了不起！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : to himself and those around him-- suckered by snake oil sales pitch EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who would've thought?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁会这么想？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : to himself and those around him-- suckered by snake oil sales pitch EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't believe it does ALL that! That's wonderful!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真不敢相信它全做到了！真是美妙绝伦啊
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : to himself and those around him-- suckered by snake oil sales pitch EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Amazing! Simply amazing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 神奇！太神奇了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : to himself and those around him-- suckered by snake oil sales pitch EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇哦！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : to himself and those around him-- suckered by snake oil sales pitch EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Amazing Aqua Cura cures all the common Ghoul ailments! Guaranteed!
ESP.TRADUIT: 神奇的沌净水能够治疗僵尸的各种疑难杂症！包你满意！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : enthusiastic, snake oil sales pitch EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hellacious halitosis. It's a common condition of the Ghoul state. But it's not permanent. Not with Amazing Aqua Cura that is!
ESP.TRADUIT: 难闻的口臭。这对僵尸来说是常见问题。但绝不是永久的。只要你用了神奇的沌净水它就不是！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : enthusiastic, snake oil sales pitch EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Friends, have you stopped combing your hair? Afraid of pulling out the few remaining plugs?
ESP.TRADUIT: 朋友们，你是否已经不再梳理你的头发？害怕把脑袋上仅剩的几根毛发拽下来？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : enthusiastic, snake oil sales pitch EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Forget all that. Just give me 300 caps this once, and we'll call it even.
ESP.TRADUIT: 算了。给我300个瓶盖，我俩就算扯平了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. That's pretty steep...
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。听上去太多了……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : upset he's been blackmailed EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the hell. It's just this once, and then we're through.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真他妈的。只此一次，从此我们就两清了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : upset he's been blackmailed EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. Here's your 300 caps. There. I just bought your silence. So keep your mouth shut.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好。这是给你的300瓶盖。拿着这个。我已经给了你封口费，所以管好你的嘴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : upset he's been blackmailed EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Either you tell them, or I tell them. Your call.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要么你告诉他们，要么我来。你自己选。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't believe it... I have a good thing going here... Why mess that up for me? What have I done to you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真不敢相信……我正在这忙我的好事呢……你干嘛来捣乱？我惹你了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : worried, but pretending to be chipper EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not hurting anyone. I mean, really? Reverse the Ghoul condition? With a bottle of water? I wasn't fooling anybody; they were fooling themselves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我谁也没伤害。我的意思是，真的？把僵尸变成人？就靠一瓶水？我谁也没骗; 是他们自欺欺人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : worried, but pretending to be chipper EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. I've made enough money here, anyway. Well, um... It's probably best if I tell them. I think I know what to say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。反正我也赚够了。那么，呃……还是我来告诉他们好些。我知道该说些什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : worried, but pretending to be chipper EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wish me luck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 祝我好运吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : worried, but pretending to be chipper EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please, water. I'm so thirsty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 求你了，水。我好渴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Water Beggar [09006517] (mod) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water Comment (NAM2) : Begging EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, poor dear. Here, I've got some water I can spare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢。我可怜的。拿着，我这有点水可以分给你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rosa [090064FE] (mod) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water Comment (NAM2) : Ministering to the ill EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: For... for me? Crystal clear water? Oh, bless you! Bless you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 给……给我？水晶般纯净的水？噢，上帝保佑你！保佑你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Water Beggar [09006517] (mod) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water Comment (NAM2) : Begging EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, bless you. I'm glad to help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，愿上帝保佑你，我很高兴帮助你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rosa [090064FE] (mod) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water Comment (NAM2) : Ministering to the ill EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's okay. You couldn't have known.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。你也不知道会这样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, it's not okay! Not for him! It was supposed to be holy water. The man at the monastery in Springvale said it was blessed!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，这水有问题！他不能喝！这应该是圣水。春之谷修道院里的人说它是被祝福过的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: He gave me this pamphlet along with the water. Called himself Brother Gerard. You can find him on the road through Springvale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他还把这个宣传册随水赠给了我。他自称杰拉德兄弟。你可以在春之谷的路上看到他
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rosa [090064FE] (mod) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know if it'll help, but I don't know what else I can do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道这有没有用，但是没有其他办法了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rosa [090064FE] (mod) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll look into it. Where did you get the water?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会去查查看的。你的水是从哪来的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought it would help him. It was supposed to be holy water. The man at the monastery in Springvale said it was blessed!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以为这能救他。这应该是圣水。春之谷修道院里的人说它是被祝福过的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: He gave me this pamphlet along with the water. Called himself Brother Gerard. You can find him on the road through Springvale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他还把这个宣传册随水赠给了我。他自称杰拉德兄弟。你可以在春之谷的路上看到他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rosa [090064FE] (mod) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: They said they had lots of this holy water. Please, do something to stop them!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们还说有好多这样的圣水。拜托，请阻止他们！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rosa [090064FE] (mod) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds to me like you wanted him dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得你是故意害死他的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I promise, I thought it would help! It was supposed to be holy water. The man at the monastery in Springvale said it was blessed!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不， 我发誓，我真的以为能帮上忙！它应该是圣水！修道院里的人说它是被祝福过的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, he gave me this pamphlet with the water. Called himself Brother Gerard. You can find him on the road through Springvale! He's responsible!
ESP.TRADUIT: 看这个，他还把这个宣传册随水赠给了我。他自称杰拉德兄弟。你可以在春之谷的路上看到他。他要负责！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rosa [090064FE] (mod) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was just trying to help. It's not my fault! Please!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是想来帮忙的。这不是我的错！真的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rosa [090064FE] (mod) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about your order.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉我你的命令。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why, to offer Enlightenment to all those who suffer, of course. No more, no less.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊哈，当然这正是为那些仍在苦难中的人们提供启发。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [09004C77] (ID) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Atom came to me with a vision: the starving, the ill, the weak, all being made whole and well by receiving the sacrament of Atom's Glow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 原子带给了我们这样一个景象：饥饿，疾病，虚弱，一切生命在接受了原子的荣光的圣礼后都重新复苏了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [09004C77] (ID) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: And so, with our holy water, we can make this vision a reality. When exposed to Atom's supreme Glow, the ill are reborn in his glowing visage.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，有了我们的圣水，我们可以让这种景象实现。当你笼罩在原子的终极光辉下，苦难中的人们将恢复生气从而获得新生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [09004C77] (ID) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those reborn never hunger, never suffer, and never age. All our Enlightened brethren need to know is Atom's Glow, and they are happy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们重生之后将永不饥饿，永无痛苦，永不老朽。我们所有启发过的同胞只须谨记原子的荣光，便可仙福永享。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [09004C77] (ID) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you doing all of this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么要这么做？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's been confirmed. The Purifier has been activated. We've been ordered to fortify our current position and wait for orders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 已经确认。净化器已经启动。上级命令我们在原地防守，并等待指示。

ESP.ORIGINAL: With a lull in the fighting, we set up and fortified our position outside the Capitol Building, near Seward Square.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在战斗的间歇，我们在国会大厦的外围，苏华德广场附近，建造起防御工事并再次加固。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Things have been relatively quiet around here lately. That'll all change when word spreads of the purifier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 前段日子的情况相对起来还是较为平静。但当关于净化器的流言传开，这些全都变了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyone and everyone will do whatever they can to get there hands on some of that water. For life or profit, it makes no difference.
ESP.TRADUIT: 任何一个人都想在这水中分一杯羹。为了生存或利益，这没什么区别。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Same old killing, just a different ingredient.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一如既往的杀戮，只是为了不同的理由。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've been in position for a couple of days now. No sign of the caravans. This is bullshit! I want some god damn water.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们已经在目标地点等了好几天了。没有商队的消息。真他妈的！我要那该死的水。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm gonna kill Jed for putting us girls through this shit. Why get close to the caravan when we could just blow 'em away from a distance?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我打算为了姑娘们把杰德干掉。如果可以从远距离赶走商队我们为什么还要靠近他们呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He says we need the ammunition and can't afford to lose anybody. "Just use your good looks or something", he says. What an ass.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他说我们需要弹药，并且没法承受失去任何人了。他说，"只要使用你的美貌或别的什么"。多么愚蠢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hahaha!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！哈！哈！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Split Jack [09003B3A] (mod) Quest : ([09003B42]DLC03WQ01) Protecting the Water Way Comment (NAM2) : blood thirsty, watching a fight EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please! Don't shoot!
ESP.TRADUIT: 求你了！别开枪！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I killed him. But I'm here to set up a "protection" deal with the gang.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，我把他干掉了。不过我想和你谈谈"保护费"的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What?!
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Officer Lepelletier [09003B3C] (mod) Quest : ([09003B42]DLC03WQ01) Protecting the Water Way Comment (NAM2) : shocked and angry EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pay 500 caps now, and I'll call off the attacks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在给我500个瓶盖，以后你们就不会再受袭击。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Damn it. I just don't have that kind of money at my disposal...
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死的。我手头可没那么多钱…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Officer Lepelletier [09003B3C] (mod) Quest : ([09003B42]DLC03WQ01) Protecting the Water Way Comment (NAM2) : frustrated but with no other choice EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's the deal. I'll give you 500 caps, from my own personal savings, mind you, and you call off the attacks. But that's it. That's all I have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的条件就是这样。我付给你500个瓶盖，请注意，这是我私人的积蓄，而你去阻止这次进攻。就这样。我只有这么多了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Officer Lepelletier [09003B3C] (mod) Quest : ([09003B42]DLC03WQ01) Protecting the Water Way Comment (NAM2) : frustrated but with no other choice EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on, I know you've got something more. Quit holding out on me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来吧，我知道你还剩了点。别再装了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. Here's an extra 50 caps. Now get out of here until next week.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。这里还有50个瓶盖。现在离开这儿下个礼拜前别回来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Give me more. Or I'll bust you upside the head.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再给多点。不然我就把你的脖子拧下来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Damnit man, why you got to be like that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真该死，哥们，你什么时候开始变得这么贪？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : partly scared partly annoyed EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here. Take half my caps. Then get the hell out of here until next week.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着。我的钱分你一半。现在滚吧下周之前别回来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : partly scared partly annoyed EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not good enough. Give me your caps, or I'll take them from your corpse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不行。把你们的瓶盖都给我，省得我在你们尸体上搜。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just don't hurt me, alright? Here's all my caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别伤害我好吗？我的瓶盖全在这里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't got shit for you to take. Honest man. My pockets are empty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我身上没东西值得拿的。说真的伙计。我的口袋空空如也。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha. I might of believed you were capable of that. But everyone knows you're a softy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈。我真该相信你能做的出来那种事。但每个人都知道你是个软蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Comment (NAM2) : laughing off an idle threat EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahem. If it wasn't for me, there'd be no protection racket.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃哼。如果不是我，你们连保护费都没机会交。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. I guess you're right. Here's a bigger share of the take. We'll see you next week.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。我猜你是对的。我再多分你点儿钱吧。我们下周见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh god, somebody help!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，上帝啊，快来人呐！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rosa [090064FE] (mod) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: No! That's not supposed to happen! No, get up! Get up! You can't pass out, you're supposed to get better! I gave you holy water, and everything!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不！这本不该发生的！不，起来！起来！你不应该死的，你本该好起来的！我给了你圣水，我给了你一切！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rosa [090064FE] (mod) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: That water... you... damn you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这水……你……该死！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Water Beggar [09006517] (mod) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water Comment (NAM2) : retching and dying from poisoned water EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I haven't tasted water this pure since... urk... Oh. Oh god, what's wrong? Water...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我好久都没喝过这么纯的……呃……噢。天啊，怎么了？这水……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Water Beggar [09006517] (mod) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water Comment (NAM2) : Suddenly succumbing to stomach cramps from poisoned water - dies at end EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Due to the security breach, access to the southern and eastern metro lines is currently prohibited.
ESP.TRADUIT: 由于安全系统被侵入，通往南部和东部的地铁线路目前被封闭了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Presidential Metro Loud Speaker [0900D502] (mod) Quest : ([0900817C]DLC03DialoguePresidentialMetro) DLC03 Presidential Metro Dialogue EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The security breach inside the Presidential Metro System has been cleared. All sections, stand down from alert status.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总统专用地铁系统的安全问题已经排除。所有区域解除紧急状态。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Presidential Metro Loud Speaker [0900D502] (mod) Quest : ([090011AD]DLC03BS3) Who Dares Wins EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Metro Transit Authority would like to extend its very best to our soldiers fighting abroad and wishes them a safe and speedy return.
ESP.TRADUIT: 地铁运输机构对我们在外国奋战的士兵表达最热诚的祝福，希望他们能早日凯旋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Presidential Metro Loud Speaker [0900D502] (mod) Quest : ([0900817C]DLC03DialoguePresidentialMetro) DLC03 Presidential Metro Dialogue EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The robot is our best weapon. If we can keep it running, we have a chance. If not, we have to find another way to counter their Vertibirds.
ESP.TRADUIT: 机器人是我们最好的武器，如果我们能保持它的运转，我们就有取胜的机会，如果不能，那必须找到其他办法来对付他们的飞鸟。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't forget they apparently have missiles they can launch at us from... hell, I don't know. Space? Kind of hard to fight back against that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别忘了他们还有导弹，他们可以从…操，我也不知道从哪里打击我们。也许是太空？见鬼，那样的话，怎么还手啊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a necessary move, but yeah. If the attack fails, they're going to come at us hard.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是必要的一步，是的。若进攻失败，他们就会让我们很难过。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've been able to steamroll the Enclave so far, but how do you think this is going to end? Can we really defeat them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们一直到现在都压着英克雷打，但是你觉得最后会结束吗？我们真的能打败他们？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm trying to stay positive, but losing the robot was a huge blow. Do you think we'll still be able to pull through this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想乐观些，但是没有了机器人，真是打击很大。你觉得我们能渡过这个难关吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go on...
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续……

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need to enter the monastery.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要进你们的教堂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, but of course! You have been blessed by Atom with Eternal Light, and are most welcome to our monastery.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，没问题！你已经被原子的永恒之光祝福过了，非常欢迎来到我们的修道院。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brother Gerard [09004C76] (mod) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You will find many kindred spirits within. Please, introduce yourself to our leader, our Luminescent Mother, Curie the Third.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会在里面发现很多血族的勇士。请你向我们的首领，我们的荧光嬷嬷，圣母居里三世，介绍你自己吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brother Gerard [09004C76] (mod) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, I can feel the Light within you. By all means, you are welcome in our sanctuary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，我能感觉到你体内的圣光。也就是说，我们的圣所现在欢迎你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brother Gerard [09004C76] (mod) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please, speak with our leader, our Luminescent Mother, Curie the Third.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请您与我们的领袖谈谈，我们的荧光嬷嬷，居里三世。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brother Gerard [09004C76] (mod) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There. I've gotten a little irradiated. Can I go in now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，我已经受了点辐射。现在我能进去吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, truly your Light is second only to the Suns of Atom themselves! You are more than welcome.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，你身上的圣光已经仅次于原子骄阳了！我们非常欢迎您。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brother Gerard [09004C76] (mod) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please, speak with our leader, our Luminescent Mother, Curie the Third.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请您与我们的领袖谈谈，我们的荧光嬷嬷，居里三世。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brother Gerard [09004C76] (mod) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am consumed with Atom's Light. Let me into your monastery.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经浸泡过原子的圣光了。让我进教堂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still working on decrypting the Enclave data pulled from the last encounter. We should have solid results soon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们还在破解上次交锋时获得的英克雷数据。相信很快就会有重大进展。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't stay here. Not after something like that...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能呆在这儿。尤其是发生了这种事之后……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rosa [090064FE] (mod) Quest : ([09004C75]DLC03WQ03) Holy Water EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hear you can help me get into Old Olney.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说你能帮我进入老奥尔尼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, maybe. I mean, possibly. I think so, but I'm not certain.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，可能吧。我是说，也许。我想是的，不过不能确定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Vallincourt [09005685] (mod) Quest : ([09000AFD]DLC03BS2) Shock Value EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know how much this will actually help... I mean, I'm not quite sure how effective it might be since it hasn't really been field tested...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道这能帮上多少忙…我是说，因为这还没在战场上测试过，所以我不是很肯定它多有效…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Vallincourt [09005685] (mod) Quest : ([09000AFD]DLC03BS2) Shock Value EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I think I've figured out a way to override the signals the Enclave is using to control their Deathclaws.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是我认为我已经研究出办法，来改变英克雷用来控制他们那些死亡爪的信号。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Vallincourt [09005685] (mod) Quest : ([09000AFD]DLC03BS2) Shock Value EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take this. It's only a prototype, so please don't lose it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，拿着。只有一个样机，所以别弄丢了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Vallincourt [09005685] (mod) Quest : ([09000AFD]DLC03BS2) Shock Value EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah... my um... LOYAL customers and FRIENDS!
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊……我的……嗯……忠实的顾客和朋友啊！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : nervous con-man, talking his way out of retribution EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, but we're Ghouls so it's not like it's hurt anybody.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错，但是我们都僵尸，所以这玩意不会危害到任何人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (stalling) nervous con-man, talking his way out of retribution EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: And, as I've said with each and every purchase: "All sales are final." Eheh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 并且，就像我对每一个买我货的人说的一样: "概不退换。" 嗯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : nervous con-man, talking his way out of retribution EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can assure you, ladies and gentlemen, that violence won't be necessary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请相信我，女士们先生们，暴力是完全没有必要的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Griffon [09003B64] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : (backing away from mob) nervous con-man, talking his way out of retribution EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Little Sister, I've stashed away a considerable amount of fuel behind the small building west of the Air Traffic Control Tower as you requested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 妹妹，我按你的要求在空中交通控制塔西面的小楼里藏了相当多的燃油。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The container's tucked away under some barrels and tires. And no, I couldn't safely confiscate an Incinerator for you, that's your job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个油桶就藏在一些桶和轮胎下面。不过，我没法给你弄到一把喷火枪，只有靠你自己了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I took too big a risk hiding that fuel for you in the first place. If you do come across an Incinerator, please be careful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在那地方为你藏了那些燃料可是冒大风险的。如果你真想弄到一把喷火枪，那就要当心了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyway, they're shipping me out to some relay station far west of here in the Wasteland. I'm afraid I won't be seeing you for awhile.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管怎么说，他们要把我送去废土西面很远的一个中继站，恐怕我们要有一段时间不能见面了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take care and good luck in all your endeavors. Your Big Brother.
ESP.TRADUIT: 以后的日子自己当心，祝你好运。你的哥哥。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So get your glasses ready, children. This round's on me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以把你的杯子准备好了,孩子们。这次我请客。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As I speak, the Brotherhood is working with Rivet City security to get that fresh water to the Wasteland. The caravans are coming!
ESP.TRADUIT: 听我说,兄弟会正在与铆钉城市保安把那些淡水送到废土。小篷车就来了!

ESP.ORIGINAL: God, ain't that beautiful? But even better, it's finally happened! The water is clean, and hell yes, it's free! Just a little patience, children.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天,不漂亮吗?但更重要的,最后成真了!水是干净和无害的,它是免费的!只要有点耐心,孩子们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: See, she was a scientist too, worked on that project. You know what she wanted? "The waters of life. Free and clean, for any and all."
ESP.TRADUIT: 看，她也是科学家,参与那项目。你知道她的想法吗?“生命之水。干净的免费的,给所有的人。”

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now you all remember James, right? Father of 101? Well, Three Dog has learned that back in the day, James' wife had a dream.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在你记住詹姆斯,好吗?101小子的父亲?嗯,三狗在以前已经认识了,詹姆斯的妻子的梦想。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Two weeks. It's been two weeks since our boys in Power Armor kicked those Enclave bastards out of Project Purity, and started that baby chugging.
ESP.TRADUIT: 两个星期。已经两周了我们的孩子在那些穿电力盔甲的英克雷混蛋手里抢回净水工程后，开始了新生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Three Dog's advice? If you've got one of those Mister Dandy butler bots, have him make you some purified water, and count yourself lucky.
ESP.TRADUIT: 三狗的建议吗?如果你能让那些上等人或管理者给你些纯水,算你走运。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The water going 'round may be free, but it sure as hell ain't clean. So when you see that caravan comin', tell 'em to keep on going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 水可以免费的拿，但是这样是不道德的。所以当你看到运水队，一定要付点什么才让他们走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Coincidence? Three Dog thinks not. For all their good intentions, it looks like those eggheads at the Jefferson Memorial screwed up royally.
ESP.TRADUIT: 巧合吗?三狗的想法,不是。因为他们的善意,它看起来像那些有知识的人在杰佛逊纪念堂搞砸了很多。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It also happens that this new illness ONLY started showin' up AFTER the Brotherhood started distributing so-called "clean" water from that purifier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在发生这种新疾病后才开始关心调查研究水净化器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Experience would tell ya this is your garden variety radiation sickness, but nuh uh. This is something else, children. Something worse. Much worse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 经验告诉你这是多种多样的辐射病。这是别的什么东西,孩子们。更大的灾难。更糟了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: People are gettin' sick. Sicker than usual, I mean. Weakness, nausea, you name it. Even a couple of deaths reported.
ESP.TRADUIT: 人是肯定病了。往常一样,我是说。软弱,恶心,就是这样。甚至有了死亡病例。

ESP.ORIGINAL: All righty, children, time to let you know about yet another problem plaguing our tranquil little post-apocalyptic neighborhood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的,孩子们,时间让你知道另一问题新的瘟疫出现在启示录之前。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Enclave's been responsible for enough death and destruction. We need to get back to normal. You know, like fighting Raiders and Super Mutants.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有太多的死亡和破坏了。我们需要回到正常的生活。你知道，如同抵抗歹徒和超级变种人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know, some laser beams here, a few exploded corpses there. Let's just hope this mop up operation ends ASAP.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道,一些雷射光束闪过,一些尸体被分解。我们希望尽快完成操作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But the fight, dear children, did not end there. The Brotherhood has been pursuing "President" Eden's little minions throughout the Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是这样战斗,亲爱的孩子们,并没有到此为止。兄弟会还在废土追缴伊甸总统的一些走狗。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's been some time since those plucky paladins in Power Armor first stormed the Jefferson Memorial and gave the Enclave their walking papers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 未来一段时间，因为那一群勇敢的骑士在杰佛逊纪念堂，把穿电力装甲的英克雷赶走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What else can you tell me about the fight against the Enclave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于对抗英克雷的战斗，你还有什么能告诉我的吗？
