ESP.ORIGINAL: As you know, I had my reservations about engaging the Enclave. They did not directly attack us, and I believed we had time. Time to be cautious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道的，我在关于与英克雷交战的问题上还保留意见。他们不会直接攻击我们，我认为我们还有时间。是时候谨慎行事了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elder Lyons [060156E4] (mod) Quest : ([09000802]DLC03BS1) Death From Above EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Their assault on the purifier forced our hand. We had no choice but to engage them directly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们对净化器的袭击迫使我们动手。除了开战，我们别无他法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elder Lyons [060156E4] (mod) Quest : ([09000802]DLC03BS1) Death From Above EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And, once that engagement was begun, we could do nothing but see it through to the end. If they had not considered us a threat before, they do now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有就是战斗一打响，我们所能作的只有等待它的结束。如果他们之前没有把我们当成威胁的话，那现在他们该改变想法了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elder Lyons [060156E4] (mod) Quest : ([09000802]DLC03BS1) Death From Above EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So we have spent the time since you and I last spoke systematically locating and destroying every bastion of Enclave force we can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 自从我们上次找出并摧毁英克雷的每一个堡垒之前已经有些时日了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elder Lyons [060156E4] (mod) Quest : ([09000802]DLC03BS1) Death From Above EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Liberty Prime has proven far more successful than any of us could have hoped for.
ESP.TRADUIT: “自由先锋”已经证明我们能取得的成功远超出我们的期望。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elder Lyons [060156E4] (mod) Quest : ([09000802]DLC03BS1) Death From Above EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've been trying to get outta here for awhile. See, I've done things for the Enclave... Things I can't say I'm proud of, but a man's gotta eat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我尝试离开这里已经有一段时间了。你也看到了我为英克雷做事…。这些事当然不怎么光彩，但是人总要吃饭啊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: When the Enclave picked me up, I was starving and suffering from radiation poisoning. I felt I owed them. But now... now it's time to leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当年英克雷收留我的时候，我正饱受饥饿之苦和辐射的伤害。我觉得我欠他们的。但是现在…现在是时候离开了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll make a great distraction while I make off with a few robots and supplies. I help you, and you help me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你尽可能的吸引他们的注意力，而我去弄点补给和机器人。我们互帮互助。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're really helpful. Why should I trust you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你突然这么帮助我。我为什么要信任你？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Man, I'm glad you realize I'm not one of the bad guys. I'll be happy to answer any questions you have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 伙计，我很高兴你明白了我不是个坏人。我很乐意回答你的任何问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Likewise. I was wondering if you could answer a few questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也很高兴见到你。不知道你能不能回答我几个问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's something jamming the control frequency!
ESP.TRADUIT: 有东西在干扰控制波频！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0900946A] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : This is said during combat. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Releasing Deathclaw!
ESP.TRADUIT: 放出死亡爪！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0900944F] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : This is said during combat. EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got blood samples to turn in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我带回了些血样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good job. I'll inform Lyons of your progress.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得漂亮。我会告诉里昂斯你所做的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fantastic. I'll get the Scribes to record your kills.
ESP.TRADUIT: 难以想象。我会让文员们记录下你的杀敌数量。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice work. Come back when you have more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得不错。如果你取得了更多的就回来找我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great! Keep them coming.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了！请再给我多带一些。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, you don't seem like the goody-goody type. But don't spread this around: So this Ghoul, Griffon, comes in wanting to PURCHASE a bunch of water.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你也不像是个虚伪的人。别把这事说出去了: 那个僵尸，格里芬，经常来这儿买水。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : pleased with his arrangement EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the hell does that droopy irradiated fool need with pure water? Thinks he can sell it in Underworld. Moron.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个快腐烂的傻瓜要这么多净水干嘛？他以为他能在地下城卖掉这些水。蠢货。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : pleased with his arrangement EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, he's the only one who's offered to PAY for water, in caps AND technology.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，只有他愿意用瓶盖或是科技来换水。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : pleased with his arrangement EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: And what Lyons doesn't know won't hurt him. There's plenty of water to go around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 里昂斯虽然不知道，但这对他没什么危害。这儿还有好多水。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : pleased with his arrangement EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: And I can use it to pay Rivet City to provide security for all the caravans we can't escort ourselves. I'm lucky he came along.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们还能用他给的钱让铆钉城的警力保护我们的商队。他来找我可是我的运气。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : pleased with his arrangement EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know you've got something set up. Don't worry, I won't tell your superiors.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你正在偷偷的干些什么。别担心，我不会告诉你上司的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found some Sensor Modules for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我给你拿了些传感器模块。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, very nice. I'll have my assembling team get right on it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，很好！我现在就让装配组去做！

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll need a lot more where this came from to reconstruct Prime's electrical systems. Keep bringing more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们还需要更多的材料才能重新建造自由金刚的电子系统。请多带点过来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's but a drop in the bucket, but it'll have to do. Thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 杯水车薪啊，但是聊胜于无。多谢啦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have Cameras for you, Scribe Rothchild.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我给你带了相机，文员罗斯查德。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good, good. Please keep bringing them to me... it's my only hope of getting Prime's optics rebuilt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，很好。请再多带一些过来…只有靠这样我才能把先锋的光学系统修复。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, splendid! Hopefully these will contain unbroken lenses unlike the last few I've acquired.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，太棒了！我希望这里面还有完好的镜头，可别像我上次拿到的那几个。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent! I'll begin disassembling them immediately. Good work!
ESP.TRADUIT: 太棒了！我马上就把它们拆开。干得好！

ESP.ORIGINAL: If someone finds this... please get this to my lover at the La Maison Beauregard Hotel in East Georgetown... he'll want to hear what I have to say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果有人发现了这个…请把它带给我住在东乔治敦，迈松博勒加德酒店的恋人…他会想要听听我说了什么的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0900B958] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : You've been shot, dying and have left a recording behind to your lover. You die at the end (trail off). EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My darling... they've found me. I... I tried to get away... tried to get away so we could be together once again...
ESP.TRADUIT: 亲爱的…他们已经找到我了。我…我试着逃走…逃走回去和你再在一起…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0900B958] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : You've been shot, dying and have left a recording behind to your lover. You die at the end (trail off). EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know you risked your life to get it to me... combing the ruins, avoiding the Super Mutants... all for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你冒着生命危险为我找到它…搜寻废墟，避开超级变种人…这一切都是为了我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0900B958] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : You've been shot, dying and have left a recording behind to your lover. You die at the end (trail off). EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It seems I shall never lay my eyes upon your gift... you... you'll have to keep it and remember me every time you see it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来我没法亲眼见到你的礼物了…你…你要带着它，每当看到它时你就会想起我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0900B958] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : You've been shot, dying and have left a recording behind to your lover. You die at the end (trail off). EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm so sorry my darling... so... so... sorry I've let you down. So many have died for this thing... so many hearts have been broken.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，亲爱的…真的…真的…对不起，让你失望了。太多人为这东西而死…太多人因此心碎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0900B958] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : You've been shot, dying and have left a recording behind to your lover. You die at the end (trail off). EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please remember, I'll always love you... you will be with me forever in my spirit... I... I... l-love... you...
ESP.TRADUIT: 请记住，我一直爱着你…你永远在我心里…我…我…我爱…你...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0900B958] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : You've been shot, dying and have left a recording behind to your lover. You die at the end (trail off). EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you down here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你来这里干嘛？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, this wasn't how it was supposed to go down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看，这没有像原本猜想的那样下降。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wint [0900B39E] (mod) Quest : ([09000AFD]DLC03BS2) Shock Value EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was a good idea at the time, y'know? Figured we'd try and set ourselves up down here. Just like Underworld, only better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当时这是个好主意，你知道吗？想想我们试着在这里建立起我们自己的地盘，就像地下城那样，而且比那里更好
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wint [0900B39E] (mod) Quest : ([09000AFD]DLC03BS2) Shock Value EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's gonna bother a bunch of Ghouls living underneath Old Olney, right? So we get down here, we start knockin' some walls down...
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有谁会想过要去惹一大堆住在老奥尔尼地下的僵尸，不是吗？所以我们来到这里，开始试着推倒几赌墙…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wint [0900B39E] (mod) Quest : ([09000AFD]DLC03BS2) Shock Value EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And the next thing you know we're getting our faces chewed off by Deathclaws.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而你会知道接下来的事情就是我们的脑袋会被死亡之爪们嚼碎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wint [0900B39E] (mod) Quest : ([09000AFD]DLC03BS2) Shock Value EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, great. Ghouls. I hate Ghouls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，太棒了。僵尸。我讨厌僵尸。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Officer Lepelletier said you'd be rewarding me...
ESP.TRADUIT: 莱佩莱捷警官警官说你会给我奖励……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, yes. I received a message from her. It's here somewhere... Well, no matter where it is, I know what it said.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，是的。我收到她的讯息了。在这儿……算了，找不到，我知道那讯息说什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : falling asleep EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Sigh.> The Initiates just finished itemizing a requisition of confiscated Enclave gear. There were a few items that we didn't immediately send out.
ESP.TRADUIT: <叹气。>那些新兵刚刚提交了一份详细的清单，申请发放被收缴的英克雷装备。我们只剩下一些没有送出去的装备了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : falling asleep EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose you are welcome to those...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得你会喜欢……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : falling asleep EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Brotherhood thanks you for your efforts. Now if you don't mind? I think I'll just take a brief nap here at my desk...
ESP.TRADUIT: 兄弟会感谢你付出的努力。现在如果你不介意的话……我想我能在这儿打个盹……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : falling asleep EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Sigh.> The Initiates just finished itemizing a requisition of confiscated Enclave gear. There were a few items that we didn't immediately send out.
ESP.TRADUIT: <叹气。>那些新兵刚刚提交了一份详细的清单，申请发放被收缴的英克雷装备。我们只剩下一些没有送出去的装备了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : falling asleep

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose you're welcome to those...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得你会喜欢……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : falling asleep EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Brotherhood thanks you for your efforts. Now if you don't mind? I think I'll just take a brief nap here at my desk...
ESP.TRADUIT: 兄弟会感谢你付出的努力。现在如果你不介意的话……我想我能在这儿打个盹……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : falling asleep EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: DLC03RewardMegaton
ESP.TRADUIT: DLC03WQRewardMegaton

ESP.ORIGINAL: Heard about that. News traveled fast. I couldn't believe it. I mean, everyone knew it was crazy building a city around that bomb...
ESP.TRADUIT: 这事传的很快，我听说了。不过我不敢相信。我是说，是人都知道围着炸弹建房子肯定是脑子进水了……

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I don't think anyone expected the bomb to actually go off...
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我觉得没人会相信那炸弹能真正安全……

ESP.ORIGINAL: I didn't expect things to end like this... but it did get Lyons off my back about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没料到这事会这样如此结束……不过现在里昂斯也不回来烦我了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So here. Might as well take the money I was going to give you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你。不如把我要给你的钱拿走吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Megaton's destroyed. I suppose their water shipment isn't much of concern now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 核弹镇已经炸没了。你再也不用担心给他们送水的问题了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A cult? There's something about Megaton, isn't there. It's apparently THE place to start a cult these days.
ESP.TRADUIT: 邪教？核弹镇果然有些古怪，不是么。很明显那儿就是这些天来出现的邪教的发源地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : exhausted but genuine EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Guess I can start sending them water again. Hopefully they can keep their grubby hands on their shipments this time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来我又能给他们送水了。希望这次他们的脏手不要来碰这些货物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : exhausted but genuine EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here. It's not much. Most of the assets have been exhausted, but take this. It's definitely worth getting Lyons off my back. Thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这儿。不算很多。有用的东西几乎都用完了，不过还有这个。这应该值得让你让里昂斯少烦我了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribe Bigsley [0900382D] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : exhausted but genuine EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've stopped the cult that was stealing Megaton's water.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我制止了从核弹镇偷水的邪教。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's wrong? What did the letter say?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么不对？信上说什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Obadiah Blackhall sent me. I have a letter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥巴迪亚·布莱克霍尔派我来的，我这有封信。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Obadiah sent you? Well, then, let's see what he has to say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥巴迪亚派你来的？好吧，来看看他要说什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: (Pauses to read note)
ESP.TRADUIT: （停下来读信）

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh dear... no, no. This can only mean one thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊…不。这只能意味着一件事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Obadiah Blackhall sent me. I have a letter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥巴迪亚·布莱克霍尔派我来的，我这有封信。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you expect me to do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想让我做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We must get it back before the Krvibi learn anything from it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们必须在《黑暗圣经》从中学到任何东西之前夺回来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a ritual site... I'm certain they'll be hiding it there. I don't know yet what we must do, but for now it's enough to steal the book.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有一处仪式场所…我确信他们会将它藏在那里。我还不知道我们必须做什么，但现在我们应该先把书偷走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll do it, Obadiah. There's no reason for you to die.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我同意，奥巴迪亚。你不该死。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you talking about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说什么呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This isn't some ordinary book we can toss in a fire and be done with. I can destroy it here and now, but the ritual requires a sacrifice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这书不一般，不是扔到火里烧了就完事的。我现在就可以将其销毁，但这需要有人牺牲。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They'll kill me anyway. Now that they've possessed the book, they'll do anything to get it back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论如何他们都会来杀我。他们已经丧心病狂了，并会不惜一切将其夺回。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There must be something we can do. We have the book.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一定还有什么办法。书在我们手上啊！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, Obadiah, but it's true. The book is here, with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很抱歉，奥巴迪亚，但这书真的在这里，就在我这。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I... I see. Friend, this book is the bane of my Family. Now it seems it will be the death of us, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我…我明白了。朋友，这书是我家族衰败的根源。看来我们也会因此消失吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Show him the Book.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <把书给他看。>

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll be bloody well damned. She was right. It's back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会被诅咒的。她说得没错。这书回来了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Krvibi had it, I took it, and now she's dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这本来是卡维碧的，现在在我手上，她已经死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have it? God help us; you do. That damned book is back, and this time it'll be the death of me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在你手里？上天相助啊，你得到了书。诅咒之书回来了，这一次我面对的将是死亡。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Marcella? Why? She's done nothing to them!
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛塞拉？为什么？她什么也没做！

ESP.ORIGINAL: They killed her, Obadiah. I'm sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她已经死了，奥巴迪亚。我很抱歉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What good are you, then? Take her that letter; she's the only person who might know how to help me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这对你又有什么好处呢？带封信给她；恐怕只有她会帮我了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I haven't seen her yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还没有看到过她。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good job blocking off that hole! Hurry and get in here! It looks like they are about to breach from the East wing!
ESP.TRADUIT: 洞口堵住了！干得漂亮！快进来！看起来他们要从东翼突破了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0A0035B4] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Player just blocked the first breach from the attic in the West wing. Desmond meets him, possibly thanks him with some dialogue, then says they are EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hurry! Get in there before more of them come out! Find where they are coming from and stop them. Just like before I'll be keeping an eye out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 快！在更多人来之前进去！看看他们是从哪进来的，阻止他们。和刚才一样，我会一直盯着你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0A0035B4] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : At the door to the East wing after a small battle. Tells the player to basically do what he did before, and that he'll be keeping an eye out. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's one less way for them to get in. Follow me. I think we are about to get hit hard.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们又少了一条可以进来的路。跟我来。咱们有场硬仗要打。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0A0035B4] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : After sealing the second attic breach he tells the player to follow him because they are about to get swarmed. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, here they come. Grab all the ammo and stimpaks you need. This is gonna be a rough one!
ESP.TRADUIT: 耶，他们来了。拿上你所需要的弹药和治疗针。这会很刺激！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0A0035B4] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Checkes the cameras quick, notices that he was right and they are about to breach from every angle. Tells the player to get prepared, and where to go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They've been at it all night. I think they are just about to breach the inner walls. Follow me. I'm going to go check it out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们整晚都在。我想他们就要突破内墙了。跟着我。我们去查看一下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0A0035B4] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Looking at the security monitors he notices they are about to breach the inners walls in the West wing. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It looks like they are coming in from somewhere upstairs. Hurry, follow me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来他们从楼上另一处来。快点，跟着我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0A0035B4] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Looking up at a hole he notices where they are coming in from. Tells the player to follow him as if he has something for him to do. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go through these doors and up the stairs. Find where they are coming in and stop them. I'll be keeping an eye on the cameras down here. Hurry!
ESP.TRADUIT: 从这门上楼。看看他们从哪进来的，一定要阻止他们。我会在这里从摄像机中观察。快去！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0A0035B4] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Orders the player to get up there and find out what's going on. Reminds the player that he'll be keeping an eye on him through the security cameras. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the mine, Kenny.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉我关于矿井的事，肯尼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Old Man Herzog's Mine-hole? Isn't much, but it's home!
ESP.TRADUIT: 老赫尔佐格的矿井？不多，但那是家！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about this mine, Kenny.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉我关于矿井的事，肯尼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is Caroline Saunders, principal geological chemist, for Bysshe natural gas survey MD-16-001.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里是卡洛琳·桑德斯，首席地质化学家，为彼希测量天然气，编号MD-16-001。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sample set one shows promising concentration of bio-gas in mostly limestone substratum of wetlands.
ESP.TRADUIT: 样本的分析指出生化气体最有可能会在塘持的石灰岩底层。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No exact levels yet, but this site should exhibit more than enough extraction potential to meet survey goals.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有具体数据显示可能会在多深处，但是这个地点应该有足够的量来萃取以达到测量目标。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm going to leave a couple of interns here to handle the minutiae, but it's a formality.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我将会留下几个实习生来处理细节上的东西，但是那都不过是形式上的措施罢了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll move on to the other sites now to make sure this isn't an aberration. Consider this my authorization signature on Sample Site One.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在就去下一个地点，以确定测量上没有差错。可以把这当成是我的样本地点一的授权。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey! Over here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨！这！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0A0035B4] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Telling the player look at him instead of take off in the wrong direction. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ok, any second now. Get ready!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，随时会来。做好准备！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0A0035B4] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Final Wave: Telling the player where the attackers are coming from EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here they come! Second floor, on the right!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们来了！二楼，右边！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0A0035B4] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Final Wave: Telling the player where the attackers are coming from EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: More of them! On the right, first floor!
ESP.TRADUIT: 又来了！右边，一楼！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0A0035B4] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Final Wave: Telling the player where the attackers are coming from EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The door on the left! First floor!
ESP.TRADUIT: 左边的门！一楼！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0A0035B4] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Final Wave: Telling the player where the attackers are coming from EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're at the front door! Get ready!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们在正门！准备好！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0A0035B4] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Final Wave: Telling the player where the attackers are coming from EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That looks like the last of 'em. You're a pretty good shot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来是最后一波了。你枪法不错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0A0035B4] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Lets the player know the final wave is over. Says something snarkier than what i wrote. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does this tonic really cure anything at all?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这种活力水真的能治好什么病么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, just about whatever ails you, sweetie! A real cure-all. Say, I don't reckon you're the dry type, is you? Oh, never mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论是什么让你不适，宝贝！真正包治百病。我认为你不是那种干燥的类型，对吗？噢，别介意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why exactly should I help you, again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我到底为什么还要再帮你？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I don't rightly expect you to help me out of goodness, though I welcome you to prove me wrong, sweetie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我并不期望你出于好意帮助我，但我欢迎你证明我错了，宝贝。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When we brew this batch of tonic up, you'll have rights to a share for yourself, and a payday of 300 caps to boot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等我们制好了这批补药，你将可以分得自己的一份，以及开始每日300瓶盖的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We got everything. Now we wait while it brews. Three days should do the trick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 万事俱备了。现在等着它调制吧。三天应该就够了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I can fix it. No charge.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我可以修好它，不要钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aren't you a smart one? Sweeter tonic's better for both of us, after all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不是一个聪明人吗？毕竟，甜一些的补药对我们俩都好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll get it working like new, but I want 200 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以让它工作得像新的一样，但我想要200个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I reckon you've got a deal, sweetie, but I'd better notice a difference in the tonic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认为你做了笔买卖，宝贝，但我最好能看到补药的不同。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can fix it up. Let's call it 100 caps of work?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以修好它，代价是100个瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I reckon I can scrape that together. Go ahead and do what you can for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认为我能把那弄到一起。去吧，尽力而为。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your still could stand to be fixed up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你仍然可以随时来这里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Could it, now? I suppose you'd know how to see to that, wouldn't you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在呢，可以了么？我猜想你可以照顾好那个了吧，你说呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you build that still yourself?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是你自己建造的?

ESP.ORIGINAL: That old thing's been in my family for years and years.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个老古董在我家族中流传了很多很多年。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well before the bombs, there was a time folks couldn't get no tonic by law, and my family did okay helping them get what they needed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在核弹爆炸前，曾有一段居民们不能依法获得补药的时光，而我的家族很非常乐意帮助他们取得所需。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to know more about you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想知道更多关于你的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why, I'm just folk. What more is there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么，我只是个平民。还有什么事？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about this tonic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们来谈谈恢复药剂的事吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you're gonna love it, sweetie. Just you wait.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你会爱上它的，亲爱的。先稍等片刻。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, I guess I just haven't heard of that illness. Maybe I can help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很遗憾听到这些，我想我从来没听说过这种病。或许我能帮你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I reckon you can, at that. I just need some help brewing up a little tonic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而且我认为你能做到。我只是需要点帮助来调制补药。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're sick? What's the matter?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你生病了？什么病？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Reckon it's the Orange Fever. I do feel light in my head...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认为是橙流感。我感到脑子发热…...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Twenty wild Punga Fruit, just for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 20个野生膨葛，拿去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Little scrawny, but they'll do. Thank you, sweetie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小个了点，但也行。谢谢你，宝贝。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take ten of these refined Punga Fruit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，这是10个精制的膨葛。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sweet and ripe, too. These will do just fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 又甜又熟。这些正合适。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go to the bank and use password xìn tian weng. The software is configured to recognize only our voices.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去银行，并且使用密码xin tian weng。软件已被设置为只会识别我们的声音。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A010A4B] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Chinese man with an almost perfect "American" accent. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Nadine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉我关于娜丁的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, thank you so much! And now that she's got this boat and carrying all this cargo...
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，太感谢你了！现在她有了这艘船，还载着这么多货物……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I can afford to actually pay you! Thank you so much!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我真的付得起你的报酬了！太谢谢你了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got Nadine back, safe and sound.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把娜丁安然无恙地带回来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So? It's smoke. Things burn down all the time. Especially around me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么？这不过是烟而已。每时每刻都有东西烧着，尤其在我周围。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, it's smoke, all right. Where there's smoke, there's fire - and where there's fire, there's profit to be made selling an extinguisher!
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，是烟，好吧。哪儿有烟，哪儿就有火 — 哪儿有火，哪儿就有兜售灭火器的机会！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A006634] (ID) Quest : ([0A005846]DLC04MQ01) The Local Flavor EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: That smoke's coming from old Calvert Mansion. I always heard it was haunted, but more importantly, I always heard it was full of Pre-War treasure!
ESP.TRADUIT: 烟从老卡尔弗特公馆出来。我一直听说那儿闹鬼，但更重要的是，总听到那里满是战前宝藏！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A006634] (ID) Quest : ([0A005846]DLC04MQ01) The Local Flavor EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know I said Point Lookout was perfect for treasure hunters, but it's a rare day when you get a beacon like that!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道我说过望海崖是财宝猎人的圣地，但现在能有那么个灯塔很稀奇了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A006634] (ID) Quest : ([0A005846]DLC04MQ01) The Local Flavor EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why did you run away from home, Kenny?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么要离家出走，肯尼?

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wasn't born right. Mama hid me in the basement and pappy kinda just forgot about me, but I knew I had to go before I grew up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我生得不是时候。妈妈把我藏在地下室，爸爸好像是把我忘了一样，但是我知道我要在我长大之前离开这里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come over here, boy. Let's talk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 快过来，小子。咱们谈谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0A00584A]DLC04MQ05a) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come over here, girl. Let's talk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 快过来，小妞。咱们谈谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0A00584A]DLC04MQ05a) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why did you attack the mansion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么攻击这公馆？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We take no pleasure in violence. Our goal was merely to remove the Ghoul. His presence is an offense to the Transcendent Master's astral dominion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不喜欢用暴力解决问题。我们的目标仅仅是除掉那个僵尸。他的出现是对我们至高无上主人的星之领土的冒犯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I cannot claim to understand the exact reasons that the mansion's resident caused such disruption, however. To understand fully, ask the Master.
ESP.TRADUIT: 公馆里的居民造成如此破坏的具体原因我并不清楚。如果想知道的话，你应该去找主人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course I did, but that moron thought it was one of his addled visions. The real goal was to destroy the Ghouls' jamming device!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然了。但是那个傻子还以为是他那愚蠢的“神谕”呢。实际上，真正的目的是去摧毁僵尸的干扰设施。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Honestly, those fools aren't worth the meat they're made of. A minion that can't follow directions is no use at all!
ESP.TRADUIT: 坦白地说，那些傻子一点存在的价值都没有。奴才要是不听话，那就一点用都没有！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you tell the Tribals to attack the mansion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是你下令让部落攻击这公馆的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Woah, woah, woah! That was all Jackson's crazy idea. I knew better than to volunteer for that suicide mission!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇哦，哇哦，哇哦！这很显然是杰克逊出的疯狂的主意。这种自愿去送死的做法，我一眼就能看出来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Last time I wandered too close to that mansion, some old Ghoul sicced his dogs on me. Screw that!
ESP.TRADUIT: 有一次我打算接近那公馆，结果有些老僵尸竟然把狗放出来咬我。去他娘的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm afraid of heights.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有恐高症。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that's just too bad, ain't it? But since you're so afraid, attach the thing to one of the cars and then spin it around to get it to the top.
ESP.TRADUIT: 喔，那太糟了，不是吗？但既然你这么害怕，那就随便装到一个客厢上，再转到高处。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll watch from here and turn it on when it's ready. Then we'll see where our little Professor is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就从这里观察，就绪了便开启开关。然后就能知道咱们的小教授在哪了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, go!
ESP.TRADUIT: 去吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: That big wheel down by the docks, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 港口下面的巨轮，没错吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right. Attach it to the bottom car, then turn it on and spin the jammer to the top. No fuckin' problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错。装到最下面的客厢上，开启开关，把干扰器转到最高处。绝对他妈的没问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll watch from here and turn it on. Then we'll see where our little professor is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就从这里观察并开启开关。然后就能知道咱们的小教授在哪了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, go!
ESP.TRADUIT: 去吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was just admiring the architecture. I didn't mean any offense.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是在欣赏这建筑，没有任何恶意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're in Blackhall Manor. This isn't a tourist attraction, but I appreciate your good taste. Come, let's talk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你身处布莱克霍尔庄园。这不是旅游胜地，但我欣赏你的品位。来吧，我们谈谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A002F3E] (ID) Quest : ([0A002F47]DLC04FF02) The Dark Heart of Blackhall EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was just admiring the architecture. I didn't mean any offense.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是在欣赏这建筑，没有任何恶意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found your teddy bear. <Lie.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到你的泰迪熊了。<撒谎>

ESP.ORIGINAL: I... guess that's Kenny-Bear. Thanks for bringing him back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我…猜那就是肯尼熊吧。谢谢你帮我把他带回来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kenny [0A00815A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : uncertain (it really isn't his teddy bear) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. I'll go get it for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我会帮你把它搞到手的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gee, thanks! I dropped him near the shaft, so he's probably at the bottom.
ESP.TRADUIT: 耶啊，谢谢！我把他掉进那个通风管道里了，也许你能在最底部找到。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm still looking for your teddy bear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还在找你的泰迪熊呢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kenny-Bear! You're the greatest!
ESP.TRADUIT: 肯尼熊！你是最棒的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found your teddy bear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到你的泰迪熊了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kenny-Bear! You're the greatest!
ESP.TRADUIT: 肯尼熊！你是最棒的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kenny [0A00815A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : hoping he's found a new friend EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So hey. You can use this place as your hideout if you want. Hide from the folk out there. Stash your stuff. Okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，嘿。如果你想的话你可以把这里当做你的藏身之处。藏起来不被外面那些家伙发现。存放你的东西。好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kenny [0A00815A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : hoping he's found a new friend EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found your teddy bear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到你的泰迪熊了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What should I be doing again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我下面该做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I told you about their ritual site, remember? See if they're hiding the book there and bring it back to me. From there? I don't yet know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我跟你说过他们的仪式场所，记得吗？看看他们有没有把书藏在那儿，有的话带回来？我可说不好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a bit short on caps at the moment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在手头没那么多瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps you're in the wrong place? Do come back when you have the means.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许你找错地方了吧?当你想到解决办法的时候再回来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, Desmond. But whose side is she on? Do you know? Can you be sure? You always were so bad at choosing your allies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，德斯蒙德。但你知道她会帮哪边吗？你能确定吗？你总是不会选择盟友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0A00584B]DLC04MQ05b) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Neat! I want some of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真棒！我要一份！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're free to take whatever you find in this disgusting place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这个令人恶心的地方，你找到的东西都归你所有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What I came for is of no interest to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来这里的原因与你无关。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enjoy your spoils. I don't think our paths will ever cross again. And I think we can both thank Christ and say hallelujah for that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好好享用你的战利品吧，我想我们以后的道路不再会有交集了。并且我们可以为此感谢主，并说声哈利路亚。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, where's my cut?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，我那份在哪儿？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're free to take whatever you find in this disgusting place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这个令人恶心的地方，你找到的东西都归你所有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What I came for is of no interest to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来这里的原因与你无关。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enjoy your spoils. I don't think our paths will ever cross again. And I think we can both thank Christ and say hallelujah for that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好好享用你的战利品吧，我想我们以后的道路不再会有交集了。并且我们可以为此感谢主，并说声哈利路亚。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're free to take whatever you find in this disgusting place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这个令人恶心的地方，你找到的东西都归你所有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0A0035B4] (mod) Quest : ([0A00584B]DLC04MQ05b) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What I came for is of no interest to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来这里的原因与你无关。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0A0035B4] (mod) Quest : ([0A00584B]DLC04MQ05b) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enjoy your spoils. I don't think our paths will ever cross again. And I think we can both thank Christ and say hallelujah for that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好好享用你的战利品吧，我想我们以后的道路不再会有交集了。并且我们可以为此感谢主，并说声哈利路亚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0A0035B4] (mod) Quest : ([0A00584B]DLC04MQ05b) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It happens to us all. Let's go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 碰巧就落到我们头上了。走吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Brace yourself, my friend. You're about to witness the end of an era!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要打起精神，我的朋友，因为你将见证一个时代的终结！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0A0035B4] (mod) Quest : ([0A00584B]DLC04MQ05b) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because I'm done taking orders from you. After this, we're through.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为我受够了听从你的指挥了。从现在开始，我们没关系了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: After this, I won't require your services any longer. I suppose that works out now, doesn't it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这一切结束以后，我就不再需要你的服务了。我想这就解决了我们之间的问题，不是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0A0035B4] (mod) Quest : ([0A00584B]DLC04MQ05b) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, since we're in agreement about this, let's go in there and "retire" the good professor!
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为你已经同意了，那么就让我们进去，让那个大教授“退休”吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0A0035B4] (mod) Quest : ([0A00584B]DLC04MQ05b) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Brace yourself, you're about to witness the end of an era!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要打起精神，我的朋友，因为你将见证一个时代的终结！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0A0035B4] (mod) Quest : ([0A00584B]DLC04MQ05b) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That'll do. Let's go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 行了，我们走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've waited a long time for this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我为了这一刻已经等了很久了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0A0035B4] (mod) Quest : ([0A00584B]DLC04MQ05b) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Savor the moment, my friend. This is the end of an era.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好好品味这一时刻吧，我的朋友。这是一个时代的终结。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0A0035B4] (mod) Quest : ([0A00584B]DLC04MQ05b) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't need eyes to know you're there. Come here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不用眼睛就知道你在哪里。过来！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, we shall be free of all limitations! Thank you, master. We shall be the instrument of your mighty will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我们不应受任何界线的阻碍！谢谢你，主人。我们将辅佐你万能的意念。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, fine, go destroy the house and its "impurities." Just stop that jammer, and I'll be free of you morons, once and for all!
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，好，去摧毁那房子和那“干扰器”，我就放了你这个白痴，你就永远自由了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: No need to worry, enlightened one. We shall re-consecrate the mansion, and remove the impurities disrupting your perfect guidance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没必要担心，文明人。我们会重新供奉公馆，并清除一切干扰你完美指引的杂志。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, not "astral knowledge" you simpleton! Psychic domination! And that still won't be possible until you destroy Desmond's jamming device.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，不是“星界知识”，你这呆子！心灵控制！而且要等你摧毁了德斯蒙德的干扰器后才有可能！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, and you will be able to spread your knowledge across the astral plane for all those wise enough to accept it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，你将可以在整个星界对那些足够聪明的人散播你的知识。

ESP.ORIGINAL: At last, yes! Desmond will die, and our long struggle will finally end the only way it could have - with me as the victor!
ESP.TRADUIT: 最终，是的！德斯蒙德会死，而我们旷日持久的斗争终将迎来唯一可能的结局——我是胜者！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Soon, your sacred land shall be cleared of all obstacles. No longer shall its mystical powers be diminished!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不久，你神圣的土地将清除所有障碍。所蕴藏的神秘力量将不再衰弱！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I might be able to help you. But first I want to know more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我可以帮助你，但我需要先多了解一些事情。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent. I cannot tell you how satisfying it is to find a suitable assistant after all these years.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了，这么多年，我终于找到了像你这样合适的帮手，这可真是太令我满意了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, the Ghoul is a pain, and may require disposal, but Desmond is only of secondary importance. The real target is a device in his possession.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个僵尸是个障碍，也许应该除掉他，不过吗，德斯蒙德不那么重要，那个设备才是头等大事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He has a jammer which limits my projection range to this pathetic cave. Remove that, and I can extend my reach so much further...
ESP.TRADUIT: 他的那个干扰设备限制了我的对这个可怜的洞穴的控制。除掉那个东西，我就可以将我的思想传播得更远了…

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't promise anything, but tell me more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在不能承诺你任何事，但你可以先多告诉我一些事情。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Useful? What are you using the tribe for?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有用？你打算用这个部落做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: At the moment, they've been no use at all, but I have very few options. They can't even seem to remove a single Ghoul from a house.
ESP.TRADUIT: 目前来说，这些人一点用都没有，但是我的选择并不多。他们连个房子里的僵尸都搞不定。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you come to lead this tribe?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么成为这个部落的首领的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jackson believes me to be some kind of god. You'd think that would be good, but his interpretations of my commands leaves something to be desired.
ESP.TRADUIT: 杰克逊还以为我是什么神呢。你也许认为这不错，但是他对我的命令的解释说明却延缓了我渴望要做的事情。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Regardless, I trust you can be more effective than he has been. I need your help on an important task.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管怎么样，你做事会比他更有效率吧。我需要你帮我做一个非常重要的事情。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a troublesome Ghoul who lives in Calvert Mansion. I need him destroyed, and his jamming device neutralized, immediately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有一个非常麻烦的僵尸，他住在卡尔弗特公馆。我需要你立刻把它杀死，并且毁掉它的干扰设备。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He thinks I'm some sort of god, and I have no reason to disabuse him of the notion. This makes me de facto leader of the tribe, as it were.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他以为我是个神，并且我也没有理由去纠正他错误的想法。在某种程度上，这使我成为这个部族的实际首领。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Regardless, I trust you can be more effective than he has been. I need your help on an important task.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管怎么样，你做事会比他更有效率吧。我需要你帮我做一个非常重要的事情。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a troublesome Ghoul who lives in Calvert Mansion. I need him destroyed, and his jamming device neutralized, immediately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有一个非常麻烦的僵尸，他住在卡尔弗特公馆。我需要你立刻把它杀死，并且毁掉它的干扰设备。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why was Jackson talking to you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 杰克逊为什么要跟你谈话？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just wanted to meet the Tribal leader.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只想跟部落的领导见一面。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I may be the man who leads our physical affairs, but I cannot claim true wisdom. I take my orders from a higher master!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我大概可以被称为是这里实际事务的决策者，但是我并不是精神领袖。有更高阶的领导给与我命令。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whether it be how to explore higher planes, or the decision to remove the disruptive Ghoul, all wisdom comes from the Transcendent Master.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论是定下长远目标，还是决定除掉恼人的僵尸，所有的智慧，学问与正确的判断都来自于那个至高无上的主人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was drawn to your eternal wisdom.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我被你永恒的智慧所吸引了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What splendid news! At last the holy land is empty of its destructive aurora, and the astral plain is open to us all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多好啊！也许你就是那个能够净化这片残破不堪的圣地的救世主。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, but the Transcendent Master will want to hear of this! And as the returning champion, it is your right and honor to tell him yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，但是这个消息要通知给至高无上的主人！你要亲自告诉给主人，这是你的权利也是你的荣誉，因为这一消息是多么显而易见的神谕啊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: After all, it is he who makes all true decisions about the spiritual growth of our tribe, including the decision to cleanse the mansion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 毕竟，他才是我们部族精神上的决策者，决策也包括净化那公馆。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Batteries? For extra "kick"?
ESP.TRADUIT: 电池？ 更“带劲”?

ESP.ORIGINAL: You best keep this one to yourself, sweetie. The family tonic gets real kick from our secret ingredient. We just need a lil' bit of battery acid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好把这个留给自己，宝贝。家传秘密配方炼制的补药可带劲了。我们只需要一点电池酸液。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, don't look like that, now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我可不喜欢那样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You reckon I'd be around to tell you about it if it weren't safe enough? Bring me six fission batteries and I'll scrape 'em into the mix.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是危险的话，你以为我还会在这儿告诉你这些吗？给我六块电池，我来把它们磨成碎屑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought so. Those things do carry a smell, don't they?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也这么想。那些东西真的很难闻，不是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me take 'em off your hands, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我把它们从你手里拿走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got batteries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我搞到电池了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mentioned yeast?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你提到了酵母？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see. Thank you kindly for these.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我懂了。谢谢你这些东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got the yeast with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我弄到酵母了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We need Punga Fruit?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还需要膨葛?

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wild fruit, eh? Just as good, if a sight weaker for flavor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 野生水果，嗯哼？也不错，希望味道不会太浓烈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This enough Punga Fruit for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这么多膨葛够了么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see you sprung for the refined fruit. Good for you, sweetie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看你搞到了精制水果。太棒了，宝贝。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This enough Punga Fruit for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这么多膨葛够了么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I might be. Motivate me not to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许吧。别逼我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you fucking joking? I suppose you aren't. What is it you people use for money these days? Those bottle caps?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你他妈在开玩笑？我看不像。最近你的人都把什么当作货币？就这些瓶盖？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right. Well, here's a bunch of those. Now go do your goddamn job before my patience runs out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错。唔，这还有一串。现在，在我失去耐心之前滚回去做你那该死的工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You... and- ... that Ghoul... ... ...both... ... pay...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你……和-……那个尸鬼……都……代价...

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...coming for- ...you... ... ...
I'd like to buy a ticket.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想买张票。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, I'm not normally one to discourage an adventurous spirit, but certain... events have convinced me of the value of forewarning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如今，我通常不会劝阻有冒险精神的家伙，但某些……事让我相信预先警告的重要性。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know you think you're ready for anything, but the threats you'll face in the swamp make those Super Mutants look like playful puppies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你认为自己已经做好面对一切的准备，但是你即将要面对的是是把沼泽里的超级变种人搞得束手无策这样的威胁。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So just be sure you know what you're getting into, okay? You still want to head out to Point Lookout?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道你将要卷入一个什么样的事件里么？即使如此，你仍然打算去望海崖？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's see what you've got to trade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看你都有些什么东西要卖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm here to buy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要买点东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Happy to oblige!
ESP.TRADUIT: 乐意听从！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm here to buy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要买点东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: At last! He's just ahead! I'll circle around and distract him. You take him from the front.
ESP.TRADUIT: 终于！要逮到他了！我绕着分散他的注意力。你从正面进攻。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0A0035B4] (mod) Quest : ([0A00584A]DLC04MQ05a) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Air Com, we have multiple flashpoints on horizon, come back?
ESP.TRADUIT: 空军指挥部，我们发现地平线有多处闪光点，请指示？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A00C2B7] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Excitable/Stressed. Cockpit recording. No-nonsense Military Jargon. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Air Command, USN Three-Five-Oh requesting landing vector. Have zero ceiling visbility and low on state, somebody get me a landing clearance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 空军指挥部，美国海军3-5-0请求着陆航线。当前能见度为零并且器械运转状态不佳，请给与着陆指示。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A00C2B7] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Excitable/Stressed. Cockpit recording. No-nonsense Military Jargon. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: State One plus one zero to splash, have zero read on outer marker. This is USN Three-Five-Oh, I'm blind out here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 状态为离斑点1+10处，雷达无显示。这里是美国海军3-5-0，我失去定位能力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A00C2B7] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Excitable/Stressed. Cockpit recording. No-nonsense Military Jargon. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Attempting Emergency Landing over water. INS pinger active on distress band. Flaps up, descent to eight cherubs. Three green, over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尝试紧急水上迫降。惯性导航系统声波发生器紧急启动。有振动，高度降至800。通话结束。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A00C2B7] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Excitable/Stressed. Cockpit recording. No-nonsense Military Jargon. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Five cherubs, treeline up, throttle easy on four lights. Prepping to pull the loud handle. <Static>
ESP.TRADUIT: 高度降至500，垂直下降，油门调节可轻易达到四灯。做好拉起飞机准备。<静电声>
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A00C2B7] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Excitable/Stressed. Cockpit recording. No-nonsense Military Jargon. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good! Good... now, come speak with me. We have matters to discuss...
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好！好吧… 现在，来跟我聊聊。有些事需要讨论…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Loud Speaker [0C0790C5] (mod) Quest : ([0A00584B]DLC04MQ05b) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No! How... how could this... be... ... ?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不！怎么…怎么会…这样……？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A005A38] (ID) Quest : ([0A00584B]DLC04MQ05b) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No! How... how could this... be... ... ?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不！怎么…怎么会…这样……？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A005A38] (ID) Quest : ([0A00584A]DLC04MQ05a) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All robots! Activate! Destroy Desmond!
ESP.TRADUIT: 所有机器人！启动！干掉德斯蒙德！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Loud Speaker [0C0790C5] (mod) Quest : ([0A00584B]DLC04MQ05b) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All robots! Activate! Destroy Desmond!
ESP.TRADUIT: 所有机器人！启动！干掉德斯蒙德！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Loud Speaker [0C0790C5] (mod) Quest : ([0A00584A]DLC04MQ05a) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about I kill you instead?
ESP.TRADUIT: 把你给杀了怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Surely you mean that you will TRY!
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来你想试试！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A005A38] (ID) Quest : ([0A00584B]DLC04MQ05b) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Robots! TO ME!
ESP.TRADUIT: 机器人！到我这来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A005A38] (ID) Quest : ([0A00584B]DLC04MQ05b) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Killing you is going to be more fun than killing Desmond.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得干掉你比干掉德斯蒙德更有意思。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I certainly hope you enjoy your final moments!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我当然希望你能享受最后的时刻！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A005A38] (ID) Quest : ([0A00584B]DLC04MQ05b) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Robots! To me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 机器人！到我这来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A005A38] (ID) Quest : ([0A00584B]DLC04MQ05b) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, let's do this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，动手吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha ha ha ha ha! YES! LET'S!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈哈！是的！来吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A005A38] (ID) Quest : ([0A00584B]DLC04MQ05b) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Robots! To me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 机器人！到我这来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A005A38] (ID) Quest : ([0A00584B]DLC04MQ05b) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Assist me, my robots! I am... under attack!
ESP.TRADUIT: 协助我，我的机器人！我遭到了…攻击！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A005A38] (ID) Quest : ([0A00584B]DLC04MQ05b) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Assist me, my robots! I am... under attack!
ESP.TRADUIT: 协助我，我的机器人！我遭到了…攻击！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A005A38] (ID) Quest : ([0A00584A]DLC04MQ05a) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All in a day's work. Now share your wisdom with me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 天天如此。现在，跟我分享一下你的智慧吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, for you... I have a very special gift:
ESP.TRADUIT: 唔，我为你…准备了一份特别的礼物：
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A005A38] (ID) Quest : ([0A00584B]DLC04MQ05b) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: DEATH!
ESP.TRADUIT: Death!
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A005A38] (ID) Quest : ([0A00584B]DLC04MQ05b) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wanted to show Desmond that no one pushes me around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要让德斯蒙德知道，没人能摆布我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I would have expected nothing less from you. And now, I have a very special gift:
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没想到你会这么无能。现在，我有份特别的礼物：
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A005A38] (ID) Quest : ([0A00584B]DLC04MQ05b) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: DEATH!
ESP.TRADUIT: Death!
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A005A38] (ID) Quest : ([0A00584B]DLC04MQ05b) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's right. So, what do I get for it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有道理。那我能有什么好处呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, for you... I have a very special gift:
ESP.TRADUIT: 唔，我为你…准备了一份特别的礼物：
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A005A38] (ID) Quest : ([0A00584B]DLC04MQ05b) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: DEATH!
ESP.TRADUIT: Death!
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A005A38] (ID) Quest : ([0A00584B]DLC04MQ05b) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One... two... three... four... five... six... seven... eight... nine... ten...
ESP.TRADUIT: 一…二…三…四…五…六…七…八…九…十…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kenny [0A00815A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : calling out, counting off before playing hide and seek EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ok ok... I'll do it. Just point that thing somewhere else. ...My name is John Adlam, son of Joseph Adlam, and brother of Richard Adlam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，好…我会说的。你能不能把那个东西指向别处啊。…我的名字是约翰·阿德拉姆，约瑟夫·阿德拉姆的儿子，理查德·阿德拉姆的哥哥。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Two days ago I was caught stealing from the groups' claim.
ESP.TRADUIT: 2天前，我因为偷东西而被抓。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Today, with the consent of my father, I am to be shot and killed on the cliffs of the old cathedral by the hands of my brother, Richard.
ESP.TRADUIT: 今天，在我父亲的许可之下，我将会在大教堂那里的悬崖上被枪决，而执行枪决的人是我的弟弟，理查德。

ESP.ORIGINAL: With my execution, my punishment is exacted and the Adlam name will be avenged.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我被枪决以后，我将受到应有的惩罚，而且阿德拉姆家也会被正名。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let my punishment be a reminder to those who may be tempted to do as I did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就让对我的惩罚警告后人不要步我后尘。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I usually hide my bodies in the river, but this is nice, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我一般都是躲在河里的，但这样也不错。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We are nothing alike. More so than you could ever comprehend. Go now, and never return.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们完全不同。你完全无法理解。走吧，别再回来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A002F3E] (ID) Quest : ([0A002F47]DLC04FF02) The Dark Heart of Blackhall EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nah. I think I'll kill you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我想杀了你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then you shall die along with him!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你就跟他一起死吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A005A38] (ID) Quest : ([0A00584A]DLC04MQ05a) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My dad always said, "Never trust a disembodied brain."
ESP.TRADUIT: 我爸爸总是说，“永远别相信没有肉体的脑袋”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You would have been wise to listen to him!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你该乖乖听他的话的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A005A38] (ID) Quest : ([0A00584A]DLC04MQ05a) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: ROBOTS! ATTACK!
ESP.TRADUIT: 机器人！进攻！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A005A38] (ID) Quest : ([0A00584A]DLC04MQ05a) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't we talk through this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不能把话说清楚吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are permitted to talk while you DIE!
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么话等下地狱再说吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A005A38] (ID) Quest : ([0A00584A]DLC04MQ05a) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: ROBOTS! TO ME!
ESP.TRADUIT: 机器人！到我这来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A005A38] (ID) Quest : ([0A00584A]DLC04MQ05a) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you've got to be kidding me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你一定是在跟我开玩笑吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Professor Calvert is never kidding!
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡尔弗特教授从不说笑！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A005A38] (ID) Quest : ([0A00584A]DLC04MQ05a) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: ROBOTS! TO ME!
ESP.TRADUIT: 机器人！到我这来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A005A38] (ID) Quest : ([0A00584A]DLC04MQ05a) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's right. And what do I get for it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就对了。那么，我能得到什么好处？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a very special gift for you, my friend...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一个非常特别的礼物送给你，我的朋友…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A005A38] (ID) Quest : ([0A00584A]DLC04MQ05a) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: DEATH!
ESP.TRADUIT: 死吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A005A38] (ID) Quest : ([0A00584A]DLC04MQ05a) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where do you get your stock from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你从哪儿进货？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found some of it. Some was here when I got here. I get some from them mercs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有些东西是我自己找到的，有些是本来就在这个商店里的。还有一些东西是从走私者那里搞来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And every once in a while, that weirdo with the boat comes up here and trades a few good things.
ESP.TRADUIT: 并且每隔一段时间，那个划船来的古怪家伙就会来这里一次并且做一些交易。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Show me what you have for sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看你都卖些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look around. It's all here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便看吧。都在这呢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got all sorts of stuff. Take a look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我这里什么都有。看看我的货吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's what I'm here for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就是为这来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I knew that's why you came to me...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你为什么来找我…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Panada [0A00EA7C] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Coyly. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All of Madam Panada's wares are top quality.
ESP.TRADUIT: 帕娜达女士的商品可都是最优质的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And what is it you would like to purchase?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要买什么东西呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, I already took care of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，我已经处理好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'll be. Here, let me give you something for your trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会的。来，给你点东西对付你的麻烦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is this stuff, anyway?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这到底是个什么东西？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell you what - have a bit. This is left over from an old batch, but should be a swig or two there. More'n enough to loosen you up, I wager!
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉你—来一点。这是一批老货里剩的，可能够喝一两口。足够让你放松了，我打赌。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marguerite [0A003F6E] (mod) Quest : ([0A003F70]DLC04FF03) A Spoonful of Whiskey EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: 500 caps? Here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 500个瓶盖？拿去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gristle and gore await! Proceed inside and use the button, as before.
ESP.TRADUIT: 软骨和血块在等待着你！进到里面来，并且按下那个按钮，就像以前一样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have some secret farming trick?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么耕种秘诀么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It feels good to work with dirt, doesn't it? Some people call it work, but they don't understand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟土打交道的感觉可是相当好的，不是吗？有些人说那叫工作，实际上他们根本不理解。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take my shovel. It has seen much use, and much dirt. Maybe it will help you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿上我的铲子。已经使用过很多次了，上面还有不少泥土。也许能帮上你的忙？

ESP.ORIGINAL: But be careful not to cut yourself with it. It can make you sick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小心点，不要被它割伤。不然你会因此得病的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I love digging in the dirt, but I never can get anything to grow right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我喜欢在地上挖洞，但我从来都看不到有什么正经东西从里面长出来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do not know if this is a secret, but I have always used this shovel. It has seen much work, and much dirt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道这算不算是个秘密，因为我经常使用这个铲子。这个铲子见证了许多的工作和泥土。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If it helps, have it. But be careful not to cut yourself. It can make you sick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果能帮上忙的话，你就把它拿去。小心点，不要被它割伤。不然你会因此得病的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you share your secret to getting them to grow?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能告诉我你让它们长得那么好的窍门么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have the caps, you get the book.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想要书，拿瓶盖来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, yes, of course. Here's your errand fee. Now, give it to me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，是的，当然。这是你的钱。快把东西给我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A002F3E] (ID) Quest : ([0A002F47]DLC04FF02) The Dark Heart of Blackhall EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I haven't decided what I'm going to do with it yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还没决定该怎么办。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Surely you're not considering giving it to Marcella? Come now, the woman can't rub two caps together. Give it to me and be paid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不会想要把它给玛塞拉吧？得了吧，那女人没几个钱。给我吧，我绝不会亏待你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A002F3E] (ID) Quest : ([0A002F47]DLC04FF02) The Dark Heart of Blackhall EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's no reason in your keeping that book - my book! Talk to me again when you've come to your senses.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你没理由留着那本书——我的书！想清楚了再来找我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A002F3E] (ID) Quest : ([0A002F47]DLC04FF02) The Dark Heart of Blackhall EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They attacked while I slept. I... I don't expect to survive. I only pray that you haven't taken that book to Obadiah. You must take up my mission.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们趁我睡觉时袭击。我…我们奢望活下来。我只祈祷你没把书带去奥巴迪亚。你必须接受我的任务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcella [0A002F42] (mod) Quest : ([0A002F47]DLC04FF02) The Dark Heart of Blackhall Comment (NAM2) : quietly, saying Act of Contrition to herself. She either turns the recorder off or takes her last breath as she fades EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is... one way to utterly destroy the Krivbeknih, but you must take a pilgrimage, far north of Point Lookout, in the Capital Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有……个办法能彻底销毁黯日圣经，但你必须去朝圣，望海崖遥远的北方，首都废土。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcella [0A002F42] (mod) Quest : ([0A002F47]DLC04FF02) The Dark Heart of Blackhall Comment (NAM2) : quietly, saying Act of Contrition to herself. She either turns the recorder off or takes her last breath as she fades EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Seek a place called Dunwich. Within is an obelisk, itself a wicked thing. It'll consume the book - you need only press the book to its surface.
ESP.TRADUIT: 找到一个叫邓维奇方尖碑的地方。里面有座方尖碑，本身就是个邪恶的东西。它会消化掉这书 — 你只需要把书按到上面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcella [0A002F42] (mod) Quest : ([0A002F47]DLC04FF02) The Dark Heart of Blackhall Comment (NAM2) : quietly, saying Act of Contrition to herself. She either turns the recorder off or takes her last breath as she fades EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: May God shed his blessings upon you, child. Make haste for Dunwich.
ESP.TRADUIT: 愿主施恩惠于你，孩子。快去邓维奇方尖碑吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcella [0A002F42] (mod) Quest : ([0A002F47]DLC04FF02) The Dark Heart of Blackhall Comment (NAM2) : quietly, saying Act of Contrition to herself. She either turns the recorder off or takes her last breath as she fades EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My God, I am sorry for all my sins with all my heart. In choosing to do wrong and failing to do good, I have sinned against You whom I should...
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊，我真心为我的罪孽悔过。我选择了行恶而非为善，我犯下了罪孽…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcella [0A002F42] (mod) Quest : ([0A002F47]DLC04FF02) The Dark Heart of Blackhall Comment (NAM2) : quietly, saying Act of Contrition to herself. She either turns the recorder off or takes her last breath as she fades EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm gonna catch you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会捉到你的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kenny [0A00815A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : calling out to a friend, playing tag EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, that's enough tag for now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，捉迷藏已经玩得差不多了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hehe. That was fun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呵呵。真有趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kenny [0A00815A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : giggling EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tag! You're It!
ESP.TRADUIT: 捉到你！到你了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll get you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会捉到你的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kenny [0A00815A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : laughing, playing tag EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Haha! Here I come!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈！我来了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kenny [0A00815A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : laughing, playing tag EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look out!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当心！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kenny [0A00815A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : laughing, playing tag EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tag! You're it! You'll never catch me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 捉住了！该你了！你永远都捉不到我的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kenny [0A00815A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : laughing EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hark! Who goes there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听！谁在那里？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A00927F] (ID) Quest : ([0A005847]DLC04MQ02) Walking With Spirits EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dammit! Trapped! I knew he'd try this!
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死！是陷阱！我就知道他会这么干！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0A0035B4] (mod) Quest : ([0A00584A]DLC04MQ05a) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's just down this way!
ESP.TRADUIT: 顺着这条路就能找到他了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0A0035B4] (mod) Quest : ([0A00584A]DLC04MQ05a) A Meeting Of The Minds EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any idea where Nadine might be?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你大概知道娜丁可能会在哪儿么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: And now we say goodbye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在是说再见的时候了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I said another thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说的是其他事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We are talking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们正在谈话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What should I be doing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在该做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't be daft. You agreed to retrieve my book. With more haste than this, I would have thought.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别犯傻了，你已经同意帮我把书拿回来。如果动作能快一点的话，也许我还会考虑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A002F3E] (ID) Quest : ([0A002F47]DLC04FF02) The Dark Heart of Blackhall Comment (NAM2) : elderly, pushy. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You need to head for the ritual site east of the boardwalk, and expect a fight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要去仪式之地，就在板道的东面，随时做好战斗准备。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0A002F3E] (ID) Quest : ([0A002F47]DLC04FF02) The Dark Heart of Blackhall Comment (NAM2) : elderly, pushy. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, let's hear it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我们来听听吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm afraid I don't have a copy of the scripture with me, but I can share a few passages. Here's one of my favorites.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我恐怕我没有经文的拷贝，不过我可以分享你几段。这是我比较中意的一段。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcella [0A002F42] (mod) Quest : ([0A002F47]DLC04FF02) The Dark Heart of Blackhall EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I tell you the truth, whoever hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life and will not be condemned;
ESP.TRADUIT: 我实话告诉你，无论谁听见我的话并且相信他会带给我永恒的生命，都不会受到责难。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcella [0A002F42] (mod) Quest : ([0A002F47]DLC04FF02) The Dark Heart of Blackhall EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: he has crossed over from death to life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他死里逃生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcella [0A002F42] (mod) Quest : ([0A002F47]DLC04FF02) The Dark Heart of Blackhall EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My mother had a favorite passage from the Bible. Revelation 21:6 - recognize it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我妈妈最喜欢圣经中的一段话，启示录21章第6句，记得么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course! "I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely."
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然！“我是阿拉法、我是俄梅戛、我是初、我是终。我要将生命泉的水白白赐给那口渴的人喝。”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcella [0A002F42] (mod) Quest : ([0A002F47]DLC04FF02) The Dark Heart of Blackhall EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So lovely. Selflessness like that is a rare commodity these days. I can see why that particular passage inspired her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了。在这种日子里，无私可真是非常少见的啊。我现在明白为什么那特别的通路能够激励她了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcella [0A002F42] (mod) Quest : ([0A002F47]DLC04FF02) The Dark Heart of Blackhall EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Leave me alone, okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 别烦我，行么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nadine [0A006635] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Disdain EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I appreciate the advice, but I'm fine, okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很感激你的建议，但是我没事，明白？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're not the boss of me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你又不是我的老大。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，问吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nadine [0A006635] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Disdain EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, mother Woodrose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，银背藤母亲。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I try to, sir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 先生，我会尽力的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. Simple.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。很简单。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As you say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如你所说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you. Be at peace.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多谢。祝你平安。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You really think this will work?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真觉得这可行？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's worth a try. What's the worst that could happen? Nothing changes, only we've got a few more bruises. Big deal. Let's give it a shot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认为这值得一试。再糟又能怎么样呢？我们顶多会有几处擦伤。没什么大不了的，试试看吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Quest : ([0B000802]DLC05MZ1) Not of This World EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I promise I'll go easy on you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我保证我会好好对你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Quest : ([0B000802]DLC05MZ1) Not of This World EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do they want with us?
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们想从我们身上得到什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your guess is as good as mine. I can't understand what they're saying. I don't remember half of what they did to me, and that might be a good thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和你想的不同。我不明白它们在说什么，不记得它们对我做了什么，但可能是件好事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Quest : ([0B000802]DLC05MZ1) Not of This World EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know we ain't the only ones; there's a whole bunch of us in here. They'll pluck folks out every now and then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道不只是我们在这里，还有一大群人。它们时不时会挑出一个带走。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Quest : ([0B000802]DLC05MZ1) Not of This World EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sometimes they bring 'em back... Sometimes they don't. Either way, I ain't keen to find out what they're doing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有时会被带回来…有时不会。不管怎么，我不想知道它们在干什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Quest : ([0B000802]DLC05MZ1) Not of This World EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So how do we get out of here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们该怎么逃出去？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, yeah. Let's do something about getting out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错，好吧。让我们想办法从这里出去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Quest : ([0B000802]DLC05MZ1) Not of This World EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, there ain't no easy way out. Trust me, I've looked. Can't even find anything to pry open, see what's blocking the doorway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我告诉你从这里出去不容易，相信我，我看过了。甚至找不到任何可以橇开的地方，门也被堵死了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Quest : ([0B000802]DLC05MZ1) Not of This World EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm thinkin' they did us a favor, putting us together in here like this. And I say we use it to our advantage.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想它们帮了我们，把我们放在一起。我的意思是我们应该好好利用这机会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Quest : ([0B000802]DLC05MZ1) Not of This World EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think you should remain in the Engineering Core for now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你现在应该留在工程中枢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. Whatever you think is best.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。你想的都是最好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elliott Tercorien [0B00096B] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Putting me on guard duty, huh? Swell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我执勤，是吧？很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. If I see any aliens, I'll say hello for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。 要是我遇到些外星人，我会代你向它们问好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paulson [0B0032FB] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I may need an extra gun in the Hangar Bay. Can you lend a hand?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在机库需要多个能开枪的家伙帮忙。你能帮把手吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now you're speakin' my language. Hell yeah, I'll come with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 正合我意。地狱什么的，我会跟着你一起去的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paulson [0B0032FB] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need some help in the Robot Assembly area. You in?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在机器人装配车间需要些帮手。你来吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Heck yeah. I can take apart and put together a Protectron with my eyes shut. I'll go with you. Lead on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哎呀！我可以闭着眼睛拆装钢铁护卫。我会和你一起去的。领路！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need to get through the Cryo Labs. Think you can help me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要穿过低温实验室。我想你可以帮助我，是吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmmm. Sounds like I may be of some use in there. If there are other people in stasis, I could help revive them or something. Just watch my back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。听起我有些用处。如果有其他人有麻烦，我可以救助他们。只要保护好我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elliott Tercorien [0B00096B] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you tell me more about where you're from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能告诉我你从哪儿来的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does it really matter?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这真的很重要吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars Comment (NAM2) : defensive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean, we're fighting to stay alive here. Whatever I did before we got to this point doesn't mean a whole lot right now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的意思是我们争取在这里生活。在我们达到这个目的前，我做的并不一定很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars Comment (NAM2) : defensive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does it really matter?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这真的很重要吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars Comment (NAM2) : defensive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean, we're fighting to stay alive here. Whatever I did before we got to this point doesn't mean a whole lot right now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的意思是我们争取在这里生活。在我们达到这个目的前，我做的并不一定很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars Comment (NAM2) : defensive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a prisoner like the rest of us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个囚犯，跟我们一样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Prisoner? Last thing I remember I was being outside our bunker and then... oh my god!
ESP.TRADUIT: 囚犯？我最后记得的事是我在我们在碉堡外面然后…我的天！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elliott Tercorien [0B00096B] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aliens! I was taken by aliens! You! You must be the aliens trying to get into my mind... well that's not gonna work!
ESP.TRADUIT: 外星人！我被外星人带走了！你！你一定是试图进入我思想的外星人…你不会得逞的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elliott Tercorien [0B00096B] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Private Elliott Tercorien, U.S. Army Medic, Serial Number 3477809. That's all I'm going to tell you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 上等兵艾略特·特克里安，美国陆军医疗兵，编号3477809。这就是我能告诉你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elliott Tercorien [0B00096B] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your uniform... it looks familiar, but I can't place it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的制服…看起来很眼熟，但是我记不清楚了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My what? Who the hell are you... oh my god... wait a minute!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我什么？你他妈到底是谁…我的天…等一下 !
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elliott Tercorien [0B00096B] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aliens! I was taken by aliens! You! You must be the aliens trying to get into my mind... well that's not gonna work!
ESP.TRADUIT: 外星人！我被外星人带走了！你！你一定是试图进入我思想的外星人…你不会得逞的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elliott Tercorien [0B00096B] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Private Elliott Tercorien, U.S. Army Medic, Serial Number 3477809. That's all I'm telling you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 二等兵艾略特·特克里安，美国陆军医疗兵，编号3477809。这就是我能告诉你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elliott Tercorien [0B00096B] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looks like this door's locked, too. Hang on, I'll see if I can get it from the other side.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看起来这扇门也是锁着的，坚持住。我看能不能从另一边打开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0B000969] (ID) Quest : ([0B000804]DLC05MZ3) This Galaxy Ain't Big Enough... EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't believe you killed him, he has it just as bad as us. I'll see you later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不敢相信你杀死了他，他和我们一样。迟点见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How are you holding up?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还撑得住吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could use one of those stimpaks if you don't mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你没意见，我就用下治疗针。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Status report?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么情况？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck you and this whole fucking situation. They'll work when they work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他妈的一团糟，需要它们时就能运作了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's this thing do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这玩意是做什么用的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm, looks like I'm at the helm. I'll have these controls figured out in no time at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，看起来这是舵轮室，我马上就能弄明白应该如何操控这些开关。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's my squad in there! What the hell are the aliens doing to them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是我在那的战友！外星人到底对他们做了什么可怕的事？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elliott Tercorien [0B00096B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Runs up to the glass and says this. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You green bastards! Get your hands off them!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们这群绿杂种！把你的手拿开！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elliott Tercorien [0B00096B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Says this as he backs up and fires at the glass. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There has to be a way to release their containment seal! Maybe there's a button or something on this console.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一定有办法脱离他们的控制！或许会有个按钮或其他什么在那控制台上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elliott Tercorien [0B00096B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Says this as he runs up and presses the button in front of the window. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're flanking us from behind. Quick, find some cover.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们正从后面包抄我们两侧。快，寻找掩护。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elliott Tercorien [0B00096B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Says this toward the end of the cryo warehouse when he notices they are coming in from behind where the player just came from. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So that's the generator. Now how the heck do we destroy it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就是发电机。我们现在该怎么摧毁这鬼东西？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elliott Tercorien [0B00096B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Says this as he enters the generator room and sees the generator. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get a load of this!
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿上这个！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elliott Tercorien [0B00096B] (mod) Quest : ([0B000804]DLC05MZ3) This Galaxy Ain't Big Enough... Comment (NAM2) : amazed EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Would ya look at that...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看那个……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Quest : ([0B000804]DLC05MZ3) This Galaxy Ain't Big Enough... Comment (NAM2) : amazed EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇哦！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0B000969] (ID) Quest : ([0B000804]DLC05MZ3) This Galaxy Ain't Big Enough... EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How's the jammer holding?
ESP.TRADUIT: 干扰器运行得如何？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's holding fine for now, I guess. It should help with the bastards teleporting onto the ship.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜它现在运行得好极了，它能够帮你传送到飞船顶部。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, don't forget to put on the Astronaut's Suit before starting the decompression sequence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，在减压前不要忘了穿上宇航服。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got it! The deathray is working and will be fully charged in 30 seconds!
ESP.TRADUIT: 知道了！死光正在运行，还需要30秒才能充能完毕！

ESP.ORIGINAL: 20%. I hope you've got a plan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 20%。我希望你另有打算。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't be sure if I'm reading this right, but it looks like they're hitting us pretty hard. Hull integrity is at about 90%.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不确定这读数是否正确，不过看起来它们正在猛攻我们。飞船耐久度约为90%。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ship's at 30%. I hope you have something up your sleeve.
ESP.TRADUIT: 飞船耐久度30%。你最好抓紧时间。

ESP.ORIGINAL: At about 60%. Do something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 飞船耐久度约为60%。做点什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: 30%. This is not good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 30%。大事不妙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Watch out, more are coming from behind you. I'll try to block their progress.
ESP.TRADUIT: 保持警觉，你后面还有更多。我会试着挡住它们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's obvious, isn't it? They're threatening us. You could tell just by the way he sounded.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在开玩笑吗？它们太蠢了，我们知道它们已经要绝望了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Quest : ([0B000804]DLC05MZ3) This Galaxy Ain't Big Enough... EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you kidding me? That was stupid of them. Now we know they're getting desperate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很明显，不是吗？它们在恐吓我们。你能从刚才它的语气里听出来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Quest : ([0B000804]DLC05MZ3) This Galaxy Ain't Big Enough... EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Give me a minute, I'll try to get these doors open for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我点时间，我会尽快为你打开这些门。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow, that looks dangerous. See if you can turn it off while I try and figure this door out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，这看起来好危险。看看在我解决这扇门时你能不能关掉它。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh-oh. I think they found a way to get to you. I'll try and get the next door open fast!
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，我认为它们可能采用了某种限制。我到隔壁去看看能不能更快打开。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hang on! One of these buttons has got to open that door...
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等！其中一个按钮能打开那扇门…

ESP.ORIGINAL: Their radios got quiet all of a sudden. I'd be careful if I were you...
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们的电台讯号突然消失了。如果我是你，我就会小心点…

ESP.ORIGINAL: More could bust in at any second. Get ready!
ESP.TRADUIT: 随时都可能有更多家伙冲进来，做好准备！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I told you so! Ambush!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我告诉过你的！有埋伏！

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're almost out of here! I'll meet you up ahead. Hurry!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们就快能离开这里了！我会在前面和你碰头。快点！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Elliott... Is that you? What... What's going on? Where the hell are we?
ESP.TRADUIT: 艾略特…是你吗？发生了什么？我们在哪？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Agh... feels like someone rearranged my insides. What happened to us?
