ESP.TRADUIT: 啊…感觉像是有人重新整合了我的内脏。我们怎么了 ?

ESP.ORIGINAL: End it... put them out of their misery.
ESP.TRADUIT: 结束吧…让他们得到解脱！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose you're right. Don't worry, they won't feel a thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你是对的。别担心，他们不会有感觉的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait! I think that's some more of my squad!
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等！我想那是我的战友！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elliott Tercorien [0B00096B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Notices that the actors in the pods are his squad mates. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, let's see. This must initiate the thawing process. Blood pressure looks normal. Heart rate... normal enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，让我们看看。必须启动解冻程序。血压看来正常，心率…足够好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elliott Tercorien [0B00096B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Monitors the squads vitals just before telling the player to open the pods EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. Lets put these guys to use.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。让我们带着这些伙计。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elliott Tercorien [0B00096B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Says this when returning to follow the player. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No sense discussin’ it now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在没什么好争论的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paulson [0B0032FB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : matter of fact, after killing a potential alien hostage EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don’t know, but maybe we should... there must be something...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道，但也许我们应该…做些什么…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elliott Tercorien [0B00096B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : coming up short for a good argument in his favor EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And how are we supposed to do that? We can’t understand what the hell they’re saying!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我们应该怎么做呢？我们不知道它们在说些什么！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : wanting to kill the alien and get it over with EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: He’s not going anywhere. Why don’t we just hold on to him, and try to negotiate? Y’know, like a hostage?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他哪也没去。为什么我们不再耐心点对待他，并试着和他沟通？你觉得像一个累赘？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elliott Tercorien [0B00096B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : about a near dying alien captive EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmmm. Let me take some of this cryogenic compound back to the engine core. I might be able to make some use of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。我会带一些冷冻化合物回工程中枢，它可能有用。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait just a second...
ESP.TRADUIT: 等一下…

ESP.ORIGINAL: Try hitting that button down there. It's flashing, it probably does something good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 试着按那个按钮。它在闪，也许能派上些用场。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's some alien goo tubes on that table over there. I've seen them use it to fix guns and stuff. I bet it'll work for you too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那边桌子上有些外星凝胶管，我见过它们用它来修理武器等东西。我相信它也能为你所用。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go away, meanie! Just you wait 'till my friend gets here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 走开，混蛋！我朋友来了的话，会给你好看！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, we're moving... Cool!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，我们正在移动…酷！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aliens! Look out!
ESP.TRADUIT: 外星人！小心！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cows? We got cows!
ESP.TRADUIT: 牛？我们看到了牛了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you think you can make use of that stuff you picked up in the Cryo Labs?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认为你从低温实验室里面搞回来的这些东西有用吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I think so. Before I was shipped out to Anchorage, I was trained in cryoscience. We were hoping to apply that to medicine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我想是的。在来到安克雷奇前，我进行了新兵训练。我们希望成为一名医疗兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The compounds we used weren't that different from this cryogenic liquid. I'm pretty sure I can make us some improvised weapons from it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们使用的化合物与这低温液体差不多，我确信能用它改进武器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm thinking something along the lines of cryo grenades and cryo mines... I don't know yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在想冷冻手榴弹和冷冻地雷的联系…我还不太清楚。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Check back with me in about an hour and I'll see what I can do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 过一小时再来找我，看看我能做出什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, sure did. I was able to make a few cryo grenades and cryo mines.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，当然了。我能制造一些冰冻手榴弹或冰冻地雷。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can make more, but I'll need around three more hours. Keep checking back with me and I'll tinker with it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能做更多，但我需要大约三小时。时不时回来看看。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Were you able to come up with any cryogenic weapons?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能搞到一些冷冻武器吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here you go. Hope you're making good use of them. If you need more, I should have a batch ready in about three hours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你，希望你好好利用。如果你要更多，我需要大约三小时。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any more Cryo Grenades or Cryo Mines ready?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有更多的冷冻手榴弹或者冷冻地雷吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not yet. Still working on them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还没完成，我正在做。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any Cryo Grenades or Cryo Mines ready?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有更多的冷冻手榴弹或者冷冻地雷吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found this sword... does it belong to you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到这柄剑，是你的么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, sessha no ken! Katajike nai.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，在下的剑！万分感激。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Toshiro Kago [0B0032FC] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sumanuga, korekara dosuruka hitoride kangaetai. Shitsurei suru.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，在下想独自细想今后的打算。失礼了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Toshiro Kago [0B0032FC] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take this Plasma Grenade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着这个电浆手榴弹。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got it! Give me a minute to sneak around them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 了解！给我点时间偷偷绕到它们后面。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take this Frag Grenade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着这个烟雾手榴弹。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cool!
ESP.TRADUIT: 酷！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Give me just a second to get behind them...
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我点时间偷偷绕到它们后面…

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that was... fun. What now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，那可真……有趣。现在干嘛？ ?

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you think we were noticed?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得我们被发现了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I get it! We're in one of their trash cans that move around the ship. I always wondered where these things go...
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我知道了！我们在一个环绕飞船旋转的垃圾桶里，我想知道接着会发生什么…

ESP.ORIGINAL: [BANGING SOUND COMING FROM BRIDGE DOOR]
ESP.TRADUIT: [舰桥上传来的砰砰声]

ESP.ORIGINAL: [BANGING SOUND COMING FROM BRIDGE DOOR]
ESP.TRADUIT: [舰桥上传来的砰砰声]

ESP.ORIGINAL: There it is again. Is that an Alien?
ESP.TRADUIT: 又来了。是外星人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gas. Flammable gas.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瓦斯。可燃气体。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're flooding the room with gas.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们想用瓦斯灌满这房间。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hell, my horse never did that...
ESP.TRADUIT: 真见鬼，我的马从来不那样…

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our situation didn't get any better by the looks of what happened here. I say we get the hell out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里发生的事并没改善我们的处境。要我说，我们该离开这鬼地方了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Curious, but I don't think I want to know the answer judging by what happened here. Let's not stay long, this place gives me the creeps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有点好奇，但关于这里发生了什么来看，我不想知道答案。我们别待太久了，这地方让我毛骨悚然。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What kind of horses are these anyway? I can't see anyone havin' any respect ridin' into town on one of those things.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论如何，这是哪种马？我没见过小镇中有这样的马。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are they doing to the Buttercups?
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们要这小马巴特卡普干嘛？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh OK, now it all makes sense...
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，现在这都说的通了…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : said very sarcastically EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why look at what we got here. Little girl here ridin' one of those horses. Giddyup Buttercup... kind of catchy ain't it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看我们为什么来这，小女孩要来这骑马。小马巴特卡普…它挺吸引人的，不是吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh wow. I remember these posters plastered all over the place back home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇。我记得老家那里到处都贴着这样的海报。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They even have some of the posters I've seen scattered about the Wastes. Looks like they're studying them...or idolizing them, not sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们甚至有那些我在废土上见过的海报，看来它们正在学习…或者崇拜它们，我不确定。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Giddyup.
ESP.TRADUIT: 驾。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is kind of disturbing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 令人不安。

ESP.ORIGINAL: OK, this is getting a little ridiculous now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有点意思。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well I'll be damned...look at all 'em!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我会被诅咒的… 看看它们！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, even more of them. Buttercups that is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看啊，还有更多。小马巴特卡普。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Huh, I wonder what they're doing with them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想知道它们正在对他做什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey look, Giddyup Buttercups! All the rich kids had them. Waste of money if you ask me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，看啊，小马巴特卡普！有钱的孩子都有。但要我说那就是浪费钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've got to be kidding me... I saw posters like these all over the ruins. Never actually saw one 'til now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你一定是在开玩笑…我在废墟中见过类似所有这些一样的海报。但直到现在从没见过一个这样的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now that looks like some tough ridin'. Those things real?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在那看起来有些不好骑的样子。那些东西是真的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, yes, I understand! I've seen the others. I'll do what you want.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，是的，我明白！我见过其他人了。我会照你说的办。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is Doctor Morrison Rand, Professor of Anthropological Archaeology at Banfield College, Humboldt, Oregon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是莫莉森·兰德博士，俄勒冈州洪堡班菲尔德学院的人类考古学教授。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shortly after 10:00 p.m., on August 16, 2041, as I was leaving the college campus, headed to my car, I saw a blinding light.
ESP.TRADUIT: 10年00月16日下午2041时后，就在我离开大学校园，走向我的汽车的时候，我看到了一道耀眼的光芒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It just... appeared. In the sky, directly over me. I was blinded. I also found my body completely immobilized. I couldn't move, not at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它…出现了。在天上，直对着我。我看不见了。我还发现我的身体被完全固定了。一动都不能动。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened next is... hazy. I don't remember much. But what became clear later - what is certainly clear now - is that I was abducted.
ESP.TRADUIT: 后来发生的事很…朦胧。我记不太清。但我后来明白了一些事—现在则彻底明白了—我被绑架了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am now the captive of an alien race, one of many people held here, against our will. And, like those others, I am recording who I am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在是外星人的俘虏，被强行囚禁在这的人中的一员。和其他人一样，我正在记录着我是谁。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why? Because the aliens want us to, for some reason. They have us do it right before they put us into some kind of... suspended animation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么？因为出于某种原因，外星人要我们这样做。它们要让我们进入了一种…假死状态。

ESP.ORIGINAL: These recordings... It's almost as if we're creating our own library catalog entries, before we get put into a giant collection.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些录音…这就相当于我们正在创建我们自己的资料库索引条目，在当我们被放置进一个巨大的收集库之前。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The entire experience would be fascinating if I weren't so completely terrified.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我不是被吓坏了，这个经历将会是多么令人着迷。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Stop? You want me to stop now. All right! All right, see? I'm stopping...
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？停止？你要我现在停止。好吧！好吧，明白了，我已经停止了…

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Talk into this thing? Just... talk? I don't have to do anything else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？谈谈？只是…谈？我不需要做什么其他的事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ow! All right! <Zap!> Ow! I said all right! Just stop!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗷！好吧！<电击声！> 嗷！我说好吧！快停下！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello. Um... hello. My name is Andrew Endicott.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好…我叫安德鲁·恩迪科特。

ESP.ORIGINAL: On the night of May 17th, the year our Lord 1697, I was... I was taken. From my home in Salem Village.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在5月17日晚上，教历1697年，我被…带走了，从塞勒姆村的家里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I... I do not know where I am, exactly, or why I came to be here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我…我不知道我在哪里，还有为什么会来到这里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have seen, through... windows... the stars, and sun, and beloved Earth. Down there, below me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 透过…窗户…我看到星星、太阳和亲爱的地球。就在那里，在我脚下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So it would seem I am aboard some vessel, suspended in the ether. Ironically, it would seem, so close to where I thought Heaven must surely lie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我似乎是上了一艘悬浮在以太中的飞船。讽刺的是，这看似非常接近我曾认为是天堂的所在之处。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But this is not Heaven. And my captors are not angels. I am not entirely unconvinced that the scripture is wrong. That Heaven and Hell are reversed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但这不是天堂，虏劫我的并非天使。我不是说信奉的圣经是错的，天堂与地狱已然颠倒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: For my captives are devils. Demons from my nightmares. Even now they watch me, make me talk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 虏劫我的人是魔鬼。来自我噩梦中的魔鬼。即使是现在它们还在盯着我，逼我开口。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They seem to want me to tell my story. I know not why. A record of their deeds, perhaps? Or am I just a pawn in some... some evil game.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们似乎想知道我的故事。我不知道为什么。也许是为了它们的一项记录？或者我只是一只棋子…一只邪恶游戏中的棋子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And there are others. Other... captives, I mean. From whence they came I cannot say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有其他一些。其他…我是说，俘虏。我不能确定他们来自何方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some wear strange dress, as if they are from... a different time. And some are... frozen! As in ice! Unmoving! But, I think... alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一些穿着怪异的服装，好像来自…不同的时代。一些是…被冻结的！在冰块里！一动不动！但是我觉得是…活的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe they plan the same fate for me. Will I be frozen, too? Will I...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信它们也打算给予我同样的命运。我也会被冻起来？我将…

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ow! Stop it! I did what you said! You wanted me to talk, so I talked! Just leave me! Leave me be!
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢！住手！我照你说的做了！你要我说，我都说了！现在放过我！放过我吧！

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll be at the engineering core in no time!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们要赶快到工程中枢！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nuka what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 核子什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paulson [0B0032FB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Paulson commenting on Nuka bottles, nuka cola machine. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thirsty? Heh, I wonder if the aliens love this stuff as much we do down below.
ESP.TRADUIT: 口渴了？嘿，我怀疑外星人和我们下面的人一样喜欢这东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Somah commenting on Nuka bottles, nuka cola machine. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nuka-Cola! You know, they came out with this stuff called Nuka-Cola Quantum way back. Now that was some powerful stuff. I can still taste it now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 核子可乐！我知道，他们中途还推出过种叫做量子型核子可乐的玩意。那可是相当带劲的东西。我现在嘴里都还有它的味道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elliott Tercorien [0B00096B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Tercorien commenting on Nuka bottles, nuka cola machine. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wouldn't go jumpin' down there if I were you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是我是你的话，是不会冒险下去的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Paulson [0B0032FB] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Commenting on an extremely large trash chute found in the cargo hold. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now that's what I call a trash chute. I wouldn't get too close, don't wanna fall in or anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就是被我称为垃圾瀑布的玩意。我可不想靠太近，免得掉下去或出别的什么事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Commenting on an extremely large trash chute found in the cargo hold. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that's one way to take out the garbage.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，那就是条处理垃圾的通道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elliott Tercorien [0B00096B] (mod) Comment (NAM2) : Commenting on an extremely large trash chute found in the cargo hold. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, here it is. Neat, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，在这。对吗，是吧?

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh god, what are you doing to me? What's that thing? Get it out of me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 天哪，你在对我做什么？那是什么东西？把它从我身上拿掉！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahhh... that hurts... oh, please... stop... no... <grunting>
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊…好痛…噢，拜托… 停下…不要…<惨叫声>

ESP.ORIGINAL: <growling noises>
ESP.TRADUIT: <咆哮声>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow, look at this place! It looks like the ship in Captain Cosmos!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，看这里！它看起来就像《考斯莫思舰长》里面的飞船！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh-oh...
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊-喔…

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're stuck. Let me see if I can figure something out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们被困住了，让我看看我能不能想到点办法。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow! This looks just like the bridge on Captain Cosmos! I know what to do!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇！这看起来就像《考斯莫思舰长》里面的舰桥！我知道该做些什么了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shit, they hit the core and sapped our power. Look around for some buttons or something to restart the generators.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死，它们打中了中枢，降低了我们的动力。找找按钮或别的什么东西来重启发电机。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lights out, they killed our power! Maybe there's some buttons or something around here to restart this hunk of junk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 灯灭了，它们切断了我们的动力！也许会有按钮或别的什么东西能让这堆破烂重新启动。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Things are flashing again! We got flashing things! You must be doing something right. Keep it up!
ESP.TRADUIT: 灯又亮了！我们又有光了！你肯定做对了什么。继续！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Holy shit. Where did that come from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 操。那是从哪冒出来的?

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just take it easy. If they wanted us dead, we'd be dead. They must need something from us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 放松点。如果它们要弄死我们，我们早就死了。它们一定要我们做什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0B009A08] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Responding to: "NO! GET US THE HELL OUT OF HERE!..." <Slap> SFX is a face being slapped. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey! I said, calm down! If they hear you they may come for us. Try and take it easy!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨！冷静点！如果它们听到你的话就要来抓我们了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0B009A08] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Responding to: "NO! GET US THE HELL OUT OF HERE!..." <Slap> SFX is a face being slapped. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I said to SHUT UP! <slap>... I'm... I'm sorry I did that. Please, forgive me. But we need to keep our heads on straight if we're going to survive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说闭嘴！<打耳光> 我很…我很抱歉这样对你。原谅我。不过我们要生存下去就要时刻保持头脑清醒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0B009A08] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : Responding to: "NO! GET US THE HELL OUT OF HERE!..." <Slap> SFX is a face being slapped. EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are we gonna do? They just threw me in this cell with you after they poked and prodded me and now I just hope they won't kill us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们怎么办？它们刚才对我又戳又刺的，现在又把我跟你丢到了一起，希望它们不要杀了我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0B009A0B] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : crying as she says this EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just take it easy. If they wanted us dead, we'd be dead. They must need something from us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 放松点。如果它们要弄死我们，我们早就死了。它们一定要我们做什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0B009A0B] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : crying as she says this EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah! They need us for FOOD or something! You saw that guy! He was all... cut open... like he'd been butchered! Oh my god! We're gonna be next!
ESP.TRADUIT: 对！它们应该把我们当作食物或什么的！你看那家伙！他就被整个…切开了…就像被屠宰了一样！天哪！我们就是下一个了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0B009A0B] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : crying as she says this EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey! I said, calm down! If they hear you they may come for us. Try and take it easy!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨！冷静点！如果它们听到你的话就要来抓我们了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0B009A0B] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : crying as she says this EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: NO! GET US THE HELL OUT OF HERE! <pounding noise> SOMEONE! GET US OUT! PLEASE! <pounding noise>
ESP.TRADUIT: 不！带我离开这个鬼地方！！<砸墙声>有人吗？救我们出去！！求你了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0B009A0B] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : crying as she says this EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I said to SHUT UP! <slap>... I'm... I'm sorry I did that. Please, forgive me. But we need to keep our heads on straight if we're going to survive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说闭嘴！<打耳光> 我很…我很抱歉这样对你。原谅我。不过我们要生存下去就要时刻保持头脑清醒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0B009A0B] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : crying as she says this EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please, please. I just want to go home... I just want to go home...
ESP.TRADUIT: 救命，救命。我只想回家…我只想回家…
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0B009A0B] (ID) Comment (NAM2) : crying as she says this EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our defenses consist of 3 battalions of light infantry, 34 pieces of field artillery, 108 armored vehicles and 42 aerial vehicles.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的防御包括3个轻步兵营，34门重炮，108辆装甲车辆以及42个飞行单位。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We have 38 ICBM's always on alert and ready to fire when the word is passed down from the White House.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们有38枚受命白宫随时准备发射的洲际导弹。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The codes to activate the launch sequences are... are... uhhngh... no... I can't let you... uggh... get out of my mind!
ESP.TRADUIT: 发射导弹的密码是…是… 啊~~…不…我不能让你们…噢…从我的脑子滚出去 !

ESP.ORIGINAL: Agggh! The c-codes... are... ugh... no... I can't betray... AGH! My head! I can't... won't... AGGGGH! Agggh...
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊~~~！密…密码…是…噢…不…我不能背叛… 唔呃！我的头！我不能…我不会…啊~~~！啊...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Damn it. Their shields are back up at max.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死。它们的护盾能量又充满了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How's life in space?
ESP.TRADUIT: 太空生活怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I told Mr. Elliott this really funny joke earlier, but he didn't get it. He's weird.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我之前告诉艾略特先生个非常好笑的笑话，但他却听不懂。真奇怪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could use some more of these alien weapons. Got any?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以使用更多外星人的武器了。你有吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yep, sure thing!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，没问题！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是这样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's everything I've got.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是我得到的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything to report?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么要报告的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, yeah! Here, you can have this stuff. I found it when I was looking around the rest of the ship.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，好的！这些东西给您。我在飞船四处张望时找到的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yep, I was able to scrounge up some more stuff for you. Here you go, Captain!
ESP.TRADUIT: 是，我为你找到了一些材料，给你，舰长。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sir, yes sir! I found some more supplies for you, sir!
ESP.TRADUIT: 长官，是的，长官！我为你找了些补给，长官。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know you can't understand me, but I thought you might want this sword.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你听不懂我说什么，但是我想你可能会想要这把剑。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, korekoso sessha no ken. Katajike nai.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，这正是在下的剑。万分感激。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Toshiro Kago [0B0032FC] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sumanuga, sessha mizukara korekara okorukotoni sonaeneba naranu.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，在下必须独自应对今后所发生之事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Toshiro Kago [0B0032FC] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found this sword... Is it yours?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到这柄剑，是你的么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, sessha no ken! Kaeshite moraerutowa, katajike nai.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，在下的剑！承蒙寻回，万分感激。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Toshiro Kago [0B0032FC] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sumanuga, sessha mizukara korekara okorukotoni sonaeneba naranu.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，在下必须独自应对今后所发生之事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Toshiro Kago [0B0032FC] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think the aliens want with us?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得那些外星人抓我们是为了什么呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm... maybe, just maybe, they're responsible for life on earth. Like, they seeded the planet a really long time ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯…可能，仅仅可能。它们会为地球上的生命负责。好吧，它们在地球上播种已经很久了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elliott Tercorien [0B00096B] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And they've been coming back every once in a while to check on the progress... and now they've decided they don't like how it turned out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们每次回来都要看看进展…它们不喜欢这结果。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elliott Tercorien [0B00096B] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you imagine? They made us and now they're pissed at us!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能想象吗？它们制造了我们，现在却要抛弃我们！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Elliott Tercorien [0B00096B] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, at least it wasn't coming for us...
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，至少它不是冲着我们来的……
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Quest : ([0B000802]DLC05MZ1) Not of This World EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello, Mr. Alien. Yeah, I know... I'll talk into the thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，外星人先生，好的，我知道…我会对着那东西讲话的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know why you brought me back here. We've done this a whole bunch of... Hey! Giddyup Buttercup! Wow!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道你们为什么会把我带回这里。我们之前都已经…嗨！小马巴特卡普！哇 !

ESP.ORIGINAL: I always wanted one of those!... Why do you have one?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我一直都想要一个！…为什么你们会有！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't understand... What do you want? It's a toy. A TOY. Why are you so excited? You're weird.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不懂…你想要什么？那是一个玩具。一个玩具。为什么你们看起来那么兴奋？真奇怪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found this recording... Sounds like you regret something you did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我发现了这个记录……听起来你很后悔自己做过的事情？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, great.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，太棒了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All right, listen. Not that it's any of your damn business, but yeah. Before I got sucked up into this crazy alien land here, I pulled some shady stuff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，听着。这和你那该死的生意无关。在我被吸到这个疯狂的外星地方之前，我捡到了一些可疑的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Many of my associates may or may not have been slavers, and I may or may not have received payment for helping them in their trade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的同伴可能是奴隶贩子，为了金钱我也可能为他们的贸易提供帮助。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay? Big secret exposed! Great job! Hope you're happy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了？秘密曝光！很棒的工作！希望你高兴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There must be a reason you don't want to talk about yourself. What is it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不愿意谈论你自己肯定是有原因的。到底是什么原因呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A reason? Yeah, there's a reason. It's because I worked for slavers, okay? I worked for them, I helped them, and sometimes I liked it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 原因？是的，是有原因。我为奴隶贩子工作，对吧？我为他们工作，我帮助他们，我就喜欢这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They needed someone who was good with machines, stripping tech, building shit. That's me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们需要擅长摆弄机器的人，精通技术，制造机器。那个人就是我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So I did the work. And look where it got me. Now can we stop talking about me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，那就是我做的，看看我得到了什么？现在能不能别再讨论我了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Quest : ([0B000803]DLC05MZ2) Among the Stars EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <sobbing>
ESP.TRADUIT: <哭泣声>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please... just please, let me go...
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜托…拜托了，让我走吧...

ESP.ORIGINAL: <mechanical sounds>
ESP.TRADUIT: <机器声>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, not really shut it off... More like blow it up. If you turn off the coolant, it'll get really hot and then explode, so be careful, okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，不是真的关掉它…更像是弄坏它。如果你关闭了冷却剂，它就会因为过热然后爆炸，所以小心一点，好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0B000969] (ID) Quest : ([0B000802]DLC05MZ1) Not of This World EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have to shut that off to open the door here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你必须关掉它才能打开这扇门。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0B000969] (ID) Quest : ([0B000802]DLC05MZ1) Not of This World EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the hell is this thing? What are we supposed to do with it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这算什么破事？我们到底该做什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Somah [0B00096A] (mod) Quest : ([0B000802]DLC05MZ1) Not of This World EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now that I have a better understanding of the Family, may I speak to Ian?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在我对家族有了了解，我可以和伊恩谈谈吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had always assumed if a human happened upon our home, it would be for the purpose of our extermination.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我一直以为如果有人类接近我们的家，就是来屠杀我们的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: It appears my fears were ill-placed. It is a pleasant surprise to meet someone as amenable as yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来我的担心是错误的。能碰见像你这样通情达理的人真是让人惊奇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. I will allow you to speak to Ian. Perhaps you can help him come to grips with his greatest enemy. Himself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，我会让你去找伊恩谈。或许你能帮他对付他最大的敌人。他自己。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Vance [0601D5F7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9C]MS09) Blood Ties EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I already read your laws and I think I understand what you people are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经阅读了你们的法律，我想我明白你们是什么人了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Indeed? Tell me what you've learned from the Laws. What do you think we are?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？告诉我你从我们的生存法则里学到了什么？你觉得我们是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you heard the election results?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听说选举结果了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I didn't win it, huh? Well, there'll always be other elections.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没赢对吧，呃？嗯，还会有下一次选举的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry you didn't win it, Rosie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很可惜你输了，萝丝。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There'll always be other elections.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总会有下一次的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry you didn't win it, Rosie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很可惜你输了，萝丝。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who needs it. I'd prefer to be second in command anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁稀罕。我宁愿当副手。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Results are in. Better luck next year.
ESP.TRADUIT: 结果出来了。祝你明年好运。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, what are the results, Mister President?
ESP.TRADUIT: 总统先生，票选结果如何？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The people have re-elected me as their president.
ESP.TRADUIT: 人们又选了我作为他们的总统。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's great to see the democratic process at work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如此民主的过程真是让人欣慰啊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, what are the results, Mister President?
ESP.TRADUIT: 总统先生，票选结果如何？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There was a tie. Under these unique circumstances, I'll have to remain the leader until we know the results for sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 平局。在这种罕见的情况下，我将继续作为领袖直到确认选举结果。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, what are the results, Mister President?
ESP.TRADUIT: 总统先生，票选结果如何？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Under these unique circumstances, I'll have to remain the leader until we know the results for sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这种罕见的情况下，我将继续作为领袖直到确认选举结果。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, what are the results, Mister President?
ESP.TRADUIT: 总统先生，票选结果如何？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me get back to you on this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我再多和你谈谈这事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well, I've waited this long, a bit longer won't make much difference.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，我已经等了很长时间了，再多等一会也没区别。

ESP.ORIGINAL: In the meantime, allow me to get back to my calculations.
ESP.TRADUIT: 同时，请允许我继续我的演算。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there anywhere you can hide?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么可以躲的地方吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, there is the personal shelter next to the old diner.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，有一个圆形遮蔽所就在餐厅旁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pappa always said to stay away from it... but, I guess it's supposed to be safe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 爸爸总是让我离那远点……但我觉得那里面很安全。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll head over there and wait inside. Hurry back!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会躲在那里面。快点回来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bryan Wilks [060307C7] (mod) Quest : ([06014E97]MS04) Those! EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, you think you could get a campfire going here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，你认为你可以在这里架一个营火吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，当然。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, boy. Go do your business and mark this spot so we can find this place again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，小子。 去标记这个地方，这样我们就可以再次找到这个地方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <aroo?>
Go on, do your thing... I want to be able to find this place again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去吧，做你的事......我希望能够再次找到这个地方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <bark> <bark> <bark>
Nevermind, let's remember the last spot instead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没关系，让我们记住最后一点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <bark bark>
Pretty rare piece of equipment, this. Good find.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常稀有的装备。好手段。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How'd you like your payment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要什么回报？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got a Multiplas for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一个多束等离子步枪给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pretty rare piece of equipment, this. Good find.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常稀有的装备。好手段。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How'd you like your payment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要什么回报？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got a Recharger Pistol for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一个充能手枪给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pretty rare piece of equipment, this. Good find.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常稀有的装备。好手段。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How'd you like your payment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要什么回报？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got a Recharger Rifle for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一个充能步枪给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We can always use another one of these.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这类东西对我们来说总是很有用。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How'd you like your payment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要什么回报？

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about a Tri-Beam Laser Rifle?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一个三眼激光步枪给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We can always use another one of these.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这类东西对我们来说总是很有用。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How'd you like your payment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要什么回报？

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about a Laser RCW?
ESP.TRADUIT: 激光汤姆森怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We can always use another one of these.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这类东西对我们来说总是很有用。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How'd you like your payment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要什么回报？

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about a custom Laser Pistol?
ESP.TRADUIT: 激光手枪怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's practically junk, but we can get some use out of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它实际上是垃圾，但我们能变废为宝。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How'd you like your payment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要什么回报？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You might be interested in this Salvaged Power Armor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 您可能对回收的NCR动力装甲感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not much good on its own, but the optics are useful, at least.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不怎么值钱，不过这光纤多少还有点用。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How'd you like your payment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要什么回报？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take this Salvaged Power Armor Helmet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有个回收的动力头盔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'd better believe it. I haven't seen a suit like this in a long time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 信不信，我很久没见过这样的装备了。

ESP.TRADUIT: 那泼妇毁了我的生活。但你是对的，谁会在乎那些呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horace Pinkerton [060156CA] (mod) Quest : ([06014E9B]MS08) The Replicated Man Comment (NAM2) : warning someone but betting his advice will be ignored anyway EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，她除了毁灭我的一生之外，整天就无所事事。不过我看你倒是满不在乎的样子，随你。
